title: Chapter 44 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 44 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter

Volume 3 · Chapter 44

Oh my god!

Who can tell me...

What exactly happened just now?

They brushed past each other, and then... that was it...

A bead of cold sweat trickled down Alice's forehead as she stood frozen in place, completely unable to comprehend what kind of battle had just taken place.

With the naked eye alone, it was impossible to see what was going on! It felt as though the battle had already ended the moment it began.

Alice knitted her beautiful brows and stood between the two of them, not even daring to breathe heavily. A fight on this level was truly not something she could get involved in.

If she actually had to fight Claude, Alice wouldn't even be able to draw her sword before being defeated outright. The gap between them was extraordinary.

All Alice knew now was that the deadly duel between the two had been decided in a single move.

As for who won and who lost? Alice herself wasn't sure. She thought about how Claude had exploded with 100 times his power, while Merlin had always been killing enemies in one hit, his strength unfathomably deep. Without seeing the fight unfold, it was really hard to say.

The air grew extremely oppressive. Merlin and Claude each held their poses, and neither had fallen yet.

Alice nervously swallowed, her heart pounding doki doki doki, ready to see the result—

"Spit!"

Claude was the first to break. He suddenly dropped to his knees, coughing up a mouthful of blood, and his heavy sword clattered to the ground.

Just moments ago, relying on his superhuman perception, he had genuinely foreseen the trajectory of the sword-drawing strike, yet in the end there was still no escaping death. He had been slashed.

Alice breathed a sigh of relief. It looked like Merlin had won. This guy was seriously inhuman. Claude had erupted with 100 times his power and still got instantly killed. Could it really be, as Claude had babbled, that Merlin had long surpassed Saint-tier!? Was that even possible...

Claude felt his life draining away. Using his remaining breath, he gasped, "Wh... why... how were you able to hit me? Clearly I..."

"My apologies..." Merlin didn't even look back as he wiped the filthy blood off his katana. "My sword-drawing strike is faster than perception. By the time you sensed me drawing my blade, you were already dead."

Claude found it utterly inconceivable. He couldn't imagine that a sword-drawing strike could reach such an astonishing level.

He would never know that Merlin was a man who came equipped with 9,999 skill points, and that he had maxed out the sword-drawing strike to an explosive level 9,999!

Claude crashed onto the ground, no longer able to lift his sword. Seeing Merlin's back in his peripheral vision, he fell into a state of existential doubt.

Who exactly is this man? He never expected that in the current era there would exist someone this powerful...

Merlin twirled his katana twice before sheathing it.

Unexpectedly, the barely-living Claude caught a clear look at Banri Garan and his eyes widened in shock—

That... that's one of the Kings' Artifacts of the Seven Demon Kings, right?

Its pitch-black blade radiating demonic energy, there could be no mistake!

Four hundred years ago, I saw that sword. It's the King's proof of the First Demon Lord Palace!

Could this man be Lucifer? The Demon Race's arrogant sovereign...

He remembered that in the era of 400 years ago, Lucifer had been an extraordinarily powerful woman, whose strength dominated all others in the demon race.

So it's a different person now, then. Who knows which reincarnation this one is, but these things have nothing to do with me anymore...

Claude sighed inwardly. Figuring out Merlin's identity before dying was somewhat comforting, at least.

He gave up all hope and, with his last breath, let out a sigh.

"Lucifer... as expected... of the Demon Race's strongest... arrogant sovereign..."

"Hm?!"

Merlin turned his head, as if he'd heard Claude call him by his former name, but on second thought, he must have misheard, right?

He was a famous shut-in among the demon race and had never left the Swamp of Death. There shouldn't be many people who knew him.

Alice stared blankly at Claude, thinking that this guy was actually quite powerful and had the capital to be proud, but he had the misfortune of running into a big pervert like Merlin. Considering that Claude was a remnant of the former kingdom, they would never be allies, so it was actually quite a pity.

Seeing that Alice was spacing out, Merlin strolled over to her casually and snapped his fingers to get her attention.

"So? Are you stunned by my strength? Completely in awe of me..."

"Mmm..." Alice looked depressed. Just seeing Merlin's smug expression annoyed her, so she huffed and said, "It's... it's just so-so. Barely presentable. Nowhere near my teacher! Hmph~!"

"Who's your teacher?" Merlin frowned. He had no idea.

"Have you heard of the Extreme Ice Sword Saint of the Alps?" Alice said confidently. Thinking of her teacher, although he was quite scatterbrained, his strength was extraordinarily powerful, and she admired him greatly.

"No, but I'm sure he couldn't beat me either." Merlin shrugged.

"Narcissist, so disgusting!" Alice turned her head away, strongly repulsed by Merlin's bizarre confidence.

"Hmph, say what you want." Merlin took out the key and examined it closely. This key involved a great treasure that could ensure he'd never worry about food or clothing again. "I've made quite a profit this time. 5,000 gold coins coming in, plus I got this key."

"This key involves remnants of the former kingdom. You can't keep it to yourself. You should hand it over to the kingdom!" Alice said with righteous indignation.

"You silly girl, use your brain a little." Merlin pointed at his own head and continued, "If this key does lead to a treasure, are you really going to naively hand it over to the kingdom?"

"If we don't give it to the kingdom, you want to pocket it all yourself?" Alice knitted her brows.

"That's right! I'm going to pocket it. Handing it over to the kingdom is out of the question..." Merlin waved his hand.

"You..." Alice ground her teeth in anger, thinking Merlin was too greedy. "If you dare to keep it for yourself, I'll report you!"

"Uh..."

Merlin felt a bit uncomfortable. Thinking about it, being reported was really disgusting. Wouldn't there be piles of guards interfering with his peaceful life?

So Merlin thought for a moment. Couldn't he just pull Alice into this too?

"Alice, come, come, let's discuss this."

"What... what for?" Alice was rather wary.

"Since we're old acquaintances, how about we split the treasure between us?" Merlin kept rubbing his hands together, looking like a tiny miser.

"How do you know it's a treasure? I heard Claude say something about gaining power..." Alice said困惑edly.

"Something a Saint-tier person wants so badly—could it be worthless?" Merlin narrowed his eyes.

"Well..." Alice hesitated, not sure what to say.

"Alice, don't be so rigid. My debt is only tens of thousands of gold coins, while yours is tens of millions!" Merlin tried to persuade Alice. "I think if you don't have some miraculous encounter, you'll never be able to pay it off in this lifetime. Do you want to struggle in poverty for the rest of your life?"

"I..." Alice wavered. Merlin had a point. With her miserable work, when on earth would she ever pay off her debt?!

"Do you want to be a slave to debt for your entire life?" Merlin asked again.

"..." Alice fell silent.

"You don't, right!? So here's an opportunity. Let's research this key, go treasure hunting, and strike it rich in one go!" Merlin showed a very greedy expression and continued, "Look, you didn't even exert yourself just now. How about I take 9 and you take 1?"

Alice: "No way!"

Merlin: "I take 8 and you take 2. That's the most I can go. If you push any further, I'll lose my temper!"

Alice: "No way! That's not fair!"

Merlin: "Damn it, I take 7 and you take 3, alright!? If I give any more, I'll cough up blood!"

Alice: "No way. At the very least, 40-60. I take 4, you take 6!"

Merlin: "Deal!"

Merlin agreed to the deal right away. A 45-55 split wasn't unacceptable; he could barely still stomach it.

Alice had a strange expression, feeling like she might have gotten pulled onto Merlin's pirate ship after all.

"The only problem now is figuring out the secret of this key..." Merlin looked at the key, finding it quite ordinary.

"I... I have a friend who is very learned." Alice paused and added, "He's also an adventurer in Lexem. We can go ask him."

"Can we trust him?" Merlin asked in surprise.

Alice was about to answer when mournful wails suddenly echoed from all around.

"Aa wooo wooo wooo..."

"Necromancers?" Merlin raised his eyelids slightly.

"There must have been some that weren't killed cleanly. They followed the scent of the living!" Alice drew her slender sword and entered a combat stance.

"Never mind the key. We'll talk about it when we get back to Lexem. For now, let's figure out how to get out of here." Merlin said lazily.

"I know, no need to tell me!" Alice pouted.

Countless skeletons stormed in, their red eyes flickering in the darkness. They kept wailing incessantly; it looked like there were quite a lot of them!

The two stood back-to-back, one in front and one behind, guarding their surroundings as they prepared to charge out of the cemetery.

Merlin tugged at his glove and said flatly, "Don't hold me back. I won't be taking care of you."

"Who needs your care!? Stop being so full of yourself!" Alice retorted unhappily and channeled her magic power.

The undead lets out a "woooo" and surged forward together, their hunger making them unusually fierce.

Inside the grand hall—

The aura of寒冰 and deadly chill suddenly exploded...

title: Chapter 45
content:
Chapter 45

Volume 3 · Chapter 45

Outside the forest, before the necromancer's death.

The Denby County Investigation Corps and the summoned adventurers had gathered here.

Everyone was fully armed, preparing to face a great battle.

According to the plan, the undead were to be contained within the forest, then multiple priests would cast a Light Barrier to seal it off, and the capital city would send over strong warriors.

The crowd was divided into two factions: the adventurers and the stationed units. Even though they were completely different factions, they had been forcibly arranged together.

But they were easy to tell apart. The adventurers dressed very casually, like rangers.

Meanwhile, the soldiers of the stationed corps wore blue military uniforms, standing perfectly straight at attention.

The vanguard cavalry stood at the very front, the infantry in the middle, and at the rear were all the archers and priests.

Opposite the makeshift army was a dense mass of undead legions that made one's scalp tingle with dread.

Skeleton soldiers wielded weapons, the cold flames in their sockets burning fiercely, their fighting spirit gradually surging.

Hobbs and Arnold, these two big loons, had also buckled on their helmets, skulking about among the crowd.

"Arnold, aren't you a noble? What are you doing joining the fight?" Hobbs looked at Arnold beside him in surprise, noticing this guy had never fought a battle before. His helmet was even askew, looking like a slacker deserter.

"Yesterday many officers said our Austin family is a lineage of outstanding military merit, and they're very much looking forward to my performance today, so what else could I do? I'm absolutely desperate. Surely I can't bring shame to the family, right?" Arnold's face twisted in embarrassment; he nearly wanted to die.

"So it's a case of forcing a duck onto a perch," a bead of cold sweat dripped down Hobbs' forehead. "By the way, your family has such outstanding military merit, how did someone like you turn out?"

"You don't understand. Reincarnation is a technical skill," Arnold said with a completely straight face.

Hobbs was speechless and awkwardly replied, "Forget it, let's stay cowardly at the back. If things go south, we bolt and run, no one will notice."

"No way. As the eldest son of the Austin family, how could I do something like that? I'd be laughed at by everyone." The golden broadsword in Arnold's hand stood out conspicuously among the crowd.

"You nobles really suffer for the sake of appearances. When faced with the threat of death, stop pretending to be so morally upright. Can't you learn to adapt?" Hobbs stared at Arnold, utterly exasperated.

"No way. If Miss Alice finds out I ran away as a deserter, she'll look down on me for the rest of her life." Arnold said seriously.

"Give me a break! You two are already living together, there's no chance for you, just give up already." Hobbs said helplessly.

"But we're not married yet, so there's still a chance, right? As long as I don't stop trying and being shameless, maybe Miss Alice will change her mind and give me a shot again." Arnold refused to give up.

"What if she changes her mind only because she's pregnant?" Hobbs asked in astonishment.

"I'll support it. The kid can even take the Lucifer surname, I'll take this盘的. I'll handle it!" A faint green hue rose above Arnold's head.

"Arnold, you son of a bitch, you really are a talent!" Hobbs made a strange expression and patted Arnold on the shoulder. "You should go to the hair salon and dye your hair green, it really suits you~"

"Really?" Arnold scratched his hair, thinking whether green was a bit too alternative.

"By the way, Alice and that newcomer have been gone for so long and haven't returned yet. I wonder how they're doing?" Hobbs brought up something he was more worried about.

"Don't worry, Mr. Claude is very strong. Alice's safety should be no problem." Arnold said confidently, then remembered someone else. "The one who should be worried is Merlin. A Black Iron adventurer with neither aura nor magic power, wouldn't running into undead be seeking death? Although he's my rival, it's kind of a pity if he'd die so simply. There aren't many people who can be my match, Merlin barely qualifies..."

"Nothing bad will happen to him. Merlin is too sharp to just keel over. If there's any danger, this guy would absolutely be the fastest runner." Hobbs paused, then said in an uneasy tone, "We should be worrying about ourselves right now. When things go sideways, I'm bugging out. You, the silly son of a rich landlord, can keep striving here for the sake of noble spirit."

"Don't, Hobbs. We're sort of friends, and now that Miss Alice and Mr. Claude aren't by my side, I can only rely on you." Arnold shamelessly moved closer to Hobbs.

"What the hell! Don't come near me! We're fair-weather buddies at best, both piece-of-shit Black Irons. I can barely take care of myself, why should I have time to worry about you?" Hobbs rejected him and distanced himself from Arnold, this dead weight.

"Hobbs, I remember you often go to Helena's Secret Cabin for entertainment. I heard you racked up quite a few tabs on credit," Arnold flicked his hair, saying it somewhat deliberately. "You know me, I have no other merits, I'm just loaded."

"What the hell! Arnold, you're looking down on me too much. We're good brothers. I may lack other strengths, but I'm loyal. I'd cut two ribs for a friend, and cut my bro two knives for a woman. Leave it to me, bro, no problem~" Hobbs patted his chest, his attitude doing a complete 180-degree turnaround.

A horn blared suddenly, and the undead legions surged forward——

The formation of adventurers and soldiers entered combat readiness.

"Oh shit, they're coming, they're coming! Run!" Hobbs turned tail and fled.

"Huh?! But that's not what you just said!" Arnold grabbed Hobbs tightly.

"What time is this to still be standing around? Are you dumb!" Hobbs frowned deeply.

The skeleton knights, serving as the vanguard, charged straight at them, the气息 of death pressing forward.

The most forward troops immediately grew flustered. As expected, a hastily assembled force had absolutely no coordination.

The skeleton knights raised their lances, riding undead warhorses, and thrust directly at them!

"AAAAAAAAAAAAA!"

"We're gonna die, we're gonna die, we're gonna die, we're gonna die, we're gonna die!"

Hobbs and Arnold clung to each other, screaming in terror, their faces pale as death.

Just as the great battle was about to break out, the situation suddenly changed——

The massive undead legion instantly turned to dust and vanished entirely!?

Countless particles of dust spread across the field, rising into the sky, as if those undead had been nothing more than a nightmare.

"Ummmmmm..."

Hobbs and Arnold stared blankly, completely unable to comprehend the current situation. The undead legion had been so ferocious just moments ago, so how had it suddenly turned to dust and disappeared? What had happened?

It wasn't just Hobbs and Arnold; everyone present was stunned, having no idea what had occurred. They had all expected to fight to the death, yet nothing had happened at all.

In truth, everyone present had been saved by Merlin. These undead had been summoned by the necromancer.

When Merlin had killed the necromancer on the third floor of the graveyard, this group of undead had lost their source of magical support and thus vanished instantly.

It seemed Merlin had muddled his way through resolving Denby County's crisis, while everyone remained completely unaware.

Hobbs: "Although I don't know what's going on, it seems like we're..."

Arnold: "Looks like it, so next we should..."

Their momentum suddenly picked up, both assuming very serious expressions——

Hobbs: "As expected of the guild's strongest adventurer, truly insanely powerful!"

Arnold: "As the eldest son of the Austin family, asking me to crusade against the undead is truly using a cannon to kill a mosquito, hmph!"

title: Chapter 46 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 46 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter

Volume 3 · Chapter 46

After the turmoil.
This commission has ended.
The garrison troops investigated the cemetery in depth, and combined with Alice's report, they already knew that the remnants of the former kingdom were still active in the shadows.
This important information was reported overnight by the garrison troops to the capital, and the surging undercurrent finally surfaced, letting the public know.
As for the biggest contributor this time, it wasn't Merlin, but Alice.
Even though Merlin worked that hard, he only got the minimum living allowance, while the 5000 gold coin reward went to Alice.
Although Merlin killed two bosses, he himself was just an iron-rank adventurer, plus an ordinary person without magic or battle aura.
So even if Alice had no intention of stealing Merlin's credit, no one believed Merlin played a key role in the incident; they thought he was just a leecher who went into the cemetery to mooch some experience.
Although Merlin was a bit disappointed, he didn't mind much, because he had obtained the key and felt that the day of getting the treasure and making a comeback was not far away; thinking about it made him a little excited~.
As the biggest winner of this incident, Alice gained both fame and fortune: not only did she become a celebrity in Dengbi County, but as the hero who resolved the crisis she rightfully earned the 5000 gold coins, so she no longer has to worry about this month's living expenses.
Although taking Merlin's credit was a bit unscrupulous, seeing Merlin's embarrassed look made Alice secretly pleased.
Thinking about how Merlin usually bullies her, now he's pulling a long face, looking displeased—it's also a case of evildoers meeting their due.
In fact, Alice upholds an honest character and does not want to take Merlin's credit. J5 T
When explaining to the garrison troops, Alice truthfully recounted all the details and the process.
Even Merlin's one‑hit kill of two Saint‑tier experts, she described vividly.
But even if Alice exhausted her words explaining, the garrison troops simply didn't believe her!
Because Alice said the necromancer and Claude were very powerful, while Merlin was just a weakling iron‑rank adventurer without magic or battle aura—how could he possibly one‑hit a Saint‑tier? Everything seemed utterly implausible.
In the end, the garrison troops thought Alice had gone a bit mentally unstable after the fight, so they sent her away and gave themselves a more reasonable official explanation—
The necromancer and Claude fought to the death, both badly injured and on the brink, when Alice dealt the finishing blow; Merlin? just watched from the sidelines, leeching.
Alice found this official explanation helpless; even if the necromancer and Claude were seriously wounded, she herself could not possibly defeat them—these two were genuine Saint‑tier powerhouses, not some goblin emperor knockoff.
Later, Alice also grew tired of explaining, fearing she'd be mistaken for a lunatic and sent to a mental institution.
After Merlin found out, although he was a bit displeased, he didn't mind, his body and mind immersed in the daydream of soon obtaining the treasure with the key.
FA
London Mail reporter Bella headed to Dengbi County right at the start of the incident.
When she arrived, all the fighting was already over, and she didn't get any first‑hand news.
Between say
So Bella had no choice but to interview the parties involved in the Dengbi County crisis.
“Good evening, viewers, I'm Bella from the London Mail. Not long ago, Dengbi County saw a surge of undead creatures, but thanks to the joint efforts of the Wiltshire adventurers and the Dengbi County garrison, the incident was resolved. However, beneath this surface lies an astonishing secret: the remnants of the former kingdom continue to operate in the shadows of Great Britain. Now let's go on‑site and interview those who personally experienced this event.”
Bella held the microphone, with a batch of camera crew behind her.
“Hello sir, could you please describe the situation at that time?”
“Yo? Interviewing me? Sure, sure, hic~” Hobbes, holding a wine bottle, his red nose glowing, turned over and said with a hiccup, “I’m Hobbes, gender male, like women, 36 years old, hahahahaha hic~”
“Okay, thank you sir, next—” Bella covered her nose and walked over to Claude, “Sir, could you please explain the whole story?”
“Ah~, why am I so handsome? As the eldest son of the Austen family, I was born with a huge handsome face, bearing pressure that peers my age don’t have. To this day, because of my face, I’ve knocked out seven maids; my mother faints at the sight of my face, overwhelmed by my handsomeness. Can you understand my feelings? Handsomeness is my original sin.” Arnold flared up again, waving his arms and legs in front of the reporter.
“Thanks, goodbye.” Bella got goosebumps and hurried away, seeing Merlin and Alice walking toward her, so she went up to meet them.
The two had just returned from the garrison troops, preparing to leave by vehicle from Dengbi County back to Wrexham.
“Hello, could you two give a detailed rundown of what happened?” Bella handed over the microphone.
“Hehe, ask her, the big contributor of Dengbi County, Merlin beside her was sour‑mouthed saying.”
“Tsk! What tone is that?” Alice rolled her eyes.
“So you’re Miss Alice? Before coming, Xin said you dealt the finishing blow to two Saint‑tier experts; now as the hero of Dengbi County, how do you feel?” Bella pressed on.
“Just a normal mindset, nothing special.” Alice said, feeling pressured, and it wasn’t really her doing.
“Putting on airs invisibly is the deadliest!” Merlin muttered sarcastically from the side.
“Are you done yet? I’ve been speaking up for you, it’s all your credit—if they don’t believe it, blame me? I almost got labeled a lunatic!” Alice stomped her feet in anger; she understood Merlin felt unbalanced, but it wasn’t her trying to take credit.
“Then—then, Miss Alice, when you dealt the finishing blow to those two Saint‑tier experts, did you feel any psychological pressure?” Bella continued pressing.
“I’m telling the truth, it wasn’t me! Don’t bother me anymore!” Alice couldn’t take it; she could no longer explain clearly.
“What she means is, not only those two Saint‑tiers, but all Saint‑tiers in Great Britain are trash.” Merlin muttered again from the side.
“What the hell do you want?!” Alice grabbed Merlin’s collar, gnashing her teeth, “I never meant to steal your credit—how many times do I have to explain before you believe me?!”
“Cut it out, half of your reward is mine.” Merlin said bluntly; Alice had become the biggest winner, leaving him feeling awful in body and mind.
“Dream on!” Alice’s face flushed with anger, thinking this jerk actually had his eye on her property! ?
Bella smelled a juicy scoop, turned to the camera and started making up nonsense—
“Viewers, have you seen this? This dog‑couple, due to a dispute over profit distribution, are now fighting in private, making one suspect the Dengbi County undead incident—was someone plotting it? Their aim is to swindle a lot of money from the garrison troops; the loopholes in Great Britain’s system must draw official high attention, lest more people like this dog‑couple continue to defraud taxpayers’ hard‑earned money. Behind all this, is it a distortion of human nature or a collapse of morality?”
The two dubbed a dog‑couple stared expressionlessly at the unscrupulous reporter—
Merlin: “Is her brain sick?”
Alice: “f is a neural camp”

title: Chapter 47 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 47 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 3 · Chapter 47

Night.

The way back.

The moon finally rose into the cold, desolate sky, a dazzling expanse of crystal light.

The wind had long since died down. Dead grass roots stood upright one after another, like copper wires.

On both sides of the path, near and far, there were only fields marked with the signs of autumn.

Behind Arnold's magnificent carriage trailed a small donkey cart.

Everything had already been explained, and everyone boarded the carriage returning to Rexem.

Since they were heading back to headquarters, Merlin and Hobbs no longer needed to ride in that shabby little donkey cart; they could join Arnold and experience a taste of luxury.

Arnold hadn't refused. He seemed quite pleased — Merlin's willingness to climb up proved he possessed something Arnold envied.

Inside the carriage.

Alice sat on one side with a sour face.

As for Merlin, Hobbs, and Claude, they sat across from her.

From the moment they got in, those three trash Black Iron adventurers huddled together, giggling nonstop.

The three of them were like a pack of shameless buddies, chatting recklessly without any restraint.

It made Alice extremely awkward, since she simply couldn't fit in at all.

What was even harder to understand was Merlin and Arnold. Logically, the two of them were rivals for Alice's affections.

Yet right now, there was absolutely no sign of them arguing until their faces turned red and necks swollen, or coming to blows.

This made Alice deeply suspect that Arnold might be a fake suitor.

What made Alice most uncomfortable was that bastard Hobbs. Once the alcohol hit him, he started spouting crude jokes nonstop.

Please! Have some class, okay? There's a lady right here!

Alice fumed inside, but she couldn't find a way to insert herself into the conversation.

Merlin's mood was the complete opposite — he was extremely happy. He thought Arnold's carriage was wonderful, so comfortable to sit in. Thinking that Alice had been enduring the journey all this way while he got to enjoy himself made him feel a bit unbalanced.

Arnold felt a bit dizzy. He swirled his wine glass and said, "I really didn't expect Claude to be a necromancer — one of the Four Heroes of the Kingdom from four hundred years ago. Telling the Guildmaster about this will definitely shock him."

"Yeah, the former kingdom's forces from four hundred years ago haven't been completely wiped out. This might even stir up the queen herself, and the mysterious Begonia Knight Order might start investigating too, right?" Hobbs took a sip of wine.

"The Begonia Knight Order?" Merlin said he'd never even heard of them.

"You've never heard of the Begonia Knight Order, Merlin?" Arnold asked in surprise.

"No, who are they?" Merlin frowned.

"They're the royal family's personal guard knight order. Extremely mysterious — no one knows who they are. They only take orders from the queen. I've heard they're composed of twelve Saint-tier experts, known as the Thorny Twelve Holy Knights. Their commander is incredibly formidable — they call him the strongest among Saint-tier!" Arnold said enthusiastically.

"Oh~" Merlin nodded. "I think I remember now. Isn't that guy who brags about being the strongest? Unaware that the legendary Spear Hero has already surpassed Saint-tier. Too bad he's gone missing."

"If the Begonia Knight Order is mobilized, the former kingdom's remaining forces would be wiped out pretty quickly, right?" Hobbs stroked his chin.

"Naturally. I've heard each of the Thorny Twelve Knights can rival an entire army. Very strong!" Arnold seemed to hold the Begonia Knights in high regard.

"That's true," Hobbs agreed, nodding.

"I just never expected that Mr. Claude would actually be a former kingdom undead, operating right beside me. It gives me the creeps." Arnold said with a pale face.

"This is quite common. Adventurers don't ask about the past, and guys who shock you will turn up from time to time," Hobbs said, shaking his head.

"I'm also someone who surprises you. I used to be the Great Demon Lord of the First Hall. How about that? Scared yet?" Merlin grinned crookedly.

"Alright, Merlin's had too much to drink and is bragging again," Hobbs said, patting Merlin's shoulder, not believing a word.

"Hehehe" Merlin laughed and懒得 to explain. He was fully accustomed to this by now.

In ordinary people's eyes, the Seven Lords of the Demon Race were like beings from another dimension, each with their own legends. It was said they were powerful enough to drive humanity to despair.

For example, Lucifer III — Hobbs had heard of this guy. He was a man even Hell feared, and he'd personally beheaded a Hell apostle.

But these were all just legends. Hobbs had only heard them secondhand, and it was impossible to confirm what was true.

"But the demon race does feel a bit terrifying," Hobbs said exaggeratedly. "The seven Demon Lord Palaces are all very close to human nations. If they ever attack, I wonder if we could stop them — especially Lucifer, who keeps repelling the Holy Church's Crusade Army. I've heard he's ridiculously powerful!"

"Hmph." Alice sneered coldly and glanced at Merlin.

"Who told you that the demon race would invade human territory?" Merlin frowned.

"The Holy Church," Hobbs said matter-of-factly.

"The Holy Church?" Merlin spat. "The demon race believes in the doctrine of 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.' If you don't provoke them, they'll never invade others. Think about it — hasn't it always been the Holy Church organizing crusades? When have the demons ever organized an army to crusade against humanity?"

"Well, that's true," Hobbs nodded, pondering it himself.

"So that bunch of religious quacks at the Holy Church just fan the flames, right? Don't you think so, Alice?" Merlin then turned to ask Alice. After all, she was a former Hero — she must know what was going on.

"Hmph! I don't know anything!" Alice turned her head away, unwilling to answer.

"By the way, I've always been confused — why don't the demons migrate to the Southern United Kingdom like other non-human races? That's where non-human species gather. Why do they insist on guarding the territory around the seven Demon Lord Palaces?" Hobbs asked with interest.

"You've read too few books. World evolution is divided into four epochs: the First Epoch of the Gods, the Second Epoch of the Elves, the Third Epoch of the Demons, and the Fourth Epoch — which is the current Human Era." Merlin paused, then continued. "When the Human Era arrived, the Elf King lobbied all races except humans to migrate south and form new kingdoms. But the demons refused, because the Elf King meant nothing to them — he was just a fart in their eyes!"

Alice narrowed her eyes. She thought Merlin's knowledge was quite rich. She'd always assumed he was a simple-minded, brute-forced sort of guy.

"That arrogant?" Hobbs's eyes widened.

"I wouldn't call it arrogance. The demon race is a particularly independent species. They submit to no faction and cooperate with no faction." Merlin explained coolly, then whispered mysteriously. "But the main reason is that beneath each of the seven Demon Lord Palaces lies a great secret. They cannot leave."

"What secret?" Hobbs became interested.

"I can't say." Merlin replied with a half-smile.

"Pretending to be mysterious~" Hobbs patted Merlin's shoulder. "But you know a lot about the demon race, huh?"

"Of course I do. I'm the Demon Lord of Pride among the seven demon lords, after all." Merlin said matter-of-factly.

"Hahaha. As fellow Black Iron adventurers, I have to admire your ability to brag. You make it sound so real." Hobbs said with a chuckle.

"Let's not chat about useless stuff — I have something to say!" Arnold stood up unsteadily. He seemed a bit drunk. "In this duel for Miss Alice's companionship rights, clearly neither you nor I, Merlin, have won. But I won't give up. Best two out of three — let's continue next time!"

"Oh." Merlin sighed. He thought Alice had nothing to do with him. When would this silly rich kid figure it out?

"Get lost! Do you want to die, Arnold?!" Alice ground her teeth in anger, wanting to chop up the babbling Arnold to pieces.

Merlin grinned crookedly, but his expression suddenly froze. He remembered something he'd forgotten. It seemed pretty important...

Holy crap! He remembered it — that noble young lady! He had promised to go back and rescue her.

Never mind, whatever. Ohohohoho~

Underground Labyrinth, Second Floor.

Cecilia held the unconscious Kael and was pitifully dangling from a long spear hooked onto the rock wall.

In the darkness, many undead gathered below. Umbra's eyes were fixed on Cecilia, but the distance was too great — they simply couldn't reach her.

Cecilia trembled, looking around in all directions searching for Merlin's silhouette —

"Where is he?"

"Why hasn't he come to save us yet?"

"Weren't we supposed to meet up? Hey~ whimper whimper~"

title: Chapter 48
content:
Chapter 48

Volume 3 · Chapter 48

The Scottish Borders.

On a certain active volcano.

This was the former site of the Kingdom Temple.

After 400 years of history and upheaval, it had become dilapidated beyond recognition.

Yet some towering pillars and solemn temple structures still retained the faint echoes of their former splendor from four centuries ago.

The temple was built atop the volcano, with molten lava churning beneath. Disobedient heretics were often sent here to be executed.

After the former kingdom fell, the place had long been abandoned. But now it served as headquarters for the remnants of that fallen kingdom.

Using the method of drinking elf blood to sustain life, the former kingdom's Crown Prince Copeland had survived an astounding four hundred years. He now secretly resided here, poring over the former kingdom's legal code and attempting to unravel the secrets of hell, seeking to summon the devastating Hellfire Legion from the underworld to assist in restoring his dynasty.

Half a year ago, Copeland had learned the forbidden art of summoning souls from hell within the code. As long as bones remained, the dead could be resurrected and regain their peak strength at the time of death. But the ritual could only revive someone once.

Thus, he had located the bones of the former kingdom's Four Heroes, resurrecting them through the forbidden art and making them his key ministers in the restoration cause.

According to the former kingdom's code, in addition to a vast ritual magic array, four keys were needed to open the gateway between the mortal world and hell.

By now, the ritual array had been laid out long ago, three of the four keys had been secured. Only Bernold (Claude)'s key remained missing.

Only when all four keys were assembled would the gates of hell swing wide open, summoning the Hellfire Legion to help Copeland crush the Britannia Dynasty and rebuild the former kingdom.

Copeland had already negotiated with hell's apostles and signed a contract with Satan himself. As long as he helped restore the former kingdom, he would become hell's representative on earth, faithfully serving its lord, Satan.

But just as everything was in place and only one thing remained, something seemed to have gone wrong with Bernold...

The deep and dark temple held only the flickering light of torches.

In the center of the temple, a massive magic array had been painted with an unknown dye. At its center lay a strange stone slab entangled with countless interwoven arms.

Three red keys were already inserted into the slab; only one keyhole remained empty.

Not long before, Carona, the Dragon-Taming Thief who had made a public appearance, knelt respectfully on one knee below. Her purple hair partially covered her face, and her long, striking legs beneath her skirt drew every eye, her entire presence radiating a seductive aura.

Beside her, two similarly dressed figures knelt on one knee as well — one wearing a smiling mask and the other a crying mask. They were obviously the legendary Twin Sword Saints, the brothers Zoi and Joy.

Upon the raised dais, a cloaked figure in black robes and holding a magic staff, hunched over with their back to the three heroes of the former kingdom. That must have been His Majesty Copeland, as they called him.

The atmosphere inside the temple was somewhat oppressive, and Copeland's aged silhouette made no one dare speak freely.

"Bernold's soul fire has gone out. It seems he has already been killed."

"Your Majesty, do not grieve. Bernold died for the restoration of the former kingdom," Carona responded calmly from below. "That is a worthy death."

"I am not grieving. It is simply that that fool Bernold failed to bring back the key even in death!!!" Copeland's body seemed to be in poor condition, and after speaking he couldn't help but begin coughing. "Cough, cough, cough..."

"Calm yourself, Your Majesty. Your health is what matters most." Carona said respectfully.

"Bernold was merely a stupid warrior. Aside from brute strength, there was nothing about him worth respecting." Zoi, the older brother wearing the smiling mask, spoke with sarcastic sneer.

"You speak the truth, brother," Zoi's younger brother Joy, wearing the crying mask, agreed.

"Regardless, Bernold was an excellent warrior and the foremost among our Four Heroes. You shouldn't speak ill of him like that," Carona said coolly.

"The foremost among the Four Heroes? How laughable. Neither my brother nor I have ever acknowledged that. If we fought him seriously, my brother and I are confident we could defeat Bernold in three rounds," Zoi jeered.

"Brother speaks the truth." Joy echoed.

"Heh, what bold words. Even if Bernold was a simple-minded brute, his loyalty is beyond question and deserves our respect." Carona narrowed her eyes, her tone gradually turning cold. Although she herself was confident she could defeat Bernold, she would not be so blatantly aggressive as the Twin Sword Saints.

"A useless wretch who couldn't even retrieve a key — what good is loyalty? He's worse than a dog~" Zoi's remarks grew increasingly sharp.

"Brother speaks the truth." Joy agreed numbly, as though a puppet.

"Your insulting words make me very uncomfortable."

Carona's eyes revealed a hint of hostility.

"Stop arguing." Crown Prince Copeland rasped.

Below, Carona and the twin brothers fell silent, their quarrel ended.

"Carona, I asked you to investigate the cause of Bernold's death. How does your investigation stand?" Copeland asked in a low voice.

"I saw in the newspaper that Bernold fought the Necromancer Chancellor to a stalemate, and then an adventurer named Alice finished him off," Carona answered very respectfully.

"What? Could such an absurd thing really have happened?" Copeland was slightly astonished.

"The details are still unclear, but this is official information, so it should be credible," Carona replied respectfully.

Copeland felt that whether Bernold lived or died was unimportant; what mattered were the keys. "Then where are the keys? Have you found no leads at all?"

"Since Bernold was finishing blow by an adventurer from Lecxem, I surmise..." Carona paused, and said very seriously.

"The keys likely fell into the hands of someone named Alice."

Copeland fell into silence, while his three heroic subordinates waited for further orders.

The keys were the most crucial asset — they absolutely must not be lost.

The Britannia Dynasty had already noticed them, and soon someone would come to crusade against them. The situation had grown extremely urgent.

After weighing every possibility, Copeland decided to split up and act.

"Our secret has already been discovered by the royal capital. I estimate that within a short time, someone will come to crusade against us. Fortunately, with the three of you heroes present, we should be safe in the short term. However, the summoning of the Hellfire Legion is an urgent matter. If we do not speed up our progress, we will all be killed here by the knights of Great Britain."

"What is Your Majesty's intention?" Carona asked tentatively.

"Zoi and Joy, remain behind to guard the temple and prevent small enemy forces from attacking." Copeland said calmly.

"Yes, my lord." Zoi lowered his head humbly.

"Brother speaks the truth." Joy bowed his head in agreement.

"As for you, Carona..." Copeland turned his gaze toward Carona and ordered, "Go immediately to Lecxem. Use any means necessary to夺回 the key from this adventurer named Alice."

"Yes!" Carona placed her hand over her heart and swore earnestly.

"I will definitely recover the key that is vital to our great restoration!"

"Those who take what belongs to us shall pay in blood!"

title: Chapter 1 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Pass Subscribers
content:
Chapter 1 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Pass Subscribers

Volume 4 · Chapter 1

Rexem.

Two days passed.

The group returned here.

Together they went back to the Guild.

After completing each request, they needed to come back here to register before receiving their payment.

"Alice, welcome back~" Lucia greeted them warmly.

"Finally back. That trip was incredibly annoying with those idiots along," Alice said, looking exhausted as she slumped in front of the counter.

"She means the other two, not me." Merlin also leaned in. Why wouldn't he be enthusiastic about getting paid?

Hobbs and Arnold collapsed onto the table the moment they arrived, pretending to be dead. Two days of bumpy carriage rides were truly exhausting.

Alice rolled her eyes, thinking to herself that Merlin was a scoundrel with thick skin.

"Ne ne Alice, I heard you were quite active in Derbyshire, it even made the newspaper." Lucia smiled as she said that.

This... A cold sweat dripped from Alice's forehead. She thought it had nothing to do with her at all, yet she somehow became a celebrity.

"Isn't that right? Super awesome, the completion-strike maniac Alice~" Merlin said mockingly from the side, his face full of sarcasm.

"Will you ever stop?! " Alice glared fiercely at Merlin.

"What's with the hostility? You're flat as a washboard but still got a huge temper?" Merlin rested his face on his hand, continuing to provoke Alice.

"Stop arguing, you're already a married couple, why not just be considerate of each other?" Lucia smiled awkwardly.

"Who's married to this guy?! " Alice quickly retorted, her emotions flaring up.

"I... I have to argue about it... " Merlin said helplessly, feeling that he was truly cursed. Everyone in the world seemed to misunderstand him as being married.

"I get it, I get it~" Lucia struck a knowing expression. She thought Alice had already been conquered by Merlin's big banana, so what was she acting tsundere for? They were only one step away from having a wedding ceremony at the church.

Merlin and Alice both wore expressionless faces. From their perspective, Lucia didn't look like she understood anything at all.

"But Alice is only slightly famous now, while I'm often featured in fashion magazines. I have so many fans I can't even count them. The other day a fan even mailed me chocolate from Ireland, pfft~" Lucia couldn't help showing off to Alice.

Merlin wore an expressionless face and thought: She's such a schemer, right? Yes, that's right!

Alice's delicate brows twitched. Angry, she thought: What's there to show off about? Being popular with fans is so what? You just wear less clothes and sell yourself every chance you get. I'm not incapable of doing that, I just choose not to!

Guild Master Old Taylor leaned on his cane behind them, resting his eyes. Looking at Merlin and Alice, his mind was as clear as a mirror.

Regarding Alice becoming a hero of Derbyshire and the news that she completed-strike two Saint-tier experts, he personally did not believe it.

Because even if Saint-tier experts fought each other to mutual destruction, they wouldn't easily be killed by Alice, a single high-tier adventurer.

Old Taylor thought carefully and knew what must have happened. It was certainly Merlin who did it.

But since Merlin had no magic power or battle energy, no one would believe he defeated Saint-tier experts.

Only Old Taylor, who had seen a fraction of Merlin's strength, understood clearly in his heart. But he chose to see through it without saying it.

His Guild having a strong person was certainly something Old Taylor was happy about, but the fact that he had no magic or battle energy was regrettable. If he went around bragging, no one would believe him.

Alice suddenly remembered Claude and quickly asked, "Guild Master, do you know about the Claude situation?"

"Hmm, this old man has already heard. The Denmark Headquarters has cancelled the adventurer qualifications. They are assisting the Royal Capital in investigating remnants of the former kingdom. I heard the Royal Capital will be sending the Bauhinia Knight Order down to investigate recently." Old Taylor said in his aged voice, his expression somewhat serious. One of the Four Heroes of the former kingdom actually worked as an adventurer in their guild? This was not a small matter. He himself would have to undergo investigation by the Bauhinia Knights.

"Yes..." Alice nodded, thinking it seemed she didn't need to worry about it anymore. The Guild Master had already handled everything.

"It's surprising that a hero of the former kingdom would come to our guild to be an adventurer. Fortunately, no major problems appeared." Old Taylor said very seriously.

"Please, can we get paid quickly?" Merlin looked utterly uninterested in these matters. He only cared about his money.

"Patience." Lucia turned around and organized some files, then took out a money bag from under the counter. "A total of 6000 gold coins were earned from the requests. After deducting 70% for your own debt repayment, the actual amount received is 1800 gold coins. Please take good care of it."

Alice took the money bag. She had a clear idea in her heart. Although she earned a lot each time, the actual amount after repaying debts was quite small. After resolving rent and various other expenses, her life was still tight. But this time something felt strange.

"Lucia, did you miscalculate? It feels like there's more money than usual."

"I think you're making things difficult for your gold-medal accountant. How could I possibly miscalculate? This is the money the two of you earned together." Lucia said helplessly.

"Eh?! " Alice was stunned, her brain short-circuiting for a moment.

"Wait!" Merlin seemingly understood something in an instant. Something felt very wrong. "What... the money the two of us earned together?"

"The debts of the two of you have been merged..." Lucia explained calmly.

"What?! " Alice's eyes widened, falling into a state of confusion.

"Merged?! " Merlin felt like everything was going wrong. "What's going on?! "

"Mr. Merlin, please calm down first. Aren't you and Alice a married couple? Of course a married couple shares debt repayment. So your debts were directly merged. Is there any problem?" Lucia furrowed her delicate brows, speaking with righteousness.

"We are not married! ! ! " Merlin and Alice said in unison.

"Uh! " Lucia was stunned, then suddenly smiled. "Stop being so standoffish. Admitting it won't kill you? Everyone has some sense in their hearts..."

"If we're married, may lightning strike us right now! ! " Merlin and Alice shouted.

Outside, the sky was clear, but rumbling heavenly thunder began to roll. Thunderous cracks echoed loudly and fiercely.

Continuous thunder in a clear sky! It was utterly incomprehensible. The adventurers in the guild all began to tremble in fear.

"Merlin."

"Alice."

Lucia seemed to snap out of it and felt something was wrong. "...Not really married? Could it just be that you're cohabiting?"

"We've only lived together for one day! ! ! " The expressions on Merlin and Alice's faces were utterly exasperated.

"T-this... " Lucia was somewhat embarrassed and could only wave her hands repeatedly, honestly saying, "Grandpa himself changed your information. It has nothing to do with me! In the Denmark Headquarters files now, your relationship is recorded as husband and wife, and all property and debts are fully merged."

"Hey! What's going on? " Merlin felt like the end of the world had come.

"Guild Master?! " Alice's face was full of astonishment.

"Cough, sorry. This old man assumed you two were already married. It seems from the looks of it that this old man misunderstood." A waterfall-like cold sweat dripped from Old Taylor's forehead as he turned and ran, showing zero resemblance to an elderly man.

"Excuse me, this old man needs to go to the restroom now. Let's talk another time..."

title: Chapter 2 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Votes
content:
Chapter 2 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Votes

Volume 4 · Chapter 2

Merlin and Alice stood frozen in place, disheveled in the cold wind.

Why?

Why did it turn into a couple?!

They didn't know what happened, it just happened suddenly, and now they're married...

Merlin and Alice both thought to themselves, feeling everything was so sci-fi.

Even though they're not really married, it won't affect their daily lives.

But in the adventurer circles, their marriage is already official!

In the future, people will look at them with strange eyes, thinking they're a couple of adventurers.

"No!!!" Arnold felt his head was about to explode, dropping to his knees and screaming, "Alice! Alice, why did this happen?! It's me, me first! I sent flowers, confessed my love, and chased after Alice! Why did this happen...!"

"Arnold, you still have a chance. Merlin and Alice haven't registered their marriage at the British civil registry, so they're not really married. They're just a couple in name only," Hobbes said, sipping his drink.

"But that's not good enough!" Arnold cried, tearing at his handkerchief, "I'm so jealous! ! !"

"Jealousy won't solve the problem..." Hobbes said awkwardly.

"If this continues, everyone will think Alice is a married woman! There's no way to explain it!" Arnold cried, feeling his love's starting line had been cruelly moved back 100 meters. It's so unfair, and there are always bystanders who give Merlin an unfair advantage in the 3-day SE3 novel.

Hobbes chewed his lips and said to Merlin and Alice, "Congratulations, congratulations, aren't you two happy now?"

In fact, contrary to many observers' expectations, Merlin and Alice were not happy at all, but rather very upset and frustrated.

"Lucy, can this marriage be changed? It's too unfair!" Merlin couldn't take it anymore and quickly asked.

"Yes, Lucy! I also feel it's unfair! I don't want to be in a marriage with him!" Alice added, looking urgent.

"It can be changed, but you need to show your divorce certificate..." Lucy smiled awkwardly.

"We never got married, where would we get a divorce certificate?!" Merlin looked very desperate.

"The problem is that without a divorce certificate, we can't change it," Lucy said after a pause. "But you can get married first, then divorce, and that will give you a divorce certificate. The couple adventurer relationship will also be canceled."

"Who wants to marry such a guy? Let me die!" Alice looked at Merlin, her face full of disgust.

"I'm not the one who wants to marry you! You're the one who's disgusted with me!" Merlin frowned.

"Ha?!" Alice was furious, pointing at Merlin's nose, "What's wrong with me being disgusted with you? You're such a lazy, lecherous..."

"What?!" Merlin narrowed his eyes, pointing at Alice's breasts, "You're such a bra, always wearing a bra, what's wrong with me being disgusted with you?"

They seemed to be starting a fight in the guild, arguing loudly and turning red.

Lucy felt like she had done a great job, apparently tricking Merlin and Alice.

"Cough cough!"

Lucy lightly coughed to hide her embarrassment and took two new adventurer certificates from under the counter.

"These are the new couple adventurer certificates sent from the headquarters yesterday. The ones you have on your necks are no longer valid. These are..."

Merlin's new black-iron adventurer certificate:

Region: Lexum.

Name: Merlin Lucifiel.

Wife: Alice Claudia.

Occupation: Just a villager with no magic or qi. By the way, my wife is more powerful, she's a housewife, eating soft food.

Alice's new gold adventurer certificate:

Region: Lexum.

Name: Alice Claudia.

Occupation: Swordswoman.

Husband: Merlin Lucifiel.

They looked at their new couple adventurer certificates and fell into deep thought, neither saying anything.

Merlin thought to himself without expression, "What the hell is this?! There's a wife introduction?! We're not married! What's with the occupation description?! I can tolerate being called a villager, but being called a housewife is unacceptable! Whoever says this, dare to stand up, I promise not to kill you!"

Alice's face turned pale, thinking, "Oh my God! There's a husband introduction now, and everyone will see that I'm married to Merlin! This is unbearable, God, please save me, don't continue to torment me..."

"Congratulations to both of you, you are the 201246th couple of adventurers in the guild. Congratulations, and on Valentine's Day, couple adventurers will have discounts at entertainment venues."

Lucy smiled politely, thinking that since the marriage can't be changed, she might as well match them up, so her grandfather won't have any blame.

"What are you congratulating me for?! ?" Alice looked a bit sad, almost crying, "I haven't done anything wrong, but I've accumulated tens of thousands of gold coins in debt. How can I pay it off? I've been paying it off, but now it's back to square one. Why is this happening to me?"

"Well..." Merlin looked hopeless and bitterly laughed, "Never mind! Now, with the combined debt, everything is on my head, I'm really at a loss! ! !"

Alice listened and realized it was true. She had already accumulated a huge debt, and it was very possible that she would never be able to pay it off in her lifetime. Now, adding tens of thousands of gold coins is nothing! It's just a light rain! ! !

On the other hand, Merlin had only a few thousand in debt, which he could pay off quickly. Now, with the combined debt, millions of gold coins were pressed on his head, and he was the one who was at a disadvantage!

Alice felt that she had dragged the devil Merlin down with her, and had badly tricked Merlin, and it was a bitter sweet feeling, and she felt a great sense of satisfaction!

Originally, Alice had been very annoyed with Merlin, and she didn't like him at all. If it weren't for him robbing her, she would have had a much better life now.

But today, Alice finally got her revenge, and seeing Merlin's miserable expression, she felt a great sense of satisfaction.

"Hahaha, Merlin, you bastard, I never thought I'd see this day! You robbed me, and now you're getting your comeuppance!" Alice laughed and clapped her hands, "Tell you, justice may be late, but it never fails! Hahaha..."

Merlin narrowed his eyes and looked at Alice's smug expression, which made him very angry, and his forehead veins were jumping.

"Hmph! I'm running away, I'm not doing adventurer anymore, you take care of the debt yourself, hehe~"

Merlin turned and walked away, not looking back. He wanted to run away, who could stop him? !

Alice was shocked and felt something was wrong.

If Merlin left, the debt would all be on her, which wouldn't be fair?

This is too unfair, it's a self-destructive pattern!

Alice quickly panicked and hugged Merlin from behind, hugging him tightly and not letting him go, her eyes filled with tears, and she was almost crying.

"Don't leave me!"

"You can't leave me!"

"You can't go anywhere, you have to stay with me!"

"What have you done to me, take responsibility, you bastard!"

"Did you hear me! If you dare to leave me, I'll fight you to the death! You can't escape! AQA..."
