title: Chapter 3
content:
Chapter 3

Volume 4 · Chapter 3

"~" Lucy held her cheek, saying with a hint of excitement, "A bold confession~"

"Stay strong, bro." Hobbs patted Arnold's shoulder, then tilted his head back to drink. "Gulpgulpgulpgulp~!"

Arnold felt his head turn another shade greener, tears streaming down his face as he wailed, "Miss Alice, please don't aggravate me anymore, waaah—"

Merlin broke into a sweat, glancing back awkwardly. "What kind of terrible line is that? I can feel a deep sense of malice."

"....." Alice's face flushed red. It seemed she had only just realized something, but she still clung to Merlin tightly as if afraid he'd run away. "I mean.... I can run, but you can't!"

"Hehe, you think because I tell you not to run, I won't? What kind of logic is that?" Merlin grinned broadly, then put on a serious expression. "Let go, or I'll flip out."

"You two can forget about running away. No matter which country you go to, you'll have a record..." Lucy couldn't help but pour a bucket of cold water on them.

"..."

Both Merlin and Alice were stunned. They actually had a criminal record?!

That meant no matter where they ran, they'd be burdened with enormous debt.

Alice felt crushed. It was really frustrating—there wasn't not even a chance to become a fugitive. But since she could drag Merlin this bastard along, it wasn't entirely pointless. She had to make him experience the life she was living.

Her mindset now was simple: she couldn't stand seeing Merlin do well, so she had to pull him down too. If they were both suffering together, wasn't that beautiful?

Merlin felt a splitting headache. Having Alice's debt inexplicably land on him made him feel utterly hopeless. Tens of thousands hadn't been much, but tens of millions straight up was despair-inducing.

"Hmph!" Alice pouted, released Merlin, and suddenly became all fiery. "Run! Go ahead and run! Let's see how far you get? Hehe~"

"Hehe, you want me to run? Then wouldn't that be such a loss of face?" Merlin shrugged, thinking that since he'd have debt chasing him in every country, plus waves of cockroaches coming after him to collect, what was there to run for?

"Both of you, stop arguing. Since you just became couple adventurers, the Guild has a regulation—specifically established for couple adventurers—that I hope you're aware of...." Lucy clapped her hands, hoping to get Merlin and Alice's attention. "Guild rule: couple adventurers must accept quests together. Otherwise, I won't approve you. If you want to team up with others, you must both come. Accepting quests separately is absolutely not allowed."

"Huh?! " Merlin and Alice both shouted in surprise. This rule was unexpectedly坑(坑)like!

They already owed so much debt. If they could separate and earn money, it would obviously be faster. But since they had to accept quests together, paying off the debt would be much slower. And the main issue was—

They couldn't stand each other! They wanted to kick each other flying!

"Tch! Why do I have to team up with a salted fish like her? She's always dragging me down...." Merlin frowned, his eyes full of disgust. He found Alice's meddlesome personality annoying—he despised that type the most. And whenever he and Alice were thrown together, nothing good ever happened.

"Huh?! As if I'd want to team up with you! Narcissistic pervert..." Alice's forehead veins pulsed wildly. She thought that while teaming up with Merlin guaranteed quest completion rates, she just couldn't stand looking at him. As a former Hero, having to team up with a demon felt like some kind of humiliation.

"This can't be helped. A few years back, there was a couple of adventurers. The wife went on a mission alone with someone else, and the husband got... you know... the story made waves everywhere. That's when the Guild headquarters rolled out this new rule." Lucy said awkwardly, hoping Alice and Merlin could understand.

"Hehe, women~" Merlin glanced sideways at Alice, his meaning unmistakable.

"What kind of look is that? You bastard...." Alice ground her teeth in anger.

Their gazes seemed to be shooting sparks at each other, provoking one another. If Alice could beat Merlin, she might already have drawn her sword.

"Please don't be like this....." A bead of cold sweat slid down Lucy's forehead as she awkwardly played peacemaker. "Think about it—you're going to be couple adventurers working together from now on. Let's keep it peaceful. Hang in there for your livelihood~"

"Miss Alice, I have a proposal!" Arnold popped up again, craving attention.

"Spit it out or scram!" Alice was furious, her words thick with gunpowder.

"Miss Alice, please marry me! I'll pay off your debts! Although it's still an astronomical figure for me, even if I sell the mansion I'll help you!" Arnold scampered over joyfully, dropped to one knee, and cried, "Give me a chance, Miss Alice~!"

"Scram...." Alice treated Arnold like air. She felt so unlucky today. Wanting to stay away from Merlin, she turned and walked off. "Hmph~!"

Alice would definitely reject Arnold's enthusiasm. She had a bit of pride and didn't need anyone's charity.

And marry Arnold? That was even more unacceptable—it felt like she was selling herself to pay debts.

Arnold was heartbroken, turned into a flat piece of paper, fluttering凌乱ly in the cold wind. His first-ever marriage proposal ended in failure at light speed.

"My condolences~ my condolences~" Hobbs offered words of comfort, but his face was grinning wider than anyone else's—clearly schadenfreude.

"Wait! Alice, don't go yet!" Merlin suddenly called out to her.

"What?! Don't you have the nerve to talk to me." Alice turned around, hands on her hips, and confronted him.

"...." Merlin felt a bit irritated inside—this girl's temper was terrible. "Didn't you forget something important?"

"What could I possibly forget?! As if I'd be like you, suffering from old-age dementia....." Alice didn't hold back her words.

"...." Merlin felt like his heart had been stabbed. As a human, he was technically in his 200s now—being called senile was his biggest taboo. "Money! Money, get it? You idiot!"

"....What?! Trying to extort my savings?" Alice hid her money pouch behind her back, striking a miserly pose.

"The reward is shared. I want my own share back—how is that extortion? Your skill at playing the victim is getting more impressive by the day, huh?" Merlin narrowed his eyes, finding Alice shamelessly trying to swallow his money whole.

Alice realized and opened her money pouch to check the inside. She remembered that Merlin did have a share in there.

But there wasn't much to begin with, and she'd have to give some to Merlin—Alice really didn't want to.

After reluctantly pulling out several coins, she suddenly thought of the co-living arrangement and got an idea.

"Aren't we supposed to co-liver? I agree now. Let me calculate how much you should pay....." Alice, like a little money-grubber, tapped her fingers. "Rent, property fees, utilities, cleaning fees, food costs—"

Merlin's heart pounded in terror. Alice rattled off over thirty charge items. How much would be left?!

"All the various costs associated with dating and co-living—these are your earnings...." After finishing her calculations, Alice slapped a single gold coin onto Merlin's table, then turned and left the Guild. "Hmph~!"

Merlin picked up the lone gold coin from the table, completely dumbfounded. He thought he'd worked all this hard for just ONE gold coin?!

"Hahaha, Merlin, congrats..." Hobbs laughed and leaned over, patting Merlin on the shoulder.

"Welcome to the Wifely Tyranny Club {weihei*

0)?"

title: Chapter 4 — Monthly Vote Bonus
content:
Chapter 4 — Monthly Vote Bonus

Volume 4 · Chapter 4

Merlin hung out with Hobbes and the rest at the guild until evening before heading home.

In the meantime, Arnold cried his eyes out, shouting that he wanted to duel Merlin, but he was too scared to actually swing.

After all this time, Merlin's head was slightly clearer now, and he began to carefully think about his future.

Though all his hard work had only brought in one gold coin, even a mosquito is meat, so of course he'd accept it.

But the tens of millions in debt on Alice's shoulders left Merlin completely speechless, crushing any hope he had for his future life.

Originally, a debt of a few dozen thousand wasn't much — a few big commissions and it'd be paid off. But now? It had become an astronomical figure.

Merlin was beginning to feel dim hopes for his future, planning to just drift along, living one day at a time.

This kind of negative mindset was innate and hard to shake.

Merlin wouldn't pick himself back up the way Alice would, full of energy and hope the next day.

After all, Merlin had gotten used to coasting through life; he was too lazy to do anything or even bother trying to live properly.

He only wanted to avoid trouble and enjoy a peaceful life of fun in another world.

For someone like Merlin, who was past the point of no return in his laziness, his greatest dream was to be bedridden with someone caring for his meals, then simply sleep forever.

Merlin genuinely believed that was what living like a god felt like. If it weren't for the curse in his heart, this guy wouldn't have moved a single muscle after arriving in another world.

Merlin staggered back to Alice's house and knocked on the door.

Alice came out wearing loungewear with an apron, but she only opened the door a crack, glaring at Merlin with great suspicion.

"What do you want?"

"I'm going back to my own home, what else would I want?" Merlin said impatiently. "Miss, I paid for this. I've got half usage rights to this house now. If you keep chasing me out, you're overstepping~"

"...Alice furrowed her delicate brows, thought for a moment, then opened the door. "Come in. If the neighbors see an inappropriate man hanging around my door every day, they'll think I'm not proper either, hmph~!"

"Hah..." Merlin forced a laugh, thinking to himself: Who isn't a proper man? How come I don't see it?

After entering the familiar house,

Merlin had barely crossed the doorway when he caught the scent of meat. On the dining table sat a freshly prepared steak.

It was only one serving, but that was fine — Merlin had thick skin.

"You actually made food for me? How kind~"

Merlin plopped down in front of the steak and picked up his knife and fork, acting like he wasn't a stranger.

Alice was suddenly startled. The fruit of her half-day labor — was she really supposed to hand it over to Merlin?

"Get up! That's my steak! If you want something to eat, make it yourself. Don't steal mine!"

Alice strode over, grabbed Merlin's collar, and yanked him violently.

But Merlin acted as though he'd learned the thousand-pound drop technique — he didn't budge an inch, as if his bottom had merged with the chair.

"Miss Alice, that's not fair. Didn't I remember you saying something about food costs? How could there be no share for me?" Merlin wore a very teasing expression.

"T-that..." Alice was at a loss. Had she actually said that? Well, she'd been babbling nonsense at the time and hadn't cared, so... "Th-then... only half is yours!"

"Tch!" Merlin sliced the steak in half with his knife and flicked his portion onto the opposite plate. "Such a pain."

"Hmph~!" Alice huffed and sat across from Merlin, looking at her half of the steak with great grievance. She had worked hard for a long time to prepare this for a proper feast, and now it was cut in half — with the other half sitting on the bastard's plate.

Merlin calmly took a bite of Alice's cooking and immediately furrowed his brows. "This is truly awful. What a waste of ingredients. The outside of the steak tastes sour, it's a bit salty, and the inside isn't tender enough. It barely qualifies as sustenance..."

"If you don't want to eat it, spit it out!" Alice tapped the table, displeased.

"I won't waste free food. I never pick and choose when it comes to filling my stomach." Merlin chewed the steak, his eyes full of disgust. "But hey, you've got small boobs and terrible cooking skills. You'll probably never marry in the future, since your beauty as a woman is zero~"

"Shut up! I refuse to let you gossip about me like that!" Alice gripped a fork, wishing she could nail it to Merlin's forehead. "Are boobs important or not? The bigger they are, the more inconvenient they are. I find mine very convenient."

"Since you care so little, then stop stuffing breast pads, okay?" Merlin said with a half-smile.

"...I'll stuff them if I want! Mind your own business!" Alice slammed the table, furious.

"Heh~" Merlin sneered. "But with your cooking skills, I bet your mom's wasn't great either..."

"My parents passed away long ago. I grew up living with my teacher, and she only knew how to roast sweet potatoes," Alice said flatly.

Noticing no emotion on Alice's face, Merlin guessed she'd never even seen her parents, otherwise she wouldn't be so cold.

"No wonder your chest is so small. Lack of nutrition when you were a kid, huh..."

"Can you stop bringing up my chest every time?" Alice put on a serious face. "I'm telling you — if I wear a bandeau-style bra, I could squeeze these enough to make them grow too!"

"Please~!" Merlin nearly laughed out loud. "Cut your hair short, walk into a men's bathhouse, and if someone recognizes you as a woman, I'll chop off my dick."

"You!" In a fit of rage, Alice threw the fork she was holding at Merlin. It shot through the air.

"Hmph." Merlin scoffed and easily caught the fork, twirling it around in his hand. "Miss, no violence. Have some manners."

Alice couldn't do anything about Merlin. Her little face turned red with anger, her cheeks puffing up like buns.

"You've got plenty of flaws, but you can勉强 serve as a maid. From now on, you'll be fetching foot-washing water or whatever~" Merlin acted like a bigshot, instantly reclassifying Alice into the servant tier.

"Scram! We're on equal footing, so everything needs to be laid out clearly..." Alice poked out her finger, looking like she was about to make a detailed plan. "We'll take turns cooking! We'll split the cleaning, one person each time. I get priority on the bathroom, and you can't use it until I'm done showering."

"Tch!" Merlin felt this wasn't fair — everything favored Alice. "So if you don't shower, I have to keep waiting?"

"Yes, exactly!" Alice nodded like a little landlord.

"So if you skip showering for a month, I skip it for a month too?" Merlin frowned.

"I'm not that dirty! I basically shower every day at home!" Alice was terrified of being misunderstood.

"Everything goes first for you — that's unfair. Then the bed's mine!" Merlin pointed at himself. He figured he was always being taken advantage of by Alice. This wasn't room-sharing; he was lodging here!

"Hah!?" Alice's delicate brows locked together, and she immediately put on her housekeeper's demeanor —

"The bed is obviously mine!

"I got here first, so it's mine!

"This little sofa is your home, hmph~"

title: Chapter 5 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 5 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 4 · Chapter 5

"Alice, we're roommates. I'm not staying at your place as a boarder, got it?" Merlin tapped his fingers on the table, very不满. "You've taken all the benefits, leaving me with zero rights."

"I'm a girl. Ladies first. Would it kill you to show some gentlemanly courtesy?" Alice said staunchly. She was starting to use her gender to steamroll Merlin in these situations.

"Sorry, I always judge gender by breast size. In my eyes, you're as straight-up manly as it gets." Merlin waved his hands dismissively, making it clear he wouldn't fall for that tactic.

"...What did you say!?" Alice grit her teeth furiously and snapped, "I don't care. I rented the place first, so I call the shots!"

"What gives you the authority? Big chest? Perky butt? Or cute coquettishness?" Merlin spread his hands, his expression clearly looking down on Alice.

"I..." Alice was at a loss for words and retorted angrily, "The bed is mine. I've slept on it for ages, it can't be separated from me!"

Merlin kept a straight face, wondering if she'd said it backwards — wasn't it this girl who couldn't leave the bed?

"Dream on. If it were fair, we'd each sleep in it one day at a time."

"I'll never let you sleep on my bed!" Alice exploded at once, patting her fake chest. "Please have some decency, okay? I'm a girl, it's not easy for me either. Didn't you call yourself the Arrogant Monarch? Would you steal a girl's bed? Isn't that embarrassing?"

"..."

Merlin's expression turned strange. Those words had somehow struck a nerve.

As the Arrogant Monarch, stealing a girl's bed was indeed somewhat shameful.

It was like an adult snatching a brat's lollipop. But Merlin quickly found an excuse —

Alice was the former Hero. He was suppressing an opponent; it wasn't shameful.

"Please have some sympathy for me too, okay? I'm an aging man suffering from cervical spondylosis, rheumatism, and even hemorrhoids. Aren't you the Hero representing justice? Can't you show some respect to an old man like me?"

Though the two sat at the dining table like a married couple chatting, the atmosphere was far from harmonious — they'd started competing in who could play the victim better.

Alice had a fiery temper and couldn't hold back anymore. "Stop putting on an act in front of me. If you won't agree, I'll refund your money and you can go live somewhere else!"

Merlin squinted at Alice. Her expression said she was prepared to burn bridges. Thinking about the little money he'd earned, he couldn't afford to rent another place anyway...

So after careful consideration, Merlin decided to bide his time and reluctantly sleep on the sofa. When the opportunity arose, he'd find a way to hang Alice from the roof.

"Fine, fine. You're right since your chest is small."

"Your chest is small!" Alice shot back indignantly.

"Yes, yes. As small as yours." Merlin said with ill intent.

Alice pressed her lips together tightly, her face flushed red with anger, her hands slamming the table until it shook.

"Let's eat, let's eat~" Merlin picked up his knife and fork and put on an innocent act, leaving Alice half-dead with rage and moving on.

Alice calmed down somewhat. The roommate arrangement had basically reached a consensus — they could barely manage living together.

But there were still a series of other issues that needed proper discussion.

"What do you think about the couple adventurer thing? Let me get this out front — I will absolutely not acknowledge any marital relationship with you!"

Merlin was chewing his steak and nearly choked, "Cough cough! Don't worry, I'll absolutely not acknowledge it either. Not to mention you're as flat as a washboard — even if you were a sexy bombshell, I wouldn't be tempted. Don't be so provocative, keep your distance, OK?"

Alice felt that getting along with Merlin for too long would damage her liver sooner or later.

She didn't want to argue with him right now. Even though the guy's mouth was full of garbage, she'd try to hold back.

"Just what I want — I don't want to get tied to you with some weird relationship either!"

"Same here~" Merlin nodded. If Alice came any closer, he'd happily kick her out of the solar system.

"About the debt consolidation matter..." Alice hesitated.

"..." Merlin put down his knife and fork and sighed. "This is the most rigged scam ever."

"What do you plan to do?" Alice asked tentatively.

"I think I'll never pay this off in this lifetime. I'll just honestly muddle through — live one day at a time. Honestly, I'm quite willing to just loaf around and wait to die." Merlin said lazily.

"How can you say that?!" Alice immediately objected, saying righteously, "As long as we work hard, we'll definitely pay it off in our lifetimes! Don't give up on treatment!"

"In our lifetimes? Holy crap..." Merlin felt Alice's words were like a tall tale. "Are you kidding me? Being a debt slave for nearly half my life — I refuse! I want to loaf around and wait to die!"

"I'm not lying, we really do have a chance!" Alice was the type who never lost heart as long as there was hope. "Right now, I can take S-rank commissions at the highest level — each pays at least tens of thousands of gold coins. If I advance to Saint-tier, I can become a Mithril Adventurer and have the right to take SS-rank commissions, which start at a minimum of 100,000 gold coins!"

Merlin raised his eyelids. If Alice spoke like this, it did seem like there was actually a chance to pay off the debt in their lifetimes. If they got lucky and frequently received SS-rank quests, it might be done in less than ten years.

"But... I checked the commission board before, and there were no SS-rank commissions at all. The highest S-rank bounty is only 30,000 gold coins."

"SS-rank commissions are just rare. They're not easy to get. But as long as you're willing to work hard, there's still hope, right?" Alice was full of motivation, still brimming with hope for the future.

"The main problem is... you haven't reached Saint-tier. You're just high-tier fodder." Merlin hit the nail on the head, thinking what good was all this pie in the sky from Alice?

"...I'll reach Saint-tier someday." Alice said resentfully.

"When pigs fly. I've heard of people who reached high-rank and never made it to Saint-tier before they died. There are plenty of..." Merlin said with lukewarm interest.

"Will you die if you don't crush me?" Alice furrowed her brows and said不满ly, "My teacher even said my talent is pretty good."

"Haha, 'pretty good' means stuck in the middle, unable to go up or down. Do you really think you're somebody? Your teacher was just comforting you, silly kid."

Merlin smirked, thinking Alice was truly clueless.

"Is it fun for you to crush me like this? If I don't reach Saint-tier, I can't take advanced tasks, and we'll never become free people. Can we stop this, okay?" Alice said very seriously.

"At worst we'll just loaf around and wait to die. I don't care~" Merlin put on a dead-pig-unafraid-of-boiling-water attitude.

"Please take this seriously, okay? This is our problem as two people." Alice became earnest and was genuinely anxious about this matter.

"Alright, cough!" Merlin cleared his throat and straightened his attitude. "Setting aside when you'll reach Saint-tier — even if you do, there aren't enough SS-rank tasks for us to complete. In the end, we're still paying off debt at a snail's pace, stretching out indefinitely. So loafing around and waiting to die is the safer option. No need to work hard anymore."

"What about SSS-rank commissions? Only Mithril Adventurers can take those, and the reward starts at a million gold coins." Alice herself gasped when she mentioned it.

Merlin's heart stirred. It seemed making Alice reach Saint-tier was actually quite necessary. SSS-rank quest rewards were truly substantial — three or four runs could clear this astronomical debt. But all of this was premised on Alice becoming a Mithril Adventurer. Without magic power or aura, he had no hope. It was just...

"...So what? I've never even seen an SS-rank commission. Do SSS-rank commissions come out once every million years?"

"Who said that? According to the guild master, the last SSS-rank commission appeared 30 years ago. One..." Alice held up two fingers, letting him guess.

"2 million gold coins?" Merlin answered tentatively.

"20 million gold coins, you idiot! If we can get one, not only will the debt be cleared, we'll never worry about food and clothing for the rest of our lives!" Alice said very excitedly. This was the biggest reason she became an adventurer — if she got lucky, she could achieve astonishing returns overnight that no other profession could match.

"Pfft!" Merlin nearly spat out his food in shock, his eyes wide, thinking he'd heard wrong.

Holy crap?

20 million gold coins!?!

It seemed he didn't need to work hard anymore.

Just lie around and wait for SSS-rank commissions to fall into his lap.
