title: Chapter 17 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 17 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 4 · Chapter 17

Carolina felt this time it was a sure thing. Recovering the Hell Legion's key was truly effortless.

Killing an ordinary person without magic and battle energy was like crushing an ant.

Carolina needed to move discreetly, not causing a big commotion.

Originally she thought the key was in Alice's hand, which would be a small trouble.

But now it was on Merlin's neck, and she felt the difficulty had dropped significantly, like snatching a lollipop from a baby's hand.

Carolina dared assert that Merlin definitely didn't know what that key was used for.

So maybe no force was needed, and the key could be easily borrowed.

Merlin originally thought it was just him and Hobbes.

But halfway there, Hobbes called over the guard captain Price as well.

Hobbes and Price—upon meeting, hooked up—looked like they were very familiar.

The two chatted with bright eyes and white teeth, clearly looking like fox friends and dog friends.

Merlin thought for a moment and felt relieved, after all, the two were about the same age, and Price was exuding a somewhat lewd aura.

Price: "Going into a secret base, right?"

Hobbes: "Right, this operation is very important. We must be extra careful."

Price: "Why is it important?"

Hobbes: "Because this time we're bringing a rookie recruit. The danger level increases exponentially."

Price: "Screw you, is your wife safe over there?"

「仝」

Hobbes: "Don't worry. If anything happens at home while taking care of the kids, we'll quickly break out from the back door."

Price: "No wonder you're Hobbes' brother, your plans are so meticulous."

Hobbes: "That's natural. I'm a veteran, I have rich experience."

Merlin stood to the side, confused, thinking isn't this just visiting a brothel? Making it seem like a secret meeting between spies.

"Isn't this Merlin, little brother?" Price came over, familiar and casual, saying, "You come out and join us. Does Miss Alice know?"

"I'm freelance, and I have nothing to do with Alice." Merlin emphasized the relationship, not wanting any psychological pressure.

"Everyone who comes out to play says they don't have a wife, we understand~" Price hammered Merlin's chest, his expression more lewd than Hobbes'.

Merlin rolled his eyes, not knowing what to say. Originally he had little interest, but since Hobbes spoke so mysteriously, he couldn't help but get curious, so he thought of going to Helena's hut to take a look.

"However, Merlin brother, you already have a wife as beautiful as a flower at home, and going out to play with us, will there be any psychological pressure?" Price asked tentatively.

"Hobbes also has a wife, you ask him if he has any psychological pressure?" Merlin steered the topic to Hobbes.

"Hobbes' older brother is different. His wife isn't as pretty as Miss Alice." Price waved his hand, smiling and saying, "Keeping Miss Alice at home and coming out with a girlfriend, that's a bit of a waste of heaven's resources. It's rare that Miss Alice is so great. If she violently kicks your butt with her high heels, it must be a very stimulating thing, ah! Fun~"

"? ? ?" Merlin furrowed his brows, silently creating distance from Price.

"Don't say that~" Hobbes came out and seriously talked nonsense, "We're out to have fun. Don't use such a vulgar word like 'girlfriend'. It's not elegant~"

"Still, Hobbes' older brother has culture. Even when coming out as a girlfriend, one can speak so... Price made empty gestures with both hands, his expression conflicted, struggling to find words, "So clear-headed and transcendent, awesome~"

Merlin had a blank expression, completely not wanting to join their topic. Thinking, can these two really have no problem going to such a place together?

A three-person team of ghostly and sneaky way to a brothel.

Merlin felt a sense of helplessness inside, feeling like a thief.

It's just visiting a brothel, why...

Turning unknown how many corners and walking unknown how many roads, finally arriving in front of a shop. Looking at the exterior, it wasn't a proper store.

bookSFACG.c

「Helena's Secret~」O。上h之

Above the archway, the store name was written in lascivious font, and at the tail there was a pink naked woman shadow logo. A lewd aura assailed the face.

"Arrived, our secret base." Hobbes revealed a serious face.

"Oh! The heaven of men of Rackham!" Price followed with a serious face, imagining in his mind being stepped on by ladies in high heels, and started getting richly excited.

"Looks pretty good..." Merlin said lightly.

The three didn't hesitate much, diving into this wonderful store.

After entering the interior, it was filled with pink atmosphere. Although the scale wasn't very large, it had a feeling of being substantial, seeming divided into many small rooms.

A woman in a beautiful white long dress came gracefully, her delicate figure slightly swaying as she walked, never for a moment failing to attract male eyes.

She had blue hair like waves reaching her waist, violet eyes that seemed able to put one in a fantasy.

Although her looks were not inferior to Rukia and Alice, but more charming aura, probably due to the tear mole at the corner of her eye.

That tear mole was very obvious, not stealing the spotlight, but playing a decorative role on the face, making one unforgettable at a glance.

This lady must be the owner of this shop, the legendary Miss Helena.

"Hobbes gentleman, Price gentleman, it's been a long time since you two came over, hasn't it?"

Helena slowly approached, hooking her lewd lips, revealing a beautiful smile, her voice soft and making those who listen feel tingly all over.

Merlin roughly scanned Helena, and couldn't help but furrow his brows, thinking, look look! Look look! This is really a woman! Alice should seize the chance to come over and learn! Always letting me be dazed and think I live with pure men!

Yeah, recently too busy, didn't have time to take care of Miss Helena's business, making me feel a bit guilty~" Hobbes looked at the Helena, his expression a bit restrained and shy.

Merlin looked at Hobbes with utter astonishment, thinking, damn! This old lecher actually gets shy and blushes! Suddenly became many years younger! Wake up! She won't fall for you! That's a polite smile, don't have any illusions about the three major life mistakes!

"Anyway, serious business is important. I'm very happy to come once in a while." Helena speaking was very pleasant, making one's body and mind very comfortable.

"Miss Helena! Missed being scolded by you for a long time, quickly scold a few sentences." As a man in his thirties, Price actually begged the young Helena to whip answer him.

"Price gentleman is still so disgusting, like a maggot wriggling in front of me, still not quickly rolling out of my sight, lowly garbage, puk!" Helena's attitude suddenly turned vicious, her face turning dark, her eyes like looking at a bug, and she even spat a mouthful of phlegm at Price's face.

"..... A few drops of sweat fell on Merlin's forehead, thinking what's going on!

"Hahaha~" Helena's face trembled with an expression that vanished in an instant, two rosy clouds surfacing on her face, replacing it with a warm and gentle smile one-

"Is Miss Helena's few sentences satisfactory to Price gentleman?

title: Chapter 18
content:
Chapter 18

Volume 4 · Chapter 18

Merlin's expression was complicated. So it was just a joke. He had thought that earlier was real.

Price's face was flushed red, his whole body trembling with excitement. His gaze was resolute. Then suddenly he dropped to the ground with a thud, wearing an expression even more devout than one offering worship to the Goddess of Light —

...So thrilling!

"Indeed, Miss Helena is the greatest!"

"These few words were enough to make her eligible as our sadomasochistic goddess!"

Merlin looked at Price with a flat expression. Something's wrong here. Didn't you say yesterday that Alice was the greatest? In an instant you've transferred your affections? What happened to your faith, Price!?

"Sorry, I have no interest in ascending to that kind of goddess. What a pity, Mr. Price."

Helena still wore her polite smile, not angry at all. Having dealt with enough customers, she'd seen every type of person there was.

"...Price paused, then brazenly said with hope in his eyes, "Then would you please trample me hard with your high heels later?"

"I'm afraid I can't. My job doesn't go that far..." Helena touched her cheek, feeling embarrassed.

Merlin pressed his palm to his forehead. Coming out with Price was so embarrassing. Can't a guy have some dignity?

"Since Mr. Hobbs and you are here today, that means you're not busy, right?" Helena shifted the topic to work.

"Yeah, we came to relax a bit today..." Hobbs put his arm around Merlin's shoulders and said meaningfully, "Mainly I brought a newcomer over to introduce himself. Get a familiar face~"

"This is..." Helena then turned her gaze to Merlin, feeling that he looked somewhat familiar.

"Merlin Lucifer, a new adventurer from the guild." Hobbs cheerfully introduced Merlin beside him. After all, he was part of the Brothel Team, and they'd often hang out together in the future. "Although he's a villager without any magic power or fighting energy, he still earned Old Tyler's recognition and was specially promoted to become an adventurer. Clearly this guy has some skills behind the scenes. But the strongest adventurer in the guild is still me, hehe~"

"You..." Merlin greeted flatly. He thought Hobbs introducing him was fine, but why couldn't he resist boasting about himself? Was he trying to make himself look better by comparison? It felt somewhat annoying~

"Brother Hobbs forgot to add one thing — little Merlin's big banana is quite formidable, hehehe~" Price's face was full of lewdness, obviously recalling some well-harmonized scene.

"That addition is unnecessary..." Merlin grumbled in rebuttal. He felt like a square peg in a round hole sandwiched between two middle-aged men. Although their combined ages didn't exceed his own.

Helena had been staring blankly at Merlin from the start, and then her expression changed drastically, filled with shock. She covered her mouth and stepped back half a pace.

This strange behavior left all three men on the other side deeply confused. They couldn't understand what was wrong with Helena.

Merlin watched Helena's bizarre reaction, puzzled. What's going on?

"Helena... miss?" Hobbs looked at Helena, thinking she might suddenly feel unwell.

"Helena..." Price, whose nerves were rather thick, grinned and said, "Could it be that I mentioned Merlin's big banana is formidable and it scared you? Haha..."

Helena slightly regained her composure, quickly recovering. The previous incident flashed through her mind for an instant, then she smiled and said, "How could that be? Please, come in everyone."

Hobbs and Price completely disregarded the earlier little episode and eagerly headed toward the private room.

Merlin silently followed behind, but when he passed by Helena, he stopped in surprise. He widened his eyes and turned back to look at this beautiful woman.

Without getting close, one wouldn't really notice. This brief brushing past instantly made Merlin sense a trace of familiarity.

Yes, very familiar. It was like the aura of his own kind, though faint and fleeting.

Merlin looked at Helena with suspicion and uncertainty, unable to confirm whether that aura was real. What if he was mistaken?

Helena looked up, her thin lips curving into a tempting smile as she asked, "What's wrong? Does something bother you, Mr. Merlin?"

"...Nothing." Merlin turned and walked away, shaking his head.

Probably just my imagination, right?

Perhaps Helena is practicing some dark magic, which made me misinterpret it...

Merlin had originally thought this place was very lewd.

But after careful consideration, it was more like a song and dance hall.

A place where you sit together, drink and chat, accompanied by many pretty girls.

There were also many performances. As long as you spent gold coins, you could enjoy an emperor-like life.

There seemed to be some unspoken rules too. Like the old rogue Hobbs opposite — from the very beginning his hand was firmly grasping the girl's chest.

He was already a man with a wife and child. Couldn't he be at least a little more restrained?

Merlin felt a slight resistance inside. If he were still single, perhaps running around wouldn't matter much. But now that he was married with a child, wasn't this a bit excessive? A fight with his wife was minor, but wouldn't his father image completely collapse in his child's eyes? One moment towering and mighty, the next transforming into some creepy, vulgar man.

Although Merlin had also been young once, that phase was long behind him now. Even as a demon, he still had some bottom line.

Actually, Hobbs touching a breast was already relatively restrained. Just look at that sadomasochist Price beside him — it was almost too painful to watch —

"Miss, hit me again~"

Price was being furiously slapped by two girls riding on top of him, and while being struck he cursed them with foul language.

"So satisfying~ It feels amazing~ Hit harder~!"

"Emmmmmmm."

Merlin completely wanted to stop expressing any opinion. He thought — is this really someone who holds the position of guard captain? Totally embarrassing Lexum.

"Brother, your skin is so good. How are you kept?" one girl asked.

"Not just the skin, even your face is handsome. More beautiful than a girl~" another girl agreed.

"Hah, I was born naturally gorgeous." Merlin gave a dry laugh.

The two girls giggled, finding Merlin quite humorous.

In truth, Merlin was just perfunctorily getting by. He thought women were such a bother. He had expected something more exciting, and this was it? How boring...

"Merlin, what do you think of this place?" Hobbs asked while taking a break. Two lipstick marks had appeared on his face at some point.

"Average..." Merlin answered offhandedly.

Hobbs saw that Merlin clearly had no interest, so he awkwardly said, "Shall we order a performance then?"

"A performance?" Merlin furrowed his brows. He thought — I want to see a beauty break a stone on her chest. I wonder if they have that?

"Let me see..."

Just as Hobbs picked up the program list, a purple-haired woman walked in. She wore a thin, light white sari.

Her purple hair was piled high, a strand of hair covering half her face, and she wore a veil. A sense of mystery wafted toward everyone.

"Eh!? She came without being booked?"

This purple-haired dancer was naturally Karona. She had originally been looking for an opportunity to quietly retrieve the key, tailing Merlin and the other two the whole time.

Then she discovered the three of them entering this establishment. Karona burst out laughing, because in a place like this she could better leverage her advantageous capital. Stealing a key wouldn't be a problem at all, right?

So Karona sneaked into Helena's secret room, disguised herself as a sari dancer, and prepared to obtain the key to the Hell Legion.

The moment Karona entered, she stole a glance at the gleaming key around Merlin's neck and proudly thought —

Searching high and low in vain, yet it appears right before your eyes. Hehehe...

title: Chapter 19 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 19 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 4 · Chapter 19

Carolona, though a blood‑licking thief on the blade’s edge, is also a versatile talent, adept at using her beauty and disguise, able to play any role from noble elegant ladies to lowly tavern hostesses, a veritable super‑spy who can portray any character convincingly. Now Carolona dresses as a sari dancer, intending to mesmerize these men with her dance, then bewitch Merlin‑down and snatch the key unnoticed—low‑key and without revealing her true identity. She is determined to take the key hanging from Merlin’s neck, already feeling it as her own, and she remains confident in her dance and charm. “Gentlemen, may I perform a little act to liven things up?” Merlin glanced at Carolona lazily; from the single eye visible he could tell she was a bewitching woman, though her hair and veil obscured her full face, but since she wanted to perform, he didn’t mind watching. As for the other two, drool dripped onto the floor—Carolona looked utterly enchanting; though her face was hidden, her fiery figure was impossible to ignore, and her seductive waist, if it swayed, would surely set hearts racing. The sari itself is thin and revealing, much of her skin exposed, her breasts lifted by two layers of gauze appearing ample, her flat belly devoid of fat yet brimming with a dancer’s strength. Golden bells on her hands and feet jingled with alluring beauty, likely the instrument of her dance. “Great, great, let us enjoy— if you could dance and strip at the same time, even better, hehehe~” Hobbes slurped, his eyes fixed on Carolona’s bewitching figure, imagining some steamy scene. Even if Hobbes had seen Carolona before, the veil now made her hard to recognize—a mere black‑iron adventurer daring to tease a Saint‑tier powerhouse? Carolona’s forehead veins throbbed at Hobbes’s lecherous stare; she thought, a low‑rank salted fish dares to flirt with me? If not for the mission, I’d have slit his throat seven times over. “Excuse me, miss, may I step on you while you dance? Hard stomping, that kind.” Price raised his hand, eyes widening, nostrils flaring, finding Carolona’s bare feet alluring, especially with red nail polish—stepping on the key would surely feel great~ “Sorry, sir, I don’t offer foot‑massage services.” Carolona laughed awkwardly, fuming inside—hard stomping? If I pushed, I’d probably crush your liver! “What a pity, I still wanted you to stick your toes in my nostrils~” Price said disappointedly, each quirk weirder than the last. Carolona broke out in a cold sweat and a black line, thinking, what kind of people are these? Isn’t there anyone normal? Oh right! This Merlin fellow, though a useless villager, is calmer than the others. Why no reaction from me? Is he uninterested, or is my charm lacking? Impossible! No one can resist my charm unless he’s gay! ? Definitely—looking at this Merlin fellow, his face screams gay, I’ve figured it out. Even if he’s gay, I’m confident I can turn him straight, hahaha… Carolona brimming with confidence, struck a graceful pose, ready to dance. “Gentlemen, don’t blink~” Merlin remained his usual lethargic, end‑stage face, unchanged front to back, yet still interested in watching—completely unaware he’d become the prey. The bells on Carolona’s limbs trembled, emitting a clear tone that instantly drew focus. Her waist began to twist, sinuous as a snake, full of temptation; her toes brushed the floor, revealing snow‑white long legs, combined with fair skin, dazzlingly bright. Hobbes and Price’s eyes went straight, feeling those gorgeous legs could be played with for a century. Carolona’s exquisite form began to move, like a dagger tip heading to the center. Her fierce yet graceful dance, timed to the bell’s rhythm, exuded exotic charm, as if hearing an ancient ballad. Hobbes and Price slipped into a stupor, unable to tear their gaze from Carolona, as if petrified by Medusa’s stare, for the dance was simply too gorgeous. The undulation of her neck, the quiver of her shoulders, wave after wave of supple motion from arm to fingertips—this dance brimmed with allure, leaving viewers spellbound. I don’t know if Carolona isn’t sultry enough or Merlin’s standards are too high; he watched the whole time with a blank expression. …Just so‑so, I guess? Merlin silently judged, as an old man who’d seen through women’s façades, his resistance so high it was despairing; even the slightest twitch to show courtesy he managed. Carolona felt the mood was ripe; she suddenly approached Merlin, pressing forward, parting his legs with her snow‑white thighs and wrapping them around his neck. “? ? ?” Merlin’s head filled with question marks—thought dancing still involved this steamy interaction? ; Carolona straddled Merlin, her ample chest thrust forward, blocking his view so he saw only a blur of white. Merlin felt no period, his mood a mix of complexity, a growing weariness. Carolona lowered her head slightly, lifted a corner of her veil with her hand, and lightly kissed Merlin’s cheek, leaving a purple lip print. At that moment she thought the kiss was Merlin’s most distracted moment—time to strike. Her other hand shot out, aiming straight for the key on Merlin’s neck. Merlin suddenly shoved Carolona away, his face bored, thinking such hormone‑stirring antics were dull. Though such ambiguous poses and actions could excite many men into losing reason, Merlin was different; he deemed this behavior utterly meaningless. “Huh?” Carolona blinked, a bit dazed, “Are you saying I lack charm?” “Perhaps, you’d better go pester those two over there; I have zero interest in this boring flirtatious game.” Merlin said flatly. “….Carolona was shocked, feeling looked down upon—for the first time someone ignored her charm. “Miss, may I ask your age? I sense you’re not young.” Merlin inquired curiously. “…Ugh, I just turned twenty~” Carolona said embarrassedly—by rights she should be over four hundred. “Lying, your perfume isn’t that of a young girl; it’s the sort a middle‑aged matron uses.” Merlin smiled, knowing full well, “Besides, anyone who actively approaches me is definitely an older maiden or a middle‑aged woman.” Carolona stared, feeling her dignity insulted. Being called a matron! ? An insult no woman could tolerate! If not for the key, I wouldn’t bother approaching this trash villager! Carolona couldn’t hold back—her eyes bloodshot, expression twisted with murderous intent, she resolved to slaughter everyone in the room. She should gather Saint‑tier battle qi, first take down Merlin for the key, but then a knock sounded, forcing her to suppress her urge. “Knock knock knock!” Helena slowly opened the door, smiling politely, gave a slight bow, “Sorry to disturb you all, Mr. Merlin, someone outside is looking for you, please come out a bit.” “Huh?” Merlin frowned. Hobbes jerked awake, a little clearer, hurriedly asked anxiously, “Merlin, could it be your wife coming to fetch you? ?” “Alice?” Merlin’s eyes widened, face shocked, an over‑startled reaction— I’m going. No way! This is my first time coming to a place like this. z(° O°D}

Chapter 20 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 4 · Chapter 20

Narrow corridor,

Helena led the way in front, with Merlin following behind.

From the look of it, they were heading toward a more secluded part of the shop — Alice certainly wasn't coming.

Merlin secretly exhaled in relief. If Alice had shown up, she'd likely have pinned some fabricated charge on him.

Truthfully, Merlin wasn't afraid of Alice. He just found her troublesome.

After all, he and Alice were merely sharing a living arrangement, not actually married. What right did she have to come grabbing him?

Merlin gazed blankly ahead at Helena — a beautiful woman with an air of seductiveness. Now she looked rather mysterious, and he couldn't figure out where she was taking him or who wanted to see him. It was quite puzzling.

Helena walked ahead and stopped at a wall. She twisted a vase beside it, and the wall began to rumble loudly.

Merlin grew slightly alert. For one, he hardly knew this woman named Helena. He feared she might suddenly launch an attack or spring a trap.

The wall in front of him slowly rotated open, revealing a deep, dark passage with no visibility into what lay within.

Helena said nothing and stepped inside, lifting her skirt as if to allay Merlin's suspicions.

Merlin looked at the passage but didn't enter immediately. His heart churned with unease. This Helena wasn't an ordinary person — why was she leading him to an underground secret passage?

"Lord Merlin, please follow me," Helena called from below.

"Why should I go to a place I don't even know?" Merlin touched the tanto at his waist, his expression dismissive. "Didn't you say someone wanted to see me? Where are they?"

"Lord Merlin, please come with me, and I will explain." Helena spoke calmly.

Merlin studied Helena's face, unable to detect any hostility in her eyes.

He decided going along wouldn't hurt — there probably wouldn't be any danger.

Merlin walked calmly into the secret passage to see what game this woman was playing.

The underground passage looked surprisingly clean, likely someone tidied it regularly.

Rows of torches were neatly arranged, illuminating the corridor as bright as day.

The air carried the scent of lamp oil, making one frown.

Neither of them spoke, maintaining an eerie silence.

"Miss Helena, where do you intend to take me?" Merlin asked.

"You'll find out soon enough." Helena replied, showing no inclination to elaborate further.

At the end of the passage stood a massive stone door engraved with strange characters, apparently quite old.

"We've arrived. This is it." Helena stopped before the stone door.

"Hm?" Merlin frowned, not quite understanding.

"It's been a long time." Helena turned around, lifted her skirt, and bowed deeply in a respectful manner. "Lord Lucifer, I..."

Merlin's eyes widened. He suddenly realized that if Helena addressed him as Lord Lucifer, she must be of the demon race — only a demon would use such an address toward him.

"Are you... a demon?"

Helena didn't answer. Instead, she turned her back to Merlin and slowly began removing the upper part of her dress.

The white long dress was gradually lowered to her slender waist, revealing her smooth, bare back.

Her pale skin gleamed under the torchlight, appearing breathtakingly beautiful. Her shoulder blades were exquisitely shaped, forming an graceful arc.

Helena held her own shoulders with both hands and glanced slightly over her shoulder at Merlin in silence.

A drop of cold sweat trickled down Merlin's forehead. What the hell! Why did every girl he met undress in his presence first?

Just as Merlin was at a loss for words, a surge of demonic power erupted from behind Helena's shoulder blades. Many black spots appeared on her pale skin, densely packed as if something was trying to burst forth.

And then—

A pair of pitch-black feathered wings instantly sprouted from her shoulder blades, and one could easily sense the Saint-tier demonic power radiating from them.

The dark wings flapped a few times, nearly extinguishing all the torches. They looked incredibly powerful.

"Lord Lucifer, I believe my wings have made themselves clear, haven't they?"

Helena's eyes glowed with a strange red light, soul-piercing and mesmerizing.

Countless black feathers drifted in the air, chased by the wind.

"... Merlin looked at those sleek, pitch-black wings and had confirmed Helena's identity — she was indeed of the demon race.

Fallen angels were also a part of the demon race, though their numbers were quite rare. Most demons were the true kind with membrane wings growing from their backs.

In principle, Merlin could also display wings from his back, but since his soul was human, his demonic traits were suppressed to the minimum, making it impossible to manifest them.

Legend had it that the fallen angel lineage were poor creatures abandoned by the gods during the Age of Gods. They were later taken in by the first Lucifer and joined the demon race.

After countless generations of reproduction, aside from the black feathered wings on their backs — which differed from true demons — their hearts and souls had been fully assimilated by the demons, making them indistinguishable from true demons.

Fallen angels were an important part of the demon race. Their magical talent far surpassed that of true demons.

Even Samael, one of the Seven Demon Lords, had fallen angel bloodline. It was easy to imagine how highly fallen angels were regarded within the demon race.

Helena slowly retracted her dark wings and gradually put her dress back on. Even while undressing in front of a man, her face showed no emotion whatsoever, as if she felt no sense of shame.

Merlin found it rather unusual to encounter a clansman in Lexem. No wonder he had sensed a familiar demonic aura earlier.

"How did you recognize me?"

Helena finished dressing, turned around, and spoke reverently, "Earlier I heard those lowly humans mention your surname was Luciferfil. I recalled the prestigious family that had once produced two Demon Lords and pieced it together after a bit of deduction."

"My tenure as the Pride Demon Lord was quite short. Few colleagues should have seen my true face. Can you really identify me just by surname? Do humans also bear the surname Luciferfil?" Merlin stroked his chin, finding it hard to believe.

In fact, Merlin wasn't lying — he had only been the Pride Demon Lord for three years.

When his mother served as the Pride Demon Lord, the world had long been in the Human Age. She had reigned for tens of millions of years.

The first Lucifer was even more terrifying. She had lived through the Elf Age, the Demon Age, and more than half of the Human Age. Conservatively, she had lived for hundreds of millions of years!

Compared to that, Merlin's three-year term as Demon Lord amounted to nothing — an instant in the blink of an eye, never even making a ripple in demon history.

That was why Merlin felt there weren't many demon colleagues in the race who knew him personally. He wasn't the Sloth Demon Lord — he was an old monster from the same era as the first Lucifer, whom everyone would know.

"To be honest, I have met Lord Lucifer before." Helena said honestly.

"When!?" Merlin was startled.

"Three years ago. I heard you had just inherited the throne and was holding the Seven Demon Lords' Conference at the First Demon Lord Palace. I served as my lord's guard and accompanied you there. I had the honor of catching a glimpse of you at that meeting." Helena smiled.

"Hm? Whose subordinate are you?" Merlin immediately became interested.

"Lord Lucifer, please allow me to introduce myself..." Helena placed her hand over her chest and bowed slightly, speaking humbly.

"This humble one's name is Helena Feltrin Fitzgerald.

"I serve under the Fourth Demon Lord Palace as the Great Demon General.

"I believe you already understand."

"My lord is your old friend, the Great Demon Lord of the Fourth Palace, the Lust Demon Lord Asmodeus."

title: Chapter 22 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Tickets
content:
Chapter 22 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Tickets

Volume 4 · Chapter 22

On the screen, a woman seated upon a throne appears, beautiful enough to take one’s breath away.

She is wearing an extremely lavish black dress, with a deep front slit.

Her sexy, beautiful legs are on display, clad in tantalizing purple lace‑trimmed stockings.

Her pink hair falls to her waist, and she holds a fan, covering half of her face.

Just those beautiful eyes alone can make a man lose himself.

She must be the legendary Lustful Sovereign, the Fourth Hall Great Demon Lord, Asmodeus.

Merlin glanced at Asmodeus’s gorgeous legs, his gaze a little awkward, thinking, “That guy Asmodeus is getting more and more lewd. What’s his motive dressing like this to meet me?”

A few years ago, Merlin and Asmodeus discussed how to make one’s legs look seductive.

Merlin said that purple stockings with lace trim are sexy, and even gave a detailed explanation of what lace trim actually is.

Now, Asmodeus actually made them and is wearing them himself!

Seeing Asmodeus’s hand‑woven stockings, they’re beautiful; the lace trim looks just like the real thing, proper and presentable.

Sometimes Merlin thinks Asmodeus isn’t cut out to be a Demon Lord, but rather a tailor—he could surely strike it rich.

Asmodeus lifts his long legs, the lines sharp, and with the purple stockings they look irresistibly attractive, as if deliberately showing them off to Merlin.

“Long time no see, Asmodeus, you’re still as beautiful as ever,” Merlin forced a smile, feeling that Asmodeus was indeed gorgeous, but every time that deep, gender‑neutral voice rang out it snapped him back to reality; he recognized that the person before him was a cross‑dressing master with a man’s genitals.

“You’re flattering me,” Asmodeus smiled, still using the fan to hide his face, as if deliberately maintaining an air of mystery. “Helena, why don’t you bring a chair for Lucifer? Letting him stand while talking to me would make it look like I’m neglecting a friend, wouldn’t it?”

“My deepest apologies, Your Majesty, that was my oversight,” Helena quickly bowed and apologized, hurriedly bringing over an expensive chair. “Lord Lucifer, please sit.”

“Though it may not be as noble as your throne, it will suffice for a rest,” Asmodeus said gracefully.

“I don’t really care about those things,” Merlin said bluntly as he sat down.

“The last time we met was a year ago; looking back now it feels like yesterday. I never expected we’d meet again today in this manner,” Asmodeus said softly.

“Indeed, I didn’t expect Miss Helena to be on your side,” Merlin shrugged.

“Helena is my most capable subordinate; I’ve had her run a brothel in Great Britain,” Asmodeus replied coolly.

“You still have that kind of business?” Merlin frowned.

“It’s unavoidable; the economy of our Fourth Demon Lord Hall is in a slump, so we have to rely on other means to survive,” Asmodeus said helplessly.

“It sounds like you’re living a miserable life; you’re supposed to be the Lustful Sovereign, yet your aura just dropped to a low level,” Merlin said, at a loss for words.

“Aren’t you the same? I heard your First Demon Lord Hall also sells demon‑summoning scrolls to the outside. Everyone has a side business, it’s mutual,” Asmodeus sighed.

“Ha, looks like everyone’s life isn’t easy,” Merlin said apologetically with a smile.

“The wealthiest is probably Mammon, the Greedy Sovereign, but he’s so stingy that taking even a single coin feels like a death sentence,” Asmodeus shook his head.

“Can’t you dress in women’s clothes and entertain customers? With your looks you’d make a fortune daily, hehe,” Merlin said half‑jokingly.

Asmodeus’s expression instantly soured; looking at Merlin he suddenly said, “Helena, step back for now; I’ll call you if I need anything.”

“Yes,” Helena silently stepped out, leaving the secret room.

Seeing that only Merlin remained, Asmodeus quietly lowered the fan that had been covering his mouth, revealing a flawless, radiant visage; his thin, elegant lips were tinged with a dazzling crimson.

“Finally you put the fan down, you cross‑dressing pervert. I was just thinking, when old friends meet, why keep up the mystery?” Merlin said with a calm smile.

“Merlin, I hope that in front of my subordinates you can give me some face; the way you’re acting makes it hard for me to command them,” Asmodeus said, a bit dissatisfied.

“Fine, stop pretending to be elegant in front of me. Everyone knows what kind of person you are behind the façade,” Merlin replied bluntly, adding, “But if I have you dress as a woman to serve drinks to customers, it’s truly human—so long as you stay silent, no one can tell you’re actually a man.”

“I am an idol of the demon race; going into the flesh trade is out of the question. Maintaining my purity is the very foundation of an idol’s existence,” Asmodeus said seriously.

“Heh, you’re clearly a cross‑dressing pervert, what idol? That’s laughable,” Merlin said with a face full of contempt.

“Is it really that ridiculous? I seem to recall when we first met, you gave me lecherous looks and even slipped me a little gift. Even a fool could see you were trying to pursue me, hahaha,” Asmodeus retorted with a laugh.

“Shut up! You shameless old thief! I didn’t know you were a cross‑dressing pervert back then! Stop digging up people’s dirty pasts at will, okay?!” Merlin’s brows knit, his anger flaring.

“And now you even come to the brothel I run for fun. Friend, are you lonely? I recall you saying women are a troublesome… back 200 years ago you were willing to be a human‑meat punching bag, a sowing warrior of the new era, and now you just want to be a single dog?” Asmodeus said with a wry smile.

“I swear I’m just here to look around, nothing else,” Merlin’s forehead veins pulsed a few times.

“Fine, as a friend I won’t mock you,” Asmodeus sighed, then continued, “I heard you got fired by the Elders’ Council?”

“Yeah, because I’m too lazy to revitalize the demon race, the elders looked down on me,” Merlin said, rubbing his neck, not telling the truth.

Staying in the Demon Lord Palace, without a powerful enemy to keep me alive, is a reason I can’t really tell others; it involves the secret of my own curse.

“Isn’t it just because you’re too lazy? Go tear down a few of the Church’s temples; the council wouldn’t be able to trace you, yet you choose to stay holed up, refusing to leave the death swamp,” Asmodeus said with a helpless expression.

Merlin smiled without replying, thinking that because of his curse, the Demon Lord position is definitely untenable, unrelated to laziness.

“Do you want me to help? I know quite a few elders in the council; if I write a letter, the Demon Council could reconsider your situation,” Asmodeus waved his fan, extending an olive branch. “What do you think?”

Do you want to get back to your seat?

title: Chapter 23 — Monthly Bonus Chapters
content:
Chapter 23 — Monthly Bonus Chapters

Volume 4 · Chapter 23

"Sorry, I refuse."
Merlin answered lightly, there was no way he could go back—going back would be waiting for death.
No one would give him a life extension; if he really needed one, he'd probably have to cut down his own teammate.

"Hah!?" Asmodeus was astonished, saying in disbelief, "Why refuse? Do you know how rare this opportunity is? Once missed, you truly can never return. As the Lord of Pride, the glory of the throne should be your pursuit, right?"

"Though what you say isn't wrong, I really don't want to go back. Sometimes, feeling free is pretty nice." Merlin answered casually.

"Free?!" Asmodeus narrowed his eyes, saying in a bad tone, "I heard from Helena you became an adventurer? A garbage Iron-rank one?!"

"That's right, haha." Merlin laughed.

"You're really foolish. You have extraordinary talent, power at the Monarch level—how can you willingly be a mere adventurer?"
Asmodeus furrowed his brow, finding it utterly unbelievable.

"Please, I'm just living my life. Don't make it sound like I've fallen." Merlin said helplessly.

Asmodeus glanced at the couple adventurer badge around Merlin's neck, his eyes widening instantly. "You're married!? To a lowly human named Alice Claudiah?!"

"Uh, no..." Merlin felt awkward, thinking the couple adventurer badge was such a hassle.

"No wonder you won't come back—you married a lowly human woman and now have ties that make you not want to leave, right?" Asmodeus's expression was utterly shocked, as if he couldn't accept reality.

"Tch! We—" Merlin was about to explain but got interrupted.

"Good heavens! You, the Lord of Pride, married a human—you've brought shame upon the Lucifel family! There are so many beautiful demon women, and you didn't fancy any of them? You had to choose a human woman. If you can't find anyone, isn't there me?" Asmodeus said, somewhat frantic.

"Wait, what?!" Hearing something weird, Merlin burst out swearing, "Get lost! You cross-dressing freak! Get far away from me!"

"I was just joking, don't take it seriously." Asmodeus awkwardly covered his mouth with a fan.

"Don't misunderstand, I'm not married. This couple adventurer badge is purely a fluke—it's just nominal." Merlin explained briefly.

"So you say that, I'm relieved—you haven't betrayed the demon race, right?" Asmodeus asked seriously.

"No, I currently only work for myself." Merlin answered sincerely.

"Good, I was worried you married a human and would betray the demon race. If possible, I don't want to fight you." Asmodeus sighed.

"Former friends turning against each other? I don't know how you feel, but if you're my enemy, I'll draw my sword without mercy." Merlin said, half-joking, half-serious.

"You're really cold-hearted." A drop of cold sweat rolled down Asmodeus's forehead as he changed the subject. "So you're not planning to return to the First Demon Lord Palace?"

"Not necessarily, let's see." Merlin wasn't sure either; if he was lucky enough to lift the curse, he'd probably only be able to return to the Demon Lord's life.

"If you don't come back, the First Demon Lord Palace will probably remain masterless, and you'll still be carrying the empty title of Lord of Pride." Asmodeus said, frowning.

"What do you mean?" Merlin asked in surprise.

"Even if the council wants to elect a new Lord of Pride, there's no suitable candidate. You know the demon race speaks only through strength—you have to conquer the other Lords with power to be recognized." Asmodeus said with a smirk.

"Speaking of which, my seven generals are quite capable and have the potential to be my successors." Merlin recalled his subordinates.

"You're joking, right? To be honest, your seven subordinates—I could annihilate them in an instant. Their strength is far below Monarch level, and they want to be Demon Lord? Haha~" Asmodeus laughed contemptuously, continuing, "Even if there are capable ones, they have to draw the King's Artifact from your waist to be considered the legitimate successor of the First Demon Lord Palace. Otherwise, if some nobody becomes Demon Lord, who would obey?"

Merlin frowned, feeling this was particularly troublesome. It seemed he was still carrying the Demon Lord title and wandering around everywhere. Though he didn't really want to be Demon Lord anymore, there was no one to take his place.

The most troublesome part was gaining recognition from the other Lords through strength—that was the hardest. Because the other Lords found Merlin impressive; even himself, he had only demonstrated his unstoppable slash to get these guys to acknowledge him and smoothly succeed to the Lord of Pride's throne.

"Based on my speculation, the council elders won't find a suitable candidate to inherit the First Demon Lord Palace, so they'll invite you back." Asmodeus looked knowing. "So my friend, you can't escape—you'll have to come back sooner or later."

Merlin showed an impatient expression, not wanting to chat about these annoying matters. "Is that all you want to tell me today?"

"Of course not." Asmodeus grinned seductively, speaking mysteriously. "Actually, I want you to cross-dress—to make the demon race stand out among the world's ethnic groups. How about we form a cross-dressing duo and debut as idols?"

"Get lost!" Merlin's face turned black instantly; he wanted to smash a shoe horn on Asmodeus's head.

"I've always thought you had talent. Not cross-dressing wastes your pretty face—wouldn't it be wonderful if we both dressed as girls?" Asmodeus said seriously.

"Let me tell you, Asmodeus—even if I scavenge, beg, or steal electric bikes, I'd never go into the sea cross-dressing like that." Merlin said angrily. This bastard actually wanted to drag him into it—he deserved a beating!

"Why are you so resistant? Can't you face your true inner self like me?" Asmodeus fanned himself, his manner fully displaying feminine allure.

"I've already faced it. My true inner self is a straight man—straighter than steel." Merlin responded with emphasis.

"Straight? If I cut off my penis and became a real girl, would you want to marry me?" Asmodeus said seductively.

"Cut it off first," Merlin remained unmoved. "There's no precedent of a demon turning into a girl after cutting off his penis."

"You really don't want to be like me—wearing dresses, being adored everywhere, making men lose their minds, having them ejaculate onto your stockings?" Asmodeus encouraged Merlin.

Merlin's brows knitted, his face turning black. Thinking—

This guy is a sexual pervert.

After chatting with Asmodeus for a while, Merlin stood up to leave.

Helena had been waiting at the door for a long time, ready to see Merlin off.

"My friend, wait a moment." Asmodeus returned to a serious demeanor.

"Hmm?" Merlin turned around.

"You're in Britain right now?" Asmodeus asked.

"Yeah, what's up?" Merlin asked confusedly.

"My subordinates reported traces of hell使者 activity in Great Britain recently. If I recall correctly, you once cut down a demonic apostle from hell?" Asmodeus asked.

"Any problem with that?" Merlin recalled the apostle making him submit to hell, so he naturally cut it down without complaint.

"Hell is very mysterious and not to be trifled with. Besides, you're the man they hate and fear, so please be careful." Asmodeus gave Merlin a piece of advice.

Merlin laughed, spreading his hands, saying casually:

"No worries, who do you think I am?"

"Even if the Lord of Hell, Satan, came, I'd cut him down in one stroke."

title: Chapter 24
content:
Chapter 24

Volume 4 · Chapter 24

Merlin asked Helena how the two old rascals Hobbs and Price were doing. Helena said they were still drinking and having fun, seemingly not wanting to leave. Merlin found this a bit boring, so he decided to go back home. Looking at the time, Alice should have already returned from the training ground. The two left the secret room and headed toward the door.
"Lord Lucifer, if your master still wishes to see you, I will go inform you." Helena said from the side, her position slightly behind making her appear very reserved.
"Sure." Merlin nodded, thinking that talking to himself was also chatting about the shy "fashion" topic, "Helena, do you feel pressure in front of Asmodeus, meaning you feel ashamed of your own gender?"
"This" Helena hesitated a moment, then whispered, "I might feel a little, after all your master is as beautiful as a painting; even as a woman I feel a bit inferior."
"Yeah," Merlin chuckled, thinking Asmodeus was great in every way, the only regret being that he wasn't born a daughter, "By the way, how long have you been following Asmodeus?"
"About a few hundred years; previously I always served as his maid, taking care of his food and daily life." Helena answered honestly.
"Girl+ ah Merlin couldn't help but recall his head maid, who was also one of the Seven Generals of the Demon Lord Palace, often taking care of his and Lilith's life, though her personality was a bit odd—"
"Your Majesty Lucifer, the bed is already made; do you need me to warm it for you?"
"Your Majesty Lucifer, I have tasted all the dishes, there is no poison; these are the utensils I just used, the saliva hasn't dried yet."
"Your Majesty Lucifer, please hand over your underwear so I can personally wash it for you."
The head maid behind the scenes.
"Wow oh oh~, this underwear has Your Majesty Lucifer's scent, filled with male demon pheromones, sniff~~~!"
Merlin put away his memories, a bead of cold sweat trickling down his forehead, thinking his head maid wasn't quite normal; it would be nice if she were like Helena.
"Helena, if I ever return to the First Demon Lord Palace, would you be interested in becoming my personal maid? I think you're far better than my head maid."
Merlin thought that if he were lucky enough to lift the curse, returning to live in the First Demon Lord Palace would be fine, with no worries about food and clothing; having a normal maid like Helena attend to him would surely make life very comfortable.
"Helena's cheeks on both sides flushed a faint red, her mind went straight to the gutter—any fool knows what being intimate entails—she hastily lowered her head, I—I've never done such a thing; even if you are a monarch, you cannot easily trample my will."
"Huh?!" Merlin blinked, then quickly said, "Helena, wait a moment—are you misunderstanding something?"
Helena seemed not to have heard, blushing as she lowered her head and muttered, "After being intimate, one would have to marry, right? I never even thought about marrying a monarch; suddenly being asked this leaves me utterly confused."
"No, I'm just asking if you'd be interested in leaving the Fourth Demon Lord Palace to work at the First Demon Lord Palace." Merlin reorganized his wording.
2 SEz lane.
Helena stared, the flush on her face fading instantly, she bowed deeply to Merlin, "Sorry, Lord Lucifer, I will not leave Lord Asmodeus's side; thank you for your kindness."
Merlin gave a faint smile, thinking indeed he was Asmodeus's confidant, his loyalty quite high.
"Never mind, I was just asking casually."
Helena let out a breath, silently following behind Merlin, looking at the adventurer's proof on his neck.
"Lord Lucifer, may I ask you a question?"
"Go ahead." Merlin said lightly.
"I heard from His Majesty Asmodeus that your strength is immeasurably great, but why are you now a lowly black iron adventurer, mingling with a bunch of base humans?" Helena asked curiously; as a subordinate, she really doesn't know much about her lord's affairs.
"This" Merlin wanted to speak but held back, feeling embarrassed to say.
"There must be some big secret, right? Earlier I heard you were dismissed by the council, and I felt quite surprised." Helena continued her speculation, "Are you now carrying out an extremely secret plan? Similar to letting the demon race revive, so you willingly suffer humiliation by leaving the Demon Lord Palace to divert attention, then sneak into human society, infiltrate the enemy's interior, find an opportunity to enact your secret scheme?"
"e m m" Merlin remained silent, his face black as a mess, "What damn secret plan? It doesn't exist at all; I'm just suffering from late-stage laziness, disliked by the council elders, and I became an adventurer only because I'm poor, to make a living!"
"Actually, whether being a trash adventurer, mingling with humans, or even marrying lowly humans, it's all to cover up that secret plan, right?" Helena sighed, speaking resentfully, "Surely Lord Lucifer is the demon race's savior, wholeheartedly striving for the demon race's revival; even if faced with criticism and doubt, he steadfastly upholds his righteous cause without wavering—you are truly a model for all demons."
Merlin didn't want to speak; Helena had painted herself too lofty, practically a nameless hero of the demon race, while his true situation now was completely embarrassing to admit, feeling ashamed—
Time passed, the two left the brothel; Merlin found himself in a difficult spot, to save face he just went along with Helena's words.
"That's right, Helena, you're very smart; I've hidden this so secretly, yet you still found a clue, because this concerns the fate of the entire demon race, I can't tell you, so you must keep it confidential."
Seeing Merlin's serious expression, Helena immediately became solemn as well, "Alright, Lord Lucifer, rest assured I will absolutely not tell anyone; if you need any help, please let me know."
"I actually really do need some help." Merlin's expression was that of a righteous person.
"Lord Lucifer, please speak; I will surely give you my full assistance." Helena responded earnestly, feeling she was participating in a tremendous plan.
"Because of a certain issue, I owe some money, which has stalled my progress, making me very worried." Merlin showed a worried look.
B SE novel
"Owe a little money, I can help you repay it, as long as the demon race revival plan proceeds normally." Helena instantly turned into an impassioned radical youth.
"Not much, just a few tens of millions of gold coins." Merlin said lightly.
The air suddenly fell silent, not a sound to be heard.
Helena looked at Merlin expressionlessly, slowly closing the shop door.
"Lord Lucifer, wash up and sleep early; feel free to come by when you have time, good night."
Merlin gazed at the tightly shut door, in the chilly autumn wind he was utterly disheveled—
Changing faces faster than flipping a book!
This is completely different from what she just said!
What happened to the promised full help? Women, truly untrustworthy!
z(° O°I)}
On a distant rooftop platform, a black shadow had long been waiting.
Carolina changed back into her black combat outfit, her sharp eyes fixed tightly on Merlin below—
Dark windy night, perfect for murder; the hunt is about to begin.

title: Chapter 25 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 25 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update

Volume 4 · Chapter 25

The moon hung like a small boat sailing through the clouds.

Now and then it spilled beautiful silver light through gaps in the clouds onto the streets of Rexcum.

After night fell, the city was exceptionally quiet, with nothing but the howling of the wind all around.

Merlin didn't call on Hobbs and Price, who were immersed in their joys; he simply walked home alone through the night.

His footsteps echoed clearly along the cobblestone alley path through the pitch-black night.

On top of a certain high rooftop, Carona wore a black combat outfit suited for the action ahead.

The fierce wind at such heights whipped around, ruffling Carona's purple hair and her cape embroidered with gold thread.

Under the large moon like a disk, although Carona's figure was slim and graceful, no one could appreciate her silhouette.

Carona's eyes were filled with intense killing intent. Merlin had just come out of Helena's cottage, and from his height she watched him dead fixated.

Merlin traveling alone on the night road was simply heaven-sent for her, making it easier to quietly eliminate this ungrateful black-iron adventurer.

Even if the other two old rogues were with him, it didn't matter — Carona just needed to dance with her daggers a few more times to send them all to hell.

Hmph, I was originally going to just toss over the key, but you insisted on courting death.

Carona thought about the key to the Hell Legion. She could have stolen it, and Merlin would have kept his dog life. But he deliberately called her an old lady?

Think about it. Although she was a person from 400 years ago, her appearance at this time was that of someone in her twenties. There was absolutely no way she could be considered an old lady.

Anyone would think they were so breathtakingly beautiful that smelly men would throw themselves at her wherever she went, yet Merlin remained unmoved like some weirdo.

Carona held a grudge against that word "old lady," her pride deeply wounded. So she abandoned her calm image and decided not only to snatch back the key to the Hell Legion but also to kill Merlin, to stomp that bastard's head flat under her high heels while shouting—

"I am forever a 17-year-old girl in the bloom of youth, absolutely not a 400-year-old figgy old lady!!!"

Carona was now thoroughly provoked by Merlin. If she didn't kill that bastard, she wasn't worthy of being called one of the Four Heroes of the former kingdom.

Just how strong was Carona?

As a Saint-tier thief who had been famous throughout the kingdom 400 years ago, her strength was naturally formidable.

She was also proficient in the Ancient Dragon Language and could communicate with powerful dragons, commanding them to fight alongside her.

This was the main reason Carona was called the Dragon-Riding Thief — knowing the Dragon Language greatly increased dragons' favorability toward her.

Carona herself also knew a unique assassination art, and her Saint-tier secret technique could kill a person in an instant.

Even now in the distant east, there exists the Assassins' sect founded by the Old Man of the Mountain.

The method they use to train assassins is the technique passed down by Carona, and those who master it each become top-class assassins.

Carona's martial skills were regarded by later generations as textbook-level existence, and her raw strength had long been recorded in the history of the former kingdom.

Legend has it that on a night 400 years ago, invading Sand Russian forces were stationed in the cities of the former kingdom.

At the moment just before dawn, dozens of giant dragons swept over the city sky, blotting out the sun, spitting scorching dragon breath and destroying nearly half of the Sand Russian army.

Carona descended from the sky, her purple figure like a ghost, flickering in and out of the darkness. Using her extraordinary assassination techniques and the strength of a Saint-tier powerhouse, she assassinated seven Sand Russian Saint-tier generals in a single night, shaking the Sand Russian legion to its core.

In the temporary imperial palace of the city, when the Tsar who had led the army in person awoke from his sleep, he was startled to find a dagger and a note left by Carona beside his pillow, reading—

"If you don't滚 out of our territory, next time this dagger will pierce your chest."

At that moment the Tsar was horrified, his gallbladder nearly splitting from terror, and he evacuated the former kingdom with his army at the fastest speed, returning to Sand Russia.

After returning home, the elderly, dying Tsar evaluated Carona in his memoirs as follows:

"Anyone the Dragon-Riding Thief wants to kill will never see tomorrow's dawn. No one can escape that crimson dagger piercing their chest."

Thus a legendary female thief had now set her sights on Merlin, and it looked like he was in serious danger.

The sea of clouds in the sky rolled heavily, completely obscuring the bright moonlight and making the night even darker.

Carona felt it was about time. She pulled two dark-red daggers from her waist, their shapes deliberately curved like a serpent in motion.

These two daggers were carved from the single fang of a Crimson-Eye Demon Snake. Even a grazing hit, though not immediately fatal, would quickly kill with its剧毒 poison.

"Stupid black-iron adventurer, die obediently at my hands, heh heh heh..."

Carona's figure suddenly vanished. She moved lightly across the rooftops, approaching Merlin at an astonishing speed.

Meanwhile, Merlin seemed unaware of the impending danger, still strolling leisurely along the road, wondering what he should cook and eat tonight.

Carona landed on the ground, glaring fiercely at Merlin's back, her eyes full of bloodshot veins, as if in a state of extreme excitement.

Seeing that Merlin remained completely oblivious, Carona was thrilled inside.

She turned into a black shadow, suddenly closing in on Merlin, and activated her Saint-tier martial skill — "Double-Throat Sever."

This martial skill was formidable because it was difficult to defend against. Two daggers struck simultaneously from different directions; unless you blocked both at once, death was certain.

Haha, got him! Killing a villager was ridiculously easy!

Carona's Saint-tier golden battle aura coated her daggers as she revealed a ferocious grin, already picturing the scene of Merlin's throat being pierced by her daggers the next second, blood gushing wildly.

Merlin suddenly felt a cold draft rustling behind him, as if someone was approaching. Without a second thought, he sharply spun around.

"Who's there?"

During his turn, Merlin's elbow accidentally bumped right into Carona's face! ?

The tremendous force caused Carona to let out a shriek as she was sent flying like a cannonball straight into the nearby alley, instantly falling silent.

Merlin looked utterly bewildered, having no idea what had just happened. All he knew was that a purple-haired woman had been "sent" into the adjacent alley by a single elbow strike.

What the heck! Seriously? Some woman just approached me — was she trying to pat my shoulder?

Merlin caught a familiar perfume scent in the air and immediately realized who it was. He shouted toward the alley.

"You're the old lady, right!? Please stop pestering me. I know I'm overwhelmingly handsome and radiate domineering presence — it's my fault for being so attractive that you fell for me. But I'm sorry, I'm not into older women."

After saying that, Merlin quickened his pace and fled the scene, his heart uneasy as he thought—

Was my elbow strike a bit too hard just now?

Did I ruin her looks?

In the alley.

Carona lay against the wall in a bizarre posture, her limbs hanging limply as if broken.

Her entire face was twisted into a grotesque and terrifying shape, with the two daggers scattered on the ground.

Half her face, previously hidden by purple hair, was now exposed — completely rotted away, revealing dark red nerves. Only her eyeballs darted around wildly.

This was clearly a necromantic trait, like an undead zombie, except not as rot-filled and repulsive as Bernard's.

Merlin's unintentional elbow strike had nearly killed Carona, leaving her severely injured.

"Hu ha, hu ha..." Carona's whole body went limp, gasping heavily, cold sweat pouring down her face, her eyes extremely—

"Hey hey hey."

"Is this black-iron adventurer really a villager? This can't be—"

"Are you kidding me? He's obviously far too strong."

title: Chapter 26 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 26 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update

Volume 4 · Chapter 26

The clouds slowly parted, revealing a disc-shaped moon.

The cool moonlight filtered down, lightening the darkness of the night.

The elbow strike earlier had sent Carolina stumbling all the way back, as if every bone in her body had been shattered.

Fortunately, as an undead, as long as her soul fire didn't extinguish, she wouldn't die. She just needed to reassemble her bones.

Carolina twisted her head back into place and used her purple hair to cover the disfigured half of her face.

She slowly stood up, her entire body crackling as bones popped and cracked.

Her deformed limbs twisted and shifted under the moonlight, returning to their proper positions until she was as good as new.

Who was that man named Merlin?

Why did he have such overwhelming power without even trying?

Damn it, she'd been deceived by the Adventurers Guild. This guy was clearly hiding his strength.

How could someone this powerful be a Black Iron adventurer? He should easily qualify for Silverite rank at the very least.

Looks like I'll have some difficulty getting the key on my own. I'm going to need some help.

Carolina was deeply shaken inside, feeling as though she'd walked right into Merlin's trap and been caught completely off guard from the start.

She felt the situation was becoming troublesome. If the key to the Hell Legion fell into the hands of a powerful individual, she'd need to put in significant effort to get it back.

Waves of magical fluctuation suddenly rippled through the air, and a black hole appeared beside Carolina.

This was the spatial magic of the former kingdom's prince, Copeland. Not only could it facilitate communication, but it could also transport objects, making it extremely practical.

Although Copeland was a high-tier magician, the fact that he could wield such useful spatial magic must have been thanks to the Kingdom Codex.

Carolina's heart jumped, and she quickly knelt respectfully before the black hole, her mind racing with anxiety. She'd taken so long and still hadn't obtained the Hell Legion's key, which was clearly an embarrassing display of incompetence.

Carolina finally understood why Bernard had died. It wasn't because someone had finished him off — he'd encountered this mysterious, powerful villager!

If she herself had been gravely injured without much effort from Merlin, who could even imagine what Bernard, that battle maniac, had suffered.

Carolina's thoughts were somewhat muddled right now, not knowing how to explain this to His Majesty.

Copeland: "Carolina, how did things go? It's been so long — did you get the key?"

Carolina: "I apologize, Your Majesty. I just failed!"

Copeland: "What?! You've stumbled just like Bernard, that useless bastard?!"

Carolina: "I sincerely apologize, Your Majesty. If my death would atone for my failure, I am willing to pay with my life. Please extinguish my soul fire."

Silence lingered for several seconds. Carolina wondered if she was about to die. Although she was a Saint-tier powerhouse and had no reason to fear a high-tier magician, her soul fire was damaged by Copeland. If he wished for her to die, she'd be sent straight back to hell.

Copeland: "You are one of the Four Heroes and have rendered great service to the former kingdom. How could I possibly let you return to hell?"

Carolina: "Thank you for Your Majesty's mercy."

Copeland: "So, how powerful was he? Could you do nothing against him?"

Carolina: "Yes, extremely powerful. I didn't sense any magical power or battle aura from him, but conservatively estimated, he should be at the peak of Saint tier!"

Copeland: "What?! Someone like that actually exists?!"

Carolina: "Yes, I was also very surprised. I thought a small place like Rexem wouldn't have any powerful enemies. What frightened me the most was an old warrior named Taylor, but I never expected there to be other strong ones besides him."

Copeland: "Looks like Bernard's defeat wasn't without reason."

Carolina: "Your Majesty, please give me one more chance. This time, I will definitely obtain the Hell Legion's key."

Copeland: "Alright, but you need to hurry. The Royal紫荆 Knight Squad from the capital has started searching for our strongholds everywhere. I hear an Thorn Knight named ZahaJ is in charge of this matter. We must open the passage between the present world and hell as soon as possible and gain the power of the Hell Legion."

Carolina: "Your Majesty, rest assured. I, Carolina, will absolutely not allow myself to fail a second time!"

Copeland: "Are you really okay with this? Even facing a Saint-tier peak expert, you don't have a hundred percent guarantee of winning, do you? Should I send the Twin Sword Sages to help you? Their combined ultimate technique can make even a Saint-tier peak expert struggle to handle it."

Carolina: "No need, Your Majesty. Please trust in my abilities. I alone am sufficient."

Carolina thought of the Twin Sword Sages, the brothers Zoi and Joey. Those two arrogant bastards — if at all possible, she didn't want to seek their help. Her pride simply wouldn't allow it.

Copeland: "Carolina, this isn't a joke. We must have complete confidence in obtaining the key."

Carolina: "Has Your Majesty forgotten something? I can speak Dragon Language."

Copeland: "What do you mean?"

Carolina: "Does Your Majesty still remember the Frost Holy Dragon, Malygos?"

Copeland: "Malygos? Isn't that the guardian holy dragon of our former kingdom? With transcendent Saint-tier strength, few Saint-tier experts could match him."

Carolina: "That's right. Among the Six Great Holy Dragons, the royal family's guardian deity — Malygos, who shares equal fame with the Light Holy Dragon Aelves, who watches over the Vatican Church's temple!"

Copeland: "Could it be that you know where the Frost Holy Dragon is?"

Carolina: "Exactly. When the kingdom fell, the Frost Holy Dragon Malygos was sealed by several thousand court magicians of Britannia atop Ben Nevis Mountain in Scotland, falling into a sleep that lasted four hundred years. But I can speak Dragon Language, so I'm fully capable of waking Malygos."

Copeland: "I see."

Carolina: "With the help of the Frost Holy Dragon Malygos, it makes no difference how many Saint-tier experts come. I have confidence I can slay them all and retrieve the Hell Legion's key."

Copeland: "Hahaha, looks like Britannia's fortune has run out. Even heaven is helping me. If Malygos still guarded the former kingdom, we'd be like tigers with wings added, invincible. What is mere Britannia? In the blink of an eye, we'll turn it into an endless frozen wasteland!"

Copeland's maniacal laughter echoed from within the black hole, and Carolina couldn't help but smile along.

She thought: this Black Iron adventurer named Merlin — whether he's a real villager or a fake powerhouse —

Under the combined assault of the Frost Holy Dragon Malygos and herself, there was absolutely no hope of survival!

The Hell Legion's key would be within easy reach, falling into her hands, and she'd restore the former kingdom's glory!

Carolina had greatly underestimated the situation and completely failed to understand how powerful Merlin truly was. What was the Frost Holy Dragon Malygos compared to him?

Little did she know, the Light Holy Dragon Aelves, who shared equal fame with Malygos, had long been decapitated of his wings by Merlin and now served as a watchdog in the basement of the First Demon Lord Palace.

Merlin slowly made his way home and knocked on the door a few times.

Alice opened it almost instantly, much to Merlin's surprise. He had expected to wait a while.

Actually, Alice was a bit hungry after finishing her training and wanted Merlin to come back and cook as soon as possible, so she'd been waiting for him for a long time.

"Uh, why did you open the door so quickly today?" Merlin asked in surprise.

"Where were you? It's so late and you're finally back. I went to the Guild to look for you but couldn't find a trace of you!" Alice pouted, questioning him with a thoroughly dissatisfied expression. Her scattered silver hair hung over her shoulders, and she wore casual home clothes, making her look cuter and less heroic — though her blue eyes, deep as a still lake, carried a hint of mild anger.

"Oh, I went out…" Merlin waved his finger, thinking he couldn't tell Alice that he'd visited a brothel. Otherwise, with her personality as a righteous little guardian, she'd definitely lecture him. So he gave a vague answer, "Just took a stroll, a casual walk~"

"A walk?"

Alice narrowed her eyes suspiciously. Suddenly, she noticed a purple lipstick mark on Merlin's cheek — the one Carolina had left behind.

Her heart skipped a beat. Where did the lipstick mark on Merlin's face come from? It must have been from some unknown fox spirit who kissed him!

"Hm?" Merlin sensed a trace of hostility and asked alertly, "Alice, what's wrong?"

Alice's face flushed red with anger. Her expression was both furious and aggrieved, a little pitiful too.

A nameless fire surged up in her heart, and her vinegar jar — her jealousy — was completely overturned. She felt incredibly uncomfortable.

Alice couldn't hold back anymore. She reached out and grabbed Merlin's cheek like a jealous wife and interrogated him:

"A walk? Who are you kidding?"

"What's with the lipstick mark on your face?"

"Where were you fooling around just now? Spill it!"

title: Chapter 27
content:
Chapter 27

Volume 4 · Chapter 27

Alice was furiously pinching Merlin's cheek, extremely angry in her heart. Where had this guy been messing around? He had actually been kissed by someone!

Although Alice also understood that she and Merlin didn't really have any substantive relationship, encountering something like this made her genuinely upset, and she herself didn't understand why.

She just felt that Merlin should be more careful. Being close to other girls all the time made her furious whenever she saw it, and she felt odd and uncomfortable inside.

"Eh?! Lip print!" Merlin froze, completely forgetting that Karona had kissed him. He had long since forgotten about that middle-aged woman.

"Yeah! It's a lip print! What are you trying to cover up? Who wouldn't see that huge mark!?" Alice's cheeks puffed up like a stirred-up pufferfish, about to explode from anger at Merlin.

Merlin thought about it himself and found it very embarrassing. Didn't he also have a lip print on his face when he saw Asmodeus earlier? And that Ms. Helena didn't even tell him about it!? Now he realized walking around town with a lip print on his face didn't look like a decent person at all!

"Stop playing dumb!" Alice's eyes were fierce, acting just like a proper wife would. "Tell me the truth right now! Who kissed you!?"

"I haven't gone anywhere, just accidentally got kissed by someone. You know, I'm quite handsome, so middle-aged and elderly women tend to throw themselves at me." Merlin looked away, tapped his head with his hand, and stuck out his tongue, saying, "Ehehe~"

Class: Martial Artist.
