"EpX E τa 1!-φρOσ τ,Maiρ η，av，o!!!"

Karona shouted the final invocation at the cliff, her voice loud and reverberating throughout the entire cave.

The massive magic formation pulsed with intense red light, blazing with extraordinary heat. From the depths of the cliff came a piercing dragon roar.

"Roar!!!"

A sudden cold current erupted from the cliff, causing even more ice spikes to form on the ground.

The dragon pressure that surged skyward was enough to make Karona, a veteran who dealt with dragons frequently, feel a chill of fear.

As one of the Six Great Sage Dragons, he was truly on a different level from ordinary dragons. His power was simply not in the same league!

"Haha, it worked! Come now, Malygos. Four hundred years of slumber is long enough. It's time to come out and breathe some fresh air..."

Karona was ecstatic in her heart. Feeling Malygos's pressure, she knew she could fight anyone who came. What was some village kid named Merlin? Even if he had some skills, he couldn't possibly defeat a Sage Dragon. Besides, she could always resort to underhanded sneak attacks!

A fierce blizzard suddenly blew up from the valley below, and then a blue-and-white great dragon emerged, flapping its powerful membranous wings as it rose from the depths of the cliff!

The fierce wind hit hard, forcing Karona to shield her eyes and channel her Saint-tier fighting aura to steady herself. She marveled inwardly—so powerful! Just his physical body was at this level. How had those court mages ever managed to seal Malygos!? It was unbelievable!

The Frost Sage Dragon flew through the air, the surrounding temperature dropping to an absurd degree. Its graceful flight was filled with an air of nobility.

It possessed a powerful build, a long and thick neck, and ice horns on its head like a crown, radiating limitless oppressive pressure.

Every swing of its long dragon tail caused the very space to quiver, while its pale blue dragon wings blotted out the sky, telling of its great legend!

Its scales were crystal-clear like万年-old ice, shining with a brilliance like gemstones, white and blue blending into perfect art.

Anyone who saw the Frost Sage Dragon would be moved to exclaim—

Ah~! So beautiful. It's hard to imagine the Creator could have brought such a magnificent being into existence!

"Malygos!"

Karona called out. Since the seal had been broken, she would now need to discuss how to obtain the key to the Hell Legion.

Hearing someone address him in the Dragon tongue of his own kind, Malygos sharply turned his massive body mid-flight, circled twice before the cliff edge, and then landed before Karona.

Karona felt as though the Frost Sage Dragon's approach was about to freeze her entire body. She was a Saint-tier expert and an undead—ordinarily, a normal person would have been frozen to death on the spot.

"Huff...huff..."

Rumbles of breath issued from the Frost Sage Dragon's throat, like thunder. It extended its long neck, brought its snout close to Karona, sniffed twice, and blinked its blue eyes, as if thinking—probably finding the purple-haired woman before it vaguely familiar.

"Maip η，av,uoU, kaρτa，εival, η, ρov a，μ E，θuμaσa !"

Karona saw that Malygos didn't seem to remember her, so she quickly introduced herself.

Malygos responded with a dismissive snort through his nose, then actually spoke in human speech.

"Shut up, Karona. I can speak the human tongue. Don't talk to me in your lousy Dragon language—it reeks of barbarian."

"Uh!" Karona felt a waterfall of sweat and black lines running down her forehead, deeply hurt inside.

So he could already speak human language?

Then what had she been doing speaking鸟语 just now?

She could've just used normal speech from the start...

(Dragon tongue is basically Greek. I'm not making this up.)

Summoning Translation:

O Great Sage Dragon, sixth scion, ruler of the icy cold!

O sleeping guardian god of the royal bloodline, awaken at last!

Descend! Frost Sage Dragon, Malygos!!!

Calling his name: Malygos

Explaining identity: Malygos, I am Karona. Do you still remember me?

title: Chapter 32 — Monthly Vote Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 32 — Monthly Vote Bonus Update

Volume 4 · Chapter 32

"Corona, your Draconic sounds exactly like some country bumpkin's slang, hopelessly infected with that rustic stench. It makes my scalp tingle. It's an outright insult to the magnificent language of my kind."

The Frost Saint Dragon Malygris's deep voice rang out, like rolling thunder.

"Cough!" Corona cleared her throat to hide her embarrassment and continued, "It's been a long time, Malygris. I never thought I'd see you again four hundred years later."

"Who allowed you to call me by my name? You should address me as Great Lord Malygris!" The Frost Saint Dragon roared, spewing cold energy from his mouth.

Corona frowned, a layer of frost instantly forming over her body. She had to exert her Saint-tier斗气 to resist, or she would surely be frozen here.

"...Yes, I was careless just now. I apologize sincerely, Great Lord Malygris."

Corona shook off the ice flakes on her body, secretly cursing the giant lizard under her breath.

In truth, Corona was no match for the Frost Saint Dragon. She had no choice but to play along since she needed his power.

"That's more like it. You're not qualified to call me by my name." The Frost Saint Dragon blinked his big blue eyes twice, like gemstones.

"Yes." Corona bowed slightly to show respect. "Great Lord Malygris, congratulations on regaining your freedom after four hundred years of imprisonment."

"Is that so? Did four hundred years pass in just one nap? Those pathetic court wizards actually made me waste so much time. How despicable!" The Frost Saint Dragon's gaze turned furious, pure white coldness billowing from his large nostrils.

"You need not be angry, Great Lord Malygris. Those court wizards have long been forever frozen here by you." Corona lowered her head and said.

"That goes without saying. The price for angering me has only one path—death." The Frost Saint Dragon mused, then changed the subject. "But I must thank you for helping me break the seal."

"You're welcome, Great Lord Malygris. This is what I should do." Corona's expression was respectful, but inwardly she thought, If not to retrieve the key, who would release you back into eternal slumber in the Abyss!?

"Since four hundred years have passed, why are you still alive? You've long exceeded the human lifespan limit, right? And you look exactly the same as before, not a hint of aging." The Frost Saint Dragon narrowed his eyes, carefully sizing up Corona.

Corona lifted her head and slowly swept her purple hair aside, revealing half of her rotting, withered face to the Frost Saint Dragon.

"I see. So you've become a lowly undead? No wonder I can still see you." The Frost Saint Dragon was slightly surprised and continued, "Who is controlling you? To repay you for breaking my seal, I can help you eliminate him."

"No need. I was resurrected by His Royal Highness Copfield." Corona let her hair fall back, her expression calm.

"Copfield? The late king's son? He hasn't died either?" The Frost Saint Dragon found the current situation increasingly incomprehensible.

"That's right. His Royal Highness Copfield has survived until today依靠 the elf race's blood, and is still working tirelessly toward the cause of restoring the former kingdom." Corona gave a brief explanation and continued earnestly, "So Great Lord Malygris, I helped break your seal hoping you would lend us your strength."

"Why should I help you? In the past, it was because of the contract with the late king that I guarded the former kingdom. Now that the former kingdom has been replaced by Britannia, I am free and have no need to continue guarding you." The Frost Saint Dragon clearly refused outright.

"Great Lord Malygris, but I saved you. Surely that's enough to make you lend us a hand?" Corona was somewhat panicked. Don't let all this effort go to waste. Thinking of that powerful villager, she was genuinely a bit timid facing him alone—if she could use terrain advantages, she might dare to fight him one on one.

"You helped me break the seal, so I should help you restore the kingdom? That's an unfair trade." The Frost Saint Dragon shook his massive head. Just because she saved him, he should be a mighty helper for humans? What nonsense.

Corona frowned, sensing things were getting complicated. She began pondering to herself. She felt that if she got the key and let His Majesty gain the assistance of the hellish army, that would be far more powerful than Malygris as an ally. Even if he refused to continue serving the former kingdom, it wouldn't matter much—as long as he was willing to help her get the key, wasn't that enough?

Having figured it out, Corona took a step back and said hopefully, "Alright, Great Lord Malygris, I won't make unreasonable demands. Could you help me take out one person?"

"That's easy. I can agree." The Frost Saint Dragon said deeply. "But Corona, aren't you also outstanding among humans? It's quite rare to hear that you have an enemy you can't handle."

"That person is very strong, likely at the peak of Saint-tier. In a direct confrontation, I don't have full confidence I could eliminate him." Corona said seriously.

"Hmph, peak Saint-tier and you've become like this? How disgraceful, Corona." The Frost Saint Dragon sneered arrogantly.

"Just leave your enemy to me. Stand back and watch—watch how I wield the tremendous power of the great dragon race and crush all obstacles."

"Great Lord Malygris, I think we should use some strategy. You handle the frontal battle, and I'll handle the sneak attack—one strike and it's over. That would be more reliable." Corona was still being cautious.

"Shut up! Corona! Are you looking down on me, one of the Six Great Saint Dragons!?" The Frost Saint Dragon roared fiercely, and a violent blizzard erupted instantly.

"...." Corona gritted her teeth. Her entire upper body was already immobilized, encased in a layer of ice.

"I am the great dragon race! Do I need your help to defeat a trivial human? Cut it out, Corona." The Frost Saint Dragon continued roaring, feeling his dignity had been insulted, and shook his dragon wings violently. "Our dragon race is the most powerful! All other races are mere vermin in our eyes! The powerful enemy you see in your eyes is all trash before me!"

After the Frost Saint Dragon's roar subsided, Corona lowered her arms and knelt on one knee. "I sincerely apologize, Great Lord Malygris. It was my poor judgment."

"Hmph, where is your enemy?" The Frost Saint Dragon asked, as if eager to demonstrate his power.

"I'll prepare right away, and have them come deliver their own deaths..." Corona answered respectfully, but inwardly fumed—

How arrogant a Saint Dragon is this?

This personality is truly uncomfortable.

But one had to admit, the dragon race does indeed have reason to be proud among all races....

Night fell over Rhexem.

Alice's bedroom door was closed tight.

Everything at home seemed perfectly peaceful.

Merlin was fast asleep when he suddenly sprang his eyes open, falling off the sofa with a thud.

He furrowed his brows deeply, clutching his chest, his pajamas wrinkled and crumpled.

A piercing pain surged through his heart, unlike any pain he had ever felt in battle.

That's right, this was the precursor to the curse flaring up—like an alarm bell, warning him that he couldn't live leisurely and needed to find someone to extend his life.

Merlin pressed his chest muscles together, which made it slightly more comfortable.

The pain in his heart tightened in waves, as if it were about to explode at any moment, making him gasp for air frequently. Cold sweat instantly poured down his forehead.

Although Merlin knew the precursor would pass soon, it was still painful.

He knew he couldn't keep drifting through days, enjoying a peaceful life. He had to go kill someone sufficiently powerful.

Enduring the pain, Merlin began to think about things—

The interval between curse flares has gotten shorter this time, hasn't it?

Who was the Saint-tier he killed last time? Oh right, the Goblin Emperor.

As expected, since the enemies were too weak, the effect of relieving the heart curse wasn't strong enough either....

title: Chapter 33
content:
Chapter 33

Volume 4 · Chapter 33

Alice came out of her room in the middle of the night, wanting to use the bathroom.

Because usually, Merlin had already fallen asleep.

So Alice didn't bother covering up either, coming out in a slightly transparent sleep dress.

Highlighting her sexy charm, exposing her neck, revealing a charming collarbone, outlining a fascinating fashionable allure.

Her skin was fair, delicate and translucent, radiating a dazzling brilliance that easily attracted attention.

Her two long, graceful legs bounced with every step.

Alice was still somewhat wary of Merlin. Although they were living together, she couldn't dress too casually and wander around.

Unlike when she lived alone, where anything went. Now that there was a male in the house, she had to be careful about what she wore.

If she exposed too much one day, Merlin—the sex-crazed pervert—might lose his mind, and that would be terrible.

But today was different. The moment Alice stepped out, she saw Merlin kneeling on the floor, hands supporting the ground, cold sweat on his forehead, his face pale and in pain.

Alice took a step back, her first reaction was to flee back into the room, because she was dressed too scantily, making it look like she was seducing Merlin in the middle of the night.

But then she reacted quickly—Merlin, this iron man, could actually be in pain. That was rare. Could something be wrong?

"...Are you okay?"

Alice hurried to Merlin's side, squatting down to examine him carefully, but found no wounds at all.

"What's wrong? Don't pull pranks like this at night. It's worrying."

Merlin frowned, turned his head to look at Alice, and seeing the concern on her face, couldn't help rolling his eyes. He thought: Was he really the type to play pranks out of boredom?

His gaze dropped, seeing how little Alice was wearing, and the slightly transparent sleep dress—the young girl's slender figure looked extremely tempting.

"Damn! What is this thing she's wearing? In the middle of the night, too indecent, right? But even the front of the sleep dress couldn't hold anything up, too shabby..."

Merlin awkwardly looked away, enduring the pain in his heart, pretending nothing was wrong.

"Nothing, it's an old habit. It'll pass soon."

Alice looked at Merlin clutching his chest and asked tentatively, "Chest pain?"

"No," Merlin replied casually, feeling the constricting pain in his heart subsiding, not as bad as before, so he wanted to go back to the sofa.

Alice grabbed Merlin's wrist, trying to help him up, but met stiff resistance.

"I can get up myself, don't hold me." Merlin said不满. Being proud by nature, he really didn't want to accept help.

Although Merlin was a human soul transported from another world, but after over 200 years of磨合, his personality had almost assimilated with the demon race of this world, both having somewhat isolated dispositions.

But Alice was a warm-hearted good person, and quite persistent at that.

"That won't do! Look at how weak you are. If it weren't for me, you might die alone here!"

Alice couldn't help exaggerating, gripping Merlin's wrist harder, her little nose turned up in the air.

"Uh, you this household..." Merlin dripped a few drops of sweat from his forehead, feeling his pride wounded, like a lonely old man being pitied.

"Don't be stubborn, go back to the sofa quickly. The floor is cold this time of year anyway." Alice only felt relieved after helping Merlin back to the sofa.

Merlin was a bit weak from the curse acting up, but being looked at with sympathetic eyes by Alice made him uncomfortable all over.

After getting on the sofa, Merlin covered himself with a blanket and turned over, facing away from Alice, not letting her see his awkward expression.

Seeing Merlin acting like a sulking child, Alice whispered, "What illness is this?"

"It happens often. I'm used to it." Merlin replied casually.

"If this happens again in the future,... you can call me... " Alice's gaze drifted, saying intentionally or not, "It's not that I'm concerned about you. It's just that we have to pay off our debt together. If you die mysteriously, I'd have a headache. Yeah, just that. Don't misunderstand."

"No need." Merlin said without courtesy.

Alice clicked her tongue, looking at Merlin不满. She felt his attitude was arrogant. She had good intentions, but he didn't appreciate them at all.

But seeing that Merlin was physically uncomfortable, she didn't feel like arguing with this stinky demon today.

"I can be merciful and let you sleep in the bed today. Think about it..."

"No thanks, I think the sofa is more comfortable." Merlin replied casually.

"Hmph! Stuck-up guy!" Alice stamped her foot in anger, turned around and walked away, going to the bathroom herself.

Hearing the surroundings go quiet, Merlin secretly sighed with relief. Thinking that he had been pitied by Alice, the "washboard Hero," he really was a failure of a Demon Lord. After all, he didn't need anyone's care.

Thinking about Alice's upright personality—willing to risk her life to save others—Merlin immediately felt relieved.

Although he didn't like saints with overflowing sympathy, as a human himself, Merlin didn't reject kind people.

This week hadn't been wasted. Merlin accompanied Alice in training. As a sparring partner, he hadn't accidentally hit her with a stick again.

Alice felt she had improved a lot, with significant growth in her aura. Thanks to Merlin being there, she could safely enter extremely dangerous states.

Two

Under the pressure of near-death, Alice's training was several times faster than usual. This kind of life-risking training was truly heretical!

But Merlin had a bit of a perfectionist streak, still complaining that Alice trained too slowly, always feeling it wasn't as fast as directly taking drugs.

Even with so many complaints, powerless in magic and combat power, Merlin could only pin his hopes on Alice. He still patiently accompanied her training, hoping she'd reach Saint-tier soon and get the Mithril Adventurer license.

Alice came out of the bathroom and saw Merlin lying motionless on the sofa. She was still a bit worried.

She and Merlin were living together now. If either of them had a problem, the living pressure would fall on one person. That would be bad.

So Alice went to the kitchen, heated a cup of milk for Merlin, placed it on his coffee table, and was about to return to the room when—

"Wait, Alice." Merlin suddenly spoke.

"...What are you doing?" Alice asked疑惑.

"Well... tomorrow we shouldn't rest. Let's go to work?" Merlin suddenly said. Now that the curse was acting up, it didn't allow him to rest.

"Sure, sure." Alice had rested enough these past few days and felt it was time to start accepting quests. "But it's weird for you to be so diligent. You should be living off others and waiting to die. Being lazy every day is the way to go."

"You can't live off savings forever. Earning more money is fine, right?" Merlin said casually. The secret of the curse wouldn't be told to anyone easily.

"Fine then, let's go to the guild tomorrow." Alice thought: Has this guy finally seen the light? She thought she'd have to urge him to work in a few days. Was he moved by her?

"Also... Merlin paused and continued, "Alice-san, we're roommates. Be careful about what you wear at home. Don't be like tonight—I could see your panties under the sleep dress. Are you tempting me to sin?"

"What did you say?!" Alice's face instantly flushed cherry-red. She quickly retreated to her room, shouting angrily, "You pervert! Freak! Can't you keep your eyes still?! Die, you!"

The door was slammed shut with a "bang," and the living room returned to silence.

Merlin slowly turned over, looking at the hot milk on the coffee table. White steam rose gently, stirring his emotions—

Alice was clearly concerned about me, right?

Unexpectedly, it felt kind of cute.

No no, her personality probably acts like that toward everyone. = =

title: Chapter 34 — Monthly Ticket Extra Chapter
content:
Chapter 34 — Monthly Ticket Extra Chapter

Volume 4 · Chapter 34

Alice had returned to her room, her heart pounding with panic, the blush on her cheeks still showing no sign of fading.

Being teased by Merlin had left her inexplicably nervous, as though she'd been deeply humiliated.

Alice hadn't meant to dress like that; it had just happened to be the case, and she knew her outfit was somewhat revealing.

Yet Merlin hadn't considered her feelings at all and had simply blurted out his criticism, leaving her in such an awkward position.

"Absolutely full of H thoughts, you demon. I'll let you off easy this time, but you won't be so lucky next time."

Alice huffed as she climbed back onto her bed, snuffed out the lamp beside her, and curled up with her pillow to sleep on her own.

Before sleep took her, Alice couldn't help but let her mind wander.

Why did her heart race when Merlin looked at her with those explicit eyes?

Did she care so much about Merlin's gaze, afraid he'd see her shameful sides?

Could she actually have feelings for that bastard Merlin?!

No, no, no! How could that be?!

It was all an illusion! Anyone would feel shy being seen like that!

She was the one who liked the great swordsman Elgin!

She needed to be devoted and not... fall for someone new....

Alice thought about the great swordsman Elgin and realized she hadn't heard any news about that mysterious man in quite a while.

That powerful, righteous back view remained fresh in her memory, always appearing in her dreams.

Alice had no idea that she was actually the one who liked seeing Merlin's back and spent every night fantasizing about him before sleep—

My idol, where are you right now?

If only I could share a room with the great swordsman Elgin...

Early the next morning.

Merlin and Alice went straight to the guild.

The two were fully geared up, as though preparing for battle.

Merlin was his usual self, wearing a lazy expression.

But Alice was very serious, looking dashing, like a valkyrie who had descended to the mortal realm.

As soon as they entered the guild, the two saw Hobbs, who grinned and walked over.

"Yo~ good morning, you two!"

"Hmm." Merlin twisted his neck, his face expressionless.

"Hmph!" Alice couldn't help but feel angry the moment she saw Hobbs. She hadn't seen him for several days and had wanted to scold him, yet he had taken Merlin to some improper place like Corona's secret cabin?

"Miss Alice, look, look, are you going to beat me to death first thing in the morning? I haven't even provoked you~" Hobbs said awkwardly.

"You still have the nerve to talk!" Alice gave Hobbs a fierce glare, pointed at his nose and demanded, "A few days ago, didn't you take that guy to some improper shop!?"

"Hmm..." Hobbs grew embarrassed, nearly dropping what was in his hand. "Isn't this no big deal? Merlin is a man too; sometimes he needs some entertainment. You controlling him so strictly isn't a good thing."

"Save it! Let me tell you, don't corrupt him while I'm not around! I absolutely will not allow him to go to such places!" Alice said earnestly.

Merlin glanced at Alice beside him and thought to himself whether he was becoming more and more henpecked? That didn't seem like a good omen...

"Don't be like this, Alice. I know you're husband and wife, but you should relax a bit with Merlin." Hobbs said thick-skinnedly.

"Don't speak nonsense in front of me. If you corrupt Merlin, I definitely won't let you off!" Alice's expression was fierce, as if she were about to draw her sword at any moment.

"Don't make it sound like it's all my responsibility. Actually, Merlin is quite the womanizer too; he wanted to go as well." Hobbs raised his eyebrows, looking quite smug.

"I don't really want to go to such a place..." Merlin said resignedly, thinking to himself, women? Hehe~

"Don't talk nonsense. Didn't you have fun last time when we went out together? Just think about that sari dancer, dancing while riding on top of you, how sexy~" Hobbs felt a bit excited just thinking about it now, but that sari dancer had left as well after seeing Merlin depart.

"Enough!!! " Alice drew out a portion of the slender sword at her waist, almost furious enough to pop a vein. Just thinking about other girls dancing while riding on Merlin made her extremely uncomfortable. "I'm warning you, Hobbs! This time I'll let it go, but if there's a next time, I'll definitely send you to hell!"

"Miss Alice, please calm down..." Hobbs saw Alice's sharp blade and his face instantly turned pale. He earnestly said, "I understand, please don't get so worked up. I promise there won't be a next time."

"Hmph!" Alice snorted and sheathed her slender sword.

Hobbs leaned close to Merlin and quietly said, "Brother Merlin, it's not easy having a wife like that. Us henpecked husbands are all angels with broken wings~"

"We're not a real married couple..." Merlin muttered under his breath, utterly exasperated.

"Alright, alright. I know you hold a grudge in your heart. Leave this to your bro. As a long-term victim of henpecked husbands, I naturally have all sorts of methods to help you dodge your wife's surveillance so you can continue having fun~" Hobbs sent a series of suggestive looks at Merlin. As the captain of the brothel-going squad, how could he easily abandon a teammate?

Merlin sighed, feeling extremely helpless in his heart, thinking that among those girls, only Helena was decent, very feminine, but that girl only handled reception duties...

"Hobbs, what are you whispering about sneaky-like!? That creepy expression of yours means it's definitely nothing good!" Alice furrowed her pretty brows, wanting nothing more than to clean up Merlin's shady companions.

"Nothing, nothing. Just saying that Miss Alice is wonderful and that one should cherish what they have." Hobbs said, breaking into a cold sweat.

"Hmph. Let's go."

Alice grabbed Merlin's arm and walked off, not wanting to say another word to the old rascal, leaving Hobbs凌乱in place.

The two arrived at the request bulletin board and carefully searched for their next job.

Although there were quite a few posted requests, there weren't many suitable ones.

And some contents weren't detailed enough; they had no idea what level of enemy might appear.

Merlin frowned. There were several S-rank requests that seemed to involve powerful enemies, yet he couldn't find a single one that explicitly stated the need to defeat a Saint-tier powerhouse.

He didn't want to waste too much time; at the end of the day, he'd be busy for nothing and his curse would remain completely unrelieved. That would be terrible.

Just as the two were at a loss, Lucia suddenly called from behind the counter, "Alice, come over here quickly, there's something."

Alice hesitated for a moment, then pulled Merlin over to Lucia and asked curiously, "What's wrong, Lucia?"

"Looking at your appearance... are you about to start work?" Lucia scanned the two with her eyes.

"Yes." Alice nodded, then said somewhat helplessly, "But I just glanced around earlier, and it seems there isn't anything suitable."

"It's fine if there isn't anything suitable. Yesterday, I received a designated request here, specifically looking for the two of you." Lucia said patiently.

A designated request was a method used by the Adventurers Guild, allowing someone to specifically request a particular adventurer of their choice to complete the task they posted.

Generally, the more famous an adventurer was, the more designated requests they would receive. Most people tended to trust well-known and powerfully capable adventurers, because entrusting tasks to them often provided a certain degree of assurance.

This was Alice's first time receiving a designated request, and she asked in great surprise, "What kind of task? Why would they designate us?"

"It's a request from a Scottish villager..." Lucia was efficiently going through a stack of request parchment and continued, "It says that a village near Ben Nevis is being plagued by a giant dragon, and they hope the two of you will go help resolve the situation."

title: Chapter 35 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapters
content:
Chapter 35 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapters

Volume 4 · Chapter 35

"Is a giant dragon harassing the village?"

Alice looked puzzled, thinking that ever since the great migration of the other races to the Southern United Kingdom, humans had rarely seen dragons.

Earth dragons, a sub‑species of draconic beings, are quite common, but they’re mostly used for pulling carts because they’re much stronger than horses.

"That's right, it seems to be a recent incident. I heard that the dragon made winter arrive several months early and also destroyed houses, the worst part..." Lucia, while busy searching for a named commission, looked up seriously and said, "This dragon eats people."

Merlin's expression was flat, showing no surprise. In fact, many of the other races have a habit of eating humans, treating them as huntable food—dragons, beastfolk, sea peoples, and even the demon race will eat humans raw or roasted.

But Merlin, being a human who had traveled from another world, had never eaten them; his body and mind recoiled. Still, other demons told him that human flesh tastes much like chicken—crunchy and crisp.

"Eat people?!" Alice felt her heart flutter and was a little frightened.

"Yes, it does eat people. The named commission says that the evil dragon demands the village sacrifice a virgin under twenty every three days for it to eat. If they don't provide one, it will slaughter part of the villagers. It seems a girl has already been killed," Lucia said with a stern expression.

"...." Alice furrowed her delicate brows, and a small flame of justice instantly flared wildly in her heart.

Although she knew dragons were powerful beings, as long as they weren’t Saint‑tier dragons, she felt she could handle them in a single battle.

If it were a Saint‑tier dragon... wouldn't Merlin be the one to take care of it?

Alice immediately pulled Merlin onto the “pirate ship,” already planning to set off for Scotland to rescue the villagers in dire straits.

"Found it!" Lucia finally located the parchment of the named commission, unfolded it, and showed it to Alice and Merlin. "This is the commission; if we succeed, we can earn 20,000 gold!"

"Twenty thousand?! That's a generous revenge..." Alice couldn't help but exclaim, thinking that she could both uphold justice and earn a substantial reward, though the higher the bounty, the greater the difficulty.

Merlin was also a bit tempted; the payment was good. He wanted to see exactly what the commission entailed.

He took the parchment from Lucia's hands and looked at it together with Alice. The main contents were—

Commission Rank: S

Details: In the village of Rowickol at the foot of Ben Nevis in Scotland, a cold‑blooded evil dragon has been harassing the area, demanding a virgin under twenty be offered every three days for its consumption. The villagers are suffering heavy losses and beg adventurers to slay the dragon.

Requirements: Merlin of Reckserum County and Alice couple are to accept this mission.

Reward: 20,000 gold.

Commissioner: Simon Anne.

After reading it, both let out a sigh, feeling that the only noisy point was Merlin and the Alice couple!?

"We're not really a married couple, yet we're being called a couple?" Merlin frowned.

"Yeah, being called a couple is awkward," Alice replied, a bit dissatisfied, then floated up again. "But being given this named commission must be thanks to my merit; after all, I performed brilliantly in the Dembi County undead incident and have become somewhat famous, ha~"

"That time had nothing to do with you at all..." Merlin retorted lightly, feeling that Alice had no right to be proud.

"Alright, you two, isn't this the time to worry about such trivial matters?" Lucia slid three black lines down her forehead, thinking these two really couldn't tell what's important.

The two calmed down a little and began to think about the evil dragon commission.

Alice wanted to take the commission, but adhering to team spirit, she still needed to ask Merlin, "What do you think?"

Merlin fell silent, momentarily indecisive. Although the reward was attractive, he didn't know how strong the dragon actually was.

If it were a Saint‑tier, he'd set off immediately; if not, it might be a waste of his time.

"Whoa~" Hobbs, the lingering specter, shuffled over, having peeked at the dragon commission several times. "It's the dragon that attacked Rowickol village..."

Merlin suddenly remembered that Hobbs was always well‑informed and thought to ask him, "Hobbs, do you know anything?"

"I heard travelers say that the troublemaker in Rowickol village is a Saint‑tier ice dragon, not an ordinary dragon—very powerful," Hobbs stroked his chin, sounding uncertain.

"Is everything you said true?" Merlin narrowed his eyes. If Hobbs wasn't exaggerating, Merlin would be willing to head to Rowickol right away.

"I've only heard rumors, but it's not impossible. Think about how Ben Nevis sealed a monster 400 years ago," Hobbs said softly, recalling countless court mages who used their lives to seal Marigous.

"Monster? Is it strong?" Merlin asked tentatively, his interest piqued.

"Not just strong—it's one of the Six Great Saint Dragons, the Frost Saint Dragon Marigous," Hobbs inhaled a cold breath, thinking how terrifying it sounded.

Alice stared in shock, her eyes wide, never expecting that Ben Nevis had once sealed one of the legendary Six Great Saint Dragons. The Six Great Saint Dragons are said to each command top‑tier elemental power, the elite among Saint‑tier beings.

Many Saint‑tier heroes together still couldn't match any single Saint Dragon; their strength is evident.

As one of the six sovereigns of the dragon race, their power is far beyond what humans can resist.

Alice also recalled her teacher's tale of the Frost Saint Dragon Marigous, who centuries ago froze half of the Greenland Sea for days and nights, turning the raging ocean into solid ground—a terrifying, bottomless magical force.

Alice gave Merlin a strange look, remembering that he once said the Light Saint Dragon Aevus, also one of the Six Great Saint Dragons, was imprisoned beneath the Death Swamp...

Merlin remained expressionless, thinking, "Six Great Saint Dragons? What junk?" He remembered that a few years ago the Church's guardian Aevus was also called that, initially arrogant, then forced to submit when a blade was drawn, now its wings cut off, dubbed "Wangcai," serving as a watchdog in the Death Swamp.

"In my estimation, the dragon harassing the village might actually be the legendary monster, Marigous!" Hobbs voiced his speculation, though he tended to exaggerate.

"Stop messing around!" Lucia thought Hobbs was being alarmist, saying irrelevant things—

"If it really is the legendary Frost Saint Dragon Marigous..."

"The whole of Britain would fall into extreme panic!"

"In the kingdom, perhaps only ten thousand Thorn Knights could stand against it!"

title: Chapter 36
content:
Chapter 36

Volume 4 · Chapter 36

Alice hadn't dared to speak earlier; Hobbs's words had frightened her a bit. If the one harassing the village really was the legendary Frost Holy Dragon Marigous, she was no match at all. The danger level of this commission was also very high, definitely far beyond S rank.

Alice glanced at Merlin beside her, saw his expression was very calm, and she still couldn't decide.

title: Chapter 37 — Monthly Vote Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 37 — Monthly Vote Bonus Update

Volume 4 · Chapter 37

Arnold entered the room and saw Alice, as if he were looking at an angel in armor.

Such a lucky coincidence—who would believe it isn’t destiny’s guidance?

Arnold, lost in his own thoughts, rushed forward and presented the rose.

“Miss Alice, please give my heart back to me!”

“Huh? Exchange what?” Alice furrowed her brows, didn’t take the rose, thinking what Arnold was up to!

“You stole my heart long ago, keeping me sleepless, thinking of you every moment. These past days I’ve thought it over, and I figure you don’t accept me because my love isn’t passionate enough. From now on, I’ll pursue you fiercely!” Arnold became dazzling, like the male lead of a shoujo manga, “So, Miss Alice, will you change your mind and love me?”

Merlin got goosebumps and whispered, “He’s pretty infatuated, isn’t he?”

“Get away from me, I’m annoyed by you.” Alice replied softly, then awkwardly laughed at Arnold, “What nonsense are you spouting? Please just be normal, okay?”

“Miss Alice, I’m perfectly normal now, and my love for you is truly sincere!” Arnold said earnestly.

Alice looked at Arnold’s romantic, bard‑like gaze and felt a shiver, “Arnold, no matter how many times you harass me, my answer is always refusal. Please stop bothering me, okay?”

“No! Miss Alice, I will never give up. True passionate love means relentless pursuit!” Arnold’s nerve seemed thicker than before.

“Go away, we’re about to start work, don’t bother me!”

Alice ignored Arnold’s chatter, grabbed Merlin, and headed out of the guild.

“Work?” Arnold stared blankly, then turned and shouted, “Miss Alice, I have a splendid, comfortable carriage, I can give you a ride.”

“No need!” Alice replied loudly, turning back and said—

“My little donkey‑cart is quite comfortable too…

_book.SFA

Bennivis Mountain.

Inside the cave that seals the Frost Saint Dragon.

SF Light Novel

“Really making me threaten the villagers at the foot of the mountain, what a degradation of status.”

The Frost Saint Dragon Marigous hovered at the cliff edge, its massive, beautiful body almost filling the entire space.

Especially its huge wings—each slight tremor could unleash a violent blizzard.

Karona stood before the Frost Saint Dragon, bowing slightly, her attitude exceedingly respectful.

“I am deeply sorry, Lord Marigous, for tarnishing your glory; I truly deserve death to atone!”

“Enough…” The Frost Saint Dragon flicked its tail a few times, exhaling fierce cold from its nostrils, “Humans are insignificant to me, utterly worthless. Killing countless weeds won’t earn immortal merit, though the taste is not bad…”

“Yes!” Karona bowed her head deeply, thinking that this great lizard would never submit to humans; how the ancient king once forged a pact with it was a mystery.

“I will continue to threaten the village below; your enemy will come here, won’t he?” the Frost Saint Dragon asked in a low voice.

“Exactly, I have issued a targeted commission; they’ll surely arrive soon.” Karona replied seriously.

“Good, I dislike waiting; it feels dull and tasteless.” The Frost Saint Dragon’s icy‑blue eyes showed a hint of world‑weariness, “I’ll help you eliminate your foe, and I’ve decided to visit the Vatican; it’s been a long time since I talked with that fellow, Evise…”

“Eh?” Karona seemed to have heard something second‑hand.

“What’s wrong, Karona? Your expression looks like you have something to say.” the Frost Dragon questioned.

“Lord Marigous, I heard something involving Lord Evise, but I’m not sure if it’s true.” Karona answered awkwardly.

“I heard that the Light Saint Dragon Lord Evise has already died at the hands of the arrogant monarch of the demon race.” Karona replied earnestly.

“Impossible!?” the Frost Saint Dragon roared, dropping the surrounding temperature sharply, and began to bellow, “How could the filthy demon race kill Evise!?”

Karona felt the temperature drop too low and had to summon Saint‑tier qi to resist, “I… I only heard…”

“Impossible!” the Frost Saint Dragon let out a howl, a blizzard sweeping the cavern, “How could an arrogant monarch be a match for Evise! As the Light Saint Dragon, it has absolute counter‑measures against dark beings; a mere arrogant monarch could never defeat Evise, let alone kill it!”

The freezing cold made the undead Karona suffer, so she quickly changed tack, “Maybe… it’s just a rumor. I don’t believe that a great dragon race, equal to Lord Marigous, could be slain by a filthy arrogant monarch.”

“Enough.” the Frost Dragon lowered its voice, sounding a bit anxious, “Finish your business quickly. I’ll investigate this myself. It’s just an arrogant monarch, right? I want to see what he’s capable of. The filthy demon threatens our great dragon race—what a fool’s dream!”

“Yes! I’ll disguise myself and return to the village, waiting for them to walk into the trap.”

Karona lowered her head, golden qi rose from her feet, slowly engulfing her head.

In a short time, Karona transformed into a girl with deep‑brown curls tied into a ponytail at the back.

She wore simple linen clothes, and her small face bore light freckles, giving her a very innocent look.

Only her deep eyes appeared unusually mature and alluring, not like a naive girl.

As a thief, Karona excelled at disguise, and after the change she looked almost identical to her original self.

As long as she mimics the personality well, no one will notice the impersonation—a true art of confusing enemies.

Now Karona plays the role of a villager, waiting to ambush Merlin and deliver a fatal blow.

Her current name is—

Simon Anne, an ordinary village girl with no parents, raised by the old village as an orphan.

The targeted commission was also issued by Karona while disguised as Simon Anne.

The real Simon Anne had long been killed by Karona, her corpse dumped in the wilderness and fed to wild dogs.

All the traps are now set, just waiting for Merlin and Alice to bite.

A few days later.

On the road to Bennivis Mountain.

Alice and Merlin arrived in Scotland.

They took turns driving the donkey cart, and were almost at the village where the incident occurred.

The white snow fell like willow catkins and poplar fluff, covering the grayish sky in a swirling blanket.

On both sides of the plain, a thick layer of frost had formed, white and somewhat beautiful.

Even though it was noon, the sun hidden by the snowstorm could not break through, leaving the sky dim.

Merlin held the reins, staring ahead; the closer they got to Bennivis Mountain, the colder it became, and even the donkey’s cheerful pace slowed.

Alice hadn’t expected it to become so cold all of a sudden and, unprepared, quickly felt uncomfortable.

Merlin, however, had the foresight to buy a woolen scarf and wrap it around his neck, making it less painful.

Alice hugged her arms together, rubbing back and forth, stamping her feet with her shoes repeatedly to warm herself a bit.

Even so, Alice still felt very cold, her complexion turned pale, and her silver teeth chattered.

Merlin glanced at Alice, seeing her white breath curl in the air, and couldn’t help recalling the hot milk from that night, a complex feeling stirring in his heart, a faint warmth.

“Alice, come closer.”

“Hm?” Alice looked at the expressionless Merlin in surprise, hesitated, then shifted her hips toward him.

“Tsk! Come a little closer, can I really kill you?” Merlin said helplessly.

…What are you doing?” Alice’s mind was uneasy.

“Just come over, that’s all, no need for so many words.” Merlin’s expression grew impatient.

Alice puffed out her cheeks as if protesting, dissatisfied with Merlin’s somewhat forceful attitude, thinking, “What the heck is this bastard doing?”

But Alice quickly thought maybe he saw she was cold and wanted to take care of her.

The two squeezed together, thinking it would make them a bit warmer, and so on…

Alice felt a slight warmth in her heart, thinking that sometimes this guy wasn’t completely heartless; occasionally he showed a hint of gentlemanly charm.

But a former Hero cuddling up with a former Demon Lord for warmth? It made her a bit repulsed.

Alice hesitated, a cold gust blew in, making her shiver, and she decided to rely on Merlin.

Merlin gave Karona a sidelong glance, wondering why she thought he would harm her; he wasn’t that bored.

“If you don’t come over, that’s fine, saves a lot of trouble.”

“…I didn’t say I wouldn’t come over! Don’t decide for me! If I’m coming, I’m coming! Who’s filming this?”

Alice blushed, slowly moved her hips next to Merlin, pressing close enough that the cold wind could no longer reach them.

She wasn’t sure if it was an illusion, but a faint warmth seemed to emanate from Merlin’s body.

It was indeed much warmer; perhaps a demon’s body temperature is a bit higher than a human’s?

Alice stared blankly, instinctively leaning closer to Merlin, letting their shoulders touch, feeling instantly more comfortable.

Indeed, a demon’s temperature is slightly higher; a simple skin contact reveals the difference.

Now Merlin served as both a heater and a windbreak, even a makeshift chair—truly multifunctional.

Seeing Alice lean in, Merlin’s face showed a silly, happy expression, probably delighted that the cold had left him.

That idiot, the washboard hero, is such a hassle…

Merlin muttered a curse under his breath, untied his wool scarf three times, and unceremoniously wrapped it around Alice’s neck, letting them share one scarf for warmth.

Merlin’s whole demeanor remained expressionless, cold on the outside but acting like a big warm‑hearted man.

“See, now you’re warm enough, right?”

title: Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update

Volume 4 · Chapter 38

Snowflakes drifted in midair, white and gleaming, pure and beautiful.

In an instant, the icy wind that had been sweeping across the fields seemed a little less fierce.

Shoulder to shoulder, they pressed close together, leaving no room for anyone else to squeeze in.

The atmosphere suddenly turned a bit sultry, and even a single glance seemed to carry a burning warmth.

These flashes of light kept blooming, drawing countless lonely men into wild frenzies.

A red scarf was wrapped around both their necks, instantly drawing the two closer together.

Originally enemies from opposing camps, who would have thought they'd end up sharing a scarf to keep warm?

It wasn't anything expensive—just a few dozen silver coins—but at this moment, it felt incredibly warm.

Merlin held the reins, his expression extremely calm, as if he hadn't done anything special at all. In his mind, he was just lending Alice half a scarf. Nothing to get worked up about. After all, there's an old saying about reciprocating kindness, isn't there? She'd taken care of me once, and I'd taken care of her once. Very fair.

In truth, Merlin was doing this for the first time, but he didn't feel particularly moved by it.

After all, he was a Demon Lord at the pinnacle of power, and human emotions were something he had little use for.

Yet just now, the human feelings that had been dormant in Merlin's heart for a long time seemed to have stirred slightly.

Merlin, the sovereign who was extremely arrogant and aloof, would never admit that he cared for Alice.

But remembering that night when Alice looked worried, and that cup of steaming milk, a trace of warmth still flickered in his heart.

Still, Merlin knew that the two of them were only forced together by the pressures of life. It wasn't love at all—just wounded stray dogs licking each other's wounds. (?) py Q E

Unlike Merlin's completely calm demeanor, Alice was clearly not doing well at all. Her heart felt like a great wave was churning within.

...What the hell!?

This bastard suddenly got so kind!

It's making me not know how to respond to this situation!

He just directly put a scarf on me without even asking for my opinion first!

Still, it's really warm and cozy...

Alice's eyes widened like blue sapphires, her small mouth forming an "O" shape, with a faint blush rising on both cheeks. She clutched the scarf around Merlin's neck, looking dazed and confused, like a startled cat.

What the heck? Suddenly turning into a big warm guy, being so attentive to me... Did you eat the wrong medicine? SE2 novel

Alice muttered silently in her heart, grabbed at the wool scarf, her lips moving for a long time without saying a word, but she couldn't bring herself to take it off either, because it really was warm and comfortable around her neck.

Merlin glanced at the dazed Alice and asked, "Alice?"

"Eh? That... Alice came to her senses, and the blush on her face still hadn't faded."

Merlin furrowed his brow, seeing Alice's flushed face, feeling awkward, "You're blushing..."

"I... I'm... Alice, with a burning red face, stammered, "It's because it's cold, that's why my face is red! It's not because I'm shy! Don't imagine things!" SE2 novel

Merlin narrowed his eyes, thinking, This troublesome woman, could she be falling for me? That's such a headache.

He examined Alice carefully. Besides being able to tell she was flustered, he couldn't see anything else, so he figured it was just from the cold.

"...What are you staring at? Stop looking at me!" Alice couldn't help but say irritably, getting nervous under Merlin's gaze.

"Says the one who wants to look at me..." Merlin withdrew his gaze and said casually, "It's warmer now, right?"

"...". Alice looked down at the scarf, then turned her face away with a haughty tone, "It's just so-so, barely enough to ward off the cold. It's just cheap stuff anyway, no point expecting much warmth from it, huh~!"

"Tch!" Merlin clicked his tongue, seeing Alice's lofty demeanor, feeling a bit annoyed, "Wearing such cheap stuff is really something, quickly give it back to me."

"Ugh!" Alice's face flushed bright red, looking pitifully at Merlin without saying anything, thinking to herself, I was just saying that, and this guy actually took it seriously!

"What are you staring at?" Merlin furrowed his brow, reaching out his hand, "The scarf is still mine..."

"...". Alice clutched the scarf tightly, looking flustered, quickly changing her words, "I didn't mean it like that! It's fine even if it's cheap, as long as it keeps the cold away, right? Seriously, you're so mean to me at times!"

Merlin rolled his eyes, listening to Alice's increasingly quiet complaints, he couldn't be bothered to argue with her, and focused on driving the donkey cart. The road was bumpy, jolting up and down.

Alice saw that Merlin stopped talking, gradually relaxing, and tentatively asked, "Why did you think to buy a wool scarf?"

"What, are you stupid?" Merlin replied without any courtesy.

"SE novel"

"...Don't curse at me!" Alice frowned, wanting to pinch Merlin's ear.

"Lady Roxy did say that the big dragon made winter come several months early, so we should prepare some cold-weather gear."

Merlin replied calmly.

"...". Alice remembered that Roxy had indeed said something like that, but she had quickly forgotten it. "When you bought the scarf, why didn't you tell me?"

"To be honest, I didn't expect you to be this slow." Merlin said expressionlessly.

"Who's slow?!" Alice got angry, grabbing Merlin's coat and shaking him, "Take back what you just said!"

"Stop messing around! I'm driving, and if you cause me to crash, whose fault would that be?" Merlin's brow was tightly furrowed, impatiently casting a glance at Alice.

Alice huffed in resentment, although she was annoyed by Merlin's attitude, the act of him putting the scarf on her was still quite touching.

No, no! What kind of feeling is this?

This is a really big problem!

The person I like is the mysterious Elkin legend, the great swordsman!

Not some petty, lazy, self-important First Demon Lord!

Getting all flustered over something so trivial, making me act like some promiscuous girl!

Alice felt embarrassed about being taken care of by Merlin.

She suddenly thought of something, quickly turned around and rummaged through her things, finding a paper bag with apples she had prepared to eat on the road.

Each apple was bright red, exuding an enticing fragrance, looking very appetizing.

Alice took one out in her hand, looked at Merlin beside her, then at the red apple in her hand.

For a moment, she was a bit reluctant, not wanting to share it with Merlin, feeling it would be a shame to let him have the first bite.

But if she didn't return the favor to Merlin, she would feel guilty.

Dazed Alice hesitated between her husband and the food for a long time, biting back the painful feeling, and forcefully shoved the red apple against Merlin's face.

"...Here, eat one!"

"Eh?" Merlin was startled, his face being pressed and distorted by the apple, thinking, This ice-cold apple is so uncomfortable to press against my face. Is this damn laundry-obsessed hero causing trouble? What nerve!

"I... I just felt sorry for you... so I'm magnanimously letting you have one!" Alice hurriedly closed her eyes tightly, seemingly giving her own food to Merlin, her face twisted in discomfort and embarrassment.

"...But I'm saying this in advance.

"You can only take one small bite, don't eat more!"

"Otherwise... otherwise I won't talk to you anymore!"

"Huh~!"

title: Chapter 39
content:
Chapter 39

Volume 4 · Chapter 39

Merlin was stunned for a moment, thinking Alice was deliberately picking a fight, only to realize she was offering it to him.

He looked down at the apple, then at Alice's reluctant expression, and said lightly, "I don't need it."

"Eh?" Alice froze, not expecting Merlin to refuse. According to her reasoning, he should have been happy to take advantage.

"What 'eh'? I said I don't need it." Merlin said impatiently.

Alice took the red apple down and rubbed it with her finger, tentatively asking, "Are you really sure you don't want it?"

"Mm." Merlin coldly replied with one word, thinking that since she was so unwilling, why bother pressuring her?

Alice instantly deflated like a punctured balloon, thinking Merlin was really tactless. She kindly offered him food, and he actually refused. That kind of rejection felt quite uncomfortable.

"Fine, don't want it! I'll eat it myself!"

Alice said crossly, growing more and more annoyed with Merlin. She then viciously took a bite of the apple.

Because the temperature around them was low and light snow was falling, the moment she bit into it, she felt an intense coldness that made her expression twist together in discomfort.

"So cold! So cold! Aaaaaah..."

Alice covered her small mouth, feeling like her teeth might not hold out much longer. She looked about as if she'd eaten something sour.

Merlin chuckled heartlessly beside her, thinking this girl was truly dumb to the core.

Alice glared resentfully at Merlin, her frustration surging from somewhere deep inside. She felt Merlin was deliberately setting her up just to watch her embarrass herself.

If it weren't for that wool scarf, who would willingly offer their things to him?!

Alice stole a glance at Merlin and wondered why he had given her the scarf in the first place. He wasn't usually this kind, right? Could it be...

He wanted to do her a favor, try to recruit her into the demon race as an ally, and then rule the world?! Become a member of the evil faction! Oh my god! This is too terrifying!

The way Alice looked at Merlin changed completely, filled with vigilance. If this were true, it would be better to return the scarf. She didn't want to get involved with an evil person.

"Hey, why did you suddenly put that scarf on me? Why are you suddenly being so nice? I feel like there's a trick~"

"No reason. You kept stomping your feet and it was getting on my nerves," Merlin said with a half-smile.

"Aren't you trying to drag me into some evil plan?" Alice's expression was very serious, utterly devoid of humor.

"Huh?" Merlin looked at Alice and thought she was being ridiculous right now. "What evil plan? Are you crazy..."

"Hmm?" Alice tilted her head. Merlin didn't look like he was lying. Had she misunderstood?

But why was he being so nice to her? There was absolutely no logical reason!

...Unless he likes me?

Actually, that seemed quite possible. After all, I'm this pretty, and my personality is cute. Even someone like him would be captivated by me, right?

But I don't like Merlin. I like the great swordsman Elgin. This is so troubling.

Besides, I'm a former Hero and he's a former Demon Lord. Would we really be fine together?

No, no! If this keeps going, those romantic stories that bards make up randomly will become reality!

Alice thought narcissistically to herself and a confusing blush spread across her face as she stammeredly asked Merlin,

"...Do you happen to like me..."

"What!?!" Merlin nearly fell off the cart, completely blindsided by Alice's words. "What nonsense are you suddenly spouting? Are you some kind of retard?"

"...Didn't giving me the scarf mean you were being nice to me? So you do...like me, right?" Alice poked at her fingers repeatedly, her cheeks flushed, looking terribly conflicted.

"Who would like you?" Merlin's face instantly darkened, showing clear disgust. "Look at yourself, your sorry excuse for a figure. How could I like you? Stop talking to yourself, will you?"

"What?" Alice raised her eyes, biting her silver teeth as she glared hatefully at Merlin. "It's better that you don't like me. I'm the one who just breathed a sigh of relief! Whoever you like would be truly unfortunate!"

"Tsk!" Merlin clicked his tongue, not wanting to argue with Alice, and directly shot back, "I definitely wouldn't like you, but do you like me? Lately you've been losing your temper over nothing, clinging to me, and giving me worried looks..."

"Hah!?" Alice blinked, startled by Merlin's words. What did he mean she liked him? That was absolutely impossible. "I definitely don't like you! Stop being so narcissistic! Look at yourself! Only a blind person would like you, you know!?"

"Oh? Then that's good. I can rest easy then." Merlin said nonchalantly. It would be best if they just coexisted peacefully without any weird roommate romance developing. That would be quite troublesome.

"I already have someone I like! It's definitely not you!" Alice clasped her hands together, a yearning expression on her face, her entire being sparkling with fangirl energy as she declared, "The one I love is a peerless hero. I know one day he'll appear under the spotlight of countless watching eyes, draped in golden armor, riding colorful clouds to come marry me—"

"Mmmmm....." Merlin's expression grew complicated as he inappropriately chimed in, "You mean...a monkey, right?"

"Shut up!" Alice angrily smacked Merlin's forehead and said不满, "Your crush is the monkey! He's a human! A handsome and powerful human! Just his silhouette can make thousands of girls swoon. Stop saying acid-tongued nonsense. You can't compare to him at all!"

Merlin furrowed his brows, unable to force a smile despite wanting to, thinking he was at least quite handsome and pretty decent among the demons.

Thinking about how many demons didn't even look human, wasn't he significantly superior?

Now Alice was clearly trying to刺 his ego, and he couldn't tolerate that!

Provoked by Alice, Merlin's competitive spirit stirred. He wanted to hear who this person she loved was and how he couldn't possibly compare.

"Who is your crush? I want to see which poor bastard got liked by you."

"You're the unlucky one!" Alice puffed out her cheeks angerly, like a hamster eating. "My crush is super famous. Everyone in Great Britain knows him. He's way better than a lazyglutton like you."

Merlin let out a dry laugh, feeling inexplicably annoyed at Alice's smug expression. "Tell me the name. Maybe I've heard of him."

"The name....." Alice knit her elegant brows and said awkwardly, "I don't actually know his name either."

"Hehe, you can't even know his name and he's still your crush? How casual are you?" Merlin couldn't resist mocking her.

"Even if I don't know his name, everyone knows what he's called. He's the legendary great swordsman of Elgin. You've definitely heard of him, right?" Alice placed her hands on her hips and declared.

"Pfft!" Merlin choked and nearly spat out water, almost drowning on his own saliva.

Wait! What!?

The legendary great swordsman of Elgin!?

If he hadn't misheard, wasn't that literally him! ! !

title: Chapter 40 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Tickets
content:
Chapter 40 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Tickets

Volume 4 · Chapter 40

Merlin looked at Alice with an oddly expression, feeling as though he had discovered some earth-shattering secret about her.

So all this talking to Alice wasn't really about her at all — it was all about himself?

But this guy apparently didn't know that the Elgin Great Swordsman was him, of course.

So she fell for him based on just a single legend? It was rather hard to understand....

Alice saw Merlin's astonished expression and thought he was looking down on her, so with reddening cheeks she said, "What's with that look? Is it so strange that my ideal man is the Elgin Great Swordsman?"

"It's nothing. So it's the Elgin Great Swordsman, how amazing. Tell me, why do you like him?" Merlin wore an ambiguous half-smile, then turned his gaze away and focused on driving, wondering whether he should tell Alice the truth and shatter her romantic fantasy...

"Half a year ago, Elgin City was attacked by pirates. I was there at the time, and I saw that handsome, towering figure of his with my own eyes. Before I knew it, I realized I had already fallen for him." Alice rested her rosy cheeks in both hands, gazed down at her toes, and actually got shy on her own!

A giant bead of sweat plus a dark vein appeared on Merlin's face, and he remained silent, thinking so it wasn't that she liked *him* as a person, but rather his back view? What the hell kind of melodramatic nonsense was this!? Love at first sight is supposed to be about the face — and this Alice was turned on by a back of the head? How refreshingly unpretentious!

Alice: "The real Elgin Great Swordsman is a true strong man, and he's also righteous. He's nothing like you."

Merlin: I admit I'm strong, but righteous? Please. I only drew my sword for myself. Rescuing Elgin from crisis was nothing but coincidence — I just happened to have created a legend for all of Great Britain.

Alice: "Even though I didn't clearly see his face, that flowing long hair and resolute, unwavering back were so handsome. I'm sure the real person must be a noble-looking gentleman — far superior to someone like you who's wearing a woman's face!"

Merlin: Come on, I hadn't had money to go to a barbershop for half a year, so my hair was a little long, okay? ! And in the Crusade Hero's eyes that turned into some kind of flashy nobleman's coolness? ! I might as well just bash my head against a wall, honestly.

Alice: "If fate allows me to meet the Elgin Great Swordsman again, I'll definitely confess my feelings, and then we'll get married and live a happy, joyful life~"

Merlin: Wow~ sounds truly lovely, but stop daydreaming. I am the Elgin Great Swordsman, and I have absolutely no intention of marrying you, okay? ! Stop fantasizing about me all day like this! It's giving me the creeps, being targeted by a loon like this!

Alice had spent the whole time disparaging Merlin, and she was feeling very pleased with herself. "Anyway, *I'm* the true national idol, loved by countless people. You evil Demon Lord will never, ever be able to reach his heels in this lifetime! Hmph~!"

"Tch!" =

Merlin clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction, glanced over at Alice's smug, lovestruck face — her little nose was curled up toward the sky as if the Elgin Great Swordsman were really her husband.

He felt inexplicably irritated and decided to tell Alice the truth. If she knew that he *was* the Elgin Great Swordsman, what expression would that smug little jerk make? Just thinking about it made him feel a little excited~

Merlin straightened his attitude, turned his head, and looked at Alice with a serious expression.

"Alice, I'm going to tell you a secret."

"Hmm?" Alice saw that Merlin was very serious and thought it must be something important.

"I am the legendary Elgin Great Swordsman." Merlin said it in a calm tone.

Alice's eyes went blank and her expression grew a little startled, as though she hadn't yet processed the situation.

"Haha, surprise? Shocked?" Merlin grinned broadly, feeling that destroying Alice's romantic fantasy was a wonderfully exciting thing to do.

"Shut up! Shameless old thief!" Alice raised her tiny fist and gave Merlin's forehead a hard whack, furious. "Don't you dare insult my idol!"

"Huh? !" Merlin rubbed his forehead, thinking that he was admitting he *was* the Elgin Great Swordsman, so how was that an insult? !

"You could never possibly be the Elgin Great Swordsman, stop lying!" Alice felt the two of them bore no resemblance at all. Although both of them used katana-style swords, their convictions were worlds apart.

"I really am the Elgin Great Swordsman. What would I gain from lying to you?" Merlin said indignantly, feeling somewhat unbalanced inside — he had been upstaged by his own back view.

"G、U、N!" Alice's expression was full of disdain as she said without mercy, "Look at yourself properly. How could you possibly be the Elgin Great Swordsman? ! Although he's a wanted criminal, he's a partner of justice, someone admired by many people. And then look at you... tsk tsk tsk."

"Alright then~" Merlin nodded, sustaining considerable emotional damage, and said seriously, "With that attitude of yours, I swear the Elgin Great Swordsman will never, ever marry a girl like you in his entire life! And live a happy life together? Keep dreaming!"

"My chance to marry the Elgin Great Swordsman has nothing to do with you whatsoever, hmph~!" Alice also got into a huff. She was actually cursing him? Clearly utterly rotten to the core. How could she possibly be the righteous Elgin Great Swordsman? And then having the nerve to impersonate him — thick-skinned indeed!

Merlin felt stifled inside. Of course no one believed him — not even Alice. How had he, a great Demon Lord, become some kind of righteous idol? ! It was damned strange!

Alice cooled down a little and began to wonder if she had spoken too harshly and hurt Merlin's pride?

So Alice's attitude softened, and she muttered in a comparatively lower voice.

"Although you're no match for the Elgin Great Swordsman, I'll reluctantly thank you for the scarf."

"Note.... it's *reluctant*, not a genuine thanks or anything."

"Whatever. Consider it repayment for that hot milk you gave me that night. Our demon race never likes being in someone's debt." Merlin replied nonchalantly, still somewhat bitter about what had happened earlier.

Alice's expression grew odd, and she looked down at the scarf around her neck, thinking—

What the?

So the great Demon Lord could also show gratitude.....

After a whole day of travel.

In the evening the two finally arrived at the village at the foot of Ben Nevis.

Down came the snow in great goose-down flakes from the sky, like silver flowers falling from heaven.

There was also a very thick layer of accumulated snow on the road, and the season looked highly abnormal.

It was clearly autumn, yet it gave one a deep-winter sensation.

Moreover, Merlin and Alice could both feel that the closer they advanced toward Ben Nevis, the colder it became.

Carona seemed to have calculated the timing in advance, knowing that Merlin and Alice would arrive here tonight,

so Carona, disguised as the fake Simon Anne, had already been waiting here for a long time.

When she saw Merlin and Alice, leaning against each other, appearing in her vision riding in a donkey cart, Carona thought—

As expected, they've come......

But you will never be able to return to Lexem.

Because this village is to be your burial place, hahaha!
