title: Chapter 41 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Tickets Added
content:
Chapter 41 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Tickets Added

Volume 4 · Chapter 41

Even with her scarf wrapped around her, Alice still felt a chill, her slender frame shivering.

"The closer we get to the village, the colder it becomes. It seems this dragon's power is quite formidable, actually capable of altering the weather." Merlin said flatly.

"You don't mean... the legendary Malygos?" Alice's expression grew grave, a wave of pressure suddenly pressing down on her.

"I'd almost wish it were the Frost Sacred Dragon after all." Merlin quirked the corner of his mouth. Among the Six Sacred Dragons, that would indeed be lucky.

"Then wouldn't this mission be incredibly difficult?" Alice was somewhat worried. If they truly encountered Malygos, she might be too frightened to fight. And at her current high-tier level, she couldn't help much anyway.

"For you it might be quite difficult, but for me it's barely a walk in the park." Merlin spread his hands, looking entirely at ease.

"Hmph." Alice grew a bit annoyed, feeling that Merlin was belittling her and treating her like an extra who just showed up for background extras.

"But I'd say this is at least a Saint-tier dragon. You can just stay back and clean up the mess afterward." Inside, Merlin was actually rather pleased. He felt this trip hadn't been in vain; his heart curse should be easing up. Judging from the current situation, a dragon capable of altering the weather was definitely above Saint-tier.

"I... I can fight too!" Alice gripped her slender sword, her expression stubborn.

"You can't be of any help at your current strength. It'd be better if you didn't follow and hold me back~" Merlin smiled, harboring zero hope that Alice could be of any assistance to him.

"Don't look down on me so much!" Alice was so frustrated that the ahoge on her head stood completely straight.

"Hey, let's not argue. Looks like we've arrived at LoweCol Village." Merlin signaled Alice to be quiet.

Alice gazed ahead and indeed saw the village, though it had grown somewhat ruined. Many houses had collapsed, as if buried beneath ice and snow, with only a few lights flickering.

Most striking of all was a conspicuously prominent ice spike at the center of the village...

No — it could no longer be called a spike. It was a massive ice mountain, towering into the clouds.

Though it didn't rival the distant Benwyvis Mountain, it was still quite spectacular, seeming almost close enough to touch the low-hanging cloud layer.

This ice mountain had buried most of the village houses beneath it, reducing them to ruins, radiating an intense cold aura.

It seemed this inexplicably appearing ice mountain was what had caused winter to arrive months early here.

"What's that? How could an ice mountain appear in a place like this?" Alice's eyes widened in shock, finding it utterly unbelievable. Even from this distance, she could faintly sense that overwhelming magic power.

"That's probably the work of that dragon." Merlin's expression remained completely calm, unfazed.

"Do you really think it's the legendary Frost Sacred Dragon Malygos?" Alice asked in astonishment, her voice trembling slightly.

"We still can't be sure. I've crossed paths with the Light Sacred Dragon Avis before. If it truly were a Malygos of equal rank, its magic would involve far more than just creating a small ice mountain." Merlin said casually, leaving things open. He couldn't rule out the possibility that it really was the Frost Sacred Dragon — what if it was hiding its true power?

Alice thought that made sense too. Legend had it that Malygos had frozen over half of the Greenland Sea. This ice mountain wasn't nearly as impressive, but it was certainly enough to shock most people.

Alice looked at Merlin with awe in her eyes, feeling he was nothing short of a monster. If even an ice mountain this massive paled in comparison to the Six Sacred Dragons, how had he managed to make the Light Sacred Dragon submit back then?

"Looks like someone's at the village entrance." Merlin spotted Carona disguised as Simon Anne.

Following Merlin's gaze, Alice indeed saw a girl wearing coarse linen clothes. "She appears to be a villager."

Merlin took out the parchment from his chest and checked the client's name. "Perfect. Let's ask this one for information about the client, then get a sense of the village's current situation."

"Understood." Alice nodded without objection, thinking that though she hadn't been an adventurer for long, she was getting rather proficient at this.

The two drove the donkey-drawn cart faster and arrived before the girl disguised as Anne.

Merlin gave the reins a slight tug, and the little donkey came to a stop in front of Anne.

Alice studied the girl and found her to be perfectly ordinary — a teenager of about sixteen, with freckles on her face that made her look innocent and adorable.

"Hello, are you a resident of LoweCol Village?"

"Yes, I am." Anne nodded, her voice slightly childlike.

"Then do you know someone named Simon Anne?" Alice asked patiently. Seeing the other girl was younger than her, she adopted the attitude of a big sister next door.

"Aren't you two adventurers?" Anne pretended not to know, playing naive and cute on the surface, while inside she was a 400-plus-year-old grandmother named Carona!

Alice lifted the golden Adventurer Certification hanging around her neck and shook it. "That's right, we're adventurers."

"Ah, Alice Crodi..." Anne looked closely at the golden tag and murmured, then put on an expression of great surprise, covering her mouth with her small hand. "You must be Miss Alice? And the gentleman beside you has to be Mr. Merlin!"

"Hm?"

Alice and Merlin exchanged a glance, both feeling something was odd.

Merlin looked at Anne and asked flatly, "You seem to know not only our names?"

"Oh, I nearly forgot. It would be terribly rude not to introduce myself first." Anne pressed her hand to her chest and said innocently, "My name is Simon Anne, and I'm the village chief's adopted daughter."

"So you're Simon Anne? Our client?" Alice was somewhat surprised.

"That's right. I've been waiting for you two for a long time." Anne smiled.

Alice was a bit startled, thinking that the client who had hired them turned out to be a young girl — quite unusual.

"Let's not waste time. My father is already waiting for you two at the church. The dragon attack came suddenly, and those who've lost their homes have taken refuge at the church. My father would like to discuss the commission with you there." Anne said seriously.

Carona was indeed a thief of legendary stature; her disguise skills were truly formidable. Though she was a 400-plus-year-old woman, when imitating a sixteen-year-old girl, she was remarkably convincing.

"Then get on. Let's go to the church together now." Alice replied.

"Alright."

Anne nodded and slowly climbed onto the donkey cart, a few shrewd glints flashing in her eyes as she looked at Merlin and Alice.

After scanning both of their necks a few times, the girl disguised as Anne couldn't help but frown, thinking anxiously inside:

What the hell is going on!

Why do only the Adventurer Certifications hang from their necks, with no key to the Hell Legion in sight?

Could they be hidden under their clothes? Please tell me they didn't leave it behind, or this is going to be a real problem.....

title: Chapter 41
content:
Chapter 41

Volume 4 · Chapter 41

Merlin, Alice, and the imposter Anne traveled together in a horse-drawn carriage on their way to the village church.

"Anne, what's the situation? Can you give us a rough rundown?"

Alice glanced at Anne beside her, wanting to understand the basics before taking action.

"We can, it happened a few days ago...". Anne paused, then began a brief account, "We were harvesting wheat in the fields when the temperature suddenly plummeted, and snow started falling, as if we had instantly entered the depths of a cold winter. The next day, a blue-white giant dragon descended from the sky, destroying many village houses and buildings. Many people perished in the disaster, and it threatened us to offer up virgins for it to consume, otherwise it would turn our homeland into an uninhabited wasteland..."

Merlin pulled the reins, his expression calm, as though he hadn't heard a word.

But Alice was different. As a little guardian of justice, she was immediately filled with righteous indignation, her face brimming with anger.

"This evil dragon deserves to be killed!"

Alice hadn't considered the dragon's strength at all; she simply felt she couldn't let this creature run rampant and that she should do something about it.

But gazing at the somewhat spectacular iceberg in the distance, Alice couldn't help but feel a twinge of unease. Even if she drained all her mana, she couldn't create something so massive. It seemed that evil dragon's magical power was truly terrifying.

Alice glanced at Merlin beside her and thought that surely this guy could help out, right?

"Because of the evil dragon's threats, several of my sisters have already been eaten by it, but it's still not satisfied. Instead, it keeps demanding we hand over more girls. Tomorrow... tomorrow it will be my turn... Hooor..." Anne broke down crying, hot tears streaming down her cheeks, her face twisted in grief.

bookSF

"Don't worry..." Alice embraced Anne's trembling shoulders and comforted her like an older sister, "Since we're here, we will definitely rescue you."

"Really?" Anne's face was filled with hope, her eyes glistening with tears.

"Yes. No matter how powerful that dragon is, we will defeat it and save your village!" Alice said confidently, thinking that even if she couldn't handle it alone, there was still Merlin. He had come out on this mission too; he couldn't just stand by and do nothing.

"Thank you, senior sister. I originally only posted this commission with a try-your-luck attitude, not expecting to actually get..." Anne flashed a brilliantly radiant smile. In her heart, she thought: Foolish creatures. Neither of you two stands a chance against Malygos. You'll only be crushed by overwhelming power. And you think you can defeat the Frost Dragon? How laughable. But this little girl really is an innocent fool. It makes one want to break her spirit, haha~

"Why did they specifically name us?" Alice asked curiously. She wondered that neither she nor Merlin was particularly famous, so why would someone in Scotland specifically request adventurers from Wales?

"This..." Anne hesitated for a moment, then smiled, "Because I read the newspaper often. I heard that Senior Alice had some very impressive feats in Denbighshire, so I thought I'd ask you to help. I didn't expect you to be a Gold-rank adventurer. So amazing~"

"Hmph~" Alice stuck her hands on her hips and struck a triumphant pose, saying proudly, "I knew it! I'm a famous person now! Even someone in Scotland knows me~"

A flicker of displeasure flashed deep within Anne's eyes. She thought: Famous my ass! What's there to be proud of with some trashy Gold-rank adventurer?

"What are you getting so full of yourself about..." Merlin muttered helplessly, glancing at Anne and asking flatly, "Miss Anne? How old are you this year?"

"Huh!?" Anne saw that it was Merlin who was asking and couldn't help but feel a little nervous. She could never forget that casual elbow strike that had left her severely injured. "...I'm sixteen this year."

"Is that so? Then that smile of yours just now looked like a seventeen-year-old grandma..." Merlin's tone carried a hint of confusion. He felt Anne's smile wasn't quite right, looking more like an old lady.

"Uh..."

Anne's expression froze on her face. The veins on her forehead jumped twice. She had伪装 herself as an innocent and naive girl, yet Merlin had ironically called her a middle-aged woman!?

I've said it one hundred times already, I'm forever seventeen! I'm not an old lady! ! !

Carona's pride, disguised as Anne, was deeply wounded. She nearly lost her temper and struck, but ultimately decided to prioritize the bigger picture and endured it.

Alice thought Merlin was mocking Anne, so she angrily tapped him on the forehead. "What are you saying!? What seventeen-year-old grandma? That's so rude!"

"Tsk! It feels like it to me..." Merlin rubbed his own forehead and complained dissatisfiedly.

"Shut up! We girls will never turn into old ladies!" Alice huffed and deliberately went against Merlin.

Merlin sighed and mumbled gloomily...

The group rode in a donkey cart.

Before entering the church, they first passed by that magnificent iceberg.

Beneath the iceberg, the people looked like tiny ants.

Alice looked up and thought this iceberg was enormous—completely different from how it appeared in the distance. She felt immense pressure weighing on her.

At the foot of the iceberg,

many villagers wearing straw hats held pickaxes, constantly chipping away at the ice. Presumably, they wanted to destroy this iceberg, but the results were negligible.

Because this ice was condensed from Malygos's magical power, it was extremely hard ancient ice spanning tens of thousands of years. Its hardness rivaled steel, and it wouldn't melt easily.

So many villagers worked until they were drenched in sweat, only to chip off scattered bits of ice flakes, making one feel the insignificance and helplessness of ordinary humans.

"My father is over there!" Anne tugged at Alice's sleeve and pointed toward an elderly man with white hair in the distance. "Such a shame—at his age, why did he come out of the church...?"

Alice followed Anne's finger and saw an elderly man in thick cotton clothing, his hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the iceberg with a deeply worried expression.

His skin was withered and wrinkled like dried dates, his small eyes dull and lifeless. There was even a trace of faint despair showing through.

It seemed this was the village head of Luoweike Village. For some reason, he had left the church and come to the foot of the iceberg.

Merlin pulled the reins and brought the donkey cart to a stop.

Anne immediately got off and ran over, calling out loudly, "Grandpa! Why did you come out of the church? It's so cold outside!"

"This is something we have no choice about. This iceberg radiates chilling coldness at all times. If we don't get rid of it, our village will be trapped in eternal winter, completely unsuitable for our survival." The village head shook his head and sighed.

Anne's outward expression showed concern, but in her heart she thought: Hehe, foolish old man. An iceberg created by Malygos—do you really think you can just wish it away and have it disappear?

"Father, I found two adventurers. Perhaps they can help us."

"Oh?" The village head turned around and happened to see Merlin and Alice also dismounting and walking over.

"Hello~" Merlin greeted casually, his gaze fixed continuously on the villagers chipping away at the iceberg.

"Hello, Village Head. We are adventurers from Rexham, entrusted by little Anne to come here and resolve the matter of the dragon harassing your village." Alice introduced herself.

The village head's initial expression was one of joy, and hope naturally surfaced in his eyes.

But when he saw they were Gold and Black Iron-ranked adventurers, his disappointment was immediate and he shook his head straightaway—

"It won't work. Please, young masters, turn back."

"That dragon... is absolutely not something you can possibly withstand...."

title: Chapter 44 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 44 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter

Volume 4 · Chapter 44

Countless fragments of icebergs crashed down, throwing the accumulated snow back into the air!

Merlin stood with his back to the collapsing iceberg, unmoving amid the white snow.

His expressionless face was calm, his eyes still lazy, as if he had just done something perfectly ordinary.

The dark clouds that had been pressing down on the sky instantly scattered, and long-missed warm sunlight shone into the village, beginning to melt the age-old ice and snow.

Everyone present was in a state of shock, unable to utter a single word, none of them understanding what had just happened.

Carona, disguised as Annie, wore a look of astonishment, thinking, Damn it! How did a casual punch achieve this effect? He clearly has no magic power or battle qi, so why is he so powerful? Could he really defeat the Frost Saint Dragon? No way! This iceberg didn't use all of Marijus's magic power; if he went all out, Merlin definitely wouldn't be a match for Marijus.

Merlin patted his shoulder, brushed off a layer of ice chips, and prepared to go rest.

Passing by the dazed Alice, Merlin tapped her forehead with his finger.

"You still need to keep working hard..."

"Mmph!" Alice touched her forehead, feeling extremely indignant inside, thinking, This perverted guy!

Merlin came before the village chief, seeing him still staring up at the long-collapsed iceberg, and couldn't help finding it a bit funny.

The village chief's heart was now shocked beyond measure. He was clearly just a small-time Black Iron adventurer, yet he'd so easily destroyed such a troublesome iceberg?! This strength — it's fundamentally not weak at all!

Merlin grew impatient and snapped his fingers right in front of the village chief, pulling him back to reality. "Don't choose to give up in despair at every turn. Despair is contagious. As long as you wait patiently, you'll eventually see sunlight like now."

"...." The village chief's face flushed red. He hadn't expected to be lectured by a youngster, but he was convinced in his heart.

"We're going to kill Marijus, but right now we need a place to stay. Could you help arrange something, Village Chief?" Merlin asked tentatively.

The village chief didn't speak, just nodded rapidly like a chick pecking rice.....

Beniweis Mountain.

Deep in the pitch-black ice cavern abyss.

The Frost Saint Dragon was sleeping soundly, when it suddenly sensed that the iceberg it had condensed with its magic power had vanished.

It jerked awake in the darkness, opening its massive eyes, emitting a faint blue light.

The Frost Saint Dragon slowly raised its head, looking toward the direction of Rowecol Village.

"Who destroyed the iceberg I created?"

"Could it be Carona's enemy has come...?"

The Frost Saint Dragon slowly rose, its powerful blue-white dragon wings suddenly flashing.

Cold air mixed with a blizzard soared straight up, leaving the ice cavern.....

The Church.

Hearing Annie say there was a hot spring behind the church, letting Merlin and Alice go soak to relieve their travel fatigue.

Merlin and Alice thought it sounded good too, so they agreed to the proposal, deciding to rest and recuperate today, then go subjugate the Frost Saint Dragon tomorrow.

.

Now that the iceberg was gone, the air gradually warmed up, not as cold as at the beginning.

The village chief now completely changed his previous cold attitude, taking extra care of Merlin and Alice. Whether the village could survive this crisis depended entirely on Merlin and Alice.

The two were now in the hot spring, separated by only a single wooden board between the men's and women's sides.

Merlin sat in the hot spring with eyes closed, his posture much like when he usually sprawled on the sofa. Feeling the comfort of soaking in the warm water, his whole body went limp and lazy.

On the other side, Alice was wrapped in a bath towel, soaking in the hot spring. Her silver long hair was piled high, revealing a sexy neck and alluring collarbones. If not for the fact that she had to remove her bra pads for the hot spring, making her chest appear quite flat, she would probably make many people spurt nosebleeds right now.

At this moment Alice recalled what had just happened, feeling a bit upset. She was clearly Merlin's senior as an adventurer, yet now she felt like she was dragging him down.

Alice, with her extremely high self-esteem, found it hard to tolerate. Her desire for powerful strength grew ever stronger. Unwilling to be a mere vase, she wanted to demonstrate her own value.

"Merlin, Merlin!"

Alice knew Merlin was right behind the wooden board, but he didn't respond after she called loudly twice.

She couldn't help wondering what this guy was doing.

Just then, Merlin climbed onto the wooden board in the center of the men's and women's hot springs, staring straight at Alice soaking in the water. "What is it?"

"....." Alice froze, her face gradually flushing red.

"Yaaaaaaaaaaah!"

"Who said you could look over here?!"

"Pervert! Go away!"

Alice groped blindly for the wooden water basin beside her and, without thinking, hurled it like a flying disc. It struck Merlin squarely on the forehead with a "thunk."

"Ow!" Merlin fell into the hot spring with a splash, sending up a meter-high spray of water. "What are you doing?! You called me!"

"Calling you didn't mean climb over here to peep! You pervert!" Alice cursed furiously.

"Look at your washboard! You think I care to look? Don't be so full of yourself!" Merlin couldn't help sneering.

"Your mouth says you don't care, but who knows what you're thinking inside?" Alice really wanted to pull out her thin sword and throw it, seeing if it could fall from the sky and pierce Merlin's forehead.

"I don't want to argue with you. What did you call me for? Spit it out!" Merlin said discontentedly.

"Then...." Alice paused, then asked seriously, "Can my strength improve faster? Do you have any good methods?"

"Take drugs. Experience pills, time potions, leopard fetus tendon-changing pills, stretch-legs-and-die pills, that sort of thing...." Merlin said offhandedly.

"Wait, did some weird drugs get mixed in there? And taking drugs isn't good — unstable foundation, overdrafting potential." Alice asked expressionlessly, feeling Merlin was harming her.

"Anyway, besides taking drugs, I can't think of any better methods..." Merlin shifted gears and continued, "But if the Goddess of Luck extremely favors you and you manage to get your hands on a Dragon Race Inheritance Crystal, that would be a different story."

"Inheritance Crystal? What's that?" Alice had never heard of it.

"Something that only exists in dragon brains. Extremely low appearance rate. Similar to me winning a bet on a horse race." Merlin said blandly.

"Does it have any effects?" Alice instantly grew interested. Though she knew the acquisition probability was low, there was no harm in fantasizing a bit.

"Simply put, if you eat a Dragon Race Inheritance Crystal and fully digest it, you'll become a humanoid dragon. Of course not turning into a giant lizard, but possessing dragon race power in human form. Not only would you be able to use dragon magic and martial arts, you'd also have a physical body rivaling dragons and inherit their vast magic power. Most importantly — no side effects." Merlin explained as concisely as possible.

"That powerful?" Alice was a bit astonished, not expecting this crystal to provide such a huge boost.

"Powerful it may be, but it's extremely rare. Even in our demon race's ancient texts, it's described vaguely. There might be other secrets." Merlin paused, saying softly, "Dragon race power can be called the strongest among all races. We demons can't compare. They're ancient creatures that appeared since the Era of Gods, so they definitely have something unique."

Alice was extremely tempted. She really wanted to get an Inheritance Crystal to try. If her strength advanced by leaps and bounds, she wouldn't be a burden anymore.

She might even surpass Merlin, and then she'd absolutely have to step on his face with her high heels to vent. Thinking about it made her a little excited~

The hot spring changing room.

Carona, disguised as Annie, was sneaking around here.

She had urged Merlin and Alice to soak in the hot spring, and of course there was a purpose.

That was to secretly rummage through their clothes and find the Hell Legion's key.

But Carona had searched through both their clothes several times and found no trace of the key, as if she'd seen a ghost.

Carona grew anxious inside. Without the key, the former kingdom's restoration grand plan would make no progress.

Right at this moment, the hot spring changing room's soundproofing wasn't great, and she could hear Merlin and Alice's conversation.

Merlin: "Wonder how that mysterious key research is coming along?"

Alice: "No problem. Trust the person I recommended."

Merlin: "If we can discover some treasure, getting rich overnight would be sweet."

Alice: "Could you do fewer daydreams?"

Carona's whole body trembled, her hands clenched tightly into fists, knuckles turning ghastly white.

Damn it! The key was actually given to someone else?!

What have I been busy with all this time?!

No! I can't fail. I must change plans!

Carona's eyes were bloodshot, her face pale with rage, her breathing growing heavy.

Got it! There's a way!

Kidnap Merlin's wife; make him bring the key to exchange! = =

(+-m~)

title: Chapter 45
content:
Chapter 45

Volume 4 · Chapter 45

After soaking in the hot spring, the two rested separately.

Alice's room was at the very top of the church.

Merlin was on the floor below, but he did not go to bed early.

Instead, the village head had summoned him to a private room.

The village head had originally wanted to arrange for Merlin and Alice to share a room.

But the two had seriously refused—if they weren't really married, why should they sleep in the same room?

Facing the village's confusion, Merlin and Alice didn't bother explaining; being misunderstood had become routine.

Inside the church, which served as a makeshift office.

The village head took a bottle of red wine out of the cabinet, its surface coated in dust—clearly aged.

He then took out two wine glasses, poured the wine, and handed one to Merlin.

"This is red wine from the Château Lévy et Mélesville in France; ordinary people rarely get to taste it."

Merlin didn't hesitate and took a small sip. It was decent—better than the wine he'd had when he worked as a servant at noble ballrooms.

"Village head, what did you want to see me about?"

The village head held his wine glass and smiled. "Nothing important. I just wanted to chat with you about Malygos."

Merlin stayed silent and studied the village head, noting the worry etched between his brows—he clearly had something on his mind.

"Can you really defeat Malygos?" The village head still harbored some doubts.

"Of course." Merlin shrugged, his expression casual.

"But you're so powerful—why are you an Iron-rank adventurer? You should at least be Mithril. Even becoming a Thorn Knight of Britannia should be no problem, right?"

The village head was genuinely puzzled. Though he wasn't a martial artist and couldn't sense pressure, Merlin had easily shattered the ice created by the Frost Saint Dragon, clearly extremely powerful. So why settle for an Iron-rank adventurer, a position looked down upon by most people—it was incomprehensible.

"Becoming an Iron-rank adventurer involves many reasons. As for the Thorn Knights? I will never bow to anyone." Merlin answered casually, then looked directly into the village head's eyes. "Fool, are you still doubting my strength? Aside from me, who can save you now?"

"No, no, I didn't mean to offend you, I'm just confused inside." The village head quickly said respectfully—Merlin was the village's hope now, and he dared not offend him. "Since you're so confident, I feel relieved. I can also tell you about the recent abnormalities in the village."

"Abnormalities?" Merlin narrowed his eyes, somewhat interested.

"I suspect my daughter, Simone Jane, has been possessed by something evil." The village head said with a troubled expression.

"Oh?" Merlin perked up slightly. As far as he knew, people being possessed by darkness was quite common—demons all had magic that manipulated the mind.

"The incident happened before Malygos attacked the village, about a month and a half ago. The priest of this church is an old friend of mine, and Anne often came here. One day, my old friend secretly told me that Anne had a dark aura on her, as if possessed by a demon." The village head recounted briefly.

"Did your daughter have contact with a demon, or disturb one?" Merlin frowned, wondering if another demon conspiracy was at play—perhaps those Holy Church charlatans were spreading nonsense again.

Of course, such a thing wasn't entirely impossible. Since they didn't belong to the Demon Lord Palace, there were plenty of demons wandering in human territories, like the current Merlin.

These wandering demons had no jurisdiction over them—some had left the demon race voluntarily, while others had been exiled for major crimes. Could there even exist those who enjoyed playing with humans? Hard to say.

"No, our village has no connections with the demon race whatsoever." The village head shook his head.

"The priest said it was a demon possession, and you just believed it? Did you really investigate the truth properly?" Merlin asked mildly.

"I didn't want to believe it—anyone would hesitate to suspect their own daughter. But the very next day, my priest friend was murdered, and his body was dumped in the well behind the church with a dagger in his chest. Not long after, Malygos attacked our village for no reason."

"You suspected your daughter was possessed by a demon because of these things? She seems perfectly normal to me." Merlin was losing patience, feeling this was the village head's personal matter and unrelated to the current commission. He wasn't like Alice, who had a habit of meddling in other people's business.

"As Anne's father, I know her best. She really is acting abnormal. After the ice dragon attacked the village, while everyone was panicking, she remained calmer than the adults, even suggesting we seek out adventurers. She's only sixteen—she used to scream at cockroaches. But now…" The village head trailed off, seeming不敢 to continue thinking about it.

Even if Corona's disguise was perfect, making those closest to her not notice anything unusual was still quite difficult.

"Lord Merlin, I mean no harm. We had all agreed to invite an adventurer to help the village through this crisis, but we needed someone of Mithril rank or higher, or someone with a well-known reputation, because they would appear more capable. But Anne went against everyone's wishes and hired you two. To be honest, before this, I had never even heard your names. Bringing two unknowns to deal with a Frost Saint Dragon—wasn't that just throwing your lives away?" The village head felt this was highly abnormal, as if his daughter had deliberately planned it.

Merlin fell silent, also sensing something was off. The current information completely contradicted his常识. Something secret must be involved.

Even if Alice had performed outstandingly during the undead incident in Derbyshire and gained some fame in Wales, it certainly wouldn't have reached such a remote Scottish village. Even the village head didn't know of Merlin and Alice's names—how did a sixteen-year-old Anne know?

And she issued a commissioned request without specifying that the dragon was the powerful Malygos. Any normal adventurer knowing the enemy was a Frost Saint Dragon would dare not accept the task. Everything seemed deliberately designed to lure Merlin and Alice here.

"I feel that you adventurers are well-traveled and knowledgeable, and might be able to figure out the reason for my daughter's abnormality. So, Lord Merlin, can you help me?" The village head stated his purpose.

What help? Merlin thought. He didn't know what was going on either—he'd only been an adventurer for barely a month.

"Village head, does Anne often read newspapers?"

"Huh? No, she doesn't read them. Anne never went to school and can't read." The village head answered in astonishment.

Merlin shuddered, his eyes widening—a strong feeling of being led by the nose surged through him.

Damn it! This Anne doesn't read newspapers at all—she was lying! Why lie to us?!

Merlin suddenly had a suspicion: this commission was entirely premeditated, a trap—probably intended to get him and Alice killed.

This matter couldn't be ignored. Merlin suddenly stood up and prepared to go talk to Alice.

But just as he was about to turn and leave, the entire church shook violently, as if an earthquake had struck.

Countless dust fell in torrents, coating the interior in a thick layer, even splashing into the wine glasses.

Then came a hissing sound. Walls visibly condensed with vast patches of frost, and the temperature plummeted!

"What's happening?" Merlin frowned.

"It! It's here!" The village head panicked, falling to the ground and shouting in terror—

"It's coming!!!"

Outside.

The Frost Saint Dragon landed on the village church. Its massive body clung to it—far larger than the entire church!

The church swayed beneath Malygos's weight, seemingly unable to bear the dragon's mass, on the verge of collapsing from the tremors.

Its limbs dug into the church structure, the ice-scaled scales gleaming brilliantly, and its horn-like crests like a crown declaring its power!

Its wings suddenly unfurled, blotting out the sky, casting everything in its shadow.

Its graceful posture inspired awe, its overwhelming power brought one to their knees.

The Frost Saint Dragon raised its noble head and roared furiously at the sun in the sky—

"ROAR!!!!!!"

title: Chapter 46 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Votes
content:
Chapter 46 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Votes

Volume 4 · Chapter 46

The arrival of the Frost Sacred Dragon caused the temperature around it to plummet, dropping straight below freezing.

With an enraged roar, dense dark clouds appeared in the sky, shrouding the entire village back in darkness.

The sky grew ever darker as goose-feather snow began to fall, swirling through the air along with hard shards of ice, making the weather even more vicious.

Its massive body climbed over the church, causing the entire structure to begin swaying precariously.

Powerful dragon-king pressure was released shamelessly, golden flames flickering within its ice-blue eyes — that was a mark of holiness!

Raising its dragon claw, the Frost Sacred Dragon demolished the church roof without any effort at all, as if the whole thing had been ripped open.

The seemingly majestic cathedral could only be easily trampled under the claws of the Frost Sacred Dragon.

After the church dome was violently destroyed, Alice's room was directly exposed to the bone-chilling wind and snow.

Alice had originally planned to rest, but with the entire church shaking, she instantly snapped to full attention.

She drew the slender sword at her waist and stood ready for battle, but when the roof was torn off, she saw the great Frost Sacred Dragon right before her eyes!

At that moment, Alice lost all will to resist. She could feel the Saint-tier dragon race's pressure, overwhelming as a mountain range.

It was impossible to gauge just how powerful this legendary Sacred Dragon truly was.

Alice was still just an insufficiently powerful human. Under the pressure of a higher dragon race, she felt an urge from deep within her heart to kneel and submit, let alone the fact that she was facing one of the dragon race's elite — one of the great Six Sacred Dragons.

Dragon pressure was no small threat to other races. It could bring about very pronounced fear. Even魔族 of a relatively high tier would feel some pressure.

However, Alice was someone with very high pride. Even with Malyagos's enormous, ferocious dragon head right before her, and even as she could feel the piercing cold of its breath, she still held firm against the overwhelming fear, though she was somewhat petrified.

"A...

Alice's eyes widened. Even gripping her slender sword, her petite body trembled uncontrollably. Her lips moved, but she could only manage sounds from her throat.

Although Merlin was also very powerful, demons valued etiquette. They lacked any sense of brutishness. But the pressure from the Frost Sacred Dragon before her could only be described as that of an emotionless beast.

The Frost Sacred Dragon blinked its lantern-sized eyes, gazing at the tiny Alice. It opened its mouth slightly, its voice like rolling thunder.

"Lowly insect. Do you know where the human named Merlin is?"

Alice's lips trembled. Under the crushing dragon pressure, she couldn't speak at all.

"If you're willing to tell me, I'll spare your l... The Frost Sacred Dragon narrowed its eyes and exhaled gusts of cold air from its nostrils.

Alice still didn't speak. She didn't move an inch. At this point, she was completely dominated by fear.

"Then perish."

The Frost Sacred Dragon seemed to have little patience. Seeing that Alice wouldn't speak, it directly sentenced her to death!

It raised its head, and an ice-blue glow lit up its belly, slowly drifting along its long neck before converging within its dragon mouth, as if a sacred fire of ice-blue flame were burning.

The magic power became extremely intense, so volatile it was terrifying. It was a dragon breath — the dragon race's most commonly used technique.

But what gushed from the Frost Sacred Dragon's mouth wasn't simply a small flame. Frost breath would cause everything to die in the extreme cold.

The Frost Sacred Dragon lowered its head and opened its enormous mouth toward Alice, revealing fang-like teeth and the condensed ice flame deep within its throat!

Snow-white ice flames radiated brilliantly. Alice felt as though she were looking at the sun, growing ever more dazzling.

Not only her body — even Alice's very flesh felt a deep, bone-searing cold!

...Am I going to die here?

Turned to countless ice shards beneath the dragon's breath, dying peacefully?

No! I want to live!

I still have so many things I haven't done. I've never even been in love!

At a moment like this, a flash of Elgin's silhouette as the great swordmaster crossed Alice's mind.

I... I want to see him one more time...

Someone... please save me! Anyone will do!

Alice thought to herself that anyone would do, but her mouth, still weighed down by immense fear, called out one name—

"Merlin!!!"

Alice let out a heart-rending scream, her desperate voice echoing beneath the dragon breath that was about to fire.

"Being scared into looking this ridiculous. Truly embarrassing, Al..."

A familiar voice rang out. Merlin's proud, outstanding figure flashed past, charging toward the Frost Sacred Dragon, his face wearing a resolute expression, a half-smile playing on his lips.

"Huh?" Alice froze, gazing blankly at Merlin's back. For a moment, she felt his figure bore an extremely close resemblance to the great swordmaster Elgin.

In order to avoid endangering Alice and the villagers, Merlin could only choose to draw the Frost Dragon away, far from the church.

Thus Merlin suddenly threw a punch at the Frost Sacred Dragon's face, making it let out a pained cry.

Just then the dragon breath fired, but due to the shock of Merlin's punch, it was thrown completely off course, blasting into the distant ground and forming a long stretch of frozen ice.

"There's a path to heaven, yet you refuse to walk it. There's no gate to hell, yet you投 yourself in. Malyagos, let us have a proper fight!"

Merlin's handsome face carried an evil yet somewhat cynical smile. His golden hair flew up, revealing a smooth forehead, as he followed the Frost Sacred Dragon that had been punched flying, both disappearing from Alice's line of sight.

The scene briefly returned to calm. Alice's terrified legs gave out, and she sat directly on the ground. Cold sweat streamed down her cheeks, and she felt utterly drained.

Recalling the scenes from just now where she had nearly died to the Frost Sacred Dragon's breath, Alice was still shaken, feeling as though she had taken a trip to hell.

The courageous figure Merlin had shown earlier kept flashing through Alice's mind, making her blush. She wondered if her feelings had changed — did she no longer like the great swordmaster Elgin and instead... like Merlin? I'm so terrible. Being unfaithful in one's affections is unacceptable. But this guy Merlin has such a strong fighting spirit today. He hasn't been this proactive in battle before...

Merlin was still very excited. This was because Malyagos was not a deathly undead — he had value in terms of stealing life. Moreover, the Six Sacred Dragons were quite strong, and the effect of relieving the heart curse was extraordinarily good.

To Merlin, Malyagos wasn't an enemy. He was a precious key to a peaceful life. If I chop down this Frost Sacred Dragon, I can party however I want for the rest of this period!

Alice had mostly recovered. She slowly stood up, thinking that someone like Malyagos definitely wouldn't be able to help much. It might be better to go assist the villagers instead.

But just then, Anne slowly pushed open the door, her appearance extremely hollow, tears swirling in her eyes.

"Sister Alice..."

"Anne?" Alice turned to look and asked worriedly, "What's wrong?"

Anne ran over and threw herself into Alice's arms, crying, "I'm so scared! I didn't expect a giant dragon to come eat me again... waaah..."

"Don't be afraid, don't be afraid. Big sister is here..." Alice patted Anne's head, feeling great sympathy for the girl.

Haha, such a naive little thing~

Pretend to be pitiful for a bit and she drops all her guards.

Even if I eat you, don't blame anyone but yourself!

Carona, disguised as Anne, had an expression that turned terrifyingly gruesome. A pitch-black dagger slipped from her sleeve—

She suddenly thrust it into Alice's unaware abdomen...

Only rough drafts of the two characters wearing scarves exist. You can click my profile avatar to see the animation.

title: Chapter 47 — Monthly Vote Bonus
content:
Chapter 47 — Monthly Vote Bonus

Volume 4 · Chapter 47

A sharp metallic clatter suddenly echoed through the air.

Annie's black dagger clinked and fell to the ground, leaving one to wonder what had just happened.

It looked like Annie's sneak attack had failed, with Alice reacting in advance.

"Who are you!?" Alice swung her rapier sharply, forcing Annie back and keeping her from approaching.

Annie executed a swift backflip to create distance, landing beside the window with a bizarre smile on her face.

Just now, Annie had tried to stab Alice with her dagger, but Alice sensed something was off and immediately countered with her rapier to protect herself.

After days of training under Merlin, daily experiencing the threat of death, Alice's vigilance had improved immeasurably, allowing her to quickly detect hidden sneak attacks against her life.

Annie's sneak attack was still too slow, nowhere near Merlin's sword-drawing technique in a different league entirely.

Alice pointed her rapier at Annie, her expression full of caution. Someone who could sneak attack her with a dagger — there was no way she could be just an ordinary village girl. This innocent appearance was surely a facade!

"Who are you!? Why are you sneaking attacking me!?"

"Big sister Alice, why so angry?" Annie wore a half-smile.

"Don't call me that! You're not an ordinary person, are you!?" Alice's expression grew grim, her voice sharp.

"How boring. I was hoping to play a bit longer. You really are someone who can't read the atmosphere..."

A faint golden glow emerged from Annie's body as she dropped her disguise, transforming into the curvaceous Karona with purple hair partially covering her face.

Although Karona had hidden well, dropping her disguise still let Alice know she was a Saint-tier powerhouse.

"I underestimated you a bit. Despite being a weak High-tier, you do have some real skill." Karona glanced at a shallow sword mark on her wrist, wounded by "Light Aria," wisps of white smoke rising from it. "Your sword is decent. I must compliment you — you actually managed to wound me."

"You—"

Alice questioned, taking a combat stance. Since the opponent was a Saint-tier powerhouse, she probably wouldn't last two moves unless she was like the Goblin Emperor, a fraud.

"I am one of the Four Heroes of the former Kingdom, the Dragon-Riding Thief." Karona answered with a smile. Since she'd already been discovered, there was no point hiding.

"Dragon-Riding Thief..."

Alice murmured, remembering what Claude (Bernard) had said — the person before her was named Karona, a remnant of the former Kingdom.

"Looks like you know me."

Karona stepped closer to Alice, exerting immense pressure.

"Stay back!" Alice shouted, her whole body on alert. "You former Kingdom remnants, what do you want from me? Here to avenge Bernard!?"

"That fool is dead, so let him be. No one mourns him endlessly. I'm here to take back something you stole." Karona narrowed her eyes, her smiling expression resembling a fox.

"What did we steal from you!?" Alice furrowed her brows, unable to understand.

"-A key. The red key..." Karona tried to prompt Alice.

"Eh?" Alice paused, instinctively thinking of the key she'd handed to Da Vinci.

"Can't remember, can you?" Karona closed the distance another step.

"Wh-what key!? I don't know anything about it!" Alice felt immense pressure, sensing this woman was exceptionally skilled in close combat.

"How disobedient. Then I'll just kidnap you and have your husband bring the key to redeem you~" Karona had already decided to act.

"He's not my husband! You've misunderstood!" Alice insisted.

"Do I look like I'd believe that? Heh heh heh..." In an instant, Karona dissolved into a purple phantom and lunged at Alice.

"Hah!" Alice's gaze sharpened, her magic surging as she swept her hand, summoning countless large ice spikes from the ground that pounced toward the charging Karona.

"Heh heh heh..." Karona's purple phantom suddenly vanished from Alice's vision.

Panic seized Alice. Against a thief, the worst fear was not knowing their location — every direction felt filled with threat.

She rapidly condensed magic and fighting spirit into ice crystals upon her rapier, boosting her attack power.

All around was silence, only the howling wind outside. Not a single shadow could be seen.

"Where are you looking?" Karona's voice suddenly sounded behind Alice.

With swift reflexes, Alice swung her sword at her rear without thinking, but struck nothing — Karona wasn't there at all.

A cold sweat dropped down her face. Her heart pounded loudly, the sound unusually prominent. An enemy hidden in darkness was the most anxiety-inducing sensation.

Alice knew full well the power gap between herself and her opponent. Karona was clearly toying with her for amusement.

"Too slow. I don't even need to take this seriously." Karona's voice sounded from behind Alice again.

Alice spun around abruptly, wanting to attack, but was met with a kick straight to her face.

Karona's black high heel slammed hard into Alice's abdomen, her expression contorted in a delighted smile.

"Keh!!"

Alice felt excruciating pain in her stomach, screamed, and was sent flying backward like a cannonball, crashing into the wall with a tremendous crash.

"You're truly weak~" Karona approached step by step, her high heels clicking. "Your husband Merlin acts like a gay toward my temptations, showing zero interest. Is he even a man?"

"Cough, cough..." Alice kept coughing, blood at the corner of her mouth, clutching her stomach as she slowly propped up her trembling body. She felt her stomach churning, never expecting a single kick from Karona would leave her so severely injured, nearly unconscious.

"But your husband seems to prefer you more? My figure is better, more feminine. What does 'boring' even mean?" Karona stood before Alice, barely supporting herself.

Alice squeezed out a last ounce of strength, reaching for her fallen rapier, stubbornly determined to fight back.

But Karona moved faster, kicking the rapier away with her high heel. That rapier had wounded her — she couldn't let Alice pick it up.

Karona bent down, one hand supporting her knee, the other lifting Alice's cheek, her expression full of confusion and coquettishness as she breathed softly, "I consider myself full of feminine charm, yet your husband seems only interested in you. What is this? Are you saying my beauty pales in comparison to yours? How laughable. What kind of magic does your innocent, childish face possess?"

"Arrgh! Die!" Alice clenched her teeth, raised her hand, magic surging, still fighting back.

But this struggle was useless against Saint-tier Karona, who hadn't even used her full power yet, simply enjoying playing with Alice.

Karona suddenly gripped Alice's throat with one hand, lifting her off the ground and interrupting her spell.

"Aah... let me go... urgh!... Let me go!"

Alice's face flushed red from the grip, her eyes filled with pain, her hands constantly clawing at Karona, but the power gap was too great. She couldn't break free, her feet dangling above the ground, flailing helplessly.

"Fine, I've played enough. Be a good hostage now, big sister Alice~"

Karona gave Alice a sweet smile and punched her directly in the stomach.

"Cough!" Alice's eyes widened, coughing up a mouthful of blood that splattered onto Karona's face. Her limbs went limp, and she instantly fell into a deep coma.

"Haha..." Karona laughed watching the unconscious Alice, then ran her tongue along her cheek to taste the blood staining her lips, making her already red lips even more crimson.

"The key's筹码, the hunt was successful. Heh heh heh~"

title: Chapter 48
content:
Chapter 48

Volume 4 · Chapter 48

Carona let go of her hand, letting the unconscious Alice fall to the ground.

"How boring. I finally got a chance to stretch my limbs, and my opponent turns out to be some weak high-ranking one."

Caro shook his head, a self-mocking smile on his lips as he began chanting an ancient spell.

A dark, abyssal black hole appeared before them, and from within it slowly emerged a man wearing a grinning mask and wrapped head to toe in bandages.

It was Zoe, one of the Four Heroes of the former kingdom, and the elder brother of the Twin Sword Sages!

"Yo~ Caro-na..." Zoe's voice was hoarse as he stroked his body. "What brings me here? You want to beg for my help?"

"I do need your help with a small matter," Carona said expressionlessly.

"The Majesty told me you don't need my help at all. Is it because the enemy is too strong, forcing even someone as proud as you to bow before me?" Zoe smiled darkly, like a ghost, exuding a chilling aura.

"Don't joke around. This small favor doesn't warrant me bowing to you. It's simply for our shared great cause," Carona said coldly, clearly displeased with Zoe's attitude.

"Hmph. What do you need me to do?" Zoe snorted.

"Take this woman back to our stronghold." Carona pointed at Alice lying on the ground.

Zoe glanced at the unconscious Alice on the ground and asked, "Why? What's special about this woman?"

"The key to the Hell Legion was taken by her and her husband. They no longer have it on them, and I don't know who they handed it to. I plan to use this woman as a hostage and force her husband to trade the key for her," Carona explained briefly.

"Why go through all that trouble? Just capture them and use torture to make them reveal where the key is. Wouldn't that be better?" A flicker of mania flashed in Zoe's bloodshot eyes.

"Her husband isn't someone easy to deal with. Capturing him would be quite difficult," Carona said calmly.

"If you feel pressured, he must be quite strong. Want me to help you?" Zoe narrowed his eyes, suddenly interested in Merlin.

"No need. Who do you take me for?" Carona smiled, his expression arrogant. "I've already summoned Malygos. I think that guy is currently fighting hard, or perhaps already crushed beneath the Frost Saint Dragon."

"You actually summoned Malygos?" Zoe was slightly stunned, genuinely shocked within. That legendary Saint Dragon had been thought long dead, yet it was still alive.

"Shaken?" Carona felt a bit smug.

"Not exactly shaken. Just a little surprised. The combined ultimate technique of my brother and I has tremendous attacking power — we might just be able to tear apart a Frost Saint Dragon," Zoe said meaningfully, seemingly unafraid of the Frost Saint Dragon.

"Hmph!" Carona snorted, unconvinced by Zoe and assuming he was just boasting.

"I need to go check on the situation over there. Hurry up and send the hostage back."

"If possible, I'd very much like to personally cut out that man's tongue."

"Anyone who calls me 'auntie' won't have a good ending."

Before the time rewind — a while earlier.

Merlin punched the Frost Saint Dragon, sending it skidding far from the church to an open area.

Roar!

The Frost Saint Dragon growled miserably and slid across the ground, carving a long trench.

Merlin descended from the sky, grinning as he looked down at the Frost Saint Dragon, his eyes full of battle intent.

"So you're Malygos? Your scales are quite pretty, like a craftsmanship piece..."

"Small human, how dare you slap my face? You will pay a dearly price!"

The Frost Saint Dragon quickly rose to its feet, shaking its massive wings, and began circling Merlin, its ice-blue eyes filled with vigilance.

This human who could shake its body and make it feel pain was not ordinary — his strength was already quite formidable.

But once he truly got serious, this insignificant human would undoubtedly be instantly annihilated!

The Frost Saint Dragon had full confidence in his own strength. Among all of the human world, there were barely any creatures worthy of his attention — he could count them on one hand.

"Make me pay a dearly price? Fine, that sounds delightful. I was hoping your power could actually injure me."

Merlin circled along with the Frost Saint Dragon, always keeping it directly in front of him, maintaining a combat-ready stance.

A man and a dragon kept watch over each other in the open field, pacing around one another. The space had become a coliseum where only one would survive.

"You truly are an arrogant human. Has ignorance robbed you of fear? I am Malygos, one of the Six Great Saint Dragons!"

The Frost Saint Dragon roared, his colossal dragon's roar seeming capable of tearing the sky apart. A creature who radiated no magical or warrior energy pressure refused to bow to his dragon presence — instead, he remained arrogant! This infuriated him greatly.

Even knowing Merlin had some strength, the Frost Saint Dragon still believed he couldn't possibly be his match. He saw the other as an ignorant fool, unaware of heaven's height or earth's depth, daring to speak such arrogance before him.

"Hmm?" Merlin frowned slightly and said calmly, "I know you're one of the Six Great Saint Dragons, but I find it rather unimpressive."

"What did you say?!" Fire surged within the Frost Saint Dragon. Someone dared to look down upon the Six Great Saint Dragons? His brain must have been—

The anger? It came to him on a silver platter.

Merlin now already regarded himself as dead in the Frost Saint Dragon's eyes — only slightly more intelligent, that's all. Merlin shrugged.

"The Six Great Saint Dragons are no different from ordinary large lizards in my eyes. When I call my dog Wangcai, he wags his tail at me," he continued. "Take the Radiant Saint Dragon among you, for instance — right now, he's my little plaything~"

"Absolutely not! I, a Saint Dragon, will never submit to an insignificant human!"

"Nonsense! Avis cannot possibly be like that! We are great Saint Dragons—"

He went into a frenzied roar, conjuring a cold blizzard around himself. "And you'll be dead soon anyway. I see no need to lie to you."

"It's true. Avis is currently the lowest-ranking being in the demon race. That's reality."

Merlin shook his head, thinking that someone so arrogantly self-possessed was simply difficult to reason with. The golden flames within him burned fiercely. "Pathetic and lowly human—

"What are you talking about?!" The Frost Saint Dragon suddenly assumed an attack stance, his eyes—

"Daring to humiliate us like this! Do you want to die that badly?!" Merlin, braving the biting cold wind, laughed and pointed at the Frost Saint Dragon.

"Hah, I won't die, because the one lying drowned in blood will surely be you!"

"Despicable human!!!" The Frost Saint Dragon unleashed his dragon breath, a blue-white pillar of light carrying terrifyingly low temperatures that froze everything in its path. J作用!

But unfortunately, before Merlin, who was immune to magic, none of it had any effect. The scattered ice shards flew past him, creating countless beautiful frost formations out of thin air! Shivering cold—

The Frost Saint Dragon stared wide-eyed and instinctively stepped back, his dragon mouth gaping in shock.

"W-what the—

2(OonOo!)

title: Chapter 45 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Votes
content:
Chapter 45 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Votes

Volume 4 · Chapter 45

"Ha ha~" Merlin chuckled, not taking the dragon's breath attack seriously at all.

"How can it have no effect?!" The Frost Sacred Dragon was extremely startled by what had just happened, utterly disbelief.

"Stop using magic, it's useless..." Merlin wore an expression of sympathy.

The Frost Sacred Dragon narrowed its eyes, as if remembering something. "Nonsense! Don't think you can be so conceited here just because you have magic-defense equipment! Our great dragon race's close-quarters combat is also extraordinary! Just submit and be reduced to flesh paste!"

"Want to fight me hand-to-hand? Come then, let me see your martial arts skills. If you're not as good as our Wangcai, I'll be disappointed."

Merlin beckoned to the Frost Sacred Dragon, his eyes full of contempt.

"Arrogant insect! Seeking death!"

The Frost Sacred Dragon let out a long roar, and a Saint-tier golden battle aura surged across its beautiful blue-and-white body as it charged toward Merlin!

Despite the Frost Sacred Dragon's enormous size, it moved swiftly rather than slowly—only a white afterimage could be seen suddenly flashing past.

Its massive dragon wings beat once, causing the very air to tremble, accompanied by a fierce blizzard, its momentum like a moving iceberg.

Merlin realized battle aura attacks could still affect him, so he became slightly more serious, wanting to see just how strong the Frost Sacred Dragon truly was.

Before the chilling wind carried by the Frost Sacred Dragon could even reach Merlin's face, its enormous body had already closed in!

"Boom!" A loud muffled sound erupted as the Frost Sacred Dragon began using a dragon martial art.

An "Ice Dragon Heavy Fist" hammered toward Merlin's face, but he blocked it with both hands!

"Ha ha, pretty average, then. Your martial arts are weaker than our Wangcai's. Are you perhaps better suited to magic?" Merlin resisted the Frost Sacred Dragon's claws, wearing a half-smile, apparently feeling no pressure.

The Frost Sacred Dragon was startled within, thinking this human was no ordinary fellow! Could he actually withstand my full-power punch?! His strength must definitely be among the top-tier humans!

The Frost Sacred Dragon shook its wings and soared skyward, circling in the heavens, causing the temperature to plummet dramatically!

It couldn't accept that Merlin had resisted its attack—what right did such a insignificant human who couldn't even sense magic or battle aura have to look down on a great Sacred Dragon like itself?!

The Frost Sacred Dragon believed Merlin was merely putting up a strong front, and with increased force it could easily crush him, so it launched a frenzy of continuous strikes:

"Ice Dragon Wing Strike!"

"Ice Dragon Tail Sweep!"

"Ice Dragon Hook Sickle!"

The more the Frost Sacred Dragon fought, the more alarmed it became. A whole series of techniques seemed to have almost no effect on Merlin, apparently only causing minor scrapes.

Why was this guy's physique so overwhelmingly tough?

No matter what attacks he faced, they could all be defended against!

I'm already so powerful—why can I only deal trivial damage to him?

The Frost Sacred Dragon grew anxious and unleashed a extremely powerful "Ice Dragon Impact." It dove from the sky, flying at extreme speed at low altitude, and suddenly rammed its crown-like horns directly at Merlin.

The blizzard instantly transformed into bayonets, sharp enough to slice through human flesh—this impact carried tremendous momentum!

The Frost Sacred Dragon's horns were held at bay by one of Merlin's hands, producing a tremendous "crack" sound. The ground cracked open in an instant, fragments of stone exploding skyward.

Yet Merlin only retreated one small step, cracking the ground beneath his feet, but he nonetheless halted the Frost Sacred Dragon's charge.

The earth lay ravaged, pits and fissures looking gruesome!

A trace of panic appeared in the Frost Sacred Dragon's blue eyes. What the hell! This still had no effect?! Is he really human?!

Merlin stroked the Frost Sacred Dragon's horn, a contemptuous smile on his face.

Although Merlin's tiny frame was like an ant before the giant dragon—even smaller than the beast's nostril—he felt this big lizard wasn't particularly strong, only its low temperature being excessively uncomfortable.

"Ha ha, is this all you've got? Really disappointing!"

Merlin delivered a hard punch to the Frost Sacred Dragon's nose, sending its massive body flying.

The Frost Sacred Dragon let out a miserable wail, rolling continuously across the ground with a rumbling sound.

"You've got no more tricks, have you? Then it's time I let you experience despair!" Merlin adjusted his black gloves.

The Frost Sacred Dragon staggered to its feet, shaking its large head vigorously, feeling somewhat dizzy.

"With such strength, you rank among the rare few even among humans. Reveal your name!"

The Frost Sacred Dragon roared, sensing there were few humans who could match it—but it had never seen Merlin before.

"Me?" Merlin pointed to himself, thought for a moment, then replied carelessly, "You're barely qualified to know my name. I am Lucifer III, the First Demon Lord Palace's Great Demon Lord, the strongest monarch of pride."

The First Demon Lord Palace's Great Demon Lord?

He must be that demon Cora mentioned.

But this guy is definitely lying, because I can't sense any demonic aura from him at all!

He's probably trying to scare me off by borrowing the prestigious name of a Great Demon Lord. What naive fool...

The Frost Sacred Dragon narrowed its eyes, not believing a word Merlin said, and decided to go all-out, overwhelming him with sheer power.

"Despicable human, I admit you're strong, but before a great Sacred Dragon, you have no grounds for arrogance!"

"Oh? Still refusing to accept defeat?" Merlin smiled crookedly, watching the guy who thought himself so powerful leap about in front of him, feeling a wave of exasperation.

The Frost Sacred Dragon spread its enormous wings and ascended into the sky, blotting out the sun like a deity and casting the earth beneath a pitch-black shadow.

"I know you have magic-defense equipment, but there will always be a limit to what you can endure. Next, I'll show you the ultimate secret technique forged by my lifetime of effort: Ice River Descent! Keep your eyes wide open! This is the pinnacle of ice-element dragon chant magic! In an instant, everything before my eyes will become eternal permafrost!"

Ice River Descent was Marigos's most powerful spell, freezing and encasing all living things in a vast area, creating a scene like an ice hell. Back then, the half-freezing of the Greenland Sea had used this very technique. Under this ultimate art, surely no one could survive!

From the shadows, Cora waited for an opportunity to strike. She had been present since Marigos was using martial arts to attack Merlin earlier, her heart pounding with fear at Merlin's overwhelming strength—so much so that Marigos had been forced to use his strongest secret technique!

Good heavens!

This guy is so powerful!

Even placing him 400 years ago, it would be hard to find a worthy opponent!

Could everything she'd heard be true? Is he really the current Great Demon Lord of the First Demon Lord Palace?

Though she couldn't sense any demonic aura, this level of power truly wasn't something a human could achieve!

A drop of cold sweat formed on Cora's forehead as she felt waves of pressure, hiding her presence and patiently waiting.

A giant blue magic阵 suddenly appeared before the Frost Sacred Dragon, with dragon script floating upon it—it looked even larger than the dragon's entire body.

"Hmm, it seems you have no more potential left. Pushing yourself to the limit only brings forth this much strength. Truly disappointing..." Merlin stepped sideways, gripped his sword hilt, and assumed a drawing stance.

"So then..."

"Let me bring this boring game to a close!"

(一一)

title: Chapter 50 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 50 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 4 · Chapter 50

Judging from Malygos's description earlier, Merlin roughly understood that 「Glacial Descent」 was an ultra-wide-area dragon language spell.

It was very likely that the villagers of Rovicore Village would be caught in the crossfire, but what worried Merlin was Alice. Although she was high-tier, it was still unknown whether she could withstand the Frost Holy Dragon's ultimate secret art.

Merlin's feelings toward Alice weren't particularly strong, but given his debt consolidation situation, he couldn't afford for Alice to accidentally croak — that would be letting her off too easy.

Otherwise he'd be facing tens of millions in debt alone, with nothing but a splitting headache. His current mindset was that if he had to suffer, he must drag Alice along to suffer with him.

The Frost Holy Dragon hung suspended in the sky, its beautiful dragon body slowly twisting as if dancing.

It hummed a cryptic, incomprehensible dragon incantation, as if transporting listeners to an ancient era and letting them hear songs long forgotten.

The blue magic circle grew ever brighter, the dragon runes upon it moving, twisting and transforming.

Even from far away, one could feel the terrifying draconic pressure and the boiling magical elements!

The air temperature plummeted, becoming unbearably cold, and the ground froze over at a visibly rapid pace, turning a deathly pale and crystal white.

It looked beautiful, but it signaled a threat of death.

Although Merlin was immune to magic, this ultra-low temperature still sent faint chills through him.

As for Karona, being undead, she had no worries at all. As long as her soul fire at headquarters didn't extinguish, she could still function.

Merlin's golden hair fluttered, his hand gripping his sword hilt as he suddenly launched himself from the ground. The force of that single kick split the earth, revealing just how tremendous it was.

His figure became a bolt of lightning, charging straight toward Malygos in the sky.

Merlin intended to take out the Frost Holy Dragon before 「Glacial Descent」 was activated!

Unaided by wings, Merlin was not well-suited for aerial combat, so there was only one chance — he had to seize it carefully.

"Here comes the opportunity~"

Karona, hidden in the shadows, chuckled softly and drew her two red snake-shaped daggers.

The moment the opportunity for an ambush arrived, Karona no longer concealed herself, but decisively launched a swift strike, transforming into a purple phantom as she quickly closed in on Merlin mid-air.

Karona's assassination techniques were highly variable, and her speed wasn't far behind Merlin's. At this moment, she chose her Saint-tier martial art: the Coiling Serpent Stranglehold.

This Saint-tier technique was specifically designed to deal with tough opponents, restricting their movements until they were completely immobilized, then slowly slitting their enemy's throat.

"Hm!?"

By the time Merlin sensed the killing intent behind him, he was already a step too slow.

Karona's figure resembled a ghost, her tall and sexy body instantly wrapping around Merlin's frame and binding his limbs.

Merlin was slightly taken aback. He never expected someone to suddenly appear and ambush him at such a critical moment!?

Their bodies entangled in mid-air — originally a rather sensual scene — but it gave one an unsettling chill, because Karona's crimson daggers had already successfully crossed and locked onto Merlin's throat. As expected of a legendary-class thief, she was only one step away from assassinating a Great Demon Lord!?

"Hmph hmph hmph~" Karona laughed proudly, her eyes bloodshot, looking very excited. "Little brother, hurry up and call me sister~ If you call me sister, how about I let you live?"

"Who are you?" Merlin asked in a cold, expressionless voice. No one had ever dared press a dagger to his neck — anyone who had done so was already dead beneath the blade!

"Already forgotten your big sister so soon? Didn't you have me dancing on your body just recently..." Karona protruded her long tongue, licking her own vivid red lips, resembling a demon.

"Is that so? So it's that old broad. I already told you I have no interest in old women like you — why do you still dare come throwing yourself at me recklessly?" Merlin's gaze turned icy. His limbs were locked by Karona, unable to move an inch. It seemed like a definitely fatal situation!

The Frost Dragon above the heavens appeared to have finished preparing its secret art, and could unleash 「Glacial Descent」 at any moment. It seemed there was already no time to stop it.

At this point, Merlin didn't know Alice had been captured. He still secretly prayed in his heart for the Goddess of Fortune to look after Alice, hoping she'd be lucky enough to躲过 this catastrophe.

"I'm not an old broad! Why keep insulting me!?! I'll forever be a seventeen-year-old beautiful girl!" Karona seemed to have a morbid obsession with her age. Her expression twisted viciously, her purple hair covering half her face rising to reveal patches of rotting skin, her protruding eyeballs appearing sinister and terrifying.

"I advise you to let go of me as quickly as possible. Don't seek your own death." Merlin said expressionlessly.

"What?" Karona was stunned. She wondered why he remained so calm when her dagger was already pressed against his neck.

"I am the strongest among the Seven Demon Lords, the Sovereign of Pride. No one can press a cold dagger against my neck..." Merlin glanced sideways at the Karona behind him, glaring angrily. "As a king, how could I tolerate your threats?! Not even the gods are allowed!"

"Ugh!" Karona's delicate body shuddered. Seeing Merlin's cold eyes, a sense of fear rose from within her heart. That sovereign authority belonging to the supreme ruler made one involuntarily tremble. It wasn't fake at all. Could he truly be the Great Demon Lord who dwelled in the Marsh of Death!?

Merlin detested nothing more than being threatened, and it stirred waves of revulsion within his heart.

Worse still, he felt that his dignity had been trampled by Karona.

Merlin began to break free from Karona's bindings, and used the most overbearing method — crushing through her with pure force.

No matter whether Karona was a temperament marvel or a calamitous fairy, having angered Merlin meant only one path ahead: death. He showed no mercy and sent her straight to hell.

Merlin rawly snapped Karona's snow-white jade arms with sheer strength, seeming to exert no effort at all, then immediately delivered a vicious elbow strike to her beautiful face.

"Cough ah—"

Karona was struck, her face beaten into bloody pulp, her body hurtling straight like a meteor from the sky into the ground, cratering the earth and spraying dense snow dust. Whether she lived or died was uncertain.

Interrupted by Karona's interference, Merlin failed to approach the Frost Holy Dragon and instead fell back to the ground.

The moment Merlin's feet touched the earth, the Frost Holy Dragon's secret art, 「Glacial Descent」, was instantly unleashed.

The Frost Holy Dragon in the sky wrapped itself in a cocoon with its dragon wings, then suddenly spread its wings wide, emitting light comparable to the sun!

Centering on the Frost Holy Dragon, the light instantly spread across a vast area, killing everything beneath the winter's grip.

Merlin clicked his tongue. Due to the blazing intensity of the light, he was forced to cover his eyes.

He could only feel a bone-etching cold piercing straight through his body.

When Merlin lowered his hand shielding his eyes, the entire world was enveloped in a sea of white.

Wherever his gaze reached, everything was covered in crystal-clear ice and snow, with several ice tornadoes shooting into the sky.

Distant mountains and vegetation alike had become ice sculptures, countless ice spikes rivaling mountains in size, as if one had entered a frozen hell!

All living things had nearly died in that single instant. The chances of survival were vanishingly slim.

The current scene was like civilization had regressed, returning to the legendary Ice Age!

As expected, the Frost Holy Dragon was better suited to magic. To be able to produce such a wide-area freeze — how terrifying was its magical power? But it was still utterly useless against Merlin.

Merlin glanced at the distant church, a worried tightening in his heart. He wondered how Alice was doing — had she already turned into an ice sculpture? She should be able to barely survive, right? She was so far from the core area, and even if she was only high-tier mediocre...

"Why!? Why are you still fine!?" The Frost Holy Dragon finally panicked. It had never encountered such a situation — even its strongest secret art couldn't so much as scratch the opponent.

"I've said it a hundred times — magic is universally ineffective against me!" Merlin kicked off the ground and soared upward, rapidly closing in on Malygos.

"Even a demon race sovereign shouldn't be able to emerge unscathed from my secret art! Who exactly are you?! Could you be a god who survived from the Era of the Gods!?" The Frost Holy Dragon was afraid, beating its dragon wings to retreat backward, wanting to flee.

"No idea? If your soul is lucky enough to ascend to heaven, you can go ask that bitch the Goddess of Light!"

Merlin gave the Frost Holy Dragon no chance to escape. His speed was bizarrely fast as he shot from the ground straight into the sky.

His waist-mounted katana was drawn in one motion — a single slash, slaughtering the dragon.

The Frost Holy Dragon's originally indestructible scales were, in fact, like tofu dregs.

They provided absolutely no defensive function. Merlin's draw-cut severed its slender neck in an instant — the kill was complete!

Malygos's dragon head separated from its massive body, and crimson blood fireworks exploded in the sky in an instant....

title: Chapter 51
content:
Chapter 51

Volume 4 · Chapter 51

Malygos was killed in one stroke by Merlin — his head separated from his body in midair, dragon blood exploding through the sky like fireworks.

Before the otherworldly Frost Divine Dragon could even let out a scream, before he could fully register the chilling intent behind Merlin's draw cut, he was already dead.

Merlin landed, shattering the frozen ground beneath his feet with each step. Although not skilled in aerial combat, as long as he could jump high enough, executing an instant kill on a Saint-tier dragon wasn't difficult.

Malygos's corpse fell from the sky and crashed to the ground with a thunderous impact. His head bounced a few times like a rubber ball, those ice-blue eyes now utterly lifeless.

As for the headless dragon body, it continued to spasm and twitch on the ground, its belly turned inside out, dragon blood spraying like a fountain, staining the white snow crimson until, after a short while, it went completely still and lifeless.

Merlin shook the dragon blood clean off his pitch-black katana, then skillfully sheathed it.

Half his face was splattered with dragon blood, turning it a crimson scarlet and making him look like a blood-soaked Asura, standing proudly in the midst of the frozen river.

A wave of relief spread through his heart — the curse had been noticeably alleviated, likely not flaring up again for quite some time.

After all, Malygos's strength was respectable, so the effect of easing the heart curse would certainly be far greater than against ordinary foes.

Merlin turned to leave, wiping his dragon-blood-stained face with his sleeve, planning to check on Alice at the church — hopefully she hadn't gotten into trouble.

He had barely stepped away from the dragon corpse when suddenly a purple phantom flashed past overhead, and a familiar scent of an older woman's perfume caught his nose.

Merlin whirled around to see Carolna standing atop the Frost Divine Dragon's head — the same Carolna from earlier.

At this moment, Carolna was no longer the sensual and enchanting woman she used to be; she had become as repulsive as a walking corpse.

Her face was sunken, her eyeballs hanging loosely from their sockets, her limbs almost entirely twisted and deformed, like something that had just clawed its way out of a grave.

Countless bones throughout her body were broken, yet she could still maintain movement — and even after taking the冲击 of "Glacial Descent," she had avoided any fatal injuries.

It seemed the advantage of the undead was very clear: as long as the soul flame didn't extinguish, they could never truly die. Otherwise, a normal person struck by Merlin's elbow would have died long ago.

"What? Still alive..." Merlin said flatly, his expression devoid of emotion, showing absolutely no regard for Carolna. His scornful gaze was as if he were looking at an ant.

"Cough, cough..." Carolna seemed to have some problem with her throat — she couldn't speak, could only cough to express her anger, her bloodshot eyes brimming with malice.

"That look..." Merlin crooked his lips slightly and said casually, "You want to kill me?"

Carolna swung her dark red dagger, slicing open the Frost Divine Dragon's skull, and plunged her arm inside.

Viscous brain matter coated her arm as she groped around, and in an instant, her fingers brushed against something hard.

Carolna's heart leaped with joy, and she sneered at Merlin like a wild ghost in the night.

Merlin narrowed his eyes, feeling as though he sensed something. He couldn't quite pinpoint what, but it was definitely some kind of trump card or similar thing.

Carolna withdrew her arm from the dragon's brain, and there, floating in her palm, was a small ice-blue crystal radiating brilliant light.

"That..."

Merlin's eyes widened. Though he had never seen a dragon clan inheritance crystallization, he had a strong feeling that the small crystal in Carolna's hand was precisely the legendary object said to allow humans to transform into dragon form!

He had assumed the chance of it appearing was minuscule — roughly equivalent to his odds of winning a horse race — but who would have thought Malygos had one right inside his brain!?

It seemed he had still underestimated Alice's luck stat. The Goddess of Fortune practically looked like her mother! This went far beyond mere special favoritism!

Merlin felt somewhat resentful. From the moment he was born, bad luck had piling onto him constantly, while Alice seemed to have the exact opposite — various luck auras blessing her. How unfair!

Why did Carolna know there was an inheritance crystallization inside Malygos's brain?

That brought us to a certain night over four hundred years ago. As the only person in the kingdom who could speak the Dragon Tongue, Carolna had naturally conversed with Malygos.
