Yet now she had fiercely slapped the head knight in the face on behalf of a subordinate knight. How satisfying it was.

Not just the ordinary onlookers — even Chapman was witnessing for the first time a Thorn Knight reprimanding a head knight, his astonishment almost beyond description.

"Your Excellency Mestfield, perhaps you should—"

"Say nothing more. Franklin nearly dragged Her Majesty into a fire pit. That slap was delivered on behalf of the Queen." Mestfield cut off Chapman from speaking further.

She had seen everything just now. Public outrage had been ignited. If he didn't know when to stop and instead destabilized Queen Elizabeth's position, even executing Franklin wouldn't be enough to挽回 the damage.

Chapman clammed up. He was merely a captain-rank knight — how would he dare to dictate terms to a Thorn Knight?

"Spit!"

Franklin opened his mouth and spat out two molars. That slap had actually knocked his teeth loose! ?

Why is he hitting me? Was I wrong to protect Her Majesty?

I am the head knight too, and I have my dignity. Even a Thorn Knight can't just slap me around!

Franklin clutched his cheek, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth, and slowly rose to his feet, his expression utterly baffled.

"Your Excellency Mestfield... why are you hitting me? Chapman defied orders, refused to stick to the prepared script, and damaged our knight order's reputation. What's wrong with executing him?"

"Franklin," Mestfield said expressionlessly. "Chapman preserved the last shred of dignity for the Bauhinia Knight Order. He did nothing wrong. The fault is yours."

"Why? Your Excellency Mestfield, don't you realize? Hero Elgin's fame only grows louder, and he's already beginning to shake our knight order's position." Franklin pointed at Chapman, speaking earnestly. "He openly sides with Hero Elgin — what else is he but a traitor to us!?"

"Franklin, why can't you ever understand? What Chapman did was entirely correct, and thanks to him, our knight order's honor has not been sullied." Mestfield said seriously, her position unmistakable.

"Your Excellency Mestfield... are you really saying that?" Franklin's expression was blank, finding it hard to believe.

"Of course I am serious. Chapman is not at fault. The fault is yours, for using such despicable means to steal credit and deceive the common people here. Your conduct alone proves—" Mestfield's eyes were full of open contempt as she spoke without reservation, "—that you are utterly unworthy of being called a knight. Your actions have shamed not only Her Majesty but the entire knight order's honor!"

"Ugh!" Franklin tried to argue further, stubbornly insisting, "Your Excellency Mestfield! As the Queen's sword, if our status is shaken—"

"Enough! Franklin! Do you think this farce hasn't already embarrassed us enough!?" Mestfield scolded in a voice brooking no argument. "I will report this matter directly to Her Majesty myself."

"Arrgh!" Franklin dared not defy her, could only glare at Mestfield with hatred, then turned on his heel and strode away in anger, refusing to say another word.

Mestfield approached Bella, her tone softening slightly as she asked, "Miss reporter, is this still being broadcast live?"

"Huh?"

Bella had been so engrossed in their quarrel that it took Mestfield's question to snap her back to attention.

This was her first time seeing the First Thorn Knight up close. That pale lavender hair made her look exceptionally noble.

Everyone praised her as the strongest Saint-tier — and now up close, her beauty was equally striking. As expected of Her Majesty's premier knight.

Bella marvelled inwardly and quickly replied to Mestfield.

"Yes, we are indeed live broadcasting right now."

"Could I say a few words?" Mestfield, lost in thought, actually wanted to speak to the camera.

Bella's heart leaped with delight. As far as she remembered, this First Thorn Knight had never granted an interview before. She'd just scored another big story.

"Of course, Your Excellency Mestfield. Please go ahead."

Seeing Bella hand her the microphone, Mestfield felt a hint of nervousness.

A slight flush tinged her cheeks. She worried about whether her appearance and demeanor were appropriate.

After all, this was her first interview. Some fluster was only natural.

But the First Thorn Knight quickly composed herself, facing the camera with a serious expression.

"Hello everyone. I am the premier knight of the Bauhinia Knight Order, Windsor Terence Mestfield."

"On behalf of the knight order, I sincerely apologize for the farce staged by Knight Commander Franklin just now."

"Perhaps our performance this time was not outstanding, and we will face considerable criticism."

"But the spirit with which we protect Great Britain is genuine, and it will never change in the slightest."

"As for those roving warriors who dare not reveal even their names or true faces — can the general public truly trust them?"

"Please keep faith in our knight order. We will prove through action who the true guardian of Great Britain is!"

"On behalf of the First Thorn Knight, I extend my gratitude to Hero Elgin regarding this expedition."

"But I also have some words for this mysterious great swordsman..."

"No matter what righteous cause you pursue, the destruction of a thousand royal warships remains a fact."

"As a wanted criminal, if you continue to roam about freely, I will make certain you are imprisoned in the most secure dungeon in Great Britain!"

After the broadcast ended,

the adventurers began buzzing with excitement.

Some were very interested in the Bauhinia Knight Order's internal infighting.

Others discussed heatedly how ugly the Queen's manners had been.

But most still couldn't stop talking about Hero Elgin.

This time Merlin's silhouette had made a huge splash, slaughtering countless Saint-tier undead! ?

This swagger would likely be bragged about for an entire lifetime. Before long, the entire human kingdom would know of this legendary great swordsman.

By then, Hero Elgin might well be hailed as the human closest to godhood, the strongest man in the world, or other supreme titles.

If the world discovered that the righteous Hero Elgin was actually the evil First Demon Lord of the Grand Hall... it would surely spark considerable panic.

The problem was that such a powerful existence was unmonitored and still living in Great Britain,随时 posing a potential catastrophe.

Queen Elizabeth would feel uneasy. Her authority could be threatened, and countermeasures might very well follow.

Merlin tilted his lips slightly, shook his head with an indifferent smile, and thought helplessly inwardly:

What kind of situation is this?

Everyone's obsessed with my legendary silhouette.

Come on, I have zero interest in becoming the guardian of Britain.

And that Mestfield actually wants to throw me in jail?

Heh, how amusing.

Since that knight lady speaks so arrogantly, then I'll have to pay extra attention to you~

(w//▽//w)

title: Chapter 18 — Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 18 — Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 18

Alice felt things might have blown up out of proportion, so she asked with an meaningful look.

"What are your thoughts about being mistaken for the great swordsman Elgin?"

"I have no thoughts, because I am the great swordsman Elgin," Merlin said, shrugging his shoulders with an innocent expression.

"You really know how to take the hint, you thick-skinned guy. Even if you're stronger than the great swordsman Elgin, you don't have a tenth of his charm. Stop slapping that reputation on yourself, hmph~!"

Alice crossed her arms, looking thoroughly annoyed, completely unwilling to believe that Merlin was actually the great swordsman Elgin himself.

She actually thought Merlin was bragging, trying to hitch a ride on the great swordsman Elgin's popularity.

Merlin sighed and spread his hands, his face serene as he said, "What should I say to that?"

"Oh? You're here? Why did it take you so long to get to the guild? I saw Merlin come back days ago." Hobbs walked over carrying a bottle of cheap whiskey, a perpetual drunken flush on his face.

"Oh well..." Alice scratched her cheek and said awkwardly, "It's a long story."

"Lucia said your mission failed?" Hobbs put his hand on Merlin's shoulder.

"How did you know?" Merlin asked in surprise.

"How a mission goes, Lucia gets the news fastest," Hobbs explained casually. Merlin nodded, figuring the time limit must have run out and it was automatically judged a failure.

"A failure is just a failure, it's fine. As long as everyone's safe, that's what matters. There's always next time~" Hobbs waved his hand broadly, speaking like a seasoned adventurer. "Actually, in our line of work as adventurers, mission failures are way too common. Don't let it weigh on your mind as a newbie, burp~"

Merlin was nearly overcome by Hobbs's alcohol burps, fanning his nose as he said, "I don't have any psychological pressure at all."

"You've got a good attitude, friend. Your wife Alice is the serious type." Hobbs thought for a moment and grinned. "I remember when she first became an adventurer and failed her first mission, she went to Lucia and cried about it for ages, hehe~"

Merlin looked at Alice and recalled that during the carriage ride back, Alice's expression had indeed been quite despondent.

"You're making that up! I never cried!" Alice's face turned red as she retorted.

"You can ask Lucia about that." Hobbs raised his whiskey and downed two gulps, his face full of satisfaction.

"You dare!" Alice was so angry she wanted to punch Hobbs right in the eye socket.

"By the way, Merlin, I'll tell you something in private." Hobbs deliberately lowered his voice and said mysteriously, "Right now there's a Damocles' green hat over your head, ready to drop at any moment."

"What do you mean?" Merlin frowned.

"I heard Lucia mention that Alice seems to really like the great swordsman Elgin. You should watch out." Hobbs stroked his chin and said seriously, "I figure someone like you definitely can't beat a national idol, so you'll need to use your big banana to conquer Alice's soul to be safe."

Merlin gave a dry laugh, thinking he'd already known that secret long ago. Honestly, Lucia is such a loose mouth.

"S秒杀 countless Saint-tier adventurers? Not many people in my understanding could do that. It must be that knight exaggerating. If it's true, then the great swordsman Elgin isn't human—he's more like a god." Hobbs stroked his chin thoughtfully, still harboring doubts about what he'd just heard.

Alice was covered in question marks above her head, unable to hear what they were chatting about, very curious.

"Alice-san!!!"

A familiar voice sounded, making Alice's whole body shiver involuntarily.

Arnold slid in and dropped to his knees right in front of Alice, holding out a bright red rose.

His eyes were sparkling, his blue hair neatly curled, fully embodying the shrine maiden protagonist from a shoujo manga.

"Beautiful Lady Alice, welcome back, ooh~"

"Stay away from me, Arnold! Why are you always like this?!" Alice was beside herself.

"I have to show my enthusiasm, otherwise I won't even have the chance to wear a green hat." Arnold said with one-sided devotion.

"No, you look disgusting!" Alice's expression darkened, showing clear disdain.

Arnold's heart was stabbed.

"Alice, Arnold has been waiting for you at the guild entrance every day recently, rain or shine." Hobbs said in an indifferent tone.

"Waah!" Alice jumped back a step in horror and said, "What the hell!? He's like a stalker, so gross!"

"Ghh!" Arnold's heart was stabbed a second time, cold sweat streaming down his forehead.

"Don't go calling people perverts all the time. Last night we slept together and you called me a pervert after waking up. That really hurts, you know?" Merlin said expressionlessly, looking quite disgusted.

"What are you talking about!?" Alice's face flushed as red as a ripe apple and she retorted angrily, "Climbing onto my bed without permission in the middle of the night while I was completely unconscious—what's wrong with me calling you a pervert?!"

"Woah~" Hobbs let out an exclamation, raised his eyebrows, and shot Merlin a look that said *you know exactly what I mean*.

"Pfft!" Arnold's heart was stabbed a third time by the philanderer and the adulteress working together. He promptly coughed up three liters of blood, then tearfully ran out of the guild, waaaahhhhh!

The three of them watched Arnold's defeated loser-like背影 with complicated feelings.

Merlin smacked his lips and said inappropriately, "See? I told you not to insult people so casually. How poisonous is your mouth?"

Alice secretly but firmly elbowed Merlin's ribs and said discontentedly, "Shut up, you're not innocent either."

"Grandie! Grandie, fight back!"

"Wtf! Grandie, stop looking at that mare!"

"Damn it! This is a race, save the mating for tonight, okay?!"

"Rigged at the Royal Racetrack again! They even used that beautiful horse's record!"

Merlin angrily threw the horse racing pamphlet to the ground, his mood sinking, while the horses on the screen raced furiously.

Hobbs took a sip of whiskey and said with a smile, "This Grandie isn't as good as Richard."

"Both are rotten."

Alice, sitting at the counter, offered a casual remark and quietly averted her gaze.

Lucia placed a glass of milk in front of Alice and asked with a smile, "Are you unhappy about the mission? Want to chat with me?"

"Yeah..." Alice's face turned slightly red. She felt she wasn't a child anymore, yet there was something comforting about being taken care of by Lucia.

"If you're asking for my secret to staying beautiful, sorry—I was born this way, so I can't teach it, oh hehe~" Lucia covered her mouth and laughed gracefully, full of confidence.

"Nah..." Alice rolled her eyes, feeling awkward.

"What is it then?" Lucia flicked the pen in her hand and asked with interest.

"I came to borrow the president's dojo, but..." Alice glanced behind the counter. The old Tyler who usually meditated there wasn't in sight. "The president doesn't seem to be around. Where did he go?"

"Oh, you're looking for my grandpa?" Lucia smiled and answered casually, "My father recently sent word saying he'll be back soon. Grandpa went to prepare. Even though they often look down on each other, they actually get along really well."

"Mr.卡尔 is coming back?! " Alice's eyes widened in shock, thinking carefully in her mind.

The president's son, Karl Taylor.

The sole inheritor of Thunderclap Fighting Style.

A powerhouse mithril-ranked adventurer.

The star pillar of the Locksram Adventurer's Guild, also famous elsewhere.

Many people believed Mr. Karl was the strongest in the guild, his strength even subtly surpassing his father, old Tyler.

She didn't expect he was almost back. Mr. Karl deeply admired his father, regarding him as his rival.

And the president seemed to have been repelled by a single move from Merlin... with Mr. Karl's hot temper, would some kind of conflict arise?

title: Chapter 19
content:
Chapter 19

Volume 6 · Chapter 19

The training hall was located at the back of the guild.

Merlin and Alice arrived here.

In fact, the guild leader hadn't returned yet, but Lucia had a spare key.

So, they didn't waste much time and entered the training area.

Old Taylor usually didn't allow idle people to enter the training hall, but he made an exception for Merlin.

Additionally, he had inadvertently created this fake couple, and now he felt guilty for causing trouble.

Old Taylor knew he was at fault, so he wouldn't refuse Merlin and Alice's requests.

Lucia understood this and handed the spare key to Merlin and Alice, even gaining something from it.

At this moment, Merlin held a wooden sword and stood lazily in front of Alice, continuously tapping his neck with the sword, like an elderly person with a sore shoulder.

Alice held her slender sword in front of her, with two fingers pressing against the cold blade, and a white chill surrounding her body, as high-ranking pressure continuously rose.

Merlin saw this situation and couldn't help but cover his face, sighing, feeling disappointed and uninterested, suspecting that Alice was still the same.

Alice focused her mind and immersed herself in her world, fully experiencing the inherited crystal within her body.

The energy emitting from it was extremely cold and violent, difficult to control, and seemed to resist weak Alice.

Alice felt pressure, and her intuition told her that with her current abilities, it was hard to absorb the dragon's power.

However, she had a merit: she wasn't arrogant or impatient, had a lot of patience, and wouldn't be easily defeated by difficulties.

Time quietly passed.

Merlin didn't interfere with Alice, patiently waiting.

After unremitting effort, the power of the frost saint dragon's inherited crystal was finally stolen by Alice.

Suddenly, Alice, immersed in her own world, saw many things, and countless dragon magic and martial techniques slowly emerged.

Although they seemed powerful, most skills were beyond Alice's current level.

However, some simple and low-requirement dragon skills were within her reach, and it wasn't a complete loss.

Alice's heart became excited; if she combined these dragon skills with her fusion essence from the Great Snow Mountain, the attack effect would likely increase exponentially, and the power wouldn't be simply additive.

For such a long time, Alice had only gained a little dragon power, but it was incredibly useful.

Merlin watched Alice during her training, and suddenly became interested because certain changes occurred around her.

The chill surrounding Alice's body gradually transformed into a dragon shape, and with a sudden spread of its wings, the chill began to wreak havoc.

"Dragon威" (Dragon威, or Dragon's aura).

Merlin muttered softly; apart from external changes, Alice's aura also had a slight change.

Alice began to emit dragon威, a unique aura of dragon tribe, which had a deterrent effect on weak species.

Although it was still very weak and hard to detect, Merlin sensed it.

The rampaging chill slowly dissipated, and the training hall returned to its usual calm.

Alice slowly opened her eyes, and her blue pupils became clearer than before.

"Oh, it seems the dragon's inherited crystal is quite good," Merlin said softly, feeling that Alice had become stronger, but still far from the Saint-tier.

Alice's physical and mental aspects had been significantly strengthened, and her magic and combat energy had increased considerably, which was very impressive.

Especially the dragon威, which gave her a nobler temperament.

Alice was delighted with these changes, not expecting her strength to increase so much.

She now felt her magic and combat energy were very abundant, and even her body was filled with strength she hadn't had before.

"So powerful, this is the dragon's power? It seems to be much stronger than humans."

"That's not even close; you need to fully digest the inherited crystal to see the real effect," Merlin said nonchalantly.

"I feel that I'm just a step away from the Saint-tier; it doesn't seem that difficult," Alice said directly.

"Don't be naive; you still have a significant distance from the Saint-tier. Even if you reach the threshold, you need a breakthrough opportunity. If the Saint-tier were that easy to reach, it would be everywhere. This opportunity is quite troublesome; some people can have an epiphany, while others are stuck and can't comprehend it their whole lives."

"I can do it; I have plenty of opportunities for breakthroughs," Alice said confidently.

Merlin clicked his tongue, thinking that this person was showing off, but what did having a high luck stat mean? Didn't it just mean he'd be beaten up by someone with a low luck stat like himself?

"Alright, let's get to the death training; don't waste time!" Alice held her slender sword, posed for battle, and her silver hair fluttered, releasing a gorgeous electric flower.

"Emmmm," Merlin watched Alice calmly, tapping his shoulder with a wooden sword, "are you feeling a bit inflated?"

"Yes, I am! I want to test my current strength," Alice still hadn't forgotten her dream of stepping on Merlin's face with her high heels.

"Is that so? It seems I need to pop your bubble and bring you back to reality," Merlin stopped tapping his shoulder, aimed the wooden sword at Alice, and said, "Let's begin!"

Alice's pressure suddenly surged; her slender sword condensed with combat energy and magic fusion ice crystals.

Facing Merlin, she naturally didn't hold back and decided to go all out.

Alice didn't choose magic but selected the dragon martial technique「龙形」(Dragon Shape) she had just learned.

This martial technique wasn't advanced in the dragon tribe, but for Alice now, it was quite powerful, more like a status buff, enhancing her physical combat strength.

Alice stomped the ground; her figure shot out like electricity.

The chill around her formed a giant dragon shadow, which rushed towards Merlin.

Alice used her full strength, but Merlin still seemed nonchalant.

This made her angry; did Merlin look down on her that much?

Alice's anger surged, and she thrust her strongest sword.

Merlin raised an eyebrow, easily deflected Alice's sword with his wooden sword, and counterattacked with a casual punch.

Ah!

Alice cried out in pain, and her body flew out directly.

It hit the wall of the training hall with a "thud," like a mosquito being squashed.

Merlin blew on his fist and thought helplessly.

"Little hero, are you still feeling inflated?"

"Have you begun to doubt your life?"

title: Chapter 20 — Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 20 — Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 20

The setting sun cast slanting rays over the paint-chipped, worn-out streets of the town.

Rosy light filtered through the crimson-stained clouds, looking quite gorgeous in its deep red hue.

The two had trained at the dojo for the entire afternoon, and both looked somewhat exhausted.

Under Merlin's frequent threats of near-death, Alice's absorption of the inheritance crystal had become much faster, and her control over her power more skilled as well.

However, Alice had been getting beaten up so often that she began to question her life, feeling that the dream of stepping on Merlin with her high heels was drifting further and further away.

Next, the two planned to go to the Rexem market to buy groceries, preparing for dinner that evening.

Merlin rested his hands behind his head, looking casual and unconcerned; with nothing else to do, he accompanied Alice to shop.

He didn't know the streets and alleys of all of Rexem well enough, so this was a good chance to look around and get familiar with the area.

Alice silently followed beside Merlin, tears brimming in her eyes. She had been training all day and actually cried because of the Great Demon Lord!?

Every time she went all out attacking, it was easily deflected, and watching Merlin's lazy movements dealt a heavy blow to her pride.

Even after absorbing the Dragon Clan's power, why was the gap still so huge? She couldn't possibly win at all!

No matter how hard she tried, it seemed like she'd never get the chance to stomp Merlin with her high heels in this lifetime.

Alice's spirits were low. Having such a strong sparring partner was a good thing, but it also made her question her life!

Merlin glanced at the despondent Alice beside him and said blandly, "What's wrong? You've been wearing that bitter melon face all day, spreading negative energy, and it's even affecting me."

"—Nothing! I'm just in a bad mood!" Alice huffed and turned her head away, growing even more angry at Merlin's questioning.

"Oh~" Merlin raised an eyebrow, as if he understood everything, "Unhappy about being hung up and beaten, are you? Starting to question your life?"

"Who's questioning their life! I am not!" Alice retorted without holding back. "Aren't you just a bit stronger? What's so great about that? Haven't you got a mountain of debt?"

"You really don't let up with your sharp tongue," Merlin tilted his mouth, looking up at the sky. "You should stop thinking about defeating me and focus on paying off your debts instead. That's more realistic."

"Guh..." Alice made a whimper like a small animal, unwillingly thinking, Do I really have to be ground into the dirt by this bastard Merlin forever? Where's the part about us slaves rising up and singing?

"Alice, how about I teach you cooking when we get back?" Merlin suddenly said. He recalled that Alice always made him cook whenever she wanted something delicious, which wasn't ideal after all—teaching a man to fish is better than giving him fish.

"Huh!? Why?" Alice asked in bewilderment.

"It's unfair that I'm always the one cooking. To be fair, if I teach you cooking, won't you then be able to feed yourself?" Merlin said blandly, wanting to ease his own labor burden.

Alice turned her head and thought about it, weighing the pros and cons—

If I learn to cook, won't I be able to not rely on Merlin?

Thinking about it, this guy was threatening me yesterday.

If I could make delicious food, why would I have to endure Merlin's threats!?

Alice turned back, her cheeks flushed with excitement, and nodded like a chick pecking at rice.

"I'll learn! I want to learn!"

"What are you so excited about?" A bead of cold sweat rolled down Merlin's forehead. He thought, Is this plank-chested Hero planning some scheme again?

Alice hurriedly lowered her red little face, then clutched her fake breasts and said in an arrogant tone, "I don't particularly want to learn—it's you who begged me. Since you're so sincere, then... then I suppose I'll reluctantly agree, hmph~"

Merlin gave a dry laugh and couldn't help but think—

What should I do?

Should I throw this guy up high and then kick them out of the solar system!?

The two arrived at the Rexem marketplace.

Rexem had three markets this large.

This was only one of them, and it was relatively close to their home.

Actually, this wasn't just a place to sell ingredients; they sold all sorts of things.

The entire alley was filled with shops, the merchandise so dazzling it made one's eyes spin.

Pedestrians rubbed shoulders and pressed against each other, weaving past one another in a flash.

Merlin discovered that Alice was truly a homemaker at heart, possessing a natural bargaining skill. When haggling, she was practically a different person.

"Three silver coins, not a penny more!"

"So what if it's newly caught fish!"

"It was caught this morning, and it's already afternoon—totally not fresh!"

"Three silver coins, final offer, or I'll go buy fresher fish elsewhere!"

Alice's bargaining was particularly vicious, slashing prices well below normal asking rates, making the vendor across from her break into a cold sweat.

Merlin watched Alice's demeanor and found it hard to describe in words—it seemed even more intense than a life-and-death struggle where one's life hung in the balance.

But this scene reminded Merlin of the real world, where buying and selling during haggling felt like waging world war III.

"Fine, fine, I'll sell!" The vendor, unable to withstand Alice's brutal haggling, silently handed over the fish. "Ah~ Miss Alice is truly impressive. We always feel quite afraid when you come shopping—the way you bargain is too vicious."

Alice took the fresh fish and said awkwardly, "How can you say that? Don't make me sound like a plague god that everyone avoids."

"Forget it. Before, you weren't married, but I didn't expect you to already be wearing couple adventurer proof now. Consider this fish as a wedding gift for you, Miss Alice—just give me the cost price," the vendor said with a smile, not minding.

"Uh, it's not—"

Alice's face flushed red as she wanted to explain, but the fish was already being handed over.

She also felt embarrassed to argue further and could only silently accept it.

Alice had a premonition of something ominous. In the future, she might be called Mrs. Lucifer or the Merlin couple, and she couldn't help but feel a shiver of dread.

After finishing their shopping, the two headed straight home.

"I didn't expect you to be so well-liked," Merlin asked in surprise.

"That's a given~" Alice said proudly, handing the fish bag to Merlin. "Here, you hold it."

"Why am I the one holding it? I'm not your husband. Don't actually treat me like your husband," Merlin frowned and said discontentedly.

"I used so much effort haggling just now, isn't it normal that you carry the bags?" Alice said with complete self-assurance.

"Tch!" Merlin impatiently clicked his tongue. He had just said the word "fair," and she immediately turned around and used it against himself.

Although Merlin felt unbalanced inside, he still helped carry the groceries.

Merlin and Alice had completely ignored the looks from those around them; the sight of them shopping and heading home together looked more like a young married couple.

Not long after leaving the market, they ran into an acquaintance—the landlady who had appeared not long ago.

Seeing the landlady holding a sausage dog on a leash, it was clear she was out for an evening stroll.

"Long time no see, Mr. Merlin and Miss Alice. You two couples came out grocery shopping?" The landlady greeted them with a beaming smile.

"Long time no see, landlady," Merlin replied awkwardly.

"Are you out for a walk?" Alice launched into awkward small talk, worried that the rent deadline was approaching and fearing she'd be urged to pay.

"Yes, I'm taking my beloved dog out for a walk," the landlady said, glancing at her dachshund and continuing with a grin. "I didn't expect to run into you two couples. I spotted you from far away—even though you haven't been married for very long, you're looking more and more like a proper couple."

"Uh!" Both of them caught in their throats, they instinctively stepped a meter apart in a flash—

Merlin: What do you mean "couple-like"! I never intended to march into the wedlock pit with this plank-chested Hero!

Alice: Are you kidding me! How are Merlin and I anything like a couple! Who would marry this perverted Demon Lord!

title: Chapter 21 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 21 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 6 · Chapter 21

“Hm?” the landlady wore a look of confusion, astonishedly saying, “.-. What kind of reaction is this?”

Alice and Merlin glanced at each other; they were merely trying to avoid awkwardness.

“Don’t be like that. Since you’re a couple, you shouldn’t be so far apart,” the landlady said, supporting her cheek, smiling happily, “Honestly, you’re so bashful, saying one thing and then being shy....”

Merlin: Who’s bashful! I just don’t want to get glued to this washboard!

Alice: What a pity, the landlady has completely misunderstood.

“If I offended you just now, I apologize.” The landlady’s hair was already white, but she was still lively when she smiled, “It’s just that the two of you gathered together are truly likable, always reminding me of the blossoming years of my youth...

The two hesitated and then drew closer.

After all, the other party is the landlady; one must show respect.

If I don’t rent the house to the two of them, with such a good location and environment, it would be hard to find another rental in all of Rekthor.

“Landlady, we don’t have a husband-and-wife relationship. Don’t misunderstand; you must have seen wrong,” Merlin said with a dry laugh in defense.

“Oh, oh, definitely a misunderstanding,” Alice chimed in.

“No, no, I didn’t see wrong. Back when I and that old man were together, we were just like you two—intimate and inseparable,” the landlady said, touching her wrinkled cheek, sighing, “Those were good times...

The two had nothing to say, unable to imagine the landlady seeing her younger self on them.

“Are you two going home? There’s a chance to go the same way; won’t you accompany this old lady?” the landlady said kindly.

“Of course not,” Merlin nodded, thinking, just dealing with an old lady? So easy~

“Let’s go,” Alice smiled and said.

Three people walked together; the small sausage in front, due to its short legs, kept adjusting its four short legs.

“When I was young and with the old man, we were inseparable on the way home, just like you two now, except we were much more intimate. Although you’re already a couple now, it still feels a bit lacking. I was thinking of halving the rent next month, after all, you two are working hard,” the landlady said with a smile that wasn’t quite a smile.

The two exchanged a glance; their eyes communicated instantly, and they immediately understood each other’s meaning.

Merlin extended his hand, firmly pulling Alice’s small waist over.

Alice fell into Merlin’s arms, wide-eyed, offering no resistance or scolding, just her face turning strangely red.

Merlin embraced Alice’s delicate body, feeling her entire body tense up, like an electric pole.

Estimating that Alice is now about to die from nervousness, because being held while conscious feels completely different!

Merlin narrowed his eyes at the strange Alice, thinking, she’s blushing for nothing! Isn’t it for the half-price rent? A bit of acting professionalism, isn’t it?

Alice blushed, flustered, and lowered her head carefully, her heart pounding nonstop.

Why am I shy? Am I crazy!

Why is my heart beating like it took an excitant?

Being held once won’t kill me, calm down!

Alice smelled Merlin’s scent, and her mood became extremely unstable, like a girl in love who is very sensitive.

The two clung to each other on the way home; from afar, the movements looked very stiff, completely a product of temporary adaptation.

Merlin ignored Alice’s strangeness and said to the landlady, “Is this the feeling?”

“Exactly, just this feeling. Looking at you two, I feel like I’ve returned to my youth,” the landlady said with a satisfied face.

Alice stared wide-eyed, thinking embarrassedly, Did the landlady have no shame when she was young? How shameful!

“Actually, landlady is still quite young now,” Merlin said with a faint smile.

“Old, old. Compared to you young people, I’m not as good. Being able to see you two show off is already enough for me to be satisfied,” the landlady said with a smile.

The two said nothing, responding with a face of awkwardness. They weren’t really a married couple, and acting was still troublesome.

“By the way, Miss Alice, may I ask something?” The landlady changed the subject.

“Please ask; don’t be polite. Alice, hurry to respond.

“Has Mr. Karl from the Adventurers’ Guild returned?” the landlady asked seriously.

“Not yet, but he’s coming back soon. Does the landlady have something?” Alice asked back.

“I was previously taken care of by Mr. Karl, and I wanted to give a gift to express my thanks, but I didn’t expect he hasn’t returned yet,” the landlady sighed, a bit disappointed, saying, “It’s understandable, though. After all, Mr. Karl is the pride of Rekthor, a famous adventurer with a reputation outside; I imagine his work must be very busy?”

“Busy is busy, but he should be back soon. Don’t worry,” Alice said with a dry laugh to comfort her.

“...Landlady nodded.

“Who is Karl?” Merlin asked curiously.

“He’s the club president’s son, a famous silver-rank adventurer, acknowledged as the strongest in Rekthor,” Alice simply introduced.

“The strongest adventurer in Rekthor isn’t the club president?” Merlin had question marks all over his mind.

“The old president hasn’t made a move for a long time, while Mr. Karl has shown his strength. According to many old adventurers, now Mr. Karl is stronger than the president,” Alice explained.

Merlin narrowed his eyes, said nothing, and thought to himself—Is he stronger than the old president?

I don’t think so.

Because no one stands still.

If this guy called Karl is really stronger than the old president, I’d be interested in sparring with him. Afternoon.

Snowily, who had spent the whole day catching up on sleep, lazily got out of bed.

She rubbed her sleepy, sparse eyes and left Alice’s room.

She had wanted to drink some water, but ended up seeing Merlin and Alice messing around in the kitchen.

Merlin: “That’s how you cut vegetables?”

Alice: “Yeah, any problem?”

Beforehand, it was agreed that Merlin would teach Alice cooking, but not knowing would be one thing; teaching would reveal that this washboard is frightening!

In Merlin’s eyes, Alice is simply a barbaric person who eats raw meat and drinks blood. She was definitely never taught how to cook; she’s completely a newbie!

This isn’t Alice’s fault. She’s lived in the Great Snow Mountain since childhood; whatever the teachers eat, she follows what they eat. Naturally, she doesn’t know much about cooking.

Merlin watched Alice chop the vegetables on the cutting board into pieces, and couldn’t help but say with a headache, “Your vegetable cutting is, apart from Russian cubes, I can’t find other descriptive words; it’s rotten to the point of being unusable!

“Then you cook,” Alice said without any politeness.

“Go to hell. Even if you’re a pig, I’ll make you learn to cook your own kind!” Merlin picked up the knife and demonstrated in front of Alice, “Learned?”

“I’ll try,” Alice mimicked Merlin’s appearance, striking a pose that looked somewhat like the real thing, and then proceeded to chop randomly and messily.

Merlin covered his black face, losing his patience, which had been worn out by Alice.

No matter how beautiful the posture was set, the end result would definitely be chaotic chopping.

Impatient Merlin suddenly hugged Alice from behind, and his body also pressed against hers.

“Ah!

Alice was greatly startled and threw the knife away.

A wave of masculine aura came over, making her head a bit dizzy.

Alice cautiously turned her head to stare at Merlin, worried he might do something bad.

“...What are you doing! ? Dare to molest... I’ll fight you to the death!”

“Tsk! Thinking something dirty?” Merlin heavily knocked Alice’s forehead.

“Oh!” Alice felt her forehead clamped by a crab, very painful.

Merlin’s hands went around Alice’s waist and placed them on the cutting board, “Come on, give me your hand.”

“...What’s the matter?” Alice’s face turned red.

Feeling that Merlin is now holding her, a bit resistant, but a little excited; if it were intimate behavior, it would make her heart beat faster by many beats.

“Let me teach you cutting vegetables by hand; I don’t believe you can’t learn!” Merlin said angrily.

Alice muttered a sentence, obediently putting her hand into Merlin’s palm.

Merlin didn’t bother to refute Alice, beginning very intimate teaching, “First, grasp your hand into a cat’s claw, so as to prevent getting cut.”

Alice’s face couldn’t help but start turning red again, like boiling water, puffing out hot air.

Merlin’s big hand temperature slowly transmitted to Alice’s hand, making her even more sensitive.

The most exasperating thing was Merlin’s words, blowing into Alice’s ear, making her a bit ticklish.

This situation made Alice not know what to do; it was the first time she was this close to a male, being hugged from behind.

A faint ambiguous atmosphere slowly flowed, making Alice’s heart race and mind go blank—

What the heck am I doing! ?

Why is it necessary to teach like this?

I wonder if my heart rate is too strange!

, youth SF novel

Does my heart rate accelerating with Merlin prove I’ve fallen for someone else?

I am the former Hero, the Great Demon Lord’s arch-enemy; absolutely cannot have strange things happen!

And I like Elkin, the great sword hero... heavens...

Alice’s heart is very chaotic, shaken, and she can no longer tell whether she likes Elkin, the great sword hero, or the nearby Merlin.

By rights, Alice should dislike Merlin intensely, but since he hugged her from behind, she didn’t resist, but fell into hesitation.

Alice wants to know what expression Merlin is making now, so she secretly glanced back, seeing him serious in teaching, apparently having no other meaning.

“Why are you looking at me? Any flowers on my face? You look at the cutting board, okay?” Merlin said with a frustrated look.

Alice quickly turned her head, saying in a panic, “..- Looking at what’s wrong! It won’t die! I just wanted to see if you’re thinking impure thoughts...

“I’m a serious person, don’t think of those messy things, sensual Demon King, online hand-to-hand teaching, opportunity is hard to come by,” Merlin lowered his head and looked at the Alice in his arms, “Now I suspect you’re intentionally causing trouble.”

“I really didn’t cause trouble!” Alice’s two cheeks flushed with a faint red, stammering, “Just continue teaching, I’m listening seriously...”

Merlin felt a bit relieved and continued hugging Alice to start beginner-level cooking lessons.

What’s there to be anxious about? It made me anxious too.

Merlin silently complained in his heart, thinking Alice was too sensitive.

The two seem to be teaching cooking, but to outsiders, it completely looks like they’re flirting in the kitchen.

Snowily watched from outside for a long time, getting her face covered in dog food.

She twisted her mouth corner and smiled dryly, thinking ignorantly—

How dare you say you aren’t a real couple—

Look at now, who would believe it! ?

Isn’t this the super loving five pairs! ?

W/wMY

title: Chapter 22 — Update Is a Bit Late, hehe~
content:
Chapter 22 — Update Is a Bit Late, hehe~

Volume 6 · Chapter 22

A few days passed in the blink of an eye.
Alice almost every day went to the dojo with Merlin to train, her strength steadily increasing.
As for her cooking, she had made a little progress, no longer as clueless as before.
After all, it was Merlin's hands-on, close-quarters instruction; if there were no effect at all, that would be weird.
At first, Alice was quite resistant to Merlin teaching her cooking from behind, hands-on, her face flushed and heart pounding, her restless girlish heart unable to calm down.
But after secretly observing Merlin countless times, she discovered he seemed to have no malicious intent at all.
So Alice relaxed a bit, and in order to finish this awkward hands-on lesson as soon as possible, she earnestly began learning cooking.
Merlin himself was also a bit embarrassed, but he hid it well, so Alice didn't notice.
After all, if Alice didn't look at her chest, she was still a very beautiful girl, her nobility revealing a hint of cuteness.
Holding Alice in his arms, it was impossible for Merlin to feel nothing unusual; he certainly had some stray thoughts.
But Merlin, this old man, has extraordinary self-control; how could he lose composure over a mere washboard?
Gradually, they became accustomed to each other's small contacts; even close contact would not cause the initial embarrassment.
Alice's attitude also changed; she was no longer simply resisting Merlin.
12.
Previously: "Don't touch me! Don't get close! Disgusting! Pervert! Lustful man Jiang"
Afterward: "Isn't it normal to touch hands while teaching cooking? What's weird about that?" D
Obviously to outsiders they seemed more and more like a real couple, yet the two appeared oblivious to this, still maintaining a rather subtle distance.
Usually it's the same; they often argue over the slightest disagreement, leaving Shirley speechless, really wanting to urge them to get married quickly! Those watching are anxious......
These days, Shirley always tells Alice about her hometown before bed, her eyes unconsciously showing longing.
Alice felt it was time to send Shirley to London; otherwise dragging it on wasn't a solution.
So Alice and Merlin discussed it briefly and decided to take a commission that would conveniently go to London.
That way we wouldn't waste time; we could send Shirley back to her hometown and also start the new job quickly.
Isn't this plan of killing two birds with one stone wonderful?
Merlin had no objection; he thought earning two sums on one trip was pretty good, so he agreed.
Alice enthusiastically wrote the new plan on the schedule board at home—
"In the coming days, we'll set off for London with Miss Shirley!"
o(*≥V≤)
Today Alice wanted to rest, so she didn't train.
Instead, she stayed home playing with Shirley, showing off the cooking she had learned.
Alice was full of confidence; her cooking had improved greatly, and the time to practice had come!
She felt her salad was no worse than Merlin's, and wanted Shirley to give her opinion.
Shirley looked apprehensive, thinking that Alice's usual cooking was like a fight, so the result probably wouldn't taste good either.
But Shirley isn't good at refusing people, and Alice has done her a favor, so she reluctantly agreed.
Merlin thought Alice was basically a little brat who gets smug and flies off the handle at the slightest bit of progress.
Such a one-sided comparison has no meaning at all.
If Alice could surpass me after just a few days of cooking lessons, I'd probably be a fake transmigrator.
Merlin, feeling bored, thus left home alone, went to the guild to drink and chat with Hobbs—
"I haven't seen Arnold lately...."
"That home... ah....." Hobbs shook his glass, embarrassed, saying, "Last time you couple stabbed me in the heart, and I still haven't replied; I heard the count's manor recently called in a psychologist~"
"That serious?" Merlin put down his whiskey glass.
"Isn't that so? Arnold pursued Alice for half a year with no result; you came and snatched her goddess away; in a short time, who could accept it?" Hobbs analyzed point by point.
"I can't understand Arnold; how could a noble young master just want to hang himself on a washboard? There are plenty of girls with big breasts and hips, aren't there?" Merlin, who has also seen high society, said most of them have good figures.
"Actually I don't get it either; maybe Arnold is just a romantic? Perhaps time will make him mature and change his mind." Hobbs stroked his chin, then gave a lecherous expression: "Honestly, Rosetti is pretty good—dark skin, wild chicken, and those big breasts, yo yo yo~"
"Do Arnold and Rosetti have something going on?" Merlin asked, surprised, as he hadn't seen them together before.
"Well, it's not exactly an affair; there must be some shameful past. Haven't you seen Rosetti at the guild? Arnold never shows up; he's deliberately avoiding." Hobbs, like a gossip machine, seemed to know everything.
"A shameful past?" Merlin frowned, a bit interested.
"Before, Rosetti that little slut and Arnold went on a mission together; something somewhat ambiguous happened; I heard that this pure-hearted virgin Arnold almost got eaten by Rosetti, hah...." Hobbs laughed lecherously, his expression conveying a huge amount of information.
"I... go...." Merlin narrowed his eyes, embarrassed, saying, "So Rosetti is that unrestrained?"
"You can't say that either; although Rosetti looks unrestrained, she's actually quite proper—this is 'externally wild, internally pure'; she just has a thing for Arnold." Hobbs said meaningfully.
"Yes...."
Merlin nodded, silently raised his cup, and thought everyone's gossip was quite interesting.
He thought, since Hobbs knows so much, why not ask him about work that passes through London?
"Hobbs, any work going to London lately?"
"Well... none, London adventurers are generally strong, so any commissions they usually produce and sell themselves." Hobbs shrugged helplessly, then changed the subject: "But not long ago there was a commission from a Kent coastal fishing village, with a very generous reward."
"Eh?! Merlin jumped up, wanting to grab the task first, "Is that commission still available?"
"You're really unlucky; it was just assigned yesterday, and another adventurer already took it." Hobbs said helplessly.
"Tsk!" Merlin clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction; he was only slow by a day, truly damned!
"According to Lukiya, the person who took the commission has quite a background, his fame is...." Hobbs said in a deep, secretive tone.
"Ah?! Who is it?" Merlin asked curiously.
"Cough cough!" Hobbs cleared his throat twice and solemnly introduced: "-"
"He's the genius mage from Ireland."
"A mere fourteen-year-old Saint-tier powerhouse, a Mithril adventurer."
"His name is Elvin Johnson; his magical talent can be called monstrous!"

title: Chapter 23 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 23 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 23

Merlin has heard too much about so-called geniuses and monsters; he's long been accustomed to these empty reputations.
However, reaching Saint-tier at just fourteen years old and being among the strong is indeed rare.
Merlin was also hearing this for the first time, feeling a bit surprised; if not for taking strong medicine, his own cultivation progress is indeed quite good.
“Sounds okay.”
“Isn't it more than just okay?” Hobbs thought Merlin was speaking too lightly, so he gave a more detailed introduction: “This genius mage is the son of the president of the Navia Adventurers Guild; his father is a very famous old mage who once worked at the Denmark Kingdom Adventurers Guild headquarters, was invited to be a specially appointed professor of magic, and even participated in compiling the royal magic textbook; now the noble academies all use this set of textbooks.”
“Hmm... still okay~” Merlin nodded, thinking, “What magic department magic? I'm magic-immune; any magic thrown at me is trash.”
“Merlin, could you be a little surprised, okay? Don't you think this genius mage Johnson is awesome?” Hobbs felt a bit embarrassed, finding the conversation boring.
“What's the use of bragging about his dad? Does it have much to do with this fourteen-year-old mage?” Merlin showed a playful expression, thinking, “If the parents are awesome, the descendants aren't necessarily awesome; there are plenty of kids without magic or battle aura talent, right?”
“My point is, Johnson's dad's magical attainment is so high, this genius mage won't be lacking either.” Hobbs said seriously, continuing: “I heard Johnson has been intensely trained by his father since childhood; his talent is terrifying, he's almost proficient in all magic elements. How strong is that? For an ordinary person, mastering one element is already good, two is impressive, but Johnson can handle all attributes!”
“Emmmmm......” Merlin remained silent, deeply understanding that biting off more than one can chew isn't good; being skilled in many areas doesn't necessarily mean stronger, it only shows Johnson has great comprehension, just like Alice's dual cultivation of magic and martial arts, which literally adds difficulty to one's training.
“Moreover, Johnson is a Saint-tier powerhouse at just fourteen, his future prospects are limitless, and he even received a personal commendation from Queen Elizabeth; he's practically Britain's wealth, a supernova of the magic world, a much-anticipated…!” Hobbs said seriously to Merlin, then took a sullen swig of wine, his face showing a gloomy expression: “Back when I was four years old, I was still playing in the mud in the fields, while he's already a star adventurer at fourteen…”
“Hobbs, a person's worth isn't measured by strength; for example, your social skills and talent as an information dealer—many strong people lack those—be a bit more confident in yourself.” Merlin patted Hobbs on the shoulder, regardless of what others think; anyway, he considers Hobbs a rare talent.
“Although that's true, this kind of genius like Johnson really makes people envious....” Hobbs said with great worry.
“I admit this genius mage has decent talent, but how is his actual strength?” Merlin asked curiously, thinking he couldn't be just all talk and no practice.
“How could his strength be lacking? His reputation outside is on par with Karl's.” Hobbs took a big gulp of whiskey, using the alcohol's courage to continue: “Johnson is a strong Saint-tier mage; the pressure he exudes feels like a humanoid monster, but the most bizarre thing is still copying and replicating…”
“Copying?” Merlin narrowed his eyes, feeling a bit incredulous.
“Yes, copying—I've never seen it myself, it's all hearsay....” Hobbs paused, then said seriously: “They say Johnson's talent is extremely high, he can master all magic element attributes, his understanding of the essence of magic is almost inhuman, so he can copy others' magic techniques; just one look and he can replicate it with even greater power—right?”
Merlin remained silent; this is truly the first time he's heard of such a thing—if it were common magic it wouldn't be strange, but if even his own created magic could be copied, that's somewhat bewildering.
“Moreover, the copied stolen magic is permanent and can still be used later, so Johnson himself is like a magic library, collecting magic everywhere; think about it, the number of spells he will know in the future can only be described as terrifying.” Hobbs took a heavy swig of whiskey.
“Is that so? He really is a peculiar mage.” Merlin said lightly.
“That's not all.... Seeing Merlin not very surprised, Hobbs dropped an even more bombshell: “Johnson apparently can also copy ultimate techniques.”
“Even ultimate techniques can be copied?!” Merlin furrowed his brows, instantly becoming surprised.
“Can! They say as long as you've seen it, you can copy it—ancient language magic, forbidden curses, grand ritual magic, as long as it's human, it can all be replicated!” Hobbs said seriously, even he himself found it hard to believe.
“”. Hmm....”.
Merlin stared wide-eyed, thinking this fourteen-year-old Johnson is simply a pervert, a bug in the world! Ultimate techniques are the lifelong blood and sweat of a mage and warrior, mostly original moves. Some ultimates have been refined over generations and passed down to today. Yet Johnson can steal them with just a glance and even unleash them with greater power! ... This makes one feel like spitting blood on the spot! If these rumors are true, how many ultimate techniques will Johnson end up using? Honestly, it's hard to imagine; at just fourteen, what will he become in the future? Merlin's surprised expression returned to normal, and he said lightly.
“Alright, this mage indeed deserves the title of genius, but he's far inferior to me.”
Merlin wasn't joking; he is magic-immune, a bug among bugs! Any goddamn flashy mage, in front of him, can only stare helplessly. With magic immunity, mages to him are like leeks—he pulls out his blade and harvests one batch after another.
“Come on, Merlin, I see you love to brag; you're just a bronze adventurer, while they are mythril Saint-tier powerhouses—you two aren't even from the same world....” Hobbs said helplessly, clinking Merlin's wine cup.
Merlin smiled without speaking, too lazy to explain to Hobbs; he thought Johnson wasn't worth mentioning and hadn't even put him in his sights.
The guild suddenly erupted in a commotion, vaguely hearing everyone mutter:
“Isn't that the shopkeeper? What's she doing here?”
“Look at those breasts, look at that butt, this figure—sigh, sigh, sigh—so full of feminine charm…”
“If I could ever marry a woman like the shopkeeper, I'd be willing to die ten years earlier.”
Adventurers all turned their gaze toward the door, their eyes almost popping out, saliva flowing three thousand feet.
When Lucilia saw the arrival, she jumped in fright, tossing her work aside.
She hastily lifted her chest to make herself look more sexy and alluring, fearing her charm would be outshone by the other.
As the guild's billboard girl, Lucilia couldn't allow her status to be threatened.
Now she looks just like two peacocks meeting, spreading their tails to compete in beauty.
All these strange reactions made Merlin turn his head in surprise, and he saw….
A white long dress, blue long hair, bewitching starry eyes, a tear mole adorning her face—who else could it be but Helena?
“Eh? ? ?” Three black lines slid down Merlin's forehead, his mind full of question marks.
Helena this fallen angel…
Why did she suddenly come here?

title: Chapter 24 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 24 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 24

Helena stood gracefully at the entrance, and even in the mixed crowd of the guild, she still appeared dignified and elegant, exuding a goddess-like aura that made her look nothing like a brothel madam.

Despite being several hundred years old, even older than Merlin, when she tiptoed to look around, there was still a touch of girlishness about her.

Hobbs stared with wide eyes, his old face turning an odd red as he stammered, "...The hell! Miss Helena, what are you doing here!?"

"No idea..." Merlin said indifferently, thinking that Helena really didn't fit in with the people here at all. She was truly glaring.

Lucia was internally startled and uncertain. She knew the woman at the door was the madam of Helena's Secret Hut. Helena was very famous in Rexham, especially among men, and Lucia had often heard of her.

Now appearing suddenly at the guild, it felt a bit like she was encroaching on Lucia's territory.

This couldn't be tolerated! If she lost, her title of Adventuress Goddess might change hands...

Lucia cleared her throat and asked bluntly.

"Well, well, if it isn't Miss Helena? What brings you to our guild?"

Helena glanced at Lucia, a trace of contempt flashing in her eyes, as if she looked down on humans entirely.

But with her identity confidential, she still replied with a polite smile.

"I'm here to find someone."

"Find who? Is there really an adventurer here worthy of your notice? I thought you looked down on us drifters, ohohohoho~" Lucia let out a bell-like laugh, dripping with sarcasm, showing off her scheming nature to the fullest.

Helena smiled but didn't speak, choosing to ignore Lucia, thinking with inner disdain, lowly human, trying to compete with me in charm? If I got serious, I'd crush her into nothingness.

It seemed Helena was no pushover either. In terms of psychological warfare, she was no less skilled than Lucia.

The open and covert rivalry between the two women made the atmosphere in the guild somewhat tense....

Helena spotted Merlin, the blonde-haired one in the guild, and a wave of joy rose in her heart; she had thought she wouldn't find him.

So Helena gracefully walked over to Merlin, stopped in front of him, gave a slight bow, and then spoke.

"Mr. Merlin..."

"Hmm? Helena."

Merlin looked surprised and hadn't processed what Helena wanted from him.

"Hey~, Miss Helena." Hobbs waved from the side, wearing a lecherous smile.

"It's been a while, Mr. Hobbs." Helena smiled and continued, "Since you have time to drink at the guild, why not come sit at my place instead? The quality of my wine is certainly different from what you have here."

"I'll definitely come back to support your business, hehehe~" Hobbs seemed enchanted, and though he was a man in his thirties, he said it with a grin, "I wonder what brings you here today, Miss Helena?"

"I'm here to find Mr. Merlin. Something a bit...private..." Helena spoke cryptically. Her mystery inspired all sorts of imaginings, such as the implication that she and Merlin were involved.

"找我?" Merlin furrowed his brows, not understanding the situation.

"Merlin, come here a bit..." Hobbs put his arm around Merlin's shoulder and pulled him aside to whisper, "You're amazing, man. Ridiculously good. I don't even know what words to use to describe you anymore!"

"What's wrong?" Merlin was very confused.

"You went behind our backs and got involved with Miss Helena! It's too shocking! We weren't prepared at all." Hobbs frowned, and suddenly he empathized with Arnold. A goddess getting snared like that felt damn uncomfortable!

"Ah!? What are you talking about? When did I get involved with Helena?" Merlin became somewhat annoyed. He had no desire to get entangled in any messy relationships with women.

"Stop pretending. I'm saying, last time when we went to the shop, why were you so indifferent to all those girls? So it turns out you had your eye on the madam all along. You left abruptly in the middle of it, which obviously means you had already hooked up with her by then. Come on, tell me what kind of spell you cast on Miss Helena, what underhanded methods you used to succeed. Don't hold back, teach me too."

Hobbs, the old rogue, had directly jumped to the wrong conclusion, continuously poking Merlin's ribs.

Although Hobbs thought Merlin loved to brag, his skills with women were genuinely admirable, something he wholeheartedly admired!

Everyone said Helena barely had any interest in men, yet she could be ensnared by Merlin!?

Not just Hobbs, but all those adventurers' eyes turned red with envy.

What gives that rookie with a woman's face? It makes no sense at all!

He was just a tiny Black Iron-ranked adventurer, yet he managed to hook up with Miss Helena!?

Good heavens, this world was too crazy. Miss Helena was actually favoring a mere Black Iron adventurer?!

Such thoughts echoed in the minds of all the male adventurers, and they seemed to begin questioning their lives.

"Stop with the nonsense..." Merlin pushed Hobbs away and turned to ask Helena, "What do you want?"

"Could you spare a moment of your time and come with me?" Helena circled a strand of her blue hair with her finger and said meaningfully, "It's not good for outsiders to know about this~"

Hobbs' mouth twitched and a cold sweat broke out. He understood completely and thought, See! So mysterious, and not even allowing outsiders to know. They must have hooked up!

Watching Helena's reaction, Merlin suddenly slapped his own forehead and remembered what Helena had said before:

If Asmodeus had something to discuss with him, Helena would be the one to notify him.

Asmodeus coming to find him suddenly likely meant something very important, something that concerned his own interests. He had to go.

"I understand. Let's go."

Merlin stood up and was ready to leave without hesitation.

Although Merlin was usually lazy, he still knew how to weigh priorities.

"Please follow me, Mr. Merlin..." Helena turned to lead the way, her posture respectful yet elegant.

Lucia watched from behind the counter for a long time and also started to wonder if Merlin had something going on with Helena. She thought, what magic does this man possess? Alice falling for him was one thing, but now the madam of Helena's Secret Hut was falling for him too? He was just an ordinary, utterly unremarkable Black Iron adventurer!

However, Lucia didn't entirely believe what she saw with her own eyes, nor did she plan to leak information about Merlin's infidelity to Alice.

After all, what if it was a misunderstanding? Matters of infidelity were hard to clarify, and getting involved would be super troublesome.

It was their marital matter in the first place, and it would be better for her to stay out of it. She'd wait until she saw solid evidence before making any moves.

Lucia was relatively rational. As Alice's good friend, she was genuinely a bit worried about her marriage.

"Merlin..." Hobbs called out to Merlin, seeming to have something to say.

"Hmm?" Merlin turned around in surprise.

"You're a married man. It's fine to play around a bit, but don't actually do anything outrageous, or the consequences will be unimaginable..." A layer of fine cold sweat appeared on Hobbs' forehead. As a married man himself, he seemed to deeply relate to the situation.

"..." Merlin gave a dry chuckle. Not wanting to explain, he simply followed Helena away, surrounded by countless envious, jealous, and resentful gazes.

Hobbs watched Merlin's retreating back, sighed, and drained the whiskey in his glass, muttering to himself:

"How long has he been married?"

"A marriage crisis this soon?"

"Merlin, you must keep yourself in check."

"Otherwise, with Alice's temper, she'd definitely explode on the spot..."
