title: Chapter 33 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 33 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 6 · Chapter 33

As soon as Kail heard that his master, Cecilia, was going to teach Alice how to be a proper person, he felt a bit embarrassed. It was an awkward situation, and Kail wasn't foolish enough to engage in a fight. Alice was a master of both magic and martial arts, with a versatile fighting style that included close-range melee attacks and long-range bombardments.

If they were to fight, Kail would be at a disadvantage, especially since Alice's magical and physical abilities were both superior to his. With Cecilia providing support from behind, Kail still didn't think he could win. Although Cecilia was supporting him from behind, he thought it would be better not to have a conflict. After all, it was just a misunderstanding, and there was no need for a real fight.

Cecilia, seeing Kail's hesitation, said dissatisfiedly, "Kail, what are you hesitating about? Go ahead! Don't be a coward!" Kail dared to advise her, saying seriously, "That... Cecilia, it's better if you calm down." Cecilia was displeased and said, "What's wrong with you? Whose knight are you, anyway?" She almost kicked Kail.

Kail didn't speak, but instead looked at Alice and said under pressure, "Miss, please calm down too. We're people of the Rose Duchess." Alice narrowed her eyes, thinking that the Rose Duchess was the highest ruler of Wales. Kail patiently said, "That's right. The family crest on my armor is genuine."

Alice looked at Kail's silver-white armor, and the rose pattern on it was quite distinctive. She thought to herself that it was indeed the Rose Duchess's crest. But why were they here? When did Merlin get in touch with the Rose Duchess? These questions made Alice quietly retract her aura, and the ethereal cold air surrounding her dissipated.

Alice wasn't afraid, but as the lord of Wales, the Rose Duchess had many rights and powers. If she provoked a noble lord, it would inevitably cause some trouble. If possible, she wanted to understand the situation before taking action. Kail saw Alice retracting her aura and relaxing her attitude, and he let out a sigh of relief. He put down his gun and introduced, "This is Cecilia, the daughter of the Rose Duchess."

Alice looked at Cecilia and was slightly surprised. She realized that Cecilia's bad temper and outspokenness were likely due to her noble upbringing as the daughter of the Rose Duchess. Cecilia smiled slightly, seeing Alice acknowledge her identity and retract her aura. She felt a bit proud and said, "Knowing my identity makes you afraid, doesn't it? Commoners like you shouldn't dare to confront me. You're not very polite."

Alice frowned, not in a good mood, and especially disliked Cecilia's superior attitude. She asked, "Since you're the daughter of the Rose Duchess, what's your relationship with Merlin? I don't remember him having any connections with the Rose Duchess..." Cecilia said proudly, "I'll tell you, but it's not like it's a secret. I'm a fan of Merlin, and I was saved by him in a dark and perilous dungeon. So, Merlin is my savior."

Alice's expression eased slightly, and she thought to herself that it was just a simple relationship. She had overthought things. However, she still found it hard to believe that Merlin would actively save someone without any motives. Perhaps there were benefits or interests involved.

Actually, Merlin had no motives at all; he just happened to be sweeping away monsters. Cecilia said, "I've told you my relationship with Merlin. Now it's your turn. Please be honest about your relationship with Merlin. Don't try to deceive me with a false story about being his wife again."

Alice didn't speak, thinking that Merlin, the great man, had no noble integrity at all. Kail quickly whispered, "Cecilia, look at the adventurer's certificate around her neck." Cecilia looked closely and saw the certificate, which had basic information on it: Region: Wrexham; Name: Alice Kroudia; Occupation: Magician; Husband: Merlin Lucifer.

Cecilia's eyes widened in shock, and she looked utterly astonished. "What?! Merlin is actually your husband! You two are really married! I thought Merlin was still single recently. Why did he get married so quickly?" Alice blushed, feeling a bit embarrassed.

Although she had been misunderstood many times before, this time felt different. She had a sense of triumph, as if she had successfully protected her marriage. Even though she knew it was a false marriage, it still felt good to have her marriage acknowledged. Perhaps normally she would explain the misunderstanding, but this time she didn't even bother to explain. She directly admitted it.

"Yes, that's right! I got married in a flash. You haven't heard of it? Merlin is my husband, and we're very loving..." Alice deliberately emphasized the word "loving", as if declaring her ownership and telling Cecilia that she had no chance.

Cecilia was taken aback, muttering to herself, "Merlin would marry someone like that? It's probably intentional. Because she's so unlovable and pitiful, Merlin took pity on her and married her out of mercy..." Alice smiled wryly, feeling annoyed. "Hey, watch it! I'll kill you!"

Cecilia sang, "Merlin is indeed a great person. Not only does he have exceptional strength and noble character, but he also has a kind heart. He's like the archangel Michael, the deputy of the Goddess of Light..." Alice thought to herself that she shouldn't say more, as Merlin was the Great Demon Lord, and describing him as an angel would humiliate him.

Kail had a black line on his forehead, unable to understand what kind of brainwashing Merlin had done to Cecilia, making her talk like that all the time. Cecilia calmed down, looking displeased that her idol had gotten married.

Although she was reluctant, she could accept reality. Since they were married, what could she do? "Fine, since you're Merlin's wife, I'll apologize for my attitude earlier. But just a little..." Alice suddenly became angry and said, "Your superior attitude is annoying. That's enough. I don't need your apology. Leave quickly and don't bother us."

Cecilia said, "When people can't have a nice conversation, they give us the boot. That's not very polite. We're here on important business that requires Merlin's help." Alice frowned and asked patiently, "What is it?" Cecilia thought for a moment and said vaguely, "Simply put, it's a win-win plan that everyone needs... We need Merlin's power to ensure..."

title: Chapter 34
content:
Chapter 34

Volume 6 · Chapter 34

Home.

Upon hearing that Cecilia seemed to have something serious, it was still a win-win situation.

Alice suddenly took an interest, thinking she would ask about it after Merlin returned.

So she let Cecilia and Kyle come in and detailed what had happened.

Sherry had just heard the argument outside the door and thought a fight was about to break out.

Because Sherry's courage was a bit small, she had never dared to go out.

But upon seeing two strangers enter the house, Sherry was frightened and hid directly into Alice's room.

She deliberately left a door crack open, curiously peeking at the situation outside.

Out of politeness as the mistress, Alice poured two cups of coffee for Cecilia and Kyle.

After all, she had just claimed to be the mistress herself; some magnanimity was required, and she couldn't appear stingy.

"Thank you." Kyle was still very polite, thanking properly.

But the other party wasn't so simple. She looked at the coffee and said with a sarcastic tone, "Hmph! Commoners are just commoners. The coffee served to guests at home is so poor in quality, and it's completely not the same level as what I drink at home. How shabby~"

"Cecilia-sama, this is already good enough." A cold sweat dripped from Kyle's forehead as he tried to stop Cecilia from saying something unpleasant. After all, the young lady came from a noble family; how could eating and dressing be the same?

"You can't not... Alice gritted her teeth, veins popping up on her forehead, very annoyed by Cecilia's character.

Cecilia wasn't angry either. She lifted her head and surveyed the rental house, speaking with an air of superiority, "How small a house? Is this a place people live in? It really suffered Merlin-sama. Our family's servants' quarters are bigger than here. Tch!"

Alice's brows were tightly furrowed, her face dark as she said, "If you want to fight, just say so. I'll accompany you anytime."

"Calm down, Alice-sama." Kyle stepped forward to mediate, his forehead beading with cold sweat. "Cecilia-sama is just saying things without any other meaning."

Cecilia felt Kyle's elbow veering outward. She punched him hard on the head, glaring at him with dissatisfaction.

Kyle rubbed his head, a foolish smile on his face, thinking that helping the young lady block a blow was also tiring.

"Hmph!" Alice let out a cold snort, not wanting to bother with Cecilia. "What's your plan to find Merlin? Speak up!"

"Hah?! " Cecilia's expression was haughty, and she pouted, saying, "Why should I tell you? I'm going to discuss it directly with Merlin-sama."

"Don't say it then, you stingy ghost!" Alice grumbled, secretly guessing, probably needing to rely on Merlin's power to do something?

"Eh?! " Kyle happened to glance at Alice's room, which was slightly ajar. Although it was just a fleeting glance, he still saw Sherry, "A spirit?"

"What spirit?" Cecilia looked at Kyle in surprise, completely unaware of Sherry.

"Right inside the room."

Kyle pointed affectionately at Alice's room, asking Cecilia to go over.

".....Sherry was startled and jumped up hurriedly, hiding the door, her heart almost jumping out of her throat, appearing very timid.

Because of being imprisoned by the previous kingdom, Sherry was still very afraid of humans. Only Alice could make her lower her guard and interact happily.

As for other humans, Sherry still resisted them and didn't want too much interaction. It was better to keep her distance so that this spirit girl could feel at ease.

It seems that the humiliation of being imprisoned has become an unhealable wound for Sherry. Perhaps only time can make her forget.

"Sherry? Come out, it's fine. They aren't bad people." Alice spoke to her own room.

"...I don't need to, Alice-sama. It's... best to just stay like this." Sherry mumbled.

Alice suddenly showed a melancholic expression, thinking that Sherry was still like this. It seemed she must send her back to her homeland.

Kyle stood there dumbfounded, thinking he had scared Sherry. Very gracefully, he stood up, bowed to the room, and said with apology, "Sorry, miss. I was rash just now, suddenly coming in to disturb. Very sorry."

"...Sherry timidly responded, daring to speak inside the room but unwilling to come out.

"What a bothersome spirit, truly lacking in manners..." Cecilia couldn't help but mutter.

"Sherry is just timid." Alice rebutted, afraid that Cecilia would say something sharp and hurt Sherry.

"By the way, aren't you and Merlin-sama a couple? Why is there a spirit living in your house?" Cecilia asked curiously.

"You don't tell me your plans, so why should I tell you?" Alice glared at Cecilia with disfavor.

A pauper... don't be too arrogant!" Cecilia angrily reprimanded with a face full of hostility.

Just as the two girls were about to fight, the doorbell "ding-dong" rang, interrupting them.

"Who? Is it Merlin-sama?" Cecilia's heart suddenly had a little anticipation, and there was also the excitement of about to see an idol.

Alice didn't answer but hurriedly went to open the door. It was indeed Merlin.

At this moment, Merlin stood at the door with a somewhat listless expression, having chatted with Asmodeus for a long time, and was a bit tired.

"Did you cook? It's your turn today, right? I haven't eaten until now, I'm starving."

Merlin entered the house without being polite and didn't explain where he had been fooling around.

Alice felt that Merlin didn't put her in his eyes at all. She should at least explain. So she unhappily questioned, "Where did you go? Again a whole day."

"Hmm?" Merlin stopped his steps, embarrassedly saying, "Of course I was wandering outside. Most of the time was spent drinking with Hobbs, though."

"Really? You won't die-hard, and you won't secretly go to Helen's secret cabin again, right?" Alice asked very skeptically, her eyes like a wife questioning a husband who came home late.

"...A cold sweat dripped from Merlin's forehead. His expression was complex. He had to admire the woman's intuition—more accurate than a prophet, especially when it comes to infidelity.

"Emmmm.... Alice didn't speak, thinking maybe she had overthought it?

"Also, stop asking east and west. You aren't my wife, don't meddle in so many things? It's really troublesome.... Merlin turned his head and walked into the room.

"What! ?" Alice gnashed her teeth in anger, very dissatisfied with Merlin's attitude.

Merlin walked into the room and just happened to see Cecilia sitting on the sofa, and behind her stood Kyle.

"Huh?! What's the situation?"

Merlin was surprised, not expecting strangers at home.

Seeing Merlin return, Cecilia was overjoyed. She quickly stood up and ran to Merlin's front.

Not expecting to be able to see Merlin-sama again, it was truly lucky...

Cecilia clasped her hands together, assuming a praying posture. Her eyes were full of adoration little stars.

"Ugh!" Merlin, uncomfortable, took a step back. A large sweat droplet fell from his forehead. Amazed, he thought one after another.

What a troublesome woman is this!

Slightly feeling a bit familiar, who was it again =

title: Chapter 35 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Ticket Support
content:
Chapter 35 — Bonus Chapter: Monthly Ticket Support

Volume 6 · Chapter 35

Cael gave Merlin a cold look as soon as he saw him.

To him now, Merlin looked exactly like a scammer.

Someone who specifically preyed on girls' affections. As a knight, there was nothing he despised more than people like that!

But seeing the way Cecilia looked at him with such adoration, Cael felt a wave of helplessness rise from deep within.

Because as long as Cecilia was around, he absolutely couldn't show too much hostility—it would make him look unfriendly.

Cael really wanted to challenge Merlin to a duel and use his true strength to pierce through that pretender's mask.

But he was afraid Cecilia would scold him for being rude and develop a distaste for him, which would be more harmful than helpful.

So Cael could only choose to temporarily hold back and wait for an opportunity to let Cecilia see reality—that this black-iron villager was nothing but a big liar!

The flame of Cael's justice burned fiercely in his heart. No matter what kind of love potion Cecilia had drunk, he had to bring her back to her senses.

Merlin couldn't bear to see that adoring gaze Cecilia was giving him. It was exactly the kind he detested the most.

Because whenever a woman looked at him with those eyes, things would inevitably become troublesome afterward.

You ask why Merlin knew this so well?

Because Merlin's former head maid during his Demon Lord era also looked at him with those same eyes, and ended up following behind him like a pervert.

Every time he needed to take a proper dump, he had to be constantly on guard against being peeped on, heart perpetually on edge.

"Cough!" Alice couldn't take it anymore, so she cleared her throat and pulled Cecilia back to reality. She wasn't even dead yet, and here Cecilia was staring so openly at Merlin in front of her—did she not have Alice in her eyes at all?

"..."

Cecilia snapped out of her daze, her face turning a bizarre shade of red; she must have realized her own impropriety.

She quickly lowered her head, trying to cover herself, thinking that staring at Lord Merlin like that upon reuniting showed how ill-mannered she was.

Cecilia lifted the hem of her skirt, dipped into a perfectly standard noble bow.

"Long time no see, Lord Merlin. Do you still remember me?"

Alice watched Cecilia's respectful posture and couldn't help but think—she had been so rude to her just now, but turned completely different around Merlin. The blatant double standard was simply too obvious!

"Hmm...." Merlin studied Cecilia for a moment, then asked with a puzzled expression, "Who are you? Have we met before?"

"Eh!?" Cecilia froze, finding it hard to believe. It hadn't even been that long since he stood her up—how could he have already forgotten her so quickly? Was this lady not alluring enough, or had Lord Merlin's standards just gotten higher?

Cael felt his lady was being slighted, and immediately took offense. He gripped his spear tightly and jumped forward. "How dare you! A mere black-iron villager, daring to be so disrespectful to Lady Cecilia!"

"Silence, Cael!" Cecilia cried out angrily, feeling that Cael's attitude toward Merlin was far too hostile.

"But—" Cael's heart felt instantly wounded. He had only been trying to help, yet Cecilia had scolded him. "Tch!"

Merlin glanced at Cael and thought this guy looked somewhat familiar too. Why did he carry such deep resentment? Like Merlin had stolen his wife or something.

Seeing Cael fall silent, Cecilia felt slightly relieved. She raised her head, cheeks flushed, and earnestly tried to help Merlin remember her.

"My name is Cecilia. I'm the daughter of Duke Rose. Don't you really remember me? After everything that happened, you wouldn't easily forget, right?"

*Stare.* Alice's eyes widened with suspicion as she glared at Merlin. She had a bad feeling, and could even detect the faint whiff of potential infidelity.

"Alice, put away that murderous glare. You're making me awkward. Don't just believe whatever this guy says..." Unable to endure Alice's stare any longer, Merlin turned back to Cecilia. "Miss, don't say things that make no sense. What kind of thing are you talking about? I really have no impression of you..."

"In the underground tomb's second floor of the former Kingdom Chancellor's estate in Denby County...." Cecilia hesitated, her little face flushing red. "Didn't I take off my clothes right in front of you!? How could you forget so easily!?"

"Huh?!?" Rage surged straight to Alice's head. She grabbed Merlin's collar and started shaking him. "What exactly did you do, you pervert!? Why do you always make other girls take off their clothes!?"

"Oh no!"

Cael dropped to his knees with a thud, gazing blankly at the floor, his face so dark it could drip water.

Dear gods! What happened while I was unconscious!?

Why do I feel like my head is covered in a lush green landscape?

Did something incredibly dark happen while I was out cold?

He had thought Lady Cecilia was just joking, but it was all real!

Cael quickly got to his feet, his high-tier battle aura surging, spear in hand, his furious expression looking as though he intended to take Merlin down with him.

"You black-iron villager, what did you do to Lady Cecilia!? Today I will fight you to the death!"

"Wait, Cael! Calm down!" Cecilia quickly blocked Cael, stopping him from causing more trouble.

The scene suddenly descended into chaos, and the complicated relationships in the room left everyone feeling bewildered.

Shirley, crouching inside the house, could no longer understand anything. She thought to herself, is this really how human private lives are? So chaotic it's eye-opening.

"What are you doing, you bastard!? Can you consider my feelings or not!? Don't think just because we're fake spouses you can run around like this! Alice was about to cry from anger at Merlin's womanizing ways. Even though she knew they were fake spouses, she still felt inexplicably upset about this.

Merlin's head was being shaken like a rattle drum, his face wearing an expression of utter despair. Thinking carefully, he did seem to recall something like that happening.

So Merlin gently pushed Alice's hands away and said with sudden realization.

"Oh~ I remember now. You must be the person I stood up."

Yes, so you do remember standing me up..." Cecilia said with a smile that didn't reach her eyes. She felt the way he remembered her was terribly strange.

"My apologies. I never remember the names of idle deadwood." Merlin said flatly.

"....." Cecilia's mood grew complicated. Even if she was idle deadwood, please don't say it out loud, okay?

"Don't change the subject. Why did you make her take off her clothes!?" Alice gritted her teeth in anger, even her ahoge standing straight up from rage.

"Alice, calm down. What could I have done? I didn't do anything. She was the one who wanted to take off her clothes, and I stopped her." Merlin wore an amused smile.

Alice narrowed her eyes, clearly unconvinced. Think about it—would Merlin be so kind-hearted? With such a great opportunity, shouldn't he have just gone for it first?

"Lady Cecilia, is everything he's saying true!?" Cael asked with a shocked expression, his voice trembling slightly from his agitated state.

"Yes, Lord Merlin is telling the truth, but there were reasons for all of this, and also a bit of misunderstanding...." Cecilia recalled the scene from back then and felt genuinely embarrassed talking about it.

Cael's expression went blank, as if his soul had left his body. It was as though his entire life's dream had instantly been shattered.

Lady Cecilia actually took off her clothes voluntarily in front of this black-iron villager!

No way! That's absolutely impossible! Lady Cecilia wasn't that kind of person!

They had grown up together. Such a pure and innocent Lady Cecilia.

How could she.... do something so devoid of self-respect!

Right! This was all this black-iron villager's fault! It must be him!

He used sweet words and bewitched Lady Cecilia into making such a humiliating gesture!

He could no longer bear it. He had sworn to dedicate his entire life to serving and protecting Lady Cecilia!

But today he could not follow Lady Cecilia's orders. He had to help her restore her dignity!

No matter what confusing sorcery this black-iron villager knew, he would pierce through this despicable black-iron villager's strongman mask!

Cael's battle aura and pressure climbed higher and higher. He gripped his spear tightly and swung it through the air twice.

His face contorted with rage, his eyes full of hatred fixed on Merlin, his complexion turning pale from anger, his breathing growing heavy.

Cael pointed a finger at Merlin and, with a voice that seemed ready to bite through his own teeth, delivered his challenge—

"You shameless black-iron villager!

"I, Cael, hereby issue a fair 1v1 duel to you!"

title: Chapter 36 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Tickets
content:
Chapter 36 — Bonus Chapter for Monthly Tickets

Volume 6 · Chapter 36

An awkward silence fell over everyone as no one spoke for a moment, as if they were looking at an idiot.

Cecilia looked at Kyle's furious expression and was deeply puzzled.

What was wrong with Kyle? Why did he have such hostility toward Lord Merlin?

Every time she brought up Lord Merlin, he seemed unhappy, and lately he'd been disobeying more and more often.

He was grown up now; could he still be going through a teenage rebellion phase?

Cecilia thought awkwardly, feeling a bit embarrassed by Kyle's behavior. They had come to ask Merlin for help, not to deliberately pick a fight.

Alice's brows were tightly furrowed as she looked at Kyle in disbelief, thinking hurry up and stop causing trouble. Merlin's strength was monster-level; she couldn't even beat him, let alone Kyle. Was he out of his mind?

"You guy, calm down. Why the sudden challenge to a duel?"

"Miss Alice, please don't interfere. This is my own will!" Kyle ignored Alice's pleas and fired back, "I'm guessing you're just another pitiful girl who was fooled by this Black Iron villager, aren't you?"

"Huh?" Alice froze, confused about what was going on. "Fooled by a pitiful girl? What do you mean..."

"Miss Alice, please open your eyes and see this Black Iron villager's true colors. He has no real strength, only some sinister tricks. He uses despicable deception to manipulate your emotions, and I seriously suspect this bastard's reason for wanting to marry you is just to live off women!" Kyle felt as though he had seen through everything, all of it was Merlin's dirty scheme.

"Alice was at a loss, not knowing how to explain at all. There were many reasons why she was with Merlin, and it couldn't be explained in a short time."

"But it's okay, Miss Alice, don't worry."

Kyle held up the spear in his hands and said seriously, "I'm challenging this Black Iron villager to a duel right now, and I have confidence that I can take him down in a single strike against someone without any magic or aura pressure! Everyone will know whether he's truly strong or not then! You've all been under this liar's spell long enough, it's time to wake up!"

Alice didn't speak, watching Kyle deliver his impassioned speech of justice despite his terrible luck. If Merlin got serious, people could die.

It seemed Kyle had already planned a series of moves to expose Merlin's true weakness by tearing off his strongman facade right on the spot.

Wasn't everyone being deceived by this Black Iron villager's fake strength? Then they should take him down and prove through facts that he was weak!

At that point, not only would the foolish Miss Alice come to her senses, but the young lady who blindly adored Merlin would also see reality clearly!

Merlin sat on the sofa, and even as Kyle clamored about the duel, he remained in a lazy state and said casually, "A duel? What a bother. I decline."

"What!?"

Kyle was stunned, his eyes wide open. He never expected Merlin to refuse.

Any normal man would accept a duel to defend his pride.

But Merlin seemed different from the norm, catching Kyle off guard.

Kyle felt he had overestimated Merlin. What dignity could a stupid bastard who only knew how to use sweet words to deceive women possibly have?

"Are you even a man!? If you're a man, accept my duel! Don't you have a single shred of masculine honor!?"

"Don't... don't say that..." Cold sweat dripped down Alice's forehead. If Kyle provoked Merlin further and angered him, they were all dead. She had no confidence she could stop Merlin from killing.

"Hah!?" Merlin twisted his mouth and frowned. "Are you stupid? What's the connection between accepting a duel and male honor? I really don't understand your stupid logic..."

"You dare curse me!?" Kyle's eyes bulged, and his fury rose another notch. How dare this piece of trash Black Iron villager call him, a high-ranking knight, stupid? The audacity!

"So what if I did? Let me tell you the truth..." Merlin paused, sprawled lazily on the sofa and said without reservation, "Your strength is too weak. I look down on you at a glance. I wouldn't even bother fighting you. You want me to duel you? Ridiculous. You have no资格 to stand opposite me. Go wash up and sleep..."

"What did you say!?" Anger surged through Kyle, his spear trembling uncontrollably in his hands. He wanted to attack right there in the room. "What gives a lowest-rank Black Iron adventurer the right to be arrogant!? Since you're so confident in yourself, then duel me and fight it out!"

"To duel me? There's a threshold for that. First, your strength must reach Saint-tier. Second, you must embrace the determination to die." Merlin paused and said calmly, "You don't meet either condition and hold no value to me whatsoever, so I refuse to duel you."

Kyle was like a furious lion, and Merlin's slouching posture made him even madder. How much did he look down on him? "You bastard..."

"That's enough! What are you doing, Kyle!?" Cecilia couldn't hold back any longer. She felt the situation was deteriorating. They had originally come to ask Merlin for help, and now the relationship was so tense. "Have you forgotten my instructions? You must not show disrespect to Lord Merlin. Why did you throw it aside and challenge Lord Merlin to a duel? Apologize to him right now!"

"...Kyle was scolded by Cecilia and felt deeply hurt. Under pressure, he said, "I'm very sorry, Lady Cecilia, but this time I cannot obey your order."

"What!?" Cecilia was bewildered. Kyle disobeying her orders was unprecedented, leaving her greatly astonished. "Why!? You're my knight! Obeying orders is your duty!"

"But protecting your honor is also my duty!" Kyle gritted his teeth and glared at Merlin. "This bastard took advantage of my unconsciousness to seduce you into taking off your clothes. This vulgar act has insulted your honor, and as your knight, I absolutely will not allow you to suffer any humiliation!"

"Idiot Kyle! Nothing happened between Lord Merlin and me! And I didn't expose myself too much... and I was the one who... I..." Cecilia's face flushed red, unable to continue. She had been the one to take off her clothes, and she had misunderstood Merlin's intentions.

"Stop talking, Lady Cecilia. I'll listen to you about anything except this!" Kyle resolutely averted his gaze.

"Kyle!" Cecilia stamped her foot in anger, somewhat at a loss for how to handle Kyle.

"Merlin, I know why you refuse to accept my duel. It's because you're guilty!" Kyle pointed at Merlin and said earnestly.

"Guilty?" Merlin's head was full of questions. He hadn't stolen Alice's private savings, nor had he gone out to prostitute himself. What was he guilty about?

"You have no real strength. You're just a deceiver who knows some tricks. You're afraid of being defeated by me in the duel and having your weakness exposed!" Kyle narrowed his eyes and sneered, "You really are a guy who lives off women, aren't you? Not a real man! Pah!"

"Tch! I know many people think I'm living off women, but you're the first to say it so boldly and directly."

Merlin's brows tightened, seeming somewhat angry. It didn't matter if they called him weak because they were ignorant. But to call him a freeloader and not a man crossed a line.

Merlin decided to teach Kyle a lesson. He sat upright, his eyes filled with contempt.

"Since your skin is itching, I'll reluctantly help loosen it up. If I make you cry, don't blame me, okay?"

"Wouldn't have it any other way!" Kyle's eyes lit up with excitement. The reverse psychology method really worked.

"Very well. I accept the duel, but not in my house. Outside!" Merlin pointed his thumb toward the door, signaling to go out and play.

"Good. I'll wait for you downstairs!" Kyle grabbed his spear and left.

"I'm truly sorry, Lord Merlin. Let me go and reprimand..." Cecilia bowed apologetically and hurried out after them. "Kyle, you—"

Alice watched Cecilia and Kyle leave, and asked Merlin worriedly, "You're not actually going to kill that knight, are you?"

"Ridiculous. Does that guy even have the qualification to be killed by me?" Merlin sneered, curling his lips in disdain.

Alice felt somewhat relieved. As long as Merlin didn't randomly kill people, things would be manageable.

"Sigh, what troublesome matters..." Merlin sighed and held out his hand to Alice. "Alice, you know what I mean, right?"

"Huh? Know what?" Alice didn't understand what Merlin meant.

"Can't you keep up with me even a little?" Merlin raised his eyebrows, saying with dissatisfaction, "Hurry up and get the rolling pin for me."

"I'll go turn that little knight into a flatbread!"

title: Chapter 37
content:
Chapter 37

Volume 6 · Chapter 37

Night had fallen, with stars arrayed across the sky.

Moonlight poured down like flowing water, settling quietly on the open ground beneath the apartment.

Merlin and Kael stood facing each other, a major battle about to erupt, seemingly impossible to stop.

Alice and Cecilia watched from the sidelines, deeply worried about the duel.

However, both of them were somewhat concerned that Merlin might slip up and kill Kael outright.

Cecilia had already tried advising Kael, using every tactic of threat and temptation at her disposal.

But Kael was like a rotten stone in a latrine, completely ignoring her, absolutely determined to duel Merlin.

Cecilia had personally witnessed Merlin's cheat-level strength, at least Saint-tier, nowhere near what Kael could defeat.

At first Cecilia was very worried about Kael's life, but when she saw Merlin come down without a sword, wielding a rolling pin instead, she instantly relaxed—

Surely Lord Merlin wouldn't hold a grudge against Kael, right?

Coming armed with a rolling pin meant he clearly had no intention of fighting seriously.

If Lord Merlin were actually angered and got serious, Kael would hardly have a chance of survival.

But Lord Merlin was a Saint-tier powerhouse, so even with a rolling pin he could still injure Kael, couldn't he?

Cecilia thought silently to herself; although Kael wouldn't be in life-threatening danger, it still pained her to see him get hurt.

Alice glanced at Kael, then at Merlin, and couldn't help but awkwardly think: Can't this guy take things seriously? Coming to a duel with a rolling pin—wasn't that too insulting?

In the center of the arena, the evening wind rustled—

Merlin had his hands on his hips, tapping a rolling pin against his neck, his expression indifferent, even carrying a hint of mockery.

Clearly, he wasn't taking the opponent in front of him seriously at all, treating the duel as mere entertainment.

In contrast to Merlin, Kael looked extremely serious, fire burning in his eyes.

Kael was fully confident about exposing Merlin's fake strong-man facade in front of the two ladies, and had been itching to get started for some time.

But Merlin's arrogant attitude made Kael extremely displeased. Showing up with a rolling pin—how much did he look down on him!? Was he treating Kael like a disobedient brat who needed to be hung up and beaten?!

Anger surged within Kael as he sharply vibrated the spear in his hand, loudly accusing, "Hey! Are you out of your mind!? This is a duel! Can you please take it a little more seriously!?"

"Huh?" Merlin rolled his eyes impatiently and said casually, "I'm already being serious. Let's get started already."

"Who are you trying to fool!?" Kael couldn't stand Merlin's unserious attitude. "Fighting with a rolling pin doesn't count as serious! Can't you go grab a proper weapon? I've seen you always carry a katana!"

"I don't need a weapon to deal with you. A single rolling pin is more than enough. This thing is great for domestic discipline, you know~" Merlin waved the rolling pin in his hand.

"You bastard! I can tell you're clearly looking down on me!" Kael's forehead veins throbbed furiously with rage.

"You're right, I do look down on you..." Merlin stated bluntly without any expression.

"Damn it!" Kael swung his spear, immediately taking a combat stance, and angrily declared, "What right does some common Black Iron villager like you have to look down on me!?\nI advise you to quickly drop your strong-man facade and stop deceiving people. Blades have no eyes, and don't go losing your life over this!"

"Heh, even if I just stand here and let you stab at me for a day and a night, you think you could kill me?" Merlin curled his lips into a smile.

"Pure nonsense! You won't learn your lesson until you see the coffin!" Kael's high-tier fighting spirit surged, his body radiating heat like high temperature, making the surrounding air shimmer and blur. "For Lady Cecilia's dignity, today I will surely beat you until you have no intact skin left!"

"Kael..." Cecilia murmured, thinking how it was all just a misunderstanding, and that Kael didn't really need to duel on her behalf.

"Enough talk, you're eating into my dinner time..." Merlin tapped his shoulder with the rolling pin, beckoning to Kael provocatively. "I'll graciously show you what this little knight is capable of. Come at me with your strongest move."

"You're courting death!" Kael's high-tier fighting spirit erupted instantly, and the opening strike was an ultra-high-speed thrust, as if trying to pierce right through Merlin's body.

The fallen leaves on the ground were instantly shaken apart. Kael's figure flashed like lightning, his spear full of power, overflowing with explosive force!

To Merlin, Kael was nothing but a freeloading fraud with not a shred of real strength—this move alone was sufficient...

But was that really the case?

Kael's overpowering thrust was surprisingly blocked by a single one of Merlin's fingers, with zero effort required.

Such an bizarre sight instantly stunned Kael, his jaw dropping to the ground.

His full-power thrust had been defended by merely a finger!?\nKael found it hard to believe the reality before his eyes; no matter how hard he pushed, he couldn't advance even an inch—

What was going on?!\nWhy could he block his attack with just one finger?\nThis kind of terrifying physical strength was truly shocking!\nIt seemed this man was no ordinary fellow; he had reason to be proud!

Kael felt as though he weren't facing a human finger, but rather an impregnable wall of bronze and iron.

Alice and Cecilia remained relatively calm; having witnessed Merlin's strength before, this result didn't surprise them in the least.

"Is this your strongest move? Weaker than I expected..." Merlin chuckled helplessly, feeling like he was bullying a small child.

"Tch!" Kael quickly retreated, secretly deciding to go all-out. "How could that have been my full power? That was just me probing you!"

"Oh, then stop wasting time and just bring it." Merlin frowned, seeming somewhat impatient.

"Don't think that just because your flesh is strong, you can be arrogant in front of me. What comes next is the real deal."

Kael straightened his combat stance, thinking that unless he showed his true skills, he really wouldn't be able to defeat this Black Iron villager.

Could everything the young miss had said be true? This guy was powerful...

No way. How could someone powerful fail to sense even the slightest mana or fighting spirit pressure? That was abnormal!

Kael decided to get serious. Since he was the one who initiated the duel, he had to win.

"Haa!!" Kael let out a roar, suddenly closing the distance, and swung his spear, transforming it into a storm of spear shadows that descended upon Merlin like a deluge.

This was Kael's high-tier martial art, "Thousand Shadows Strangle," an ultra-high-speed spear dance that turned into countless afterimages, directly strangling the enemy—utterly imposing in its声势!

The sky filled with spear shadows, easily numbering in the thousands, looking extremely fearsome, while also generating gales of wind that rushed toward Merlin.

"Wahahaha!" Kael said boastfully even as he attacked, "See the vibration frequency of my spear? Are you scared yet?"

"Oh, not bad for someone who's been single for over twenty years, I'll give you a thumbs up!" Merlin raised his thumb, then quickly added, "But that's nothing, because I've been single for 200 years!"

"Huh?!" Kael froze, not understanding what he meant.

Merlin moved, swinging his rolling pin at an unbelievable speed, in an instant transforming into tens of thousands of rolling pin shadows!

The situation flipped completely; countless rolling pin shadows pressed back toward Kael instead.

Kael's eyes widened to their limit as he stared at the dazzling array of rolling pin afterimages.

He was so stunned he couldn't even move, actually scared silly by Merlin's counterattack!

A biting wind suddenly struck, making Kael doubt his very existence, and he instinctively cried out—

"N...NANI?!!"

title: Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 38

“In my rolling pin, tremble! Oh, hehehehe....

Merlin laughed very evilly, not serious about dueling at all, instead treating Kyle like a child’s plaything.

A clatter of hammer blows, and Kyle was beaten senseless by Merlin’s rolling pin.

Merlin used a baseball motion, directly striking Kyle and sending him flying home.

Kyle flew backward, lying on the ground like a dead dog, trembling all over, obviously having been knocked silly by Merlin.

Although easily knocked down by Merlin, Kyle still tightly gripped his spear, this kind of obsession was worthy of respect.

“Kyle!” Cecilia was heartbroken, almost crying.

She was just about to take a step to check Kyle’s injuries, but was stopped.

“Don’t come over!” Kyle struggled to prop up his body, his face swollen and bruised from Merlin’s slap, his bones feeling like they were about to break, a bone-deep pain making him gulp down cold breaths repeatedly, “Cecilia-sama, this is my duel with him, don’t interfere.”

“Kyle! What are you doing? Stop this stupid behavior!” Cecilia shouted emotionally, very wanting to smash Kyle’s head with her magic staff.

“Cecilia-sama, please understand me!” Kyle slowly stood up, his eyes devoid of any fear, “As your knight, if I can’t even beat an iron villager, what face do I have left to stay by your side!”

...Cecilia was speechless, anger and sorrow intertwined, unable to hold back a curse, “Kyle you idiot!”

Kyle gave no response, for this duel was not only for Miss Cecilia, but also for his own survival meaning.

“Merlin, you hit too hard, right?” Alice frowned, feeling Merlin was a bit too much.

“It’s because he insisted on dueling, blame me, huh?” Merlin shrugged his shoulders, looking very innocent.

Alice was at a loss for words, thinking it indeed had nothing to do with Merlin, but still couldn’t help saying, “Can you let her go? I’ve never seen you so straightforward before.”

“Tsk!” Merlin clicked his tongue, feeling a headache, he had already been so unserious about the duel?

“Alice-sama, please don’t interfere in our duel!” Kyle shouted seriously.

“Huh!” Alice looked at Kyle with a look of staring at an idiot, anyone with eyes could see he couldn’t beat Merlin, why was he so obsessed?

“Can he still get up?” Merlin poked his ear, saying helplessly. I advise you to give it up, otherwise it won’t just be a minor skin injury.

“No! Before I use all my strength, I won’t give up.” Kyle gritted his teeth, very unwilling, “I apologize for my previous rudeness, you are not a useless iron villager, I admit you are a strong person with strength above mine.

“If you know that, then don’t play around, fighting you has no meaning at all, like bullying a kindergarten friend - -

Merlin waved his hand, looking very disdainful, feeling that Kyle’s duel here was simply wasting his precious time.

“Please don’t lightly underestimate me!” Kyle showed a serious expression, clutching his chest, saying unyieldingly, “We are dueling, and I am your opponent, if the battle can’t be brought to a close with all-out effort, isn’t that a pity! Please respect me as your opponent!”

Merlin looked at Kyle’s persistent appearance, and fell into silence for a moment.

This weak guy actually resonates with my ideology?

If a battle isn’t all-out, it’s meaningless.

I think so too, and have always adhered to it.

Even if Kyle is weak, I must respect him as a true warrior.

Merlin sighed, suddenly pressing the rolling pin to his waist, drawing a sword-drawing posture.

“Well, I admit you are a true warrior, facing me I will be a bit more serious - -.”

“Merlin, you’re not joking?” Alice widened her eyes, even if Merlin doesn’t use the demon sword Banri Garan, he can use such a terrifying sword-draw slash, it would kill people.

“Shut up, Alice, what I do doesn’t need you to meddle.” Merlin said lightly.

“You!” Alice’s face flushed with anger, she could only stomp her foot, having no way to deal with Merlin.

“Then I won’t be polite! Receive my attack!”

Kyle instantly raised his high-level battle aura to the peak, and his long spear in his hand shot out like an arrow from a bowstring!

The spear turned into a standard spear, “whoosh” the sound of breaking the air came, fierce battle aura seemingly able to penetrate everything.

This is Kyle’s strongest high-level close-combat technique ‘Spear’s Return Kill Technique’, it has two moves in total, first move thrown, second move instant body!

Merlin slightly turned his head, dodging the incoming spear, letting it brush past his ear.

He felt a bit strange, thinking what was the point of such an obvious attack technique?

The second move of the Spear’s Return Kill Technique was instantly activated, originally far away from Merlin, Kyle instantly appeared beside the flying spear, actually approaching Merlin in a short time! ?

Got it!

The winner of this duel is me! ?

Kyle gripped his spear, in mid-air the spear tip pointing at the unaware Merlin, aiming straight at his heart.

“I won!”

The spear suddenly stabbed out, containing all of Kyle’s battle aura, very lethal!

However, ideals are full, reality is skinny, Kyle blinked, the Merlin behind him suddenly disappeared without a trace, no shadow!

Damn it!

What situation! ?

Why did he suddenly disappear!

A bone-chilling feeling surged from the bottom of Kyle’s heart, sure enough, Merlin’s voice sounded behind him.

“You think you won, huh?

Kyle was astounded by Merlin’s unimaginable movement speed, unable to understand what happened!

He stabilized his form, quickly turned around, facing Merlin’s most powerful ultimate technique, unrivaled sword-draw slash (rolling pin mode).

“Die!

Or small沉

Merlin suddenly pulled out the rolling pin hanging at his waist, a violent wind rose!

A murderous sword intent exploded at the scene, attacking the bewildered Kyle!

Kyle felt a death threat covering the sky and earth, his head could no longer think, his mind was only that he was doomed!

He had never experienced such a powerful force, the murderous sword intent coming at him was more terrifying than any monster!

Apart from powerful, there was no other word to describe it!

The death threat flashed by, Merlin’s rolling pin stopped one centimeter in front of Kyle’s throat, shadows covering his entire face.

The ground, who knows when, had cracks like a tortoise shell, although not large, but shocking to the eye, showing how cruel Merlin’s attack was.

“If I hit you with this rolling pin, you’re already dead, do you still need to continue the duel?”

Kyle looked at the rolling pin like he had lost his soul, staring blankly, like an idiot.

Even though the danger had passed, he still felt a bone-chilling cold.

Kyle’s spear fell to the ground with a clatter, then his whole body went limp, cold sweat pouring out.

He “keng” knelt on the ground in front of Merlin, his body trembling uncontrollably...

...Too powerful!

This power is probably already a Saint-tier powerhouse, right?

I actually dueled a Saint-tier powerhouse, isn’t this suicide?

title: Chapter 39 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 39 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 39

The two girls watching the duel nearby finally relaxed, their long-held fears lifted.

Cecilia looked at Merlin with gratitude in her eyes, thinking that Lord Merlin was truly a kind-hearted person — no matter how rude Kyle had been, he still hadn't killed him outright!

Alice secretly exhaled. Thank goodness Merlin wasn't completely unhinged, or this would have become a real problem. That guy sometimes really didn't seem like a demon who committed every evil under the sun.

Merlin pounded his own shoulders with a rolling pin, looking very relaxed. "Looks like you've already lost your will to fight..."

Kyle couldn't say a single word. The terror still lingered in his heart, dominating his mind —

Never in his dreams would he have imagined...

This Black Iron village villager was actually this powerful!

So all that careless, nonchalant attitude was an act — used to conceal his overwhelming strength!?

Weren't they being way too low-key? One couldn't tell at all that Merlin was a Saint-tier powerhouse!

Kyle panted heavily, still unable to comprehend why Merlin had been so strong, recalling the ruthless power he'd displayed just now.

He only felt as though he'd cheated death, like he'd walked through hell and come back to life.

Kyle felt reborn, his entire outlook on life reshaped. He would never judge people by their appearances again from now on.

"Since you came to challenge me of your own accord, I can't let you lose without any punishment. How about I reward you with something nice!" A demonic grin spread across Merlin's face, and he was already growing restless — after all, an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth was a demon's code.

"Eh!?" Kyle slowly came back to his senses, not knowing what the so-called punishment was — until he immediately found out...

"Take this rolling pin!" Merlin bonked Kyle right on the head with the rolling pin, knocking him straight unconscious.

Kyle was still half-dazed when suddenly he went completely limp, collapsing onto the ground like a dead dog.

"Eh?!!" Alice stared at Merlin in astonishment, thinking she'd been far too naive — he really was a demon after all!

Kyle!

Cecilia hurried over to check her knight's condition, but he was merely unconscious with no serious injuries.

She didn't blame Merlin either — it was already remarkable that the duel hadn't cost Kyle his life.

Normal Saint-tier powerhouses tended to have rather strange tempers, and after being publicly humiliated that day, they would certainly feel murderous intent.

And yet Merlin was so kind, merely striking him once with a club to knock him out.

Cecilia silently thanked Merlin's mercy in her heart. Otherwise, with Kyle's reckless personality, Merlin would've already bashed his skull in with that rolling pin.

"Hmm~" Merlin tapped his shoulder and said nonchalantly, "You little knight were shouting at me so impudently. If I don't teach you a lesson, you'll never learn."

"Merlin, he already lost. Weren't you a bit too harsh?" Alice felt sorry for Kyle — facing off against a monster like Merlin was just cruel. He'd probably question his entire existence after waking up.

"This is nothing? I didn't even take his life, which is already showing great mercy." Merlin turned and walked away, too lazy to argue with Alice, that little guardian of justice.

"Merlin, listen to me..." Alice chased after him in annoyance. "Wait for me!"

Halfway there, Merlin suddenly remembered something. He turned back and asked Cecilia, who was tending to Kyle, "Oh right, that noble young lady — what were you doing coming to our house suddenly today?"

Alice also paused, almost forgetting about this. Didn't Cecilia say she had some grand plan?

Cecilia thought for a moment and grew somewhat worried.

Her knight Kyle had just had such an unpleasant encounter fighting Merlin. Could Merlin still help her?

But she had to try. What if Merlin agreed?

Cecilia raised her head and said seriously, "I'd like to ask Lord Merlin to do us a favor and join our party to handle something together."

"Hmm?" Merlin leisurely turned around and asked, intrigued. "What sort of thing?"

"Please accompany us to a remote island in the straits and help us defeat the evil alchemist there." Cecilia said it briefly, her expression extremely serious.

The moment Merlin heard "strait," he felt a headache coming on, thinking it involved naval combat.

Because his only weakness was that he couldn't swim — he dreaded fighting in aquatic terrain dearly.

If Merlin fell into water, he'd be a pathetic warrior with combat power below five.

Perhaps many would wonder — what if Merlin encountered a water-element mage?

Actually, that wouldn't be much of an issue. Against water-element magic, Merlin's broken-level magic immunity would still hold effective.

But the real danger lay in water mages using large-scale terrain-altering magic to flood the entire battlefield into an endless ocean.

For instance, if a water mage summoned a devastating tsunami, the initial shockwave driven by magic power wouldn't affect Merlin at all — it would even split the incoming tsunami apart.

But once the waters calmed and the surrounding area became a vast ocean, if Merlin unluckily fell in again — that would be pretty much the end for him, left entirely at the mercy of fate...

Just thinking about it — if he couldn't even approach any water, would he never be able to bathe in his entire life? How filthy would that be!

So Merlin paid close attention to water-heavy regions and avoided them whenever possible, since the danger level was obvious.

"I'm not good at naval combat. It'd be hard for me to be of much help..."

"Really? Didn't we cross the strait together? How could you not be good at it?" Alice asked in surprise.

"Didn't I tell you I can't swim? Nothing happened last time because I didn't fall into the water, right?" Merlin shrugged his shoulders.

"Lord Merlin, please don't worry about falling in. Our Rose family still has influence along the coast — we can borrow a warship that won't be easily capsized. Moreover, the evil alchemist we're hunting is on the island itself, so no naval battle is needed." Cecilia explained everything specifically to dispel Merlin's doubts.

"What's your goal?" Merlin asked cautiously, wondering why someone would seek him out without some agenda.

"I hope Lord Merlin can let me take the credit, because I need this honor greatly right now — to prove myself to my family!" Cecilia said passionately. Merlin's participation was a crucial part of her plan. Based on the intelligence she'd purchased, this alchemist was quite formidable and shouldn't be underestimated.

"Why do I get the feeling all the benefits go to you? No way!" Merlin felt that claiming credit was also an important thing — how could he just give it away?

"Please, Lord Merlin. Aside from you, I can hardly find any Saint-tier powerhouse to help me." Cecilia begged sincerely.

"Merlin, she seems a bit..." Alice whispered to Merlin privately, feeling somewhat sorry for Cecilia — she looked like someone with no way out.

Before Alice could finish her sentence, Merlin poured cold water on her. "You see, without any benefits, she's already getting impatient. She's been constantly egging me on to demand benefits."

"Who's egging you on!!!" Alice instantly flew into a rage, thinking it was clearly this shameless guy, Merlin, who was shamelessly demanding benefits and now dumping the blame on her!

"Lord Merlin, please tell me directly what benefits you want from me. Within my capabilities, I will definitely satisfy you." Cecilia had no demands of her own, so whatever Merlin wanted to pick, she'd let him choose.

But it was impossible to offer nothing —

Cecilia's spine suddenly grew cold, as if she were standing naked before Merlin, being lecherously ogled by that shameless pervert.

The expression on Merlin's face as he contemplated索取 benefits — in Cecilia's eyes now, the right side was extremely lewd, like someone harboring wicked designs. Interested? Using that ——

Cecilia couldn't help but grow nervous, wondering what Lord Merlin meant by this. Was he eyeing her body again ——

His bare, unabashed gaze fixed directly on her body. Embarrassing. Helplessly, she said —

"Could you please smile normally?" Alice smacked her hand over Merlin's face, stopping him from continuing —

"Miss Cecilia, please don't misunderstand —"

"Merlin is just sick. Every time something like this comes up, his smile automatically turns disgusting."

“Huh? !” Cecilia couldn't figure out what this couple was up to, always feeling they were hurting each other.
“Alice, don't block my shot, give me some face.” Merlin pulled Alice's hand away from his face, then rubbed his fingers at Cecilia and said, “The benefits we want are so obvious—how do you not get it? Money, miss~”
“Uh!”
Cecilia stared blankly, a bit slow to react.
I always thought Merlin was a transcendent powerhouse who didn't care about fame or profit, but after all this he still needs money!
Turns out I overthought it—Merlin himself can't escape worldly needs; he needs money too?
Besides, living in a cramped apartment and drinking cheap coffee—who wouldn't want to change their life?
Cecilia lifted her head, thinking if Merlin needed money, that would be easy—she could actually come up with some.

.”00....... CE light novel

No wonder every adventurer wants to make a name for themselves; jobs like this are usually assigned to famous, capable adventurers, leaving ordinary ones with no chance to get involved—this is the gap.....
Although Alice really wanted to take the job, she suddenly remembered she still had to go to London to deliver Shirley to the elves' embassy; the matters piled up, forcing her to make a decision.
“300,000! 300,000 coins! I can't come up with any more money—if Lord Merlin isn't satisfied, I fear I'll have to go out and do compensated dating!” Cecilia said frantically, like a desperate person letting out a final roar; she never imagined Merlin's appetite would be so big.

.”...Great

Although it felt painful, Cecilia was still satisfied; finding a Saint-tier expert as an assistant is hard enough, so Merlin's joining is a tremendous boon.

“Wait a minute!” Alice sprang up urgently to object, tugging at Merlin.
What's wrong? You're all flustered—Merlin looked at Alice, puzzled.

Merlin couldn't help but think, weighing the pros and cons—
Shirley promised to produce 1,000,000 gold coins, while Cecilia only has 300,000.
It's obvious who has more and who has less, but all we need to do is get Shirley to the London embassy.
If we can make it a stop along the way, earning money twice on one trip is totally doable.
Merlin turned his head to look at Cecilia, probing with a question.
“Miss Cecilia, we have to go to London for something—can you accept that?”

Good, we'll head to London first, then take care of Miss Cecilia's matter.” Merlin gave a thumbs up, speaking seriously, having made this quick decision—we will tomorrow hot ground teach” SF light novel<
The moonlight flowed.

Kyle lay in Cecilia's arms, still unconscious.
Cecilia's hand glowed with white light as she repeatedly cast healing spells, quickly mending Kyle's external wounds.
The night wind outside was lively, gently brushing the two of them.
Time slowly passed; Kyle gradually woke up, and Cecilia's face came directly into his view—
“Cecilia =
Kyle seemed still a bit weak, speaking with little strength.

“Do you know how much trouble you just caused me? You almost offended Lord Merlin, ruining my whole plan!” Cecilia recalled Kyle's disobedience earlier, and her anger flared. 2 no text

Now Kyle has come around—his strength can't even reach Merlin's toenails; the gap is huge, and the fact that Merlin didn't take his life is already a great mercy.
Thus Kyle developed a sense of awe toward Merlin in his heart, changing his previous attitude and still addressing him as Lord Merlin.

title: Chapter 41 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 41 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 6 · Chapter 41

"Huh?" Cecilia's eyes widened, not expecting such words to come from Kyle.

Kyle knew his words were harsh, but that was what he truly felt.

"You've been played for a fool. If I, your knight, cannot see justice done for you, then what kind of knight am I!?"

"...Where in the world did you get that idea!?" Cecilia grew flustered and couldn't help but explain. "How could something like that possibly happen!"

"Weren't you the one who said it yourself? You even took your clothes off. I know perfectly well what happens next..." Kyle said, his heart aching. Hearing that Cecilia had stripped in front of Merlin made him genuinely miserable.

"Nothing happened between Lord Merlin and me! I was the one who took off my clothes..." Cecilia paused, hesitating. "But you heard it, right? Lord Merlin stopped it..."

"Lady Cecilia, please forgive my insolence."

Kyle raised his head, his face filled with sorrow. "Why would you do such a thing? You're always so dignified and composed, so self-respecting... How could you..."

"...I..."

Cecilia's lips moved, but she could barely force out a single word.

She thought that if she didn't explain the truth, Kyle would keep misunderstanding her forever.

Since Kyle was sincere enough to speak with her directly, what was there she couldn't say!

Cecilia raised her head, her face flushed red with a mix of shyness and nervousness.

"I did it all to save you, you idiot!"

"Huh!?" Kyle froze, completely bewildered.

"The situation was so dire back then, and you were unconscious. Only Lord Merlin could save us!" Cecilia said, her tearful eyes shimmering, her tone tinged with sadness. "But Lord Merlin wouldn't just work for free. I mistakenly thought at first that he didn't need money—he needed... my body. So in order to save you, an idiot like you, I had no choice... It was all a misunderstanding."

"So... that's how it was..."

Kyle's eyes went wide, his expression thoroughly shocked. All this time, the young lady had been doing it all for him.

What was he even thinking? He had actually made Lady Cecilia so heartbroken. Such disrespect!

It seemed he really shouldn't have come after Lord Merlin. Unlike his carefree exterior, the man was truly upright and honorable!

Kyle bowed his head deeply, assuming the posture of someone utterly surrendered in body and spirit.

"I'm sorry, Lady Cecilia. I was useless, making you endure such humiliation. This is my failure!"

"Enough. It's all in the past now, don't mention it again." Cecilia waved her hand and wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes.

"My strength is no match for Lord Merlin's. Perhaps someone as weak as me doesn't deserve to be your knight at all!" Kyle's heart was far from calm. He felt Cecilia had done so much for him, yet he had nothing to offer in return.

"What are you talking about!? I didn't choose my knights based on strength alone..." Cecilia's face flushed, and she muttered unhappily. "I mostly just go by whether I find them pleasing to the eye!"

Sherry learned she was about to return to her homeland and was so happy she didn't sleep all night.

Instead, she chatted with Alice about her hometown, as if she had endless topics to share.

Although Sherry was over four hundred years old, her mental maturity seemed no more developed than Alice's.

Alice treated her like a big sister each time, caring for the timid elf and listening seriously as Sherry recounted stories of the distant southern kingdom.

Sherry was incredibly eager to return home and see her father, the Elf King, once again.

Alice felt that Sherry had wandered outside long enough; it was time to go home.

By the next morning...

The sunlight couldn't wait to burst over the horizon, bringing light to the Welsh town of Raxem.

Numerous citizens stepped out of their homes to busy themselves, braving the energetic morning.

Below the apartment, Cecilia had long had her private carriage parked there, waiting for Lord Merlin and the others.

The carriage was elaborately decorated, catching the eye the moment you saw it—it was no cheap item.

Especially the black steeds pulling it; their muscles were plainly visible, suggesting they were far from ordinary breeds.

Cecilia still cared deeply about her dignity, and she had strict demands for everything she used.

As the daughter of Duke Rose, how could she ever settle for a dilapidated carriage?

She had to make it immediately obvious to anyone that Cecilia was nobility. Otherwise, she wouldn't feel the sense of superiority.

Alice led Sherry out, a faint dark circle under her eyes, as if she hadn't slept well the night before.

Sherry wore a cloak, hiding her pointed elf ears to avoid unnecessary trouble.

Seeing Alice's slightly fatigued expression beside her, she couldn't help but feel guilty.

"I... I'm sorry, Lady Alice. I was too excited last night and didn't consider your feelings."

"It's fine~" Alice waved her hand and smiled. "Aren't you going home? It's normal to be excited. You've been wandering outside for so long. I'm happy for you."

"...Thank you, Lady Alice." Sherry blushed and lowered her head, thinking that Lady Alice was such a kind person. Among all the humans she had met, only Lady Alice was truly trustworthy. That kindness was simply angelic.

"I've enjoyed living with you for a while. Now that you're leaving suddenly, I'm finding it hard to adjust." Alice thought for a moment and said helplessly, "I'm a little reluctant to see you go..."

"...I'm... a little reluctant too."

Sherry's expression turned wistful, and she hurriedly stammered, "But I must go back. Father hasn't seen me in a long time. He might have worried himself into a few white hairs. After I return, I'll just have to think of you from time to time, Lady Alice."

"Alright, let's go. Family is obviously more important, right?" Alice patted Sherry's waist, as if cheering her on.

"..." Sherry awkwardly lowered her head, tugged at her cloak, and walked toward the carriage.

Cecilia waited inside the carriage, while Kyle stood outside to receive them. Seeing the two girls, he politely bowed.

"Good morning, my ladies."

"Good morning." Alice nodded and glanced at Kyle. Seeing him in high spirits this morning despite getting beaten to a pulp by Lord Merlin the day before, she was somewhat relieved.

"...." Sherry murmured timidly, her voice like a mosquito—barely audible unless you listened carefully.

"Why does this lady wear a cloak? Are you afraid of sunlight?" Kyle asked, puzzled.

Hearing herself addressed, Sherry immediately shrank in fear behind Alice, barely daring to breathe.

"Sherry is an elf and a bit shy. Covering up like this helps avoid some trouble." Alice explained simply.

"I see. Please forgive my rashness..." Kyle expressed his apology. He thought that elves were very rare in human kingdoms and would easily attract crowds whenever something happened, so it was better to stay low-key. He stepped aside. "My ladies, please board the carriage."

Alice and Sherry boarded the carriage one after another, and then Merlin finally emerged with a slow, sluggish pace, covering his mouth with his hand as he yawned.

"Ohhhhhhhh..."

Merlin had slept well yesterday; he was just too lazy to get moving.

If he hadn't almost been late, he never would have come out at all.

Seeing Merlin, Kyle was reminded of everything that had happened the day before, and a sudden wave of deep respect overwhelmed him.

A feeling of awe and reverence rose within his heart...

Kyle tensed up, standing like an honor guard soldier receiving inspection, and made a respectful gesture.

"Lord Merlin, please hurry and board the carriage. We will depart shortly."

"Huh!" Merlin furrowed his brow, deeply uncomfortable with Kyle's attitude, thinking awkwardly—

Are you kidding me?

Why does everyone keep calling me "Lord Merlin"?

All these "my lords" are making me super awkward!

I'd rather people call me Rubbish Black Iron Villager—that's easier to accept.

Damn it, I feel like my swagger passive skill just leveled up again!
