Samuel was slightly displeased by Merlin's casual attitude, a trace of pride flashing in his eyes as he replied, "Of course he was powerful. Aethelwood was a natural genius who could wield the power of the Elf God Corelon. Mortals simply couldn't even imagine..."

"Wielding... a god's power?" Merlin frowned, wondering what level this was at. Was it, like the "Legendary Spear Hero," already beyond Saint-tier? !

"Yes, that's a genuine divine power. Apart from Aethelwood, I've never seen anyone else capable of using it." Samuel's eyes were full of longing, his tone inevitably revealing a streak of worship. "If he hadn't been assassinated by the Elf King, Aethelwood would have easily been called the strongest in the world. He was simply the reincarnation of the Elf God Corelon, the only living god..."

Merlin said nothing but furrowed his brows, thinking—

This guy seems to highly revere the Dark Elf King, doesn't he?

Weren't he considered a taboo of the elven race?

She certainly doesn't show any signs of that...

After finishing the meal.

Alice and Merlin bid farewell to Shirley.

They planned to go back and get straight to work on Cecillia's matter. =二

Before leaving, Shirley and Alice embraced each other.

She seemed somewhat reluctant to part. Shirley, this gentle and soft-spoken girl, had red-rimmed eyes, barely holding back her sorrow at parting.

Alice was also affected by the atmosphere, her little nose tingling with a sour feeling.

After all, she had stayed there for a while, experienced many interesting things, and there was already a bond between the two girls.

Alice felt that Shirley had always liked to stay close to her, seeking that sliver of security, just like a child afraid of being abandoned.

This feeling of being relied upon was gradually becoming something Alice was accustomed to.

But now, this elven girl who had suffered so much outside had finally found her way home. Even though she knew this was a good thing, Alice still felt a touch of sadness.

Shirley's gratitude toward Alice and Merlin went without saying. She knew their parting was temporary and they might meet again in the future. She also urged Alice to visit the Southern United Kingdom someday if she had the chance.

The two girls exchanged blessings, each telling the other to take care, and said their goodbyes....

In the embassy study.

Samuel watched with a flat expression as Merlin and Alice's figures disappeared into the distance, then slowly lowered the curtain he had lifted.

He turned to look at Sharron and Sharon, both kneeling on one knee before him. Their expressions were serious, as if waiting for Samuel to issue his orders.

"These two dogs must be eliminated. Before the Elven Lament grand magic阵 is activated, no one can know that Princess Shirley has returned to us. We must make them shut up forever..." Samuel said in a commanding tone.

"Lord Samuel, are you ordering us to kill those two scum?" Sharron narrowed his eyes; he had absolutely no hesitation when it came to killing.

"Sharron, no need for you to lay a finger on them. Leave it to me..." Sharon lightly stroked her cheek, a痴迷 and excited smile spreading across her face.

"I love watching weak creatures struggle desperately in the vortex of darkness.

"Their bodies slowly eroded and rotting away, bones turning to pus, accompanied by ear-pleasing screams.

"Ahh~●"

"Absolutely wonderful. What a exquisite thing, isn't it?"

0(////*1*

title: Chapter 11 — Bonus Update for Monthly Tickets
content:
Chapter 11 — Bonus Update for Monthly Tickets

Volume 7 · Chapter 11

......

Shapuren didn't speak, but instead looked at Shalan with a complex expression as she was in an excited state.

No matter how many times he saw it, Shapuren found it difficult to accept Shalan's eccentricities, which were essentially those of a sadistic person who didn't care about anything.

Even Shalan's specialty, dark magic, was full of sadistic attributes, slowly corroding enemies and letting them die in endless pain.

Shapuren thought that humiliating opponents was meaningless; as a warrior, he respected the way of martial arts and considered respecting one's enemies to be a basic principle.

Moreover, the black elf combat technique that Shapuren specialized in was known for its sinister and ruthless tactics, and he rarely encountered opponents, which gave him a lot of pride.

Samuel looked at his two black elf subordinates, shook his head silently, and said淡淡, "This operation doesn't require your participation."

“Eh?!” Shapuren was taken aback and asked curiously, “Samuel, why not give us the task? Are we not worthy of your trust?”

“Yes, Samuel, killing these two weak adventurers can be left to me, it's enough. Seeing this pair of lovebirds being affectionate makes me even more eager to torture them to death...” Shalan said excitedly, her enthusiasm not suitable for the FFF team, and it seemed like she wouldn't be comfortable unless she broke up the couple.

"I've already said that this doesn't require your help; a high-ranking magician and a useless villager, do you two Saint-tier strong warriors really need to lower yourselves to deal with them?" Samuel said with a smile.

“.....

Shapuren hesitated, and Shalan beside him didn't speak either; the two of them seemed to have high loyalty to Samuel and wanted to help her with her worries.

"Letting you deal with two weak people would be a waste of your talent, it's simply an insult to you; you're strong enough to match the Thorn Knight, and you don't need to do such trivial things. Do you understand what I mean?" Samuel said seriously.

If Saint-tier strong warriors who could match the Thorn Knight were to deal with a high-ranking magician and a villainer, it would indeed be a bit laughable.

“Understood!”

Shapuren and Shalan nodded in unison, understanding Samuel's meaning.

"Moreover, you two have more important things to do now; check the large magic array of the elves' sorrowful cry in this period, don't miss any magic points around, and ensure that the plan to revive Archduke Ashidore is foolproof..." Samuel said in a commanding tone.

"Yes, sir!"

Shalan and Shapuren responded loudly and bowed their heads humbly, looking very serious.

"As for those two garbage adventurers...” Samuel pondered for a moment, and a playful smile appeared on his lips.

"Leave them to the dark elf assassination team."

title: Chapter 12
content:
Chapter 12

Volume 7 · Chapter 12

Alice couldn't help but let her thoughts wander again, her mind filled with Merlin's good qualities.

After much deliberation, Alice came to the conclusion that Merlin was a marriage-worthy man.

Although Merlin had many flaws, when weighed together with his strengths, he was actually pretty good...

What the hell! What am I even thinking! Has my brain already broken? Why am I suddenly remembering how good Merlin is every now and then!

I'm supposed to like Earl Kin the Great Sword Champion, not this guy Merlin!

If I'm already judging Merlin as a great marriage prospect, how far am I from changing my heart?

Please don't! Be normal! I'm not the kind of flighty girl who easily changes her mind!

Merlin the Great Demon Lord is the embodiment of evil; I must firmly resist this guy...

Alice's face darkened as she covered her aching forehead, feeling like she wasn't acting normally today, as if Merlin had mentally polluted her.

Merlin turned to look at the strangely behaving Alice and thought, This ironing board is getting weirder by the moment. Did I accidentally provoke some kind of trouble? Sigh, I feel inexplicably irritated...

Actually, Alice also felt somewhat lost right now. Who did she like?

Her conscious mind told Alice that she liked Earl Kin the Great Sword Champion.

But her subconscious kept hinting that Merlin was actually the one she could rely on more.

Merlin was the Great Demon Lord, after all. They came from different paths entirely. How long could he stay by her side?

Alice wrestled with these thoughts inside her heart for a long time but couldn't reach any satisfactory conclusion, so she decisively pushed them aside.

To break the awkward atmosphere, Alice changed the subject and asked—

"Merlin, you've been separated from your sister for so long, don't you feel sad?"

"..." Merlin chuckled faintly and said, "Sad my ass. I'm super happy!"

"Eh!? Why?" Alice found Merlin's words hard to understand. Wasn't parting from family a sad thing? For instance, when she separated from her teacher, she found herself missing her from time to time.

"That kid Lilith..." A cold sweat dripped down Merlin's forehead as he said awkwardly, "She's way too clingy. Honestly, she's even more troublesome than you. I have to take care of her for everything."

"Don't—don't drag me into this! How am I troublesome!?" Alice bit her lip and demanded, clearly dissatisfied, as if she were some kind of parasite.

Merlin gave Alice a meaningful look and silently sighed in his heart.

This guy really has no self-awareness. Doesn't she have the slightest clue how troublesome she is?

Merlin withdrew his gaze and decided to leave Alice a shred of face.

"I'm just using her as an example. My sister is indeed annoying. She's always clinging to me, giving me not a single bit of private space."

"Isn't that lovely?" Alice actually liked the idea of having such a sister. Especially the feeling of being relied upon—it was quite comfortable.

However, thinking about Merlin's sister Lilith still made people feel somewhat ill.

Always talking about her brother—that seemed abnormal, didn't it?

Alice recalled that obsession-filled gaze and felt a shiver run down her spine.

"Lovable my ass!?" Merlin frowned and emphasized seriously, "My dream is to slack off and drift through life, not to be anyone's sister's babysitter."

"But you're the older brother. Taking care of your sister is your duty—"

"We demons don't operate on that system," Merlin said sternly. "All demons must learn to be independent once they come of age. Even among family members, there's no reason why one must be taken care of." He thought that in the demon race, emotional indifference was a very common thing. A brother like him, allowing his sister to cling to him constantly, was already considered a freak.

"You demons really are heartless..." Alice remarked with furrowed brows.

"It's quite... normal..." Merlin shrugged and continued, "Moreover, my sister has issues in the head. Behind my back, she does things that give me headaches."

"Hm? What things?" Alice asked curiously.

"This girl drives away every woman who gets close to me and only leaves me with these problem children that I don't like..." Merlin said with a helpless expression.

Lilith always thought her brother didn't know about her secret schemes, but Merlin understood everything she did behind his back—he just couldn't be bothered to settle scores with his sister.

"Urgh! No way!?" Alice was horrified, her eyes wide as walnuts, her heart shuddering uncontrollably.

"That's not even the worst of it. At first, there was a little maid around me, a very gentle woman, and I quite liked her. Then she suddenly disappeared. Before long, my sister gave me a wine goblet made from her skull as a gift. At that moment, my feelings were like a million sand horses stampeding through my heart—I was completely speechless." Merlin sighed, his expression extremely complicated. These matters made him feel so exasperated.

But Merlin wasn't angry, because that was the nature of the demon race—the strong devour the weak.

If you were weak, being eaten was nothing to complain about. Such things were commonplace.

"What a cruel creature your sister is!?" Alice's face went pale, unable to imagine such things. It felt like Merlin's sister had already reached the level of severe mental illness.

Merlin didn't respond. Admittedly, Lilith was a cruel little devil, but this was common in the demon race.

At first, Merlin thought his sister was merely short-tempered, but later he discovered she was actually a control freak with extremely strong possessiveness.

This gave Merlin a terrible headache and only made him want to avoid Lilith more.

"...Could this be the reason you've been single for over 200 years!?" Alice seemed to have thought of something and asked tentatively.

"I guess so. At first, I also liked girls with slender waists and long legs. But after my sister turned everyone around me into problem children, I lost the desire to date. Until now, I've become completely numb. Heh..." Merlin gave a wretched smile, full of bitterness.

Alice pressed her lips tightly together, unable to say a word. She had thought having a sister would be wonderful, never imagining Merlin would be so unlucky!

"Coughhhhhhhhhh!

A cry of pain rang out from nowhere. A burly, muscular brute came flying over, his arm seemingly dislocated and swollen.

The big man, wearing only a tank top, landed directly in front of Merlin and Alice. His face was twisted in agony as he clutched his arm and gritted his teeth in pain.

"Damn it! What kind of crazy strength is this!?! This is absurd..."

Merlin and Alice looked around in surprise and curiosity.

They saw a lively marketplace with an arm-wrestling ring surrounded by crowds three layers deep.

Hanging at the front was a sign displaying the game rules: one hundred gold coins for one play, and the winner received a prize of two thousand gold coins.

At this moment, a man with pink hair and a masked face slowly stood up in front of the ring. He looked like the reigning champion of the game.

Although the muscles on his body weren't exaggerated, they were well-defined.

That he could dislocate the arm of a brute so much larger than him was indeed quite unbelievable.

Amateurs couldn't tell much, but Merlin could sense this person's strength was no small feat.

Physical strength had nothing to do with body size. Some skinny old men still possessed astonishing power.

The pink-haired masked man extended a single finger, his expression arrogant, grinning as he said—

"Next!"

"Is there no stronger person among you all?"

title: Chapter 13
content:
Chapter 13

Volume 7 · Chapter 13

The masked man's arrogant shouts were quite striking, his refreshing short pink hair particularly eye-catching.

Although he was yelling at all the onlookers around him, there was no sense of malice behind it. It seemed he simply wanted to have a bit more fun.

"This..." Alice narrowed her eyes and stared at the pink-haired masked man, saying in surprise, "He seems to be deliberately hiding his strength, not letting his natural aura release itself. Really suspicious."

"You actually noticed that too?" Merlin was slightly surprised, not having expected Alice to be able to detect it.

This pink-haired masked man hid himself very well. Under normal circumstances, it was difficult to discover his true strength, giving people the illusion of an ordinary person. In this regard, he seemed remarkably similar to Merlin.

However, under any circumstances, it was nearly impossible to achieve 100% concealment of one's aura. Unless using some special methods or props, some power would always leak out and be detected by others.

Merlin, on the other hand, was completely different from the pink-haired masked man. There was no possibility of exposure at all, simply because he lacked mana and fighting spirit entirely. His aura was fundamentally nonexistent.

"Why can't I notice it? Don't look down on me..." Alice pouted indignantly, glaring resentfully at Merlin.

"I'm not looking down on you."

Merlin smiled and didn't say more, thinking to himself that the inheritance crystal had truly boosted Alice's strength considerably. She could actually tell that the pink-haired masked man was deliberately hiding his power. Under normal circumstances, he himself wouldn't be able to see through it unless he took things seriously.

For Alice to notice the other party's concealment with merely high-tier strength was already quite impressive.

"By the way, how did you figure it out?"

"I don't know either. I just feel like my senses have become much sharper than before..." Alice answered in surprise.

Merlin didn't speak, stroking his chin and thinking it must be the power of the dragon bloodline. As an extremely superior creature, having super sharp perception was not surprising at all.

Over by the arena, the pink-haired masked man kept shouting, hoping someone would come challenge him to an arm wrestling match.

"Hey, hey, hey! Someone come already! Has no real courage existed anymore?"

The onlooking crowd stared at each other in confusion. No one stepped forward, instead whispering quietly among themselves.

"He probably can't win, right? That guy earlier was a mid-tier warrior with considerable strength, and his arm was dislocated right from the start."

"Yeah, even though he looks small in build, his strength is no joke. He completely pinned down a high-tier warrior. Winning against him will be rather difficult, I guess."

"Could this stall guy actually be a Saint-tier expert?"

"What are you dreaming about?! Do you think Saint-tier experts are as common as dirt? There aren't even that many in all of London. He doesn't seem to carry any imposing aura either. I guess he's only high-tier at best."

London citizens speculated among themselves, and no one stepped forward to accept the challenge. Regarding this masked mysterious figure, it seemed everyone had great interest.

"Can you guys stop being such cowards? This is boring..." The pink-haired masked man shrugged, putting on an extremely bored expression. "Just win an arm wrestling match against me, and you'll get 2000 gold coins. Aren't you tempted at all?"

Even though the pink-haired guy repeatedly goaded the crowd with words, still no one stepped forward to accept the challenge.

An arm wrestling match for 2000 gold coins was tempting for most people.

Although it sounded easy, you needed actual strength to claim the reward.

Think about that mid-tier warrior earlier, rushing up enthusiastically to compete, only to be instantly defeated and forced out with injuries. Who would still dare to casually challenge? Anyone without at least high-tier strength would be throwing their life away going up there.

"You guys are truly boring."

The pink-haired masked man sighed, looking extremely disappointed. He had no choice but to resort to psychological provocation to stir up the crowd. "Are you really all men? If you think you're real men, you should boldly walk up to me and challenge me courageously!"

Merlin smirked, unable to help thinking that this mysterious fellow was quite interesting. Just how confident was he in his physical strength? He had to admit, the guy was truly a naive fool...

The onlooking crowd remained unmoved. The sight of that mid-tier warrior's arm being snapped earlier had left many feeling lingering fear, worried they too might get injured if they tried.

The people now gathered here just wanted to watch the spectacle. If by chance some more foolish souls stepped forward to challenge, it would indeed be rather entertaining to watch.

The pink-haired masked man saw no brave souls stepping forward and couldn't help but show a frustrated expression. He then turned around and silently began packing up his arm wrestling stall, seemingly intending to leave.

"I came out only once, thinking London was full of hidden dragons and tigers, expecting to meet some formidable opponents. Instead, they're all cowards. So boring."

The pink-haired masked man muttered unceremoniously, giving off a deeply dejected feeling, as though unsatisfied and gradually growing restless.

"Wait!" Merlin suddenly called out, stopping the departing pink-haired masked man.

At first, the pink-haired masked man was somewhat delighted, thinking someone wanted to come compete with him.

But upon seeing the black iron Adventurer Guild identification around Merlin's neck, his interest instantly vanished, becoming even more disappointed than before.

A mere black iron adventurer wanted to challenge himself? Was this a joke? He couldn't muster the slightest interest either.

The pink-haired masked man waved his hand dismissively, not even looking at Merlin properly. He didn't consider him a worthy opponent, classifying him among the weak.

"What do you want? If you're here to challenge me, forget it. You've already seen that mid-tier warrior's miserable state. If you insist on stepping forward, your ending will be far worse than his."

"Hah..." Merlin gave a dry laugh, saying nothing more in explanation, because proving through实力 spoke louder than words.

Seeing Merlin's grinning demeanor, the pink-haired masked man assumed he was ignoring the warning, so his expression turned serious as he said, "It seems you still haven't grasped the situation. Simply put, I just don't take you seriously. You don't have the qualification to compete alongside me. Black iron adventurers are all low-tier at best, right? That mid-tier warrior was instantly defeated by me. What capital do you have to challenge me?"

Not only did the pink-haired masked man think so, but even the surrounding onlookers felt Merlin was digging his own grave.

Someone who was at the lowest rank of black iron adventurer dared to challenge another person. Aside from overestimating himself, there was hardly a better descriptor to be found.

Facing the rising waves of doubt from those around him, Merlin was just about to say something when Alice pulled him aside.

"Hey! What are you doing? Don't go causing trouble randomly in London, just for fun."

"What are you talking about? Not earning money would make a fool of oneself. Do you think I'd lose?" Merlin frowned.

"Uh..." Alice was speechless. She thought about it — how could Merlin possibly lose? Even if the opponent was hiding his strength, it was impossible for him to defeat Merlin, the ultimate cheat user!

"Cut the nonsense. Now is the time I need you..." Merlin rubbed his fingers toward Alice with a significant look. "Hurry up and sponsor me 100 gold coins for the entry fee. Half the prize money is mine after I win, and I'll also teach this pink-haired guy a lesson..."

Hearing this, Alice quickly pulled out a hundred gold coins from her wallet like lightning and forcefully pressed them into Merlin's hand, gripping them tight for him.

The entire action was executed without the slightest hesitation, her eyes sparkling with stars, full of anticipation.

"Merlin, go for it! I believe in you~!"

Merlin looked at Alice expressionlessly, a bead of cold sweat slowly trickling down his forehead, thinking to himself:

This brat, usually as stingy as an iron rooster.

Today was the first time she handed over money so readily. It was rather surprising...

(I've arrived home already. I'll rest well tonight and resume the grueling update schedule starting tomorrow.)

title: Chapter 14
content:
Chapter 14

Volume 7 · Chapter 14

The onlookers saw that Alice was a Golden Adventurer and quickly changed their conversation, whispering to each other.

"That Golden Adventurer seems to be his wife, right?"

"It seems that way, but isn't he just freeloading off her?"

"Well, it does look like he's freeloading, but maybe she's just sparring with someone?"

The unaware citizens of Rondo pointed and whispered to Merlin, assuming Alice was the one who had come to challenge the powder-haired masked man, and they thought Merlin was just a weak, dependent husband.

The powder-haired masked man stroked his chin, looking surprised, and thought that the woman was the one who was going to spar with him, a Golden Adventurer, which seemed much stronger than his Black Iron rank. However, he didn't mind playing along.

Merlin picked up 100 gold coins and walked up to the powder-haired masked man, smiling and saying, "Shall we start here?"

As soon as he spoke, the crowd watching the commotion erupted into a surprised murmur, thinking they must have misheard.

"Is this guy for real? This Black Iron Adventurer is actually going to challenge him?"

"Of course, he's not even as strong as his wife, what's he trying to do?"

"A mid-tier warrior was defeated instantly, and now a Black Iron Adventurer is stepping up, it's like he's asking to be humiliated. I think his wife has a better chance of winning."

Everyone discussed it enthusiastically, treating Merlin like a fool, and wondering why Alice wasn't the one challenging the powder-haired masked man.

Alice didn't pay attention to the doubts of those around her, her eyes shining with excitement, thinking that with Merlin stepping up, she was 2000 gold coins richer.

Because she had tasted the sweetness before, Alice raised her small fist and, for the first time, cheered for Merlin.

"Merlin, go! I believe in you!"

"Ah?!" Merlin turned back in surprise and said nonchalantly, "Do you need to cheer me on? Just don't interfere with me, thank you."

"Ugh, what do you take me for?! You混蛋!" Alice's face turned red with anger, and she said, "I was just trying to help you, and you're so ungrateful!"

Merlin didn't respond to Alice, instead saying to the powder-haired masked man, "How about it? Are you ready to start?"

The powder-haired masked man recovered from his shock, grinned, and said, "Did I really hear that? You want to spar with me?"

"Is that a problem?" Merlin shrugged, looking relaxed.

"I said all that, and you still didn't understand the situation?" The powder-haired masked man seemed a bit helpless and continued, "Your strength is too weak, and fighting you doesn't bring me any joy or excitement. In simple terms, you're on a completely different level than me, so how can we have a fair fight?"

Merlin chuckled and said, "You're quite confident in yourself, aren't you?"

"It's not confidence; it's that you're so weak I'm almost pitying you..." The powder-haired masked man approached Merlin, lowered his voice, and said, "Your wife is behind you, right? She's a beautiful woman. I understand that you want to show off in front of her, but it makes you look pitiful."

"Because of your weakness, you have to brush up your presence in this situation, and in the end, you're still a miserable and pitiful guy. Now, I'm willing to let you off once, just leave with a smile, and you can still protect your last bit of dignity in front of your wife."

Merlin didn't bother to correct the misunderstanding about Alice being his wife and simply looked at the powder-haired masked man.

For a moment, it was hard to tell if he was humiliating himself or genuinely trying to give him a way out.

However, Merlin was clear about one thing: he was starting to feel a bit annoyed.

"Your words are too much..." Merlin threw the 100 gold coins in his bag to the powder-haired masked man and said, "Thanks for your kindness, but I don't need it. The game doesn't restrict strength ranks, does it? Then you have no reason to refuse me."

The powder-haired masked man stared at the small bag of gold coins in his hand, a flash of surprise in his eyes, thinking that this man was being foolish, not taking his kindness and instead wanting to face defeat.

"Come on." Merlin put his wrist on the stone table, waiting for the contest to begin.

"You really are foolish..." The powder-haired masked man looked at Merlin, smiling playfully and said, "Let's get one thing straight: if you get seriously injured, I won't pay for your medical bills."

"Not necessary," Merlin sighed and said impatiently, "The game hasn't started yet, don't think you've won. Life is full of surprises; I might give you a shock that makes you question everything."

"Give me a shock? You're not qualified." The powder-haired masked man put his wrist on the stone table, grasping Merlin's hand and said, "Don't worry, you won't die, you'll just be bedridden for half a year, and..."

Merlin smiled and didn't speak, thinking that this guy seemed to be a fighter, with thick calluses on his hands, which was why he was so confident in his physical strength. However, in front of him, it was just that and nothing more.

Many of the London citizens began to silently mourn for Merlin, showing sympathy.

The mid-tier warrior had dislocated his arm; how many bones would this stranger break?

Although the match hadn't started yet, except for Alice, no one seemed to think Merlin had a chance, and they all assumed he would lose miserably.

The powder-haired masked man took out a gold coin, looked into Merlin's eyes, and said, "Let's begin."

As soon as he spoke, the powder-haired masked man threw the gold coin high into the air.

Merlin glanced at the coin in mid-air and, without needing to be told, knew that when it landed, the match would start. The powder-haired masked man suddenly exerted force, unleashing a fierce gust of wind that made the onlookers take a step back.

However, Merlin's face was still smiling, and his wrist on the stone table didn't move at all.

The powder-haired masked man widened his eyes slightly, feeling a bit surprised.

Normally, his strength would be enough to make a low-ranking novice's arm fracture and fly out.

But Merlin not only didn't get injured but also blocked the force effortlessly, his wrist still motionless!

The two men's arms, tightly gripping each other, trembled slightly on the stone table, but neither could gain the upper hand.

"Is this your strength? Don't hold back; it's not interesting this way," Merlin said lightly, a hint of disdain in his eyes.

"Looks like you're also holding back," the powder-haired masked man said, his expression turning serious. "I take back what I said earlier; you seem to have the qualification to make me take you seriously. You're the first man to make me do so..."

"Is that so? Then let's see..." Merlin raised an eyebrow, his expression still relaxed.

"Cheering for the opponent? You're quite interesting."

The powder-haired masked man seemed to get angry, feeling that Merlin was belittling him.

So, he used his full strength without holding back, planning to crush Merlin with his power!

A golden aura suddenly burst out from the powder-haired masked man's body, rising like flames.

"I acknowledge you have some strength, but it's time to end this!"

title: Chapter 15 — Bonus Update with Monthly Tickets (Next Chapter Before 1 AM)
content:
Chapter 15 — Bonus Update with Monthly Tickets (Next Chapter Before 1 AM)

Volume 7 · Chapter 15

The golden battle aura on the pink-haired masked man surged up fiercely, the explosive pressure radiating from him so distinctly frightening that it sent tremors through everyone nearby.

"Saint-tier!?"

Alice's eyes widened. That ferocious pressure meant his strength was no joke at all.

A Saint-tier powerhouse running an arm-wrestling stall at the market, of all things... it was genuinely hard to understand.

Alice was taken aback by the pink-haired masked man's display of strength and watched the contest of power with rapt attention.

She wasn't the only one surprised—London's citizens present there were even more stunned.

Though London was a core city, Saint-tier experts were few and far between, and many began to speculate about the masked man's true identity.

"He's been running a stall here for three years, even if only appearing occasionally—turns out he's a Saint-tier expert!?"

"Who exactly is he?! Someone with Saint-tier power would never be an unknown in London!"

"If he's being taken seriously by a Saint-tier expert, then this black-iron adventurer can't be weak either!"

Many in the crowd heatedly discussed what was happening, sensing both competitors were holding back—that made this all the more entertaining to watch.

Their wrists gripped each other tightly on the stone table, exchanging raw force, and the entire stone surface began to shake.

The pink-haired masked man's golden battle aura erupted wildly, his Saint-tier pressure climbing steadily higher—and it seemed he still had reserves left.

"Ah, so you really are a Saint-tier expert..." Merlin gave a calm smile. He had sensed it from the very beginning, so he wasn't the least bit surprised.

"You don't seem the least bit nervous. Do you really have full confidence that you can defeat me even now that you've seen my true strength?" The pink-haired masked man narrowed his eyes, finding Merlin an utterly enigmatic person.

"You're quite clever..." Merlin quirked a corner of his mouth, feeling zero pressure. Among all the enemies he had ever faced, this masked man was merely average.

"You're only growing more and more interesting to me. Aside from the First Knight of Thorns, I wouldn't say I'd necessarily lose to anyone in a contest of pure strength. Let's decide this right now!" The pink-haired masked man's gaze hardened, unleashing all of his Saint-tier power without reservation.

"Hm?" Merlin frowned, recalling the woman named Mestfield—the First Knight of Thorns—who had publicly vowed to capture him on camera...

The situation was too urgent for Merlin to dwell on those thoughts any longer.

Because the pink-haired masked man, operating at full power, was already overwhelming Merlin's wrist.

Although Merlin wasn't taking this seriously, losing in such a public setting would be incredibly embarrassing.

So Merlin gathered a bit more focus to face his opponent, a mocking smile still playing on his lips.

Golden battle aura began spreading outward from Merlin. The pink-haired masked man's eyes bulged and his teeth ground together.

Veins swelled and bulged along his arms, writhing like a dense cluster of snakes!

Clearly, the pink-haired masked man had gone all out—yet facing Merlin, this monster, made everything feel impossibly exhausting.

Meanwhile, Merlin remained casually smirking, as though he hadn't even begun using his full strength, with an expression like he was picking on a kindergarten child.

A single cold bead of sweat traced down the masked man's forehead. What the hell! This is too strange! I'm already using Saint-tier power and I still can't budge his wrist!? Have I completely misjudged this man's strength!? He's nothing but a black-iron adventurer!!!

"Still holding something back? If you don't use your true strength, you'll never defeat me. Oh, wait—actually..." Merlin thought for a moment and teased, "Even if you do use your true strength, you still won't be able to defeat me~"

"Uh!" A flash of bewilderment crossed the pink-haired masked man's eyes before pure rage took over, and he screamed inwardly:

You damn bastard! Don't look down on people like that!!!

The pink-haired masked man's Saint-tier golden battle aura erupted again, fierce and unstoppable like a tiger descending a mountain, whipping up violent, blade-edged winds around him!

The stone table was on the verge of collapse, looking as though it would shatter at any moment under the contest's strain.

The ground began to crack, making a crisp "kacha" sound, the fissures slowly spreading outward in all directions.

Broken stones swept along with the vicious gales, striking at the surrounding crowd and forcing spectators to retreat repeatedly, unable to even keep their eyes open.

The clash of power between the two was nothing short of fierce—they had seemingly entered a white-hot stage of combat.

Well, only the pink-haired masked man felt the atmosphere reaching such intensity. Merlin remained his usual condescending self.

Alice knitted her brows and shielded her eyes with her hand, barely able to make out the situation at center stage.

Oh my god! Are you kidding me!?

It's just a normal arm-wrestling match!

Do it have to be this absurd!?!

Are they trying to demolish all of London!?!

Still... this masked man is incredibly strong...

A single bead of cold sweat trickled down Alice's forehead. She had never witnessed such an exaggerated arm-wrestling match before—it was nowhere near the level of a casual game!

The two competitors' power collided, neither gaining the upper hand for the time being—

The pink-haired masked man locked eyes with Merlin, nearly grinding his teeth to dust as he steeled his resolve for a final push.

"Ohhhhhhhhhhh!"

The pink-haired masked man exerted his full strength at last, his entire skin flushing a fiery red, and the veins on his arms stood out horrifically.

Merlin's wrist was suppressed almost instantly, falling just two fingers' width away from defeat!

Alice's gaze went blank, an uncontrollable shudder coursing through her chest. No way! Would Merlin the monster actually lose to someone!?!

At last, a trace of triumphant smugness broke across the pink-haired masked man's face. I've won!

"Do you think you've won?"

Merlin's voice drifted over in a nonchalant tone, causing the pink-haired masked man to look up in shock.

"As I said, life is full of surprises. The real game ends now!"

Merlin countered and seized the initiative, forcefully pinning his opponent's wrist. Crushing power detonated explosively, sweeping through like a reaper through withered grass.

Magic immunity was already absurdly overpowered—but physical strength was Merlin's equally praiseworthy forte!

"BOOM--!"

A thunderous explosion erupted. The stone table, unable to bear the strain any longer, collapsed in an instant. Shattered fragments of rock and earth flew skyward, sending thick clouds of dust billowing outward!

Such a tremendous commotion resembled a rampaging magical beast, leaving the scene in absolute chaos. Even the entire royal capital could likely see it.

Alice had to cover her face with her hands. Debris whizzed past like throwing knives, and she thought: Merlin, this guy is so reckless! Causing a scene like this will attract the Purple Gold Flower Knight Order that guards the capital!

As the dust settled, the result became clear—

Merlin held the pink-haired masked man's wrist pinned forcefully to the ground. The match was over!

Alice wasn't surprised by this outcome, but she worried about what would happen next.

However, the gathered onlookers were anything but calm. The result before their eyes left them utterly stunned, their eyeballs nearly popping out of their sockets—

"A Saint-tier expert actually lost! How is that possible!?"

"The opponent is just a black-iron adventurer! This is insane! ! !"

"What on earth is going on?! Are black-iron adventurers this strong now!?"

title: Chapter 16 — Extra Chapter for Monthly Tickets
content:
Chapter 16 — Extra Chapter for Monthly Tickets

Volume 7 · Chapter 16

London citizens expressed that they no longer understood the power hierarchy.

By all logic, Iron-rank adventurers were low-tier, yet Merlin in front of them was suppressing a Saint-tier powerhouse! ?

This result was unacceptable to many, and they couldn't help but whisper among themselves.

Many believed Merlin was also a Saint-tier expert who was concealing his true strength, otherwise how could he possibly suppress the pink-haired masked man?

However, the fact that Merlin, as a Saint-tier expert, was carrying an Iron-rank adventurer certificate still left people bewildered.

Because the treatment for Mithril and Iron ranks differed greatly; their reputations were on entirely different levels and incomparable.

Ordinarily, Saint-tier experts were all Mithril-rank adventurers. Merlin was something of an oddity even among such oddities.

Merlin released the pink-haired masked man's wrist and rubbed his own neck. "Looks like I won."

The pink-haired masked man looked at his wrist from their earlier struggle and said blankly, "I actually lost..."

Looking back, he still felt utterly bewildered.

He had nearly been winning, yet the power Merlin unleashed at the end was simply unstoppable!

This was a crushing victory with no tricks or excuses — he genuinely couldn't match this Iron-rank adventurer.

The pink-haired masked man found it hard to accept, and in that instant, he understood what was going on.

Merlin hadn't been serious from the start and had been holding back throughout their contest.

But the moment Merlin got serious, it resulted in his complete and utter defeat.

The pink-haired masked man sighed deeply and began to question his entire life. He had lost to an Iron-rank adventurer. If this got out, wouldn't it become an indelible black history?

"I told you from the start that I'd give you a little surprise," Merlin said with a calm smile, his smugness utterly unhidden in his eyes.

"What a wonderful surprise. My heart still isn't at peace. I never expected to actually lose, haha..." The pink-haired masked man laughed continuously while holding his forehead. "I never thought someone other than the First Knight of Thorns would ever beat me at arm wrestling."

Merlin didn't speak, instead wondering inwardly whether the First Female Knight was really that formidable. Why did so many people praise her? If she were to face him, he reckoned a single burst of saliva would make her so delighted she couldn't breathe...

The pink-haired masked man took a deep breath and managed to calm his emotions somewhat.

He had no intention of making trouble. He had lost, and he would accept it openly.

"Speaking of which, you're incredibly strong. You may be an Iron-rank adventurer, but your power truly surprises me."

"Adventurer ranks are just empty titles. I don't care about them," Merlin answered with a morally upright expression, thinking inwardly: Do you think I don't want a higher rank?! Who told the Adventurers Guild to only evaluate based on magical power and aura intensity! Damn it!

"You're right. No wonder someone as strong as you is still an Iron-rank adventurer — you've long stopped caring about empty titles. There really are people like you..." The pink-haired masked man nodded, appearing to deeply understand Merlin's words. "Actually, you're Saint-tier, aren't you? With that kind of power, you're certainly no ordinary person..."

"I decline to answer," Merlin shook his head, putting on an aloof expression. Inwardly: Saint-tier my foot. I'm just a villager. I don't even have a rank.

"Don't deny it. You're definitely Saint-tier, but how did you manage to completely conceal your strength?" The pink-haired masked man seemed very interested in Merlin and continued asking. "Frankly, I've been deliberately suppressing my own pressure to appear like an ordinary person, but your method seems far superior. From start to finish, I never sensed any magical power or aura from you. It's too strange..."

"This..." Merlin hesitated, thinking he had no magical power or aura to conceal in the first place, so he said mysteriously, "This is my secret. I can't share it."

"I've been disrespectful. I shouldn't have asked so casually. Merlin Lucipher..." The pink-haired masked man carefully examined Merlin's adventurer certificate. "Hmm. I'll remember your name forever. You are among the few men I can recognize. Looks like Rexem has produced another talent. Though you're called Cross-Eyed Adventurers, occasionally quite decent individuals do appear."

"Cross-Eyed Adventurers is unnecessary..." Merlin rolled his eyes. He strongly objected to that nickname; it carried a hint of regional discrimination.

"Hmm? I didn't know everyone resented that title. I always thought it was quite amusing," the pink-haired masked man said in surprise.

"Pff!" Merlin clicked his tongue dissatisfiedly and scrutinized the pink-haired masked man, somewhat tempted to chop his head off.

"Cough! Sorry," the pink-haired masked man cleared his throat, covering his embarrassment, and quickly pulled out a bag from behind. The jingling sound confirmed it was gold coins. "Lord Merlin, this is your prize. I accept defeat. In arm wrestling, I indeed lost to you."

Merlin weighed the bag slightly, then opened it to check and found it was roughly 2000 gold coins.

So Merlin smiled at the pink-haired masked man, thinking that although this guy talked big, he was at least a man of his word.

Merlin didn't linger and turned to call for Alice before departing directly.

Receiving the prize money, Alice showed little joy on her face. Instead, she whispered, "You went a bit too far..."

"What's wrong?" Merlin juggled the money bag in his hand and said proudly. "Getting easy money like this — aren't you happy, you miser?"

"Who's a miser! Wait — no! That's not the point!" Alice shook her head and said seriously, "You've caused such a huge commotion. You'll attract the Crimson Maple Knight Order stationed in the capital."

"Huh?! Why would they arrest me?" Merlin furrowed his brow, thinking he hadn't stolen or robbed anyone. What crime had he committed?

"Destruction of public property, disturbing the peace — both could be pinned on you..." Alice whispered stealthily, feeling as though countless eyes were watching her and Merlin from behind.

Merlin curiously turned his head to look. The place where they had been arm wrestling had become a devastated crater, and the London citizens were all looking at him with terrified expressions.

This...

It really did seem somewhat excessive.

He accidentally ended up like this.

Thinking back to two and a half years ago when he had demolished several thousand British warships at Elgin...

And yet he became a wanted criminal, and the royal family still hadn't lifted the warrant on his head.

He had heard that the fleet's commander was directly executed by order of Queen Elizabeth on the grounds of failing to protect his ships.

Now that he thought about it, the commander was actually quite wrongfully accused. He was completely killed because of him...

Although Merlin's expression was somewhat unnatural, he still spoke calmly.

"What's there to fear? I'm so lucky that nothing usually goes wrong for me."

Hardly had Merlin finished speaking when a loud shout suddenly erupted.

"Surround this area! Not even a single fly escapes!"

Countless knights clad in silver-white armor rushed over with a clatter, completely surrounding the area.

Seeing their crimson maple banners, these were indeed the capital's stationed knights — the Crimson Maple Knight Order!

Alice wore a deeply despairing expression. Just when you feared something, it came. She had never expected to cause trouble on their very first day in the capital.

She thought to herself: It certainly wasn't her fault. It was Merlin's relentless bad luck, dragging trouble wherever they went.

Alice covered her darkened face and felt that she and Merlin never had good things happen when they were together...

"You call yourself lucky? Your own toxic bragging poisoned you to death..."

title: Chapter 17
content:
Chapter 17

Volume 7 · Chapter 17

Merlin and Alice stood awkwardly in place, feeling that these Bauhinia Knights were coming at them aggressively—they clearly meant business.

Over a hundred Bauhinia Knights had completely surrounded the area, holding exquisite weapons and looking quite imposing.

As expected of a knight order composed of British elves, completely different from the knight orders they had encountered before.

The knights in the center automatically parted to form a path, and a knight with a mustache walked forward, exuding an upper-middle-class temperament inside and out.

Merlin furrowed his brow slightly and recognized him immediately. Was this not Sir Franklin, the knight commander who had recently streamed the execution of Chapman?

Franklin walked to the front, looked at the wreckage around him, and roared angrily, "Who did this!? Come forward! Daring to cause trouble in the royal capital—I bet you have the guts of a lion and豹子!"

The onlookers were completely confused. They hadn't expected a simple arm-wrestling match to attract the Bauhinia Knights!

"Who did it!? If you don't admit it, I'll arrest all of you here!" Franklin asked again, his face full of ferocity, wanting to cut the matter short and drag everyone back for questioning.

The gossiping crowd wasn't stupid either. They all turned their gazes toward Merlin, who was pretending to be dead on the ground. The meaning was very clear.

A bead of cold sweat slipped down Merlin's forehead. He thought to himself, these people really have no heart! They had been so happy watching the arm-wrestling just now, but the moment something went wrong, they sold him out so easily! They really are all fence-sitters!

Franklin scrutinized Merlin for a few moments and spoke, "...

Merlin's eyes flickered. He didn't want to admit anything at all, so he decided to pin the blame on the guiltless-looking Alice.

Merlin unceremoniously turned to look at Alice beside him and redirected the祸水 eastward.

Franklin paused, thinking—is this female adventurer the one who caused the disturbance in the royal capital?

He didn't think much more about it and frowned, asking loudly.

"You're the culprit behind this riot, aren't you!?"

"Huh!? Me?" Alice pointed at herself, completely bewildered.

"Yes! It's you! Stop pretending and come with us!" Franklin said with a serious expression, looking as though he wouldn't give Alice any easy treatment.

Alice glanced at Merlin and saw that this heartless guy was looking at her with an incriminating gaze. She immediately understood what was happening.

"You bastard! You're framing me even at a time like this! Do you have any humanity!?"

Alice angrily raised her little pink fists and rained blow after blow on Merlin, thinking this guy was truly heartless.

"What's wrong with me just from looking at you?" Merlin's expression darkened, feeling that Alice's raindrop-like punches were doing him no harm.

"What's going on!?" Franklin frowned deeply, unable to make sense of Merlin and Alice.

Alice tightly grabbed Merlin, as if afraid he might suddenly run away, and pointed at him with her finger, saying, "It's him, he did it, I can prove it!"

Franklin's expression grew complicated. He felt like he was watching a family drama where "husband and wife may share the same forest, but when disaster strikes, they fly apart各自."

"Enough! Anyway, it's you two. Someone—arrest both of them and take them back!"

"Huh!?" Alice's delicate brows furrowed high. She complained, "Do you even understand justice!?"

"Hmph!" Franklin snorted coldly and said contemptuously, "In London, our Bauhinia Knights are justice!"

"Ah~! What a pain..." Merlin rested his hand on the hilt of his sword at his waist and said impatiently, "Just kill these people already. Want to arrest me? Let's see what you're made of first."

"Don't do this! Calm down!" Alice grabbed Merlin's hand as he reached for his sword, stopping him from acting recklessly.

"What audacity! Trying to resist arrest with violence!?" Franklin ordered the knights beside him, "Arrest them! Take them to the dungeon!"

"Tch!" Merlin clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction, quietly harboring killing intent. If Alice hadn't stopped him, he would have already cleaved Franklin's forehead open.

Several knights in armor stepped forward, clearly intending to capture Merlin and Alice alive.

Just before they were about to make their move, a voice suddenly rang out, surprising everyone—

"Stop! ! !"

The pink-haired masked man slowly walked to the front, positioning himself between the two sides, clearly intending to meddle.

"Franklin, is this how you usually enforce the law!? Arresting people without understanding the facts."

"It's truly disheartening. No wonder the reputation of the Bauhinia Knights keeps getting worse. It's all people like you causing trouble!"

Hearing the pink-haired masked man's scolding, Franklin visibly froze, then burst into anger.

"Who do you think you are!? You dare point fingers at me!? And you dare call me by my name—call me Sir Franklin properly!"

"What am I?" The pink-haired masked man pointed at himself and smiled, saying calmly, "Franklin, I never expected you to be like this. Tsk tsk."

"I think you're just meddling in other people's business. Fine, then I'll fulfill your wish." Franklin narrowed his eyes and shouted loudly, "Someone! Arrest this masked guy too. I now seriously suspect he's a wanted criminal who illegally entered London!"

"Want to arrest me? Interesting..." The pink-haired masked man took off his mask, revealing a sunny and handsome face. He curled his lips into a smile, looking very cheerful.

"Uh!" Franklin looked at the man in front of him and immediately turned pale, his breathing becoming chaotic. "Mo... Mo..."

"Morrison..." Merlin furrowed his brow, looking at the man who had been arm-wrestling earlier with surprise. Though he didn't know his identity, judging by Franklin's reaction, this person clearly came from an influential background.

"It's actually Morrison!?" Alice's eyes widened. It seemed she knew who the other person was.

"Who's that?" Merlin curiously whispered, hoping for an explanation.

"You don't even know that? Please have some common sense..." Alice rolled her eyes, feeling quite exasperated by Merlin's question.

"Sorry, I never remember the names of the weak." Merlin shrugged, looking utterly innocent.

"She's not weak..." Alice emphasized, then slowly explained, "Morrison is one of the Thorns' Twelve Knights, the fighting king of Britain. His strength is extremely formidable. From a young age, he challenged many grandmasters in the fighting world and was personally recruited by Her Majesty the Queen as the Seventh Knight. He also once sparred with our guild master, though we don't know the result. But the old guild master spoke very highly of him, saying that if Morrison's talent is as high as everyone says, and with his deep understanding of combat and ability to draw from all schools to strengthen himself, he will certainly forge his own martial path in the future..."

"Ummmm..." Merlin fell silent, pursed his lips, and frowned while looking at Morrison in front of him, thinking awkwardly:

Why does it sound like everyone's one up the other in badassery?

But isn't Morrison someone I've already defeated?

It seems the other Thorns Knights are all at roughly the same level.

Not that impressive at all. I feel like I could take on all twelve...
