title: Chapter 36 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update
content:
Chapter 36 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Update

Volume 11 · Chapter 36

The sky was dim, the blood moon hung high in the air.
The black seawater was impossible to calm, the wind wouldn't stop, occasionally whipping up huge waves.
The North Sea Giant seemed to lurk in the deep sea, its scarlet eyes staring from below at the desperate Alice, apparently treating her as prey.
Those gigantic eyes were like red searchlights; Alice, trapped within a magical barrier, saw everything her gaze touched bathed in crimson.
Ten tentacles, like sky‑supporting pillars, continuously stretched toward the sky, as if the legendary sea monster had just awakened and was stretching.
The tentacles were covered in shells, seaweed, even rocks; one could barely see the black‑red skin, and the dense tiny suckers on the back made one's skin crawl.
The sky‑obscuring tentacles slowly advanced toward the central Alice, forming a surrounding posture.
“How's that?! Take a good look at this magnificent form—you could never match it; before you die, savor this despair‑like agony! Hahaha....” Hamil's mad laughter slowly came from opposite; he stood in the pitch‑black seawater without any problem.
At this moment Alice was severely wounded; even if she wanted to resist she couldn't, she could only stay where she was and wait for death.
Seeing the sky‑obscuring huge tentacle and the enormous monster eyes beneath the seawater, she instantly lost all will to fight.
Even if Alice weren't seriously injured, facing such a nearby legendary creature would still scare her witless, leaving no thought of resistance.
Alice felt that this monster, left over from the mythic age, was something humans could never defeat; in that extermination thirty years ago, who knows how many outstanding human powerhouses died, and in the end they never succeeded, suffering heavy losses.
Now Alice faces this legendary monster—how could she have any thought of resistance? If she could beg for mercy, she would have done so already.
A strange low growl came, and a huge tentacle slowly approached Alice, seeming to strangle this human here.
Alice's face drained of color; her delicate body trembled with fear, her teeth chattered, and her eyes showed obvious terror.
The tense heartbeat, short rapid breaths, in the still eerie atmosphere, were unusually clear.
No! I must act, otherwise I'm doomed!
Alice broke out in a cold sweat, wanting to move—even jumping into the sea would do.
But because she was too frightened, Alice discovered her legs had no sensation; she couldn't move at all.
Alice sank into deep despair, as if in a cold ice cave; her last will to live was extinguished.
Her gaze gradually lost its luster, becoming empty and blank. 二
Even her consciousness began to grow hazy, hard to maintain.
Although her body still lived, her soul was already stepping step by step toward death.
Alice indeed fell under Hamil's technique; if it continued, she would become a walking corpse, played with like a puppet on strings.
A person who has lost their fighting spirit is no different from a soulless empty shell.
6F Light Novel
The Kraken's huge tentacles gathered in one day, covering the sky, leaving everything under its despairing shroud.
“Hehehe~”
Hamil let out a strange laugh, feeling his plan was perfect,
This female adventurer is already done; when the time comes she'll become a soulless puppet, and I can play with her however I like.
Think about it—I could even turn her into a little dragon person, such a fresh feeling I've never tried before, hahaha~
Hamil's expression instantly turned somewhat lewd, as he imagined many indecent scenes.
A katana suddenly pierced Hamil's chest, making it hard to understand what happened?
Hamil's breath caught; he felt a burning pain in his chest, his whole body shivered.
He slowly lowered his gaze and saw half of a katana protruding from his chest, the blade rusted and nicked.
This stab—tetanus in a minute.
Hamil's heart filled with terror; he widened his eyes, his face turned pale, watching his blood flow down, his lips twitching.
“--一-一-一” y QEz、治
Before his eyes, the sea, the blood moon, and that invincible North Sea Giant instantly turned into white mist, vanishing without a trace.
Everything returned to the original scene: the night‑shrouded royal capital streets, the ruined, broken houses—just as before.
The earlier monster attack seemed like a dream; nothing had happened, it was all just an illusion.
Alice finally caught her breath, her chest rising and falling, she frequently breathed while observing her surroundings.
“What... what happened...
Alice furrowed her beautiful brows, feeling a slight headache; after a moment of doubt she realized—everything was an illusion, not real.
Think about it: even if the Thorn Knight could summon the North Sea Giant, he couldn't do it in the royal capital; besides, Alice had been completely deceived by what she saw with her eyes, she hadn't...
To deal with herself, wounded and unable to resist, did she really need to summon a legendary sea monster like the North Sea Giant?
Alice felt annoyed, but her injuries were still severe; she couldn't help sucking in a breath of cold air.
Alice's gaze turned toward Hamil; she saw this ugly fellow already pierced through the chest, face full of fear, not daring to move, afraid the person behind him would draw blood— as for who that person behind him was....
“Merlin! ?”
Alice cried out in surprise, never expecting Merlin to appear here.
But being able to see Merlin at such a time made Alice feel relieved; she let out a sigh of relief.
Logically, Merlin would prioritize protecting Michelle's safety; it seems the plan has already succeeded. 业
Moreover, he turned back to look for me—could it be that he's concerned about me?
Alice's face regained some color; looking at Merlin, her eyes grew strange, her heart fluttered a little.
“Ah...... Hamil shivered, feeling his life being swallowed by this strange blade, not knowing if it's an illusion?”
But Hamil couldn't figure it out; his illusion magic is an area skill—anyone within range would be affected.
Yet why could the man behind him directly find him and stab him with a single blow?
It's as if he were completely unaffected by illusion; under normal circumstances this would never happen—it's too strange!
Hamil had never seen such a thing; it's practically like seeing a ghost!
Merlin is magic‑immune, so illusion magic naturally has no effect on him.
Don't look at how grand the illusion scene was—Merlin basically saw nothing at all!
“Friend, what were you doing waving your arms and legs just now? Chuunibyou late stage?”
Hamil was terrified to the extreme, trembling as he turned his head to look at the Merlin behind him.
His eyes glanced at Merlin's black‑iron adventurer's proof; he didn't dare look down on him, but nervously swallowed a mouthful of saliva—
“..Please spare my life.'
“I swear.
“I will never again: 'I will never dare to bully your wife again.'”

title: Chapter 37 — Healing
content:
Chapter 37 — Healing

Volume 11 · Chapter 37

Hamil immediately caved in, not daring to make a rash move or say anything harsh.

He felt a chill run down his spine, his life force draining away at a frantic pace.

Hamil turned to look at Merlin, raising both hands into the air, clearly intending to surrender.

Merlin thought for a moment. He had already stabbed the man; letting Hamil go now would be too late.

Besides, he had already slain one Thorn Knight; one more wouldn't make a difference.

After all, it was a longevity pill delivered right to his doorstep. How could he refuse?

Merlin grinned and shook his head with a knowing look, speaking seriously.

"Truly a pity. No."

......Hamil's eyes widened, the color draining from his face as he felt as though he had just been sentenced to death.

Without a shred of hesitation, Merlin used his katana to flick Hamil into the air, then delivered two slashing strikes, one horizontal and one vertical!

"Aaaah... Gah!"

Hamil's scream cut off abruptly as Merlin cleaved him in half on the spot.

His body shattered into four pieces in mid-air, blood spraying out like crimson fireworks.

The last remnants of Hamil's life were completely devoured by the demon sword Banri Garan.

Merlin sheathed his katana and walked over to Alice. Seeing her disheveled state, a mischievous smile spread across his face.

"...W-Why did you come?" Alice knelt on the ground, too badly injured to move for the time being.

"Weren't you supposed to come check if I was dead?" Merlin said, stroking his chin.

In truth, Merlin was still a bit worried about Alice. She had only just reached Saint-tier, and he wasn't sure if she could handle a Thorn Knight.

However, the outcome seemed decent enough. Although she was covered in wounds, at least she was still alive.

Alice looked at Merlin, a hint of doubt in her heart, and asked tentatively, "You're so concerned about me. Are you up to some shady scheme behind my back?"

"No, no, no, don't misunderstand. I'm just worried that if you accidentally die, I won't be able to pay off my debts and will have to crawl back to my hometown." Merlin paused, crossed his arms, and added, "But seeing that you still have a breath left is truly a blessing."

Alice rolled her eyes, a sense of disappointment welling up inside her. She said huffily, "I don't need your concern. Even on my own, I can live just fine."

"Really?" Merlin crouched down, looking at the countless wounds on Alice's body. He couldn't help but poke one with his finger.

"Yaaah!" Alice cried out in pain, as if she had touched a high-voltage wire, her body trembling.

"Doesn't that hurt? Why are you forcing yourself to hold it in? It's fine to cry out loudly." Merlin teased Alice.

"Hiss~" Alice's face turned pale from the pain. She gasped for air, enduring it as best she could, cold sweat dripping from her forehead. She hadn't expected Merlin to be such a jerk! Poking her wounds? What the hell is wrong with him?! Bastard! Don't touch me!

"Hehe, I just love seeing you so angry you're about to explode but can't do a thing about it~" Merlin smirked.

"I'll kill you!" Alice mustered a sliver of strength, raising her hand to strike Merlin's face.

"Yo~" Merlin easily caught Alice's wrist, saying with a sigh, "Taking such a heavy beating and still having so much energy. Impressive, truly impressive~"

"Tch!" Alice glared at Merlin with a vicious look, wishing she could bite the bastard to death.

"You should be a bit more careful. Don't be so stubborn. If you can't win, just run. Why insist on ending up in such a sorry state?" Merlin pulled Alice's hand away, speaking to her in a lecturing tone.

"...None of your business!" Alice said stubbornly, her face flushing slightly.

"Even with your Dragon race talent boosting you, you can't withstand fighting like that. With injuries this severe, it will probably take a long time to recover." Merlin said flatly, thinking that if Alice kept acting so impulsively, she would eventually lose her life.

"I don't need your lectures... Keep your mouth shut. I know what I'm doing. If I could have run away, I would have." Alice puffed out her cheeks, still looking a bit defiant.

Merlin laughed helplessly, too lazy to argue with Alice. He reached out and wrapped his arm around her waist, using his other hand to support her arms, and lifted her up directly.

"Let's drop this for now. We should leave the capital. It won't be long before more troublesome people come chasing after us."

Alice was held in Merlin's arms like a princess, a faint blush spreading across her cheeks. She stammered, "...What are you doing? Put me down! ...I'm not a child, I don't need to be carried!"

"Alright, stop making a scene at a time like this. We're in a hurry." Merlin said with a straight face, wondering where he should leave the capital from. It seemed that with his abilities, he could break through in any direction he chose.

"Mm... I'm not making a scene. But since you're so insistent, then... I'll accept it. Just this once, no next time, hmph~!" Alice said this, but her body was very honest, snuggling closer into Merlin's embrace.

Merlin looked down at the pouting Alice in his arms, a few black lines appearing on his forehead as he thought—

This bitch...

Why does she say such nonsensical things every single day?

Late at night.

Merlin brought the heavily injured Alice out of the capital and returned directly to the encampment of the Rose family's private army to rest.

The Duke of Rose had originally assigned Alice a relatively quiet private tent for her to rest in.

After Merlin brought Alice back, he didn't see the Duke of Rose or Michelle. They were likely preparing for a counterattack, mobilizing the entire private army.

Before leaving the capital, Merlin had noticed that knights and soldiers were everywhere inside the city. Shouts and terrified screams were constant as they hurried to the city walls on all four sides, seemingly preparing to defend against the upcoming war.

It seemed both sides knew a great battle was inevitable and that it would soon turn into a prolonged siege.

Back in the tent, Merlin placed Alice on the bed and casually lit the kerosene lamp nearby, letting the dim yellow light shine out.

Merlin came to Alice's bedside and asked tentatively, "How are you? Has the injury gotten any better?"

Alice lay in the bed, looking at Merlin. She thought, this guy is clearly just worried about me, isn't he?

She hurriedly averted her gaze, her face red as she mumbled.

"It's fine, I'm much better. I just need a priest to help treat it."

Because Alice's injuries were severe, her self-healing ability was recovering very slowly. It would probably take a month for her to fully heal.

If Alice could control the Dragon race power at 100%, this kind of severe injury would basically heal in a single night.

"With injuries this severe, even if a priest treats you, it will probably take a week. Am I supposed to take care of you for that entire week?" Merlin narrowed his eyes, the word "unwilling" written all over his face.

"...I didn't ask you to take care of me. Who would want you to take care of me?!" Alice huffed, turning over to face away from Merlin, not wanting to look at him.

"Tch!" Merlin showed an impatient expression, scratching his head. "Hey, I have a quick healing method. Do you want to try it?"

"What?" Alice flipped back over.

"It's just..." As Merlin spoke, he reached out to unbutton Alice's clothes, looking like he wasn't up to any good.

Seeing Merlin's movement, Alice's breath hitched and she froze, thinking, what does this bastard want to do by unbuttoning my clothes?!

It was the dead of night, and the surroundings were silent and empty. Merlin reaching out to pull at Alice's clothes made it hard not to have dirty thoughts.

But the moment Merlin had just undone one button, his lecherous hand was smacked away by Alice with a sharp "slap."

"Hiss~ What are you doing?" Merlin frowned, rubbing his stung hand, his face darkening as he said—

"Don't be so nervous, okay?

"Calm down a bit.

title: Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Plus
content:
Chapter 38 — Monthly Ticket Plus

Volume 11 · Chapter 38

Alice heard his suggestion to calm down and instantly rolled her eyes.

She thought to herself: I'm about to be taken advantage of and you want me to stay calm? Are you out of your mind?!

Alice tugged at her clothes and glared at Merlin with clear vigilance, as if guarding against a pervert.

"What are you doing? Shouldn't I be asking you that! What do you want by unbuttoning my clothes?!"

"What would I want?" Merlin shrugged, putting on an innocent expression. "Of course I'm here to heal you. Don't worry, after treatment you'll be bouncing around the next day. It won't take long at all."

"Heal me by taking off my clothes? Are you kidding me? How could I possibly believe that?!"

Alice was furious. Not only did Merlin want to take advantage of her, but he was using such a lame excuse, as if he thought she was an idiot he could fool.

Still, after Merlin had touched her, Alice felt somewhat complicated inside. There was a tiny flutter of excitement, but more than that, she felt resistance.

After all, Alice felt that Merlin didn't have deep feelings for her, so it would be better to maintain a relatively polite relationship. If things got too messy, how could they continue working together in the future?

"I think you just can't give up on your scheming, wanting to take advantage of me while I'm injured... disgusting!"

"Pfft!" Merlin clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction, a bit upset at being slandered. Crossing his arms, he looked at Alice, whose face was red and who was hesitating to speak. His meaning was clear: "You think I'm trying to take advantage of you?"

"Isn't... isn't that what you're doing?" Alice glared at Merlin with a wary look and said plainly, "Don't think I don't know what you're thinking. Demons like you aren't kind-hearted,哼~!"

"Miss Alice, haven't we been living together for quite a while now? When have I ever assaulted you?" Merlin fired back.

"...Alice thought about it and realized he wasn't wrong, but she still refused to admit defeat. "You definitely have the intentions but not the courage!"

"Hah..." Merlin laughed helplessly. "Miss, if I wanted to do something to you, could you even resist?"

"You—!" Alice's eyes widened. She instinctively shifted her body backward, putting distance between herself and this rogue.

"Hey hey! Don't actually treat me like a rapist, I'm joking, cough..." Merlin coughed twice to cover his embarrassment, then explained seriously, "I really am healing you. Using my saliva."

Alice was dumbfounded. Using saliva to heal? That sounds kind of gross...

A flash of panic darted through her blue eyes. Her heartbeat suddenly quickened as she nervously asked,

"Saliva can heal?! What kind of nonsense is that?! I've never heard of that before!"

"Don't be so surprised. It really is just my saliva. Let me lick the more serious wounds on you. Didn't I tell you before? I'm a male succubus." Merlin pointed at himself. "I feel that my saliva has a fairly obvious effect on women."

Alice thought about it. Her injuries were mainly on her waist, neck, and legs. Was she really supposed to let Merlin lick all over? !

Oh my god! Does it have to be this disgusting?! Why can this guy say something like this so calmly?!

But Alice did seem to remember hearing Merlin say back when they came to the capital last time that he was a succubus and that his saliva could heal.

However, Alice didn't believe in this strange treatment method at all. It was clearly just another way for him to take advantage of her!

Alice felt that having a man fiercely lick all over her body was disgusting, so with a flat expression and a darkened face, two words emerged from between her teeth.

"Pervert."

"Uh..." Merlin's expression turned awkward. "I'm trying to help. I want you to get better sooner."

"That's not... the main point... you want to lick my body..." Alice's cheeks flushed faintly. She stammered a response, not even daring to look Merlin in the eye.

"Miss, have some self-respect. How could you think I want to lick your body? What do you take me for?!" Merlin was starting to lose his mind.

"A pervert, what else?" Alice said earnestly. "I never expected you to have this kind of fetish. I never noticed it before. Really... truly unlookable."

"I'm seriously trying to heal you and you won't believe me?! When have I ever harmed you?" Merlin was running out of patience. He couldn't leave her like this either. "It's just licking your body! Do you think I haven't done it before? I know every single hair on your body!"

"Huh?!" Alice's eyes widened as she asked in shock, "When did that happen? ! ...When did you touch my body? ! Tell me the truth, you bastard!"

"Hehehe, so you really don't know? I thought you already knew." Merlin wore a teasing smile.

"Speak!" Alice urgently pressed, on the verge of tears. She thought: Am I that clueless? I didn't even realize I'd had intimate contact with Merlin?

"When we first met at the village tavern, you were badly beaten by goblins. Then I handled it. Without me, how could you be bouncing around the next day? Use your brain a little~" Merlin tapped his own temple, his smile feeling rather sinister.

Alice suddenly froze and remembered that it was indeed so.

She had always assumed the tavern owner had taken care of her and helped treat her wounds.

And it turned out to be Merlin? ! And using prprpr?!

Alice felt like her whole world was crumbling. She'd let Merlin take advantage of her completely without even realizing it!

"How... how could this be... no way..."

Seeing Alice unable to accept reality, Merlin found it somewhat amusing. "Don't take it to heart. The situation was special back then. The village was in chaos, there were no priests around to heal you, and I couldn't let my new job's patient just die randomly, right? So I had to step up personally and use my saliva to help you through it. You should properly thank me."

"...Alice covered her face, unable to imagine the scene at the time. "...What exactly did you do to me, you bastard?"

"Not much. I just helped you take off all your clothes and licked your wounds. You had pretty serious injuries on your washboard too, back then." Merlin answered honestly, not really hiding anything. It was fine, after all, he'd been saving her life at the time.

"Huh? !!" Alice's eyes widened in sheer shock, as if she'd discovered some earth-shattering secret!

"What's with that reaction?" A bead of cold sweat ran down Merlin's forehead.

"I had wounds on my chest too?!" Alice couldn't help but press further. If it was true, that meant Merlin had... sucked on her... !

"I'm not entirely sure about the chest. After all, you're a washboard, but I did help treat it..." Merlin finished, then licked his lips with his tongue. "You know what I mean~"

Alice stood frozen, looking at Merlin's overtly salacious demeanor with utter disbelief.

So that meant Merlin not only saw her completely naked...

But he also used his mouth... to lick her tiny breasts? ! !

Wyyy wyyy wyyy, I can't live anymore, I've lost all face to keep living...

Alice gathered her remaining strength, sat up on the bed, and despite the excruciating pain in her body, resolved to perish together with this guy.

She grabbed Merlin by the neck and screamed tearfully QAQ.

"Yaaaaaaaaaah!

"Merlin, you lecherous bastard!

"What exactly did you do to me while I was unconscious? !"

"After you did that to me... how am I ever going to get married..."

Alice was currently injured, so even while gripping Merlin's neck, she couldn't exert any real force.

Merlin remained completely calm and easily pushed her hand away, his expression flat as he said,

"Calm down. As for not being able to marry...

"I'll marry you~"

title: Chapter 39 — Desperate Situation
content:
Chapter 39 — Desperate Situation

Volume 11 · Chapter 39

Alice was taken aback by Merlin's "I'll marry you" response, and her heart began to churn.

Huh? Merlin wants to marry me? Is that really true? Why does it feel so casual?

Does Merlin even have feelings for me? If not, saying something like that is just being a pervert!

A blush colored Alice's cheeks. Given how many times Merlin had pulled jokes before, she needed to probe a little.

"Is it true or not? You're joking with me, right?"

"Ha, of course it's a joke. You actually believed it?" Merlin wore a meaningful smile. "I'm the Great Demon Lord, so why would I marry some piece of laundry? I don't want to."

"Mmm, I wasn't taking it seriously! If I have to give myself to you someday, I'd rather just kill myself now!"

Alice's blush faded like a receding tide. The pain in her wounds felt worse than before, so she lay face down on the bed, motionless.

"Ugh, do you really have to be this cruel?" Merlin broke into a cold sweat, laughing. "Helping you with treatment using saliva is just between us two—neither of us will say anything, and it won't interfere with your future life at all. You can rest assured."

"Enough. Let me just die here by myself..." Alice buried her head under the pillow, putting on an aloof expression.

"Do you really not want me to help you heal? I'm not lying—my saliva really is miraculous." Merlin furrowed his brow and asked.

"You can get a priest to heal you. I can take care of myself. I don't need you. Just leave. I'm tired." Alice lay on the bed and said quietly, seemingly bothered by what had just happened.

Merlin was a man of limited patience. Since Alice didn't want to accept his help, there was no need for him to keep insisting.

So Merlin slowly got up and left. But halfway out, he stopped, his expression shifting through several changes as he seemed lost in thought.

Hidden under the pillow, Alice was torn inside.

Who cares about healing? What I care about is love, you idiot Merlin...

Merlin had never seriously considered the question of a life partner. The reason was that he carried a curse—he risked dying at any moment from gas, so it was better to remain a lone wolf.

Still, Merlin had desires and emotions. Naturally, he hoped for love, but it seemed this kind of thing wasn't really suited to him.

Up until now, Merlin had only ever harbored feelings for Asmodeus, even going so far as to consider proposing. But that guy was a man!

No matter how desperate Merlin got, he wouldn't have any evil thoughts toward Asmodeus, that precious little girl.

Merlin briefly imagined it—though Alice was a piece of laundry, as a marriage partner, she wasn't entirely unacceptable.

After all, they'd been together for so long. Merlin felt he and Alice got along pretty well. Maybe...

Even though Alice was human, Merlin might face significant obstacles if he wanted to marry her.

But Merlin had always despised rules and restrictions, and he possessed a modern mindset. How could such obstacles possibly hold him back?

"Well then... Alice, I actually don't have many requirements for my future wife. I just want to live a quiet life with someone. So..."

Under the pillow, Alice listened and guessed that Merlin was trying to trick her again, so she interrupted, "So what? What does my future wife have to do with me? Stop saying such nonsensical things. I'm tired. Just disappear from my sight. Hmph!"

Merlin's face slid downward in three black lines, left speechless by Alice's retort.

His second half was supposed to be: "So even if you're a piece of laundry, it doesn't matter. As long as you're willing to marry me, I'll dare to wed you."

But Alice was too sensitive at the moment, and Merlin ended up swallowing those words.

Merlin wondered if he had misread the situation—Alice still regarded him with hostility and resentment.

Love was just his one-sided fantasy. Over 200 years of being a single dog, had he mistaken kindness for love?

Merlin's face turned awkward. He cleared his throat softly, abandoning his impulse, and said with a slight tone:

"Tomorrow, I'll find a priest to help you heal."

"Good night, Alice. Sweet dreams..."

Deep in the palace at night.

Catherine strode into the grand hall, her brows tightly knit, moving quickly.

She had already received news of the deaths of three Thorn Knights and had to come discuss strategy with the Queen.

Losing three important combatants at the very start was a major blow to the entire knightly order—almost a crippling one.

Originally, the Thorn Knights were meant to deal with the O'Fleur family's rebellion. But they were beheaded in a row by the Marquis of Roses right from the start!

This was a significant setback for the Queen. After Dexter, Immanuel, and Hammurabi fell, only five Thorn Knights remained in the capital.

Among them, Mesphield, Morrison, Winifred, and Miliacus were still imprisoned. They were being held as leverage to delay the O'Fleur family's rebellion, so they couldn't be moved freely.

The second Thorn Knight, Seth, was still on his way back and couldn't help with the urgent situation in the capital.

Thinking this over, the Queen's only remaining reliable knight was just Catherine alone.

At this moment, Catherine felt immense pressure, unsure if she could protect the capital and the Queen on her own.

The deaths of the three Thorn Knights revealed a problem: the Marquis of Roses apparently had a very powerful guard by his side.

As Catherine thought about this, she felt a wave of headaches. She had trouble defeating three Thorn Knights, let alone facing that mysterious powerhouse.

If tomorrow at dawn the Marquis of Roses launched an attack on the capital with that mysterious powerhouse by his side, the consequences would be unimaginable!

In the grand hall, Isabella hadn't left. She looked somewhat fatigued, waiting for news from the Thorn Knights.

Catherine hurried to the foot of the throne and knelt on one knee, speaking calmly: "Your Majesty, Dexter, Hammurabi, and Immanuel have all sacrificed themselves."

"What?! They're all dead!"

Isabella's eyes widened in shock, and she exclaimed loudly, completely losing her composure, startled by the news.

She had originally believed those three Thorn Knights would complete their mission successfully and return with the Marquis of Roses's head.

But the result was a total reversal—none of them came back alive.

Isabella felt deeply disappointed. The incompetence of the Thorn Knights nearly made her faint.

"How... how could this happen..."

"Your Majesty, please calm down." Although Catherine had her eyes closed, she could sense how tense Isabella was. "The Marquis of Roses definitely went prepared, with an extremely powerful person protecting him. That mysterious powerhouse's strength is likely far beyond that of the Thorn Knights!"

Isabella fell silent. Her delicate face grew increasingly cold and rigid, like a piece of cast iron or concrete.

It seemed the cunning Marquis of Roses had long planned ahead and brought a strong ally to protect him.

Tomorrow, I'm bound to face the siege of the O'Fleur family's fifty thousand troops. What am I to do?

After Gregory was struck down by Elkin the Great Swordsman, he remained unconscious and couldn't help.

To resolve the current predicament...

It seemed the only option was to play that trump card.

title: Chapter 40 — Monthly Ticket + Update
content:
Chapter 40 — Monthly Ticket + Update

Volume 11 · Chapter 40

Isabella felt she had no way out; she would have to deploy her final trump card—the Lake Fey.

As long as the Lake Fey could defend the capital for half a month and drag the northern kingdom army back, she would still be the ultimate victor!

Although after using the Lake Fey, the empire would fall into a period of weakness lasting two hundred years, lacking sufficient military power to deter other nations.

But as long as some concessions were made, the empire's stability could still be maintained. Eliminating internal threats was the highest priority.

Isabella's face turned cold and silent. She was forced to make certain choices to continue consolidating her rule.

Originally, the Lake Fey trump card was meant for dealing with major upheavals in the empire.

Take Duke of Aufré, for example, who had been plotting for a long time and whose accumulated power was now enough to threaten the empire.

But Isabella's greatest threat right now was indeed Duke Rose. Even if it meant revealing her final trump card, she had to play it.

Catherine saw the Queen remaining silent and grew uneasy inside, not daring to speak.

She knew the current situation was turbulent, and the Queen's ruling position had already begun to weaken.

If left unchecked, the empire might fall before Duke of Aufré even raised his rebellion banner!

As the Queen's knight, she had to guard until the last moment.

But that mysterious powerhouse had defeated three Thorn Knights, and she feared she wouldn't be able to resist either.

Catherine, feeling uneasy and unable to bear the oppressive atmosphere, summoned her courage and asked.

"Your Majesty, what should we do now? I suggest a strategic withdrawal, joining forces with the northern kingdom army with what remains of our strength."

Isabella glanced at Catherine, thinking—what strategic withdrawal? That's just running away.

"Don't be nervous, Catherine. We haven't lost yet."

Catherine paused for a moment, then furrowed her brows in concern. "Right now, most of the kingdom's forces have been deployed to the north. The entire capital is like an empty city. If Your Majesty doesn't want a strategic withdrawal, releasing Mesfield and the others, then consolidating the capital's surviving forces, should be enough to fight the Rose family!"

"It's useless. Even Dexter and the others have died in battle. Sending Mesfield would likely meet the same fate," Isabella replied calmly.

"Then... then what does Your Majesty plan to do? We absolutely cannot just sit here and wait for death!" Catherine was already somewhat panicked. Seeing the queen so composed, she wondered if something was wrong with her mind.

"Rest assured. I already know what to do next. All rebels will meet a terrible end." Isabella clenched her teeth, releasing a chilling killing intent.

Catherine suddenly looked up, surprised. "Does Your Majesty already have a countermeasure?"

"That's right. We still have a sure-win trump card. No matter how powerful a fighter Duke Rose has brought, none can stand against our royal clan's guardian deity." Isabella paused, narrowing her eyes viciously. "Everyone who opposes me must pay with blood!"

"The royal clan's guardian deity..."

Catherine furrowed her brow slightly, thought for a moment, and then her eyes widened!

Who else but those fairies of the underground lake could be called a guardian deity!

Was His Majesty planning to mobilize the very foundation of the empire to deal with Duke Rose?

"Your Majesty, do you mean the Lake Fey that lies dormant underground? The powerful beings that formed a blood pact with the previous king..."

"That's right. They are the mighty power upon which we stand—the Lake Fey." Isabella paused, speaking with confidence. "Now that the enemy is at our gates, we cannot hesitate any longer. We must awaken the Lake Fey. As long as these powerful creatures remain in the capital, even if Duke Rose summons the great swordsman Elgin, it will be useless. After all, the Lake Fey are ancient beings beyond human resistance."

Catherine closed her eyes, her body trembling slightly, feeling a trace of fear toward these monsters.

Though she had never seen the Lake Fey, based on various legends, they were simply overlords who swept across this land!

But Catherine felt something was wrong and gathered her courage to ask.

"Your Majesty, directly deploying the Lake Fey seems inappropriate, doesn't it? The capital is a densely populated area. The Lake Fey's tremendous power could affect ordinary people. It would be better to give advance notice first."

"No need. Time is running short, and there's no reason to waste energy on ordinary people. Turbulent times inevitably bring bloodshed and sacrifice. The lives of lowborns are completely worthless." Isabella said seriously, appearing extremely cold-blooded.

Catherine felt some disgust inside but didn't say anything in rebuttal. Instead, she lowered her head in submission. "I understand, Your Majesty."

"Catherine, I can only rely on you now. So, are you willing to stand with me through this?" Isabella asked earnestly.

"Of course." Catherine placed her hand over her heart and replied with certainty.

"I am willing to burn my own life to protect you, until the moment of death!"

Outside the capital.

An army of over fifty thousand was fully prepared.

Their armor shone bright as snow, weapons gleamed with a cold edge, clearly displaying a posture of full military readiness.

A massive formation composed of cavalry, infantry, and archers was neatly arranged, appearing strictly disciplined.

Siege towers and giant trebuchets were also ready, prepared to launch an assault on the capital at any moment.

As for the capital's city walls, countless torches burned brightly.

Most of the soldiers hadn't slept the entire night, worried about the Rose family's army attacking.

But with so few defenders, beneath the iron hooves of this fifty-thousand-strong army, they could only tremble.

Duke Rose, clad in red robes, rode out on a tall black steed, surveyed his troops, and began to speak loudly.

"Next, we will capture the capital and trample the queen's palace beneath our iron hooves."

"But this is not bringing shame to our loyalty and righteousness—it is to uphold the empire's legitimate lineage!"

"The woman sitting on the throne now is not our queen. The true queen has disappeared without a trace!"

"Therefore, we will pledge our allegiance to Her Highness Michelle and fight for the empire's legitimacy!"

Duke Rose delivered a pre-battle rally speech to boost morale, wrapping it under the banner of justice.

As the first ray of dawn appeared on the horizon, Duke Rose drew the sword at his waist.

"All forces, attack!"

The cavalry charged ahead as the vanguard, followed by dense ranks of infantry.

The sky darkened with rain like locusts, whistling toward the imperial capital's walls.

Giant trebuchets swung like windmills, launching one massive stone after another!

Fifty thousand Rose legionnaires launched fierce attacks, their battle cries shaking the heavens, rapidly beginning the war to seize the imperial capital.

Merlin did not participate. Instead, he chose to watch from afar, observing both sides constantly slaughtering each other.

This mission was only to protect Michelle, not to help capture the capital.

So Merlin had no interest in meddling further, but looking at the current situation—

What the—?

Isn't this a one-sided affair?

It looks like there's no need for me to get involved anymore.

(´°ω°` )

title: Chapter 41 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 41 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 11 · Chapter 41

The siege battle outside was raging fiercely, and the remaining garrison troops in the capital had all been dispatched to the city walls for defense.

The palace remained temporarily undisturbed, spared from the conflict.

Deep in the lightless underground, the true Queen Elizabeth was imprisoned.

For these past few days, Elizabeth had not slept well, constantly worrying about her daughter Michelle.

After all, she knew Isabel's personality well. If Michelle learned the secret, she would not survive.

Perhaps Isabel wouldn't bring herself to kill her own blood relative, but she would lock Michelle up just as she herself was locked up, never seeing the outside world again.

Elizabeth felt that either fate would be catastrophic for Michelle.

She didn't want Michelle to suffer here like her, forever cut off from the outside world.

Elizabeth paced anxiously back and forth in the prison, unable to find any peace.

But at that moment, Isabel arrived outside the cell carrying an oil lamp—

"What's wrong? Are you worried about Michelle?"

Elizabeth turned around in surprise, lifting her skirt as she approached the prison bars. "Sister, how is Michelle doing now?"

"Don't worry, she's fine. She's currently with the Duke of Roses from Wales, and hasn't fallen into my hands yet." Isabel responded with an expressionless face.

Elizabeth breathed a slight sigh of relief, then asked curiously, "What is Michelle doing with the Duke of Roses?"

"Do I need to ask? Of course she wants to overthrow my position and take it for herself," Isabel said with a cold laugh.

"Huh!?" Elizabeth's expression was stunned. She hadn't expected her daughter to do something like this.

"Michelle is a lot like you were when you were young—always restless, always doing unexpected things." Isabel paused, a hint of annoyance flashing in her eyes. "I've already been driven to the brink of despair by her. The entire Rose Family's army of fifty thousand has started besieging the imperial capital, and I have no choice but to deploy the lake sprites to suppress these wretched creatures."

Elizabeth's eyes widened instantly, a wave of horror surging through her. "You'd deploy the lake sprites just to suppress the Rose Family's army? That's far too reckless! Sister, calm down! Don't you want to turn the entire capital into an ocean?"

"So what? Who do you think is to blame for this, you foolish sister? It's your daughter who turned things into this mess. Even if the entire population of the capital perishes with her, it's all Michelle's fault!" Isabel paused and said in a sinister tone, "I have no choice now. The Rose Family's army could storm the grand hall at any moment. I must release the lake sprites and reverse the current situation."

Elizabeth's face drained of all color. She felt that Isabel had already become obsessed and would no longer listen to anyone's advice.

As the true queen, and with the power of the lake sprites, she was far beyond what any human could withstand.

For all the Rose Family's fifty thousand troops looked magnificent and imposing, they would be nothing more than an appetizer compared to the lake sprites.

As long as Isabel held the ultimate trump card in her hands, Elizabeth had no doubt her sister could reverse the situation.

"Sister, please reconsider. If you deploy the lake sprites, for the next two hundred years, the empire will lose its foundation—"

"Sorry, Elizabeth. I can't care about that much. Power, money, strength—I want everything this empire has to offer." Isabel revealed her greedy nature, her appetite appearing insatiable.

Seeing her sister like this, Elizabeth instantly lost hope. She could only wish her daughter could stay safe. "Sister, then could you let Michelle go? She's still a child."

"She caused me so much trouble—how could I possibly let her go?" Isabel's tone was resolute, showing she was genuinely determined to kill.

"Sister, I'm begging you. I'm willing to cooperate with you. I'll say I'm actually Isabella, and no one will ever suspect you. I only hope Michelle can live happily. If you still have anger in your heart, I'm willing to accept the punishment in Michelle's place."

Elizabeth reached through the iron bars, trying to touch her ruthless sister.

But Isabel seemed unappreciative, pushing Elizabeth's hand away and saying seriously—

"Give it up, Elizabeth. Stop begging me. My sympathy isn't so cheap...."

The entire underground was hollow.

At the very bottom lay a lake that shimmered with a pale fluorescent glow.

Specks of starlight drifted up from the lake's surface; fireflies danced in the midair.

This was the sleeping quarters of the lake sprites—the underground lake.

It was also the oldest lake throughout the entire Britannia Empire, its history traceable back to the Age of Gods.

Long ago, this underground lake had many legends, the most widely circulated being—

A water sprite dwelled in the lake, guarding a sword left behind from the mythological era, named the Sword of Victory and Promise.

Legend had it that this sword was forged by craftsmen from the dwarf kingdom of the mythological era, using ore from the roots of the World Tree.

However, after the Britannian kings constructed the underground palace beside the lake, few people still knew this legend, and it gradually faded into history.

The underground space was vast, and reaching the lake floor required a long journey.

An ancient, simple spiral staircase descended, and Isabel's face reflected the lake's shimmer as she carried her oil lamp, slowly approaching the lowest lake.

After arriving before the glowing lake, Isabel set her oil lamp aside and observed her surroundings.

Strange plants grew around the lake, the same color as the water, appearing like trees carved from gems.

Elizabeth felt a surge of excitement inside, because what she was about to do next was a monumental feat—she would summon the lake sprites!

The empire had endured for over four hundred years, and many monarchs had come and gone, but no one had ever dared to wield the lake sprites' powerful and terrifying force.

Isabel would be the second ruler after the founding emperor Egbert to command the lake sprites.

This meant the world to Isabel—it was as if she had achieved parity with the founding emperor himself!

Isabel didn't waste time. She took out a dagger and sliced open her finger.

A single drop of blood fell into the lake, producing a soft "ping" sound that echoed throughout the chamber.

Then Isabel closed her eyes, calmed her mind, and began reciting an obscure, incomprehensible spell.

As the incantation took effect, the previously calm lake surface began to ripple.

A woman dressed in sheer gossamer, nearly naked, slowly rose from the lake bottom.

Her figure was beautiful, perfectly proportioned, neither too tall nor too short, as if crafted by divine hands.

Yet her skin was blue, and intricate magical patterns wandered across her body, emitting a faint glow.

Although the lake sprite's skin tone was strange and her figure was tall—about three times the height of an adult—she still appeared humanoid and carried a sense of sacredness, lacking the overwhelming hostility one might expect.

After finishing the incantation, Isabel opened her eyes and saw the lake sprite, rendering her speechless with astonishment.

The lake sprite leaned her head forward, her massive face coming very close to Isabel, as if examining her.

She tilted her head and spoke in an ethereal, eerie voice—

"Child of Egbert—

What do you seek here?"

title: Chapter 42 — Fairy
content:
Chapter 42 — Fairy

Volume 11 · Chapter 42

The deep underground lake.

Silence so profound it made one uneasy.

Only the pitter-patter of dripping water echoed through the cave.

The lake surface glowed with a color even brighter than before, the faint blue light points floating and drifting in mid-air.

Though the lake fairy's figure was nowhere near the size of the giant race, her three-tall stature was still imposing enough to look up to.

Though draped in translucent gauze, her graceful figure was perceptible, yet the blue skin made her feel uncanny; a normal human would not find her beautiful.

Holy radiance radiated from her body, and magical patterns swam across her form, making one question whether this creature truly belonged in the monster category.

Ever since the lake fairy appeared, the water elements in the air had surged geometrically. The lake seemed calm, yet contained enormous power.

If any magician were here, they would likely faint from being overwhelmed by the densely packed, overwhelming water elements.

Isabella, seeing the lake fairy's true form for the first time in her life, widened her eyes, an uncontrollable tremor stirring within her heart.

Isabella had imagined a lake fairy to be a beautiful noblewoman, but instead found a blue-skinned little giant!

It was completely different from what she had pictured; she could only think of it as some unknown creature!

Still, she harbored zero doubt that this was truly the royal family's guardian deity, a powerful being with whom the ancestors had forged a contract!

The lake fairy's massive face drew close to Isabella, her eyeballs rolling up and down, the tip of her nose nearly touching Isabella's.

Isabella steadied her emotions and said solemnly,

"For the Holy Trinity Novel"

"The Empire is now in crisis; rebel forces of fifty thousand troops are besieging the royal capital.

"I am at my wit's end and have no choice but to seek your aid.

"For the sake of protecting the empire our ancestors built, please spare no expense and eliminate every single rebel out there!"

The lake fairy's expression remained unchanged, as though pondering, her gaze shifting several times before she spoke.

"I once promised your ancestor Egbert that I would only protect the safety of the royal family. I never agreed to become a war machine."

"Eh!?" Isabella froze, unfamiliar with such a pact, and when the lake fairy brought it up, she was instantly at a loss.

"All of my actions revolve around ensuring your safety. Commanding me to slaughter your enemies falls outside my duties," the lake fairy said, her voice ethereal and entirely devoid of emotion.

Isabella felt a pang of panic. The lake fairy was her final ace; if she couldn't use it, she might never get another chance to turn things around.

Still, Isabella was clever. If the lake fairy refused to act, then she would have to resort to some extreme measures!

Isabella suddenly raised her head, drew a dagger from her lap, and pressed it against her own throat, her gaze sharp and unwavering as she threatened in a resolute tone:

"If you refuse to clear the enemies outside for me, I will take my own life right before your eyes!

"Isn't your mission to protect our royal family's safety? By not helping me, you're driving me to certain death!"

"Rather than be imprisoned by those rebels outside, it would be better to end my life now! What say you?"

The lake fairy stared straight into Isabella's eyes, as though trying to gauge whether this human was truly willing to kill herself.

Isabella did not back down, meeting the lake fairy's gaze directly. The dagger pressed against her neck had already broken the skin, thin streaks of crimson blood trickling down the blade.

Dead silence filled the air. Only Isabella's nervous breathing and the rapid thumping of her heart could be heard.

The lake fairy closed her eyes and said softly, "I understand. As you wish."

Isabella lowered the dagger and exhaled with relief. Fortunately, the lake fairy possessed wisdom, otherwise this tactic would have been useless.

Splash! Water erupted in all directions like a deep-water bomb!

The blue-tinged lake water was forcibly driven high into the sky, forming towering walls of water!

A fierce gale rose, forcing Isabella to struggle to keep her eyes open as she had to steadily retreat.

The lake fairy shot upward into the air, spreading her arms and unfurling fin-like appendages, ascending toward the heavens.

The entire lake's waters rose with her, as though alive.

Isabella looked up, watching the lake fairy's graceful dance, unable to suppress a smug smile.

The royal capital had been consumed by flames of war.

The garrison forces guarding the capital were weak.

0F SF Light Novel

They didn't resist for long before the Rose Family's fifty thousand elite troops broke through.

The city gates were smashed wide open, and several trebuchets rained destruction across the capital, sending civilians scattering in all directions.

Rose knights clad in crimson robes charged through like a thunderous tide, their battle cries shaking the heavens, heading straight for the magnificent palace!

Most of the capital's soldiers had weak fighting resolve; upon seeing how ferocious the Rose Family was, they dropped their helmets and armor and fled.

As for those with backbone, they had already been hacked to pieces by the Rose knights.

The remaining capital soldiers retreated deeper into the palace, barred the heavy palace doors, and dug in, defending their last line of defense to the death.

Duke Rose led the charge on a black steed, surrounded by countless knights clad in rose battle robes.

They crushed everything in their path, unstoppable wherever they went.

Upon seeing the sealed palace gates, Duke Rose shouted his command: "Breach the gates! Bring the queen alive!"

Rumbling! A massive siege tower was pushed forward by dozens of burly men, beginning to pound against the palace doors.

The fall of the entire capital was only a matter of time—

On the palace's high terrace, Kaset served as the supreme commander, issuing orders from here.

But the gap in strength between friend and foe left Katherine utterly helpless.

The kingdom's army, accustomed to ease and luxury, lagged far behind the Rose legion and found it hard to hold the line.

Katherine could only repeatedly order her troops to retreat, fortify the palace, and hope to buy time.

She watched the palace doors groan under relentless impacts, her army's morale starting to crumble, the situation growing increasingly precarious.

Many kingdom soldiers began to panic, their grip on their swords faltering.

"Lord Katherine!!! "A scout rushed over frantically, knelt on one knee, and stammered, "The gates can't hold much longer. The Rose army will pour into the palace soon. Wha-what should we do now?!"

"Damn it! Is this really the end?!"

Katherine slammed her fist against the wall, frantically thinking of a countermeasure.

If she could, she would have loved to flee with the queen.

Defending the palace was pointless. As long as the queen lived, there was still a chance to rise again!

Just as Katherine was consumed by despair, the blue lake fairy emerged from somewhere unseen, soaring through the sky.

The lake fairy performed an eerie dance while ethereal incantations echoed across the heavens.

It seemed harmless, but behind this fairy churned a monstrous tidal wave!

"..........." Katherine felt that incomparable, overwhelming magical power. Her usually calm expression turned ashen, fear flickering across her features.

This was the royal family's trump card, the lake fairy!?

Such immense magical power was far beyond what any human could withstand!

No wonder His Majesty was so brazen. With combat power like this, who would dare disobey?

title: Chapter 43 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 43 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 11 · Chapter 43

As a magician, Katherine could feel the near-terrifying pressure from the lake fairy in the lake.

Especially that extremely ferocious water element, it made Katherine feel as if she were instantly in the deep sea!

This was the first time in Katherine's life that she had seen such a powerful monster; she was so frightened she couldn't even say a word.

It seemed that Britain could stand firm on this land for 400 years, and there must be some reliance for that.

With existences like the lake fairy at this level, other human kingdoms would probably also have trouble eating and sleeping.

"....Katherine-sama! ...What is this?! ! !" The scout beside her had already been scared out of her wits.

"What is it?" Katherine calmed down slightly and responded calmly, "That is the guardian deity of the royalty, our winning trump card!"

The lake fairy danced slowly in the air, ancient spells seeming like distant songs.

Behind it followed towering waves coming from all directions, converging together.

The water of the entire underground river became restless, surging out of the ground and following the fairy's movements toward the sky.

For a moment, the entire capital fell into the crisis of being flooded; houses began to collapse one after another, unable to withstand the torrent in the flood.

Many people who hadn't managed to escape struggled in the water, crying out in madness, even drifting with the current.

The entire Rose Army outside the palace gates were stunned, foolishly raising their heads, looking at that blue elf, while vast amounts of water gathered toward the sky.

Large amounts of water suddenly spread out, all flooding up to the knees of the Rose Army; many people, seeing this situation, fell into unease.

"Duke.... what is this? Feeling that something major is wrong!" The Rose Army's advisor shouted.

"Tsk! This is quite bad, I didn't expect the main clan to still have such an overwhelming weapon..." The Rose Duke dropped a cold sweat on his forehead.

Many mages in the Rose Army had pale faces; if the Duke hadn't given the order, they would have run long ago.

However, the Rose Duke was very unwilling; they had already reached the palace gates, and if they were forced to retreat like this, capturing the queen alive would become even more difficult.

Thus, the unwilling Rose Duke, seizing the moment, wanted to quickly rush into the palace and capture that fake queen.

"Don't be afraid! We still have time, hurry up, let's fight quickly!"

Although the Rose Knights receiving the order were afraid of the lake fairy in the sky, they still chose to forcefully strike the palace gate; the dull thuds had not stopped.

On the high platform, Katherine saw the Rose Duke being so obsessed and not retreating, and she curled her lip in disdain, "Even at a time like this, you don't want to run fast, still thinking of rushing in, truly extremely foolish!"

The lake fairy stopped dancing and hovered suspended directly above the palace; the surrounding torrential water had already begun to become restless.

She looked down from a high vantage point at the densely packed Rose family army below, narrowed her eyes, and seemed not to put this rabble in her eyes.

The lake fairy changed her hand sign, and immense Saint-tier magic power surged out; this pressure was frightening, seeming to have already surpassed the peak of Saint-tier! There was an indistinct trend of stepping into another level!

The flood from all directions suddenly rose, converging toward the lake fairy, gradually forming a huge water column connecting heaven and earth!

This spectacular scene made both sides present gaze at it.

Then the sky-piercing water column trembled and scattered, and a huge water demon suddenly appeared in the palace.

No wonder the lake fairy was classified as a magical beast; at this moment, its ferocious and terrifying form; there was no difference from a deformed magical beast!

Its upper body was human, bare-chested and exposed, its lower body was a snake, covered in scales, and its head was scattered with countless tentacles.

Its entire body glowed with a blue-green hue, seeming to be composed of the purest water element.

That enormous snake body almost circled the entire palace, protecting all the Queen's faction people.

After transforming, the lake fairy's pupils were crimson, staring at the Rose Army below, sticking out its tongue and constantly releasing pressure.

"Sigh....

The besieging army were all shocked, and no one dared to push the siege engines anymore; instead, they retreated in fear, wanting to stay far away from this huge water monster.

Seeing this scene, the Rose Duke immediately felt that something major was wrong; even he, an ordinary person, could feel that terror.

"Retreat! Full army retreat! ! !"

With the Duke's order, the entire army of five ten thousand men began to frantically move away from the palace; a black press of people, none had time to clear the battlefield.

The cavalry were fine; relying on warhorses, they could move quickly even in the water, but the infantry were very unfortunate; wading in water reaching their knees, their movements were slow.

"Sigh sigh.

The lake fairy made a sinister sound, raising her finger, and a high-pressure water sword instantly shot out!

title: Chapter 44 — Mobilization
content:
Chapter 44 — Mobilization

Volume 11 · Chapter 44

The news of the Rose Legion's crushing defeat at the hands of the lake sprites had spread everywhere.

The outcome of this campaign had been utterly unexpected. They had expected a resounding victory.

But the reality was that the Rose Legion suffered a devastating defeat — out of the full fifty-thousand-strong army, nearly thirty thousand had been killed or wounded!

Only twenty thousand soldiers managed to escape alive; the rest were either drowned or torn to shreds by the lake sprites!

The once-mighty Rose family had been severely crippled in this campaign, suffering a wound to its very bones and元气, making it nearly impossible to mount a second wave of attacks.

With that enormous serpent-shaped water demon coiled around the royal palace, it seemed futile to try again however many times.

After all, the power of the lake sprites was terrifyingly overwhelming,隐隐 surpassing the peak of Saint-tier, making it difficult to simply overwhelm them through sheer numbers.

Unless one was exceptionally well-equipped, with one thousand high-output magic cannons mounted, perhaps there might still be a chance.

But the cost of high-output magic cannons was absurdly exorbitant; even an entire empire might struggle to possess more than ten.

A prestigious family like the Rose family, even after emptying their entire treasury, apparently could not afford a single one.

However, ordinary magic cannons, they could certainly afford — like the one Captain Dennis had sunk to the bottom of the sea.

At this moment, inside the temporary command post set up with tents, the high-ranking officials of the Rose Legion and the Duke gathered together, discussing what to do next.

Merlin had also been invited to observe silently from the sidelines, sitting quietly in a corner and watching the situation unfold before him.

Although Merlin did not understand why Duke Rose wanted him to listen in, he had a vague feeling that some trouble would soon come knocking.

These officials no longer looked as splendid as they had at the beginning; all of them looked disheveled and battered from the retreat.

"Duke, what should we do now?" one subordinate asked.

"What else can we do? It's not safe to stay here for long. We should evacuate quickly. When the Kingdom's army counterattacks, we won't even have the chance to resist," another subordinate suggested, recommending a retreat, since they had suffered heavy losses and all the siege weapons they had brought were destroyed by the lake sprites.

Duke Rose's face was dark and silent. Although retreating was clearly the best option given the current situation, even if they returned to Wales, they would still be regarded as enemies of the empire, since power still rested in the hands of that fake queen.

"Everyone could see that water demon's strength for themselves, right? It is far beyond anything we could defeat. Our small force suffered heavy losses just from one exchange. Even if we organize more troops, they would just be marching to their deaths. Why don't we fall back to Wales and seek help from outside forces? There's still a chance to counterattack," one subordinate analyzed rationally, supporting the retreat proposal.

"Yes, if not for that bizarre water demon, we would have already breached the palace long ago. I never expected the royal family to have such a powerful trump card hidden away. To take down the fake empress, our preparations were still insufficient." An elderly subordinate then turned to ask Duke Rose, "Duke, what is your opinion?"

Duke Rose's face was grim, clearly in a terrible mood. The dire situation left him somewhat at a loss.

"For now, let's adjourn. Let me consider it a bit longer."

Duke Rose was silent for a long while before giving the reply that they would discuss it again, feeling that they should seek outside support.

Upon hearing this, the subordinates rose and left the tent one by one, expressions somewhat dejected.

Merlin, who was afraid of trouble, also rose and planned to slip away quietly, not wanting to be drawn deeper into the chaos.

However, Duke Rose spoke first. "Lord Merlin, please wait. Could we sit down and talk?"

"...

Merlin's steps froze, a vague sense of ill omens stirring.

Given the special circumstances, it seemed like someone was coming to make demands!

But Merlin still gave the Duke a bit of face, so he awkwardly sat across from him.

"What would you like to discuss?"

"... " Duke Rose paused, his expression turning friendly, even somewhat flattering. "I know that Lord Merlin is extremely powerful, comparable to the Thorn Knight. A talent like yourself is rare nowadays, and I think you understand that strength and responsibility go hand in hand, so..."

"I refuse!" Merlin interrupted Duke Rose bluntly, and he didn't need to hear the rest to know what was coming.

"Um, Lord Merlin, I haven't finished yet..." Duke Rose's expression grew awkward.

"No need to say more. I know what you mean." Merlin paused and continued, "You definitely want me to go deal with that water demon and lend a hand."

"That's not it, Lord Merlin. I actually want to ask your wife, Alice..." Duke Rose corrected Merlin's wandering thoughts.

" Hmm!? " Merlin immediately furrowed his brows, surprised that he had misunderstood.

After all, Alice was the invincible powerhouse; she could only be considered his little sidekick. She was still far from it, but Alice's adventurer rank was higher than his, so her strength must be above his as well. Therefore, he wanted to ask him to put in a good word, hoping Merlin could act as a messenger and convey the request.

Duke Rose laid out his plan: Although Lord Merlin was also extremely powerful, when it came to dealing with that water demon, he felt that Lord Alice could help them out. He believed that based on her strength, she could fight that water demon.

Merlin's face darkened. He felt he was being looked down upon, so he slowly stood up.

"I apologize, Your Grace. The purpose of our trip is only to protect Michelle. And I already saved your life once in the royal capital. I've helped you more than enough. Dragging us into even deeper trouble is something I simply cannot accept."

Merlin angrily swept his sleeves and left, declining Duke Rose's request.

In truth, if Merlin couldn't defeat the water demon, there was no way Alice could. The illusion that Alice was stronger than Merlin was deeply rooted in people's minds.

In fact, Merlin's demeanor in front of Duke Rose had been strong enough. Yet he always felt inexplicably mistaken for a woman-mantaining-idler.

Merlin never wanted to meddle in other people's affairs to begin with, and now he was even less willing to do so.

Duke Rose probably didn't even realize himself that Merlin was the real heavy hitter.

Since the situation was still unclear and Michelle had not yet fully recovered, they could not leave the encampment for the time being.

So Merlin and Alice had not yet completed this mission, and the money could not be collected yet.

Back in the tent, Merlin saw Alice sitting on the bed, looking as though she were deep in thought. But she still needed several more days of recuperation.

After the Rose Legion's priests had treated her, Alice's complexion had improved considerably.

"How are you feeling? Much better?"

Merlin walked over and sat by Alice's bedside, asking cautiously.

Alice startled back to reality and curiously glanced at Merlin beside her, her expression shifting.

What's wrong with this guy?

Didn't he say he wouldn't know how to take care of me?

Why is he suddenly being so caring? Anything out of the ordinary must have an ulterior motive~

Has he done something bad again?

title: Chapter 45 — Monthly Ticket Updates
content:
Chapter 45 — Monthly Ticket Updates

Volume 11 · Chapter 45

"Did you do something guilty outside, you bastard?" Alice wore an interrogating expression.

"Who did something guilty?" Merlin pursed his lips.

Alice found it hard to understand Merin's tsundere ways and couldn't help squinting her eyes as she asked.

"Weren't you the one who said yesterday you'd rather die than take care of me? Why are you suddenly so warm and eager all of a sudden?"

Merlin paused, then put on a pensive expression. "I was just asking casually, I didn't mean anything else. Once your health recovers we can quickly leave this troubled land."

"Hmph!" Alice immediately pursed her lips and answered in an indignant tone. "I'm already much better, I can walk on my own. You don't need to worry about me blindly, hmph~!"

Merlin nodded and proposed, "Then that's good. Let's get our payment quickly and return to Lexem tomorrow. I feel like things here are getting worse and worse."

"Well..." Alice looked at Merlin, her expression hesitant. "That's not good, is it?"

"What's not good about it? Can't you see it yourself? Things here are getting more and more chaotic — the Empress and that Duke Rose are tearing each other apart. We're right at the center of the conflict. To avoid getting involved in trouble, it would be better to leave sooner rather than later," Merlin said in a very serious tone.

"We can't leave just yet because the matter hasn't been resolved. If that fake queen isn't overthrown, Michelle will remain in constant danger. We can't just abandon her," Alice retorted, clearly disapproving of Merlin's irresponsible suggestion.

"Miss, do you even understand our current situation? Duke Rose's side has obviously started showing weakness. We should cut ties with Michelle and get out of here quickly, otherwise endless trouble will land on your head and mine," Merlin frowned, not wanting to be dragged into this murky water.

"That's being too heartless, isn't it? Are you going to let Michelle die without helping her? Cold..." Alice furrowed her delicate brows and complained.

Merlin looked a bit uncomfortable and reasoned patiently, "I admit I'm a bit cold-blooded, but from the standpoint of our own interests, cutting and running is the best choice."

"No, I don't agree. Since we promised to protect Michelle, we should carry it through to the end," Alice said stubbornly.

Merlin immediately rolled his eyes. He felt he and Alice were simply not on the same wavelength.

If not for the need to pay off their debts together, they probably would never have crossed paths in this lifetime.

Merlin was a typical realistic egoist, while Alice was an idealist; their minds would always clash greatly.

"Your Highness Michelle came to see me just now and we had a talk," Alice suddenly blurted out.

Merlin's eyes widened as he asked in surprise, "What did she talk to you about?"

"She hopes I'll eliminate the water demon that's entrenched above the royal palace," Alice disclosed the core of her conversation with Michelle just now without hiding anything.

Merlin's expression instantly turned strange. He didn't believe it was Michelle's idea to come seek Alice's help; this had to be Duke Rose's instigation.

Damn it, this Duke Rose is pulling strings on both sides!?

He was not only instigating him over here, but also having Michelle come do Alice's ideological work over there.

It seems this situation means he's determined to get Alice to help!

Merlin felt the other party was targeting Alice because this little justice guardian was relatively easy to reason with, which is why he was being so proactive.

"Alice, stay calm. You didn't agree, did you?"

"Yes, I agreed," Alice nodded, being very honest.

"Hiss~"

Merlin sucked in a cold breath and immediately pressed a hand to his forehead.

He thought: I knew it! This Alice girl is simply too naive!

Why is she so easy to talk into things!? Can't she just properly refuse!?

Merlin calmed his emotions a bit, harboring strong objections toward this spendthrift wife of his.

"Why can't you properly refuse? Wouldn't this just be taking trouble upon yourself?"

"Be...cause..." Alice hesitated, then said with a completely serious expression, "Because Her Highness Michelle is so pitiful. She said the current queen is her aunt, and treats her terribly, like a cold, indifferent stranger. Her biological mother seems to have already been harmed. If she can't overthrow her aunt's rule, Her Highness Michelle will be in terrible shape — she might be harmed or forced to wander outside forever. With such a background, isn't she deserving of sympathy?"

"...Just because of sympathy, you agreed to take this on?! ... Merlin was nearly气晕ed by this justice little guardian. He felt this was absolutely a useless teammate who ran toward danger wherever it was.

"Yes, Her Highness Michelle is so pitiful. We can't just leave her alone." Since we accepted the quest, we have to help to the very end. We can't give up halfway!" Alice said with a straight face.

Merlin looked at Alice's forthright appearance and was instantly at a loss for words, his eyes nearly blinded by her saintly aura.

"Alright, you win. Then go handle that unknown water demon above the palace. I won't stop you."

"Eh? I still have injuries right now. Isn't it within your ability to kill that water demon?" Alice's gaze drifted toward Merlin's face.

"Huh!? Why are you so shamelessly shoving the trouble onto me? You agreed to it — you go do it, I'm not going!" Merlin shot Alice a withering look.

"This isn't just my business either. This quest is worth 700,000 gold coins — that includes my share too, doesn't it? We've only gotten half so far. If we don't help Michelle overthrow her aunt's rule, that half is gone," Alice countered Merlin.

"Tsk tsk tsk! You talk a good game. How many times has even 100 gold coins actually ended up in my hands? Even if I went scavenging for trash I'd earn more than this~" Merlin said with a thoroughly dissatisfied sneer.

"Well..." Alice's face flushed red and she said somewhat guiltily, "Aren't all your daily clothing, food, housing, and transportation covered by our shared property? Moreover, you still owe me 50,000 from my private stash! And if it weren't for you robbing my inherited Mithril Armor back then, would things have come to this?!"

"..." Merlin's expression darkened and he asked perplexed, "You damn bastard, why do you get so shrewd whenever money comes up? Calculating more clearly than anyone else?"

"For living, already. We're on the verge of being unable to put food on the table. Every bit we can earn is something," a trace of a homemaker's melancholy appeared on Alice's face.

"But you shouldn't go looking for trouble either? Get out of here quickly. It's obvious there's no future in跟着 Duke Rose." Merlin said pragmatically.

"We can't extricate ourselves anymore, and there's no choice," Alice said earnestly.

"Why?" Merlin grew somewhat puzzled.

"Because we killed the Thorn Knight. If Duke Rose fails in his rebellion, do you think that queen will let the two of us go? But if Duke Rose succeeds, our situation will be completely different — we'd be heroes restoring the legitimate line~" Alice held up her thumb, as if she hadn't merely been careless but had actually given some serious thought to their escape route.

Upon hearing this, Merlin found Alice's words somewhat reasonable. Now both he and Alice were criminals who had killed the Thorn Knight. To avoid trouble, they had to assist Duke Rose in weeding out the opposition. Damn it, had this Alice girl already had this line of reasoning prepared all along!?

"Merlin, I'm begging you, this is the first time I've ever begged you..." Alice pouted prettily, her big eyes welling with unshed tears, looking utterly pitiful.

"Pfft!" Merlin couldn't bear to look at Alice directly, averting his gaze and pressing his hand to his forehead in exasperation.

"That's enough, you stinking woman, stop acting cute with me."

"Disgusting, just like a stray dog. Not cute at all..."
