title: Chapter 46 — Bloom
content:
Chapter 46 — Bloom

Volume 11 · Chapter 46

Due to the lake spirit, the water in the entire underground river system began to churn restlessly.

Massive amounts of water began surging to the surface, and the ground started to collapse in various places.

Fierce currents surged wildly, with many people being swept along helplessly by the waves.

The royal capital, already not fully reconstructed, sank into an even more dilapidated state.

Methusfield had already broken free from her sealing collar and was moving swiftly across the rooftops toward the palace.

The water wasn't particularly deep yet—barely one story high. If they organized quickly enough, it might still be possible to do something about it.

Methusfield looked at the lake spirit looming over the palace in the distance, its enormous body sheerly terrifying.

There was also an overwhelming pressure in the air—enough that even Methusfield could feel a slight difficulty breathing.

This is really bad....

What would it matter even if the queen could hold the royal capital's last line of defense?

Without the support of her subjects, wouldn't she just be an empty shell?! And to risk destroying the entire imperial capital in a single day—this approach was far too ruthless!

Methusfield found it hard to imagine the queen doing something like this. Recalling Michelle's doubts about Her Majesty, her loyalty to the queen began to waver.

The old Elizabeth had always been kinder—she would absolutely never make such a ruthless choice. She would definitely prioritize protecting other people's lives rather than pressing forward blindly for her own benefit!

Methusfield decided to use force to confront the queen and get answers to the questions troubling her heart.

Along the way, Methusfield kept diving down to rescue anyone who fell into the water, keeping her utterly occupied.

Though her efforts felt like a drop in the bucket, it was better than doing nothing at all.

The lake spirit circling above the palace turned its cold gaze sharply toward Methusfield, like a fierce predator that had locked onto prey.

Methusfield's breath caught. Cold sweat beaded on her forehead, and she was uncertain whether she would be attacked.

The lake spirit glanced at Methusfield for a moment, then lost interest and looked away. It sensed no hostility from this human and deemed her harmless.

As long as the Rose Legion outside the capital did not withdraw, the lake spirit had no intention of leaving. It would continue guarding the palace until it was safe.

Methusfield breathed a slight sigh of relief. If the lake spirit saw her as a threat, the consequences would be unthinkable.

Catherine, who was guarding the high platform, noticed Methusfield and couldn't believe this person had escaped.

"Tch, what a troublesome one, showing up at a time like this...."

"Cath-er-ine!! !"

Methusfield roared in fury, drew the straight sword at her waist, channeled Saint-tier battle energy, and struck fiercely at Catherine.

But Catherine remained completely unfazed, making no move at all, a scornful smile playing on her lips.

The straight sword struck the suddenly appearing magic shield, and battle energy collided instantly with magic power!

"Hmph, drawing your sword right away? Seems like being locked up for so long hasn't taught you any sense, has it?"

Catherine said with a cold sneer.

"Why go to such lengths?! The entire capital has been destroyed!" Methusfield relentlessly hammered the magic shield with her sword, attempting to break through Catherine's defenses.

"This is all the Queen's will. It is none of your business to complain," Catherine replied dismissively.

"Why didn't you stop Her Majesty? Don't you understand the consequences of summoning the Lake Spirit!?" Methusfield demanded, unwilling to yield.

"I only need to obey. To interfere with Her Majesty's will the way you did is treason," Catherine said disdainfully.

"Where is the Queen? I have many things I want to ask her." Methusfield's expression turned cold as anger surged within her.

"If you wish to see Her Majesty, very well—if you can defeat me—"

Before Catherine could finish her sentence, Methusfield's golden battle energy suddenly exploded, amplifying the force of her strike dramatically!

Catherine was taken aback and was forcibly knocked off the high platform by Methusfield's assault, plummeting straight down!

Methusfield's eyes blazed with intensity. Seizing the momentum, she followed, leaping off the platform. Boundless battle energy surged into her straight sword as she aimed to defeat Catherine in midair.

"Truly ruthless, Winther."

Catherine smiled faintly, pointing her wand at the ground beneath her as Saint-tier magic power erupted thunderously.

Although Catherine specialized in barrier magic and excelled at defense—easily outmaneuvering her enemies—

it did not mean she could not fight without barriers. She herself possessed great talent and造诣 in magic, and was incredibly unpredictable; she herself was a mobile magical barrier.

Many barrier spells required advance preparation, sometimes needing multiple mages to operate them together to take effect.

But Catherine didn't need any of that. She could complete all barrier magic alone, and it was instantaneous—no incantations or hand seals required at all.

"Forest Boundary: Giant Tree Guardian."

The moment the words left her lips, colossal ancient trees erupted from the earth beneath Catherine, their thick trunks and dense foliage appearing as though transplanted from an ancient forest.

Catherine landed softly on the lush branches unharmed and looked up at Methusfield, who was coming down from the sky like a killing storm.

The enormous ancient tree thrust its thick vines skyward, striking at Methusfield mercilessly.

"Cough—!"

Methusfield screamed in agony as she was sent flying backward like a cannonball, crashing heavily into a blue-gray stone wall and sending clouds of dust exploding into the air!

Catherine stood atop the ancient tree, smiling down at the devastation below, a cold laugh escaping her—

"I told you. Even though your rank is first, there are still those stronger than you."

"For example—"

"Me?"

Just as the two Thorn Knights continued to trade blows relentlessly—

Merlin suddenly ventured deep into the royal capital alone, intending to defeat the lake spirit directly.

Although Merlin was a landlubber who couldn't swim, moving across the rooftops was no problem at all.

As long as she reached the palace grounds, it would become safe—after all, no matter how powerful the lake spirit was, it couldn't flood the palace itself.

Merlin knew her own weaknesses, so she decided to end this quickly without dragging it out.

Whenever she faced water-elemental mages or monsters, she would always be very cautious. She couldn't afford to make a mistake here.

The oppressive presence in the air surprised Merlin a bit, causing her to instinctively observe that water demon.

Though it was difficult to determine the lake spirit's exact species, its powerful aura slightly surpassed even the Phantom Flame Oni from before!

Merlin was somewhat interested in eliminating this water demon, but if she truly killed this lake spirit, it might bring even more trouble.

After all, this was the empire's foundation—Britain's hidden reserve, the trump card used to establish their footing in the human world.

If Merlin killed the lake spirit, Michelle or the royal family would likely pursue her to the death, showing no mercy.

Though Merlin didn't fear this trouble, the thought of it triggering a series of butterfly effects made her feel restless.

So Merlin flipped her katana 180 degrees, intending to defeat the lake spirit rather than kill it.

The lake spirit circling over the palace seemed to sense the hostility, its gaze locking onto Merlin as she closed in at tremendous speed.

Without hesitation, it extended its arm and fired a high-pressure water blade, aiming to eliminate Merlin mid-flight.

However, the high-pressure water blade dissipated entirely upon approaching Merlin, automatically splitting into two streams that swept across other areas instead.

Merlin's magic immunity was still effective, which caught the lake spirit's attention.

It immediately launched two more high-pressure water blades, but the result was identical.

"Useless. Stop wasting your strength now!"

Merlin shouted loudly, leaping into the air and charging toward the lake spirit suspended overhead.

A flicker of panic flashed in the lake spirit's eyes as it brought both hands together, unleashing a super-large high-pressure water blade ten times more powerful than before!

Hiss hiss hiss!

The piercing sound vibrated through the air as the super-large high-pressure water blade swept nearly everything in its path with devastating, unstoppable force—as though splitting the earth itself!

Merlin remained calm and composed, charging straight through the super-large high-pressure water blade until she reached the lake spirit's face.

Such a powerful water blade—yet it had absolutely no effect on him!?

Merlin drew her sword in one swift motion and slashed down—

The lake spirit's head exploded on the spot, split cleanly in two! PS■

title: Chapter 47 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 47 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 11 · Chapter 47

The lake fairy's head was directly chopped apart by Merlin; it looked quite powerful, but turned out rather fragile.
Merlin hovered in midair, thinking, "Damn it! Is this water sprite's body really this fragile?"
Normally, Merlin's strike would at most heavily wound the lake fairy, not cause such a bloody decapitation.
Merlin turned his head in surprise, and saw a rather bizarre scene.
The lake fairy's head was indeed blown apart, but its body was actually composed of a large amount of water elements.
Therefore it wasn't dead; the exploded head scattered into countless droplets that clung to the surroundings, as if pulled by some force.
"...Not the real body?" Merlin frowned, drawing that conclusion, feeling that this huge water sprite, though it had inherited power, was actually a manufactured creature.
The countless droplets scattered around began to frenziedly coalesce, and in an instant restored the blown-apart head completely.
The lake fairy seemed to realize its magic had no effect, so it quickly reached out and grabbed Merlin in midair.
"Huh?!" Merlin was instantly seized in the giant's palm.
The lake fairy opened its huge mouth and, without hesitation, swallowed Merlin whole with a "gulping" sound, sending him into its belly, then licked its fingers.
Deep inside the lake fairy's belly, Merlin suddenly felt as if he were in the deep sea.
His inability to swim became apparent; he felt difficulty breathing, and waves of dizziness assaulted his consciousness.
Merlin desperately flailed his arms, trying to rise and burst out of the water sprite's mouth.
But the result was that he only sank deeper, continually descending into darkness.
The lake fairy's interior seemed highly corrosive; Merlin's clothes dissolved instantly inside, leaving him completely naked.
Although Merlin possessed immense strength on land, in water he was like a different person, unable to exert any force.
Unable to bear the suffocating sensation, Merlin spat out a string of bubbles from his mouth and slowly sank into darkness.
Like trash drifting with the current, he didn't know where the water had carried him.
The lake fairy's massive body was connected to the entire underground river, allowing it to draw endless power or even be reborn.
As long as the underground river didn't dry up, or its true body remained unharmed, it was nearly invincible.
Below the open ground.
Catherine raised her head to watch the lake fairy that had swallowed the enemy; she had witnessed everything that had just happened.
Just who was that man? He actually came alone to deal with the lake fairy?
And he could scatter the lake fairy's head—surely he wasn't a weakling.
But he certainly didn't know the lake fairy was immortal, so he suffered a great loss.
Surely that man, inside the lake fairy's belly, would have his facial bones corroded away completely.
Catherine faintly sensed something, thinking that the man just now was the Rose Duke's strongest trump card hidden up his sleeve, and yet she had come here to throw away her life.
"Heh, truly an overconfident man, daring to provoke the lake fairy? He deserves to die, serves him right~"
From the dust on the opposite side, a golden light shot out—Mersfield's straight sword thrust forth, brimming with strong fighting spirit.
With a swoosh, the sound of tearing air rang out; the wooden guardian was suddenly cut in half at the waist, and the barrier magic was destroyed.
Mersfield emerged from the swirling dust, flicked his hand, and his straight sword flew back to his grip, rushing straight toward Catherine.
"Catherine, where is the king?!" or牡小 said
"You abandoned wretch, even if you knew where His Majesty is, what could you do about it?"
Catherine waved her wand—"Sea Realm: Guardian Spirit J Water System Barrier" instantly activated.
A strand of deep blue liquid appeared before Catherine, seeming alive, swirling around her.
This barrier magic belonged to the defensive type; it could sense and block swift attacks, dissipating all force like rubber.
Mersfield's sword thrust into the guardian spirit, feeling like a mud cow entering the sea—at first causing no ripples, it was restrained by it.
But speaking purely of pressure, Mersfield was stronger than Catherine; how could he be so easily restrained?
Mersfield's golden fighting spirit blazed like flames outside his body, boiling, and his straight sword trembled slightly in his hand.
I saw Mersfield attempt to pierce the defensive guardian spirit; if Catherine hadn't dodged quickly, that sword would have surely earned him a marquessate.
Yet Catherine was still shaken; her cheek was grazed by the sword, and strands of blood trickled down her face.
Catherine touched her injured cheek, looked at the blood on her hand, and fell into a daze.
"Winsha, are you serious?"
"Where is the queen?!" Mersfield only wanted to see Isabella.
"Don't ask anymore; now you're in an irrational state, I won't let you see His Majesty."
Catherine's face changed—the liquid guardian spirit instantly became agitated, like a hedgehog sprouting spikes.
Mersfield drew his sword and retreated step by step, clutching his abdomen, seemingly also sustaining some minor injury.
Catherine waved her wand again; the water system barrier was absorbed by the wood system barrier, precisely speaking, the two barrier magics were fused.
The wooden guardian, severed at the waist, absorbed the power of the guardian spirit, instantly revived, and stood upright once more behind Catherine.
The trees, nourished by water, grew even sturdier than before; though their size didn't match the lake fairy's, they still required one to look up, full of vitality.
The two barrier magics complemented each other, multiplying their attack power.
"Winsha, I advise you to be more careful— because a little carelessness will cost you your life!"
Vines burst forth from the wooden guardian, covering the sky and earth, shooting out like lightning whips, their speed several times faster than before.
"Tsk!" Mersfield felt a bead of cold sweat trickle down his forehead, silently gripping his sword tighter....
The winding, twisting underground river.
The rushing water continuously scoured the rock walls on both sides, endlessly supplying power to the lake fairy.
The entire hollow underground structure was already in chaos, constantly on the verge of collapse.
No one knew how much water the underground lake contained; under the drive of magic, it kept rising, and flooding the royal capital was merely a matter of time.
Stark naked, Merlin continually struggled in the torrent; after being swallowed by the lake fairy, he was actually flushed straight down into the underground!
Merlin intensely disliked his adrift state; he spotted a hole, braced his katana against it to steady himself.
He looked around; aside from the dim light, it seemed safe, so without further thought, using the katana as a brace, he managed to get ashore.
Upon reaching land, Merlin began to vomit; he didn't know how much water he'd swallowed, his belly was bloated, his head swam.
He looked rather disheveled, soaked through, with no clothing at all, and a strand of water grass stuck in his hair~
Having vomited enough, Merlin leaned against the cave wall, began to catch his breath.
Indeed, not knowing how to swim is a real pain.....
He wasn't killed by a curse, but he nearly drowned.
Damn, I should figure out a way to rig a life buoy for myself.
Actually, Merlin's body had already become quite abnormal; a normal person eaten by the lake fairy would have been completely digested in its belly.
But Merlin, aside from his clothes being corroded, his body suffered no harm at all; anyone seeing him would find it unbelievable.
Merlin didn't want to linger; he wanted to leave quickly, because the place looked like it could flood and collapse at any moment.
However, while Merlin was looking around, he noticed a faint light flickering deep in the cave.
No way?
There's still someone living here.

title: Chapter 48 — Monthly Vote Extra Chapter
content:
Chapter 48 — Monthly Vote Extra Chapter

Volume 11 · Chapter 48

Merlin sensed that the place was precariously unstable, but he guessed this must be somewhere underground within the palace; otherwise, the water would have already flooded in.

He was quite curious about the faint light in the distance, so he got up and made his way deeper into the cavern.

Merlin's footsteps were very light, and going barefoot, he barely made any sound at all. As he drew closer, the scene inside gradually became clear.

A golden-haired woman was dipping a quill into ink and scribbling furiously on a sheet of cowhide paper.

Elizabeth was fully absorbed in her task, with an air of deep worry on her face, giving the impression that she was troubled.

Merlin frowned tightly, and as he neared the dungeon cell deeper inside, her features became clearer and clearer, giving him a strange sense of familiarity — as though he had seen her before.

Huh? Why does this woman look so familiar?

It feels like I've met her somewhere... where was it again?

Merlin thought hard, then suddenly widened his eyes. The woman's face gradually overlapped with that of the Empire's queen.

Although Merlin had never met the queen in person, he had seen her on various broadcasts — they were virtually identical.

No way, isn't this the British queen?!

Why is she locking herself in a cage?

What kind of weird kink is this?!

Merlin didn't quite understand what was going on, but after a moment's thought, something felt off.

This place was becoming more and more dangerous — only a fool would lock himself in a cage and wait to die!

According to what Michelle had said, perhaps this was the real....

Elizabeth felt that her time was running short, so she had already begun writing her last will, needing to settle matters for the future.

She didn't know if it could ever be delivered, but it was better than doing nothing and waiting to die.

Elizabeth was mostly worried about her daughter Michelle, and in her will she kept begging Isabella to let her go.

But just as the atmosphere was perfectly quiet, Merlin suddenly couldn't help but make a sound.

"Ahem!"

Elizabeth was startled, stopped writing, and looked in surprise at the outside of the cage.

There stood Merlin, completely naked, shivering slightly in the cold breeze, his bare cheeks trembling.

His sturdy figure resembled a tall, straight pine tree, and his inverted-triangle build was quite eye-catching.

If this were a bodybuilding competition, there would be a whole crowd cheering and clapping.

But in the current situation, it had a strangely shameless feel to it, as if he were saying —

「Just you wait until I get out of here, I'll rough you up!」JPG

Elizabeth hadn't seen anyone other than her older sister in a long time, especially not a man.

Seeing Merlin standing there stark naked and radiating strong masculine energy, Elizabeth felt her face grow warm.

The scene at that moment had reached an extreme level of weirdness — a bare-bottomed man gazing at a flushed mature woman inside the cage.

This was the kind of suggestive scene that, honestly, might make quite a few people think of prison-themed adult videos.

Elizabeth's daze was brief. Finding the man outside the cage rather indecent, her gaze drifted downward.

She barely looked and was nearly scared out of her wits — Merlin's large member was hanging there, completely unhidden!

Elizabeth's eyes nearly rolled back, and she almost fainted from fright, as though she could hear cows lowing!

Her composed face flushed bright red all the way to her ears, her expression turning panicked, and the quill in her hand snapped with a "crack!"

Elizabeth hurriedly covered her eyes with both hands and lowered her head. Merlin was acting so calm that he was making her feel embarrassed.

"Y-you..."

"Ma'am, I have a question."

Merlin bent the bars of the cage and stepped inside without ceremony, wanting to have a proper conversation.

But seeing Merlin walk in completely bare-bottomed made Elizabeth even more frightened! It was as if she'd been struck by lightning!

A naked man suddenly appearing was already frightening enough, and the cage had been Elizabeth's only source of safety.

She never expected the cage to be so fragile in front of this perverted man — it had been destroyed so easily!

Elizabeth was completely dumbfounded. If Merlin wanted to go insane and plant his seeds, she, as an ordinary person, would have no way to resist!

Especially Merlin's swinging member between his legs, which Elizabeth could barely bring herself to look at!

"Aaaahhh!"

Elizabeth let out a scream, her face drained of color, her whole body shaking like a sieve, and she collapsed onto the ground.

She kept backing away, putting distance between herself and Merlin, terrified of suffering some humiliation.

She now suspected that Merlin was sent by her sister to disgrace her, and she was on the verge of a breakdown!

Elizabeth curled herself up in fear, her lips trembling constantly, like a frightened rabbit.

"W-what... what are you?!"

"Wh-why are you completely naked... what do you want?!"

"Pl-please don't do anything reckless, I... I'll fight back!"

Seeing Elizabeth's fierce resistance, Merlin felt awkward inside. He wondered: do I really look like some kind of pile-driving machine that scatters seeds everywhere without sparing a single field?!

"St-stay away from me! Or or... or I won't be polite!" Elizabeth tried her best to act tough, hoping to scare off this uninvited guest, but her voice lacked conviction.

Seeing the other party so terrified by his presence, Merlin couldn't just ignore it — that would be far too disrespectful to women.

Merlin looked around and spotted cowhide paper on a table, so he shamelessly took it to cover himself.

"Cough, please calm down, ma'am. I'm not a bad person, and I don't intend to do anything to you."

"You burst in completely naked and say you're not a bad person?!"

Elizabeth wore an expression of utter disbelief, but after Merlin covered himself with the cowhide paper, they could at least勉强 have a normal conversation.

That said, Merlin was using Elizabeth's will — something originally very important — to cover his crotch!

"It... it's a long story." Merlin didn't want to explain what had just happened because it was complicated. "Beautiful lady, please calm down first. I just want to ask — are you truly the Empress? And the queen outside is actually Michelle's aunt?"

Upon hearing this, Elizabeth froze abruptly. These were top secrets — how could this suddenly bursting-in naked man know about them? And how did he know about Michelle?!

She felt extremely puzzled by the mysterious man before her, unable to fathom his identity, yet he knew such important secrets.

"Who are you? How could you possibly know these things?"

Merlin read Elizabeth's reaction and instantly understood almost everything — this woman in front of him was the real queen.

He had originally thought being flushed into the sewer was bad luck, but instead he'd stumbled upon a treasure. Merlin quickly began calculating in his mind.

He felt that if he could rescue the real queen, it seemed like the whole matter could be resolved.

And saving a queen would count as a significant merit — even killing the Thorn Knight probably wouldn't be a big problem, right?

After that, he only needed to deal with the lake fairy and bring in Duke Rose — then everything would be over.

He and Alice wouldn't cause any trouble, and they would receive a large sum of money to go home. It was practically a foolproof plan!

Merlin suddenly felt a rush of exhilaration, like green fields beyond dark willows. In an instant, he had made up his mind, and his expression turned serious.

"Hello, my name is Merlin. I'm an adventurer hired by Her Highness Michelle, from Rexham. I'm not a suspicious person at all."

"I... why should I trust you?" Elizabeth was somewhat swayed, mainly because Merlin's first impression was terrible — who would believe a guy streaking around naked? Moreover, Merlin claimed to be an adventurer but had no adventurer credential whatsoever — he was completely an unregistered person!

In truth, Merlin was also quite frustrated. His Iron-tier adventurer credential had been melted by the lake fairy, and he would need to get a new one back in Rexham. For now, he couldn't prove his identity.

But Merlin figured he still had information — matching it up should prove he wasn't some creepy naked streaker.

"Her Highness Michelle has already told us about your situation. Because of a pendant, she suspects that the current queen is actually her aunt Isabella, so she went to Wales seeking the help of Duke Rose. Her Highness Michelle is currently staying in the garrison camp outside the capital, so I am not your enemy. Please trust me." Merlin paused, then added, "And besides, given the current situation, you really have no choice but to trust me."

Elizabeth fell into deep thought. She found that what Merlin said completely matched the secret information she possessed. Unless Michelle herself had told them, it would be hard to explain — could this... pervert-like man actually be here to rescue her?!

"Come, I will take you out of here. Trust me — there's only one chance." Merlin held out his hand to the queen on the ground, while his other hand covered his crotch with cowhide paper, his katana tucked under his arm, looking rather disheveled.

Elizabeth looked into Merlin's eyes and hesitated for a moment.

She felt that although the man before her was rather disreputable, it seemed she had no choice but to bet on him.

So Elizabeth bit her silver lip, placed her small hand in Merlin's, fully expressing her trust.

One would think an Empress of an Empire would hesitate before placing her hand in that of a mysterious naked streaker — she was taking enormous trust risk and pressure.

Merlin smiled, feeling things were going smoothly, and pulled Elizabeth up from the ground with force.

Elizabeth swallowed nervously and couldn't help but urge, "S-so, Lord Merlin, shall we leave quickly?"

"Wait, hold on a moment. You can see that my current state is quite improper, so I'd like to ask..." Merlin's expression was awkward. He pursed his lips and asked solemnly, "Do you happen to have any men's clothes I could borrow?"

"Clothes? W-we have some..."

Elizabeth nodded, lifted her skirt, and ran to the wardrobe in the dungeon to dig around for a while.

In fact, Isabella hadn't treated her sister too badly, and many of the clothes were brand new.

They were almost on par with the规格 Elizabeth had when she was queen — every garment was expensive and beautiful.

Elizabeth held four or five pieces of clothing and came to Merlin, asking tentatively.

"Lord Merlin, do you... do you think these will work?"

"Uh, well..." Merlin looked at the colorful, gorgeous dresses in Elizabeth's arms, his expression suddenly darkening. Looking somewhat uncomfortable, he asked, "Um... cough! Is there absolutely no men's clothing here?!"

title: Chapter 49 — Escape
content:
Chapter 49 — Escape

Volume 11 · Chapter 49

Merlin looked at the colorful skirt in Elizabeth's hand with a complex expression, completely refusing to touch it.
He felt the world's malice, always some troublesome people wanting him to wear a little skirt!
Damn! Can't I escape this calamity?
I am a man straighter than steel!
A man determined to break all female‑wear flags! Don't even think of making me comply!
Merlin felt awkward inside, his gaze drifting, though he wanted to consider the special situation, he still refused to wear such things.
Elizabeth seemed to see Merlin's difficulty, so she awkwardly said, “Usually only I live here, no men come, how could there be men's clothing?”
Merlin immediately rolled his eyes, thinking Elizabeth's words were fine; being singly imprisoned couldn't possibly involve men's clothing.
If I really wore this colorful skirt, wouldn't I look like that Asmodeus fellow?
Am I the great Demon Lord of the first hall, and should I start a female‑wear career with Asmodeus as an idol?
What a joke, let me die instead!
Merlin covered his face, awkwardly unable to speak, thinking about taking Elizabeth to escape; would it really be okay to go naked like that?
“Maybe… maybe we should try?” Elizabeth probed, handing the clothing forward.
........
Merlin thought of another way, taking a red skirt.
Someone might think Merlin would stoically wear it, but no, he definitely wouldn't do that.
“...I won't.” Elizabeth shook her head.
Not an intention to exchange this relative's SF light novel.
Sshla one
Merlin tore the red skirt, then quickly wrapped it around his waist, turning it into an apron.
From afar, it still had a bit of a Spartan warrior vibe.
Although it was an apron, it could at least somewhat avoid the awkwardness of female wear.
Merlin felt it was enough, so he walked to the prison gate and waved at Elizabeth—
“Your Majesty, let's go.”
The entire hollow ground below was restless.
The lake water rushed, its impact on the walls sounding like a muffled thunder.
Normally water flows downward, but under the pull of fairy magic etched in the lake, it was moving upward.
The two reached the cave mouth, and the black darkness ahead made the path hard to see; even the only spiral staircase was washed away.
Merlin found it troublesome, unable to find an evacuation route for the time being.
Although Merlin could simply rush out with his power, the underground river environment made him hesitant to act recklessly.
If he accidentally drew more lake water, the non‑swimmer Merlin would find himself at a disadvantage.
“Your Majesty, do you only know this place?”
“Hmm?” Elizabeth thought, “I still know it fairly well.”
“Do you know where we can safely exit?” Merlin asked again.
“There’s only one path here, but there’s also a place connecting to the palace’s dry well; we might leave from there.” Elizabeth thought, looked around, saw a bright light at the opposite top, “It must be there!”
Merlin followed Elizabeth's line of sight, fixed his gaze on the light above, deciding to escape upward from there.
“So offended…”
Merlin turned and embraced Elizabeth, wrapping his arms around her legs, holding her in his arms.
Elizabeth initially shouted, her delicate body trembling, seeming somewhat uneasy about Merlin's bare upper body.
Although Merlin's lower body was covered by the apron, his bare arms still looked quite unsightly.
But Elizabeth saw that Merlin had no rude behavior, so she felt somewhat relieved.
Merlin stomped hard on the ground, leapt from the cave mouth with Elizabeth in his arms!
His silhouette leapt onto the opposite wall, then bounced to the other side.
Thus he shuttled back and forth, carefully approaching the protruding light.
Elizabeth was a bit scared, feeling that Merlin's reckless manner could cause them to fall into a ten‑thousand‑foot abyss.
So Elizabeth, seeking safety, instinctively wrapped her hands around Merlin's neck.
After calming down, Elizabeth looked up and saw Merlin's solid chest, feeling as if he was using male allure to tempt her.
The male hormonal scent surged onto Elizabeth's forehead, making her pretty face involuntarily blush.
In fact, Elizabeth had been imprisoned for a long time and had never seen a man; Merlin's sudden naked appearance inevitably made the queen recall a hint of first‑love feelings.
This adventurer named Merlin doesn't seem to be a bad person, does he?
-....And his figure looks... quite sexy...
But this mature temperament clearly indicates a married man, right?
Wait! What's happening to me? Suddenly, it's too strange to fantasize about a stranger.
It seems I need to calm down, otherwise I'll be seen as a freak...
Elizabeth was lost in wild thoughts. She seemed completely unsettled.
After all, Merlin can give Elizabeth a sense of security, and that security makes any woman feel his charm.
Merlin was moving quickly; he felt the opportunity was good, just right to bring up the killing of the Thorn Knights with Elizabeth.
Now might be a great chance to absolve responsibility; after all, who else holds Elizabeth's life in his hands?
“So... Your Majesty?”
“Ah!?” Elizabeth seemed to wake from a dream, her whole body trembling.
“I have something I want to ask your forgiveness for.” Merlin first tested the tone.
“Eh? What?” Elizabeth asked, puzzled.
Actually, my companions and I also participated in the campaign against the royal family, and we killed three Thorn Knights. Merlin paused, seriously said, “I know the Thorn Knights are the empire’s precious assets, but in that situation we had no choice, so I hope you can understand.”
Elizabeth fell silent, her expression noticeably low; she was still very sad about the death of the Thorn Knights.
But the empire is under Isabella's rule; perhaps the Thorn Knights didn't know who the real queen was.
Such an event is understandable; after all, conflicts inevitably involve bloodshed.
“I understand; this is unavoidable. My sister Isabella is temperamental and impulsive; as a child she liked extreme methods to solve problems. Surely those Thorn Knights had no idea the current queen was my sister.”
“That’s right, the Duke of Rose has already explained it, but the Thorn Knights apparently didn't believe, so they had to resort to violence.” Merlin paused, speaking in an exclamatory tone, “But they defended their loyalty with death; I still admire them.”
“Many Thorn Knights have followed me for a long time; that bond feels like a family. For example, the first knight—she became my knight when she was younger than me, and I always treated her like a sister.” Elizabeth said wistfully, feeling that she also had responsibility for the empire's chaos.
Merlin said nothing; he had no interest in the queen's past, only wanted to sort out the trouble and return to living in Lexrum.
But speaking of that... Elizabeth lifted her head, her eyes flashing with a hint of admiration, saying “Mr. Merlin can defeat…
Mr. Merlin can defeat the Thorn Knights; he must be a very powerful adventurer, right? At least… at least he's of the silver level, isn't he?”
“Uh, this… countless black lines slid across Merlin's forehead, making him feel awkward—”
What silver!?
I'm a black iron villager!
Such a badass silver master, we can't even reach that level. Funny~

Chapter 50 — Monthly Vote Bonus Chapter

Volume 11 · Chapter 50

Elizabeth saw that he had no hesitation, and thought there must be some sensitive spot.

But this sort of thing isn't a secret either; if one wants to know Merlin's level, it's easy enough to find out.

Elizabeth hesitated, then carefully asked.

"D-difficult... is there really nothing improper about it?"

"Ah? There's really nothing improper... Merlin doesn't care what level he's at, and saying it's fine, 'I'm not a silver-rank adventurer, but a bronze-rank adventurer.'

"Eh?!!!"

Elizabeth opened her eyes wide, her face full of disbelief—an overreaction of shock-

What! Is Merlin-sensei actually a bronze-rank adventurer!?

Then my thorny knight... was defeated by a bronze-rank adventurer! ?

No... impossible, right!? A bronze-rank adventurer—when did they become so strong!?

Aren't they living on the lower floors, barely getting by with some trivial quests!?

Elizabeth knows the strength of the thorny knights, and finds it hard to believe what Merlin says, feeling it's unlikely.

The thorny knights are top-tier power within the empire; to be defeated by one bronze-rank adventurer sounds like a joke.

Seeing Elizabeth silent, he guesses what's on her mind. "True regret, letting you down, huh?"

"No, no..." Elizabeth denies awkwardly, continuing to ask, "Merlin-sensei are truly a bronze-rank adventurer? Not... not joking?"

"No, I'm truly a bronze-rank novice," Merlin says with deep meaning.

"...How could you possibly win my knight?" Elizabeth pursues with great suspicion, feeling that bronze-rank adventurers and thorny knights are completely different worlds. Merlin suddenly rolls his eyes, giving a helpless explanation, "Your Majesty, who told you that bronze-rank adventurers can't beat thorny knights? I can, sometimes you can't judge a person's ability just by appearances, and there are many things you can't know from the surface."

Elizabeth says nothing, thinking, Could it be that although Merlin-sensei is a bronze-rank adventurer, his strength is actually very strong? I have a total feeling that there's no persuasiveness...

In a certain corner of the palace grounds.

Here there's a dried-up well mouth, located at a relatively high position.

Even if the entire imperial capital has a risk of sinking, this place is relatively safe.

Elizabeth holds Merlin, and they burst out of the well, successfully escaping the dangerous underground river.

The two are temporarily safe, and following the next plan, Merlin intends to defeat the lake fairy.

"Alright, Your Majesty, it should be safe here for now. You'd better not wander around, and it's best to wait until things are calm outside before leaving."

Merlin sets Elizabeth down and feels she should carry out the plan as agreed, flattening—every chaotic source.

"Eh?!!" Elizabeth hears Merlin's meaning as leaving her behind to go alone, and her heart immediately starts to feel anxious, "Merlin-sensei, . you're leaving?"

"Don't worry, this place shouldn't be affected at all, it's safe," Merlin pauses, saying helplessly, "I have some of my own things to go do, so I have to start acting alone."

Because Merlin plans to go kill the lake fairy, he also sees that this water demon is in an undying state.

So Merlin plans to use a full-power drawn cut, blasting the lake fairy into pieces, making revival impossible!

However, doing so, the scene will become somewhat terrifying, at least causing a major change to the land like half a year ago in Elgin City, digging out a super-large ditch, causing widespread panic is inevitable.

In that case, Merlin would easily expose the identity of the Elgin Sword Great Master, putting himself in a precarious situation.

Although the true queen has been found now, who knows if she'll be like that sister, feeling uneasy about the Elgin Sword Great Master, trying every means to eliminate her.

Merlin doesn't completely trust Elizabeth, after all, people's hearts are hidden behind bellies, some people can't be easily trusted.

Moreover, now Elizabeth has some understanding of Merlin, he won't take the risk of possibly exposing his identity, so he plans to act alone, handling the lake fairy trouble discreetly.

"Is that so..." Elizabeth feels that since she's already been rescued, and Merlin has his own things, she can't be willful and keep him, thinking about it a bit disappointing—

"Well, I understand, I'll wait here until things end before going out. Outside

The two thorny knights are fighting fiercely, looking like a dragon and tiger battle!

Wood and water barrier magic overlap, the power is truly extraordinary.

Strengthened wooden guardians, combat ability has improved a lot, vines covering the sky like whips, whipping Mesfield!

Catherine is at the center of the two barrier magics, continuously outputting magic power, behind her a huge ancient tree, mocking the enemy.

"What's wrong? Don't keep bouncing around, okay? You're the first knight, aren't you? So undignified, really embarrassing... ."

Mesfield grits his teeth, the holy-stage battle aura on his body burning fiercely, dodging the vine attacks that are as fast as lightning at extreme speed.

"Actually, I'm increasingly suspicious of you, Mesfield.... Catherine asks with a faint smile, 'Are you betraying the Queen, betraying the oath you swore once, you've countless times bragged in front of me about your loyalty to the Queen, and now you've fallen to this point, I'm very disappointed in you.'

"Shut up! My loyalty to the Queen is not weaker than yours at all, but the Queen has problems right now! She very likely is Isabella! Mesfield angrily responds, feeling that other thorny knights are all confused.

"Saying things like dealing with the Rose Duke,果然 you and those people are the same, all wanting to assassinate the Queen!

Catherine shows no mercy, taking out all the vines used by the wooden guardians for defense, intending to wipe out Mesfield here

Countless vines surge from the ancient tree, covering the sky and sun, enveloping the tiny Mesfield below.

In a distant corner, Merlin secretly watches the two fighting thorny knights, his heart a bit impatient—damn!

There are still two thorny knights fighting internally here!?

Among them, that one isn't the first knight who was frequently educated by mouthwash education?

If I'm going to kill the lake fairy, I'll definitely be seen by these two female knights...

Elizabeth paces back and forth in the small wooden hut at the dry well, worrying about the situation outside.

But Merlin said it's dangerous outside, wait until it's calm before going out.

So Elizabeth chooses to believe Merlin, staying obediently in the small wooden hut without going out.

But as queen, Elizabeth will definitely be very worried about the situation below, worried that thorny knights might die. Qi er

Out again, Merlin comes back, leaning against the door, his face ugly.

"Eh? ?" Elizabeth is startled, showing a puzzled expression, astonishedly asking, "Merlin-sensei, .... how did you come back? Is there danger outside?"

Merlin doesn't speak, but thinks to himself that he needs to find a way to cover his face, so that the two female knights outside won't recognize him.

However, all the fabric on his body, only the Sparta apron at the crotch, if torn off a bit, he'd probably have to go naked.

Merlin looks at Elizabeth with a scrutinizing gaze, locking onto the white stockings under the queen's skirt, and suddenly his brain lights up!

".... Merlin-sensei, ... what kind of eye expression is that?" Elizabeth feels very uncomfortable, instinctively shrinking her body and retreating backward, feeling Merlin's gaze just now was very lewd, like he was thinking of bad things.

Merlin straightens his chest, takes a few steps forward, and extends his hand—"Pa-chu" just wall-bangs Elizabeth against the wall.

Elizabeth suddenly feels pressure, looking at Merlin's exposed upper body, feeling the other getting closer, masculine breath assailing her.

Mature queen, her face instantly turns weirdly red, her heart thumping wildly, always feeling this situation is very bad.

"M-Merlin-sensei! ?"

"Your Majesty.... Merlin looks at Elizabeth's panicked eyes, expression serious as he says one

"To be honest.

"I really want your thigh-high stockings now"

title: Chapter 51 — Humiliation
content:
Chapter 51 — Humiliation

Volume 11 · Chapter 51

Merlin pinned Elizabeth against the wall in that cramped little cabin. As the queen of the empire, she had zero dignity about her right now.

For all that Elizabeth was the legitimate ruler of the empire and a young widow, she seemed to fall into that mature married-woman category.

But inside, she was still in her maiden phase. At times her thoughts were quite幼稚, far from as mature as her older sister Isabella.

Right now, this little wooden cabin was cut off from the world. It wasn't some dignified royal palace — there were no constraints of any kind.

Merlin could just claim Elizabeth was a queen, and she would be. If he refused to acknowledge it, she was nothing more than a beautiful young wife who raised children.

Even if Merlin wanted to tease this august empire queen right now, absolutely no power could stop him.

With a serious expression, after finishing his request for stockings, Merlin stared at Elizabeth with a completely straight face.

He had no idea how rude and twisted a demand for women's stockings was — it would be treated as extremely serious sexual harassment.

Actually, Merlin only genuinely wanted the queen's stockings to gain some kind of identity-concealment buff.

"......." Elizabeth looked into Merlin's eyes, her entire body stiffening, her expression going blank before shifting to sheer terror. "Eh?!?!?"

Seeing Elizabeth get so worked up, Merlin unavoidably felt a guilty conscience. "Your Majesty, calm down first. I don't intend to do anything else."

Elizabeth pressed her lips shut, terror in her eyes, darting around and refusing to meet Merlin's gaze at all.

She couldn't believe Merlin said he wasn't up to anything else. Every explanation felt like digging one's own grave.

Did I hear that right just now?!

Mr. Merlin... actually reached out and asked for the stockings I'm wearing?

Good heavens, I thought this man was a decent sort. Turns out he's a pervert!

And not just any pervert — a stocking fetishist who likes women's intimate clothing. Why does he have such a weird kink?

Even though a man like that is quite charming,... his tastes are just way too strange, aren't they...

Elizabeth's face flushed red as she shivered on the spot. She gripped her clothes tighter, her delicate figure practically wishing to merge with the wall.

"That... that Mr. Merlin, I used to think you were a decent..."

"....." Merlin saw the disappointed look in Elizabeth's eyes and felt his heart sting. She must have realized the queen was genuinely despising him from the bottom of her heart.

"But... but I'm still a queen! If you show disrespect toward me, I'll get angry!" Elizabeth tried her best to make her gaze look commanding, hoping to suppress this pervert. But trapped in an isolated little cabin with no support, what use was a queen's aura?!

"Don't be nervous. I only need your stockings. I won't do anything dirty to you." Merlin said with a complicated expression. Why did women always assume he'd assault them? Did he look that much like a rapist?!

".... I know what you're planning — you weirdos with kinks will definitely do strange things!" Elizabeth was like a hissing cat, completely losing her composure.

"Strange things?" Merlin was full of question marks, failing to understand Elizabeth.

"It's just... liking women's intimate clothing because it carries the owner's scent, like... your asking for my stockings counts as original-flavor stockings..." Elizabeth blushed harder and harder the more she spoke, until her voice dropped to a mosquito's hum. She could barely bring herself to say it, so she blurted out emotionally, "You just want to bury your face in my original-flavor stockings and sniff hard, right?! I... I can already tell!"

"???" Merlin's face darkened. Was this really the empire queen? What was going on in that brain of hers? What kind of childhood did this woman go through to become so sensitive?! Why did she know so many perverted tricks?! Even original-flavor stockings — a gentleman's divine artifact!

"Even though... even though you saved me, Mr. Merlin,... please allow me to refuse such a filthy request!" Elizabeth forced out a thread of dignity, hoping Merlin would back down.

"Your Majesty, please don't misunderstand. I'm merely borrowing them." Merlin said patiently. If the other party weren't a queen, he probably would've already forcibly ripped her stockings off.

"B-borrowing them for what?" Elizabeth probed with utter terror.

"To be honest, I'm going to put them on my head...." Merlin felt a bit awkward saying this. He suddenly understood why those robbers who wore stockings over their heads had it tough — wondering how much psychological pressure they bore before mustering the courage to put a woman's stockings over their heads.

"And then press them against your face to smell them, right?" Elizabeth's expression grew even more panicked, unable to face Merlin. "Ew~!"

Merlin's face darkened. To be honest, he was growing impatient and running out of patience.

So Merlin decided to use forceful means. He flashed a scoundrel's expression and pouted as he threatened Elizabeth.

"You damn woman, behave yourself, got it? Stop wasting my time with useless nonsense and acting all pure. Do what I say quickly, or I won't be polite~"

"Mr. M-Merlin,....." Elizabeth felt a chill run down her spine, her face going even paler.

"Shut up!" Merlin barked, hooked his finger under Elizabeth's chin, and said sinisterly, "I hope you understand your current situation. I'm robbing you — robbing your stockings. You get what I'm saying, right?"

Elizabeth's expression shifted. She had assumed Merlin was actually a gentleman who wouldn't use forceful means to humiliate women.

She never expected this guy to be a complete and utter scoundrel. When his polite request was refused, he went straight to open robbery. How unsophisticated.

What was this man doing? Wasn't he here to save her? Why was he treating her so rudely?!

....I'm the queen of the empire, the ruler of Britannia, and I'm being robbed by a Black Iron-rank adventurer?!

Robbing wealth and virtue are both common. But robbing stockings — this was the first time! Why do I have to encounter a pervert like this?!?!

She clearly responded better to soft tactics than hard ones. While terrified of Merlin's martial prowess, she still had底线 as a queen.

Elizabeth's eyes reddened slightly, tears welling up. She forcefully held back her tears and fear, putting on a dignified expression — sacred and untouchable — and decided to combine kindness with authority.

"Mr. Merlin, I warn you to watch your words. I am the queen of the empire. If you dare make any rude moves against me, you will not end well. But given the special circumstances now, I can pretend I never heard those words. Apologizing now would still be in time."

"Oh? You dare not make rude moves toward me? Hehe~" Merlin deliberately flashed a lecherous look, scanning Elizabeth up and down.

"W-what are you planning to do?! " Elizabeth raised her guard and subconsciously clutched her clothes tighter.

Merlin's gaze lingered on Elizabeth's full, snowy breasts, where two pale mounds pressed together into an alluring valley.

Elizabeth's eyes grew wary, instinctively averting her gaze from Merlin's unapologetic stare.

Merlin narrowed his eyes and smiled, stroking his chin as he said in a teasing tone —

"Hmph, those nice-sized tits. Truly befitting a woman who's been a mother~"

title: Chapter 52 — Monthly Ticket Update
content:
Chapter 52 — Monthly Ticket Update

Volume 11 · Chapter 52

Merlin felt this was about right—sure enough, he could crush this little queen's spirit.

Although he was the Great Demon Lord, playing the role of a petty hooligan was second nature to him; it was almost like playing himself.

Watching Elizabeth frozen in terror, Merlin was very satisfied. This was exactly the effect he wanted.

And the way he had just smacked Elizabeth's huge breasts—Merlin found it quite stimulating.

It seemed when his wife wasn't around, this guy Merlin got pretty loose.

Elizabeth stared blankly at him, feeling her bosom had gone numb from his slaps—

I... I was just assaulted by this man?!

How could someone in the Empire dare to be so rude to me?!

Doesn't this Black Iron adventurer fear my retribution?!

I, the proud Queen of Britain, have suffered such humiliation—there's no dignity left...

Elizabeth's face went pale, her eyes reddened, tears welling up as she felt deeply wronged.

"YAAAAAAHHH!"

Elizabeth let out a high-pitched scream, curling up, hunching her back, shielding her breasts to avoid further attack!

Merlin frowned and rubbed his ears, then launched into verbal assault against the queen: "Scream all you want—no one's coming to save you, not even if you shred your throat. Right now it's just you and me. I can do whatever I want. Hehehe~"

"...You dare lay hands on my breast? I'm the queen! Don't think I'll let you off!" Elizabeth threatened, biting her lip.

"I don't need you to spare me? Seems you still haven't grasped the situation." Merlin paused, raised his eyebrows, and began intimidating Elizabeth in an extremely wicked tone: "There's no one around. I could force you to bear my child, and you wouldn't have the strength to resist. Then I'd just walk away, leaving you to carry a big belly and face the mockery of the entire empire."

Elizabeth's expression froze on her face, feeling more and more that Merlin was a dangerous individual who could hatch any vile scheme.

"You think that's all? No no no, there's something more thrilling..." Merlin paused, and various 18X tropes came pouring out of his mouth—

"I could kidnap you and lock you in a basement, abusing you every day, using you as a tool for my desires."

"And no one would ever know. You'd only survive in that pitch-black basement, for my pleasure."

"Slowly you'd lose your mind, having no hope for your future, degenerating into an inflatable doll with no emotions at all."

"Finally, when I got bored of you, I'd sell you to the most chaotic district in the empire, turning you into a cheap money-making tool."

"Hehe, how's that? Isn't this more thrilling, my queen? Surely you now understand your situation, right?"

Hearing this, Elizabeth's face turned purplish, her breathing became difficult, and her body suddenly went ice cold.

Elizabeth, as queen, had never heard such terrible things, and was simply too scared by Merlin to even breathe.

What kind of terrible punishment is this? Imprisoned like a slave, and then sold to the darkest place to make money.

So this man wasn't some kind-hearted fellow, but... but a demon...

Elizabeth's eyes were somewhat swollen and red, tears like a clear spring frequently spinning in her sockets, her lips trembling as she couldn't speak—obviously terrified.

"But as long as you obediently listen to me, I can spare you..." Merlin reached out toward Elizabeth, his face showing the essence of a demon with an evil smile: "Hand over your stockings, or I'll use despicable means to drive you mad."

Elizabeth was internally terrified, feeling that in the current situation, she had no choice but to submit to Merlin's tyranny.

As long as Merlin didn't harm her, handing over a pair of stockings she'd worn didn't seem like such a bad idea.

Although it felt very humiliating—she, the proud Empress of the Empire, was being threatened by a Black Iron adventurer, and having to hand over her intimate clothing...

But dignity seemed to have no effect on Merlin, and wisdom only led to him treating her in a more vicious way.

Elizabeth felt more and more wronged, wanting to resist to the end, but also thinking what Merlin had said was very terrible. She could only grit her teeth and say:

"Fine. Aren't you just wanting my stockings to do some filthy things? I'll satisfy this pervert's..."

Merlin's eyebrow twitched. Thank goodness—it was going quite smoothly. This little queen had softened up, and he didn't need to force it himself.

Elizabeth bit her lip, glaring at Merlin. After hesitating, she reached out to grip her own skirt hem.

"Could you turn around? Staring at me like this is disgusting."

"No, I want to watch you take them off."

Merlin gave a mischievous smile, rejecting Elizabeth's proposal, because he worried that if he turned around, this little queen would play some trick—so it was better for him to watch the whole process.

"Hmph!"

Elizabeth pouted, looking furious and embarrassed, her face turning red.

She had no choice but to follow Merlin's order and start taking off her stockings.

Elizabeth gritted her teeth and, in front of Merlin, lifted her skirt—suddenly the view beneath was completely exposed—

She was wearing white pantyhose. Her legs were slender and long, her back straight as a pole, like a standing white poplar.

Her round calves were wrapped in white fabric, looking quite lean without much extra flesh, and would probably be very bouncy to the touch.

Following upward was an even more blushing mysterious zone—her mature and sexy black panties were hidden behind the white stockings, showing a hazy, indistinct outline.

Merlin looked shamelessly, stroking his chin like a connoisseur of lingerie. Although he didn't want to do anything to Elizabeth, he still had to admire that a woman who had given birth could still have such a good figure—it was already quite remarkable.

Elizabeth glared at him with a face full of disgust, her hand reaching under her skirt to fumble around.

Then with a soft rustle, Elizabeth slipped off her white pantyhose.

The stockings rubbing against her skin made a susurrous sound, making one's heartbeat quicken.

Merlin awkwardly averted his gaze. Being watched with such disgust by the little queen while she took off her stockings for him—it always had a stimulating feeling. Damn it, could a new attribute be awakening in him?

Elizabeth took off the white stockings and handed them directly to Merlin, turning her face aside, her expression carrying anger.

Merlin held the queen's stockings in his hand—they were still warm.

Merlin turned to leave, but suddenly thought: what if Elizabeth plotted against him after reclaiming the throne? It seemed he needed to threaten her again.

So Merlin stopped, holding Elizabeth's stockings and swinging them slightly, threatening to say:

"Don't think about coming after me once you're safe. If you dare cause trouble, I'll throw your stockings into the auction house and let everyone sniff the queen's body scent."

"As the queen, you surely don't want your reputation damaged, right? Then best to behave yourself. See you if fate wills it."

Merlin hummed as he left, feeling like he was threatening a woman with compromising photos—but whatever. Anyway, he hadn't wanted to get entangled with the empire's queen in any unclear relationship.

After seeing Merlin leave, Elizabeth could no longer withstand the pressure. Her legs went weak and she collapsed to the ground, cold sweat seeping from her forehead.

Damn adventurer—won't you even give me a chance for revenge?

And throwing my stockings into the auction house to be insulted by even more people.

Elizabeth's face went green then pale, her delicate body trembling as she muttered to herself—

"Merlin?"

"What a terrifying man..."
