title: Chapter 62 — Double Chapter Update for Monthly Ticket Voters
content:
Chapter 62 — Double Chapter Update for Monthly Ticket Voters

Volume 13 · Chapter 62

Merlin looked over at Alice beside him, his expression heavy with meaning.

After all, Merlin had seen firsthand how difficult life was for that mother and son. He really hoped Steve could return home soon—

Martha was raising little Henry all by herself. Besides struggling to get by, she also had to deal with the harassment of single men from the village. And little Henry thought his father was a hero. Before Merlin appeared, the person he most admired was his own father.

Though he was still young, little Henry would protect his family even when his father wasn’t around—even if threatened with a knife, he wouldn’t back down. It was only after seeing the Steve family that Merlin had any hesitation about killing him. He didn’t want to become a bloodthirsty executioner.

Little Henry admired him so much, but if he killed the boy’s father—even if the boy was just a child—Merlin knew he’d never be able to hold his head up again.

Merlin felt he and the Steve family had some kind of fate tied together. Maybe everything was destined from the start. Steve meeting him would give him a chance at a new life.

If it weren’t for the locket with the photo inside, Merlin would have killed Steve without hesitation.

“What nonsense are you talking about?! I don’t understand you at all!”

Alice sat beside Merlin, fuming, frustrated by the interruption of their mission clues.

“In other words, you’re just soft because he has a family?”

“Tsk!” Merlin clicked his tongue in displeasure, turning to emphasize to Alice, “It’s not about being soft. I just don’t like meaningless slaughter—that’s all.”

“Really?” Alice narrowed her eyes, clearly skeptical of Merlin’s words. This guy actually letting someone who betrayed him go? She’d never seen that before.

“Forget it. I’m tired. Let’s rest for a bit. Don’t bother me.” Merlin waved his hand, not wanting to argue with Alice further.

Alice huffed and turned away, her chest puffed out in a huff. She was furious about Merlin making decisions on his own. The fire from the explosion still hadn’t been fully extinguished.

Under the starry sky, the two sat on the rooftop. In the distance, the Casy Castle still burned, its flames flickering. It seemed that those who enjoyed meaningless slaughter were just soft-hearted.

Alice stole a glance at Merlin beside her, thinking to herself that this guy claimed he wasn’t soft toward those who betrayed him.

How strange. Merlin had never shown mercy to enemies before, especially after guarding this place for N hours—why? Why did he suddenly change and let the man go? Tonight, of all nights...

Maybe the butler really was a good father. Merlin hadn’t done anything wrong. But the question was—could he have consulted her first?

“Cough! As for you unilaterally deciding to let that Steve go, I’m not blaming you. You’re my little underling.” Merlin’s face turned serious.

“Consult what? Do I need to ask for your permission before doing something? Straighten your attitude, you little—” Alice thought Merlin might regret his decision, but...

“Consult what? Do I need to ask for your permission before doing something? Straighten your attitude, you little—” Alice thought Merlin might regret his decision, but...

“You’re my underling! If it weren’t for me, you’d still be dead, stuck at Black Iron rank. Your attitude is a hundred times worse than mine!” Merlin smirked. “You’re a Black Iron adventurer. The one who needs self-awareness is you.”

“Hah! If it weren’t for me bringing the inheritance crystal, you’d still be a Gold rank adventurer now.” Alice sighed helplessly. “Why do I say one thing and you have to reply with ten?”

She puffed out her cheeks, unable to argue back.

“A team needs harmony!” Alice tried to appeal to higher principles when she couldn’t win the argument.

“Ah, now you’re singing the praises of teamwork?” Merlin tilted his mouth, his tone dry. “By the way, have you forgotten we didn’t get the treasure map?”

“You’ve always been so lazy with your work. Now I seriously doubt your intentions. You let that guy go—what about our mission? Our last clue was Steve! You’ve ruined everything!” Alice’s face twisted in frustration.

Before she could finish complaining, Merlin pulled out the hunter’s journal from his chest and slammed it down.

“Shut up! Want to fight?”

Merlin shook the journal in his hand. “This is the clue... I thought we’d get nothing, so I was going to settle accounts with you later.”

“...What?” Alice snatched the journal from him, her anger deflating. “The treasure map was found with this?”

Merlin spoke concisely. “It’s an old journal from a vampire hunter, written in the language of the old kingdom. It’s not completely useless.”

Seeing something so mysterious, Alice immediately believed Merlin seven or eight parts.

“Does it have Dracula’s information?” Merlin shrugged helplessly.

“Maybe. We’ll need someone to translate it. I can’t read it. Since we’ve already decoded the key to the old kingdom’s treasure, maybe—”

“Then let’s go back to Lexem and ask Da Vinci for help. Last time, she helped us with the treasure map, and this journal won’t be a problem for her.” Alice’s hope reignited, and she was full of energy again.

“Or we could ask Old John for help. He’s knowledgeable and fluent in many languages. He’s an adventurer from Lexem, not High威 City’s Guild.”

“No way. We can’t keep owing people favors. Besides, we’re from Lexem.” Alice rejected Merlin’s suggestion.

Lexem’s Guild was in competition with High威 City’s, so for safety’s sake, it was better to ask Da Vinci.

“Fine. Then we’ll head back tomorrow and figure out our next move.”

Merlin and Alice prepared to leave, leading out their little donkey, Momo. Just as they were about to go, Old John and his son stepped forward as their hosts to see them off.

“Really not staying in High威 City for a few days before leaving? So eager?”

“Sorry, we have urgent matters to attend to and can’t stay long. We’re not here to rest.”

Facing Old John’s enthusiasm, Alice could only respond politely. Right now, they had a mission to complete.

Old John shook his head, his expression disappointed.

“That’s a shame. I was hoping to continue discussing the divine descendants with Merlin.”

“Ehhh... Maybe another time.” Merlin’s forehead was damp with cold sweat. “I’ve already been through enough with that old man last night.”

“Well, I won’t force you, Merlin. Actually, it’s good that you two are leaving. High威 City has been a bit unsafe lately, what with the explosion and all.” Old John nodded, fearing they might get involved in trouble.

Merlin and Alice’s expressions were complex. They didn’t plan to be honest with Old John, so they simply nodded.

“Then I’ll wish you both a safe journey. But before you go, I have one question for you.”

“Hmm? What is it?” Merlin raised an eyebrow, clearly exhausted from last night’s events, but the question seemed to carry deep meaning.

“Are you two interested in working somewhere else?” Old John smiled warmly.

“What do you mean?” Alice felt something was off.

“I was wondering if you two have any plans to leave Lexem. If so, I’d like to extend an offer—hopefully, you’ll join High威 City’s Adventurers Guild.” Old John truly valued Merlin and Alice, so he boldly extended an olive branch, hoping they’d join his camp.

“I know it’s shameful for the Guildmaster of High威 City to poach members, but I’m not trying to be disrespectful. The choice is yours. Joining High威 City’s Guild means more opportunities for growth, rather than staying in a small one like Lexem.”

“...The Guildmaster, Old Taylor.”

Alice hesitated, wanting to refuse. It would be ungrateful to switch now, especially since Old Taylor had helped her when she was down on her luck two years ago. Many of her friends were in Lexem.

Although Lexem was small and its Guild wasn’t strong, it would still be cruel to betray them.

As Alice’s power grew, so did her value. Now, switching Guilds would mean joining High威 City’s, which was far stronger.

Merlin wasn’t against switching Guilds, but he was against Old John himself.

This old man wouldn’t leave him alone! He’d probably keep coming up with schemes at night. There’s no such thing as a free lunch.

No wonder he was so enthusiastic—he’d been trying to recruit them from the start. The future would be terrible with Old Taylor on their side.

Merlin was deeply opposed to joining High威 City’s Guild. He preferred the freedom of being a lone wolf.

“What do you two think? Give me a clear answer.” Old John smiled.

“We—”

Before Alice could finish, Merlin firmly rejected the offer. “It’s not just about benefits. It’s about honor.”

“Why? A stronger Guild means higher status for you both. There’s plenty of room for growth, like in a cultivation game,” Old John said, confused by their choice.

Merlin shrugged. “I like small Guilds. Low starting point, slow growth—that’s what gives me a sense of achievement.”

“...Cultivation game?” Old John was confused, not understanding the term.

Alice frowned inwardly, thinking, *Why does he have to bring this up now?*

“Alice, let’s go. We’re in a hurry.” Merlin turned and walked toward the donkey.

“Sorry, Old John. Thank you for your offer.” Alice responded politely.

Young Johnson’s face darkened. With his father beside him, he kept quiet, watching silently.

Seeing his father invite Merlin and Alice directly was a shock. His father was the Guildmaster—inviting them was like lowering his own status to recruit them.

But Merlin and Alice didn’t take the bait, which stung Johnson’s pride.

“Merlin, just wait and see! Next time we meet, I’ll make sure you bow to me!” Johnson gave a cold reply.

“Next life...” Merlin sat on the donkey cart and turned back, smiling. Since he was immune to magic, he wasn’t afraid.

“You!” Johnson trembled with rage, feeling disrespected.

“Johnson, you should be chasing after me instead.” Alice turned back and smiled.

“Hah! Who do you think you are, calling me that?” Johnson sneered, his heart aching. His hair seemed to stand on end from anger.

“...” Alice’s face darkened. Merlin whispered to her.

“Hey, Alice, calm down. Arguing with a little brat isn’t worth it.” Merlin tried to defuse the situation.

Alice suppressed her anger, knowing she couldn’t afford to lose her composure. “Right, right. We shouldn’t get angry. We should be elegant and mature, like proper ladies.”

She acknowledged his point, though it still stung.

Merlin didn’t say anything, but his expression was a little unnatural.

Alice... did she misunderstand the term “proper lady”?

(°∞6)争一--

Old John and his son watched as the donkey cart slowly disappeared into the distance, their hearts unsettled.

“Father, why do you value them so much? They’re not even capable of what I can do,” Johnson sighed, his hands behind his back.

“John, you’re still too young. You don’t see things clearly yet.” Old John sighed. “I’ve always wanted to revive the family, but I didn’t want to discourage you. Your mother was a stubborn woman. Before she died, she told you to build your own path with confidence.

But I think the pressure of reviving the family has been too heavy for you. It’s my fault. I thought your strong will would help you rise, but it’s only added to your burden. I should have guided you earlier.

It’s not your fault that you’re not a genius—you’re just more diligent than others.”

“John, facing reality is also important. You’ve already realized it, haven’t you?” Old John shook his head, his voice filled with regret. “Without my help, you wouldn’t have come this far. But in terms of foundation and temperament, you’re still lacking.”

“I’m starting to doubt my upbringing. There must be something wrong with it.”

Johnson lowered his head, feeling bitter.

“Future? What do you mean?” Johnson didn’t understand his father’s words.

“Because I see potential in those two. It’s something others can’t achieve no matter how hard they try.”

Old John lightly stroked his pale beard, gazing at the rising sun in the distance.

“Merlin is a true genius, a divine descendant with an unbeatable nature. Even the dragon race’s pressure couldn’t suppress him. I suspect he’s consumed a dragon’s inheritance crystal—likely a high-grade one—and has dragon-like abilities. Alice is also a prodigy with extraordinary skills. That night, I clearly felt her power. If the Adventurers’ Tournament comes in a few years, they’ll be mountains standing in your way.” Old John raised his head, his gaze deep.

“The future landscape will change. No one can escape it.

This era is extraordinary. So many talents have returned.”

title: Chapter 1 — Beelzebub
content:
Chapter 1 — Beelzebub

Volume 14 · Chapter 1

Southern Sicily Sea, a certain small island.

The Fourth Demon Lord Palace is situated here.

At this time, in Asmodeus's study, he was still obsessed with making beautiful clothes and couldn't pull himself away.

However, a subordinate's voice sounded from outside the door, as if something important was happening.

"Your Majesty, I have important matters to seek an audience with you."

"Hmm? Come in." Asmodeus was holding scissors, cutting the fabric in front of him, and asked without turning his head, "What's the matter so urgent? I didn't say that when making clothes, only especially important things are not allowed to disturb me?"

"It is indeed a very important matter, Your Majesty.... A drop of cold sweat trickled down the forehead of the demon subordinate.

"What is it? Could it be that our * * industries were threatened?" Asmodeus paused, putting down the scissors in his hand.

"Not exactly, it's a contact request from the Fifth Demon Lord Palace, the Gluttonous Main Lord. It seems there is something very important." The subordinate said concisely.

"Is it that gluttonous main lord Belial that actively contacted me?"

Asmodeus furrowed his beautiful brows, his expression becoming serious, feeling puzzled about the contact request from the Gluttonous Main Lord.

After all, there are rarely interactions between lords. Everyone is busy with their own affairs, and they almost never chat idly.

Of course, Asmodeus and Merlin are good private friends, so frequent contact is only natural.

The number of times the Demon Lords meet each other can be counted on one's fingers. A situation like actively contacting the other party is very rare.

Unless it's encountering a very urgent situation, reaching the point of danger to the survival of the race, then it's possible to contact each other and unite.

Otherwise, besides the Seven Lords Conference held every ten years, there would be no other opportunities to meet each other.

Asmodeus had to take this seriously, and for this matter, he couldn't be careless. Perhaps something big really happened.

"Quickly prepare more formal clothes for me, I will personally talk to Belial..."

Because of the blood pool seal beneath the Demon Lord Palace, the lords cannot easily leave the Demon Lord Palace.

Those with royal blood need to maintain the blood pool seal regularly, otherwise it will cause unimaginable disasters.

After Merlin was fired, the burden of maintaining the seal fell on his younger sister Lilith, which is also the fundamental reason why Merlin left the Demon Lord Palace without any problems, someone helped cover for him.

Of course, the Demon Lords are not bound to the blood pool seal, they can leave, but there are clear time limits. Wanting to go out is also extremely inconvenient, so the lords generally will not leave the demon race's territory.

Although the demon kings are inconvenient to leave their territory, the information network is quite developed, communication can be done at any time and place.

This is thanks to the remote connection magic device, which is the large screen used by Asmodeus and Merlin to contact each other.

This kind of high-tech not only arranged in various demon race bases, but also arranged in each Demon Lord Palace, facilitating the timely transmission of information.

At this time, in the secret room of the Fourth Demon Lord Palace, Asmodeus changed into a very formal black skirt, sitting elegantly on the throne.

Asmodeus ordered the subordinate to start the remote connection, and soon connected with the Fifth Demon Lord Palace's Belial—

"You, this dead sis-con, are in a hurry to see me, it's really rare? Isn't it that you can't bear to be glued to your own sister every day? What's the matter that made you leave your sister to find me, finally discovering my charm and starting to discard the old for the new?"

"Shut up, cross-dressing pervert, no matter how flamboyantly you dress up, you can't compare to my sister who is a million times cuter! My sister is the cutest in the world! Someone like you, a pervert, is also worthy of being compared with her?"

On the large screen appeared a very thin man, pale-faced like a sickly child, sitting on the throne. He must be the Gluttonous Main Lord Belial.

Looking at his appearance, Belial was indeed too thin, almost indistinguishable from skin and bones.

His hands are bone-white, almost excessive. All his features are sunken, with large dark circles under his eyes.

This poor health appearance is actually the Gluttonous Main Lord? It's more like the Hungry Main Lord, the sis-con lord also fits the image.

Asmodeus was called a cross-dressing pervert by Belial, his mood instantly dropped a thousand zhang, very unhappy and said, "Since your sister is so outstanding, why don't you go find your sister? What do you want to bother me for?"

Belial set aside his disdainful attitude, showing an anxious expression, "I have urgent matters and want to ask for your help."

"What's the rush, if you have something say it, if you don't have something scram, I'm busy every day.... Asmodeus elegantly waved his hand, showing an impatient attitude.

"My cute sister... she... she was kidnapped by lowly humans! Waaah..."

Belial showed an extremely sad expression, tears swirling in his eye sockets, as if he had suffered a great injustice.

Perhaps because he was too worried about his sister, Belial actually couldn't maintain the lord's dignity in front of Asmodeus, and cried out loud.

"Your sister was kidnapped by humans? What's going on?" Asmodeus was a bit curious, thinking that in the demon race's territory daring to kidnap a demon race princess, who would have such guts? It's simply not wanting to live.

Although it's impossible to guarantee the safety of every demon outside the demon race's territory, but such a thing happening inside the demon race's territory is like stepping on shit on top of a demon's head, acting without restraint!

"Half a month ago, I told my sister she had no talent for training, and to give up early. Even if she is born, she would just be an ordinary demon, I would still raise her. But the result is that my sister has a strong personality, and after arguing with me, she ran away from home. And the result seems like not long after leaving the Fifth Demon Lord Palace, she was kidnapped..."

Belial choked up, covering his face and secretly crying, "My poor sister!"

Asmodeus wasn't particularly surprised, because he knew that Belial's sister had no training talent, she was just an ordinary demon.

A mid-level warrior could easily catch her, and leaving the demon race's territory had no safety guarantee, being kidnapped by humans is within reason.

"Where was she kidnapped to? Do you have any news?"

"According to my subordinates' report, it seems she was kidnapped to the French Empire. More specifically, I don't know." Belial answered with a tone of worry.

"Is that so...." Asmodeus looked at Belial on the screen and said lightly, "It's all your fault, you so bluntly said your sister has no talent, her running away is due to your lack of foresight," SE3 novel

"I know! I'm already reflecting on it!" Belial sadly said, not wanting to hear any lessons.

"This is also a good thing, the Demon Lord Council has long been dissatisfied with you, being one of the seven Demon Lords, yet listening to your sister, how do you think this is a trivial matter?" Asmodeus said with a half-smile.

"You.... Is this a good thing?" Belial raised his head, his face darkening, clearly angry, "I came to find you not to hear your cold sarcasm. For the matter of my sister being kidnapped, if you dare to rejoice in my misfortune, I swear I will personally tear you apart."

A drop of cold sweat trickled down Asmodeus's forehead, not expecting Belial to be so serious, so he changed the subject, "I understand, calm down, today you came is to ask me for something?"

"Help me find my sister." Belial said seriously.

"Don't joke around, you and I are both demon race kings, it's impossible to easily leave the Demon Lord Palace." Asmodeus dispelled Belial's thought.

"I'm not letting you go, I know the rules of the demon race too..." Belial paused, and seriously stated his intention this time

"It's not that I'm letting you go, but recently, I heard that Lucifel wasn't fired?"

"Recently I heard he's been wandering around the human empire everywhere."

"Since he's so idle, helping me find my sister isn't a small matter, right?"

title: Chapter 2 — Monthly Ticket Extra: Cabin Exposed
content:
Chapter 2 — Monthly Ticket Extra: Cabin Exposed

Volume 14 · Chapter 2

Hey, since Lucifer left the demon race, you haven't seen him at all, why are you sure he's idle? It's really rude to make a claim without thinking....
Asmodeus had a face full of black lines, thinking that aside from himself, the other monarchs probably had some opinions about Merlin to some extent.
“Huh? Could it be that he's busy?” Beelzebub rested his chin on his hand, asking with interest.
“Of course he's busy; he's been working hard to pursue a more fashionable and beautiful path.” Asmodeus said, feeling relieved.
“I don't understand what you mean by 'what time'.... Beelzebub paused, speaking sincerely, “To be frank, although Merlin's strength has been acknowledged by us, as the youngest among the seven monarchs, his behavior has many points that clash with ours; he's practically an outsider. I don't think Lucifer leaving the demon race will bring him greater achievements.”
“Isn't your relationship with Lucifer still decent? Badmouthing him like that, yet you still want to ask him to help find your sister?” Asmodeus asked with a strange expression.
“What misunderstanding makes you think our relationship is still okay?” Beelzebub furrowed his brow.
“I heard you didn't clear Lucifer before? I hope he could be your sister's teacher.” Asmodeus recalled something from long ago.
“That was only out of necessity; Lucifer can unleash astonishing power without magic or battle aura, which really moved me. Maybe he could make my sister strong too, but Lucifer refused to give me face and directly turned me down. Do you think our relationship would still be okay?” Beelzebub retorted.
“Huh....” Asmodeus indeed had some misunderstanding, asking, “Wouldn't it be better to have your subordinates handle finding your sister? It wouldn't matter if they left the Demon Lord Palace, and besides, whether Merlin would agree to help is uncertain.”
“That's my real sister; entrusting this to someone of mediocre ability, I wouldn't feel at ease!” Beelzebub became anxious, then after thinking said, “As for Merlin... I think he'll agree, after all he's also a sister complex, and I believe only he can understand my current anxious feelings.”
“This...” Asmodeus remained skeptical about Merlin being a sister complex, “I think you might have some misunderstanding about the relationship between Lucifer and his sister.”
“In short, I just want to ask Lucifer for help, that's all.” Beelzebub spread his hands, speaking kindly, “You and Lucifer are on such good terms; you surely know where he is now and can contact him, right? Say a good word for me, this time I'm asking you.”
“You're really causing trouble; even if I'm willing to help you contact Lucifer, what if he refuses?” Asmodeus didn't dare to pat his chest and give an absolute guarantee.
“This.... Beelzebub showed a serious expression, crossed his arms in thought, then answered seriously.
“If Lucifer refuses to help, then I'll have to go find him myself.
“Asmodeus, you are also a Demon Lord; the strength of us monarchs in this world—what position do we hold? I think you know better than anyone.”
“If I recklessly enter the human empire and something major happens, I won't take any responsibility....”
Midnight in Rexhelm.
Merlin and Alice, after several days of travel, finally returned from Highwick City in Ireland.
Arriving in Rexhelm at the dead of night, the streets were nearly empty, even the Adventurers Guild had closed.
As for asking Da Vinci to help translate the diary, we could only wait until morning each day.
At such a late hour, bothering others would be impolite, and Merlin and Alice wouldn't be so tactless.
Merlin and Alice drove the donkey cart Mengleng directly to the gate of Rexhelm.
“Finally arrived; my bones are falling apart from this journey, I'm exhausted to the point of questioning life...” Merlin complained.
“What's there to complain about? We're here, aren't we? Besides, it's inappropriate to look for Da Vinci this late; tonight I'll allow you to sleep until you wake naturally.” Alice replied irritably; Merlin had been complaining nonstop along the way, making her impatient.
“Why do I need your permission to sleep however long I want? Don't give yourself airs; wouldn't it be better to just honestly be a little lackey?” Merlin replied nonchalantly.
“You? I rarely have a good heart...” Alice glared at Merlin, feeling resentful.
“I just want to sleep, I don't want to argue with you; let's both say less.” Merlin waved his hands repeatedly, then shouted at the city gate, “Open the door! Hurry up and open it!”
“Who is it?! ? In the middle of the night, still not letting people rest! ?” The voice of the guard captain Price came from above.
“Price, it's me, Merlin!
“Oh? Merlin junior, you came back this late?” He held a torch, poked his head out from above, looking lecherous, as if afraid... Then the gate of Rexhelm slowly opened; Price stood inside holding a torch, grinning. “Merlin junior, you're really lucky; tonight I'm on guard duty, others probably wouldn't open the gate for you.” “Thanks then.” Merlin replied calmly. “Wow, adventurers aren't easy either, you're out traveling in the dead of night; where are you headed?” Price asked curiously. “We just came back from Ireland.” Alice replied coldly. “Really?” Price nodded, teasing, “Wow, don't think Miss Alice's dusty appearance is just for show; she actually has a unique charm; looking at her ever more charming little face, it must be the result of Merlin junior's hard work at night.” Merlin remained expressionless, immune to such teasing; Price's lecherous mouth he had seen before. However Alice's face flushed red, she became angry, feeling this was sexual harassment, “Price, shut your stinky mouth; if you dare keep spouting nonsense, believe me I'll stab your ass with my sword!” “...stab my ass?” Price's expression turned excited, eyes lecherous, nose bleeding, saying “Not bad, Miss Alice, you still know how to play; each time you hit my sweet spot, Merlin junior, you're so blessed~”
Alice's body trembled with anger, she instinctively gripped her slender sword at her waist, wanting to slash this old lecher. Due to the darkness, Price didn't notice Alice's small movement; instead he moved closer to Merlin, secretly trying to lure a decent woman into bad habits. “Merlin junior, when will we go play at the secret cottage again?” “I'm not interested in that place....” Merlin replied softly, not really liking that kind of place. “

title: Chapter 3 — Onset
content:
Chapter 3 — Onset

Volume 14 · Chapter 3

"No way?"

Merlin frowned, feeling this matter was somewhat serious, not that easy to handle.

Humanity's attitude toward demons has always been resistance; while not as severe as hatred, it's absolutely fear.

If Helena's identity exposure is true, she could only flee back to demon territory; no human empire would have a place for her.

Of course, Helena's personal fate doesn't matter; what's feared is causing empire-wide panic, leading to large-scale identity checks.

Then those affected wouldn't just be the Fourth Demon Lord Palace—all demon race outposts in human empires would be threatened.

You should know, most of the demon race's territory is in barren places; to survive, secretly conducting external procurement and trade is necessary.

If things really develop to the worst case, even if Demon Lords can't easily leave their palaces, they'd still grit their teeth and come out to plunder resources.

"I also find it hard to believe this rumor. Anyway, I believe Miss Helena is innocent." Price said firmly.

"Why... do you trust her so much? If I remember right, you two aren't close... Merlin's expression turned strange, finding Price's blind trust very puzzling!"

"Miss Helena is so beautiful, how could she be a demon? There must be some crazy woman jealous of her beauty behind the scenes, spreading rumors everywhere—it must be that." Price paused, then said seriously, "A girl with such a beautiful face couldn't possibly be a bad person."

"Uh... Merlin frowned, thinking it was all about looks! If Helena were an ugly woman, even if rumors called her a demon, Price would probably agree wholeheartedly! This guy is more vulgar than his appearance!"

"What are you two sneakily talking about? Let me hear the whole thing!"

Alice had been watching from the side for a while, but since Merlin and Price's conversation was too quiet, she heard nothing.

Thinking that neither Merlin nor Price were good people, and they seemed to share some similar tastes, maybe they were privately discussing something shady?

So Alice couldn't hold back anymore, interrupting their conversation, hinting they shouldn't sneak around—if they had something to say, bring it into the open.

"-.- Nothing, let's go..." Merlin quickly drove the donkey cart away, not wanting Alice to think too much.

"Brother Merlin, don't forget~" Price waved from behind, his expression full of peculiar significance.

"What shady secrets are you two exchanging in private again?" Alice looked at Merlin with suspicion.

"What shady secrets? There's nothing! I think it's YOU who's shady, right? A shady person sees everything as shady!" Merlin said with an innocent expression.

"You!" Alice was choked by Merlin's words, her face darkening as she thought—

Could she be overthinking and wrongly accusing him?

No no no, this bastard was full of lies through and through. She couldn't let her guard down.

It seemed she needed to keep a closer eye on him recently. She couldn't let him slip through her fingers. Hmph~

Merlin and Alice returned home and rested well for one night.

s-A

This past month or so, the long journey left both of them somewhat weary. Light novel

After finally returning home, naturally they wanted to keep their mental state in the best condition.

However, that very night, Merlin's heart curse, as expected, flared up once again.

Merlin had already anticipated problems would arise soon, but he never imagined it would strike while he was sleeping soundly—what a pain!

After all, Merlin himself had felt at ease for a while; what's meant to come will come.

So far, the last Saint-tier powerhouse Merlin used Banri Garan to take a life from were still those two Thorn Knights.

It was the late night; due to travel fatigue, Alice fell asleep early and was sound asleep, completely unaware of Merlin's condition outside.

Merlin curled up on the sofa, face pale, cold sweat pouring from his whole body, like he had a serious illness—pain made it hard for him to sleep.

Each time the curse flared, Merlin was pulled back to reality by intense pain, forced to face the fact that his life could end at any moment.

Volume 14 · Chapter 4

Although the two of them had a mix-up as soon as they got up early in the morning, still, the proper business is more important.

So Merlin and Alice, surprisingly, didn't argue but got busy, preparing to go to Da Vinci to talk about that diary.

Merlin doesn't really care about his image in Alice's eyes; anyway, they're too familiar, so he already has no image to speak of, might as well pretend he didn't hear.

But while the two were busy tidying up, the door was suddenly knocked on, dong dong dong--

"Merlin, go open the door." Alice's voice came from the room.

"Tsk!" Merlin got annoyed, really disliking being ordered around, "Can't you go yourself?! Why do I always have to be bothered with these trivial things?!"

"You're not that far away?! Opening the door won't kill you!" Alice retorted angrily.

title: Chapter 5 — Deciphering the Diary
content:
Chapter 5 — Deciphering the Diary

Volume 14 · Chapter 5

Alice wasn't entirely convinced by Merlin's "neck and neck" assessment. She and this jerk were fundamentally different.

Forcing a comparison between them was simply beneath her.

In truth, Merlin's wastefulness was self-serving and pleasure-seeking, while Alice's was of the saintly, foolish kind—there was a difference.

Alice didn't want to stoop to Merlin's level. She couldn't even be bothered to mention his "glorious" history of throwing tens of millions of gold down the drain.

So Alice just scoffed, went back to her room, and began changing. Serious business was more important anyway.

After a short while, both were ready. They headed straight out to find Da Vinci, hoping she could translate this ancient diary for them.

Merlin and Alice went to the Guild first, but Da Vinci wasn't there.

Asking Lucia, they learned Da Vinci had returned a few days ago. By her habit, she'd surely be in the library's laboratory now.

They didn't linger and made a beeline for Rexham's library.

This left Hobbs, who had been warily eyeing Merlin in case he came to drink, deeply puzzled. Why was Merlin so serious now? In such a hurry...

On the way to the library, Merlin curiously asked Alice,

"Miss Da Vinci never goes home? Why does she always hole up in the library?"

"The library is her home. It's sponsored by Count Austin. It looks like a library on the surface, but it's actually a laboratory. Da Vinci lives and eats there," Alice replied irritably. She wondered how long Merlin had been here and why he didn't know such things.

In truth, Merlin had spoken to Da Vinci only a handful of times. He was far more familiar with Hobbs than with her.

"So dedicated? What's she researching?"

"Alchemy. Da Vinci is obsessed with it. She pours almost all her energy into it..."

At the library, in Da Vinci's laboratory.

The desk was cluttered with bottles and jars, and the multicolored liquids were dazzling to the eye.

Da Vinci's daily routine was to conduct experiments, constantly eliminating errors to refine her craft.

She had a dream: to create the ultimate alchemical artifact—the Philosopher's Stone.

The Philosopher's Stone was the lifelong pursuit of countless alchemists. It was said to have the power to turn decay into wonder, to create matter from nothing. A more extravagant claim was that it could grant eternal life to mere mortals. This was why so many royals and wealthy merchants were willing to sponsor alchemists.

Hoping to obtain the Philosopher's Stone to fulfill their desires, even though everyone knew the chances were pitifully slim, many still flocked to it.

Creating the Philosopher's Stone was Da Vinci's long-standing pursuit, and the ultimate proof of her skill.

Da Vinci had studied alchemy since she was seven. Over a decade had passed, but she hadn't even seen a speck of the Philosopher's Stone.

This left Da Vinci feeling lost, doubting whether the Philosopher's Stone was even real, a complete fiction.

But she didn't want to give up. After investing so much effort, giving up would be a huge loss.

Right now, Da Vinci was busy at her lab bench. Rossetti sat on the sofa, looking thoroughly bored.

"Da Vinci, are we done for today? Let's call it a night."

"It's almost there." Da Vinci was absorbed in her experiment, not even glancing at Rossetti.

"You haven't slept since last night. Can't you rest for a bit?" Rossetti asked lazily, sprawled on the sofa.

"Human life is limited. Wasting it on sleep is a terrible thing," Da Vinci said seriously.

"You're so dedicated..." Rossetti sighed, then said thoughtfully, "Ever since I met you, I've watched you constantly trying to make this Philosopher's Stone. It's been five or six years with no results. I'm pretty sure the thing is just made up. You should learn to give up, don't you think?"

"I believe the Philosopher's Stone exists, even if it takes my whole life..." Da Vinci put down the test tube in her hand and turned to look at Rossetti. "If you're bored, why don't you go out for a stroll? You might run into Arnaud."

"...Rossetti's expression shifted. She immediately sat up straight. "Why bring up Arnaud? I don't want to see him. He avoids me like I'm a snake. Every time he sees me, he's long gone."

"You like Arnaud, don't you?" Da Vinci wore a faint, teasing smile.

"So what if I do?" Rossetti showed no hesitation about her feelings. "I like him, but he doesn't like me. He's completely obsessed with that Alice. I can't figure out what's going on in that noble boy's head."

"I think you're just too eager. You scared him. If you were a bit more reserved, Arnaud would surely notice the good qualities in you and develop feelings for you," Da Vinci said thoughtfully.

"No, no, Arnaud is a coward. If I were reserved, he'd be overjoyed," Rossetti said, shaking her head repeatedly. She found Da Vinci's suggestion unreliable.

Just as Da Vinci was about to say more, the lab door was suddenly knocked on three times.

Seeing Da Vinci was busy, Rossetti went to open the door herself. She found Merlin and Alice standing outside.

"Huh? Why are you two here?"

Alice said, "We have something we need your help with, Miss Da Vinci."

In the laboratory.

With guests present, Da Vinci had to pause her work and attend to Merlin and Alice.

The previously messy desk was tidied up, and Rossetti served several cups of black tea for everyone.

The lab still looked cramped. The four of them had to gather in the center to talk.

"You came suddenly, so you must have run into a problem, right? I knew it~" Rossetti puffed out her chest, always eager to show off in front of Alice. "The old Guild Master speaks highly of you two, calling you the future stars of the Guild. But looking at you now, you're not so impressive after all~ You still have to come to us for help."

"Rossetti, why do you have such a problem with me? Every time you come, you have to sarcastically criticize us?" Alice frowned, unhappy.

"I'm just telling the truth, don't be angry~" Rossetti said with a wave of her hand. "I'm just thinking the old Guild Master is getting old. His eyesight isn't what it used to be. It's easy to misjudge people."

"Hmph!" Alice glared at Rossetti, annoyed. What had she done to deserve this constant cold shoulder?

"Well... you two bicker, but please don't drag me into it. Thank you," Merlin said, putting on an air of detached aloofness.

Alice suddenly turned and glared at Merlin. She thought that not helping her and now trying to distance himself—before any real trouble had even begun—was a terrible sign. What would happen when they actually faced a crisis?

"Don't say that, Merlin. The old Guild Master's favorite is you. He always smiles when your name comes up," Rossetti said, leaning close to Merlin, her ample cleavage almost spilling out, teasingly. "What exactly is your charm, sister? I'd really like to know. If circumstances allow, we could have a nice chat tonight~"

"This..." Merlin's face darkened. He didn't take Rossetti's words seriously at all.

But Alice, like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, suddenly pushed Merlin away, telling him to stay away from this fox.

"Ow!" Merlin landed on his butt, staring at Alice in shock. Was this shrew planning a rebellion?

Alice ignored Merlin completely. She glared directly at Rossetti, her voice dripping with hostility. "Stay away from him. He's mine."

"Huh?" Merlin frowned, finding Alice's words ambiguous.

Alice also felt a bit awkward. Her face flushed red. She hesitated, then corrected herself, "I mean... my male servant!"

Merlin's face darkened again as he stood up. What was this woman babbling about? Who was her male servant?

"You are so strict with him, Alice. That's not good. Men are fickle. The more you control them, the more they'll mess up," Rossetti said meaningfully.

As the only man present, Merlin felt immense pressure from Rossetti's words.

"Cough!" Da Vinci, unable to bear the spectacle, stepped in. She said seriously, "Everyone, quiet down. This is my laboratory, and this is a library. Maintaining silence is the most basic etiquette. This minor matter is nothing."

Hearing Da Vinci's words, the others quieted down and stopped bickering. However, Alice and Rossetti still shot hostile glares at each other.

"Mr. Merlin, Miss Alice, what brings you here today?" Da Vinci got straight to the point, without beating around the bush.

"Ah, it's like this. We went on a mission to Ireland recently and found a diary. It's written in an ancient language we can't understand. We hope you can translate it for us. The information inside might be very important to us." Merlin said, pulling the simply-bound diary from his coat and placing it directly in front of Da Vinci. "This is it. Please take a look."

"Just a moment."

Da Vinci put on a pair of gloves, looking highly professional, like an archaeologist.

Just from the diary's appearance, she could tell it was very old and needed to be handled with care.

Da Vinci carefully opened the diary. Her delicate eyebrows furrowed and relaxed by turns.

Merlin and Alice were both anxious. This was their only lead. If they got nothing from it, things would be difficult for them later.

Rossetti behaved herself nearby, not causing trouble. She knew her partner hated being disturbed while working and waited patiently.

Time passed slowly. The black tea on the table had already gone cold. Da Vinci finally finished reading over twenty pages and closed the diary, placing it down with a sigh.

"Well? Any results?" Merlin asked eagerly.

Da Vinci calmly took a sip of her tea and said unhurriedly,

"The writing is from the ancient French Empire. It's similar to the former kingdom's language, but not exactly the same."

"The owner of the diary was a vampire hunter. To save France, which was deeply mired in trouble, he wanted to kill a certain vampire."

"This 'deeply mired in trouble' has many interpretations, with no definitive answer. But I can make a bold assumption."

"The true ruler of the French Empire was actually the vampire race, not humans. This vampire hunter wanted to change..."

title: Chapter 6 — Weapon
content:
Chapter 6 — Weapon

Volume 14 · Chapter 6

"Change? Change what?" Merlin pressed curiously, not quite grasping what Da Vinci meant.

Still, Merlin greatly admired Da Vinci. After skimming just a few pages, she could lay out the facts with remarkable thoroughness.

"Perhaps it was to change France, which was mired in quagmire. For several hundred years, it seems the entire French Empire was controlled by the vampire race," Da Vinci said calmly. Having read only twenty pages of the diary, that was as far as she could speculate.

"Could such a thing really have happened?" Alice furrowed her delicate brows, finding it hard to believe. Considering the limited numbers of vampires, and that most had never even been seen, what methods could they have used to control an empire?

"I can't be certain such a thing occurred either. These are merely my speculations after reading part of the diary. They may not be accurate," Da Vinci said earnestly, careful not to pass along incorrect information that could jeopardize Merlin and Alice's mission.

"That's already impressive. This diary came from a vampire hunter, after all," Merlin felt that entrusting the diary to Da Vinci was the right choice. If she could speculate about vampires, then Dracula was very likely recorded in it as well.

It seemed that even without obtaining the treasure map to the vampire ruins, Merlin and Alice had still found traces of Dracula. If they followed the clues, they might stumble upon something significant.

"I wonder what information you're hoping to get from this diary?" Da Vinci set down the diary and removed her gloves.

"We want to know the whereabouts of a vampire noble," Alice replied.

"A vampire noble?" Da Vinci looked puzzled, not quite understanding what Alice meant.

Seeing that Da Vinci didn't quite grasp it, Merlin quickly added, "Count Dracula, the so-called Prince of Impalers. There are plenty of legends about him, right?"

"Huh?!" Rossetti was visibly startled upon hearing Dracula's name. "You're looking for that legendary vampire?!"

"What? Is there a problem?" Alice shot Rossetti a look, responding somewhat irritably.

"That's so dangerous! Haven't you heard enough stories about Dracula? I heard that monster nailed countless people onto wooden stakes. He's a ruthless, twisted creature. Aren't you just courting death?!" Rossetti couldn't understand why Merlin and Alice would deliberately walk into danger. Wouldn't it be better to play it safe?

"Yes, although Dracula's existence remains unverified, from all the legends, he's certainly a powerful and cruel figure. Investigating him will inevitably put you in danger," Da Vinci didn't remain neutral this time; like Rossetti, she offered words of caution.

"Don't worry, nothing will go wrong. That Dracula fellow is just a bat that gained sentience to me," Merlin said nonchalantly, signaling that Da Vinci and the others need not worry unnecessarily.

"Merlin, you're impossible. Why do you, a Black Iron adventurer, never seem to have any self-awareness? You're making everything sound so easy." Rossetti had several dark lines sliding down her forehead, unable to comprehend Merlin's calmness.

"Really, no need to worry. I'm here!" Alice struck a confident pose, even patting her nonexistent biceps.

"You? Don't joke around. Even though you're now a Saint-tier powerhouse, you're still far from being able to challenge a legendary existence!" Rossetti said seriously, hoping to dissuade Merlin and Alice from this unrealistic notion.

"Really?" Alice opened her hand, and several golden fused ice crystals floated above her palm. Saint-tier peak pressure radiated unmistakably. Though it was merely magical power, it was enough to astonish those around her.

"...Your strength has improved again?!" Rossetti's eyes widened. How long had it been since Alice became a Saint-tier powerhouse, and she had already reached the peak? This cultivation speed was truly jaw-dropping!

"Naturally. Do you think I'm the type to stand still?!" Alice placed her hands on her hips, beginning to look smug. "Although my magical power has only just reached the peak, before long I'll definitely achieve a grand slam in both magical power and battle aura!"

"Tch!" Rossetti, disliking Alice's smug demeanor, said sourly, "You've only reached Saint-tier peak. You're only... a bit stronger than Mr. Karl. Nothing to be proud of."

"Really, only a bit stronger? Even joining the Thorn Knights would be well within my capabilities right now~" Alice's ahoge began to wiggle. She had finally found something besides her chest that could overshadow Rossetti. How could she give that up so easily?

"You brat..." Rossetti's expression darkened. Though she was annoyed by Alice's smugness, she had no real way to counter it.

"Since Miss Alice has already reached Saint-tier peak, executing dangerous missions will be much safer. However, the legendary Dracula is ageless and immortal. I still don't recommend you undertake such a dangerous task," Da Vinci still felt it was unreliable. Even if Alice was a Saint-tier peak powerhouse, encountering a legendary monster would still be perilous.

"Miss Da Vinci, you don't know this, but we've already accepted this mission. It's not easy to back out now. Please help us check whether this diary has any information about Dracula." Merlin figured they had already invested so much effort into this mission; giving up now would feel like too great a loss.

"Since you've already made up your minds, I won't say more." Da Vinci sighed and said slowly, "I only gave this diary a cursory glance just now. There are still many parts I don't fully understand myself. I need to consult some references to ensure I don't misinterpret any sentences. So I need time to read the diary thoroughly from beginning to end."

"Then... how long will it take?" Merlin was rather eager, since his curse had just flared up not long ago. If possible, he was looking forward to encountering a strong enemy.

"Three days. Three days will be enough. I will translate the entire diary," Da Vinci gave a definite timeframe.

"You should count yourselves lucky. Da Vinci is very busy. She's translating this diary for you now, and she didn't even rest last night." Rossetti said sarcastically from the side.

"...Is that so? Then I'm sorry for the trouble." Merlin said awkwardly.

"If it's too much trouble, you can take your time. There's no need to insist on three days. Wouldn't that be too rushed?" Alice asked anxiously.

"It's fine. Translating a diary isn't any difficulty. I can complete it in my spare time." Da Vinci nodded, signaling Alice not to worry.

"Then we'll trouble you. Oh, by the way! We also acquired something during this trip. We hope you can help us appraise it..." Merlin pulled out a pitch-black spear from behind his back, the one Osward had thrown. "This thing looks ordinary, but its power is no small matter. I wonder what exactly it is?"

Da Vinci put her gloves back on, picked up the spear, and examined it closely. Then her expression changed, as if she had made some significant discovery—

"This is an extremely high-grade alchemical weapon."

title: Chapter 7 — Extra Chapter for Moon Votes (Teacher-Student)
content:
Chapter 7 — Extra Chapter for Moon Votes (Teacher-Student)

Volume 14 · Chapter 7

“An alchemical weapon?” Alice asked, puzzled, as she didn’t understand alchemy very well.

“That’s correct.” Da Vinci nodded, seemingly full of interest in this spear. “Alchemy involves every aspect: pharmaceuticals, artifact refinement, extraction, and even the creation of life is possible. It can be said to be extremely profound knowledge, and creating weapons is one of its most basic applications.”

“But what?” Merlin pressed. He had personally experienced the power of this spear; it was far more formidable than ordinary weapons.

“But the quality of this alchemical weapon is very high. Although it is a basic item, it is extremely precious. Unless one has extraordinary achievements in the field of alchemy, it is impossible to create such a high-standard weapon.” Da Vinci praised the spear endlessly.

“You make alchemical weapons too, don’t you? How come I can’t see any difference?” Rosetti carelessly took the spear and examined it closely, but didn’t find anything particularly special about it.

Da Vinci sighed, got up, and went into the inner room for a while before returning with another alchemical sword.

This was a weapon she had made herself, and it looked much more gorgeous on the surface than that spear.

“This is an alchemical weapon I made, and you are using one of the same type. Look at the differences.”

Rosetti picked up the alchemical sword, then looked at the alchemical spear, and immediately said, “Yours seems more gorgeous, especially the red patterns, which are much brighter than this broken spear.”

“Rosetti, you must remember that the more gorgeous an alchemical weapon is, the lower its quality, because it contains many impurities, giving it a gorgeous appearance.” Da Vinci picked up the spear from the table and said seriously, “The reason this weapon looks dull is that the impurities have been removed cleanly. My alchemical sword is not just slightly inferior to this spear; the difference in power is probably worlds apart.”

“So exaggerated?!” Rosetti stared wide-eyed in shock, feeling as if she had encountered a treasure.

Hearing Da Vinci’s evaluation, Merlin’s mind suddenly lit up. *Holy crap! I always felt this thing wasn’t ordinary; it turns out to be a very rare treasure! Oh no, why do I feel like there are piles of little money in front of me? Is this hinting at something?*

“Such a precious thing shouldn’t have been forged by some unknown person…”

Da Vinci took the spear and began to carefully inspect every part, as if looking for clues to prove the owner’s identity.

Normally, after an alchemist creates a weapon, they leave a mark representing their identity somewhere.

It’s like giving the weapon five identities, letting users know who made the alchemical weapon.

After careful searching, Da Vinci finally found the mark at the top of the spear, in an inconspicuous place—

It was an emblem of an Ouroboros, an ancient design adapted from the mythological World Serpent, Jörmungandr.

However, Da Vinci was incredibly familiar with this symbol because it represented someone she knew well, a person with outstanding talent in alchemy.

Since the Ouroboros emblem was seen on this weapon, there was no doubt that this spear was undoubtedly made by that person’s own hands.

Seeing that Da Vinci’s expression was abnormal, as if she had been stimulated, Alice couldn’t help but ask, “Miss Da Vinci, what’s wrong? Are you okay?”

“I’m fine.” Da Vinci put down the alchemical spear, her mood somewhat unsettled, and hesitated to say, “The maker of this spear is someone I know. No wonder he could produce such a high-level alchemical weapon. I’m not surprised at all now.”

“Eh!?” Rosetti was startled and said blankly, “Really? You rarely go out, and I’ve never seen you have any alchemist friends. How could the maker of this spear be someone you know?”

Merlin and Alice didn’t speak, but hearing Da Vinci’s words, they were somewhat surprised in their hearts.

They hadn’t met many alchemists, but Da Vinci’s level was already quite good. Who could be someone she admired so much?

“Rosetti, I’m not a self-taught genius either. I learned alchemy through study, and naturally, I also had a teacher.” Da Vinci looked at the spear on the table and patiently explained, “The maker of this spear is named Flamel. We studied alchemy under the same teacher, so he counts as my senior brother. He really liked the Ouroboros symbol, which carries the meaning of reincarnation. Almost all the alchemical weapons he made had the Ouroboros emblem.”

Rosetti, standing nearby, felt quite shocked. It was the first time she heard Da Vinci talk about things from long ago, and she never expected her to have a senior brother.

“So coincidental?” Alice felt a trace of surprise, probably not expecting this spear to bring up Da Vinci’s past.

“Your senior brother’s alchemy is pretty impressive. Just touching this spear, I felt a bit stunned by the power it brings. I didn’t expect an alchemical weapon to reach such a level, containing powerful strength, even surpassing some rare-quality weapons. Your senior brother is truly an excellent alchemist,” Merlin commented. As someone who caught a spear bare-handed, he indeed had the right to evaluate the other party.

“Excellent? I admit my senior brother Flamel is outstanding in alchemy, and calling him excellent is not an exaggeration at all. But I dare not compliment his character. To achieve his goals, he acts without any bottom line.” Da Vinci did not fully agree with Merlin’s evaluation, though she certainly didn’t deny Flamel’s excellence in alchemy.

“From your words, it seems there are other hidden circumstances?” A cold sweat dripped from Merlin’s forehead, feeling that he had stepped on a landmine just now.

“Flamel is indeed much stronger than me in alchemy, especially in making alchemical weapons. Even our teacher feels inferior to him. His forging skills have long surpassed many people, including those alchemy masters in history. But my senior brother absorbed too much of our teacher’s ideology and slowly changed. He began to hate humanity, and even hated himself.” Da Vinci paused and continued, “Eventually, he crossed the forbidden zone of alchemy, involving life in alchemy. He constantly transformed his own body using alchemy, becoming a humanoid alchemical weapon.”

“…” Several black lines slid down Merlin’s forehead, and he inexplicably thought of the alchemical beasts he had encountered earlier,畸形 monsters composed of various species.

“Perhaps geniuses are always different, doing things that ordinary people cannot understand. But I think my senior brother went down the wrong path because he was poisoned too deeply by our teacher’s thoughts.” Da Vinci rubbed her forehead, feeling a wave of pain. “Our teacher is a weirdo. He claimed that humans are the most fragile race and need evolution for civilization to continue, and that alchemy is the only key to opening the door of evolution. I simply cannot agree with this point.”

“Who is your teacher? He sounds like a madman…” Merlin’s expression became somewhat strange.

Da Vinci raised her head and answered Merlin in a casual tone—

“Our teacher is called Democritus. He was once a professor at the Imperial Research Institute.”

“Besides being an alchemist, he was also hailed by many as the Dragon Race’s Expert…”

title: Chapter 8 — Casual Surrender
content:
Chapter 8 — Casual Surrender

Volume 14 · Chapter 8

Hearing Democritus's name, Merlin and Alice were suddenly startled inside, looked at each other, and felt very surprised.

The two hadn't expected the world to be this small; the evil alchemist they had dealt with before was Da Vinci's teacher, which was too incredible.

Merlin stealthily moved closer to Alice and asked stealthily, "The alchemist we dealt with that time turned out to be Da Vinci's teacher, what a huge misunderstanding?"

"Yes, Miss Da Vinci is such an excellent person, how could she have such a perverted teacher? It's really hard to understand." Alice replied in a lowered voice.

"What to do? Should we tell Da Vinci that her teacher is doing bad things everywhere." Merlin asked tentatively.

"This kind of thing isn't good to hide, I'll tell her." Alice looked toward the opposite side, with an embarrassed smile on her face. Miss Da Vinci, is your teacher really called Democritus?

"That's right, what's up?" Da Vinci showed a puzzled expression, seeing Merlin and Alice's reactions were strange.

"We've met your teacher, on a certain day about half a year ago, Alice and I carried out a mission." Alice looked embarrassed, showing a hesitant look.

"Is that so?! Ever since Teacher became obsessed with alchemy beasts, he was expelled from the research institute for violating taboos, and my senior brother Flamel and I went our separate ways, and I haven't heard any news of Teacher since." Da Vinci paused for a moment, unable to resist asking, "When you saw Teacher, how was he? Is he still obsessed with alchemy beasts?"

"Yes, your teacher is still very obsessed with alchemy beasts." Alice thought for a moment and organized her language, "And his alchemy beast caused us and others a lot of trouble, almost causing a great disaster."

"What happened? Do you mind telling me in detail?" Da Vinci was very curious inside, after all Democritus was her teacher, how the situation was now she still wanted to find out.

"Alice and Merlin received a mission to exterminate an evil alchemist, that alchemist was your teacher Democritus, he carried out alchemy beast experiments without restraint on a small island, and even captured ordinary people as food for alchemy beasts, which caused widespread panic but in the end Alice and Merlin repelled Democritus, as for now?" Alice pondered for a moment and said earnestly, "We don't know where Democritus went? I think he shouldn't dare to continue his wanton experiments."

"Okay, I understand, Teacher hasn't changed at all to this day, still adhering to his wrong ideas." Da Vinci showed a sighing expression, lamenting x | "I didn't expect Teacher to have reached this point today, completely becoming a dangerous element that harms the empire, although his thoughts were extreme before, his character wasn't rotten to the point of being beyond redemption."

"Don't think about unhappy things, your teacher is not the same as you, cheer up." Rosetti patted Da Vinci's shoulder.

"Yes, Miss Da Vinci, don't overthink it." Alice also followed.

"I know, different ideals will inevitably part ways, I just regret that Teacher's talent has been wasted."

Da Vinci sighed silently, as a teacher and student it's impossible to have no feelings. "优

If possible, Da Vinci hopes Democritus can become a more excellent person, rather than going further and further down the wrong path.

"Since we know what this thing is, we won't disturb you." Merlin was thinking about this spear, preparing to see if anyone was willing to buy it at a high price, listening to Da Vinci's words just now, this thing was very precious, it must be another windfall!

But just as Merlin was about to put his thieving hand on the alchemy spear, Da Vinci finally couldn't help but speak, "Mr. Merlin, can you give me this alchemy spear?"

"Huh? Why?" Merlin was stunned, never expecting the usually shy Da Vinci to suddenly speak up and directly ask for something! ?

"This spear was made by Flamel, it can fully demonstrate his current skill, I hope Mr. Merlin will allow me to study it, this will be of great benefit to me." Da Vinci said in a very serious tone.

"This... Merlin stroked his chin, pondering in his heart, giving it to Da Vinci for free would be a loss, "I wonder how much Miss Da Vinci intends to pay me? Well, we all know each other, I'm willing to give you a friendship price."

As soon as Merlin's words fell, Alice lightning-fast covered Merlin's foul mouth, not letting him continue speaking, afraid this bastard would destroy the pure friendship.

Alice glared at Merlin, obviously angered by his mercenary remarks, asking for money outright would clearly damage the relationship with Da Vinci.

Merlin looked at Alice, unable to speak because his mouth was covered, but it still scared him.

Alice turned to look at Da Vinci, with a polite smile on her face. 牡小“ 比

"Merlin was just joking, you must not take it seriously, since Miss Da Vinci wants this spear, then give it to you."

"Then thank you." Da Vinci nodded, putting this alchemy spear away.

"Hmm! ?" Merlin felt he had no human rights at all, this spear was originally brought back by himself, and as a result Alice, this spendthrift woman, didn't even ask for his opinion, and passed it on as a flower offering, her face wasn't generally thick!

"What are you doing? Do you have an opinion?" Alice glared at Merlin angrily, feeling he was not generally selfish, completely not understanding what reciprocity meant.

Merlin rolled his eyes, very angry inside, his opinion was big, now was really a time short of money, and he had to give away a treasure, wasn't that crazy?

"I tell you, don't try to take anything from Miss Da Vinci, think about how much help we've received? Deciphering the key to the former kingdom, now translating the diary also relies on her, these are all help Miss Da Vinci gave us for free, and now you still want to make money off her? I ask you, do you still have a conscience! ?" Alice said in a very small voice.

After hearing this, Merlin felt it made some sense, so he didn't refute anymore, thinking he really should repay Da Vinci...

The hidden Azure... secret base.

After Osweid died, Laurie alone brought back the treasure map of the blood race ruins.

The president of Azure... Hanfulei was now sitting in the main seat with left and right embraces, looking at Laurie who had just returned below.

The sister flowers Yuna and Vina nestled in Hanfulei's... that seductive appearance made one's heart itch unbearably.

As the whole guild's strategist Eden, also looked at Laurie, seeing he returned alone, vaguely sensed something?

Laurie knelt on one knee, completely not raising his head, not even daring to breathe, because Osweid's death he bore some responsibility, he was worried his explanation wouldn't work.

"Laurie, how did things go? Did you get the treasure map of the blood race ruins?" Eden asked seriously.

"Yes, I have already obtained it." Laurie took the treasure map out of his chest and handed it to Eden with both hands.

Eden took the treasure map, unfolded it directly to look, the originally serious expression gradually replaced by a smile --

"Laurie, well done, this mission was really hard on you."

"With this thing, unifying the dark guild world is just around the corner!

title: Chapter 10 — Matchmaking
content:
Chapter 10 — Matchmaking

Volume 14 · Chapter 10

The next day.

The Vampire Hunter's diary had already been handed over to Da Vinci, and it would take three days to finish translating it.

Although they didn't have the treasure map of the ruins, with this diary, they might be able to follow the clues and achieve the same result through a different path.

So Merlin and Alice didn't plan to disturb Da Vinci for the next few days, hoping she could focus entirely on translating the diary.

Since Alice's magical power had just been raised to the peak of the Saint-tier not long ago, she was in an excited state.

So Alice planned to strike while the iron was hot and wanted to raise her fighting aura to the peak level as well.

And because her training yesterday was too grueling, it left her exhausted today, so she was still resting.

Merlin, who was usually lazy, had already gotten up, yet Alice was still sleeping, showing just how hard she had worked for her training.

With Alice resting, Merlin found himself with nothing to do and felt extremely bored, so he happily went off to find Hobbs for a drink.

However, Hobbs seemed to have something to do today and wasn't at the guild. Arnold, on the other hand, was there, chatting with Lucia at the counter.

Arnold frowned and asked with little interest,

"Lucia, what did you call me here for?"

Lucia smiled and tentatively said, "Do you want to go on a date with a girl?"

"Who? Is it Miss Alice? If it's Miss Alice, then I'm a thousand percent in!" Arnold suddenly became quite excited.

Lucia looked full of resentment, rolled her eyes, and said, "Tch! Is there something wrong with your eyes? Can you only see Alice? There are so many unmarried girls waiting to be wed, why are you fixated on a married woman? Do you have some disgusting fetish for married women?"

Arnold suddenly felt inexplicably nervous and quickly explained, "What married woman fetish? Don't slander me, okay? In my eyes, Miss Alice will always be the purest woman in this world. How could she be compared to you common women?"

"...Can you stop making sweeping generalizations when you speak? I'm kindly introducing a girl to you, you idiot. Instead of thanking me properly, you call me a common woman?" Lucia furrowed her brows, somewhat annoyed by Arnold's blanket statement.

Arnold looked at Lucia's angry and embarrassed expression and instantly realized something. "Oh~ I see. So it's you who wants to go on a date with me?"

"Arnold, I warn you, you can eat whatever you want, but don't speak carelessly. When did I ever say I wanted to go on a date with you, the stupid son of a landlord?!" Lucia pointed at Arnold and said with a serious expression.

"It's clearly written all over your face. But Lucia, it's really a pity. I can't accept you. Our family strongly opposes marrying shrewd women, as it would taint our noble character." Arnold shook his head, looking full of regret.

Lucia was disgusted by Arnold's narcissism and said with disdain, "Wow! You really think too highly of yourself, don't you? Now I finally know why you and your sister have something wrong with your brains. It's all because of bad genetic inheritance. At this rate, your family will surely decline sooner or later!"

"Heh heh, I hit the nail on the head, so now you're angry and embarrassed and starting to curse me? Lucia, you really are a woman with a narrow mind~" Arnold spread his hands, feeling that Lucia's reaction was exactly as expected.

"You!" Lucia's delicate body trembled with anger. To avoid misunderstanding, she explained, "Let me tell you, even if I went on a date with a beggar, I wouldn't choose you, you idiot. If it weren't for someone else's request, do you think I'd want to find you?! Talking to an idiot like you is a waste of two minutes of my life!"

Arnold became puzzled and asked curiously, "Someone's request? Who?"

Lucia replied impatiently, "Rosetti. She asked me to help sound you out and find out what your attitude is."

"...Rosetti?!" Arnold was suddenly startled and asked in astonishment, "She asked you to ask if I want to go on a date?"

"Yes, otherwise why would I have called you here? Do you think I want to go on a date with you? Wake up~" Lucia put her hands on her hips and scolded Arnold.

"Why would Rosetti need to find you?" Arnold didn't quite understand.

"Duh, you can always avoid her. If she doesn't ask me, who else can she ask?" Lucia became impatient and added, "Going on a date with Rosetti, just say yes or no. Don't drag your feet. Are you even a man?!"

"No! I like Miss Alice. How could I be fickle?! I'm not that kind of person!" Arnold shook his head desperately.

"Stop dreaming, okay? Alice is already married. You have no chance anymore." Lucia couldn't help but shatter Arnold's fantasy.

"That's just a marriage in name only. I don't think Merlin and Miss Alice truly love each other. I still have a chance," Arnold said very persistently.

"Arnold, what's wrong with Rosetti? She's warm-hearted, has a fiery figure, and a cute personality. She's way better than Alice's bad temper and flat chest. I'm telling you, if you miss this village, there won't be another shop. You'd better think it over, or you'll regret it later when it's too late." Lucia spoke very tactfully, but her true inner thoughts were:

"Arnold, don't you have any idea what a loser you are? It's already a miracle that someone blind enough likes you, an idiot. And you're still eating from the bowl while eyeing the pot? Do you even deserve it?!"

"Lucia, please stop persuading me. Rosetti and I are not suitable." Arnold shook his head like a rattle drum, showing just how resistant he was inside.

"Weren't your relationship with Rosetti not very good before?" Lucia's expression turned helpless, feeling she had let down Rosetti's expectations.

"The past and present are different. Before, we were friends. Now Rosetti just wants to eat me. How can that be the same?!" Arnold showed a look of fear, thinking that having an aggressive woman around every day was a terrifying thing no matter how you looked at it. He treated her as a friend, but she wanted to sleep with him!

Merlin had been listening from not far away for a while and thought, What's this? So Lucia is acting as a matchmaker to set up Arnold and Lucia. I thought it was some secret.

So Merlin no longer held back, walked straight up, and sat next to Arnold. "You guys are chatting so intensely. Lucia, give me a beer."

"Her?" Merlin slowly sat down and said calmly, "She's sleeping at home."

"That doesn't sound right. Miss Alice is usually full of energy. How could she be so lazy?" Arnold checked the time.

"Well..." Merlin thought for a moment and answered honestly, "Isn't it because she was too exhausted from last night? Otherwise, how could she still be asleep until now?"

Upon hearing Merlin's words, Arnold and Lucia's expressions instantly became quite colorful, as if they had thought of something inappropriate for children.

Too exhausted from last night?!

No way?!

Are they already eagerly starting their baby-making campaign?!

title: Chapter 11 — The Red Flag Never Falls
content:
Chapter 11 — The Red Flag Never Falls

Volume 14 · Chapter 11

Lucia's expression turned awkward, thinking Merlin was really blunt, saying anything he wanted, inexplicably making the topic dirty.
Lucia, inexperienced in worldly matters, clearly couldn't keep up with Merlin's bluntness; she silently wiped the plates, not intending to respond to his remarks.
However, Arnold sitting next to Merlin was indeed feeling terrible, his breath almost stopping.
Good heavens! Is Miss Alice already going to... have a child?!
What should I do? If a love child is born, I won't have any chance at all!
Arnold clutched his chest, his face showing the expression of someone having a heart attack; after hearing Merlin's words, he felt utterly awful.
Merlin glanced at Arnold and Lucia's strange expressions, instantly understood, smiled and said, "Are you thinking the wrong thing? Last night Miss Alice was training hard, overexerting herself, which is why she's still fatigued now."
Lucia suddenly understood, indignant, saying, "Don't always say things that cause misunderstandings; I thought you two..."
"What's wrong with me and Alice?" Merlin asked, feigning ignorance.
"...Nothing, I just overthought it." Lucia blushed, shaking her head repeatedly, afraid of being called dirty-minded.
"You scared me half to death; I was just saying Miss Alice isn't that kind of casual person~" Arnold sighed in relief, the weight on his heart finally lifting.
Merlin calmly took a sip of beer, glanced at Arnold, smiled without speaking, thinking, "This guy is really persistent; what's so good about Alice? Why is Arnold so devoted?"
"Merlin, my father said he entrusted you with a task? What is it exactly?" Arnold recalled something from a few days ago, complaining, "I asked my father, but he just wouldn't tell me."
Merlin thought the task of finding Dracula was a secret; Count Austin had said not to let others know, including Arnold and Jenna.
The family carries a curse of not living past fifty; there's no need to let this dim-witted sibling know, lest it cause chaos—just adding trouble.
So Merlin decided not to let Arnold in on the secret, instead patting his shoulder and saying meaningfully.
"It's not a big task, just having us run errands; you don't need to know."
"Tell me, it's nothing; I see my father's expression is still serious, I feel it's something important entrusted to you." Arnold looked wistful.
"No, you idiot, stop overthinking." Merlin said this with his mouth, but inside he thought this was a major issue concerning the survival of the whole Austin family, indeed serious; but Arnold, that foolish young master, wouldn't be of any help, so it's better for him to live in the lie of world peace.
"Really? Then I can relax." Arnold let out a breath.
"I just heard you and Lucia chatting; Rossetti wants to go on a date with you, why won't you agree? This is a rare opportunity you'd struggle to find even with a lantern." Merlin's smile was full of meaning, as if hinting at something.
"Yes, yes, Merlin, you really need to talk to Arnold properly; this blockhead is hopeless—no other girl would look at him, and now he finally has a girl with vision problems, yet he still refuses?!" Lucia grabbed onto this like a lifeline, pulling Merlin and herself onto the same front.
"We... aren't suitable, can't you stop spouting nonsense here?" Arnold's tone grew dissatisfied, feeling everyone was trying to set him up.
"Arnold, do you believe me?" Merlin asked earnestly.
"This... uh..." Arnold hesitated.
"Based on my experience with many women, Rossetti is definitely the type who's flashy on the outside but pure inside; this contrast wouldn't make your heart flutter? Moreover, Rossetti has both personality and figure, far better than Alice—you should consider it." Merlin said solemnly.
"Merlin, why are you so eager to set me up with Rossetti, oh~ I..." Arnold pointed at Merlin, putting on an air of having figured it out.
"You... you understand what now?" Merlin frowned, his intuition telling him Arnold's persecution complex was acting up.
"If you managed to set me up with Rossetti, does that mean you and Miss Alice will naturally become a couple? That's got to be the case." Arnold felt his intellect had skyrocketed, able to guess people's thoughts precisely, "I never imagined, Merlin, you're quite the player."
Merlin chuckled, ignored Arnold, and turned to Lucia.
"Miss Lucia, stop wasting time on this guy; he's beyond help."
"I think the same..." Lucia said expressionlessly, looking at Arnold with pity.
Seeing both of them look pitiful, Arnold scratched his head bewildered, "What kind of reaction is this from you two? Did I do something wrong?"
Merlin and Lucia stopped talking, each going about their own business, treating Arnold as if he were air, making him feel extremely embarrassed.
But just then, Helen walked straight in from outside the guild, scanning around, her eyes locking onto Merlin who was drinking beer.
Helen's sudden appearance immediately drew many gazes, some admiring her beautiful figure, others gossiping about her identity.
This is all due to the recent rumors spreading through Rexham, with Helen being whispered to be an evil angel from the demon race, causing many to feel uneasy and reluctant to approach her.
However, in the Adventurers' Guild where men are the majority, few would gossip about Helen.
After all, even if she were a fallen angel, given her dignified beauty, many would unconditionally believe she is innocent.
Helen paid no attention to the surrounding gazes, as if the recent criticism didn't exist.
This haughty disregard for gossip only made people think the rumor of Helen being a fallen angel was just false.
Upon seeing Merlin, Helen showed no hesitation, walking straight toward him.
"Mr. Merlin?"
"Huh?" Merlin turned back, seeing the graceful Helen behind him, a hint of surprise in his eyes, "Helen? ...."
Before Merlin could finish his sentence, Helen interjected, "Mr. Merlin, I have something to discuss with you; may I have a word?"
Merlin composed himself, thinking, "Could it be Asmodeus again looking for me?" He realized he needed to go with Helen.
So Merlin nodded, didn't refuse, left the half glass of beer on the table untouched, and stood up.
"Let's go."
The two walked off as if in sync, without extra exchange, leaving Arnold and Lucia looking bewildered.
After the two left the guild, Arnold blinked repeatedly, his expression turning strange, muttering to himself.
"This is the rhythm of the family's red flag never falling while outside flags fly."
