title: Chapter 40 — The Thorn Knights at the Same Moment
content:
Chapter 40 — The Thorn Knights at the Same Moment

Volume 15 · Chapter 40

Late at night in the British Imperial Capital. At this moment, in the room of the Second Thorn Knight, Seth was carefully tending to his pitch-black demon armor. Although Merlin had made it clear that wearing this demon armor was not a good thing. If the host is not strong enough, it is very likely that their mind will be devoured, turning them into food for the armor. It could even invite a more perilous disaster: the vengeance of the Greedy Demon Lord. Nevertheless, Seth did not heed Merlin's advice and did not return the demon armor. Because everything Seth has now came from this armor; if he lost it, he would be nothing! It's doubtful that, relying on his own strength, Seth could even qualify as a Thorn Knight; he would be the weakest. Thus Seth chose to take the risk, clinging to a sliver of hope, insisting on not returning this armor with its added abilities. Even though Mersfield and the queen repeatedly asked whether the demon armor was safe, Seth gave a casual reply that there was no problem. In truth, only Seth himself knows that the armor is becoming ever more greedy, demanding ever more flesh and blood. Each time after fighting in the cold armor, he feels as if he has suffered a severe injury, plunging into weakness and needing months of rest. This demon armor indeed possesses its own consciousness, and is especially ruthless, submitting only to the powerful. Even if Seth tends to it carefully, he is merely using foolish humans to let himself survive. Once Seth's value is completely drained by the demon armor, he may be discarded and the so-called master eaten outright. Yet Seth, like someone with no way out, is trapped and has become enamored with the great power the armor brings. Everything about Seth is being slowly devoured by the armor; his strength has not improved for a long time, and indeed shows signs of regression. Who could make Seth give up this hard-won power? Perhaps it would be even more painful than killing him. Seth was carefully polishing the demon armor, yet there was another person in the room: the Seventh Thorn Knight, Morrison. After the empire restored peace, Morrison returned to days of idleness aside from training, which was pleasant but also aimless. Among the Thorn Knights in the imperial capital, only Seth can talk with Morrison and chat about interesting topics. Mersfield is upright and would never idle chat with Morrison; each time he sternly urges Morrison to train, to master greater strength as soon as possible. As for Catherine? She is an ice-cold person; whenever Morrison's warm face approaches, it meets her cold backside, and she completely ignores him. Thus Morrison now has few people he can talk to; in the imperial capital, only Seth is someone he can chat with. In the past, Morrison used to go find Miliuss and Wenifred to drink and chat; although Miliuss had a foul mouth, Wenifred's honest nature acted as a buffer, making each gathering fairly enjoyable. But Miliuss and Wenifred died in the war, and Morrison's friends are now almost nonexistent, leaving him very lonely. Britain's successive turmoil saw the original twelve Thorn Knights lose six, sacrificing half. The third knight, Dexter. The fifth knight, Miliuss. The sixth knight, Emmanuel. The ninth knight, Sahadin. The tenth knight, Hamill. The eleventh knight, Wenifred. These familiar old comrades that Morrison used to see are now completely gone; after peace returned, it's inevitable to feel some sorrow and nostalgia, especially the foul-mouthed narcissist, Miliuss. As for the fourth and twelfth Thorn Knights, which have never appeared, they are very special, belonging to outliers among the Thorn Knights; they basically never show up, and Morrison is almost forgetting what they look like. The fourth Thorn Knight is a necromancer, with a very dark disposition, his worldview not quite like that of the proper knights, and he doesn't fit in. Yet his great strength has earned the queen's approval; even if he doesn't stay in the capital, it's fine—just in times of national crisis we hope he will come to assist, but this rebellion has shown no trace of him. This fourth knight once said, these few Thorn Knights are all too weak, basically just rice buckets; fighting alongside them is truly disgraceful. Being able to say such remarks shows how unpopular the fourth Thorn Knight is; his dark nature makes him a lone wanderer, and nobody knows where he is. The twelfth Thorn Knight, rather than being a knight, is more like a scholar, obsessed with researching ancient magic and martial arts, often traveling the world and rarely returning to the capital. The ancient magic and martial arts he studies have almost become authoritative, and they have played a crucial role in enhancing the strength of the Thorn Knights. Like a coach guiding the Thorn Knights to further improve their strength, he is someone the queen highly values. Having him guard the capital would be a waste of talent; it would be more valuable to devote all his energy to researching ancient magic and martial arts. Frankly, Morrison's ultimate move 'Rakshasa Ghost' was created under the guidance of this twelfth Thorn Knight, combining ancient martial arts; thus this 'coach' is equally unfathomable in strength. However, Morrison's talent is limited; to this day he can only reach the first stage, unable to wield the great power of the third stage. Watching Seth carefully polish the armor, Morrison couldn't help teasing, 'Do you really like this armor?' 'This is my lifeline; there's no reason not to like it. Even if the most beautiful girl in the world offered to swap with me, I wouldn't.' Seth replied with a smile. 'Although this armor's power is great, recalling what Elgin the Sword Saint said that day, it doesn't feel like alarmism; is this... really safe?' Morrison said with some concern. 'Do I even need to answer? Of course it's safe—I've been wearing it for how long?' Seth's expression changed; he doesn't like hearing doubts about the demon armor. 'Although Elgin the Sword Saint is strong, his words can't be fully trusted. I know you admire him, but don't be blind. I always hold a bit of skepticism about what he says; after all, he's just a shady figure lurking in the shadows, unwilling to show his true face, so I find it hard to trust him.' Hmm, if it's safe then that's good. Seeing Seth's impatience, Morrison refrained from saying more, fearing it would affect others' moods. Although they fought together with Elgin the Sword Saint, the queen seems to also trust this mysterious man. But aside from Morrison, the other Thorn Knights remain as before, wary of Elgin the Sword Saint. 'Now we Thorn Knights are down to six; I don't want to see anyone else die.' 'If this continues, not only will we not deserve the title of the queen's sword, we won't even qualify as a shield.'

title: Chapter 41 — Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 41 — Bonus Chapter

Volume 15 · Chapter 41

"You such a carefree guy, why are you suddenly becoming sentimental?" Seth stopped wiping his armor and turned to look at Morris.

"Because... too many companions have died in such a short time. Before, I used to find Miles and Winifred to drink and chat all the time, but now even finding someone to talk to is hard. Now in the entire imperial capital, only you'll listen to my nagging, so I don't want the Thorn Knights to suffer any more sacrifices." Morris lowered his head, his expression somewhat sad.

"Is that so..." Seth thought for a while. He hadn't been a Thorn Knight for long and wasn't very familiar with them, but they were companions nonetheless. "If I were in the imperial capital, you could come find me anytime. After all, not everyone is as thick-skulled as Mesfield. You need to relax sometimes."

"Oh? ! You really dare say that. Mesfield is such a stiff person, talking to her is so pressuring." Morris agreed, seemingly finding common ground in criticizing Mesfield.

"But you shouldn't be sighing about companions dying. For a knight, dying for loyalty is glorious." Seth paused and added, "You're close to Miles and Winifred, but you shouldn't think their departure is pitiable. They're both excellent knights; you should be proud of them."

"Ah, so your resolve is higher than mine. That's surprising. I was indeed being too sensitive." Morris scratched his cheek awkwardly, then changed the subject. "But Miles's death was a heavy blow to Knight Captain Leonard. Ever since that guy Miles died, Knight Captain Leonard has been staying at the knight's public cemetery, guarding Miles's grave, and hasn't left for a long time."

"Knight Captain Leonard?" Seth looked puzzled.

"What? ! You don't know? Oh right, you joined the Violet Knight Order too recently, you've probably only met Knight Captain Franklin. That guy colluded with Isabella and died mysteriously." Miles said with no emotion in his voice. Franklin wasn't a great person, so he felt no sympathy for the guy's death.

"What a pity..." Seth had only met Knight Captain Franklin a few times and wasn't very familiar with him. Thorn Knights are much higher ranked than Knight Captains, being the highest command, so his impression of Knight Captains was very faint.

"Our knight order has three Knight Captains. Besides Franklin, there's Rebakov, whom I've never even met. He seems to be a nominal Knight Captain; Her Majesty the Queen refuses to speak of him, his identity is mysterious. The other is Knight Captain Leonard—he's our senior, the Thorn First Knight of the previous generation!" Miles said with a very serious expression, seemingly full of reverence for Knight Captain Leonard.

"The Thorn First Knight of the previous generation?" Seth had never heard of such a thing.

"Yes. Knight Captain Leonard used to be the strongest in the empire. Unfortunately, he was ambushed in battle against a powerful enemy, suffered severe injuries, and his body was crippled. He can no longer fight at all, reduced to a useless person. But the Queen felt Knight Captain Leonard had meritorious service, so she kept him in the knight order as Knight Captain to handle some miscellaneous affairs. He's basically a retired old man now, though other Thorn Knights still respect him." Morris's tone was full of regret.

"That sounds sympathetic. A strong person reduced to this state... might be worse than death." Seth sighed silently and asked curiously, "Then what's the relationship between Knight Captain Leonard and Miles? Why does he linger at his grave and refuse to leave?"

"Miles's Starlight Sword Art was taught by Knight Captain Leonard. He's Miles's master..." Morris emphasized.

"Such a thing exists? !" Seth showed a look of slight astonishment.

"Miles is Knight Captain Leonard's only disciple. When he was a child in the orphanage, Leonard noticed him and nurtured him carefully, serving as his mentor. Even Miles becoming a Thorn Knight was recommended by Knight Captain Leonard." Morris lowered his head and said in a low voice, "Now that Knight Captain Leonard is so sad, refusing to leave Miles's grave, their master-disciple bond has probably turned into father-son feelings, right?"

"Possible. After all, humans are creatures that can't survive alone." Seth sighed and asked curiously, "But why did Knight Captain Leonard only take one student? Shouldn't he have disciples all over the place?"

"This is similar to Mesfield's situation. Her Qi Sword Art can only be practiced by her family members; others can't learn it at all. Similar to Qi Sword Art, Starlight Sword Art is also a rare high-tier martial art, a precious legacy passed down through countless predecessors. The requirements are very harsh, requiring qualifications, character, and willpower all to meet the standard. So it was really not easy for Knight Captain Leonard to find an inheritor. Miles was somewhat of a genius in that regard." Morris would never have admitted Miles was a genius before, but now that guy was dead, no one would argue with him.

Seth nodded. He really wanted to ask for advice, but it wasn't convenient now. "If it weren't that I have to leave the royal capital tomorrow morning for a trip, I would definitely go ask Knight Captain Leonard for some experience."

"Ah? !" Morris was startled and asked in surprise, "You're leaving the royal capital tomorrow morning?"

"Yes." Seth turned around and continued wiping his armor. "Now the empire is at peace and doesn't need my strength. Rather than staying here and wasting my life, I might as well go out and adventure. Maybe there will be more opportunities."

Actually, Seth was lying. The real situation was that the Demon Armor had become very violent and greedy, urgently needing to consume more flesh and blood.

If he stayed in the imperial capital, Seth felt the Demon Armor would fall into a hunger-induced rampage, causing bigger trouble.

That's why Seth decided to leave the empire and hunt enemies outside to feed the Demon Armor.

"Yeah, staying in the royal capital is boring. No one likes staying here."

Morris said with sadness. Once Seth left, no one in the royal capital would want to deal with him.

He didn't want to go find Mesfield every day to be force-fed stiff knight spirit. It was too painful!

Morris looked up at the Demon Armor but suddenly noticed a small pierced hole at the shoulder guard position. If he didn't look carefully, he really wouldn't notice it easily.

"Seth, how did your armor get damaged?"

"Where?" Seth asked in confusion.

Morris said.

"Here, it's all pierced through." Morris stepped forward and pointed at the small hole in the shoulder guard. "This isn't armor with extremely strong defense? How was it pierced by someone? If it were the chest, that would be fatal!"

"My armor isn't invincible defense. Of course it can be pierced by attacks that are too strong, but few people can do that." Seth paused and continued, "This was caused by a powerful enemy I encountered in France. The enemy was a ruthless mercenary leader, skilled in using a blunderbuss filled with beast crystal cores. The power was enormous; even this Demon Armor couldn't withstand it, directly piercing through my shoulder."

"A French mercenary leader?" Morris was puzzled.

"Yes. At the time I was passing through Avignon in France. Late at night I saw this group of mercenaries kidnapping women and children. I couldn't stand by and intervened, but their strength surprised me." Seth shook his head, his expression becoming slightly grave.

"The mercenary leader is that strong? He wouldn't be a very famous thief, would he?" Morris speculated.

"That mercenary leader's name is Dickte Ping. He's a cunning and utterly wicked scoundrel who has never told the truth." Seth stroked the hole in the shoulder guard and said meaningfully.

"If not for being fast enough back then to dodge the beast crystal aimed at my heart..."

"I would have been killed by this bastard with one shot (died in France)."

(; 7_7)

title: Chapter 42 — A Surprise for the Mercenary Group
content:
Chapter 42 — A Surprise for the Mercenary Group

Volume 15 · Chapter 42

In the mercenary corps' underground base, the lights were bright.
Dickteping lay lazily on his throne, playing with his beloved rapid-fire gun in his hands.
This gun was made by the dwarven race, capable of firing continuously for 24 shots.
The ammunition was not ordinary black powder and iron pellets, but made from magic beast crystal cores.
The gun can unleash the powerful energy contained within the crystal core to serve as an attack.
Depending on the quality of the magic beast crystal core, the gun's power varies; the higher the quality, the greater the attack power.
With the gun's enhancement, high-level magic beast crystal cores can often reach the power of saint-tier magic, making them very rare items.
The principle of this gun that fires magic beast crystal cores is almost identical to that of a magic cannon, but its capability is more convenient and even more formidable. The dwarves' casting talent is top-notch in this world; the weapons they forge, whether in quality or power, can become rare-grade.
However, the dwarves pursue perfection in craftsmanship and do not like mass-producing junk, so weapons from their hands are usually praised as works of art.
Dickteping was once merely a small pirate with high-level strength, serving under the infamous Red Beard Pirate King brothers, living each day following the captain in a life of plunder, slaughter, and looting.
During a raid on a merchant ship of the United Kingdom, Dickteping found this rare gun in a chest in the hold; at first glance he knew it was not an ordinary item.
Out of greed, Dickteping hid the gun for himself, intending to keep it for his own use.
However, at that time Dickteping was not strong, merely a small crew member trailing behind the pirate king's rear, fearing that if the captain discovered his hidden treasure, he would be thrown into the sea to feed sharks.
So Dickteping soon took advantage of the night, sneaking away on a small boat from the Red Beard pirates' ship, heading out to make his own way, wanting to become a boss himself rather than always shining others' shoes.
After leaving, Dickteping began to hone his shooting; after fully mastering this gun and experiencing some adventures, he became a saint-tier powerhouse and founded the mercenary corps in France.
Regarding leaving the Red Beard pirate gang, Dickteping felt especially lucky, because not long after he heard that the pirate gang was wiped out by a man named Elgin the Great Sword Master, and the Red Beard brothers were directly slain.
If Dickteping had stayed there, he likely would have met the same fate as the other crew members, being slain by that Elgin the Great Sword Master; surviving a great disaster must bring future blessings.
Dickteping meticulously polished his gun, caring for it with such attention that it surpassed even how he would treat his own son!
Although he has been feeling uneasy lately, his vice-captain died, the mercenary corps lost a great commander, and its combat strength greatly diminished.
But fortunately, refugees flooded into Avignon, and by kidnapping and selling women they earned quite a bit, especially that delicate-skinned little loli from last night; her tender flesh would surely fetch a high price.
Using the gun consumes magic beast crystal cores; each shot burns money, and the higher the core's quality, the more money is spent.
Thus Dickteping values money more than his companions; he is such a selfish profiteer, constantly ordering his subordinates to kidnap more women, then sell them to regular customers, using a small portion of the earnings to maintain the mercenary corps' expenses, while the bulk goes toward purchasing magic beast crystal cores to replenish his ammunition stock.
After wiping it clean, Dickteping looked at the shining masterpiece, nodded satisfied, and showed a smile.
These were the two mercenaries who had kidnapped Alice, walking in and putting the sack containing Alice on the ground.
Alice, lying in the sack, slightly opened her eyes and thought, 'Have we already arrived at the lair? I'll make these guys suffer!'
"Boss, we’re back!" said the long-haired mercenary confidently.
Dickteping on the throne raised his eyelids, saw the sack on the ground, and immediately smiled, saying, 'Oh? Tonight we have a haul—nice, you deserve praise; I thought you two would come back empty-handed again.'
"How could that be? We two are your capable aides!" said the short-haired mercenary with a grin.
"Good, although the vice-captain died, business has been good lately; keep working hard, and perhaps one of you will become the next vice-captain." Dickteping drew a big pie for his two subordinates.
The two glanced at each other, both seeing delight in the other's eyes, becoming extremely excited.
Being able to become the second-in-command of the mercenary corps is great; you’ll surely enjoy the good life from now on!
"Boss, rest assured, we will definitely work hard." said the short-haired mercenary, quickly expressing his determination.
"We will strive to kidnap women every day to contribute to the mercenary corps." said the long-haired mercenary, not wanting to be outdone.
"Hmm, good." Dickteping nodded, changed the subject, and said suspiciously, 'You usually come back empty-handed; why was it so easy to capture someone today? No trick, right?'
"No, no! We were very careful; we didn’t see anyone following us on the road—absolutely safe!" said the long-haired mercenary, raising his thumb.
"Yeah, we brothers will definitely not mess up; this old woman is likely a new refugee in Avignon, with no precautions at all, like a fool."
Short-haired mercenary.
Alice gritted her teeth in anger, making a clicking sound; these guys always insult her, test her limits, and if they don’t fight, they’ll end up looking for teeth on the ground, making it hard for her to vent her hatred.
Dickteping slightly lowered his guard and ordered, 'Open it so I can take a look?'
The two mercenaries hurriedly opened the sack, revealing Alice's face for Dickteping to see.
Alice showed no reaction; she continued to feign unconsciousness, wanting to hear if there were any other secrets.
"Tsk! Not a little girl? At this age, could she be a virgin? If not, she’s not worth much." Dickteping showed a disappointed expression.
"Boss, you don’t know; we’ve kidnapped too many little girls, and those refugees have wised up, tightly guarding their daughters, leaving us no chance." said the long-haired mercenary, venting his frustration.
"Yeah, boss, this is the one we caught after staking out all night; definitely a virgin." said the short-haired mercenary in agreement.
"Although she’s a bit old, we can make do; give her a drug so she doesn’t wake up causing trouble, then lock her up with yesterday’s little girl, and the day after tomorrow we’ll meet the old customer and sell them both together." Dickteping casually waved his hand.
"Okay."
The two mercenaries busied themselves, preparing to imprison Alice in the jail.
Alice thought that there seemed to be no useful intelligence left; it was time to rebel!
SurpriseMotherfucker- 一
Alice suddenly opened her eyes; her saint-tier magic and battle aura erupted like a bomb, blasting outward!
The two mercenaries who had kidnapped Alice were blown away like cannonballs on the spot, falling into deep unconsciousness.
"What!?" Dickteping widened his eyes, startled, and jumped up from his throne.
Countless golden icicles shot up from the ground, sharp as thorn bushes; the intense cold lowered the underground temperature below freezing.
Alice slowly lifted her head, staring directly at the mercenary leader Dickteping, revealing a smile full of hostility—
"It seems you are the head of the traffickers, right?"
"Stop the nonsense; come down quickly to die."
Ten thousand leaves

title: Chapter 43 — Death!
content:
Chapter 43 — Death!

Volume 15 · Chapter 43

Alice's sudden burst of power gave Dickteping quite a fright. Originally I thought things were going smoothly—kidnapped a young woman, but it turned out to be a powerful intruder sneaking in! I had been constantly telling myself to be careful, yet I ended up attracting a meddling stray dog—really, two good‑for‑nothings! Dickteping cursed them bitterly in his heart, quickly recovered from the shock, and fixed a solemn gaze on Alice. Amid the relentless chill, the fierce Saint-tier pressure kept crashing against the surroundings, mixed with a faint dragon aura that made one instinctively feel fear. Dickteping clearly sensed that the opponent's pressure exceeded his own, especially the magical power that crushed him from above, forcing him to be cautious. Although Dickteping's strength among Saint-tier experts is only mid-tier, he does have a dwarf‑made firearm at his side, so he isn't completely helpless against this uninvited Alice. In the past, many strong ones have come looking for trouble for Dickteping, but almost none gained any advantage, and some even nearly fell and died at his hands. So Dickteping knows Alice's strength surpasses his, yet he feels no panic. He glances at the adventurer's proof on her neck and taunts: “An adventurer from Britain? Or a cock‑eyed from Rexham? Haha, you actually pretended to be a refugee to sneak in. “....Alice's expression turns embarrassed, she angrily snaps, “Shut up! You human‑trafficking scum!” “How interesting~—truly a justice‑filled adventurer adult, who sent you? Did someone commission you to take me out?” Dickteping says, unflustered. “People like you, who do endless evil, don’t need anyone to commission me.” Alice snaps angrily. “So that’s it—you’re just a nosy fool~” Dickteping shows a mocking expression, provoking, “Do you really think you can beat me alone?” “Why not?” Alice narrows her eyes, silently letting her magic and battle qi surge. “You’ll pay for your big talk—going in alone like a lamb into a tiger’s den, you’re asking for bad luck, idiot!” Dickteping raises his firearm, aims at Alice, and pulls the trigger without hesitation. A deafening “boom” rings out—Dickteping’s tiny firearm actually erupts with the roar of a magical cannon. The high‑grade monster crystal in the barrel shoots out at a speed the eye can barely follow, its momentum intent on quickly taking down Alice! The monster crystal explodes in mid‑air; the tiny crystal rivals a fierce bomb, flames erupting and roaring in all directions! The cramped underground chamber instantly becomes hard to breathe in, the rumbling tremors as if the chamber might collapse at any moment. “Huu~” Dickteping blows smoke from his barrel, smirks, “Don’t think just because your pressure exceeds mine I’ll fear you—people like you I’ve killed too many.” The flames dissipate, a golden ice wall perfectly shields Alice, slowly spreading outward. What’s with that firearm? How is its power so huge!? If I were even slightly distracted, I’d surely suffer heavy damage! Alice’s brows knit tight; though startled by the firearm’s might, she isn’t really afraid, for her fused ice wall is extremely hard and won’t be pierced. “You don’t really think this will let you beat me, do you? “Hmph, of course—I was just testing you a bit. Looks like you’re still lacking; worthy of me getting serious now… the real show has just begun…… Dickteping spreads his arms, exposing his weaknesses blatantly, his demeanor wildly arrogant, Saint‑tier battle qi spilling from his body. Besides using the firearm’s design technique, he basically knows no other martial arts, but he can reinforce himself with battle qi, fully unleashing his potential, surpassing human limits! Dickteping gathers his strength for a moment, opens his eyes, fervently locks onto Alice, baring his teeth in a grin. “You’d better not let your guard down, otherwise you won’t even know how you died!” As his words fade, Dickteping’s figure instantly turns into a golden streak of light, leaving an afterimage where he stood. The sound of tearing air—swoosh, swoosh, swoosh—accompanied by the golden Saint‑tier battle qi, like a flash of lightning cutting through the air! With battle qi boosting him, Dickteping’s potential is fully unleashed, his speed pushed to the limit—so fast the naked eye can hardly track it! So fast! I can barely see it! Knowing I’m weaker than him, is he trying to gain the edge with speed? ! Alice can’t figure out how Dickteping will attack, but his bizarre movement and speed startle her. Bang! Bang! Bang! Like thunder, the gunfire erupts nonstop, a rain of monster‑crystal bullets pouring from all directions! Dickteping moves like lightning, constantly circling Alice while shooting, firing madly from every angle! For a moment it seems countless Dicktepings have formed a gun squad, surrounding Alice from all directions as if each were a separate person! Alice’s heart jumps—this barrage density is indeed terrifying; a single hit could seriously wound her. In desperation, Alice intertwines her magic and battle qi, instantly forming a 360° dead‑angle ice‑wall defense, even sealing the top of her head! Although she’s enclosed herself, she perfectly protects her safety, gaining a brief respite. The dense monster‑crystal rain smashes against the ice‑wall like thunderous cannon fire, though it can somewhat damage the wall, it cannot pierce through at all. It seems that against such fierce bombardment, Alice’s fused ice is superior, able to provide perfect protection. But Dickteping’s vitality is too ferocious; Alice’s ice wall can only hold for a moment, not forever—sooner or later the barrage will pierce it. Dickteping’s reloading speed is especially skilled, almost seamless; each monster‑crystal bullet he fires is hard‑earned gold and silver from his usual gains! The explosive shockwave of fire envelops Alice’s ice wall; Dickteping shows no intention to stop moving and shooting, the barrage grows ever fiercer, and he doesn’t forget to taunt: “What’s the matter!? You were just so arrogant—why are you hiding in there like a turtle? Come out and meet me head‑on! “Shout! Alice grits her teeth; under such fierce gunfire she simply cannot leave the ice wall, or she’d surely be riddled with bullets. [Some garbled text: “口牡」玩] Just a second later, the fierce rain of gunfire stops, as if Dickteping outside has ceased his attack? What’s going on? Did he run out of ammo? Alice feels a surge of doubt when she hears a “dong”‑like crisp sound—the supposedly indestructible fused ice wall is actually pierced by a golden monster‑crystal! The golden monster‑crystal is clearly Saint‑tier in quality, utterly different from the earlier high‑grade crystals, its attack power multiplied several times; the solid ice wall instantly turns to soggy crumbs! Seeing the golden monster‑crystal about to shoot through Alice’s forehead, she panics and chooses full‑body dragonification. Dragon horns, dragon wings, dragon tail, and dense white‑blue gem‑like scales appear in an instant, pushing her defensive capacity to the peak! At this moment, bolstered by dragon power, Alice’s perception, speed, and physical strength all multiply, already very close to a true dragon form. Yet, with the dwarf‑crafted firearm plus the rare Saint‑tier monster crystal, this shot’s power exceeds imagination— “Pu”‑ Alice’s body is pierced right through!

title: Chapter 4 — Fear Fantasy
content:
Chapter 4 — Fear Fantasy

Volume 15 · Chapter 4

“Cough!”

With Alice’s cry of pain, the solid defensive ice wall collapsed like a house of cards.

Alice’s figure was thrown out directly from inside, landing heavily on the ground.

In the moment before the Saint-tier demon core would have pierced her skull, Alice, relying on the dragon race’s powerful perception and reaction, managed to side-step her body just in time.

She barely avoided the fatal strike, but her shoulder was pierced, taking a serious hit. If the demon core had pierced Alice’s brain or heart, she would have been done for.

This dwarf-made firearm was incredibly powerful, able to perfectly unleash the demon core’s force and increase its attack capability by one level.

High-tier demon cores could unleash the power of Saint-tier magic, and Saint-tier demon cores could unleash power comparable to that of a realm-level mage!

“Tsk! Did she avoid it? Her desire to live is really tenacious...”...

Dirkter’s face darkened as he hadn’t expected Alice to avoid the strike, which was quite surprising.

His relentless firepower suppression was all a distraction, all for the final shot. When the Saint-tier core was fired, he should have won.

In his imagination, Alice would have been unable to avoid the final shot, with her head being pierced by the demon core, ending the battle.

However, reality struck him hard, and this unexpected feeling made Dirkter very annoyed.

“Huff...” Alice, now in her dragon form, held her pierced shoulder and slowly stood up from the ground. Though it wasn’t a fatal injury, the situation was not optimistic, and she was gasping in pain, her body not responding to her commands.

Dirkter observed Alice’s appearance after her transformation, feeling a slight surprise in his heart. Seeing dragon traits on a human was quite strange.

“Dragon race power? Haha! Interesting, where did you get this? Can you tell me?”

Dirkter was very interested in Alice’s dragon race power and wanted to take it for himself.

He knew that if Alice didn’t have the power of another race, she would have been blown away by the shot just now.

The number of people who could avoid Dirkter’s attacks was limited, and besides Alice, there was only one knight in black armor who could do so before.

“Can you shut up, you disgusting bastard, I feel sick just hearing your voice!” Alice cursed, biting her teeth, and after the initial pain, her body began to regain some sense.

The dragon race’s self-healing ability was still effective, continuously healing Alice’s pierced shoulder, visible to the naked eye.

Although the crystal core attack and piercing from the firearm were very powerful, the damage was not sufficient to cause large-scale destruction, only leaving a hole the size of a finger on Alice’s shoulder.

As long as Alice wasn’t severely injured, her self-healing ability would help her heal well, but if it exceeded the self-healing threshold, the healing effect would not be as obvious.

Just like the recent tree spirit, after Alice was beaten to the point of being severely injured, the help provided by her self-healing ability was minimal.

“Oh? Even now, you’re still so angry? Honestly, if we weren’t enemies, you would be the type of woman I like. It’s a bit of a pity to kill you...” Dirkter shrugged, displaying a helpless expression.

“Shut up! Die!”

Although her shoulder hadn’t fully healed, she could still move around.

Alice didn’t want to delay the time, wanting to finish the fight quickly and kill Dirkter!

She noticed that Dirkter wasn’t good at close combat, preferring to shoot at the critical moment!

It was likely that Dirkter’s own strength wasn’t great, relying on his weapon.

Alice crouched down, on all fours, her eyes locked onto the distant Dirkter.

Her back wings spread out, her scales shimmering and vibrating, as if they had come to life, breathing and exhaling.

Golden qi and magic surged outward, spreading outward continuously.

With Alice as the center, the entire underground room was soon frozen, the temperature dropping to an unbearable level.

Ice crystals covered the surroundings, glowing like they were in an Arctic tomb.

Suddenly, Dirkter felt his legs were frozen, and he couldn’t move!

He looked up, hatred in his eyes, and loaded a Saint-tier demon core into his firearm.

Dirkter realized that Alice intended to fight him head-on, but the surrounding temperature was getting colder, and his body’s reactions were no longer as quick, and a bit stiff.

If he continued like this, he wouldn’t be able to expose his weakness before he froze to death here. Enduring the fight was too much of a disadvantage, and he had to finish it quickly!

“Do you want to die with me? Ugly bitch! Wake up and realize, don’t think you’re a dragon just because you have dragon power! You won’t even get close to me before I shoot you! Come on! Let me send you to hell myself!”

Alice’s face showed anger, suddenly springing up, her body launched like a cannonball, her dragon wings vibrating rapidly, quickly rushing towards the frozen Dirkter, with fierce dragon power approaching.

“Goodbye!” Dirkter grinned wildly, raised his firearm, aiming at Alice’s heart, and began to pull the trigger.

However, in the blink of an eye, Dirkter saw the approaching Alice hesitate for a moment, slightly stunned.

Dragon power has a very obvious intimidation effect when facing weaker enemies, making people feel extremely fearful in their hearts.

This is the suppression of a higher species on the weak, almost unavoidable. If the mind is not strong enough, it is very possible to be controlled by fear.

Alice’s strength was greater than Dirkter’s, perfectly forming a suppression in terms of strength.

A person like Dirkter, who relied on weapons, could not resist the invasion of dragon power?

At this moment, the intimidation effect of dragon power made Dirkter see terrifying illusions--

The Alice rushing towards him was not a human, but a blue-white giant dragon, with beautiful and dazzling scales like jewels, dragon wings that covered the sky, and a massive body filling the entire underground room.

Instantly, Alice seemed to truly become an ice and frost dragon dancing, accompanied by a fierce blizzard, it opened its huge mouth, and towards the tiny Dirkter, issued a mocking roar, mixed with the cold wind, making the hearts of ordinary people tremble!

Dirkter’s face turned pale, his whole body shook like a sieve, and his firearm was almost unable to hold, his lips moving, but he couldn’t say a word, only a faint sound came from his throat.

“......”

“...What... monster?

“I can’t believe it, isn’t it really a dragon?”

(°O°)

Correction and recent comment responses

That was episode 44, I was too excited to update and made a mistake. Recently, I’ve been coming home too late, and I have less time to write.

Moreover, I found a part-time job two months ago, although it’s not tiring, it’s no longer a full-time status.

From 10 AM to 5 PM, with one day off a week.

After work, I can’t get home quickly, often needing to entertain for one or two hours.

So the updates are fewer, and that’s unavoidable. Please understand, everyone has their own life.

I do read the comments, and at the beginning of the month, I read them from start to finish, checking every one, but I rarely speak anymore.

Especially when my daughter isn’t out yet? Crack, come with a bad review, I’m speechless.

It seems like these readers are teaching me how to write books, right? I’ve said I control the pace, and I won’t let readers interfere.

Especially after my sister’s book, I’ve learned my lesson. Readers with one mouth, and the book becomes chaotic.

So no matter what they say, my daughter will come out when she’s supposed to, and a bunch of bad reviews I’m also unshaken.

And they say the plot is boring, well, that’s normal, it’s not that I’m doing it on purpose.

I’m also not stupid, I know that intense confrontation is more attractive.

Like Death God, the blue-dyed big villain is what keeps people watching.

So I also understand, but in the early stages, to speed up the pace, the supporting and antagonist plots are suppressed.

Because everyone knows, the faster the pace, the more enjoyable it is, especially in the early stages, when the story worldview is complete, most people will care about other characters.

So in the early stages, I didn’t make a mistake with the plot, I made some choices to speed up the pace, and later it will change.

I started writing supporting and antagonist characters, and the people who criticized watering them down, now they’re complaining that I don’t write them, I can’t do anything, I’m very desperate, haha.

Today, coincidentally, the title was wrong, so I took the opportunity to talk about recent matters, which was supposed to be written in the afterword.

Many of the plots in this volume have brought out the earliest clues, right? The plots are all moving forward, so don’t worry.

My daughter will also come out according to the timeline, don’t be too anxious.

Then, illustrations, because I can’t afford it for a month, so I’ll combine it into two months, mumu.

Finally, I wish you all a happy Mid-Autumn Festival, a happy October 1st, and I’ll send you advance blessings, and I won’t say anything after that, hehe~

title: Chapter 45 — The Treacherous One
content:
Chapter 45 — The Treacherous One

Volume 15 · Chapter 45

The overwhelming power of the dragon sent a chill through Dickter, and he was overwhelmed by terrifying illusions.

That massive frost dragon, it looked like it was eating itself alive!

Dickter's body trembled as he, who had aimed at Alice, lacked the courage to pull the trigger!

Alice shook her dragon wings, and a cold wind mixed with snow swept in!

Every time Alice's power increased, she would learn some magic and martial arts from the inheritance crystal.

There was a technique called "Ice Dragon Impact," which was a high-level martial art of the dragon race.

By combining a dive at super high speed with qi, it could unleash tremendous destructive power, usually shattering the enemy's internal organs.

This technique was very fast in dragon martial arts, and was perfect for dealing with Dickter.

Although Alice didn't have a dragon's body, she could use her fists to replace it and still unleash the original power!

In a few breaths, Alice reached the terrified Dickter and used Ice Dragon Impact, slamming her fist into his face!

"Ugh!"

Dickter let out a piercing scream, waking up, and his entire face was distorted and sunken at that moment.

Alice used all her strength to throw Dickter's body, then shook her dragon wings and flew up, creating a fierce storm!

Dickter, who was thrown back, hard hit the frozen wall, and the cracking sound of the wall's collapse echoed, with the wall being struck with horrifying cracks!

Dickter spat blood and fell to the ground, feeling as if his spirit had been reached, swaying and collapsing to the ground.

With just one punch, the arrogant Dickter was beaten into serious injuries, with his face deformed.

Alice circled in the sky and dove down again, using Ice Dragon Impact for a second time, wanting to end Dickter's life, but she didn't know that-

"I'm sorry! I won't do it again! Spare me!"

Dickter, who was kneeling on the ground, begged desperately for his life, begging Alice to spare his life?

The strong desire to survive made Dickter abandon all his dignity, even if he had to kneel and lick Alice's feet now, he would be willing.

Alice's fist hovered over Dickter's forehead, stopped the attack, and did not choose to kill this despicable man.

She was naturally kind-hearted, and since the other party had surrendered, killing him was obviously not a necessary choice.

Alice wasn't someone who killed people without blinking an eye, and her kind nature made her decide to let Dickter live, but he must accept a certain punishment.

Moreover, Dickter was also an important clue for the mission, and he still needed to ask the girls who were kidnapped about who they were sold to, so he couldn't be killed.

Dickter trembled all over, slightly raised his head, and his face was already beaten beyond recognition, with blood flowing from his nose.

He had tears in his eyes, sobbing pitifully, looking like a victim, and was actually cried by Alice!

Looking back at his previous arrogant appearance, Dickter was completely different from just now.

Dickter looked at Alice's fist, which was close to him, and was terrified to the extreme, feeling the deep cold from it.

"I'm sorry! I won't do it again! I surrender! I'm wrong! I'm your little brother."

Dickter's appearance made Alice feel a bit of sympathy, she withdrew her fist, and said harshly, "Why not surrender early? If it weren't for the matter to ask you, such a villain, I would have killed you long ago!"

"I'm sorry, Heroine, spare me! I promise I'll never do it again." Dickter hit his head on the ground, as if he had lost all his fighting spirit.

"Hmph!" Alice coldly sneered, slightly relaxed her vigilance, thinking to tie up Dickter and take him away for a thorough interrogation.

However, just as Alice had relaxed her vigilance, Dickter suddenly raised his head, staring at Alice with a malicious gaze, showing a triumphant smile.

"Naive fool! Do you really think I can beg for mercy? Die!"

Dickter pointed the firearm at Alice's head, and without the overwhelming power of the dragon's intimidation, he had regained his freedom and was more determined than ever to kill this female adventurer.

"Uh!" Alice's face turned pale, not expecting Dickter to suddenly turn on her, and everything was a deception to relax her vigilance, looking at the black muzzle, she felt the threat of death.

Dickter's cunning was far beyond Alice's imagination, and what he said was completely unreliable, and he was a man of lies.

In such close proximity, Alice was unable to avoid the firearm's shot, and was in a desperate situation.

Dickter smiled cruelly, becoming more and more arrogant, but a variable occurred as he was about to pull the trigger-

A huge explosion!

"What?!"

The wall behind Dickter suddenly collapsed, as if it had been broken by brute force!

Numerous stones fell, burying the confused Dickter under the rubble.

Poor Dickter, who had been planning for so long, was interrupted by someone.

After the underground hall became quiet, Alice looked at the other side in surprise, and it turned out that Merlin had arrived here!

Merlin was holding a mercenary who had been beaten to a bloody nose, as if he was torturing him?

Merlin also looked at Alice with surprise, obviously surprised that she was right next to him.

The two of them were only separated by a thick wall, fighting each other.

"Merlin, why did you arrive now?" Alice frowned, breaking the silence, with a tone of complaint, as she was always fighting alone.

Merlin shrugged his shoulders, threw the lifeless mercenary on the ground, and kicked aside the screaming enemies.

"Uh, Merlin has become used to Alice's casual attitude, but still feels dissatisfied, as she is on a mission! Why are you taking a nap? Can't you be serious and die me this guy?"

Merlin walked through the just broken wall, into the underground hall, looking around, "So, you were right next to me, and I was looking everywhere, I poisoned all the mercenaries here, and they all said they didn't know, I thought they were lying to me, haha."

Alice frowned, thinking that it was this guy's negligence, and those beaten mercenaries were just air vents!

"You sword, take it." Merlin threw Alice's sword to her.

Alice felt a pain in her shoulder when she picked it up, although she could move, the injury was not yet healed.

"What's wrong? Injured?" Merlin asked in surprise.

"It's not a serious injury." Alice suppressed her anger.

"That" Merlin stepped on the rubble, frowned and looked around, very confused, and said-

"By the way, where is the leader of the mercenaries?"

"I didn't see him."

(u -_.))?

title: Chapter 46 — Mysterious Scroll
content:
Chapter 46 — Mysterious Scroll

Volume 15 · Chapter 46

"Down beneath you." Alice pointed at the ruins under Merlin's feet.

"Is that so?" Merlin looked down at the ruins beneath him, having completely failed to notice that Dikteping had been buried down there.

With a "bang," Dikteping struggled out from the very bottom layer of the ruins and swiftly retreated backward, putting distance between himself and the enemy.

"Hmm!?" Merlin exclaimed in surprise, looking at Dikteping bursting from the ruins. "So you're the leader of the mercenaries? Hurry up and surrender; don't waste our time."

Dikteping's physique obviously wasn't as tough as Alice's; being beaten repeatedly had left him heavily injured, blood flowing from multiple wounds on his body, his condition worsening by the moment.

He kept panting heavily, looking utterly bedraggled; it seemed this was the first time he had suffered such a heavy loss.

Dikteping glared at Merlin with hate-filled eyes, gritting his teeth against the pain of his injuries, still not forgetting to mock the opposition.

"Surrender? What a joke? Who do you think you are? Managing to take out my subordinates as a Black Iron adventurer is not bad, but don't get too cocky, you idiot!"

"If you refuse to surrender, then I'll just have to beat you to death." Merlin said blandly, as if delivering a final ultimatum to Dikteping — after all, they still had to investigate the missing persons case; killing him wasn't the best option.

"Hahaha, you think I'll lose just because it's two against one!? That woman's strength is pretty good, but what are you? A trash Black Iron adventurer isn't even qualified to be called combat power!" Dikteping aimed his gun at Merlin, feeling it would be much easier than dealing with Alice. "This is a duel between me and that woman; you piece of trash, disappear!"

The moment the words fell, Dikteping viciously pulled the trigger, venting all his previous resentment onto Merlin —

A thunderous bang exploded, the firearm spewing a long tongue of flame, and then that Saint-tier magic beast crystal core shot out activated.

Carrying destructive power that could penetrate everything, it reached the space between Merlin's eyebrows in a single breath; in the next second it would be a headshot kill!

"Mer—"

Alice cried out in alarm, just about to warn Merlin to be careful — this firearm's power was no small matter.

But Alice only managed to force a single syllable from her throat before she fell silent again, swallowing all her warning words back down.

Alice stared wide-eyed in shock, finding the scene before her utterly inconceivable; her worry had been completely unnecessary.

Only to see Merlin, facing the magic beast crystal core about to blow his brains out, extend his hand at a speed the naked eye could barely capture — a single swipe, the motion just like he was swatting a fly.

That Saint-tier magic beast crystal core with extremely strong lethality, seemingly unstoppable, was directly batted away by Merlin's hand, deviating from its original trajectory and shooting off to the side!?

The magic beast crystal core made a 90-degree right-angle turn, plunging into the ground and instantly triggering a massive explosion; flames soared into the sky, sweeping the surroundings, the entire basement shaking violently.

"Is this the power you're so proud of? May I ask, is the toy gun fun? This kind of thing can only bully rookies, right?" Merlin questioned expressionlessly, feeling this mercenary leader was very weak, but the toy in his hand wasn't bad — still, it wasn't his own strength; trash is still trash, fundamentally incapable of changing the facts.

"What!?" Dikteping was instantly startled by Merlin's action of swatting the bullet away with his bare hand; his eyes bulged, his heart seized with horror — impossible! That was a Saint-tier magic beast crystal core! How could its power possibly be neutralized by hand!? Am I seeing things!?

Alice's expression was a bit unnatural; she had inexplicably been saddled with the "rookie" label, so she awkwardly thought to herself: although I'm never easily surprised no matter what Merlin does, every time I see it I still find it inconceivable — is this guy's flesh harder than the hardest metal in the world? Even my dragon form couldn't block that shot, so why can he easily deflect it and act like nothing happened?

"Alice, I'll handle this guy; you stand back. Since he refuses to cooperate, we'll just use force to make him submit." Merlin walked toward Dikteping, his bearing completely without any guard — with this mercenary leader's strength, it would be very hard to injure Merlin.

"Ah—" Alice didn't say anything, only able to leave things to Merlin, thinking he should have a sense of proportion — Dikteping very likely knew about the blood race matters; they absolutely couldn't beat him to death.

Dikteping fearfully swallowed, subconsciously taking a step back, cold sweat trickling down his forehead, feeling that this unimpressive-looking guy before him was not simple, not someone to be gauged by common sense.

However, Dikteping still didn't truly submit; he thought Merlin might have just gotten lucky deflecting the Saint-tier magic beast crystal core the first time.

If the second shot also fails? Only then would he believe his weapon truly had no effect on Merlin.

To survive, Dikteping racked his brains trying to catch Merlin off guard and pull off a sneaky counter-kill maneuver.

So Dikteping went "thud" and knelt on the ground, immediately bursting into tears, bawling his eyes out.

"I was wrong! I surrender! Please spare me! I'll never dare again!"

Merlin came to stand before Dikteping and asked testily, "Really?"

"Really! Just now I was brain-dead; if I'd known you were this strong, I'd definitely have actively cooperated with you! As long as you leave me a way to live, I'll do anything!" Dikteping said through tears, but his hand behind his back was secretly loading a second Saint-tier magic beast crystal core into the firearm, still not giving up on the idea of a sneak attack on Merlin.

"Your confession has zero sincerity, though?" Merlin had seen too many scumbags, all sorts of characters — seeing Dikteping hiding both hands behind his back, he knew exactly what was up with just a slight thought.

"I didn't— Mmph ah—"

Dikteping hadn't even finished speaking when Merlin punched him square in the face, the whole person flying backward and crashing heavily into the throne, shattering it, coughing up a pool of blood.

"Sorry, a guy like you isn't worth trusting; I'll only feel at ease after breaking all your limbs." Merlin blew on his fist, revealing a wicked smile.

"Ugh—"

Dikteping clutched his nose bleeding nonstop, eyes wide, staring at Merlin in disbelief; his injuries had worsened again, he could barely move, his whole body feeling like his bones were being torn apart.

Damn it! Why!?

My routine doesn't work on him at all!

This guy is completely different from that woman just now!

Ruthless attacks — doesn't he have a shred of sympathy!?

No! If this keeps up I'll die; how can I die in a place like this?

Looks like I have to use that thing here, otherwise I definitely won't escape today's calamity!

Dikteping gritted his teeth, enduring the pain as he fished out a badass scroll from his bosom and unfurled it.

"Want to make me your prisoner!? Hah, dream on! What kind of skill is two against one!? I've got a powerful helper too! Prepare to die!"

"That scroll—" Merlin narrowed his eyes, feeling it looked familiar somehow!

Dikteping bit his own finger, dripping blood onto the scroll, whereupon the magic array on it seemed stimulated, instantly activating!

A huge magic array rapidly unfolded, covering the entire great hall of the basement — in an instant black mist rose up, as if some path had been opened!?

Dikteping shakily stood up; he could no longer fight for the moment, but he was brimming with confidence in this summoning scroll, revealing a arrogant grin.

"Come on! Today this grandpa will let you two poor-ass adventurers open your eyes!"

"Get a good look — from the mysterious First Demon Lord Palace—"

"The legendary Great Demon—"

(▼皿▼)

title: Chapter 47 — Head Maid of the Demon Lord Palace
content:
Chapter 47 — Head Maid of the Demon Lord Palace

Volume 15 · Chapter 47

Alice's eyebrows were tightly furrowed on her forehead, and she had to raise her guard, as she felt a heavy demonic aura emanating from the summoning magic array.

It was obvious that Diketping hadn't lied; this was truly a demon-summoning magic array!

Alice instinctively looked at Merlin, noticing his expression was also rather serious. She thought, a great demon from the First Demon Lord Palace? That's not Merlin's hometown?

Merlin remained silent, recalling the magic inscribed on the scroll just now. It felt strangely familiar. Oh, it was a scroll from his hometown!

Watching the black mist rise, gradually filling the entire underground hall.

Merlin's heart suddenly became a bit uneasy. Maybe some of his acquaintances were about to arrive. He didn't know who it would be. Please, don't let it be that girl, Lilith!

If Lilith was summoned over, then his position would be exposed. At that time, this clingy little thing might come looking for him no matter what, which would be a disaster!

After Merlin left the Demon Lord Palace, it seemed he wasn't doing too well either. If his sister came knocking on the door now, she would definitely see him as a useless stay-at-home older brother!

And with Lilith's personality, she would definitely refuse to leave once she arrived. Could he still live a peaceful life? He couldn't have any more troublemaking deadweight at home!

Merlin could still remember the last thing Lilith said to him, "It's like you're a madman—

There are a lot of fox spirits outside. Brother, don't get tempted, or I'll kill every single one of them! Not leaving a single one! I'll pull out their hair strand by strand, skin them, then put them in lava to roast into meat dry, and finally eat all of them without leaving any scraps! Hehehe hehe hehe..."

Crap! Although he and Alice weren't really married, that girl would definitely find it hard to tolerate that. At that time, she would definitely try every means to kill Alice.

But with his useless little sister's strength, it seemed she was completely no match for Alice. She would definitely be beaten to a pulp by Alice. These were all troublesome matters.

Merlin's face turned dark, and he supported his forehead, feeling a dull pain in his brain. His whole being was resisting the thought of seeing Lilith, praying that this little demon wouldn't come.

Magic scrolls made by the First Demon Lord Palace were all used to summon great demons. The rule was that no matter who the user was, they had to obey the instructions and help them with one thing.

And those who could be called great demons were at least at the level of serving as officials in the demon race. So the one summoned over would definitely be one of Merlin's subordinates, the seven great generals, and Lilith was among them!

Merlin being so tense at this moment was understandable, after all, he was about to see that long-unseen, mentally unstable sister. He felt very embarrassed inside.

Diketping saw Merlin and Alice's faces turn grim and was overjoyed, thinking they were afraid. He immediately began to mock them with a victor's attitude—

"Hahaha, what! ? Now you know fear, right! ?"

"Tell you, it's too late!"

"I want both of you to die here. Don't even think about leaving my territory!"

Merlin slightly frowned, thinking this guy must have some misunderstanding. Did he look like he was afraid? As long as it wasn't his sister, others were completely pressure-free.

"This summoning demon scroll I spent 800,000 gold coins to get from a very special channel. It can summon a powerful demon for me to command. As long as I want, I can do anything~" Diketping gestured wildly, clearly a case of forgetful after being thoroughly beaten earlier, "So, what method should I use to torture you two to death next?"

"Merlin, this scroll..." Alice wanted to ask Merlin what it meant. If it was a familiar friend of his, it might be hard to take action.

Merlin raised a finger to Alice, telling her to be quiet first, then turned to Diketping and said, "No matter who you summon out, it won't change your situation. Give up quickly."

"Yo~" Diketping showed a very annoying smile, saying with a sense of superiority, "You're talking big. That's a demon, an extraordinary warrior of the upper race. A normal person would have their legs trembling just hearing about it. How could you possibly fight back? You two will probably be defeated for sure..."

"Ugh!" Merlin found Diketping's attitude very annoying. So he said in a very serious tone, "Alright, I won't hide it anymore. Let me tell you the truth. The demon you summoned from the First Demon Lord Palace, no matter who it is, has to obey my commands. It's not realistic to have a demon fight me."

"Pfft! What the hell are you? Upper-class demons need to obey your commands? You're the first one I've seen who can blow such big talk in front of me!" Diketping raised a thumb, with a completely dismissive expression.

Merlin had nothing to say anymore. Further explanations would probably be useless. Alice looked at Diketping with a strange expression, watching this poor guy run full speed down the road of self-debasing.

Merlin wasn't blowing smoke. Although he was a former arrogant monarch, his subordinates wouldn't dare to attack him boldly. Until a new arrogant monarch was appointed, Merlin was still considered the only master of his subordinates, and it was hard to change that.

The huge magic array on the ground began to rotate, and the surrounding black mist also rotated, gradually converging at the center. The surrounding area began to echo with sharp winds. A vortex appeared in the magic array, as if opening a door to another realm—

A young woman with long purple hair, wearing an exquisite maid outfit, slowly rose from the center of the vortex, her back to Merlin and Alice.

Alice's expression became serious. She could feel the demonic aura from that woman and couldn't help but secretly ask, "Merlin, do you know that demon?"

Merlin saw the maid outfit and immediately felt relieved. It was good that it wasn't Lilith who came, but the situation was still not optimistic. "She's Ophelia, the head maid of the First Demon Lord Palace. She was specifically responsible for taking care of my life and Lilith's. She has very senior qualifications. She was once my mother's servant and has always served our Lucifer family."

"Head maid? Is her strength average?" Alice could sense Ophelia's pressure wasn't weak, but the true strength could only be accurately judged when faced directly.

"Average strength? What are you thinking? Ophelia isn't a watered-down version like my sister. Among my seven subordinates, her strength should be in the upper tier." Merlin answered in a low voice.

"Since she's your subordinate, will she attack us?" Alice hesitated to ask, feeling the situation becoming subtle.

"I think you might have some misunderstanding," Merlin's face darkened, licking his dry lips seriously. "She definitely won't attack me, but you... that's not certain."

"I think she will definitely kill you, and with all her might."

title: Chapter 48 — My Maiden, Oh
content:
Chapter 48 — My Maiden, Oh

Volume 15 · Chapter 48

“Ah! ?Why are you picking a fight with me?” Alice didn't really understand what Merlin was saying; this summoned demon isn't his subordinate? How could self-2 also count as Merlin's companion? Attacking himself isn't reasonable, right?.

“This”. Merlin showed a hesitant expression, seemingly not wanting to tell Alice the reason, because his head maid Ophelia is a pervert who is extremely obsessed with him!

When Merlin was young, he hadn't noticed anything strange about Ophelia; she seemed like a very enthusiastic older sister.

However, the truth was not like that; Ophelia is a pedophile who likes young males, and she has a special fondness for Merlin as he grew up.

Ophelia's true form is a spider-like demon, extremely perverted, enjoying raising and then eating human boys once they're grown.

Naturally, what Merlin objected to wasn't that, because demons are inherently cruel; what he couldn't tolerate was Ophelia's behavior.

I recall that bright afternoon, Merlin, as the heir of the Pride King, though just a brat, naturally had a noble status.

As the head maid of the Demon Lord Palace, Ophelia was ordered by Lucifer II to personally take care of Merlin and Lilith.

One day, Ophelia took Merlin's dirty clothes away, preparing to wash them.

But the old clothes contained something important; Merlin just needed to find them, making sure they weren't ruined in the wash.

As a result, in the Demon Lord Palace's laundry room, little Merlin hid at the doorway, peeking inside, only to witness something that would haunt him for life.

Ophelia held Merlin's underwear, pressing it to her mouth and nose, vigorously sniffing, making a sound like a bellows.

She looked extremely excited, as if she could barely breathe, her body trembling, her eyes bloodshot, muttering.

This is the prince's scent! ?How wonderful! It's the smell of virginity! Ah~, I can't take it, Prince!

Little Merlin stood outside with a dark face, not daring to make a sound; this incident was so shocking that he hasn't forgotten it to this day.

From that moment on, the image of Ophelia as that enthusiastic older sister shattered in Merlin's heart; he no longer believed there could be any normal beings among demons—they're all freaks.

Merlin never told anyone about this melodramatic incident; his relationship with Ophelia remained as before, but he just couldn't forget it.

Moreover, Ophelia's seniority is old; she's a capable subordinate of Merlin's mother, so some face should be given, and it can't be casually spoken about.

Ophelia watched Merlin grow up, gradually becoming the new monarch, possibly still harboring special feelings for him in her heart.

Dickteping sized up the female demon before him, estimating it was his first time seeing a demon, and found it quite novel.

Although Ophelia's appearance is very similar to a human's, the two horns on her head, belonging to a demon, fully indicate she is a demon.

book.SFA鼋。

“Is this a demon?

Dickteping muttered absentmindedly, feeling Ophelia's strong pressure, and couldn't help feeling delighted inside.

Haha! As expected, the scroll I bought for 800,000 gold coins is indeed an extraordinarily powerful great demon!

So what should I do with those two wild dog adventurers? Today I must make sure they never return!

Dickteping's face showed a smug smile; the joy had already eased the pain from his injuries.

Ophelia's eyelids twitched, she slowly opened her eyes, looking at Dickteping before her, and spoke with a superior tone.

“Human, why have you summoned me here?

“There's business! There's business!” Dickteping nodded like a pecking chicken, pointing at the two behind Ophelia, and said fiercely, “Help me kill those two!”

“I understand.”

Ophelia nodded, began to fulfill the contract, obeying the summoner's instructions.

She slowly turned, extended her palm, and instantly a green gas ignited in her palm, burning like a flame, fiercely and continuously.

This gas that looks like flame is actually a toxin made by magic, capable of destroying any living body's flesh, and it's Ophelia's specialty attack.

As long as one is stained with Ophelia's poison, if she isn't killed, it will continually destroy the enemy's flesh.

Ophelia looked at the two behind her; her pressure became evident, her strength at a medium level within the Saint-tier.

“Hurry up and let me give you wish2 SF...

Ophelia hadn't finished speaking when she suddenly let out a sound of surprise, staring at Merlin in disbelief, and the poison gas in her hand went out directly.

No way! ?His Majesty is actually here! ?

Clearly, since leaving the Demon Lord Palace, there's hardly been any news.

Only occasionally does he send a letter, still hiding all addresses!

I never expected to be summoned out of the blue, yet I saw His Majesty!

I'm truly incredibly lucky! This is a huge profit!

Originally, Princess Lilith was worried sick every day because she couldn't find her brother's whereabouts, but now I've found him!

Indeed, maybe all this is fate's arrangement? Perhaps I and His Majesty...

No no no! I'm just a lowly servant; how could I imagine such an impossible thing?

Merlin is no longer that little brat; he's my master now!

Ophelia hadn't seen Merlin in a long time; upon seeing him now, she actually felt an urge to cry, her mind full of lewd ideas.

Dickteping was dumbfounded, his mind full of doubts: What's happening? Why did you stop attacking? I thought you were in heat, but you're a ferocious great demon! I summoned you to kill, not to have this old woman go on a date! Get serious, don't disgrace the demon race!

SF starts small news.

Even Alice couldn't quite understand, thinking: Is this really Merlin's subordinate? A powerful great demon? It doesn't seem aggressive at all, and his demeanor somewhat resembles my teacher.

Watching Ophelia cover her cheeks and twist her body, she looks utterly like a lovesick fool.

Merlin's mouth twitched, he gave an embarrassed laugh, thinking: Is Ophelia having her old problem again? She likes to overthink; who knows what little drama she's playing out in her head.

To break the tense atmosphere, Merlin forced himself to speak first, waving his hand and saying.

“Long time no see, Ophelia-sister.

“Eh! ?” Ophelia froze, then her eyes flickered with a hungry light, emitting a series of “hehehe” perverted laughs.

Your Majesty still calls me sister?

That's right, after all, I've been taking care of you since you were little.

I have no resistance to young males, especially since I raised you myself!

What to do? This old lady can barely suppress her maiden heart anymore, cool hehehe.

title: Chapter 49 — Alice Can't Bear It Anymore
content:
Chapter 49 — Alice Can't Bear It Anymore

Volume 15 · Chapter 49

Alice watched Ophelia lost in delusion, her expression gradually turning strange, thinking, "How is this female demon like Jenna?! It seems even more exaggerated."

Merlin looked embarrassed, thinking, "Did he not hear me speaking? Why is he daydreaming by himself?"

"Ophelia sister? Ophelia sister! Can you hear me speaking?"

"Ah! I almost forgot."

Ophelia heard Merlin's call, covered her small mouth, and showed an expression as if just waking from a dream-

I accidentally started imagining things, how rude of me.

You are my master, Your Majesty; it's been so long, I must greet you properly.

Ophelia slowly approached Merlin, lifted her skirt, and bowed, expressing her astonishment.

"Your Majesty, long time no see, I never expected to meet you here, I am truly honored."

"What! ?"

Dickteping stared wide-eyed, face full of shock, an over-the-top frightened reaction—he never imagined the summoned great demon would call this black-iron adventurer 'Your Majesty'! ?

"No way! ? How could this happen to me! ?"

As it turns out, this black-iron adventurer wasn't lying; the summoned great demon actually obeys him!

Since this female demon from the First Demon Lord Palace calls him 'Your Majesty,' could his identity be

Dickteping's expression turned fearful; he dared not think further, his heart filled with unease.

Since the summoned great demon is this black-iron adventurer's subordinate, I definitely won't have any good luck!

I'm doomed; if things go badly, I might die here today!

Dickteping had heard a bit about the arrogant ruler residing in the First Demon Lord Palace—a guy who kills without blinking.

The Holy Church had dispatched countless armies to subdue him, but each time they returned defeated, forcing the Church's strength to retreat ten years, leaving it in a dire state with no usable forces!

In that case, that infamous arrogant ruler must be this black-iron adventurer before us, right?

Good heavens! This is terrifying—the Great Demon Lord didn't stay in the Demon Lord Palace but is wandering freely in human territory!

Dickteping's face turned pale, cold sweat trickling down his forehead; just the thought of that arrogant ruler's killing star filled him with fear, feeling that today he's more likely to suffer misfortune =

"I didn't expect you to be summoned either," Merlin said with an embarrassed sigh.

"Thanks to that lowly human, but raising my hand against Your Majesty would be disrespectful." Ophelia shot a puff of poison gas at Dickteping behind her.

Dickteping, whose survival instinct was strong, had wanted to sneak away, but the poison gas came, and he hurriedly flung himself to the ground, trembling.

The poison gas splashed onto Dickteping's throne, and in the blink of an eye, the luxurious seat corroded into a pool of filthy water.

Seeing this, Dickteping's legs went weak; if he hadn't dodged just now, he would already be useless!

"Don't don't kill me! I dare not! I didn't know you knew each other! If I had known, even if beaten to death I wouldn't dare to act arrogant!"

Behind Merlin, Alice slightly furrowed her brows, thinking, "What strong aggression! When I served as Hero, I never saw such a powerful being in the Demon Lord Palace—could it be because I was stationed elsewhere at the time?"

Merlin couldn't be bothered to look at Dickteping that little rat-, and instead asked about his sister's situation: "Ophelia sister, how is Lilith? Is she still behaving? Won't she cause trouble for others?"

"After you left, Her Highness also tried to leave the Demon Lord Palace, but the council wouldn't allow it, so she could only stay temporarily, busy every day maintaining the stability of the blood pool seal, so occupied she had no time to play; she looks exhausted, I even feel heartbroken." Ophelia spoke in the tone of a neighborly older sister, as if Merlin and Lilith were family.

"Indeed, that's right," Merlin chuckled dryly, thinking that after he left, Lilith basically took over his duties, becoming the temporary manager of the Demon Lord Palace.

"The council of idiots actually voted to dismiss you—what a foolish decision, causing huge losses to the entire First Demon Lord Palace." Ophelia looked worried and continued, "Especially Her Highness Lilith, she misses you terribly; every day she mutters, Why hasn't Your Majesty sent a letter? Even in her sleep, she talks in her dreams, calling your name."

"This made Merlin instantly feel pressured; although he finds Lilith a clingy nuisance, after all she's his sister, so he does miss her a bit."

Hearing Ophelia say Lilith's life is now hard, Merlin felt a twinge of guilt.

Annoyed, he just patted his butt and left, dumping the mess on Lilith, making himself seem like an irresponsible failure of an older brother.

"But seeing that Your Majesty's health is still fine puts me at ease; I'm sure Her Highness Lilith will be glad to hear it. We thought your life outside would be awful, that nothing would go smoothly," Ophelia said with a laugh, seeming to think Merlin is a shut-in, unreliable in many things.

"Don't look down on people; I, after all, am the older brother Merlin, with a few black lines on my forehead, thinking that leaving my hometown makes people wonder how uneasy I am! ?"

Ophelia laughed, stepped closer to Merlin, sniffed him, and instantly showed a beaming expression.

"Long time no see, Your Majesty seems more manly than before; just a whiff makes it hard to bear."

"Um, Ophelia sister, don't do that, normally—Merlin frowned and stepped back, thinking this female pervert, can she not keep up the act anymore?"

"Cough cough."

Ophelia realized her lapse and quickly coughed twice to hide her embarrassment, but she accidentally couldn't hold back.

One must be dignified, cultivated, and act like a proper lady to bewitch Master Merlin. See

She has watched Merlin grow up since childhood, naturally knowing he yearns for such women.

Ophelia forced composure, using her slender fingers to ambiguously poke Merlin's chest.

"What does it matter? You've never left the Demon Lord Palace from childhood; this is the first time you've been away so long, it's worrying. Not only does Her Highness Lilith miss you, I"

"That" Merlin's face darkened; Ophelia really does take care of him, making him too embarrassed to expose her perverted fact!

Having remained silent behind them, watching the two reminisce, Alice couldn't sit still; she couldn't bear to watch.

At first it was fine, but the atmosphere grew increasingly ambiguous, and they started having physical contact!

How could Alice possibly hold back? If I were dead, I wouldn't even exist!

So the angry Alice bluntly stepped between Merlin and Ophelia, separating them.

"Just speak properly, don't get handsy, okay? !"

"I'm still here—am I just air to you? ! ?"

"Give me a break, E point ah"
