My cousin is getting married; as his cousin‑in‑law, I have to run around before and after, visiting relatives and helping with the wedding preparations, etc.
So please bear with me; things will be fine after the wedding on the 14th.

title: Chapter 18 — Arrest Merlin
content:
Chapter 18 — Arrest Merlin

Volume 16 · Chapter 18

"Hmm." The little girl was comforted by Alice; although she still felt scared, she was much better now, continually snuggling into Alice's embrace seeking safety.
Alice held the little girl tightly in her arms, lifted her head, and glared at the group of black-clad people, shouting angrily, "Who sent you?!"
The black-clad people didn't speak at all; a few of them had been pierced through the body by golden ice spikes, yet they slowly stood up, seemingly unharmed.
This made Alice inevitably wary; a normal person whose body is pierced would scream, even die, yet these people showed no reaction at all!
The black-clad people completely refused to communicate with Alice, and certainly wouldn't openly say they were here to kidnap the child, lest Alice become even more wary.
Before Alice could figure out the situation, the black-clad people joined forces, and a second wave of attack came!
High-level battle qi condensed, surging like a tide; dozens of black-clad people shot out like cannonballs, wielding sharp curved blades, aiming to slice Alice to pieces on the spot.
Seeing that the enemy couldn't be reasoned with, Alice could only choose to fight back, first knocking down these black-clad people then talking later!
Only seeing where the sword light passed, countless golden ice shards suddenly appeared, like winter ice blossoms blooming, all spinning wildly, slicing any enemy daring to approach.
Alice held the little girl, protecting her with all her might, as she charged into the midst of dozens of black-clad people; her posture was extraordinarily fierce, entangled with the enemies, secretly gaining the upper hand.
Although the black-clad people came with great force and their attack methods were fierce, they could hardly defeat Alice; they could only barely manage to tie her down.
The sharp ice shards acted like knives, wounding the black-clad people, yet they could keep fighting like undead; Alice found it hard to inflict lethal damage on them.
Moreover, Alice discovered that these enemies seemed to fear her blade, preferring to take magical attacks rather than be cut by her fine sword—
Strange? What exactly are these people afraid of?
The plaza.
As Merlin flared with anger, showing an utterly merciless— face, he directly subdued the refugees present.
Seeing Merlin's god-of-death—like eyes, many refugees dared not step forward rudely to tug at him.
Just now Merlin said if they dared to cause trouble again, he wouldn't be polite; looking at the person lying on the ground vomiting blood, already severely injured, the refugees had no doubt about Merlin's wordsM/ =
Faced with Merlin's overbearing martial deterrence, these people felt a bit intimidated, fearing that any misstep would provoke him.
But compared to the pain of losing loved ones, death obviously couldn't deter everyone; there were still emotionally charged people cursing:
"You bastard, you kidnapped my child, you should go to hell!!!"
"Where is my child? Where did you sell her to?!"
"You're all wanted by the lord, yet you're still lying! Besides you foreigners from Great Britain, who else would do such a despicable thing"
Merlin never put down the longsword slung across his chest, took a deep breath, and was made irritable by this crowd.
How do I look like a wanted criminal? Apart from being teased that my smile looks like a female gangster, there's nothing else that would cause misunderstanding.
Even if I, as a demon, am as cold-blooded as possible, I wouldn't lay a hand on a little brat; if it got out to the demon realm, I'd be laughed at.
Although demons are evil, their nature is similar to that of dragons; they consider themselves a superior race, most are unwilling to bully the weak with strength, and even if they win, it's not glorious.
Little demons all have this mindset, let alone those high-and-mighty monarchs.
Merlin took a deep breath, trying to suppress his anger, glanced at the civilians around him glaring at him, and said coldly.
"I kidnapped your children? Hah, would I lay a hand on a brat who hasn't even grown hair? You say I did it—where's the evidence? Without evidence, blindly accusing me is irrational; you're all idiots, huh?"
The crowd was left speechless by Merlin's retort, yet many still thought Merlin was now wanted, and began to panic, desperately shifting blame—
"You've been exposed by Lady Camilla!"
"Exactly, Lady Camilla wouldn't casually slander anyone!"
"Lady Camilla is the wisest lord; since you've been personally wanted by the lord, what are you covering up for?"
"Tsk!" Merlin clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction, feeling these people were like they'd been brainwashed—whatever Camilla says, they believe it; it's a blind worship of a single person, already reaching an infuriating level!
Just as Merlin was about to stalemate with this crowd, a sound of surprise came from afar, and the crowds packed three layers inside and three outside automatically made way.
Soldiers in red robes surged forward with weapons in hand, over three hundred forming a knightly unit; judging by their attire, they should be Camilla's lord's personal guard.5  =
Their steps were neat, their momentum fierce as they charged; the clinking of their armor made clear sounds, obviously heading straight for Merlin.
Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking, "How could an army come after me so quickly? This must be Camilla's premeditated plan—could it be to capture me?"
Actually, Camilla knows that Merlin, as a Great Demon Lord, is immensely strong; sending out three hundred personal guards is hardly a match.
This group's main task is to contend with Merlin here, buying time to snatch the little girl from Alice's side.
As long as they can't retreat, being pinned here means this suicide squad of personal guards has fulfilled its mission.
A group of armored soldiers surrounded Merlin completely, letting the surrounding civilians disperse, preparing to focus all force on Merlin.
Seeing the lord's personal guard arrive, many people secretly cheered, thinking that this evildoer Merlin would finally receive severe punishment.
Merlin vigilantly watched these people; his brother's face was deathly pale, like he had albinism.
As long as these people dare to be rude, Merlin will unsheathe his sword without hesitation; these people differ from civilians—they are armed soldiers.
Since soldiers are inherently aggressive, there's no need to be overly polite.
From the personal guard stepped out someone resembling a squad leader, who came straight to Merlin and showed him the wanted poster.
"You must be the criminal who kidnapped the Avenion child, right? Now, according to the lord's command, we are to arrest you; please drop your weapons and come along quietly—"
As soon as the words fell, over three hundred personal guard knights drew their waist swords, glaring fiercely at Merlin; if Merlin dared to resist, they would swarm him and take him down.
Merlin wouldn't so meekly put down his weapons; what does it matter that the opposition is the lord's personal guard?
If I insist on fighting, no one could possibly do anything to me.
Merlin's gaze swept over these stern knights; he suddenly—smirked, speaking in a teasing tone:
"What if I say no?"
"What can you do?"
"You want to arrest me? I have to admire your courage"
、(-_-))

title: Chapter 19 — Ambush
content:
Chapter 19 — Ambush

Volume 16 · Chapter 19

“If you refuse to cooperate, we’ll have to take forceful measures.” The captain of the personal guards gradually grew stern.

“Sorry, I never intended to cooperate with anyone,” Merlin said seriously, tightening his grip on the katana. “If you’re resolved to die, come on then—give it a try.”

The atmosphere suddenly grew tense. Over three hundred knights slowly approached Merlin, apparently really intending to test themselves against him.

The personal guard captain looked into Merlin’s eyes, gripped his sword hilt tightly, and without further thought raised his sword and struck—sounding the charge.

Yet the captain had barely lifted his sword before his body froze rigid in place. His head flew through the air, blood splattering everywhere.

In merely a few breaths’ time, the captain lay beheaded, his neck cleanly severed by Merlin’s blade, leaving a perfect cut.

Before the onlookers could process what had happened, the captain became a headless corpse, blood gushing forth in alarming volume.

“Heh, you really do dare attack me?” Merlin calmly sheathed his katana, which had somehow been drawn without him noticing, and taunted the guards.

The other knights looked down at the headless body at their feet and fell silent, terror spreading through their hearts.

As for the gathered crowd, they were so frightened by this brutal scene that their legs turned to water. Screams erupted as people scattered in all directions.

“Murder! !”

“This is a demon!”

“Run! This guy’s gone insane!”

Panicked shouts intermingled, and the crowd that had surrounded the area in dense layers promptly broke apart, scrambling away in every direction.

Many felt Merlin’s conduct in the Crusade was utterly arrogant—attacking the lord’s personal guards without a second thought. He had reached the point of disregarding everything!

The night felt somewhat oppressive. The dim yellow glow of torches barely illuminated the square. Merlin stood at the center of the encirclement, and the three hundred-plus knights were so cowed by him that not a single person dared approach within a short span of time.

“Move aside. Don’t block my way.” Merlin’s expression grew serious as he attempted to leave.

Not a single knight made room. They persisted in surrounding him.

At that moment, the headless corpse of the fallen captain suddenly sprouted countless blood vessels from its severed neck, reattaching its head.

Then the previously cold corpse rose again. The severed head rejoined its neck, and that horrific wound was visibly healing before their eyes.

“Huh?! Merlin slightly sharpened his focus. This opponent possessed an immortal constitution—beheading it and it still rises? Clearly, this is no human!

“Skreeeetch!!!”

With a roar, every guard’s body elongated, their skin turned jet black, and their armor cracked under the transformation.

Membranous wings unfurled from their backs, and countless crimson eyes glared wrathfully at Merlin.

These guards had completely lost their human appearance, becoming fanged, clawed monsters. They looked similar to demons, but with subtle differences.

In particular, their sharp canine teeth resembled straws. That was hardly a demonic trait.

Merlin had seen vampire specimens in Count Austin’s basement. He recognized these beings immediately—weren’t these the very creatures from legend? Vampires!

All three hundred-plus guards transformed into vampires in an instant, their wings shaking as they rose skyward, circling above Merlin and emitting piercing shrieks!

Frowning, Merlin strapped his katana to his waist and drew another blade—a holy silver katana gifted by Count Austin. In a calm voice he said—

“I see. So you’re the vampires hiding in the shadows.”

“You’ve had us looking for quite some time.”

---

Inside Alice’s room, dozens of black-clad figures relentlessly engaged her in combat.

Sheets of ice shards like razor-sharp knives collided crazily with the attackers’ strikes.

Because she needed to divide her attention protecting the child in her arms, Alice couldn’t unleash her full power and was constrained.

After all, the little girl knew no magic or martial arts. Casting wide-range magic would cause the room’s temperature to plummet.

Adults could endure the cold for a while, but children were physically delicate. It was hard to imagine her surviving the chill’s assault.

The black-clad figures, sensing Alice’s divided focus, pressed their attacks fiercely, showing no mercy.

Though ordered to capture them alive, Alice was simply too strong. Even at full strength, the attackers found it nearly impossible to kill her.

Shadows wove together as curved swords danced into a dense,绞杀 formation. Clearly, these individuals had received special training—their coordinated attacks were terrifying!

Although their teamwork partly compensated for the power gap, the disparity was too vast to bridge.

These opponents were merely High-tier. Alice’s magic had reached the peak of Saint-tier. Even trading lives, they could hardly hope to win.

Soon the black-clad figures began to falter, being driven back one by one by Alice alone.

Her magic paired with sword techniques seemed utterly flawless, leaving these people with no counterplay.

Forget kidnapping—

even getting close to the child proved difficult.

Alice swung her blade fiercely. Ice spikes shot forth like a machine gun—thrust, thrust, thrust—raining down on the black-clad figures.

They writhed as if seized by epilepsy, ice spikes piercing their bodies and causing violent tremors. Yet after a few seconds, they rose again, seemingly unharmed.

“Ugh!” Alice furrowed her brows. She realized this approach wouldn’t work. These opponents possessed formidable healing abilities. No matter how grievous the wound, they recovered completely—like adhesive bandages that refused to be peeled away.

But Alice had noticed something. The fact that they feared closing distance with her so intensely, avoiding her Holy Sword at all costs, fully indicated they were dark creatures. Only dark beings would instinctively dread the «Light Aria».

This slender sword was a treasure capable of harming even Merlin. Naturally, it would terrify dark creatures. Visible wounds wouldn’t even heal—and holy power could burn them to death outright.

“Baby, hold onto me.” Alice offered a reminder. Feeling the situation growing awkward, she realized she’d be worn down to death if this continued. She had to close the distance and swiftly slay these dark creatures. Their healing was infinite, but her magic and battle energy were finite.

“Mmph, Mommy…” The little girl nestle deeper into Alice’s arms, too frightened to open her eyes. From earlier, she’d heard nothing but the sounds of combat.

“Don’t be afraid. Mommy’s here.” Alice comforted the child. Seeing the little girl’s terror thoroughly awakened her protective instincts.

Before the words had even faded, countless shadows erupted from the ground like whips, instantly binding Alice rigidly in place!

“Ah!” Alice felt her entire body tightly constrained and privately grew alarmed. Who?! Was there another ambush lurking in the shadows?!

“Truly a Mithril-rank adventurer. As persistent as expected. But with you needing to protect a child, just how much of your power can you actually bring to bear?” One of Camilla’s subordinates slowly rose from among the shadows. Dressed like a diligent young butler, his expression was mocking as he directly reached his demonic claws toward the little girl in Alice’s arms—

“Hand over the child to me obediently!”

“Without Lucifer the Third by your side, you’re nothing to fear!”

---

Helped my cousin set up his new room this afternoon. The wedding’s tomorrow.

title: Chapter 20 — The Blood Clan Reveals Itself
content:
Chapter 20 — The Blood Clan Reveals Itself

Volume 16 · Chapter 20

“Is that Camilla's person! ?”
Although they had only met a few times, Alice still recognized them—wasn't that the person always standing by Camilla's side?
Now Alice is bound and restrained by the opponent's eerie shadow magic, unable to move at all, falling into danger!
“You don't need to know all that, just hand over the child in your arms!” Camilla's subordinate raised his hand— the shadow like tentacles— all reaching out to pull the child from Alice's arms.
“Mommy!” The little girl had already been scared to tears, seeing the black shadow spreading toward her, she clung tightly to Alice, pleading for protection.
“Stop!” Alice shouted angrily, but her body was bound, making it hard to move, able to seal her own actions— obviously the opponent is also a Saint-tier mage!
Alice, trying to struggle, temporarily couldn't break free from the control; although she could forcefully break free with magic and battle aura, it would likely harm the fragile baby in her arms.
Indeed, having to divert attention to look after the little girl left Alice unable to exert her full strength, constantly in a state of being restrained.
The shadow tendrils, as if entering an uninhabited realm, forcibly pulled the little girl from Alice's embrace, successfully separating them.
“Mommy! Mommy!” The little girl screamed desperately in midair, already terrified to tears, appearing utterly helpless.
“Damn it! Give my child back!” Alice grew anxious, beginning to disregard everything in her struggle to break free.
Camilla's subordinate directly tossed the little girl to his black-clad companion behind him, coldly saying, “Take this child to Lady Camilla, you go ahead, I'll stop this woman.
“Yes!” The black-clad person slightly bowed in response, they held the petite young girl and covered her mouth to prevent her from shouting.
“Give her back!
Alice's eyes flashed with a dazzling gold deep within; having her child taken made her extremely anxious, no longer holding back, her magic and battle aura erupted violently.
The overwhelming magic and battle aura intertwined, instantly tearing apart the shadow magic's restraints, allowing her to move.
“What! ? That's even a magic that Saint-tier magic beasts struggle to break free from!” Camilla's subordinate was startled by Alice's aura; he already thought this female adventurer was tough to handle, but now having taken her child and enraged her, isn't that even worse?
The black-clad individuals holding the little girl were dumbfounded; originally Alice worried about harming the child, so she was restrained everywhere, but now having no reservations, how could they possibly lose?
Alice held a slender sword, both powers on her body increasing, preparing to slay the gang that kidnapped her child with one strike.
The shadows on the ground suddenly gathered and turned into thick black vines, launching a sudden attack toward Alice.
“Cough!”
Because Alice's eyes were solely on retrieving her little girl, she failed to notice Camilla's subordinate preparing an attack.
Her whole body was directly flung away by the black giant shadow, slamming hard into the wall.
“Wuu wuu wuu!!!” The little girl saw her mom get blown away and cried out in worry. work
“You're outright ignoring my attempt to retrieve the child? Are you looking down on me?” Camilla's subordinate's tone was filled with anger, “You go, I'll deal with this adventurer.”
Dozens of black-clad individuals nodded, turning into a wisp of black smoke, directly taking the little girl and vanishing on the spot, likely returning to the ancient castle.
Alice suffered a heavy blow while completely unprepared; the injury on her body was not light, feeling as if all her bones were about to be pulled apart.
It seems Camilla's subordinate is not weak; he was able to gain the upper hand in battle against a Mithril adventurer, and since he could be deferential to Camilla, one can glimpse the lord's strength from this.
Camilla's subordinate slowly walked up to Alice, gripping her neck with both hands and lifting her off the ground.
“You bunch of bastards, Alice has blood trickling from the corner of her mouth, she's gripping Camilla's subordinate's arm, trying to pull it open.
Camilla's subordinate kept exerting force with both hands, trying to strangle Alice to death, “Don't blame us for being heartless; if you must blame someone, blame yourselves for meddling—Camilla Lady already gave you a chance, but you didn't cherish it, so prepare to die.”
“You really are colluding with the mercenaries who kidnapped the child, aren't you?” Alice felt waves of breathing difficulty, being choked by the opponent causing a bit of suffocation.
“You don't need to know that; you're all going to die anyway, even if you knew the truth, what good would it do?” Camilla's subordinate revealed a contemptuous smile, his sharp teeth faintly visible.
Alice resisted the feeling of suffocation, she wondered, do humans have such sharp teeth? It looks more like some beast's.
“Go die, insignificant adventurer.” Camilla's subordinate's eyes changed, he increased force in his hands trying to directly twist Alice's neck.
Alice's pupils contracted slightly, her heart racing, an extreme cold aura permeated her body, freezing Camilla's subordinate's arms, instantly disabling both hands!
“Tsk! Really a pain!” Camilla's subordinate quickly retreated, his hands forming a layer of golden ice shards.
“Cough cough cough!” Alice fell to the ground, coughing a few times, barely managing to break free from the opponent's control, otherwise she would truly be in danger.
Camilla's subordinate severed his own arms, regenerating new ones at a visible speed, without suffering frostbite.
“Ugh!
Alice saw the opponent's newly regenerated arms, feeling shocked and doubtful, realizing why she couldn't kill these people earlier— with such regenerative ability, any damage inflicted on them had little effect.
However, the sharp fangs combined with the extraordinary regenerative ability immediately made Alice think of a certain creature— a vampire!
“You couldn't be of the blood clan, could you? !”
“Oh? Only now realizing? I thought you knew from the start.” Camilla's subordinate loosely gripped his newly regenerated arms a few times.
Having received a clear answer, Alice instantly understood many things, then her eyes flared with anger as she said, “I see, you colluded with the mercenary group to abduct girls— what did you do to those people? !”
“You seem to have some understanding of our clan; what do you think kidnapping humans could be used for? Besides drinking human blood to keep us from hunger, is there anything else?” Camilla's subordinate no longer hid himself, revealing his true form: black skin, undulating membranes, and a ferocious face with sharp mouth and monkey cheeks.
“You bunch of beasts, your doom has arrived.” Alice gripped her slender sword, pointing it straight at Camilla's subordinate.
“You really think you can beat me?” Camilla's subordinate showed a disdainful expression, mocking, saying—
“Even among the blood clan, I am a very high-ranking existence.”
“Skilled in using shadow magic to launch surprise attacks, I hardly ever fail.
“To be frank, if I get serious, you are no match for me.”
“I once endured a siege by a horde of magic beasts, yet survived in desperation and killed their leader.”
“As for strong humans? I've forgotten how many I've slain with my own hands.”
“Mithril adventurer? Heh, seems to be the weakest among the foes I've killed.”
