Although she hadn't managed to defeat Beelzebub, it was still a force to be reckoned with. The only special魔兽 that could rival the fire demon was the water nymph from the British legends.

"Your servant knows the value of the fire demon. I immediately protected Batiloka's body and secretly sent it to the underground research facility in the capital city. However, because the host Batiloka has died, the fire demon's power is fading. If we can't find a container to hold its power, it might... disappear completely..." Blaze replied concisely, knowing that the fire demon inside Batiloka was an important force for the empire, so he naturally couldn't be careless.

Margaret frowned, her fingers tapping the armrest repeatedly. She took a deep breath and said, "Find a suitable person as soon as possible. Although we can't sign a contract with a fire demon like this魔兽, nor can we completely control it, we absolutely can't let it fall into other people's hands, even if it rots in our own hands..."

In the darkness, the sound of hooves echoed, and the luxurious carriage headed toward the palace.

The driver in front wore the attire of an imperial guard, his heavy, oppressive helmet covering his face.

He slowly raised his head, revealing a cunning face. It was none other than Diketping, who had been tailing Merlin and Alice—

A fire demon? A special魔兽 that needs a human container?

That sounds like a very precious thing...

Heh, interesting~

◇

Room in the mansion.

After arriving here, Merlin and Alice were warmly received and given a large room to rest.

After arriving in the capital city, their leads were once again cut off, and they couldn't find the escaped Medes.

So now they could only wait patiently to see if Margaret could find Medes' whereabouts, which might help them uncover the secrets of the vampire clan.

However, Merlin and Alice had originally failed to obtain the map to the Dracula ruins. It was already a great achievement that they had managed to get this far through all the obstacles.

Although they couldn't directly find the vampire clan's ruins, they were very close to the final truth.

Merlin pushed open the door to the room. Although it was dark all around, he could feel that the space was spacious, more comfortable than staying in an inn.

"Wow~, so big! Finally, we can rest!"

Alice followed Merlin inside. Seeing him stretching, she felt a bit annoyed and slammed the door shut with a loud "Bam!"

"Merlin..."

"Huh? What is it?" Merlin felt the atmosphere was a bit awkward. Even in the darkness, he could sense Alice's bad mood.

"You... you..." Alice was a bit hesitant, not daring to ask directly, her words stumbling.

"There's no one else here. Just say it straight, isn't it?" Merlin scratched his head.

"Um..." Alice hesitated for a moment and asked in a low voice, "Do you... do you like that little princess?"

"Who said that?" Merlin's eyebrows twitched.

"Everyone... has already designated you as her fiancé. Are you happy about it?" Alice asked tentatively.

"That's obviously a joke. How could a princess just casually designate a fiancé? Besides, if I were bound to a princess and lost my freedom, do you think I would be willing?" Merlin countered, thinking to himself that he hadn't even lifted the curse on his heart yet, and was already thinking about a stable, peaceful life? That was just a dream!

"Ugh..." Alice's face turned red, and she lowered her head, fidgeting and muttering, "Then... then do you think I'm worse than that princess? Her status, figure, personality... seems... seems a little better than me..."

Merlin held back a laugh, fortunate that the light was dim so Alice couldn't see. What did she mean by a little better? She was clearly out of her league, wasn't she?!

"Of course, a little better, that little princess is obviously better..."

"Huh!? You..." Alice's inner fire immediately flared up!

"Of course, no matter how good she is, it has nothing to do with me. I really don't like women who are too calculating. It's much more relaxed talking to you, with no pressure at all." Merlin quickly defused Alice's anger, still having a bit of self-preservation instinct.

"This... this is more like it..." Alice felt much more balanced.

"Isn't it you who's strange? Why didn't you explain our real situation? Hiding things, you must have something to hide..." Merlin thought it was strange that Alice hadn't explained that they were a fake couple.

"I..." Alice showed her true colors, finding it hard to explain, and could only pretend to be calm and coldly say, "I'm not... not afraid she'll steal you away? Who will pay me back then? Don't even think about running away, I'll be watching you closely,哼~!"

"Tsk!"

Merlin rolled his eyes, thinking Alice was really petty. If he wanted to run away, wouldn't he have done it already?

Merlin didn't want to argue with Alice and just wanted to rest quickly, so he walked to the table and lit the oil lamp, illuminating the dark room.

But just as he lit the lamp, a fierce coldness erupted from Alice's side, startling Merlin.

"What are you doing again!?"

"Stop..." Alice's fine sword was already drawn, and she was in a battle-ready stance. Her face was pale, her expression terrified as she stared at the left side, her hairs standing on end like a scared cat defending against danger!

"Hmm?" Merlin saw Alice's strange expression and realized something was wrong. He looked in that direction and saw a familiar person sitting in the chair.

Beelzebub removed the hood from his robe, looking sickly, like a ghost seen in the dead of night!

He slowly turned his head, his gaze focusing on the bewildered Merlin, and suddenly revealed a meaningful smile—

"Lucifer, I've been waiting for you for a long time..."

title: Chapter 3 — Beelzebub the Extreme
content:
Chapter 3 — Beelzebub the Extreme

Volume 18 · Chapter 3

Beelzebub was truly like a ghost, elusive and hard to grasp.

He had been beaten so badly by Merlin that he couldn't get up, yet here he was moments later?

It was as if he had complete knowledge of Merlin and Alice's movements, following them like a shadow.

Alice was on high alert, gripping her slender sword tightly, never expecting Beelzebub to tail them and appear so openly here!

Recalling Beelzebub's battle with Merlin, Alice immediately felt the pressure, realizing this manor had become extremely dangerous.

Beelzebub stared at Alice, shrugged his shoulders, and smiled. "Is it really necessary to be so tense? Are you afraid of me?"

Merlin observed Beelzebub for a while, thinking this guy wasn't here to cause trouble. If he were, he wouldn't be greeting them; he would have launched a疯狂 attack immediately.

The fact that Beelzebub could speak so calmly indicated he wasn't here to fight, but to fulfill his promise and behave a bit more properly.

So Merlin walked over to the tense Alice and gently lowered her sword arm.

"Don't be nervous, Alice. He has no ill intentions. He's not here to cause trouble."

Alice was still shaken, finding Beelzebub untrustworthy. She whispered, "What are you doing? He's our enemy, and he nearly paralyzed France. The fact that he's here... it must be a bad intention!"

Merlin sighed and quietly replied, "Relax a bit. I've already beaten him into submission. So in front of me, he'll definitely behave a bit more properly than before. You being like a hedgehog full of caution won't make him lower his guard either."

"...But..." Alice hesitated, still unwilling to trust Beelzebub. "He's a demon. Can you really trust him?"

"I'm a demon too. Do you think I'm trustworthy?" Alice countered.

"You..." Alice narrowed her eyes, recalling their past interactions. "Who knows if you've ever lied to me?"

"Ugh!" Merlin was displeased, thinking to himself... Even if I occasionally lied to Alice, there was no need to doubt myself so much?

"We should be cautious of this demon..." Alice glared at Beelzebub with hostility, but noticed Merlin wasn't moving. "You're on his side, aren't you?"

"..." Merlin hesitated, finding it hard to say. It was true he was a demon, but Alice was also a companion. Being caught in the middle was uncomfortable. "Anyway, calm down. With me here, what do you have to fear? Don't worry, Beelzebub won't eat you."

...Alice didn't say anything else, instinctively hiding behind Merlin, thinking to herself that even Merlin had been driven out, how could he still believe demons were the same? Although she could trust Merlin, she couldn't necessarily trust all demons.

Beelzebub on the other side grew impatient and said in a low voice, "What are you whispering about? Let me hear too. You two really look very affectionate."

"What right do you have? Who are you?" Alice retorted, feeling emboldened by Merlin's presence.

"Hmph, despicable humans..." Beelzebub's expression turned cold, clearly not liking Alice.

Merlin had black lines flowing down his forehead, thinking to himself how strange Beelzebub's tone was just now. Was he mocking him for being with humans? No wonder...

"Don't say nonsense, Beelzebub. Aren't you going to act recklessly this time?"

"Ha, do I need to ask?" Beelzebub shrugged his shoulders and continued, "Since I didn't win against you, of course I'll do as you said. This is the rule between demons and demons. I will abide by it."

Alice suddenly paused, hearing Beelzebub's words and slightly relaxing. It seemed like what Merlin said was true. He wasn't here to start trouble.

Merlin also secretly let out a sigh of relief. Not having to fight here was still a good thing.

"Don't get too excited, little..." Beelzebub paused, saying meaningfully, "Earlier, I didn't even use my real techniques against you."

"Shouldn't that be something I say to you? I didn't even use my sword slash because I thought it wasn't necessary to fight you." Merlin's words were equally unyielding, confronting him head-on.

"Hey!" Beelzebub's face darkened, saying with a hint of anger, "Your mother wouldn't be as difficult to deal with as you are."

"What does she have to do with this?" Merlin didn't want to discuss his mother and countered, "By the way, how did you end up here?"

"I've been following you all along. When I saw you were going to stay in this manor, I climbed in through the window in advance. After all, in the eyes of these insignificant humans, I'm a notorious demon. It's no longer convenient for me to show my face."

"You still have a bit of self-awareness," Merlin teased.

"Hmph, haven't you forgotten the promise you made to me?" Beelzebub suddenly changed the subject.

"What promise?" Merlin frowned, not remembering any promise he made to Beelzebub.

"Ugh! I said if you behaved a bit more properly, you would help me find Miranda. You've already forgotten so soon? I think your brain is only a little better than a fish's." Beelzebub became somewhat angry.

"Oh, Miranda? I almost forgot about her," Merlin's expression was exaggerated, as if deliberately provoking Beelzebub.

"Miranda always calls you teacher in front of me. She really admires you. If she saw you being so cold now, she would definitely be heartbroken. Although I don't mind you being cold to my sister, as her brother, I really want to punch you." Beelzebub's brows furrowed. His sister admired Merlin so much, yet this guy didn't even care about his sister's safety.

"Who is Miranda?" Alice suddenly asked in a low voice, feeling very curious, sensing some connection to Merlin.

"It's none of your business," Merlin waved his hand, not wanting to talk to Alice about it.

"...Alice puffed out her cheeks in anger, thinking why Merlin seemed to have such a rich romantic history on the demon side?

"Miranda's whereabouts... I do have some clues. She might have been captured by the Empire's Prime Minister, Medes," Merlin recalled what Margaret had said.

"Imperial Prime Minister? That bastard where is he? I'm going to twist his head off," Beelzebub's attitude immediately turned恶劣 upon hearing about his sister.

"That man was scared away by you. I don't know where he is. We're also looking for him, but we need Princess Margaret to gather intelligence, otherwise it's hard to find him," Merlin shook his head, complaining, "In the end, it's all because of your reckless actions. If you were a bit more low-key, how could you have scared Medes away and made things even more complicated..."

"I've been low-key for a long time, but it's been useless. If these humans don't feel fear, they won't know how terrifying demons are," Beelzebub paused, recalling Margaret, and his tone suddenly became meaningful...

"As for that little princess? She's just a scheming whore."

"She's not worth our trust. Her eyes are only on so-called interests."

"I've seen enough of these despicable humans, greedy and fearless of death."

"If you trust this princess, you'll definitely be played by her, even sold out."

"Believe me, Lucifer. In this world, besides my sister, there's no pure creature..."

title: Chapter 4 — Doglike Demon Lord
content:
Chapter 4 — Doglike Demon Lord

Volume 18 · Chapter 4

Alice beside him frowned at Belphegor's words, thinking this guy's ideas were too extreme—believing only his sister was worth trusting, and no one else?

However, Alice found Belphegor's words quite reasonable. She also thought Margaret wasn't a lamp that would drip oil, and it was a good opportunity to remind Merlin—- down.

"Merlin, I think he makes sense. That woman—stomach and intestines full of flowers, untrustworthy." Alice whispered secretly.

Merlin glanced at Alice—- eyes, "You're only agreeing out of personal bias, aren't you?"

Alice turned red and quickly explained, "...I'm not maliciously slandering them just because that fox spirit always flirts with you!"

Merlin rolled his eyes, temporarily not wanting to deal with Alice who confessed without being asked, and instead asked Belphegor, "Although you have some truth, can you find this man McDess another way?"

"I.... Belphegor's face turned awkward, hesitating in his response, "I don't know."

"Not knowing? Then wait obediently, okay? I thought you had another method, yourself?" Merlin shrugged his shoulders and continued, "I know this imperial princess has heavy schemes, and what she says is indeed hard to believe. But you also know the current situation—we can't find any clues at all. Better to be patient and wait. Maybe—when that princess finds McDess's whereabouts, it's good news for both of you."

"Wasting time waiting here is not as good as tearing apart all of France. As long as we kill the humble humans,— we'll definitely find my sister." Belphegor said with a half-smile.

Alice frowned, feeling that although Belphegor and Merlin are both Demon Lords, his behavior was completely different from Merlin. At least Merlin has normal human thinking, but Belphegor's mind is filled with slaughter. Could it be that only Merlin is special, and other Demon Lords have extreme sides too?

"Belphegor, doing this is useless. Putting aside whether you have the ability to destroy the human empires, even if you do, it might not save your sister, right? It will only make things more chaotic." Merlin said seriously.

"You this.... Belphegor narrowed his eyes, scanning Belphegor several times, "Seems smoother than before? Has wandering in human territory for too long made you timid? You're a Demon Lord at best, yet now you're becoming more and more like a lowly human~

Merlin found Belphegor's words somewhat irritating and displeased, saying, "If you want me to help you find Miranda, I'm willing to help. But if you're looking for trouble, then you'd better leave quickly, before I draw my sword and chop you— it'll be too late."

"Hahaha, Lucifel, you're still as obnoxious as ever..." Belphegor walked into Merlin, reaching out to grab his adventurer's proof on his neck. "Look at what you've become now. Stripped of the Demon Lord position by the council, wandering alone in the human world, and finally becoming.... inconspicuous black-iron adventurer? Truly makes me want to laugh. You once entered the Death Mountain alone to train, returned and killed a high-ranking demon noble to reclaim the throne, and commanded the seven legions of the First Demon Lord Palace— where has that spirit gone? Now you look like the lowest failure in the human world, put among beggars, and I wouldn't even notice you—... C bowl"

Alice looked at Merlin's back, seeing he had no reaction and didn't know what he was thinking one- mouth.

Was the Merlin who was once a Demon Lord a shining existence? Thinking about his usual actions, it's completely not visible.

It's a pity that Merlin's time as Demon Lord was too short, and even the Church doesn't have many records of him.

Guess I still don't understand him enough. If being Demon Lord was so successful, why insist on leaving after being fired?

Alice wouldn't know that Merlin has a curse on him, and if it's not lifted, he will never be able to settle down.

Merlin's forehead vein twitched, a bit unable to bear Belphegor's sarcastic tone.

He pushed Belphegor's hand open, not letting this guy touch his adventurer's proof.

"Finished talking? What's it to you? Old man was Demon Lord enough, okay? Do you have to be so meddlesome.."

"It's none of my business, just that your miserable state differs too much from before, I'm not quite used to it, Highness who is high above, now scrambling at the bottom of the human world? Are you willing? Don't you feel ashamed?" Belphegor seems to be provoking Merlin's dissatisfaction, not knowing what he's planning?

"What shame! ? Merlin doesn't steal or rob, he's much stronger than you!" Alice couldn't help but speak up for Merlin.

"Shut up! Lowly human, hearing your voice makes me feel sick." Belphegor's face full of anger,威压 immediately released

"Ugh!" Alice's face turned pale, Belphegor's威压 came like a mountain, making her feel deep fear!

"Ah, really? I do feel a bit ashamed, but you're also a high-and-mighty Demon Lord, weren't you knocked to the ground by me, isn't that more shameful?" Merlin showed an attitude of "a pig not afraid of boiling water", unmoved by Belphegor's words.

".... Truly hopeless...." Belphegor's facial muscles twitched continuously, obviously pissed off by Merlin, "When you first took hold of the First Demon Lord Palace, we other several monarchs were very opposed, but your draw-and-cut was indeed formidable, not to mention you're the son of Vivian, talented and gifted, not though I detest your inferior bloodline c but I quite like your eyes at that time, killing and decisive, without any other redundant emotions, simply a being born for slaughter....".

A layer of cold sweat appeared on Alice's forehead, thinking Vivian? This is Merlin's mother's name? Or heard for the first time? Merlin this guy never says.

"However your eyes now are no different from garbage, what made you change so much? Mo.... Belphegor for the first time actively focused his gaze on Alice.

"Mmph!" Alice was scared and retreated a few steps, her back breaking out in cold sweat, feeling she was just food in Belphegor's eyes!

"Is this your.-. human wife?"

Belphegor smiled playfully, carefully examining Alice, his nose constantly twitching, like he could judge her value based on the scent.

Among the seven Demon Lords blocking the way, Gluttony Belphegor's nose is most sensitive, and as long as he judges based on scent, he can get a lot of information that is hard to detect— this is his unique talent.

Belphegor just sniffed a few times with his nose, and suddenly his eyes lit up, "Innerly overturned Alice's evaluation of being a lowly human, thinking she has value.

"Truly good, the scent exuding from this woman is remarkably good, the sweetness... unprecedented, simply the masterpiece of the world! How can such a delicious human exist?"

"Evil.... Alice's face turned green, her whole heart was repulsed, they say eyes can kill women, what does Belphegor's nose kill count as? Nose women? So disgusting like a pervert!

"Not.... Belphegor's obsessed expression suddenly faded, becoming a bit serious, the topic turned to continue appraising Alice

"In this delicious sweetness, yet there is a feeling of rejection.

"Just what is it?"

"This woman is really human? Something that makes this demon king feel rejection...."

"Could it be from the Holy Spirits of heaven or something?"

(- one "-")

title: Chapter 5 — Protecting One's Wife Without Reason
content:
Chapter 5 — Protecting One's Wife Without Reason

Volume 18 · Chapter 5

Alice heard Belial's evaluation and couldn't help but feel puzzled. A saintly spirit from the celestial realm? What nonsense.

Although Belial spoke with great conviction, Alice couldn't understand a word of it. She was human, after all. What did she have to do with the legendary celestial realm?

As a species that had existed since time immemorial, the demon race had records of fighting against celestial beings, which is why they remained highly sensitive to sacred auras to this day.

However, the celestial realm was a plane that existed independently of the mortal world, much like Hell, and no one had ever truly seen it. Most of what was known were just legends.

Belial, being the demon in the demon race with the best sense of smell, instinctively felt a slight alertness toward Alice, sensing the aura of a sacred being.

"A saintly spirit from the celestial realm..."

Merlin blinked in surprise. He had heard of this title before, and it was considered the archenemy of demons.

According to records, celestial saintly spirits were servants of the Goddess of Light, and the most representative ones were probably angels with pure white wings.

Angels were hailed as messengers of the Goddess of Light, holding a status below the goddess but above all living beings, far superior to the common mortals of the Holy Church.

In the distant era of the demon纪元, the powerful demon race had fought against the saintly spirits descended from the celestial realm, paying an extremely heavy price.

The number of demons plummeted during the war, nearly facing extinction.

Six of the seven original Demon Lords perished, with only the Lord of Sloth surviving. The brutality of the war was unimaginable.

Among the current seven Demon Lords, Gluttony, Wrath, Envy, and Greed were all second-generation Demon Lords. Only Sloth was one of the original Demon Lords, having experienced that horrific war.

As for Merlin? He was merely a short-tenured third-generation Demon Lord of Pride, making him relatively young compared to the others and having no memory of the ancient war.

However, Merlin's mother, Vivian, might still have some memories and feelings about the war where the saintly spirits had nearly exterminated the demons.

That war between demons and saintly spirits lasted for a full century, ending with the saintly spirits retreating to the celestial realm and the demon race narrowly emerging victorious.

But the demon race had paid too heavy a price, never being able to recover its former strength and the glorious era of demons came to an end, giving way to the fourth era, the current age of humans.

If it weren't for the saintly spirits from the celestial realm eliminating the demons, with the demon race's former might, humans probably would have never been able to stand up. It all seemed destined.

Merlin became more alert, casting a suspicious glance back at Alice, thinking—

Belial's perception abilities were unparalleled among demons, rarely making mistakes. Could it be that Alice was truly from the legendary celestial realm?

"...Alice saw Merlin's doubtful look and mumbled, "What are you doing? Suspecting me... what saintly spirit? I'm human, you know? You've lived with me for so long and you still doubt me?"

"Cough!"

Merlin coughed lightly, thinking maybe Belial had made a mistake. Alice was too clumsy to be the demons' archenemy.

If saintly spirits were all that clumsy, how had they nearly exterminated the demon race before?

It might be the problem with Alice's rapier. The weapon itself carried a very heavy sacred aura, and it seemed to be a sealed item.

Merlin thought it was normal for Belial to have misunderstood, so he said to Belial,

"Belial, you should stop being so suspicious. She's definitely human. It's just that her rapier is quite rare..."

"Really?"

Belial narrowed his eyes, focusing on the Light Cantata in Alice's hands. Indeed, a heavy sacred aura was present.

The entire rapier seemed like a suppressed volcano ready to erupt, clearly its power was being restrained by something.

Although this sword seemed to be inferior to the pseudo-relic Red Siren he had previously fought, such a雄厚 sacred aura made it a rare and extraordinary weapon.

Belial retracted his perception, realizing he might have had a brief illusion due to his unstable mindset.

"If she's human, that's even better. She's radiating a sweet aroma. This kind of food is truly rare. If I could taste it, I'd be willing to live ten years less, hehehe~"

"...Alice shivered, constantly tugging at Merlin's sleeve for help. Seeing Belial's obsession with human flesh, she was truly terrified.

If it were just a common imp, Alice might not have been afraid and would have drawn her sword to cut off its head.

But this was Belial, one of the few top-tier demons. Even if Alice was upset, she couldn't do anything about it, as she simply couldn't fight him.

Although Alice felt that Belial appreciated her more than Merlin did, it wasn't the kind of appreciation one has for food!

Merlin's expression wasn't good. Seeing Belial's hungry look, it seemed he might really harm Alice. "She's not your food. Wipe your drool clean."

"Oh?" Belial looked at Merlin with a playful tone. "By the way, this woman is your human wife. You actually found a lowly human as your wife? That's truly unbelievable."

Merlin shrugged helplessly and explained, "We're not a real couple. We just had to be together for various reasons."

"Hey, Merlin, you heartless guy," Alice was very dissatisfied with Merlin's reaction, glaring at his back with puffed-up cheeks.

Alice had hoped Merlin could at least pretend to be her husband in this situation, so Belial would back off.

She hadn't expected Merlin to be so straightforward, being heartless to a certain extent, wasting her efforts.

"It's the truth, isn't it? It would be strange not to explain if people keep misunderstanding," Merlin countered.

"...Alice's face was already about to inflate like a balloon, clearly accumulating a lot of anger with nowhere to vent.

"I see. A fake couple. If that's the case, I won't hold back," Belial's expression gradually became狰狞, revealing his fangs like a hungry wolf.

"...What are you going to do!?" Alice's face turned white instantly. Belial looked like a madman!

"Such a delicious human. If I don't eat her while she's fresh, I'll feel regret," Belial suddenly made a shushing gesture and said mysteriously, "Hear that? My stomach is already growling. Congratulations, you lowly human, you've become my dinner!"

"Ah?!" Alice took a half-step back.

The hungry Belial became reckless, drooling and lunging toward Alice with his bony hands trying to grab the delicious human.

But Merlin suddenly grabbed Belial's wrist. A "crack" sound was heard, and the atmosphere fell silent...

Belial stumbled backward, a layer of cold sweat forming on his forehead, watching Merlin with caution.

His arm seemed to have been broken by Merlin, dangling uselessly.

"Lucifer, are you crazy? You said this woman wasn't your wife. Why are you protecting her, and even attacking..."

"We are indeed not a real couple..." Merlin's face was expressionless, his eyes coldly staring at Belial as he seriously warned,

"But I won't allow anyone to hurt her. You're no exception."

title: Chapter 6 — Questioning
content:
Chapter 6 — Questioning

Volume 18 · Chapter 6

......

Alice, hiding behind Merlin, felt a faint blush on her cheeks. Seeing him protect her so attentively, an uncontrollably sweet feeling welled up inside her.

.-. This guy usually treats me with indifference, but at critical moments... he seems quite reliable.

He even knows to protect me. It seems I haven't been good to him for nothing, hehe.......

Alice felt wonderful inside, thinking that Merlin right now truly looked like her husband, always thinking of her everywhere.

Merlin stood in front of Alice, his expression extremely serious, not as if he were joking. If Belphegor tried to move Alice, he might fight on the spot.

Belphegor twisted his fractured wrist, returning it to its place, and said with a grim face, "What are you doing?"

"I'm just telling you to be quiet." Merlin said coldly.

"You're crazy, attacking for a human? Are you still a member of the demon race?" Belphegor's expression turned angry, and in his heart he had already equated Merlin with the scum of the demon race. To stand up for a lowly human? !

"I don't deny my identity as a demon, but I absolutely won't let you lay a hand on her. To me, she is more important than my kin." Merlin said seriously, even uttering words of great ingratitude.

Alice's delicate body trembled, as if struck by the love god. Her mood could no longer be described as sweet; instead, her heart was in full bloom, and she was about to completely let herself go.

More important than the demon race? When did my status in Merlin's eyes become so high?

Truly surprising. This guy is actually willing to betray his own kind for me.

Under such circumstances, my previous refusal to return to the Holy Church as a Hero was also the correct choice.

Then the two of us can... live in peace, can't we?

Alice, blushing, started to daydream to herself, feeling that she was so important in Merlin's heart. Then in the future, marriage, well... wouldn't it be a matter of course?!

".... You're really crazy.

Belphegor showed an expression of disbelief, looking at Merlin with eyes as if seeing a ghost, appearing very unfamiliar.

To hear such words from the mouth of the former Demon Lord? Clearly denying one's ancestors is no different.

Such words are generally said by exiled criminals, only those fallen into the status of prisoners would belittle their own race.

Belphegor's eyes suddenly changed, filled with hostility, as if he had completely turned against the demon race and sided with the lowly humans.

"You aren't an ordinary demon, but one of the former Demon Lords. Now you're actually colluding with humans? Are you challenging the bottom line of the entire demon race? Don't forget, the demon race prohibits intermarriage with other races; this is a taboo. Who dares to test the law with their body, and they will surely die!

Hearing Belphegor's words, Alice's heart couldn't help but waver. She hadn't expected the demon race to have such strict regulations.

So, if she were to be with Merlin, would she have to face pressure from the entire demon race?

Alice's heart wasn't very convinced. If she and Merlin were mutually affectionate, why should this bunch of demons oppose it?

"What taboo?! People falling in love is free, and besides, Merlin has left the demon race for a long time; he already has nothing to do with you!"

"What right do you have to speak in front of me?" Belphegor's eyes revealed killing intent, flying out a few buzzing flies from his mouth. Though you smell beautiful, you are merely food. Who gave you the courage to speak in front of us?

"You!"

Alice wanted to retort, but was stopped by Merlin's impatient face, not wanting to make things more troublesome.

Merlin seemed to have figured it out. Belphegor is a demon with traditional thinking, deeply contemptuous of humans, and besides himself, he can't communicate with others.

"Alice, say a little less, Belphegor, you also calm down. We aren't really husband and wife, haven't you heard?"

"If you aren't truly husband and wife, why don't you eat her? She's just a human. Could this woman be special?" Belphegor asked patiently.

"If she died, I would be very troubled, after all, we still have so much money to pay back... Merlin answered in a casual tone.

"Eh!" The blush on Alice's face receded like a tide, and her mind was filled with, ah, as expected, I was too naive, what to do? So I want to strangle this guy....

"Stop talking nonsense. I only know I want to eat her, and you attacked me for this lowly human woman; that's enough." Belphegor seems to be a one-track mind, never considering others' feelings. No wonder her sister was stimulated to run away.

SE This small path

"Enough, Belphegor! This isn't your Demon Lord Palace, but the domain of humans. Your arbitrary actions will only make things worse." Merlin gripped the hilt of his sword, as if threatening. "If you still hope I help you find Miranda, then don't seek trouble yourself; everything listens to me."

".... Belphegor's eyes remained unwilling, but upon hearing the name Miranda, his heart instantly calmed down many times.

After all, Miranda is not just a sister to Belphegor, but a spiritual pillar for him to survive.

Belphegor still very much hopes Merlin can help him find his sister.

It's late at night, and the room in the mansion is silent.

The dim oil lamp flickers, reflecting the shadows of two men.

Because she was too tired, Alice lay on the bed, covering herself with a blanket, seeming to have fallen asleep.

Perhaps because Merlin is here, Alice would feel much more at ease, not very afraid of the dangerous Belphegor.

Belphegor and Merlin circled around the oil lamp, sitting on opposite sides of the table, confronting each other, still not intending to sleep.

Merlin does not trust Belphegor, this lunatic who, in a state of hunger, dares to do anything.

So as long as Belphegor doesn't leave the mansion, Merlin has no intention of resting, always staring at this guy to prevent him from taking advantage of his carelessness and harming Alice.

Belphegor is also vigilant against Merlin, feeling that now he is like wearing shackles, every move monitored by Merlin, making him very uncomfortable.

"Speaking of which, are you thinking the same thing in your heart as me?

"What?" Merlin lifted his eyelids.

"This woman is very good, her aura is fascinating. I believe any demon who smells it would go mad, including you.' Belphegor showed a few points of ferocity, guessing, "Are you planning to enjoy this beauty exclusively? Wait until the time is right and then eat her alive; that's really tasteless..."

"I have no habit of eating people, sorry." Merlin coldly answered.

"You're pretending, Rutaos? You're also a demon, how can there be a demon who doesn't like eating pure humans?" Belphegor's eyes uncontrollably looked at the sleeping Alice, his eyes glowing with green light from hunger. "Now she's asleep, it's a good chance. I know the method of eating people so they are unaware; in their sleep, they become our dinner, and the meat is fresh and delicious. Want to try starting?"

Merlin placed the demon sword Banri Garan on the table, his face expressionless, saying, "You can try. I guarantee that before you harm her, your head will already be cut off by me.

"It seems you're truly beyond saving, to think for the sake of a human woman you would kill me?" Belphegor narrowed his eyes, not doubting at all that Merlin was serious. If he laid a hand on Alice, he would definitely bring disaster upon himself, he doesn't have enough confidence to oppose the terrifying draw-and-cut stroke-

"Oh, I know?

"Do you love her?"

title: Chapter 7 — Layered Pressure
content:
Chapter 7 — Layered Pressure

Volume 18 · Chapter 7

Facing Belzebub's sudden question, Merlin instantly shivered, as if stimulated by something.

.....Why ask that?

"I will kill anyone for Miranda, because I love her. Would you kill your own kind for that human woman? Isn't it obvious?" Belzebub narrowed his eyes, as if seeing through Merlin.

Usually, demons would never kill each other. After all, the demon race is naturally scarce, and constant infighting would bring them closer to extinction.

So, when demons have disputes, they simply fight. Rarely do they hate to the point of wanting to kill the other.

But Merlin actually harbored killing intent toward Belzebub to protect Alice. This resolve already speaks volumes.

In Merlin's eyes, Alice might really be more important than his fellow demons...

Merlin fell silent suddenly, lowering his head to look at the tantō on the table without speaking, unsure how to answer Belzebub.

Is it because I love this meddlesome, annoying woman? Even I myself am not too clear about it.

Although Alice—she has her little quirks, but overall, she gets along with me quite well.

If I no longer have to worry about my curse in the future, living peacefully with Alice doesn't seem like a bad thing.

After all, having spent so much time together, Alice is one of the few who can understand me. It's unlikely a second person so compatible will appear in the future.

book.SFA's bunch....

05 SE this small treatment

Merlin seriously pondered. In his eyes, Alice is a pretty good person. Aside from her bad temper, meddling, and occasional bouts of maternal heart, there really aren't any major flaws.

Seeing Merlin completely silent, as if weighing the question, Belzebub couldn't help but say, "Not speaking is default, right? You really fell in love with a lowly person, ah...."

Merlin took a deep breath and gave a rather vague answer, "Pretty much. If you insist on understanding that I love her, I can't help it."

"Hah."

Belzebub let out a contemptuous laugh and said lowly, "I thought you were just living miserably. Didn't expect you to have fallen so low?"

"This counts as falling? Am I not heroic and wise if I don't go around rampaging like you?" Merlin retorted sarcastically, completely disagreeing with Belzebub's thinking.

Although both are Demon Lords, their thinking is worlds apart: they can't possibly be compared.

Merlin, though a demon, has many demonic habits, but his essence is still an outsider who transmigrated. The human nature deep inside his heart cannot be removed.

Belzebub, on the other hand, is the purest demon. He cares nothing for the evil things he does, as if it's an everyday occurrence, arrogant like a tyrant.

CE novel

No matter how they are, the two could never understand each other, just like the sharp contradiction between the innovators and the traditionalists.

"You may have lost the title of Demon Lord now, but your identity is still noble. Falling in love with a lowly, stupid human makes me feel ashamed, and it brings shame to the entire demon race! If Viviana were here, she would definitely think your brain got water in it, you good-for-nothing son!" Belzebub's words were sharp. Merlin's actions were simply lowering the B-grade of demons. Not choosing a wife from the demon race but loving a human—too laughable.

"Belzebub, I'm not the Demon Lord anymore. I'm just a demon wandering outside. For me, the rules of the demon race are simply not important. Do you understand?" Merlin is not the type who wants to be bound. He has been away from the demon race for so long—should he be bound by the demon race's rules? That's unreasonable.

"If you were an ordinary demon, I'd definitely not bother with you. However, you are the former Demon Lord, and this matter absolutely cannot get by unnoticed. Belzebub lowered his posture and continued, "You think that just because you were stripped of the Demon Lord position, you have nothing to do with the demon race? Your influence still exists. The demons of the First Demon Lord Palace won't easily acknowledge a new monarch. They are still willing to be loyal to you. Rest assured, you will eventually return to the Demon Lord Palace; you can't escape. As for your human wife, her fate will probably be even worse."

"What do you mean?" Alice raised her eyebrows, not quite understanding what Belzebub was saying.

"You marrying a human violates the demon race's taboo, and you will face the harshest punishment. That woman will also be tortured to death, not leaving even bone fragments. This is the cruel reality you will have to face," Belzebub said with a serious expression, not seeming to be joking. He continued with deep meaning, "If I tell the Demon Council about your marriage to a human, guess what terrible situation you will face?"

Merlin fell silent and did not respond. He felt Belzebub was threatening him. Touching the demon race's taboo would definitely not have a good outcome. Perhaps he would face...

"You will face the entire demon race's pursuit. Your relatives, your colleagues, your subordinates won't understand you marrying a human. The council can integrate all power to crush you," Belzebub is not alarmist. When the situation truly develops to that point, it is that severe. "But you can still brake in time now, as long as you kill that woman, I can completely pretend I never saw it."

"Your convenience." Merlin answered coldly.

"Huh? What did you say? 5 Belzebub's expression stiffened, thinking he heard wrong.

"Say 'convenience'? What about 5 Belzebub thought he heard wrong.

"I said 'as you wish.' I don't want to explain anything. If you're willing to report my affairs to the council, I'm completely fine with it." Merlin spread his hands, seeming to not take the entire demon race seriously.

...Are you crazy? You will face the entire demon race's pressure. As a former Demon Lord, you must know how terrible the demon race's foundation is. Do you have the ability to fight the entire demon race alone?"

"I don't know if I have that ability, but I don't mind trying. Isn't it exciting to beat up those guys who think highly of themselves?" Merlin showed a smile that wasn't quite a smile, and subconsciously reached for the tantō on the table, seeming a bit eager to move.

"Even Viviana wasn't as arrogant as you..."

A cold sweat trickled down Belzebub's forehead. He thought this guy is either a calf unafraid of tigers, or really has strength. He's completely incomprehensible now.

Although his drawing of the blade is indeed terrifying, going alone to challenge the entire demon race... looking at the whole world, no one would dare say such a thing!

Could it be that Viviana's previous words were true? Is Merlin the hero reincarnated who deters the gods, the slayer of gods mentioned in the prophecy who once ended the era of the gods?

This kind of thing... is impossible, right? If it were true, how could anyone stop his killing steps?

But for the sake of a human woman, to fight the entire demon race—Merlin is really shameless...

Belzebub was internally doubtful, and there was no room for maneuver anymore. It seems Merlin is determined to go to the end of the road.

Lying on the bed feigning sleep, Alice had not actually fallen asleep. The discussion was also heard seven or eight-tenths.

Alice turned her back to the two of her, secretly opening her eyes, and her heart became uneasy for a moment.

Merlin, how does he view me? Does he like me?

"Pretty much" what does that mean? Such a perfunctory answer!

However, listening to it, there won't be any result between me and Merlin. Being together will face huge pressure.

What to do? Are we destined not to be together, and only by being apart forever can we live in peace?

Sigh, just found the person I like, why is it so hard....

title: Chapter 8 — The Fire Thief
content:
Chapter 8 — The Fire Thief

Volume 18 · Chapter 8

Underground of the Royal Palace. The empire's most secretive research facility was built here, used for studying magic and alchemy.

Batiloca's corpse was stored here. To slow the dissipation of the Flame Demon, its life was maintained using a unique technique.

Late at night, after Margaret visited the unconscious old king, she brought Blaise to check on the Flame Demon.

As a rare pure-element magical beast, the Flame Demon was just as important as the twelve Legendary Magitech Cannons and needed extra care.

The old king's condition was not optimistic. The chronic poison was beginning to take effect, slowly devouring his life force, and his breath was growing ever fainter.

Margaret knew nothing about pharmacology, so she would have to think of another solution for this thorny situation.

The heavy door slowly creaked open as guards entered and lit the torches in the room, a pungent smell hitting their faces.

At the very back of this sealed chamber, Batiloca's corpse was submerged in some kind of liquid, with a faint fire radiating from its body.

This flame was extremely unusual. Even while encased in liquid, it continued to burn — it was likely the Flame Demon's true body.

Batiloca had no family. From childhood, he had been locked in a room with other children in the empire, selected to find those with the talent to become a vessel for the Flame Demon.

Relying on his exceptional talent and physical condition, he had risen above the rest, and was the only one who survived.

Since then, Batiloca had hurtled headlong toward madness. His mental state was extremely unstable, and he occasionally heard the Flame Demon's voice inside his head.

A person who had suffered torment since childhood growing up to become a madman wasn't particularly strange. The fact that he had maintained his sense of self and resisted the Flame Demon's mental erosion was already remarkable.

Being killed by Beelzebub was, for this poor fellow, about as lucky as it got — he wouldn't have to endure the torment of split consciousness any longer.

Margaret and Blaise entered the sealed chamber and looked through the glass at Batiloca's motionless corpse.

Blaise instinctively lowered his head, visibly moved by the sight of Batiloca's body, though it was unclear what he was thinking.

Margaret, on the other hand, wore a completely cold expression with no reaction at all. She likely didn't see Batiloca as a human being, but rather as a rare specimen for experimentation.

"Is the Flame Demon already this weak?"

"Yes, Your Highness. At most half a year, and the Flame Demon will dissipate completely," Blaise replied.

"Tch!" Margaret bit her lip, feeling a splitting headache. "Such a short timeframe — finding a suitable vessel seems far too difficult."

"If it really can't be helped, then let it go. The Flame Demon is an untamed magical beast by nature. Forcing control over it would only create a safety hazard."

"No. If we let the Flame Demon dissipate on its own, the empire will lose considerable strength. Legend has it that the Lady of the Lake helped Britain establish its kingdom — the Flame Demon's status is no less. How could we simply abandon it?" Margaret said seriously.

"....." Blaise hesitated for a few seconds before saying respectfully, "The Flame Demon is naturally violent and uncontrollable, very different from the Lady of the Lake. Finding a suitable vessel is not easy. A human host will fall into madness, their mind suffering torments. Even if they ultimately retain their sanity, their personality will change drastically like Batiloca's, becoming erratic and疯癫."

"So what? As long as we keep the Flame Demon under the empire's control, we'll always have an ace up our sleeve." Margaret pondered for a moment, then said lightly, "If it really comes to it, we'll do what was done back then — capture some children and try them one by one until we find a suitable vessel."

"....." Blaise stared, astonished. "Your Highness, you must be joking, right?"

"Do I look like I'm joking? This is only a last resort. No matter what the cost, we must ensure the Flame Demon survives." Margaret's gaze locked onto Blaise, and she added meaningfully, "Why don't you try yourself? Who knows — if you become the Flame Demon's vessel, your strength will skyrocket, and surpassing Saint-tier won't be a dream."

"..... Your Highness, you really do know how to joke...." Blaise forced a smile that didn't reach his eyes, cold sweat pouring down his forehead. "My abilities simply cannot contain the Flame Demon. If I fail, I'll be burned to death. And then who will protect Your Highness's safety?"

"Hmph. You're much sharper at moments like these. Don't worry — you're so loyal to me that I wouldn't push you into such a death trap." Margaret smiled, appearing innocent and harmless. Who would have guessed how dark a heart lay beneath that guileless maiden's appearance.

Blaise repeatedly wiped the cold sweat from his brow and obediently said, "I shall go about it tomorrow and surely find a suitable candidate."

"Good." Margaret nodded in satisfaction. In her heart, she thought that if Merlin would simply obey her, the Flame Demon would be neither here nor there. But she knew clearly that this man would never willingly accept being controlled.

Despite his overwhelming strength, he chose to remain a Black Iron-class adventurer rather than seek employment with better待遇.

With Merlin's capabilities, becoming a Knight Commander or Royal Guard would have been far too easy.

Clearly, Merlin valued freedom far more than generous conditions. Adventurers nearly all shared this trait — they refused to follow the orders of rulers.

"Your Highness, what about His Majesty's condition? His illness is worsening by the day. If we continue拖延 like this... something will happen." Blaise wanted to see if Margaret had a good solution.

"Post a proclamation throughout the nation seeking capable individuals, preferably someone proficient in pharmacology." Margaret issued her order, adding, "I refuse to believe that all of France lacks even a single person skilled in potions."

"Yes, Your Highness." Blaise bowed slightly and prepared to act immediately. The king's time was running short.

After they left, the sealed chamber's door closed, and two guards were ordered to stand watch.

Presently, the guard on the left adopted a somewhat furtive manner and hurriedly said, "Brother, look — I need to relieve myself. I'll be right back."

"Go ahead, go ahead." The guard on the right nodded, watching his companion rush away as if憋着 badly. He hadn't dared leave even for a moment while Their Highness the Princess was present.

Once his companion was far enough away, the guard slowly removed his helmet — it was Dick Tepin in disguise.

Dick Tepin pushed open the sealed chamber's door and crept inside stealthily.

He saw Batiloca's flaming corpse and scratched his neck repeatedly in agitation.

Although Dick Tepin was greedy and wanted to profit from everything, he wasn't a fool. He had picked up most of what Margaret and Blaise had been discussing:

So this Flame Demon is truly an extraordinary thing!

If I could obtain that power, my strength would definitely increase substantially, right?

But it sounds far too dangerous. I don't have the ability to take it.

Even the empire's Hero wouldn't dare try casually — let alone someone like me.

Tch, I'm unwilling, but I'll have to think of another plan...

title: Chapter 9 — Don't Know Life or Death?
content:
Chapter 9 — Don't Know Life or Death?

Volume 18 · Chapter 9

A few days later.

Margaret took control of the capital city, and in a short time successfully restored the empire's operations.

Many fleeing nobles and commoners heard the news that Belphegor had been defeated and returned accordingly.

The capital city, which had originally been desolately quiet, had become bustling with people in the past few days, gaining quite a bit of popularity.

However, looking at the damaged buildings still gave people a chilling feeling, thinking of that day's unprecedented Gluttonous Demon Lord.

Heal McDess? This prime minister still had no news, and the returning nobles began to flatter Margaret one after another, hoping not to be held accountable for past mistakes.

Recently, Margaret has been very prominent. After all, she is the only heir of the empire. Temporarily taking full control of the empire is also understandable, and it has not encountered any obstruction.

Today, a batch of suspicious people entered the capital city. They moved discreetly but had organization and discipline, as if they were passing by here by chance.

No one could easily recognize them as the famous organization, one of the Four Great Dark Guilds—the Azure Flame.

Although the president of the Azure Flame, Hannibal, had already obtained the map of Dracula's ruins, his actions were slightly slower than Merlin and Alice by half a step.

Because the Azure Flame, as one of the Four Great Dark Guilds, is somewhat large, organizational actions appear very clumsy, and any big movement becomes much slower.

This time, Hannibal mobilized almost the entire guild's power to come here, so the preparation time was also quite long.

"SF Novel

It seems Hannibal has also spent a lot of money. If anyone dares to block him from occupying the ruins, he will surely face the ruthless crushing of the entire guild.

Following Hannibal were over 1,300 warriors and mages, and there were also several capable subordinates guarding the way, Saint-tier mage Eden, Saint-tier assassins the twin sisters Una and Vina, and Saint-tier fighter Lori.

As for that Saint-tier archer Oswald, he had long ago been sniped to death by Merlin— a loss that caused quite a blow to their guild.

Nevertheless, this lineup can already be considered luxurious, and even has some capital if going up against the empire directly. Concentrating the entire guild's power to expedition, who would know that the Azure Flame wasn't going to pillage and plunder cities?

Hannibal's hidden eyes surveyed the surroundings, and he said calmly, "How did the capital of France end up like this? It looks like it encountered robbers."

"President, I heard that not long ago this place was attacked by the Demon King, suffering heavy losses." Eden explained beside him, his calm eyes seeming not to be swayed by anything.

"Hah, although the demons are few in number, a thin camel is still bigger than a horse. Being able to contend with the Holy Church, this behemoth, for thousands of years without falling behind shows how deep their foundation is. What's the point of provoking them?" Hannibal said with a cold laugh.

"It is said that the sister of that Demon King was kidnapped by humans, and she vented her anger on France."

"Hmph, the royal family is seeking their own death. Legends say that Demon King powerhouses are as numerous as clouds, and even all our heartless Dark Guilds dare not easily touch the tiger's whiskers. This time it's just one Demon King attacking; if the Demon Army were to mobilize fully, probably France wouldn't exist anymore." Hannibal said in a tone of schadenfreude.

"President, look at France now, it's so ruined it's barely able to withstand a blow..." Una said with deep meaning.

"Shall we forcibly occupy France? While we're at it, let's kill our fill! Now the empire has suffered such severe damage, isn't this a good opportunity for us?" Vina grabbed the chance to say.

The two sisters are indeed twins, their thoughts almost the same, ideas coming to mind in the same way.

"This...", Hannibal thought for a moment, it really stirred his heart, this time he brought so many subordinates, he has the ability to seize the mountain as king, and moreover the details of the empire are not much less rewarding than finding Dracula's ruins.

"Not at all, although France has suffered heavy losses now, but they successfully defeated the invading Demon King, obviously the empire has the capability and trump cards to fight against the Demon Race, we should try our best to avoid provoking demons, rashly going up against an empire that can defeat the Demon King carries too great a risk, it's better to seek Dracula's ruins more steadily." Eden did not agree with the sisters' ideas, and for the guild's risk, it's not worth doing.

"Eden is right, our goal this time is to seek Dracula's ruins, the capital city is just passing by, pass down the order, anyone is not allowed to cause trouble here."

Hannibal is still quite rational, and did not intend to do anything risky. The order was quickly spread to everyone's ears, this mighty队伍 planned to pass through the capital city discreetly.

"How boring, I heard that the little princess of France is holding external martial arts competitions, I really want to see what this little b*tch looks like?" Una swayed her body, appearing alluring.

10)led CE's little flood

"Hearing the sister say so, I'm also very interested." Vina bit her nails, her eyes fanatical.

The fighter Lori at the back of the team is indeed muttering silently, although he successfully brought back the ruins map, but Oswald's death caused the guild to suffer a considerable loss.

Although the president Hannibal did not say anything to blame, but unconsciously Lori's status was marginalized, from the moment he opened his mouth he would be teased by the twin sisters.

Suddenly Lori stopped his steps, his gaze astonished, looking at a person eating watermelon by the roadside, that back view made him feel extremely familiar—

Her face was Merlin! Opposite was sitting Belphegor! Alice didn't know where she went to?

....me in

me in this

"What's wrong, Lori?" Eden noticed Lori's oddity.

"That... that black iron adventurer and the person who killed Oswald are partners!" Lori pointed at the back of the man eating watermelon.

"What! ?" Eden was startled, looking along Lori's gaze.

"Interesting, really narrow paths for enemies, to be able to meet here, I'll go secretly kill him!" Vina licked her crimson nails.

"Sister, such a thing still should be done by me, that little guy looks quite handsome, ha....." Una seemed full of interest.

"How just a - black iron rookie? Isn't it said there was still a - magic swordsman?" Hannibal asked in confusion.

"Originally there were two, maybe they temporarily separated due to something, the other one is a silver-ranked adventurer, with strong strength, able to reflect Oswald's spear back, not to be underestimated! As for the one facing them?" Lori's gaze looked at Belphegor opposite Merlin, dressed mysteriously with unseeable appearance, wearing rags, so he speculated, " Probably some beggar that came from where."

"What not to be underestimated, is a silver-ranked adventurer that scary? Moreover that black iron little brother can completely ignore, you are 2 against 1 and were able to be killed, really useless." Vina taunted Lori one sentence.

"You! ?" Lori was very upset, completely unable to explain.

"Don't cause trouble, since we've met we can't just do nothing, let's just take down those two adventurers here, kill this one, the other one will jump out, we are one of the Four Great Dark Guilds, those who dare kill our people must pay a painful price." Hannibal holding a wand walked toward that man eating watermelon, "You guys just watch here, I'll go personally solve them without leaving a trace."

"President going to do it personally? This time there must be good drama to watch!" Una showed an appreciative expression.

"With the President's strength, killing two adventurers is simply within reach, probably just moving fingers can do it~" Vina showed an expectant look.

"I haven't seen President personally make a move for a long time, I imagine the other party wouldn't know how they die." Eden didn't even bother to look, evidently regarding Merlin as a dead person.

Several disciples all looked at Hannibal walking toward the watermelon-eating Merlin, this Dark Guild leader would never know—

What he is about to face is how terrifying a existence.....
