“That's right, you need to obey; I'm your brother, I'll definitely not harm you.” Sebupu's old face turned red, he muttered beside, thinking Merlin finally spoke like a person.
“Don't call me teacher; I haven't taught you anything, this title feels weird..." Merlin scratched his cheek, seeming a bit shy about the title 'teacher'.
“No! Teacher, although you haven't taught me any martial skills, your spirit as a demon race waste who continually strives is something I need to learn! So calling you teacher is completely fine!” Miranda lifted her head, her eyes full of little stars for Merlin the waste.
“Demon race's... waste?!” Merlin's expression twisted, feeling his heart pierced by an arrow, suffering a considerable mental blow.
"... This girl seems not to know how to speak; maybe I should take her back and put her in a pot to stew?"
"What does 'demonrace waste yet continually resisting' mean? Do I look that miserable?"
"Enough!"
"Stop looking at me with admiring eyes, bulingbuling!"
"This is really not something worthy of admiration, okay?!!"
(+~皿7)

title: Chapter 59 — Thank You Kiss (Random Update)
content:
Chapter 59 — Thank You Kiss (Random Update)

Volume 19 · Chapter 59

Barbatos saw Merlin wearing a gloomy face and, to defend his sister, said, "What kind of look is that? Did my sister say something wrong?"

Alice looked at Merlin and thought, Really, what kind of teacher is this guy? He's clearly misleading people.

Merlin grumbled inwardly for a while, too lazy to argue with Miranda, and said, "...It's fine. Just fine."

"Not... not for a long time. I haven't seen the teacher in a while. You've changed so much..." Miranda blushed and lowered her head, wearing an expression of wanting to say something but hesitating.

"Oh? Have I changed from before?" Merlin frowned, examining himself, and didn't feel like anything was off.

"That... the teacher has become more human-like, losing much of the demonic aura..." Miranda hesitated as she spoke.

Alice curiously stared at Merlin, recalling their first meeting at the Demon Lord's Palace, and felt there wasn't much difference from now.

Was it because she was always by his side, so she couldn't see Merlin's changes at all?

Alice's expression grew melancholy, as if she had lost some of her enjoyment.

Merlin touched his chin and wondered what "losing demonic aura" meant. He supposed becoming gentler than before counted.

"And... and I didn't expect the teacher would be with a human. How... how surprising..." Miranda blushed, covering her mouth and muttering, "I'm so envious."

"What did you say?" Merlin didn't catch it clearly, because Miranda was shy and her voice wasn't very clear.

"...Nothing. I was just surprised. I didn't expect the teacher would choose to be with a human. In the demon race... that's absolutely not allowed..." Miranda said meaningfully.

Alice's face didn't look good at all, clearly not wanting to hear this. Every time she heard that demons don't allow being with humans, it felt like a hint that she and Merlin wouldn't end up together.

"Don't... don't you... " Merlin was about to explain, but was cut off by Miranda.

"The teacher doesn't need to explain. Brother has already told me everything." Miranda lowered her head, her eyes slightly disappointed, "Although I don't agree with you two... still, I'm glad the teacher can be happy."

"Emmmm..." Merlin's expression was complicated. He thought, Why won't you listen to me? Give me a proper listen!

"Although I don't fully understand Miss Alice, but from these few days of contact, I think she's a kind human, not someone with ulterior motives coming close to your teacher." Miranda hooked her fingers together and said with a wince.

Alice proudly lifted her head, thinking, Isn't that obvious? What could I possibly scheme for Merlin? There's nothing at all!

"So, teacher, please rest assured. I won't let brother say anything about this. As for the rest... it's up to the teacher." Miranda said seriously.

Barbatos looked at his sister, sighed silently, and chose to temporarily hide the matter of Merlin marrying a human, preferring to remain ignorant of everything.

Alice secretly let out a sigh of relief. She had originally worried that after this incident, her peaceful life with Merlin would be disrupted. Now it seemed her worry was unfounded.

"Although I don't know what you're trying to say..." Merlin scratched his head and smiled, "But not reporting to the Congress is already helping me out, right?"

"That... " Miranda lowered her head, wearing a shy expression, "Teacher, I'm about to head back. There's something I want to say to the teacher..."

"Say it..." Merlin saw Miranda's serious expression and had to become stern, "Just make sure it's not some new trouble coming our way."

"No, no..." Miranda shook her head frantically, stepped forward to Merlin, and said mysteriously, "Teacher, could you lower your ears? I don't want others to hear..."

"Huh? ? ?" Alice's eyebrows knit together tightly. She caught a faint, strange, and... suggestive scent!

"Fine." Merlin slightly lowered his head, tilting his ear toward Miranda so she could easily whisper. But suddenly he felt his cheek go cold.

A fleeting kiss, like a dragonfly touching water, gone in an instant.

Merlin's face stiffened. He hadn't expected Miranda to do something like this. Was this stupid girl finally making a move on him?

"This is just... thanking the teacher for saving me. Nothing else..." Miranda parted her lips, slowly stepped back, and returned to Barbatos's side with a blushing face.

"Ah..." Merlin blinked blankly, touched his lips, and felt a complicated emotion. It wasn't particularly happy, nor particularly surprising. It was just an ordinary kiss.

Alice: "Yikes! Ahhhhhh!"

Barbatos: "Ugh! Ahhhh!"

Because of Miranda's sudden kiss, both of them exploded on the spot, clearly suffering a great shock, their faces like they had seen a ghost!

Alice was naturally jealous and upset. She had already kissed Merlin's cheek, yet somehow she got beaten to it by someone else!

It was like saving the delicious food for last, only to have someone steal it. Alice felt utterly desperate!

"You... you you... you guys are doing what?! " Alice covered her head with both hands and demanded angrily.

"You're making such a ruckus. As you can see, it's just a simple thank you, right?" Merlin wiped the lip print off his face and reacted with extreme calm.

"How is that simple?! You heartless guy, you completely ignored my... my... my... and that... that... that person's..." Alice's face flushed red, angry and pinching her waist, clearly wanting to make a big deal out of it, but too embarrassed to say it directly.

"You've seen it too. It's not my fault at all. It's just a simple misunderstanding..." Merlin spread his hands, putting on an indifferent act.

...You bastard! Alice grabbed Merlin's arm, her face flushed red, and asked, "I suppose you're happy about this, you scoundrel, aren't you?!"

"Huh? Why do I look like a pervert in your eyes..." Merlin's face fell, feeling looked down upon by Alice.

"You're not a good person at all. Despicable, low, shameless!" Alice, enraged, shook the innocent Merlin furiously.

"Forget what just happened! Forget it! Forget it! Forget it!"

"Don't... don't force it, okay?" Merlin's body was shaken like a seesee, but still maintained a calm expression.

Alice wasn't that bad, but the one who suffered the most from this kind of thing was the siscon Barbatos, who looked ashen as if dead.

"Lan... what were you just doing?" Barbatos asked sternly.

"I was just thanking the teacher for the help..." Miranda answered innocently.

"...Barbatos nodded, and suddenly a swarm of blowflies burst forth from his body, "I'm going to kill him!"

"Huh?! Don't make a scene. The ship is about to set sail. Let's hurry and get on board." Miranda desperately pushed Barbatos, trying to get on the ship quickly.

"Don't stop me! I'm going to have a final showdown with this bastard! Today, he's not leaving without me!" Barbatos was pushed further and further away by Miranda, but his shouting voice still echoed on—

"Damn you, Lucifer! I'll make you pay! I won't let this slide!"

"You dared to seduce my sister?! I'll definitely kill you!"

Chapter 60 — The Recent Guild

Volume 19 · Chapter 60

Britain, the town of Wrexham. The town's only love master is here answering girls' questions, although this guy is actually a daydreamer who has never dated. A girl: "Miss Jenna, after I got together with my boyfriend, he became indifferent to me, even though he wasn't like that when he was pursuing me before—what should I do?" Jenna: "Just dump him, find another one. I've seen plenty of these pig‑hoofed men; you've already depreciated in his eyes." A girl: "Miss Jenna, my boyfriend isn't wealthy; he can only afford a house in a suburban village, not in Wrexham city, but I don't want to go to the village—what should I do?" Jenna: "Huh! This worthless man, dump him! Believe you're the best, don't get tangled up with such useless men." A girl: "Miss Jenna, I've gained a bit of weight, why am I still single?" Jenna: "What are your requirements?" A girl: "Handsome enough to surpass a celebrity, wealth comparable to the Rothschild family, preferably even a kingdom heir..." Jenna: "...your demands aren't high at all. As for why you're still single, need to ask? It's definitely because you're too outstanding, making the men around you feel inferior. It's not because you're as fat as a tank, or because you have a troublesome princess complex, or because you're daydreaming about unrealistic fantasies that keep you single! Believe in yourself, be patient, and sooner or later your dreams will come true!" The girls chattered around Jenna, although Jenna was just spouting nonsense, these little girls unexpectedly liked listening to her, taking her as a life mentor, and continually straying further down the melodramatic path. "Hmph..." Jenna, puffing with pride, hands on hips, enjoyed the feeling of being the center of attention. Although she hadn't solved the girls' problems at all, force‑feeding others with chicken soup for the soul still gave her a sense of achievement. "Listen up, everyone: in love we should try every way to get an advantage—ah, pfui! I mean fight for our rights! We must never shortchange ourselves; men are all useless pig‑hoofed beasts. We girls should treat ourselves better, so we won't suffer losses without realizing it. Marriage is our chance to change fate, and it must be firmly in our own hands. I'd rather sit on a dragon's back and cry than ride a donkey and laugh." Clatter, the inexperienced girls clapped enthusiastically, stirred up by Jenna's foolish remarks, which sounded quite reasonable. I thought Jenna would only talk about love knowledge, but I didn't expect a cult‑like trend to have already begun, the embryonic form of otherworldly feminism, already starting to appear. A girl: "! So Miss Jenna, after saying all that, do you already have your ideal other half?" "Of course I do!" Jenna said confidently. A girl: "What kind of person is he? Miss Jenna, your standards are so strict, he must be truly outstanding, right?" "Not exactly outstanding, huh? He's just a black iron adventurer." Jenna answered bashfully, recalling Merlin V587's model... (she couldn't help but show a fangirl expression.) A girl: "....A black iron adventurer? How could someone like that be worthy of Miss Jenna? They don't even deserve to carry her shoes!" "Although that's what I said, I like his cold, domineering look, especially when he beats me hard......so handsome..." Jenna's face flushed pink, she exclaimed excitedly, her eyes full of little stars. The girls: Jenna silently sighed, showing a bit of displeasure, thinking resentfully one by one: "Sigh, Lord Merlin has been away from Wrexham for a long time?" "Still no news at all, and I don't know how he's doing now." "But every time he goes out with that woman Alice, it's really annoying....." The Wrexham guild doesn't have many members. "Cheers!" Arnold and Hobbs clinked their cups, the two idle ones drinking their sorrows away here. In the distance, Mr. Karl was chatting with his daughter Lukiya, constantly putting on a smiling face. "Sorry I'm three days late, really apologetic, you this... don't get angry over such small matters...." "Is that also a small matter?" Lukiya gave her father a white eye, speaking unhappily, "You said you'd be back three days ago, yet you inexplicably were three days late—don't you know I and Grandpa thought something happened to you on the road? The three days of worry left us without sleep." ".....Is that so? It's my fault; next time won't happen, I will definitely return on time to report safety." Mr. Karl, in front of Lukiya, seemed like a child who made a mistake, afraid his daughter would get angry and ignore him. "You always say that, hoping you have it figured out in your heart; otherwise I and Grandpa are constantly worried about you, which is also a torment for us." Lukiya sighed, picked up a feather pen, scribbled, handling guild affairs. Cold sweat trickled down Mr. Karl's forehead; feeling his daughter hard to deal with, he gave a sheepish grin and changed the topic: "I'll definitely pay attention, but Lukiya, you actually can worry about me—Dad's really happy, ha...." "Huh!" Lukiya lifted her head, face slightly red, speaking in an awkward tone: "I'm not worried; what does it matter to me if you die out there? It's only Grandpa worrying about you." "Oh, is that so.... Mr. Karl wiped the sweat from his forehead, feeling defeated, 'Speaking of your grandfather, I came back and didn't see...'" "Grandpa is in closed‑door cultivation, saying he learned a new battle technique from Merlin and wants to study it further...." Lukiya answered with a furrowed brow, apparently not clear on the details. "Eh? Learning a new battle technique from Merlin? If true, our family's Thunderbolt individuals could possibly become much stronger." Mr. Karl's expression turned serious. "I say you two, you're not young anymore, why do you look like idiots...." Lukiya put down her feather pen, looking at her father, accusing him. "Hey hey hey, just scold me, don't drag Grandpa into it—how uncultured, Dad doesn't want you to become a street‑mouthed shrew..." Mr. Karl hurriedly said. "I just don't understand you two. Merlin is a black iron adventurer verified by the crystal ball; his strength is at the black iron level, so why do you and Grandpa keep fussing over him? Every time you meet, you talk about how Merlin is this and that." Lukiya felt her father and grandfather shouldn't focus their energy on Merlin—clearly inappropriate. "Merlin is just a black iron adventurer; is he worth you pouring so much attention into him? If you two want to cultivate promising people in the guild, there are plenty better than Merlin, aren't there? If Grandpa is doing it because he's old and his mind isn't clear, why are you also following suit in fussing over Merlin? I see your attitude... could it be that you want to groom Merlin as the next guild chief? ! Have you ever seen a guild whose chief is a black iron adventurer? !" "....." Mr. Karl's expression twisted, lines of black like a waterfall sliding down his forehead, sweating and thinking: "..I didn't expect Lukiya to have so many doubts?" "Paying attention to Merlin is undoubtedly for the guild's future consideration." "But how can Merlin's great strength be explained to Lukiya?"

title: Chapter 62 — The Pressure of Fame

Chapter 62 — The Pressure of Fame

Volume 19 · Chapter 62

“Cough... Bella coughed lightly, continuing to speak seriously, “Not long ago, there was a crisis of dark creatures invading France, terrible monsters all the way into the royal city, making the kingdom perilous. However, under the leadership of Princess Margaret of the royal family, this crisis successfully passed with no mishaps. In this struggle, an outstanding adventurer emerged, coincidentally also from Great Britain. Today, let us step into this hero and get close to him... ...”

The camera suddenly panned to Merlin’s hopeless face. He impatiently said, “Why is it always you for interviews and such? Can the director not afford a second actor to fill in?”

“Don’t mind this little follower, give a close-up of Alice over there.” Bella commanded, seemingly not intending to mind Merlin at all, treating him as air.

The camera panned for a long time, finally focusing on Alice. She gave a slight bow and said calmly, “Hello everyone.”

Although Alice appears calm on the outside, her heart has actually been excited inside—

Mommy~ An exclusive interview prepared just for me!

Now my reputation will spread far and wide, and I’ll become a celebrity in the adventurer industry, right?

Pfft pfft pfft, no! I must seize this opportunity well. When the time comes, my value will skyrocket!

Alice feigned a cold and expressionless face, giving people a serious feeling, but privately her eyes had already turned into crescent moons.

“Oh! It’s Merlin and Alice, huh!” Hobbs’s eyes lit up, staring intently at the broadcast screen, “I was wondering why there was no news after they left for so long. Turns out they went and did a big thing, huh? Didn’t expect there to be an exclusive interview too. I estimate Alice will also become....”

“Alice!” Arnold’s emotion was extremely excited, quickly rushing to the screen in front of him, his eyes already turning into beating hearts, “Long time no see, Alice, you are still so beautiful and charming. I’m about to be moved to tears, wail...”.

...Hobbs looked at Arnold’s lecherous expression and couldn’t help but sweat, thinking, isn’t the problem of being unable to catch up with Alice already discovered? In the end, he’s still a sycophant! And there’s no change at all from before!

“What! It’s Alice!” Lucilia put down her work and hurriedly came to the screen, her mood instantly becoming very unbalanced, jealous said, “Wow, it’s the highest-grade exclusive interview. This guy clearly still can’t compare to me in popularity. When did he get such treatment? I’m so unwilling.”

Mr. Karl came over, stroking his chin and looking at the screen, laughing heartily,

“Oh! They really did a big thing in France too, but why is the protagonist Alice and not Merlin the younger brother?”

“Why would it be Merlin? Alice is a silver-ranked adventurer, and in every aspect she is superior to Merlin, right.” Lucilia said seriously.

“Ah....... Is...... Mr. Karl embarrassedly scratched his head. Looking at his daughter’s serious appearance, he didn’t dare to say anything more.”

W SF novel

Lucilia looked at Alice on the screen and sighed, “When she joined the guild, she was still a penniless wanderer. A few years have passed. Now, looking at it, she’s about to become a famous adventurer. Time really flies.”

“That’s right, Alice is sort of our accidental...” Mr. Karl nodded and said, adding in his heart another sentence: Merlin is the guild’s accidental surprise!

Bella handed the microphone to Alice inside the screen, marking the formal start of this interview—

“Alice, we are meeting for the second time. Last time was when you and your partners resolved the undead crisis in the labyrinth. This time it’s still against dark creatures. Why do you always fight at the forefront of fighting darkness? What mindset do you have to do these things? I hope to get an answer.”

“What mindset.......”

Alice lowered her head and hesitated. Her face was very calm, but internally she was panicking, feeling embarrassed, thinking, how on earth what mindset am I holding?! It was completely a chance encounter!

Situation... it wasn’t me who did it, it was Merlin. However, even if I explain seriously, I don’t think anyone would believe it?

So Alice secretly poked Merlin and asked in a low voice.

“That.... when you slaughtered those dark creatures just now— what was your mindset?”bd U

“Why ask me? Aren’t they all done by us? Our big, heroic~” Merlin responded in a teasing tone.

“You.”

Alice’s face turned red with anger, turning her head away, “Hmph!”

Merlin looked at Alice. He didn’t feel resentment because she arbitrarily took credit, but only felt a bit unbalanced inside.

After all, his identity as an iron-ranked adventurer really has no persuasive power in the eyes of others.

Wasting opportunities to become famous twice, it’s better to let Alice become a thigh respected by everyone, and himself can also follow and drink some soup.

“What mindset? It’s just that when executing tasks, I casually chopped them down. If you weren’t always jumping in front of me, who would care about them?”

“.... Alice was at a loss for words. She felt Merlin’s answer was perfunctory, but it was very much in line with his character. However, this obviously cannot be used as a formal answer, right?

“What are you thinking, Alice?” Bella suddenly leaned closer, giving Alice invisible pressure.

“I....”. A drop of cold sweat flowed from Alice’s forehead. Facing pressure, she had no choice but to say it in the same way. There’s no particularly special mindset, I just took care of it casually.

“.... Not to be outdone, Alice is an adventurer fighting on the front line against evil. Speaking of words, she is domineering and unique.” Bella dryly laughed in response, thinking, clearly she was a golden-ranked adventurer before, but after such a short time upgrading to silver, she also became arrogant?

“A trivial matter, not worth mentioning.” Alice feigned a serious expression.

“Hearing that you successfully destroyed the celestial body blocking the sun this time, creating such a feat, it’s truly unprecedented. I don’t know if this is true?” Bella continued to inquire.

“Of course.... Alice glanced at Merlin beside her, seeing he had no reaction, then thoughtfully asked seriously, “I’m saying it’s not me. Do you believe it?”

“Haha, of course not. Many people saw you flying into the sky and destroying the planet. I didn’t expect you to be a humble person. I suppose your strength has already exceeded this silver-ranked level, right? I wonder when you plan to officially become a purple-ranked adventurer?” Bella persisted in her questioning.

“...... Alice was in a fix, at a loss for words. Although she likes the feeling of being famous, the various pressures that come with it make her breathless—

My strength.....

Obviously I can’t become a purple-ranked adventurer yet, right?

If I really become a purple-ranked adventurer someday, and sit with other true big shots.....

It would be like a wolf mixed into a pack of wolves. Ah. The pressure is huge!

Chapter 62 — Much Controversy (Extra Chapter)

Volume 19 · Chapter 62

“That.... becoming a violet-gold adventurer isn't something you can just decide to be; you need an invitation from headquarters and must pass through layers of strict screening before you can take the position. I think it's premature to talk about these advantages now.” Alice struck a Taiji pose, successfully dodging Bella's questioning.
“With Miss Alice's strength, I'm sure you could easily handle even the strictest screening—there's basically no difficulty at all.” Bella said meaningfully.
“Until I receive the invitation to advance to violet-gold adventurer, I can't be certain I'll definitely achieve promotion, so becoming a violet-gold adventurer... isn't something I'm currently pursuing.” Alice answered vaguely.
“Really? After helping the Kingdom of France overcome the crisis, you could be considered a well-known adventurer. As everyone knows, celebrities usually get nicknames from the public. I wonder what nickname Miss Alice would like everyone to call you by?” Bella asked curiously.
“Sigh~” Merlin pondered nearby, interjecting, “How about calling you the King of Picking Up Bargains? It fits your situation.”
“...Who would want to be called the King of Picking Up Bargains! I'd never admit that even if you beat me to death!” Alice retorted indignantly.
“Then... how about Merlin's little errand boy?” Merlin thought this was not bad.
“Your skin is too thick, don't!” Alice angrily rejected Merlin's idea.
“It seems... Miss Alice has already thought of something better, right? I wonder what it is?” Bella asked curiously.
“That.... just.... Alice's face turned slightly red, a bit hesitant.”
“Hey, don't pick weird names like Li Gou Dan, you'll regret it for life.” Merlin leaned in, lowering his voice to remind her, worried that Alice hadn't even debuted as an idol yet before her stage name would be condemned to death.
“That's not weird at all!” Alice said with a serious face, “From now on I'll be called... Ice Dragon Empress!”
“What... nonsense....” Merlin looked at Alice's proud expression and probed, “Are you serious?”
“Of course I'm serious—could you possibly find a cooler name than this?” Alice felt good about herself; this nickname was flawless, and even saying it out loud had presence.
“? ? ?” Merlin's expression turned weird, thinking this foolishly full-of-self-importance name... where exactly is it cool?!
Even in the Rexham guild, four people wore strange expressions as they watched the live broadcast screen, commenting on Alice's self-given nickname—
Hobbes, Carl, and Lucia spoke in unison: “What a chuunibyou name...”
Only Arnold liked it, his face full of excitement: “No wonder it's Miss Alice, truly literary brilliance! If it were me, I could never think of such a cool name! So full of presence =”
“Emmm....” Hobbes stared expressionlessly at Arnold's flailing limbs, inwardly muttering that a simp deserves no good end!
Bella at the live scene had no comment, instead she lifted Alice's smelly foot—
“No wonder she's the hero who helped the Kingdom of France out of trouble—she even picked such an overbearing name!”
“Hmph!” Alice snorted triumphantly twice, giving Merlin a challenging glance, as if saying, “Look, everyone else thinks it's cool except Merlin doesn't get it.”
..... Merlin furrowed his brow, thinking, “Damn, is this unscrupulous reporter's brain messed up? Just because Alice is now famous, she starts blindly sucking up to her smelly feet? This is a bit too real, isn't it?”
“Well then, Miss Alice, thank you for accepting our interview. Finally, I'd like you to answer one more question.... Bella's expression suddenly turned serious; the unscrupulous gossip reporter's nature was again quietly brewing, she needed something eye-catching—if there wasn't a shocking exposé, the news industry would probably have gone under already.”
“Please go ahead.” Alice straightened her attitude.
“Your strength is so great, yet you're a noble mithril adventurer—why...” Bella's eyes were like knives, slicing over Merlin's face, “Why would you choose to marry a black-iron adventurer?”
“It's because... it's our own matter, not convenient to answer.” Alice didn't elaborate further, but her face turned red instead.
“Huh?” Merlin wondered, thinking, “What's inconvenient to answer? We could just say our marriage is a misunderstanding, right?”
“Surely there's some unspeakable difficulty, right?” Bella's eyes suddenly lit up with excitement.
“Eh? There's no unspeakable difficulty at all...” Alice furrowed her brows in rebuttal.
Bella didn't answer, instead she handed the microphone to Merlin, asking, “Being able to cling to your wife's thigh like that, Mr. Merlin, are you about to die from pleasure?”
“Me? ? ?” Merlin pointed at himself with a face full of doubt, thinking it utterly unbelievable—did he really have to rely on hugging Alice's big white leg just to barely sustain his life?
“What a brilliant statement!” Bella suddenly snatched back the microphone and shouted excitedly.
“Damn! I didn't say anything at all?!” Merlin furrowed his brows—what's brilliant about me saying nothing?!
“This is truly a sorrowful tale....” Bella suddenly went into drama mode, blurting out, “Pure Miss Alice was deceived by a scumbag, forced to work hard every day to support this pretty boy, having to toil like an ox and horse to provide for Mr. Merlin, yet Mr. Merlin doesn't even feel grateful, and outside he's kept 108 little lovers—good heavens! Why must Miss Alice suffer such a thing?! Is it a distortion of human nature or a collapse of morality....”
Alice:
Merlin:
The relationship between the two was fabricated by this unscrupulous reporter Bella, instantly turning into a popular melodrama these days....
or轮小
After the interview live broadcast ended, in the guild many people had gathered in front of the screen, discussing heatedly....
“Miss Alice will now become a super-popular adventurer, right? After all, there aren't many adventurers who've been on a special interview.”
“I'm more interested in Merlin marrying Miss Alice and still keeping 108 little lovers outside.”
“It might be true, after all Miss Alice has always been a pushover in front of Merlin....”
Listening to many adventurers chatting, Arnold turned around and seriously emphasized, “They aren't a real couple! Don't talk as if they're already married!”
“Hmm~” Hobbes held his wine cup, swaying, saying, “Alice... is going to blow up, I should prepare some autographs beforehand—maybe I'll make a fortune.”
“Alice... destroyed the gigantic celestial body blocking the sun in France? No.... impossible, right...” Mr. Carl stroked his beard dubiously, thinking if Merlin could pull off such an outrageous feat, he could barely believe it, but Alice's strength he knows clearly hasn't far surpassed mithril tier—it's just a bit stronger than him at most.
“What's impossible? This guy's luck has always been great; maybe he had some encounter....” Lucia turned and walked toward the counter, muttering to her father—
“Stop paying attention to Merlin that black-iron adventurer; you should focus on cultivating Alice more.”
“I think now that if Grandpa retires and leaves the guild, Alice becoming the next guild master would be the most... capable...”

title: Chapter 63 — Cain
content:
Chapter 63 — Cain

Volume 19 · Chapter 63

Outside a violent wind and rain raged the bone‑chilling autumn rain pattering against the stained glass in a chaotic disorderly manner In the small chapel on Glenn Plains the old priest friend of Old Akaron was inside wiping the silver bottle taken from the dark forest altar The old priest loved this exquisite bottle not only because it recorded the stories passed down in the Holy Light Church but also because it gave him a faint sense of sacred solemnity So the old priest did not discard the bottle as trash instead he placed it at the feet of the Goddess of Light’s statue venerating it as a holy relic The old priest carefully wiped the bottle until it shone clearly reflecting a human face then nodded in satisfaction and gently placed it on the altar Great Goddess of Light Maria I pray that you bless Glenn Plains with perpetual favorable weather The old priest prayed devoutly this flood has left many homeless perhaps because those people have done wrong and the goddess is punishing them However as a clergyman the old priest still believes this is the punishment humanity deserves and once the goddess’s anger subsides peace will surely return After finishing his prayer the old priest made the sign of the cross on his chest lifted his head to admire the statue of the Goddess of Light her visage was blurred as if deliberately preventing mortals from seeing the true face of God But suddenly a very strange thing happened before the old priest’s eyes strands of scarlet blood began to trickle from the eye sockets of the Goddess of Light’s statue looking as if she were weeping blood tears What is this?! the old priest exclaimed in shock for this was the first time he had seen the statue weep clearly a miracle yet filled with ominous portents With a loud bang the church doors were flung open and the violent wind and rain rushed in extinguishing all the candles The rain driven by the wind kept washing the church floor the priest was blown backward repeatedly crashing into the altar causing the neatly arranged items atop it to tumble to the ground Who who is it?! the old priest shouted loudly trying to dispel his fear with his cry but the cold rain striking his body still made him feel icy his clothes soaked halfway through This is the holy ground serving the Goddess No evil may set foot here even a step if you know that please leave at once From an outsider’s perspective the old priest seemed like a madman muttering to himself there was no one outside at all just empty space and the relentless downpour But the old priest could see clearly outside stood a short‑statured human with thick drenched long hair likely a girl Moreover the intruder had smashed the church doors with brute force even causing the Goddess of Light’s statue to weep blood anyone could tell that the person outside was no good A bolt of lightning split the dull sky and in its pale flash the old priest barely managed to make out the figure standing outside Her petite frame was soaked rain clinging to her pallid skin her dense black hair was drenched like countless tendrils sticking to her head She wore a smile her icy scarlet eyes revealing a disregard for life much like the eerie grin of a death row inmate who has just escaped prison and gained freedom The little girl before him was precisely the one Merlin and Alice had rescued from human traffickers faintly it seemed as if fate were pulling her back to the starting point The girl coldly glanced at the old priest as if looking at an ant utterly disregarding mortals Leave What right do you have to point fingers at me You re just a raised in the mortal world What did you say?! I am a faithful follower of Maria to insult me is to insult the great God of Light You should kneel before her statue and apologize The old priest summoned his courage speaking excitedly Hmph a bunch of people used and unable to see the truth forever living in the beautiful illusion after brainwashing how pitiful The barefoot girl stepped into the church leaving faint water marks Don t don t come closer the old priest produced a holy symbol of light holding it before his chest intending to use fictitious holy power to repel evil Useless don t wave that fake toy at me The girl waved her hand instantly releasing an invisible force akin to telekinesis rolling him away You?! the old priest screamed repeatedly the girl flung him up he slammed into the church s stone wall spitting blood The girl smiling walked to the statue of the Goddess of Light looked up at the mythic sole deity who governs the heavens blood tears continued to flow streaming down her neck to her skirt I have escaped Mother.... No matter the cost I will come to see you Even if I must destroy the entire mortal world I will build a stairway to the heavens Since you locked me away I have longed for freedom every day Now I breathe the foul air of the mortal world yet I can still recall what you have done to me This resentment accumulated over countless ages I will personally end it I will kill you The girl muttered before the statue seemingly expressing her inner hatred her previously calm eyes were also filled with She slowly picked up the silver bottle from the altar the very holy vial in which she had been imprisoned for several hundred thousand years enduring pain and torment each day The old priest on the side dragging his weary body to his feet stared with his aged eyes and asked in astonishment ...What did you just call the goddess Mother is there a problem In some sense you should kneel before me for I am the Son of God The girl examined the holy bottle her face revealing a meaningful smile Impossible the old priest exclaimed trembling as he pointed his finger Your name .... is Ah... the girl lifted her head showing a hint of helplessness It s been so long I m almost forgetting my name my name Love what is it Anxing is the heavenly sovereign revered by countless beings called the transcendent sole god The existence of that being radiant with sunlight is meant to alleviate her eternal loneliness and to call her mother My sister and I were created by her own hands but long ago we were slain by demons Mother said she once had a sister my sister and I perhaps have no reason to exist nor would we be given souls If Mother s sister were still alive perhaps the gift prepared would be to make her happy that is the meaning of our existence My sister and I must present Mother with painstakingly crafted feminine ornaments yet I still love her deeply though she does not like me Instead she dotes on my sister She is pure as driven snow her smile sweet a lovable person Abel my sister is utterly innocent a person everyone likes I feel resentment because Mother favors Abel over me and her love for me forever But I don t like her I even feel a deep‑seated hatred She has more than I do she is a lovable little lamb while I prepared a muddy sweet potato When presenting the gift Abel offered lavish praise and admiration while I Mother obviously favored Abel s gift she never spoke to me not even giving me a look As for me I could only stand aside silently acknowledging my envy and hatred toward her Watching Abel s joyful smile I realized this is already the most precious thing I could give why after giving my all do I still not receive Although my sweet potato is cheap Not a single word of praise It s simply that she doesn t like me preferring my sister Abel instead From that moment I realized that Mother as a mother would have no choice but to love me If only Abel would disappear I thought I eventually made it real stabbing Abel with a dagger and discarding her corpse This thought haunted my mind refusing to fade In the mortal world I destroyed the body and obliterated evidence The loving sister s final expression and her helpless eyes I can still recall my lovely Sister Here Mother can only love me alone Disappear you shouldn t be in the holy bottle With a hideous face you smash to the ground breaking the prison that held me defying time In the chapel the girl stared blankly at the silver The cage shatters the murals the entire chapel filled with raging fire the weeping goddess statue crashes down Suddenly flames erupted surging toward the old priest engulfed in fire who spoke with a resentful tone The girl smiled lightly turning her head to look at the My name is Cain!

title: Chapter 64 — One Third of Power (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 64 — One Third of Power (Bonus)

Volume 19 · Chapter 64

Glenn Plain was ravaged by torrential rain and madness. Though the rainy season had passed, this downpour did not look like the weather of late autumn.

Unlike the turbulent rain, a roaring fire burned in the lonely little church, filling the space and creating a sharp contrast.

The flames broke through the colored glass, only to be pressed back by the rain outside.

The lonely church swayed in the wind and rain, finally unable to bear the burden, crashing down into the mud, turning into a pile of ruins.

Dickert平 rode a black steed onto the plain, observing the recently collapsed small church.

He pulled the reins, standing on the mountainside, his expression filled with disappointment and urgency, as if dissatisfied at having failed to achieve his purpose.

Following his plan, Dickert平 began searching for the black-haired little girl, aiming to control the god mentioned by Dracula into his own hands.

However, according to the intelligence, Dickert平 had already been to Xiao Niu Town, yet he found the little girl was already gone. An old man named Akalon was posting missing person flyers everywhere, so busy he hadn't slept for days.

Now Dickert平 felt uncomfortable. The little girl was lost, where on earth to look for? He had planned for so long, only to end up with nothing.

Fortunately, Dickert平 was not one to give up easily. Thinking that the little girl was originally trapped in the dark forest within Glenn Plain, he decided to check there—maybe there would be unexpected gains.

Just as he had passed by, he saw the small church collapse in the wind and rain, leaving Dickert平 bewildered.

"What happened? Poor construction?"

"Never mind, don't meddle in other people's business. Finding that girl is the priority."

Dickert平 muttered to himself silently, pulled the reins, and led the black horse away, marching toward the forest in the rain.

But when he passed a certain intersection, a familiar shadow caught his eye in the corner of his vision: tattered clothes, dense black long hair, red eyes smiling.

Right here!

Dickert平 urgently pulled the reins, making the horse stop, and quickly turned his head to look, but only saw swaying rotten branches in the wind and rain, an empty and desolate intersection.

Hmm? How could there be nothing? Could it be that I just saw things?

Dickert平 furrowed his brows, dismounting and coming to the intersection, carefully inspecting the surroundings, but found nothing.

"Tch! What's going on? Could it be that because I've been rushing for days, I'm feeling fatigued and seeing phantoms?"

Dickert平 shook his head, just about to turn and leave, when suddenly a crisp voice rang out—

"I know you. You locked me in the dungeon, threatened me, insulted me, wanted to sell me as a slave to others..."

"Huh?"

Dickert平 gasped, his face turning pale. This voice sounded hair-raising, and it was coming from very close behind him.

In his panic, Dickert平 fled hurriedly, suddenly turning and seeing the little girl he had been searching for.

However, Dickert平 did not feel any surprise, because he clearly sensed that the little girl was quite different from before. Her speech was completely unlike that of a little child, more mature than the crying and tearful appearance she had before.

Wait, the other party is so strange? Originally it was indeed a child, why now does it give off the feeling of an old monster?

"Why don't you speak? You look very strange," Cain stepped forward a step, seemingly threatening yet causing the hair on Dickert平's body to stand on end. "You're afraid of me? I'm clearly the pitiful little one bullied by you, why do you guard against me as if it were a monster..."

"If it's really a pitiful little one, then that's good..." Dickert平 muttered through gritted sweat, his whole body on guard.

"...It seems you already know something?" Cain narrowed his eyes, sensing Dickert平's inexplicable fear of him. Then he must know his bottom line, otherwise who would fear a child?

"Yeah, the child of the Goddess of Light, the true ancestor of the vampire, Cain, right?" Dickert平 said through gritted teeth, "....I didn't expect a god to really exist. This life of mine hasn't been in vain."

"Oh? Where did you hear that?" Cain asked with interest.

"I heard you gave your power to three people. I've already seen one of them, and I've heard about your affairs." Dickert平 answered cautiously.

"So boring. I was still thinking of teasing you, but I didn't expect you already knew." Cain showed a childish disappointed look. "Then just die at my feet as penance, though before that, I want to ask, why did you appear here?"

Dickert平's eyes grew tense. Things had changed, some things exceeded his expectations.

But returning empty-handed was not his character. Maybe he could try to bargain...

After obtaining the power of the flame demon, his strength had increased greatly.

Now, Cain's power should still be incomplete. If he gives it a try, who knows, there might be a chance!

Dickert平's whole body burst into flames, entering the flame demon state. In an instant, the rain around him was all evaporated, forming mist.

Behold, he pulled out the Flame Demon Great Spear from behind, his eyes serious, as if he had just crawled out of magma.

"Why did you appear here? You guess..."

Dickert平's gaze focused, he raised the Flame Demon Great Spear and directly began firing. Raging hot flames surged out, like a fierce laser scan.

This ferocious firepower, wanting to directly burn the ground into rolling magma. The extremely high temperature made the heavy water vapor permeate, almost covering half of Glenn Plain!

Dickert平's attack this time was far more intense than when he defeated Mesfield. At the very least, the firepower was over twice as strong!

The Flame Demon's roar struck Cain, yet she did not dodge at all, smiling as she looked at Dickert平, her eyes almost indistinguishable from looking at an idiot!

Flames swept past, Dickert平 put down the Flame Demon Great Spear, watching the fire storm sweep by, his heart still somewhat uneasy. "Can I kill you?"

"You think... this is interesting?"

Cain walked out of the flames carelessly, in the fierce flames, not even a single hair of hers was hurt.

Dickert平 unleashed his full firepower, and for this "child of a god," it was truly a bit childish.

"What! ?"

Dickert平 widened his eyes, feeling it was somewhat impossible. His full attack actually couldn't hurt a single hair of the other party?

This is... the power of a god? An insurmountable abyss, complete suppression!

Dracula must have been killed by the Demon Lords, so the three parts of godly power bestowed upon him returned to the original owner, Cain!

This made Cain, who had previously entrusted the amnesic little girl state, become the high-and-mighty true ancestor of the vampire now!

Now, Cain only possesses one third of his original power, yet I see no point of victory at all!

If Cain were to reclaim all his power, just how terrifying would that be?

Dickert平's face turned pale, his whole body unconsciously began to tremble, experiencing that in the face of absolute things, small tricks are completely useless.

Cain:

"Drop your weapon."

Dickert平 like a controlled puppet, obediently dropped his Flame Demon Great Spear, becoming empty-handed.

Dickert平 wanted to try resisting, but there was no use at all. His instinct forced him to obey Cain's command, kneeling obediently in the muddy dirt...

...Bloodline suppression!

Damn!

Shit! I messed up again, I'm dead, I'm dead, I'm dead 2___

title: Chapter 65 — Professional Fence-Sitter
content:
Chapter 65 — Professional Fence-Sitter

Volume 19 · Chapter 65

Dicktepingle trembled all over, wanting to resist with all his strength against the pressure from his instincts.

However, from the moment he became a member of the vampire clan, he could not resist the commands of a superior of his own kind.

No matter how strong Dicktepingle became, he would ultimately be subject to these bloodline rules and find it difficult to resist.

Cain walked barefoot toward Dicktepingle, her scarlet eyes full of contempt.

She bent slightly, cupping Dicktepingle's face in both hands, and said with a grin—

"Wanting to resist me? You're overthinking things. I sensed it earlier—your body...."

"Flowing with my blood."

Dicktepingle's eyes widened, his expression turning terrified, immense regret churning within him.

Damn it! Although the power of the vampire let me obtain the fire demon, it ultimately landed me in dire straits!

Dicktepingle's lowly bloodline made him nothing but a weakling, a mere descendant, before Cain, the True Ancestor.

"How does my immortality power feel? Do you like it?" Cain's smile grew deeper as she said leisurely, "When I originally shared my power among those three liars, it was merely a compromise with no other choice. Once I gained my freedom, I would have killed them and reclaimed my power. I never expected them to choose to create more dependents, causing my power to scatter even further. Although your bloodline is lowly, you inherited one-millionth of my strength, correct?"

".....It's not....." The flames on Dicktepingle's body extinguished, and he abandoned his childish idea of resistance. "I don't dislike vampire power at all! To go from being a human who can live in sunlight to becoming a monster despised like a rat crossing the street—who could accept something like that?!"

"Hmm~" Cain nodded, smiling. "I suppose those three liars felt the same. That's why they created more of their own kind, to comfort themselves in their loneliness, yes? If everyone becomes a bloodthirsty monster, then humans would be the strange ones."

"...." A bead of cold sweat rolled down Dicktepingle's forehead. Could Cain have known long ago what the three original vampires would do after leaving? It was a pity that Dracula's crazy plan hadn't succeeded.

"I also don't like this immortal body. This is my mother's curse upon me. My hands are stained with the blood of my closest kin. I am forever in a state of hunger and torment. But this curse has etched my hatred deep into me for over two hundred thousand years. I now quite enjoy being tormented—it is what gives me the drive to keep living." Cain spoke softly, almost as if talking to herself, or perhaps seeking someone to confide in.

Dicktepingle didn't even dare to raise his head. His heart trembled uncontrollably. This woman's mental state was already somewhat unstable, wasn't it?

"Did you know? I feel an inexplicable warmth toward you. You are just like my child. Unfortunately, I need to reclaim all of my power, so the portion within you must also be returned." Cain grabbed Dicktepingle's hair, lifting his head. Her mouth opened slightly, revealing her sharp little fangs. It seemed she intended to drain this pitiful man dry of his blood.

"......" Dicktepingle's face went pale, his terrified eyes darting left and right. His overwhelming will to survive sent his mind racing.

"What's wrong? You wouldn't be thinking of begging for mercy right now, would you? That's so predictable..." Cain chuckled lightly, finding Dicktepingle's behavior rather boring.

"You... didn't you ask me why I appeared here? I'm answering you now—I came here specifically to find you!" Dicktepingle's eyes widened as he loudly declared.

"Hmm?" Cain suddenly paused, slightly intrigued. "Find me? What do you want from me?"

".....I wish to become your servant!" Dicktepingle nervously swallowed, speaking slowly, "I may not want to become a monster, but I can't deny the might of vampire power. I hope to become your subordinate, ready to face fire and water without hesitation!"

"You want to submit to me in exchange for keeping your dog life?" Cain said mockingly; Dicktepingle's intentions were easily seen through.

".....That's not it! I'm serious!" Dicktepingle hastily explained, "Now that I've become a vampire, I have nowhere to go. It would be far better to stay by your side and serve the great True Ancestor. By any measure, that's my best option!"

"What a pity, I don't need servants," Cain said with a meaningful smile.

"No! You do need them! Serving tea, running errands, delivering messages—those menial tasks, how could they be handled by someone as noble as you?" Dicktepingle knelt on the ground, speaking vividly, "I can do it all! I can handle anything for you. Even if a group of clowns cause trouble for you, there's no need for you to intervene yourself—just leave it to me. I'll be a thoroughly loyal servant, willing to do anything without complaint! Just treat me like a pet dog you've raised, hehehe..."

Listening to Dicktepingle's honeyed words, Cain felt a slight stir of temptation and couldn't help but hesitate.

She needed to eliminate all the vampires and reclaim her own power.

So keeping Dicktepingle alive to take care of herself seemed like a reasonable choice.

By the time her strength had fully recovered to its peak, it wouldn't be too late to kill this spineless man.

Cain smiled and took a step forward with her muddy foot.

"Fascinating. Come, show me your loyalty..."

"Uh..."

Dicktepingle looked up at Cain with a strange expression, but upon meeting her gaze, he immediately cowered and silently collapsed onto the ground.

Then this humble man extended his tongue, kissing Cain's foot and licking the filthy mud clean.

"Hahaha, you really are just like a dog," Cain chuckled, her eyes crinkled in amusement. She thought to herself, you foolish fool—how could I ever trust humans again? I'm merely using you for now, but in the end, you'll still meet your demise.

As Dicktepingle licked Cain's foot, he lifted his eyelids and resentfully stole glances at this True Ancestor, his thoughts beginning to churn restlessly—

I barely escaped Dracula's control, only to fall into another deep pit. I'm truly cursed!

But to willingly become a lapdog? Impossible! This is merely a temporary measure.

First, I need to save my life, stay by Cain's side, and patiently wait for the opportunity to turn the tables!

I wonder if the God-Sealing Stone can kill Cain, this divine child. If so, then I still have a trump card to win against defeat....

In the backpack on Dicktepingle's back was the God-Sealing Stone belonging to Kradi. After killing Medes until he turned to ashes, he had picked up this secret treasure that could seal away regeneration and resurrection abilities.

"Shouldn't we go find the other two original vampires, Master....."

"There's no need to rush. I've only reclaimed part of my power, and my current condition is unstable. I need some time to consolidate." Cain said calmly, then suddenly remembering something important—

"However, before that, I'd like to meet two people..."

"One of them... is something of a concern to me."

title: Chapter 66 — I’ll Only Marry Him (Bonus Update)
content:
Chapter 66 — I’ll Only Marry Him (Bonus Update)

Volume 19 · Chapter 66

The old king of France successfully escaped danger, reassumed control of the empire, and began to rectify the chaos left behind by Medes.

He eradicated all nobles who had once colluded with Medes, shattered the kingdom's power network that Medes had personally cultivated, and incorporated large-scale garrison forces to bolster the kingdom's military strength.

Once the security issues were resolved, the old king opened the royal granaries to relieve the civilians affected by the floods in the Glenn Plains, established temporary settlements, and gave all refugees a place to stay.

Thus, under the old king's personal governance, the Kingdom of France quickly returned to normal operation; even if evil forces wanted to take advantage of the chaos, they no longer had a good opportunity.

Then, once everything was back on track, the old king personally wrote a letter to the Purple-Gold Adventurer of the White Dew Forest, thanking her for saving his life in his time of need, and sent her a generous amount of treasure.

Although the Purple-Gold Adventurers weren't short of money, adventurers worked for pay; the old king made no presumptuous moves to approach them, which counted as being very understanding of propriety.

This Sersi living in the White Dew Forest was about as described by Claudi, truly skilled in the art of potion-making.

Generally, after being bitten by a vampire, the poison was incurable; the victim would slowly become a member of the blood clan, and would slowly die of thirst if they didn't suck human blood.

However, the antidote potion that Sersi, as people called her, sent was extraordinary; it was not an antidote against vampire poison, but rather fused time magic with potions to create a special elixir that could "reverse aging."

Since the vampire poison couldn't be cured at all, they simply reversed time, letting the patient's body regress to before the poisoning, thus solving the problem easily.

Sersi's attainments in potion-making were thus revealed; being able to fuse time magic with pharmacology, there was probably no second alchemist on this continent who could do such a fantastical thing.

With the old king taking over the entire kingdom, Margarette finally relaxed a bit and had spare time to do things she liked, such as harassing Merlin?

In the palace, the old king sat on the throne, looking at his daughter with loving eyes, and said softly—

"Margarette, during my serious illness, were you exhausted?"

"Of course! I was almost worked to death! It's all because Father was unreasonable and trusted that wolf-hearted Medes, letting the whole kingdom become a mess!" Margarette had just been calm, but exploded the moment the old king asked, her grievances pouring out. "Now I don't understand, what's so good about that Medes? You're willing to hand the kingdom to him to manage, but I'm your only daughter!"

The old king's white beard trembled; knowing he had done wrong, facing Margarette's complaints, he didn't even dare to rebut.

"Then, Your Highness, there's no need to blame the King anymore, right? Can you tone down your attitude a bit?" Blaise, though wrapped in bandages, had mostly recovered from his severe injuries; his arm severed by Robert had been reattached through healing magic. This guy had survived several disasters in a row, so he was quite a lucky person.

"Why should I not blame him? Making mistakes deserves criticism; that's what Father taught me!" Margarette retorted relentlessly.

Blaise pressed his lips tight, looking awkward, thinking why had he butted in? This was picking a fight for no reason.

"You're right. No matter what criticism, I can accept it humbly." The old king responded awkwardly, understanding why Margarette was so resentful. After all, he had trusted others blindly and needed his daughter to clean up the mess; this was inherently the incompetence of a father.

"As the kingdom's only heir, I was almost killed by that Medes!" Margarette puffed up her chest, saying resentfully, "I worked day and night adjusting the kingdom's forces, resisting Medes' rebels, and in the end I had to put on armor and go to the battlefield myself. Shouldn't Father properly reflect on his own foolishness?"

The old king broke out in a cold sweat on his forehead. Though a bit embarrassed, he nodded. "My child, I am truly sorry for trusting Medes, letting you suffer dangers that shouldn't have happened. This is my fault. But you must know, in the past your conduct was immature—how could I let you manage the whole kingdom? However, after this incident, I've changed my view of you. You have grown into an excellent crown prince."

"..." Margarette's expression softened slightly; hearing her father's recognition was worth more than anything.

"Lord Blaise, you must also be thanked for always staying by Margarette's side. If not for you, she might have faced lethal danger. You are truly the strongest warrior serving the royal family." The old king nodded, praising Blaise.

Upon receiving the king's praise, Blaise's old face turned red. He even said shyly, "Not at all, I'm not as excellent as Your Majesty said."

"This disaster caused us huge losses; the twelve legendary magic cannons are temporarily offline, and the rare intelligent magical beast Fire Demon was stolen by thieves. We need to strongly reinforce the kingdom's defenses afterward." The old king said with a helpless tone; clearly, losing so much family wealth made him very uncomfortable.

"Those wretched thieves—surely they took advantage of the kingdom's chaos to infiltrate internally and steal many secrets. They not only took Lord Claudi's Sealing Stone but also stole the precious Fire Demon." Margarette had already learned of Dicktebin's existence and, after careful investigation, discovered that the guy had been impersonating a royal guard during that time.

"I've already sent a large group to find this thief, though there's no news yet. But I believe as long as he's still on French soil, finding him is only a matter of time." Blaise responded seriously, having already defined Dicktebin as the kingdom's number one wanted criminal.

"Lord Blaise, that matter is left to you. I trust your ability." The old king said calmly.

"Understood." Blaise bowed slightly in response.

"Margarette, I've seen all your efforts. This time you truly helped the kingdom overcome the crisis, so what is your wish? Say it; I will fulfill it." The old king smiled kindly.

"Really?" Margarette instantly became excited, lifting her head and saying seriously, "I want freedom! Don't arrange any fiancé for me, but give me the right to choose freely!"

"This..." The old king hesitated for a moment, then nodded. "Of course, my child. Do you already have someone you like?"

"Exactly!" Margarette's face flushed red, and she introduced in a very excited tone—

"His name is Merlin, a Black Iron Adventurer from Britain."

"I've already designated him as my fiancé. I won't marry anyone but him!"

"I also hope Father will allow us to be together and witness our love!"

title: Chapter 67 — Planning to Slip Away
content:
Chapter 67 — Planning to Slip Away

Volume 19 · Chapter 67

Here's a translation that follows all the rules:

Blaze couldn't help but secretly furrow his brow after hearing Margaret's words, thinking: Is Princess really serious? Why is she so eager to marry Lord Merlin? She already hastily requested the Emperor's approval—setting aside Lord Merlin's class issue, he's already a married man, after all. As the kingdom's heir, she shouldn't have connections with such people; it would inevitably bring shame to the royalty.

"Black Iron Adventurer."

Old King - - just hearing it was enough to furrow his brow. He thought Margaret liked someone outstanding, but didn't expect it to be the lowest-tier adventurer.

Though Margaret is also a noble kingdom heir, wanting to marry an inconspicuous Black Iron adventurer? That's clearly unlikely.

Even if Margaret really hopes to marry Merlin, the old king would never agree under any circumstances.

Although Margaret can be given freedom in marriage, it's not license for her to run wild, is it?

The old king's expression immediately turned much uglier. He let out a light cough, suddenly striking a Tai Chi pose.

"We should talk about something else."

"Father, what do you mean? Didn't you just agree? To give me freedom!" Margaret asked very seriously, "I don't want an arranged marriage—what's wrong with that?"

"Who said I was arranging your marriage? Actually, I..."

The old king fell silent, and to prevent Margaret from really marrying a Black Iron adventurer, he had no choice but to delay the matter of marriage: "I don't wish for you to step into the marriage hall. You're still young; you can live freely for several more years. Why be in such a hurry to set a date?"

"You used to not say that." Margaret furrowed her brows.

"Cough." The old king coughed a few times, changing the subject, "My body hasn't fully recovered yet, and I'm already a bit tired, Blaze, help me back."

Blaze glanced at Margaret's unsightly complexion and silently shook his head. He had to step forward and assist the old king up, "Your Majesty, slowly—"

After the old king was helped out by Blaze, only Margaret remained in the vast palace.

She let out a silent breath, thinking: To be with Merlin, it seems there's still quite a bit of resistance.

Although Margaret could completely explain the truth, she doesn't want to do so now.

After all, Merlin is a man full of talent. If the truth spreads, who knows—maybe more competitors will come?

So Margaret thinks the current situation is quite good, at least besides Alice, there are no other rivals, so there won't be so much pressure.

Margaret stayed in the palace for a long while, then suddenly gave an eerie smile, thinking silently:

I won't give up. Even if the father king doesn't agree, it's fine; I have my own method, hehe

At the mansion, Merlin and Alice were packing their luggage. The two were already prepared to leave.

This mission can be considered fully completed. After returning to Reckham, they should receive a reward from Count Austin.

Plus, they extorted money from the city master of Avignon, Kamila. On this trip, they earned quite a bit, enough to console themselves for quite some time.

"Leaving secretly? Why be so sneaky? We're not criminals," Merlin asked, frowning, listening to Alice say they shouldn't tell anyone and leave in the middle of the night, which was just like being a thief—it made him quite uncomfortable.

"We can leave as soon as possible instead of dragging it out. Otherwise, we might not be able to leave later," Alice was packing her things, feeling that Merlin was talking too much at a time like this. Just quietly follow and walk over.

"Hmm?" Merlin looked at Alice's strange reaction and asked dubiously, "Why would we not be able to leave? Is there another enemy here?"

Alice was suddenly asked, and a flicker of panic flashed in her eyes. The words reaching her throat were swallowed back into her stomach.

Why leave sneakily? Of course, it's to avoid Margaret's prying eyes!

These past few days, Margaret has been idle; if she has nothing to do, she'll come to harass Merlin. If not for Alice's excellent defensive capabilities, she would have really been taken by this guy!

So Alice thinks it's not suitable to stay here for long. To prevent Merlin from being hooked by this bitch Margaret, it's better to hide far away early.

That way, she doesn't have to watch over Merlin like a shepherd every day, for fear he'll be snatched away by a she-wolf.

However, Alice definitely won't tell Merlin such small thoughts—it's a bit hard to bring up. Either she's especially worried about Merlin leaving her, or leaving sneakily seems like a lack of confidence in her own charm, afraid of Margaret one way or another.

"What's there so many reasons for? Just listen and don't talk nonsense."

"Tch!" Merlin helplessly clicked his tongue, muttering a sentence, "Your current look is like a debtor being urged to the door, hurrying to escape a disaster."

"Hmm!" Alice's whole body shuddered, her face turning red as she explained, It's not! Don't think random things.

Merlin spread his hands, asking, "Leaving secretly actually has nothing wrong with it. Do we not need to tell anyone? After all, we've received quite a bit of care these past few days."

"Ah?! " Alice seemed to have been electrocuted, suddenly turning her head, "Absolutely not! Tell anyone, and absolutely cannot tell this person!"

"A woman?" Merlin's expression turned strange, looking Alice up and down, thinking she didn't eat today?

Alice hesitated, disguising and saying, "My point is, Margaret is a person with many schemes. If she knows we're leaving secretly, we won't be able to leave!"

"Why say that?" Merlin looked at Alice with interest.

"Because— the kingdom is now short of soldiers and generals. Margaret will definitely hope we stay. She has a lot of bad water in her stomach; maybe later she'll use some despicable methods to restrict our freedom," Alice's heart had already demonized Margaret, always feeling this cunning woman was brewing toxic plans every moment.

"I think this little princess, although she has many heart eyes, also can't be called a bad person," Merlin stroked his chin, thinking after saying, "You're unnecessarily too sensitive, depicting her as a toxic old witch."

"Merlin, what do you mean? Praising the excellence of other women in front of me? I think we need to talk well." Alice's complexion instantly turned cold, her mood plummeted to the bottom. Margaret this bastard wants to snatch a man from herself; calling her a toxic old witch is light!

"Not I didn't mean other things. Merlin's forehead had a few black lines drop, diverting the topic, saying, "I suddenly find what you say very reasonable, very good! Let's finish collecting things and leave right away!"

Alice's expression slightly eased, turning her head to continue packing, "Humph!"

"So it was just worrying about being absorbed by the Kingdom of France? I thought earlier you were because these past few days Margaret kept harassing me, so your heart was sour," Merlin revealed a look of sudden realization.

"Er!" Alice's face slowly turned red, her shoulders slightly trembling, then turning her head and angrily saying, "Who has a sour heart? I don't have good!"

"Meaning I ate wrong?"

"No! I didn't—"

title: Chapter 68 — Mrs. Merlin (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 68 — Mrs. Merlin (Extra Chapter)

Volume 19 · Chapter 68

"Just because someone else is harassing you, I feel all sour inside—am I stupid or not? I wouldn't act like that!" Alice desperately tried to hide herself, afraid Merlin would notice something.
"I was just saying it offhand, why is your reaction so big?" Merlin asked awkwardly.
"" Alice stared, her pretty face flushed, "I just wanted to say I wouldn't be so easily jealous, and how could I possibly be jealous of you? Don't overthink it."
"Really? Why does it seem like every time a girl approaches you, you want to eat explosives and act all fierce?" Merlin asked expressionlessly.
"That's because..." Alice was at a loss for words, couldn't find a good excuse, so she said, "It's just because I don't like it—isn't that allowed? I just don't like seeing people flirt in front of me, it's disgusting!"
Clap clap clap, Merlin lightly clapped, nodding and said, "Alice, you're truly outstanding~"
"Hmph, don't waste time. Since you're so idle, come help me tidy up, don't just sit there like a big shot." Alice said angrily, her face full of disdain.
"." Merlin stood up to help, and asked in passing, "Are we taking a steamship straight back to Britain?"
"How could that be? Obviously there are more important things, right?" Alice said very seriously.
"Anything else important?" Merlin wondered, seeming to have really forgotten.
"Do you have a fish's brain, with only a seven-second memory?" Alice rolled her eyes, utterly speechless with Merlin, "The child we rescued—we're temporarily leaving him with Old Mr. Akalon, we need to take her back!"
Merlin slapped his forehead, recalling that black-haired little girl, but this child only gets close to Alice, while to me she's a stranger, so I don't pay attention, making it easy to forget.
"Ah right! There's still this little brat around—what are you planning to do? Want to find her parents?"
"Of course, until I find them, I'll look after her." Alice said with determined eyes.
Merlin glanced at Alice, probing, "You're not planning to raise that child for a lifetime, are you?"
"That's the worst case scenario, but I think we can still find her parents." Alice paused, then continued, "That child thinks I'm her mother—I can't just abandon her."
Merlin's expression turned strange. He showed a look of wanting to speak but holding back.
"What's that expression supposed to mean?" Alice pressed her lips together, glaring at Merlin.
"-Nothing, I just think you'll be a good mother in the future," Merlin said meaningfully, though inside he thought, "No way? Will our house end up with another little troublemaker? How am I supposed to deal with a kid? I have zero experience!"
Hearing Merlin's words, Alice's cheeks flushed a faint pink on both sides, stammering, "Don't don't say silly things"
Knock knock knock, the door-knocking sound rang—
"Who's there? Visitors this early in the morning?" Merlin walked over to open the door, and immediately a fragrant breeze blew in, a soft figure flung herself into his arms.
"Lord Merlin! Long time no see, I've missed you!" Margaret suddenly visited, seeing Merlin she tightly embraced him, such an intimate gesture truly unbecoming of a kingdom princess.
"Ugh!" Merlin clearly felt Margaret's ** softness, his face instantly turning awkward, "Your Highness, didn't we just see each other yesterday? What's with 'long time no see'? We're just acquaintances; there's no need to miss me after not seeing each other for a short while!"
"Lord Merlin, please don't say such heartless words; in my heart you are a special existence—even if half a day passes without seeing you, I'll miss you to the point of going mad." Margaret lifted her head, blinking her big watery eyes, frequently sending electric vibes to Merlin.
"Mmmmm Merlin's face darkened, thinking what the heck is this weird habit, 'I understand, but Your Highness please let go first—you hugging me makes me a bit uncomfortable.'
"No!" Margaret hugged even tighter, completely oblivious to others' gazes and feelings, not thinking there's anything wrong with being so close to Merlin, even secretly enjoying it in her heart, "I won't let go—we rarely get a chance to embrace like this, don't you think Lord Merlin doesn't see this as a hard-won opportunity? So we should cherish each other more, right?"
"" Merlin felt immense pressure; if it weren't that he isn't too familiar with Margaret, he'd really want to spin her around like a top.
This clingy type of girl Merlin doesn't like, even feels some aversion, easily reminding him of his sister Lilith.
"Lord Merlin, right now it's just us; this private setting somehow makes Margaret's face turn like a ripe red apple, she silently puckered her lips, apparently wanting a kiss?"
"Excuse me, I'm still alive, thanks." Alice's voice suddenly came, instantly breaking Margaret's oblivious atmosphere, making the situation awkward.
"Hey! What the heck, there's still a light bulb?" Margaret dissatisfiedly pursed her lips, forced by Alice's pressure to release Merlin, stopping her shameless freeloading behavior, after all she's wary of Alice's strength, worried about provoking her.
"Light bulb cannon!"
Upon hearing that, Alice's face turned red X like a small volcano about to erupt, and she angrily thought,
"Light bulb? Are they talking about me?"
"Are you kidding? This ** female has already taken Merlin as her own?"
"Come on, I'm the legitimate wife, alright? She's the shameless light bulb! Always trying to hook up with my man!"
Alice's forehead veins faintly showed, her body trembling from Margaret's anger.
This is why Alice left in such a hurry—it wasn't without reason.
If we kept staying in the royal capital, Margaret would harass Merlin every day—who knows what might happen?
So Alice also had some foresight; she just didn't expect Margaret to come storming over so early today.
"Ha, Your Highness sure loves to joke—if I'm the light bulb, then what are you?"
"Maybe I'm Lord Merlin's sweetheart?" Margaret answered feigning shyness, "Lord Merlin, you agree, right?"
"You?!" Alice pointed at Margaret, thinking she was utterly shameless!
Merlin suddenly felt sandwiched in the middle with great pressure, so he solemnly asked, "I don't know what brings Your Highness here this time?"
"Lord Merlin, you really don't understand romance," Margaret said disappointedly, "I came to invite you to tonight's victory banquet—after all you helped us get through the crisis, we haven't properly thanked you yet, so I hope Lord Merlin can attend this banquet."
"" Merlin hesitated, thinking Alice's side was rushing to leave, seeming willing but unable.
But who would have thought Alice suddenly stepped forward, stood beside Merlin, and calmly said, "Sure, since the Princess warmly invited us, we'll naturally go."
"Miss Alice, please wait a moment—I didn't invite you, you don't have to come." Margaret retorted, speaking just as bluntly.
"But such banquets usually bring a female companion, right? How could I let Merlin go alone?" Alice paused, then gave a meaningful smile and said,
"Of course."
"I'm participating nominally as Merlin's wife."
