"I heard that the great wizard Seraphina lives here, and my friend is on the brink of death, I hope to receive your help!" Merlin responded loudly, "Please, madam, come out and see me, don't hide and hide!" The silver-white iron trees rustled and swayed, and suddenly parted to reveal the path ahead. A girl with a bunch of bottles and jars hanging from her waist, and a pharmacist's pack on her back, slowly walked out, looking like a student. This girl had a big, fiery red hairstyle, and a face that was both fierce and cold, like she didn't care about anything. Merlin sized up the girl in front of him, and wondered in his heart, what the heck? Isn't she supposed to be an old witch? Why does she look like she's only 15 or 16 years old? Is she using some kind of anti-aging potion? "Madam... you're... the legendary purple-gold adventurer Seraphina?" "No, I'm Seraphina's apprentice, Susan." The girl clarified her identity, and introduced herself as Seraphina's disciple. Merlin furrowed his brow, and had already seen the golden-level adventurer certification on Susan's chest, and the information was mostly accurate. Location: Calamandia Name: Susan Brownell Occupation: Pharmacist Merlin withdrew his gaze, and thought to himself, so that's it, she's the apprentice of the legendary purple-gold adventurer, no wonder she looks so young. "So, could you please call your teacher out for me? My friend's injuries are very severe, and if they're not treated, they'll probably die!" Susan looked at Merlin's back, and saw that Alice's face was pale, and confirmed that Merlin wasn't lying, he really was here to seek medical help. "I'm sorry, but you should just leave. My teacher is currently resting, and won't be treating anyone else, please look elsewhere." "What?" Merlin's expression turned ugly, and he asked, "A matter of life and death, and you're just resting because of that? What kind of joke is this?" "Sir, please understand, my teacher is not a saint, and doesn't have the responsibility or obligation to save anyone. Whether to save or not is entirely up to her mood, and... Susan furrowed her brow, and said seriously, "If every single person came to seek her help, then my teacher would be exhausted to death. This world has countless people with serious illnesses, and my teacher is not a savior, she can't save everyone!" "I'm not asking you to force my teacher to save me, I'm just asking if you could help me, and I'll do anything for you, anything at all!" Merlin offered his promise, as long as he could save Alice, he would do anything for them, even if it meant doing a favor for them. With Merlin's incredible strength, he could basically do anything, and this promise was something that couldn't be bought with money. If Margaret could get this opportunity, she would probably laugh in her sleep. However, to people who didn't know the situation, Merlin's promise was worthless, and even a bit laughable... "Sorry, sir, your promise isn't worth much...". Susan said seriously, her eyes occasionally glancing at Merlin's black iron adventurer certification, and thought to herself, what's wrong with this guy? Does he have a screw loose? The teacher is a purple-gold adventurer, does she need someone else's help to do things? "Pffft!" Merlin's two eyebrows were tightly furrowed. "Teacher is getting old, and needs to rest more, not long ago, the imperial princess sent a personal letter, and teacher helped her out, it was a special case, and she won't be doing it again, please leave!" Susan said bluntly, without any hesitation. "Fine, since we can't persuade you, I'll just have to use force, don't say I didn't warn you..." Merlin's eyes turned sharp, and a cold glint appeared in his eyes. "You know, every single person who comes to seek my teacher's help, but gets rejected, eventually chooses to use force, but they all end up dead." Susan raised an eyebrow, and looked at Merlin with disdain, "You think you can threaten us? You should think twice before you act, you're just a black iron adventurer from Rekzem,..." "Looks like we can't come to an agreement easily, I've already thought it through, and I have the upper hand." Merlin didn't look at the rotting corpses, but instead gently laid Alice down on the ground, and then drew out his waist-mounted katana. "I'll give you two choices... " "Either call your teacher out to save my friend." "Or die."

title: Chapter 4 — The Great Potion Wizard (Extra Update)
content:
Chapter 4 — The Great Potion Wizard (Extra Update)

Volume 20 · Chapter 4

Susan looked at Merlin's resolute eyes, and her heart skipped a beat. Normal people would be terrified by the sight of so many dead bodies and wouldn't think of engaging in any more bloodshed. But Merlin seemed to be a different story, and he showed no signs of backing down, which put Susan under a bit of pressure.

"I'm warning you not to engage in a futile endeavor, no matter how hard you try, you'll only end up as fertilizer for these iron trees," Susan said.

"Consider me fertilizer? Don't be afraid to come at me, I'll... Merlin said calmly.

"Like you said, Susan took out a bottle of red potion from her body, opened the cap, and slowly poured it into the ground beneath her feet. The entire forest suddenly emitted an eerie glow, and the pure white iron trees began to display pulsing blood vessels, as if they had come to life! ? The ground shook with a low rumble, and the iron trees swayed like seaweed, as if they had entered a forest of tree spirits. The White Forest, a natural defensive barrier, had been activated by the bottle of potion, and it had become Susan's powerful tool.

"Disappear, you reckless fool!" Susan said, and the moment the words left her lips, a metallic tremor echoed through the air, and the iron trees above began to shed their leaves, which turned into countless flying darts that shot towards Merlin, the intruder, like a swarm of bees! These leaves were originally incredibly sharp and hard, and now they were falling from the sky like a net, making it impossible for anyone to avoid them, not even a fly! Hiss hiss hiss! The forest was filled with the sound of flying darts, and the air was filled with the sound of piercing through the air!

Merlin shielded Alice behind him, not flinching at all, and instead, he stared straight at the all-around attack, his eyes fixed intently. He drew his sword, and with a mighty swing, he unleashed a powerful slash! OP SE this small... The terrifying sword energy exploded in the air, like a raging flood, tearing through everything in its path!

The countless silver leaves were destroyed in an instant, and the impact shot straight towards Susan, who was caught off guard! "Ahh... Susan's face was filled with shock, and she couldn't believe that the seemingly insignificant Merlin could instantly shatter the iron trees' killing array! This person was not ordinary!

The White Forest was a place cultivated by Seraph, with a powerful ability to repel external enemies. Even Saint-tier strongmen wouldn't be able to withstand the attack and emerge unscathed! In fact, many Saint-tier strongmen had died in this forest, seeking help but being refused, and then being killed by the countless silver leaves. But Merlin was the first person to directly break through the attack with brute force!

The slash of the sword continued to charge towards Susan, and she took a step back in surprise, her eyes wide with fear. The iron trees around her suddenly intertwined, forming a defensive iron wall to protect her. These iron trees were incredibly hard, and their defense was more than sufficient. Even if this man was not ordinary, he probably wouldn't be able to do anything to her... Susan's heart was still racing, and she hadn't had time to calm down when the seemingly solid iron wall in front of her was shattered by Merlin's sword, instantly destroyed!

"A sharp sound echoed through the air, and Merlin's sword sliced through the entire White Forest, almost cutting through the entire forest! Merlin's face remained expressionless, and he looked down at the ground, his sword pointed at the stunned Susan, "Go, call out your teacher."

"...Susan's eyes widened in shock, and her heart skipped a beat. A few strands of red hair fell from her head, and she was only alive because Merlin hadn't shown any intention of killing her... Suddenly, a magical array of light appeared behind Susan, and an old woman with a pale face, dressed in a gray robe, and wearing a pointed hat, walked out, holding a small black dog.

This old woman looked worn out, with white hair like dry grass, and she leaned on a walking stick, her posture like she could break her back at any moment. Her most distinctive feature was her sharp nose, like a hawk's beak. "What's all the commotion outside? Susan, what are you up to again? Are you brewing explosives?"

"...No, teacher, it's... Susan looked at Merlin with a stern expression.

Hearing the old woman's hoarse voice, Merlin carefully examined the old woman, and indeed, she looked like a genuine old witch. So, he tentatively asked, "Seraph... You are Seraph?"

"You are who? Breaking into the White Forest is bad enough, but now you're destroying everything here, you have a lot of nerve... Seraph narrowed her eyes, her expression filled with anger, and she looked like she hated anyone who dared to disturb her.

Merlin sheathed his sword and spoke calmly, "Seraph, I've come to ask for your help, and I hope you won't refuse."

"Teacher, this guy is relentless, I've already refused him, but he won't give up, and... Susan frowned, her voice low.

Seraph looked at Merlin, then at the surrounding destruction, and she realized that this was not the work of a black iron adventurer, but something more serious. "I've had many people come to me for help, but you're the first one to be so impolite."

"I didn't mean to be, I just wanted to talk to you in person, and if you had appeared earlier, I wouldn't have been so impolite," Merlin said, his voice low.

Seraph turned around, her expression cold, "Leave now, I won't help you, and people who are impolite should pay the price."

"Is that so?" Merlin looked around, "Then I'll just have to destroy your forest first, and then I'll take care of you."

"You shameless wretch! You think the world revolves around you?!" Susan couldn't help but scold Merlin.

"If you won't help my friend, then you're of no value to me, do I need to worry about being shameless or not?" Merlin said, his words dripping with meaning.

"Hmph! You're a young man with a thick face... Seraph opened a bottle of green liquid from her pocket and poured it onto the ground. The small black dog, which had been sleeping, suddenly became excited and licked up the potion, and then, with a loud, bone-cracking sound, it transformed into a massive black wolf, its body towering over 100 feet tall, tall enough to look down on the entire White Forest! The wolf's claws struck the ground, creating a massive crater, and its weight... was far beyond that of a full-grown dragon.

The wolf's fur stood on end, its massive tail thrashing about, and its red eyes glared at Merlin, its mouth foaming with hunger, its jaws open wide, radiating an aura of terror, like a tsunami. "A truly impressive technique... Merlin looked up at the wolf, his eyes filled with admiration, and he couldn't help but feel a newfound respect for this old witch.

What kind of potion did she give this dog? Just a few drops of potion, and it transformed into a terrifying monster, a creature of the realm! Not bad, not bad at all, this old witch is indeed a rare purple-gold level adventurer, her techniques are truly impressive, and it seems that the old man who was knocked unconscious earlier didn't even get to show his true strength... Merlin looked down, his eyes fixed on the wolf's crotch, and he suddenly smiled, his lips curling up in a sneer, and he licked his dry lips.

This old witch is indeed a formidable opponent, and her techniques are truly impressive, but... Merlin's eyes sparkled with a hint of mockery, and he looked up at the wolf, his voice dripping with sarcasm, "A...

title: Chapter 5 — Significant Meaning
content:
Chapter 5 — Significant Meaning

Volume 20 · Chapter 5

The giant black wolf, its teeth bared and its jaws wide open, glared menacingly at the tiny Merlin, its massive body blocking out the sun and casting a dark shadow. "Now's your chance to run," the old wizard said in a low, gravelly voice, not wanting to kill Merlin easily. "Sorry, but 'run' isn't even in my dictionary," Merlin shrugged, his eyes never leaving the wolf's.

"That's not surprising," the old wizard said, waving his hand dismissively and giving the wolf a command. The wolf let out a loud howl and lowered its head, its massive jaws open wide, revealing razor-sharp teeth that glinted in the sunlight. Its mouth was filled with a mixture of saliva and the stench of blood, and it charged straight at Merlin! Merlin didn't flinch, however, and instead greeted the wolf with a calm, collected air, "Ah! Ptoo!"

The wolf suddenly closed its mouth, its eyes wide with surprise, as if something strange had just flown into its mouth. "What's going on?" Susan asked, her eyebrows furrowed in concern, thinking that the old wizard's pet dog was acting strangely today, unlike its usual obedient self.

The wolf suddenly revealed a few moments of happiness, its tail wagging furiously as it sniffed the air, searching for the scent of a male. Its eyes grew wild with excitement, and it began to drool, its tongue darting in and out of its mouth as it ran off, completely unaware of the old wizard's disapproving expression.

This reaction was clearly a sign that it was mating season, and the female wolves were starting to look for males to continue their lineage. However, Merlin was well aware of this, and he knew that his demon saliva was capable of crossing species and was still very effective.

"What...what's going on? Why is Blacky acting so strangely today? It's never done this before!" Susan exclaimed, her face filled with shock, looking at the calm teacher, "Teacher, what's going on?"

"It's not that it's running away, it's just...in heat," the old wizard said, his voice low and mysterious, his eyes fixed on Merlin. "I didn't expect this young man to have so many tricks up his sleeve."

"Are you going to continue with this? You're making me uncomfortable," Merlin said, his voice stern, his eyes fixed on the old wizard.

"I don't want to bother you, but your words are really getting on my nerves," the old wizard growled.

"If you're willing to help my friend, I'll apologize for my previous behavior," Merlin said, his tone softening.

"You think apologizing will make everything okay? Look at what you did in the White Forest!" Susan exclaimed, her red hair fluttering in the wind, her face filled with anger.

The old wizard looked at Merlin, a hint of interest in his eyes, "I can make an exception and ignore your past actions, and I'll even help your friend."

"Ah?!! Teacher?! What are you talking about? This guy is not only impolite, but he's also destroyed the forest, and he should be punished! Otherwise, he'll just get bolder and bolder!" Susan exclaimed, her eyes wide with shock, thinking that the teacher was being strange today, unlike his usual self.

"Susan, calm down, I know you've been taking care of this forest for a long time, and you have feelings for it, but don't let your emotions get in the way of your words," the old wizard said, his eyes fixed on Merlin, his voice low and mysterious.

Moreover, this young man looks quite good, and although I'm a purple-gold adventurer, there are some things that I can't solve on my own, so I need help from other sources, hehehe."

"...Teacher, what...what are you talking about?!" Susan's face turned bright red, feeling that the old wizard's words were very meaningful, even a bit...unseemly.

"Ah!" Merlin subconsciously took a step back, his eyes narrowing, thinking that this old woman was...maybe a bit too old to be interested in young men? Was she excited because she had just seen the effect of my saliva?...this is a bit too stimulating, I'm not that kind of person, you know!

"Don't worry about it, I've made up my mind, I need this young man's help, and as a reward, I'll help his friend," the old wizard said, his eyes fixed on Merlin, his expression softening.

"...Teacher, what you're saying...is that a serious thing, right?" Susan asked, her voice trembling, her eyes fixed on the old wizard, hoping that he would be serious.

"Of course, it's a serious thing, I haven't done something like this in a long time...old wizard chuckled, his wrinkles deepening, "Young man, come with me, we need to find a private place to talk."

"...thing?...?" Susan's eyes narrowed, her voice filled with annoyance, hoping that the old wizard would be serious.

"Ah!...I'm...I'm exhausted," Merlin said, his face red, his eyes fixed on the old wizard, his voice barely above a whisper.

"Good enough, it's just barely enough," the old wizard said, his eyes fixed on the bottle of transparent, sticky liquid, his expression serious.

The old wizard only needed Merlin's saliva, and when he discovered its special properties, he had a plan. Merlin swore that he had never spat so much in his life, and he had produced almost half a bottle's worth, which was why he looked so tired.

"That...old wizard, what do you need my saliva for?" "I've been experimenting with many pigs, and recently, those little ones have been cold, and if they don't get better, they won't be able to give birth to piglets...the old wizard said, his eyes fixed on the experiment table, his back to Merlin.

"Piglets?" Merlin's eyebrows furrowed, his eyes scanning the room, until he saw a book on the bookshelf that didn't belong, 《Postpartum Care》.

title: Chapter 6 — Fair Skin, Beautiful, Long Legs (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 6 — Fair Skin, Beautiful, Long Legs (Bonus)

Volume 20 · Chapter 6

...So that's how it is, I need to use my own saliva for the piglets?
No wonder before I came in, I heard the surrounding 'oink oink' sounds; turns out it's Sesi-like livestock...
I thought this guy had some special intentions toward me, but I was overthinking it, phew~
But my saliva can actually help frigid sows reproduce offspring; it's also added a skill for getting rich......
Bullshit
Heck, I'm a Great Demon Lord, one who commands a million demons with a single call!
Not some wandering vet who specializes in treating frigid sows in the countryside!
This is an insult! A naked insult to me!
Merlin's expression changed continuously, from initial relief to gloomy and extremely displeased.
But thinking that I still need to ask Sesi for help healing Alice, even if Merlin feels insulted, he wouldn't voice his dissatisfaction at this time.
"You're really an unexpected youngster, using saliva to make my pets think only about mating and lose their minds—just what kind of terrifying natural aphrodisiac is this?" Old Sesi was concentrating on his research, muttering, "Probably just a tiny drop would make those frigid sows go crazy."
...Merlin had a complex expression, covering his face and thinking, 'Don't say any more; my saliva is a hidden skill, effective against female enemies—please don't portray me as a vet specializing in treating post-partum frigid sows.'
"Such a potent concoction would likely need to be diluted dozens of times; otherwise the piglets won't be born before the boars are drained and die explosively." Old Sesi fiddled with Merlin's saliva, discovering that this seemingly ordinary saliva contains the power to drive female species into frenzy; if misused, it could cause...
"I'm not, I didn't...." Merlin covered his mouth, desperately denying that the saliva in his mouth is such * * stuff.
That....
Old Sesi continued his work, then suddenly said in a casual tone, "You actually aren't human at all, are you?"
"Eh!" Merlin startled, nervously thinking, "Surely I've been found out? I thought I could bluff my way through! Now that you know I'm a demon, what will happen to me? Be blown away? Exterminated? Or refuse to heal Alice?"
"A normal human.... couldn't possibly secrete saliva with such strong aphrodisiac effect; as far as I know, only creatures like succubi among demons can have bodily fluids with such effect...." Old Sesi turned his head, his deep gaze scrutinizing Merlin, "I've lived half my life, and this is the first time I've seen a male succubus."
"...." Merlin's eyes darted uncertainly, not knowing whether to admit it, worried that the other might turn hostile and refuse to heal Alice...
"There's only the two of us here; if you have something to say, spit it out, otherwise how can I feel at ease healing your friend?" Old Sesi paused, then lowered his voice, "Actually, just now you made my pet lose its mind, and I already sensed your special identity; but considering everyone has their own secrets, I didn't confront you directly. Now that we have a rare chance, aren't you going to come clean about something, young......"
Merlin saw that the other had already noticed the clues; continuing to hide was pointless, so he sighed and said seriously, "That's right, I'm a succubus, but my bloodline is thin and I lack demonic traits."
Originally Merlin wanted to admit he was one of the Seven Demon Lords, but after thinking it over he dismissed that idea, because demon lords in the human world are powerful and terrifying beings; he might scare Sesi, so it's better to give a more conservative answer, just admitting he's a demon.
"Thin bloodline? No wonder it's hard to tell you're a demon; you're hardly different from a normal human." Old Sesi nodded, his guess nearly matching, "But male succubi are really rare, and your saliva's potency far exceeds that of an ordinary succubus—were you born through some special means?"
"...." Merlin widened his eyes in surprise, never expecting Old Sesi to see that, "My mother despised men, so she used the power of succubi to give birth to me...."
"Oh~, that makes sense." Old Sesi suddenly understood, smiling ambiguously, "You inherited succubus power but not a complete demon bloodline; using magic to give birth unilaterally indeed has this flaw, it's purely luck. I've heard the demon race has very strict standards for offspring; your kind, unable to inherit maternal bloodline, should have been disposed of as defective long ago—surviving to adulthood is already lucky. Were you fleeing the demon race since you were little?"" 。厂扛!小玩
"...." Merlin's eyes flickered; since Old Sesi misunderstood, there's no need to clarify and avoid trouble, "That's right, I fled the demon race as a child and grew up in the human world."
"That sounds really tough." Old Sesi slowly turned, looking at Merlin and said, "If you just lied, I would break our agreement; but seeing your honesty, I can heal your friend, after all your saliva is a very rare material, and it also helps me out."
"....? F5 Merlin's anxious heart gradually eased, 'I am an evil demon race; are you willing to coexist peacefully with me? Ordinary people would surely shout for my death as an evil creature.'
"The rule of the adventurer industry is non-interference; I'm not a follower of the Holy Church, nor a brainwashed ignorant mob—what reason would I have to target you?" Old Sesi slowly turned, tidying the messy test bench, "Among adventurers there are also non-human members, not all are human; demons may sound fearsome, but essentially what's the difference between them and elves, dwarves, or orcs? They're all non-human races anyway; moreover, you left the demon race as a child, so you probably can't go back anyway—what do I have to worry about?"
"."...." Merlin watched Old Sesi's hunched back, thinking this old guy is a relatively sensible human? If so, that's fine; otherwise I'd be in trouble.
"Not.... There are plenty of people in the adventurer world who have zero tolerance for dark beings; you'd better be careful not to be noticed, a not everyone is as easygoing as me." Old Sesi finished cleaning up and turned around. 小此 C
"Thanks for the pointer." Merlin expressed gratitude; according to seniority, Old Sesi counts as his senior in the adventurer industry, so his words are naturally worth referencing.
A blast sounded, and thick white smoke filled the entire indoor space.
"What! ? What happened! ?" Merlin covered his 0 nose, shielding Alice behind him, thinking it was a sudden attack.
But after the smoke cleared, the old hag was gone, replaced by a stunning middle-aged woman that made eyes pop!
A pointed witch's hat perched on her flowing emerald-green hair, her ample **. perky buttocks straining the originally loose gray robe to the brink of bursting!
Especially those long, plump thighs peeking from the slit robe, making one wish to pop their eyeballs out!
"Oh dear, did I miscalculate the time? I didn't expect the aging potion's effect to kick in suddenly..."
"You... you...." Merlin rarely stumbled over his words, gazing at Sesi's eyes as if seeing a painted-skin monster—
Damn it!
Just like an old lady who could kick the bucket any moment, suddenly turned into a charming, alluring auntie!
.Truly a rare gem in the city who really knows how to play =

title: Chapter 7 — Blank Paper Susan (Bonus Chapters per Rules)
content:
Chapter 7 — Blank Paper Susan (Bonus Chapters per Rules)

Volume 20 · Chapter 7

Truly a mistake, big mistake, big mistake. Cessily rubbed her temples, not expecting her aging potion to run out of time, "What a low-level error, indeed, age has made my brain dull, is that it?"

Merlin's face was filled with astonishment, pointing at this old woman, who was actually a mature and alluring woman, her beauty was more fierce than Elizabeth's. Originally, she was an ugly old woman, but in an instant, she transformed into a stunning aunt, so beautiful that even Merlin couldn't resist.

"Hmm?" Cessily adjusted her robes and looked up at Merlin's strange expression, "Do you need to be so surprised? That's just my original appearance."

"Old sister, I think..." Merlin's face turned red.

"What do you want?" Cessily showed a sly smile, swaying her beautiful body, "You won't fall in love with me at first sight, will you? Young..."

"...no, I want to ask you what you're doing. Why do you use an old appearance?" Merlin couldn't understand Cessily's attitude, normal people liked their appearance to be young and full of vitality, but Cessily was...

"It's not because I'm not charming enough, it's just that I'm too charming, and men will fight each other for me." Cessily sparkled with bright eyes, sighing, "I'm just a red-haired girl, causing trouble everywhere."

"Ha!" Merlin almost spat out his old blood, unable to help but think in his heart, "Stop it, you old woman! Don't be so self-absorbed! Look at your age! You're already an old maid!"

"Now it's not like it was back then, I was more beautiful when I was young, and I didn't have any men I couldn't charm, haha!" Cessily self-indulged, touching her face.

Merlin didn't know what to say, although he couldn't see how beautiful Cessily was when she was young, he could see that this old woman was...

"Actually, I never show my true face to outsiders, I always use the aging potion to disguise myself, just in case I'm bothered by men." Cessily looked at Merlin, whispering, "You're lucky to see my true face, you're a very fortunate guy."

"I... Merlin furrowed his brow, barely understanding Cessily's meaning, so she used an old appearance to avoid many disturbances, right? This old woman...

Cessily waved her hand, indicating Merlin to follow her, "Come with me to the underground room, I need to check your injuries." Outside, apprentice Susan was still nervously eavesdropping.

After the intense shouting, the voices became much softer, and it was impossible to guess what was happening inside. However, Susan's rich imagination allowed her to think of something, she thought that after the intense passion, there must be a romantic aftermath!

Good heavens! The teacher was so old, why was she so fond of this impudent man? Could it be that... the teacher was powerless against such bad men?

It was impossible! The teacher was young and beautiful, and everyone knew her, what man hadn't seen her... Susan stopped thinking, but she didn't notice that the door had suddenly opened.

Cessily, carrying Merlin, walked out of the room, and Susan was shocked by the teacher's stunning appearance.

"Teacher! ...why did you show this kind of appearance to outsiders?"

"What can I do? The aging potion's duration has ended, otherwise, I wouldn't have shown my true face to strangers." Cessily looked helpless.

"Really? The teacher won't be... Susan hesitated, her expression becoming deep and meaningful, suspecting that the teacher was trying to seduce the stranger by deliberately removing her old appearance.

The teacher and apprentice had been living in seclusion in the White Forest, rarely seeing anyone, let alone a young and vigorous man.

As Cessily's only apprentice, Susan had some knowledge of the teacher's past, and she suddenly thought that the teacher might be tempted by the stranger, and that was why she showed her true face.

"Because of what?" Cessily bent down, giving Susan a slap on the head, "You little devil, are your thoughts too dirty? I told you not to sneak around at night and read those dirty books, and now you're thinking of such nonsense? If you have the chance to go out and cause trouble, don't say you're my student, it'll be embarrassing!"

Merlin looked at Susan's eyes, feeling embarrassed, he didn't expect this girl to be so...

"...I didn't do anything like that! It's just that you, teacher, always look at those male models in front of me, and you're always admiring them, even when they're just wearing underwear!"

"What's that?" Cessily punched Merlin's chest, suddenly understanding, "You've been observing carefully, have you? Well, I won't blame you, you're old enough to be interested in men, if you find someone you like, bring them back and let me see, as your teacher, it's my duty to check their skills!"

"Uh..." Merlin looked at Cessily, who was licking her lips with a seductive expression, and he felt uneasy, why did he feel that these two people were not normal? Could they really save Alice?

"Teacher, please be serious, you're being too perverted, it's making me uncomfortable!" Susan said, looking unhappy.

"You're just pretending not to know, aren't you? You've been eavesdropping for a long time, haven't you? Nature is hard to change, my dear apprentice..." Cessily looked at Susan with a deep meaning.

Susan looked away, pretending to look at the surroundings, as if she didn't know anything, "What... I didn't hear anything, I don't know what you're talking about..."

"All red-faced and still pretending to be innocent?" Cessily bent down, pinching Susan's red ears.

"...I'm just afraid that this unknown man will harm you, you shouldn't make such a low-level mistake, our place is never allowed to have men come in." Susan said, her eyes full of hostility, staring at Merlin.

"Regulations are dead, people are alive, don't be so rigid, I've taught you that, haven't I?" Cessily looked at Susan with affection.

"...but, teacher, look at this guy's eyes, he sometimes shows a seductive power, and he looks at people with a flirtatious gaze, he must be a bad guy... Susan evaluated Merlin, without knowing why, she felt an unusual sense of danger towards men.

"You didn't say that before, did you?"

"Men are very dangerous creatures, even sharing the same air can lead to pregnancy."

"That means we're in danger now, aren't we? Extremely dangerous!"

"Ah, yes! He just passed by the pigsty, and our pigs might have been killed by him!"

title: Chapter 8 — Old Friend (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 8 — Old Friend (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 20 · Chapter 8

Merlin couldn’t help but stare at Susan in disbelief. *"This guy’s knowledge of physiology—did the gatekeeper teach him that?!"*

Just breathing the same air as me would make her pregnant? Does she think I’m some kind of pathogen?!

If it were that easy, my kids would already be running wild across the world by now!

Merlin was left speechless by Susan’s clueless rambling, unable to think of a single thing to say, so he could only let out dry laugh after dry laugh.

But Merlin also noticed something strange—Susan was only a little younger than Alice, yet her mind seemed like a blank slate, ignorant of everything.

Who knew how long she’d lived with that old hag, Serci? Probably never left the White Dew Forest, which explained why she was so naive.

But Serci, her teacher, never bothered to teach her about physiology? If she ever stepped outside, she’d probably make a fool of herself.

“Hahaha, you’re so funny,” Serci chuckled, patting Susan’s head. In her mind, Merlin’s flirtatious gaze was just his natural charm—his demonic allure at work, nothing unusual.

“Teacher, focus!” Susan whined, her eyes welling up. “We’re about to get knocked up by this evil man!”

D5 SE this novel.

“Enough,” Merlin snapped, nearly at his wit’s end. “Serci, you’re not going to explain?”

“Don’t worry, we won’t get pregnant,” Serci reassured her.

“But… but you said—” Susan frowned, confused.

“Well…” Serci scratched her cheek, embarrassed. “It’s true that getting too close to a man *can* lead to pregnancy, so you shouldn’t get too close to those stinking men. But this young one… is actually a girl!”

“…?” Merlin raised an eyebrow, stunned. *Who’s the girl?*

“Ah?!” Susan’s expression twisted in shock, her gaze on Merlin turning strange. “…How? From voice, build, looks—everything’s male! How could she be a girl?”

“You’ve seen so few people, dear,” Serci said, pointing at Merlin. “Some girls have thick hair—just like him! They look like men, but they’re real girls.”

“Hmph.” Merlin smirked coldly, thinking, *Who’d believe that? Only an idiot would.*

“Ah…” Susan studied Merlin curiously, muttering, “So that’s how it is… unbelievable!”

Merlin spat out a mouthful of blood, thinking, *Wow, someone actually believed that? Too pure for this world!*

“So no need to worry,” Serci said, pulling a vial from her cleavage—a diluted version of Merlin’s saliva. “This is for treating frigid sows. Take it and feed it to them. I’ll go check on our guest’s injuries.”

Susan blinked, stunned. She’d been struggling with the sows’ refusal to breed for days—now a solution just fell into her lap.

She took the vial and turned to leave, but paused. “Teacher, don’t you need to drink the aging potion to hide your appearance from outsiders?”

“Already seen,” Serci sighed. “No point now.”

“Okay.” Susan glanced at Merlin, thinking, *So she’s just a hairy girl. No need to worry.* But still—what a day. A girl who looks this manly?

“Serci,” Merlin frowned, “why lie to your apprentice? This isn’t ignorance—it’s stupidity.”

“She’s an orphan I raised from childhood,” Serci said, meeting his gaze. “The outside world is full of temptations, and alchemy is dry and boring. If I didn’t paint the world as dangerous, how could she ever commit to my legacy? Men are just one of those temptations. Don’t go spoiling it by telling her the truth.”

Merlin clenched his jaw. *Poor kid. Got stuck with a strict mentor.* But honestly, the forest *was* dangerous—maybe not a bad thing.

Serci’s pumpkin house looked small from the outside, but beneath it stretched a vast underground chamber—dark, hidden, the perfect place for secret work.

Alice lay still on a stone bed, Merlin standing guard beside her.

After examining Alice’s wounds, Serci exhaled, wiping sweat from her brow. “How is she?”

“Still breathing?” Merlin pressed, eager for an answer.

“A miracle,” Serci said, smiling. “Most would’ve died by now. But she’s clinging to something—some unresolved matter keeping her alive.”

Merlin’s brow furrowed. *Same old story from the priests.*

“Lift her over here. We’ll stabilize her before her wounds get worse.”

Serci led Merlin to another sealed room, where a massive pool of glowing green liquid bubbled ominously, connected by thick pipes. It looked like some kind of cultivation tank.

“What is this?” Merlin asked, suspicious.

“Potential-awakening elixir,” Serci explained. “Boosts cultivation, makes breakthroughs easier. It also unlocks latent power and halts wound progression—even stops death in its tracks. Put her in.”

Merlin hesitated, then decided it was safe. He lowered Alice into the pool.

Suddenly, a Saint-tier dragon’s aura erupted—icy cold spreading through the space, freezing the liquid into jagged gold ice crystals. The once-dull room now shimmered like a frozen palace of light.

“What’s happening?” Merlin panicked. “Is this normal?”

“Relax,” Serci said calmly. “Her latent power is activating, repairing her consciousness.”

Merlin forced down his unease, watching Serci’s face. Her expression was strange—shock? nostalgia? pride? A mix of emotions flickered across her features.

“Golden ice…” Serci murmured, touching the frigid crystal. “Fusing martial energy and magic into one…”

This world is so small.

Claudia… though we never spoke again, I never thought I’d see your student in my lifetime.

title: Chapter 9 — Rare Materials (And Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 9 — Rare Materials (And Bonus Chapter)

Volume 20 · Chapter 9

Xerxes gazed around the room, her eyes lingering on the golden icicles scattered everywhere, and her expression grew complex as memories from her youth surfaced.

She sighed at how small the world was, realizing she was about to heal a student of Claudia’s—an odd mix of emotions welling up inside her.

Though her relationship with Claudia had long been strained, having gone decades without contact, these old grudges had nothing to do with Claudia’s student.

And if she managed to save Alice, perhaps it would even make Claudia feel ashamed—now that would be a win-win!

Xerxes secretly preened, imagining the severely wounded Alice as the perfect opportunity to sting Claudia.

In truth, Xerxes and Alice’s teacher from the Snow Mountains weren’t enemies—they were bitter rivals, the kind who would brawl at the slightest provocation.

Their personalities clashed completely, and their feud dated back to their youth, when they’d both served in the Spanish Royal Guard for years.

Claudia was upright and conservative, with good morals but terrible luck with men—Xerxes had always called her a "country bumpkin."

Xerxes, on the other hand, was fiery and passionate, not just stunningly beautiful but also boldly seductive in her attire. Back then, she was the object of countless secret crushes among the Royal Guard, while Claudia dismissed her as a "whore."

Before Xerxes joined the Royal Guard, Claudia had thought her romantic prospects were fine—she was the only woman in the unit, a rare flower among men.

But once Xerxes arrived, everything changed. The men acted like they’d never seen a woman before, utterly smitten.

Even the young swordsman Claudia had admired was swept away by Xerxes with just a few words, turning the Royal Guard into a chaotic harem under her personal domain.

This infuriated Claudia, who fought with Xerxes daily, often breaking into fistfights. Their explosive conflicts had happened countless times.

Xerxes found Claudia insufferable, and every time she drove her to the brink of fury, she felt an odd satisfaction.

Despite Claudia’s disdain for Xerxes’ reckless behavior, she secretly admired her brilliance in alchemy.

Later, Xerxes chose freedom, leaving the Royal Guard to become the legendary Purple-Gold Adventurer.

Claudia, however, stayed behind, rising to the prestigious rank of Royal Sword Saint, tasked with protecting the royal family.

After that, the two barely spoke, drifting into a state of mutual disdain and estrangement.

Merlin watched Xerxes’ strange expression and couldn’t help but ask, “Elder, what’s wrong? Did you notice something?”

“Oh, nothing,” Xerxes laughed, shaking her head. “Just looking at these icicles reminded me of a certain stiff, pompous woman....”

Merlin raised an eyebrow, sensing the sharpness in her tone. If they weren’t friends, why did she sound like she was reminiscing about an old acquaintance?

“Your friend’s condition is stable for now, but to fully heal her, we’ll need another approach....” Xerxes glanced at Alice, submerged in the green pool. If she’d known the girl was Claudia’s student earlier, she’d have saved her out of spite—even without Merlin’s coercion.

“Another approach?” Merlin frowned, expecting Xerxes to work a miracle.

“I could create a Time Reversal Elixir—it reverses aging to some degree. If dosed correctly, it could fully restore someone from severe injuries to their pre-wounded state.” Xerxes revealed her secret formula.

Merlin’s eyes widened. *That’s the elixir used on the old king, isn’t it?*

“Unfortunately....” Xerxes sighed, looking at Merlin with a resigned tone. “The Time Reversal Elixir is gone. The imperial princess wrote to me recently, begging me to save the old king from the bloodline’s poison. They used the last bottle.”

Merlin’s expression darkened. Even if they found a way to save Alice, without the elixir, it was hopeless. “Elder, surely you can recreate it?”

“Technically, yes,” Xerxes said, though the process demanded extreme precision—failure was very likely. “But with my skill, it’s not impossible. It’s just....” She hesitated, as if holding back something.

“What is it? If there’s anything you need or want, just say it—I’ll make it happen!” Merlin’s voice was firm and resolute.

“Making the Time Reversal Elixir requires an extremely rare ingredient called *Flowing Pearl*,” Xerxes explained. “It’s found inside Abyssal Clams. When I was young, I once found a dead one on the beach and extracted the pearl, using it to brew some elixirs. But that was the only time I’ve ever seen one. These creatures are legendary—once seen, never found again.”

Merlin rubbed his temples, frustrated. “So where do we even *get* this thing?”

“If it were easy, I wouldn’t have run out of elixirs long ago,” Xerxes muttered. “I’d have stockpiled them.”

Merlin groaned, his mood sinking. “So... there really is no way?”

“Not *no* way,” Xerxes said after a pause, studying Merlin with a meaningful look. “But your current condition isn’t great.”

“I’ve noticed,” she continued bluntly. “You reek of decay, like a corpse. You’ve been poisoned by something that corrodes the flesh.”

“To be blunt,” Xerxes said, “your time is running out, poor young man....”

title: Chapter 10 — Arrangements (Bonus Update)
content:
Chapter 10 — Arrangements (Bonus Update)

Volume 20 · Chapter 10

Sessie had already noticed that Merlin had a tendency to become increasingly ill, so even with some clues from the Abyssal Shell, he wasn't very willing to reveal them. Because using his last moments of life to search for a somewhat impractical rare material wasn't a very good idea. It was better to quietly prepare for his own funeral and enjoy the last of his time, which was far more reasonable than staking everything on uncertain possibilities. Sessie judged Merlin's situation to be different from Alice's, as Alice had only suffered from difficult-to-heal injuries, whereas Merlin had poison, which wasn't something that could be easily resolved. Although Merlin had a nearly BUG-like magical immunity, his poison resistance didn't have any unique talents, and he would still stumble over it.

"...Merlin unconsciously grasped his own arm that had been bitten by Cain, thinking that his situation was indeed not optimistic, and the poison had already expanded and was pressing against his heart over the past few days. Even in his dazed state, Merlin would unconsciously stare at other people's necks, with some impulse to pounce and bite. It was very obvious that the vampire's poison had already begun to infiltrate Merlin's consciousness, gradually turning him into a ferocious beast of the night. However, being pointed out by Sessie still made Merlin feel a bit anxious, realizing the severity of the situation. "You're clear that your time is running out, even if I tell you where the Abyssal Shell might be living, you might still die on the way to find it," Sessie thought that Merlin's self-rescue was already a problem, and it was unlikely to get the Pearl of Eternity in a short time. "So...I don't recommend you do this, or just give up...". Merlin raised his head, looking at Alice, who was submerged in the green pool water, with an uncertain gaze. This feeling of being on the brink of despair, except for when he was a young hero facing a gun, he had never experienced it again. All of this was thanks to Cain, no matter what, he would definitely return the hatred to its original form! Eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth, was the creed of all demons, and even Merlin deeply believed in it. Looking at Alice's half-dead state and his own terrible condition... Merlin had a moment of selflessness, even thinking of sacrificing himself to save the foolish woman in front of him. If he was destined to die, it would be better to use his last time to gamble for Alice's sake. If he was lucky, he could get the Pearl of Eternity, and Alice could live on... As for himself? He didn't need to worry about anything. Alice always got taken advantage of and bullied by him, so... he could only do some insignificant things to make up for her. Merlin lowered his head, closed his eyes, and took a deep breath, already putting his life and death aside, so he spoke in a flat tone. "Sessie, I don't care how I am, I want to save her, even if the chance is slim, I'll die on the way to find the Abyssal Shell, as long as there's a tiny chance, I'll try. If I'm destined to die, I hope my death can be slightly meaningful...". "Is that so, I can somewhat understand your feelings...," Sessie smiled and nodded, understandingly saying, "You're a good man, if I were younger, I wouldn't let you off so easily, I would definitely use every means to devour you...". "Please don't make such jokes...," Merlin said with a bitter smile. "Alright, if you insist on finding the Abyssal Shell, then it's best to leave as soon as possible, the sooner you leave, the more time you'll have, and the higher the chances of you two surviving," Sessie said seriously. "I understand, can you tell me where this strange creature lives?" Merlin asked. "It's said that our world is not the only one, there are many worlds existing in the same universe, and the Abyssal Shell is said to be a creature that roams between two worlds," Sessie paused, then added, "To find it, you need to find the area where the two worlds intersect, I've investigated for many years, and the most likely place is the mysterious sea in the west, which has not been fully explored and is extremely dangerous, many ships have entered that area and never returned, not even a single piece of wreckage has been left behind." Merlin's eyes widened in doubt, thinking that this place sounded familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had heard it before. However, listening to Sessie's words, he felt that this place was not ordinary, and it wouldn't be just some super powerful sea monsters, would it? If there really were powerful sea monsters, Merlin would be in a lot of trouble. He was a typical land war king, and sea battles were his weakness, this situation was almost impossible to solve. "That mysterious sea, it's very likely to be the area where the two worlds intersect, the ships that disappeared weren't just destroyed, but were absorbed into another world," Sessie looked at Merlin, emphasizing, "So if you want to find the Abyssal Shell, I suggest you investigate the mysterious sea in the west, you might find something unexpected there...". "The mysterious sea...," Merlin muttered to himself, then raised his head, "Alright, I'll leave tomorrow morning! After Merlin left, the only ones left in the room were Sessie and the dying Alice. Sessie had somewhat exaggerated Merlin's condition earlier, just to see how this young man would react. In fact, Merlin's condition wasn't that bad, and he wasn't on the brink of death. Moreover, if Merlin really could bring back the Pearl of Eternity, both he and Alice could escape danger, and they needed the same kind of medicine. Sessie carefully examined her dead opponent's student, and suddenly smiled mockingly. Although that "country girl" had no man, her student had found a decent man, had she? Clodia, don't you think you're a failure? Even your own students are better than you, ha ha ha... Sessie had prepared a separate room for Merlin, and tomorrow morning, he would set out on his new journey. The sound of running water came from the bathroom, and the steam filled the air, making it hard to see clearly. Merlin stood in front of the mirror, examining his body, the chest wound was still visible, but his right arm had turned completely purple-black, and even had some signs of decay, spreading to other parts of his body. "The mysterious sea?" Merlin thought, rubbing his chin, the more he thought about it, the more familiar it sounded, he must have heard it somewhere before. Lahmahn, the name suddenly popped into his head, making him remember some things... This person from the mysterious chaos tribe, one of the three giants, was originally a rebel noble from Great Britain, the military advisor under the account of Duke Overrey, the mastermind behind all the chaos. Lahmahn turned against Overrey's rebellion and killed him, claiming that he came from the mysterious sea of the chaos tribe, had the ability to absorb magic and qi, and needed to find a new continent for his tribe, which was the reason for the rebellion. If he hadn't killed it himself, Elizabeth might have died back then, and several of the Thorn Knights wouldn't have been able to stop this monster. After Merlin remembered, he felt that things were becoming clearer, and he was sure that his journey wouldn't be peaceful. The chaos tribe, huh? Yeah, he needed to pay more attention to that...

title: Chapter 11 — Dangerous Thoughts
content:
Chapter 11 — Dangerous Thoughts

Volume 20 · Chapter 11

Since Merlin has cut down so many people, he sometimes has trouble remembering what kind of enemies they were. If he hadn't suddenly had to go to the mysterious sea, Merlin might not even remember that the Chaos Tribe existed. Since the rebellion in Britain was put down, the Chaos Tribe seemed to have vanished into thin air, with no news of them ever since. As for Queen Elizabeth, whether she would do anything, was something Merlin couldn't know. This time, Merlin was going to the Chaos Tribe's lair, and maybe something would happen that would require him to be extra careful. If he wasn't mistaken, these bizarre creatures had a very unique ability to absorb magical power and martial arts energy. Just this powerful ability alone was enough to let the Chaos Tribe perfectly suppress many strong people, and it was difficult to find a way to counter them. Not everyone was like Alice, whose power was beyond the two systems of magical power and martial arts energy. As long as one used magical power and martial arts energy to fight, it would be very difficult to defeat the Chaos Tribe. However, Merlin was a freak who never needed magical power and martial arts energy, even if the Chaos Tribe could absorb magical power and martial arts energy to strengthen themselves, he probably wouldn't be defeated this time either. The sound of dripping water continued, Merlin looked at his reflection in the mirror, and for a moment, he felt a lot of discomfort. In the past, he would argue with Alice every day, but now she was on the verge of death, and Merlin didn't have anyone to argue with, making him feel empty inside, as if something was missing. However, Merlin knew that his time was limited, and if he could, he would do something for Alice in his last moments, even if it was just to let her live on her own. A soft, gentle voice came from outside the bathroom, and the door suddenly creaked open, with Susan carrying a set of clean clothes walking in without hesitation. At this moment, Susan believed the teacher's words, and in her eyes, Merlin was just like herself, a girl. So, she didn't think it was strange to bring clean clothes into the bathroom, and it seemed that girls looking at each other was also not a problem. Moreover, Susan had never seen a girl with such lush hair, and she still had a bit of curiosity about Merlin's body. "Your Highness, there are some clean clothes here... um?" Susan had just brought in the clean clothes and saw Merlin's shocked face, then discovered his flat chest, and immediately stared at his "big treasure" before suddenly turning pale! The atmosphere became extremely awkward, quiet to the point where only the sound of dripping water and Susan's furious heartbeat remained, clearly, the scene in front of her had given her a huge shock, and her hands were trembling. "Hey! What are you staring at? Why didn't you knock on the door before entering?" Merlin furrowed his brow, speaking calmly, and didn't even try to hide, but instead, he complained that Susan was staring at him in an impolite manner. "...I Susan's face quickly turned red, and she was as hot as a ripe apple, and she couldn't bring herself to say the words "I thought you were a girl". Her common sense was not very good, but she was not stupid to the point of being ridiculous, and she knew that the basic common sense of male and female bodies was not the same. Susan's whole body was shaking, and the clean clothes she was holding fell to the ground, and she turned her head and ran away, still shouting loudly. "Ah! Teacher is bad! ...He's a man! And his lower body has been bitten by a snake! ! ! " "Ah?" Merlin's brow furrowed, and he splashed a piece of clothing over his lower body, and was left bewildered by Susan's actions, with a black line suddenly appearing on his forehead, thinking, what's going on? You've been bitten by a snake, and that's not something I've done to ruin your worldview? It's completely this guy's fault, and he's probably the first time you've seen something like this. In the evening, Merlin slept in the south-facing room of the pumpkin house, but Serenity's room was not very quiet. Susan, who had been shocked by her worldview, was still complaining to her teacher, feeling that she had seen something dirty, and she had become unclean herself. "Waa... Susan was crying and holding Serenity's cloak, saying, "Teacher, why did you lie to me? That person is a man! Although I lack common sense, I'm not stupid! His lower body is not the same as ours, that's definitely a man, teacher, how could you let a man come in? You're not responsible enough!" "Hmph!" Serenity was driven mad by Susan's complaints and couldn't sleep, and she couldn't help but show a helpless expression, sometimes lying to Susan was to protect her, and sometimes this protection turned into trouble, "Are you scared? Ha ha... Susan looked at her teacher's expressionless smile, and suddenly felt angry, "I almost died from fright, teacher, you have the nerve to smile! ? I hate you!" "Oh, who made you clumsy, and you just barged into someone's bathroom, getting scared isn't your fault?" Serenity thought that Merlin was probably not intentionally doing it, and she knew her disciple too well, her nerves were a bit too big. "...I thought he was a girl!" Susan looked up at Serenity with a pout, her eyes flashing with anger, "It's all your fault, teacher, why did you lie to me and say he was a girl, otherwise, I wouldn't have seen that terrible thing!" "This... Serenity was a bit guilty and dodged, "This is all my fault? I've been teaching you all this time, and you still can't even tell the difference between a man and a woman? You need to have your own judgment, I say something, and you just believe it, you're useless..." "What? ? You criticize me for not listening to you when you're arguing, but when I get hurt, you say I don't have the ability to judge, what do you want me to do?" Susan was furious and stood up, "You're just making things worse!" "Oh, calm down, forget about today's thing, and it's not a big deal, you didn't get hurt, and you even gained something..." Serenity suddenly became unseemly, and asked meaningfully, "How big was it? Did you see it clearly? You can describe it to me, can't you?" "At the time, my brain was blank, and I didn't see it clearly" Susan answered honestly. "Oh, what a useless disciple... Serenity sighed and shook her head. 2 hours later, Susan was still furious and emphasized, "The point is not that! ! He's a man, and we've let a man into our home! What are we going to do? I might get pregnant tomorrow, and I'll be a laughingstock!" "This Merlin, although his adventurer level is a bit low, but overall, he's not bad, and I actually quite like him, if you get pregnant by him, I think I can accept that result." Serenity said seriously. "Teacher! You can't say things like that! " Susan looked up at her teacher with a pitiful expression, feeling hurt inside, and thinking that she was just like those silly pigs, being fattened up to be sold. "I'm serious, this matter can be considered, it's just that I don't know how you feel about this Merlin, is there any romantic interest? If there is, then this time, I'll support you in making the first move, and I'll even help you plan and scheme to win him over, don't worry, I'm a professional at winning men over." Serenity said with a playful expression. "Teacher, what are you talking about? I don't know him, how can I just do that? But, teacher, why do you like this guy so much? You like him, why don't you just go after him yourself? You always say that you were beautiful in your youth, and you're still charming now..." Susan looked at her teacher with a scathing expression, "You're just joking, right?" "I wish I could do it myself, but I've already taught you for so long, and you still can't even get a guy, what's the point of teaching you?" Serenity sighed, and she actually wanted Susan to hook up with Merlin, the reason was that she wanted to compete with her own youth, when she had snatched away the man from Clodia, now her disciple couldn't lose either, if she could even snatch away the man of Clodia's student...

title: Chapter 12 — Obstruction (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 12 — Obstruction (Extra Chapter)

Volume 20 · Chapter 12

The next day, Merlin tidied up the necessary formalities and prepared to leave the White Forest, heading directly to the mysterious sea area to search for the rare deep-sea clam.

Senior, I hope you can take care of Alice during my absence. "If you don't come back?" Xixi suddenly asked with a smile that was neither here nor there.

Merlin was taken aback, and replied seriously, "I've never thought about not coming back." "Good, I hope so." Xixi nodded, thinking that Merlin's confidence was still good, so it was at least possible to succeed, and if he was timid, the result would almost be certain. "Goodbye." Merlin turned around and left the White Forest, big strides.

Suzanne watched Merlin's retreating back, and couldn't help but tell Xixi, "Teacher, look at him, he's so deeply immersed in that girl in the medicine pool, you should put away your bad intentions." "How? You're not a little envious, are you?" Xixi glanced at Suzanne. "....I'm not!" Suzanne loudly refuted. "Hmph! A bit resentful, aren't you? If you had enough ability, you could definitely give me a mouthful..." Xixi said meaningfully, thinking to herself, "What a pity, I've been suppressing Claudette all my life, do I have to lose to my disciple? Damn it, if I were younger, I could have done it myself."

After Merlin left the White Forest, he headed directly to the port of France. Since he was going to explore the mysterious sea area, he needed a sturdy ship that could sail far, as well as an experienced captain. Otherwise, he might not be able to find the place, or get lost at sea, or worse, get swept away by the waves.

However, when Merlin arrived at the western port, he found that he couldn't find a ship, let alone someone willing to help him. Because the place he was going to was extremely dangerous, the mysterious sea area, where countless people had gone in and mysteriously disappeared. There were rumors that there were giant sea monsters there, and any ship that entered that area would be swallowed up directly.

So, these rumors made people nervous, even the most experienced sailors would turn pale when talking about that cursed place. Merlin became more and more despondent, originally, time was very tight, but he wasted three days in the port, wasn't that wasting his life?

As a result, Merlin had to sit in the port's tavern, drinking fiercely, trying to numb his anxious heart. In fact, Merlin had already thought of hijacking a ship, planning to do it tonight, and then ordering the captain to sail into the mysterious sea area.

Merlin believed that people were afraid of death, and sometimes he didn't need to use rough and tough methods to persuade these sailors who lived by the sea.

The ship he was looking at was a commercial ship that sailed between France and Greenland, often transporting fish products. To prevent pirates from attacking them on the way, this ship was covered with iron plates on the outside and equipped with dozens of magical cannons.

In theory, it was a regular commercial ship, but in reality, it was almost a warship, which was exactly what Merlin needed to hijack and sail to the mysterious sea area.

Merlin was wrapped in a black cloak to prevent his body from being burned by the vampire's poison, and sat alone in the corner, drinking heavily. However, Merlin's attire was too strange, and it easily attracted the attention of others, so there were many burly men who occasionally looked at Merlin.

The port was a place where people from all over the world gathered, with merchants, thieves, dancers, robbers, mercenaries, and so on. However, the most numerous were the sailors, who would often leave the ship and come ashore, usually without replenishing supplies, they would not need to dock.

Sailors would bring the money and treasures they received on board to trade, and they would spend their days drinking and indulging in their most primitive desires, never saving any money. Because they knew that they might die at sea the next day, saving money was useless, it was better to enjoy themselves while they could.

However, sometimes, sailors would become poor, and they would use some despicable means to earn more money, such as what was happening now.

In the nearby tavern, there were two dirty-looking big men, who were short of money, and they had their eyes on Merlin. In the port, Merlin's low-key attire made him an easy target, because here, the strong were respected, and everyone wanted to show off their strength, so that no one would dare to provoke them.

"Brother, look at him, he doesn't seem to have any valuable items, why bother to pick on him?" "You're blind, he has a waist sword and a legendary sword like Elgin, such a commemorative item is worth a lot of money, and those swordsmen's fans and admirers are willing to pay a lot of money to buy it." "....Is that so? Then we'll make a fortune!" "Just keep an eye on him, I've already sent a dancer to approach him, when they're stuck together, I'll rush over and say it's my wife, then I'll extort money from him, and give him a few punches, haha!" "That's a good idea, we have reason to ask for compensation, it's not too much!" The two men secretly watched Merlin, and unconsciously revealed their evil smiles, planning to use the "tiger leap" method to extort money from him, so that they would occupy the initiative, and even the guards wouldn't be able to do anything.

Merlin was thinking about hijacking the commercial ship that night, and didn't notice that he had already been noticed by two sailors.

A woman dressed in revealing clothing, with heavy makeup, suddenly approached Merlin, she was the bait, waiting for the other party to take the bait.

The dancer sat naturally next to Merlin, with a seductive gaze, looking at him as if to attract his attention. These women were all pure and refined professional dancers, who relied on selling their beauty to make a living, and knew how to hook up with lonely men.

The sailors' money was mostly drained by the dancers, but Merlin had once been a male escort, and in a sense, he was a fellow traveler with these dancers.

"Sir, are you drinking alone? Do you need someone to keep you company?" The dancer threw a flirtatious glance at Merlin.

Merlin wasn't interested, looked at the dancer, and coldly said, "No need, thank you."

"Are you sure you won't be lonely drinking alone? I can help you relieve your worries." The dancer didn't give up, even after being rejected.

"I don't need it." Merlin emphasized again.

"Sir, I think you might have misunderstood something, I'm not a bad person, I just... The dancer leaned in close to Merlin, lowering her voice, and seductively said, "I swear, I can make you feel like you're in heaven, I've been watching you for a long time, you seem like a man who's been dumped by women, drinking alone in the tavern, but in my arms, you can let go of all your unhappiness, believe me, you'll forget everything."

"Did I speak in a language you don't understand?" Merlin put down the empty wine cup, and the heavy wine smell filled the air.

"....What did you mean?" The dancer suddenly froze, a bit unclear.

"I said I don't need it, you didn't understand, did you?" Merlin tightly furrowed his eyebrows, and spoke in a low voice, "Now, immediately disappear from my sight, or else..."

"Believe me, my little friend, my fist can also make you feel like you're in heaven."

title: Chapter 13 — Extortion
content:
Chapter 13 — Extortion

Volume 20 · Chapter 13

Seeing Merlin's icy gaze, the dancer felt a deep threat and wanted to quickly get away. But thinking she still needed to seduce Merlin, she had to grit her teeth and continue. The dancer had never encountered a man like Merlin—neither cold nor hot before; in the past she could easily win men's hearts with her charm, but now she had hit a snag. "Sir, your threatening look is full of manliness; I'm almost dying for you~" The dancer smiled, affectionately linking arms with Merlin, her eyes seductive, constantly sending electric vibes that would make any man's legs go weak. A strong perfume wafted over, continually stimulating Merlin's sense of smell, giving him a strong jolt that made his whole body shudder. "Huh?" The dancer noticed Merlin's reaction, instantly delighted, teasing, "What? Your reaction is huge—could it be you haven't touched a woman in a long time? If so, you don't need to hold back; we can find a deserted place and have a deep exchange." Hearing the dancer's blunt hint, a faint blush rose on Merlin's face, making it seem as if he were responding to the suggestion. But the reality was different; close observation revealed Merlin's forehead veins bulging, his eyes flashing scarlet light, a brutal, bloodthirsty aura silently spreading. This was the sign of his bloodlust acting up; the vampire toxin's influence on Merlin was growing clearer, though he fought desperately, his mind was gradually affected. Because of the dancer's intimate gestures, the scent of a living person triggered Merlin's bloodlust faintly, his subconscious constantly telling him that blood was sweet. Merlin panted, turned his head to glare at the dancer, staring at her neck, truly wanting to bite it off. "Sir? .... The dancer felt Merlin's temperature abnormal, like a small furnace burning, his skin scorching. "Shout!" Merlin gritted his teeth, suppressing the bloodlust urge, swung his arm violently, shoved the frivolous dancer away, "Get lost, F!" "Yah!" The dancer fell to the ground, frightened, looking at Merlin, thinking the man before her was a lunatic, completely insane. With Merlin's low growl, the whole tavern's attention was drawn. A crowd stared at Merlin, wondering what madness had possessed him—maybe he'd drunk too much. Two sturdy sailors saw the dancer fail to hook Merlin, feeling shocked in private, muttering— "This kid doesn't go near women; what do we do? He doesn't seem to bite." "Just go pick a fight? Say I can't let you beat my wife off so easily; wanting to extort you isn't that hard?" After changing tactics, the two sturdy sailors slammed the table, rose angrily, and began cursing Merlin directly. "TMD! Dare hit my wife? ! I see you're looking for death!" "Huh?" Merlin suppressed his bloodlust urge, coldly glanced at them, thinking, Is this dancer his wife? Really or not? Letting his own wife do this line of work—wouldn't that make him wear a green hat piled as high as the Himalayas? Unrelated people laughed and kept drinking, preparing to watch the show quietly, not wanting to meddle. Such scenes happen every day; the extortion targets are just weak, honest folks." Dead In the fish-and-dragon mixed port, fists are the law; the weak being bullied is taken for granted. The two sturdy sailors closed in, glaring at Merlin with murderous looks, seeming ready to twist his head off. The dancer's eyes shifted cleverly; suddenly she turned into a drama queen, sobbing and hiding behind the sailor, "Dear, you have to stand up for me..." "Wife, rest assured, no one dares bully you here; if we don't get an explanation today, it's not over!" the sailor shouted, playing his role to the fullest, making Merlin look like a true bully who oppresses people. "I didn't hit her." Merlin withdrew his gaze, too lazy to look at these two burly sailors. "Not hit? I saw it with my own eyes just now—you started it!" the sailor declared righteously. "Exactly, a man actually laying hands on a woman—aren't you ashamed?" his companion chimed in, hands on hips. "I'll say it again: I didn't hit her. If you understand, get lost, stop swaying in front of me, I'm annoyed." Merlin calmly sipped his rum, completely ignoring these petty clowns. "Still so aggressive after hitting someone? I've never seen such a shameless bastard before." The sailor swore, pointing at Merlin, "Do you believe I'll make you spit out your teeth?" "....." Merlin replied indifferently; such small fry, he couldn't be bothered to even glance at. "Hey? You hit someone's wife and still act so arrogant?" The sailor's companion, seeing Merlin unafraid, shouted beside him, "Such thick‑skinned guys deserve to have their legs broken!" Merlin rolled his eyes, this time not even responding, simply ignoring them. The two sturdy sailors glanced at each other, guessing they'd never seen someone like this—neither soft nor hard tactics worked. "Did you hear? ! We'll break your legs!" "...." Merlin chuckled, actually stretched out his leg, "Please~" The sailor was stunned, thrown off by Merlin's devil‑may‑care attitude. Normally, ordinary people would have been scared silly, peeing themselves and kneeling to beg for mercy. Seeing Merlin's backbone, the sailor decided to back down a bit, settle with compensation. "If we break your leg, you'll be a cripple—but today we're in a good mood; just hand over your valuables, and we'll forget about the wife‑beating incident. We're not petty people, but if you give us face and then spurn it, don't blame us for not being polite." The two sturdy sailors stepped forward, flexing their muscles, issuing various threats at Merlin, which still seemed somewhat intimidating. Yet they never imagined that the man sitting here, quietly drinking his sorrow, was actually how terrifying a monster? "Oh~" Merlin turned his head, sizing them up, "You're blackmailing me, huh?" "Ha, hitting means paying compensation—it's only natural!" The sailor, hands on hips, lowered his head and slammed Merlin's forehead hard, then whispered, "Steep novel" "Even if you blackmail me, what of it? The rule here in this port is survival of the fittest. "You pale‑skinned little thing, still not obeying?" "What? Not satisfied? Bite me...." Outside the port tavern, people bustled about, looking quite peaceful. Then came a loud "bang!"—shrapnel flew everywhere! The two sturdy sailors, noses bruised and faces swollen, crashed through the tavern door and flew out. They winced, rolling on the ground, screaming in agony, a miserable sight. The outside crowd, though unaware of what happened, remained calm. Because around here the port is rather chaotic, brawls are everyday fare. Just then an old man wearing a weathered captain's hat, his temples streaked with white, strode over, his immaculate coat and spotless lining drawing attention. He planted his feet firmly, lowered his gaze to the two injured sailors, then turned his eagle‑like, deep stare toward the tavern interior, falling into deep thought....

title: Chapter 14 — Old Captain (Updated)
content:
Chapter 14 — Old Captain (Updated)

Volume 20 · Chapter 14

The two sailors rolling on the ground, wailing in pain, froze in shock when they saw the old man standing before them. Their pained cries died in their throats.

Their reaction was no different from rats spotting a cat. In a flash, they knelt upright, bowing their heads as they trembled violently—clearly terrified of the old man before them.

"C-Captain... why are you here?"

"Y-Yes... Captain."

Dennis glanced at his two bruised and battered subordinates, his sharp features unreadable. "You two idiots, don’t you know we’re about to set sail?"

The two sailors shivered at the words, realizing the gravity of their mistake. Delaying departure time was a serious offense, one that would earn them severe punishment.

"You’ve only been on the *William* for a short time, but the rules are clear—delaying departure means being thrown into the sea to feed the sharks. I assume you’re both prepared for that?" Dennis’s hawk-like eyes gleamed with cold fury.

"Captain, we were wrong! Please spare us this once!"

The two sailors were so terrified their souls nearly left their bodies. They begged for mercy repeatedly. Though Dennis was an old man, his authority was unmatched—after all, he had once been a pirate, ruling the seas for years.

"Settle this with you later!" Dennis barked furiously, then shifted his tone to ask, "Where the hell were you two loafing around? Why do you look like this?"

The sailors perked up at once. If the captain was asking personally, he must be ready to avenge them! Like men clutching a lifeline, they exaggeratedly recounted what had just happened.

"Captain, you’ve got to get us justice! There was a drunk in there who beat us up without even asking what happened!"

"Yeah, Captain! That drunk was so arrogant, we couldn’t even reason with him!"

"Oh? Something like that happened?" Dennis’s gaze turned icy. As captain, he couldn’t let such a thing slide. He pulled out the flintlock pistol from his back.

"I’ve sailed the seas for years, been to countless places—does anyone not know my temper?"

"No one can bully my crew..."

"And if they do, they’ve already been blown to pieces by my gun!"

Inside the tavern, the crowd was still shaken, their hearts pounding.

Merlin’s lightning-fast strike had stunned everyone present, filling them with dread. No one had even seen his move—before they could blink, the two thugs extorting him had been sent flying.

His strength was clearly not to be trifled with. A few others who had been considering causing trouble for Merlin now stayed quiet, not daring to provoke him.

In this chaotic corner of the port, Merlin had earned respect through sheer power. Though he didn’t think much of it, many now looked at him with newfound awe.

The dancer, however, remained unmoved. Nervously swallowing, she saw the tension ease slightly and began to sneak away step by step, terrified Merlin might take his anger out on her.

Merlin swirled the empty cup in his hand, then suddenly asked, "Where do you think you’re going? You and your friends try to extort me, then just walk away? I may not like hitting women, but I’ve never refused to do it."

"Ah!" The dancer’s body jolted, and she froze in place, her face pale as she slowly turned back. "...What do you want, sir? I-I can apologize, can’t I?"

"Apologize? Unnecessary. I don’t even consider you worth my attention." Merlin said coldly, then made a shameless request, "Come over here and pay my tab like a good girl. I might consider letting you off."

The dancer seethed with humiliation. She felt like a total failure in her profession—this was the first time she’d ever had to pay a man!

But after what had just happened, she was too afraid of Merlin to refuse, worried he might hit her.

With a heavy heart, she slammed two gold coins onto the table, then turned and fled at what felt like 80 miles per second.

"O-One coin would’ve been enough..." Merlin stared blankly at the two gold coins, thinking that maybe his charm (or intimidation) was just that good—he’d earned an extra coin. Yeah, that had to be it!

Suddenly, the hot-headed old man Dennis stormed in, pistol in hand, with the two wronged sailors in tow, determined to avenge his crew.

The sea was often lawless. Disputes were settled by force, and whoever was ruthless enough held the power.

So Dennis couldn’t let this slide. If word got out, others would think he was weak, someone they could push around. That was absolutely unacceptable!

This time, Dennis wasn’t just seeking revenge—he was reinforcing his reputation in the industry to prevent bigger trouble down the line.

"Good heavens! It’s that mad old man Dennis!"

"Run! If he starts shooting, people die! Bystanders getting caught in the crossfire happens all the time!"

"Those two sailors were from the *William*? That young man’s in deep trouble now. Better not stick around to watch!"

The tavern patrons, upon seeing Captain Dennis, immediately panicked. They dropped their cups, lowered their heads, and scrambled out like scared dogs, afraid of getting caught in the coming fight.

Even the tavern owner looked like he’d seen a ghost, quickly ducking into the kitchen, silently bemoaning the day’s lost profits.

It was clear Captain Dennis carried considerable weight and fear in every major port. Everyone knew: the captain of the *William* was not to be provoked. Conflicts with him were to be avoided at all costs.

Dennis scanned the tavern and saw only a single gaunt figure remaining. For some reason, a faint sense of familiarity stirred in his chest.

"Boss! It was him! He beat us up without any reason! You’ve got to get us justice!"

"Yeah! That bastard was incredibly arrogant! He trampled on the *William*’s dignity! We can’t let this go!"

The two sailors took turns pleading, hoping Captain Dennis would restore their honor and take Merlin down a peg.

"You two shut up," Dennis growled. "If it weren’t for the *William*’s reputation, would I even bother with this nonsense?" He lowered his voice. "Stay here. I’ll go have a word with this reckless young man."

Merlin was aware of the commotion in the tavern, but he didn’t care. Anyone coming for revenge was just asking for a beating.

But then he felt something hard press against the back of his head, and a surge of anger flared up inside him.

Merlin hated having a weapon pointed at him. Whoever came for revenge was digging their own grave!

"Young man, were you the one who assaulted my crew?" Dennis’s hawk-like eyes burned with killing intent as he said seriously, "You should know, in any port, no one has the guts to do that. Those who do end up with their heads blown open."

Merlin slowly turned around, intending to take out the man behind him—only to pause in surprise at the sight of the old man’s weathered, sharp face.
