You’re still being arrogant?!” Adams’ face darkened. “Exactly, we’re just afraid you’ll throw your life away for nothing!” Rene thought Merlin didn’t know his place. “I heard Ralf you can leave the mysterious sea zone safely, but don’t let me down…” Merlin ignored the three behind him, pulled the Chaos King’s head from the black sack; the hair full of poisonous snakes hissed “hiss hiss”, he focused his gaze, lifted the head high, and presented it to the North Sea Giant Demon in the deep sea for close inspection— “Come on, let me see your power!!!” The eyes of the Chaos King Medusa were suddenly stimulated, they widened, emitting an eerie purple light! I don’t owe anything, I’m making it up now, hehehe!

title: Chapter 37 — Perilous Encounters (Extra Update Later)
content:
Chapter 37 — Perilous Encounters (Extra Update Later)

Volume 20 · Chapter 37

The Kraken’s tentacles churned the sea into towering waves, crushing everything in their path.

The head of the Chaos King Medusa swayed in the storm, its eerie eyes emitting a dark violet glow.

For a moment, the petrifying gaze blazed like a fierce sun, illuminating the pitch-black sea engulfed by the Kraken!

The Chaos King had always planned to lead its people in escaping the Divine Power Sea, and its confrontation with the Kraken had been part of that calculation.

Perhaps, in the William’s dire straits, the Chaos King’s head could turn the tide!

Merlin had no real confidence, but he was willing to take the gamble. If it bought the William time to escape, that would be the greatest victory.

Relf had mentioned before that leaving the Mystic Sea required the Chaos King’s power.

When Merlin had fought the Chaos King, he realized its eyes were its greatest weapon—perhaps the very key to escaping the Mystic Sea.

A tentacle, vast as the pillar between heaven and earth, came crashing down. The Chaos King’s eyes blazed even brighter, instinctively resisting.

Storm and waves raged as Merlin stood alone, raising Medusa’s head high—like a mythic hero battling the gods single-handedly.

The people behind him were stunned, unable to comprehend what he was doing. All they knew was that the head in his hands held an unfathomable power.

“...What the hell is he doing?!” Adams’ eyes widened in shock.

“...He’s absolutely insane...” Reni’s face paled, forced to acknowledge this black-iron adventurer who had boarded mid-voyage.

Morris said nothing, watching Merlin face the Kraken’s attack without a hint of fear. A surge of admiration welled up in him. Regardless of Merlin’s strength, that kind of courage alone put him above most.

Captain Dennis gazed at Merlin from afar, the head glowing with dark violet light in his hands like a lantern guiding them through the night.

Seeing that snake-haired monstrosity, Dennis was convinced Merlin had told the truth earlier—he had truly single-handedly slain the island’s leader.

No wonder it’s Lord Merlin. I was already amazed by his overwhelming strength back then!

But today, his understanding was shattered once more. His power was even greater than I imagined!

At the very least, Merlin was on a completely different level from the Thorn Knight and the mithril adventurers...

Under the petrifying gaze, the Kraken’s movements slowed. At three feet from the William, the petrification finally took effect!

The massive, barnacle-encrusted tentacle rapidly turned to stone, like poison spreading, visibly consuming it until it became an immobile stone pillar!

In that critical moment, the Kraken’s tentacle stopped moving. The William was saved. The monstrous waves subsided, and the sailors stood frozen for three seconds before erupting into earth-shaking cheers, celebrating their survival.

For sailors, nothing was more exhilarating than cheating death. Surviving the Kraken’s assault would make them legends when they returned!

“...This can’t be real...” Reni stared in disbelief, her gaze flickering over Merlin’s back.

“...The Kraken’s attack... was actually stopped!” Adams trembled, rubbing his eyes, unable to believe what he had just witnessed.

Morris collapsed to the ground, cold sweat streaming down his face. It felt like a dream—how had they survived?

Though the Kraken had dozens of tentacles and only one had been petrified, it had bought the William precious time to escape.

Seeing the Kraken temporarily restrained, Captain Dennis dragged his exhausted body up, gripped the wheel, and urged the William forward at full speed until they broke free of the Kraken’s domain.

Merlin exhaled, lowering the Chaos King’s head and wrapping it in a black sack. It seemed they had escaped danger.

The petrified tentacle soon broke free from the stone, slapping the water in frustration and sending up waves.

Fortunately, the William—this stinking sardine of a ship—had slipped away during the petrification. To capsize it now would take some effort.

The Kraken didn’t seem particularly interested in the William. It was just annoyed by its presence. As long as it was driven off, the beast wouldn’t bother with such a tiny ant.

The Kraken thrashed its colossal tentacles, each lined with jagged teeth like mountains, rising from the sea and devouring the island in a single gulp!

It seemed the Kraken had appeared to consume the island, not to hunt humans. As for the reason, no one could say.

Perhaps it was maintaining the world’s balance by exterminating creatures caught between two worlds?

The thunderous roars sent shivers through everyone, a terrifying display of the legendary beast’s might.

Merlin watched the Kraken from afar, a vague premonition stirring—this wouldn’t be the last time they met.

He hadn’t forgotten the humiliation of trembling under O’Brien’s spear. He would return that shame in kind!

Perhaps the Kraken, this great sea monster, held some clue...

But Merlin was in poor condition now. His thirst for revenge would have to be suppressed for the time being.

The William sped across the sea, not daring to slow. Merlin, clutching the Chaos King’s head, swayed unsteadily, his body on the verge of collapse, his vision swimming.

“Lord Merlin!” Morris rushed over, eyes alight with curiosity. “How did you do it?! How did you save us from the Kraken’s attack?!”

“Huh?” Merlin, exhausted in body and mind, frowned. “As you saw. It’s all thanks to this thing. Otherwise, we might’ve been in trouble.”

“...What kind of treasure is this? To have such terrifying power...” Adams, still shaken, stared at the black sack, unable to forget the sight of that snake-haired head.

“Yeah, that’s the Kraken—the undefeated sea monster said to rule the oceans. And yet, the thing in your hands can petrify it! Even if it’s just one tentacle... that’s already incredible!” Reni’s eyes sparkled. She was deeply versed in alchemy and always fascinated by rare artifacts.

“Oh, so you’re all interested in this?” Merlin lifted the black sack meaningfully. “It’s nothing special. Just the head of the Chaos King.”

“The Chaos King?” Morris furrowed his brow in confusion.

“You know, the ruler of the monsters on that island. Didn’t you just go through a huge struggle to defeat its underlings?” Merlin explained offhandedly.

Adams:

Reni:

title: Chapter 38 — Reverent Respect (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 38 — Reverent Respect (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 20 · Chapter 38

After several days and nights of sailing, the William slowly sailed to the western port of France.
The sailors cheered loudly as soon as they disembarked, feeling extremely fortunate to have escaped death from the Kraken's claws!
For the sailors, this journey felt like a dream—emerging from the mysterious sea with no exit and encountering the invincible North Sea Giant Demon.
Bragging about this could fool people for ten years; it's no problem to bewitch a bunch of adventure-story fans!
Everyone firmly believed they had defeated the God of Death and were lucky children favored by the sea,
Inside the cabin, everyone was preparing to go their separate ways—,
Merlin planned to take his belongings and return to the White Dew Forest to heal Alice.
Morrison, Adams, and Renee intended to return to Britain.
Captain Dennis, meanwhile, intended to tidy up for a few days and then continue transporting sardines.
However, the atmosphere inside the cabin was somewhat delicate, not as harmonious as imagined.
Because Adams and Renee still refused to believe that Merlin had single-handedly fought the Chaos King, they were merely boasting about themselves.
“Some people are just glory‑hounds; they don’t even need a mirror to see themselves—where do they get the ability to take on a strong foe alone?” Adams leaned against the wall, speaking in a sarcastic tone, “Oh! The treasure on you is indeed powerful, but it’s not your own strength, so what’s there to be proud of?”
“Yeah, being able to petrify the North Sea Giant Demon—how could that treasure not be impressive? But as for me… it’s just so-so…” Renee paused, speaking hypocritically, “I’ve warned you before not to risk yourself; you’ve had an arm cut off by the enemy—can’t you still face your true self?”
“Exactly, even if your strength is lacking and you lost an arm, it’s not shameful, but to boast in order to hide your disgrace? That’s just too ugly…” Adams spoke, pointing at mulberry trees while cursing locust trees.
The two sang in harmony, instantly filling the cabin with a sour atmosphere, making it somewhat hard to bear.
They were merely saying that Merlin’s ability is poor, but the Chaos King’s skull on him is powerful—relying on an item isn’t real strength?
Little did they know that the Chaos King’s head was personally taken down by Merlin, not something he had always possessed.
Their inner imbalance was extreme, sour to death; as Mithril adventurers, they were outshone by a low‑rank newcomer—who could swallow that?
Merlin gave a faint smile, too lazy to argue; if he kept pressing, he’d be no better than those frogs at the bottom of a well.
Merlin then took out the black box with embedded rubies he had retrieved from the island’s secret chamber and handed it to Captain Dennis.
Merlin couldn’t open this black box; it felt strange, the inside seemed empty, only the gems on top appeared to be worth some money.
“Captain Dennis, I found this on the island; it looks like an antique. I know you like collecting old things, so please accept it as a token of my gratitude for your care on this voyage.”
“No, no, it’s you who’s been looking after us; we don’t need the item.” Captain Dennis repeatedly refused.
“We’ve met before; I don’t like owing others, so please accept my gift.” Merlin said seriously.
“Then… I’ll accept it.” Captain Dennis took the black box; it felt cold to the touch.
Merlin stood up and left; upon reaching the port, he refused to waste any more time—he had been away for a long time and didn’t know how Alice was doing now.
“I’ll see you off.” Captain Dennis followed Merlin.
Adams and Renee’s faces flushed red, looking quite unpleasant, and the sour atmosphere in the air grew even stronger.
Morrison lowered his head, expressionless; no one knew what he was feeling at that moment.
After the two left the cabin, Merlin threw on a tattered robe to shield himself from the sun’s harm; the poison on his body had not yet been dispelled, so he had to be careful.
“Lord Merlin, this voyage succeeded thanks to your presence; otherwise we’d all have become ghosts drifting on the sea.” Captain Dennis said sentimentally.
“I merely lent a hand; it’s nothing to worry about.” Merlin smiled, not regarding his help in getting the William out of danger as anything special.
“That’s not right; you’re being too modest. When our young lady first took a liking to you, I still looked down on you a bit, but this experience has made me see you in a new light.” Captain Dennis said sincerely, thinking Merlin was like gold hidden deep in the sand.
“Oh, I’m long used to this…” Merlin twisted the corner of his mouth.
“Actually, I think being an adventurer is beneath you, especially since you’re only a low‑rank Black Iron. With your abilities, you could easily go onto a broader stage and take up a lofty position as a Guardian Knight or Royal Guard, for instance.” Captain Dennis suggested, believing Merlin deserved a higher‑status job rather than being a low‑rank adventurer who seems to just loaf around.
“Never mind; I don’t like living under someone else’s roof. Being an adventurer is fine—free, with no one telling me what to do.” Merlin shook his head, saying, “Guardian Knight? Royal Guard? That sounds a bit ridiculous.
“That… is truly a pity…” Captain Dennis sighed.
“Merlin, brother!” Morrison suddenly chased out of the cabin and came up to Merlin.
“What’s the matter, Lord Thorn Knight?” Merlin said with a hint of sarcasm.
“Ha, no need to mock me, right?” Morrison gave a bitter smile and said seriously, “Thank you for saving our lives this time; if the chance arises, I’ll repay this favor.”
“Don’t do that; it’ll put pressure on me.” Merlin waved his hand.
“You don’t like receiving favors, and neither do I.” Morrison grinned, showing his teeth, and pointed his thumb at the cabin, “Don’t worry about those two guys inside; they were hired from the London Guild. You stole their spotlight this time, so their bonus will be cut by a lot—it’s normal for them to feel upset, but their attitude doesn’t represent mine; I hope you understand.”
Merlin’s face remained expressionless; he thought this was just a way to disclaim responsibility—truly heartless, that muscular knight.
“You live in Wrexham, right? If the opportunity arises, I’d love to chat with you, and best of all, have another man‑to‑man duel!” Morrison slapped his biceps, his cheerful smile full of amiability.
“Tsk! I really detest endless trouble.” Merlin turned and walked away, waving his hand without looking back, “Never again!”
Morrison looked embarrassed, watching Merlin’s retreating back, “He’s truly an amazing adventurer—always surprising me.”
Captain Dennis slowly fastened his old captain’s hat, saying, “Yeah, whenever I encounter a Black Iron adventurer, I feel a solemn respect, wondering if they’re a hidden big shot—it’s scary…”
◇
A few days later in the White Dew Forest.
Susan was swinging a shovel to dig a grave, occasionally wiping seawater from her forehead.
The old woman Sesi, meanwhile, was carving a person’s name onto the tombstone—,
「Alice Claudya」
Tomorrow starts a new month; please continue to support us!
This volume is about to finish; also, in April we’ll attend the website’s annual meeting.
Sure, I like to stockpile drafts—after all, I had to write two books last year; I went to Guangzhou and didn’t even have time to properly enjoy myself, what a waste~

title: Chapter 39 — Little White Mouse
content:
Chapter 39 — Little White Mouse

Volume 20 · Chapter 39

Here's a translation that follows all the rules:

Susan was vigorously swinging a shovel, digging Alice's grave in advance, of course all under Cersi's instructions from the old woman.

"Master? Is this really okay? Merlin hasn't returned yet, and we're burying his friend."

"It's been this long already. By rights, that man should have died from poisoning. He can't possibly return." Cersi paused and continued, "Besides, this isn't a welfare institute. Because this girl still has a breath, should we nurse her for a lifetime? I'm not a saint, you know..."...

"That makes sense." Susan nodded and continued digging the hole, "However, Master, aren't they too pitiful? You used to appreciate them so much, but when the deadline passed, you didn't recognize them anymore. How cold-blooded..."...

"Cold-blooded? Good, finish your work. People need to be practical, you know?" Cersi scolded her disciple a few thoughts, thinking that Alice was actually her sworn enemy's student. Helping to save her is righteousness; if she can't be saved, it's also a retribution for this earthling. Anyway, I've done what I should do. It's just a pity that Merlin, such a sentimental man, probably dropped dead along the way.

"Hmph, two-faced and treacherous. Looking at it, now that she can't come back, you're preparing to cross the river and tear down the bridge..." Susan couldn't help but mutter, feeling that her teacher is good at everything, but her heart is a bit improper.

"Huh! What are you saying?" Cersi walked over and grabbed Susan's ears, "Your courage is really something. Resorting to discussing me now?"

"Wah wah wah, I dare not, Master." Susan was pulled by her ears, eyes welling with tears, and once again felt how powerful this old woman is. Could it be that menopause has come?

OB SE aside

Merlin carried his luggage and returned to the south of the White Dew Forest, to the pumpkin house. Seeing Cersi and Susan the disciple busy doing what? Hot and busy.

". . ."

Merlin's voice startled the two of them, and they hurriedly put down what they were doing, staring at this man who should have died on the road.

"Wow!" Susan cried out, quickly hiding behind Cersi. ".... Teacher! ... He came back alive! ... You said he was dead already... . Could it be a ghost?"

"..... Cersi became embarrassed, a large drop of sweat flowing from her forehead, thinking wrongly. By rights, this guy should have died from poisoning long ago. How is he still alive?"

Seeing Merlin's strange reaction, she lowered her head and looked at what they were busy with. As a result, she saw a tombstone with Alice's name written on it.

After thinking a little, one would know what was going on. N一定 is definitely Cersi thinking he was dead, so she planned to bury Alice in advance.

Merlin lifted his head, nodded at this peculiar old woman Cersi, and then raised his thumb, praising her one by one.

"You this old hag...

"Your conscience is really big and bad!"

OB SE aside

In the laboratory before the secret room, Cersi was busy configuring potions.

Susan was left outside, filling in the grave she had dug.

She kept rolling her eyes, complaining that her master tormented her, and in the end, it was all up to her to clean up.

Merlin quietly sat in the corner, thinking that he was lucky to have come early. If he came a little later, Alice would have been buried alive.

Although Cersi wanted to abandon Alice, Merlin couldn't blame her for anything. After all, if he died, she wouldn't have any reason to keep Alice nurtured, wasting potion resources uselessly.

Merlin had some resentment about this, but thinking that he still needs Cersi to treat Alice, he had to suppress his resentment and maintain surface peace.

"Not bad, you actually did it. Too surprising..." Cersi rubbed the passing pearl in her hand, and mysterious power slowly flowed on it. "I thought you would definitely die on the way."

"Haha, I didn't only not die, but also brought things back. Really sorry to disappoint you." Merlin smiled insincerely.

Cersi caught the sarcasm in Merlin's words, but didn't mind, and continued asking, "Sure enough, the abyss mussel, this peculiar species that survives in the gap between two worlds, exists in the unknown mysterious sea area. I didn't guess wrong. How did you get this thing?"

"Killed the monster leader and found it in the treasure room." Merlin said concisely and briefly, not saying the details. As for the head of the chaotic king? He planned to keep it himself. After confronting the North Sea Giant Zombie, he found this thing was quite useful.

"Oh~ So that's how it is. Anyway, now that the passing pearl is in hand, everything is easy to say. Looking at your bruised and battered appearance, you should have suffered a lot, right? Take off your clothes and let me see." Cersi's expression suddenly became excited, as if she was expecting something?

"Huh! Take off clothes?" Merlin frowned, always feeling that this old woman was taking advantage of him, and his heart wasn't very happy.

"What are you afraid of? I've seen everything. Even if you're wearing clothes now, I can imagine what you look like naked with a little mental computation." Cersi revealed a mysterious smile.

"...." Merlin's face turned red, thinking that Cersi's words sounded like an old lecher, "Okay! I'll take off!"

Merlin cleanly took off his clothes, revealing a body full of wounds. Half of his body had already been eroded by vampire toxin, and being able to survive was simply a miracle!

Cersi carefully examined Merlin's injuries and felt the situation was very unfavorable. By rights, Merlin should have already lost consciousness. Now he can still keep his mind clear. It's no wonder he has such strong willpower!

"The left arm is completely cut off..."

Merlin lowered his head and said in a low voice, "This is an accident."

"However, Ding J's condition is still pretty good, puff puff puff..." Cersi this old lecher laughed with deep meaning.

"Please be serious! !" Merlin felt a bit of a situation. Previously, he didn't care at all whether he wore clothes or not. But in front of this old lecher, he felt a bit of surrender, "Can you quickly configure the potion and save my friend first?"

"Easy, easy. She won't be in any danger for now. Your situation is much worse than hers. Isn't it seeing someone and wanting to pounce and bite their throat?" Cersi narrowed her eyes, lightly touching her long neck, "If you bite down like this, it's very stimulating, right?"

"...." Merlin lowered his head, forcing himself not to look at Cersi's tasty neck. Indeed, he had this thought, but he still maintained rationality, otherwise he would definitely become like those crazy vampires.

"Hah..." Cersi saw Merlin's reaction and suddenly laughed lightly, "Your current reaction is like a shy little boy. It's quite interesting."

"Don't joke around. I beg you to quickly configure the potion, okay?" Merlin's tone became serious.

"Good, but last time the time-flow potion was more than 20 years ago. I'm old now, and my memory isn't good. So I don't remember clearly how much dosage and steps what's needed." Cersi rubbed her temples, showing a troubled expression. "I need someone to voluntarily help me test the medicine, so I can control the dosage well and save your friend. If the time-flow potion dosage is too large, there might be some side effects, you know~"

....... Merlin frowned, feeling that now that we've come this far, we can't stop. If we have to, we'll go all out. So he seriously said--

"I'm willing to test the medicine for you. As many times as needed.

"If you can save Alice, please use me as a guinea pig as much as possible."

The update will be in the second half of the night, around 1 o'clock in the morning. Please be patient.

title: Chapter 40 — Little Merlin (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 40 — Little Merlin (Bonus)

Volume 20 · Chapter 40

Merlin sat in the corner waiting patiently, hoping Sesi would work faster to finish the time potion. He didn't dare make a sound, afraid he would disturb this renowned potion master. Sesi had her back to Merlin, grinding a pearl the size of half a hand into powder, then took out many strange things— lizard tails, screaming tree roots, toads sticking out their tongues.... These eerie things made Merlin's heart pound, he grew nervous, wondering if she was making poison. Seeing Sesi pull out more horrifying items, Merlin's face wavered, because the old woman produced... snake venom, dumping it all into the bottle! Damn! Is she planning to torture me to death just because I'm her little guinea pig? Merlin felt embarrassed, very uneasy, sitting on pins and needles, thinking he and Sesi had no grudge, no need to be so harsh! "What else... oh right, there's concentrated plant toxin essence..." Sesi muttered, adding various liquids to the jar, making the potion shift through beautiful colors. Merlin's face grew uglier; just moments ago he confidently offered himself for experiment, now he's a bit timid. Having watched Sesi prepare the potion firsthand, Merlin thought she wasn't trying to save someone, but to kill! But as a potion master, Sesi naturally has two sides: she can heal with potions, and naturally can harm with poison. Merlin calmed himself, trying to stay composed, suddenly entrusting his life to an old woman, he remained very uneasy. Watching Sesi's busy figure, he suddenly noticed this fiery old woman had a strange beauty? Thinking of Sesi's personality, when she was young she must have been a bewitching beauty who could enchant people to death and back... Merlin thought Sesi's neck was the most beautiful spot, his inner feelings became restless, very much wanting to go up and bite— -0. Now the two were alone in the room, this private atmosphere made Merlin inevitably have weird thoughts under the interference of the vampire toxin. Merlin furrowed his brow, suppressing the urge to attack Sesi; if he caused a scene here, it would be sexual harassment of the old woman. Sesi shook the potion jar, carefully observing its color and smell, then nodded, "Almost done, should be successfully made." "Success?!" Merlin jumped up, his hanging heart finally at ease; now Alice could be saved. Sesi handed the potion jar to Merlin, "Here, drink it and see how it works." "....Okay, I'll try...." Merlin tried to cheer himself, staring at the dark liquid constantly bubbling, a bit afraid, wondering if he'd die instantly after drinking. "Drink, what are you spacing out for? You're not gonna chicken out, are you?" Sesi covered her mouth and chuckled, looking mysterious, truly unknown what she's thinking. "How... how could that be, haha" Merlin gave an embarrassed dry laugh, sniffed slightly, a foul stench, just like something filthy pulled from a toilet. But Merlin glanced at Sesi, pinched his nose, and forced himself to gulp it down! "Gulp gulp gulp gulp gulp gulp gulp..." Sesi's expression froze, her eyes turned weird, looking at Merlin she always felt something off? "Wow, disgusting.... Merlin drank the whole jar, instantly showing the face of someone who ate a fly, his tongue turned black, "Is this enough now?" "Impressive, he's impressive, but that... Sesi pursed her lips, hesitant to speak, "Why did you drink the whole jar of potion?" "Ah.. Merlin's shocked expression froze on his face, his whole body seemed petrified, -like, feeling like he might have misheard? "Did I tell you to drink this much, to finish the whole jar?" Sesi blinked her innocent big eyes, feeling she had no responsibility. The two stared at each other, the atmosphere instantly became extremely awkward, silent to the point you could hear a pin drop. Merlin smacked his lips, looked at his empty potion jar, then slammed it to the ground, "You didn't need to drink it all, why didn't you say so earlier? Damn it!" "You didn't ask me either? You just grabbed it and gulped it down..." Sesi shrugged helplessly. "It's you urging me on!" Merlin's veins bulged on his forehead from anger. "Does this taste good? Normal people who drink something this awful wouldn't want to finish it." Sesi spread her hands, pushing all responsibility away. "....I" Merlin was furious, trembling, really wanting to knock this old woman out with one punch, but then he suddenly felt uncomfortable all over. He saw Merlin clutch his stomach, feeling his stomach churn, waves of nausea hit, wanting to vomit something? However besides dry heaving, he couldn't vomit anything, only feeling utterly miserable all over! Merlin broke out in cold sweat, his face turned pale, he knelt on the ground, as if suddenly struck by a deadly poison! "Hehehe, I said earlier, drinking too much time potion will definitely have side effects, you're finally experiencing it yourself, right?" Sesi gave a weird smile, not worried at all, instead looking down on Merlin with mockery. "..ugh! ..." Merlin curled up on the ground, trembling all over, glanced at Sesi's evil smile, his heart gave a jolt- Come to think of it, this old woman isn't anything good! Her character is so-so; could be judged as neither righteous nor wicked, completely lacking any morality! He almost couldn't return and was going to bury Alice, showing she's a selfish scumbag! Now he was bewitched, drank that strange potion, suffering immensely, and this old lady actually had the mind to mock him?! Damn! I won't have been tricked by this old woman from the start, right? She planned to kill me from the beginning! Using me to find the flowing pearl, then taking the chance to poison me and claim the rare materials for herself! The more Merlin thought, the scarier it got; he shouldn't have trusted Sesi with his life, but he was too eager to save Alice and let his guard down. ".....I" "Tsk tsk tsk! Can't even speak clearly?" Sesi stared at Merlin, especially his undisguised hostile eyes, icy cold, "You must really want to get up and kill me, huh?" "You!" Merlin's face flushed red, his expression turned hateful. "You have no strength now..." Sesi slowly squatted down, her ample chest pressing together, she gently patted Merlin's angry twisted face, "In my eyes you're just a little brother." Xiao Zhi Merlin gritted his teeth, trying to stand, but then his vision went black and he lost consciousness-. Morning sunlight shone into the pumpkin house, Merlin lay quietly on the captain. When he woke again, he saw a familiar yet strange ceiling, he had once lived here. Merlin felt sore all over, but still struggled to sit up, his sleepy eyes rubbed his eyes. My left arm regenerated? I'm still alive, could it be that old woman Sesi wasn't trying to kill me? I misunderstood. But are these hands mine? They look weird, small, and look so childish..... Merlin frowned, examining his hands, they looked like a child's, delicate skin, a bit translucent in the morning light. His heart gave a start, feeling these weren't his hands, so he lifted his head, looked at the opposite mirror, his eyes instantly turned extremely terrified! The Merlin in the mirror was no longer a strong adult, but a petite, cute-looking child, about six or seven years old, better called Little Merlin. Merlin trembled all over, both hands covering his chubby little face, letting out a soul-piercing protest of panic- "I, the mighty arrogant Demon Lord, actually turned into a little brat?!" "No way!" (;≥几≤)

title: Chapter 41 — The Irresponsible Old Woman
content:
Chapter 41 — The Irresponsible Old Woman

Volume 20 · Chapter 41

Merlin kept staring at his small hands, feeling a creeping sense of despair. He had completely failed to anticipate this situation.

He was one of the Seven Demon Kings of the demon race—wait, so now he had inexplicably turned into a child? What kind of joke was this?!

If anyone else found out, the usual nose-in-the-air, insufferably arrogant Merlin had suddenly become a little brat. Wouldn't that be laughed to death?!

Normally, Merlin found dealing with children troublesome and couldn't even be bothered to give them a glance. Now look—he had become the kind of brat he had despised the most back then?!

"Why has this happened?!"

"I barely spent 200 years reaching adulthood, and now—now this! Have I just been agonizing for over 200 years for nothing?!"

Little Merlin clutched his head, his entire being in a state of panic, unable to accept the reality that he had become a little kid.

His face ashen, he looked at his small body and gazed blankly, carefully sorting through the information at hand, trying to understand his current condition.

The time potion was indeed effective. But he had drunk too much of it, causing his body to regress directly to how it was over 200 years ago, turning him into a rotten little brat!

Although his left arm had fully recovered and even the vampire's toxin had disappeared, becoming a child was far from what he wanted.

And the most致命 thing was... over 200 years ago, his childhood self was the demon race's trash little prince who had a 9,999-level Flash Sword skill but had failed to unlock its power!

If the effect of the time potion was to reverse the consumer's body back in time, then Merlin right now... truly had no power. He would be easily bullied by anyone!

Little Merlin's expression was full of worry, yet he still held onto a sliver of hope, hoping his strength was still there. Otherwise, how could he possibly get by?

So he lowered his head, pushed open his strawberry-patterned pajamas, and looked at his chest, and then...

That shocking scar had already disappeared!

Back then, that mysterious man in black had pierced his chest with a golden cone, thereby unlocking his invincible power.

Since the scar had now vanished, it proved that Merlin's body had truly returned to over 200 years ago—to the demon race's little prince with hardly any fighting ability. And there would no longer be the threat of the heart curse.

However, Merlin hoped the curse would disappear, but he didn't want his own power to vanish along with it. After all, in this dangerous otherworld, how could he survive without something to rely on?

"Gone! It's all gone! It's actually really gone...."

"No, no!"

"I don't want to become a child! Make me back to normal!!!"

Little Merlin angrily pounded the bed, wanting to confront that old woman, Cycse. If she wouldn't reverse him back, he would definitely tear this old hag apart with his bare hands!

Although Cycse had no intention of killing Merlin, letting him completely escape danger, he had still inexplicably been swindled. She had taken back his strong body! And her invincible power!

Just then, Cycse pushed open the door and walked in. Seeing the adorably clueless little Merlin glaring at her resentfully, she couldn't help but burst out laughing.

"What's with all the shouting and screaming this early in the morning? You've already turned into a little brat and still can't keep quiet. If you're not good, I'll spank your butt~"

"...Little Merlin's face flushed red. He was thoroughly infuriated by Cycse. He felt some sense of a fallen tiger being bullied by dogs. He was a renowned Great Demon Lord! This old woman was actually threatening him with spanking! How outrageous!

"How do you feel? Your injuries have all healed, and the vampire toxin has been neutralized. Don't you feel much lighter?" Cycse swayed her sinuous hips as she strolled over, sat on the edge of the bed, and laughingly reached out to pinch little Merlin's cheeks. It looked exactly like an old aunt teasing a young boy, with ulterior motives!

"Don't... don't touch me!" Little Merlin angrily swatted Cycse's hand away and began questioning her in a fierce manner. "What am I supposed to do in this state? You must give me a reasonable explanation!"

"What else can I do? You became like this yourself. Wasn't it because you drank too much of the potion? Hehe...." Cycse covered her mouth, laughing nonstop. She was glad Merlin was a demon whose lifespan was long enough that regressing to childhood was acceptable. If a human had drunk it, they would probably have dropped dead on the spot.

"You still have the face to laugh! This is all your fault, you old hag!" Little Merlin bared his teeth at her with hostility. He was so infuriated by this old woman that his mind was going blank. "I don't care! You need to find a way to turn me back, or else this isn't over!"

"Oh? You want to kill me?" Cycse sized up little Merlin. He was nothing but a toddler who hadn't even grown his full set of teeth. There was zero intimidation factor. "You have absolutely no threat right now. I could subdue you easily...."

"I... I'll perish together with you, old hag!"

Little Merlin brandished his arms and legs and jumped up. But Cycse raised her magic wand and tapped his head. Instantly, he collapsed onto the bed.

"Ouch! You... you played me and now you're hitting me too!?"

"If you're well-behaved, I can try to brew an antidote. It might be able to restore you to your adult state. But if you don't behave...."

Cycse looked at little Merlin and pinched his cheeks. "Then I won't bother. You can just stay a child forever..."

Little Merlin's expression darkened, but he had no temper left against Cycse. What if she truly stopped caring about him? That would be disastrous. But hearing that Cycse said she could make an antidote, there was still hope. He wouldn't have to be a brat forever. The "humiliation" before him was only temporary.

"That's much more well-behaved. I didn't expect you in this child's form to be quite likeable. Cute~" Cycse stroked Merlin's cheeks and seemed to have gotten addicted to teasing him. "You look almost like a little girl, haha."

Little Merlin felt he was under someone else's roof and had to bow his head. So he could only suppress his dissatisfaction. "Auntie, have you finished touching? Can you find a way to help me brew an antidote?"

"Nope. Don't call me Auntie. Call me Sister Cycse, hehe." Cycse pressed her finger against Merlin's lips, not allowing him to speak like that.

Merlin couldn't help but roll his large eyes. Did she have a brain?! How old are you, and you have the nerve to let me call you Sister? Shameless old hag!

Although Merlin's actual age was far greater than Cycse's, according to the standards of the demon race, he was considered a young demon who had just reached adulthood.

"About the antidote, don't rush. You slept for two full days and nights. I had just finished perfecting the rescue potion for your friend and was about to give it to her when you woke up." Cycse paused, then comforted little Merlin. "So regarding your antidote, please wait patiently for now."

Hearing that the time potion for Alice had already been prepared, Merlin instantly lost his temper. "Then hurry up and give it to her. My problem can wait. Surely you can turn me back, right?"

"Hehe..." Cycse smiled without answering, her expression very mysterious. She didn't answer Merlin directly. Instead, she thought—

What a pity. I've never brewed an antidote to counter the time potion before.

This situation is also my first time encountering it, so I'll just have to try.

As for whether it will succeed....

It all depends on his luck. Hehe~

title: Chapter 42 — Misfortune turns to blessing (Extra)
content:
Chapter 42 — Misfortune turns to blessing (Extra)

Volume 20 · Chapter 42

“Let's save my friend first, I'll go with you.” Little Merlin stood up, putting the antidote matter aside for now; saving Alice is the priority.
“Do you want to change clothes?” Chris said meaningfully, a certain expectation flashing in her eyes.
“This.... Little Merlin looked down at his small body wearing pajamas printed with little strawberries, looking rather effeminate.
“I’ve already prepared it... Chris opened the nearby wardrobe, eagerly taking out overalls and lining, which looked very small and fit Merlin’s current size. “How about this?”
“Why do you still have children’s clothes here?” Little Merlin frowned, feeling a bit wary, afraid Chris was teasing him.
“I’m saving this for my future son, but since you don’t have suitable clothes, it’s fine to lend you to wear.” Chris gave a harmless smile.
“Really?” Little Merlin took the clothes, examined them, thought they weren’t embarrassing like a little skirt, and put them on.
“Wow, it fits perfectly.” Chris laughed and clapped, a hint of purity flashing in the depths of her eyes.
“But… why does the crotch feel so tight?” Little Merlin thought the clothes were fine, just the pants felt weird.
“Maybe it’s not the right size; just bear with it.” Chris’s smile grew increasingly strange, making it seem she was teasing Merlin to satisfy some fetish. <
Little Merlin followed behind Chris’s buttocks as they walked out; due to his body turning into a child’s, where an adult takes one step, he needs three steps, looking like he’s jogging.
Just as the two left the pumpkin house, they bumped into Susan, who was cleaning the yard.
“Master! He’s awake?”
Susan ran over, bent down, stared at Little Merlin, and tried to poke his cheek with her finger, looking very curious.
Originally Susan was afraid of Merlin the man, but after he turned into a child, she wasn’t as afraid.
Perhaps because a child lacks pronounced gender traits, it let Susan let down much of her guard.
“Oh~, soft and tender skin, nice skin.
“Tsk!” Little Merlin clicked his tongue in annoyance, wondering why everyone liked to press hard on his face—maybe because he had baby fat as a kid—he flared up and shoved Susan’s hand away: “Don’t touch me! I hate people touching my face.
“Huh?” Susan furrowed her lovely brows, hands on hips, looking down at the little Merlin, “Even though you’ve turned into a child, your temper is still as nasty as before—not cute at all!
.... Little Merlin’s face darkened, thinking the word “cute” would never be used on him—he’s pure 24K hardness!
“You’re clearly wearing my childhood clothes, yet you act so domineering, and you don’t even thank me?” Susan said haughtily.
“...Childhood clothes?” Little Merlin’s expression instantly turned to shock, frozen in place.
“Yeah, you’re wearing the clothes Master made for me when I was little; I didn’t expect them to end up on you?” Susan said seriously.
“Damn it, old hag.... Little Merlin glared at Chris, head raised, thinking I said the crotch was tight—turns out it’s Susan’s childhood clothes; girls don’t have a—!
“Pfft!” Chris burst out laughing, holding back her laughter as she explained, “It doesn’t matter; do children’s clothes still distinguish between male and female? Right?”
“_... Little Merlin clenched his fists in anger, really wanting to jump up and smash Chris’s knee to vent his fury—
I’ll hit you, you old hag!
Once I recover, I’ll definitely make you taste what the Demon Lord’s wrath is!
In the secret chamber, golden icicles glowed, filling the whole space, making one feel as if in an ice cellar.
The pool filled with potential‑activating elixir was almost drained by Alice alone.
No wonder Chris planned to bury Alice early—this clearly shows they can barely afford to keep this patient alive.
Little Merlin stood not far away, his white breath flowing with his respiration as he watched the unconscious Alice, feeling extremely cold; he could only stomp his feet and rub his arms to fend off the chill.
At this moment, Merlin was unlike before—his body had formidable defensive prowess, yet as a child he still felt the cold easily.
Chris took out the prepared perfect time elixir—just a tiny bottle—but if Merlin guzzled it like gulping down tons, he’d truly be a tough guy.
Only saw Chris carefully drip a few drops of the time elixir into Alice’s mouth, then slowly retreat.
Little Merlin frowned and demanded, “Hey! Old hag! Why no reaction?，
“Let the elixir absorb a...
As Chris’s words fell, Alice, immersed in the medicine pool, suddenly burst forth with intense dragon might, waves of fierce cold making it hard to approach!
“Eek!
Little Merlin bared his teeth, feeling the cold blast hit his face; instantly a layer of frost formed on his eyebrows, looking a bit comical.
He never realized that the girl beside him had grown so fast she was already quite a strong fighter, surpassing most people he’d ever met!
Before, because his own strength was overwhelming, he never paid attention to Alice’s power.
But now Merlin has returned to his weak childhood state, yet he feels differently—
Actually, Alice is already strong; on the road she can be felt as a formidable powerhouse!
It’s just that because he was too strong, he ignored Alice’s growth and strength, treating her purely as a little follower.
Little Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking he should reflect properly—he should promote Alice from lackey to assistant.
Alice’s dragon might kept growing, suddenly rising a level; the surrounding golden icicles also dimmed considerably, turning pale green.
“Misfortune brings fortune” fits Alice perfectly—she was already a dual Saint‑tier peak of battle qi and magic power; after absorbing the pool’s potential‑activating elixir, her strength advanced once more! .
“No..... Merlin felt a hint of astonishment, thinking Alice had grown stronger again; this time she might be about to reach the threshold of the Ancestor Realm? Why is her luck always off the charts? Even unconscious she can level up! I owe an apology to those Perseverance Emperors who train all their lives and still can’t become strong!
“Indeed,” my potential‑activating elixirs are all specially made—how could an ordinary person absorb so much? It turns out this girl’s potential far exceeds that of ordinary people; her future is immeasurable.... Chris spoke expressionlessly, muttering to herself, wondering where Claudia’s stiff‑as‑a‑board guy found this girl? She really picked up a treasure! A human with such top‑notch talent has already surpassed my comprehension!
Previously Merlin judged Alice’s talent as average, her cultivation speed slow—reaching Saint‑tier in a lifetime would be difficult.
But now it seems it’s because Alice’s own potential is too great, requiring too much energy, so her cultivation is slow.
It’s like Alice is an energy vessel; its capacity is huge, so filling it is no easy feat.
One day, if Alice approaches perfection, she might reach a level beyond human reach!
“Potential far exceeds ordinary.... Merlin furrowed his brows, recalling recent events, thinking how terrifying is this? Alice seems to be becoming less and less like an ordinary human...
The cold wind ceased; Chris turned her head and walked toward the outside of the secret chamber, her voice echoing within—
“Don’t worry, she’s safe now.”
“Just rest a few days and she’ll wake up on her own.”
“Blessing in disguise—this continent now has one more Saint‑tier‑transcending powerhouse....”.
“Ugh! So annoying!”
Claudia’s students have all advanced to the Ancestor Realm, while my disciple is still wandering around in the high stage!
No way! I must find a way to torment this little girl—I can’t lose to that “country bumpkin”....

title: Chapter 43 — Awakening
content:
Chapter 43 — Awakening

Volume 20 · Chapter 43

Midnight.

Although he had turned into a child now, he wasn't too worried, after all, Cersi the old lady said she could make an antidote.

This weak state shouldn't last long; sooner or later he would recover.

Moreover, Alice had already escaped danger; Merlin's hanging heart settled, no longer as worried as before.

Nevertheless, even so, Merlin right now had some difficulty falling asleep; his whole body was tense; he was staring at the ceiling with wide eyes bloodshot.

Because right now, Merlin was facing a precarious situation of being attacked on both sides -

On the left lay Susan, fast asleep, her vigorous body seeming full of elasticity; although her age wasn't great, her chest development was already very magnificent!

On the right lay the ample Cersi, despite her advanced age, she still retained her charm; her snow-white skin seemed to glow in the darkness, a sight any man seeing this body would go crazy trying to suppress!

Since it was their own home, the master and disciple were dressed rather casually and intimately; the pajamas couldn't conceal their beauty, the snow-white long legs pressing down on little Merlin, rendering him immobile.

Little Merlin never demanded to sleep with them; he was forcibly dragged over by Cersi, the reason being one -

"Merlin is now a child, he needs someone to accompany him; otherwise, he wouldn't dare go to the bathroom alone at night."

Listen, is this still human talk? They completely didn't treat Merlin as a man, but rather as a little kid.

Little Merlin felt he was being insulted, although his body had become a child, his heart was still an adult! Is it really fine to pull someone into sleep so unprepared? Did they never hear that kids can also drive big cars?

Especially Susan, this white-paper-like silly sweet, she originally had objections, but was persuaded by Cersi's few words, losing her temper, thinking little Merlin had no attack power at all, and sleeping together seemed no big deal.

Little Merlin was sandwiched between two voluptuous women on the surface looking fine, but internally he was panicking like a monkey.

He simply couldn't say anything, it wasn't excitement, but fear that he would be eaten alive by the old woman on the right, like a wolf or tiger, or the stupid girl on the left!

Little Merlin wanted to secretly slip away, trying to escape from between the mistresses' long legs.

But suddenly, a white arm patted little Merlin's chest, easily pressing him back onto the bed.

Cersi slowly opened her eyes, secretly asking, "What do you want to do?"

"...I want to sleep..." Little Merlin trembled, feeling the person in front wasn't human, but a man-eating mother tiger!

"You aren't an adult now, you need protection, be quiet..." Cersi pulled little Merlin over, hugging him to sleep.

"Pu chi"

A sound, little Merlin buried his head in Cersi's ample bosom, being loved by the older sister, "Happy" to death!

"Mmm!!!" Little Merlin struggled, repeatedly rolling his eyes, his face turning eggplant purple, his heart constantly wailing

...I'm going to suffocate!

I'm not your toy!

Let me go!

Next morning, outside the pumpkin house.

Susan was practicing gathering magic elements into a bottle under the author's guidance, but the progress was slow, being knocked on the head by Cersi many times.

"Wuuu wuuu, master don't hit me, I'm already trying my best

'Tch! Why did I take you as a disciple back then, really useless~'

'Although there was nothing before, these past few days you've suddenly been urged, can't you just mind your own business, old lady?'

"What did you say? I see your courage is getting bigger and bigger, you must be properly disciplined-."

Because seeing Clodya's students had entered the sect realm threshold, Cersi received a considerable stimulation, feeling Susan was not just a little worse than them.

Cersi, who was always competitive, didn't want to lose to her arch-enemy, recently starting to strictly urge Susan, at minimum also should become a Saint-tier powerhouse early, otherwise it's simply losing face.

As for little Merlin? He went early to accompany Alice, squatting by the bed, waiting for her to wake up.

Actually, Merlin wanted to hide from Cersi the old lady, last night he didn't sleep, almost suffocated to death, making him now listless.

Little Merlin leaned on his face, beside the sickbed, dozing, his head foggy, looking like he would crash into the bed's edge at any moment.

Alice's unconscious hand twitched, slowly opening her eyes, seeing a very unfamiliar ceiling one-

...Where is this?

A question floated in Alice's mind, she slowly sat up, feeling her whole body aches beyond measure, unable to help but take two bright breaths.

However, she felt her strength surging inside her body, and magic power and battle aura had condensed many times, becoming much stronger?

Alice looked at her palm, virtual gripped a few times, immediately making a "popping" crisp sound, as if containing the power to move mountains and overturn seas.

I... became stronger without reason? Feels a bit strange...

Alice couldn't figure it out, thought hard, recalling- but suddenly revealed a panicked expression.

Right! That woman... isn't human! She's a monster that can suck blood!

I and Merlin were tricked, it seems I received serious injuries?

Say... where is this?

Alice looked around, "

The blue scenery was very unfamiliar, as if residing in a secluded place far from the bustle.

...... Little Merlin leaned on his head, dozing, completely unaware that Alice had awakened.

Alice stared at little Merlin, suddenly showing a puzzled expression, obviously already a bit unable to recognize her partner- -

...Who is this child? Why is he sleeping next to me?

Although looking at his appearance, he has a few points like that bastard Merlin?

Could it be my illusion?

Alice looked at the little kid in front more and more, feeling he was very much like Merlin that bastard, especially the eyes and beauty, almost coming from the same mold, but far too tender than Merlin.

...... Little Merlin's head swaying, dozing, finally with a "bang" hit the edge of the bed, quickly rubbing his forehead and crying out in pain, "It hurts!!!"

"mmm...." Alice covered her mouth, staring at the little friend, thinking this somewhat airheaded temperament is also very like Merlin's guy.....

Evil!" Little Merlin rubbed his red and swollen forehead] complaining, his eye corner glancing to see Alice staring at him, "Alice! ? You

. You woke up! ?"

"...Recognize me?" Alice felt subtle, pointed at herself, thinking she completely didn't recognize this child?

Wow! You finally woke up! Could make old me tired!" Little Merlin struggled to climb onto the bed, carefully examining Alice strangely, "How is it? Are there no uncomfortable places left?"

."No..4. Alice frowned, feeling this child is familiar, ".. month... Who are you ah

"I? Shout!" Little Merlin pouted, proudly showing double hands, nose to the sky, saying, "I am Merlin! Can't you recognize me? Walking beside me so long, tch tch tch~"

"Eh?!"

Alice was stunned, feeling this arrogant personality, this look-down-on-people attitude, this tone of looking down on others? ? ?

Except for Merlin this bastard, she had never seen anyone so deserving of a beating!

So Alice pinched little Merlin's waist, lifted him high, then carefully looked, her expression suddenly becoming incredible one-

"Eh! ! !"

"You are Merlin?
