title: Chapter 46 — Black on Black (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 46 — Black on Black (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 21 · Chapter 46

At that moment, Alice in the darkness finally saw the secret hidden in the carriage, her eyes widening in shock as she was unable to speak.
That was… Helena, the female boss of the Rexham secret cottage!
Why was she being held here!?
What… what happened….
Alice didn't act rashly; although she wasn't very familiar with Helena, she still recognized the name.
She was the dream lover of the Rexham men, even Merlin had once sneaked over to the secret cottage.
Alice's mind was filled with doubts. She had thought that by following back and forth she could find traces of Blackman, but instead she ended up accidentally bumping into the kidnapped Helena?
'I thought your weak body couldn't accomplish anything, but I didn't expect you to actually bring that demon woman to me—worthy of praise.' The black‑clothed man said with deep meaning.
'Did you look down on me from the start? Hmph!' Lochi let out a cold snort.
'Your fathers once sailed the seas, but you're just a child they picked up; aside from being equally cunning, you have nothing in common with them.' The black‑clothed man gave a strange laugh.
'Cut the nonsense—I won't work for free. Can we start the trade now?' Lochi held Helena in his arms.
'Of course, hand over that demon woman, and our Phoenix will grant you a wish…' The black‑clothed man reached out his demonic claw toward the unconscious Helena.
'You haven't forgotten, have you? No matter the cost, you'll help me take down Elgin the Sword Master.' Lochi said seriously.
'Of course, if you help us, we'll repay you. Even if Elgin the Sword Master reaches the heavens, he's still just a human.' The black‑clothed man paused, then continued, 'Our Phoenix has spent a century hiding and biding its time; our foundation and strength have long surpassed any organization in history. There are rarely any beings that make us fear. That swordsman will face an unprecedented colossus; resistance is merely a dying flicker of light, and he will inevitably meet his doom.'
'You speak so eloquently, but can I trust you?' Lochi frowned slightly.
'What choice do you have? Besides us, where else could you find the power to oppose Elgin the Sword Master?' the black‑clothed man countered.
Lochi fell silent for a moment, then showed a faint smile, placing Helena's hands in his own, 'I hope our cooperation can be pleasant.'
'Me too.' The black‑clothed man took Helena, examined her carefully, confirmed there was no problem, and upon first contact felt her immense magical power and demonic aura, on par with a high‑ranking demon.
'So, what's your plan? If you help me successfully kill Elgin the Sword Master—since your guild is such a colossus, killing him surely wouldn't be difficult, right?' Lochi asked, expecting a detailed plan; otherwise, he'd have wasted his effort.

The black‑clothed man held the bewitching Helena, letting out a series of strange laughs, ‘What nonsense are you spouting in your foolishness? What plan? I have no idea at all…’
Lochi staggered, his eyes turning icy as he spat out a sentence from between his teeth, ‘Don’t you have any sense of contract? Breaking it so easily is utterly without principle—even the demon race can’t compare.’
‘A trade is based on equal footing; you’re just a pirate’s son, nothing more than an ordinary person who likes petty tricks—where does your confidence come from to trade fairly with us?’ the black‑clothed man said, looking at Lochi, his voice low, ‘To be frank, I could kill you with a single finger; a fair trade simply doesn’t exist. You’re merely a pawn to be used and discarded at any time, just like your two foolish fathers who could only survive by looting small towns, ultimately ending up split in half by Elgin the Sword Master.’
Lochi’s face flushed with anger, veins bulging on his forehead, ‘Don’t insult my father—you’re playing with fire and will burn yourself; take back your contemptuous words!’
‘Take back my words? No…’ the black‑clothed man shook his head, ‘Compared to your father, you’re immature; perhaps this ordeal will make you a bit more mature, helping you recognize the stench of your own worthlessness—you’ll never turn around, destined to be a petty pirate forever on the run.’
Lochi narrowed his eyes, his pupils deep as an abyss; though silent, his fury was more intense than any shout.
He recalled the humiliation of being abandoned by the Red Beard pirate crew and the hardships of drifting at sea, eating the rotten fish and shrimp the sailors had thrown away, barely surviving…
Lochi clenched his fists, his body trembling; he had expected to unleash a torrent of curses, but instead a smile suddenly appeared on his face.
‘Hah, you think you won? You think you’ve tricked me? You think I’m a naive kid who’ll believe you completely? Naivety is yours.’
‘What do you mean?’ the black‑clothed man narrowed his eyes, murderous intent rising.
‘We’re both scum who shun the light; only scum understand what scum think. Doing business with your Dark Guild, nine out of ten times you’ll end up unlucky—I know well that protecting the weak is—’ Lochi pulled out a piece of rawhide from his pocket, slowly unfurling it for the black‑clothed man to see, ‘This is the slave contract between me and that demon woman; I knocked her out and forced her to sign it. Now, as long as I tear this rawhide apart, the demon woman in your arms is doomed! I know you want a living high‑ranking demon—too bad, I won’t let you succeed.’
The black‑clothed man’s aura seeped out, revealing that he had entered the Ancestral Realm and was a super‑strong expert; waves of pressure distorted the surrounding space slightly.
Phoenix has always been the pinnacle of the Dark Guild, its strength far surpassing that of its peers!
A super‑strong expert of the Ancestral Realm could easily serve as a leader in other guilds, but in Phoenix he’s merely an errand‑runner—his terrifying power hints at just how formidable they are.
‘You despicable pirate’s son…’
‘You’re no good either—my father told me never to trust anyone, and he was right.’ Lochi waved the slave contract in his hand, saying, ‘Now you have two choices: you kill me, I tear up the demon woman’s slave contract, and we all perish together; otherwise, you obediently fulfill our original agreement and take down Elgin the Sword Master.’
‘Taking down Elgin the Sword Master is no problem.’ the black‑clothed man’s withered palm, nails long, said, ‘First hand over the slave contract.’
‘You wish…’ Lochi snorted and shook his head.
Seeing the two sides at an impasse, Alice in the darkness sensed her chance, decided to rush in and rescue them.
Although she wasn’t close to Helena, since they had met, Alice felt she could still do something.
At that moment, a blackish object with trembling wings suddenly fell from the sky and smashed hard into Lochi.
Alice lifted her head, eyes wide, face full of shock—a terrified reaction—and saw a familiar figure.
‘Merlin!’
‘Why aren’t you wearing pants…’

title: Chapter 47 — My Baby
content:
Chapter 47 — My Baby

Volume 21 · Chapter 47

"What the hell has this bastard been up to, disappearing for so long?" Alice covered her eyes, ashamed to look at Merlin falling from the sky.
Little Merlin's clothes had long been tossed onto the big bed in Mersfield, and now he was wearing Blakeman's robe.
Anyone below who looked up could see little Merlin without pants, looking like a crazy kid with a built‑in mosaic.
Little Merlin locked onto Lochiri and said to Blakeman, "Put me down!"
"Yes sir!" Blakeman flew while holding little Merlin, then immediately let go upon receiving the instruction, launching little Merlin like a cannonball!
"Huh? ! ... Lochiri noticed the abnormality, lifted his head and saw the furious little Merlin.
"You bastard! Die!" Little Merlin shot forward, a rocket‑head hammer, slamming hard into Lochiri's stomach.
"Pfft!" Lochiri was struck as if by thunder, spitting out a mouthful of old blood on the spot and collapsing instantly.
"You think I'm dead? Dream on!" Little Merlin pressed the attack, leaping onto Lochiri's face and using his fingers to gouge his eyes, hoping to blind him outright.
Though temporarily unable to recover his strength, little Merlin could use any move, even the despicable eye‑gouging, as long as it deprived the opponent of resistance.
"Ahhhh!" Lochiri screamed, blood tears bursting from his eye sockets, obviously injured by little Merlin. "Get lost!"
Little Merlin lacked the strength to match Lochiri, who kicked him like a football!
But in that instant, little Merlin snatched the slave contract from Lochiri's hand!
"Ouch!" Little Merlin plopped his butt on the ground, looked at the slave contract in his hand, and had no idea what was going on—he had unintentionally gained control over Helena!
"Ah! The contract! Give me back the contract!" Lochiri covered his bleeding eyes, spinning wildly on the spot; without the contract he truly had no bargaining power!
"Huh?" Little Merlin lowered his head to look at the cow‑skin paper in his hand, thinking that this guy's reaction was so huge—could it be something important?
The black‑clothed person originally had no good way to deal with Lochiri, but the sudden descent of little Merlin broke the stalemate—it was the perfect chance to seize the slave contract!
Helena is absolutely vital to the entire Phoenix Guild; she must not die, and must be brought back alive!
"Little friend, hand over that cow‑skin paper to uncle, and uncle will give you candy~"
Little Merlin's face darkened; using candy to trick him into giving things up? He might as well have spent over two hundred years living in a dog's belly.
So little Merlin hid Helena's slave contract behind him, raising his eyebrows.
"Why should I? It looks shady and mysterious—definitely not something good at a glance!"
"You little... you're asking for death!"
The black‑clothed person's aura rose in rank; he didn't believe a brat would tear up that paper, so he could only kill and loot.
Directly, the black‑clothed person extended his withered sheep‑I? (maybe "withered arm") at little Merlin and released a battle‑qi blast, aiming to blast this clueless fool into debris!
"Er!" Little Merlin startled and stepped back; he wasn't afraid of magic, but the problem was battle‑qi. He figured that since the opponent was so fierce about wanting that cow‑skin paper, he certainly couldn't hand it over—he had to keep it in hand!
"Your Majesty is in danger!" Blakeman shot down from the sky, positioning himself in front of little Merlin, hands crossed before his chest, using his body to block the attack head‑on.
SE Cup Novel
The fierce battle‑qi blast tore the earth apart, leaving a shocking gully, with a booming "bang!"
.... Blakeman was at the center of the battle‑qi blast, his skin cracking all over; he hadn't expected the opponent's power to be so terrifying!
Blakeman barely managed to withstand the enemy's attack, but his body couldn't control itself and flew backward, slamming hard into the wall.
"Blakeman!" little Merlin shouted worriedly, realizing the opponent wasn't easy to deal with—even Blakeman was in such a sorry state.
"Really a nuisance!" The black‑clothed person slowly approached Merlin, extending his hand: "Little brat, hand over that cow‑skin paper, or you'll surely die!"
"Oh? I'll surely die? Then you go see if it agrees!" Little Merlin lifted the black bag, pulled off the black cloth, and the eyes of the King of Chaos, Medusa, snapped open, flashing a dark purple death light.
"Uraaaah!!!" The black‑clothed person froze on the spot, starting from his arm, petrifying at a visible speed: "This... this is...?"
"Go die, hum..." Little Merlin grinned, glad he had his treasure; otherwise he'd have capsized in the gutter.
"Damned brat!"
The black‑clothed person turned his fingers into a blade, placed his hand under his armpit, and severed his own arm alive—just as Merlin had done earlier?!
This mysterious man dropped to one knee, his severed arm gushing blood, plunging him directly into a state of severe vital injury.
"Little bastard!"
Lochiri's side, his eyes injured but barely regaining some sight, he lunged straight at little Merlin.
Little Merlin didn't have time to turn and use Medusa's head before Lochiri knocked it away, losing his ability to defend himself!
That powerful head rolled several times on the ground and stopped where little Merlin couldn't reach.
Lochiri pressed little Merlin beneath him and reached out to seize the slave contract in his hand.
"Give me back the contract!"
"Damn it, this crazy..." Little Merlin was pressed to the ground by Lochiri, glanced at the distant, unreachable Medusa head, and in desperation, something utterly unexpected happened.
One could see little Merlin sweep Helena's slave contract into his mouth, with a "gulping" sound, swallowing it into his stomach, literally eating it so the opponent lunged at nothing!
"Ah...... Lochiri stared, dumbfounded, never expecting this; his eyes turned red and streamed with blood, not knowing if it was from rage.
Little Merlin licked his lips, flashed a mocking smile, stuck out his tongue, and said, "What contract? I don't know, it's not with me at all, blah blah blah~"
Lochiri stared blankly at little Merlin beneath him; for a moment, blood tears gushed from his eye sockets like a spring, and the anger in his heart burned ever fiercer.
He reached out with both hands to choke little Merlin's neck, exerting all his strength, trying to kill this little demon who had ruined his plans.
"Spit it out! Otherwise I'll kill you!"
"Cough cough... Little Merlin really was being choked to the point of sticking out his tongue, waves of suffocation hitting him.
"Let him go!" Alice drew her waist‑sword, seeing Merlin about to be strangled, she couldn't hold back and rushed forward, wishing to run her sword through Lochiri's throat.
Bao SF Light Novel
Lochiri hadn't expected this female knight to keep following him; seeing her brandish a sword to kill him, he snapped out of his rage considerably.
No way! Staying here means certain death—I must escape!
As long as the green mountains remain, I need not fear lack of firewood!
This setback cannot stop me from avenging my father!
Lochiri quickly rose and fled toward the sea; upon passing Medusa's head, he without hesitation picked it up and held it in his arms, and before leaving he also wanted to grab something else.
"Where are you running!" Alice suddenly swung her thin sword, countless sharp golden‑ice blades shooting out, hoping to pin Lochiri down.
However, at the critical moment, Lochiri, holding Medusa's head, leapt into the sea, his whereabouts unknown.
"Shout!" Alice furrowed her brows, disappointed, thinking that this villain ran fast; otherwise he'd surely have to pay a price—besides me, no one may bully Merlin!
"Cough...
Little Merlin kept coughing a few times, drawing deep breaths, gazing at the vast sea, and said sorrowfully:
"Damn
"My treasure!!!"
~~o(>_ .<)o~~
The three‑a.m. train; I need to go sleep, otherwise I might faint again.
Sorry for the inconvenience, everyone; just two or three days, after which it will stabilize to three updates a day—definitely......

title: Chapter 48 — Thunder Demon
content:
Chapter 48 — Thunder Demon

Volume 21 · Chapter 48

"Alice!?" Little Merlin's eyes widened, large beads of sweat rolling down his forehead. "How did you suddenly appear here?"

"Merlin..."

Alice looked down at the somewhat disheveled little Merlin, her expression shifting constantly, anger and joy alternating on her face.

Originally, Alice had assumed Blackman had taken it upon himself to bring little Merlin back to the Demon Lord Palace, and she had intended to thoroughly scold that hermaphroditic demon once she found him.

But now it seemed the situation was quite different — it appeared little Merlin was the one leading Blackman around by the nose.

"...What are you doing?" Little Merlin felt a chill of unease and took a step back.

Alice desperately wanted to reprimand Merlin, but all the words in her throat refused to come out.

Especially seeing how little Merlin had not had a peaceful journey, looking so disheveled, like some unfortunate child?

Alice's maternal instincts surged uncontrollably, and she found she couldn't bring herself to say anything harsh.

"Where have you been? Didn't I tell you not to wander off? Idiot!"

"...." A black vein throbbed on little Merlin's forehead as he awkwardly replied, "It was sudden, I didn't have time to explain..."

"Enough..." Alice squatted down and hugged little Merlin, speaking softly, "As long as you're okay. Next time, no matter what happens, you have to tell me."

"Hehe..." Little Merlin, held in Alice's embrace, secretly chuckled to himself. I thought I'd be hung up and whipped. A child's appearance is so useful — in normal circumstances, I'd have already gotten a fist to the face, right?

Not far away, the man in black staggered to his feet. The blood gushing from his severed arm had lessened considerably, and the pools of blood spreading across the ground formed a bizarre picture.

He slowly raised his head, looking at the two embracing in the distance, and a raging fire of anger surged within him, killing intent radiating from every pore.

He absolutely could not let this demon woman's life fall into someone else's hands. He had to seize that slave contract, even if it meant tearing that brat open and gutting him!

Now that the troublesome snake-haired head was gone, this was the perfect opportunity to eliminate them...

The man in black placed Helena under his foot, tore off his black clothing, and revealed his true form — pitch-black fur and skin, beast-like eyes, a robust body topped with a black panther's head, and a frame covered in razor-sharp muscle.

A non-human race. He never expected that the dark guild Phoenix was composed not only of humans but also of异族 members. The internal complexity must be beyond imagination!

"Hand over the contract. This is your last chance..." The panther-man bared his claws. Though he had only one arm left, his intimidation was still formidable.

"Beastman?" Alice released little Merlin and studied the异族 with a panther's head.

"I wondered why you refused to show your face. So you're an异族..." Little Merlin frowned.

"Did I not make myself clear? Hand over the contract, and if possible, we can resolve our conflict peacefully."

The panther-man, despite nearly bleeding dry, still maintained his composure.

"So... what exactly is this contract you mentioned earlier?" Little Merlin wore a puzzled expression, completely unaware of what he had eaten.

"It's that cowhide paper you just swallowed. That's Helena's slave contract. Whoever holds it is Helena's master, and can kill her at will..." Alice spoke in a low voice. She had caught some important fragments earlier.

"Huh!?" Little Merlin froze, muttering with a strange expression, "So I ate something incredible? Helena's slave contract was eaten by me, which means Helena is now my slave!?"

"That's how it works, but..." Alice looked down at little Merlin, her gaze turning cold as she said seriously, "I'm in a terrible mood, and I absolutely will not agree to you having a female slave."

"W-why so serious...?" Little Merlin felt a bit intimidated, not understanding what Alice was angry about.

"Don't ask. The answer is no." Alice puffed out her cheeks and grumbled angrily, "How could you have a female slave? Absolutely not. I'm unhappy, hmph!"

"...." Little Merlin's brows furrowed, his face darkening as he thought, Female slaves are a no, but male slaves are fine? She's determined to push me down the gay path, isn't she...

"....Anyway, it's a no. It's not because I'm jealous or anything..." Alice huffed and turned her head away, speaking awkwardly, "I'm just preventing you from harassing decent women, hmph~!"

"Harassing decent women?" Little Merlin was wounded inside, thinking that in Alice's eyes, he was such an unbearable person?

"Adventurer, I have no intention of fighting you. I only want that slave contract." The panther-man said earnestly. He was unwilling to clash with Alice because her pressure was somewhat terrifying, an absolute suppression similar to that of a higher species.

Beastmen's perception had always been strong, able to detect many dangers that posed threats to themselves. The Alice radiating dragon aura before him made the panther-man feel a trace of fear, unwilling to fight her.

"No, I won't hand this over to you. Rather, you should return Helena..." Alice was unwilling to compromise with the dark guild, her hand already gripping her sword hilt.

"It seems... there's no room for negotiation..." The panther-man's whiskers trembled, his ferocious nature fully revealed. "You've forced my hand. I'll have to tear you to pieces."

"Merlin, stay behind me. I'll handle this..." Alice spoke in a low voice. Once the fighting started, it would be inconvenient to protect Merlin.

"Got it! Take back my slave!" Little Merlin's eyes sparkled.

"Dream on..." Alice gritted her teeth in response, thinking that Merlin really wanted a female slave? No way! I won't agree! Having a beautiful woman following me around every day — how could I possibly feel at ease! Why would I dig a pit for myself!

Just as Alice was about to charge at the panther-man, a thunderous boom suddenly erupted behind her —

Blue lightning descended from the sky, angrily striking the ruins!

Crackling currents exploded continuously, and the piled stones were torn to shreds!

"Bang!"

Blackman stood up again, her demon wings unfurled. At some unknown point, she had completed her transformation, reappearing in a feminine, graceful figure.

She wielded a heavy thunder demon warhammer, lightning constantly coiling around her body, her hair rippling in the electric wind, like a combat deity of thunder and lightning!

"Those who dare lay a hand on His Majesty must die!"

Before the words had even finished, Blackman was bathed in the light of lightning, her appearance almost completely obscured, as if she herself had become the embodiment of thunder!

Blackman leaped into the air, swinging the thunder demon warhammer, and unleashed a devastating thunder strike from above!

In an instant, thunderous power filled the air, sand and stones flying everywhere!

The panther-man raised his arm to block, but he still couldn't withstand such狂暴 force. He fell to one knee on the spot, the earth trembling and cracking in all directions.

"This androgynous bastard..."

What incredible strength!!!

z( A;)

The hospital visit is over. The problem isn't serious. I'm taking a car back in the early morning, then I'll add an extra chapter to make up for it.

title: Chapter 49 — Physical Anesthesia
content:
Chapter 49 — Physical Anesthesia

Volume 21 · Chapter 49

Blackman's entire body surged with lightning, his warhammer sweeping through the air as he smashed the leopard-man to his knees!

A bead of cold sweat trickled down the leopard-man's forehead. He hadn't expected this demon, now transformed into a woman, to have her combat power surge so dramatically.

Seeing the leopard-man block his heavy hammer strike with just one arm, Blackman was equally startled, realizing he was not on the same level as this beastman.

榆 Blackman quickly changed tactics. Rather than trying to defeat the leopard-man, he chose to rescue the unconscious Helena.

"Die!!"

Lightning crackled across Blackman's body as his membrane wings beat and he launched into the sky, raising his thunder demon warhammer high!

Dark clouds instantly filled the sky, dense lightning continuously converging toward the warhammer, making the ancient weapon shine with the brilliance of the sun!

Blackman was now the embodiment of lightning itself. Beneath the flashing thunderlight, his figure became utterly majestic, as if a ferocious thunder god were roaring!

"You're not bad either..." The leopard-man narrowed his eyes. He felt both Blackman and Helena were elite demons, and either one would do if captured.

Blackman descended from the sky. A pillar of terrifying lightning crashed down, shaking the entire Bristol port, and the giant waves on the sea surface churned along!

"Tch!" The leopard-man's entire body tensed, every inch of muscle swelling as he roared against the overwhelming lightning strike. "It's useless! Compared to my strength, there's an insurmountable gap! Want to kill me? You're dreaming!"

The lightning descended. The leopard-man's veins bulged all over his body, gritting his teeth as he forcibly endured Blackman's full-power attack.

But Blackman suddenly burst out from the towering thunder, catching the leopard-man completely off guard!

Blackman's target was directly Helena beneath the leopard-man's feet. He had to find a way to rescue her.

"Hmm?! Playing cheap tricks!" The leopard-man's gaze turned sharp. He grabbed Blackman's head and slammed him into the ground, then unleashed a qi storm!

A pale golden qi storm shot skyward, blowing apart the dark clouds!

Every strand of wind was like an incredibly sharp blade. The earth was instantly reduced to tofu, drilled with a massive crater!

"Ughhhhh!!!" Blackman screamed repeatedly, his body covered in wounds, flesh and blood flying everywhere, even exposing stark white bones! If his frame hadn't been tough enough, he would have been sliced into fragments in an instant.

"Since you're delivering yourself to me, I won't hold back. I only wanted to capture one living elite demon, and you count as my prey too."

The leopard-man pinched Blackman's neck with one hand, lifting the nearly lifeless woman from the ground, deciding to abandon Helena.

After all, this demon woman's life was already in someone else's hands. There was no guarantee she'd survive being brought back alive.

The leopard-man carried Blackman and slowly advanced toward town. The phoenix pendant on his neck suddenly lit up, and flames rapidly spun into existence before his eyes, forming a portal whose destination was unknown.

But just as the leopard-man was about to kidnap Blackman and flee directly, pale golden ice swords rained down like rain, pock pock pock, continuously stabbing toward him!

The portal was forced to close. The leopard-man's gaze tightened, and he dodged with continuous agile movements. Turning back to look, he thought the enemy he least wanted to fight had finally arrived...

Alice had long since entered her semi-dragon form. With her dragon wings beating, her speed was astonishingly fast, and her slender sword was aimed directly at the leopard-man's throat!

"Tch!" The leopard-man hastily dodged, thinking, No wonder I felt afraid. This is someone with dragon bloodline power!

"Let him go!" Alice's slender sword carved pale golden ice shards, and several massive ice spikes emerged from the ground like bamboo shoots after rain!

The leopard-man's figure was nimble, stepping on the giant ice spikes as he continuously retreated backward. The opponent's strength wasn't much inferior to his own. A prolonged battle would be extremely disadvantageous for him!

He was very worried that a large number of kingdom knights were already en route here. If that happened, he'd be trapped in a passive situation surrounded on all sides, making escape difficult.

Alice pursued relentlessly. Her slender sword trembled, shattering several massive ice spikes into countless ice needles that launched an all-around fierce assault on the leopard-man!

The dense ice needles were like small knives, whizzing whizz whizz, continuously striking at the leopard-man, trying to pierce him full of holes like a honeycomb!

The leopard-man's brows knitted tightly. He turned and opened his massive mouth full of fangs. "Haa!"

An even more ferocious qi storm erupted, the terrifying tearing force causing space itself to tremble slightly!

Such a large-scale martial technique, used continuously while already severely injured — this leopard-man was clearly no ordinary opponent. His qi reserves were unbelievably vast!

Alice's eyes widened in surprise. She raised her left arm and quickly formed a massive ice shield!

She vibrated her dragon wings, holding the ice shield, and forcibly pushed through the terrifying qi storm to close the distance to the leopard-man!

The ice shield shimmered with golden light, but under the qi storm's effect, it was continuously cracking bit by bit, on the verge of collapse at any moment!

Cold sweat trickled down the leopard-man's forehead. Why was the ice this woman created so hard?! Normally, ice created by regular mages could be easily shattered by my qi!

Relying on the secret technique of the Great Snow Mountain, the fused ice crystal produced by the combination of qi and magical power had extraordinary strength. It allowed Alice to successfully close in on the leopard-man just one second before the ice shield completely shattered.

"Put him down!" Alice shouted angrily. Her slender sword flicked upward, and silver light flashed instantly!

"What?!"

The leopard-man thought Alice was going to slit his throat with a single sword strike to kill him. But unexpectedly, her blade suddenly changed direction, slashing diagonally toward his heart!

His heart lurched in terror. The enemy's move was so profound — it was already too late to dodge in panic!

Alice's sword technique was extremely fast. A wrist vibration lifted the blade, barely grazing the leopard-man's wrist!

The sudden sharp pain made the leopard-man gasp sharply. His hand tendons must have been injured. He instinctively lost his grip on Blackman, and she fell.

Alice caught the female Blackman, feeling a slight sense of relief in her heart. As long as the demon couldn't be captured, the opponent's mysterious plan might not be able to proceed.

"Damn human!"

After all this effort, the result was nothing. Fire spewed from the leopard-man's furious eyes, his whiskers trembling as he kicked Alice, who was lost in thought.

"Cough!" Alice cried out in pain, falling from the sky with Blackman in her arms and crashing heavily onto the ground, dust billowing everywhere.

"Huh?! " Little Merlin ran over and asked, "Alice! Are you okay?!"

"Cough..." Alice coughed twice, got up from the ground, and wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth. "I'm fine. You just watch..."

Little Merlin frowned, seeing Alice's body swaying unsteadily. Clearly, she'd been kicked pretty hard. Was she really okay?

He looked down at Blackman's injuries. They were severe, with blood flowing nonstop!

Blackman was one of the tougher members of his subordinates, yet she'd been injured so badly in that storm? The opponent's strength was completely overwhelming Blackman!

"Hey! Blackman?! How are you?!"

"Your Majesty... I'm afraid... I won't make it. I won't be able to serve you anymore..." Blackman said weakly, on the verge of death.

"Pull yourself together! This kind of wound isn't anything!" Little Merlin shook Blackman, afraid she might faint.

"I have... one last regret..." Blackman's voice grew quieter and quieter.

"...What regret?" Little Merlin gripped Blackman's soft, tender little hand, his heart growing sentimental.

"I've never... with Your Majesty... had physical intimacy..." Blackman said with utmost seriousness, her eyelashes covered with tears of regret.

"Huh... Is that your regret?" Little Merlin's expression remained blank, but his face instantly darkened. He picked up a nearby brick and ruthlessly smacked it against Blackman's pretty face, using physical anesthesia to knock her unconscious.

"I see..."

"Then you should rest in peace quickly."

title: Chapter 50 — Counter-spray Update
content:
Chapter 50 — Counter-spray Update

Volume 21 · Chapter 50

Merlin took the opportunity while Alice was fighting that beastman to drag Helena over as well.

He looked at Helena and Blackman; seemingly nothing major, just that Blackman's injuries were a bit severe.

However, obviously the other party had no intention of killing Blackman, so it wasn't fatal.

Merlin wiped the sweat from his forehead, looking into the distance, thinking the next part was the most important issue.

"That beastman is very angry now, won't he fight to the death? I wonder if Alice can hold up..."

Alice came before the leopardman again, with blood traces at the corner of her mouth, "What are you Phoenixes planning? Actually thinking of striking against the demon race, have you suddenly seen the light and want to contribute to the world?"

"Has nothing to do with you, adventurer..." The leopardman's eyes were cold, his tone as if suppressing rage in his chest, "As a human adventurer, actually protecting two demons? Really opens my eyes, looks like you're inclined to join the dark guild..."

"Nonsense!" Alice frowned, explaining, "I'm just stopping you bastards from doing evil. I heard you Phoenixes claim to be the number one dark guild, surely you're plotting something?"

"No comment. I thought the only ones to watch out for in Britain were those purple-gold adventurers and the kingdom's retired old knights. Didn't expect to encounter someone like you..." The leopardman paused, then added, "The dragon aura on you makes me uncomfortable, but it's definitely not stronger than mine. If you want to live, hand over those two demons to me. I can disappear from here immediately."

"Think I'd believe that?" Alice raised her slender sword, the dragon aura becoming more fierce, strands of cold air forming into a divine eagle of a dragon.

"I didn't want to fight you, but you're not appreciating the situation, so I'll have to take you down!"

The leopardman's whole body veins bulged, tendons standing out on his forehead, looking like he was forcibly enduring immense pain!

His black fur turned bright red, the pressure of his realm suddenly surged, his strength seemingly making a huge leap in a short time!

All wounds on his body healed, even his arms were reborn, becoming more powerful than before!

With every breath, it could stir up violent storms, making people dare not approach easily!

Berserk! A skill innate to demihumans, at the cost of their sanity and body, entering a mode similar to frenzy, combat power gets a very strong boost.

Initially that Goblin Emperor also used this self-destructive skill, his strength indeed surged a lot, but his sanity was lost too, leaving only madness and slaughter.

But after this leopardman entered berserk mode, his scarlet eyes remained calm, his rationality and consciousness not affected too much?

The leopardman bared his sharp fangs, looking at Alice with fierce eyes, howling winds raging around, terrifying pressure ravaging everyone...

"I'll tear you into pieces..."

"..." Merlin couldn't open his eyes fully, thinking Berserk? Now Alice will be hard to deal with? After all she just surpassed Saint-tier not long ago...

"Dragonification--" Alice placed the slender sword horizontally before her, blue-white dragon scales trembling and wrapping her whole body.

Wind and snow intertwined, a massive cold current instantly swept across the entire Bristol Port, the temperature of the entire Manchester city dropped sharply, as if instantly entering winter!

Flying goose-feather snow rushed straight to the sky, making it hard to look directly at the huge figure at the center of the blizzard, towering and majestic, imposing without anger!

Powerful dragon wings stirred the blizzard aside, a beautiful and majestic Frost Holy Dragon appeared above the port, roaring at the berserk leopardman below!

The temperature got even colder, wind and snow continuing, Merlin's resistance wasn't as good as before, teeth chattering, he pulled his cloak tighter, hoping it would end soon.

The leopardman narrowed his eyes, the pressure from the dragon aura still made him feel waves of pressure, but he didn't retreat, as if charging head-on.

Only seeing it leap from the spot, the ground crushed beneath it, its figure like a cheetah, fast enough to only see a red afterimage!

The leopardman revealed its sharp claws, scratching fiercely at the Frost Holy Dragon's neck, claws and dragon scales colliding wildly, sparks flying brilliantly...

As the emperor of the dragon race, the Holy Dragon's scales have extremely high defense, able to resist most physical and magical attacks.

But under the berserk leopardman's claws, it didn't seem that effective, the sapphire-like dragon scales torn open hard, revealing the fragile flesh underneath!

The Frost Holy Dragon's eyes were furious, not giving in at all, vibrating its wings to turn in mid-air, using its thick dragon tail to strike back hard, hitting the leopardman's chest!

The berserk leopardman fell from the sky like a cannonball, smashing the ground into a huge pit, debris and dust shooting into the sky!

The Frost Holy Dragon pursued victoriously, inhaling a breath of cold air, white light glowing on its abdomen, gradually spreading to its neck, as if brewing something?

At this moment, the Frost Holy Dragon that Alice transformed into had strength surpassing Malygos, the cold brewing in its mouth more destructive than before!

The angry dust on the ground suddenly rippled, the berserk leopardman having anticipated the Frost Holy Dragon's pursuit, taking a stance on the ground, opening its bloody mouth toward the dragon in the sky.

The Frost Holy Dragon suddenly lowered its head, breathing a cold "Dragon Breath" at the berserk leopardman, the blazing light like a laser sweeping across the entire port!

The berserk leopardman "roared" angrily below, spraying a pale golden aura storm at the Frost Holy Dragon in the sky, its might not inferior to the Dragon Breath at all!

"Dragon Breath" and "Roar", two powerful forces collided violently in mid-air.

Space shook, the fragile port was destroyed in an instant, as if it would be flattened to the ground at any moment!

The Frost Holy Dragon and berserk leopardman's clash, looking like they were evenly matched in the short term, deadlocked there...

"Holy crap holy crap holy crap..." Merlin rolled on the ground, tightly grabbing a stone pillar, terrified of being blown away by the fierce blizzard-

"Stop showing off!"

On a pirate ship far from the port, several pirates were constantly moving the gold and silver treasures stolen from the Morgan Trading Company.

Suddenly a head full of snake hair was thrown up from the seawater, rolling on the deck.

Several pirates who didn't know what was going on, because they glanced at it inadvertently, all showed shocked expressions and turned into statues.

For a moment the pirates panicked, none daring to approach that hideous head full of snake hair....

At this time, Lochili climbed up from the sea onto the pirate ship, his whole body seeming exhausted and weary, face pale, wrapped in seaweed.

Fortunately Lochili lived on the sea since childhood, his swimming ability very good, otherwise over such a long distance, he would have died of exhaustion in the sea.

"Haah..."

Lochili panted heavily, seeing several of his subordinates turned to statues, slightly stunned.

Then he suddenly understood, just now that little brat, the one whose head the leopardman saw, was the reason he nearly got petrified, right?

Lochili dragged his tired body, staggering over, stumbling upon the head of Medusa, King of Chaos, suddenly laughing-

This... interesting, my eyes were poked by that little brat, already blurry, don't know if I can...

"Master! You're back?" Several pirates ran back, looking at Medusa's head in fear, not daring to approach, "What is that you're holding-?"

"Hmph, good stuff..." Lochili placed Medusa's head behind him, to prevent hurting his people.

"...." The pirate subordinates didn't dare ask more, but asked about the transaction, "That dark guild sir didn't come back with you?"

"Him? Yes..." Lochili slapped his forehead, having swum so long, almost died in the sea, forgot the most hateful thing-

"Don't talk so much crap!

"Raise our pirate flag!

"Then fire all cannons, aim at Bristol Port!"

"Today! I'll level this place! Not even ten people can walk out of the port alive!"

title: Chapter 51 — Bombardment
content:
Chapter 51 — Bombardment

Volume 21 · Chapter 51

A storm of battle energy erupted, mixed with a crackling force, roaring into the sky!

The frost breath caused the temperature around them to drop sharply below freezing, and the scorching light that passed through turned everything into eternal ice!

The port was in ruins, the ground shattered, and the sea surface froze into ice several hundred meters deep!

The berserk panther and the Frost Dragon exchanged blows, and the chaos at the center of the battlefield shook with the collision of their forces!

Little Merlin hid behind a large rock, shivering uncontrollably, wondering if it was over yet? I'm almost frozen to death!

Blackman and Helena lay on the ground, unaware of the chaos and cold outside.

The Frost Dragon, in the form of Alice, kept increasing its power, trying to use its breath to disperse the battle energy storm, but the opponent's strength was no less impressive. Although it seemed to be just a beast, its battle energy was no weaker than that of the dragons, and it was bottomless!

The berserk panther's eyes were sharp, and it seemed to have an endless source of power within its body. It could see that the Frost Dragon, though powerful, had unstable pressure, obviously having just surpassed the Saint-tier, and if it continued, the panther would eventually gain the upper hand!

Both had their own plans in mind, both wanting to defeat the other in a battle of strength. However, the panther encountered a problem at a critical moment—

Due to severe blood loss and then entering berserk mode, the panther's body was struggling, and its consciousness was becoming hazy, making it difficult to focus.

The faint golden battle energy storm it was spewing from its mouth suddenly showed signs of weakness, and a breach was made by the dragon's breath!

"Now!"

The Frost Dragon seized the opportunity, and the light of its frost breath intensified, like a dam breaking and releasing a flood, overwhelmingly pressing down.

The battle energy storm was dispersed, and the berserk panther was directly hit by the dragon's breath, finally causing the beast to emit painful growls.

"Ugh!"

After the dragon's breath dissipated, the berserk panther was frozen solid, its body stiff and its movements sluggish.

It felt as if its body was not responding to its will, and even a slight movement might cause the entire body to shatter!

The berserk panther realized its situation was dangerous and could not continue fighting the Frost Dragon. It had to escape quickly!

Thus, the phoenix pendant on the panther's chest lit up again, and a fire portal appeared, leading to an unknown area.

"Want to run? There's no door!" The Frost Dragon roared angrily, shaking its massive wings in the air, and its huge dragon horns were ready to crush the berserk panther to death right here!

However, at that moment, far away in the sea, a fleet of ships openly flew pirate flags, no longer hiding their identity, and launched a fierce bombardment on the ruined Bristow Port!

"Boom, boom, boom" the continuous cannon fire echoed, and the sea was soon filled with smoke. Under Lochi's command, the pirates carried out a carpet bombing on the port, wanting to turn it into a wasteland!

Numerous cannonballs rained down, emitting shrill screams. Such a large-scale bombardment almost instantly consumed all the black powder on the ships, obviously a way for Lochi to vent his anger over being deceived!

No! Merlin is still here, and his current body is very fragile, unable to withstand the cannonballs!

Damn it! I can only let go of this beast and protect Merlin!F novel

The Frost Dragon, in the form of Alice, gave a cold snort and suddenly turned in the air, heading towards the direction where Little Merlin and the others were hiding.

The berserk panther, frozen solid, slowly walked to the portal, turned back, and looked at the Frost Dragon in the distance, exhaling white breath.

"Wait for me, human adventurer. This is not the last time we see each other..."

After saying that, the berserk panther limped into the portal, and the rotating fire gradually shrank and finally disappeared.

The Frost Dragon landed on the ground, spread its massive wings, and then crouched over Little Merlin and the others, forming a physical shield.

Before Little Merlin could react to what was happening, the sky was filled with cannon fire, bombarding Bristow Port!

Ferocious flames rose to the heavens, the sea churned into giant waves, and the entire port was engulfed in the pirate ships' cannon fire, a sight of devastation!

The Frost Dragon, in the form of Alice, guarded Little Merlin with its body, as cannonballs continuously struck its body......

Far away, the pirate ships were quickly escaping, avoiding any possible pursuit by the Royal Navy.

Lochi put down his spyglass, his face as grim as ever, and the anger in his chest had not subsided.

He held the head of Medusa, the Queen of Chaos, and stared deeply at the land of Britannia—

I will not give up....

I must kill Elgin the Swordmaster!

Even if it means sacrificing myself, I will bring him down with me!

Fathers, watch and see, with this weak body, I can still topple the giant!

The residents of Manchesters were unaware of what was happening outside.

They only knew that the weather suddenly turned cold, entering an extremely low-temperature winter, and they all rushed indoors.

When the clouds outside cleared, they dared to step out of their houses, only to find that the world had become a snowy one.

Suddenly, the wisteria flags fluttered in the streets, and a knight squad led by Mesfield arrived from Lund.

The horses trotted through the snow, making movement slower, and the knights, seeing the strange weather, wondered what had happened. However, since most of the residents were safe, they took a slight sigh of relief.

The main force arrived at Bristow Port, and seeing the port in ruins, it looked like a dead zone.

The ground was covered with crater-like cannonball holes, looking dark and similar to the moon's surface.

Mesfield dismounted and took off his helmet, looking at the scene before him, and frowned deeply—

"What happened here?" Chapmann approached, feeling as if he had missed an exciting battle.

"We came too late... Mesfield said in a gloomy voice.

"Uh..."

Chapmann was stunned and continued, "It looks like that... but the pirates have already left, right?"

Mesfield looked at the empty port, where the ships had been overturned and sunk in the skirmish, and there was not even a shadow of a ship on the sea, "Here has been destroyed like this, obviously experiencing a fierce battle, and the forces of both sides do not seem weak. The sea... has either been eliminated or escaped."

"Is that so?"

Chapmann was in doubt, as there was too little information here, and the entire knight squad was kept in the dark.

"But who defeated the pirates? Is there any witness here?"

Mesfield lowered his head and thought.

"There shouldn't be any witnesses, right? The weather changed suddenly, and everyone hid...." Chapmann hesitated and then added, "It's not... Elgin the Swordmaster, is it?"

Mesfield's face darkened, and he immediately stared at Chapmann's eyes, as hearing the name of Elgin the Swordmaster made him feel uneasy.

"That... I'm just guessing, haha...." Chapmann sweated cold, scratching his head and laughing nervously, realizing he had said something wrong and should not have mentioned Elgin the Swordmaster in front of Mesfield.

Mesfield's delicate eyebrows were tightly knotted on his forehead, his head lowered, and he thought silently—

Demons have been active in the kingdom, and it is possible that they have clashed with the pirates here.

Could it be that the demons, who were here not long ago, fought with the pirates?

The child and the demons have an unusual relationship, and it seems that he also likes Elgin the Swordmaster?

There's a feeling that Elgin the Swordmaster is not a human, and his identity is worth suspicion...

title: Chapter 52 — Bitter Water (Extra)
content:
Chapter 52 — Bitter Water (Extra)

Volume 21 · Chapter 52

Night fell. A small donkey-drawn carriage was leaving the bottom of Manchesters.

Four people were in the car: Alice, little Merlin, Blackman, and Helena.

Helena had already woken up, holding little Merlin on her lap, bowing her head in silence, feeling that she had caused quite a bit of trouble.

Blackman had restored his male form, his tall body hunched on the carriage, clearly uncomfortable, his head hitting the carriage canopy. He kept grinning at Alice.

Little Merlin had a serious expression, sitting obediently on Helena's thigh, his head pressing against Helena's chest. It looked proper, but his heart was full of absurdity.

Alice sat upright on the three demons, hands on her hips, scrutinizing them with a blank expression.

Inside the carriage, the three demons were gathered together, only Alice—a human—making her want to say something fierce, but she felt tremendous pressure.

What to do? Only I am human, in a three-against-one situation, I have no advantage at all!

And what is Merlin doing, this freeloader! Don't seriously take advantage of Helena! Do I not exist?

Alice watched little Merlin staring at Helena's ample chest, her heart sour, but she didn't dare openly rebuke him, fearing it would reveal her jealousy.

"Cough!" Alice lightly coughed, breaking the oppressive atmosphere inside the donkey carriage.

Blackman shivered all over and hurriedly began his statement, "It's all the Emperor's forcing me to do this! I knew nothing! I was just doing the whole time playing the fall guy!"

"Blackman! You wallflower! Alice hadn't asked anything yet! You just sold me out like that?" Little Merlin was so angry his eyes were rolling white, his head trembling against Helena's chest.

"Your Majesty, I am an upright demon." Blackman clutched his chest, speaking with a serious face.

"Who would believe that!" Little Merlin bared his little tiger teeth, speaking ferociously, "When this matter is over, you must obediently roll back to the Demon Lord Palace, I will definitely not keep such a subordinate by my side!"

".... But I still need to assist the Emperor in establishing a demon race foothold on human territory, which relates to the great cause of the demon race reappearing its former glory, I must stay!" Blackman spoke with great seriousness.

"? ? ?" Alice furrowed her brow, her mind full of question marks, thinking what chaotic mess is this? Merlin wasn't fired long ago? What magic empire foothold? This guy besides liking to run around with a group of old rascals, or using his body's pocket money to buy horse racing lottery tickets, seems to have never done anything serious!

"Shut up! Such a thing doesn't exist!" Little Merlin grumbled, thinking Blackman's demon identity had already been exposed, so many people had seen its face, probably can't continue staying in the Kingdom of Britain.

"Puff.... Blackman this three-meter-tall strongman, actually in front of Merlin girlishly poked up his little finger, sadly saying, "Your Majesty is so cruel, after playing with me you want to abandon me, I'm so pitiful...."

"? ? ?" Alice's expression became strange, looking at Merlin's eyes were wrong, what unforgivable things happened during these days when I wasn't here?

"Just letting you take a few black pots, right? Don't say it so as to cause misunderstandings!" Little Merlin hurriedly explained, afraid of being thought to have some weird preference.

"Enough, be quiet a bit.... Alice's face was black, really unable to endure them, rubbing her slightly painful forehead.

"I basically also understand the course of things, you guys to rescue Helena, along the way causing trouble, right?"

"Not at all.... Little Merlin waved his hand, emphasizing, "This isn't called causing trouble everywhere, but punishing those with guilty hearts, we killed are not thieves, just pirates, please don't randomly throw dirty water, thank you."

"Blake Road was ruined into a mess, the Bristol port of Manchesters was flattened, actually all related to you, right?" Alice coldly said.

"...." A few black lines fell from Little Merlin's forehead, speechless.

"I estimate the knight team has already arrived at the port, luckily we ran fast, otherwise it wouldn't be easy to leave." Alice sighed, full of resentment saying, "You demons really know how to cause trouble, you know you gathering together won't have any good things, I can trust Merlin, doesn't mean I can trust other demons, if I could choose again, I wouldn't interfere in the demons' affairs, hum!"

Blackman scratched his head, speaking with an apologetic tone, "This time indeed added a small trouble for Miss Alice, I apologize.

"After your injuries heal, you leave my home, understand? I don't want to be watched by the Holy Church because there's a demon fugitive hiding at home." Alice said seriously.

.... Blackman let out a wail from his throat, thinking why everyone has to drive him away? After taking the black pot, he has to pack up and leave, this is discarding the donkey after the millstone is worn out!

"Miss Alice, don't blame others, this time's matter all started because of one person, I am willing to take full responsibility." Helena had been silent for a while, suddenly shouldering all the black pots.

"Miss Helena, this isn't your problem, completely human..." Blackman wanted to say something but stopped.

"It's fine, if I were more decisive, directly killing that group of thieves, maybe it wouldn't have turned out this way." Helena said, head not lifting.

"No one is asking you to take any responsibility, I just dislike Merlin almost dying for you, he is now very fragile, easily encountering danger, must stay by my side." Alice said very firmly.

"Alice, I have nothing.... Little Merlin had big sweat droplets falling from his forehead.

Helena felt dissatisfied in her heart, Merlin is actually the demon race's seven monarchs, why must he be left beside a human woman, this is too confident.

However, Helena didn't want to argue, but lowered her head looking at little Merlin below her chest, showing a puzzled and concerned expression.

"Speaking of it, even Lucifer His Majesty became a child... truly unexpected, why is this?"

"This.... it's a long story, just think I ate wrong medicine.... Little Merlin wanted to say something but stopped.

"I don't know what's happening on Your body, if I knew you became a child, I wouldn't have sought your help.... Helena lowered her head, silently hugging little Merlin, affectionately looking at him.

"Tch! How long are you going to hug? Now Merlin needs to be by my side, I can protect him." Alice's vinegar sentiment rising really couldn't stand Helena's ladylike attack, she couldn't help standing up and picking up little Merlin.

"Why are you sour?" Little Merlin meaningfully pursed his mouth.

".... Sour! I.... I am being angered by you!" Alice's stomach sour water, couldn't help muttering, "Running away from home without saying anything, I thought you were arrested, you know? Why not tell me the ins and outs? Don't you know your current state is very bad? Truly, you don't put me as your own person? You are a magic king who was fired, still thinking of going back, huh?"

After listening, Little Merlin's head was big, blinking big Camel eyes, acting cute, "I don't know anything, people are still a child wailing~"

"Ah? You still know how to act like a baby to sell cute! ?" Alice's forehead veins jumped.

"Eh heh~*" Little Merlin stuck out his tongue, trying to bluff over.

"You still play tricks! ?"

Alice gritting her teeth in anger, very wanting to teach Merlin a lesson, let him know he did wrong things.

But seeing Merlin's small appearance, Alice's stomach anger like a deflated ball, just couldn't vent out.

Alice glared and sat down, letting little Merlin sit on her thigh in the same way, also pressing a fake chest on his head, like confronting the opposite Helena?

"Really hateful, just knowing how to bluff, don't think every time can succeed, I'm not that kind of soft person, if I get angry... really..."

"Tch spitting.... Little Merlin rolled his eyes, lifting his eyelids, looking at the fake chest pressing on his head Alice-

title: Chapter 53 — Female slave
content:
Chapter 53 — Female slave

Volume 21 · Chapter 53

Helena looked at little Merlin sitting in Alice's arms, feeling deeply uncomfortable in her heart.

After all, three of the four on the donkey cart were demons, and only Alice was human.

How could a human be so close to a demon race monarch? This was far too abnormal!

But Helena didn't say much more, since Alice's strength was indeed formidable enough now. She was no longer at the Saint-tier from their first meeting; even Helena herself probably couldn't be her match.

Helena was puzzled in her heart, wondering if Alice had been eating fertilizer or something, why her strength had improved so rapidly? In just a few short months, she had stepped into a realm unknown to Helena.

Alice held little Merlin and grumbled indignantly, "This time I'll reluctantly forgive you, but next time you won't get off so easily. Remember this, hmph~!"

"..." Little Merlin gave a nervous laugh and explained, "After all, this is demon race business. If you get involved, it's a bit awkward, isn't it?"

"Who wants to deal with your demon affairs? ..." A pair of red blushes appeared on Alice's cheeks, her voice growing quieter. "I was just worried you might be in danger."

"Huh? What did you say?" Little Merlin furrowed his brows, not having heard clearly.

"...Nothing!" Alice awkwardly covered it up and said, "If you hadn't suddenly turned into a child, I wouldn't have bothered to meddle in someone else's affairs, tch!"

"..." Little Merlin looked at his own tender little hands. He couldn't even lift a sword now, and his heart grew heavy. I've already drunk half of the antidotes that Ceres gave me. I wonder if I can recover after finishing the last few bottles. That old woman better not have given me fake medicine, or I'll truly be hopeless...

Helena's gaze was deep as she stared at Alice across from her, thinking that Lucifer, as the demon race monarch, would absolutely not violate racial taboos and marry a human. This human woman was probably just a cover for his demon identity. His Majesty Lucifer was a man of great vision and ambition; he must be secretly plotting some grand plan behind closed doors, working hard for the revival of the demon race. Yes! It must be like that, for sure!

Blackman noticed the strange smile on Helena's face and wondered what she was thinking about in her heart.

"Miss Helena, what are you smiling about?"

"Huh?!" Helena came back to her senses. Thinking that Alice was merely a pawn of the demon race, she felt much better, so she covered it up and said, "Nothing. I'm just feeling lucky to have escaped death."

"Oh~" Blackman nodded in agreement and asked curiously, "By the way, Miss Helena, you belong to the Fourth Demon Lord Palace, right?"

"That's correct. Is there a problem?" Helena raised her head in confusion.

"Hehe, your master Asmodeus is quite the focal point in the demon race. With that breathtaking beauty and that dignified, noble temperament, every movement is so... beautiful..." Blackman showed an envious expression and said yearningly, "To be honest, I really want to learn from His Majesty Asmodeus's strengths and become more eye-catching~"

"..." Black lines dripped from little Merlin's forehead. He thought Blackman's motives were impure. He didn't want to learn cross-dressing at all! He simply envied the fact that Asmodeus always captivated a large number of men, didn't he!?

"Asmodeus..." Alice, this former Hero, knew the names of the Demon Lords fairly well. She lowered her head and asked, "Merlin, is she the only female Demon Lord among you?"

"No... don't ask. I'd rather not bring her up..." Little Merlin said evasively, since the black history of once being moved to propose to her was still vivid in his mind. It was best not to have too much contact with that person!

"Miss Helena is so beautiful; I imagine it's because of the influence of your master, right?" Blackman asked curiously.

"This..." Helena hesitated. In truth, the subordinates of the Fourth Demon Lord Palace had quite a few objections to Asmodeus's male-body cross-dressing appearance, feeling it brought shame to the Demon Lords and such.

"Shut up, Blackman. You really have no sense of the atmosphere. If you're so yearning, why not just pack your things and go to the Fourth Demon Lord Palace?" Little Merlin rolled his eyes, wondering if even his subordinates couldn't be kept by a boss with such "leadership charm."

"...I didn't mean that..." Blackman scratched his head awkwardly.

Alice looked at Helena across from her and suddenly remembered something important. She lowered her head and asked seriously, "Merlin, that slave contract is still in your stomach, right? We need to find a way to get it out!"

"Right~" Little Merlin remembered the piece of cowhide paper he had hastily swallowed. "That's Helena's slave contract. I must find a way to spit it out, otherwise Helena will become my slave..."

"Huh!?" Helena's eyes widened. She was completely unaware of this, but after a moment's thought, she understood—certainly those despicable humans had done something to her.

"Don't panic. I will definitely find a way to get it out. I won't let you truly become my slave, otherwise I'd have a hard time explaining to Asmodeus." Little Merlin said seriously. He had no such twisted interests, of course he wouldn't use this slave contract to force Helena to do strange things. "But I don't feel any urge to vomit right now. It might take some effort to get that cowhide paper out."

Helena lowered her head, and her face suddenly turned red. Her posture became stiff, as if she had something on her mind.

...To become His Majesty Lucifer's slave? It doesn't feel like a bad thing at all...

What did a female slave need to do? Take care of the master's daily meals and起居, and also... warm the bed?

Helena lowered her head in shame. Although "slave" wasn't exactly a prestigious title, being the slave of the demon race's youngest monarch didn't seem so unpleasant after all.

"Then... if things can't be reversed, it's not impossible for me to become your slave. I need to explain the situation to my lord and hope... that you can be gentle..."

Little Merlin looked at Helena's shy and timid expression, his astonished face freezing in place. He felt the other party had misunderstood something.

What was going on? A normal person would be angry upon becoming a slave, right?

Why was she blushing with a hint of anticipation? I'm not that kind of person!

Little Merlin quickly shook his head. He didn't want any slave following him, and he said seriously, "No, Helena, calm down. I don't need any slave at all..."

"But..." Helena was conflicted and said in a low voice, "Whoever holds my slave contract is my new master. To survive, there are some things I can't resist."

"Uh!"

Alice's expression darkened. Seeing Helena's attitude, it seemed she was eager to take the top position, completely disregarding Alice.

No way! Alice absolutely couldn't let Merlin have a female slave. That guy who appeared proper on the surface—who knew what evil things he'd do with a beautiful female slave?

So Alice suddenly stood up from her chair with a "whoosh," grabbed little Merlin's ankle, and turned him upside down, shaking him like he was pulling a radish—

"Merlin! Quick!"

"Spit it out already!"

Little Merlin's head tilted down, his ankle grabbed by Alice, the yellow-headed feeling a bit dizzy, he couldn't help but repeatedly call for a stop— "Alice! Calm down a bit! This way you can't spit it out..." "What can't be spat out? How you ate it, you spit it out that way, you wouldn't be moved just because you could have a female slave, right?!" Little Merlin rubbed his chin, face darkened, seriously said, "I think... maybe wait until I defecate and see if I can pull it out, it should be in my stomach, it will definitely come out..." The desert country far from Britain, the Ptolemaic Dynasty. Although this kingdom's territory is vast, almost all of it lies within the desert. Howling winds and yellow sand fill the air, whipping up terrifying sandstorms. A huge blazing sun hangs in the sky, the scorching heat makes one feel parched, as if the sun here is larger than anywhere else. In a certain mysterious unknown region of this desert country, there stands a strange tower-like structure. Overall it shows a crimson hue, occasionally flames erupt from the top, making it look like a monster's nest. This is the headquarters of the strongest dark guild, Phoenix, hidden in the remote desert, ordinary people find it hard to discover them. The reason it's called the strongest dark guild is because their overall strength surpasses all peers, even comparable to any powerful organization in history. Once the fierce demon god praised for daring to oppose a nation, even at its peak could not match today's Phoenix, only to be hung up and beaten. Each member is a renowned figure; pulling out any one can shake the outside world, and their background and strength are unfathomable. The man leading this organization is hailed as the human closest to God, his origins unknown yet mysterious, practicing the ultimate magic of ancient civilizations, the guild is named after him. Phoenix, the mythical immortal bird that can be reborn infinitely in flames, seems to foretell that this guild will stand firm in the eternal torrent of time. At this moment outside the spire, a woman wearing black leather clothing, tight-fitting attire with a fiery, alluring figure, stands outside, seemingly waiting for someone to return? She is gorgeous, her eyes flashing with a seductive air, a mass of pink hair flowing behind her back, with two strangely shaped dual swords strapped to her back. No matter how fierce the wind and sand, one cannot approach her vicinity; she seems to have an independent aura, like a shield isolating everything outside. This alluring woman is called Hesi, a member of Phoenix, her identity mysterious and unknown to anyone. Suddenly, rotating flames appeared in the sky, faintly forming a phoenix cluster, the portal opened—. The leopard man who fought Alice slowly walked out from within, his expression somewhat fatigued. This journey left him feeling exhausted; even a strong half-beast could barely cope, let alone repeatedly encountering troublesome foes. "You finally returned? I've been waiting for you here for a long time, Sarret...." Hesi said with a half-smile. "Was it the chief who sent you to pick me up?" asked the leopard man named Sarret. "Exactly, he thought you'd be back soon, I've waited three days and three nights here, you really know how to dawdle...." Hesi's face showed a hint of dissatisfaction. "Sorry, this operation didn't go smoothly; I ran into too many troublesome guys, wasting too much time." Sarret said helplessly. "How come you came back alone? Why didn't you bring back any elite demons?" Hesi sized up Sarret, asking quietly, "You didn't fail the mission, did you?" Sarret thought it over, feeling he had no good excuse, and sighed, "That's right, I failed. Everything was going smoothly at first, then adventurers showed up and messed things up, I had no choice but to give up." "Really useless, ha...." Hesi couldn't help but laugh. "..."... Sarret frowned, his whiskers trembling, revealing a few fangs, "So many unexpected things happened; even if you couldn't handle it, I was petrified by something with snake hair, could only sever my own arm, leading to serious injury, then a human adventurer who could turn into a dragon fought me, my body can't take it anymore; if I were at my peak, none of this would be a problem, but that thing that could petrify me is too weird...0)了SFZ小治" "Ha...." Hesi gave a dry laugh, casually saying, "I'm not the one you vent your grievances to; I have no interest in your experiences, don't explain to me, explain it to the chief...." "I know, I'll personally explain the reason to the chief." Sarret couldn't be bothered to look at the woman posing and primping before him, basically unable to communicate. "You should be glad, Phoenix isn't a leader who kills indiscriminately but a wise ruler; if failing a mission were placed in other dark guilds, your fate would only be a dead end." Hesi said meaningfully, implying Sarret had picked up a lifeline. "If Phoenix were a lunatic, I wouldn't have left my homeland to follow him." Sarret paused, then continued, "I'm a beastman; by instinct I wouldn't trust humans, but the chief is an exception, he deserves my lofty head held high underground...."
