content:
Chapter 9 — Marriageable Age (Bonus Update)

Volume 22 · Chapter 9

“Little brother, what's your name?” The black-haired demon maiden poked young Merlin's cheek with her finger.

"Don't just go touching him like that, haven't you noticed he's shy?" The red-haired demon maiden said with a smile.

"… Little Merlin sat with a stern expression, but his eyes were filled with nothing but bare flesh, and he was about to faint."

"He really is a cool and aloof little brother, refusing to talk with his big sisters at all," the black-haired demon maiden said, growing even more interested in Merlin. It seemed a child had suddenly appeared, which was far more interesting than those old human men.

"Could it be because he's too nervous? Would you like a glass of milk?" the red-haired demon maiden said as she walked over.

Young Merlin knitted his brows together, thinking that in the demon race, openly harassing one's lord like this would earn you a thoroughly beaten rear!

"Excuse me, allow me to interrupt… Helen suddenly pushed open the door and walked in. Seeing Hobbs and Price bowing slightly, she said, "It's been a while since the two of you last came. Don't tell me you've mistaken me for a demon and think I'll eat you?"

"Absolutely not!" Hobbs stood up from the sofa and hurriedly approached, grabbing Helen's hand. "In my eyes, your beauty rivals the stars. How could I ever suspect you're a demon? I'm always on your side."

"… I see…" A few drops of cold sweat trickled down Helen's forehead, and she frowned deeply from the alcohol breath coming off Hobbs.

"That's right! From the very beginning, I never once suspected you. Let me see who dares to slander you, Miss Helen — I'll throw them in the dungeon to cool their heads!" Price also crowded over, grabbing Helen's other hand. "You know, you haven't scolded me in such a long time. I can still recall the look of disdain you used to give me. Ah~ feels so good~"

… Helen's awkward smile froze on her face as she pulled her hands free. "Thank you for your kindness, gentlemen. I hope you'll visit often in the future. However, we don't allow children here."

"Huh? That's Merlin's little nephew. He's curious about this place, so we brought him along to broaden his horizons~" Hobbs said cheerfully.

"That's right. This child, just like Merlin, has ambition but no courage. We're teaching him how to become a real man~" Price said with a straight face.

"Merlin's… little nephew?"

Helen glanced at young Merlin, who looked like a victim, and her expression turned strange. She realized not everyone knew about Merlin shrinking.

What were these foolish humans doing? Bringing the demon race's monarch to revel with drinks in the demon race's own den?

If not for the fact that the two fools still had value to squeeze out of them, the sisters would have already pounced on them and eaten them down to the bones…

Helen composed herself, walked over, picked up young Merlin, and said with a serious expression, "Even so, children aren't allowed here. You two have fun; I'll take him home."

Hobbs and Price exchanged a puzzled glance, feeling that Helen was acting strangely today.

In truth, Helen didn't take young Merlin home — she went straight to the secret basement to see Asmodeus.

Young Merlin sat on a chair, his tiny body unable to reach the floor with his feet dangling and swinging.

On the screen, Asmodeus sat upon her throne, looking at young Merlin. The originally serious atmosphere suddenly broke into laughter.

"Pfft hahaha…"

"Hey! Did I take the wrong medicine or what's so funny about this?" Young Merlin bared his baby teeth and lashed out helplessly at Asmodeus on the screen. "I absolutely hate this body right now! I spent over 200 years barely making it to adulthood, only to end up like this! And instead of offering a few comforting words, you're laughing at me?!"

"I'm sorry, I didn't expect you'd end up like this too. Actually, your current appearance isn't bad — at least it can win the favor of elderly people, doesn't it?" Asmodeus covered her mouth with her fan.

"Shut up, stupid…!" Young Merlin's face darkened. He really didn't want other Demon Lords to see him — who knew how much more they'd mock him.

"I'm being serious. Although you can't debut alongside me now as a demon idol, you could totally go solo…" Asmodeus's eyes curved into slits as she said carelessly, "Become an idol for middle-aged and elderly women. They have zero resistance to a kid like you, haha…"

"Asmodeus, when I recover, I will definitely press you to the ground and rub it in…" Young Merlin's face turned green, a vein throbbing on his forehead.

"Cough, cough!" Asmodeus lightly cleared her throat to cover her embarrassment and put on a serious expression. "Let's talk business. I already know about everything that's happened lately. Helen's affair has caused you quite a lot of trouble. But those despicable humans made her owe a slave contract to you, and you ate her, right?"

"… That's right…" young Merlin answered casually.

"The contract?" Asmodeus pressed.

"It hasn't come out. I've been to the bathroom many times already…" Young Merlin shrugged helplessly. "I simply can't pass it."

Behind him, Helen looked up, her eyes flickering. She was probably wondering what he was thinking — likely worried because her life was now in someone else's hands.

"You're not… planning to keep my subordinate because she's beautiful and you've developed a desire to seize her, are you? Let me say this upfront…" Asmodeus paused and said seriously, "I don't have many subordinates. Helen is one of my most favored…"

"I know. I have no intention of taking what belongs to others. Besides…" Young Merlin trailed off, thinking that Helen wasn't as beautiful as Asmodeus anyway, so there was no need for him to covet her. It was only natural to move forward when the opportunity presented itself.

"I figured you'd say that. After all, you have seven outstanding subordinates — no need to poach mine," Asmodeus said with a smile.

"Huh? They're either insane or outright crazy. Even if I gave them to you for free, you wouldn't take them…" Young Merlin's head throbbed just thinking about his own subordinates.

"……" A bead of sweat the size of a fist rolled down Asmodeus's forehead. She had at least heard rumors about the Seven Great Demons of the First Demon Lord Palace. "But if you can't produce Helen's slave contract, I'll be in a difficult position as well."

"What should we do then? Do you have a solution?" Young Merlin looked up and asked tentatively.

"Or I could just slice open your belly and search carefully. We'll definitely find it — whatever you've eaten will never simply disappear into thin air," Asmodeus said meaningfully.

"You're kidding, right?" Young Merlin was dumbfounded. Search for a slave contract by dissecting himself?

"But you hold the lives of my subordinates in your hands. I can't just sit idly by regarding this matter," Asmodeus said expressionlessly.

"So what do you intend to do?" Young Merlin asked, looking at Asmodeus on the screen.

"Now, you're technically an adult demon as well. You've reached marriageable age, and normal demons all find their beloved…" Asmodeus's eyes flickered repeatedly, then she narrowed them like a fox. "What do you think of my subordinate Helen?"

"Do you think she has what it takes to become the mistress of the First Demon Lord Palace?"

title: Chapter 10 — Secret Room Dispute
content:
Chapter 10 — Secret Room Dispute

Volume 22 · Chapter 10

"What did you say?" Little Merlin furrowed his brows, unsure of what Maxisfield was plotting in his heart.

"You're alone now anyway, so why not take this opportunity to form an alliance between our two Demon Lord Palaces and deepen our friendship? Wouldn't that be wonderful?" Asmodeus said without expression, his tone very serious.

Helena suddenly heard her master intending to dominate her marriage, and her heart trembled uncontrollably. She abruptly raised her head to look at Maxisfield on the screen.

Asmodeus had never discussed this matter with Helena before. She knew nothing about it and was left completely blank by the sudden conversation!

Helena silently gripped the hem of her skirt, crumpling it tightly. Her feelings were extremely complicated at the moment, like a tangled mess that was hard to unravel.

"Is there something wrong with your brain today? What kind of joke is this?" Little Merlin couldn't understand Asmodeus. Why would someone who indulged in cross-dressing every day think about such matters?

"Lucifer, we've known each other long enough. Do I look like I'm joking?" Asmodeus closed the fan in his hand and said faintly, "Helena is my most trusted subordinate, from a prestigious noble family with deep roots, a pureblooded fallen angel. Becoming the mistress of the First Demon Lord Palace, standing by your side to assist you, should pose no problem, right? Among the demon race, it's hard to find a woman more suitable for you than Helena. From now on, we join forces and increase our voice in the Elder Council."

"...Little Merlin gave a nervous laugh, feeling as though Asmodeus were forcing demands upon him, and decisively said, 'I refuse.'"

Helena's slender body trembled. She didn't dare to interject in this situation, but a trace of melancholy showed between her brows.

"Why?" Asmodeus's expression suddenly darkened. "What are you afraid of?"

"No reason. I cannot accept your suggestion." Little Merlin hopped off the chair, his expression also growing unfriendly. "Asmodeus, are you kidnapping me with Helena's slave contract? Don't play these tricks in front of me — it looks too ugly!"

"Oh?" Asmodeus narrowed his eyes and said coldly, "But what if you control the life of my beloved subordinate? I won't let this go so easily."

"It's just a contract. If I have no ill intentions toward Helena, there would be no problem at all. Just treat it as a piece of wasted paper here, wouldn't that work?" Little Merlin stared at the beautiful figure on the screen and said meaningfully, "Asmodeus, you're being a bit too aggressive today, ah..."

"Oh, I see. So that's how it is... Beelzebub was telling the truth..." Asmodeus's gaze at Merlin grew increasingly strange.

"What? Did Beelzebub say something to you after he returned?" Little Merlin became alert.

"Hephraze expressed it quite tactfully, but I still pieced it together..." Asmodeus paused and said with deep meaning, "The reason you refuse to accept Helena is because you violated the taboo of the demon race."

"What?" Little Merlin's brows drew tight on his forehead.

"You've fallen in love with a human... that fake wife of yours..." Asmodeus took a deep breath, growing more convinced of his answer.

"At first I thought you were just playing around and didn't take it seriously, but after hearing Beelzebub's account of you and that human, I felt something was off. Now I can be certain — you've fallen in love with a human woman!"

"Uh!" Helena was truly stunned for a moment, looking at Merlin with disbelief. She had always thought Lucifer was the youngest and most promising ruler in the demon race, and that a human wife was merely to cover his Demon Lord identity. She never expected it would become real. A Demon Lord falling in love with a human — this had actually happened. Interspecies union was a taboo since ancient times among the demon race, and violators would be sent to the guillotine, even if they were a demon king....

Little Merlin fell silent for a moment, turned, and walked away. "Nonsense..."

"What are you still covering up? Do you think I'm just some perky loser like Beelzebub?" Asmodeus couldn't help but sneer. "A great king of the demon race, in love with a human two-legs. Haha, what a ridiculous thing! Once the youngest Demon Lord in demon history, crowned in glory, but now you're the entire demon race's shame and joke!"

Little Merlin's face darkened with anger, a trace of scarlet faintly surging in his eyes. The usually careless Merlin had actually been provoked by Asmodeus?

His eyelid twitched violently, his mouth twitched ceaselessly, steam seemed to rise from his head, and he pointed his finger at Asmodeus on the screen.

"This is all your speculation, with zero evidence. Your rudeness has made me utterly lose patience. From now on, I don't want to meet with you privately again. Goodbye!"

....Helena's expression grew anxious. She really wanted to step forward and say something, but the quarrel between the two Demon Lords made her dare not speak up.

Asmodeus watched Little Merlin's stubborn retreating back, seeing him about to leave the secret chamber, and couldn't help but say in a deep voice, "A hopeless fellow. I'm saving you! It's not too late to turn back now! By the time the old fossils in the council find out, it'll be too late! Take my advice — don't continue down this wrong path. Kill that human woman and end the source of all mistakes!"

Little Merlin suddenly stopped, turned his head, and said carelessly, "I haven't been a Demon Lord for ages. I'm just an adventurer hiding among the commoners now. The demon race? What does it have to do with me?"

Helena's eyes widened, her face filled with shock. Apparently stunned by Merlin's words, the towering and noble image of the arrogant king in her heart crumbled in this moment.

"My friend, you can't escape. From the moment you were born into the demon race, you couldn't change that fact..." Asmodeus said softly, watching Little Merlin stubbornly depart.

The secret chamber fell silent. After hesitating repeatedly, Helena finally couldn't help herself and raised her head to ask, "Master, Your Majesty Lucifer...."

"If he persists, there will be no good ending for him." Asmodeus sighed and closed his eyes. "I'm sorry, Helena. I used you earlier to test Lucifer without consulting you."

"I-it's okay...." Helena lowered her head, knowing that at the moment she was rejected, she felt something indescribable inside her heart.

"I initially only suspected him. I didn't expect my guesses would all turn out true in the end." Asmodeus said with his eyes closed, his tone unreadable. "I should have kept him away from humans from the start. Still, he exceeded my expectations. He's still too young...."

"W-what should we do next? Notify the Elder Council to make a judgment?" Helena asked tentatively.

"That would be the worst choice." Asmodeus paused, opened his eyes, and his gaze grew profound, as if gazing into the distance.

"If everything is beyond repair, then we might very well...."

"Forget it. I need to think this over properly. If possible, I don't hope he becomes the first Demon Lord in history to be sent to the guillotine."

title: Chapter 11 — The title "Elkin the Little Swordmaster"
content:
Chapter 11 — The title "Elkin the Little Swordmaster"

Volume 22 · Chapter 11

At home, silence reigned, broken only by the ticking of the clock.

Alice's eyes were bloodshot, staring fixedly at the passing time. When the minute hand hit 6, she felt awful.

Alice lowered her head, her expression shifting constantly, growing increasingly uneasy.

Thirty minutes...

Merlin had been gone for thirty minutes and still hadn't returned!

Merlin... this guy didn't tell Helen the truth, and instead something indescribable is happening?!

It's my fault, I shouldn't have let him go alone. If I had been there, those flashy little fairies wouldn't have dared to come near!

Alice's body began to sway, feeling a bit dizzy, and couldn't help but start fantasizing—

Merlin: "From now on, you'll be my slave. I'm going to do very evil things to you, hiahiahiahia~"

Helen: "Ah~ Don't do that, Lord Merlin, you're so bad~"

"Slap," Alice slapped her own forehead hard, shaking off the weird mental image.

"No, absolutely cannot become like this, I have to stop...

Alice's gaze hardened. She walked to the wall, picked up her slender sword, and strode out the door, determined to pull "troubled" little Merlin back.

But just as she opened the door, she saw a man in a blue leather jacket with a pointed hat on his head, carrying a messenger bag, seemingly just arrived, and he froze when he saw Alice.

"Ah... Alice-san?"

"Ah? I...", Alice nodded, thinking: mailman? Did something get sent to me?

"There is a letter here, I hope you'll sign for it." The mailman took out a letter from his backpack and handed it to Alice.

Alice took the letter, examined it carefully, then frowned--

From the United Kingdom?

That's not a place where non-humans gather. Who would write to me?

Little Merlin walked out of the secret room alone, his expression far from calm, rather grave.

Damn it, has Asmodeus seen through something?

Beelzebub with his big mouth,果然 couldn't keep any secrets.

He kept saying he wouldn't tell anyone, but after chatting privately with Asmodeus he spilled everything...

What to do? If he quarreled with Asmodeus, wouldn't this guy blab it to the Elder Council in a fit of pique?

That would be troublesome. If the Elder Council determined I violated demonic taboos, they wouldn't go easy on me, and even Alice would be in danger.

Although Alice is quite strong now, fighting against demons is still unrealistic.

If things got out of control, I'd probably have to go back to the Demon Lord Palace alone to face the Elder Council's judgment to ensure Alice's safety.

Little Merlin looked at his childish hands, feeling the situation was even more dire. With his abilities, what could he use to face the Elder Council? Even ordinary demons could pin him down and rub him in the dirt.

He hated this child's body with a passion, unable to do anything about anything, having to rely on others to protect him.

I wonder if any of his former subordinates would still follow him after the Elder Council confirmed their judgment?

Fortunately, the antidote to the time-reversal potion had two bottles left. After drinking them all, could he recover? Hopefully the old witch Circe hadn't tricked him...

Little Merlin sighed deeply. The taste of not being able to control his own life was truly awful.

For the first time in his life, he felt that a curse threatening his life wasn't such a bad thing...

"Ah! It's the golden-haired brother!" Suddenly a childish voice rang out.

"Hm?" Little Merlin turned back in surprise, seeing five or six-year-old Mimi blinking her big eyes at him. He immediately threw Hobbs aside, "Tch! What's wrong? Looking for your dad? Your dad is playing at the pleasure house..."

"Nonsense!" Mimi retorted, pouting. "That's not playing. Dad said the sisters inside aren't feeling well and need regular massage therapy. Dad is doing a good deed!"

Little Merlin was stunned, then rolled his eyes. He thought: only a kid like you would believe that crap!

Speaking of which, this old rogue Hobbs used such shameless reasons to fool his own daughter. Isn't he afraid of his wife killing him when the scandal breaks out?

Seeing Mimi's silly expression, Little Merlin didn't bother with the kid and waved his hand. "..."

"Never mind, I have things to do. Play by yourself, don't bother me.

"Wait!" Mimi suddenly blocked Merlin's path, saying seriously, "I'm holding a gathering here.

"It's just kids playing house anyway, right? Move aside, I don't have time to play with you..." Merlin said pompously.

"Absolutely not playing house!" Mimi said seriously, "This is a gathering that decides the fate of Lexem..."

ESMi:

Little Merlin was stunned. Could this kid have discovered some earth-shattering secret?

"The world has suffered long under Charlie and Duke. These two villains bully us, so we must rise up and form an alliance. Only by uniting do we have a chance to win!"

Mimi stood on a barrel, imitating adults, giving a passionate speech up there. With proper cultivation, she might become a great orator.

Below were two of Mimi's playmates, one wearing extremely thick glasses, the other with mucus flowing almost to his mouth. The kids were all about the same age.

"But our alliance can't do without a leader. We found the perfect candidate - this one!" Mimi suddenly pointed at Little Merlin beside her seriously. "He's very strong, chased Charlie and Duke away in a few moves. He'd be the best leader for our alliance!"

"I...", Little Merlin covered his blackened face, thinking: I knew it, what serious business can a bunch of kids have? Is this making me the boss of Lexem's brats? No! I'm an adult! How did I stoop to hanging out with a bunch of kids? But being suddenly treated as the boss... what's this strange feeling of satisfaction?

"Four-eyes, runny-nose, any objections?" Mimi asked looking down.

"...No, but we've never seen him before..." Four-eyes pushed up his glasses.

"Yeah, never seen him..." Runny-nose slurped the mucus back in, looking very smooth.

"This doesn't matter! What matters is he has the ability to lead us in rebellion!" Mimi looked at Little Merlin, pulled out a prepared toy - the hot Elgin Great Sword Hero's blade from Britain, the Banri Garan children's version, looking 100% authentic, just short and small, made of wood - "From now on, you are the justice partner who eliminates evil! Elgin's little swordsman! This is your token!"

Little Merlin was forced to take the Banri Garan children's version. Layers of black lines appeared on his forehead. The treasured treasure of the First Demon Lord Palace had completely become a toy beloved by bear children.

What the hell is this?

These kids couldn't dream that I'm the real Elgin Great Sword Hero...

(0w0川)

Plus extra update, late at night.

title: Chapter 12 — The Silly Knights (Add Updates)
content:
Chapter 12 — The Silly Knights (Add Updates)

Volume 22 · Chapter 12

Xiao Merlin stared at the toy Banri Garan, feeling mixed emotions for a moment. Have I really ended up mixing with these little brats? How shameful!

However....

The way these little kids looked at me with admiration was pretty satisfying, I feel like I'm once again towering above all living beings! Wahahaha!

Xiao Merlin hugged the Banri Garan toy sword, holding his head high and chest out, the sack cloak behind him rustling, looking imposing.

"Wow!" Three children let out a static sound, struck by Xiao Merlin's imposing figure.

"Hmph...hmpf..." Xiao Merlin struggled to climb onto a wine barrel, looking down at them from a height, "To be honest, I'm the Elgin Grand Swordsman, and from now on, you all must listen to me, you must obey me.

"You're a little swordsman, not a big swordsman, big swordsmen are much taller than you...." Mini Minie's untimely rebuttal.

"Tch!" Xiao Merlin clicked his tongue dissatisfied, "Just you talk too much, I don't care, I'm the Grand Swordsman.'

"Is little swordsman, you think tying a sack around your neck makes you a big swordsman? Childish!" Mini Minie said poutily.

"..." Xiao Merlin furrowed his brow, thinking to himself that he was barely an adult, being called childish by a little brat? Preposterous!

"No! Why should he be little swordsman just because he's new? I want to be too!" The bespectacled one was the first to object, looking at the Banri Garan toy in Xiao Merlin's hand with envy.

"You? Forget it, you can't even beat me, do you forget the time I popped your glasses?" Mini Minie hands on her hips said.

"..." A large bead of sweat rolled down Xiao Merlin's forehead, thinking how Hobbs usually taught Mini Minie, she's so young and already fighting.

"..." I also want to be the leader! I can definitely be the head, that big swordsman's knife should be mine!" The mucus worm suddenly raised his hand, equally full of desire for the toy,

"You still wet the bed, being the leader is too shameful, quickly blow your nose, it's almost dripping into your mouth, you didn't eat dinner tonight, did you?" Mini Minie snapped at her playmate.

...Hearing Mini Minie's words, Xiao Merlin thought she was still a sour and vicious girl, her words too sharp. Point...

"Since we've formed an alliance, everything must follow orders. How about we pick a name first?" Mini Minie racked her brains.

"...4 Gua Wa Knights it is..." Xiao Merlin said with full malice, clearly mocking these three little brats.

"Oh! Good name! From now on we'll be called the Gua Wa Knights!" Mini Minie clapped her fist, thinking there was absolutely no problem.

Xiao Merlin's face turned dark, wanting to say something but stopping, thinking these three kids aren't stupid, right? Could it be because they can't understand my original world's dialect?

I've established my own organization, right? Gua Wa Knights' leader Merlin? Such a LOW name! Another black history I never want to mention in this lifetime!

Putting that aside, although I knew Elgin Grand Swordsman was an object of worship for many, I didn't expect it to be so hot among kids, making me a hero?

If they knew Elgin Grand Swordsman was the demon Lucifer, they'd definitely cry in fear!

After all, Britain is the kingdom closest to the First Demon Lord Palace, they must have heard my extremely evil story, liking to eat children's stories.

Xiao Merlin sighed, unknowingly walking a road completely opposite to the Demon Lord, - definitely not a good thing.

"Then... Gua Wa Knights' Lord, please announce the Knights' code of conduct, from now on this will be our behavioral guideline!" Mini Minie said excitedly.

Xiao Merlin looked at the three expectant eyes below, suddenly spirited, recovering his former heroic mien - -

"You all listen up! Our Gua Wa's enemies are those adults who think highly of themselves!"

"So we must play to our advantages, if no candy, then smash to death!"

"..... But we can't beat those adults!" Mini Minie proposed the meaning.

"Idiot! I'll just teach you the six-character true saying, that is 'I'm still a child!' " Xiao Merlin's expression extremely serious.

"Report! This is seven characters!" Mini Minie expressed objection.

"Shut up! How can there be you! ?" Xiao Merlin's face turned red, exposing his uncultured fact, "As long as this skill is activated, at worst it makes adults feel guilty and die of shame, at worst it accumulates rage leading to bodily explosion, and it can also call for strong support to fully suppress the enemy's morale and spirit, truly our bear children's ultimate move! We'll use the spirit of not hitting the wall for three days to tell all the adults of Rekshurm, who is the true owner!"

"Oh! ! !" The three children suddenly showed admiring eyes, their eyes full of little stars.

"Haha.

Xiao Merlin tossed his flowing hair, thinking right! This is the feeling, the feeling of looking down on everything from a height...

Suddenly Xiao Merlin's neck meat was grabbed, his entire small body lifted up, and he jumped down.

Alice frowned at Xiao Merlin, saying helplessly, "I looked everywhere for you, originally you were having so much fun here.

"Eh! Alice? ...I just got a bit carried away..." Xiao Merlin stared wide-eyed in shock.

"Come home with me, there's something important to discuss." Alice lifted Xiao Merlin, turned around and walked home.

"Oh, no problem... Xiao Merlin completely lost his spirit.

"What did you just say about three days not hitting the wall? What does that mean?" Alice carrying Xiao Merlin, lowered her head curiously asking.

"Forget about this matter... Xiao Merlin instantly shrunk, lowly protesting -

"I'm now the Gua Wa Knights' captain, please give me some face in front of my subordinates, thanks...."..

Back home, Xiao Merlin put down the letters he had just received, thinking.

"So it's the elf princess we saved earlier, inviting us to play in the Southern United Kingdom.

"How do you feel?" Alice asked.

"All meals and lodging, public funds for eating and drinking, great~" Xiao Merlin thought it was very good, mentally planting crops.

"....... Alice frowned, thinking that recently Merlin had turned into a child, his mood was not good, maybe temporarily put aside work, go out to relax and relax his mood, seems not bad. Moreover, recently there's Helen's matter, just right can take this opportunity to leave Rekshurm for a while, I believe the slave matter will calm down? - - Both gain!

"You don't want to go catch up with this Shirley princess?" Xiao Merlin lifted his head.

"Also not bad.... Alice paused, adding with great righteousness, "Anyway, in your current state, you can't do without me by your side, since you want to go look, I must accompany you.

"Then it's decided, we'll set out tomorrow...".

Xiao Merlin opened the bottle, drank the medicine inside in one go, immediately turning his eyes white and sticking out his green tongue, nauseated to death.

Every time he drank the potion prepared by Xesi, it was a painful process.

However, for the early recovery, this pain is nothing!

He looked at the last bottle of medicine in his hand, showing a relieved expression, as if victory was within reach?

Xiao Merlin lowered his head, like a thief secretly staring at Alice, his expression becoming sinister, his heart full of malice wanting to-

Already stabbed the last bottle of medicine, once the time comes to drink it, old man can restore his former heroic mien!

Alice has been so strong toward me these past few days, wanting to control me? Dream! All accounts I'll keep in my heart.

After I recover, just watch me how I take revenge on you, not letting you call me miserable?

title: Chapter 13 — Mature Ghost
content:
Chapter 13 — Mature Ghost

Volume 22 · Chapter 13

Alice's back felt cool, and she saw little Merlin secretly staring at her, looking like he was plotting something.

"...What are you laughing at?"

"Ahem!" Merlin quickly hid his smile, put away the last bottle of medicine, and said, ".......

You look so bad, are you thinking of some kind of conspiracy or trick?"

Alice became cautious.

"It's just your imagination, I'm still a child, after all..."

Merlin said with a face full of innocence, but in his heart, he was thinking of how to torment Alice after he recovered.

Alice's forehead veins jumped, and she suddenly asked seriously, "You didn't go to explain the situation to Helena, did you? What happened?"

Merlin suddenly furrowed his brow, recalling the unpleasantness in the secret room, and didn't want to talk about it at all.

But looking at Alice's eyes full of expectation, he could only respond with a forced tone.

"It's all settled, I'm not some evil guy, I wouldn't do anything to Helena..."

"Really, it's all settled?" Alice was very suspicious, and it was hard to believe that Merlin had handled this matter properly.

"Of course, it was just a trivial matter, Helena temporarily left her slave contract with me."

Merlin replied carelessly.

"Helena... didn't say anything?" Alice was a bit incredulous, and couldn't believe that Merlin had handled this matter so simply.

"Not that you'd think of anything else, this is a slave contract, who would willingly become a slave?"

Merlin raised an eyebrow.

...Alice was speechless, thinking that Merlin had handled this matter too simply. She knew that Helena looked at Merlin with an abnormal gaze, and with her intuition, she thought that Helena was definitely trying to get closer to Merlin. Why was she so confident in leaving the slave contract with Merlin? It was very suspicious...

Merlin was uncomfortable under Alice's gaze, so he pretended to be stern and said, "What are you staring at me for? This matter is settled, what else do you have to complain about?"

"Very suspicious..." Alice narrowed her eyes and asked tentatively, "Are you hiding something from me?"

Merlin's forehead broke out in a cold sweat. "What... you're really suspicious, huh?"

"Did Helena miss... try to get close to you through the slave contract?" Alice asked, based on her intuition as a woman, Helena wouldn't give up this opportunity.

"You're thinking of all sorts of nonsense, what would Helena want to get close to me for? I'm not her subordinate."

Merlin's eyebrows were tightly locked on his forehead.

Alice thought it was probably her own misunderstanding, so she coldly snorted and muttered, "Hmph! I'll believe you this time, but don't make me regret it..."

"Ahem!" Merlin sighed, helpless.

"That's why I'm going to prepare for our trip to the Southern United Kingdom tomorrow, right?" Alice turned around and asked.

"Wait, what's that?" Alice stopped in her tracks, curious.

"By the way, have you ever been to this foreign land?"

"...No, I haven't," Merlin said awkwardly, thinking to himself that he was just a homebody, and leaving the Death Swamp was only a few years ago.

"I haven't either, but I've heard it's a gathering place for foreigners, like beastmen, elves, and mermaids... it sounds pretty interesting..."

Merlin's eyes lit up with excitement, and he thought to himself, "Girl elves, beast ear girls, beautiful mermaids? Maybe there are even women with chests as big as mountains... I have to go and take a good look, hehe..."

"What are you thinking about?" Alice furrowed her brow, feeling uneasy and on guard.

"Stop thinking about those dirty thoughts, I'll be watching you."

Half a month later, a merchant ship sailed across the vast ocean, approaching the isolated continent.

Alice and little Merlin followed the merchant ship, entering the land of non-human species, and were about to enter the port.

Merlin sat in a chair, folding his arms, looking serious, trying to look more mature while outside.

Alice was beside him, holding a travel trunk, with two swords at her waist, one was her own sword, "Light's Lament", and the other was Merlin's "Banri Garan".

Although Merlin was still small, he had asked Alice to bring the Banri Garan and temporarily take care of it.

Alice was now reading a travel guide to the Southern United Kingdom, trying to prepare in advance and learn more about the foreign land.

"Ah, we're approaching the elven territory, according to the letter, Shelly will meet us there."

That elven princess had prepared well, it seemed that saving her hadn't been in vain... Merlin thought, but then he suddenly remembered the compensation he was supposed to receive, and his face darkened.

"Helena... didn't pay me the agreed-upon compensation because I forgot, what a cunning move!"

Alice smiled awkwardly, feeling embarrassed, and said, "You're still holding a grudge over this? You're such a miser..."

"How could I forget?" Merlin glared at Alice, his eyes flashing with anger.

"I hate people who don't pay their debts, I've secretly kept a list of all those who owe me money, that Elizabeth..."

"Elizabeth?" Alice suddenly furrowed her brow, hearing Merlin mention the queen's name, and felt a strange sense of unease.

"Ahem! Nothing, nothing..." Merlin quickly covered his mouth, pretending to know nothing.

"Hmph?" Alice didn't quite believe it, but didn't think much of it, so she looked down at the travel guide and said, "The Southern United Kingdom is managed by nine great tribal leaders, each tribe lives in a different place, unfortunately, you can only see the elves, not the beast ear girls..."

"Damn it, I'm so curious about the beast ear girls' tails, I've already made up my mind to lift up their skirts..."

Merlin said seriously.

"Shut up!" Alice was furious, her eyes flashing with anger.

The merchant ship let out a loud roar, signaling their approach to the Southern United Kingdom.

Alice's excitement grew, and she stood up, looking out the window at the distant mountains, towering trees, and buildings that looked like they belonged to another world.

"Wow! Merlin, come see! It's so beautiful! I've never seen a place like this before, it's so magical!"

Merlin looked at Alice's childish expression, and sat still, looking old and wise, and said, "Shut up! You're so childish, you think everything is new and exciting, can't you be more mature like me?"

"Hmph!" Alice was offended, her eyes flashing with anger.

After getting off the ship, Alice carried her luggage, and Merlin couldn't contain his excitement, and started to let loose.

Merlin ran ahead, his eyes shining with excitement, and everywhere he looked, he was full of wonder and excitement.

He opened his mouth and let out a string of excited words, his body language expressing his "I have no culture, but I can react like a classic '卧槽'!"

"卧槽! This mountain!"

"卧槽! This water!"

"卧槽! This light!"

"Merlin, you idiot..." Alice watched Merlin from behind, rolling her eyes, and thought to herself, "Good, you're supposed to be more mature, but you're even more childish than me..."

"Good, you're supposed to be more mature, but you're even more childish than me..."

title: Chapter 15 — Three Turns
content:
Chapter 15 — Three Turns

Volume 22 · Chapter 15

Two black elf soldiers dared not even breathe under Alice's overwhelming pressure.

However, just then, a slightly angry voice suddenly rang out, breaking the silence one—

"Who's so bold? Daring to run wild here?"

A black elf wearing full armor, with two short swords at his waist, stepped forward, his face filled with hostility as he stared at Alice and Merlin.

"Captain... they... they don't listen to reason, insisting on forcibly entering our territory!"

"Oh?"

The black elf captain was the one who had recently sneaked into the palace to eavesdrop on the Elf King's words, dressed like a thief that night, but now, wearing armor, he appeared wise and formidable.

He looked over Alice, realizing she wasn't a trivial person, yet she hadn't shown fear enough to make him tremble.

"My lord, the Empress has recently decreed that no humans may enter our territory, regardless of your reasons, you cannot trespass on our land. Any violation will be handled according to the kingdom's laws."

Alice, who had been listening to the black elf captain speak politely, retracted her overwhelming pressure, responding calmly, "We didn't come to trespass on your land. Princess Snow White sent us here. Here's the letter."

The black elf captain opened the letter, looked at it doubtfully, and immediately showed a wary expression, occasionally lifting his head to examine Alice...

How strange, why would Princess Snow White suddenly invite humans here?

This matter hasn't been mentioned to me at all, clearly it's acting on their own. Has she noticed something?

The master is about to return soon, we cannot afford any mistakes...

The black elf captain returned the letter to Alice, recalling the Elf King's vague words, he asked tentatively, "May I ask... are you perhaps related to the humans' Holy Church? Are you clerics?"

"...No relation at all..." Alice's expression turned embarrassed, internally thinking, I've kept my past hidden so well... How did they figure out I was a Hero of the Holy Church at a glance?

"Impressive, can elves see people's pasts? If that's the case..." Merlin suddenly became excited, as if discovering something extremely novel, never having heard that elves could see the past, could they also see that he was a demon?

The black elf captain's eyes widened instantly—he had only been testing, but didn't expect to hear such important information!

According to the master's recent explanation, the Elf King's vague words referred to a sealed letter from a cleric of the Holy Church, and a demon from a barren land.

After so many days, this human woman was the only visitor with ties to the human Holy Church. In that case...

No way! No matter what the cost, we cannot let these two enter the territory!

His back chilled, feeling fear from the Elf King's prophecy, indeed, they were coming as expected, unavoidable.

Though he still couldn't help but glance at Merlin, who looked like a child, wondering if the prophecy had gotten it wrong?

Would such a small child be a demon? And falling in love with an adult woman, that's too melodramatic...

Though the black elf captain couldn't figure out what was going on, he still showed some hostility, gripping the two short swords at his waist tightly.

"Regardless of your identity, leave here at once, or else don't blame me for being uncourteous!"

"Don't you recognize Princess Snow White's personal letter? We were invited here..." Alice frowned her brows, having thought things were turning around, but the other party seemed to harbor hostility toward her, refusing to let them pass.

"Exactly, this is your elves' way of treating guests, isn't it?" Merlin raised an eyebrow.

"Even if you're guests invited by Princess Snow White, without the Empress's permission, you cannot enter. Leave quickly, before we decide to take action..." The black elf captain said with a significant meaning.

"Hmph!" Merlin immediately expressed his dissatisfaction, "We traveled all this way just to be turned away at the gate? What's the misunderstanding here?"

Alice's mood was similar to Merlin's, her patience gradually worn thin, unable to help but say, "Until we meet Princess Snow White, we won't leave. If we forcefully enter, you're sure you can stop us?"

The black elf captain suddenly stopped, turned back, and sternly stared at Alice, "Take note of your words, human, this is the land of the alien races."

"So what?" Alice slowly drew her slender sword, its blade gleaming with chilling silver light, exuding a terrifying cold.

"Such a novice doesn't even need me to intervene, I'll leave that to you, Alice, let it experience the harsh reality..." Merlin fanned the flames of dissent beside her, since she was in such a state, she might as well grab onto Alice's thick leg tightly.

"Since you refuse to leave, then we'll have to reason with you..."

The black elf captain's two short swords at his waist suddenly shone with sharp light, his gaze became keen, emitting golden Saint-tier aura.

In his assessment, he believed he had the strength to battle Alice and wouldn't easily fall behind, because just now, the dragon aura emanating from Alice wasn't that terrifying to him, not knowing that it was Alice's deliberate suppression...

The black elf captain crossed his arms, using the two short swords like daggers, a technique not very common.

"You people, sinners, have long oppressed the alien races since ancient times, but coming here to cause trouble in the United Kingdom now, truly hopeless!

"If there's an opportunity to eradicate you sinners, I'll definitely take the lead, slaughtering you without leaving a scrap!

"Don't think just because you possess a certain dragon's power, you can roam freely and tyrannize on our land..."

"I tell you, dragons aren't rare here, the giant dragon I defeated had 99 out of 100, you won't even make it past three turns under my hand!"

Alice showed no expression, suddenly charging forward, instantly reaching the black elf captain, sword swinging down!

"Coming just in time... Ah!?"

The black elf captain's cheerful exclamation suddenly stopped, he was terrified by Alice's true strength, letting out a startled cry!

Alice's slender sword cleaved through the black elf captain's shielded dual blades, instantly freezing them solid, freezing his arm in the blink of an eye!

Unable to withstand Alice's force, the black elf captain was blown backward, crashing to the ground.

"Captain!" The soldiers were startled, quickly helping the black elf captain up from the ground.

The black elf captain's forehead dripped cold sweat, his expression frozen, staring at his instantly frozen hands, trembling so much he couldn't even hold his weapons, realizing the terrifying gap beyond the Saint-tier barrier, his judgment of the enemy's strength was wrong, and he had severely embarrassed himself in front of his comrades.

"...You... absolutely couldn't..."

Alice slowly sheathed her slender sword, looking down at the black elf captain sitting on the ground...

Was he talking about himself? That's right, wasn't it?

title: Chapter 16 — Pressure
content:
Chapter 16 — Pressure

Volume 22 · Chapter 16

Hearing Alice return her words verbatim, the black elf captain's face turned red, and he felt deeply ashamed.

Feeling that this human woman had openly trampled on his dignity, and in front of many of his own kin!

"We need to see Princess Sherry, please notify her. Otherwise, we'll have to use our own methods...Alice spoke politely, but her tone was clearly applying pressure.

"Just let you run errands, is that so hard? Wanting to use force to drive us away is just asking for it, isn't it?" Little Merlin spread his hands, completely confused as to why the black elves on the other side kept trying to drive them and Alice away.

"It seems you're all enemies of the other races, and I won't let you leave alive." The black elf captain stood up, feeling humiliated, and his anger grew increasingly difficult to contain.

"Still want to fight? I advise you to stay calm. No matter how many times you try, you won't have any success....Alice said seriously.

"You really think so? Self-righteous criminal...The black elf captain's eyes turned sinister, reaching behind him as if he had some hidden card up his sleeve.

Just as the two sides were about to draw their swords, a white stallion suddenly burst into the scene, and the sound of the horses' hooves caused everyone to calm down.

"Stop!"

Hilf, wearing a silver male armor and a white cloak, roared from the horse. Her piercing gaze swept over the three black elves, seemingly somewhat disapproving.

Hilf quickly dismounted and walked straight to Alice and Little Merlin. "Are you two guests invited by Princess Sherry?"

".......Alice had thought it was a reinforcement of black elves, but it turned out to be someone checking identities. She then handed over the letter from Princess Sherry, "This..."

Hilf looked at the letter, which was indeed written by Sherry herself, and then carefully examined Alice's appearance, which was no different from the newspaper. "Yes, I am a knight of the Elf King, sent by Princess Sherry to welcome you.

Alice and Little Merlin let out a sigh of relief, thinking that someone had finally come to pick them up, otherwise, they would have had to stand off here, which wasn't a good solution. Fortunately, they hadn't been driven away by the black elves just now.

Hilf turned to the black elf captain, her face filled with anger, seemingly displeased with the black elves who had blocked Alice and Little Merlin.

"Hilf, adult..."The black elf captain, who seemed to have found reinforcements, immediately began to accuse Alice, "These criminals are not good people, they are causing trouble here and should be put in the kingdom's prison for questioning. Maybe they are spies sent by humans!"

Hilf quickened her pace, without saying a word, "Pah" gave the black elf captain an ear slap, and Alice and Little Merlin were both stunned.

"Uh."

The black elf captain covered his face, looking shocked, "Hilf, adult? You..."

"They are carrying Princess Sherry's personal letter, so they are guests. What right do you have to block the guests of the princess?" Hilf was furious, and she was not polite to the black elves. "Foolish!"

Little Merlin slightly frowned, thinking that the elves were so strict. Even if they were their own kind, they would slap their own kind to humiliate them for us outsiders. Wasn't that a bit too much?

The black elf captain finally regained his composure, his expression changing from shock to anger, and he glared at Hilf, gnashing his teeth, "In recent times, no human races are allowed to enter the territory. This is the order of the Queen Mother! Hilf, adult, you are openly disobeying! I will report your disrespectful behavior to the King."

"Even if the Queen Mother has issued a blockade order, the guests of the princess are exceptions. You have no right to block them. Don't forget your own identity, you are only a border patrol captain. Hilf's piercing gaze swept over every black-skinned elf in the crowd, and she said fiercely, "You black elves, behave properly and do not try to disrupt the rules of the elves. You were all rebels who followed Asmodeus and were exiled. The Elf King, out of his kindness for being elves, did not pursue responsibility and exiled you, but left you here. So you should be grateful and work hard in your posts, instead of causing trouble! Understood?"

The black elves lowered their heads, most of them dared not speak up, and Hilf's attitude made them feel very uncomfortable.

Alice watched the black elves one by one lower their heads, thinking that this male elf knight was so powerful, with a high and mighty attitude, as if he was scolding slaves.

Although Alice thought it was a bit inappropriate, at this time, it was the elves' own business, and she was just planning to go on vacation and had no intention of interfering.

Hilf saw that the black elves' morale had weakened, and finally relaxed, turning to Alice, "The two of you, please follow me. Princess Sherry has been waiting for you for a long time...."

Alice and Little Merlin nodded and followed Hilf away from the scene, and the black elves only dared to lift their heads at this time, with a look of strong dissatisfaction in their eyes.

Especially the black elf captain, who silently clenched his fists, thinking that although he was not much stronger than himself, he could be a knight on the side of the Elf King, while he could only be a border patrol captain here, fairness? Equal treatment? It doesn't even exist! Only when Asmodeus returns will we get the treatment we deserve!

Although the Dark Elf King Asmodeus was not one of the nine leaders, he had once led a rebellion, which almost split the Alliance of Races apart, but unfortunately, it ended in failure.

These black elves who once followed Asmodeus, although they were not exiled and executed by the Elf King, they would never be given the opportunity to be promoted, and their status was also inferior to ordinary elves, and they could only work as laborers at the bottom.

After walking away, Alice finally couldn't help but ask, "Um...Elf Miss, do you elves treat your own people so strictly?"

"No, they are black elves, although they are indeed part of the elf race, but I personally do not recognize this." Hilf said seriously, her pointy ears trembling. Little Merlin looked up, wondering if there was a class division based on bloodline within the elf race, as there was in the demon race, where the demons' bloodlines were also divided into three levels. Although they were very noble and legitimate, because of their thin bloodline and lack of demonic features, they were still discriminated against by their own kind.

"E! !" Alice was stunned, and then asked, "Why?"

"Black elves are different from us. They like war and killing, and they are absolutely different from us who love peace." Hilf turned her head to emphasize, "They are all traitors who have betrayed us. If it were not for the kindness of the Elf King, they should have been expelled outside."

.......Alice dared not ask any more, feeling that the Union Kingdom had a big problem, and she often heard that it was a sanctuary for the races, but it didn't seem to be as peaceful as it looked.

"Wow, you have the courage to continue using people who have betrayed themselves. It seems that the Elf King has a lot of ideas. In other places, the normal ruler would definitely exterminate them." Little Merlin muttered, and in the demon race, where the weak were eaten by the strong, the idea of rooting out the grass was deeply ingrained.

"Hmm?" Hilf looked down at the plump Little Merlin, and asked with deep meaning, "It seems that this child is not old, but knows a lot."

"Is this your son? You don't look like him at all....(u -_.)?"

Volume 22 · Chapter 18

"No, it's all in your head. It's just your illusion." Barla shook his head seriously and said, "My father once told me that the Elf King's power is extremely terrifying, with the strength to sweep away other races. Such an existence, as long as he's alive, will never cause any turmoil."

"Although you say that, I'm still a bit uneasy..." Fairy Freya scratched her little head.

Barla finished the drink in his hand, then shook the empty bottle, and said with lingering emotion, "Do you want to steal some more? One bottle isn't enough."

"Every time it's me, why don't you go?! " Fairy Freya poked Barla's forehead.

"Hehe, I'm just clumsy, aren't I?" Barla laughed awkwardly and then changed the subject, "Do you know that the finest wine is stored in the Elf Palace? I was fortunate enough to taste a small cup once. The flavor... is hard to describe with words. It's incredibly delicious. Why don't you sneak a bottle tonight when it's dark?"

"...Really that good?" Fairy Freya's eyes widened, looking like she was getting interested.

"Of course, my taste is still worth praising~" Barla said proudly.

"...Fairy Freya lowered her head, her eyes sparkling and turning around, looking like she was tempted...

Alice and Little Merlin followed Hilfy and arrived at the palace built on the giant tree.

-On the way, they also experienced the local customs of the elves. It seemed that every elf was very cold, giving off an aura of "no strangers allowed."

Those elves saw Alice and Little Merlin strolling around confidently on the street. At first they were very surprised, but then immediately turned to rejection.

It seemed that all foreign races had the same problem - they didn't like humans. If it weren't for Hilfy, the knight beside them, they might have caused some trouble.

Looking at the grand palace built on the giant tree in the distance, they entered it and felt a sense of oppression. Even Little Merlin and Alice exclaimed in surprise.

Even among demons, probably no Demon Lord Palace could match the Elf King's palace, which was integrated with this giant tree that reached the sky.

Hilfy looked back at the two people's reactions and couldn't help feeling pleased, thinking that the commoners probably didn't know the depth of foreign races.

"This giant tree is a sacred relic of our clan. The great Elf God Corlon was born under this tree. It carries the history of our clan and witnessed the rise of the new world after the fall of the gods. When the Elf King decided to use the Star-Splitting Cannon to tear apart the continental map and drift countless foreign races to the southernmost end, he brought this tree here. That was a remarkable feat worth recording in history. The land we stand on has been wandering on the sea for several hundred years, and finally established a stable country, the last sanctuary for our foreign races..."

"Is that so? It does sound like a remarkable feat..." Alice felt surprised, rarely hearing such stories.

As a fellow foreign race, Little Merlin frowned, because Hilfy's words were too lofty, as if he was telling future generations how great his clan was. Every clan has its own history, and demons are no exception. In the demon records, elves are not the guides of world change, but a bunch of wise and resourceful cowards.

The Elf King's event of splitting the continent should have happened after the war between demons and the heavens, at the end of the Demon Era, when countless foreign races fell in the blood pool and were suppressed by the spirits.

The first Demon Lords fought fiercely against the spirit army, with 6 of them falling directly, barely driving the spirits away. Since then, the era of demons ended, and the rise of humans was unstoppable.

In the demon records, during the peak of the holy war, what were the elves doing? To put it bluntly, they were just staying on the sidelines, preserving most of their strength and not participating in the war at all.

As a reincarnator raised among demons, Little Merlin was still willing to believe the demon side's records and sneered at Hilfy's words.

"That's right, right? Stop talking nonsense. The Elf King saw that the rise of humans was unstoppable, but couldn't see the hope of restoring past glory, so he allied with numerous foreign races and ran away, right?"

"Is that so?" Alice asked in surprise.

"You!?" Hilfy stopped in his tracks and turned back to glare at Little Merlin, "What nonsense are you talking about? We're just not a warlike race, and we simply can't get along with humans."

"Ha, you just say whatever makes you happy..." Little Merlin didn't bother to explain. In fact, the evaluation of elves as cowards was exactly his strong-willed mother, Vivian.

In those distant times, the Elf King personally visited the Demon Lord Palace and told his plan to Vivian, who was the second-generation arrogant ruler, but was met with a cold shoulder.

If the demons had agreed to the Elf King's drifting plan, perhaps the United Kingdom wouldn't need to be composed of the Nine Great Leaders plus 7 additional seats.

"How unreasonable." Hilfy turned away and continued leading the way, couldn't help muttering under his breath, "Commoners are commoners, their souls are permeated with..."

In the palace bedroom, Snowy had been waiting here early.

To welcome her friends, she had dressed up carefully, afraid of leaving a bad impression on Merlin and Alice.

Snowy wanted to be hospitable to the two of them, as a way to repay them for saving her life.

Although they had only been together for a short time and the promised reward was forgotten, Snowy felt very grateful to the two of them.

Especially Merlin, who destroyed the Burning Army from another dimension, left a deep impression on Snowy.

Hilfy slowly walked in, knelt down on one knee, "Your Highness, I have brought them in and temporarily arranged them in the living room."

"Is that so, thank you for your hard work." Snowy smiled sweetly.

Hilfy's face turned red for no reason, then said seriously, "I hope you understand, don't get too close to the commoners. On the way here, I chatted with them a bit. That human woman is quite nice, but that one... isn't very good..."

"How... how is that?" Mr. Merlin, although quirky in temperament, is still a decent... maybe?" Snowy was also nervous in her heart.

"That guy is too self-righteous, with a disdainful attitude, revealing arrogance of looking down on others, a stupid commoner who doesn't know his own strength." Hilfy didn't hold back in criticizing Little Merlin, but in just a few sentences, he managed to describe Merlin's shortcomings so comprehensively, which was still quite good.

"...". Snowy was at a loss for words, because Hilfy was right, this was exactly her Mr. Merlin.

At this time, in the living room, Hilfy led Snowy to the door of the living room and saw such an embarrassing scene.

Alice and Little Merlin were in front of them with tea, the delicate tea set looked magnificent, with a strong sense of luxury.

However, Little Merlin was trembling and picked up a golden spoon, bit it with his teeth, and his eyes lit up immediately.

"Golden!? The Elf King, this old scoundrel, seems to be very wealthy."

While cursing the Elf King, Little Merlin's hands were very honest, silently pocketing the golden spoon, and with a sheepish smile to Alice beside him.

"Hey, Merlin, what did you just do? Do you think I'm blind...?" Alice's face turned black immediately, and her hands holding the tea set were trembling.

Little Merlin raised his hand and waved it in front of Alice's eyes, "You didn't see anything, it was all an illusion, trust me."

"I feel..." Alice bit her lip, her beautiful face ugly, gritted her teeth and said in a low voice,

"You're insulting my intelligence."

title: Chapter 19 — Power of the Past
content:
Chapter 19 — Power of the Past

Volume 22 · Chapter 19

"Only someone without intelligence could have missed what just happened..." young Merlin said with a grave expression.

"Are you telling me to turn a blind eye to your despicable behavior just now?" Alice set down her teacup, completely helpless regarding Merlin's greed for money.

"That's made of gold. There might be other good things in this palace. Since we're already here, why would we go back empty-handed?" young Merlin said with great excitement.

"Put it back. We're adventurers, not thieves." Alice looked at young Merlin and emphasized, "I don't want to have to say it twice, Merlin."

"Hmph!" young Merlin pouted and obediently put the golden spoon back, "So boring~"

"I can't just ignore your bad habits. If I did, I'd be your accomplice." Alice paused and continued, "This trip is mainly so you can relax. Stop coming up with all those bad ideas."

"How would I ever relax if I'm with you? I'd have been better off coming on my own..." young Merlin muttered.

"With how you are right now, you couldn't beat up even a stray dog. Just forget about all those messy schemes." Alice said firmly, brooking no argument.

"This is the elf clan's palace. I hope you two can behave yourselves." Sylph suddenly appeared behind them, glaring at young Merlin as if warning him not to cause any trouble.

Young Merlin turned around and made a funny face, sticking out his tongue mockingly. "Nyah nyah nyah~"

"Hmph." Sylph's brows knitted together. She thought this human was absolutely insufferable. If Merlin weren't the princess's guest, she really wanted to kick him to the ground.

"Merlin, don't be like that..." Alice whispered a reminder to Merlin.

"Isn't this androgynous elf clearly looking for trouble?" young Merlin crossed his arms and kept looking at Sylph with contemptuous eyes.

"Miss Alice, you've finally arrived." Shirley hurried over and grabbed Alice's hands.

"...Alice was a bit flattered and nodded with a smile. 'Your Highness, long time no see.'"

"You don't need to call me Your Highness. Just call me Shirley, the same way I stayed at your place." Shirley's smile seemed to radiate warmth, making everyone feel comfortable.

"....Wouldn't that be a bit inappropriate?" Alice hesitated. This was elf territory; surely they couldn't be too casual.

"Hey hey hey! Over here, over here!" young Merlin raised his hand, drawing Shirley's attention. "Hey, do you still remember me, the elf miss who cries at the slightest thing? You haven't forgotten me already, have you?"

"Please watch your language. Don't be disrespectful to Her Highness..." Sylph said with a dark expression, barely holding back her anger at Merlin.

"...." Shirley hadn't heard from Sylph about this. When she first came in, she was wondering why Mr. Merlin wasn't there and instead there was a child. Didn't they say both of them were coming?

"Merlin! I am Merlin!" young Merlin pointed at himself and said resentfully.

"Huh!?" Shirley's expression was one of disbelief. She whispered, "Mr. Merlin...?"

"That's right! It's me!" young Merlin placed his hands on his hips and replied joyfully.

"....Why do you look like a child?" Shirley was full of questions. In her eyes, Merlin was an extremely powerful being. How could he end up as a useless little brat?

"This..." Alice was hesitant, letting out a helpless sigh. "It's a long story."

"Mr. Merlin personally tested the medicine to save you, which is why he turned into this state, right?" Shirley's eyes widened.

The few of them sat down and chatted about recent events. Sylph stood behind Shirley, watching young Merlin. She couldn't shake the feeling that this guy was up to no good.

"That's right. But this state is temporary, and he can recover." Alice explained.

"Mr. Merlin is usually so cold and aloof. I never expected him to risk everything to save Miss Alice in a crisis. So it seems..." Shirley studied young Merlin and said straightforwardly, "you really do like Miss Alice, don't you?"

"....Cough cough!" young Merlin was immediately choked by his own water, coughing uncontrollably. "What nonsense are you talking about? I don't understand a word."

"This guy just doesn't want to take the blame alone. He had to drag me along to feel satisfied." Alice puffed out her cheeks, full of resentment toward Merlin.

"....That's exactly it, cough cough." young Merlin nodded repeatedly, looking guilty and avoiding eye contact.

"...." Shirley looked at young Merlin and felt something was off, as if he were hiding something.

"By the way, you've changed so much. I almost didn't recognize you at first glance. You don't look like the little girl you used to be at all..." Alice said with a smile.

Young Merlin rolled his eyes. He thought elves had extraordinarily long lifespans. What little girl? Calling her grandma would still be an understatement.

"I haven't changed at all. It's you, Miss Alice, who has become an incredibly famous adventurer. I saw you in human newspapers." Shirley's eyes lit up with excitement, apparently very eager to hear Alice's adventure stories.

"That..." Alice's smile became awkward as she explained, "Actually, it's all thanks to Merlin. The details are hard to explain, so everyone just assumed I did it all. Now I'm under a lot of pressure. If someone exposes that I couldn't possibly do any of those things, I feel like my life would be over."

"Weren't you supposed to be delighted?" young Merlin suddenly said.

"Shut up. How would you understand the pressure I'm under right now?" Alice frowned and retorted.

"I actually thought of this long ago. Mr. Merlin is the one who truly turned the tide. After all, I personally witnessed him sweep through countless Saint-tier evil spirits. Only someone like Mr. Merlin could do something as insane as splitting apart a massive celestial body." Shirley said seriously.

Sylph, standing behind them, frowned more and more with each word. The longer she listened, the less real it all seemed, so absurd that she almost couldn't bear to hear it anymore.

Sweeping through countless evil spirits was already outrageous enough, and then they claim he split apart an extraterrestrial body? That's too ridiculous! Can a human really do that?!

Even though Merlin was currently in a child's body with all his power lost, Sylph found it hard to believe he could have such terrifying strength once he recovered. Even the Elf King probably couldn't accomplish something like that.

"Your Highness, please don't trust humans so easily. They're often nothing but liars who say whatever comes to mind. It's fine that you're inexperienced and got fooled, but don't fall for their tricks so readily. Saint-tier warriors are rare, and each possesses power capable of handling situations on their own. Even to casually annihilate a large number of Saint-tier experts, Your Highness the Elf King would need to be wary of being worn down by continuous battles. 'Sweeping through countless Saint-tier evil spirits'? Hmph, they might fool children with that. And as for destroying an extraterrestrial body? They must have relied on some powerful weapon. Otherwise, no human could achieve that."

"That's not true, Sylph. Mr. Merlin's abilities are something I witnessed with my own eyes. I couldn't believe what I was seeing at the time!" Shirley said with wide eyes and a very serious expression.

"...." Sylph suddenly froze, frowning at young Merlin. Her mind became conflicted.

Her Highness never lies. She's refuting me so earnestly....

Could all these unbelievable things actually be true?

title: Chapter 20 — Capture
content:
Chapter 20 — Capture

Volume 22 · Chapter 20

Hilf looked at little Merlin with suspicion, still unable to believe that so many unbelievable things were done by a single person.
If she believed it, Hilf's worldview would probably shatter, after all even the Elf King finds it difficult to accomplish such things, let alone others.
"Perhaps His Highness mistook? The Elf King Majesty led our people through several epochs; it's rare to encounter someone who can match him. Things His Majesty cannot do, the lowly sinners could never achieve."
"Hilf, you must believe me; if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't believe there still exists someone in this world who is secretly stronger than Father King." Shirley paused, excitedly saying, "If you get the chance, you must definitely leave the kingdom and see the outside world; actually our United Kingdom is tiny compared to the entire human world."
"Please don't say anything that disturbs the kingdom's stability." Hilf furrowed her brows, unable to hold back, "I still know the traits of the sinners; they are constantly fighting, never ceasing their steps of slaughter. We were born of nature, yearning for peace and stability, completely different from the sinners."
"....Alice didn't refute anything, wondering why the elves harbor such great hostility toward humans? Could it be that they once did something unforgivable?"
"Are elves just frogs in a well? If the Elf King is truly so powerful that no one can rival him, why would they need to ally with other races and flee here?" little Merlin said nonchalantly.
"What did you say! ? It's because you don't want to associate with the sinners, please watch your words! Even as His Highness's guest, my patience has its limits!" Hilf instinctively gripped the sword at her waist.
"So what?" little Merlin crossed his legs, speaking meaningfully, "Still want to educate me? Then it depends on whether you have the qualifications~"
"Seriously?" Hilf's eyes sharpened, "Are you willing to go out and duel with me? I want to see what you're really capable of."
"Cough.... little Merlin quickly coughed twice to hide his embarrassment, glanced at Alice, 'I'm feeling unwell, temporarily unable to fight; let my little lackey spar with you, Alice, you go?'"
"Who's your lackey?" Alice's forehead veins twitched.
little Merlin instantly felt embarrassed, pleading softly, 'Please, Alice, go ahead; this is the moment to defend your human honor, don't forget—I'm not human.'
'This.... Alice seeing Merlin beg her so earnestly, her heart softened, but it seems hardly worth it to fight over just a few words?
'Hilf, don't do this; Merlin Lord now has exhausted his strength; if you want to spar with him, it wouldn't be a fair victory, would it?' Shirley raised her eyebrows to stop her!
'Hmph!' Hilf snorted coldly, haughtily saying, 'Out of respect for His Highness, I'll let it slide; I hope you watch your words.'
'Tsk!' little Merlin clicked his tongue discontentedly, thinking tomorrow the time will come; I'll drink the last bottle of antidote and then properly teach this elf knight a lesson.
'Miss Alice, Mr. Merlin, you must keep a low profile in the palace, otherwise I'll also run into trouble.... Shirley showed a pitiful expression.
'Huh? What's wrong?' Alice suddenly froze, sensing Shirley was hiding something.
'In fact, inviting you here was my private decision, made without my father and mother's knowledge; if they knew I had invited outsiders as guests, they would surely blame me.' Shirley said, somewhat embarrassed.
'So that's it; don't worry, we won't cause any trouble.' Alice responded understandingly, then hugged little Merlin, 'This guy, I'll keep an eye on him.'
'Then I can relax.' Shirley smiled like a blooming flower, full of anticipation, saying, 'Tomorrow I'll take you to see many things; these are the ancient relics of our elf tribe, absolutely treasures you've never heard of.'
Night fell, Merlin and Alice were arranged to stay in the palace; the two slept on the same bed, sleeping soundly.
Since Merlin had turned into a child, Alice, out of a sense of responsibility, needed to protect the weak Merlin.
Now they could sleep openly without avoidance, lying together on one bed completely free of psychological pressure.
In Alice's eyes, Merlin is just a little child, posing no great threat; that's why she feels completely at ease.
The two lay under the covers, Alice slept on her side, holding little Merlin's hand to prevent any nighttime mishaps so she could wake promptly.
little Merlin tightly shut his eyes, brows furrowed, his small body unusually tense—
In his dream he saw again the Spear Hero O'Brien, contemptuous gaze, sharp spear, and that humiliation that could kill him at any moment....

little Merlin suddenly sat up, not expecting to have that nightmare again after so long; his body was drenched in cold sweat, his heart racing.
He kept taking deep breaths, his nervousness gradually easing, unsure how long this nightmare would follow him.
He glanced at the peacefully sleeping Alice, seemingly sleeping soundly, even drooling, wondering if he'd dreamed of something delicious.
little Merlin gently squeezed Alice's hand, a strange feeling welling up inside him—
Yeah, I'm not alone; Alice is by my side, what am I actually worried about?
If I hadn't turned into a child, getting close to him would probably be difficult anyway?
But this state should end tomorrow, right? After that she'll surely be on guard against me....
little Merlin's other hand lightly stroked his forehead, suddenly feeling a urge to urinate, lamenting how inconvenient a child's body is.
But just as he released Alice's hand, she suddenly opened her eyes, full of doubt, 'Where are you going?'
'Ah... I need to go to the bathroom,' little Merlin whispered.
'......Alice relaxed a bit, her sleepy eyes fluttering as she turned and hugged the pillow, 'Hurry back, don't run off...'
'I know, don't treat me like an old mother.'
little Merlin objected unhappily, put on his coat and left the room.

After little Merlin finished taking care of his physiological needs and prepared to return to his room, he suddenly saw a glowing fairy dart past on the way.
'Huh? What was that just now?'
The fairy Feri had successfully sneaked into the palace secretly, intending to listen to the dwarf Bali's words and steal the elf tribe's fine wine.
Relying on her palm-sized figure, she avoided many patrolling elves and found the wine storage.
Feri flew above the wine bottle, straining to pull out the cork, took a sniff, and her whole body felt light and euphoric.
'...So fragrant, Bali really didn't lie to me.'
Just as Feri was pondering how to smuggle this bottle of wine out, suddenly a hand grabbed her tiny body, startling her terribly.
'Who! ? Let go of me!'
'Hmph~' little Merlin tightly grasped the fairy Feri, examining this little fellow with an evil gaze—
'Didn't expect that? Little thing...
'We meet again. This time I'll see where you try to run.'
