title: Chapter 21 — Down It in One Swig (Bonus Update)
content:
Chapter 21 — Down It in One Swig (Bonus Update)

Volume 22 · Chapter 21

"It's actually you!?" Fairy Phyr stared wide-eyed in shock, never expecting to encounter the human brat she'd mocked during the day inside the elf palace.

"That's right, it's me~" Little Merlin looked at the tiny fairy in his hand and narrowed his eyes. "You haven't forgotten how you mocked me during the day, have you?"

"....." Fairy Phyr's gaze darted around, then suddenly he flashed an innocent smile. "I was just joking around, don't take it to heart. How about we make up and let bygones be bygones?"

"Cut it out, do you take me for a child? A few words and it's done?" Little Merlin wasn't buying it and said meaningfully, "Talk it over. How do you want to die, you little thing?"

"Gugu... Fairy Phyr began to cry pitifully. "I have an old mother in her thousands of years above, and hundreds of babies just under a year old below. Please show mercy, brave warrior~"

Little Merlin's face darkened, unmoved by the clichéd plea. "Is that your dying word?"

"Snarl!" Fairy Phyr saw that begging wouldn't work and immediately turned stern. "Do you think I'm afraid of you? You're just a human brat, plain and simple."

"..What did you say?" Little Merlin's brows furrowed deeply. "Don't you know your situation?"

Fairy Phyr gave a mysterious smile, then suddenly opened his mouth and bit Merlin's finger hard—!

".. Little Merlin sucked in a sharp breath and instinctively loosened his grip on the fairy. He blew hard on his finger and saw tiny tooth marks on it, anger surging within. He hadn't expected this little thing to be so cunning!

"Hehe~" Fairy Phyr vibrated his cicada-like wings and made his escape, not forgetting to continue making faces and taunting Little Merlin. "Stinky human brat! Foolish pig! Want revenge? Come back when you've grown your hair in, bweh bweh bweh~"

Little Merlin's face flushed red, his every instinct screaming to strangle the tiny fairy. Enraged, he chased after him. "I won't let you get away! Come down if you've got the guts and let's fight three hundred rounds!"<>

Outside the palace, the black elf captain from earlier was drinking heavily in solitude. Having been slapped to his face by Sylph in public, he felt deep humiliation.

He leaned alone against the wall, head drooping, the evening breeze stirring his tattered cloak, giving him a desolate air of unrecognized talent.

The black elf captain believed this was the elf king's prejudice against his own dark-skinned kin—himself equally capable yet ignored, the differential treatment far too obvious.

"Damn elves.. your rule.. shall end here...."

The black elf captain raised the bottle to his lips, but after setting it down, he witnessed something utterly incredible—

Little Merlin had chased the fairy and was still frantically cursing as it flew overhead, his two short legs bouncing nonstop, unable to catch that foul-mouthed fairy no matter what.

"You can fly, so what? Come down and fight me! If I can't beat others right now, surely I can handle you?"

"Tsk tsk tsk!" Fairy Phyr flew at a leisurely pace, as if deliberately provoking him. "Big talk coming from you. If I just come down because you ask, wouldn't that cost me face?"

"A one-on-one fair fight, what are you afraid of? Plain and simply, creatures like you can only bully someone like me." Little Merlin tried goading him into coming down.

"Why should I listen to you? If you're so angry, come up and fight me! Someone who can't even climb up isn't worthy of crossing blades with me!" Fairy Phyr struck an arrogant pose, taking advantage of Little Merlin's short legs and inability to fly to thoroughly mock the human brat.

" Cunning bastard, once I catch you, you're dead!" Little Merlin rolled his eyes in frustration.

"Too bad you can't catch me~" Fairy Phyr vibrated his wings and flew even higher. "Can't accept it? Then come up and get me!"

"Come down!" Little Merlin bared his fangs, looking somewhat threatening.

"Come up then~" Fairy Phyr crossed his legs midair, showing zero respect for Little Merlin.

The two kept goading each other, like two weaklings pecking at each other, neither willing to back down an inch.

But in no time at all, Fairy Phyr's expression suddenly changed. No longer bothering to argue with Little Merlin, he shot away at incredible speed.

"Haha! Scared now, huh? Thought I'd be so easy to mess with?" Little Merlin grew smug, assuming Fairy Phyr fled out of fear of him.

Fairy Phyr wasn't afraid of Little Merlin at all—he'd spotted someone terrible approaching and knew staying would risk getting caught in the crossfire.

Little Merlin was still basking in his victory when suddenly a shadow engulfed him, forcing him to turn around in surprise—

The black elf captain reeked of alcohol, gazing coldly down at Little Merlin as though he'd finally found an outlet for his frustration.

The black elf captain hadn't forgotten that during the day, Alice had defeated him with a single strike, humiliating him completely. And Little Merlin was the child by her side. With no one around now, he really wanted to vent this disgrace on this human child. Besides, today's incident had gone unpunished—why not just seize this kid and take him back?

The black elf captain's heart thrilled, growing restless. That female adventurer had been around before, leaving him no opportunity at all, but now she'd run off on her own. There was no reason not to be ruthless!

Little Merlin sensed the other party's ill intent and grew alert. ".... Is something the matter?"

The elf captain didn't speak, just stared coldly at Little Merlin, his thoughts unreadable.

"If nothing's up, I'm going back..." Little Merlin felt a chill of unease, bowing his head as he quickened his pace, wanting to return to Alice's side. This place was too dangerous.

Just as Little Merlin and the black elf captain brushed past each other, the latter suddenly made a move, extending a demonic claw to grab Little Merlin. Merlin, alert, sidestepped and caused the other to miss, demanding, "What are you doing!?"

"What am I doing? Hehehe... The black elf captain's smile grew increasingly grotesque. His eyes widened, his tone sinister. "You humiliated me today... I'm going to torture you properly!"

"...." Little Merlin retreated a step in horror. The other party was at least a Saint-tier expert; he had no power to resist. ".... You should calm down. What happened today was all a misunderstanding!"

"Misunderstanding? Defeated in a single move by a commoner, what face do I have to stay here anymore?!" The black elf captain pointed at Little Merlin, squinting his eyes. "That female adventurer seems to care about you quite a lot, must be very important to you, right? Don't blame us for being ruthless—it's your own fault for trespassing on our land!"

"I'm not crazy...." Little Merlin continued backing away, then suddenly felt something in his pocket. Fortunately, he'd worn a jacket when coming out, granting him one last lifeline. Otherwise, he'd truly be fish on a cutting board. It was the last vial of antidote Ceresi had left him!

"I'm not crazy! You've come at the worst possible time. So consider yourselves unlucky!" The black elf captain's eyes burned with fanaticism as he ferociously lunged toward Little Merlin.

"Don't come over!" Little Merlin drew the final potion from his chest, his expression serious.

"What!? Begging for mercy? Too late...." The black elf captain laughed wildly, his voice sinister and hair-raising. "Daring to make a move on me— that's your greatest mistake!"

Little Merlin's gaze hardened. He pulled the stopper from the vial and—the last bottle of antidote—drank it down in one gulp right there!

title: Chapter 22 — Coming Attack
content:
Chapter 22 — Coming Attack

Volume 22 · Chapter 22

The sun had not yet risen the next day, obviously not in accordance with Sersi's instructions, so he forced himself to drink the antidote early.
In this situation, Merlin had no choice; at best he could gamble. If the antidote worked, defeating the black elf captain in front of him would be no problem!
Merlin forced himself to drink the antidote to the end, waves of nausea rolled in his stomach nonstop.
"....What did you drink?!" The black elf captain became tense instinctively, thinking it was some kind of power‑up potion that could boost strength in a short time.
"Hum hum!" Merlin smashed the antidote bottle hard, wiped his mouth, "Behave and wait to die! After drinking this bottle, no one is my opponent!"
"..... The black elf captain was frightened by Merlin's demeanor, a chill ran down his back.
"You will see my true form, prepare to tremble beneath my feet!"
Merlin already felt a hot power surging inside his body, as if he would return to his original form in the next second.
His small body began to tremble, he lifted his head and stared angrily at the black elf captain, and let out a roar—
"Gag~|"
The black elf captain's expression was blank, looking at Merlin as if watching a monkey—, not sure what kind of trick this was.
The atmosphere suddenly became awkward, a gentle evening breeze brushed by, silence was absolute....
Merlin's expression turned fearful, cold sweat on his forehead kept pouring, he thought, damn! Why didn't it turn back!
I clearly drank all the antidote, but it had no effect at all! Sersi, this old witch, must be deceiving me, giving me fake medicine!
Even if I didn't take it on time, a little early, it wouldn't be like... no effect at all, right?
Sersi, old witch! I curse your ancestors! How dare you deceive me!
Merlin rolled his eyes, nearly fainted, becoming more convinced that the old woman was unreliable, regretful in his heart.
"Ha, you don't think that by acting crazy and foolish I'll let you go? Dream on!" The black elf captain's gaze was fixed, his fist slammed directly on Merlin's nose bridge.
Ah! Merlin's vision went black, he fell into a faint.
The black elf captain carried Merlin, looked around warily, then disappeared into the darkness.
Behind a distant tree, the fairy Furry witnessed all of this, seeing that human little demon being taken away violently by the black elf, a feeling of indescribable guilt arose in his heart—
"I..."
Did I do something bad?
When Merlin woke up again, the scene before his eyes was very strange, it looked like a mysterious room.
Gold‑plated furniture surrounded it, and a huge mirror stood out particularly.
Merlin became nervous, discovering he was bound in a complicated way, like a zongzi thrown on the ground, unable to move.
"Damn! Where is this? Where have I been taken to?"
Merlin frowned and struggled, but the ropes were tied very tightly, even no space to twist, he lifted his head, looked around, and saw two elves, one finished T QEZ / eight cure.
The black elf captain knelt on one knee, bowed humbly, "The situation is probably like this, Her Highness Xue Li privately invited two humans over, that human woman has formidable strength, and is likely connected to the human Light Church."
"Oh?" Andiaya sat on a chair, scratching her nails, "So that means the prophecy has begun to come true? Even if his prophecy is vague, it has never failed once."
"What do we do? If the Elf King's words are destined to come true, won't our plan be doomed?" the black elf captain worriedly said.
"You should know, I don't believe in fate or such, I only believe that as long as power is strong enough, anyone's destiny can be controlled." Andiaya said calmly.
"Your meaning..." the black elf captain asked, not understanding.
"If we kill these two outsiders, I don't believe the dead can play any more tricks?" Andiaya's face showed a sinister smile.
"I have already captured the child among the two, should we kill him now?" the black elf captain eager to try.
"Don't act here, it's too close to the Elf King's palace, he will smell the blood and notice something. Before the plan starts, don't easily scare the snake." Andiaya paused, suspiciously said, "Although he is weak now, who knows if he has any backup? I don't believe this old fox has any resistance at all, so you order your subordinates to secretly deal with this little demon."
"Understood." The black elf captain nodded.
"As for that female adventurer? Is she strong?" Andiaya asked curiously.
"..... Yes, I was defeated within one round. I wanted to drink the dark potion and fight her, but when Hielv came over, I didn't dare to act." The black elf captain said awkwardly.
"One round defeat... Andiaya frowned, clearly becoming dissatisfied, 'Compared to Samuel, you are really useless. It's a pity I couldn't kill him...'
The black elf captain felt a wave of humiliation, bit his teeth and said, "It's me who is useless, Master, please punish me."
"Forget it, I've been busy lately, no time to deal with you. Andiaya waved her hand, continued, 'I'll personally go and capture that female adventurer in the name of maintaining kingdom safety. After all, Xue Li invited her anyway. Andiaya's body is a bit weak, but it can still let me unleash some power to deal with those beyond Saint‑tier, no problem.'"
Merlin could not understand what they were saying, his heart filled with anger, "Hey! Let me go! Do you know who I am? Be careful, I'll slaughter you!"
".... Andiaya chuckled lightly, approached, squatted and lifted Merlin's face, 'Your temper may not be small, but you look like a child who can crush with a finger. Are you the demon in the prophecy? Completely unlike...'
"Pfft!" Merlin spat at Andiaya, drooling, said in a bad attitude, "Give you a chance, let me go, I can pretend nothing happened, otherwise don't blame me for being rude!"
Andiaya wiped the drool from her face, her complexion turned cold, "Slap" she gave Merlin a slap.
"Hmm!" Merlin widened his eyes, feeling incredulous, in his life, this is the first time a fearless person dared to slap himself? 0口SE this novel
"Do you think the threat is useful? Poor little thing, you'll soon go to hell." Andiaya said with a mocking expression.
Merlin narrowed his eyes, his face full of anger, gritted his teeth and said, "I remember this slap, don't let me turn over, otherwise I'll pay you double!"
"Hmph, fool..." Andiaya raised her hand, emitting a wave of black light, Merlin instantly became powerless, fainted again, "Take him out of the palace, order subordinates to find a deserted place..."
.... The black elf captain bowed in response.
Outside the window, the fairy Furry peered through a crack, secretly observing everything, feeling the situation becoming more and more ominous—
What to do?

Feeling like someone is about to start spraying me, I don't need you, I'll do it myself.

"How long will it take to get water, when will Merlin come back! ? J"
