title: Chapter 23 — Death Without Life (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 23 — Death Without Life (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 22 · Chapter 23

Deep into the night, Andydia brought the Dark Elf Captain, preparing to seize Alice directly and execute her.

Behind them followed an entire squad of Dark Elf guards, marching with menacing intent toward Alice's residence.

Andydia was determined not to let these two outsiders escape; she would not allow the Elf King's prophecy to come true and ruin her grand plan.

"Master, that female adventurer is a demon swordswielder who manipulates ice, and she seems to also possess the power of a dragon. She may be troublesome to deal with," the Dark Elf Captain reminded her.

"It doesn't matter. As long as she isn't powerful enough to rival the Explosive Flame Sacred Dragon, there won't be any pressure in handling her. That Red Dragon is the strongest among the Sacred Dragons, and even the Elf King would not underestimate it," Andydia said confidently. "Have you forgotten how powerful I once was? The power of the Elf God once surged within my body. Even if I can only unleash a portion of it now, it is still more than enough to crush the vast majority of human powerhouses."

"I seem to have overthought things. Your strength needs no doubt," the Dark Elf Captain said, not doubting at all. If it weren't for Arado being deceived back then, it would have been the Elf King who died.

"You only need to assist me wholeheartedly. In the future, the commander of the Personal Guard Knights won't be Sylph, but you," Andydia said with meaningful tone.

The Dark Elf Captain looked up, silently clenching its fists, unable to hide the excitement in its eyes. This was exactly what it wanted.

Andydia suddenly stopped in her tracks, her expression strange, a blush spreading across her cheeks, her delicate frame trembling slightly as if something uncomfortable had suddenly seized her body.

What was happening!? A wave of heat surged through this body, it felt so... so strange...

Andydia's eyes widened, her demeanor becoming coy and awkward. Her legs unconsciously rubbed together, like a woman holding in urine, as though something might leak out.

The saliva's effect from Little Merlin began to take hold, tormenting Andydia relentlessly. Arado, residing within Andydia's body, felt a most peculiar sensation — it was incinerating her mind.

Seeing Andydia acting strangely, the Dark Elf Captain ordered the entire squad to halt and asked in puzzlement, "Master, what's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"

"...Nothing..." Andydia's face flushed red, her eyes darting evasively.

"...Hmm..." The Dark Elf Captain frowned, wanting to speak but holding back.

"Shut up!" Andydia snapped angrily, the restlessness within her body growing ever stronger. "Take everyone and rest for now. We'll deal with that female adventurer tomorrow morning!"

"Huh? We're almost there..." The Dark Elf Captain grew even more confused, unable to grasp what状况 Andydia was in.

"Listen to me! Wait first!" Andydia said angrily, her tone brooking no dissent. Under the gaze of all the elves, she turned and headed back.

Damn it! What's wrong with me? Am I poisoned or something?

No way, who could plot against me right under my own nose?

I'm male, so why is my mind filled with thoughts of men...

In a secret room far from the palace, the walls were lined with various terrifying torture instruments.

From the dark depths of the chamber came the hungry roar of a tiger, the kind of monster being kept in captivity unknown.

This was the secret interrogation room supporting Arado's remnants. The Dark Elves would capture certain important people here, subject them to brutal torture, and then silently kill them without a trace.

The remnants who supported Arado had not perished; they continued their secret operations underground, striving to overthrow the Elf King's rule.

Shirley being trafficked as a slave to Britain was all orchestrated by these remnants. It was a pity she didn't die out there and actually returned alive.

"Ouch!"

Little Merlin, tightly bound, was roughly thrown onto the floor, a large bump forming on his forehead.

Little Merlin turned his head angrily, glaring at the Dark Elf guard who had been bullying him.

This Dark Elf guard wasn't particularly strong, merely mid-tier in实力, and seemed to be the manager of the interrogation room.

For an enemy this weak, Merlin could normally dispatch him without breaking a sweat, but right now he couldn't even win, let alone had to be tossed around like a ragdoll.

" bastard! If you have any honor left, untie my ropes and let's fight one-on-one!"

"Hehe, already sent here and still talking tough. Consider yourself a bit spine among the criminals, I suppose?" The Dark Elf guard picked up Little Merlin, examining him with interest.

"Dammit! You kind of family..." Little Merlin ground his teeth in fury, feeling exactly like a tiger bullied by dogs after falling on hard times.

"Now that you've come here, don't think about leaving alive. I usually torture White Elves and other alien races, never expected to get a criminal this time~" The Dark Elf guard let out a smug laugh.

"I'm not human, I'm a demon," Little Merlin clarified.

"A demon? Hmm?" The Dark Elf guard looked puzzled, studying Little Merlin closely. "What kind of joke is this? If you're a demon, where are your horns?"

"..." Little Merlin frowned. "I don't have horns..."

"You don't think claiming you're not human will save your life, do you? Too naive!" The Dark Elf guard leaned close to Little Merlin, his expression becoming ferocious. "You disgusting criminals all deserve to be sliced a thousand times! Because you received divine help, you've been recklessly slaughtering us alien races and seizing our homeland since the Holy War! Even dying a hundred times wouldn't be enough to cleanse your sins!"

"That has nothing to do with me!" Little Merlin emphasized solemnly, thinking that in the ancient Holy War, the demon race was the main force among alien races fighting the Spirits, and in a certain sense, they were allies with all non-human kinds.

"Stop trying to justify yourself. You're different from the usual people sent here — you're a criminal! Killing you directly would be letting you off too easily. I'll torture you until you beg for death!" The Dark Elf guard lifted Little Merlin and walked directly deeper inside. "Enjoy the pain of your body being slowly devoured!"

"What are you doing!?" Little Merlin struggled, but the ropes were too tight, leaving him unable to move.

The Dark Elf guard said nothing, opened the door to a cellar, and without mercy tossed Little Merlin inside.

"Ah!" Little Merlin cried out in pain as he hit the ground, covered in dust, the surroundings pitch black.

"Criminal, enjoy yourself. I'll come collect your bones tomorrow to offer to Great Arado..." The Dark Elf guard grinned and locked the cellar door.

"..." Cold sweat trickled down Little Merlin's forehead. He held his breath and listened intently, his heart pounding loudly, completely unaware of what might be in the darkness.

Suddenly, a pair of scarlet eyes lit up in the dark, accompanied by low growls.

A brown, muscular saber-toothed tiger approached Little Merlin with hungry eyes.

Bone spines protruded from its back, its sharp claws gleamed coldly, and its two enormous fangs were terrifying to behold.

The saber-toothed tiger was a high-tier magic beast, an extremely dangerous existence for mercenaries, very difficult to handle.

In the tiger's eyes, the human child before it was a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, nothing more than a meal to fill its belly.

"Urgh!" Little Merlin's eyes widened, his pale face filled with horror, the foul stench of blood washing over him. Despair consumed his heart —

This is fucking hell...

title: Chapter 24 — Capture
content:
Chapter 24 — Capture

Volume 22 · Chapter 24

The saber-toothed tiger stared at little Merlin with hungry eyes, looking like it hadn't eaten for days, thick saliva slowly flowing from its mouth.

"Don't... don't come over! I'm not someone to be messed with!

Little Merlin swallowed nervously, looking around. The cellar was pitch black, seemingly with no escape route.

Then he instinctively looked at the saber-toothed tiger's ** and suddenly discovered this caged magical beast was female! ?

Little Merlin instantly felt like he'd grabbed a lifeline, and something began to brew in his throat.

Whatever species it is, I'll vomit first!

Outside, the fairy Phoenix saw the dark elf guards lock the cellar, then sat down leisurely to drink tea.

It wanted to know the human child's situation, but didn't want to risk itself. If caught by that dark elf, it definitely wouldn't have a good outcome!

The Phoenix hiding in the shadows hesitated, then bit its lip, vibrating its cicada-like wings to secretly leave the dangerous place-

- What does the safety of a sinner have to do with me?

Maybe this child did something wrong to be caught by the dark elf. Just pretend to see nothing...

The next day, just as dawn broke.

Alice, Shirley, and Sylph gathered in a room, the atmosphere oppressive.

"Mr. Merlin disappeared last night! ?" Shirley exclaimed in shock, finding it unbelievable.

"Yes, he never came back after going to the bathroom last night. I've searched everywhere nearby, completely unable to find any trace of Merlin."

Alice was in low spirits, like she'd lost her soul. Waking up to find Merlin hadn't returned, she immediately sensed something was wrong.

So she searched many places Merlin might have gone, finding absolutely no clues.

Thinking Merlin might have been bullied outside, Alice couldn't suppress her worry, her furrowed brows didn't relax all night.

"Where could Mr. Merlin have gone? Could he have friends here?" Shirley asked doubtfully.

"Impossible, it's his first time here, he wouldn't have friends." Alice shook her head.

"Could it be he was playing and left the palace without permission?" Sylph couldn't help but speculate.

"He's not a child at all..." Alice slapped her forehead, saying self-reproachfully, "It's all my fault, I should never have left him...

"Alice, calm down. I'll secretly send guards to look for him. As long as Merlin hasn't left the elf territory, finding him won't be hard." Shirley comforted Alice.

"That's right, I can go out with other knights. This is alien territory, finding a human child isn't hard." Sylph said seriously.

"I can't stay here any longer. If I don't find Merlin, my heart won't settle."

Alice turned and picked up her and Merlin's weapons, preparing to leave the palace immediately to search for Merlin's trail.

Shirley thought Alice's mental state was bad and wanted her to rest, but just as the words reached her throat, an unexpected thing happened-

With a "bang," the door was kicked open by brute force. A team of elf guards rushed in, surrounding Alice.

"....Alice became alert, staring at the guards with a wary look.

Shirley was astonished, seeing the elf guards burst into her room at a loss, "What are you doing? Who allowed you in? Back off!"

The elf guards pointed their spears at Alice, unmoved by Shirley's words, as if they hadn't heard.

Sylph sensed something was wrong and shouted angrily, "Didn't you hear the princess's order? Get out!"

"Sylph, you've got quite an attitude? Dare to shout at my people... Andyia approached gracefully, followed by a dark elf captain with a smirking face."

"Princess consort! ?" Sylph froze, not expecting Andyia to come over, but seeing the dark elf captain behind her, she instantly understood—it must have secretly reported!

"What's your reaction? You don't welcome me?" Andyia said with a mocking tone.

"No..." Sylph lowered her head, recalling what the Elf King had told her. Andyia seemed mentally unstable now. Her task was to protect Shirley from harm.

"Human, who allowed you in here?" Andyia looked at Alice, saying meaningfully, "We never welcome sinners. Unauthorized entry into the kingdom is punishable by hanging. I suspect you're a spy sent by humans, a highly dangerous fellow. Put down your weapons and await trial."

Alice frowned, sensing trouble.

"Mother! She's my friend, she saved me outside. You can't do this!" Shirley explained involuntarily.

"Shut up!" Andyia glared at Shirley with fierce eyes, saying seriously, "You stupid child, letting a dangerous sinner in is already bad enough, and you dare speak for her? I haven't scolded you properly yet!

....Shirley was scared speechless by Andyia's gaze, feeling her mother's attitude was terrible, as if she'd done something unforgivable. She used to be a gentle and kind elf when young.

"Then, human... Andyia gazed at Alice, saying seriously, "Do you want to put down your weapons, or resist to the end?"

"I won't hand my life to anyone else..." Alice's eyes turned sharp, and she suddenly drew her sword, releasing intense cold air!

The elf guards surrounding Alice were suppressed by the imposing dragon aura. With her sword swings, she created sharp pale golden ice shards out of thin air!

The elf guards were knocked flying one after another, crashing into walls, falling into poisoned unconsciousness....

"Dare to be arrogant on our territory? !" The dark elf captain drew two short swords from his waist and charged, his fierce swordsmanship targeting the enemy's throat. He clearly had no intention of capturing alive, intending to kill Alice.

Alice kept a cold face, saying nothing. Her slender sword flipped continuously, releasing sword flowers, splashing layers of ice shards, stabbing back!

"Uh! ?" The dark elf captain was startled, hastily raising both short swords to block. The weapon clash emitted a piercing metallic sound!

Alice's eyes suddenly turned golden, like torches in the night. The cold air around her intensified again, eroding the enemy along her slender sword.

Only to see the dark elf captain's body freezing at a visible speed, seemingly about to be frozen alive to death? !

"Scream! Useless trash...

Andyia got angry, light glowing from her fingertips, constructing a pitch-black spear out of thin air.

This spear was made of magic power, yet the radiance it emitted was dazzling!

Andyia moved her fingers slightly, and when Alice's attention was on the dark elf captain, launched a sneak attack--

The pitch-black magic spear shot out, unexpectedly piercing Alice's left shoulder.

Her body was nailed to the wall along with it......

title: Chapter 25 — Double Imprisonment (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 25 — Double Imprisonment (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 22 · Chapter 25

“Alice!” Sherry, seeing Alice heavily injured, exclaimed in shock and wanted to rush out to save her.

“Calm down! Your Highness!” Sylph blocked Sherry, speaking in a low, conflicted voice, “You were already wrong to invite sinners into the palace. The Consort’s actions are perfectly justified.”

“......She’s my friend,” Sherry said sadly, looking at Alice with pity, “If she’s to be punished, then punish me instead! It was I who insisted on inviting them; it’s my fault!”

“I hope you can mature a bit, Your... Highness,” Sylph said with a serious expression, bowing her head, “Do you intend to defy your own mother? Are you sure you have the resolve and ability for that?”

“......Sherry was speechless, not knowing how to respond.

“Please believe me.” Sylph’s eyes were serious, as if hinting at something to Sherry.

Alice’s aura was suppressed; a pitch-black magic spear pierced through her shoulder, pinning her entire body to the wall.

She furrowed her brow; cold sweat slid slowly from her forehead, a piercing pain spreading through her whole body as her shoulder went numb.

Alice, disregarding her bleeding wound, grabbed the magic spear with her hand, trying to pull it out of her body.

But the moment she touched Andyia’s magic spear, Alice froze in shock, her whole body stiffening, unable to move—

The spear harbored an overwhelming, frenzied magic power that constantly disrupted the force suppressing Alice, leaving her unable to exert any strength.

Even Alice, who had seen much, was shocked by this magic power.

Alice raised her head in astonishment, looking at Andyia, and vaguely felt that this Consort was not as simple as she appeared!

“Hmph, you’re not much either...” Andyia came before Alice, looking at her meaningfully—

“Take her away.”

In some alley on the street, the dwarf Balor felt extremely disappointed because Firi hadn’t stolen the elf wine last night.

Meanwhile, the fairy Firi lay in Balor’s messy hair, gazing at the sky with a thoughtful expression, seeming preoccupied.

“That was elf wine! It’s a pity we didn’t steal it; we probably won’t get another chance to drink it.” The dwarf Balor smacked his lips, looking dejected.

“....” Firi the fairy responded nonchalantly.

“You successfully infiltrated the palace last night, didn’t you? For you, stealing a bottle of wine shouldn’t be hard, right?” Balor asked with confusion.

“Hm...” Firi maintained the same attitude, her brow furrowed with worry.

“What’s wrong with you? What happened last night? Ever since you came back, you’ve been ignoring me...” Balor frowned, thinking his friend was acting strange.

“Tch!” Firi sat up on Balor’s head, irritable, “You’re so talkative... So annoying.”

“I just noticed you seemed distracted. You’re usually so cheerful...” Balor scratched his messy hair.

Firi froze, then sighed, “Is that so? That... may I ask you something?”

“Sure, but why are you taking this so seriously? It’s not like you at all.” Balor became more puzzled.

“Stop talking nonsense.” Firi frowned, “You said the sinners were vicious and had committed unforgivable sins against us, so their children aren’t good people either, right?”

“This...” Balor thought for a moment, then asked in return, “Are you talking about that uneducated human child yesterday?”

“Ah... well...” Firi said guiltily.

“That’s a hard question to answer. You fairies instinctively distinguish good from evil. Since you weren’t repulsed by approaching the sinner’s child, he must be a good little guy.” Balor answered simply.

“So sure?” A drop of cold sweat rolled down Firi’s forehead.

“You’re a fairy, after all. Though your kind is few in number and weak in power, the reason you’ve survived until now is precisely your instinct, right?” Balor paused, speaking in a firm tone, “A creature a fairy is willing to approach definitely isn’t a bad one.”

“......” Firi’s brow tightened. Regarding young Merlin’s matter, she wavered more and more. Though she could pretend it never happened, the guilt in her heart was very uncomfortable.

“Are you starting to take interest in humans?” Balor asked with confusion.

“No...” Firi shook her head, standing on Balor’s head, “Then... can you defeat a Black Elf?”

“I’m a blacksmith, not a warrior. My future father expects me to carry on the family trade.” Balor trembled his bushy mustache.

“I suddenly feel that besides making weapons and armor, you seem to have no other use.” Firi placed her hand on her forehead, looking disappointed.

“Who said that? Our dwarf race is also brave and warlike. Even if I’m a blacksmith, I have my ancestors’ blood in me. Taking on two adult ordinary Black Elves isn’t a problem, as long as they don’t use magic on me~” Balor said confidently.

“You serious?” Firi immediately perked up.

“Of course! Our dwarf warriors are known as Knee Enders!” Balor replied proudly.

“Why are they called Knee Enders?” Firi didn’t understand.

“Because our dwarf race averages less than a meter tall. We can only reach people’s knees when we jump. The knees we’ve shattered could circle the world several times. Impressive, right?” Balor said proudly.

“Emmmm...” Firi was speechless, suddenly hovering into the air and waving to Balor—

“Fine, I’ll trust you once. As long as you can fight.”

“Follow me, I’ll take you to... the...”

In the kingdom’s prison, darkness reigned without sunlight.

On the table lay two weapons: the Light Ode and Banri Garan.

The captured Alice was imprisoned here, guarded by the Black Elf captain.

Andyia, to prevent unpredictable events, prepared to deal with Alice and Merlin separately.

Alice was fitted with shackles that sealed her magic and martial energy, and her whole body was hung up.

Crack! The sound of the whip exploded, echoing through the prison cell—

The Black Elf captain wielded his whip, mercilessly lashing Alice until her skin was torn and flesh exposed.

It recalled being defeated in a single round, and the fury in its heart became uncontrollable—

Taking advantage of Alice’s plight, it would take revenge on this sinner who had humiliated it, letting her know the consequence of crossing it!

The whip struck Alice’s body fiercely, yet she kept her head low in silence, not uttering a single cry of pain, enduring the storm-like lashes.

The Black Elf captain felt a bit tired and had to stop.

“Are you a block of wood? Not even a single scream? Did you never think you’d fall into my hands?”

Alice slowly raised her head, her gaze piercing. “Is this how you express anger? You’re so weak, it’s pitiful.”

“Scream!” The Black Elf captain gnashed his teeth in anger, raising his whip to strike Alice’s face, leaving a fresh red mark. “Take down that arrogant attitude! You two sinners are doomed to die anyway. Why not try begging for mercy?”

Hearing about Merlin, Alice was suddenly startled, forgetting her pain, her gaze becoming doubtful and unsettled.

“Hm? Are you worried about that kid?” The Black Elf captain seemed to have found Alice’s weakness, his expression becoming smug—

“Last night I caught him with my own hands and sent him to the secret interrogation room.”

“That place is a secret base for executing supporters of the Elf King. No one has ever come out alive.”

“Give up hope. That kid is probably already dead in there, hehehe...”

title: Chapter 27 — Betrayal of the Elves
content:
Chapter 27 — Betrayal of the Elves

Volume 22 · Chapter 27

Alice's heart sank as she heard that Merlin was already dead. "You're lying!"

"Believe it or not, killing the two of you was planned from the start. Don't be sad—you'll be reunited with him soon enough." The dark elf captain sneered coldly.

".....Alice was so angry she nearly bit through her own teeth, glaring at the dark elf captain. Before she had actually seen Merlin, she had been willing to believe the enemy's words."

"The you who has your magic and combat power sealed by shackles has no intimidating presence at all. Killing you would be as easy as taking candy from a baby." The dark elf captain tossed his whip aside, drew the short sword at his waist, and used it to lift Alice's chin. "It's over now. I'll personally send you to hell. Go ahead and confess your sins down there, criminal..."

Alice felt the cold touch of the blade against her throat. With the slightest cut, her throat would be slit.

She regretted bringing Merlin here. If she had been a little more careful, she wouldn't have run into these troubles.

Alice instinctively closed her eyes as death drew ever closer, unable to resist any longer.

But just as the dark elf captain was about to strike, footsteps echoed from the stairs...

The dark elf captain immediately grew alert, turning toward the stairway of the prison cell. Hillf descended the stairs, her gaze sweeping over Alice.

"Isn't this the Knight Captain of the Elven King's personal guard? What business brings you to this filthy prison? Don't tell me you're here to join me in torturing this criminal..." The dark elf captain said with a sly tone.

Hillf looked at the dark elf captain and, after a moment of silence, replied, "Release her."

"Did I hear that right?" The dark elf captain snapped to attention, then explained, "This is a criminal spy who infiltrated the kingdom. She's an important prisoner captured by Her Highness the Princess herself. You want me to let her go? On what grounds?"

"That's right, release her. She hasn't done anything that threatens the kingdom's safety. The accusation of being a spy is completely unfounded." Hillf said sternly.

"Did you consult with Her Highness the Princess first? If not, I advise you not to interfere." The dark elf captain said warily.

"I didn't consult with the Princess. I'm acting under the authority of the Knight Captain of the Elven King's personal guard, and I demand you release her."

Hillf's eyes grew sharp. Releasing Alice wasn't her own idea—it was only after Shirley's persistent pleading that she decided to risk coming here to rescue Alice.

After Alice was imprisoned, Shirley was frantic with worry, wanting to appeal to her father, the Elven King, to have her friend released.

But the Elven King was unwell, and even Shirley herself found it difficult to see him. She had no choice but to beg the knight she trusted most—Hillf.

Although Hillf had no particular fondness for humans, she resolutely chose to take the risk so as not to let Shirley down.

"You think you have so much authority? You're just a knight beside the Elven King. Acting on your own accord is a serious crime. I won't let you run amok here." The dark elf captain rejected Hillf, having already disliked her for some time.

"Then I have no choice but to make you submit..." Hillf drew her sword from her waist. The blade was as clear as flowing water, gleaming brightly.

Alice stared in shock, unable to believe that the elven knight beside Shirley would actually draw her sword against her own kind—all to save Alice?

"Oh? You're going to kill me just to save a criminal?" The dark elf captain frowned, surprised by Hillf's actions. "Do you even know what you're doing? This is treason!"

"This isn't treason—it's the fulfillment of my duty. My loyalty doesn't need your questioning." Hillf lightly touched her blade, and the golden combat aura on her body instantly condensed into countless glowing specks, drifting around her.

"Very well. This is your own doing, Hillf. I've been wanting to kill you for a long time. You've been riding on your status as a knight of the personal guard to casually insult me. I'll settle this grudge with your life. Right here, I'll execute you for your treason!"

Alice didn't fully understand what was happening. She could only watch in horror as the two elves—one dark, one light—began to clash. The entire prison trembled with the collision of their combat auras.

The dark elf captain moved with uncanny agility, her twin short swords weaving back and forth like a circus clown.

The sharp blades flashed through the air, her techniques fierce and lethal, striking from unexpected angles with deadly precision.

Hillf was immediately suppressed, forced to block continuously with her sword. Any moment of carelessness would see her throat sliced by the enemy's blade!

"What's wrong? Knight Captain? Is this all you've got? How disappointing!" The dark elf captain's blade seemed to have a life of its own, her swordplay like a storm of wind and rain, leaving no room for breath.

Hillf hadn't expected this seemingly unremarkable opponent to be so powerful! She was caught off guard from the very start.

Her body bore numerous mysterious wounds, slowly bleeding as she struggled to keep up with the enemy's relentless assault.

Despite Hillf's strength not being weak, she found no advantage against the dark elf captain's dual-sword acrobatics.

"How dare you become a Knight of the personal guard? This is hilarious!" The dark elf captain's combat aura erupted, sending Hillf into a flurry of retreats.

"My strength is by no means inferior, yet because of my dark elf heritage I receive no recognition. And you, with your privileged status, get to stand beside the King. Why? I'll cut off your head and prove with facts that I am the most suitable candidate to become a Knight of the personal guard!"

"No! You're wrong..." Hillf's combat aura surged, gathering in her blade. "To become a guardian of the Elven King, your strength is too far behind!"

"I want to see how long you can keep talking big!"

The dark elf captain leaped up, raised her twin swords, and brought them down in a decisive strike aimed at Hillf.

But strangely, a transparent wall suddenly appeared before Hillf, emitting a faint golden glow, stopping the dark elf captain's blades from advancing even an inch!

This transparent wall was forged from Hillf's combat aura—unbreakable and solid. No matter how the dark elf captain attacked, she couldn't break through Hillf's defense.

This was Hillf's signature technique. Compared to attacking, she was even more skilled at defense. This was precisely why the Elven King favored her and entrusted her with protecting Shirley's safety.

"What the hell is this..." The dark elf captain was amazed.

"I've spent my entire life cultivating this technique, turning my combat aura into an impenetrable defensive barrier. Compared to harming others, I'm more adept at protecting. This is the gap between you and me." Hillf's minor injuries were numerous, but her expression remained calm, her gaze toward the dark elf captain filled with contempt.

"From now on—TES

"You can't harm a single hair on my head."

title: Chapter 27 — Escape (Extra)
content:
Chapter 27 — Escape (Extra)

Volume 22 · Chapter 27

"I don't want to kill you. Give up and let me take her away." Sylph said seriously, having no intention of killing the dark elf.

"Hiding behind a wall like a coward." The dark elf captain gripped his twin swords and sneered. "I want to see just how impressive your so-called wall really is!"

"Don't force me to kill you..." Sylph's eyes turned cold. This was already her final warning.

"Then do it! Let's see what you've got!"

The dark elf crossed his two short swords, his aura churning like a wild beast. Each step he took cracked the ground beneath his feet.

He thrust both swords forward in a single motion, colliding with the invisible aura wall once again, attempting to shatter it.

The two auras crashed together once more, and the narrow prison began to shake. Pebbles rained down from the ceiling, as though it might collapse at any moment.

Esli watched silently, wanting to help but restrained by the shackles sealing her aura and magic.

Sylph looked at the dark elf captain's twisted face and closed her eyes. "You left me no choice. Don't blame me for being ruthless..."

"You're just here to rescue a criminal叛徒. Why pretend to be loyal to the kingdom?" the dark elf captain jeered. He could feel that while Sylph's aura wall was formidable, it wasn't indestructible.

Sylph sighed and raised her sword. "Vanish, you stubborn fool."

The sword came down. The once-unbreakable aura wall parted freely for Sylph, placing her in an invincible position.

The sharp blade pierced through the transparent wall and mercilessly slashed into the dark elf captain's body. Blood sprayed everywhere!

......The dark elf captain's expression twisted in disbelief. Blood gushed from the wound on his chest, exposing bright red bone. He couldn't even speak before collapsing to the ground.

Sylph stepped over the dark elf captain's corpse without expression and approached Alice. "Come with me. You need to leave here quickly."

"......Did you come specifically to rescue me?" Alice asked in confusion. She didn't feel she had any particular connection to this elven knight, so there was no reason for her to risk her life for her.

"It wasn't me. Princess Shelly ordered me to bring you away." Sylph hesitated before adding reluctantly, "I don't have much affection for humans, but you're Her Highness's friend. If anything happened to you, she would blame herself deeply."

......Alice frowned. She thought that although she and Merlin had been persecuted here, it didn't seem related to Shelly at all. Shelly was simply trying to repay the favor of being saved back then.

"Let's go quickly." Sylph didn't want to waste time and reached to unlock Alice's sealing shackles.

But to her surprise, Alice's expression suddenly changed, and she cried out loudly, "Watch out!"

In an instant, a massive figure crashed into them, stopping Sylph from rescuing Alice.

Sylph hadn't noticed and was caught completely off guard, sent flying into the hard wall.

Alice looked closely and realized it was the dark elf captain from earlier. He hadn't died at all. After getting up, he had become even stronger, though his appearance had changed drastically.

At the moment before he was about to die, the dark elf captain decisively used his trump card, downing a Special Grade Dark Potion in one gulp. He traded his life force for a massive short-term power boost!

His body had become muscular and towering, his dark skin wrapped around exaggerated muscles. His small head looked particularly out of place on such a massive frame, but the oppressive pressure radiating from him was several times stronger than before!

The dark elf captain's face was twisted with ferocity. Clearly, after drinking the dark potion, there was no turning back for him. He wanted revenge — he would kill both Sylph and Alice.

"......How is this possible? He actually used a forbidden drug..." Sylph's mouth spilled blood. She was clearly badly injured and sat weakly on the ground.

"You want to save someone? I won't let you succeed, Sylph!!!" The dark elf captain, consumed by frenzy, charged at the elven knight like an unstoppable war chariot!

"Damn it!" Sylph raised her arms and constructed an aura wall, trying to slow down the monster!

"You think this thing is still useful!?" After drinking the dark potion, the dark elf captain's frenzied power was more than enough to overwhelm Sylph. He threw a single punch, smashing a huge hole right through the aura wall!

......Sylph's heart trembled uncontrollably. Her prized technique might no longer be able to protect her.

"I'll kill you, Sylph!" The dark elf captain roared madly, reaching both hands into the crumbling aura wall and tearing it apart bit by bit.

Sylph's life was in imminent danger. Cold sweat of fear trickled down her forehead. Suddenly, she gripped her sword tightly, her gaze sharpening, and threw it with a sharp "whoosh"!

The sword whizzed past the frenzied dark elf's ear. It had veered off course and didn't inflict the slightest damage on the enemy.

Sylph's face went pale. She helplessly lowered her head, seemingly having given up all resistance. The aura wall collapsed,宣告ing her certain death!

"Hmph! Useless struggle! I'll take your life!" The dark elf captain, unstoppable, raised his heavy fist. The frenzied power kicked up stones from the ground, ready to blast Sylph right there!

"Is this really a useless struggle? Your enemy isn't me."

Sylph looked up and revealed an enigmatic smile.

The frenzied dark elf suddenly felt a biting cold wind from behind. He turned around in terror to see Alice, who had been hanging suspended, now free!

The sword Sylph had thrown earlier hadn't been aimed at the dark elf captain at all — it had been meant to rescue Alice.

The flying sword had directly severed Alice's sealing shackles, successfully freeing her from her bindings.

When Andyah had come to capture Alice, Sylph had witnessed her power.

In this enclosed prison, only this human adventurer might be able to handle the frenzied dark elf captain. Sylph was convinced of it.

"No way...." The frenzied dark elf's eyes widened in terror as he stared blankly at the severed shackles on the ground.

"Sorry about this..."

Alice suddenly raised her head, her eyes seeming to burn with golden flames. Dragon scales rapidly covered her visible body, and dragon wings unfolded from her back.

She reached toward the void, and the slender sword on the table responded to her call, quickly unsheathing and flying into her hand!

Alice's dragon aura radiated in waves, and the biting blizzard cleared the frenzied dark elf's mind somewhat.

"Die!"

"You damned criminal!"

Alice instantly appeared before the frenzied dark elf. She flicked her slender sword, and silver light erupted like a waterfall, impaling the enemy into a pincushion....

After a brief silence, Alice supported Sylph, who was badly hurt and moving with difficulty.

"Are you alright?"

"I'm not dead yet. After we get out, you'd better leave the kingdom quickly, or Her Highness the Princess won't let you off." Sylph said weakly.

"......I have to find Merlin first." Alice refused to give up.

Sylph glanced at Alice, frowned, and couldn't help but voice her thoughts.

"The dark elves aren't gentle, and they hate humans even more than I do."

"If the dark elves captured him, he's probably already in serious danger...."

title: Chapter 28 — Ritual Begins
content:
Chapter 28 — Ritual Begins

Volume 22 · Chapter 28

Alice fell silent, unwilling to believe Sylph's words, persistently saying, "That guy won't die so easily. Even if he does, I must see his corpse."

".....Sylph was stunned, lowered her head and said, "Your strength is impressive. To be honest, I've seen many humans, most of whom are mercenary. You're one of the rare ones with noble qualities. I have a bit of respect for you now."

"Thank....." Alice replied distractedly, her mind full of how to find Merlin. Since the black elves had taken him, she feared she'd have to beg that terrifyingly powerful princess for his return.

"I find it rather puzzling why you'd care for someone so arrogant and rude," Sylph said meaningfully. She couldn't understand why Alice and Merlin would be together—in her view, their statuses were simply not on the same level.

"I'm the only one who needs to know about Merlin's brilliance. I don't need anyone else's approval," Alice responded calmly.

Sylph was suddenly taken aback, faintly sensing a strong possessiveness. She immediately pushed her doubts aside. "Alright, if you insist on staying to search for him, I won't stop you. But let me remind you—be careful. Andiya won't let you off easily."

"What about you? I heard that black elf say you committed treason...." Alice looked at Sylph, a bit uneasy in her heart. After all, the person had been saddled with the traitor label because of her.

"There's nothing to worry about. I'll bid farewell to Her Highness Shelly, then secretly leave here to lay low until His Majesty the Elf King reappears. Then I can come back." Sylph had long thought out her own escape plan.

The two cautiously walked out of the prison and came outside. They had expected the scene to remain peaceful, but who would have known it had already undergone earth-shaking changes—

The earth was violently shaking, and rocks kept floating up toward the sky, as if heaven and earth were about to be turned upside down!

Twelve light pillars more dazzling than the sun shot up into the sky, together forming a colossal golden magic formation. An ancient chant slowly sang from the vortex at the center.

Countless elves lay unconscious on the ground throughout the streets, their souls slowly leaving their bodies and continuously gathering toward the center of the magic formation....

"Wha....." Sylph's eyes immediately widened in shock, her heart filled with terror. "Who is casting the elf race's forbidden magic?!"

"I've seen that magic formation before. Back then, an evil entity was about to awaken...." Alice looked at the apocalyptic scene before her and inexplicably felt a sense of familiarity. She had experienced the same thing once before in Britannia.

"This is one of the three great forbidden magics—Elf's Lament. It sacrifices the souls of countless living beings to pull the dead back from hell—a devilish spell." Sylph lowered her head and thought carefully. "Archdoll. No doubt about it, it must be it!"

"Archdoll?" Alice was puzzled, having never heard of that name.

"The black elves still have designs on the throne. I still can't leave...." Sylph's gaze grew resolute as she looked at those half-dead elves lying on the ground—

If the Elf's Lament succeeded, then Shelly would die too.

She feared that right now, just like these elves, her soul had left her body and she had fallen into a coma.

At the center of the Elf's Lament magic formation, Andiya floated in mid-air, constantly pouring her magic power into the formation to drive the ritual forward.

Right now the Elf King's strength had severely degenerated and posed no threat. The other leaders of the kingdom couldn't arrive in time. And there was even one who—

Even the two troublemakers hinted at in the prophecy had been killed by Andiya. Everything seemed to be going smoothly?

This time, she feared no one could stop Archdoll's return. That fortunate one who had inherited the power of the Elf God was finally going to use fear to dominate this land once again.

However, Andiya probably hadn't expected that both Alice and Merlin were still alive, having each somehow managed to survive by a stroke of luck.

The more souls were drawn in, the more dazzling the golden magic formation became, making it hard to tell whether it was day or night—

"Hurry up, a little faster, hahaha. I'm about to return to my own body. When that happens, not only will I enslave all the other races, but humans will become slaves to the elves too..."

Archdoll within Andiya was extremely excited and fanatical. It wanted to be resurrected, to pull the world back to the era that belonged to the elves, and to prove that it was the one most suited to lead the elf race.

Suddenly, a pale golden ice mountain appeared out of thin air above Andiya and crashed down with unstoppable momentum!

"Hmm?!" Andiya felt the icy cold and suspiciously looked up. In her hand, a pitch-black magic spear instantly materialized, and she angrily threw it!

The surging magic spear and the enormous ice mountain collided with each other. The two forces crashed together frantically, making the sky ring with explosions akin to thunder!

The massive ice mountain was shattered by the magic spear. Countless huge chunks of ice fell, crashing onto the ground with explosive force!

Andiya turned around and saw Alice below glaring at her. "Why aren't you dead?

"It was me who saved...." Sylph slowly walked over, looking up at Andiya in the sky.

"Aren't you the Elf King's personal guard knight? Why meddle and save a criminal subject? You haven't turned traitor, have you?" Andiya showed a playful smile. "It seems your loyalty is just so-so—"

"I will ask for punishment from His Majesty and accept any penalty. But Lady Andiya, what are you doing? Unauthorized use of forbidden magic—is your intention to personally destroy this place?!" Sylph questioned sternly.

"What am I doing? Isn't it obvious? I want to return to my own body..." Andiya's smile grew ever more sinister.

"To... your own body?" Sylph frowned, increasingly puzzled.

"You fools, I am Archdoll. Andiya's body is merely my vessel!" Andiya said with a triumphant, mocking smile. "All this time, I have endured humiliation disguised as a woman. Didn't any of you suspect? It's just a pity that this body is about to become the final sacrifice!"

"Ugh!" Sylph's expression froze on her face. Recalling the Elf King's words, Andiya indeed was problematic. She just hadn't expected Archdoll to hide for so long, only revealing some clues after Her Highness Shelly was rescued. If the ritual succeeded and Archdoll returned in perfect form, the consequences would be unimaginable.

"It was you who kidnapped the child by my side, right!? Give me the person back!" Alice shouted loudly. She sympathized with the United Kingdom's situation, but clearly rescuing Merlin was the most important thing.

"Hmph! You're quite lucky, having Sylph willing to risk everything to save you. But that child by your side isn't so lucky—they've already died, right? Ha...." Andiya chuckled.

"Then! If you don't hand the person over, I'll take you down with me!" Alice's face was filled with rage, her dragon aura surging skyward.

"You can try, you defeated subordinate~" Andiya's gaze was contemptuous. Even if Alice hadn't died, it didn't matter. After all, her own return was unstoppable. No matter how much the other jumped around, she was just a clown.

Alice's eyes flashed with a flame-like golden light. She summoned a terrifying blizzard and in an instant transformed into a Frost Divine Dragon, letting out a roar toward the sky!

The Frost Divine Dragon shook its massive dragon wings and soared into the air, charging toward Andiya in the sky, wanting to fight this vicious creature to the death!

"That... that's the legendary dragon!" Sylph nearly got knocked over by the blizzard Alice summoned. She had to use both hands to protect her head, resisting those ice shards like knives—

This woman.....

Could actually transform into a Frost Divine Dragon!?

This pure magical power truly was something only possessed by high-ranking dragon clans—

Could it be that she's not human? But the sister of the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon......

title: Chapter 29 — The Count of Monte Cristo (Three Chapters Today)
content:
Chapter 29 — The Count of Monte Cristo (Three Chapters Today)

Volume 22 · Chapter 29

Andyah looked at the Frost Sacred Dragon roaring toward her and smiled calmly. "Is this your true strength? You're far from being able to stop me. Wake up, my child!"

The earth trembled violently, the intensity so extreme it felt as if one were aboard a ship on the open sea, surrounded by rolling waves.

Then from deep within the ground surged a rock giant covered entirely in moss, its massive body towering over six hundred feet tall!

Its whole form resembled a moving mountain, its hollow eyes rolling about as it opened its mouth to emit a series of aged groans—

"......

The Frost Sacred Dragon paused for a moment, startled by the sudden appearance of this colossal creature.

Even though Alice had transformed into a Frost Sacred Dragon and radiated tremendous intimidation,

compared to the rock giant she still seemed somewhat insignificant, giving one a helplessness that made it impossible to shake this enormous presence.

"Cave King?! " Sylph's eyes widened in horror. She was utterly bewildered—wasn't the sole leader of the rock race normally trapped in eternal slumber? Why was he appearing here of all places! ?

"To stop me? You're dreaming.... Andyah revealed a manic grin and continued to channel the ritual of the sprites' lament, "My child, eliminate both of them!"

"Mama!" The Cave King roared and swung his massive stone fist through the air, smashing downward at the charging Frost Sacred Dragon!

The Frost Sacred Dragon flapped its dragon wings fiercely, dodging to the side, but the turbulent winds generated by the Cave King's punch still disturbed her, sending her plummeting downward.

Even though Alice's dragon form was already extremely powerful, facing the Cave King—one of the Nine Leaders—she was at a disadvantage from the very start, his oppressive pressure far more ferocious than her own.

The Frost Sacred Dragon executed a rolling maneuver and flew forward, pushing against the Cave King's pressure before countering back, shooting out streams of cold current that condensed into enormous pale golden ice cones, firing frantically at the Cave King!

Each massive ice spike was like a holy sword from the heavens, their piercing cries ringing out repeatedly as they rained down upon the Cave King's body, unleashing storms and shattering ice in an instant!

The Cave King's defensive capability was nearly monstrous. His stony body could not be damaged by ordinary attacks—the enormous ice cones could only cause him mild discomfort!

The Cave King was enraged by the Frost Sacred Dragon's assault, letting out a low growl as he brandished his claws and limbs, desperate to grab hold of the large lizard harassing him.

The Frost Sacred Dragon realized it would take considerable effort to take down this behemoth, but fortunately the opponent moved rather slowly, leaving room to maneuver and seize victory.

The Frost Sacred Dragon dodged past the Cave King's huge hand and immediately breathed forth a torrent of frost dragon's breath, spraying it at the Cave King's legs—before her eyes they were encased in ice, immobile!

The Cave King looked down at his ice-sealed legs and let out a furious roar at the Frost Sacred Dragon, "Despicable vermin!"

The Frost Sacred Dragon seized this rare opportunity, ascending into the air, spreading her dragon wings as a terrifying blizzard surged skyward, the temperature plummeting to paralyzing levels.

A glaciation descended. Alice released her most powerful magic to date, intending to permanently freeze the Cave King right where he stood.

But the Cave King refused to sit idle and wait for death. He pounded his fists against his own legs, shattering the ice in a violent tremor, then charged ferociously toward the Frost Sacred Dragon and seized her tail.

The Frost Sacred Dragon was greatly alarmed—her spellcasting was forcibly interrupted. The Cave King had actually broken free from her ice-crystal bindings!?

The Cave King exerted tremendous force, shaking the Frost Sacred Dragon wildly before hurling her hard onto the ground!

A deafening crash shook the earth!

Sylph's face went pale. She felt her abilities would hardly be of any help, and an invisible layer of cold sweat began forming on her forehead.

Has the Cave King lost his mind! ?

Why is he helping Archduke Ardor!?

If the Sprite King doesn't wake up soon, everything will be beyond redemption!

In the cellar of the interrogation room, Little Merlin sat on the ground, utterly hopeless.

Beside him, the female saber-toothed tiger, influenced by the succubus's saliva, had gone into heat.

Her barbed tongue kept licking Little Merlin's cheek, blinking continuously, attempting to seduce Little Merlin into mating with her.

"Get away! We're different species entirely—stop getting horny at me!" Little Merlin frowned and reprimanded.

"....." The female saber-toothed tiger growled twice, walked up to Little Merlin, and raised her hindquarters.

"Oh my god...." Little Merlin rolled his eyes, thinking being locked up with a female tiger wasn't exactly a good thing—especially seeing her raising her butt at him constantly, it was so eye-searingly awful!

Creak. The cellar door opened, and a dark elf guard came to collect the corpse—but the moment he stepped inside, he saw his own saber-toothed tiger mount beast hadn't killed the prey at all, but instead was raising its rear in a coaxing manner!?

"You're not dead?!"

"Hmph, your pet seems to really like me~" Little Merlin replied with pointed meaning.

Tch! Your head better move today! Come here!" The dark elf guard grabbed the bound-and-gagged Little Merlin and headed straight for the exit.

"What are you doing!? Put me down!" Little Merlin complained noisily for a moment, but soon fell silent.

Because the dark elf captain, seeing that Little Merlin had spent the night with a wild beast and survived, had chosen the most straightforward method to kill him.

Little Merlin was pressed onto the chopping block. Glancing up, he immediately spotted the sharp axe hanging overhead, his forehead instinctively breaking into a cold sweat—"Ah—

"I want to see what other tricks you have. If your magical beast won't eat you, I can't believe you can escape even on this chopping block!" The dark elf sneered, placing his hand on the chopping block's activation lever.

"....Perhaps we could have a proper conversation." Little Merlin said nervously.

"Have a conversation with my foot!"

Just as the dark elf guard was about to press down the activation lever, sending the suspended axe down to sever Merlin's head—in that critical moment—

A roar erupted, and the dwarf Baily, wielding his tiny hammer, charged over with fierce momentum.

He stomped hard on his two short legs, leaped up, and then—smashed his hammer directly onto the ground! ? ?

Baily blinked his crossed eyes, looked over at the nearby dark elf guard in complete astonishment.

"Oh~ so the left one is the real one. I was looking at it wrong."

A black line dripped down Little Merlin's forehead. Who is this idiot!? Can he stop staring at people! ?

"Where'd this little矮子 come from? Get lost!" The dark elf captain kicked Baily aside and his forehead veins throbbed furiously in anger.

"Ouchie!" Baily bounced across the floor like a rubber ball.

The dark elf guard's attention was diverted. Furious, he marched toward Baily and unleashed a barrage of furious kicks, cursing, "You damn thing, are you here to rescue someone? With trash like you, a dwarf, you dare act heroic here!? Let me beat you to death!"

..... Baily lay on the ground, gritting his teeth and enduring the dark elf's brutal beating, making not a sound.

Meanwhile, the fairy Pherry sneaked in stealthily, flying over to Little Merlin, planning to rescue him first while the dark elf guard wasn't paying attention.

"You?! " Little Merlin was surprised, having never expected this fairy would suddenly appear!

"Shh! Keep it down, I'll untie your ropes first—

The fairy Pherry warned, then immediately began untying the ropes—using his teeth as well to increase efficiency.

"......You bastard, you've gotten me into terrible trouble. I won't let this go—I'll definitely settle this with you!" Little Merlin growled in annoyance.

"Huh? I come here to save you, and you're thinking about harming me? Then I won't save you—go die." The fairy Pherry stopped in indignation.

"No no no, I was joking, how could I possibly hold a grudge?" Little Merlin frowned bitterly, his true thoughts being:

Hmph! Let me play the coward for now, and once I'm free I'll settle scores!

(^^)三

title: Chapter 30 — Turmoil (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 30 — Turmoil (Extra Chapter)

Volume 22 · Chapter 30

"That's right. I came all this way specifically to rescue you, so you should be thanking me properly." The fairy Phrye said smugly as he began helping Little Merlin untie the ropes.

Little Merlin secretly rolled his eyes, thinking that if it weren't for this detestable fairy, would he have been unlucky enough to get captured?

Not far away, the dwarf Baeli was being beaten mercilessly by the dark elf guard pinned beneath him, completely unable to fight back.

Worry welled up inside Little Merlin. These two had zero combat ability. If this continued, none of them would escape. He had to find a way to take out this dark elf guard.

"Hurry up! That little dwarf can't hold out much longer!"

"I'm trying!" The fairy Phrye was desperately biting at the rope, but his strength was too weak, making even untying the rope an extraordinary effort.

Baeli was kicked until his body was covered in bruises and wounds. Who says dwarves are a brave and fierce race? It was impossible to see any of that on him.

The dark elf guard stepped on Baeli's head and sneered, "You're truly a piece of trash. Who gave you the courage to barge in here?"

Baeli slightly opened his eyes and gritted his teeth, "Have you ever heard of the Knee Terminator?"

"What kind of nonsense is that?" The dark elf guard looked confused.

"Since you don't know, then let me show you what dwarves are made of!" Baeli raised his tiny hammer and smashed it hard down onto the dark elf's toes.

"Ahhh!" The dark elf captain felt as though struck by lightning, clutching his toes and screaming in pain as he hopped around in place, "You bastard!"

"Hah!" Baeli climbed up from the ground, jumped in place with all his might, and swung his small hammer to viciously strike the dark elf's knee.

The dark elf guard's knee was shattered to pieces. He fell to his knees with a thud, his face contorted from the excruciating pain. "Y-you..."

"See? We dwarves aren't someone you can mess with! Eat my finishing move!" The dwarf Baeli swung his small hammer from below, aiming straight for the dark elf guard's crotch.

The dark elf guard's face turned ashen, his features twisted. A series of cracking sounds echoed as his testicles shattered. The unbearable pain made his whole body tremble as he clutched his crotch, cold sweat pouring down his face.

"...Despicable and shameless!"

"My father told me that as long as you can win a fight, you can use any technique. There's no such thing as despicable or not despicable..." The dwarf Baeli said with a simple, honest expression.

"Damn it!" The dark elf guard clutched his crotch and slowly struggled to his feet. Flames erupted in his hand as he sought to burn Baeli to ashes. "I'll kill you!"

"...The dwarf Baeli saw that his opponent could use magic and immediately grew afraid, taking a step back. He was just an ordinary dwarf, while his opponent was at least a mid-tier elf who could cast spells."

"Die!" The dark elf guard threw the fireball in his hand. The scorching heat rushed straight toward Baeli's face, even curling his beard.

Little Merlin, now free, hurried over and blocked in front of the dwarf Baeli. Raising his hand, he relied on his magic-immune physique to completely disperse the incoming fireball!

"What!?" The dark elf guard's mouth hung open in shock, unable to believe his own eyes.

"Waaaah!" Little Merlin let out a fierce roar and, pressing his advantage, charged forward and delivered a rocket-powered headbutt straight into the dark elf's abdomen!

"Pfft!" The dark elf guard was hit by this hardcore physical attack and spat saliva, his body flying backward until he landed squarely on the guillotine's recessed platform. "Ugh! Don't!"

"I've been waiting for you!" The fairy Phrye sat down hard on the guillotine's activation lever!

The sound of chains rattling echoed, and the suspended axe crashed down with a whoosh, severing the dark elf guard's head clean off. His face still bore an expression of unwilling terror.

Blood gushed forth, the ground flooding with crimson that slowly spread across the floor. The dark elf's headless corpse twitched twice on the guillotine before going completely still. All three of them simultaneously exhaled in relief, temporarily safe.

"...Little Merlin wiped the cold sweat from his forehead. 'That bastard is finally dead.'"

"Hey hey hey! How did you just do that? You can dispel magic!" The fairy Phrye quickly flew over, extremely curious on the inside.

Little Merlin glanced at Phrye, anger welling up from a single source, and directly grabbed him in his hand. "Oh really? You're the one who got me captured, and you still have the nerve to flaunt around in front of me? I'm going to crush you to death!"

"Huh!? Weren't you saying something different just now? Didn't you say you wouldn't hold grudges!? As expected, sinners are full of lies!" The fairy Phrye felt very wronged.

"I'm a demon, not a human!" Little Merlin emphasized, realizing that whenever he was mistaken for a human, he always faced hostility here.

"A demon? What kind of joke is that? Where are your horns?" The fairy Phrye measured above his own head with both hands, imitating the appearance of a demon.

"...Little Merlin frowned tightly, finding it difficult to explain.

"Besides, it wasn't me who captured you, it was the dark elves. I came here with good intentions to rescue you. If it weren't for me bringing people along, you'd be the one lying on that guillotine, okay~" The fairy Phrye explained self-righteously, pointing to Baeli beside him. "This dwarf is my good bro. You saw it yourself, he's quite capable in a fight. Don't mess with me, or I'll have him beat you until you cry~"

"Hello, my name is Baeli, son of the master smith Balin. Nice to meet you, human child..." The dwarf Baeli wasn't impressed by Phrye's boasting and instead friendly extended his hand. Paired with his honest smile, he was quite approachable, but thanks to his innate cross-eyed condition, his aim was off, and he reached toward the empty air beside Merlin.

"I'm right here," Little Merlin said flatly. = =

"Oh, left side is the real..." The dwarf Baeli awkwardly scratched his head, feeling that human children and dwarves were about the same height — everyone was short — and a sense of fondness immediately arose in his heart.

"Tch!" Little Merlin felt somewhat irritated inside, brushed aside Baeli's friendly handshake, and said, "Go away, don't bother me!"

"..." Baeli felt somewhat disappointed. This was the first time he'd seen such an arrogant child.

"We at least rescued you. Not only do you not show gratitude, but your attitude is this terrible? Tsk tsk tsk~" The fairy Phrye clicked his tongue and shook his head.

Little Merlin glared at the tiny fairy in his hand and thought carefully. This guy, aside from having a foul mouth, didn't seem to want to harm him. Coming back to rescue him meant he wasn't entirely without good intentions.

Although crushing this fairy to death wouldn't be difficult, killing him just because he was momentarily annoyed seemed unnecessary. His tolerance was perhaps a bit too small.

"You stay away from me too. Just looking at you makes me angry!" Little Merlin sighed and tossed the fairy Phrye aside, walking straight toward the exit. "I'm going back. Don't let me see you again."

"Don't go outside. It's very dangerous out there right now." The dwarf Baeli couldn't help but remind him.

"Yeah! Many elves have fainted, and it's chaotic outside!" The fairy Phrye said loudly.

"Hmm?" Little Merlin stopped in his tracks. "What's going on..."

The three of them went outside and saw twelve pillars of light shooting into the sky, with a massive magic array slowly rotating in the heavens.

"Elven sorrow..." Little Merlin looked at the familiar scene and immediately frowned, feeling that something major had happened outside during the time he was locked up!

"This place is far from the center of the turmoil, so there isn't too much impact. We're the ones who got lucky and survived." The dwarf Baeli said, still shaken.

"Yeah, those unconscious elves seem to have had their souls torn from their bodies, absorbed by that magic array. How terrifying..." The fairy Phrye's eyes were filled with terror.

"Alice!?"

Little Merlin saw a rock giant in the distance hammering the Frost Holy Dragon straight down from the sky, making him realize the urgency of the situation.

Why was Alice fighting a stone creature to such a chaotic degree? What exactly happened while he was gone?

Little Merlin's brows knitted together, his expression revealing a sense of irritation. He felt that no matter how dangerous it was there, he had to go take a look.

"I'm going over there."

There will be an additional update later.

title: Chapter 31 — Brotherly Conflict (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 31 — Brotherly Conflict (Extra Chapter)

Volume 22 · Chapter 31

“Ah? ! You’re crazy!”

Bali and Frey said in unison, feeling that Xiaomei Lin was crazy. With the situation so chaotic here, going to such a dangerous place isn’t looking for death?

“I must....”. Xiaomei Lin felt some concern for Alice inside, sensing that she normally never saw such a crazy side of her; it was clearly fighting to the death with that rock giant!

“It’s very dangerous there! Didn’t you see? The elves here are half-dead even when lowered! I’ve lived here for a long time, and this is the first time I’ve seen such a scene!” The fairy Frey flew to Xiaomei Lin’s front, talking nonstop, “I feel that there is very evil power at the center of the magic circle. If you go, I don’t know how you’ll die!”

‘That’s right, this should be an internal dispute among the elves. You—an outsider child—shouldn’t get involved. Being alive is the most important thing.” The dwarf Bali said seriously.

“No, I have a reason I must go.” Xiaomei Lin frowned and said, thinking to find two guards—after all, her current situation is also quite awkward, “...Do you—want to go together?”

Bali and Frey shook their heads repeatedly, absolutely unwilling to follow Xiaomei Lin into danger, it was simply like a joke.

“Well, then....”. Xiaomei Lin waved his hand and went forward alone.

The fairy Frey watched Xiaomei Lin’s back, and said lowly, “Does this little kid have brain problems? After barely saving a life, he’s about to send it back.”

The dwarf Bali shook his head helplessly, “If you know there’s danger and still go, that’s really having brain problems. We white saved him—

The cave king and the frost sacred dragon fought without rest, and the surroundings had already become a mess. Ruins were everywhere that came into view.

Relying on speed advantage, the frost sacred dragon could barely contend with the cave king, but the declining situation was already very obvious, gradually revealing fatigue.

Hilf felt that if the cave king wasn’t resolved, she simply couldn’t approach Andia, and couldn’t stop the elf’s wailing ritual, so she couldn’t help but loudly shout “Cave king! Stop! We aren’t enemies!”

The cave king had been controlled by Andia, and paid no attention to Hilf’s voice at this moment. His mind was full of executing the “mother’s” command, and he wanted to defeat the frost sacred dragon!

Hilf felt the situation in front of her was very tricky. The cave king was like crazy, and besides Andia, he simply couldn’t listen to anyone else’s tongue.

The frost sacred dragon wind-angrily dove down, using the horns on its head to heavily strike the cave king’s body, hard pushing it back a step.

The cave king was furious, the boundary pressure of the realm greatly won, and a heavy punch struck back, heavily striking the frost sacred dragon to the ground.

Alice had just barely transcended the sacred stage and stepped into the threshold of the realm not long ago. Facing the cave king, which was already middle-level in the realm, no matter how desperately she fought, it was very hard to win:

The frost sacred dragon fell from the sky with a loud crash. Receiving such a heavy frontal attack, she was forced to return to her original form, transforming into a human state of Alice

“.... Cough cough!

Alice was covered in injuries, coughing out a mouthful of fresh blood. Magic power and battle qi were wasted—empty, and her body became very weak, obviously defeated completely.

Although she had previously fought back and forth with the previous beastman king, it was completely because the other party was suppressed in the front by Medusa’s eyes. With a wounded body fighting against her, otherwise she probably wouldn’t have any advantage.

“Die!” The cave king roared, and the rock heavy fist struck again, aiming at the tiny Alice.

“Alice Miss!?” Hilf cried out in surprise. In her urgency, she used battle qi wall, horizontal in front of Alice, and then rapidly threw Alice, wanting to save her!

Just in this electric flint-like moment, the cave king’s fist instantly smashed Hilf’s battle qi wall, but also successfully bought a second of time.

Hilf seized the opportunity, putting the weak Alice on her back, thinking to escape, but it was still affected by the aftermath of the cave king’s attack!

Ah!

Both cried out in pain, being struck down by the fist, flying wildly, rolling miserably on the ground.

The ground was smashed out a heart-pounding big pit. All the surrounding buildings were leveled, and gravel and dust splashed up to the sky 300 feet away!

Hilf received not light injury, but quickly dragged Alice into a ruined wall behind, using it as cover, gaining a moment to catch her breath.

“Alice Miss, are you okay?

“Can’t die yet, the strength of the foreign race leader far exceeded my expectation, harder to deal with than I imagined....” Alice breathed, saying with a fatigued expression.

“Not all leaders are strong. Truly strong ones are only a few while....” Hilf said sincerely.

“Is that so? Hearing it, my luck seems not too good.” Alice self-mockingly smiled.

“The cave king’s current state is very abnormal. Although he hates violence very much, this time he is so crazy. Definitely is being bewitched.” Hilf frowned her beautiful brows and said lowly, “Let’s not speak temporarily, the cave king will discover us....”

Wait until the dust dispersed, the cave king didn’t see the body, and his heart became puzzled. He started moving slowly, searching everywhere for those two mice.

However, on the other side, an even more terrible thing happened. The elf’s wailing had reached the final stage.

Only to see Andia herself walked to the center of the golden magic circle, and shining light suddenly fell from the sky.

Come! Andia, let me use your body well! I am about to restore myself to my original state....

The necessary condition for the elf’s wailing to activate, requires offering up the life of the elf royal family. Andia, as the elf king and Al’s cousin, obviously agreed with the requirement.

The purple light seemed to have devouring power, Andia laughing crazily, her body gradually decomposed, blood and flesh turning into tiny stars being absorbed into the sky’s magic circle.

Finally, fragrance vanished and jade broke, turning into forest-like white bones scattered on the ground. Perhaps at the moment when Al occupied her body, she was already dead.

“Andia great....”.

Hilf, who was hiding, witnessed all this, recalling Andia’s original self, kind and amiable, the virtuous wife of the elf king, yet she ended up with such a fate?

Although her anger had reached the extreme, she couldn’t stop it, and could only watch Al desecrate Andia’s body.

Hilf lowered her head, clenching her fists, realizing that the situation had entered the worst case, Al’s return could not be stopped.

Heaven and earth suddenly dissipated, the huge golden magic circle disappeared, everything became peaceful one-

In the center of that chaos, a beautiful youth elf dressed in a robe, with black skin, appeared out of thin air.

Winds blew, his white short hair moving with them, looking as if he had no great pressure, yet it made people feel fear.

Dark elf king Al, this evil source that once dominated this land with fear, once again returned here.

“I have not felt what it feels like to be alive for a long time, you know?

“Ah~ , right, this familiar polluted air, still so....”

Al mused to himself, returning to his body, making it feel unparalleled delight.

He gazed afar at the huge tree palace, as if was looking at the elf king across the distance, his eyes carrying a trace of mockery—

“I’m back, long time no see, my brother.....

In the depths of the palace, the elf king on the throne, with hair disheveled, extremely weak.

Branches like habits pierced into his body, continuously extracting only stored magic power.

The elf king suddenly woke up from the coma, and subconsciously raised his head, his deep gaze looking afar at the distance—

“What should happen: ultimately will manifest<

“Al, we meet again....

title: Chapter 32 — White and Black
content:
Chapter 32 — White and Black

Volume 22 · Chapter 32

Sylph and Alice were hiding behind a broken wall, secretly watching the handsome black elf that had appeared out of nowhere at the center of the chaos.

He didn't look particularly intimidating on the surface, but he gave off an invisible yet overwhelming pressure.

"Archdon… he has truly returned…" Sylph's lips trembled, hardly able to believe her own eyes.

"Archdon? That black elf?" Alice asked in confusion. She didn't recognize this brother of the Elf King.

"That's right, you could also call him the Dark Elf King. He was originally the leader of the black elves, but because of his immense ambition—to destroy the alliance of other races—he was killed by His Majesty the Elf King himself during the rebellion." Sylph paused, her face paling. "I never expected his ghost to still be lingering, returning through the forbidden magic of the Elven Lament…"

"He sounds… like a terrible guy…" Alice widened her eyes and tried to probe Archdon's oppressive aura, only to be frightened speechless.

His Majesty the Elf King's pressure was so powerful that the surrounding space was actually distorting slightly, rippling!

Alice had only seen this kind of bizarre situation once before—in one person: the Gluttony King, Beelzebub.

Even though Beelzebub was suppressing his oppressive aura as much as possible, if you observed closely, you could still see the same phenomenon as Archdon.

"Not just terrible. Back then, Archdon's followers were unstoppable and almost controlled all the other races. If His Majesty the Elf King hadn't put the kingdom above family, he might have succeeded." Sylph paused again, a deep worry crossing her face. "Even so, in order to kill this dangerous individual, His Majesty nearly lost his life. Archdon inherited some of the power of Corelon, the Elf God, and was fully capable of defeating Him."

"…" Alice remained silent. Outside, the Cave King was searching everywhere for them, the Dark Elf King had reappeared in the mortal world, and Merlin's fate was entirely uncertain. It felt as though everything had gone to the worst possible extreme.

Suddenly, the earth began to tremble. From the top of the Elf Race's sacred tree, a blinding white light erupted, directly illuminating the devastated land—

The Elf King appeared in the sky, bathed in radiance. He wore white robes, his golden hair dancing in the wind, and in his hand he held the pseudo-divine artifact of the Elf King's leadership, the Light of Corelon.

This pseudo-divine artifact staff was crafted from an ancient divine tree, its entire body gleaming in noble gold. It could greatly enhance the user's magical attacks and even control flowers, grass, and trees, as well as possess unknown special abilities.

"It's His Majesty! We're saved!" Sylph's face lit up with joy. She hadn't expected the Elf King to awaken. As long as the Elf King appeared, there was still hope.

"Hmm, is that the Elf King?" Alice watched from afar, unable to help but marvel at the elves' ageless faces and long lifespans. The Elf King still looked young, and compared to Archdon, he carried less of a sinister air.

"Archdon…" The Elf King slowly opened his eyes, looking down at his younger brother from above.

"Long time no see, brother." Archdon grinned with a mocking smile. "I heard you've been endlessly using your magic to fight the Abyss beneath the sea, protecting this land?"

"This kingdom was built by me uniting many leaders of the other races. It is the last home for all non-human kinds. I have a responsibility to protect it." The Elf King said coldly, showing zero welcome for Archdon.

"You're still so naive. You haven't changed at all. When will you ever give up that foolish idea?" Archdon paused and spoke with feigned sympathy. "Our elves are destined to be noble and powerful. Unlike the other races, we should naturally be the leaders, not treating them as equals. Setting up that Nine Kings Council and taking advice from those losers to lead the entire kingdom was a stupid decision from the start."

"Our era has long passed. Going against the tide will only lead to a bad end. Only by uniting with all non-human kinds can we possibly resist our fate of extinction." The Elf King said solemnly.

"Is it still that vague prophecy you saw so long ago?" Archdon's eyes held deep mockery.

"Yes. Long, long ago, I foresaw the destruction of all non-human kinds. If we want to avert the prophecy, uniting the power of all races is essential. Only then is there a sliver of hope." The Elf King's gaze grew profound.

"Wouldn't your prophecy happen regardless? Even the gods cannot fight against fate." Archdon gave a sinister smile.

"Only the destruction of non-human kinds—I wish it would not come to pass." The Elf King countered.

"Actually, your prophecy isn't necessarily accurate. This land floats above the Abyss beneath the sea, and you need to contribute your own magic to prevent the entire kingdom from falling into the deep ocean." Archdon paused, continuing, "Look at your exhausted state now, your strength has regressed severely. You'll sooner or later become fertilizer for this land. I heard your prophecy said two people would come to help you break free from this fate, but let me tell you—it's impossible! Because I found those two guys first and killed them. No one will come to save you! And non-human kinds won't be completely eradicated either. As long as I overthrow you and establish a supreme rule that enslaves all races and dominates the world, I can perfectly sidestep your prophecy! At that point, elves will be the supreme beings! We will jointly lead those despicable creatures!"

"The Elf God was right not to choose you as the leader. You are a complete and utter madman." The Elf King's expression turned cold, becoming grim.

"No! Reviving the elf race and restoring our glorious era is the mission for both you and me! I am the one who should be the best candidate to lead the entire elf race!" Archdon's emotions became agitated, and he rebuked, "You are too foolish. What have the elves gained under your leadership? Being oppressed by humans, fleeing our homeland, and now living on a ticking time bomb! All of this is your fault!"

"And what have you brought?" The Elf King spread his arms, looking at those elves whose souls had departed their bodies. "Because of your selfishness, so many of our own kind have died. You scum are not worthy at all to lead the elf race!"

"Revolution necessarily involves bloodshed and sacrifice. These are nothing…" Archdon grinned and deliberately provoked the Elf King, "Brother, you really are cold-blooded. Instead of worrying about those losers, why don't you care about your own queen, Andia? She's our cousin after all, though she's already dead. She became a sacrifice for the Elven Lament for my sake. Andia sacrificed her precious life for our race's revolution. This is the highest glory!"

"ARCHDON!!!" The Elf King let out a hysterical roar, pointing the Light of Corelon staff in his hand furiously at Archdon!

"Hehehe! That's more like it. This is interesting. You should be this crazy!" Archdon rose into the air, and his powerful oppressive aura caused Alice and Sylph, hiding in the shadows, to simultaneously gasp—

"But you're not the you of before. You're now a weak, pitiful thing."

"If you had stayed like a turtle hiding in the palace, I could have let you live…"

"The fact that you dare appear before me again is your greatest mistake!!!"
