title: Chapter 6 — Intimidation Ineffective
content:
Chapter 6 — Intimidation Ineffective

Volume 24 · Chapter 6

“Chris?”

“Hii!”

“Chris~”

“Yaa!

Alice kept calling Chris's name, feeling that this child liked her. Every time she called the name, it would respond.

Chris was extra happy in Alice's arms, as if she felt joy from having her name called, and she liked her name very much.

“Chris.... Merlin furrowed his brow and thought for a moment, feeling it was a good name, very suitable for a little girl. It seemed Alice had something, but it was only slightly better than calling her a dog, after all, the names I came up with are pretty good too.

Alice liked this child very much, thinking she was well-behaved. She couldn't help but poke her small face with her hand, “From now on, this will be your home. We are your mommy and daddy, do you understand? Chris.....

“.... Daddy... Mommy... Chris listened in a baby voice, learning to speak from Alice. Her pronunciation was still a bit unclear, seeming like she needed to study hard for a while.

Thinking about the possibility of possibly sending her to her biological parents, Alice felt a bit regretful. Curiously asking, “Chris, if one day you have to leave Mommy and Daddy, would you be willing?”

“Hiccup!” Chris was instantly startled and hiccupped. She closed her mouth, fiddling with her two fingers anxiously. Her gaze avoided looking at Alice, as if very worried that Mommy and Daddy would abandon her, “Gurgle...”

“Don't cry, don't cry, Mommy was just joking. How could she let you leave?” Alice quickly smiled and changed her words.

“.... Chris broke into a smile, returning to her happy mood again.

Alice secretly sighed in her heart, a bit regretful. If Chris's biological parents showed up, she would definitely have to send her back. But for now, it was better to keep this hidden.

Chris looked at Merlin, who was standing behind her, opened her small arms, and said in a childish voice, “Dad.....”

Eh!

Merlin's whole body trembled, shocked. A drop of cold sweat slid down from his forehead. He thought, what is this kid doing? Is she not afraid of strangers?

How... I was once the Demon Lord feared by all, right? According to reason, children should be very afraid of me. Crying from being scared would be a normal reaction....

Merlin gave a dry cough, internally resisting a bit of getting close to children. So he continued to maintain his aloof manner.

“Well... never mind, I still feel tired.

“Mmm, Daddy... Chris made a pitiful look, and tears began to well up in her eyes again.

“Merlin, what are you doing? Hurry up and hug her. She's your daughter, after all... Alice kept winking and making faces, putting pressure on Merlin.

“....

Merlin's expression became complex. He thought, I'm still unmarried, where did a daughter come from!

However, since this little ghost initiated it, there was nothing to be done. Hugging her is not impossible...

Merlin lifted Chris from Alice's arms, supporting her small bottom with his hand. He felt she was lighter than imagined, after all, she was just a two-year-old infant.

“Are you satisfied now? My little princess<”

“Daddy~” Chris threw herself into the crook of Merlin's arms, clutching his clothes.

“.......”. Merlin gave a stiff response, sweating internally, how strange? It felt completely different from calling him Daddy like Qinyin. It seems this child truly means it when she calls me Daddy. .... Not bad...

“Hah, Merlin, why is your face red?” Alice gave a dry laugh. Even the thick-skinned Merlin, who was usually so thick-faced, now had two rosy blushes.

“Ah? Really? I can't...” Merlin subconsciously touched his cheek.

“Why don't you go look in the mirror?” Alice teased.

“..... Say! I only... have a bit of heat...” Merlin gave a vague explanation, thinking in his heart: Calm down, must preserve his image.

Chris stretched out her chubby little hand, touching Merlin's chin. Immediately, she showed an uncomfortable expression, “Dad, Hu... za...

“This ah... Merlin embarrassedly smiled, “I actually forgot to shave today. How? Does it feel prickly?

“Hu... painful...” Chris said in a baby voice.

“I'll go shave it off in a moment.” Merlin touched his chin stubble.

Alice watched Merlin and Chris, and for a while some became distracted and absent-minded. Unbidden, she thought--

If I and Merlin had a child, maybe she would be as well-behaved as Chris,

Wait! What am I thinking? How could I and Merlin have a child? Absolutely impossible! Immerse

However, it's also unexpected that Merlin gets close to children and his face turns red...

Alice mused in her heart, suddenly the air resonated with a “gurgle” sound, breaking the harmonious atmosphere.

“Alice, this child seems hungry?” Merlin looked over, clearly hearing Chris's stomach rumble.

“Huh? Hungry?” Alice was dazed.

“.... Chris touched her small belly, showing an embarrassed look, her face red.

“I'll go make some things, Merlin is ready to cook personally.

“Isn't it okay to give the child something to eat?” Alice hesitated, thought for a moment, and said, “Never mind, Chris seems to not have all her teeth yet. I'd better go buy some formula, and on the side bring back some things for the child.

“That's good.” Merlin nodded, watching Alice leave.

Only Merlin and Chris remained in the room. Now he could finally do as he pleased.

Only to see Merlin place the petite Chris back into the basket, then squatted down, showing a strict father's look, and seriously said one by one

“Hey, little ghost, can you understand what I'm saying?

“Hiiya~” Chris clutched Merlin's clothes and wouldn't let go.

“Cough cough! Serious point, sit nicely.” Merlin pulled Chris's hand away, “We are going to have a good talk.”

Chris was stunned, then immediately sat obediently in the basket, as if waiting to be inspected as a little soldier, “Chiu chiu! ”

“Um, this is pretty good.” Merlin nodded in satisfaction, emphasizing, “I don't care where you come from, but here you have to be well-behaved and don't cause trouble, understand?”i。F牡J\玩

Chris seemed to understand, blinking her bright eyes, and laughed, “Hiiya! ”

“I am not as easy to fool as Alice with her rigid brain. I will always be on guard against you. If you have anything unusual, before it causes bad influence, I will kill you with my own hands.” Merlin pointed at the demon sword Banri Garan placed against the wall root, “My knife is super fast. If you have the guts, you can try.”

“..... Chris still seemed to understand, opening her arms to be hugged, “Hiiya!

“Tch! Don't always go 'hiiya hiiya', are you pretending to be stupid? Don't think I will relax my guard against you.” Merlin's tone was serious, immediately darkening his face and showing an evil expression, frightening Chris and saying, “To be honest, I am a demon. Every day I have to eat a lot of little ghosts like you. You'd better be honest, otherwise I will eat your bones clean, how about it? Are you afraid?

Chris looked at Merlin's fierce appearance, but she wasn't very afraid.

Only to see her staggeringly stand up in the basket, tiptoeing and making a “chur” sound, kissing Merlin's cheek.

“Dad~”

Eh!” Merlin opened his eyes wide, full of horror. Subconsciously touching his cheek, there was still Chris's saliva remaining. His heart suddenly became unbelievable one by one.....

...

This little ghost is unexpectedly cunning

title: Chapter 7 — Big News (Extra)
content:
Chapter 7 — Big News (Extra)

Volume 24 · Chapter 7

On the streets of Rexham, people came and went, and the cries of hawkers in the market never ceased.

Alice had come out alone to buy some things for Chris, whose stomach was hungry.

Because children are more delicate than adults, they cannot just eat whatever is available without consequence.

So Alice ran to many shops, carefully selecting high-quality milk powder; she could not let little Chris suffer.

After buying the milk powder, Alice bought other items as well, such as baby bottles, diapers, and truly childish little toys.

At this moment, Alice arrived at a children’s clothing store, intending to buy Chris a few simple clothes that would suffice for temporary wear.

Although Chris had inexplicably appeared with a small vest upon hatching, she lacked any close-fitting garments.

Alice planned to raise Chris temporarily as her own daughter, believing she should be raised to look like a beautiful little princess from an early age.

“Hey~, Miss, looking at your picturesque features and radiant glow, I presume you have recently become a mother?” The shop manager immediately flashed a sycophantic smile. “If so, you have come to the right place. Our shop specializes in various children’s clothes, all of superior quality. We source our fabrics directly from Greece. Look at this small children’s vest; it shines brilliantly under the sunlight.” He stroked the vest and praised it, saying, “Buying this one is definitely the right choice! The fabric makes the clothes sturdy and durable. If your child at home is disobedient and always rolls around outside...”

“Th... then my child at home...” Alice said with a forced laugh. The style was exaggerated, yet seemed full of enthusiasm.

“Ah... a girl?” The manager paused for a moment, then lightning-fast, he brought out a small red dress. “Where did you buy girls’ clothes? We also have them here! Take a look, this is premium material. Dancers in the most vibrant parts of Rexham use this fabric for their sheer dresses. I dare guarantee that once your daughter puts it on...”

“.....No, no need for such flashy clothes,” Alice thought, several black lines falling from her forehead. She believed Chris was still a child and should act like one. Such attire was inappropriate for a saint’s child. No wonder it smelled so much of worldly affairs; it was clearly something used by dancers. My baby is a proper child!

Alice acted like a strict mother, shaking her head inwardly, feeling that overly fancy clothes were not suitable for Chris, appearing too indecent.

If she raised Chris into a baby filled with worldly airs, Alice would feel her education had failed, making her an incompetent mother.

“Forget it, I only need some simple casual wear for a child. But I see everything here is too flashy and not very good....”

“....Is that so?” Seeing the deal slipping away, the manager broke into a cold sweat, thinking, Is this really a mother? Mothers usually want to dress their babies to attract everyone’s attention before they can rest easy. Why is this young wife so low-key? I have sold children’s clothes on this street for over ten years, and this is the first time anyone has said the clothes are too flashy. They all look great!

“Do you have underwear for children?” Alice asked again, remembering that besides the small vest, Chris had no other clothes. As a competent mother, how could she let her child go bare-bottomed?

“Ah! Of course we do!” The manager, once again energized like he had taken stimulants, hurriedly went to find underwear for little girls, instantly laying out several pairs of children’s panties. “These are best-sellers in my shop, highly sought-after goods. Since you came early today, I will give you a ten percent discount, and buy one get one free! To be honest, if you had come a bit later, I would have been out of stock. Madam, you must seize this opportunity well. Opportunities like this clearance sale do not come often~”

“Emmmmmm.....”

Alice fell into deep thought, carefully examining these few pairs of children’s panties printed with colorful patterns, which would look very cute on a little girl.

However, underwear is not meant for others to see; what use is being so cute? It might just cater to perverts or lolicon creeps!

Self-respect and self-love should start from childhood; one must teach her what is right and what is wrong.....

I certainly do not want Chris to grow up to be a clumsy girl who casually exposes her underwear, or a scheming woman full of bad intentions.

Alice increasingly felt that this shop was terrible; apart from flattery, there was nothing satisfactory about it.

Just as Alice prepared to turn and leave, she unexpectedly noticed a familiar style of underwear in the corner.

So Alice picked it up to examine it closely. It was a pair of white panties with a little bear pattern printed on the back, as if constantly mocking anyone who looked at it:

“What are you looking at? There are only innocent little bears here, you idiot! Go stand in the corner and reflect on your mistakes!”

Alice’s eyes lit up, as if she had discovered a new continent. This was exactly the same as what she wore, merely shrunk down to a children’s version.

Having a well-behaved daughter wear the same style as her felt somewhat intimate; her taste was absolutely flawless!

“Manager! I’ll take this one, ten pairs!”

“Huh?” The manager obviously froze for three seconds, finding it hard to believe, because these little bear panties simply did not sell; everyone despised them as tacky, lacking any appeal whatsoever.

“What are you staring at? Get them for me, I want ten pairs....” Alice emphasized seriously.

“Okay, okay, I am going to fetch them now...” The manager hurriedly turned around to rummage through the warehouse, thinking, What kind of aesthetic does this young lady have?! So LOW!

Alice was rejoicing in the fact that Chris was wearing similar things to her, but at this moment, an acquaintance walked over.

Lucia happened to have nothing busy at the Guild today, so she came out shopping. She coincidentally saw Alice coming out to make purchases and asked curiously,

“Alice, are you shopping too?”

“Lucia? Aren’t you busy at the Guild?” Alice was purchasing children’s supplies and felt a bit awkward seeing an acquaintance.

“There are no commissions today, so I can slack off a bit~” Lucia blinked playfully. “When did you return?”

“I haven’t been back long.” Alice smiled awkwardly, thinking she should hurry and slip away with the items.

“Where did you go before? You are already a celebrity here. Did private business come knocking?” Lucia asked with a meaningful tone.

“No, we only....” Alice thought for a moment; she could not admit that she had taken little Merlin to the United Kingdom to relax. Instead, she found an excuse to cover it up. “Merlin and I returned his nephew.”

“I see. By the way, it has been a long time since I last saw Mr. Merlin. When you have time, please come sit with us at the Guild. That old rogue Hobbs misses him a bit,” Lucia suggested.

“We definitely will.” Alice nodded nervously, thinking that Lucia would never discover that Merlin’s nephew was merely a pretext.

“What are you doing here? This is the area selling children’s clothes....”

Lucia looked at Alice curiously, noticing the children’s panties in her hand, and then glanced at the baby bottle and toys in her shopping bag.

Hmm? Why are there so many items for infants? Does Alice have a baby under two years old at home?

No way! Alice and Mer... Could she have a child! ...This is huge news!

Lucia was so shocked she nearly went dumb, staring at Alice with a face full of shock, and stammered,

“Alice! You and Mr. Merlin...”

title: Chapter 8 — Love from a Real Mom
content:
Chapter 8 — Love from a Real Mom

Volume 24 · Chapter 8

Lucia stared at Alice in utter disbelief, thinking that they hadn't been gone long at all — how could there be a baby at home?

The last time Lucia had seen Alice, there had been no signs of pregnancy. If she'd given birth, it couldn't have happened this fast.

Alice noticed Lucia's strange expression, glanced down at the baby items in her shopping bag, and her cheeks immediately flushed red.

Chris wasn't our real child. If someone let something slip and hurt her feelings, wouldn't Chris be terribly sad over not being a biological baby?

Alice grew nervous, thinking it was better not to tell Raxum's friends about Chris's situation for now.

"You're here! This is what you ordered."

The shop owner had already packed ten pairs of panties and handed them to Alice.

"No need for change!" Alice tossed down a gold coin, grabbed her things, and briskly turned to leave. "Lucia, I have something else to do — let's talk another day!"

"Eh! Wait—!" Lucia wanted to dig deeper, but as Alice vanished before her very eyes, she couldn't help muttering to herself. So suspicious. What is Alice hiding?

"Huh?!" The shop owner's eyes lit up, picking up the gold coin and biting it with his teeth. He broke into a beaming smile. "This young lady may lack taste in fashion, but she's surprisingly generous..."

Lucia's mind stirred. Maybe she could ask the shop owner — there might be an unexpected harvest. "Shop owner, what did that person just buy?"

"Huh? Just girls' panties, that's all?" the shop owner replied in surprise.

"Girls' panties?!" Lucia's expression grew even stranger, and she looked down, deep in thought...

A baby girl? Where on earth did she come from?

Looking at Alice buying both milk powder and children's underwear, the relationship couldn't be ordinary.

At home, Chris sat obediently in her basket, continuously batting at the basket's edges and giggling nonstop.

"Daddy, daddy, daddy~"

...

Merlin's old face flushed red. An indescribable sense of shame rose within him — he was blushing just because a child had kissed him.

This kid was even more cunning than he'd imagined. Couldn't let her go. Trying to win me over with cuteness? Keep dreaming!

Merlin cleared his throat to mask his awkwardness and put on a serious face.

"Hmph! Ridiculous tactics. I won't fall for it! You think sweet-talking me will get you by? Keep dreaming!"

"Huh?" Chris bit her finger and tilted her head, seeming not quite to understand what Merlin meant.

"Don't play dumb. Talk fast — who sent you as a spy? Confess and you'll go easy; resist and you'll face harsh treatment!" Merlin pretended to look fierce, making faces to let Chris know he was scary.

A normal child would almost certainly be frightened to tears by such a ferocious grimace, but seeing Merlin's serious expression, Chris just went "giggle giggle giggle."

Probably Chris's mental development wasn't mature enough yet to tell whether someone was scaring her or just playing with her. She must have thought Merlin was deliberately teasing her.

"Stop laughing! Be serious — I'm interrogating you very earnestly!"

Merlin's head felt like it had grown an inch larger. Why wasn't this kid afraid of him? Was he really not scary enough?

So Merlin, unwilling to give up, cranked it up further, baring his teeth and striking an enraged pose.

"You're still laughing? Want to see if I eat you? Someone your size wouldn't even fill the gap between my teeth!"

Chris struggled to her feet, reached out her small hand, and pinched Merlin's nose. "Daddy... hungry... eat rice... ewe..."

"... Merlin, having his nose pinched by Chris, completely lost his temper. He couldn't help but sigh inwardly. What am I doing? This kid obviously can't think independently yet — why am I getting into this with her? It's like playing lute to a cow, isn't it?

Clang!

A sharp sound echoed as Merlin's head was tapped with an empty milk bottle. He turned around in surprise. "Alice, you're back already?"

"What are you doing here? As soon as I come back, I see you scaring her." Alice's face was dark as she asked. She'd only just entered the door when she heard Merlin threatening Chris and saying he'd eat her.

"I... I was joking—"

Merlin replied awkwardly, thinking that he was just testing whether Chris was playing dumb.

"You're so idle, why don't you go mop the floor? Why scare her? What if she starts crying again?" Alice fired off a series of soul-searching questions.

"... I'm sorry..." Merlin rubbed his nose. Alice seemed to be quite worked up, so it was better not to provoke her further.

"Hmph! Move — a grown bullying a child..." Alice's tone was full of sarcasm.

"...I was just trying to make her happy. Don't take it so seriously..." Merlin offered an excuse.

"Was that a joke? Children start out so innocent. If you say you'd eat her, she might actually believe it." Alice said reproachfully.

"... Merlin impatiently exhaled, thinking that taking care of little kids was, as expected, super troublesome...

Alice picked Chris up from the basket and asked with a smile, "How about it? Were you scared by the bad daddy?"

"Mommy, mommy, mommy~"

Chris waved her arms and legs enthusiastically. It seemed like she missed Alice dearly even after just a short absence.

Chris puckered her little mouth and leaned in, kissing Alice's face repeatedly.

Watching from behind, Merlin felt a wave of sour envy well up. Did all children prefer Alice? Were they always closer to her?!

"All right, all right, okay okay..." Alice shrank her neck a bit — Chris's reaction was a little overwhelming.

"Ewe..."

Daddy's playing with Chris, Mommy don't want Daddy... Chris spoke in her baby voice, able to stitch together only simple words for now.

"See! I told you, I was just teasing her to make her happy." Merlin quickly interjected, using Chris's words to explain what had just happened.

"Shut up. Chris is a child. Do you think I'm a child too?" Alice显然 wouldn't fall for that so easily. She said quietly, "I know you're suspicious, but watch yourself. Don't scare her."

"... Merlin scratched his hair and said no more.

Alice put Chris back into the basket, took out the small rattle toy she'd bought, and shook it, making a "dong dong dong" sound.

"Whoosh!" Hearing the noise, Chris shivered, her eyes widening with curiosity. She thought Mommy's toy was amazing!

"Chris, this is a rattle. Shake it and it makes a sound." Alice explained simply.

"Bolo... gu..."

Chris mimicked the words unclearly.

"Bo-lang-gu," Alice patiently corrected Chris's pronunciation.

"... Bolo-gu!" Chris picked it up quickly and finally said it clearly. "Bo-lang-gu! Dong dong dong!"

"Here, go play with it." Alice handed the toy to Chris and watched her with interest.

Chris in the basket cautiously held the rattle with both hands, seeming a bit hesitant, and looked up at Alice.

Seeing Mommy's encouraging eyes, Chris gathered her courage and shook the rattle, producing a "dong dong dong" sound.

"Ewe!" Chris's eyes lit up, filled with excited little stars. "Mommy, dong dong dong~"

"That's right, dong dong dong. Do you like it?" Alice asked patiently.

"Like it! Dong dong..." Chris bowed her head, her attention captivated by the rattle.

"Damn it..."

Merlin helplessly pressed his palm to his forehead, thinking that Alice really knew how to win over children. Chris had been completely conquered!

No way! I need to figure something out too — I can't be outdone by Alice!

Of course, I don't like this kid. I'm just unwilling to lose to Alice!

Curiosity getting the better of him, Merlin rummaged through the other things Alice had bought, wanting to know what else she'd purchased outside.

That's when he saw baby panties — tiny bear-patterned bloomers remarkably similar to the ones Alice wore!

Merlin's expression instantly darkened. He tightly gripped the panties Alice had bought for her daughter, then quietly put them back, his heart still far from calm.

Underwear with absolutely no sense of aesthetics or substance — bear-print bloomers?!

Just as expected...

Motherly love from a biological mom, huh.

title: Chapter 9 — Turbulence
content:
Chapter 9 — Turbulence

Volume 24 · Chapter 9

Merlin felt a deep sense of sorrow in his heart. Alice was starting from scratch, raising Chris to be just as tasteless as herself. If Chris grew up to be this childish, it would definitely be Alice's doing! Merlin let out a deep sigh, hoping Chris wouldn't follow in Alice's footsteps and become a stubborn, uncouth person.

"Yaaay... Chris's attention was completely absorbed by the new toy, shaking the rattle drum ceaselessly as the chaotic drumbeats echoed through the room. Alice watched Chris quietly, lost in thought about her own childhood in the isolated snowy mountains. Back then, the bells carried by passing merchant caravans would fascinate her, making her long for a toy of her own. However, Alice's teacher, though not very serious, was strict about her training and wouldn't buy her any fun things. Alice's childhood was extremely dull, spent only with wooden dummies and swords, and not having toys was one of her regrets. But seeing Chris happily playing with the rattle drum filled Alice with envy, making her determined not to become like her teacher and to give her own child a good childhood.

"Is it fun, Chris...?" "It's so much fun~" Chris showed off her baby teeth, laughing happily. "Then don't cry randomly in the future, okay? I'll buy you even more fun things if you can do that," Alice said, feeling Chris's personality was a bit weak and needed proper education from a young age. "...Chris hesitated for a moment, looked up at Alice, then at the rattle drum in her hand, and nodded her head with a 'yaaay~'. Good girl." Alice patted Chris's head, thinking that she was just a child after all, and would agree to anything for some candy.

...Merlin watched quietly from the side, wondering if Alice had already started. Was she going to raise Chris to be just like her? This child would definitely face a lot of hardships in the future! "Gurgle gurgle..." Chris's stomach, which had been hungry for a long time, growled loudly again, seemingly at its limit, louder than the last protest. Chris's face flushed with two small red clouds as she touched her little belly, apparently feeling embarrassed by the loud stomach noises. Alice suddenly realized she had forgotten to feed Chris while playing with her, "Oh right, I almost forgot! Merlin, what are you standing there for? I've already bought the milk powder, can't you go boil some water?" "Me?!" Merlin showed a refusing expression. "Of course it's you, you haven't even swept the floor today." Alice never forgot Merlin's chores and had to make him do something. "Damn it, you really know how to bring up old grievances... Merlin pouted, thinking he could get through the day without doing anything, "Can't I just go?" "Then hurry up, remember not to make the water too hot when mixing the milk powder, Chris is still small and can't handle it." Alice reminded. "I know that already..." Merlin waved his hand impatiently. Merlin busied himself in the kitchen, boiling the cooled water and pouring it into the bottle, shaking it to dissolve the milk powder thoroughly. He touched the bottle to his face, feeling it wasn't too hot, and the child should be fine drinking it. Merlin sighed, looking at the bottle in his hand, and couldn't help but feel a pang of emotion. Sigh, why did it come to this? In the past, I was the mighty Demon Lord! How did I end up at this point, having to feed a child?! Well, maybe this life is just temporary... After a while, Chris fell into a sweet sleep in her basket, clinging to the empty bottle as if it were her treasure. Alice wiped the milk stains from Chris's mouth with a handkerchief and covered her with a small blanket. "Looks like she's full..." "Tch!" Merlin clicked his tongue, whispering, "Eats her fill and then sleeps, just like a little pig." "Don't talk nonsense, it's normal for children to sleep a lot," Alice retorted. Merlin stared at Chris in the basket for a while, his expression becoming melancholic, feeling like he was truly stepping into the grave of marriage. "What are you thinking about? Why do you look so pained?" Alice asked in surprise. "I don't know how long we'll have to raise this child. If every day is like this, I'm having a hard time accepting it," Merlin replied frankly. "It should be temporary, right? We're not her real parents, maybe her real parents will come looking for her soon," Alice replied gloomily. It was only the first day, and she already felt a bit reluctant, but if the real parents came for the child, she had no right to keep her. "Let's hope so..." Merlin nodded, no longer looking at Chris in the basket, "What do we do next?" "Let's just act as her parents for now, and don't tell her she's not our real child. If she finds out, she'll cry and be heartbroken," Alice said worriedly, reaching out to touch Chris's sleeping face. Chris seemed to sense something in her sleep, mumbling, "Daddy..." Alice smiled softly, growing more fond of the little girl, and looked up to say, "This child is very dependent on us now, we can't abandon her, what do you say, Merlin?" "Uh..." Merlin fell into thought, looking at little Chris in the basket. He felt that although this child was a bit cheeky, she was still quite obedient. From their time together earlier, this little devil was good at being likable, almost making him feel a protective instinct. And she wasn't afraid of him, would get close to him, and wouldn't hold grudges even when scared... Thinking about it, this child was quite obedient and well-behaved. Raising her wouldn't be a big problem. Cough cough! Of course, I'm not saying I like this little devil, it's just that watching Alice every day has gotten a bit boring, and having a little devil at home to play with isn't bad. Merlin put on a serious face, not wanting anyone to see that he had grown a bit fond of the little devil, and organized his words carefully. "Well... you make a point. I agree to keep her for now and observe her well. If she turns out to be some evil being, we can stop her before she does anything bad. It's a win-win situation." "Hm?" Alice looked at Merlin suspiciously, probing, "You seem very agreeable today? Normally you'd jump up and argue, could it be that you've grown fond of this child?" "...Nonsense! Do you think I'm like you?" Merlin said nervously, meaningfully, "Let's be clear, we're not suited to invest too much emotion in this child. You know, we're not her real parents. If one day she has to leave, don't restrict her freedom." "Ha?" Alice sneered, retorting, "Are you saying this to yourself? I think you've grown quite fond of this child, smiling foolishly at Chris when you think I'm not looking. I've seen everything." "Eh!" Merlin's face turned strange, his eyes darting around, not expecting Alice to have seen so much. "Don't talk nonsense, it was all a misunderstanding!" "...I just think this little devil is cute and fun to watch." (0w0川) There will be an update later.

title: Chapter 10 — The Possibility of Purple Gold (Extra)
content:
Chapter 10 — The Possibility of Purple Gold (Extra)

Volume 24 · Chapter 10

I hope you're not lying, because when the time comes to actually send you away, you might find you don't want to let go." Alice said meaningfully, feeling she somewhat understood Merlin; this guy isn't hateful of little imps, he just hates annoying, troublesome little imps.

.....Merlin gave a dry laugh, speaking in a nonchalant attitude, "Are you saying that to me? I'm not as sentimental as you; who knows who'll be reluctant when the time comes? Don't worry, I'll definitely stop you if you change your mind."

"Hmph! Do as you like." Alice snorted, shifting the topic, "Other people aren't like Chris's situation; I think... just 'don't let her wander around everywhere, otherwise if others find out, this child's situation will be awkward."

"If she doesn't go out for some fresh air, she'll feel suffocated; we can't keep her cooped up at home all the time, can we?" Merlin paused, self-mockingly saying, "Not everyone is like me, able to stay in one place for hundreds of years without issue."

"That's true; it seems Chris staying home all the time isn't good either, but what if she runs into acquaintances when she goes out?" Alice lowered her head, looking worried about this, then suddenly lifted her head, recalling something, "Oh right! When I was buying things for Chris, I ran into Lucilia; she saw my expression wasn't quite right—could she have already noticed?"

"Lucilia?!"

Merlin froze, thought it over carefully, and felt it was quite possible.

Lucilia has always been sharp and scheming; seeing Alice buy so many baby supplies, would she not know?

Merlin furrowed his brow, stroked his chin, and muttered to himself— "It feels like things are getting complicated."

In the Rexheim guild, Lucilia was alone manning the counter, her mind elsewhere, as if she had something on her mind?

Mr. Karl sent his old friend Ralf's adventurer certification to the Danish headquarters' Adventurer Tomb, paid his respects, and then returned.

Although losing the friend who once fought alongside him for the Rexheim guild left Mr. Karl's mood not so good all the time.

But Karl isn't the type to dwell on the past; normally he seems no different.

Only in the quiet of night does he think of Ralf, then he wipes the Hundred Strong Trophy from the Adventurer's Tournament, ensuring no dust accumulates on it.

This trophy has always been displayed in the home of the old guild chief Taylor; it's the honor Karl and Ralf earned together, symbolizing that the Rexheim town guild ranks among the world's top one hundred—considered its best achievement since its founding.

However, Mr. Karl well knows that adventurer death is commonplace; familiar people around him could die at any time, and for Ralf, he only retains a feeling of remembrance.

After returning, Mr. Karl followed his father Old Taylor into training; the previous Thunderbolt Sword-Draw technique shocked him, making this middle-aged man admire his father even more.

Old Taylor constantly pondered day and night the initial duel with Merlin, eventually learning something, improving the family's Thunderbolt combat technique and greatly increasing its destructive power.

r牡小 玩

Karl set aside his pride, preparing during this period to diligently train with his father, to promote the recent Thunderbolt Sword-Draw technique, and also striving to break into the top fifty in the next Adventurer's Tournament.

Lucilia rested her chin on her hands; the ink in her feather pen had dried, yet she hadn't written a single character—her mind was full of just having encountered Alice.

Why would Alice buy so many children's supplies? Could it be that she really has a child at home?

But when you carefully calculate the time, there's no way it's been around ten months; Alice and Merlin couldn't possibly have a child!

What on earth happened? It's utterly unfathomable!

Lucilia's mind was filled with doubt; she felt she had uncovered a huge secret, bottling it up inside made her feel terrible, and she really wanted to confide in someone.

Actually, Lucilia is a bit of a blabbermouth; she generally can't keep secrets, and having a secret makes her very uncomfortable—spilling it feels much better.

At this moment, Rosetti walked into the guild; she and Da Vinci had returned a few days ago, and with no recent tasks, she was very idle.

Because Da Vinci enjoys research, dedicating herself to the study of the "Philosopher's Stone," she rarely speaks.

This made Rosetti feel bored, so she came to the guild intending to chat with some adventurer acquaintances to pass the time, and also to see if Arnold, the landlord's foolish son, was around so she could tease him.

Lucilia lifted her head, saw Rosetti, felt a stir in her heart, and greeted, "Rosetti, how come you're here?"

"It's not like Da Vinci's always busy with research and nobody pays attention to me." Rosetti walked over, sat opposite Lucilia, and said, "Give me a beer."

"You guys also just got back recently? J"K Lucilia asked tentatively, and without Rosetti pouring her a beer.

"Yeah, I accompanied Da Vinci to the Royal Academy; she serves as a tutor there, teaching students alchemy, and it took her several months to finish." Rosetti complained, raising her cup and drinking heartily.

"Eh? Is that the British highest institution? Usually only nobles' children can get in?" Lucilia exclaimed in surprise.

"Yeah, the little brats there are young, all full of themselves~" Rosetti shook her head, then suddenly realized, "You just.... could it be that you've recently had an acquaintance return?"

"Merlin and Alice also came back a few days ago...." Lucilia said with a smile.

"Pfft!" Rosetti just took a sip of beer and spat it out, astonished, saying, "Mentioning Alice reminds me—this gal's been making headlines nonstop the past few months; I hear rumors about her everywhere, saying she got involved in France's affairs? And she also gave a commendable performance?"

CEz小说

"Not just commendable? I heard she personally destroyed the massive celestial body blocking the sun, turning the tide of France's crisis." Lucilia emphasized.

"Holy cow! Why is Alice's power advancing so rapidly, reaching an unfathomable level? I can't just casually joke about her anymore...... Rosetti covered her mouth, thinking her own skill is still stuck at the high tier while Alice's side has already taken off!? One must admit luck is also a kind of strength!"

"Now Alice is truly our guild's star; my father might only be able to step back to the sidelines, several big families have already thrown out olive branches, not long ago Alice just became a foreign Thorn Knight, considered receiving the queen's...... Lucilia felt a sour pang recalling when Alice first came looking for work— that was ages ago; who could have imagined she'd achieve what she has today?

"There's actually something like this? She's already a member of the Purple Wisteria Knight Corps."

Rosetti furrowed her lovely brows, her heart full of envy, thinking Alice's luck is just too good?

Who knows what cultivation method she used; she could eat fertilizer and still become a powerhouse capable of turning the tide this fast—

"If this continues...."

"Could Alice possibly become a Purple Gold Adventurer?"

"As of now, the number of Purple Gold Adventurers can be counted on one's fingers; that is indeed the highest honor in our industry."

title: Chapter 11 — Misinformation
content:
Chapter 11 — Misinformation

Volume 24 · Chapter 11

“Is it that simple? To become a Purple Gold Adventurer, it's not just about having enough strength.” Lucia paused, saying seriously, “As far as I know, among the Mithril Adventurers, there are several whose strength is enough to rival Purple Gold, yet they haven't received an invitation from the Danish Adventurers Headquarters. Whether Alice can get recognition from headquarters... it's temporarily uncertain.”

“Is that so? I heard that to become a Purple Gold Adventurer you need to pass an assessment, the difficulty is not ordinary.” Rosetti recalled, continuing, “Those adventurers who once received an invitation to advance to Purple Gold, many died in the assessment, and the lucky survivors keep their mouths shut about the assessment, I wonder what they're hiding?”

“These are probably industry secrets, they won't be made public easily, otherwise the number of Purple Gold Adventurers wouldn't be so small.” Lucia sighed.

“If Alice becomes a Purple Gold Adventurer, that would be good for our guild, right?” Rosetti asked curiously.

“Of course, our guild has never had a Purple Gold Adventurer before. If Alice becomes a Purple Gold Adventurer, then our status won't be worse than those guys in London.” Lucia said seriously, thinking of those arrogant adventurers in London who looked down their noses, wasn't it just because their guild master was Purple Gold level that they acted so haughty, with each commission's reward several times that of a Rexham adventurer!

“With Alice's current situation, it feels very likely she'll get an invitation to advance to Purple Gold.” Rosetti held her wine glass, sighing.

“Even if she receives an invitation to advance, Alice probably won't have time to take part for the time being, right?” Lucia raised her head, completely thinking about something else.

“What do you mean? That's an opportunity to advance to Purple Gold, most adventurers in their whole life never even see what an invitation letter looks like.”

Rosetti said in surprise.

Lucia awkwardly scratched her cheek, her mind full of Alice buying baby supplies today.

This suddenly discovered little secret weighed on her heart, making her very uncomfortable, she really needed a place to confide the secret.

Lucia looked at Rosetti, moved in her heart, deliberately lowered her voice, speaking mysteriously.

“I suddenly discovered something incredible today, it's about Alice and Merlin, do you want to hear it?”

“Huh!?” Rosetti suddenly perked up, “Want to, what incredible thing?”

“Then you have to promise me not to tell anyone about this, Da Vinci included.” Lucia said meaningfully.

“Don't worry, my mouth is very tight, besides Da Vinci won't get hung up on this kind of messy stuff, he has no interest at all.” Rosetti said with sworn assurance.

“Okay...” Lucia furrowed her brows, hesitating for a moment and said, “I saw Alice buy a lot of baby supplies today, Merlin and Alice might have a child?”

“... Cough!” Rosetti was startled into coughing, with a face full of disbelief, “Are you joking?”

“I saw it with my own eyes, why would I joke?” Lucia said with a serious expression.

“Heavens! I was only gone for a few months, Alice and Merlin... already have one?” Rosetti found it hard to accept this reality, “Didn't they always deny being a couple? How did they suddenly start acting for real?!”

“Keep your voice down...” Lucia made a hush gesture, lowering her voice, “They live together, a man and a woman... dry wood and raging fire, you understand, right?”

“... It's the meaning of saying no on the mouth but the body being honest, right?” Rosetti's expression became strange, hearing that Merlin and Alice have a child felt like a dream.

“However the matter isn't clear yet, I'm just guessing, Alice is sneaky, looks like she doesn't want people to know.” Lucia fell into thought, speaking full of doubt, “And counting the time, this child came too fast, whether it's Merlin and Alice's can't be determined, what can be certain... there is definitely a little baby in their house, otherwise she wouldn't buy so many baby supplies. I only told you this, don't go spreading it around.”

Rosetti nodded absentmindedly, she hadn't really listened to Lucia's last few sentences.

She picked up her wine glass, pretending to be calm and took a sip, her mind full of shock, urgently needing to calm down.

Has Alice already become a mother? That shouldn't be!

It was clearly the guild master being muddle-headed and making an operational mistake, creating a fake couple adventurer.

Before, they always looked down on each other, completely showing no possibility of being together!

How could they suddenly have a child, is this emotional progress too fast?!

Rosetti walked out of the guild with a heavy heart, still unable to figure out Alice becoming a mother.

From her understanding of Alice, she didn't seem like someone with extremely poor self-control.

Lucia's dry wood and raging fire... she found it hard to believe...

Rosetti, having suddenly learned this secret, also felt uneasy all over, with no one to help share the pressure of hiding the secret.

Just then Hobbs came to the guild at this time, preparing to drink and kill time with those fox friends and dog friends, and sell some information on the side.

Rosetti raised her eyebrows, as if she saw a suitable secret confessional tree hole, so she stopped Hobbs.

“Hobbs, wait a minute!”

“Huh!? Rosetti?” Hobbs was startled, grinning and saying, “When did you come back? Arnold rarely comes to the guild lately, don't wait for him.”

“Tsk! What are you bringing up that coward for?” Rosetti rolled her eyes, saying seriously, “I want to tell you a secret, but you can't tell anyone.”

“Hmm?” Hobbs stroked the stubble on his chin, saying with a smirk, “Okay, don't worry, my mouth is very tight.”

“Cough!” Rosetti paused, saying seriously in a low voice, “Merlin and Alice... they have a child!”

“WTF! Is it true?!” Hobbs was shocked wide-eyed, never dreaming of such a situation!

“It’s true! I... I saw Alice buy a lot of baby supplies with my own eyes.” Rosetti learned and sold at the same time, saying seriously, “But this child is a bit strange, it seems not to be their own.”

“What?!?” Hobbs was shocked again, feeling this was big news!

In the guild, because there was little work recently, the Rexham adventurers were almost all drinking to pass the time.

Lucia behind the counter felt much less pressure after telling the secret to Rosetti, humming a little tune and busy with work.

At this time Hobbs suddenly pushed open the guild door, shouting loudly, “Brothers! I just got an important piece of intel, Merlin and Ali... they actually have a child!”

“Ah!”

Hobbs's sudden announcement immediately set off the Rexham adventurers, with not small screams erupting in the guild.

For a moment the adventurers looked at each other in shock, more shocked than hearing the queen arrive in person! Many adventurers were so scared they crushed the wine glasses in their hands.

Alice was already a popular figure in the guild, and her fame has been rising recently, almost becoming the postcard of Rexham town.

Adventurer is a high-risk profession, few people marry and have children, this kind of news is generally rarely heard.

What's more, Alice is usually shrewd and capable, suddenly becoming a mother, you can imagine how shocked these colleagues are.

“Click” Lucia's feather pen was unconsciously snapped by her, almost fainting with eyes open, “What! Even Hobbs knows?”

“Having a child is not heavy...” Hobbs took a deep breath, then dropped another bombshell, “The child is not their own! My brother Merlin has been cuckolded!”

“??? ” Lucia's mind was full of question marks, her expression embarrassed, she hadn't expected things to turn out like this.

This is different from what I told Rosetti...

Completely different.

title: Chapter 12 — Teaching
content:
Chapter 12 — Teaching

Volume 24 · Chapter 12

The next day, for the sake of convenience in caring for her, Alice had brought Chris back to her own room last night so they could sleep there together.

Alice watched over her carefully all night long and found that the child hadn’t wet the bed; aside from occasionally muttering in her sleep, she remained quite quiet.

Alice felt that once Chris grew up, she would certainly become a lovely little lady, rather than always swinging swords and brandishing weapons.

Early in the morning, Merlin was still sleeping in, showing no signs of waking up at all; one large hairy leg was sticking out, and his sleeping posture was quite indecent.

After waking up, Chris originally wanted to run over and wake Merlin, but Alice stopped her, saying to let him rest properly and not to disturb him.

Chris nodded blankly, realizing that disturbing Daddy was a bad thing, and followed Alice to the bathroom to wash and get ready.

Actually, Alice knew that Merlin had a bit of morning grumpiness; if suddenly woken up, he would be in a terrible mood, and it wouldn’t surprise her if he took it out on Chris.

Mother and daughter washed up in the bathroom. Since Chris was too petite, Alice simply lifted her onto the shelf, allowing Chris to barely see herself in the mirror.

Chris looked blankly at the little girl in the mirror, her expression somewhat lost, thinking there was another child in the house.

Although Chris was young, children of this age already possessed a nascent sense of jealousy; they didn’t like sharing their parents’ love equally.

“Mommy... who?” Chris, wearing a small tank top, raised her chubby little finger to point at herself in the mirror, her expression full of panic.

“Huh? Hahaha...”

Alice couldn’t help but burst out laughing. She guessed that Chris wasn’t just seeing a mirror for the first time, but also seeing her own reflection for the very first time.

So when Chris saw herself in the mirror and didn’t recognize her, seeing a little girl right beside her mother made her feel a bit resentful.

“...” Chris pursed her lips, looking aggrieved, surprised that her own mother could be so heartless.

“Chris...” Alice patted Chris’s head, bending down to speak patiently. “This thing is called a mirror. It reflects your appearance. The cute little one inside isn’t anyone else; it’s you. If you don’t believe me, look closely. When you feel wronged, the person in the mirror feels wronged too.”

Chris looked skeptical. Watching herself in the mirror, she raised her small hand to touch the little girl opposite her, pressing two fingers against the glass.

Her eyes lit up instantly. As if discovering a new continent after playing with a rattle drum, she found it extremely interesting that the person inside would mimic her movements.

Chris poked her own cheek with two fingers, and the silver-haired little girl in the mirror acted cute in return.

“A mirror...”

Chris wondered if it was an illusion, but thought to herself: *Is this child glowing with cuteness?*

“That’s right, it’s a mirror.” Alice nodded with a smile.

“Mommy! She...” Chris pointed at herself in the mirror, her little face serious as she said, “She’s so cute!”

“Uh...” Alice’s breath hitched. She didn’t know if Chris was incredibly naive or naturally cunning. Who praised themselves as cute?!

Chris pointed at Alice, looking at her own reflection, and used the language she had just learned to say, “Her! My mommy! Is also cute!”

“...” Alice smiled awkwardly, feeling critically hit internally. *Oh my god! This child is so cunning! Is she trying to flatter me? But I really do like that she tells the truth!*

Seeing the girl in the mirror, Chris also pointed at Alice, declaring that her mommy was very cute.

This inexplicably made Chris angry at her own reflection in the mirror. Puffing out her cheeks in a huff, she looked exactly like Alice.

“She’s my mommy! Not your mommy!”

“She’s my mommy! What good does it do you to be angry?”

“Why are you shouting so loud? She’s my mommy!”

Tears welled up in Chris’s eyes. Clearly furious at her reflection, she felt that whatever she said, the other side seemed to echo, as if they were fighting over Mommy?

However, Alice suddenly noticed that when Chris got angry and anxious, her linguistic skills improved dramatically. While she could barely express herself before, her angry arguments were unexpectedly fluent!

Feeling she couldn’t out-shout her reflection, Chris held back her urge to cry and turned to seek help from Alice, acting like a cowardly kid who went home to find Mommy after being bullied outside.

“Mommy, the person inside is a bad guy. She’s fighting with me for you. I think I can’t beat her...”

“Hahaha...”

Alice picked up Chris, nearly laughing herself into passing out. To argue with one’s own reflection and even cry from anger—this child had unique talents. If a mirror were placed in front of her, Chris probably wouldn’t be bored all day, constantly arguing with herself until it got out of hand.

“Mom...” Seeing Alice only laughing and not comforting her, Chris asked sadly, “Mommy is Chris’s mommy, right?”

“...”

Alice looked at Chris’s pitiful little face and felt moved. Was she really this sad just because someone was stealing her mommy?

If she found out we weren’t her biological parents, she would probably suffer even more, right? It seems we really can’t let her find out...

Alice scratched Chris’s nose affectionately and said softly.

“I will always be your mommy.”

“Shoo shoo~” Chris happily hummed twice, hugging Alice, then turned her head to look at herself in the mirror.

“This is my mommy, not your mommy. I won’t be angry with you. Hmph...”

After washing up, Alice changed Chris into new clothes: a newly bought goose-yellow dress and a pair of small leather shoes.

Once dressed, although the outfit wasn’t flashy, it made Chris look even more obedient and cute, clearly resembling the proper daughter of a respectable family.

Alice surveyed Chris and nodded satisfactorily. “How is it? Do you like it?”

Chris looked down at her new clothes, happy that she was finally no longer wearing just a tank top. She smiled like a blooming flower. “Yiya~”

“As long as you like it. Remember not to get them dirty, and watch where you walk.” Alice admonished seriously, like a true mother.

“I know!” Chris responded in a milky voice, grabbing her skirt to examine it closely. Apparently unaware that lifting it this way might expose her privates, she inadvertently pleased a group of old perverts.

Alice’s expression suddenly darkened. Realizing the severity of the situation, she understood that Chris’s moral compass wasn’t yet fully formed and needed proper education.

Acting so casually might turn her into a particularly frivolous girl later on, which was definitely not what Alice wanted to see!

Alice decided to teach Chris everything about protecting herself. She pressed down Chris’s hand that was lifting her skirt and cleared her throat严肃ly.

“Chris, this isn’t okay. Don’t keep lifting your skirt. No one is allowed to see under your skirt. Do you understand?”

“N-no one?” Chris looked at Alice疑惑ly. “Doesn’t Mommy count either?”

“Mommy is the person closest to you, of course she can. What I meant is...” Alice thought for a moment and said seriously, “People who aren’t close enough are absolutely not allowed!”

“...I understand...” Chris nodded blankly, then her eyes curved into crescents. “Daddy and Mommy are both the people closest to Chris. If Mommy can see under Chris’s skirt, then Daddy can too!”

“Pfft!” Alice nearly spat blood on the spot upon hearing this, completely stunned by Chris’s remarks.

*Wait! That’s not what I meant!*

*I was just thinking about how to teach Chris to be an excellent...*

*Not raise her into a legally staying-by-my-side little fox spirit!!!*

(°Д°u)

title: Chapter 13 — Soul Interrogation
content:
Chapter 13 — Soul Interrogation

Volume 24 · Chapter 13

"You can't let Daddy see!" Alice blurted out in fright, trying to nip Chris's weird idea in the bud, "Cough, cough, if that beast sees it, then he's a bad dad...."

"Why?" Chris blinked her big, bright eyes, not really understanding Alice's reaction.

Alice crouched down, placing her hands on Chris's shoulders, with a stern face she said earnestly, "Chris, I don't mean that—I mean, as a girl, you shouldn't casually lift your skirt."

"But...." Chris looked troubled, puzzled, and asked, "Mom...--close people can"

"Close people aren't a big deal, but this doesn't include males; you and Mom are both girls, so me seeing you isn't serious, do you understand?" Alice warned sternly.

"...." Chris nodded, half-understanding.

"But if you ever meet someone you like and they like you back, then even if it's a male, it's not... not..." Alice paused, putting on a motherly look, and said, "But I must first examine... before allowing it; I won't let just any big pig's hoof run off with you."

"...person?" Chris lifted her little face, brows knotted in confusion, "Chris doesn't really understand"

"......" Alice stroked Chris's little head, speaking meaningfully, "You'll understand when you're older, no need to rush."

"Hehe...

Chris enjoyed her mother's caress, her little face slightly pink, looking quite happy, 'Chris wants to show Daddy her new clothes~"

"Huh? Wait, that guy has morning grumpiness..... Alice had just tried to stop Chris from disturbing Merlin, but this little tyke vanished in a puff, running off to find Daddy."

"Sigh, this kid...

'I take such good care of her, won't she end up liking Merlin more than me?'"

Chris's language and motor skills are growing at a visible speed. Novel

Although her speech is still a bit unclear and her walking is wobbly and unstable, she has basically grown a lot.

Merlin was still snoring loudly, lying awkwardly on the sofa, covered with a blanket, his big hairy leg exposed outside, looking very unsightly, and I don't know who he's trying to seduce.

Chris's steps were unsteady, she waddled over happily and said, "Daddy~, look at my new clothes!"

"Snore..... Merlin was sleeping soundly, oblivious to the outside world."

"....

Chris looked unhappy, lifting her little head to gaze at the sofa taller than herself, feeling a pang of worry."

In desperation, she tried to climb onto the sofa, using her short legs to jump two centimeters off the ground, but after bouncing for a while she still couldn't get up.

Chris furrowed her little brows, her angry little mouth pouting high, wanting to wake Merlin, but she couldn't even defeat a sofa.

Alice had just come out of the room, seeing this she originally wanted to go help, but then suddenly changed her mind, silently watching from behind to see how Chris would react—

At times like this, one definitely shouldn't help; if you do everything for the child, what will happen when they grow up and become a giant baby?

Come on, Chris! It's time to use your brain and think about how to wake that guy Merlin.

Chris, in place, anxiously let out repeated whimpering "wu-wu" sounds, patting the sofa's edge making "pa-pa" noises, but to no avail.

This was when she saw Merlin's leg exposed outside, hanging down—a hairy leg....

Chris's eyes lit up, she wobbled over, looking at Merlin's hairy leg with a face full of wonder, tiptoeing just enough to be able to stroke it.

"Huh? ! !" Alice's face instantly darkened, she thought to herself, liking to touch leg hair? Is her taste too weird? And it's a bit heavy on the flavor!

"...." Chris felt the sensation was very marvelous, not wanting the stubble to be too prickly, so she grabbed a leg hair and "ding" pulled one out!

"Ugh!" Alice stared, mouth agape, her mind blank, not knowing how to retort anymore.

"Sigh!" Merlin sucked in a breath of cold air, feeling as if he'd been poked, he suddenly opened his eyes, angry and about to explode, "Alice"

Merlin was about to lash out directly, but his voice cut off; he saw Chris lying on the edge of the sofa, due to her small stature she didn't reach the sofa's height, exposing half her head like a mole.

"Emmm..... Merlin's face looked grim, looking at his daughter, he thought irritably, 'So it wasn't Alice who did it?!! Just now I almost got up to give her a punch, but this little brat disturbing others' rest really deserves a beating?' Chris's ruby-like eyes blinked, seeing Dad awake she instantly smiled like a crescent moon, the little tuft on her head shaking happily, "Daddy~"

Merlin stared, feeling Chris's smile seemed to glow, the anger he'd been about to vent suddenly got extinguished—

"Hit... definitely not, who would hit this little cutie? Speaking of which, this brat's eyes really look like mine...."

Merlin calmed himself a bit, slowly rose lazily, looking at the sofa, then lowered his gaze to Chris.

"What are you doing? My... ancestor....

'Daddy look.... Chris showed off her new skirt, her little face excited and rosy, 'Mommy gave me.... new clothes, ee-ya"

"Ha, really? Like..... Merlin sighed, thinking just this trivial matter isn't worth waking me over, so he answered with a perfunctory smile, "Your mom has good taste, it's quite fitting."

".Li... cute?" Chris poked her own little cheeks, eyes full of little stars, hoping Daddy would praise her.

"...- world first- -.... Merlin gave a faint smile, speaking in a tired tone."

"...." Chris wasn't very happy, feeling Daddy was being perfunctory, not like Mommy.

Merlin noticed Chris's tuft drooping down, -that meant she was unhappy.

So he reached out, lifted Chris from the ground, and placed her on his belly.

"Upon closer look, she really is cute, no wonder she's my daughter."

"Ee-ya~" Chris happily showed her baby teeth; she sat kneeling on Merlin's belly, feeling it a bit hard.

"Does sleeping with Mommy make you happy? Anything happen?" Merlin shifted the topic.

"Happy!" Chris said with a flushed face, then immediately furrowed her little brows, huffing, "But.... this morning in the mirror there was a little kid competing with me for Mommy, I was so angry, hiss!"

"? ? ?" Merlin had a head full of question marks, couldn't understand at all, thought Chris was spouting nonsense, but this child's expressive ability had improved a lot overnight; as a newborn, she's practically a freak, so we can't let our guard down yet.

"Mommy's bed..... is soft, Daddy's wooden board, .hard... uncomfortable." Chris indicated with her hands.

"This is a so... Merlin explained helplessly, "So you like Mommy's bed, huh?"

"Like! ..... Chris's brows knotted together, she hesitantly uttered a soul-searching question—

"Only allowed to sleep with Mommy, not with Daddy."

"Why doesn't Daddy sleep with Mommy on that big, soft bed?"

(° w° m)

I occasionally glance at the comment section, but rarely reply.

Some say it's "watery"; when I write side characters they call it water, when I don't write side characters they all say the side characters are brainless and soulless.

Ha, this puts me in a tough spot—should I write side characters or not? Do side characters need soul without relying on plot to pile it up?

Zhang San is handsome, I've portrayed him well, this is a side character, yet I get criticized for side characters lacking soul; if they have soul, aside from Zhang San's good looks, shouldn't we not need to pile on more stuff?

When the daughter appears online, daily life will have a bit more; readers who like to show off will definitely be unhappy, I know that in my heart.

But is it unrealistic for the two main characters to have their affection for the daughter explode like that? Do I not need to have them interact a bit?

Merlin and Alice: "This is our daughter, we love her to bits, no reason needed!"

Writing it like this will surely still draw criticism; put simply, tastes differ, no author can satisfy all readers' tastes—only a math and science textbook could, and that definitely wouldn't draw flak.

Recently being tangled up in revision matters, updates have been few; the website's review editors are fine, they can point out what's wrong and what to fix, making changes easy and pressure-free.

But the audio team directly threw over about twenty chapters' worth of content, the revision demands are rather vague; I read them several times a day, really hard to get started, I truly think this level is still okay, saying it's seriously pornographic.

One pornographic accusation came over, telling me to find it myself; the book is mine, I think if it's unqualified I definitely wouldn't write it, if I can write it I think it's fine, let me find what's wrong myself—I might think nothing is wrong anywhere.

Also the reason for the pornographic label is "ambiguous"; everything's judged as ambiguous, yet they still call it pornographic.... I'm a bit lost on how to write.

By day I stare at the chapters needing revision, look at them for three or four hours, then not a single character changed—I can't find a place to start.

This situation has lasted ten weeks; now it makes me feel the audio team and the review editors are two different standards, so I plan to check it out and start regular updates tomorrow.

title: Chapter 14 — Dad is a Serious Person (More Coming Soon)
content:
Chapter 14 — Dad is a Serious Person (More Coming Soon)

Volume 24 · Chapter 14

"Uh! .....

Facing Chris's soulful questioning, Merlin was suddenly at a loss for words, not knowing how to respond to her.

Since Merlin and Alice were temporarily acting as Chris's parents, sleeping separately did seem out of place, and it was no wonder that little Chris would have doubts.

Merlin thought to himself that he wasn't averse to big, soft beds either, but it was Alice who didn't want to. Sleeping together would be too embarrassing.

When Merlin had transformed into a child before, he had fortunately slept with Alice for a few days.

But back then, Alice had treated Merlin as a child, thinking it was fine, but after reverting to adulthood, it became very inconvenient.

Alice watched from afar, silent and unresponsive, but upon hearing Chris's soulful questioning, she immediately tensed up.

Thinking to herself, yes! We are Chris's father and mother, and sleeping separately is indeed abnormal.

But... but Merlin had long since shed his child's body, and sleeping on the same bed now... felt very subtle!

Moreover, sleeping so close to Merlin... I'm not mentally prepared for it! No way! Absolutely not!

Alice's face turned slightly red, her heart racing with wild thoughts, wondering how Merlin would respond to Chris.

Merlin looked at the innocent Chris, stunned for a while, then awkwardly cleared his throat, "Cough... It's not that I don't want to sleep with Mom, it's just that I prefer sleeping on hard surfaces."

"Hmm?" Chris sat on Merlin's belly, tilted her little head, and said in confusion, "..... This is super uncomfortable, why does Dad sleep on the sofa?"

Merlin picked up Chris and slowly stood up, gently placing her in front of himself, smiling as he said, "Chris, you're still young and don't understand yet, this is training.

Chris knelt in front of Merlin, blinking her big eyes, "Training?"

"That's right! Training is the process of people constantly honing themselves to become stronger." Merlin paused, patting the sofa beneath him with a serious expression, "If I sleep on a bed that's too soft, my training will slacken. Only this hard sofa is suitable for Dad, understand?"

"Get stronger?" Chris's eyes suddenly sparkled with little stars, seeming to admire the idea of training.

"That's right." Merlin nodded, secretly letting out a sigh of relief. Luckily Chris was young and didn't understand anything, so he could fool her. If she were a bit older, it wouldn't work.

"Chris also wants to get stronger!" Chris raised her chubby little arms, trying to show off her strength, "Hmph! Three..."

"Why do you want to get stronger?" Merlin suddenly furrowed his brows, thinking that a child of her age should be all about playing.

"If Chris gets stronger, I can help Dad and Mom chase away the bad people who bully you~" Chris said in a childish voice, her small face tense and looking very serious.

Merlin looked at Chris expressionlessly, finding the child silly and naive, and couldn't help but burst out laughing, "Haha..."

"Dad?" Chris froze, her small face turning red as she pushed against Merlin's thigh, "Dad, don't laugh, don't laugh!"

Merlin stopped laughing, picked up Alice, and placed her on his lap, speaking in a fatherly tone, "Silly child, Dad and Mom don't need your protection. In fact, there aren't many people who can bully us.

"..... Chris wanted to say something but seemed to have many words stuck in her throat. Since she had only recently learned to speak, she couldn't express many things.

Merlin looked down at Chris, thinking that if this little devil were really his child, how should he respond to her? What expectations did he have for his own child?

He had never thought about this before, but he wouldn't force his child to become strong. Even if they didn't learn martial arts or magic, it was fine as long as they could live happily.

Merlin stretched out his hand and gently stroked Chris's hair, revealing a doting father's gaze, "Chris, you don't need to rush to protect Dad and Mom. You should do what you want to do, not change yourself for us. Of course, it's not wrong if you want to get stronger, but strength comes in many forms. Physical strength is the most superficial; becoming strong in spirit is the most important. It will make you unyielding and very strong, just like your mom..."

..... Alice's face turned red in the distance, thinking, does this guy really have such a high opinion of me? Why doesn't he ever speak nicely to me normally?

"Like Mom?" Chris's face immediately showed admiration, her eyes sparkling, "Chris wants to become like Mom!"

....... Merlin let out a dry laugh, thinking that learning from Alice wasn't bad, but her aesthetic sense was another matter.

Alice secretly let out a sigh of relief, having thought that Merlin wouldn't be able to teach Chris anything good, but now it seemed not bad. However, she didn't know if Merlin actually liked this child or was just playing the role of "father."

"Dad~" Chris called out in a childish voice, saying innocently, "Last night I slept with Mom, can I sleep with you today? Dad, sleeping in such an uncomfortable place, won't you be lonely?"

"Uh... Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking, why is this child clinging to me so tightly? Hasn't she given up yet!

Alice's face darkened, thinking, is this child too attached to Merlin? It's completely heading in the direction of a little fox spirit! No way! I disagree!

So she coughed loudly, trying to remind Merlin not to go too far.

"Cough! ! !"

"Hmm?"

Merlin turned his head to look behind him, only to see Alice leaning against the door, staring straight at him.

Merlin put Chris down from his lap and adopted a stern fatherly demeanor, "No, Dad is a serious person."

Chris, who still couldn't eat freely and only drank milk, sat in her little basket, playing with the toys Alice had bought.

In their previously peaceful home, the sound of a drum toy "thud thud thud" and a child's happy laughter occasionally rang out.

This made Merlin and Alice feel a different kind of feeling, as if their temporary rental house was gradually becoming more like a home.

"Merlin, you must mop the floor today, or else... or else I'll make you regret it!" Alice waved her fist, which had no intimidating power, as she prepared to go out and sun the bedding, giving Merlin an ultimatum. She really couldn't stand Merlin, who refused to do even a bit of housework.

"Tch! Fine... Merlin clicked his tongue in annoyance, scratching his messy hair. It seemed he couldn't escape today.

But to little Chris in the basket, this scene looked like Mom was intentionally scolding Dad.

This made Chris think Dad was pitiful, and she couldn't help but jump out, standing between Merlin and Alice, pouting as she said confidently, "Mom, don't hit Dad, Dad didn't do anything bad, he's not a bad child.

"If Mom is angry, then scold me instead..."

title: Chapter 15 — Secret Departure (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 15 — Secret Departure (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 24 · Chapter 15

“Oh?” Merlin looked down at Chris’s tiny frame and grinned, taunting, “Yeah, why’re you yelling at me? I didn’t do anything wrong — I’m just poor little me~”

“You?!” Alice pointed angrily at Merlin, feeling like she’d punched a brick wall with her bare fist. This guy was shameless!

“Don’t yell at Daddy...” Chris tugged on Alice’s leg, her face pleading.

“...Alice felt the pressure instantly and softened her tone, smiling kindly: “Don’t cry, don’t cry — who’d dare bully your dad? It’s all a misunderstanding.”

“I don’t care! You did bully me! I’m just a kid, you can’t do that to me! Waaah!” Merlin played the victim, pretending Alice was oppressing him.

“What kind of kid are you?! A giant baby, maybe!” Alice gritted her teeth — using Chris as a shield? That was low.

“Waaah, Mommy, don’t be so... mean...” Chris felt caught in the middle, torn between her parents’ bickering.

“Mommy isn’t yelling — it’s just your dad...” Alice rubbed her temples, realizing Merlin and Chris were ganging up on her. “He has chores to do, and he’s been putting them off for nearly a week. Do you like living in a dirty, messy house?”

“...Chris hesitated, glancing suspiciously at Merlin, then shook her head.

“See that? Merlin, get to work on the floor — don’t think you can fool me...” Alice crossed her arms, sternly.

“I know, I know — no need to nag all day.” Merlin waved dismissively.

“You’ve been dragging your feet for a week — what do you expect?!” Alice grabbed a damp blanket and headed out. “Finish your job before I get back, and don’t teach Chris any weird stuff.”

“Fine, I’ll do it...” Merlin scratched his head, looked around, then shrugged and lifted Chris into her basket. “You, little troublemaker, stay here and don’t cause trouble, okay?”

“I’ll be good~” Chris nodded earnestly.

Merlin smiled and got to work — fetching a bucket and mop from the bathroom, scrubbing away days of dust from the floor.

But why was Merlin actually doing the chores? Sure, Alice was nagging, but he also wanted to give Chris a cleaner environment.

Chris watched from her basket, wondering if she should help. So she climbed out and tugged on Merlin’s pant leg.

“Daddy, I’ll help with the chores!”

“Huh?” Merlin looked down at her. “You’re too small — what can you do?”

“Hmph!” Chris puffed up, mimicking Alice’s stance. “I’m strong! I can do anything!”

“...Merlin chuckled softly. “What can you actually do?”

Chris flexed her tiny biceps proudly. “Whatever Mommy and Daddy can do, I can help with! I’m super strong~”

“Okay, Chris, just rest in your basket. This is adult work.” Merlin appreciated the effort but knew she’d only get in the way. “When you’re older, you can help — no rush.”

“No!” Chris felt insulted. She pouted and stomped her foot. “I can help right now!”

“Uh...” Merlin paused, thinking: This stubbornness... it’s just like Alice. Identical.

Chris marched to the water bucket, dipped a cloth, and bent down to scrub the floor — grunting with effort.

“Chris, stand up — don’t ruin your new clothes.”

“It’s okay! Mommy will only scold me, not Daddy. Heave-ho...!”

Chris was determined, sweating within minutes. She felt happy to be helping. But after all that effort, she’d only cleaned a tiny patch — impressive for a two-year-old, though.

She stood up, covered in dirt and water, but didn’t care. She posed like a hero: “Look, Daddy! I cleaned it better than you! Am I awesome?”

Merlin was touched. This kid was changing his view of “troublesome children.” Who knew toddlers could be so thoughtful?

He knelt down, wiped her dirty face with a clean towel, and ruffled her hair: “You are awesome — no wonder you’re my daughter...”

“Yay~”

(><)

On the sea route from the United Kingdom to Britannia, a ship flying the elven flag sailed secretly toward the human empire.

The Elf King hadn’t given up on retrieving Chris. After consulting the elders, he decided to send Sherry and Sylph to Britannia to reclaim the child born from the egg.

Sherry was chosen because she was friends with Merlin and Alice — easier to negotiate with. Even if things went south, she’d likely avoid a full-blown fight.

Sylph emerged from the cabin, scanning the deck. She saw Sherry standing by the railing, lost in thought, and felt a pang of worry. Was the princess still grieving over Queen Andia?

“Your Highness, what are you thinking? Is it... Andia?”

“No...” Sherry turned, frowning. “I’m still sad about Mother, but I’m coping — I have Father with me.”

“Then why the long face?” Sylph asked.

“It’s about the child in the egg. While the egg belongs to us, the baby inside is Merlin and Alice’s. Taking it... feels wrong.” Sherry hesitated.

“I agree,” Sylph nodded. “But the elders and the King believe the child is too important to give away. They fear losing a valuable asset.”

“I understand Father’s concern for the race, but separating them from their child... I can’t do that.”

“Your Highness, you’re friends with them, but you’re also the princess. You must consider your duty.” Sylph sighed. “The King knows you’re compassionate, so he sent me and an elder to ensure you don’t act on emotion. We’re prepared for conflict if necessary.”

Sherry fell silent, torn between loyalty to her people and friendship.

“Actually, you don’t need to stress. Just keep the child’s identity secret,” Sylph suggested. “If we don’t tell Merlin and Alice it’s their baby, they’ll think it’s someone else’s — and they might return it to us.”

“So we explain politely, and they’ll hand over the child?”

“Exactly. No need to fight — just a little deception.”

Sherry looked conflicted, but Sylph smiled reassuringly: “Trust me, it’ll work. We’ll get the child back without hurting anyone.”
