After this I’ll sell you off, your tender skin will surely fetch a nice sum.” “....” Little Chris was filled with despair, praying in her heart for her father to come find her. The fat mercenary turned toward the corpse of the burnt giant spiky boar, used his knife to cut open the flesh, constantly searching for the most valuable high‑rank magic beast crystal core. The spiky hairs and protruding teeth on the giant spiky boar could be sold, but the fat mercenary alone obviously couldn’t carry too much, and he didn’t have a spatial ring, that rare trinket. Just as the fat mercenary was whistling, enjoying the harvest joy, a strange rustling sound came from around him? The fat mercenary instinctively lifted his head, instantly his face turned pale, frightened badly, his whole body seemed to turn to stone. “Ugh!” In front of the mercenary stood dozens of strong, ferocious giant spiky boars, their dark little eyes fixed on him. The fat mercenary’s legs went weak; he had a magic scroll, magic beasts were prey, without a magic scroll he would become the beasts’ prey! He trembled as he stood up, looked around, discovered he was completely surrounded, with no way to escape. Why… why did this attract so many high‑rank magic beasts? A normal child attracting two would already be the limit! That little devil… what is that little devil? What did she do?! The fat mercenary suddenly turned his head, horrified at the sight of Little Chris hanging from the tree, and shouted wildly. “It’s you! What did you do?!” “You evil little brat! I should have killed you earlier!” “....” Don’t! Uh ah ah ah ah!!! The fat mercenary, facing dozens of giant spiky boars, was gnawed to pieces, blood splattered, and even his bones were left behind. Little Chris was terrified, dared not look at such a bloody scene, tightly shut her eyes. After eating the fat mercenary, the giant spiky boars’ attention shifted again to Little Chris, gathering around the big tree. In those pairs of dark little eyes, there was a longing for Chris, saliva already dripping. Bang Bang bang bang! The giant spiky boars grew anxious, repeatedly ramming the big tree with their sturdy bodies. Being struck by dozens of magic beasts, the big tree began to emit a “crack crack crack” sound of splitting. Little Chris, hanging above, was shaken until her head swam, her heart both anxious and afraid! With the crisp “crack” sound, the big tree was knocked down by the boars and collapsed with a roar! Little Chris lost her last safety barrier and fell straight down, awaiting her was the boars’ bloody maw— The water cup fell to the ground, smashed to pieces, countless fragments reflecting Alice’s shadow. Alice at home had been waiting for Merlin to bring Chris back, but just then She suddenly felt a pain in her head, dizziness, almost unable to stand, the cup she used for water shattered. Alice steadied herself after a moment, rubbed her temples, and muttered to herself, “What’s wrong with me? Has my body been acting up lately?” It shouldn’t be… could it… Did something bad just happen? Alice felt a faint worry rise in her heart; she lifted her gaze to the night outside the window and whispered a prayer for Chris. “Merlin, you must definitely bring Chris back, don’t let anything happen on the way…” Suddenly, in this quiet night, a large bald vulture appeared out of nowhere outside the window, constantly flapping its wings, scratching the glass with its claws. This eerie scene left Alice stunned; she walked forward, opened the window, and the white‑feathered vulture flew into her embrace. The vulture’s little head kept rubbing against Alice’s bosom, appearing especially close! Alice was very surprised; she examined the vulture closely and discovered that beneath its white feathers lay a layer of black feathers! White‑feathered vultures usually live on high‑altitude snowy mountains, while the two‑colored vulture is even rarer, extremely scarce! Alice recalled, and immediately recognized that this close‑by vulture came from where, her eyes widening in fear and anxiety— Two years ago, Alice, tired of the boring life on the snowy mountain, wanted to go out and adventure; on one night she stole her teacher’s hidden sword and slipped down the mountain. At that time, the teacher had just picked up an abandoned two‑colored feathered vulture chick and kept it in his room, never expecting that after two years without seeing it, it had grown this big…. …Not…. could this be such a coincidence? It shouldn’t be the teacher’s hawk. Alice held the two‑colored feathered vulture, her heart uneasy, even feeling a bit lucky. She, with a hopeful mindset, lowered her head and looked, and indeed discovered that the vulture’s leg was tied to a small tube containing a letter. Alice shockingly lifted her head, then put on a mournful face, realizing she couldn’t escape now—this was a falcon‑delivered letter, surely sent by her teacher! “Why am I so unlucky? How did that shut‑in teacher know I was there?!!” Alice showed an expression of having lost all will to live, threw the vulture to the ground, sat alone on the sofa and lamented, feeling her good days had come to an end. The two‑colored vulture came to Alice’s feet, spread its wings, revealing the letter tied to its leg, hinting that she should open and read it. Alice sighed deeply; since the teacher’s letter had arrived, she had no choice but to look, wondering what the teacher would say after two years of no contact. Alice took the small tube from the vulture’s foot, pulled out the yellowed paper inside, which fully showed how harsh life on the snowy mountain was. “Alice! You dead‑beat girl, your wings have hardened, you actually dared to steal the sword from under my bed and then sneak down the mountain at night?” “Two years, full two years have passed, and you still won’t come back to see me, your teacher?” “You little brat, you’re too grudge‑holding! Just because two years ago I didn’t give you a drumstick, only gave you the chicken butt, so you ran away from home out of anger?” “Alright, I’ll compromise; besides the chicken butt, I’m also willing to give you the chicken claws—this is the greatest concession I can make as your teacher.” “By the way, I saw you in the newspaper; fortunately, a caravan passing through the snowy mountain brought a newspaper, I wanted to come over to prepare some pastime, never expecting to accidentally see your news?” “You’re really promising now—after two years down the mountain your strength has advanced so fast, surpassing my imagination. I thought you would definitely suffer a lot outside, the worst case being you selling your pitiful looks to cling to a thigh, but it seems I overthought it; those heretical seduction techniques I taught you are useless, I’m relieved—truly the disciple I taught (tortured) turned out well.” “Since you won’t see me, I’ll come see you myself; I plan to go down the mountain to visit you, no need to be moved to tears, you know, I, the teacher, dislike being clingy.” “Remember to prepare good wine and meat; lately the snowy mountain often has blizzards, caravans have dwindled, I haven’t eaten meat for three months, I was almost going to slaughter this vulture for a tooth‑fest, but I endured; your absence on the snowy mountain has been terribly boring.” “Oh right, don’t think about moving away to escape; you’re now a celebrity, I can easily find you.” “Teacher loves you forever~” ε 9(》>o<)$ 8 Here I can finally defend myself; earlier many people said my way of giving credit to Alice was foolish. Well, I held back my response, I didn’t explain, because explaining would easily spoil things, and as an author I can’t say too much. Now I can finally say that I’m giving the credit to Alice, letting her become famous, so that the reclusive snowy‑mountain teacher will learn of Alice’s whereabouts, the teacher’s storyline can start, and it can also lead to more of the content everyone cares about later.

title: Chapter 9 — The Two Who Lost Their Way
content:
Chapter 9 — The Two Who Lost Their Way

Volume 25 · Chapter 9

---

"It's over…"

Alice's hands trembled as she held her teacher's letter. She raised her head, her expression filled with disbelief.

She had thought becoming famous would be a good thing. Who would have guessed the news would spread all the way to that remote Great Snow Mountain?!

Alice crumpled her teacher's letter into a ball and bit her lip, fighting back tears.

It wasn't because she was crying tears of joy over her teacher coming to celebrate her achievements after two years apart—no, it was entirely because she felt terrible inside, dreading the fact that her teacher was coming to see her.

What should she do? Her teacher was coming!

Heaven only knew what purpose she had left the Great Snow Mountain for—it certainly couldn't be something as simple as a visit! Perhaps she had come down the mountain on purpose just to torment her!

That old woman ought to just stay put on the mountain and not wander around unless it was an important matter…

Alice was at a loss for words, tears welling up. Her life was fine as it was; she didn't need her teacher coming over to stir things up.

So Alice hurriedly turned around and went into her bedroom, picked up a feather quill, and wrote a reply to her teacher—

"Old bag! Don't you dare come over!"

"My life is perfectly fine, no need to miss me!"

"If I have free time, I'll come back to Great Snow Mountain to visit you."

"In short, don't come. Absolutely do not come!"

Chris, who had been hung upside down on the tree after her body was roughly rammed and snapped off by monsters, fell from the sky along with it.

"Waaaaah!"

Below, dozens of giant thorn boars' beady eyes lit up with excitement. They opened their huge mouths wide, ready to catch the falling little Chris and devour her on the spot.

Little Chris tightly closed her eyes in midair, terrified, her mind going completely blank. In those fleeting moments, only her memories of mom and dad, along with that delicious cream cake, flashed through her mind.

But at this critical moment, a thin, small figure swooped down from the sky at incredible speed, intercepting Chris and snatching her away from her fall.

Little Johnson had already been deep inside the Monster Beast Forest for some time. He had originally planned to hunt powerful monster beasts and obtain their crystal cores to strengthen himself.

However, he had never expected the depths of the Monster Beast Forest to be so vast. Towering, colossal trees were densely packed, forming a natural maze!

As someone who was already directionally challenged, Little Johnson not only failed to find any powerful monster beasts, but he had gotten lost here himself. Unless one frequently ventured into the Monster Beast Forest, it would be nearly impossible to find their way out from the depths.

Just moments ago, Little Johnson had decided to simply pick a direction and keep walking no matter what—then he had heard a shrill, bloodcurdling scream halfway along.

Little Johnson quickened his pace and happened to witness the monster beasts felling the great tree. He lunged forward in one bound and rescued Chris.

"Hm?" Little Chris偷偷 opened her eyes and saw Little Johnson. Suddenly, she broke into a smile. "Woo-hoo~ hee~"

"You can still laugh? Why are you here? Where's your dad?" Little Johnson was full of questions. Since the child was here, Merlin should be around as well. Otherwise, how on earth would a kid have dared to enter the depths of the Monster Beast Forest? Was she looking to die?

The giant thorn boars not far away, seeing their prey snatched from them, immediately flew into a furious rage. They let out low growls and charged toward Little Johnson.

The powerful monster beasts trampled the earth, shaking the ground relentlessly. Wherever they passed, everything was flattened.

Little Johnson placed the tightly-bound Chris on the ground and turned to face the charging monsters.

He slowly crouched down, pressed his hand against the earth, and his gaze suddenly grew sharp—

"Earth Spike Forest!"

Little Johnson channeled his Saint-tier magic power into the ground, making the earth itself seem to come alive!

Thrust! Thrust! Thrust! Countless sharp rock spikes erupted from the ground, instantly covering a vast area before his eyes.

The rock spikes shot upward from below, piercing through the giant thorn boars' most vulnerable bellies, riddling them with wounds!

The monster beasts' corpses were impaled high into the air on the earth spikes, their blood slowly trickling down the stone pillars.

Amidst the gloomy night, the corpses of monster beasts hung suspended above the stone forest, looking particularly eerie…

*Pop!* A few sparks flew into the air. In the dark and dreary depths of the Monster Beast Forest, the warm glow from the campfire gave one a sense of comfort.

Little Johnson sat on the ground, continually feeding slightly damp wood into the fire. He glanced over at the little one beside him.

"You're saying you were forcibly brought in by two big guys?"

"Mmhmm!" Little Chris nodded eagerly, her expression serious. "They tied me up and said they wanted to use me as bait to lure big monsters over!"

"Bait? To lure monsters?"

Little Johnson furrowed his brows. He figured they must be mercenaries—using bait to trap monster beasts was a common tactic among mercenaries.

But using a mentally immature child as bait was truly excessive…

Little Johnson was unfamiliar with the mercenary trade. Hearing about such a vicious tactic of using children as bait was something he had only encountered for the first time.

"What happened to those two? Why are you the only one left?"

"Ah…" Chris bit her finger, carefully recalling the bloody scene. Even now, she still felt a lingering chill. "One… one of the big guys got stabbed by another guy, and then the other big guy… got eaten by those giant monsters…"

"???" Little Johnson's expression turned odd. He figured this must be infighting—black eating black, killing each other. He had to admit this brat was lucky. Of the children who fell into the hands of bad people, how many actually survived? "I see. So where's your dad? You got kidnapped by bad guys, and what on earth was he doing?"

"…" Chris lowered her head sadly, her two small fingers poking back and forth in grievance. "It's all because I was too playful and didn't listen to Daddy. I ran off on my own and ran into those bad people. Daddy must be very worried right now, and he still doesn't know where I am…"

"…" Little Johnson gave a dry laugh, then said smugly, "I figured as much~ That guy's disposition, how could he possibly be a good father? As I expected, totally unreliable. Actually letting you wander around outside by yourself—that's the biggest dereliction of duty for a father~"

"Don't say that about my dad! Daddy is a very gentle, very kind person! Daddy is super nice to me~" Chris puffed out her cheeks in anger and countered Little Johnson in a childish voice.

"Hah!" Little Johnson crooked the corner of his mouth and waved his hand dismissively. "Whatever you say, little brat. I'm too lazy to argue with you."

"Guh…" Chris's expression turned mournful, and she couldn't help muttering, "You say Daddy called you a brat too, and that you have a bad temper? Looks like it's really true…"

"What?!" Little Johnson gritted his teeth in anger, the veins on his forehead pulsing. "That guy talked about me like that? My temper is bad? Your dad isn't much better himself!"

"My dad is super nice! Anyone who slanders him is a big bad guy!" Chris pursed her little mouth and stubbornly defended Merlin.

"Tch!" Little Johnson pursed his lips in disdain, then extinguished the campfire in front of him. Not wanting to argue with a child any longer, he said, "Rest is over, right? Let's get out of this damn place…"

"Okay~" Little Chris responded softly.

The two slowly moved forward, walking straight ahead in the same direction.

This time, Little Johnson had returned empty-handed. He had already given up on hunting monster beasts and decided to first return Chris to Merlin's side.

However—

The direction they were advancing was not the way out of the Monster Beast Forest at all. Instead, they were heading deeper into the forest.

The deeper one ventured into the Monster Beast Forest, the more dangerous it became…

title: Chapter 10 — Brother John
content:
Chapter 10 — Brother John

Volume 25 · Chapter 10

In the Demon Beast Forest, Merlin and Zitiao had already arrived.

In front of them were dozens of demon beast corpses impaled into the sky by earth spikes, and the blood of the monsters covering the ground had already congealed.

Merlin picked up a small shoe Chris had left behind on the ground, probably dropped without her noticing.

He patted the dust off it, his expression darkening, his mind beginning to race with worry — could something have happened to Chris?

"This is her shoe... Could it be—"

"Don't lose your head. Since these demon beasts are already dead, your child is likely still alive," Zitiao said calmly.

......Merlin's brows were tightly furrowed, his gaze full of unease. As long as Chris was not safe for even a moment, he could never feel at ease.

"The corpses of these demon beasts are, in a sense, kind of good news..." Zitiao suddenly said.

"Good news?! " Merlin glared at Zitiao and said irritably, "Don't stand there and talk easy! My child's life or death is uncertain and you call this good news!"

"Calm down." Zitiao sighed and explained, "Look at these sharp earth spikes — they're still radiating immense magical power. There's someone reasonably powerful nearby your child. At the very least, they wouldn't easily lose their life to demon beast attacks. Isn't that good news?"

Merlin slowly came to his senses and thought Zitiao made a fair point. At the very least, Chris wouldn't be eaten alive by demon beasts, so there was still some room to work with.

"Were those two mercenaries strong?"

"Those two mercenaries were already dead long ago. The third person near your child is someone unknown." Zitiao said with certainty.

"Huh?! A third person.... " Merlin froze mid-step.

"Look over there in the tall grass." Zitiao pointed in a direction.

Merlin walked over and observed — there, starkly revealed, was a cold corpse, none other than the skinny mercenary who refused to close his eyes in death.

"This..."

"This is one of the two mercenaries who kidnapped your daughter. Look at the knife wound on his back — he was clearly assassinated from behind. I poked my finger into the skinny mercenary's wound, scooped up a bit of congealed blood, and smelled it. "He hasn't been dead long. It seems that in this forest, companions are more dangerous than demon beasts. They turned on each other..."

"Why are you so sure?" Merlin asked in confusion.

"A mage capable of killing countless demon beasts with magic — would he really need to use a knife to ambush from behind? The one who killed the demon beasts wasn't one of the mercenaries." Zitiao paused and continued, "Besides, mercenaries gather demon beast cores for profit, which means they'd need to dissect the demon beast corpses. But these demon beasts killed by earth spikes are intact — not a single one has been carved open. If you were a mercenary, the cores from so many high-tier demon beasts would let you live in luxury for years. Would you really give them up?"

"......" Merlin lowered his head and realized it made sense. Leaving behind so many high-tier demon beast cores was totally unlike mercenaries. "So you're saying my child was taken by a third party?"

"A kidnapping? I can't confirm that, but what I can say is the other party isn't interested in these high-tier demon beast cores — the same as my goal. They came here to hunt even stronger demon beasts." Zitiao said seriously.

"I see..." Merlin looked at the sharp, towering earth spikes in front of him, his heart churning with unease, wondering if the other party was as bad as the mercenaries?

"Now there are two possibilities. First, the other party is a good person and led your child out of the Demon Beast Forest, crossing paths with us. Second, the other party is no good either — they used force to take your child and headed deeper into the forest, continuing to use your child as bait to lure out even more terrifying demon beasts..." Zitiao explained methodically, though he hadn't expected the other party to be such a terrible navigator — intending to lead Chris out of the forest but instead charging deeper and deeper into it.

"Even more terrifying demon beasts?" Merlin muttered to himself, growing worried for Chris's safety.

"Exactly." Zitiao slowly lifted his head and gazed around at the towering trees. "This forest is enormous. No one knows when or how it appeared here, continuously breeding ferocious monsters. There are many unsolved mysteries. Do you really think this forest only contains mediocre demon beasts like the ones we've seen? No. Many extremely dangerous creatures dwell in the deepest parts of the forest — places no one dares to explore lightly, places that are nearly impossible to even enter."

"Is it really that exaggerated?" Merlin was somewhat skeptical, feeling there was nowhere he couldn't go.

"It seems you still don't understand how dangerous this forest is. In the outer ring of the forest's deepest area, there is said to be a special demon beast — a human body with a ram's head, wielding a skull magic staff. Many powerful warriors have tried to kill it and claim its core to enhance their strength, but almost no one returned alive. Of those few who did barely escape, all of them went mad from mental trauma. From the intelligence I've collected, even I don't have full confidence in defeating this legendary creature." Zitiao slowly turned to look at Merlin and asked—

"And this is just a monster at the edge of the deepest part of the Demon Beast Forest. Can you imagine what lies at its very core?"

Little Johnson led the way ahead, while Chris followed closely behind with a hey-ho, hey-ho, terrified of being left behind.

The two had been walking for a long time, yet they still hadn't exited the dark forest. Instead, the surroundings had become even more dangerous, with occasional beast roars ringing out from time to time.

Chris walked in a strange posture, twisting and turning unsteadily, moving very slowly.

Little Johnson had no more patience and stopped impatiently, turning back to ask, "Can't you walk any faster? At this rate, when will we ever get out of this forest?"

"......" Chris stopped in grievance, two fingers nervously intertwining as she hid her bare little feet behind her back.

"Hmm?"

Little Johnson was puzzled, walking over before noticing that Chris had lost a shoe and had been walking barefoot the entire time.

With so many sharp branches and stones on the road, it was miraculous she could walk at all!

Chris's bare little foot was already covered in bruises and small wounds, and every step brought excruciating pain. The fact that she hadn't cried out was nothing short of a miracle.

Little Johnson looked down at the aggrieved Chris, feeling strange in his heart, and couldn't help but ask.

"Does walking barefoot hurt a lot? Why didn't you say anything?"

"......I don't want to be a burden. Mom told me to be strong..." Little Chris pursed her lips and said stubbornly in a low voice.

"That's enough." Little Johnson sighed, squatted down and said, "Get on, I'll give you a ride on my back."

"But... Mom said..." Chris hesitated, not wanting to easily accept someone else's kindness.

"I know. Miss Alice is a person of excellent character — far better than Uncle Merlin. But you also need to know how to judge situations." Little Johnson frowned and said softly, "You're walking so slowly, you're seriously slowing me down. Don't you want to leave this awful place sooner?"

"..." Chris thought for a moment, then hesitantly climbed onto Little Johnson's back, making sure to add, "Thank you, John哥哥~"

"Ugh! " Little Johnson was about to stand up and nearly stumbled to the ground, a vein pulsing on his forehead. "I'm not a brat! Just call me John..."

"Is that so? Then it's John哥哥~" Chris laughed cheerfully, her ahoge quivering lively atop her head.

"..." Little Johnson grumbled softly, his face oddly flushing red — apparently this was the first time anyone had called him older brother.

Could this really be Merlin's child?

She's so much more outgoing than him, and so sweet-talking...

John哥哥?

Not bad, hehe =)

title: Chapter 11 — Paen
content:
Chapter 11 — Paen

Volume 25 · Chapter 11

"Brother John, why did Daddy say your temper is terrible?"

"Hmph! Because your Daddy is jealous that I'm younger and more talented than he is~"

"Is that so? But Daddy says you're just an immature brat..."

"Preposterous! Your Daddy is always calling other people brats without looking at his own conduct!"

"But Daddy's right. Brother John, you don't look very smart...."

"Shut up! Look at yourself before talking about others, okay!?"

Young Johnson carried Chris on his back, advancing steadily. The two had been walking for a long time, yet they still hadn't seen the edge of the forest.

Chris kept asking him all sorts of questions along the way, as if she had many doubts in her heart, which couldn't help but make Young Johnson somewhat irritated.

Although being called "Brother John" felt quite good to him, Young Johnson simply couldn't handle a troublesome kid like this.

"Brother John, what is your dream?" Chris asked, blinking her eyes.

"Do I even need to ask? Of course it's to become the strongest adventurer in history, and make my family's name last forever!" Young Johnson said firmly and powerfully.

"But my Mommy is the strongest adventurer. Our neighbors all respect my Mommy, and she's the center of attention wherever we go. My Mommy is both beautiful and powerful—she's the most perfect Mommy in the whole world~" Chris said, her face full of pride.

"Yeah, yeah, yeah, your Mommy is the most amazing... " Young Johnson rolled his eyes. He really couldn't argue with Chris.

"I have my own dream too, which is to eat cream cake every day, hehe~" Chris showed her baby teeth, completely unable to forget about cream cake.

"Childish..." Young Johnson muttered under his breath. In his heart, however, he thought, actually I really like it too! But keeping face in front of a brat matters more.

"Brother John, why are we still unable to get out?" Chris asked curiously.

"...." A few drops of cold sweat trickled down Young Johnson's forehead. He was also quite puzzled himself—his legs felt like they were about to break, so why couldn't he leave the forest yet?

"Did Brother John get lost?" Chris looked dejected.

"Ugh!" Young Johnson was startled by the question, cold sweat dripping down his forehead. With his noble big-brother image at stake, he steeled himself and said, "Haha, don't worry. I'm a mature adult—how could I possibly get lost? Keep walking for a little longer, and we'll definitely leave this creepy place."

After calming Chris down, Young Johnson continued on his way, but the more he walked, the stranger things felt.

The surroundings were terrifyingly quiet, as if countless eyes were staring at him. His intuition told him this place was even more dangerous than before!

Young Johnson frowned tightly. Suddenly, a crisp "crack" echoed—the dark, dense forest ahead stirred with commotion.

Highly alert, young Johnson quickly hid behind a big tree with Chris, his expression grim.

"Brother John?"

"Shh!"

Something felt off, so Young Johnson immediately stopped Chris from speaking, then poked his head out to look—

What he saw made his blood run cold. A monster with a goat's head and a human's body appeared, tapping its hooves as it scanned around, a skeletal magic staff in hand, as if searching for something.

This demon beast was precisely the nightmare that had claimed many lives in legend. It dwelt deep within the forest year-round, and originally had no name. But as mercenaries passed word from mouth to mouth, it was eventually given the name "Pahn."

Only a rare few insane mercenaries had ever encountered it. Most people who dared to venture into the depths of the Demon Beast Forest had long since become bleached bones!

Every time mercenaries mentioned the name "Pahn," their faces would pale. It was said that anyone who saw it was best to give up all resistance and accept the reality of death—this would bring them less suffering.

Pahn's crimson eyes darted about frequently, a dark smoke radiating from its body as it continuously searched its surroundings. It had been attracted by Chris's scent, hungering for fresh, tender flesh.

Young Johnson took a deep breath, and a faint excitement stirred in his heart. This demon beast named "Pahn" was precisely the target he had been seeking.

According to Young Johnson's father, Pahn was capable of using magic, and its crystal core served as a powerful boost for mages—absolutely worth thirty years of arduous training!

Young Johnson had risked danger to sneak into this area in hopes of obtaining Pahn's crystal core, which would allow his strength to surge forward—so he could achieve great results in the upcoming Adventurers Guild competition!

However, Chris was here right now. Young Johnson wasn't worried about himself, but he was very concerned about her safety.

If Young Johnson went out to battle Pahn, he wouldn't have the time to look after Chris, and he wouldn't be able to protect her if anything happened.

After thinking it over, Young Johnson decided that this rare opportunity couldn't be wasted. So he whispered to Chris—

"I'm going to take out a demon beast. It's extremely dangerous here, so stay hidden and don't wander off. Understood?"

.....Chris pursed her small lips and nodded anxiously.

Young Johnson had just comforted Chris when he specially put on a white ring, waited for the perfect moment, and charged forward in a single bound.

Right off the bat, he unleashed the John family's signature fused magic. Wind-elemental and light-elemental mana rapidly merged in his hands, bursting forth with overwhelming power!

Young Johnson adopted a surprise-attack approach, aiming to catch Pahn off guard and seize the initiative. His fused magic detonated in an instant!

A狂暴 hurricane mixed with razor-sharp lightning erupted at once, producing a roar even louder than a dragon's cry!

The极速 spinning wind-and-thunder wave swept through everything in its path, uprooting nearby trees and tearing them to shreds!

The goat-headed demon beast abruptly halted its steps, yet it was too late—the roar of the wind-and-thunder wave had already surged toward it!

Unfazed, it swiftly raised the skeletal magic staff in its hand. An eerie black ripple suddenly appeared, spreading continuously from the staff's tip!

The ferocious wind-and-thunder wave crashed against the ripple as though slamming into an invisible shield!

But the fused magic was no joke to be underestimated. The wind-and-thunder wave only grew more fierce with each strike, its momentum surging even greater!

The collision of mana erupted in blazing brilliance, illuminating the dark forest like broad daylight!

"...Chris, who had been hiding behind the big tree, saw the scene unfolding before her and couldn't help but gasp in amazement.

Pahn was knocked back more than a dozen meters by the wind-and-thunder wave before finally coming to a stop. It had managed to block Young Johnson's fused magic.

As the thick smoke cleared, Pahn slowly raised its head. Its crimson eyes whirled about, sizing up this boyish human.

"It's not over yet!"

Young Johnson once again summoned his fused magic, preparing to press his advantage. However, this legendary demon beast would no longer give him the chance to launch a surprise attack!

Pahn raised its skeletal magic staff and shot forth an invisible, colorless ray of light in the blink of an eye—thin as a needle, fine as a thread, piercing directly into Young Johnson's brain!

.....Young Johnson's body stiffened, his brewing magic dissipated entirely, and his mind felt as though countless ants were tearing and biting at it. His spirit plunged into endless torment.

"Ahhh—!"

Pahn observed Young Johnson writhing in excruciating pain on the ground and let out a series of mocking laughs. "Heh heh heh..."

However, Young Johnson hadn't come unprepared. He already knew that Pahn possessed mental-attack magic.

Just then, the white ring Young Johnson had earlier put on suddenly lit up, emitting a gentle white radiance that continuously nourished and healed his damaged spirit.

This white ring was specifically crafted to defend against mental attacks. It had originally belonged to Old John, and this time, Young Johnson had stolen it specifically to hunt down Pahn!

......"No wonder everyone who's seen you has gone mad. I see now—it really is painful..." Young Johnson panted, slowly pulling himself up from the ground. He extended one finger and pointed at Pahn. "Since you enjoy torturing others so much, why don't you taste your own magic?"

Pahn hesitated for a moment, only to see an invisible, colorless ray of light shoot forth from Young Johnson's fingertip, piercing straight into the demon beast's skull!

Since Pahn was a demon beast, its magic was powerful but not particularly unique. Young Johnson was fully capable of perfectly mimicking it!

"...Gagagagaga!" Pahn's skeletal magic staff dropped to the ground. Clutching its goat head, it roared in agony, its body twisting as if suffering from epileptic seizures, foam bubbling from its mouth!

"Hmph, die!" Young Johnson waved his hand and delivered a finishing blow—a high-pressure water blade. The sharp torrent emitted a piercing shriek—

And so Pahn, this legendary demon beast, had its goat head severed clean from its body on the spot....

title: Chapter 12 — Illusion
content:
Chapter 12 — Illusion

Volume 25 · Chapter 12

Blood splattered, Paine's headless body staggered, and finally collapsed to the ground.

"The legendary demonic beast... this..."

Little Johnson smiled calmly, slowly walking forward, preparing to dig out Paine's crystal core.

However, just as he approached Paine's body, the demonic beast suddenly transformed into wisps of black smoke and vanished into thin air.

Immediately, eerie laughter echoed from all around, "Gigigigi..." sending chills down one's spine!

"Uh! An illusion!?" Little Johnson's cold sweat poured down, alert to his surroundings, the magic ring on his hand defending against mental attacks constantly emitting warm white light, resisting Paine's mental assault!

"Brother John... ..." Chris hid in the shadows, watching Little Johnson fall into a passive position, her heart couldn't help but worry.

Little Johnson knew the demonic beast "Paine" possessed mental attack abilities and was formidable, yet still fell for the opponent's illusion, having underestimated the power the demonic beast possessed.

He realized he had fallen into Paine's trap, whether the attacks coming next were illusions was hard to determine, he could only rely on his father's ring to dispel mental attacks!

"Boom" - A wave of black fog appeared out of nowhere, Paine rushed out from within, waving the skull wand in hand, using the wand as a heavy hammer to strike Little Johnson fiercely!

"Aargh!"

Little Johnson suddenly noticed, gritted his teeth, raised his hand to urgently cast a wind shield, resisting Paine's sudden attack!

Paine was originally a demonic beast that could use magic, but its physical strength was still formidable, not at all inferior to many beasts known for their powerful physiques!

The skull wand struck down like lightning, violent gusts of wind had already formed in Little John's hand, constantly repelling all attacks trying to break through the defense!

The wand struck the wind shield, making Little Johnson's whole body tremble, bones nearly shattering, he secretly marveled at Paine's physical strength, but still remained relatively calm.

Although Paine's attacks came with fierce momentum, seemingly unable to easily break through Little John's wind shield, but the reality was not so—

The black qi rising from Paine's body began to erode Little Johnson's magic through the skull wand!

The originally solid and reliable wind shield vanished in an instant, even Little Johnson's arms turned black, as if poisoned?

The ring used to defend against Paine's mental attacks also turned completely black, finally vanishing before Little Johnson's eyes...

"How could this be..." Little Johnson cold sweat dripped, looking at Paine in disbelief, the opponent not only had mental attacks, but his magic also had the power to erode others' bodies!

"Gigigigi..." Paine emitted sharp, strange laughter, like an infant crying, as if mocking Little Johnson for his ignorance!

After being eroded, Little Johnson felt half his body had no sensation, the magic within him disrupted by Paine, becoming extremely unstable, his strength plummeting.

What to do? Father's ring is broken, now facing this kind of monster, I have almost no chance of winning!

Little Johnson's heart began to think of retreating, if Paine used mental attacks again, he feared he couldn't resist.

The demonic beast Paine had already anticipated this, its scarlet eyes rolling around, raising the skull wand to shoot a colorless, invisible beam of light, not giving Little Johnson any chance.

The mental attack struck right on Little Johnson's forehead, beginning to continuously ravage and destroy his fragile spirit!

"Aaaaah!"

Little Johnson hugged his head and howled in pain, his expression fierce and twisted, "plop" knelt on the ground, trembling all over.

He experienced once again the feeling of countless ants biting his brain, the pain nearly drove this magic genius insane!

At this moment Little Johnson's brain was blank, unable to make any sound except the mournful cries of pain.

The demonic beast Paine slowly walked before Little Johnson, raising the skull wand in hand, ready to deliver a fatal blow to the foolish human who dared provoke him!

Chris, hiding in the shadows, grew anxious and couldn't help but step out, calling out loudly, "Brother John!"

Little Johnson felt his heart leap, his originally scattered consciousness awoke for a few seconds, but the pain didn't lessen at all.

Seeing Chris step out despite the danger, he was extremely anxious, shouting with all his strength—

Run! Run faster! As far as possible!

Chris was so scared she held her breath, her two short legs went weak, walking was difficult.

The demonic beast Paine saw Chris, its scarlet eyes instantly lit up, not bothering to deal with Little Johnson who was about to be tortured to death, rushing straight for Chris!

To demonic beasts, the smaller the human, the tastier, Chris at this age was a fatal attraction to them!

Paine rushed rapidly toward Chris who had no ability to resist, its gaze unashamedly showing greed and hunger, saliva flowing down its goat beard.

Chris's face turned pale, looking at the demonic claw reaching out, fear beyond thought, she instinctively screamed—

"Don't!!!"

Suddenly, Chris's small body emitted bursts of blazing light, as brilliant as the sun, unbearable to look at!

This powerful light seemed to turn the pitch-black forest into daytime, all things revived, trees and wild grass grew wildly.

"! ! ?" Paine covered its eyes, emitting a painful low roar, somewhat afraid to approach, as if the light was something sacred and inviolable.

Little Johnson also tightly closed his eyes, the light Chris emitted made him think he was almost blinded?

When he opened his eyes again, he was surprised to find the mental attack on him dispelled, and his eroded body restored to perfect condition!

Little Johnson quickly stood up, looking up at Chris, but was greatly alarmed, it was still too late to rescue Chris!

"Danger!"

Only to see the demonic beast Paine raise its skull wand, aiming at the young Chris, and smash down fiercely.

The light just now made it very disgusted, it no longer wanted to eat this child, but kill her!

Little Chris's frightened expression froze on her face, tears shining, watching the wand about to smash her dead.

In the blink of an eye—

A shadow flashed, carrying Chris away at an unbelievable speed, escaping danger.

Merlin looked at Chris in his arms, her barefoot full of wounds, his heart ached instantly.

"Chris? ! Are you alright?"

Chris thought she was dead, "but suddenly heard her father's voice, opened her eyes in surprise, smiling like a flower, "Dad"

"...." Merlin sighed in relief, seeing Chris seemed fine, couldn't help but scold, "You really don't let people worry, why do you run around everywhere? Even if you want to play, you need to tell Mom and Dad before going out!"

"...Sorry Dad, I was wrong..." Chris muttered guiltily, her two fingers tangled and poking at each other, "It's all because I was too playful, I... I was scared..."

Merlin sighed, finally finding Chris, the stone in his heart finally dropped.

He had just been about to scold her, but seeing she had suffered so much, the harsh scolding couldn't come out, only heartache remained.

"Be good from now on, don't run around anymore, heard?"

"Mmhm~" Chris obediently nodded, her tense little face as if swearing.

Seeing its prey taken, the demonic beast Paine flew into a rage, roaring, raising its wand aiming at Merlin and Chris, intending to kill them both.

"Swish" the sound of cutting through the air, a sharp shadow scythe attacked, slashing at Paine's chest.

The demonic beast Paine was greatly surprised, quickly backing away to dodge, but its chest was still slashed by the shadow scythe!

Qikatilo slowly walked out from behind Merlin, fingers moving slightly, the shadow scythe following like a shadow, his gaze turned sharp—

"Found you, Paine....."

title: Chapter 13 — Paen's Illusion Magic
content:
Chapter 13 — Paen's Illusion Magic

Volume 25 · Chapter 13

The demon beast Paen retreated rapidly, seemingly feeling immense pressure from Qikatile.

Paen touched the black blood seeping from his chest, his gaze angrily fixed on Qikatile.

Indeed, Paen was highly vigilant toward enemies who could harm him; Qikatile's threat to her was far greater than little Johnson's.

Qikatile walked at a leisurely pace to little Johnson's side; coincidentally, his target this trip was also hunting the demon beast Paen.

The crystal core of a magic-using demon beast— for any mage, it held incomparable allure...

Qikatile had been eyeing Paen for a long time; with the Adventurer Competition approaching, it made him decide to obtain Paen's crystal core to defeat all rivals at the tournament.

"Qikatile!?" Little Johnson seemed to recognize this half-elf adventurer and was visibly startled!

"Oh? The self-proclaimed magical genius brat? So you're here too?" Qikatile stopped, speaking with a lukewarm attitude.

"You bastard, don't call me brat!" Little Johnson's forehead veins throbbed with anger; obviously he had no liking for Qikatile. "What are you doing here?!"

"Doing what?" Qikatile cracked his fingers like warming up. "Of course hunting Paen, getting the demon beast crystal core."

"You don't get to interfere! This prey is mine!" Little Johnson said hastily.

"... " Qikatile sneered, speaking with a teasing tone. "With your strength you can't beat this monster—better leave it to me. Although you found it first, regrettably, the prey belongs to me."

"You wish!" Little Johnson's gaze turned sharp, golden magic flickering in his palm.

"Fine, how about a contest? Whoever kills Paen gets the crystal core. If you win, I won't lay claim to it—admit you're outmatched, how about that?" Qikatile said meaningfully.

"Hmph! Just what I wanted! Don't regret it later!" Little Johnson mobilized two-element magic, preparing to take down Paen.

Toward Little Johnson's arrogance, Qikatile said nothing; the shadow scythe behind him began spinning rapidly.

"Dad, who's the person next to John哥哥?" Chris, held in Merlin's arms, couldn't help asking curiously.

"That... a fellow traveler I happened to meet."

Merlin explained. He'd wanted to say something derogatory, but thinking the person accompanied him to find Chris, they weren't a bad person. Though their strength was far below his ten-thousandth part, he'd still give face.

Little Johnson and Qikatile faced the demon beast Paen together, two against one; Paen's disadvantage seemed obvious.

But Paen was a demon beast that made countless mercenaries flee in terror—how could he die from just two adventurers besieging him?

Seeing Paen erupt into rage, he let out a roar at the two, raised his skeletal staff, mumbling incomprehensible words.

Neither Johnson nor Qikatile were fools; seeing Paen seemed to be brewing magic, they launched attacks lightning-fast—

Under Qikatile's control, the shadow scythe swung, instantly firing razor-sharp black blades, howling fiercely, slashing toward Paen.

Little Johnson didn't fall behind either, fusing fire and earth dual-attribute magic, unleashing scorching lava bombs; surrounding vegetation in the intense heat could be seen turning to ash!

Though both were Saint-tier powerhouses, Qikatile's danger was clearly greater, already at Saint-tier peak, only half a step from entering a new realm!

The attacks of the two Saint-tier powerhouses came upon Paen, who didn't panic at all, suddenly opening his huge mouth and roaring—

"Mee mee mee!!!"

The skeletal staff in Paen's hand; massive black smoke surged upward, like opening a dam, surging toward both.

The light blades of the shadow scythe and the scorching lava dissipated at a visible speed upon contact with the smoke Paen emitted.

"What?!" Qikatile was stunned, never expecting magic to be nullified by a demon beast—this was the first time he'd seen it.

"I advise you to be careful. This thing has the power to erode magic. Underestimating it will cost you." Little Johnson said with a mocking tone.

The smoke Paen released surged rapidly; within the range enveloped by smoke, both their magic began to go chaotic, accompanied by intense headaches.

"Damn! Here it comes again!"

Little Johnson covered his head, gritting his teeth to endure it; the exposed skin already showed black spots—Paen's eroding power was indeed hard to resist.

Not sure if it was because they were two, but Paen's mental attack seemed weaker than at first.

Little Johnson curiously looked at Qikatile, finding this guy standing in the smoke as if nothing happened?

"Hey! Doesn't your head hurt?"

"Sorry, I have half dark elf blood, affinity for dark element magic, so my resistance is high." Qikatile waved his hand, walking toward Paen. "Looks like you can't hold out much longer, so I'll take Paen's crystal core..."

"Dream on!" Little Johnson gritted his teeth, dragging his eroded body, rushing toward Paen following behind.

Paen watched the two adventurers charge, standing still, raising his staff to slam the ground hard.

Both felt a mental impact at the same time, their bodies straightening, seemingly losing consciousness for a moment.

"What just happened?" Qikatile puzzled, looking at his own hands.

"Dunno, maybe some kind of mental attack, but it doesn't seem to have any effect?" Little Johnson muttered curiously.

"It's... mocking us..." Qikatile narrowed his eyes, enraged by Paen. The shadow scythe in his hand rapidly grew larger, wildly slashing toward Paen.

"Ahh!" Little Johnson puffed his cheeks, using fusion magic again, bombarding Paen fiercely.

The two fought Paen until sky and earth darkened, the battle extraordinarily intense.

However, from the very beginning, Johnson and Qikatile had fallen under Paen's illusion.

From Merlin's perspective, they fought fiercely in their dreams, but in reality stood still in place for a long time, motionless.

Johnson and Qikatile, their eyes lifeless like soulless puppets, fought Paen fiercely in their environment.

Unbeknownst to them, Paen stood far away, looking at the two ignorant humans with what eyes, emitting mocking laughter.

"Gahahaha..."

Even little Chris fell for it, curling in Merlin's arms, biting her fingers, drool soaking the shirt on her dad's chest.

Presumably this little brat in the illusion didn't see anything terrifying, but rather countless cream cakes, eating happily.

The only one unaffected in the entire arena was Merlin, who had magic immunity; clearly Paen's spiritual magic hadn't reached the level of Divine Power.

Merlin looked at the sleeping Chris in his arms, raised his head to tap the distant Paen, his lips curling upward—

"Illusion? Spiritual magic..."

"I see, it's very similar to Asmodeus's power."

"But the power difference is too far..."

title: Chapter 14 — Too Strong (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 14 — Too Strong (Extra Chapter)

Volume 25 · Chapter 14

Little Johnson and Chikatilo stood frozen in place like wooden puppets, their eyes empty and vacant.

Inside the illusion, they had fought the demonic beast Penn for three hundred rounds, never realizing they had long since become the beast's plaything.

To others, Penn was an extremely powerful demonic beast, with strength at the early stage of the Sect Realm, enough to crush many strong warriors. It was an easy matter to deal with Little Johnson and Chakatilo, and it even had the energy to toy with them?

Its proud mental attack seemed pitifully inadequate in Merlin's eyes, comparable to a street performer with only rudimentary skills.

Merlin understood some of Asmodeus's power—it was not only mysterious but also exceptionally tenacious. Even he would need to be careful when dealing with Asmodeus.

Spiritual magic that forced people into illusions and drove them to painful madness was merely a low-level ability.

Asmodeus could kill without pain, imprison souls forever within illusions, and even turn enemies into obedient puppets?

The demonic beast Penn approached Chikatilo and tapped his head three times with its wand, then came before Little Johnson and licked his face with its tongue.

It was toying with the two in the posture of a victor. In its eyes, these two were no different from the dead once ensnared by its illusion—subject to its whims at will.

"Kekeke~"

Penn had been obsessing over Chris's tender flesh, so it approached Merlin without guard, its gaze fixed on Chris, who was also under the illusion, in Merlin's arms.

Merlin felt a strong stench hit him, instinctively frowning as he couldn't help but look up at the demonic beast Penn.

A ram-headed human body, the lower half covered in black fur, two sturdy hooves, its massive shadow笼罩ing over Merlin's head.

Overcome with hunger, it extended its demonic claw toward Chris in Merlin's arms, planning to feast on the delicious baby first, then devour the rest of them.

Merlin stood quietly, looking at Penn with pity, which caused Penn to assume the blond man before it was also under the illusion, completely unaware of what was happening?

Merlin smiled, suddenly reaching out to block Penn's demonic claw. "What do you think you're doing? Don't tell me you believe that inferior mental magic works on me?"

"?!?" Penn clearly froze for a moment, its gaze at Merlin filled with disbelief, seeming unable to understand why someone under its illusion could still speak?

The demonic beast Penn flew backward like a cannonball, violently scraping against the earth, kicking up clouds of dust, and crashed through a dozen large trees before finally stopping.

Penn dragged its bruised and battered body to its feet unsteadily, a trace of fear revealing itself in its eyes. It never expected that the weakest of humans would be the most terrifying!

"The legendary demonic beast? Hmph, an ant...." Merlin raised his palm, then suddenly brought it down, drawing upon the power of the Earth Spirit to release a gravity space one hundred times stronger.

"Arrghhh! ! !" Penn cried out in agony, suddenly feeling an incredibly terrifying pressure, as if Mount Tai were pressing down upon it, flattening its entire body against the ground. Cracks spread across the earth in all directions.

Although both were demonic beasts, the power of the Earth Spirit was more than enough to crush Penn countless times over. The gap in strength was enormous.

Because Penn had suffered heavy damage, the illusion cast upon Little Johnson and Chikatilo directly shattered, freeing them from the dream state.

Penn coughed up a mouthful of blood. Its bones were uncountable, broken from head to toe. Directly beaten into critical condition by Merlin, it barely managed to rise again, wanting to flee?

"Damn it! I was under an illusion just now?! I wondered why this monster couldn't be killed!" Little Johnson felt a wave of emotion after waking up, still somewhat confused about the situation.

Just as Little Johnson was looking completely bewildered, Chikatilo had already noticed the demonic beast Penn's extremely weak condition, so without a second word, he rushed forward at incredible speed.

Chikatilo, though a magician, moved at a truly absurd pace. In the blink of an eye, he was before the demonic beast Penn and split it cleanly in two with a single scythe strike!

The demonic beast Penn was already critically wounded, and Chikatilo delivered the finishing blow. Its eyes filled with unwillingness, blood splattered everywhere, and its two halves fell to the ground, twitching a few times before going still.

Chikatilo patted the demonic beast's corpse, pulled out a crystal radiating a black glow, and surprisingly showed a hint of joy as he placed the demonic beast core into his own coat.

This trip, Chikatilo had made a great harvest, obtaining what he needed. Once he took this core, his strength would increase dramatically when the Adventurer Competition opened!

But Little Johnson was in an awkward position. He had been working for so long and gained nothing, a perfect wage slave. Seeing Chikatilo pocket the demonic beast while he wasn't looking, anger welled up within him.

"Hey! You're so despicable!"

"Despicable?" Chikatilo looked at Little Johnson and said expressionlessly, "I defeated Penn first, so the core belongs to me. What's the problem?"

"You!? We should have worked together and cooperated faster!" Little Johnson gnashed his teeth in anger.

"....." Chikatilo gave a dry laugh and said sarcastically, "You really are an immature brat, aren't you? This isn't a competition. Who follows your rules?"

"I don't care! Hand over the core, and let's duel!" Little Johnson said with a serious expression, unconvinced.

"....." Chikatilo shook his head and said with contempt, "It seems you're just an empty-named kid. A magic genius? How laughable. If being able to control multiple magical elements makes one a genius, then that title is far too inflated. I advise you to stop chasing empty fame and keep your feet on the ground."

"You think you're so great? Come on! Let's compete!" Little Johnson pressed on relentlessly.

Chikatilo smiled and shook his head, turning to leave alone. When he passed by Penn's corpse, he paused for a moment—

"The legendary demonic beast, its strength is nothing special. Could it be that I'm too strong?"

In Chikatilo's eyes, Merlin was like air—impossible to provide any help in battle.

Chikatilo believed the demonic beast had used illusion on both of them, exhausting its magic power, which was why it entered such a weakened state.

Little Johnson turned around suspiciously, looking at Merlin holding Chris, as if considering some possibility.

Though both had been deeply trapped in the illusion and didn't know what happened outside, Chikatilo certainly didn't know Merlin's strength. But Little Johnson knew!

Little Johnson intuitively felt that under illusion, without external interference, it would be very difficult to break free from the重重 illusions. Perhaps Merlin had done something just now?

Little Johnson had fought the demonic beast Penn and knew it wasn't so easily dealt with. Why was it defeated so simply by Chikatilo? He found this very strange.

Little Chris in Merlin's arms slowly woke up, rubbed her eyes, wiped away her drool, and her ahoge perked up cheerfully—

Chris: "Daddy! Daddy! I dreamed about so many cream cakes spinning around me, and they were so delicious! I wanted to bring some back for mom and dad to eat, but I could never catch them?"

Merlin: "Is that so? You girl shouldn't always be thinking about eating. Try to be a little more alert in dangerous situations. Do you expect daddy to protect you forever?"

Chris: "Hiii~"

Actually, every time I'm about to finish, I get rushed, and then there are more typos, especially when I'm赶ing.

I'm also quite troubled by typos, but there's nothing I can do.

On the site's author backend, authors have no permission to modify the original text—not a single character. Even non-VIP chapter modifications require several days.

For VIP chapters, each typo correction requires poking the editor. Editors are human, not machines, and rest on weekends.

There are fewer than ten editors on the site, and each editor handles at least hundreds of authors.

Just imagine, hundreds of authors pester one editor to fix typos, not just once—anyone would lose their mind.

I want to fix them too, but I have no choice. Every time I modify my own typos in the comments, it's a helpless measure.

I see many people think fixing typos is easy, just move your hands?

On the site's backend, to change a single character, I have to poke the editor and consider whether they're busy, whether they have time, whether they're on vacation, whether they've clocked out, and other factors = cried.

title: Chapter 15 — Looping Secret Realm
content:
Chapter 15 — Looping Secret Realm

Volume 25 · Chapter 15

Zikatiro withdrew his gaze, no longer looking at the demon beast Pahn's corpse, turned his back on Little Johnson, and said indifferently, "Goodbye. Next time we meet... maybe on the arena platform, I look forward to your performance as a magic genius."

"Are you provoking me? Pointy-eared bastard!" Little Johnson glared angrily.

Zikatiro smiled but ignored Little Johnson's anger, leaving alone and disappearing into the night.

"Come back! Let's duel!"

Little Johnson shouted loudly, gritting his teeth and clenching his fists; this time's results were all taken by Zikatiro.

He was very annoyed in his heart but helpless; after all, he had naively thought the gambling was fair --

Zikatiro...

You wait for me, I've noted today's matter.

When the Adventurer's Competitive Tournament comes, I will definitely beat you to pieces!

Little Johnson secretly swore in his heart that he would defeat Zikatiro in the upcoming tournament soon, making him lose face.

"Having your stuff stolen by someone else, you really are useless..." Merlin walked over holding Chris, unable to help but mock this naive guy.

"Shut up! It's all because that bastard is too cunning! Despicable adult! I must let him know my power!" Little Johnson argued.

Merlin's face turned black, frowned, and thought, because he is immature, so he blames others for being too cunning? What an unreasonable brat~

Merlin unexpectedly discovered that these two little guys had a good relationship; Chris kept calling him "Brother John," like a little sister several years older.

However, after thinking for a moment, Merlin relaxed; after all, during the time he wasn't by her side, it was Little Johnson protecting Chris, so the little girl must already trust this big brother very much.

"John, thank you for taking care of Chris..."

"Hmph! It's no big deal, after all, you're unreliable, Uncle," Little Johnson said with his nose in the air.

"..." Merlin clicked his tongue, thinking this brat couldn't be praised; the moment he is praised, he would float away.

"By the way just now... did Uncle step in? That demon beast was hard to deal with, it was impossible for Zikatiro to kill it so easily." Little Johnson asked curiously.

"Yes, I just gave that monster a little lesson." Merlin said indifferently.

"I knew it! Zikatiro isn't necessarily much stronger than me, how could he possibly kill Pahn? Sure enough, Uncle stepped in when we fell into the illusion." Little Johnson sighed, looked up and said seriously, "Uncle really meddles too much. If you hadn't intervened, the crystal core might have been mine. Thinking back now, I'm not happy about Zikatiro's smug look!"

... Merlin chuckled dryly and continued, "If I hadn't stepped in, the two of you wouldn't even know how you died.

"It seems Brother John wants to become the strongest adventurer, not only to defeat my mom, but even my dad can't beat... Chris said a big truth with a harmless smile.

"That's right, my Chris has learned to read the room~" Merlin stroked Chris's little head.

"..." Who said I can't beat your dad?!" Little Johnson's face turned red, lacking confidence, but forced himself to say, "I am a magic genius, I am young, as long as I cultivate diligently, sooner or later I can become the strongest adventurer!"

"Brother John turns red when bragging, just like when we got lost just now..." Chris said with a complex expression.

"...I won't stoop to the level of a brat like you! Goodbye! Hmph!" Little Johnson turned and walked east, not forgetting to provoke as he looked back, "I advise you, Uncle, it's better not to be so leisurely. The Adventurer's Competitive Tournament has strong people like clouds, don't get eliminated in the preliminary rounds, otherwise I won't be able to defeat you..."

Merlin: "Then... if you want to leave this forest and go south, you are going the wrong way."

Chris: "Go south~"

Little Johnson froze all over, face flushed red, turned his head and walked south in big strides --

"I know, I don't need you to tell me!"

"I just like taking the long way to exercise my body, is that not okay!?"

After Little Johnson left, Merlin calmed down. The Adventurer's Competitive Tournament has strong people like clouds? That really should be looked forward to.

He has always been active in Lexham, so regarding the strength level of adventurers in the whole world, it is temporarily unclear.

If there really are people who are overly strong, Merlin is actually quite looking forward to it, being able to see the strength of the elites among humans.

Merlin looked around, recalling what Zikatiro said, and was full of curiosity about the depths of the demon beast forest.

This mysterious forest, unknown when it existed, gave birth to a large number of demon beasts, maybe there are unknown secrets within?

After thinking for a moment, Merlin said to Chris, "Do you want to go to the very depths of the forest and take a look?"

"But... Chris was still traumatized and didn't want to see any scary monsters.

"It's okay, with Dad here, any monster can be defeated. Maybe there are many fun things in the very depths of the forest?" Merlin coaxed her:

"Mm!" Little Chris's eyes lit up, curiosity overflowing.

Merlin held Chris, carefully continued to go deep into the demon beast forest, and soon arrived at the very depths.

However, there was nothing particularly strange to see, only the trees were denser, and the dense jungle made it hard for light to fall down.

Only a weird mountain appeared, with strange rocks, and no grass or trees grew on it.

In this dense forest, the appearance of this bare barren mountain looked particularly abrupt.

A black cave appeared in front of the two of them, seeing clearly where it leads, it was pitch black and pitch dark.

"Dad, I feel a bit scared, I don't like here... Little Chris seemed to sense something? An instinctive rejection of this place

"Don't be afraid, Dad is here, there will be no danger." Merlin comforted Little Chris.

Merlin held Little Chris and entered the cave, alerting his surroundings, it was too dark here to see far away, only the sound of dripping water sounded from time to time.

Not knowing how long they walked, Merlin walked out from the cave exit, the cave connected to the entire big mountain, outside was still the dense forest.

Merlin felt this barren mountain was inexplicable, besides the tunnel-like cave there were no other weird things? He didn't feel any danger at all, only Chris felt uneasy.

Zikatiro wouldn't be exaggerating, right? There really isn't any danger..

Merlin continued to go deep, passing through the dense forest, until he saw the corpse of the demon beast Pahn, and the mess all around.

"Dad? How did we come back again?"

Merlin realized the weirdness of this forest, to verify his conjecture, he continuously tried to enter the forest's very depths three times.

Every time it was seeing the barren mountain, passing through the cave, seeing the dead demon beast Pahn's corpse....

In the dark, there is an invisible mysterious force controlling the entire forest, preventing anyone from entering the forest's depths, eventually everyone will return to the starting point, like an unwalkable maze.

"Dad?" Chris looked at Merlin curiously, thinking Dad got lost just like Brother John?

Hah, so that's how it is.... Merlin laughed, having some discovery-

"This forest..."

"It really is magical.

"What secret is it hiding?

title: Chapter 16 — Mother's Dignity
content:
Chapter 16 — Mother's Dignity

Volume 25 · Chapter 16

Since little Chris resisted going deep into the Magic Beast Forest, Merlin didn't investigate further despite finding the forest very mysterious. He only realized that the forest's mysterious power was strong; no matter how he tried to force his way into the forest's core, he would return to the starting point.

But Merlin was magic-immune; illusions meant to deceive others wouldn't work on him. A place that even stopped him, seeming to hide some secret.

A few days later, Merlin returned to Reksham with his cute daughter. He held Chris and stood at the door, hesitating.

It had already been several days; what would Alice's reaction be when she saw Chris?

And...

Hearing what Shirley said, Chris was born from the fusion of our blood, having our two bloodlines.

In a sense, Chris isn't a found child, but our own daughter!

How... should I tell Alice about this? Even normal people would find it hard to accept...

Merlin's mind was in a mess. He felt he and Alice were just cohabiting, and suddenly there was a daughter with blood ties—no matter how you think about it, it's a ridiculous thing.

"Daddy? Why don't you knock? I want Mommy."

Chris said in a milky voice.

"Oh..." Merlin woke up from his daze, carrying a hesitant heart, hard-knocking on the door, thinking step by step—looking for an opportunity to talk to Alice about this.

Knock knock knock—

The door opened. Alice's mental state seemed poor; she was staring, and her dark circles made her look very tired.

These past few days, Alice had been on edge. She had already written to her teacher Claudia, but she was still worried the teacher might suddenly show up.

Although Alice didn't dislike her teacher, the torture she endured during her childhood training was still vivid in her memory.

So these past few days, Alice hadn't been eating or sleeping well. She wasn't just worried about Chris's condition, but also feared the teacher would suddenly disrupt her life.

"..." Merlin was startled by Alice's exhausted state. Thinking that it had only been a few days since he last saw Chris, was she really worried to this extent?

Seeing Alice's face, Merlin felt familiar; her heart had no fluctuation at all, even lazy to speak.

But seeing Chris blinking big eyes in Merlin's arms, Alice's fatigue instantly vanished, and she happily pulled Chris over.

"Chris!"

"Mommy!"

Alice held little Chris; after so many days, she finally saw this little guy return. Every night she worried whether she had eaten enough or worn enough.

Merlin quietly watched the mother and daughter being affectionate together; he didn't interrupt. He suddenly felt his efforts were worth the trouble of bringing Chris back; wasn't it just to see them both doing well?

"Mommy, I really miss you; it's not fun outside at all." Chris lifted her small face, looking wronged.

"Silly child, Mommy also misses you, let me kiss you~" Alice gently kissed Chris's cheek.

"It's so itchy, Mommy~" Chris shrank her neck, laughing.

"..." Merlin dryly coughed, opening his mouth, "I brought Chris back, why don't you welcome me—?"

"Hmm?" Alice glanced at Merlin, emotionlessly saying, "Is that so? Welcome back..."

"Really dismissive..." Merlin's eyebrows twitched.

"..." Alice's face turned red; she hesitated and muttered, "You worked hard, of course even if you don't go, I would bring her back myself, hum~"

"Oh? You mean I'm meddling too much?" Merlin frowned, then sighed, "Forget it, I'm too lazy to bother with you, Alice. I have something very important to tell you."

"Hmm? What important thing could you have? Wait until I and Chris get close enough to say." Alice bumped Chris's forehead with her forehead, smiling, "Does Daddy have anything important to say? Right, Chris?"

"Wah~ Mm" Chris pouted and kissed Alice's cheek; the tuft of hair on her head swayed. For returning home, this little guy seemed especially happy.

"Alice..." Merlin's expression turned serious, speaking in a low voice, "Is it really something important? You must listen..."

"..." Alice looked at Merlin, feeling his serious expression wasn't a joke, and immediately became serious herself.

"Come in."

"If it's something very important, let's discuss it together...."

However, after Alice entered, her attention was fully on Chris.

Because Merlin, as a father, was very careless; on the way, Chris was exhausted, and her body was dirty.

How can a cute little girl be in this state?

Alice felt more and more that Merlin as a father was unreliable, careless, so as soon as she entered the house, she pulled Chris into the bathroom to wash this little kitty white.

"..." Merlin sat on the sofa, taking a deep breath. Originally planning to tell Alice about Chris's origins alone, but since that's the case, he could only find an opportunity. Indeed, it was more important to settle Chris down quickly. Water sounds could be heard from the bathroom; through the foggy glass, one could vaguely see the shadows of the mother and daughter. Alice was squatting on the bathroom floor, carefully wiping Chris's body. In the steam-filled bathroom, could one hear the mother and daughter's chatting voices? A bit of Chris: "Mommy, touching here is so itchy~" Alice: "Endure it, endure it, to be a person you must be strong, what would you do with this look, Chris?" "Good... Mommy, why don't you have Dad's big chest muscles? Dad's chest muscles are hard and warm..." Alice: "Ugh! Hush! Speak quietly, you're just a child, don't ask such random things, Chris." "But I'm curious~" Alice: "This... your dad's chest muscles were swollen after being hit." Chris: "Really?"

Alice: "Right! And normal girls are the same figure as Mommy; in the future you'll be like me, understand, Chris?" "Why does Chris feel a bit of malice? I saw many sisters after going out, clearly their chest muscles are bigger than Mommy's..." Alice: "Children shouldn't think too much! Chest muscles big... are all beaten hard, the bigger it is proves being beaten more, otherwise how could it swell like that?" Chris: "Mommy, listen, it's so scary..."

...." Merlin frowned and said nothing; dense black lines had already fallen on his forehead, feeling the conversation in the bathroom was unbearable. My god! What kind of things is Alice teaching Chris?! To protect her dignity as a mother, she's willing to distort Chris's worldview?! Malicious! More malicious than a demon! Please be a person! If Chris grows up to be as barren as Alice, that would be a real tragedy?!
