title: Chapter 17 — Our Daughter
content:
Chapter 17 — Our Daughter

Volume 25 · Chapter 17

Merlin couldn't help but ponder, thinking that under Alice's education, Chris might be educated into a strange person?

However, after thinking carefully, Chris inherited the blood of both himself and Alice, so in the future, his figure might end up as barren as his mother's.

What if he realizes that Chris realizes he is different from others, and starts "banging his head against the wall" to constantly torment himself?

Merlin's face darkened, thinking that Alice, as a mother, was very unreliable, and his responsibility on his shoulders was heavy. Creak -

The bathroom door opened, and little Chris ran out bouncing about, his whole body covered in foam, his bare buttocks exposed.

"Daddy! Daddy! Look quickly!"

"Ugh!" Merlin's expression was awkward, thinking how this child could run around without clothes? I'm so embarrassed!

"Daddy look!" Little Chris held foam in his hand, and with a sudden hammer motion, blew foam all over Merlin's face, "Daddy fun?"

Merlin showed an old father's smile, being covered in foam by his daughter didn't make him angry, but instead thought, this girl is truly cute in her naivety.

"Chris! Don't run around without clothes! Come back!" Alice hurried out of the bathroom, but forgot to put on clothes herself, her beautiful figure exposed nakedly.

"! ! !" Merlin's expression immediately became unnatural, his eyes uncontrollably scanning the naked Alice.

Four eyes met, - - for a moment at a loss for words, although there was spring everywhere in the room, the awkward atmosphere was unbearable.

Merlin had a ghost in his heart, directly forcing his gaze away, his old face strangely flushed, embarrassed and not knowing what to say?

Alice's face also quickly flushed, and subconsciously let out a cry of surprise, hiding back into the bathroom, feeling she had no face to see people.

However, Alice's heart was extremely powerful, and soon after wrapping herself in a bath towel inside, she rushed out with a kick -

"You this unscrupulous fellow! Don't stare at Chris's naked body with lecherous eyes!

". Puff!

Merlin was kicked in the face by Alice's foot, his whole body flipped off the sofa.

He lay on the ground, his face printed with Alice's footprint, all five toes clearly visible!

Merlin felt he was very unlucky, he wasn't a ghost father, who would stare lecherously at his own daughter?

"You this bastard

"Aiya?" Little Chris was very puzzled, looking at the angry mom, then at the unfortunate dad, and then took off the small yellow duck on his head and squeezed it.

"Gagaga~"

The sun had just set. Since he hadn't seen Alice for a long time, Chris had a lot of things he wanted to tell mom.

So Chris climbed into his small basket, continuously narrating things along the way, like a small spy, reporting small reports to mom?

Not knowing if it was the journey that tired him, Chris was already a bit tired, showing some fatigue, but still talked nonstop.

Chris: "Mom, there was a grumpy elf grandfather, it was bad, but those elf sisters were very good to me, especially Shirley sister, she told me many stories I've never heard before."

Alice: "Is that right? Shirley also lived here before, and she has a good relationship with mom."

Chris: "So that's how it is! But Shirley sister seems to like Daddy like Mom does? When she was leaving, she transmitted emotions with Daddy through her eyes~"

Merlin, who was sitting on the sofa pretending to be deep, was suddenly scared stiff, thinking Alice just liked to think wildly, this child shouldn't talk randomly! Otherwise we'll have another argument.

Sure enough, after Alice heard it, she started to doubt and suspect, her expression strange as she turned to stare at Merlin, feeling that she and Shirley had a good relationship but didn't see her and Merlin sparking? But the owner of the secret hut was more dangerous!

Chris: "And John brother! When John brother left, he also transmitted emotions with Daddy, it's so strange."

Alice: "John brother?"

Merlin: "Just that little Johnson, a magic genius, with a very arrogant temper, the one we stayed at his house for a few days."

"Oh~, him~" Alice secretly breathed a sigh of relief, apparently Chris didn't understand the meaning of transmitting emotions, mistaking Shirley and little Johnson's admiring glances at Merlin, "How did he suddenly appear?"

"Encountered it by chance. My daughter and I passed by a small town near the Magic Beast Forest, and we just ran into him. He was preparing for the Adventurers' Guild competition, wanting to get a magic beast core to increase his strength." Merlin simply explained.

"Is that so? Let me calculate the time, the Adventurers' Guild competition is indeed about to start," Alice nodded, seeming to have forgotten this matter if Merlin hadn't brought it up.

"It's all my fault for being playful and not listening to Daddy, resulting in meeting Wari, and seeing many terrible large monsters in the forest, and meeting John brother~" Chris said in a childish voice.

"What's going on?" Alice frowned, feeling Merlin's journey wasn't smooth sailing.

"Alice was abducted by two mercenaries at a tavern to the Magic Beast Forest, I expended a lot of effort to find her. If she hadn't met Johnson in the forest, I'm afraid the situation would have been very bad." Merlin said seriously, looking back at it still a bit frightening, his only flesh and blood might have been lost.

"Such a thing? Why didn't you take good care of her?" Alice's tone had a hint of complaint, thinking protecting a child with Merlin's strength should be very simple.

"Merlin wanted to say something but stopped, not knowing how to explain, he indeed had responsibility.

"Mom don't blame Daddy, it's all Chris's fault, I should have listened to Daddy well, otherwise I wouldn't have met bad people." Little Chris didn't want to see Daddy and Mommy argue, his tone full of plea.

"Don't run around know? Daddy and Mommy won't harm you." Alice stroked Chris's hair, recalling the small wound on her foot, she had originally thought it was unintentional, but now it seemed not as simple as she thought, "John Daddy and Mommy will find an opportunity to thank him properly.

"Um! John brother is a very ambitious person, hoping he can realize his dream, Chris視福

Chris was saying something and suddenly fell asleep, uniform breathing sounds came out, muttering in his sleep words that couldn't be understood, apparently really tired.

Merlin secretly glanced over, tentatively asking Alice, "Asleep?"

"Asleep." Alice let out a sigh of relief, covering Chris with a small blanket, "That... you worked hard on the road, it shouldn't have been easy, right?"

"Yeah, very not easy, I have no experience taking care of children, if you were there maybe it would be better." Merlin finally could relax, lazily sitting on the sofa.

"That's for sure, you have no talent for being a father, I'm much better, experienced Alice said without modesty.

"Experienced?" Merlin furrowed his brow, feeling Alice was blowing cow?

"I lived in the Great Snow Mountain when I was young, there were often blizzards there, caravans would come to my teacher's residence to avoid the cold, occasionally there would be mothers with infants in the team, all of which I helped take care of." Alice said softly.

"Compared to that— it's really powerful. Merlin said shamefacedly, he had never touched infants in his life, because he was afraid of trouble, of course if it was his own child, maybe there would be a change.

"This operation wasn't discovered by the elf race, right?" Alice asked worriedly.

"Discovered." Merlin answered seriously.

"Ah! ?" Alice frowned, looking at Chris and said, "You said you would be very careful? I originally thought I could let Chris secretly live by our side, now what to do? Is it necessary to go to war with the elves? I should have a hard time dealing with an entire elf race, your

"No life of hiding and hiding." Merlin paused, looking into Alice's eyes, speaking with a very serious tone—

"Alice, little Chris she

"Is our daughter."

title: Chapter 18 — Complex Relationships (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 18 — Complex Relationships (Bonus)

Volume 25 · Chapter 18

“? ? ?” Alice froze, her expression puzzled as she asked, “What did you just say?”
“That cough cough!” Merlin coughed twice to hide his embarrassment, wanting to tell Alice this, under great pressure, “I said Chris is our child.”
“Is that so, I see.” Alice showed a relieved expression, as if she had known all along?
“Ah? What kind of reaction is this? Aren’t you surprised at all?” Merlin’s mind full of question marks, finding it strange, Alice’s reaction abnormal.
Alice lifted her head to look at Merlin, showing a relieved expression, “Are you expressing your attitude? Even if Chris was picked up, you’d still treat her like parents.”
“? ? ?” Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking whether his expression wasn’t accurate enough?
“I understand, being able to say this startled me, you having this attitude, I’m already… Alice looked at the basket with Chris, thinking about how to handle this; the worst case would be a clash with the elves.”
“Wait, Alice! You didn’t understand my meaning?” Merlin gestured for Alice to stop, then explained in detail, “Chris isn’t just a picked‑up child; she’s our daughter who inherited our bloodline! Do you really not get it? Still can’t understand?”
Alice’s expression froze on her face, she stayed dazed for three full seconds, then exclaimed, “Eh? ! !”
“Shh! Keep it down, is it really that surprising?” Merlin immediately made a hushing gesture.
“You’re not talking nonsense, are you? Chris inherited our bloodline?” Alice looked anything but calm, biting her fingers for fear of shouting out.
“No, Shirley told me personally before she left, and do you remember at the gate of the United Kingdom’s secret realm? We two dripped our blood onto a strange stone.” Merlin paused, trying to keep it simple, “After our blood merged in the stone, Chris was born, so she and we share an inseparable blood relation, she is our two…”
“Alice turned her head to look at the sleeping Chris, her heart unable to calm, “I need to calm down a bit.”
“Actually, hearing this shocked me just as much as you, and I even felt… Merlin lowered his head; Alice’s reaction was exactly as he expected.
Alice leaned over the small basket, quietly watching Chris’s sleeping face, muttering nonstop, not knowing what else to say in her sleep talk.
No way? It’s just like Vi dreaming, 2 2.
This child isn’t anyone else’s; it’s mine and Merlin’s? ! !
No wonder it mysteriously “flew to our side, and looks so much like us, almost causing a misunderstanding.
If nobody had told us, we’d probably never know the truth and would think Chris was a foundling.
This child came a bit too suddenly, huh? Me and Merlin
Alice’s face turned red, her emotions extremely complex, hard to express her current feelings—joy, confusion, shock, etc., all mixed together.
Merlin saw Alice slightly ease up, couldn’t help but probe, “Alice, what do you think?”
“What do you think?” Alice lowered her head; she, who is usually straightforward, actually hesitated, “Of course, to raise her well, after all I have the duty of a mother, but I’m still a bit dazed, feeling all this isn’t quite real.”
“Yeah, it’s really unreal. To be honest, I never imagined I’d become a dad one day.” Merlin’s emotions grew a bit excited, covering his face as he spoke, tangled, “I thought I’d always be a free person, never expected things to turn out like this—how did we get this kid? Good heavens, I’m completely unprepared, this joke went too far.”
“Huh?” Alice furrowed her brows, seeing Merlin look like he was suffering, her heart feeling uneasy, so she asked, “Then… what are you thinking?”
“Merlin took a deep breath, looking at the basket with Chris, after a moment of lost in thought he said, “I have no experience as a father, I’m afraid…”
“Being wishy‑washy really isn’t like you? I also have no experience as a mother, after all this is all a first‑time thing—who would have experience?” Alice frowned, thinking that Merlin, who usually fears nothing heaven or earth, has become so weak over this.
Actually Merlin is showing this expression because his sense of responsibility is too strong; he’s overly worried about failing as Chris’s dad, so he’s having second thoughts.
After all Merlin knows very well that he’s a selfish, self‑interested egoist; having seen Qikatiluo, he realizes how awful his personality is, and he doesn’t want Chris to turn out like him.
Although Merlin has never admitted it, he understands in his heart that Alice is the kind of personality many people like—upright and noble; even becoming an excellent mother would probably pose no difficulty.
“-My character you know, right? It might give Chris a bad influence.
“Ah?” Alice lowered her head, silent for a long while, blushing as she muttered, “Although there are many little flaws, I think it’s fine; even if she’s just a little demon, she’s not wicked to the core, occasionally she shows a bit of sympathy for others, she won’t just hurt people randomly, her cooking is really good, what…”
Merlin stared, his old face turning red, “What nonsense are you spouting?”
The atmosphere in the room turned awkward, inexplicably both of them blushing, making it impossible for them to continue talking.
Alice’s words made Merlin feel strange; even he himself doesn’t think he’s that kind of person, that he’s a dreaded Demon Lord evil to the bone!
Just now Alice’s words—if said to a proper demon, that would be an outright insult!
“Alice turned her head away, speaking in a rather awkward tone, “Anyway, you are Chris’s real dad, aren’t you? Hesitating like this isn’t like you at all, and besides, educating Chris—you as the dad also have responsibility; her future also needs your…”
“Merlin felt ashamed, never expecting to be scolded by Alice, so he sighed and said, “Yeah, I am her dad, I have responsibility, can’t escape, even if I lack experience I can only try, though I have zero confidence.”
“Don’t worry, as a mom I will definitely raise Chris into an outstanding talent!” Alice suddenly clenched her fists, spirits high, and added, “Even if her dad is useless!”
“Hey!” Merlin jumped up angrily, retorting, “Just now you were encouraging me, and now you’re pushing me aside—you’re so heartless!”
Alice ignored Merlin, instead crouching down to keep watching Chris, her face reddish as she said, “No, this child came a bit too early, our .system”.
“Yeah! Our relationship is too weird—clearly we never really married, only able to be called comrades, this kid Merlin furrowed his brows, really hard to explain.
The two aren’t lovers, much less husband and wife; suddenly having a “crystal of love” made their relationship turn subtle.
Alice: Why aren’t you speaking? At a time like this, don’t you have anything else you want to say to me? !
Merlin: What the heck does Alice mean? What kind of relationship is this? I can’t figure it out anymore!

title: Chapter 19 — Helpless
content:
Chapter 19 — Helpless

Volume 25 · Chapter 19

In the room, Merlin and Alice said nothing to each other; neither knew how to describe their current relationship.

Unexpectedly, Chris had appeared, and she was related to them by blood—this was something Merlin and Alice found hard to handle.

They had never been intimate as husband and wife, yet they already had a child—neither of them had expected this to happen.

Only Chris was at ease, sleeping soundly and letting out "shuu shuu" breaths.

"That...," Alice thought for a long time and broke the silence first, "Even if we aren't husband and wife, we are Chris's parents, aren't we?"

"Yes... that's right..." Merlin turned his head to look at Alice.

"Then there's no problem..." Alice paused, looking down, "Even though our relationship is strange now, it doesn't prevent us from taking care of Chris. As long as we are responsible parents, that's all that matters."

"You're right, we've been overthinking this." Merlin stood up from the sofa seriously, "I didn't expect this to happen, it's too surprising..."

"Yes, who would have thought Chris is our child?" Alice pulled up the small blanket Chris had kicked off, continuing, "We aren't married, but raising this child as parents is already fulfilling our duty."

"I understand, I'll do my best." Merlin sighed, pulling out his own blanket from under the sofa, preparing to rest. "It's so late already, you take Chris to the bedroom to rest, okay?"

"What are you doing? You're coming too?" Alice looked at Merlin in surprise.

"There's no need for that, is there?" Merlin frowned.

"If this child gets up in the middle of the night and can't find you, she'll probably cry out again." Alice looked troubled.

Merlin awkwardly scratched his cheek with his finger, saying helplessly—

"I really can't do anything about this kid~"

United Kingdom, atop the Sacred Tree Palace.

The Elf King stood before the throne with hands clasped behind his back, facing away from everyone; no one could guess what it was thinking at that moment.

Shirley knelt on one knee, head lowered, looking dejected, as if she knew she had made a mistake and was awaiting her father's punishment.

The white-haired elf elder spoke eloquently before all the elves, constantly recounting Shirley's performance on the mission—

"Princess, she obstructed us from bringing the child back and revealed the truth. As the sole heir to the elf throne, she didn't prioritize the clan's interests but instead colluded with sinners. She deserves punishment!"

The elf elders on the palace murmured among themselves, their gazes toward Shirley turning hostile.

This elf princess, in the eyes of her clansmen, had already become akin to a traitor.

Standing beside them, Hylph couldn't bear it any longer. Under immense pressure, she stood up and loudly defended Shirley—

"Your Majesty! Merlin and Alice have already grown attached to that child. If we use force to snatch the child away, we will surely anger them, which is dangerous for us. Princess Shirley didn't want to see the knights accompanying her die, so she was forced to reveal the truth! Moreover, that mysterious stone may belong to us, but the child doesn't! She is Merlin and Alice's flesh and blood! I object to Your Majesty's decision! You are forcing us to become robbers!"

Hearing this, the elders were shocked. As a knight, Hylph's words amounted to questioning the Elf King.

"Audacious!" The white-haired elder shouted angrily, glaring at Hylph. "Hylph! You are the King's knight! How dare you speak such treasonous words! Are you rebelling?"

"Elder, I have no intention of betraying Your Majesty; I simply think Your Majesty's decision is unwise!" Hylph's face darkened, she added. "That child can indeed interfere with the barrier left by the Father God, and may possess infinite potential in the future. Using deceit to separate a child from its parents is not the elven way!"

"........" The white-haired elder pointed at Hylph, blowing his beard and glaring. "You are also a traitor to the clan! You and Princess Shirley are both mad! If the prophecy of the alien race's destruction comes true, you are both guilty of betraying your clan!"

"I would rather die standing up!" Hylph countered forcefully. "I would never survive through shameful means!"

After hearing this, many elf elders wore expressions of incomprehension, thinking Hylph must be crazy.

Some elders even suggested to the Elf King that Hylph be executed; such a knight who didn't consider the clan's interests had no reason to remain.

"Hylph, stop talking. This is all the consequence of my stubbornness. I am willing to bear all punishment alone..." After a long silence, Shirley finally spoke.

"Princess...?" Hylph frowned, thinking the whole matter depended entirely on the Elf King's attitude?

"Father, the responsibility is mine. No matter how you punish me, I am willing to accept it!" Shirley looked up at her silent father.

Under everyone's gaze, the Elf King slowly turned around, his face gloomy and unpredictable. He gazed at Shirley below and spoke—

"I knew this would happen all along...

"???"

The elves showed confused expressions, wondering what the Elf King meant. Had he seen some prophecy and known this would be the result?

"I know Shirley is kind-hearted and weak-willed. Sending her wasn't just because she's Merlin and Alice's friend, but because with her present, there would always be room for maneuver. Things wouldn't develop into the worst case."

"Your Majesty's intention...?" The white-haired elder asked curiously.

"If the child can be brought back, that's best. But if not, there's nothing to be done, especially since they've already grown attached to the child." The Elf King sighed, having long anticipated this situation.

Bringing the child back to the United Kingdom would be a joy for all; not bringing her back would also be within reason.

The Elf King faced two choices: fight the wandering Demon Lord to mutual destruction, or maintain friendship with him.

"But... what about this! The child has limitless potential and may become a huge asset to our clan. To give her to two aliens would be a huge loss! What if she possesses power rivaling our Father God? She would be our greatest trump card against the apocalypse!" The white-haired elder lowered his head and said seriously.

"I understand what you say, but if they refuse to hand her over, we can only seize her by force..." The Elf King said calmly.

"For the continuation of our clan, there are no cowards among the elves!" The white-haired elder raised his arm, and the other elders echoed him.

Hylph frowned, thinking they would have to fight to the death with Lord Merlin? What price would that exact?

"Fine! Merlin was once the youngest Demon Lord, recognized by all demons at a young age, and he even killed my brother Asmodeus with one sword." The Elf King showed an indescribable smile,反问 all the elf elders present—

"I ask, who among you has the ability to defeat him?!"

"I'll say it upfront, I definitely can't beat him..."

title: Chapter 20 — Happy to Be a Father
content:
Chapter 20 — Happy to Be a Father

Volume 25 · Chapter 20

The elders below looked at each other in dismay; since the Elf King himself said he could not defeat the demon race's monarch, who in this alliance of other races could possibly step up to fight?
The white-haired elder lowered his head, gradually calming down, “For that child, to fall out with the former Demon Lord is indeed irrational, but if we just let it go, it’s still our loss.”
“What was said in the Elder Chamber is correct; it’s precisely because I worried about offending the Demon Lord that I secretly sent Shirley as an envoy to Britain. The wandering Demon Lord as a friend brings far greater benefit than as an enemy.” The Elf King paused, as if in thought.
“Your Majesty’s meaning…” the white-haired elder raised his head, wanting to speak but hesitating, “Are we to maintain friendship with that wandering Demon Lord?”
Since we already have a ready-made powerful ally, why would we casually discard him?” the Elf King smiled and continued, “That child indeed has considerable potential, but wanting to surpass her father Merlin… there’s still a long way to go.”
To feud with that wandering Demon Lord may not serve our race’s short-term interests, but in the long run losing that child would still be a considerable loss. Your Majesty, could you consider this from a long-term perspective?” the white-haired elder said meaningfully.
“At this adventurers’ tournament, Merlin and his wife will definitely participate, and I have already received an invitation from the Human Adventurers’ Headquarters to attend as a guest…” The Elf King looked at the elders below and announced loudly:
“I will acknowledge that girl as my adopted daughter!”
The morning sun rose over the horizon, a new day began.
Alice woke very early, secretly opening her eyes; Chris, whom she had held in her arms last night, had already restlessy shuffled into Merlin’s embrace.
In her sleep, Chris couldn’t tell apart dad and mom, thinking Merlin’s firm chest was her mother, and she loved snuggling up with her dad.
Only see Chris curled up in Merlin’s arms, her little mouth directly biting his chest muscle, continuously sucking, as if hoping to draw out sweet milk?
Fortunately Alice knows what’s going on; otherwise she’d think Chris is a little fox spirit, jumping out to compete with her for a man!
The little Chris in her sleep gave up, rolled over with her four paws in the air, her face showing a pout, making little mouth noises—
“……Mom’s milk is good……
Little Chris probably doesn’t even know; she didn’t get any milk, but instead got a mouthful of Merlin’s sweaty odor.
Alice had a black face, secretly resenting her teacher for tormenting her, causing her childhood nutrition to lag behind!
She held Chris close, looking at her daughter, and began to dote on her tenderly.
Regarding Chris’s sudden appearance, Alice still felt a little secret joy; although her relationship with Merlin hadn’t changed, they now had a child.
If she could still run into the landlady of the secret cottage, or the fox‑spirit princess of France, Alice thought she could make them choke with rage~
Alice was tidying Chris’s messy hair, but didn’t notice that Merlin had also woken up.
He saw Alice’s indulgent expression toward Chris, and his gaze instantly turned teasing.
“You really do like kids, ah…”
“Ugh!” Alice’s face flushed, feeling Merlin was mocking her, so she retorted awkwardly, “…No, I’m just fulfilling my motherly duty…”
Ha
Merlin gave a dry laugh, got up, scratched his messy hair, then rubbed his **chest, “Strange? My breast… hurts a bit.”
“Mmm!” Alice shuddered, her face darkening, not really wanting to say that Chris had been biting Merlin’s breast all night.
“It’s tingling…” Merlin frowned, rubbing his chest, thinking he’d been bitten by a bug at night, “Um… Alice, I think we should let the guild folks see Chris; it seems we don’t need to hide anymore, anyway they’ll find out sooner or later, and if they don’t know they might start rumoring, which would be awkward…”
“That’s right.” Alice thought for a moment, then said seriously, “After dinner I’ll take Chris with you.”
“Just me taking Chris is fine, and also give me that half‑map I brought back from the Chaos Sea; maybe Da Vinci is back, I want to ask her what this is.” Merlin hadn’t forgotten the treasure map he seized from the Chaos King, which could be placed in the secret treasure vault—surely it’s not something ordinary.
“I said we’d go together—why are you taking Chris alone? Aren’t I Chris’s mother?” Alice said dissatisfiedly.
“I didn’t mean that—let’s go together—no problem…
Merlin gave an embarrassed reply.
“Hmph!” Alice snorted lightly, feeling smug inside, thinking, I want everyone to know we already have Chris; even if I and Merlin aren’t married, so what? In everyone’s eyes we’re already a harmonious family of three—those restless fox spirits ought to settle down, huh =
“Plop” Merlin lay down again, staring into Alice’s eyes, curiously asking, “What are you laughing at? Why do I feel like a victorious evil villain?”
“…Nothing!” Alice’s face turned red, her eyes darting about.
Strange home…
Just as Merlin had worried, rumors were already rampant in the Rexium Guild; everyone knew Merlin had ‘become a dad.’
And as tavern gossip, the rumors spread more and more, becoming the stuff of novels.
What’s this—Merlin eating soft food and not daring to complain? Merlin wearing a green hat without knowing? Merlin’s bad kidneys preventing him from turning in homework?
All sorts of laughable rumors spread, making Merlin become the epitome of the unlucky guy in the guild.
“Hobbs! You big‑mouth! Look at what you’ve done!” Lucia glared at Hobbs, furious.
“Me? What’s wrong with me?” Hobbs swirled the strong liquor in his cup, thinking Lucia’s anger at him made no sense.
“You bastard, spreading rumors! Things aren’t like that at all! Whether Merlin and Alice have a child can’t be confirmed, let alone whether it’s biological—look at what you’ve said!” Lucia’s forehead veins jumped; she thought Hobbs, as an information dealer, would inevitably have everything known city‑wide.
“Can’t blame me for this? It was Rosetti who told me, and besides the responsibility is clearly yours—if you hadn’t told Rosetti, how could everyone know?” Hobbs calmly took a sip of wine, provocatively looking at Lucia, “I’m the big‑mouth? Clearly you are—don’t deny it, you’re the source of the news.
“…” Lucia felt a bit wronged; if she’d known, she wouldn’t have told Rosetti, but now the rumors are rampant—
What to do?
How to explain to Alice?
Better to splash all the dirty water onto Hobbs; anyway I’ve always been a pure lotus…

title: Chapter 21 — Competing to Be the Father (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 21 — Competing to Be the Father (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 25 · Chapter 21

"Cling clang clang clang~J"

A slightly husky voice rang out, breaking the quiet atmosphere in the guild.

Arnold swaggered in with a flashy strut, a rose in his mouth, his whole figure radiating brilliance.

"I haven't been to the guild for such a long time. Have you missed me?"

Lucia: "Get lost."

"Uh!" Arnold was doused with a bucket of cold water, his expression turning awkward. "What's going on? So cold toward me? After all this time, can't you even welcome me?"

"You're the most useless adventurer in the entire guild, with absolutely zero contribution. Just seeing you annoys me." Lucia said with an unfriendly expression.

"Wait! Hobbes has as much contribution as I do—why only target me?" Arnold asked seriously.

"Hobbes, that old drunkard, at least makes decent money from gathering information. You? Hey, the landlord's stupid son...." Lucia pursed her lips, speaking in a contemptuous tone. "Other than going back to inherit your father's title and the family lands, what else do you have?"

"I also have a private knight army of over two thousand people, millions of gold coins in wealth, some port businesses, over a hundred maids, and the underground treasure passed down through my family for generations...." Arnold said straightforwardly.

Hobbes:

"....." Arnold covered his mouth, suddenly feeling heartbroken and choking out, "It seems I really am useless compared to you guys. Unlike you who are so poor, I was born into comfort that will last for generations. I don't deserve to associate with you, boohoo..."

Hobbes jumped up from his chair, lightning-fast, appearing beside Arnold and enthusiastically putting his hand on his shoulder—"Who doesn't welcome you? I'll definitely help you deal with them! We're good brothers, right~"

"Weren't you acting very differently just now?" Arnold frowned.

".... I was drunk~" Hobbes swirled his wine glass, reeking of alcohol, "We're good brothers—I'll never forget that. What's yours is mine, and what's mine is still mine~"

"???" Arnold's head was full of question marks.

"Come, come, sit! Let's have a couple drinks." Hobbes hooked Arnold's arm and whispered secretly, "You weren't bragging just now, were you?"

"Is there a need?" Arnold rolled his eyes. As soon as he sat down, Lucia proactively placed a cup of black tea in front of him.

"Sir Arnold, please enjoy your tea. It's been a few days and you seem even more vibrant than before, oh ho ho ho ho~" Lucia smiled very enthusiastically, already forgetting what she'd just said about Arnold—directly defeated by the power of money.

"You too. Haven't seen you in a few days, Lucia, you're getting more and more beautiful...."

"Not at all, Sir Arnold, you flatter me." Lucia pretended to be shy.

"Pity you're not my type. Beautiful on the outside but dark inside, fake and manipulative—whoever marries you will have bad luck."

"...What did you say?" Lucia's smile vanished as she grabbed the wine bottle nearby, trembling with anger.

"I'll have my father donate tens of thousands of gold coins to the guild! To support the development of the Rexem local guild!"

"Sir Arnold, you are so g-generous... cough! You're truly a generous person..." Lucia silently put down the wine bottle.

"Ah~, that's the feeling. I do have some contributions to the guild after all." Arnold found his life's purpose again. "Hobbes, drink whatever you want today—my treat."

Hobbes sucked in a breath of cold air, pumped up like he'd been injected with adrenaline, stood up and addressed the other adventurers in a deliberately magnanimous tone, "Everyone! Today is a good day, drink to your heart's content! Sir Arnold is paying! Don't stand on ceremony, he's my good brother! What's his is mine, so it's like I'm treating everyone!"

The adventurers all raised their cups to Hobbes after hearing this, shouting "Hobbes is awesome," completely ignoring Arnold.

Hobbes waved to his comrades, high-spirited, playing the role of the gracious host with ease.

He happily sat back down, extremely arrogant, bossing Lucia around.

"Lucia, what are you staring at? Pour me some wine!"

Lucia gave Hobbes a huge eye-roll and spat, "Ptooey! Do you even qualify?"

"Oh?" Hobbes saw Lucia ignoring him and walking away, wiping the spit off his face. "No wonder the old guild master is losing his hair from stress. Lucia still hasn't gotten married— with that temper, only a fool would approach her. Hey, Arnold, do you have business today?"

"I'm preparing a fireworks show and hope to invite Miss Alice." Arnold showed a dreamy expression and continued, "...I just want to win her heart back and have her return to my side~"

Hobbes couldn't help but laugh out loud, thinking that even if Merlin and Alice hadn't really married, Arnold still didn't stand a chance. "Good luck! I believe in you!"

"Ah, thank you, I've been preparing for this for a long time...." Arnold remained obsessed with Alice. "Actually, Alice has already returned—she's in Rexem now." Hobbes said casually.

"Oh? I need to go invite Alice...."

"Wait, I have some information here that you might be very interested in~"

"What information?"

"Well...." Hobbes started playing hard to get, showing his information broker face. "Go ahead, I want to hear what news you have?"

Arnold threw his money pouch to Hobbes.

Hobbes smiled and opened the pouch, blinded by the golden glow, then grinning from ear to ear. "Bro, you're generous. Actually, Merlin and Alice already have a child."

"What?!" Arnold jumped up in shock and said in disbelief, "They're not really married—how can they have a child?!"

"That child isn't Merlin's. Brother Merlin got cheated on, green hat on his head~ How's that, exciting enough?" Hobbes said with great enthusiasm.

"Really!" Arnold's expression grew complicated and he muttered to himself, "I knew it! Miss Alice doesn't truly love Merlin. They're just making do together. As I suspected all along!"

"What do you plan to do now? Still planning to pursue her relentlessly?" Hobbes asked meaningfully.

"Of course! Alice definitely needs me right now! Taking care of a child alone must be so hard, this...." Arnold showed a serious expression. "I'll take care of it!"

"That child isn't yours?" Hobbes said in surprise.

"Hobbes, you don't understand. When you love someone, you love their whole being. As long as Miss Alice is willing to be with me, nothing is a problem." A blazing "real man" fire ignited in Arnold's eyes.

"???" Hobbes thought Arnold must have brain problems. Who in their right mind would think like that?

At this moment, Merlin's family had just arrived. Alice was holding little Chris and constantly cooing at her. Merlin looked around the guild and felt it was noticeably quieter than usual. Confused, he said, "Has it been busy lately? There are so few people...."

Seeing Alice, Arnold quickly walked over and put both hands on her shoulders. "Miss Alice!"

"Huh? What are you doing?" Alice furrowed her brows, not knowing what new trick Arnold was up to.

"Never mind, Sister Alice...." Arnold glanced at Chris in Alice's arms, gritted his teeth and said, "I'll raise this child! From now on, I'm her dad!"

Alice's face darkened instantly. *Smack!* A palm strike like the Tathagata's thunderous palm landed on Arnold's face. She said sternly, "No! You're not!"

Little Chris, hiding behind her mother's arms, watched the scene before her and couldn't help but bite her finger in confusion, tilting her head—"Ahi? "(m - .)?"

title: Chapter 22 — Sympathetic Aunt
content:
Chapter 22 — Sympathetic Aunt

Volume 25 · Chapter 22

Merlin remained silent, wondering which screw had come loose in Arnold's head again—he wanted to be Chris's dad right off the bat? "Alice sis... why?" Arnold asked, his swollen cheeks, feeling Alice's reaction was not what he expected. "Why? I should be asking you why!" Alice said, holding little Chris, frowning. "Don't you need me anymore? Raising a child alone is hard!" Arnold said earnestly. Merlin and Alice exchanged puzzled looks, Arnold's words and actions leaving them bewildered. Arnold noticed their expressions, sensed something was off, and tentatively asked, "Alice, isn't this child the one you kicked Merlin aside for and had with another man?" Alice: Merlin. "...Isn't that so?" Arnold frowned. "Who said that?" Merlin demanded, his face dark. "Who's spouting nonsense?" Merlin's eyes turned hostile. Arnold suddenly realized, looking toward the drunken Hobbes beside him, and understood he'd been played by this "brother." "Cough cough!" Hobbes lightly coughed twice to cover his embarrassment, pretending to admire the scenery. Lucya didn't even lift her head, doodling randomly in the ledger; seeing Alice and Merlin arrive with the child, she broke out in nervous cold sweat. "Not my business, not my business, not my business....." Merlin and Alice realized that for some unknown reason, rumors were spreading through the guild. But they didn't take it to heart; instead, they sat down and explained Chris's origin to everyone. The "Merlin's green hat" rumor that had lingered in the guild for days quickly dissipated. "Is this child truly your daughter?!" Hobbes exclaimed, shocked, his eyes full of disbelief. "Indeed, because we encountered many strange things in the United Kingdom, and by a fortunate coincidence this child inherited our bloodline, so she is our daughter." Merlin lowered his gaze to little Chris in his arms, who blinked her big eyes, curiously observing her parents' colleagues. "Good heavens! Simply unbelievable!" Hobbes stroked his messy beard, staring at Chris, "I've seen quite a bit, but I've never heard of a method to create life—whether in any aspect, creating life is a taboo, impossible to touch." Alice stroked Chris's little head, lifted her head, and asked, "This child was born from a mysterious stone; even those immortal elves cannot know the stone's origin, only that it suddenly fell down long ago...." "Really?" Hobbes's eyes flickered, wondering what he was thinking; instead he chuckled, "No matter what, this world holds many unexplored secrets; perhaps this child is one of them. Since she inherited your bloodline, there's no need to dwell on her origins—as long as she isn't an evil entity, there will be no problem; just think of her as a baby born of mysterious magic." "Exactly!" Lucya, seeing Chris's adorable appearance, could no longer restrain her maternal instinct, stepped forward and poked her chubby cheeks with a finger, saying, "Look how much this child resembles her parents—her eyes like Merlin's, her nose like Alice's; she's clearly yours, right?" Merlin and Alice, hearing this, instantly felt embarrassed, unsure how to respond to Lucya. Meanwhile, Arnold beside them felt awkward; seeing Chris meant his chances with Alice were slipping further away. Arnold felt a bit resentful, even sour, and couldn't help but sneer, "What? This can count as biological? Miss Alice is still single—don't talk as if you're already married." "You talk too much—why wouldn't it count? This child inherited your bloodline; haven't you seen how much she looks like Merlin and Alice?" Lucya gave Arnold a white look. Little Chris listened to the adults' chatter, seeming uninterested and not quite understanding. Seeing Lucya's finger constantly poking her, Chris couldn't help but open her mouth and bite the finger, sucking on it like a pacifier. "Ah......." "Huh?" Lucya gasped, then instinctively stretched out her arms and said, "Mr. Merlin, let me hold her." "Ah.. okay." Merlin handed Chris to Lucya's arms. Lucya's face flushed with excitement, feeling the child's body soft and light, "This child might be just like little Alice~" "...What are you saying?" Alice felt embarrassed, thinking she shouldn't spout nonsense in front of Chris, as she needed to maintain maternal authority. "Just like Mommy~" Chris's eyes sparkled with tiny stars, the little tuft on her head perked up, feeling praised by a stranger. "Exactly, you look just as pretty as your mom~" Lucya stroked Chris's nose and asked, "What's your name?" "Chris! Mom gave me this name!" Chris answered honestly. "Chris? What a nice name~" Lucya couldn't help but praise, then introduced herself, "I'm Lucya, the guild's administrator~" Chris recalled her mother's teaching to be polite to others and immediately put it into practice, "Lucya Auntie~" "Ah... Lucya froze on the spot, struck to the soul by that 'Auntie,' as if a heavy hammer hit her chest—Lucya...... Auntie? Hobbes and Merlin's foreheads simultaneously slid down a few black lines; the atmosphere among the few present instantly turned awkward. Alice quickly forced a smile and reminded Chris, "Chris, don't call her Auntie, call her Sister!" "Huh?" Chris bit her finger, then showed her baby teeth and smiled, calling, "Lucya Sister~mi" "Such a good child." Lucya kissed Chris's forehead, expressing her affection. However, Chris suddenly noticed Lucya's chest muscles were unusually strong, enough to press down her mother several times over. Chris widened her eyes, recalling what her mother had told her yesterday, and her gaze showed a hint of sympathy. "Lucya Sister?" "What's wrong?" "Just how many beatings did you endure to get chest muscles like.....?" Chris asked curiously. "? ? ?" Lucya's mind filled with question marks, wondering what the child was saying. Beside her, Alice reacted like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, "Scoot" she jumped up and grabbed Chris into her arms. "...Don't listen to the child's nonsense, haha...." Alice lowered her head, looking at the innocent-faced Chris, and whispered softly, "Chris, don't talk nonsense outside, okay?" "Huh?" Chris pouted her little mouth, feeling wronged, thinking— I clearly didn't speak nonsense, why is Mom overreacting? Lucya Sister's chest muscles are all swollen like this—shouldn't we sympathize a bit? (.∞“

title: Chapter 23 — Three Strikes Today
content:
Chapter 23 — Three Strikes Today

Volume 25 · Chapter 23

Alice sternly warned Chris not to speak recklessly outside, lest she cause a joke outside.
Merlin frowned tightly, thinking, who let Alice teach Chris some weird knowledge? Just honestly admit that I'm the abnormal one, okay?
Chris sat on Alice's lap, lifting her little head to look at her mother, feeling wronged, not knowing what she did wrong.
Fortunately, Hobbs noticed the atmosphere was a bit awkward, so he chuckled and said, "Haha, I never thought Merlin could be a dad? That's truly unbelievable."
"Ah? Do you have any objections?" Merlin raised his eyebrows.
"Alice naturally doesn't need to say more; I've always thought Merlin, your virtue makes it impossible for you to be a father...... Being a qualified father is difficult, and given your usual behavior, I can't help but deeply worry about this child~" Hobbs said meaningfully.
"Yeah, truly worrying." Lucia also looked at Merlin with doubtful eyes.
"Ha~" Arnold chuckled lightly, unable to resist boasting, "I'm different; my whole body radiates a trustworthy glow. As long as Miss Alice is willing, I will surely become an excellent father."
"What are you daydreaming about?" Lucia gave Arnold a big white-eye.
"What are you doing? Do I look that unreliable?" Merlin broke into a cold sweat on his forehead, "As long as I'm serious, I'm also a reliable person."
"Haha, forget it; as someone who's been there, Merlin, you can ask me for advice on being a dad—taking care of a kid isn't as easy as you imagine." Hobbs said proudly.
"Right, Hobbs also has a very young daughter, though she's just too playful." Lucia thought for a moment, "I think her name is Mini?"
*Mini...ha
Merlin gave a dry laugh, recalling the time he turned into a little brat and even formed the Troublesome Kids Knight Squad with Mini.
"Mini is my little treasure; she seems a few years older than Chris. If Merlin, you're willing to beg me, I can teach you how to be a great father in the eyes of a child~" Hobbs said, stroking his chin.
"No need, I trust my abilities; everyone is a first-time father, with no experience, and I'm not lacking anything you can do well, so I won't have any problems." Merlin said seriously, thinking, why doesn't anyone believe me? Do I really look that hopeless normally?
"Well...." Hobbs shrugged his shoulders, then suddenly shifted the topic, "By the way, your current relationship is... quite strange, right? You're not officially married, yet you already have a child..."
Merlin and Alice exchanged an embarrassed glance, both blushing and lowering their heads, not knowing how to answer Hobbs's question.
Actually, both of them can't sort out their current relationship—there's hostility, friendship, affection, all mixed; the simplest solution might be to temporarily seek common ground while reserving differences.
"You've clearly been together for so long; surely you must have some feelings by now?" Lucia probed.
"Impossible! No way!" Arnold jumped up in agitation, refusing to believe it even if beaten to death.
When Merlin and Alice faced the questioning, they both shuddered simultaneously, as if a probe had hit a sensitive spot, and for a moment they became a bit nervous.
"Huh?" Chris blinked her big eyes curiously at Alice, because she could clearly feel her mother trembling.
"I remember when Mr. Merlin first came to the Adventurers Guild, Alice seemed to dislike him; they could argue after less than three sentences." Lucia put on a mysterious expression and probed, "So... now? Do you have any liking for Mr. Merlin?"
.-.... Nonsense! This is absolutely impossible!" Alice's face flushed red, she desperately tried to cover up, saying, "Who... who would like such a guy? With a bad temperament and all kinds of flaws, only someone with eye problems would like him; how could I possibly like such a guy? Impossible~"
.... Is that so?
Lucia had several black lines drop on her forehead, thinking, "Really or fake? Who is the person that Mr. Merlin rushes around looking for when he's not seen?"
So Lucia coughed lightly twice to hide her embarrassment and asked Merlin.
"And Mr. Merlin, after all this time, how do you view Alice?"
"How to view? Huh~" Merlin let out a cold laugh, retorting without mercy, "Such a self-righteous woman—better to disappear from my sight early; every day she latches onto some trivial matter and won't let go; I've never seen anyone more petty than her in my life, it's infuriating~"
Alice: "What did you say? !Clearly it's your problem."
Merlin: "Ah? What problem do I have? It's obviously because you're narrow-minded."
Alice: "I'm narrow-minded? Dare you speak some truth? Will admitting you have problems kill you?"
Merlin: "Haha, do you know what your biggest problem is? It's that you lack self-awareness~"
"..... Lucia's mouth twitched, thinking, 'Isn't this just like before? Who would develop feelings after being together a long time? That's all a lie! They haven't changed at all!'"
Little Chris looked left and right, hearing her parents argue, she became uneasy and couldn't help but say in a grieved tone, "Don't be fierce, Chris doesn't like seeing Mom and Dad fierce....."
The two looked at Chris's pitiful appearance and immediately fell silent, realizing that arguing in front of Chris isn't a good thing.
Alice: "Hmph!"
Merlin: "Shout!"
Hobbs wiped the sweat from his forehead, thinking these two were basically freaks, "Since you look down on each other, what are we going to do next? This child is innocent...."
"What else can we do? We'll treat her as our own daughter and raise her slowly." Merlin said seriously.
"Exactly, no matter what, I'll still take good care of Chris." Alice lowered her head to look at her little cutie.
Arnold showed a look of incomprehension, having thought Merlin and Alice would split up at any moment.
As a result, the two will continue to raise this child as parents! ?
With the child as a bond, how could they possibly split up?
Arnold's eyes filled with hot tears, feeling his goddess could never turn back, so he ran out sobbing.
"I'll never believe in love again, Miss Alice wishes you happiness, chirp chirp...."
"Done, this guy will definitely hide in his room for a long time unwilling to come out, really a weakling..... Lucia sighed, feeling very sympathetic toward Arnold."
"Arnold brother, it's too tragic, hehe.... Hobbs originally wanted to pity Arnold, but ended up laughing out loud."
"I've told him it's useless, why is he still clinging on?" Alice muttered angrily.
"Who was that uncle just now, Mom?" Chris asked curiously.
"Someone who keeps pursuing Mom endlessly...." Alice answered softly.
"... . Chris showed an envious gaze, 'Mom is a million-person charm~'"
"..... Alice's face turned red, she felt great, so she softly replied, 'Mm, you're right, you still have good taste, unlike your dad, who is blind....'"
"But Mom already has a dad, they can't chase Mom.... Chris pouted her little lips, showing a lack of understanding."
Alice's face reddened a bit more, she glanced sideways at Merlin, then whispered to Chris:
"You just know it yourself, don't go around blabbing...."

title: Chapter 24 — Title Favorite
content:
Chapter 24 — Title Favorite

Volume 25 · Chapter 24

Merlin looked around and asked in a strange tone, "Where did Mr.卡尔 and the guildmaster go? I don't see them."

It wasn't surprising that the busy Karl was absent, but it was very odd that Elder President Taylor, who was practically on the verge of retirement, was also missing.

Usually, Merlin would often see Elder Taylor sitting behind the counter with his eyes closed, lost in thought. Who knew what that old man was thinking about inside?

"The adventurer competition is about to begin, so Grandpa took my father for special training. They hope to break through before it starts. If nothing major happens, they won't be back for now," Luccia explained.

"Oh, I see.. So it's like that.." Merlin nodded, thinking that with the competition nearly starting, all the adventurers were getting busy. "I saw several adventurers on my way here trying to find ways to grow stronger. Is this competition really that important?"

"This is an opportunity for guilds from all regions to show off their strength to the outside world, and it attracts a lot of attention. If you perform well enough, you can gain both fame and wealth, becoming the most dazzling star." Hobbs paused and lowered his voice. "Back then, Karl had already become quite famous just by leading our guild into the top hundred. Just think about what kind of monsters are in the top ten?"

"No wonder.. I ran into Johnson, who specializes in copy magic, and Zickatilo from Manchester, on my way here. They were bleeding each other over a single monster core." Merlin nodded in understanding, though he couldn't care less about that core. The Earth Spirit's grade was already high enough, and besides, his physique could never digest a monster core anyway.

"Wait! Zickatilo?" Hobbs suddenly raised his head, his expression growing a few degrees serious.

"Yeah, what's wrong?" Merlin asked in surprise.

"You said you ran into Zickatilo? That monster from Manchester?" Alice also furrowed her brows; she hadn't heard Merlin mention this before.

"That's right, we went to find Chris together," Merlin said honestly.

"Zickati.. I've heard that person's strength is close to a Purple-Gold adventurer. I didn't expect he'd also go to the Monster Forest recently to improve his strength..." Alice said thoughtfully, wondering in her heart that people better than herself were still working hard, while she was here raising children.

"Hey hey, what's with your reactions? Do you all need to be this surprised just hearing Zickatilo's name?" Merlin looked at the others with a strange gaze.

"That's Zickatilo after all. In the last competition, he single-handedly lifted Manchester's guild into the top ten. It was a pity he didn't have strong helpers; otherwise, he very well could have been one of the top three." Luccia said seriously. With just Zickatilo himself, Manchester's guild could reach the top ten, so you could imagine how thick this half-elf mage's leg was.

"From what you're saying, he sounds pretty impressive, but I think Zickatilo's strength is just so-so..." Merlin felt it was no big deal. What he considered average in his eyes was completely different to everyone else.

"So-so? Aren't you afraid of spraining your tongue? He's a well-known, powerful adventurer, while you're just a low-level rookie scrapping by at the bottom. You dare say Zickatilo's strength is mediocre? And he hasn't even bothered to put you on his radar at all." Hobbs couldn't resist pouring cold water on him; he seemed unable to stand the arrogant tone Merlin was speaking in.

"Yes, Mr. Merlin, don't talk such big talk. Zickatilo is definitely not to be underestimated; he's a powerful enemy you'd need to guard against even in your dreams. I once heard Grandpa say that Zickatilo has an elf's magical talent, and using elf power versus not using it makes two completely... different..." Luccia's expression grew serious as she emphasized, "The rumor that Zickatilo's strength is close to a Purple-Gold adventurer is undoubtedly true, on the condition that he's willing to use elf power."

"Lucky that guy walks alone. Otherwise, it would be hard to imagine how anyone could win against that monster in a one-on-one fight..."

Alice took a deep breath, as if she had some understanding of Zickatilo.

Merlin didn't voice his own opinion. After thinking about it, Zickatilo seemed to have never used elf magic in front of him; he always relied on a demonic scythe to lead the way. Was he deliberately hiding his strength?

"Let me show you something..."

Hobbs pulled a newspaper from his chest and spread it out for everyone to see. "Although the competition hasn't started yet, the underground gambling houses have already begun taking bets. Take a look. The amount bet on Zickatilo ranks fifth. The ones ahead are all monsters among monsters, outstanding performers from the top three guilds in the last competition. Those old veterans at the underground gambling houses are extremely shrewd; they all know this mixed-breed bastard is incredibly strong. So, Merlin? Do you still believe Zickatilo's strength is just so-so?"

Merlin opened his mouth as if to say something, then closed it. He looked down at the newspaper, not particularly interested in Zickatilo; instead, he was searching everywhere for his own name.

But he did see Young Johnson's name and photo, ranked low at the bottom of the list.

Of course, he also found a much more familiar name somewhere in the middle of the list...

Merlin's expression darkened. After glancing at the ranking, he didn't want to say anything more, feeling that this ranking was very unrealistic.

"It's Mom!" Little Chris pointed at her mother's photo on the newspaper. The person in the middle of the ranking was none other than Alice.

"Hm?" Alice quickly looked down, then smiled. "I didn't expect I made the list too.."

"Anyone on this list is absolutely a championship contender. Alice, you've improved remarkably fast, and many people have noticed you now. I'm very bullish on you. I'll place bets on you, so you must perform well. The rest of my life's happiness depends on you." Hobbs said with great excitement.

"Hah. The thought that an old drunkard like you wants to turn things around by betting on me makes me want to deliberately lose just to make you pay..." Alice retorted with a cold sneer.

"No way! This concerns our guild's honor! Don't throw the match, or Elder President Taylor will surely die of anger." Hobbs frowned deeply and said seriously. "Besides, don't think of this competition too simply. As far as I know, besides the traditional powerhouses, many guilds have nurtured outstanding adventurers. There are plenty of hidden secret weapons. I've heard that London Guildmaster Gregory's only student will also compete. This competition is sure to be a fierce battle between dragons and tigers. The smell of gunpowder is already弥漫 before it even begins. This could very well be the most intense competition in history. Our guild doing anything more than retaining its top hundred status would be fortunate. If we enter the top fifty, then the Goddess of Luck has gone blind..."

"What are you talking about? Stop spreading slander here!" Luccia pointed at Hobbs's nose and reprimanded him angrily. She came to Alice's side, patted her shoulder, and said, "Alice is now our trump card. As long as she's here, what's the top fifty? We're going straight for the top twenty. Let's see who dares say any adventurer from Rexham has crossed eyes!"

"Um... I feel so much pressure..." Alice could only laugh and cry, thinking that if Merlin entered the competition, even the top twenty would be an insult to him.

Merlin kept a tense expression, his gaze fixed unblinkingly on the underground gambling house's betting list, resentful that his name wasn't included.

What does this mean? Alice could make the list, but why wasn't I ranked?

Damn it! This is clearly disrespecting the Great Demon Lord's dignity!

Just you wait. I'll make sure you all lose your underwear!

title: Chapter 25 — Tanya (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 25 — Tanya (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 25 · Chapter 25

Merlin muttered to himself constantly, but then noticed something peculiar — most of the adventurers on the leaderboard were from traditional powerhouse guilds.

The only exception was the top-ranked adventurer, who came from an unknown small town called "Vesteyer."

Judging by the photo, she was a blonde, blue-eyed girl with sharp, piercing eyes and an exceptionally curvaceous figure.

Most notably, she wore thick and extremely exaggerated arm guards that nearly covered her entire arms.

Yet these over-the-top arm guards blended perfectly with her beauty, creating no sense of dissonance — instead, they gave off an overwhelmingly heroic aura.

Merlin was instantly captivated by this blonde, blue-eyed girl, not because of her beauty, but because she wasn't from any traditional powerhouse guild yet occupied the number one spot!

The traditional powerhouse guilds were organizations that had long dominated the upper echelons of the rankings. They were teeming with talent, possessed unparalleled resources, and had the ability to cultivate powerful adventurers.

And yet, the adventurers from these traditional powerhouse guilds were being left far behind by a girl from an unknown town called "Vesteyer." This naturally caught Merlin's attention.

Merlin pointed at the top spot in the newspaper and couldn't help but ask Hobbs, "Who is this person? Why can they occupy the first place? It's too strange."

"Oh~!" Hobbs let out a surprised exclamation and laughed. "You don't know about her because you've been living under a rock. This girl is called Tania. She's from the extremely cold Tsardom, and became an adventurer around the same period as Alice. But she's been hailed by the entire nation of Tsardom as a genius born once in a century. She turned down the royal family's recruitment offer — unlike Alice, who scampered off to serve as a foreign Thorn Knight."

"What do you mean by that?!" Alice slamed the table in a huff. "It's just a title. Don't make it sound like I willingly became a pawn of the royal family. Besides, who is Tania? I've never even heard of her. Stop comparing us."

"Alice, the reason I'm comparing the two of you is because there are many similarities~" Hobbs tilted the corner of his mouth and said with a head-shaking grin, "You essentially entered the adventurer profession around the same time, and you both practice magic and fighting spirit simultaneously. And both of you were recruited by the royal family after your reputations spread far and wide. Don't you think that's quite similar?"

"Hmph, what does that have to do with me...." Alice sniffed discontentedly.

"It's not that related, really. Her name has spread through every kingdom, while you're only well-known in Britannia. Hehe~" Hobbs said with a shameless grin.

"Can you just shut up..." The veins on Alice's forehead were faintly visible.

"Exactly, Hobbs, stop spreading fearmongering nonsense." Lucia was quite disgusted by Hobbs's habit of boosting the enemy's momentum while belittling her own side.

"Tania..." Merlin furrowed his brows and asked curiously, "Why is her ranking so high?"

"The people who placed bets on Tania aren't fools. I've already said it — those ranked above Zikatiro are monsters among monsters. Many people firmly believe Tania will win the tournament and become the strongest adventurer. Being able to suppress the traditional powerhouse guilds and take the top spot speaks for itself — her strength is unquestionable!" Hobbs couldn't stop praising the girl named Tania.

"Has she done anything... earth-shattering?" Merlin pressed further.

"No one knows where Tania comes from. All that's known is that since she became an adventurer, she has never once known defeat. Her magic power and fighting spirit have both basically reached a state of consummate mastery. Three punches — to this day, I've never heard of anyone who could withstand three of Tania's strikes! Almost no one can fathom the depth of her strength — it's unfathomably deep!" Hobbs sighed, then added, "She has single-handedly accomplished countless unbelievable things. She has beaten to death no few powerful figures from dark guilds who were once feared far and wide, to the point where dark guild members now feel terror at the mere mention of her name. Many have also witnessed her annihilate near-invulnerable elemental beasts. I've heard those beasts could speak human language, just like the lake fairies from Britannian legends. I simply cannot describe how powerful Tania is. It's as if she can never be defeated..."

"Is it really that exaggerated?" Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking that an elemental beast capable of speaking human language would be roughly comparable to the Earth Spirit he had slain — both were elemental beasts that could speak. It was probably not far below the Earth Spirit in terms of strength.

"Merlin, I haven't exaggerated in the slightest. I'm telling the truth as I see it." Hobbs responded seriously, then continued, "According to whispers, Tania has already been listed as a candidate for Purple-Gold rank by the Adventurer Headquarters. She's very likely to become the first adventurer to successfully ascend in nearly fifty years. That's basically considered a miracle."

"Hah, what you're saying sounds pretty terrifying, but whether someone's strong or not can only be known after fighting them." Alice said nonchalantly.

"Right! Alice isn't weak either. Maybe that Tania is just someone who looks strong on the outside but is actually weak within." Lucia lifted her chin provocatively.

"I hope so. But Alice, if you end up facing Tania and find you can't win, don't try to push through at all costs — you could actually get killed by that person." Hobbs offered a word of earnest advice.

Merlin said nothing, but he was somewhat looking forward to it. He thought that if he ever encountered this person, he would definitely want to have a good duel and see what was so special about her "three punches."

"Anyway, Alice, don't underestimate them. Everyone on this leaderboard is a championship favorite with real skill." Hobbs tapped the newspaper with his finger and said earnestly —

"Tania is dangerous, but that doesn't necessarily mean she'll win the championship."

"Because none of the people on this list are easy opponents...."

—

In the far northern land, heavy snow fell.

Fierce winds swept the snowflakes like blades, making it hard to keep one's eyes open.

The polar temperatures caused even freshly spilled warm blood to freeze within moments.

A banner painted with a giant eyeball was directly snapped by the howling gale and lost to the endless storm of wind and snow.

The last two members of the Dark Guild Deep Cold Eyes were declared annihilated at this moment — not a single member survived. Total destruction!

The ground was strewn with frozen corpses, their bodies twisted into grotesque shapes as if their bones had been shattered. Their eyes refused to close in death.

As the Deep Cold Eyes — the Dark Guild with the richest foundation among the Four Great Dark Guilds — they boasted a history spanning several hundred years and had experienced over a dozen changes in leadership.

Their resources were the deepest among all Dark Guilds, with many powerful executives. Every successive president was not only skilled at management, but also possessed strength that was one in a million.

And yet, despite such power, this organization did not fall to the Empire's iron boots, nor was it devoured by a powerful competitor. Instead, it was shamefully wiped out by a single adventurer.

That's right — a great Dark Guild with centuries of heritage was destroyed single-handedly by one adventurer. The Deep Cold Eyes would be forever branded on the pillar of shame.

In the howling blizzard, a blonde, blue-eyed girl wearing exaggerated arm guards stood silently, dragging a corpse that had long since frozen solid.

This corpse was the president of the Deep Cold Eyes. His death was gruesome — every bone in his body was shattered, and his face bore an expression of不甘 and terror from before his death.

"I thought your strength could rival mine, but before I even exerted myself, you had already fallen." Tania's gaze carried a hint of regret as she tossed the corpse aside like trash and gazed toward the distant mountains shrouded in heavy snow.

"Why are there so few worthy opponents?"

"I'm so bored..."

title: Chapter 26 — Semi-finished
content:
Chapter 26 — Semi-finished

Volume 25 · Chapter 26

Tanya sighed to herself, looking back at the corpses covered in snow everywhere.

She had thought Deep Cold Gaze, as an evil organization with deep foundations, would definitely not be weak.

So she had come here full of expectations to hunt them down, but who would have thought such a large organization didn't have a single fighter?

Tanya even wondered how Deep Cold Gaze had survived among so many dark guilds where the weak fed the strong.

"Tanya!"

The sound of a call rang out; there was a young man wearing thick leather armor and carrying a heavy pack.

He wore a gold-rank adventurer's badge on his chest, one rank below Tanya.

Dressed like that, windblown and weary, he looked like Tanya's attendant, responsible for assisting her on missions outside.

"The guild master just sent word that the Adventurers' Tournament is about to start, telling you to hurry back and prepare!"

Tanya's face gave nothing away. "It's just a performance tournament anyway. There won't be anyone with real skill there. I have no interest."

"Don't say that. The ones competing are the most elite adventurers from around the world. Their skills are excellent. The guild master said many guilds have brought out their secret techniques. It'll surely be a fierce competition." The attendant said seriously.

"If that's the case, I might as well enter. Just what are these elite competitors capable of? I'm curious." When Tanya heard that the major guilds were taking it seriously, she reluctantly stirred a bit of interest.

"Absolutely won't disappoint you. The guild master said last year's champion was incredibly strong—absolutely able to satisfy you." The attendant paused, then laughed. "If you win the tournament this time, the guild master might laugh in his sleep!"

"Hope so. The adventurers competing had better not be as pathetic as Deep Cold Gaze—easily crushed." Tanya took off her heavy armguards and handed them to the attendant for safekeeping.

"The attendant struggled to lift Tanya's armguards, glanced at the corpses around them, and said, 'Who would have thought the infamous Deep Cold Gaze was annihilated by you alone? This'll be huge news!'"

"I don't care about fame," Tanya rubbed her aching wrists.

"You should also try to build your reputation. The bigger the fame, the higher the value. You're the face of the entire guild now." The attendant gave an awkward smile.

Tanya didn't answer that question. Instead, she changed the subject. "How many of the four strongest dark guilds are left?"

"Gokuki Reisen encountered Elkin's legendary swordsman in Britain and was annihilated. Not long ago, Blue Violet Flame also fell, said to be dragged into a kingdom rebellion. Deep Cold Gaze..." The attendant looked at the corpses and said helplessly, "No need to talk about them. The only dark guild left now is Phoenix. Pity they're nomadic; we have no intel on them and don't know where they're hiding."

"Phoenix... the undying," Tanya lifted her head, her gaze flickering. "Phoenix must be the most formidable of the dark guilds. Maybe they can give me a little thrill?"

"Ah? Why do you say that?" The attendant asked puzzled.

"The Deep Cold Gaze guild master said before he died that I could never beat Phoenix. That phoenix is a man nearly like a god..."

Tanya paused, then said in a low voice, "Deep Cold Gaze only settled in this bitterly cold land because Phoenix was too powerful. They were terrified of being swallowed up. That phoenix... truly makes one curious."

"There's still such a thing?" The attendant frowned seriously. "Don't worry, Tanya. Focus on the tournament for now. After it ends, you can investigate Phoenix. With such powerful dark guilds falling one after another, its days can't be easy either."

"That makes sense." Tanya nodded, her expression meaningful. "That legendary swordsman Elkin... he's been on my mind."

"Why?" The attendant asked in surprise.

"That guy has killed many strong enemies but never used his full strength. That's somewhat similar to me. Maybe we're the same type." Tanya tilted her head, her silk-like golden hair draping over her shoulders. "If possible, I really hope to meet him at the tournament."

"Tanya, calm down—" The attendant immediately felt immense pressure and forced a smile.

"She's not an adventurer at all. She could never appear."

In the library of Lexham, Da Vinci was busy in his laboratory.

Various liquids bubbled in test tubes.

Da Vinci, conducting experiments, was in a serious state. His monocle flashed with magic circles, precisely calculating the dosage of each material.

Da Vinci worked attentively for a long time and finally filtered out a tiny red crystal particle from the large amount of bright red liquid.

This tiny red crystal emitted a mysterious energy aura, more brilliant than any precious gem in the world.

Da Vinci stared blankly at the small crystal before him, his expression complex. He stood frozen, not knowing what he was thinking.

At that moment, Rosetti entered carrying five stacks of books Da Vinci needed, and placed them on the table with a thud.

"Huff!" Rosetti sighed, wiping sweat from her forehead. Seeing Da Vinci staring blankly, she said, "Da Vinci? What's wrong? If you're tired, go rest. Don't push yourself here. Your health is more important than research."

"Success!"

"What? What did you say?!"

"Success! I found the correct direction to create the Philosopher's Stone!" Da Vinci shouted excitedly.

"No way?" Rosetti felt incredulous. She knew Da Vinci had been researching the Philosopher's Stone for nearly ten years without even a glimpse of one. "Let me see!"

"This one," Da Vinci said, holding up the tiny crystal from the dish for Rosetti to see.

"So small?" Rosetti squinted her eyes; she could barely see the red Philosopher's Stone.

"Don't dismiss it for being small. This is the essence extracted from a huge amount of material. Unfortunately, it's only a semi-finished product."

Da Vinci said with regret.

"After all this time, you only made a semi-finished product?!" Rosetti exclaimed.

"Look closely." Da Vinci picked up the tiny semi-finished Philosopher's Stone with tweezers; it crumbled into powder at a light pinch. "According to the precious manuscripts left by alchemy pioneers, a true Philosopher's Stone wouldn't be this fragile."

Rosetti was stunned. "Does that mean all this was for nothing?"

"No, I've found the correct direction. If I continue researching, I can likely create a true Philosopher's Stone." Da Vinci lowered his head, looking at the jet-black alchemical long spear confiscated from the enemy by Merlin. The ouroboros pattern on it gleamed.

"Thanks to Mr. Merlin bringing the alchemical weapon made by Flamel, I studied it carefully and gained a lot of useful insights."

"This alchemical long spear actually contains many fragments of semi-finished Philosopher's Stones. If used correctly, its true power might rival that of a divine artifact."

"Although we are both students of Democritus, I must admit that Flamel's talent far surpasses mine. He long ago glimpsed the true meaning of the Philosopher's Stone."

On this path, he has walked far ahead, while I have only just touched the door.

title: Chapter 27 — Rule Incarnation: The Three Sages (Extra)
content:
Chapter 27 — Rule Incarnation: The Three Sages (Extra)

Volume 25 · Chapter 27

Rosetti patted Da Vinci's shoulder and encouraged her, "It's all right. With your talent, you'll certainly surpass Flamel someday."

"It's too difficult," Da Vinci sighed and recalled, "Back when I studied alchemy alongside him under Democritus, he already had unique insights. He was extraordinarily gifted — almost as if he was born to crack the mystery of the Philosopher's Stone."

"Don't lose heart," Rosetti gathered the books on the table, poured a cup of tea and handed it to Da Vinci. "By the way, why are you alchemists so obsessed with studying the Philosopher's Stone?"

Da Vinci took the tea from Rosetti and said flatly, "To understand the true nature of this world."

"To understand the true nature of the world?" Rosetti didn't understand.

"Humanity has繁衍ed for countless ages, yet we have never escaped the control of the gods. All things in this world are foolish, none being an exception. It is precisely because we do not know the true nature of the world. In the eyes of those lofty gods, we are nothing but chess pieces — while *it*..." Da Vinci paused and said seriously, "...is the player."

"That doesn't sound right. Aren't we humans living in our own era now? The Goddess Maria preached by the Holy Light Church was supposedly the leader of humanity in legend. After being reborn, she forged new rules and protects humanity from the heavens. Whether or not this story is true, it counts as a typical case of breaking free from the gods' control, doesn't it?" Rosetti refuted in confusion.

"The gods I'm referring to aren't like the Holy Light Goddess, nor the Old Gods from the previous Era Eight. They are things that cannot be described in language — entities that know all rules, to the point that they themselves have become part of the world," Da Vinci emphasized.

"Then... Da Vinci, I'm a bit confused about what you're saying," Rosetti gave an awkward smile.

"Rosetti, you've accompanied me for so long. When you have free time, haven't you read a lot of unofficial histories about the Age of the Gods?"

"No."

"Then you must have heard about the King of the Gods, Odin — and how he lost his eyesight?"

"Of course. Odin wanted to obtain incomparable power and hoped to drink from the Well of Origin, the fountain of all life. But the price was offering his sharp eyes to the three Norns who guard the well." Rosetti spoke confidently.

"Exactly. The indescribable things I'm referring to are the three Norns who guard the Well of Life," Da Vinci said with piercing eyes.

"Huh? Is there something strange about them? Aren't they just like the Old Gods of the previous era?" Rosetti was completely baffled.

"No! The Norns are even older than the gods of the previous era. At the dawn of the world, they may have been incarnations of the rules themselves," Da Vinci paused and slowly continued, "In alchemy, the Norns are known as the Three Sages. No one who studies alchemy can bypass them. The founder of alchemy, Zosimos, once recorded in his own manuscripts that the Three Sages might very well be three Philosopher's Stones."

"You're saying the three goddesses in mythology are three stones? That's too ridiculous," Rosetti frowned, finding it hard to believe.

"This is what Zosimos, the founder of alchemy, said. I think it also makes some sense. The Philosopher's Stone is precisely the embodied form of the world's true nature, while the Norns are incarnations of the rules. There must be some connection between the two," Da Vinci said calmly.

"I have a feeling you're becoming more and more like a charlatan, Da Vinci," Rosetti frowned deeply.

At that moment, the laboratory door was pushed open, and Merlin's family walked in.

They had learned from Hobbes that Da Vinci was in Rexham, so they stopped by on their way to see her, hoping she could help answer some questions — especially the half of a strange map they had brought back from the Chaotic Seas.

"So she really is here. Every time she returns, she buries herself in this laboratory," Merlin remarked.

"Long time no see," Alice greeted.

"What are you all doing here with nothing to do?"

"Kyaa~ hon!" Chris let out a cry, feeling that this place was very different from the outside. Books were piled high everywhere, forming mountains of them.

Chris had always been small and unremarkable, but the moment she called out, Da Vinci and Rosetti's attention immediately focused on her.

After a brief exchange of words, Da Vinci and Rosetti managed to piece together Chris's origins.

Though greatly shocked that life could be born from a stone, they maintained their composure.

After all, the world was vast and full of wonders, and they assumed Merlin and Alice had encountered something extraordinary during their adventures.

"I see. So this child inherited your bloodline? You're living together without being married — should I congratulate you or not?" Rosetti asked awkwardly, thinking to herself, *I thought they were going through a relationship crisis, and now they unexpectedly got a child? They seem to really like this little one. Does that mean Arnold has no chance? Hey hey, this is my opportunity!*

"No need, no need. Even if we don't get married, we will fulfill our responsibilities as parents," Alice said, her face flushing red.

"I see," Rosetti was overjoyed inside, lifted her teacup and smiled. "You scared me. I thought Alice had grown tired of Merlin and was planning to dump him."

"Hah. I heard from Hobbes that Miss Rosetti went around saying I was being cheated on, and that this is the consequence of living off a woman. Merlin said with a complicated expression.
