Merlin's gaze became serious, carefully looking at the guards behind Rothschild, “It doesn't seem like it? It's not the same as the one I fought you for, right? You must be mistaken.”

“The Hero's inheritance armor is a treasure of the Holy Church, and it changes according to the wearer.” Alice explained seriously, “Although there are many different changes in the inheritance armor, the Goddess' incantations on the wearer will not change, and I can tell at a glance...

.“....Merlin looked again, even though the Hero's inheritance armor had changed in style, the patterns were indeed the same as the one he had fought for Alice.

“What a ridiculous thing? You sold the armor to a merchant of the Rothschild family, and then threw the money into the Rothschild family's racecourse, inside and out, they made a profit, and you even lost your underwear....Alice covered her face and really didn't want to comment on what Merlin had done.

....Merlin suddenly felt a headache, at this moment, he felt how terrifying the commercial family was, not the terrifying power, but the enormous influence, encompassing all the human kingdoms....

“....”..Alice looked at the armor on the guard's back with a melancholy gaze and muttered, “If we could return this armor to the Holy Church, we wouldn't have to be so hardworking now.

Rothschild nodded to everyone and then sat down with his majestic guards in the guest seats.

The guard was named McReddy, a talented person cultivated by the family with all their wealth, with formidable strength.

He was under thirty years old and could look down on everyone, making anyone who dared to challenge the family's authority bow their heads.

However, McReddy was a low-key person, disliking being in the spotlight and showing off his strength, but rather serving as an invisible family guardian with unwavering loyalty.

Everyone who had seen McReddy's strength, except for a few friendly people within the family, were unfortunate enemies who took this man's secret to the grave.

)了SE2元

“Sir, why are you here to watch the race?” McReddy obviously didn't like it here and asked quietly, “The brawls of these villagers are meaningless.”

“I heard that Mr. Chairman will bring out something this time, and I'm very interested.” Rothschild rubbed his withered hand on his cane, “It's about the endless treasure in the gods' heritage, I must come.

“Gods' heritage. ...McReddy frowned, obviously knowing the legend, where are the ancient gods' burial places, who knows what priceless treasures are inside? That's why the family head came to watch.

“What do you think of these adventurers' strength? Can they enter your eyes?” Rothschild asked with a smile, “I must come.

McReddy's gaze swept over the crowded adventurers below and then closed his eyes, “No, a bunch of amateurs, none of them can fight, they can only attract crowds, but if it's a real fight, I can take on all of them, only a few people can make me take them seriously.”

This arrogant statement seemed like a joke, but the dominant air of McReddy, the guardian of the world's richest man, couldn't be faked.

As the guardian of the world's richest man, if he didn't have strong power, how could he make countless hidden enemies bow their heads?

Although McReddy didn't say that all the people here were trash, most of the adventurers were not worth mentioning in his eyes!

“Haha.....Rothschild smiled and his frail body trembled, “No wonder you're you, as long as you're here, I can sleep peacefully, I don't know how many people are plotting against me.

.....McReddy didn't respond, obviously acknowledging this praise.

“I know you don't like crowded places, you can go back tomorrow, I'll stay here to watch the final result of the competition.” Rothschild said.

“牡」玩

“Ah? But I need to protect you.” McReddy said surprisingly.

“Here are all the adventurers, what danger can there be? Moreover, there are many guards following me in secret, there's no problem.” Rothschild hesitated and said anxiously, “After you go back, take good care of my son, this mischievous child is not studious, I'm afraid that if I'm not with him, he might cause some trouble? In the family, only you can make him behave.”

McReddy frowned, thinking about the delinquent in the family, and hesitated.

The Rothschild family has lasted for hundreds of years, and there have been frequent commercial geniuses, but when it comes to the grandson, it doesn't work, and there is a tendency to go bankrupt sooner or later.

For the stability of the entire family, McReddy bowed slightly and replied quietly, “As you wish.”

The old Mr. Chairman on the dais was quite pleased, as he could invite the world's richest man, so he took the opportunity to announce the second guest--

“The second one, a noble from the Spanish Kingdom, who is young and has already assisted the royal family, Alphonso!”

At this time, a young man in his twenties, with black hair and black eyes, walked alone to the dais, with heavy black circles under his eyes, as if he hadn't slept for a long time.

A black cloak studded with gems, combined with his unique appearance, made this young man the most dazzling star in the night, like a bottomless abyss, his gaze was impossible to see through.

Alphonso came alone, and he didn't seem to fear any danger, and was indifferent to any matter.

This young teacher was not as famous as the Rothschild family's head, but with his unique aura, he instantly attracted a lot of people, causing cheers.

“Uh!” McReddy looked at Alphonso's back and felt a bit ashamed, trying to peek into Alphonso's mind, but it was like a stone sinking into the sea, and he couldn't tell the truth of the other party? !

“What's wrong?” Rothschild noticed McReddy's unusual behavior.

“This guy called Alphonso...is quite unusual...McReddy hesitated and said.

Alphonso's face showed boredom, preparing to sit directly in the guest seats, but his gaze suddenly focused on Alice who was holding a child in the crowd.

He slightly narrowed his eyes, his face was uncertain, and others couldn't guess what the young teacher was thinking--

That girl's innocent and stupid eyes..

It was just like the Queen Josephine who was strangled by the rope.

I was in the suburbs recently, just got home yesterday, so the recent updates are sparse.

However, I will continue to update according to the rules later, so please rest assured.

title: Chapter 20 — The Beautiful Only Deserves the Strongest
content:
Chapter 20 — The Beautiful Only Deserves the Strongest

Volume 27 · Chapter 20

“Huh?” Merlin had sharp eyes and noticed that Alfonso on the main stage seemed to be staring at Alice. He couldn't help but ask, “Do you know him?”

“How could I possibly know him? I've never been to the Kingdom of Spain...” Alice was also confused inside. This young national advisor, full of talent, was the first time she had ever seen him.

“Hahaha!” Little Chris showed her baby teeth and laughed, “It must be because Mom is too beautiful~”

“Flippant, who did you learn that from?” Alice scolded on the surface, but her heart was abnormally happy.

Merlin frowned, stood in front of Alice, and looked far away at Alfonso on the main stage, silently making the world's universal gesture, middle finger up.

Alfonso was clearly taken aback, looked deeply at the unremarkable Merlin, didn't take it to heart, smiled and turned back to his seat.

“Father, I've never heard of this Alfonso. Is he a big shot?” Mr. Karl asked curiously.

“Then you're too ignorant. The king of the Kingdom of Spain is very young, and Alfonso is his teacher, holding a high status. His presence is no different from the Spanish king himself coming personally.” Old Taylor, who had seen a lot, had a basic understanding of this young national advisor.

“Someone so young is the king's teacher? What can he teach? Normally, aren't only old men full of knowledge qualified to be teachers of the royal family?” Mr. Karl didn't quite understand.

“I'm not very clear on that either. Perhaps his appearance doesn't match his age. It's not an unusual thing.” Old Taylor said in a low voice.

Mr. Dawson, seeing Alfonso take his seat, continued to announce to everyone the third important guest to arrive at this competition—

“The third one, she possesses a beauty that makes others envious, causing countless talented men to fall at her feet...”

“???” Alice frowned, listening to the introduction, it seemed a beautiful woman was coming?

“Too exaggerated an introduction...” Merlin chuckled dryly, thinking to himself, if you're going to say it nicely, I'll lose if she's more beautiful than Asmodeus.

“She is the accomplished and talented flower of France, Princess Margaret!!!” Mr. Dawson announced with passion.

“Ah! ?” Alice was greatly surprised, her mouth couldn't close, recalling that fox spirit Margaret, she was still a bit resentful about it. She didn't expect her to come too, it was truly a narrow escape with an enemy!

“Er...”

Merlin's expression became strange, covering his face and not speaking, truly not wanting to see this princess, who was a nuisance with her entanglements.

In stark contrast to the two's rejecting reactions, the audience present and the vast majority of male adventurers, upon hearing that the princess known for her beauty had arrived, could no longer suppress their excitement.

Thunderous applause and cheers instantly spread throughout the arena, making many women below roll their eyes and feel very uncomfortable.

“Oh~” Mr. Karl rubbed his chin, “Margaret, that's truly a famous beauty far and wide, don't you think so Merlin?”

Merlin was immediately embarrassed, thinking to himself, don't ask me about that? It makes it seem like I have an affair with Margaret!

“Stare—” Alice suspiciously stared at Merlin, as if watching how he would answer.

“Cough...” Merlin coughed twice to cover his embarrassment, under pressure, he said, “I don't know either.”

Margaret slowly walked out amidst the cheers of the crowd, followed by the knight Blaze who guarded her throughout, after all, the princess was the most beautiful, and he was also worried someone would have ill intentions.

The chairman of this competition, Dawson, wanted to invite the old king of France, but the old king was in poor health, so he let Margaret come instead.

This excited Margaret to no end, she was just愁着 (worried about) how to easily leave the palace, and came without thinking.

Margaret wasn't very interested in the adventurers' competition, but she had a clear idea in her mind, Merlin came from a remote town, and the adventurers' competition would definitely have him participate.

So if it wasn't for seeing the man she could never have, Margaret probably wouldn't have come so enthusiastically.

Margaret wore an elegant purple long dress, not losing the youthful vitality, but also emitting the nobility of the royal family. As soon as she appeared, the males below couldn't suppress themselves, letting out阵阵 wolf howls.

Far away, the four people from Katowice, seeing Margaret on the high stage, couldn't help but praise her—

“This is the famous flower of France? She is indeed very beautiful.” Boz nodded, acknowledging Margaret's beauty.

“Haha, only a woman as beautiful as this, if I could get to know her, I'd be willing to live ten years less.” Noe's eyes became passionate, instantly captivated by Margaret's charm.

“Hmph! What are you doing having white daydreams? A beautiful woman is only worthy of a strong man; you?” Gabriel looked at Noe for a few seconds, disdainfully, “You're not worthy!”

“What do you mean? I'm not worthy, does that mean you are?” Noe's eyes flashed with deathly anger.

“Exactly, of course I am worthy. How could Princess Margaret look at someone as weak as you?” Gabriel smirked.

“Am I weak? Are you sure?” Noe's waist sword was already eager to move, having long wanted to settle the score with the other two.

“Your sonic sword technique does have something, but I've already seen through it. To deal with you, I don't need to use my second sword.” Gabriel said seriously.

“The two of you are arguing about what?” Shawn, as Boz's direct student, looked calmer than the other two, “Is it worth it for a woman?”

“What business is it of yours?” Gabriel's face was unpleased.

“Wouldn't you be moved?” Noe asked in surprise.

“Of course I'm moved, but I won't be like the two of you and have a meaningless argument here.” Shawn paused, meaningfully saying, “I'll perform well in the competition. As long as she sees my strength, winning her over isn't a matter of minutes.”

Boz, who had been frowning all along, heard Shawn's words and slowly relaxed his eyebrows, thinking the other two still lacked a bit of fire, far from as calm as his own student. It seemed this time it would still be up to Shawn's performance.

When Margaret first came, she wasn't bothered by the audience's cheers, instead searching for something, her eyes scanning below constantly.

Finally, Margaret spotted Merlin's figure, immediately smiled, lifted her skirt, and tapped tap tap came down from the main stage directly towards Merlin.

“Your Highness! Please calm down!” Blaze saw Margaret's actions and felt great pressure. He was very clear the princess was coming for Merlin, but he was already married. A princess having an ambiguous relationship with a married man would be a loss of face for the royal family!

“This?” Chairman Dawson had an expression of surprise, not knowing what was going on?

“Very sorry, Mr. Chairman, please continue.” After saying sorry, Blaze hurriedly chased after her.

Margaret pushed through the crowd, directly into Merlin's arms, happily shouting, “Master Merlin! Long time no see~”

“Ah!” Merlin felt a fragrant breeze, Margaret's soft body rushing into his arms.

“...?” Alice saw this scene and instantly turned to stone, stammering and unable to speak.

Everyone else was also shocked into stone, including the Katowice group who had almost fought over Margaret's ownership.

Noe: “...What situation is this!?”

Gabriel: “This is truly ghostly!”

Shawn: “...Did I not wake up this morning?”

title: Chapter 21 — This Chapter is 3,000 Words (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 21 — This Chapter is 3,000 Words (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 27 · Chapter 21

The three top adventurers of Katovitz were staring wide-eyed, unable to comprehend what was happening in front of them, wondering if they had made a mistake somewhere.

Only the guildmaster, Boz, expressed a hint of doubt, wondering if the unknown black-iron adventurer had some secret connection with the French royal family.

"!!!" Mr. Dawson, on the podium, was so shocked that he even spat out his false teeth. That was the jewel of France, how could she be paired with an unknown black-iron adventurer? Was it possible that the famous first beauty of France had already been taken?

The stunned onlookers began to murmur, guessing who this black-iron adventurer was, who could have gained the favor of the French princess.

Among all the adventurers on the field, Merlin was the least noticeable. The royal family of France, however, had chosen Merlin, which was clearly unfair.

Many viewers began to pay attention to Merlin, even suspecting that he was not ordinary, perhaps with extraordinary abilities, like the champion from last year, Klowno?

However, the majority of the audience was envious, jealous, and resentful. Especially the men who had just been howling like wolves, now they were all depressed, secretly belittling Merlin behind his back.

It seemed that only Old Taylor and the Karl family remained calm. Although newspapers and most people believed that Alice had saved France from the crisis, these two knew the truth, that it was Merlin's efforts. It was definitely Merlin who had some communication with Margaret before, otherwise, how could a princess be so close to a black-iron adventurer?

Seeing their beloved princess so close to an adventurer who was even worse than themselves, Noah, Gabriel, and Shawn couldn't help but grumble below.

"This guy is sleeping with the French princess?" Noah frowned, feeling bitter. "He's just an unknown nobody, how did the princess fall for him?"

"Damn it! Who among the adventurers is better than him? He's blind!" Gabriel, with his hot temper, clenched his fists, thinking that the princess was deceived by his good looks.

"Yes! It must be that, isn't he just pale?" Shawn spat on the ground, almost wanting to challenge Merlin right there if it weren't the opening ceremony.

Margaret was leaning on Merlin's chest, greedily inhaling the familiar scent.

"Merlin, I miss you so much~"

"Uh... Merlin's face darkened, feeling a bit lost, so he raised his hands to show his innocence. "Your Majesty, please respect yourself."

Alice was already sweating like a bug on a hot plate, feeling both angry and anxious. "You lewd woman! Shameful, let go!"

Margaret didn't listen, instead, she leaned in closer to Alice, challenging her. "Shut up, I'm just catching up with Merlin, what does that have to do with you?"

"Catching up with someone doesn't mean hugging them? Don't take advantage of this opportunity, don't act like I don't exist!" Alice gritted her teeth, almost drawing her sword if she weren't holding Chris.

...Merlin sighed, thinking that he had made it clear before. Why didn't this woman give up?

Karl whispered in Old Taylor's ear. "Old man, Merlin has even attracted the attention of the French royal family. Isn't that a bad thing?"

Old Taylor didn't say anything, but he knew. He was on Alice's side, and if Merlin was taken by Margaret, the guild would lose a great warrior. He couldn't let Mr. Dawson help correct the relationship between Merlin and Alice, and it would be better to keep it as it is.

Chris, in her mother's arms, blinked her big eyes curiously. "Mommy, who is that auntie?"

"Vixen!" Alice answered without any politeness.

"What's a vixen? Can I eat it?" Chris's eyes lit up.

"A vixen is a bad woman who wants to take your dad away!" Alice said without any hesitation.

"...Chris puffed up her cheeks, huffing and puffing. "Chris doesn't like people who take away my dad. My dad is my mommy's! Hmph~"

"???" Merlin heard that his daughter was already angry, so he quickly pushed Margaret away and said seriously. "Your Majesty, I am now a father, please be respectful."

Blaze came over and forced a sad face. "Your Majesty, you are here representing the king, you need to be careful with your identity."

Margaret ignored Blaze and looked at Chris in Alice's arms, who looked very much like Merlin.

This made Margaret feel uncomfortable. After so long, the two of them even had a child together. Wouldn't that mean she had no chance?

"Why? Why does Merlin have a child with her but not with me? I also want to have a child with Merlin."

"!!!" Merlin was shocked, thinking that this woman's brain was probably not working. Did she think she could just have a child with him? Was it that simple?

"Your Majesty!" Blaze was sweating cold, if he went back and told the king, he would definitely think that Margaret had brought disgrace to the royal family. "Your Majesty, you are the princess of France, please don't say such things in public. Otherwise, the king will blame me. Please be a little more reasonable."

Margaret looked at her old subordinate Blaze, thought for a moment, and only stomped her foot in place. Although she seemed to be more reasonable on the surface, she still wasn't giving up, thinking about taking Merlin away.

Mr. Dawson, on the podium, saw that the disturbance had settled, so he cleared his throat to attract everyone's attention. "Cough cough! Next is the fourth guest, the talented and beautiful Miss Elizabeth of Great Britain, the Queen of the United Kingdom!"

The audience's attention was immediately shifted. This time, it wasn't a beautiful princess, but a real powerhouse, a queen who had come to watch the competition, undoubtedly increasing the value of this competition.

Moreover, she was a beautiful queen. Among the human world's female kings, Elizabeth was absolutely someone who could charm a crowd. And under her rule, Britain was a strong country in the human world, her wise reputation had spread to every corner of the world, and she was respected and admired by many.

Elizabeth, dressed in a pure white long dress, came gracefully, wearing a crown symbolizing royal power. Her exquisite appearance made young, strong men feel their legs weaken.

The seventh thorn knight, Morison, was responsible for Elizabeth's safety, and he followed her with a respectful attitude, keeping an eye out for anyone who might be a threat to the queen.

After Elizabeth got on the stage, she waved to everyone, receiving a round of applause and cheers.

Unlike Margaret, the howling of the men disappeared, replaced by a gentle response.

After all, Elizabeth was a queen, and even if she liked her beauty, it was more of an appreciation, and more importantly, it was respect.

Noah: "The queen of Britain is really beautiful. I bet she was a troublemaker in her youth. Margaret is far behind."

Gabriel: "Since I can't get the favor of Princess Margaret, maybe I should try to win the queen's heart this time. It's not bad!"

Shawn looked at the two lecherous men and couldn't help but scoff. "How can you even think about the queen? I think this beautiful queen, combined with our guildmaster, would be very nice. Our guildmaster is a super strong warrior, and I'm sure the queen would appreciate him."

...Boz smiled and, after seeing Elizabeth, he was moved. He agreed with Shawn's words but shook his head. "It's not possible. The difference in status is too great. A queen like Elizabeth is absolutely not going to look down on us, a group of muddy adventurers."

Elizabeth, after greeting everyone, didn't sit down on the guest seat as usual, but walked down the steps from the high platform.

Elizabeth, who had just been calm and composed like a high and mighty queen, suddenly felt very nervous as she walked down the platform, almost tripping and making a fool of herself.

Morison saw this and quickly helped Elizabeth, subconsciously asking, "Your Majesty, are you okay?"

"..I'm...fine." Elizabeth forced a smile, but as soon as she thought about the person she was going to see, she became very timid.

"Is it necessary to do this? Your Majesty? You don't have to flatter anyone. Who doesn't respect you? The knights are willing to fight to the death for you." Morison said seriously.

"It's necessary, and it's not a bad thing." Elizabeth whispered, thinking, "Can I avoid it? I can't avoid it now. I still haven't paid back the money I owe, and if I come to the palace to collect it, even a few thorn knights won't be enough to kill."

"Okay." Morison nodded and didn't say anything else, but he couldn't help but grumble to himself. "Just a strong adventurer, is it necessary for Your Majesty to personally ask? Although Your Majesty says it's her friend, I don't know if it's true or not? Your Majesty is in a high position, besides Master Gregory, she may also know other adventurers."

Under the watchful eyes of everyone, Elizabeth walked straight to Merlin, or more accurately, to the Ergin great sword master who couldn't help but build friendship!

"Oh~" Merlin saw Elizabeth coming to see him, and his mouth let out a slightly proud sound, recalling the intimate things that happened in the small house before, now he felt a bit embarrassed~

"That... Elizabeth looked very uncomfortable, seemingly calm on the surface, but her legs under the skirt were a bit shaky. To show respect, she bowed her high and mighty head in front of everyone, almost making the crown symbolizing royal power fall to the ground. "M...Merlin, are you...okay?"

A queen who was at the top of the power hierarchy, controlling the lives and deaths of countless people, bowed her noble head to a lowly black-iron adventurer?!

Boz's face twisted into a grotesque expression, his expression was so shocked that he couldn't speak, and his eyes were filled with disbelief.

"!!?"

z(°O°I)

title: Chapter 22 — More Updates Soon
content:
Chapter 22 — More Updates Soon

Volume 27 · Chapter 22

Alice saw the Queen of Britain rushing toward Merlin, and she was stunned, her brain temporarily going blank.

Looking at how Elizabeth and Merlin were communicating, it was obvious they had known each other for a long time...

Alice couldn't help but recall what Merlin had said before, and only then did she slightly recover her wits, wondering if it was really true that Merlin had been rude to the queen.

This made Alice look at Elizabeth's eyes differently, her heart filled with vigilance, always feeling that Merlin and Elizabeth had a deeply meaningful relationship.

A look of astonishment froze on Morrison's face. He had heard before that the Queen would visit an adventurer friend, but he never expected it to be him!

Obviously, Morrison hadn't forgotten that he had gone with Merlin into the dangerous mysterious sea domain. Without this black-iron adventurer's help, the group very likely would have perished on the island.

Morrison looked at Merlin, who seemed somewhat smug, and thought that since even the Queen would proactively come to pay her respects, this black-iron adventurer must not be simple.

Recalling their only two meetings, once he had won against him in an arm-wrestling match, and the second time, facing the terrifying North Sea Giant Kraken, he showed no fear, even saving a whole ship of...

Morrison's gaze toward Merlin held a few more appreciative thoughts, thinking that no wonder the Queen would proactively show goodwill, apparently this person is a talent not to be missed, and a black-iron adventurer who has bowed to become a knight of thorns.

Originally, upon learning that the Queen would deign to meet a black-iron adventurer, Morrison's heart was very unpleasant. But after seeing it was Merlin, his doubts had long vanished.

E billion small treatment.

Although this person is a black-iron adventurer, his foresight is extraordinary, his strength is exceptional, and his power seems to be above mine. If he could become a knight of thorns, it would be a great boon for the entire Purple Hibiscus Knight Order.

Merlin looked at Elizabeth, who was silent, and grinned, saying with deep meaning, "My body is very good, it's just that I have some anger in my heart."

"Huh? ... What's the matter? If you need help, don't be polite." Elizabeth asked nervously, her gaze darting about, not even having the courage to look at Merlin, thinking that this is someone even her sister, who is ruthless, can't suppress, and she is her biggest creditor!

"If Her Majesty is willing to pay back what she owes me, I should be very happy." Merlin showed a faint smile, implying that he hadn't forgotten the huge hiring fee, but he knows that since Great Britain just went through a civil war, Elizabeth won't be able to fulfill her promise in the short term.

"Hmph!" Elizabeth frowned, thinking that he actually mentioned this, had to forcibly change the subject, saying today... it's really good, you think? Merlin gentleman...

"Hehe~" Merlin smiled, but didn't let Elizabeth make a fool of herself in public; instead, he gave this Queen some face. It's not that he doesn't want to, but that she can't pay no matter what, and if she dies, she'll really never come back. Better to find an opportunity to play this beautiful Queen well, thinking about it is quite stimulating.

Margaret, standing beside Elizabeth, had her gaze already filled with hostility, and the more she looked at the Queen of Great Britain, the more she felt her relationship with Merlin was unusual.

It was just like old lovers meeting, with unspeakable past events...

Margaret thought she could contend with Alice relying on her status, but now an equal to her own father had come to stir things up, making her very angry.

"What relationship do you have with Merlin, you old woman! Don't think that just because you have strong soldiers and strong horses you dare to snatch men from me, I'll turn your palace into... .Huh?! ! !"

Blaze, standing beside Margaret, saw the Princess firing at the Queen of Great Britain, and had long been scared into a cold sweat, lightning-fast covering Margaret's "fragrant" little mouth.

A princess daring to insult a foreign monarch in public is not a small matter, but a political event between two countries, and not even the old King of France dares to publicly evaluate other royals.

"Your Highness, little princess, you must calm down. If you anger Queen Elizabeth, the King will definitely severely rebuke you when he returns, and I can't run away either." Blaze sweated, afraid that Margaret would cause a big mess, and still attack the Palace of Great Britain with the gun team? That's declaring war!

"Huh?! ! !" Margaret refused to yield, having practiced martial arts since she was young, she fears no Elizabeth, if she doesn't agree, just challenge her one-on-one!

Blaze showed a bitter face, every time he comes out with Margaret there's no good thing, it's considered a bitter task.

To prevent Margaret from speaking wildly, Blaze straightly covered Margaret's mouth, preparing to open the ceremony and then let go.

Morrison's face was ugly as he glanced at Margaret, seeing that the Queen didn't say anything, he treated it as if he hadn't heard. He looked at Merlin and smiled, greeting, "Mr. Merlin, we meet again."

Merlin looked at Morrison, still having some impression, "Oh, is it you?"

Elizabeth felt very surprised, and curiously asked, "Do we know each other?"

"Your Majesty, I said before, when we went to investigate the chaotic sea domain, it was Mr. Merlin who, under the attack of the North Sea Giant Kraken, held back the situation and let us return alive, otherwise...." Morrison shook his head and smiled wryly, saying, "Probably all of us on the ship would have been buried in the sea."

"Is that so."

Elizabeth secretly glanced at Merlin, no wonder Morrison could survive after encountering the legendary Kraken? So Merlin was also on the ship, it's not strange.

"Mom, who are they again?" Chris, seeing so many unfamiliar faces, was full of curiosity.

Alice lowered her head and said in a very small voice, "Suspected fox spirit..."

"Another fox spirit? How many fox spirits are there?" Chris's little brain couldn't keep up, feeling like dad had dropped into a wolf pack, and there's not enough to divide.

"You have to ask your dad, what good things he's done~" Alice's vinegar jar in her heart was shaking, thinking that she watched him so tightly why this guy still managed to hook up with so many people?

"What are you saying to Chris?" Merlin vaguely heard Alice saying bad things about him, destroying his tall image in his beloved daughter's eyes.

"Say, how did you hook up with the Queen? You two aren't... secret, are they?" Alice asked with a bad complexion.

"It's just...... just Elizabeth was imprisoned by her sister during the civil war, and I rescued her, that's all..." Merlin spread his hands, indicating his innocence, but the things in the small wooden house, even if he died, couldn't say.

Alice half-believed and half-doubted, feeling that Merlin hadn't told the whole truth. Would saving a life make a high-and-mighty queen bow?

Not very likely, maybe Merlin this lecherous guy, and the Queen have an inseparable secret relationship!

Alice's senses were quite keen, staring at Merlin without speaking, but she could never have imagined that in front of herself...

Is the person she both loves and hates in her heart...

Is the Elkin Sword Hero she admires and respects!

Even more so, a terrible man who made the entire Great Britain Kingdom helpless, and even made the royal family submit!

"Grandpa, you see? Even the Queen respects Merlin so much?" Mr. Kal showed an incredible look.

"Ha...." Old Taylor shook his head and smiled silently, muttering lowly

"I used to think Alice could become an external thorn knight, because her own strength has become stronger and her reputation has spread far and wide."

"Originally the royalty looked at Merlin's face to offer an olive branch to Alice, trying to indirectly draw him in..."

"It seems we still underestimated Merlin."

title: Chapter 23 — Sorry I Fell Asleep Yesterday
content:
Chapter 23 — Sorry I Fell Asleep Yesterday

Volume 27 · Chapter 23

“Just because Queen Elizabeth wanted to attract talent, she reached out to me...it's not very honorable.

Old Taylor shook his head. Although he is a citizen of Great Britain, he wouldn't easily let go of a talent like Merlin. How could he just hand it over?

Mr. Carl looked at Merlin with a strange expression. Even the royal family is eager to favor Merlin. This guy's future is limitless! Who knows if he'll ever be satisfied with just being an adventurer.

Boz, who was just saying that Queen Elizabeth's status is high, she would never lower her proud head for any adventurer, suddenly had his face swollen. Boz felt his face burning, and his dignity was in danger among his three subordinates.

How could that be? A high and mighty queen would never be so eager to please a black-iron adventurer? Maybe she has a leg?

Boz guessed in his mind, but looking at Elizabeth and Merlin, it didn't seem as obvious as with Margaret. This made him very confused.

Noah, Shawn, and Gabriel all looked at Boz. It's rare for the leader to be humiliated, and they wanted to hear Boz's explanation.

Boz averted his gaze, feeling some pressure, and needed to maintain his dignity among his three subordinates. So he said...

“It seems I underestimated the weight of the foreign thorn knights. Queen Elizabeth clearly came for that Alice the magic sword, that black-iron adventurer is just a side attraction.

The three of them suddenly understood, thinking Boz was right. They thought Merlin had some impressive identity, but it turned out to be a worthless man who just rides on other people's coattails.

Shawn: “That should be it. That Alice was recently appointed as a foreign thorn knight. It's understandable for the queen to come and see her.

Noah: “I was shocked—I thought this black-iron adventurer had some ability. It turns out to be a worthless man who just rides on other people's coattails!

Gabriel: “You need to be strong yourself to forge iron. Such a person who relies on others is not worth mentioning. Without the protection of a big shot, aren't you just a soft foot?”

Boz nodded in satisfaction, looking at Merlin from afar, thinking that even if you know some queen or princess, how will that help you on the battlefield? Ultimately, you'll still be trampled under our feet.

The audience in the arena were whispering privately, wondering who this unknown person was? How could the royal families of two countries both favor him?

However, as fellow adventurers, they didn't buy it. Most were angry, eager for the match to start so they could teach this arrogant black-iron adventurer a lesson.

Mr. Dawson scratched his head, wondering, “This black-iron adventurer from Lexum is unfamiliar. What's his background? How could the royal families of France and Britain both be so fond of him?”

“Next is the fifth heavyweight guest, the first-ever leader of a foreign race to attend the event, giving high praise to the adventurers' guild for its 100 years of establishment!”

“He is the most noble leader of the United Kingdom, the first among the nine kings of foreign races, the great elf king, Sindaril!!!”

Although the elf king is from a foreign race, the legendary stories about him are deeply ingrained in people's hearts.

Leading the non-human races in a great migration, establishing the United Kingdom—events worthy of being recorded in history, which everyone remembers.

The audience cheered more enthusiastically than before, and many people who admired the elf king even stood up to express their respect for this ruler.

Although the elf king's power is no longer as strong as it once was, the contributions he made in his prime are worth the applause of humans.

“What? The elf king from a foreign race has come?” Rothschild, sitting in the guest seats, was a bit panicked, sitting on pins and needles.

“Is the foreign leader's name so famous?” McRae is too young and hasn't heard much about the elf king.

“When I was a child, my grandfather told me that the elf king's power is so strong that it is probably the strongest being alive. No one can provoke it. Our family's businesses are spread all over the world, but we have never been able to establish a foothold in the United Kingdom.” Rothschild sighed, “I never expected this lord to come to the scene in person. I didn't even get any news.

“First among the strongest?” McRae's eyes flashed with a hint of combat spirit, and he wasn't very impressed.

“No.” Rothschild stood up slowly, dragging his old body, “I want to go and welcome him.”

Only the Spanish master Alfonso from Spain remained calm. He looked at the elf king Sindaril walking out from afar, and a barely noticeable smile appeared on his face.

The elf king appeared beside Mr. Dawson, followed by the loyal knight Sylph, and it seemed that Sherry had not come with him.

Mr. Dawson's face was full of smiles, feeling honored. This is the first time a foreign race leader has cheered for the adventurer's competition, and it may become a turning point for improving relations between humans and foreign races.

Rothschild approached the elf king and showed a merchant's professional smile, “Your Majesty, I am Rothschild of the Rothschild business.”

The world's richest man tried to communicate with the elf king, but before he could even speak, the elf king ignored him and walked down from the stage in front of everyone.

Rothschild's smile froze on his face: the feeling of being turned down is not comfortable. He is the head of a family that is rich enough to rival a country, and everywhere he goes, he is admired and flattered by countless people. This is the first time he has been treated as air by someone, and he is a bit disoriented.

Yes, the elf king is arrogant by nature and looks down on humans from the bottom of his heart, no matter what their status or position is—whether they are royal princes, noblemen, or world rich men.

If Alice wasn't related to Merlin, the elf king might not even have taken her to the sacred land of the dragons.

Among the people in the arena, the elf king might only consider Sylph behind him and the wandering Demon Lord Merlin as his kin, as they are all non-human races.

“Damn it!” McRae had never seen his family boss humiliated, and his heart was suddenly overwhelmed with anger. He took a step forward to scold, but Rothschild stopped him.

“Alright, I've heard a lot about the elf king's character. In his eyes, we are all lowly sinners.” Rothschild shook his head, looking at the elf king's back and sighed, “This is the aura of the strongest being in the world.”

“Hmm?” McRae was confused because he felt that the aura around the elf king was not very strong and was very weak. Was it intentional to suppress his power?

“Has the elf king also come down? This time, won't he still come to greet that black-iron adventurer?” Noah was a bit nervous, as he himself didn't even have a chance. How did this black-iron adventurer make such connections? They are all powerful figures!

“No...it's not possible! A small white face uses flattery to charm Margaret Princess, and then uses his wife to charm Queen Elizabeth. The elf king is a man. Don't tell me he has a unique preference?”

“What are you two thinking about?” Shawn sneered, looking smug, “The elf king coming down is obviously to chat with our leader. A year ago, the princess of the elf race went missing, and the elf king entrusted our leader to help find her. Unfortunately, the knights of Britain got there first.

“Is there such a thing?” Noah was busy practicing and didn't hear much about it, but excluding the champion Krauno, our Katowitz adventurers' guild is the most powerful!

“Haha, the leader's face is really big! Even the famous elf king has to humble himself to greet him.” Gabriel smirked, looking at Merlin from afar—

“It's time to let that black-iron waste see the light!”

“What is the real way to make nobles bow their heads with strength?”

title: Chapter 24 — Disturbance
content:
Chapter 24 — Disturbance

Volume 27 · Chapter 24

Hearing his three subordinates’ chatter, Boz couldn’t help but smile, secretly wiping the sweat from his palms onto his trousers.

He was quite pleased with the praise from others, feeling a bit buoyant and self-important.

Originally, he had been annoyed that an Iron-rank adventurer had stolen all the spotlight at the opening ceremony, but now that the opportunity to shine himself had arrived, he was determined to seize it.

Boz believed his men were right; aside from himself, who else in this arena had ever interacted with the Elf King? Seeing the Elf King walking toward him clearly indicated he was coming to visit him!

Although Boz was not royalty standing at the peak of power, nor a merchant wealthy enough to dominate a region, he still held considerable authority among adventurers.

“You three wait here. I’ll go catch up with the Elf King.”

Noah, Sean, and Gabriel’s eyes showed awe, thinking that as expected of the Guild Master, he carried himself with such dignity, neither humble nor arrogant when facing the leader of another race!

They all felt that the Elf King’s status and reputation were enough to crush Elizabeth and Margaret. After speaking with President Boz, surely everyone would look upon Katowice with new respect.

Even Boz thought so. He felt he needed to act confidently, representing all the adventurers present to communicate with the Elf King, thereby establishing the prestige of the Katowice Adventurers Guild.

Boz approached the Elf King, extending his hand friendly, “Long time no see, Your Majesty the Elf King.”

The Elf King stopped, looked at Boz’s extended hand, and asked in confusion, “Who are you?”

“???”

Boz froze abruptly, his hand stiff in mid-air. He hadn’t expected the other party to not remember him. Was he really that insignificant?

Feeling countless gazes fixed on him, Boz quickly withdrew his hand, using a smile to mask his inner embarrassment.

“Could it be that you have forgotten? You once hired me to help find the missing Little Princess.”

Seeing that the Elf King still had no impression, Sylph hurriedly whispered something to him, trying to remind him of what had happened back then.

The Elf King suddenly realized there was indeed such a matter. To find Shirley, he had indeed hired adventurers for help, but it had eventually fizzled out.

“Oh, it is the President of the Katowice Guild. Is there something you need?”

“Ah?” Boz was startled and asked in a low voice, “Did you not come down from the podium to find me?”

The Elf King paused. Although his face maintained a polite smile, a trace of disdain flashed deep in his eyes. “President Boz, I think you have misunderstood. I am here to visit my old friend.”

“Old... old friend?” Boz was puzzled in his heart. The arena was full of adventurers; where could the Elf King have an old friend? Was he joking with him?

“If you have no other matters, I will take my leave...” The Elf King nodded and walked past Boz directly toward where Merlin was located.

“Wait!”

Boz was reluctant to give up and wanted to block the Elf King to ask clearly, but he was suddenly intercepted by Sylph, making it difficult for him to approach the Elf King.

Sylph’s hand was already pressing against the hilt of her sword at her waist, staring at Boz warily, she said coldly, “Your Majesty is currently busy with affairs. If it is urgent, please seek another time to visit.”

“...”

Boz’s face turned iron-gray. He forcibly retracted his extended hand, his heart growing angry.

After all, he was the President of the world’s second-largest guild. How could the Elf King treat him like a fart and ignore him?!

Hadn’t he helped search for Princess Shirley back then? Why did the Elf King give him not even a shred of face now?

Boz gritted his teeth in secret, feeling his self-esteem had suffered an unprecedented severe challenge. He wanted to teach the Elf King a lesson, making him regret it until his intestines turned green!

In his bones, the Elf King did not particularly like humans, especially since the adventurers present were competitors to each other.

If he wanted to build goodwill with Merlin, he naturally would not get too close to other adventurers.

The Elf King’s calculations were shrewd. He hoped to make Merlin feel his sincerity.

Building friendship with the Demon Lord who could defeat his brother Asmodeus was far more valuable than some damn powerful guild.

“Sean, didn’t you say the Elf King came to catch up with the President? Why does he look so dismissive?” Noah wondered in his heart.

“Exactly, I can’t tell if the President knows the Elf King at all. It looks more like the President’s warm face pressed against a cold butt,” Gabriel said with an expression of不解 (confusion).

“This... Sean doesn’t know what happened either. Normally, it wouldn’t be like this!”

Just as many people were confused and puzzled, the Elf King arrived in front of Merlin and gave him a very enthusiastic hug.

“Long time no see, old man...” The Elf King gently patted Merlin’s back.

“Hmm?” Merlin was highly alert in his heart. Looking at the Elf King in surprise, he wondered what schemes this old fox was plotting.

This seemingly ordinary act of embracing was extraordinary when done by the Elf King. Not only because of his high status as the leader of another race, but also because elves themselves were proud.

Most people knew that other races were hostile toward humans. Especially the proud elves; if they were willing to embrace humans, their relationship could no longer be described merely as “intimate.”

Exclamations erupted from the audience seats. The sight of the noble Elf King embracing a human caused immense shock in their hearts.

“Is that Iron-rank adventurer friends with the Elf King?”

“Friends? Probably not just friends. That is the Elf King! How could he get close to a human? Truly incredible!”

“This Iron-rank adventurer is strange. Why does he know so many big shots?”

Seeing this scene, Boz’s anger finally transformed into resentment. Katowice Guild was the runner-up of the previous term, with great strength and the largest faction, yet they were left coldly aside. Instead, an unknown Iron-rank adventurer became the focus of the entire venue. How could he accept this落差 (gap/disparity)?

Merlin Lucifer? Good... very good!

I’ve remembered you. Just wait...

I will use facts to prove that you elites are blind!

Noah, Sean, and Gabriel’s faces grew even uglier, gritting their teeth with angry expressions. They had originally thought they could gain some pride through the Elf King, but it turned out the Elf King was also there for Merlin.

Which adventurer present was weaker than an Iron-rank adventurer? Did everyone want to be like that freak Cronos?

Many adventurers on the field had already secretly decided to show Merlin what was what in the competition! The arena spoke with strength; sucking up to nobles counted for nothing!

On the podium, watching the big shots come down one by one to greet Merlin, Rothschild was somewhat uncertain and asked Macready, “What is that adventurer’s name?”

Macready’s gaze was sharp as a falcon’s. He glanced at Merlin’s adventurer certificate. “A bottom-tier adventurer named Merlin Lucifer.”

“Merlin... Lucifer, hiss....” Rothschild recalled carefully, then his face changed drastically. He said in panic,

“Quick! Help me up! I must go greet him personally!”

“You must also pay attention to your attitude. You may despise everyone else, but absolutely not this person!”

title: Chapter 25 — Take It Back Sooner or Later (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 25 — Take It Back Sooner or Later (Extra Chapter)

Volume 27 · Chapter 25

"Huh? Why?" McCrady's face showed shock—he had never seen the family head look so flustered before.

"I’m far too familiar with that name. He is the very first Diamond VIP in our family’s history. We must treat him with the utmost respect." Rothschild said gravely.

"Diamond VIP?!"

McCrady gasped. That was an honor reserved only for those who had spent tens of millions of gold coins across the family’s businesses.

But no matter how hard McCrady stared at Merlin, he couldn’t see how this man could possibly have such an astronomical net worth. He just looked like an ordinary nobody.

"Quick, let’s go greet him..." Rothschild dragged his aging body forward, leaning on McCrady’s arm as they slowly stepped out of the VIP seats.

Merlin watched the Elven King with a blank expression and muttered, "Such enthusiasm... if it’s not a scam, then it’s a trap."

"Hahaha, I just felt a long-lost joy upon seeing you again." The Elven King wore a warm smile.

"Not planning to kidnap my child this time?" Merlin narrowed his eyes, staying on guard.

"I’m not the kind of villain who breaks up families, especially not when you’re a friend to our race." The Elven King spoke meaningfully, hoping Merlin would let go of his grudges.

"Oh?" Merlin remained skeptical. With the Elven King, he couldn’t afford to take every word at face value.

"Don’t be so wary of me. We’re friends, aren’t we? If you’re free tonight, let’s talk privately." The Elven King patted Merlin’s shoulder.

Merlin said nothing, but his curiosity was piqued. The old elf wouldn’t request a private conversation unless there was something important. Clearly, the Elven King had other motives.

Seeing Merlin wasn’t in the mood to chat, the Elven King shifted his attention to Chris. "Miss Alice, it’s been a while."

Alice hadn’t forgotten how the Elven King had tried to deceive her and take Chris away. If Sherry hadn’t taken pity and revealed the truth, she and Merlin would still be in the dark. Thinking of this, she tightened her grip on Chris.

"I heard this child is named Chris? What a lovely name." The Elven King bent down, trying to pat Chris’s little head.

But little Chris was shy around strangers. Startled, she quickly buried her face into her mother’s arms, seeking safety.

The Elven King gave a dry chuckle, his hand frozen mid-air. He hadn’t expected to be disliked so immediately—it was a little embarrassing.

Hillphus rushed forward to save the situation. "Chris, do you remember me?"

"Eeh?" Chris looked up at Hillphus, then recalled and stretched out her tiny hand. "It’s Hillphus big sister~!"

"Hahaha, so I haven’t been forgotten." Hillphus sighed in relief, gently holding Chris’s hand.

The Elven King’s expression was awkward. *If I had known this would happen, I should’ve brought Sherry along.* He was lucky Sherry had been there back then. Otherwise, he and Merlin would’ve had a falling out with no chance of reconciliation.

Blaze, who had been covering Margaret’s mouth, saw the Elven King and his eyes filled with reverence. *Could Miss Alice’s influence have already spread to foreign lands?* But the way the Elven King interacted with Mr. Merlin seemed even closer...

Elizabeth watched coldly from the sidelines. This wasn’t her first time dealing with the Elven King. She understood his intentions perfectly.

Whether it was embracing Merlin without regard for his status as a foreign leader or making the unprecedented decision to attend the Adventurers’ Tournament, it was all an attempt to win Merlin over.

Elizabeth stayed silent, pondering how to ensure Merlin remained in the Great Britain Kingdom. A powerhouse like him would be a massive threat anywhere else. Keeping him under her watch was the best way to maximize their interests.

Morrison’s gaze flickered repeatedly, glancing at the Queen and then at the composed Elven King. *Just who is this Merlin? Even the Elven King traveled a great distance to see him?*

At that moment—

McCrady supported Rothschild’s frail body as they slowly approached, drawing the stunned gazes of the crowd.

Many adventurers gasped in surprise. Could it be that even the richest man in the world couldn’t resist coming to greet this lowly Iron-ranked adventurer? Was there some special connection between them?

The Rothschild family’s status was unmatched by anyone present. For them, wealth had long since become cold numbers—what truly mattered were connections and influence.

But most of the people in the arena were adventurers who worked for money. To the world’s richest man, they were nothing more than disposable pawns. So who had the power to make Rothschild leave his VIP seat?!

With so many big shots coming to greet Merlin, this unremarkable adventurer had suddenly become the center of attention.

Rothschild stopped in front of Merlin and flashed the unique smile of a merchant, bowing slightly. "Mr. Merlin, your reputation precedes you. I’ve long wished to meet you, and today, that wish has come true."

Everyone was stunned. They all knew the Rothschild family’s wealth was beyond measure, and their patriarch was a figure of almost divine reverence.

Yet now, this old man was being so humble, as if addressing someone of far greater status. It was a sight that left many people in disbelief.

Noah, Shawn, and Gabriel’s faces darkened, twisted in frustration. The constant shocks had numbed them. Even if the great Goddess of Light herself descended to chat with Merlin, they wouldn’t bat an eye.

Boz’s face twitched uncontrollably. *Fine, the nobles and royalty I can understand, but now even the richest man in the world is cozying up to Merlin? Why?! Is he some kind of social butterfly among adventurers?! I’ve worked hard for over a decade, and in the end, I’m still not as good as some useless bottom-feeder who just waits around to die?!*

"Hm? Even someone as filthy rich as you knows my name?" Merlin’s lips curled into a smirk.

"Of course. You are our family’s Diamond VIP—a most distinguished title. Naturally, I’ve committed it to memory. If my body allowed it, I would certainly share a dinner with you." Rothschild said with a smile.

Nearby, Elizabeth’s expression shifted. A Diamond VIP of the Rothschild family... just how much had one spent to earn such an honor?!

Elizabeth knew Merlin was burdened with an enormous debt, though she wasn’t clear on how he’d incurred it. Learning he was a Diamond VIP, she felt a flicker of relief.

But she still couldn’t understand. Merlin *looked* like someone who enjoyed the finer things, but what could he possibly have spent so much money on?

It seemed Her Majesty the Queen, accustomed to luxury, had little understanding of the lowest rungs of society, where a group of people known as "gambling addicts" barely scraped by.

"..." Merlin let out a cold snort, giving Rothschild no pleasantries in return. Instead, he shrugged. "I’ve seen your kind before, merchants. No need for the fake politeness. I know I still have some value left to squeeze. Otherwise, you lot would’ve kicked me to the curb long ago~"

"What? Show some respect when speaking to our family head!" McCrady frowned, issuing a warning. Even surrounded by all these dignitaries, he wasn’t afraid. In his eyes, the man before him was nothing but a fraud—all bark and no bite, good only at clinging to powerful figures.

"Silence, McCrady. Did I not just speak? Have you forgotten?" Rothschild reprimanded him, displeased.

"..." McCrady glanced at Merlin, so angry he had to close his eyes. He thought, *Even if the man is a revered Diamond VIP, he can’t be allowed to disrespect the family head!*

"Mr. Merlin, you are our honored guest. We are not the kind to forget courtesy. If there’s anything you need, please don’t hesitate to ask. We will do everything in our power to assist you." Rothschild said kindly, implying that the money thrown into the gambling dens was worth it—Merlin needed to keep losing for their sake.

"Hah, what’s mine, I’ll take back sooner or later." Merlin gave a meaningful smile.

"...What do you mean?" Rothschild was confused.

Merlin pointed at McCrady—or more precisely, at the root of all evil: the Hero’s Inherited Sacred Armor he wore.

"That armor..."

"Is only temporarily in your possession. But I *will* take it back eventually."

title: Chapter 26 — Adopted Daughter
content:
Chapter 26 — Adopted Daughter

Volume 27 · Chapter 26

Merlin's words caused Rothschild and McCreedy's expressions to change. They hadn't expected Merlin to be interested in this treasure!

Even though Merlin was a distinguished diamond VIP, this treasure wasn't something just anyone could covet.

After all, Rothschild knew this armor was a Holy Church heirloom, an priceless treasure. Back then, he had spent a large sum of money to buy it.

Once, a high-ranking cardinal from the Holy Church came to demand it. Rothschild didn't even spare a glance, directly sending the man away empty-handed. Even offering money was useless.

The Rothschild family is one of the wealthiest families in the world. Although their strength isn't as deep as the Holy Church's, their influence is by no means inferior.

Now Merlin had actually indicated he was coveting the Hero's Inherited Saint Armor. This was undoubtedly a slap in the face to everyone saying—

This good thing I've set my sights on, I'll eventually get it

"What did you say?" McCreedy's expression turned ugly. He knew the benefits of the Hero's Inherited Saint Armor better than anyone. Not only could it disperse evil creatures, its formidable defense was sufficient to deal with many dangers. Such a precious item had long been designated as the Rothschild family's heirloom.

"Merlin, what do you mean? Could it be... you still want to rob it openly?" Rothschild was astonished. Although Merlin was a distinguished diamond VIP, even under such circumstances, doing this was a bit too much.

Rothschild knew the Hero's Inherited Saint Armor was priceless, but he had still underestimated just how precious this treasure was.

This was armor capable of withstanding even a single attack from Merlin! It was only because Alice relied on the Hero's Inherited Saint Armor that she barely survived.

Since being forged, the Hero's Inherited Saint Armor had not a single trace left by any strong person, except for Merlin.

At first glance, the flawless inherited armor actually had an inconspicuous small gap at the waist. This was left from when Merlin fought Alice two years ago.

Because of this damage, Rothschild lamented that the perfect treasure had become a substandard item. Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared let McCreedy wear this Hero's Inherited Saint Armor.

Merlin smiled faintly, his tone calm. "I'm not someone who can't afford to gamble. Stealing is beneath me; robbing I only do to enemies. I will use legitimate means to get this thing back."

"Ha?" McCreedy's eyes showed deep disdain. "Just based on you? The value of this armor is something your kind can never hope to reach."

This time, Rothschild didn't stop McCreedy. His intention was to let Merlin know the heights of the sky and the earth. Don't think that just because you're a diamond VIP, you can be so arrogant.

However, Merlin just smiled and said nothing, ignoring the boastful knight in front of him. He had already decided in his heart—

As long as he wins the championship this time, the fee for hiring himself will likely skyrocket!

By then, not to mention paying off the debt, this armor might be bought back outright and above board!

Tania watched Merlin, who was surrounded by big shots, thinking she had developed a strong interest in this unassuming man. She very much wanted to know what abilities this guy had that made so many nobles flock to him.

At the edge of the arena, Zicatilo stood in a sparsely populated corner, looking far at Merlin. Many questions arose in his heart—this unassuming adventurer had actually come to participate in the competition? Getting to know so many high-ranking people, it seemed he wasn't as simple as he appeared on the surface...

The commotion at the opening ceremony hadn't been known by the London Adventurers. The reason was that Gregory, bringing his cute student Aelia, was eating and drinking to his heart's content in Budapest.

For Aelia, who was a glutton, eating to her fill was cultivating her strength, so she needed to eat a lot before the race.

However, Gregory discovered that upon returning from the opening ceremony, all the adventurers were discussing something? Everyone was indignant, making him feel very strange.

Night fell. The Elf King arrived as scheduled, wanting to talk to Merlin about something rather secretive. Hilf and Alice were on one side accompanying little Chris.

"...." Merlin looked at the Elf King with deep meaning and asked, "What do you want with me? If you want to take Chris away, I won't agree. Don't force me to flip my lid."

"Haha...." The Elf King laughed, having long guessed Merlin's attitude after learning the truth, "How could that be? I said it before, I'm not a bad person."

"But you tried to trick me into taking Chris back to the United Kingdom. What's that all about?" Merlin asked with an unsightly expression.

The Elf King was at a loss, silently sighing, using a tone of helplessness, "I am the head of the entire Elf race. No matter what, I need to consider the interests of my people. Some things aren't something I want to do. You were once a Demon King; you should be able to understand my stance and feelings."

Merlin narrowed his eyes. Indeed, he could understand this feeling of being helpless. He was a transmigrator, and he didn't originally like killing.

But living in the demon environment, and being the monarch of the Demon Lord Palace, some things had to be done, otherwise he would be excluded.

Establishing one's prestige through killing was just for the subordinates' sake, so that the cruel demons would revere him.......

However, Merlin felt the Elf King's words were half-true, half-false. This old fox wasn't worth believing in completely.

"I understand, but I won't trust you. Because I know too, as the head of a family, for the sake of the clan's interests, the guy in charge will stop at nothing."

"Since you also understand the plight of those in power, I really can't imagine why someone like you would be chased out by the demon race."

The Elf King gave a wry shake of his head, thinking that the demon race's elders were definitely not fools. Driving away a young monarch was an immeasurable loss. There must be other reasons.

Otherwise, based on the Elf King's contact with Merlin, this young monarch, although a bit arrogant, was completely a promising young monarch who needed good cultivation.

"This is my own thing; don't pry into the bottom of it."

Merlin said coldly. Being fired was just one of the reasons; because of the heart curse, he himself had to leave his hometown.

After the Holy Church was subdued, they didn't dare to easily mobilize troops to attack the Demon Lord Palace. The result was only two choices: wait to die or harm one's own clan. No matter which, Merlin wasn't willing.

"Since you aren't coming to take Chris away, then what exactly are you here for?"

"Our relationship, I'm sure doesn't need beating around the bush. Then I'll just say it straight...." The Elf King paused, lowering his voice and speaking seriously—

"I want to take Chris as a goddaughter. What do you think?"

title: Chapter 27 — Chris's Huge Potential
content:
Chapter 27 — Chris's Huge Potential

Volume 27 · Chapter 27

Merlin heard the Elf King’s intentions and felt a flicker of surprise—what exactly was the Elf King scheming?

“Oh? Why would you want Chris to become your adopted daughter?”

“This child is already a treasure of our elven race. I’m not planning to take her back now, so adopting her—is that too much to ask?” The Elf King said meaningfully.

Merlin glanced at Chris, who was playing happily in the distance, and felt that the Elf King’s thoughts were not so simple.

To sever Chris’s ties with the elven race completely, Merlin would not allow this to happen.

“No.”

“Why not?” The Elf King paused, then said seriously, “Merlin, don’t push your luck. Not taking Chris back is already a huge concession on my part.”

“Chris is my child with Alice. She has nothing to do with your elven race. You want to adopt her? No.” Merlin shook his head.

When the Elf King heard this, he smirked to himself. His real target was Merlin, not Chris—Merlin was underestimating him far too much.

Even if Chris possessed extraordinary talent, she would still need time and effort to nurture her into an unparalleled master. But Merlin, who could easily defeat Asmodeus, was already a ready-made prodigy. Why would the Elf King go through the trouble of taking Chris when he could have Merlin?

The Elf King knew his own strength had waned. To stabilize his position within the United Kingdom, he absolutely needed the support of a powerful external force—otherwise, how could the other major clan leaders ever be convinced?

In the past, the Elf King could hide within the Sacred Tree and rely on his past reputation to intimidate the others, keeping them in the dark about his true strength. But after his clash with Asmodeus, his precarious situation had been exposed. The leaders of the major clans might not act now, but what about later?

In a world where non-humans generally resisted humans, the Elf King would never choose to rely on human power. That left demons—especially a demon like Merlin, who wandered freely outside!

“Besides, Chris is just an ordinary child, not some little genius. What use would it be to take her back? Why are you so fixated on her? I don’t get it.” Merlin shook his head.

“Ordinary child?” The Elf King’s expression twisted in disbelief. He hadn’t expected Merlin to call a child who even the elven elders couldn’t control… an ordinary child!

“What? Isn’t she?” Merlin frowned at the Elf King’s strange expression, confused.

“Tch…” The Elf King let out a bitter laugh. “I thought you’d see how special she is. I guess I was wrong.”

“Huh? Does that mean Chris is extraordinary?” Merlin felt a flicker of shock. He had never noticed any talent in her—though she was pretty good at dreaming, always dreaming about cream cakes every night.

“Before she hatched, I examined her and found she possesses terrifying life force…” The Elf King lowered his voice.

“Life force? Are you sure?” Merlin was skeptical, worried the Elf King was trying to trick him.

The Elf King smiled faintly and said seriously, “In this world, is there any race more sensitive to magical energy than us elves?”

Merlin fell silent. It was true that the elven race excelled in magic. In human history, there had been few magical prodigies.

But even an average elven mage would be considered a once-in-a-century genius in the human world. The gap between them was simply terrifying.

Still, Merlin found it hard to believe the Elf King’s words. If Chris truly possessed such powerful life force, why hadn’t he and Alice sensed it?

“You must be mistaken. I don’t know magic, but Alice is a decent mage. Even she can’t sense anything unusual in Chris…”

“Don’t bring up your wife. Even among my clan’s elders, almost no one noticed it. Only I could sense it.” The Elf King pointed to himself.

“Hah~” Merlin let out a dry laugh, not taking it seriously. “What are you trying to brag about?”

“It’s not bragging—it’s a fact.” The Elf King emphasized, “You know as well as I do that power is tiered. Lower-tier power can’t perceive higher-tier power. The more hidden something is, the more terrifying it is.”

“Your…” Merlin’s brow furrowed as he realized the implication—wasn’t that exactly how he was?

“Exactly. Because this child’s life force is too overwhelming. It’s so strong that no one can perceive her potential.” The Elf King explained plainly.

Merlin could barely believe it—so strong that it was invisible? It sounded like nonsense.

“I’m the leader of the elven race. If I hadn’t inherited my father-god’s gift, I might have missed it too.” The Elf King turned to look at Chris, who was laughing and playing, and said meaningfully, “Right now, it’s not obvious, but in the future, who knows how far she’ll grow? Even I can’t predict it…”

Merlin lowered his head, thinking, then asked, “Life force… what is it?”

The Elf King looked at Merlin, realizing he knew little about magic, and explained patiently, “Life force is the primordial power that existed at the dawn of creation. It’s the foundation of all things in the world. All elements are merely derivatives of it. In a way, life force is the source of everything. Without it, we wouldn’t exist.”

Merlin listened, feeling that his precious daughter was truly extraordinary, though a trace of doubt still lingered in his mind.

“There are very few beings in this world who can control life force. If this child is nurtured properly, her future achievements will be limitless.” The Elf King sighed.

“You’re talking big, but you’ve got no proof. How do I know you’re not scheming again?” Merlin remained skeptical.

“I can prove it, but you’ll have to agree to my condition first—let me become Chris’s adopted father. Of course, I’ll give you a great gift in return.” The Elf King said mysteriously.

Meanwhile, little Chris had no idea what her father was discussing with the Elf King. But seeing Hilf made her happy, so she spun in circles on the ground.

Hilf laughed at Chris’s antics, occasionally glancing at the Elf King, unsure how the conversation was going.

She knew the Elf King had come to establish a friendly relationship with Merlin, or the other clan leaders in the United Kingdom would grow restless.

But if Merlin and the Elf King were friends, and Chris became the Elf King’s adopted daughter, the restless factions would quiet down.

Hilf understood this was a trade—using Chris to gain Merlin’s support. The only awkward part was having to call Chris “Princess” from now on.

Alice wore a smile, but her mind was elsewhere, consumed by what her teacher had told her last night. The ultimatum weighed heavily on her.

Should she tell Merlin?

What if Merlin fought her teacher?

title: Chapter 28 — Power of Life (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 28 — Power of Life (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 27 · Chapter 28

The Life Force (Bonus Chapter)

Alice wondered why her teacher stubbornly refused to give Merlin any respect. Was it simply because Merlin was a Black Iron adventurer?

If her teacher could have seen the opening ceremony today, she might have changed her attitude toward him.

Alice thought this over in her heart, and an expression of worry crept onto her face. She didn't know how to handle this situation.

"Mommy, don't be unhappy!" Chris noticed Alice's furrowed brow and quickly came over, tugging at her mother's dress hem. Her little face was full of concern.

Uh... Alice suddenly paused, realizing she shouldn't be acting like this in front of Chris. She picked her up and smiled. "Mommy isn't unhappy. What are you talking about?"

"Mommies lie. When Mommy isn't happy, she looks listless." Chris said with a completely serious expression.

Alice gave a bitter smile. If her teacher hadn't suddenly appeared, she wouldn't have had to worry so much. "...Yeah, Mommy is a bit unhappy. Really worried you'll wet the bed again tonight."

"Uhh!!!" Chris shivered all over, her face turning red, and she stared at Alice with wide eyes. She may have been young, but she already had a sense of shame.

"What are you looking at, Mommy? Did Mommy say something wrong?" Alice held her daughter around the waist and leaned close, feigning a stern expression as she interrogated her.

Chris thought about it for a moment and said seriously, "Chris wouldn't wet the bed~"

"???" Alice was stunned, frowning. "Lying isn't a good habit. Were the sheets Mommy washed all fake?"

"Then... Chris thought again. "That's not wetting the bed. That's drawing maps in my sleep late at night. It's art~"

Alice saw how her daughter could argue just to avoid admitting fault. She wondered who she got that from. Clearly, every morning Alice would pat the underside of Chris's bottom, afraid she'd wet the bed.

"Don't dress it up so nicely. Wetting the bed is wetting the bed. You should honestly admit it."

"Chris is a cutie. Cuties don't wet the bed! Cuties don't poop either. The farts they let out are rainbow-colored and strawberry-scented!" Chris said with great confidence, the ahoge on her head standing stiffly.

"!!!?" Alice's brows tightened. She felt that Chris was too young to possibly say such bizarre things. "...Who taught you these words?"

"Daddy~" Chris happily swayed her short little legs. "Daddy says I'm a cutie, and cuties don't poop. Wetting the bed is something other kids do. I only draw priceless artwork with my pee when I dream late at night. That's why Mommy washes the sheets—to keep them from falling into strangers' hands. That's what Daddy taught me, hehe~"

"Oh my god..."

Alice's face turned dark as she held Chris, wondering what on earth Merlin had been teaching her child???

"Merlin... sir," Sylph said, simultaneously amused and exasperated. "What a rare talent he is."

"Hey, Alice, come talk with me."

Merlin suddenly walked over and beckoned to Alice with a gesture of his hand.

The two moved to the side. Alice held Chris and couldn't help but ask, "What is it?"

Merlin glanced at Chris and whispered, "The Elf King wants to be Chris's adoptive father."

"Huh? Why? Hasn't he given up on Chris yet?" Alice's expression darkened.

"No, he's not after Chris. He's after me." Merlin had already seen through the Elf King's true intentions. Being Chris's adoptive father was just a cover. "He wants to become brothers with me. Chris is the bridge between us. You can see it too—the Elf King is weak right now. In the United Kingdom, he probably can't suppress the other chieftains. He needs to rely on my deterrent."

"I see... " Alice nodded in understanding and stole a glance at the Elf King.

"What do you plan to do?"

"The Elf King said Chris possesses terrifying life force. If properly cultivated, she will become a rare life-attribute mage." Merlin said calmly.

"Really!?" Alice's eyes lit up, and she looked down at the confused little Chris.

"Mommy?" Chris blinked her big eyes in confusion, having absolutely no idea what kind of destiny her parents had arranged for her.

Merlin briefly summarized what he had just discussed with the Elf King and explained it to Alice so she could understand Chris's tremendous potential.

"That's roughly the situation. The Elf King said if we agree, he will pass down the Elf clan's inheritance to Chris. After all, no one understands life-attribute power better than the elves. Apart from them, no one else could possibly teach Chris."

"In that case... " Alice let out a breath. "The Elf King wants to be Chris's introductory mentor?"

Merlin looked at Chris and thought that if they agreed, there would likely be no shortage of troubles from the Elf clan. But for Chris's sake, a compromise wasn't impossible.

"Chris, do you really want to learn magic?"

"Yes~" Upon hearing that she could learn magic, Chris's eyes already filled with little stars. "I want to learn magic to help Mommy and Daddy fight bad guys! I can also protect Mommy and Daddy~"

Hearing Chris say this, Merlin felt greatly comforted in his heart. However, he did not want his and Alice's circumstances to push their beloved daughter onto the path of learning magic.

"Learning magic is very hard. Can you endure it?"

"Yes!" Chris pouted her little mouth, looking extremely stubborn—just like Alice.

For the first time, Alice felt proud of Chris. Although she didn't want her daughter to suffer much, learning magic was a good thing, and she fully supported it.

Seeing this, Merlin no longer said more. He patted Chris's little head and thought that since Chris possessed enormous life force, if she wanted to use it, the Elf clan's life-attribute magic knowledge was very important.

Life-attribute magic was already extremely rare. Merlin didn't believe that in the human world, there was anyone more suitable than the Elf King to serve as Chris's introductory mentor. Besides, the Elf King would pass Corron's inheritance to Chris. This was truly a great gift!

As an exchange of benefits, Merlin would stand on the Elf King's side, becoming his powerful external aid, convenient for deterring the other restive non-human chieftains within the United Kingdom.

"Come then. I agree."

The Elf King smiled and came to Chris's side. Looking at this little one, it counted as his first time taking on a student, and there was an indescribable emotion in his heart.

Chris felt a bit frightened upon seeing the Elf King and pressed herself harder into Alice's embrace, timidly gazing at the long-eared uncle before her.

"Don't be afraid, Chris. You can call him Godfather now."

"No. Chris only has one daddy..." Chris protested in a蚊子-sized voice. She didn't much like calling people daddy casually.

"It's fine. It's just a title." The Elf King waved his hand, thinking that since he was here for Merlin, as long as Merlin agreed, the nominal title of adoptive father didn't matter.

The Elf King placed his finger against Chris's forehead, and gentle white light flickered between his fingers.

Chris felt very frightened and shivered, grabbing wildly, and somehow even pulled out Alice's breast pad.

"Ugh!" Alice's face flushed red with embarrassment, but under the circumstances, she didn't say anything.

Chris suddenly widened her eyes, her expression turning solemn. Within the light, she saw countless unheard-of things continuously imprinted into her mind.

The inheritance of the Elf God Corron, and numerous life-attribute elven magics, were being continuously absorbed by Chris. These precious things were all concentrated essence.

As long as Chris kept learning, as her strength increased, she would recall these super powerful elven magics. This was very similar to the Dragon clan's inheritance crystals!

The elves had once carved out their own era. They were inherently a race with tremendous magical talent, and their magic was far beyond what human magic could compare to.

And the Elf King, as Chris's introductory mentor, was exceedingly sincere. No one恐怕 could understand life-attribute magic better than him.

The Elf King was truly an ancient monster. Even Clodia couldn't detect the life force within Chris, yet he had drawn out just the tip of the iceberg!

The light on Chris's forehead blazed brilliantly, and a life force that made one feel like basking in a spring breeze emanated from her tiny body.

"...." Merlin's eyes widened in shock. This most primordial life force made his heart pound wildly—

The curse hidden deepest within it was being subtly shaken!

This felt extremely similar to the sensation of using Banri Garan to steal life force. How could this not terrify Merlin?!

title: Chapter 29 — Break into the Top Eight
content:
Chapter 29 — Break into the Top Eight

Volume 27 · Chapter 29

The function of the demon sword Banri Garan was precisely to steal life force, and the vast reservoir of life energy within Chris was exactly what Merlin desired.

Merlin was internally stunned and recalled the explanation given by the Elf King: life energy is the source of all things, existing within every living being, merely in greater or lesser amounts.

Banri Garan continuously drained the life force of those at Saint-tier and above, replenishing Merlin's ravaged, shattered heart and keeping him from dying.
