Rosetti, listening beside them, was quite puzzled and did not understand much. She could not help but poke da Vinci next to her. "Da Vinci, who is stronger, Alice or the person opposite her?"

Da Vinci lifted her head. A blue magical circle jumped from her monocular as she carefully analyzed the combat power of both Alice and Aelia.

Alice: 5500

Aelia: 5600

Da Vinci sighed and answered Rosetti truthfully, "Aelia is stronger."

"This is worrying. Alice is the hope of the whole village..." Rosetti grew concerned.

This result was not surprising. Although Alice had received the orthodox inheritance of the Dragon Clan, because her foundation was insufficient, she had not learned many of the essential techniques.

Aelia was different. Even without the orthodox inheritance of the Dragon Clan, she had the support of nearly true man-made black dragon blood. It amounted to a comparison between a Ultimate Form and a Perfect Form.

Da Vinci quietly bowed her head over her book, unaware that someone had already set their sights on her.

Flamel stood at the highest point of the arena, his gaze locked onto da Vinci. A knowing smile appeared on his face.

Da Vinci, still the same as ever...

What a clueless bookworm....

title: Chapter 39 — Three Mergers in One 6000 Words (Regular Update + Double Make-up Update)
content:
Chapter 39 — Three Mergers in One 6000 Words (Regular Update + Double Make-up Update)

Volume 27 · Chapter 39

Alyea yawned lazily, scratching her belly and eyeing her opponent. "Alice, I've been watching you for a long time. I heard you can use the power of the Frost Dragon. Coincidentally, I can also use the power of the dragon."

Alice knew immediately that Alyea had eaten the same thing as her. "Are you corrupted by the power of the dragon race?"

"You're talking about this? Well... Alyea tapped her small horn on her head. She didn't know Alice was referring to the inheritance.

"You look too young to be dealing with these things." Alice's expression turned serious.

"Hah, you seem to like meddling in other people's affairs. I'm probably older than you, and in my eyes, you're just a little girl!" Alyea took a fighting stance, smirking. "I've been waiting for this moment for a long time. Let me see how you compare to a dragon-shaped giant!"

Alice, seeing this, slowly brought out the dagger at her waist, and suddenly a cold light shot out. "Come on."

With the referee's announcement of "match start," the duel of the two dragons began.

The two didn't hesitate at all and collided violently towards the center of the arena, the strong impact nearly knocking the front-row spectators off their feet.

As a magic swordswoman, Alice's fusion of magic and martial arts was extremely elegant, looking powerful and majestic.

However, Alyea, though a warrior, had powerful techniques, obviously having laid a solid foundation under the guidance of Gregory.

Alyea's small fists moved in the air, making thunderous explosions, skimming past Alice's ears!

Alice was surprised in her heart, and couldn't afford to underestimate this opponent. Her close-quarters combat skills exceeded her own!

"That's all you've got? Don't let me be too disappointed!" Alyea followed up on her victory, jumping up and striking Alice's weak points with her small fists repeatedly.

"Yell!" Alice stabilized her form in the chaos, and her dagger moved from below upwards, layers of sharp ice resembling ripples on a lake, launching a counterattack.

"Hah!" Alyea roared, shattering Alice's proud fusion ice crystals! Alice felt a slight pressure, and the opponent seemed to have investigated her. She was very familiar with her, and ordinary techniques couldn't easily break through her fusion ice crystals. Her strength wasn't inferior to hers, and she was even slightly ahead!

Alice's heart tightened, and she could only use the power of the dragon to decide the outcome. She gritted her teeth and made her dagger tremble, then struck out with all her might.

The temperature in the air dropped sharply, and the arena seemed to have entered a cold winter. The front-row spectators instinctively tightened their clothes.

Dragon breath! Alice's dagger suddenly shot out a cold light, fiercely attacking!

"Come on!" Alyea shouted, taking a deep breath, and unswervingly spat out the breath of the Earth Dragon from her small mouth, countering Alice head-on!

The two forces were close, but the dragon breaths of different attributes collided in the air, and the pressure of the realm caused the space to slightly distort. The edges of the arena became cold frozen soil, while the other side was filled with flying stones, and the two forces were in a state of stalemate. On the audience platform, Da Vinci frowned, as she had come to watch the match for the first time and immediately noticed something strange about the arena.

Da Vinci's monocle kept showing various analyses. In her eyes, the magic and martial arts released by Alice and Alyea were flowing into the ground in an unusual way.

As someone who was proficient in alchemy, Da Vinci was puzzled, thinking it wasn't the official doing it, but someone was secretly planning something.

Just as Da Vinci's butt was about to rise, someone pushed it down. She was shocked in her heart; she looked at the mysterious figure wrapped in a black cloak sitting beside her.

Flamel sat quietly beside Da Vinci, turning his head on purpose to let her see who he was. "Da Vinci, it's been a long time..."

"Flamel..."

Da Vinci whispered softly, her hands and feet were cold, because she felt Flamel's knife had already secretly pressed against her ribs.

She believed that if she shouted loudly, Flamel would ruthlessly cut open her body and stab the knife into her heart...

Da Vinci dared not make a sound. She knew Flamel's nature was cruel, and he was prone to extremes. She could only stay calm now.

"You had better keep your usual state. If I'm exposed, I swear you'll die in a very miserable way." Flamel smiled lowly. Da Vinci's forehead dripped with cold sweat, feeling the cold knife pressed against her side. At this moment, Flamel seemed like a stranger sitting beside her, and no one noticed that she had been kidnapped. Even the recent Rossetti was fully focused on the match, completely unaware of Da Vinci's state at the moment, because Da Vinci was usually like this.

"Did you do something on the arena?"

"I guessed you would find it out soon. Yes, it's me. But I hope you don't ruin my good luck. For you, it's not good." Flamel paused and added, "We are from the same school. Don't force me."

"What are you planning?" Da Vinci asked in a flat tone, as if she was whispering to herself.

"It's not your business. You just stay calm, and I won't harm you." Flamel answered softly.

...Da Vinci didn't speak, feeling like she was on pins and needles. Flamel had changed a lot since they last saw each other, leaving her with many questions but unable to speak.

Rolling sand obscured the view, and suddenly a sky-shaking roar shook the arena. A blue-white giant dragon with scales like jewels took to the skies, flying towards the arena. A violent wind swept through, and the sand was blown away. An arena-sized dragon, similar in size to the Frost Dragon, with brown scales, wings like mountains, was staring at the enemy in the sky.

People let out a roar of surprise. Most of them had only seen the form of giant dragons, and seeing a real giant dragon like this was a rare sight!

The arena seemed to become a gladiatorial arena, and the fight between the two giant dragons raised the atmosphere to its peak, with cheers echoing!

The Earth Dragon shook its wings and roared, wanting to engage in close-quarters combat with the Frost Dragon.

However, the Frost Dragon flew higher and higher, avoiding close-quarters combat, and Alice realized that close-quarters combat wouldn't be advantageous. She had to keep her distance.

The Earth Dragon had a strong body, with scales that were incredibly hard, and was very good at close-quarters combat. However, magic was not its strength.

The Frost Dragon suddenly turned around, creating a magnificent golden ice mountain in the air, like a meteor, and smashed it towards the Earth Dragon behind it.

A huge explosion, the ice mountain shattered, and the Earth Dragon, which had just taken to the skies, was slammed to the ground, emitting an unhappy roar! The Frost Dragon spread its wings, casting its shadow over the entire arena.

A fierce blizzard swept the arena, relentlessly attacking the Earth Dragon in the center, making it feel the bone-chilling cold.

The Earth Dragon let out a low growl, planting its four limbs firmly into the ground, and after roaring loudly, it created a powerful gravity space!

The Frost Dragon in the sky let out a shout, being hard pressed by the terrifying gravity, and heavily fell to the ground of the arena. The Earth Dragon pounced on the Frost Dragon, its jaws tightly gripping the enemy's neck, using its strong body to try to win decisively.

The Frost Dragon's roar, the scales on its neck were crushed, and its golden pupils flashed with anger. Its body suddenly emitted a blinding white light! The light faded, and most people thought Alice had lost, but they saw the Earth Dragon frozen into a statue of ice, standing in the center of the arena.

After being hit by the Frost Dragon's strongest magic, the mighty Earth Dragon couldn't survive.

"Good job!" Carl stood up excitedly, as the opponent had lost its combat ability and should have won.

That's right....Old Taylor nodded and smiled, looking at Gregory far away, his heart was filled with joy.

However, the Earth Dragon's ice statue soon shattered, and countless ice blocks fell to the ground.

Her small body was completely wrapped in brown armor, with an ancient dragon pattern. The heavy helmet shone, and the steel tail behind her was like a whip, which could shatter the ground with a simple swing.

Alyea looked up, her eyes cold. She didn't want to use it, but she was forced to bring out the form of the Dragon Warrior!

"The match is over." Gregory bowed his head and stopped watching the match.

"Both have the power of the dragon, but Alyea is a Dragon Warrior. The opponent couldn't win." Vice President Wren commented.

"Unfortunately, I couldn't get the true blood of the black dragon. Otherwise, Alyea would have become a true Dragon Warrior." Gregory paused and said indifferently. "The ancient books say that Dragon Warriors have steel wings that are invincible. Unfortunately, Alyea doesn't have..."

Everyone's eyes were almost focused on Alyea's Dragon Warrior form. Who could have thought she would end up in this state?

On the guest platform, Alphonso, who had been silent all along, suddenly opened his eyes, looking at Alyea in the center of the arena, and smiled softly.

"You indeed have some ability, but I won't let you off the hook anymore. Let the match end quickly." Alyea's expression changed, and the ice melted.

The Frost Dragon didn't know what was happening, and the Dragon Warrior Alyea suddenly appeared in the sky, striking her back. Crack! The Frost Dragon's feet sank into the ground, forming a spider web, and its body was buried in the ground, emitting a sky-shaking cry!

The Dragon Warrior Alyea landed lightly on the ground, waved her hand to the referee, and said, "The result can be announced."

The referee trembled and came out, looking at the Frost Dragon trembling, trying to stand up several times, but it was powerless and fell to the ground.

Seeing this situation, the referee shook his head and was about to announce the result, but Alice had already deactivated the dragon form, using her dagger to support her body, which was covered in scales and bleeding from her neck.

"Wait! Down there, little Chris saw her mother like this, and was so heartbroken that she almost cried, but she saw Merlin still calmly carving a stick with his knife, so she kept shaking him.

"Don't be so nervous." Merlin took a deep breath and smiled at Chris. "Your mother is like this, and she won't be in danger until she's critically injured."

"....." Chris didn't understand, her anxious expression was written on her face, and she was anxious, pinching and biting Merlin, hoping her father could find a way.

"Don't fight anymore. You can't win. Even the dragon form can't be maintained... The Dragon Warrior Alyea said coldly. "I'll let you die."

"I don't need you to worry!" Alice gritted her teeth and supported her body, holding her dagger in front of her eyes, and a stock of unprecedented cold was released. The referee was scared and quickly hid, afraid of being sucked in.

"Find....." The Dragon Warrior Alyea clenched her fist, making a crisp sound, and couldn't figure out what Alice had left.

Dark clouds gathered, rolling and moving, one by one, ten thousand.

Finally, countless golden ice swords hung in the sky of the entire arena, dazzling and cold. The ground also began to change, and huge ice mountains broke through the ground, standing around the arena. Even outside the arena, ice mountains began to appear. The swords hanging in the sky, the majestic mountains, and the cold wind, made everyone feel like they were in another world.

This was the strongest sword technique of the Snow Mountain taught by Klodiya to Alice, "Sword Domain." Although she had not mastered it well, she could only rely on it against a strong enemy.

Alice rode the growing ice mountains to the highest point, her spirit had already merged with the surrounding environment, and she knew the grass and trees.

The Dragon Warrior Alyea looked around and smiled. "Flower passport, what's that?" Alice slowly opened her eyes and used the first technique "Conducting the Sword," commanding the sharp ice swords in the sky to be active, launching a full-range attack on Alyea below! The sharp ice swords, as if alive, moved exceptionally lively, and Alice seemed like a conductor, freely and willfully conducting the symphony of the swords.

Alyea, who had been disdainful, was shocked when the first ice sword exploded on her arm. Her whole arm was numb, and this attack was completely different from before, with tremendous power!

"What! ?'

Alice on the mountain peak swung her dagger again, and the sharp ice swords in the sky responded, gathering into a vast river, flowing through the ice.

The river of ice swords was vast and made a sound like the clash of arms and armor, attacking Alyea from all directions, making her groan and suffer, and her Dragon Warrior armor began to break! Finally, she roared and pounced on the confused Alyea on the ground. "Boom!" The ground shook violently, and the golden dragons gathered into nearly terrifying mountains, pressing Alyea inside, with her life and death uncertain.

The third technique "Opening the Sky," countless golden ice swords gathered on Alice's dagger, quickly creating a sword that shocked gods and demons.

This almost drained all her magic, and it was the final blow to Alyea!

The ice blade would shatter the terrifying ice mountain in front of her, and Alyea, who was pressed under the mountain, might also be pierced through and perish!

However, at this moment, Gregory suddenly appeared, his voice slightly panicked. "Stop! We give up!"

Alice in the sky swayed, she realized she had no strength left, and the third technique "Opening the Sky" would make her exhausted. She had no choice but to fall from the sky, and the strange scenery disappeared, and she had to give up the decisive blow, as there was no deep-seated grudge between her and Alyea.

Alyea coughed up several pools of blood and even lost her Dragon Warrior form.

In fact, Alyea was already confused when Alice used the first technique.

Alyea looked at Alice with a hint of regret, but she had to admit her defeat.

Gregory came to Alyea's side, picked up her severely injured body, and thought that his student wouldn't be able to move for a while. What was this sword technique? It was so terrifying? Especially the last technique, as if it contained the power of heaven and earth? Even if I were, I had to treat it seriously. If I had been just a little late, Alyea might have lost her life. The several adventurers of Katowitz felt a bit anxious, especially Noa, whose face turned green, thinking that if the duel hadn't been in a small circle, under this sword technique, he might not have lasted even one round! The referee looked at Alyea's condition and announced Alice's victory. The audience platform erupted in cheers, and many people even stood up, recognizing Alice's strength.

The arbitrators looked at Old Mr. Dawson with meaningful glances, putting a lot of pressure on him. "....I won't predict matches anymore." Klodiya was satisfied and nodded, but she was still thinking, although it wasn't proficient, it was still okay.

"Won! Won! Hahaha!" Carl jumped up excitedly, happy beyond words.

Old Taylor maintained a calm exterior, but his heart was already bursting with joy. He thought he had never seen Alice use such sword techniques before—it must have been taught by Lord Kloya, right? Impressive indeed.

"Alice is so amazing! Right, Da Vinci!" Rossetti was genuinely happy for Alice, proving that Reckless had made it to the top four, their best historical performance! But no one noticed that the silent Da Vinci was already drenched in sweat, on the verge of being killed by Flamel next to him. A bandage was wrapped around Alice's neck, and she sat exhausted on a chair. The arena had a dedicated healer who had already treated her injuries.

Little Chris silently tended to Alice's wounds and curiously asked, "Does it hurt, Mom?"

"It's nothing serious," Alice managed a weak smile. In truth, her bones and flesh were nearly shattered, but she couldn't show any pain in front of Chris.

"Heya!" Chris tensed up, focusing all her effort on healing Alice's wounds with her eyes. A few tiny light particles flickered between her hands before vanishing. She pouted like a deflated balloon. "Chris is so useless, I can't help at all..."

"It's okay, you're still young," Alice felt a warmth in her heart, thinking her daughter was truly a little cotton ball, caring for her. "You should be..."

"Mom is super awesome!" Chris sat on Alice's lap, her big eyes sparkling with excitement. "Chris admires Mom the most!" Alice felt a warm glow, her injuries suddenly feeling less painful. But next to her, Merlin shivered, feeling this couldn't continue. Even his precious daughter was becoming closer to Alice. He, as the father, had to show his skills!

"Got it!" Merlin stood up, looked at the wooden sword in his hand, and handed Banri Garan to Alice for safekeeping. Full of energy, he said, "I'm going to the match. Chris, watch carefully how Dad helps your mom get revenge~"

Chris blinked her big, cute eyes, hesitated for a long time, and said, "Dad, come back alive~"

"Er!"

Merlin's face darkened, feeling a devastating blow. Even his precious daughter didn't fully trust him anymore! It seemed he had to demonstrate something.

Alice thought for a moment, then looked up and softly said, "Merlin, be careful."

Merlin stopped, turned back, and tilted his head with a smirk. "You should say that to my opponent."

"Hahaha, that Reckless lucky winner actually dared to step on the arena? He's going to get beaten up badly!"

"Truly lacking self-awareness. A guy who got into the top eight by luck has the guts to fight a real top-eight contender?"

"This isn't just about being bold—it's about being stupid to the extreme. Is he trying to die?"

Everyone was discussing, watching Merlin and Noah on the arena. They had expected Merlin to withdraw directly, but instead, he stood there. This truly confused many people, who thought withdrawing was normal. Anyone brave enough to fight must have a broken mind.

"Hmph! You actually dared to come up? I thought you'd have packed up and fled back to Reckless last night?" Noah crossed his arms and taunted.

"Run? Why would I run? I want to leave my footprints on your face~" Merlin held the wooden sword casually, looking more like he was strolling than competing.

"Who gave you the courage to say such things? Don't you want to live anymore!" Noah's face darkened as he threatened, "Surrender now, and it might still be okay."

"Sorry, I've never surrendered. No experience..." Merlin showed a mocking smile.

"Ha..." Noah was so angry he laughed, raising his eyebrows. "You're not even a fool, right? Do you think this is a game? You come up with a sword. I'm too lazy to fight you. Do you even know what shame is?"

"I'm using a wooden sword because you're not worth me using my real one. And..." Merlin tapped his shoulder with the wooden sword, his expression becoming a bit more serious.

"You're too few. It's not enough for me to fight. Bring everyone from your guild! Let them all come!"

"Watch carefully:"

"How I pierce through all of you Catowice adventurers by myself!"

title: Chapter 40 — Double Update
content:
Chapter 40 — Double Update

Volume 27 · Chapter 40

Because the whole village, only Martha's tavern was broadcasting the Adventurers' Competition, villagers came here to have a drink and take a look.

Until Merlin leapt onto the arena, the tavern's patrons erupted in cheers, and the women screamed nonstop!

Even after years, Merlin's nickname “Little Daisy” still remains in countless people's memory.

Seeing the familiar Little Daisy brother appear, these people became excited, pointing at Merlin on the big screen, chatting about Merlin's glorious (dark) history.

“Is that Merlin? Wow! Compared to years ago, he seems much more mature.”

“Little Daisy brother! I want to give you a monkey!”

“Tsk! These old women, haven't they realized that Merlin is a man they will never get in a lifetime?”

Little Henry was even more excited, jumping in place, ran to the front and stared at Merlin on the screen, “It’s Merlin brother! Merlin brother really became an adventurer, and stood on the arena of the Adventurers' Competition? So cool!”

“You quiet down a bit, don't disturb other guests… Martha tapped her son's head, indicating he should be quieter.”

Little Henry rubbed his head, eyes full of admiration, “I want to become an adventurer like Merlin brother! So cool!”

Martha sighed; since her son saw Merlin a year ago, she has become restless, very admiring of martial arts.

Little Henry even every day sticks to the back of the only low-cost fighter in the village, Strongson, hoping to learn powerful martial arts.

As a mother, Martha was helpless about this; although Strongson is a powerful figure in the village, in the whole world he is not worth much.

And don't mention comparing with Merlin? Their circles are completely different; what decent thing can her son learn?

Now Merlin stands on the world stage, proving that the people he encounters are only 1% of the world's billions, people ordinary people never see top-tier strongmen in a lifetime, and this small village is already a completely different world.

Because of different circumstances, their circles are inevitably different; maybe Little Henry will never be able to reach the world of top-tier strongmen like Merlin, but that doesn't stop him from longing for that life.

Martha looked at Merlin on the screen, couldn't help but think, how is Merlin's relationship with Miss Alice? Are they married? So curious.

“Dear, I'm back.”

Steve walked in carrying drinks; business had been busy these days, so he hurriedly bought a lot of beer.

This man, to avenge his companion, used the power of the Dark Guild to kill Baron Barton of Gaowe City.

During the process, he almost betrayed Merlin and Alice, but Merlin, considering Martha, didn't want Little Henry to lose his father, so he let him go.

Steve lost his job, so he returned to the small village, running the tavern with his wife Martha, and caring for Little Henry.

“Dad! Come look! This is the Merlin brother I was talking about! He's super cool! That time he saved my mom!” Little Henry was excited, pulling his father Steve's hand, pointing at Merlin on the screen.

“Oh? I see…”

Steve looked at Merlin on the screen, his pupils constricting, frozen on the spot, showing a hesitant expression.

After he came back, he always heard his son say that a man named Merlin was amazing, protecting the village while he was away, and rescuing his wife from goblins?

He had always thought it was just a coincidence of names, thinking of finding a chance to thank him, but he didn't expect the Merlin his son talked about was the terrifying adventurer he had seen in Gaowe City!

Steve felt very ashamed, he almost harmed the other party, but the other party not only let him go, but was also his wife's lifesaver; such great kindness cannot be repaid.

“What’s wrong? Dear, your face… doesn’t look good?” Martha came over to ask.

“.......Steve forced a slight smile, ‘This Mr. Merlin… looks like he’s been around for a long time?’”

In the small town of Little Cow, which has few French people, the local Adventurers' Guild also watched the competition.

The silver adventurer Arkon, known as the “Liver Emperor”, when he saw Merlin finally step onto the stage, danced excitedly.

Although he's old, seeing Merlin step onto the stage made him seem twenty years younger, he jumped onto the table.

“You all are confident…

“This man is called Merlin! Previously none of you had confidence in him, now you just wait to be slapped in the face!”

“Merlin's strength I cannot describe in words, he will definitely win this championship, you all think I'm crazy, now the proof time has come!”

Hahaha, I have a life connection with him, we are friends! We once fought bloodily together, killed a terrifying vampire. Old Arkon was flushed red, he had been waiting for this moment for a long time, this useless adventurer could now, with Merlin's help, shine again.

The adventurers of Little Cow were eating peanuts, drinking beer, watching the somewhat crazy old Arkon, feeling very surprised.

“Really? This guy is fine??”

“Really? This guy got to the quarterfinals purely by luck, will be beaten badly.”

“Exactly, Arkon, I think you’re old and a bit insane?”

“I don’t believe this time the black iron monster like Krawno from four years ago will appear,”

“Hmph~” Old Arkon chuckled twice, mysteriously said, “Let’s see, all good, let’s learn well~”

In the arena, Merlin faced the runner-up of the last competition, the entire Kotoviz Guild declared war!

After hearing, Noe’s expression froze, then he laughed, “Crazy? I’ve never seen someone wanting to die like this.”

The whole audience erupted in discussion; they originally thought Merlin would withdraw, but the opponent stepped onto the arena to challenge the entire guild.

“This person’s head must be wrong, just withdraw, won’t it be fine? He really thinks he can win?”

“Maybe he’s breaking the pot? Trying to regain some pride in this way, ridiculous.”

“He, a black iron adventurer who got in by luck, where’s the courage? I don’t understand. In the audience, Claudia frowned, thinking why subject himself to humiliation? Careless, no consequences…”

“What is Mr. Merlin thinking?!” Rosetti’s worldview exploded, but he saw Carl and President Taylor both laughing silently, Da Vinci was expressionless, no reaction.

“Interesting guy… Flamel stared at Merlin on the arena, a bit interested.”

Da Vinci was tense, his mind no longer on the match, but on how to escape Flamel’s hold? The hidden knife’s chill became more obvious.

“Come on, Kotoviz adventurers? Are you all turtles, not daring to accept my challenge?” Merlin laughed, using a similar tone to Noe, sarcastically said, “President Boz can also step up~”

“Seeking death!” Noe’s face was angry, teeth clenched, clearly provoked.

Below the arena, Sean and Gabriel were even pale, thinking that this black iron adventurer dared to be so arrogant, it’s a disgrace.

“I don’t know how high the sky is!” Boz, having suffered setbacks in this competition, was in a bad mood, now provoked by Merlin, couldn’t stand it, “Sean, Gabriel, go! No need to hold back, kill him!”

“That… please wait a moment, YS” The referee, unable to control the situation, wanted to say something? As a result, Sean and Gabriel, full of vigor, went onto the stage, scaring him, he hurriedly jumped off the arena to hide.

Sean, Noe, Gabriel, the Kotoviz trio of stars stood on the arena; President Boz, due to his position, did not go up, choosing to watch from below how Merlin was beaten?

The three turned pale, glaring at Merlin, the audience erupted in cheers, thinking this match was too interesting, first time seeing a three-on-one situation.

“Go! Show him some color!”

The fastest among them was Noe, his waist sword flashed, producing a deafening roar!

The sonic sword technique was almost at its peak speed, Noe’s sword arm seemed to vanish, this move would surely shred the enemy into meat.

“Hahaha! I’ve honed this move for ten years, rarely encountering opponents, you also couldn’t…”

Noe shouted excitedly, the phantom of each slender sword surrounded Merlin, ordinary people only saw silver waves.

But at that moment, Merlin casually extended his arm, just let you first?

He heard a “ding” sound—

Noe, thinking his sonic sword technique was at its peak, was easily broken by Merlin; two fingers just pinched the unclear slender sword!

“…ah?” Noe’s face was stunned, like a fool, his mind blank, Merlin had broken his sonic sword technique.

“This turtle-speed sword technique, how can it be displayed before me?” Merlin said coldly, swinging his wooden sword at Noe’s abdomen, making him spit out a large mouth of blood.

Noe’s face turned pale, his body flew like a projectile, smashing the crystal used for live broadcast in the sky, then crashed onto the audience seat.

Dust rose, causing a great panic; timid spectators turned into a mess, screaming in terror, rushing to escape the competition.

They didn’t expect that the ordinary Merlin was actually a strongman? The renowned Noe was defeated in an instant, all knocked out of the arena.

Although the scene was chaotic, the battle spread to the audience, but there were still people who didn’t mind the spectacle, staring at the arena, secretly feeling…

“This Rexum is a winning king, … a strongman! A guy who can easily defeat Kotoviz’s top ace!”

Flamel’s face turned very ugly, the crystal’s shattering ruined his plan, he didn’t expect a sudden brute to appear halfway.

“You are strong? I want you to know Kotoviz’s strongest creator’s power!”

Gabriel shouted angrily, his twin swords emitted red light, and when he swung them, they produced a sword shadow that covered the sky.

Each sword shadow was a real entity, could easily slay enemies, extremely powerful!

Gabriel’s sword technique was that each swing of a sword was equivalent to 27,564 sharp blades attacking simultaneously; two swords swung meant 55,128 blades.

The sword shadows danced across the sky, grand in momentum, as if they could cut Merlin into fragments; Gabriel’s sword technique made him truly the strongest swordsman of Kotoviz.

“My ten-thousand-sword frenzy, when I strike, it’s inevitable to kill!”

Merlin remained very calm, smiled indifferently, “All those messy sword techniques, full of holes!”

In an instant, Merlin’s wooden sword seemed to have eyes, cutting through countless sword shadows, striking Gabriel’s two hands with a hard blow.

The seemingly terrifying sword technique was directly broken; Gabriel’s two hands swelled, the sharp swords fell to the ground, his facial features twisted in pain.

“…Gabriel felt a hint of despair…”

His mind only felt “pain”; the opponent casually tapped twice, his sword technique instantly crumbled? What a mastery in swordsmanship!

“Get out of here!” Merlin swung his wooden sword, striking Gabriel’s chin, teeth bled out; this scene was like a father fighting his son.

Waaa… Gabriel lost teeth, wind leaked, speech unclear, his body weakly flew off the arena, hitting the front row audience’s wall, causing panic.

Sean, having been defeated by Tania, originally thought to take this opportunity to show gemstone…

His magic power was not weak, but Tania was a warrior, didn’t give him a chance to use magic; he was still the strongest in Kotoviz Guild.

But this time Sean couldn’t use gemstone magic; the two companions were like children, pressed to the ground by the black iron adventurer, frantically rubbing? This caused him to suffer a lot…

Noe and Gabriel’s strength is definitely not weak; how did they get beaten like this? Did they eat too much aluminum?

I fear I can’t handle them together; the other side is so easy…

Apparently this guy deliberately pretended to be salty? He’s a real sword master!

Sean’s face was colorless, holding his wand trembling, not daring to look at Merlin; as Boz’s student…

He was a bit cowardly.

“Next… Merlin took a step forward, looking very relaxed, his wooden sword lightly tapping his own shoulder—”

“The ugly thing said in front, not yet at pseudo-divine realm; the mage in front of me…”

“All are worthless!”

title: Chapter 41 — Retort
content:
Chapter 41 — Retort

Volume 27 · Chapter 41

Shawn's words were incoherent, and although he felt a thread of fear when he heard Merlin's words, his anger still surged upward. As the disciple of the gemstone magician Boz, he was a being revered by thousands of people, so where had he ever suffered such humiliation? The opponent directly said that magicians were useless, and no matter who heard this, their self-esteem would be greatly hurt, it was simply a great shame.

Shawn bit his lips until they turned pale, and the anger in his heart slowly overcame his fear, he wanted to prove himself. Boz's face turned iron-blue, and his hands, which were tightly gripping the magic wand, turned pale, seeing his two generals being beaten until they were covered in blood, he couldn't help but fall into silence. I originally thought he was just a player that Reksum had picked up to make up the numbers, but I didn't expect that such an unremarkable family would be Reksum's main force. No wonder those nobles came to get close to him, it turned out that he really had skills.

What to do now? Shawn alone couldn't possibly win, could it be that his Katovitz Guild, the runner-up in the previous tournament, would be beaten to the point of being helpless by this Black Iron adventurer? How detestable! I miscalculated! I actually fell in front of the Reksum Guild, a bunch of trash! At this time, Noah and Gabriel, who had been easily defeated by Merlin, struggled to get up, dragging their heavily injured bodies. The surrounding audience was frightened, looking at the two people with gloomy faces, they could feel the intense anger emanating from them from a distance.

Noah and Gabriel picked up their weapons again and walked onto the stage, coming to Shawn's side. Although being knocked out of the stage meant defeat, and coming back didn't follow the rules, at this time, it was no longer just a competition, but a matter of the Katovitz Guild's honor. The Katovitz Guild had come a long way from being unknown, and as long as they could defeat the Merlin in front of them, they could prove that the adventurers of the Katovitz Guild were not to be trifled with. Shawn was about to speak, but hesitated. "We must win!" Noah growled, his eyes blazing with fury, already prepared to fight to the death.

Gabriel's face was twisted, his teeth clenched, and he was saying something, but his words were unclear. Shawn looked confused, wondering, "What is he saying?" Noah helped translate, "He said it's time to use that move, no matter what, we must defeat that bastard." "That move?" Shawn's eyes widened, his expression serious, "Do we really have to use it?" "Use it! This is no longer a competition, but a defense of the guild's honor!" Noah's fighting spirit was high.

"Okay!" Shawn responded loudly, the magic power in his body beginning to surge. The three of them looked like a desperate squad, their killing intent unconcealed. They assumed a strange posture, with the two swordsmen on either side and the magician in the middle. Their hateful gazes locked onto Merlin, as if they wanted to devour his flesh and drink his blood. Boz was shocked, his eyes wide with surprise, but he quickly regained his composure, a hint of pleasure appearing on his face.

Good! Finally, they were going to go all out, were they going to use that sword technique they had learned from the ancient scrolls? That terrifying sword technique was said to have been created by the twin sword saints of the former kingdom, and it was rumored that no one could survive its onslaught. You think Reksum has strong reinforcements? Today, I, the Katovitz Guild, will necessarily trample you underfoot! Boz's expression became excited, as if he had already seen his three generals making a desperate counterattack.

This sword technique was extraordinary, originally designed for two people to use in tandem, but after Boz's modifications, it had been infused with gemstone magic, and there was a tendency for the two different powers to merge. Gregory watched over the heavily injured Aria, and the fact that the London Adventurers Guild had been eliminated in the quarterfinals made him feel a bit regretful. When Gregory looked up and saw the strange posture of the three people from the Katovitz Guild on the stage, his expression changed.

"What's wrong, President?" Vice President Veran asked in surprise. "Their posture looks a bit like the twin sword saints of the former kingdom..." Gregory frowned, seemingly unsure. "Really?" Vice President Veran was shocked, "If that's true, then it's dangerous!" Gregory was silent, vaguely remembering the twin sword saints of the former kingdom, who had a high level of cooperation and had defeated many strong warriors, leaving them dead in a pitiful state.

Merlin looked at the three people with interest, thinking that it was pointless for them to struggle. "Are you not giving up? What are you playing at? Left green dragon, right white tiger, and a fool in the middle?" Gabriel's face was full of anger, and he was saying something, but his words were unclear. "This is what you've forced us into! Take this!" Noah translated, imitating Gabriel's tone. As soon as he finished speaking, the three people's pressure seemed to merge into one, and even the small stones on the ground floated in mid-air.

Noah and Gabriel began to swing their swords, gradually forming a whirlpool. Shawn raised his magic wand, and magic power crystals appeared, pouring into the whirlpool. "Purgatory Storm!" With a loud shout, Noah and Gabriel spun around, their swords creating a terrifying storm. The storm was even more eerie, with countless magic power crystals mixed in, and it shone with a starry glow.

The three people's combined technique had a power that far surpassed that of the twin sword saints, and it had merged magic and fighting spirit, increasing its strength. The rotating Purgatory Storm split into two, attacking Merlin with a overwhelming force. At this moment, everyone held their breath, and even the audience, who were afraid of being affected, stopped in their tracks and turned to watch.

"Do you think you can defeat me with the technique of a defeated general? Laughable!" Merlin suddenly assumed a posture, and in the blink of an eye, he drew his knife and struck down with a coarse wooden knife. The ground shook, and the stage was split in two, forming a huge gorge. The loud noise was like an explosion, and the wind from the knife slash was like a fierce devil, constantly letting out a terrifying roar.

The audience was frightened, and those who were cowardly escaped the arena in a sorry state, afraid that the fight would drag them in. After the dust settled, the three people from the Katovitz Guild were lying in the ruins, and even with their combined technique, they were no match for Merlin. Gabriel and Shawn had lost consciousness in the explosion, and only Noah was barely holding on, spitting out blood, his internal organs severely damaged.

Noah, who was lying on the ground, was gritting his teeth in pain, trying to get up again, but he had no fighting strength left. Merlin came to Noah's side, expressionless, and stepped on his chest, pointing his wooden knife at Noah's nose. "Now tell me, do I have the qualifications to challenge you?" Everyone, please don't stay up late, I have something to attend to in real life, and I need to get up at 4 am tomorrow. So I'll try to write 6000 words tomorrow to make up for it. Tomorrow, I'll be giving away prizes on the Pineapple Circle, including a set of Three Zero cards, so please remember to participate.

title: Chapter 42 — Hard to See Through
content:
Chapter 42 — Hard to See Through

Volume 27 · Chapter 42

Faced with Merlin's questioning, the heavily injured Noah's rage surged. Although his gaze seemed ready to kill, he dared not speak out against Merlin.

Having failed even against their combined technique, Noah had already realized that there was a massive gap in strength between himself and the Iron-rank adventurer before him.

Merlin snorted coldly and paid no more attention to Noah, the rat. Instead, his gaze turned toward the arena floor, toward Katowice Guildmaster Boz, his eyes full of provocation.

"That... that bastard!"

Boz's eyes glared at Merlin with hatred, his face turning deathly pale, his breathing growing heavy and labored.

My Katowice Guild ranks second in the world!

And today, we can't even defeat an Iron-rank adventurer from Rexem?!

What a humiliating disgrace! All my efforts over the past four years have come to nothing...

The angrier Boz thought about it, especially under Merlin's provoking gaze, the more his anger overwhelmed him, and his eyelids fluttered before he fainted right there.

Although the chaotic crowd had scattered for the most part, those who remained couldn't tear their eyes away from Merlin—

This Rexem adventurer had endured humiliation from the very beginning, bearing the doubts of countless people, and yet here he had proven himself in a single moment!

What Rexem's free-rider king? What a weakling who clings to the powerful? What an adventurer brought along just to fill the roster?

He was truly Rexem's real powerhouse. Even without Alice and Karl, relying solely on Merlin, he could still easily reach the quarterfinals!

Defeating three of Katowice Guild's aces in one sweep, and even the famously renowned Boz had been angered into fainting—this would surely be huge news if it spread!

The crowd fell completely silent. Merlin's performance had stunned everyone, and no one dared to call him "Rexem's free-rider king" anymore.

"...What is going on!"

Rosetti's eyes were blank, feeling as though she were about to lose her mind. She had always thought Merlin was just a freeloader in the guild, and suddenly he had become a powerful adventurer who was dismantling Katowice's aces!

The shock to Rosetti was immense. The stark contrast nearly made her doubt her own eyes—how could the guy who drank with Hobbs every day possibly be this strong?!

Rosetti frantically blinked, trying to find some reason to convince herself. Everything she was seeing felt so unreal.

"Da Vinci, is Merlin really this amazing? Isn't he always living off Alice? What exactly happened?"

Da Vinci remained silent. The knife pressed against her side kept her from making any sudden moves. She was usually this quiet, which was precisely why no one had noticed she had been taken hostage by Flamel.

Facing Rosetti's question, Da Vinci also looked at Merlin atop the arena ruins, equally surprised that he possessed such terrifying strength. Katowice's three aces hadn't even had a chance to counterattack!

Driven by curiosity, Da Vinci's monocle lit up with a magic circle once more, beginning to analyze Merlin's combat power, hoping alchemy would yield a satisfactory result.

This was Da Vinci's second time investigating Merlin's strength. The first time had been at the guild, but her glasses had malfunctioned back then, and the matter had been dropped.

But this time, the same thing happened. In Da Vinci's vision, Merlin's combat power rose wildly, and once it reached a certain level—*crack*—the lens shattered.

Da Vinci froze, suddenly realizing something. Her combat-analysis glasses were crafted with alchemy, so the probability of malfunction was supposed to be very low.

For the same person's combat power to cause two malfunctions—this was clearly impossible. Then the only possible truth was—

Mr. Merlin had become too strong...

Her alchemical glasses had limited analytical ability and could not fathom Merlin's strength.

Thinking this, Da Vinci secretly drew in a cold breath, and her gaze toward Merlin turned reverent. What kind of strength was this, something even she couldn't probe?

Da Vinci thought to herself: so many people believed Merlin relied on Alice to survive, appearing as a useless fellow—perhaps the truth was exactly the opposite!

"What an annoying bastard..." Flamel muttered under her breath, wondering what to do next.

Karl: "Merlin, you've gone a bit too far."

Father and son both had dark expressions. They had thought Merlin could defeat the Katowice Guild with a light touch, never expecting it to cause such a commotion and scare away all the spectators.

"Me... Gregori muttered to himself with a bitter smile, "So Rexem still hides a powerhouse like this? No wonder Taylor was so calm last night. He must have had this all planned out."

"Vice Guildmaster Welan lowered his head, feeling somewhat dejected."

"We didn't lose unjustly. The three Katowice aces gave it their all just now. If Elia had gone up, she might have lost instead." Gregori looked up at Merlin on the arena ruins. "Rexem was better prepared than we were."

"As expected of the man I favor~" Margaret, seated in the guest area, was already swooning. "Lord Merlin is working so hard for my sake, striving to win the championship..."

Blaise, standing behind her, was dumbfounded and couldn't process it for a long while. His mind was filled with one thought: this guy is actually this strong? He's not just Alice's accessory after all?

"Wah~!" Chris's face was full of admiration, her ahoge standing straight up like an antenna. "Mom, is Dad this amazing?"

"You're just now finding out?" Alice looked down at Chris in her arms.

"I thought Dad was just really good at cooking..." Chris drooled pathetically.

"Uh..." Alice looked awkward, wondering if she had been relegated to后勤 duties in Chris's eyes. But he's trying so hard—could it be for that fox spirit Margaret?

Merlin looked at the adventurers surrounding the arena ruins, all of them frozen like wooden chickens, not daring to breathe loudly. He knew his purpose had been achieved.

But it wasn't enough! This opportunity was rare, and Merlin wanted to use it to showcase himself. He had endured for so many days; he had to clear his name this time.

Merlin looked around and loudly declared, "I'll accept the championship. Does anyone have any objections?"

The adventurers below lowered their heads in silence. Although they weren't entirely comfortable with it, three of Katowice's aces had already fallen—going up themselves would be pointless.

Three of the adventurers who had entered the top eight were now heavily injured. The only ones who could compete with Merlin were Alice, Tanya, Chikatilo, and Cronus.

Standing atop the ruins, Merlin smiled faintly. "Don't just stay silent. It makes me look like a robber. If you have objections, come at me. This is a challenge I'm issuing to every adventurer here!"

"My..." Ligachov, the guildmaster of VesterYev, stroked his bald head. "As I suspected, this guy is no ordinary person. I had anticipated this, but I never expected it to be this terrifying. Even three from Katowice Guild couldn't handle him."

Tanya looked at Merlin on the ruins, then suddenly stepped forward. On her usually cold face, a rare hint of excitement appeared, and she quietly clenched her fist—

"I'm...

"very interested in him!"

title: Chapter 43 — Reluctant Acceptance (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 43 — Reluctant Acceptance (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 27 · Chapter 43

Ligachev saw Tanya itching for a fight and was startled. "Hey! Tanya, what are you doing?"

"His strength suits me perfectly. I came specifically for an opponent like this." Tanya's expression was serious. The moment she saw Merlin defeat Katowice and the other two, she had already marked Merlin as her rival.

"Well... although I did tell you to pay more attention to this guy, you also saw it — Katowice and the other two lost even working together. You'd better not try." Ligachev felt Tanya would likely lose if she went up; preserving her reputation was best right now. He feared that in this whole arena, only last tournament's champion Crono could contend with Merlin. After all, both of them were bugs among Black Iron adventurers.

"I entered this tournament precisely for an opponent like this."

Tanya said seriously. Ever since Crono came up short against Merlin, she had kept her eye on Merlin. When Merlin took the stage and displayed his strength, boundless fighting spirit ignited in her heart.

For some reason, seeing Merlin on the platform made Tanya want to crush him, as if a sense of mission compelled her to challenge him.

Seeing Tanya had made up her mind, Ligachev could only sigh. "Be careful. I get the feeling that guy hasn't gone all out yet."

"I know." Tanya nodded and stepped directly onto the ruins of the arena.

At the same time, Chikatilo unexpectedly refused to be left out and walked onto the arena, staring at Merlin across from him.

Chikatilo felt a strong interest in Merlin. Back in the Magic Beast Forest, he had thought Merlin was just a useless bottom-tier adventurer.

But today he witnessed Merlin displaying divine might, single-handedly defeating the Katowice Guild. Chikatilo finally began to take Merlin seriously, regarding him as a formidable opponent.

Chikatilo thought those nobles must have long since seen Merlin's capability; otherwise they wouldn't be so close to this man. That useless appearance before — it must have been an act.

Merlin looked at Tanya and Chikatilo suddenly stepping up and thought: Only two people unconvinced? This half-elf helped me before, so I'll let him off with a little less pain.

"Lord Merlin, so your strength is this great. Back in the Magic Beast Forest, you tricked me good." Chikatilo said meaningfully.

"I didn't trick you. You just assumed things on your own, didn't you?" Merlin shrugged.

Chikatilo was left speechless. Thinking back, it seemed true — he had been careless because of the Black Iron adventurer certification. "If I'd known you had this kind of strength, I wouldn't have meddled and helped you find your daughter."

"Don't put it like that. I remember the favor I owe you. You're here to challenge me?" Merlin asked with a smile.

"Exactly. You want the championship, and I want it too. Unfortunately, there's only one—" Chikatilo made his stance clear. He wasn't very convinced by Merlin's claim that the championship belonged to him.

"Then there's no help for it. I'll go easy on you." Merlin said in a helpless tone.

Being able to say that was Merlin's goodwill, but to Chikatilo's ears it was unbearably grating — an insult to his proud soul!

He felt Merlin was looking down on him, not taking him seriously at all. "I don't need you to go easy on me."

Chikatilo wanted to earn the Elven King's acknowledgment. He wanted to prove himself. Defeating Merlin was the best choice.

This half-elf mage had already mustered his full resolve, swearing to hold his head high before the Elven King!

"Go easy on me? In a one-on-one fight, not one of Katowice's three is my match. If you're not afraid of ruining your reputation, then by all means go easy—"

Merlin gave a dry laugh and stopped paying attention to Chikatilo, instead turning his gaze to the icy Tanya. "What about you? You also want to challenge me?"

"Yes." Tanya clenched her gauntlets, a harsh metallic grinding sound ringing out. "You're the biggest harvest of my trip. Don't disappoint me."

"Truly concise~" Merlin sized up Tanya. This girl of few words looked like trouble. It seemed all her matches ended in instant kills — she'd breezed her way to the top eight.

"Wait a moment, Miss Tanya. Lord Merlin's opponent is me. Please step down and let me have a solo match with him." Chikatilo didn't like winning by numbers; if he won, he wanted to win fair and square.

"Scram. I'm here. Thanks." Tanya replied expressionlessly, already treating Merlin as her prey.

"...What did you say?" Chikatilo's face darkened, faintly feeling his dignity challenged.

"I said scram. This person is my opponent." Tanya repeated it rudely.

"Hah..." Chikatilo laughed coldly. "You think because you're a rising star you can order me around? Don't be ignorant of your own limitations."

"Someone who nearly lost to a teenager barely in his teens — you're qualified to point fingers at me?" Tanya's icy gaze swept over him. From the bottom of her heart, she had never respected this half-elf mage.

"You—!" Chikatilo's eyes seemed ready to spit fire. Recalling the incident where he almost lost to Little Johnson, he felt utterly humiliated.

The two faced off needle-point against wheat-awn, about to fight each other before even dealing with Merlin?

It seemed Merlin wasn't just a destroyer of the tournament rules — he was a piece of fat meat.

Quite a few people were thinking of defeating Merlin to establish their prestige in the Grand Competition.

Merlin sighed. Being fought over by two enemies felt inexplicably strange, so he said calmly, "No need for this. This is the first time I've seen people rushing over to get beaten. You two come at me together. I said I challenge all adventurers present — no matter how many band together, I'll make you deeply understand what 'invincible' means."

Chikatilo: "Looks like we have a common enemy. Whoever beats him first gets the credit..."

Tanya: "Just don't get in my way."

Merlin's words enraged all his peers present. Though they feared Merlin's power, in their hearts they still hoped Merlin would suffer a crushing defeat.

The adventurers below began cheering for Tanya and Chikatilo, hoping the two could give Merlin a taste of his own medicine. After all, this Black Iron adventurer who had appeared out of nowhere was far too arrogant—

"Tanya's strength is unfathomable. She can definitely beat this arrogant bastard!"

"Tanya plus Chikatilo should be a sure thing. Both are powerful adventurers at the peak of their game!"

"Their individual strength both steadily surpass any one of Katowice's three aces. Together, this arrogant bastard might not be able to withstand them!"

Merlin listened to the adventurers' discussions, merely smiling without a word. He didn't retort or explain, instead thinking to himself—

Seems brute force can't make these adventurers truly convinced, huh?

I never learned any "winning hearts through virtue"...

Better to use some real skill, let them see the gap in strength, and then despair completely.

Tanya, Chikatilo — you two really think you can gain an advantage in front of me?

Pineapple Circle's lottery, if anyone wants to participate go check it out. Click my author avatar to see it.

title: Chapter 44 — Instinctive Disgust
content:
Chapter 44 — Instinctive Disgust

Volume 27 · Chapter 44

Tania suddenly clenched her gauntlets, her gaze fixed; the storm, mixed with terrifying sect-level fighting spirit, surged straight into the clouds, turning the sky itself.

She fused with the crystal core of a wind-element beast, similar to Dikt, and by harnessing the beast's crystal core gained immense power, becoming a master of a certain element.

However, Tania's storm power was clearly not as strong as Merlin's earth power, which protects the dwarven golden essence and the earth spirit; it could very well be the strongest elemental beast?

The storm's power began to sweep the arena; the seemingly gentle wind could leave marks on stone, who knows if approaching recklessly would be torn apart by the gale?

The adventurers below began to cheer, secretly admiring that he was indeed the so-called strongest new adventurer, perhaps he could really defeat the arrogant Black Iron adventurer!

"Oh~" Merlin looked at Tania and nodded, thinking that this was the guy who controlled elemental beast power, no wonder he had the courage to come up.

Tania could not hold back; she kicked the ground hard, carrying a fierce storm tornado, and slammed her fist at Merlin.

She knew Merlin was not weak, so she left no hand; she went all out from the start!

Tania was not tense at all; instead she was in ecstatic joy, how lucky it was to find a worthy opponent to fight with all her might.

Merlin stood still like a sculpture, watching the approaching storm with a blank expression; strands of golden hair were cut in the fierce storm.

The strength is indeed good; if it were someone else, they might feel fear, but unfortunately the opponent is me...

Merlin thought calmly; he saw himself back his wooden sword behind his back, firmly extending his hand to catch the incoming storm, utterly unafraid of his arm being torn by the gale.

"....Has he gone mad? Someone actually proved hard against Tania's fist!" Lijagov stared wide-eyed, thinking that a normal rational person would never do this!

Merlin's current physical strength is not something that a mere sect-level fighter could damage.

After receiving the amplification of the earth spirit, his body is probably harder than the toughest ore.

But it was only Tania's full-force attack; how could it possibly threaten Merlin?

The frenzied storm raged; Merlin stood still, his feet not moving a single moment, but the earth behind him had long been carved with countless marks by the gale!

Only when the vision-disturbing storm dissipated did everyone see clearly—

Merlin firmly held Tania's big fist with one hand; the sturdy gauntlet was unknowingly covered with fine cracks.

Tania suddenly froze, her mind blank, feeling her fist slammed into a solid wall, unmoving.

"Goodbye." Merlin muttered lightly; the earth spirit's repelling space was instantly activated.

The air trembled slightly; a huge repulsive force emanated from Merlin's body, and in her astonishment, Tania was suddenly pushed away!

Tania's body spun in midair, like a spacetime lead ball, smashing through several walls until it stopped outside the arena; she didn't know what happened.

"It's your turn." Merlin stared at Ziqatilo without expression, already pondering how to make this half-elf mage leave the stage.

"Uh!"

Ziqatilo snapped back to consciousness, thinking that this Black Iron adventurer far exceeded his expectations.

Just now, Tania's attack was strong, but it was subdued by the opponent's single hand.

What exactly is this guy? When among adventurers does such a far beyond rational pervert appear...

Ziqatilo saw Tania fly out of the arena, immediately feeling considerable pressure, and realizing he had greatly underestimated Merlin, he had to fight desperately.

"If you realize the gap, then you still have time to leave the arena, surrender to me... don't be ashamed." Merlin said with a serious face; as a former Demon Lord, accepting an adventurer's surrender was indeed normal.

"Don't be too arrogant; it seems I need to show you the real strength!"

Ziqatilo let out a low roar; the magic ring on his hand glowed with dazzling black light, and for a moment the air seemed to carry a chorus of songs.

Tiny black specks began to appear out of nowhere, surrounding Ziqatilo, as if they had independent life.

If observed closely, one would find these black specks like fireflies, constantly communicating with Ziqatilo?

In the guest seats, the Elf King saw this half-blood Ziqatilo, his instincts as an elf naturally disliking it, feeling that this half-blood had tainted his own race.

But seeing Ziqatilo bathed in countless black rays, the Elf King's face changed, feeling very surprised.

Helf noticed, curious, asking, "Your Majesty, why are you staring at that half-elf? Is there something else?"

"Nothing... The Elf King withdrew his gaze, speaking softly, "It's just a half-elf who can communicate with elements; it's exceedingly rare."

A half-blood possessing such strength is truly rare.

"Is that so?" Helf curiously examined Ziqatilo below, "It's a pity he has half-cursed blood; if he were a pure elf, he'd be more suitable as your personal guard than I."

"He seems not old,"

His talent could rival my brother... The Elf King thought of Ashudao, helplessly shaking his head, "Only a pity he's a half-blood."

Ziqatilo roared, releasing the same magic as the Dark Elf King toward Merlin; a dense barrage of magic bullets formed a net, covering the entire arena ruin.

But he already knew Merlin's strength, so naturally he wouldn't fight like with Little Johnson; the floating magic barrage suddenly swelled, turning into fierce beast heads, roaring toward Merlin.

Countless black, flame-like beast heads bared their fangs, as if one were in hell; Merlin, at the center, was surrounded—this was the strongest magic Ziqatilo could wield now!

"Disappear!"

Merlin shook his head, threw the wooden sword he held; the ordinary wooden sword suddenly became a sharp javelin in an instant?

It pierced through the surrounding flame beast heads, "thud"—a blow landed on Ziqatilo's forehead!

Ziqatilo only felt his vision go black; his body wobbled and fell to the ground unconscious, his forehead slowly swelling into a big lump.

Merlin extended his hand to catch the wooden sword rebounding; watching the magic dissipate before his eyes, he helplessly said.

"Why bother..."

Just as the words fell, a wind like a blade rushed in, cutting Merlin's cheek!

Nine storms descended from the sky, countless wind blades intermingled, emitting a swoosh-swoosh-swoosh cutting through the air.

Tania was wounded all over, but still brought the storm; every punch left meteor-like marks on the earth!

"I don't like relentless brawling..." Merlin frowned, not retreating but advancing, striking Tania's shoulder with his wooden sword.

"Ugh!" Tania groaned in pain, kneeling on one knee before Merlin, clearly badly injured.

"You can't win, surrender..." Merlin pointed at Tania with his wooden sword, his tone carrying a hint of seriousness.

Tania lifted her head; her gaze flickered with defiance, the desire to win had seeped into her marrow.

A white feather swept past Merlin's eyes, making him frown slightly—

What is this wave of nausea? It makes me so irritated I can't bear it...

In the next moment, Tania's potential was greatly stimulated under Merlin's pressure!

The long-suppressed power began to slowly manifest! ! !

title: Chapter 45 — The King in Another World (Extra)
content:
Chapter 45 — The King in Another World (Extra)

Volume 27 · Chapter 45

Why? Why is there an uncontrollable urge to kill? I have never...... Strongly wanting to kill this guy with my own hands! Tanya was in a state of extreme excitement, feeling an unbearable itch on her back, as if receiving some kind of summon. Her skin began to turn deathly pale, without a trace of blood, her eyes filled with ruby‑like light. A strange red rune began to appear on her skin, like a snake constantly snapping upward, approaching her forehead! Tanya felt her body filled with unprecedented power; only by tearing Merlin apart could she calm down. She abruptly lifted her head— and saw “a sudden blow”; Merlin’s wooden sword had already struck, “thud” hitting Tanya’s forehead..... “....Tanya’s gaze went blank, the series of changes like a tide receding, she lost consciousness and collapsed. “Tsk~” Merlin, not following the rules, looked down at the unconscious Tanya, “What are you getting excited about? Lie down quietly, stop clinging, do you think anyone will wait for your transformation to finish before acting? Naive~” Liga Jove covered his face, thinking, “Surely I lost? Tanya’s strength is too unstable; I knew this would happen.” The fellow adventurers below fell silent; even Tanya and Qikatiluo were no match— who could defeat this black‑iron adventurer who sprang onto the scene midway? “What a terrifying person— his casual strike left Tanya and Qikatiluo powerless to retaliate.” Gregory commented. “I don't know. The rule among adventurers is not to investigate anyone's past, because many people have shady histories. Gregory fell silent, recalling the major criminals that had appeared before, constantly comparing them to Merlin’s image. Possessing tremendous physical strength, skilled with swords, blond, in his twenties, with an overbearing, arrogant attitude...... Why do these traits resemble those of the great swordsman Elgin so closely? Gregory wondered, though similar, he dared not jump to conclusions. But after personally experiencing the fist of that outlaw, Gregory knew Elgin the Great Swordsman was no ordinary foe. Karl sucked in a breath of cold air and said quietly, “Four of the top eight have been defeated— this match doesn’t need to continue…” “Not certain— there’s still a low‑key contender who hasn’t taken the stage.” Old Taylor’s eyes grew deep. Merlin looked at the adventurers below, heads bowed, silent, not daring to meet his gaze, feeling he had done enough— probably no one would still have the guts to stand before him. Actually he could see that none of the participating adventurers had reached the pseudo‑god realm, so any Demon Lord could sweep everyone here effortlessly. Having shown off and vented his recent frustration, Merlin felt satisfied, turned to leave the arena ruins, carrying a sense of loneliness at the top. The arbitrators on the podium, seeing the situation spiraling out of control, were all a bit at a loss- Skinny Committee Member: “This.... Rexel’s Merlin, is too strong, right?” Short Committee Member: “Yeah, I wish one person could smash through all guilds— this simply destroys the competition’s balance....” Old Man Dawson: “Stay calm— there’s still the strongest person who hasn’t stepped up to challenge...” Just as Merlin was about to step down from the stage, the watching adventurers stirred, and faint exclamations could be heard. It seemed the strongest contender in everyone’s mind had appeared, and now the true clash of titans was about to begin— Merlin, who awed the whole crowd with his own strength, and likewise, the lone figure upholding the honorary guild’s previous champion, Clawnuo. In everyone’s heart, one mountain cannot hold two tigers; the two are destined to fight today! Merlin turned his head and indeed saw the strange Clawnuo appear behind him; his deformed visage made it hard to read his expression. Clawnuo didn’t care about the championship, but he truly wanted to kill Merlin and abduct Chris. Alice, though capable, was nowhere near Clawnuo’s perception and didn’t even register on his radar. Merlin, however, was different— his recent display made Clawnuo very wary; if he wanted to take Chris away, Merlin would be the biggest obstacle. So Clawnuo felt the opportunity was rare; he might as well try to kill Merlin now, for to take Chris he must first take Merlin’s life. “Do you want to challenge me?” Merlin inquired tentatively. Clawnuo couldn’t speak, but the eyes on his jaw rolled about, he slightly bowed like a noble offering a salute— that was his reply to Merlin. “....” Merlin sighed, then with lightning speed he closed the distance to Clawnuo, his seemingly rough wooden sword still cutting toward the opponent. The scene left everyone stunned; no one expected Merlin to strike so decisively. In the flash of lightning, Clawnuo’s pupils contracted, and beneath his feet a ring‑shaped black‑purple vortex appeared, like a magic circle. From it emerged many black‑clad knights wielding swords, tall and sturdy. Their appearance was bizarre— no noses, bluish skin, large dark eyes, like the vast starry sky. The black knights raised their swords to block Merlin’s attack, trying to shield Clawnuo behind them. Relying on numbers, they barely managed to withstand Merlin’s charge; a few knights tried to touch Merlin’s body, but suddenly they flinched. Clawnuo’s face darkened as he thought, “No magic or battle aura? How is that possible? How can this world contain someone so strong without magic or battle aura?” “What a strange bunch of summoned creatures! I’ve never seen anything like this, but do you really think they can stop me? Give it up!” Merlin suddenly increased his force; his seemingly fragile wooden sword became like a divine blade, cleaving the black knights in half at the waist. 0p SE2 Xiao Zhi Clawnuo fled in terror, thinking, “Our unique talent isn’t working— this is getting troublesome.” As he ran, Clawnuo suddenly felt a tremendous pull, his body uncontrollably flying toward Merlin behind him! Merlin unleashed a gravity field on Clawnuo, then drew his sword, glaring at the poor fellow who had walked right into his grasp. Flying toward Merlin, Clawnuo was like a lamb entering a tiger’s den— no way to resist, he had to fight for real— Summoning an arm of the Otherworld King to help himself defeat that strange man! If Merlin is the strongest in this world, then the Otherworld King is the strongest in the other world. Strongest versus strongest— it’s hard to predict the outcome. Suddenly a black‑purple vortex appeared between them, from which a colossal arm burst forth, about three hundred feet long, nearly filling half the arena! This is merely the Otherworld King’s arm; who knows what the true form would look like! The Otherworld King’s arm hammered straight at Merlin, launching him into the air and smashing him into the arena wall, where bricks and debris buried him. The adventurers saw the seemingly invincible Merlin being repelled, and they burst into shocked discussion— “He was repelled? He actually got knocked back! He isn’t invincible! “No wonder it’s Clawnuo! Or maybe Clawnuo is stronger! “Although both are monsters among the black‑iron ranks, Clawnuo is the genuine champion!” Alice sprang up and shouted anxiously, “Merlin! ?” Clatter— Merlin rose from the wreckage, his complexion a little off, he brushed the dust from his clothes. Seeing his wooden sword broken, he reluctantly tossed it aside and then said to Alice, “Alice, give me the sword....”

title: Chapter 46 — Split Regeneration
content:
Chapter 46 — Split Regeneration

Volume 27 · Chapter 46

Merlin emerged from the rubble, dusted off his body, and his expression grew a touch more serious. So the adventurers participating in the competition also had existences close to the Demon Lord level?

It is said that Krono absolutely possesses the strength standard of a purple-gold adventurer, and now Merlin believed it.

Judging by the power of the summoned creature just now, its strength was by no means to be underestimated. Merlin had suffered a loss due to complacency.

Kronos wiped cold sweat from his forehead, his heart still trembling at the recent events. Almost—his rescue head was about to split open.

The enormous arm of the Otherworld King had not dissipated but was connected to a black-purple vortex. Who knew where the main body was in what realm?

Besides being thick and large, the arm was also wrapped in black armor, with electricity constantly surging across it, giving people a feeling of an extraterrestrial civilization.

The adjudicators on the podium couldn't help but start whispering privately at the sight before them.

The tall commissioner: "Finally, someone who can go head-to-head with Merlin and Rekshum has come. Now, who wins and who loses is hard to say."

The short commissioner: "Kronos is indeed the champion of the previous edition. His strength is still strong. I didn't expect him to still have such a killer move."

The skinny commissioner: "What on earth is this huge arm? There's no magic power or battle qi pressure, yet the power is not......"

The fat commissioner: "Chairman, who do you think will win this time between the two of them?"

Dawson old gentleman thought for a while, then rolled his eyes, "I don't know. Don't ask me."

A few guests in the audience, sensing the strange power fluctuations, stood up one after another and came to the front to look at the situation in the arena.

"Damn ugly monster! How dare you injure Merlin..." Margaret felt dissatisfied in her heart. In her eyes, Merlin was her idol; how could she tolerate anyone harming him?

"What is this.... Blaze gazed down at the enormous arm below, feeling inexplicable pressure in his heart.

Alfonso silently looked at the arm, his eyes constantly shifting, making it impossible for anyone to guess what he was thinking?

However, it can be certain that Alfonso felt a threat from this arm, and his expression became much more severe.

"What is the origin of this summoned arm? It actually made Mr. Merlin suffer..." Sigha was surprised and asked softly.

As a monster who had lived for countless lifetimes, the Elf King is well-traveled. He slightly furrowed his brow, "It's a bit like a creature from another realm."

"Another realm?" Sigha became puzzled.

"In the Elven Era, there were rumors that in the parallel lines of our world, there is a parallel world called Waterford, where they are all said to be blue-skinned beings, though these are the words of some lunatics, and their credibility is not high." The Elf King paused, his gaze constantly scrutinizing the strange arm occupying most of the arena, "However, the ugly adventurer who summoned this creature, to some extent, is related to the distant legends..."

Seeing that Merlin was fine, Alice secretly breathed a sigh of relief and threw the Banri Garan to Merlin, "Be careful, everyone..."

"I just didn't expect to run into such an interesting fellow." Merlin caught the Banri Garan, his eyes fixed firmly on Kronos.

"Daddy, go! Daddy is the best!" Chris continuously waved her small chubby hands in her mother's arms, full of confidence in Daddy.

"Good girl, wait here. Daddy will come back with a trophy to play with you."

Merlin blinked at Chris and then without hesitation returned to the arena, rushing straight toward Kronos!

Kronos was frightened and retreated repeatedly, finally sitting on his butt on the ground, his whole body trembling.........

The enormous arm of the Otherworld King began to activate, appearing in front of Kronos to protect him, and a giant fist smashed over again!

"Hmph!" Merlin coldly snorted, leaped up, and drew his sword backward, slashing the Otherworld King's fist and arm in two!

This scene shocked the entire audience. It was originally believed that Kronos's summoned creature could defeat Merlin.

Yet the seemingly powerful Otherworld King's arm was cut in two by Merlin's single sword?

It seems that wanting to defeat this despairing black-iron adventurer is not as simple as everyone thought?

Just when everyone thought the Otherworld King's arm had lost its fighting power, it suddenly began to split, turning into two huge arms, irresistibly smashing toward Merlin!

"Hmm!?"

Merlin was slightly startled and quickly retreated, dodging between the two huge arms, successfully avoiding the attack.

The thick competition arena wall was directly smashed through. At once, sand and stones flew, and dust rose into the high sky!

Seeing this, Kronos slightly relaxed, and a horrific smile appeared on his distorted face. His biggest mouth opened wide, and he stuck out his long tongue to provoke Merlin.

The Otherworld King's split arms retracted and were raised high, casting a shadow over Merlin, as if threatening him.

Merlin realized that the power of this summoned creature was strange, deviating from the two major systems of battle qi and magic, and also possessing not bad regenerative capabilities?

Precisely speaking, it is split regeneration. Although it was just cut in half moments ago, it split into two arms, becoming even more troublesome.

The Otherworld King's strength was already overwhelming, and he was using split regeneration. Is it not invincible?

If Merlin could possess an god-slaying sword Mistingtian capable of sealing regenerative revival capabilities, perhaps so many weird things would not have occurred.

Merlin became serious. The enemy is the type that grows stronger the more they fight. Since this is a product summoned by a summoner, dealing with the source directly can win.

So Merlin headed straight for Kronos. As long as he defeats this summoner, the summoned creature would naturally collapse.

The Otherworld King's two arms suddenly smashed down, blasting huge pits into the ground!

However, Merlin's figure was too agile. This time, avoiding the Otherworld King's attack, he quickly killed in front of Kronos.

Kronos was greatly alarmed, turned his head and ran, not expecting that the Otherworld King couldn't stop Merlin, and he would just suffer misfortune.

Merlin decisively drew his sword, and in mid-air, he rotated the blade, using the back of the sword to heavily strike Kronos's back.

Kronos let out an scream not like a human's, and the whole person was struck flying, crashing into the wall, losing consciousness.

Merlin thought that Kronos's defeat would cause the Otherworld King's arm to disappear, but the result was the opposite—

The Otherworld King's arm did not disappear at all; on the contrary, it became even more agitated, smashing over at Merlin.

Merlin furrowed his brow, wondering what's going on! ? Kronos had lost his fighting power, why was this summoned creature still attacking!

Obviously, Merlin did not know that the Otherworld King was the ruler of Waterford, and Kronos was just a lackey.

Although it was merely the Otherworld King's arm, its disappearance or otherwise had nothing to do with Kronos.

The Otherworld King's arm suddenly split again this time, and it was an active split. The scale was so large that it made all spectators heart-pounding!

The two huge arms split into over a thousand arms, covering the sky and blocking out the sun, like a thousand-handed demon!

?

They clenched their fists and smashed down like dense raindrops this time, making it impossible for Merlin to avoid!

Facing the thousand giant fists like a mountain collapsing and sea flooding, Merlin couldn't help narrowing his eyes, assuming a sword-drawing posture—

"This is you forcing me."

"I want to see if you are really invincible!"

title: Chapter 47 — Sweeping Sweep
content:
Chapter 47 — Sweeping Sweep

Volume 27 · Chapter 47

"What monster did Crono summon?! It can even split and regenerate! There's simply no way to beat this thing!" Vice President Wayland exclaimed in shock.

"A truly troublesome summoned creature..." Gregory frowned, only now realizing how naive the idea had been that defeating Crono would secure victory.

Thousands of terrifying fists from the Otherworldly King descended from all directions, covering the sky. Before the attacks even arrived, the overwhelming pressure had already shaken the entire arena's ground.

Clearly, the unseen Otherworldly King had been enraged by Merlin and wanted to utterly kill this slippery "rat."

Everyone held their breath, uncertain whether Merlin could handle this assault. Their hearts were in their throats at this moment.

Merlin's eyes suddenly widened, his drawing stance nearly twisting as he roared toward the sky-full of Otherworldly King fists—

"Sever!"

The Banri Garan's blade scraped against its scabbard, erupting in showers of sparks, cleaving downward to unleash a sword qi brimming with killing intent!
