Old Taylor glanced at Merlin's side, then withdrew his gaze, saying, “Merlin joined the guild unintentionally; initially I wasn't clear either, who knew he would suddenly... in the competition he suddenly... startled.”
“We are old acquaintances; there's no need to hide anything anymore.” Gregory saw Old Taylor practicing tai chi, feeling dissatisfied, “Do you know where this guy comes from?”
“Could it be that Master, you're very interested in him?” Old Taylor asked in surprise.
“Possessing the ability to sweep away all strong opponents, such a person absolutely cannot be an unknown nobody; perhaps there is a curious past behind him.” Gregory said with deep meaning.
“I don't know that; I only know he was brought here by Miss Alice. As for where he's from, what his past is, I never asked—this goes against industry customs.” Old Taylor laughed, adding, “If we really want to dig deep, I'm afraid many in the adventurers' party aren't clean either.”
“I advise you to keep an extra eye; don't let, in the end, an unknown-origin guy cause you to lose reputation and status.” Gregory turned away with an unhappy expression.
Carl saw Gregory walk away, puzzled, asking, “What does Master Gregory mean by that?”
.... Old Taylor gave a dry laugh, clearly understanding, saying, I“He's jealous...0”
“Everyone, please quiet down a bit.” Old Mr. Dawson on the award platform gestured for silence, then mysteriously said, “I suppose you haven't forgotten? The pearl of France, Princess Margaret, once said before the quarter‑finals that she would give a reward to the champion adventurer; I think now is the time to fulfill that promise, right?”
Upon hearing this, the people below's eyes lit up, recalling what Princess Margaret had said before the match— they were supposed to kiss the champion adventurer?
Out of curiosity, many started shouting, hoping Margaret would fulfill her promise, just treating the award ceremony as a farce to watch.
The shouting from below rose wave after wave, demanding that Margaret come up onto the stage.
Sitting in the guest seats, Margaret felt like sitting on pins and needles, her face dark as could be, wishing she could tear apart the mouths of those shouting below—
Damn it!
Why did things turn out like this?
Could it really be that she has to... with Alice this female.....
k*..****.

title: Chapter 58 — Complete Route Map
content:
Chapter 58 — Complete Route Map

Volume 27 · Chapter 58

“Please, Princess Margaret, fulfill your promise!”
“Yes! And kiss the champion adventurer— -one!”
“We haven’t forgotten your words, Your Highness; as the French royal family, we can’t go back on our word!
The crowd below is having a blast watching the spectacle, just waiting for Margaret to kiss Alice.
Margaret’s face turned black as charcoal; she thought Merlin would win in the end, but the champion adventurer turned out to be Alice? She instinctively believed the arbitration committee was deliberately screwing her over!
The hecklers grew more impatient, Margaret just sat in her chair unmoved, hoping to muddle through—having to kiss Alice? She’d rather die!
Blaise felt the pressure, thinking it’s all Margaret’s fault for making such a promise; now she’s stuck between a rock and a hard place. “Your Highness, what should we do now?”
“Huh? What? I don’t even remember—did I say I’d promise anything?” Margaret started playing dumb, refusing to admit it.
“Uh, this isn’t good…” Blaise broke into a sweat, lowering his voice, “Back then lots of people already heard it, so it’ll be hard to wiggle out of this.”
“So what? I don’t believe anyone who ate a leopard’s gall would dare threaten me!” Margaret snapped angrily.
“I don’t mean it that way…” Blaise lowered his voice, explaining, “You represent the French royal family; if you don’t keep your promise, His Majesty will be embarrassed, and everyone will know the French royal family lacks integrity, that they go back on their word…”

“….Margaret suddenly tensed up hearing that—this concerns the royal family’s reputation, so it can’t be brushed off lightly.” “Let me go kiss Alice? … I… I can’t really accept that…”
“Alice isn’t a man, it’s fine, and it also lets the outside world see that you have a deep connection with the champion adventurer— isn’t that a good thing?” Blaise urged.
“…Alright, I’ll do my best.” Margaret gritted her teeth, steeled herself, and approached Alice, “Um……”
Alice’s face inexplicably turned red as she looked at Margaret without speaking, feeling a bit nervous.
Margaret approached Alice, the atmosphere became eerily strange, both of their eyes darting around.
This made the audience below anxious, they started urging nonstop.
“Sorry, I threw up—I really can’t do it…” Margaret turned her head, showing a nauseated expression.
“Ah! ? You sound like you’re willing—!” Alice exclaimed, cheeks puffed, “This joking promise doesn’t matter, no need to take it so seriously =
“….” Margaret’s expression was weird; she also wanted to gloss over it, but she had to uphold the French royal family’s dignity!
“Mom! Mom!”
Merlin lifted Chris onto the stage, letting her go help Alice out.
Little Chris waddled over to Alice, — a little hen protecting her chicks.
“No kissing Mommy, only I can kiss Mommy~”

…Margaret frowned, thinking, “What is this little brat causing trouble? Damn”
Alice put the trophy on the ground, picked up Chris, and asked curiously, “Why not?”
“Because Chris will get jealous, will get mad~!” Chris puffed her cheeks, speaking earnestly; even at her young age, her gaze toward Margaret held a hint of hostility.
“Haha~” Alice chuckled, feeling she still held a high place in Chris’s heart—she couldn’t even get a kiss.
“I am the sole royal heir, I say what I do!” Margaret approached Alice with fierce momentum, “Don’t think I’m doing this willingly; it’s all to shut those people up!
“Wait! Don’t come closer!”
Alice panicked, kept stepping back, instinctively clutching Chris tighter in her arms.
Margaret, eager to end this farce, closed her eyes and threw caution to the wind, planting a kiss—chu—
“Ah! ! ! That doesn’t count!”
“That’s not what I imagined!”
“Do it again! Do it again!”
The audience below let out disappointed noises, feeling they hadn’t seen the expected scene.
Margaret, eyes shut, happened to kiss Chris’s little cheek; when she opened her eyes she was startled, “Eh! ……”
Little Chris stared wide‑eyed, her face flushed, the cowlick on her head standing up straight like she’d lost her soul?
“Chris? What’s wrong?” Alice looked at Chris, wondering if her dear daughter had been frightened silly?
“Mom! ! !” Chris burst into tears, curling up in Alice’s arms.
“…It’s not that bad—just got kissed by an aunt, no need to be so scared…” Alice gave an embarrassed laugh.
Margaret felt her heart being sliced sharply, “…Aunt? !”
“Chris is doomed, Chris will get pregnant, give birth to a little Chris, chirp chirp…… Chris burst into tears, snot streaming uncontrollably.
“Who said that?” Alice was bewildered.
“Daddy! Daddy said if anyone other than Mom and Dad kisses you, you’ll get pregnant.” Chris pressed her lips tight, trying to look brave.

……Lin…. Alice flared up, turned to look down at Merlin below the stage, thinking this jerk was spouting nonsense.
Merlin hastily whistled, pretending to admire the scenery; he was just trying to educate Chris not to become a loose girl, entirely out of good intentions!
Old Mr. Dawson, seeing the crowd’s disappointment, stepped in to smooth things over, “Everyone settle down; although Princess Margaret kissed a little kid, it’s not really different, right?”
Margaret secretly breathed a sigh of relief, grateful that Chairman Dawson gave her an out.
“Next, I will award the champion adventurer the prize of this tournament—the fragmented map of the Gods’ Relics route!”
“! ! ?” Merlin rarely showed a shocked expression, thinking he’d misheard?
The audience below immediately gasped, “This is no small matter!”—“Although it’s not a divine weapon, it represents the wealth countless people dream of—”
“The Gods’ Relics actually have a route map existing!”
“If it’s true… that’s unbelievably amazing!”
“If we could obtain a divine weapon from the relics, that would be a tremendous boon…”
Rothschild lifted his head, realizing this item had fallen into Merlin and his wife’s hands, though he wondered if he could buy it with money?
Recently he’d been repeatedly given the cold shoulder by Merlin; although the world’s richest man wasn’t pleased, he could do nothing about it.
“Gods’ Relics route map?” Gabriel heard and blinked, “Who wouldn’t have struck it rich then?”
“You’re thinking too simply; this is just a broken route map. Getting a complete one is harder than climbing to heaven—it looks precious, but it’s actually worthless.” Noah said confidently.
Alice took the prize Old Mr. Dawson handed her—the fragmented Gods’ Relics route map—and felt it was surreal; she never imagined the tournament’s prize would be this!
Merlin had already been elated down below, dancing with joy; despite desperately suppressing his excitement, it was still obvious he was thrilled.
The two originally had another half of the route map; now they can join the two halves into one, which means……
Endless wealth and treasure!!!

title: Chapter 59 — The Richest Person's Deal (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 59 — The Richest Person's Deal (Extra Chapter)

Volume 27 · Chapter 59

In the inn's room, after Merlin had coaxed Chris to sleep, Alice invited Da Vinci and Rosetti over.
Alice took half of the gods' relics route map from the "Anjie" ring, the champion adventurer rewards of the two major competitions combined into -.
The four of them began to discuss in hushed tones, after all this concerned endless treasure, and Merlin and Alice did not want too many people to know about it.
If the fact that Merlin possessed a complete gods' relics route map were to spread, it could very likely spark a blood‑thirsty contest.
Fortunately, Da Vinci and Rosetti promised not to go out; they were not very interested in the treasure.
"Am I about to flip a salted fish? Hehe~" Merlin let out a series of 'sleazy' laughs, feeling that he had finally gotten out, the goddess of fortune had finally discovered this unappreciated subject!
"What are you so happy about?" Alice frowned.
"Isn't this something worth being happy about?" Merlin was surprised, his eyebrows dancing, and said, "We have a complete gods' relics route map! Complete!"
"Oh, and then?"
Alice replied coldly.
"Tsk! Don't you have a problem with your brain?" Merlin frowned in discontent, seriously saying, "This is a huge treasure! We are rich! From now on we don't have to keep running around for money, all those damn debts will vanish, isn't that a good thing? We will be free~"
Alice remained silent, a vague worry rising in her heart, the debt owed to the Holy Church being a bond of two relationships.
If the debt were really paid off, wouldn't Merlin become unrestrained, and nothing could hold him anymore?
At that time, if Merlin forced himself to leave, he would have no way.
Although he had Chris, if Merlin brought Chris back to the demon race's old home, he would likely become a lone person!
Thinking of this, Alice couldn't help but worry; she didn't really want sudden wealth to fall from the sky, living a hard life was also fine.
So Alice quickly clasped her hands together, forming a praying pose, silently wishing that this route map would be useless, and that no treasure would be found...
Merlin suddenly felt a chill all over his body, as if cursed, seeing Alice's expression, he couldn't help but ask suspiciously, "What are you doing?"
"Nothing, why are you so tense?" Alice smiled with a deep meaning.
Da Vinci held a magnifying glass, constantly observing every part of the gods' relics route map, hoping to decipher all the secrets.
Rosetti looked seriously beside him; after a long time with no result, she couldn't help but ask, "How is it? Da Vinci, this is a complete route map, is it that hard to decipher the information on it?"
"These characters come from a very old era; even a complete route map is still obscure and difficult to understand." Da Vinci sighed, put down the magnifying glass, "But fortunately, most of the information has already been deciphered."
"How is it? Does it hint at endless treasure? Can I indulge freely~" Merlin asked excitedly, already seeing his bright future.
"What are you thinking...?" Alice muttered, feeling it shouldn't be that simple.
"Mr. Merlin, you should calm down a bit; things aren't that simple." Da Vinci's expression was serious, hoping Merlin wouldn't have too high expectations.
"Ah? What does that mean? That this route map is worthless, there's no treasure at all?" Merlin fell from heaven to hell, a bucket of cold water poured on him.
"Hehe...." Alice couldn't help but laugh out loud, feeling that at least Merlin was finally letting himself go.
"It does indeed mark the route and location of the gods' relics, but Mr. Merlin, if you want to enter the relics, a route map alone is not enough." Da Vinci explained slowly.
"Still missing something?" Merlin had a headache, having already made two route maps was difficult, and yet something was missing.
"That's right, the gods' relics are the place where the ancient gods lived, once isolated from the world; even if you know the exact location, it would be hard to get in. Legend says a prophet of the demon race used some extremely powerful thing to shatter the barrier, and then entered the ancient gods' residence... Da Vinci said slowly, that he still knows some of the demon race's history."
"So you need such conditions to open the gods' relics? How unfortunate..." Rosetti sighed, thinking why so many people pursue the relics, in the end almost impossible.
"Uh, this is so troublesome... Merlin's face looked bad, since knowing the location is not easy to get in, he didn't know if his sword slash could cut through the so‑called barrier, but Da Vinci said it doesn't seem easy?"
"This route map already marks the location of the gods' relics, but it still needs something, a name too ancient to understand, I don't recognize it either, let's just call it a key. As long as you get this thing, you can smoothly enter the gods' relics." Da Vinci paused, added, "But even if you find the key, Mr. Merlin will still have to face a monster, the guardian of the relics, the North Sea giant monster Kraken." SF novel
"Kraken..." Merlin recalled the scene he met in the mysterious sea, although he couldn't defeat this monster, on the sea, he was indeed not good.
The North Sea giant monster, this legendary monster, is not comparable to the original serpentine sea dragon, and the serpentine sea dragon is just the Kraken's snack.
After Da Vinci and Rosetti left, the atmosphere in the room was somewhat oppressive, Merlin's mood was very low, having expected for so long.
"Don't be disappointed again, Merlin, I believe you, you will definitely flip a salted fish." Alice pretended to be sincere??
"Why do I feel like you are??"
"I want...??"
Dong dong dong
Three knocks sounded, the two were startled, who would come at this late night?
?
Merlin quickly put the gods' relics route map away, calmed his emotions, and went to open the door.
The result was that Rothschild came with two unfamiliar guards, holding a tray, covering the mysterious thing with black cloth.
"Good evening, Mr. Merlin, it's nice to see you again"
"Oh~, it's you, do you have something to ask me?"
"I've invited you several times for dinner, you never came, so this old bone has to put on a face and come." Rothschild smiled warmly, clearly a long‑time businessman. DF small play
"No time, goodbye." Merlin rolled his eyes, had no good feeling about this wealth‑stealing businessman, and was about to close the door and send him away.
"Hold on, I'm here to talk business, I wonder if Mr. Merlin could spare a look?" Rothschild explained his intention.
"What business?" Merlin asked puzzled.
"The gods' relics route map, do you intend to sell it? I can buy it with money, set a price." Rothschild exuded a determined aura.
"Ha, you think having money is impressive? I won't sell!" Merlin firmly refused, thinking merchants are always cunning, business often has hidden pitfalls, merchants would never do a loss‑making deal.
"I knew it would be like this, so please Mr. Merlin look at the chips I brought and decide whether to make this deal."
Rothschild gave a look to the guard behind him, the guard nodded and pulled down the black cloth, revealing a brilliantly shining Hero's Inheritance Holy Armor!
Even in the dark night, this historically long armor still emits a holy glow, carrying the honor and brilliance of countless heroes!
"I wonder if Mr. Merlin is satisfied?" Rothschild smiled, his tone seemed magical, making it impossible to refuse.
"Goo... Merlin looked at the Hero's Inheritance Holy Armor, instinctively swallowing."
"Has money-N"
"It's quite impressive, huh~"

title: Chapter 61 — Peace Will Eventually End (Bonus Update)
content:
Chapter 61 — Peace Will Eventually End (Bonus Update)

Volume 27 · Chapter 61

Seth stopped walking and looked back at the mysterious figure behind him; judging by the voice, it seemed to be a middle-aged man.

He sat alone on a rock, and even as cold winds swept through, he remained immovable like a towering figure, slowly turning the roasting tender rabbit.

Seth happened to be a little hungry, and since the other party had invited him, he might as well go over and have a few drinks.

Seth was naturally a carefree person, and as a Thorn Knight, there were very few who could harm him, so there was nothing to fear.

Moreover, Seth enjoyed making friends, and having a few drinks with a stranger in the wilderness held a certain charm.

Seth felt somewhat intrigued by this person, smiled as he walked over, set down the box containing the Demon Armor on his back, and sat across from the man.

"Thank you for your generous hospitality, then I won't stand on ceremony. However, I won't eat and drink for free—I'll pay you later."

"Haha…" The mysterious man chuckled and said slowly, "No need. I don't want your money."

"Then…" Seth felt a trace of confusion, thinking this guy in front of him was truly a strange one.

"I was just drinking alone and it was boring, so I hoped someone would keep me company. Seeing you traveling alone late at night, I was a bit curious about you." The mysterious man paused and asked, "You seem to be in a hurry—where are you heading?"

"Nowhere in particular. Actually, I'm traveling and training, hoping to encounter strong opponents so I can advance my strength further." Seth answered honestly, then asked in return, "And you? Appearing in the wilderness deep at night, it looks quite strange. You're not an ordinary person, are you? Are you also traveling and training like me?"

The mysterious man added a few logs to the campfire and said calmly, "A treasure of ours was stolen by a cunning little thief. I'm searching for that wretched fellow to retrieve the treasure."

"Oh? Something like that?" Seth grew even more puzzled, thinking that thing must be very valuable—otherwise why come out searching for it, camping in the wilderness deep at night?

"We've waited a long time, hoping that thief would voluntarily return the item. But he didn't, so I had no choice but to leave my homeland and search for him." The mysterious man said slowly.

"What kind of treasure is it? That warrants such great trouble?" Seth asked curiously.

"It's a rare treasure that could drive an ordinary person to madness." The mysterious man smiled, then abruptly changed the subject. "Don't you think this thief is detestable? He was given a chance, yet he didn't obediently return the item."

"Indeed very hateful, after all it's something so important to others…" Seth nodded in agreement, expressing his sympathy.

"Then tell me," the mysterious man asked enigmatically, "if I encountered this thief, how should I deal with him?"

"Something like that… a good beating should suffice, right?" Seth answered nonchalantly.

"A beating? Is there such a good thing? That's too light." The mysterious man shook his head, not quite agreeing with Seth's answer.

"Then what do you plan to do?" Seth didn't know what the other party was thinking.

"Kill!" the mysterious man said coldly.

Seth furrowed his brows slightly, feeling a chill despite the campfire, wondering what the thief had stolen and why it would provoke such enormous hatred.

"Everyone must pay the price for their actions. From the elderly at eighty to infants at one year old, young and old alike should receive equal punishment." The mysterious man said solemnly, his tone revealing an undercurrent of wickedness.

Seth vaguely felt something was wrong. The man opposite him might not be a good sort—his personality was extremely extreme. As a knight, he would never strike at the elderly or children; that would violate his code.

"Do you agree with my words?" the mysterious man pressed.

"I don't agree. I will absolutely not lay a hand on the elderly or children." Seth said righteously.

"What if the other party isn't an elderly person or child, but someone with great strength?" The mysterious man's entire aura turned sinister.

"If what he stole was very valuable and caused adverse effects, then…" Seth's gaze grew serious. "He should…"

"So you also think he should be killed. That's quite unexpected." The mysterious man expressed surprise.

"Is something wrong?" Seth frowned.

"I thought you lacked self-awareness, but it seems you do have some~" The mysterious man's laugh was eerie, and his entire figure began to gradually grow translucent.

"What do you mean!?" Seth sensed something was amiss, and a foreboding feeling rose in his heart.

A drop of oil from the roasting rabbit fell into the campfire, sizzling with a faint popping sound—

Suddenly, a gleaming serpent-shaped dagger pierced through the campfire, unexpectedly stabbing into Seth's chest!

"What!?" Seth's face went pale with shock, clutching his chest as blood gushed out; he staggered backward, his complexion ashen.

"Hmm hmm hmm, I've been tracking you all this way, little thief…" The mysterious man slowly stood up, removed his hat, revealing a handsome face, and two demon horns赫然 appeared on his head.

"Demon!?" Seth was struck directly in the heart and immediately fell into a near-death critical condition, completely unable to counterattack.

"You think you can still skip around outside after stealing from Lord Mammon? Naive human." The demon assassin sneered. "No one who steals from the Lord of Greed can survive—no exceptions!"

"…You…" Seth knelt on one knee, never expecting a demon to hunt him down. Now he recalled the great swordsman Elgin's warning, but it was too late.

"Since I enjoyed our conversation, I'll let this lowly human remember my name before dying." The demon assassin paused, licked the blood off his dagger clean, and sneered, "My name is Aoseu, Demon General of the Third Demon Lord Palace, a trusted subordinate of Lord Mammon. It wasn't easy tracking you down to hunt the thief who stole Lord Mammon's treasure. Now do you understand why your death is deserved? Even you yourself thought you deserved to die, hmm…"

Seth's consciousness began to scatter; clearly the situation was extremely dangerous. He started summoning the Demon Armor—for this moment, only this armor could save his life!

The pitch-black Demon Armor broke free from the box; even without anyone inside, it could still move freely.

But the Demon Armor stood woodenly in place; even as its "master" Seth continuously summoned, it still hesitated and didn't move.

"Beast! Have you played enough outside? You擅自 left with this lowly human without permission—Lord Mammon is very angry." Aoseu said slowly to the Demon Armor. "Now I'm giving you a chance at redemption. Kill that human, and I'll speak well of you to Lord Mammon. Otherwise, you know the consequences! I think you should understand—Lord Mammon has many collections; he doesn't need just one!"

The Demon Armor nodded, approaching the severely injured Seth, with what seemed like an evil soul dwelling within its deep helmet.

Seth went cold from head to toe; he had never been able to become its master from beginning to end. "No… no! ! !"

With a scream echoing through the wilderness, the Demon Armor devoured Seth's flesh and soul, turning this long-time "master" into food.

The dark night returned to silence. Aoseu sat on the rock gnawing on the roasted rabbit meat, while the Demon Armor took Seth's former seat.

"乖乖 follow me back. Lord Mammon needs your power." Aoseu wiped the grease from his mouth and ominously revealed the demon race's secret plot—

"The false peace is about to end; the Second Holy War is about to begin."

"That group of lowly creatures who constantly harass and despise the majesty of the demon race will ultimately pay the price!"

"The other Demon Lords have been too content with peace for too long, their fangs have already fallen out. False peace will only cause our civilization to die a slow death!"

"Only Lord Mammon is a ruler with both courage and foresight. The horn of the Second Holy War will be sounded first by our Third Demon Lord Palace!"

To Be Continued

Author's Notes

Where will the relationship between Merlin and Alice, having recovered the Hero's inherited Saint Armor, ultimately go?

Will Merlin truly let himself loose once he regains his freedom?

Will their relationship progress at all without the debt to sustain it?

The Second Holy War is about to break out—what will be the outcome of the war between demons and humanity?

When faced with his lover and his kin, how will Merlin choose?

On which side will Alice stand in the Holy War? Will she put on the Hero's armor again?

What is Merlin's mother Vivian waiting for? Will she become the final straw that breaks Merlin?

Please stay tuned for the next installment.

title: Chapter 1 — Celebration
content:
Chapter 1 — Celebration

Volume 28 · Chapter 1

Celebration

A week later, the Adventurers' Combat Tournament officially concluded, with Rexem claiming first place.

All the adventurers had been sent back to their respective homes, yet the images of the tournament refused to fade.

People everywhere were discussing all sorts of things from the competition, and Alice, the champion adventurer, had become the center of everyone's heated conversations.

Many were curious about this suddenly renowned demon swordsman — how had an adventurer from an obscure little town managed to defeat numerous powerful rivals and seize ultimate victory?

Some even began embellishing the story, seizing on the tournament's abrupt half-month hiatus to spin wild tales: Alice was far too powerful, and the Adventurers Guild, fearing special trouble, was deliberately hiding something.

Of course, there existed one rather faint voice — during the quarterfinals, a Black Iron-ranked adventurer had utterly dominated the matches.

But that voice had long been swallowed by countless discussions about Alice, and those who knew the actual truth remained confined to an extremely small circle.

Champagne sprays shot into the air as the Rexem adventurers held a celebration party within the guild, congratulating Rexem on winning its first-ever championship!

"From today onward! Anyone who still dares to look down on our Rexem adventurers is looking down on the entire Adventurers Guild!" Carl stood excitedly on a table, like a victorious general returning from battle. "We now represent the strongest combat power in the Adventurers Guild! Everyone should stand tall with your backs straight — don't disgrace our guild's honor!"

"That's right! This is truly wonderful news! Because we took first place, quest commission fees have nearly doubled!"

"Now accepting a single job is enough to eat and drink for a whole month — something we never dared imagine before!"

"Who can still slander us as useless, good-for-nothing adventurers? We'll smash the tournament's glory right in their faces in minutes!"

The Rexem adventurers below chattered animatedly — clearly, after winning first place, everyone had reaped considerable benefits.

This once-unremarkable guild had gone from obscurity to worldwide attention, and no one knew how much effort it had taken. Today, they had finally seen their wish fulfilled.

Comrades beamed with joy, quietly regarding Alice as the hero of the guild.

Nobody could have imagined that this person, who had joined the guild less than two years prior, would one day become the champion adventurer.

Someone who would rewrite the guild's history, making everyone living in Rexem feel an unprecedented sense of honor!

Yet few of the adventurers spoke of Merlin; they knew nothing about the quarterfinal matches, which couldn't help but feel somewhat regrettable.

Otherwise, if everyone knew that Merlin, who usually just drifted along, was actually someone who had swept through six of the eight-strong opponents, they would surely be throwing Merlin up in the air and cheering loudly right now.

Although Rossetti, Da Vinci, and the Taylors — father and son — knew the truth, they still faced a trust problem; even speaking the truth required people to believe it.

It was just unknown whether Merlin would be willing to demonstrate his strength before everyone. After all, the deeply ingrained belief that without magical energy and battle aura one was no better than an ordinary person ran deep in people's hearts.

Merlin sat far away. After becoming a father, he was no longer very fond of joining in the excitement, and he didn't particularly mind everyone praising Alice.

Not long ago, when Merlin had been in Budapest, he had been harassed by people who came seeking him out until he grew restless and irritated. Returning to Rexem was actually quite peaceful, which was a good thing....

Merlin had never known before that becoming the object of admiration in everyone's heart was such a tiring thing. Quietly being a salted fish and living peacefully and freely was actually very relaxing.

"Phew~" Little Chris sat on Merlin's lap and downed a large cup of hot milk in one gulp, her little belly slightly bulging, with milk residue lingering around her mouth.

"Does it taste good?" Merlin asked, casually wiping Chris's mouth for her.

"Tasty! I want more~" Chris looked up, her voice still babyish, no different from a hungry chick crying for food.

"Still... Dark veins appeared on Merlin's forehead as he thought Chris's appetite seemed considerably larger than an ordinary child's. Would his cute daughter turn into a three-hundred-pound beast someday?

"Dad, where did Mom go? I didn't know where she went just now?" Chris grew anxious as soon as she couldn't see Alice.

"This... Your mom went to handle some important matters. She'll be back soon." Merlin answered with a smile.

"I miss Mom.... I want a hug..." Chris's mood dropped considerably, and even the cowlick on her head looked listless.

Merlin's brows tightened. He thought — this girl was usually so clingy and enthusiastic with him, yet now she'd turned into this just from not seeing Alice for half a day....

After recovering the Hero's Inherited Sacred Armor, Merlin had handed it to Alice, asking her to return the armor and end the debt that had tormented the two of them for so long.

So after returning to Rexem, Alice hadn't attended the celebration party, but had instead taken the sacred armor directly to the Rexem church, where clergy affiliated with the Holy Church resided.

The two had been living a hard life weighed down by debt, and it seemed their days of it would come to an end today.

"Hey! Merlin, how was it? Did you have fun going around Budapest?"

Hobbs walked over carrying a wine glass and sat beside Merlin, with a slightly shy little Mini following behind.

This little one hadn't been running around playing wildly outside recently; instead, she had been quite well-behaved, following Hobbs around every day. Nobody knew what had happened between her and her little friends.

The quiet desolation around Merlin compared to the lively bustle near Carl formed a sharp contrast within the guild. Seeing this, Hobbs came over to chat with Merlin for a few words.

"How was that going out to play? I was clearly exhausted." Merlin retorted grumpily.

"Stare~"

Little Mini hid beside her father Hobbs' thigh, her curious gaze fixed tightly on Merlin. She felt this uncle looked a lot like the blond young man she had seen before, just a bit too old~

That blond young man had been the first-generation leader of the Rexem Knights, but unfortunately, for some unknown reason, he had suddenly disappeared.

Mini and several of her little friends had thought the leader had moved away and left Rexem, so they felt extremely disappointed.

Recently, they had even had a huge argument over who should be elected as the second leader, causing discord among the little friends.

The little friends didn't accept Mini, saying she couldn't use magic and therefore couldn't be the leader.

So recently, little Mini had been clinging to Hobbs, hoping to learn magic so she could show off in front of her little friends!

But Hobbs knew Mini was just an ordinary child without talent; learning magic would be simply asking for trouble, so he disagreed.

"Uh... Merlin saw little Mini's bright, sparkling big eyes and was instantly startled. He thought — could this little kid have recognized me as the first-generation Rexem Knights leader!? So inexplicably embarrassing....

"Hmm!?" Chris, who had been in low spirits, noticed little Mini and curiously poked her little head out to look at her.

The two were about the same age; Mini was only a year or two older, making her a rare child about Chris's age.

"Eee-ya-ya-ya?" little Mini muttered in a babyish voice.

"Eee-yu-yu..." little Chris responded in a similar tone.

As fathers, both Hobbs and Merlin were completely confused, unable to understand what the two were communicating at all, exchanging questions with each other.

"What are they saying?"

"....Don't know."

title: Chapter 2 — Man from the Temple (Extra)
content:
Chapter 2 — Man from the Temple (Extra)

Volume 28 · Chapter 2

Chris hopped down from Merlin's legs, waddling over to Mini, "Eeh ya ya ya hey!"
"Hee hee hee~" Mini laughed nonstop, seemingly able to instantly understand Chris's meaning.
Hobbs: "???"
Merlin: "???"
The two little ones happily chattered "Eeh ya" nonstop, but the two adults couldn't understand a thing, completely unaware of what they were saying.
However, after a moment's thought, the two little ones being opposite in age, they would surely have more common ground, making communication effortless.
"....Maybe it's just a language between kids?" Hobbs said, sweating.
"Probably, otherwise how could we not understand at all?" Merlin said with a strange expression.
"Dad, she's called Mini-sis, and like me she loves cream cake~!" Chris turned around, her ahoge swaying, not forgetting to help Merlin translate.
"..........Merlin forced a smile, because food gave them a common language? Kids' communication is really simple~"
"Oh, is that so? Haha...." Hobbs burst out laughing, pulling a few copper coins from his pocket and handing them to Mini, "Go to Sis Lucy's and buy two cakes to eat, I'll chat a bit with Uncle Merlin, remember not to run around, just play in the Adventurers Guild."
"Got it~" Mini took Chris's hand, "Let's go. 2"
Chris couldn't resist the temptation of the cream cake, waddling along, and turning back she said, "Dad, I'll be back soon, hehe~"
"Hey! Wait...." Merlin just tried to stop, but Hobbs pressed him down.
"Merlin, you're being too sensitive, nothing will happen." Hobbs chuckled, thinking Merlin was overly cautious.
"No, that...." Merlin wanted to speak but stopped, recalling how Chris was kidnapped by mercenaries, and even now he still felt uneasy, needing to stay by her side.
"Don't worry, that's the precious daughter of the Champion Adventurer; who in Lexter would dare to mess with her? Besides, we're in the Adventurers Guild, there won't be any trouble." Hobbs patted Merlin's shoulder, signaling him to relax.
"Sigh, alright...." Merlin sighed, thinking that everyone in the Adventurers Guild was fairly familiar, so there shouldn't be any problem.
"Alice is already a Champion Adventurer now, a big star in the industry, how do you feel about that?" Hobbs asked with a grin.
"No particular feeling, just ordinary...." Merlin remained completely calm, already used to it, and besides, he had enjoyed the taste of being a big star in Budapest, which wasn't great, so he now doesn't envy Alice at all.
"If you were jealous, you'd better say it out loud, I'll comfort you properly, haha~" Hobbs teased.
"It's just a Champion Adventurer title, I'm not that jealous; actually it's a rather boring title." Merlin smirked.
"Hasn't the Arbitration Committee had a private talk with Alice about something?" Hobbs asked doubtfully.
"No? Why would the Arbitration Committee want to talk to Alice alone?" Merlin replied in surprise.
"Isn't this tournament supposed to select candidates for the Purple Gold Adventurer? Alice, as a Champion Adventurer, will definitely get a promotion opportunity." Hobbs said, eyes sparkling.
"Oh~" Merlin nodded, "Those committee members haven't had a private chat with her."
"Then she will definitely receive an invitation letter later." Hobbs said, confident.
"An invitation letter?" Merlin wondered.
"The promotion method is mysterious, almost unknown to outsiders, but as long as one's strength and influence reach a certain level, they will receive an invitation letter from the Arbitration Committee, and finally the Mithril Adventurers will compete, with only one emerging to become a rare Purple Gold Adventurer." Hobbs gave a simple explanation, seeming to have some understanding.
"Heard.... the competition is brutal, huh?" Merlin asked intrigued.
"That's only natural, with so many adventurers, the Purple Gold tier...." Hobbs stretched out his hand, showing his five fingers, "Only a mere five, each one in a million, standing out from the extremely brutal competition."
Merlin glanced at Hobbs, thinking only five people? Compared to the vast ranks of adventurers, that's indeed extremely scarce, though he had seen two of them—
Po E's little cure
Whether it's the president of the London Adventurers Guild, Gregory, or the old witch Sesi, they indeed possess extraordinary abilities.
I guess the tournament is already over; afterwards the Arbitration Committee should, based on the tournament performance, select candidates with the ability to become Purple Gold Adventurers and send out invitation letters for the promotion trial." Hobbs speculated.
"Like that...." Merlin lifted his head, thinking, "Alice is about to take off like a rocket? Just after becoming a renowned Champion Adventurer, the next step is the chance to become a Purple Gold Adventurer."
"Merlin!!!" Arnold strode over aggressively, looking ready to fight.
"Arnold, what's up? Want to duel me?" Merlin tilted his head.
"...Cough cough!" Arnold quickly cleared his throat twice to hide his embarrassment, "Who wants to duel you? I'm here to give you some friendly advice."
"Huh?" Merlin gave a strange look, wondering if Arnold hadn't always held a bit of hostility toward him.
"Now Miss Alice is a Champion Adventurer, this must be putting a lot of pressure on you, right?" Arnold said confidently.
"No, it's just a Champion Adventurer, what pressure could I feel...." Merlin shrugged his shoulders.
"Miss Alice is now famous worldwide, surely she'll attract more and more suitors, how could you possibly have no pressure?" Arnold frowned seriously, "Considering our acquaintance, I advise you to stay on guard; only by constantly improving yourself can you possibly win Miss Alice's heart."
"...." Merlin couldn't help but laugh, answering offhandedly,
"You this family...."
"You really overestimate Alice's charm."
The small chapel west of Lexter, here the priest is a clergy member belonging solely to the Holy Church.
Almost every month Alice comes here alone, handing over her earnings to the priest, who then forwards them to the Holy Church.
Although Alice earns a decent income from adventurer quests, after giving a large portion to the Holy Church, she has little left.
But today is special; Alice is full of confidence, because she has brought back the lost Hero's Inheritance Holy Armor—
"Father, this is the holy armor I lost; today I will return it to the Holy Church, from now on I and the Church are even, with no further ties. Please tell the Pope, thank him for his past care, I am not suited to be a Hero...."
The priest looked at the Holy Armor on the table, fell silent for a moment, then said, "Sorry, Miss Alice, I cannot decide this matter."
"Ah? What do you mean? I've already found the holy armor... Alice furrowed her brow, wondering what else there is?"
At that moment, a man clad head to toe in shining white armor radiating holy aura, with extraordinarily handsome features, slowly walked in from outside—
"It's been two years, Alice...."
"You've changed so much: you've shed your innocence and immaturity." =
"Like a blooming rose, radiant and tempting, ever more beautiful."

title: Chapter 3 — Holy Temple Knight Commander
content:
Chapter 3 — Holy Temple Knight Commander

Volume 28 · Chapter 3

“Barras! ?”
Alice widened her eyes in shock, looking at the knight slowly approaching, as if she had known him for a long time.

Among the Temple Knights stationed at the temple, there are two knight captains, and Barras before her is one of them.

The two knight captains hold high status, directly obeying the Pope; they are the Pope’s capable guards and the objects of respect for all Temple Knights.

Even when Alice received the Hero’s baptism at the temple in Holy Rome, she had already seen the two Temple Knight Captains.

However, Barras, who should have been stationed at the temple guarding the Pope, unusually appeared in the small town of Rexum?

This surprised Alice quite a bit; according to temple rules, a knight captain must constantly protect the Pope and cannot leave without permission.

“Why have you appeared here?”
The priest glanced at Barras, nodded, and said, “I’ll step out; you two can talk.”

After the priest left, Barras smiled, slowly sat opposite Alice, and said, “Long time no see, Alice. Or rather, now you should be called former Hero.”

“That’s an old title; I’m no longer a Hero, so don’t call me Hero.”
Alice furrowed her brows.

“Oh~, alright.”
Barras paused, then changed his address, “How about Champion Adventurer Miss Alice? That should be fine, right? … Alice felt Barras was mocking her, so she snapped, “Let’s get to the point—why are you here?”

“I came for you, Alice…”
Barras, like a magician, pulled out a rose from behind his back, “This is a rose I brought from Rome. Do you like it?”

“You’re still as frivolous as ever.”
Alice sighed, feeling no goodwill toward Barras at all.

Because Barras differs from other Temple Knights—most of them are upright and simple, devoting their lives to the Goddess and considering it the utmost honor.

However, Barras is indeed a lecherous person; his behavior is frivolous, and rumors often circulate about him with nuns, making it hard to associate him with devout followers of the Goddess.

Compared to the other knight captain of the Temple Knights, the moral gap is huge; if it weren’t for Barras’s sufficient strength, he would have long been investigated by the heresy inquisitors.

“No, I think you misunderstand; I’m only frivolous toward you.”
Barras flashed a sunny smile, utterly unaware how cheesy his words were, “Indeed, my eye for talent is excellent—two years ago, the moment you put on the holy armor, I sensed you were no ordinary mortal…

“Huh?”
Alice’s mind filled with question marks.

“It’s the Goddess; you in that holy armor look just like… Mary descended to the mortal world, making you unapproachable.”
Barras’s expression turned wistful, “As it turns out, my feeling was correct—this beautiful gold of yours has finally shone brightly.”

“I don’t want to hear these useless words; what exactly are you here for?”
Alice said, slightly irritated.

“Go back; His Holiness the Pope hopes you return to continue your Hero duties. You’ve gone from obscurity to the spotlight, a great inspiration to every devout believer—the Holy Church needs someone like you.”
Barras said seriously.

“Oh~, so Lord Barras is here as an envoy.”
Alice gave a dry laugh, feeling inside that yesterday you ignored me, today I’m out of your league.

“You could say that, but the Pope sent me personally to persuade you, which shows sincerity; you can’t possibly expect the aging Pope to come himself to fetch you back, can you?”
Barras looked into Alice’s eyes.

“Sorry, I won’t go back. I’m not a believer, nor someone who puts the Goddess first. Becoming a Hero was merely to earn money with my own hands.”
Alice paused, then explained, “Since I no longer need to rely on serving the Holy Church to make a living, there’s no need to return. Moreover, after my failed crusade I returned to the temple and was humiliated by many of you, labeled the worst Hero in history, forced to leave. Now you still want me to come back? How could that be possible? There’s no such free lunch. I’m not a dog that the Holy Church can summon and dismiss at will.”

Barras was startled, hearing the clear anger in Alice’s tone, obviously still holding a grudge about the past incident.

As the sole survivor of the crusade, Alice faced ridicule from many temple folk, who thought she was cowardly and afraid of death, that she had appeased the Demon Lord at any cost just to survive.

The temple clergy believed that, as an honored Hero, Alice ought to have died in the Death Marshes; that would have been the perfect outcome.

Guarding faith with one’s life—isn’t that the story most fervent believers love?

Barras fell silent for a moment, then lifted his head with a beaming smile and said.

“Indeed, it was indeed a portion of the clergy who…”

“I can apologize on their behalf; now the Pope sincerely invites you back—isn’t that a recognition of you?”

“I don’t need it. Look at this?”
Alice pointed to the holy armor on the table, “I’ve returned the lost items; from today onward, I have no ties with the Holy Church.”

“How could it be no relation? You were once a Hero, a warrior who fought for the Goddess—there’s no way it could be unrelated; isn’t everything you’ve gained today a blessing from the great Goddess of Light?”
Barras’s face grew stern; when discussing faith, this frivolous man became especially earnest.

“Nonsense; what does my achievement have to do with the Goddess of Light?”
Alice retorted.

“You!? ”
Barras furrowed his brows, warning, “Alice, what are you saying? Blaspheming the divine will not end well.”

“Sorry, I never wanted to place my hopes in the divine; such talk only helps the followers of the Light Church.”
Alice slowly rose, expressionless, saying, “If you have nothing else, I’ll take my leave and convey my final regards to His Holiness the Pope.”

“Wait, Alice…”

Barras tried to detain her, but Alice didn’t look back and quickly left the temple, effectively severing her ties with the Holy Church.

This left Barras somewhat annoyed; alone in the room, gazing at the Hero’s inherited holy armor on the table, he thought to himself—

It seems Cardinal Scott’s secret report was not a lie—Alice has fallen and is strongly resisting returning to the Goddess’s embrace?

It is said that the root of all this is that Alice has married a certain man; that man is vicious by nature, can casually utter blasphemous words, and is a outright heretic!

Alice’s personality changed drastically under his influence, and she refuses to wield her sword for the Goddess again.

In order to make Alice once again become the Goddess’s warrior—

To protect the Goddess’s servants—

For love and peace—

That man must be eliminated!

(一“-).

title: Chapter 4 — The Two Little Ones (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 4 — The Two Little Ones (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 28 · Chapter 4

At the guild, the celebration was still going on. Rexton's adventurers drank and laughed with a few ales already hitting them.

Old Taylor looked at the cheerful scene and couldn't help but sigh. The guild hadn't been this lively in a long time. From today on, the guild would turn a brand new page.

"Grandpa, Alice is definitely the guild's top contributor this time. Don't you think she'll jump straight to an Orate-bronze class adventurer?" Lucia said eagerly, her eyes shining with excitement. "Just thinking that our guild is about to produce an Orate-bronze adventurer makes me too excited to sleep~"

"Alice is indeed very likely to receive the invitation, but top contributor is debatable..." Old Taylor said meaningfully.

"Huh? Alice isn't the top contributor? Then who is?" Lucia looked utterly confused.

"Merlin is the top contributor." Old Taylor answered with certainty.

"???" Lucia's expression turned bizarre.

"Grandpa, you're joking, right?"

Old Taylor sighed. He knew that when Merlin's deeds were mentioned, very few people would believe them, and over-explaining would be pointless.

"Oh right, I remembered..." Lucia looked up and asked curiously, "I saw Mr. Merlin challenging several aces from the Katowice Guild, and then the broadcast had an accident. I wonder how it turned out?"

"The result? Haha~" Old Taylor chuckled, feeling thoroughly satisfied. "Among the top eight, Merlin defeated six of them single-handedly, shocking all the adventurers in the arena. Not a single one dared to step onto the ring. That's the result."

Lucia forced a laugh, a few black lines sliding down her forehead. "Grandpa, can you act normal? I'm not a kid anymore. You're still teasing me like that."

"Lucia, you are my precious granddaughter. I hope you can keep your eyes open and truly see this world. Don't limit yourself to a small place like Rexton, and don't take familiar things as iron laws. This world is full of countless wonders, all of which exist beyond common sense." Old Taylor said deeply, hoping Lucia could piece together the clues herself.

Lucia fell silent, wondering if Grandpa really meant everything he said. Did Mr. Merlin defeat six of the top eight competitors and leave all the adventurers speechless?

That sounded incredibly fantastical. Was there really an adventurer who could achieve something like that?

Lucia glanced over at Merlin, who was chatting and laughing with Hobbs and Arnold, two idle guys, quite different from the other adventurers who were immersed in their joy.

At that moment, two tiny voices started chirping noisily, interrupting Lucia's thoughts.

"Lucia! We want cream cake! The kind with strawberries!"

"The kind with strawberries~!"

Lucia looked down and saw the two little ones, Mimi and Chris. She couldn't help but smile. "Aren't you supposed to be finding your dad? Why come to me?"

"No dessert and we'll cause trouble!" Little Mimi said with a serious face.

"Cause trouble~!" Chris chimed in, completely ready to follow the big boss to the end.

"Oh~" Lucia looked at the two of them and said softly, "Sister's place isn't an orphanage. I won't give you delicious food for free. Do you understand?"

Mimi and Chris looked at each other, confusion on their faces. Clearly, they were stumped.

Lucia smiled. She couldn't let the two little ones get into the habit of just reaching out and taking. Just as she was about to offer them some treats.

Little Mimi pulled out a few copper coins and said haughtily, "We have money!"

"We have money!" Chris agreed proudly.

"..." Lucia felt awkward and had to take the money. "Wait here."

"Strawberries~! The sweetest kind!" Little Mimi was afraid Lucia might get it wrong.

"I know, you chatterbox. Just wait~" Lucia replied irritably.

"Hmph!" Little Mimi looked proud, then turned to Chris and said, "Lucia is just a salesclerk. With such a terrible attitude, I'm putting her in my little notebook."

"What's a little notebook?" Chris asked curiously.

"It's a blacklist for evil villains! When I learn magic, I'll spread justice far and wide, and everyone's names in this book will be dealt with!" Little Mimi solemnly took out a small black book and doodled on it, clumsily drawing a picture of Lucia, which looked far more狰狞 than the real thing. This must be what the gentle face of Rexton looked like in children's eyes?

"Wah~ so cool!" Little Chris's eyes were full of stars, clearly starting to admire Mimi.

"Hehe~" Little Mimi was smug and began to speak without restraint. "My dad said Lucia can't get married. Her personality is bad and unrealistic. She's so grown up and still dreams of being a princess~"

"Can't be, Lucia is so pretty~" Little Chris furrowed her eyebrows, not entirely agreeing.

"Heh, what use is pretty? She's still a fierce big villain. As a knight, you must never be fooled by appearances~" Little Mimi said proudly.

"Who are you calling a big villain?" Lucia suddenly appeared behind Little Mimi and grabbed her ear.

"Waaah! I won't do it again, Lucia..." Little Mimi apologized tearfully.

Chris trembled and didn't dare to speak. She thought she'd better behave like a good kid, otherwise she might end up like Mimi...

Lucia watched with interest as the two little ones ate, almost more entertaining than watching hamsters eat.

The little ones held cream cakes and kept licking them with their small tongues, frequently letting out bell-like laughs.

Chris's mouth was covered in white cream, looking like an old child, but Lucia could already see that Chris would grow up to be a little lady.

Mimi, on the other hand, ate much messily, getting cream all over herself like a little boy, with far fewer restraints.

These were clearly kids raised by their fathers, without too many refinements. Chris, who had been raised by her mother for a long time, wouldn't be so wild.

"Mimi, look at how you're eating. What a mess! Can't you be more elegant? Look at Chris, she's what a little girl should be like." Lucia couldn't help but mutter.

"Hehe~" Chris looked up, happy to be praised.

"Hmph! Where do you get all these demands? Dad says whatever makes us happy is fine!" Little Mimi complained.

"Your dad... really leaves me speechless..."

A large drop of sweat slid down Lucia's forehead. She wondered if Hobbs had really taught Mimi anything useful?

Although he had said he had a wife, she had never seen him, had she? Didn't Mimi's mother try to discipline her properly?

Lucia thought better of it. She wasn't Mimi's mother. Why meddle? She suddenly remembered her grandfather's words and couldn't help but ask Chris.

"Chris, your father is very awesome, right? How did he perform at the arena?"

title: Chapter 5 — Spiritual Leader
content:
Chapter 5 — Spiritual Leader

Volume 28 · Chapter 5

“My dad is so awesome~” Chris chubby little hands waved, trying to depict how heroic Merlin was, but in the end she could only say dryly, “Just... two or three moves and the enemy is defeated, so fast~”

......Lucia couldn't quite understand Chris's words, because they were too simple, making it hard to imagine what actually happened.

“In short, my dad is super awesome—just go up and one will fall down, and in the end, many uncles and aunts who initially said my dad wasn’t good enough ended up saying nothing.” Chris said, lifting her little face, feeling very proud of her dad inside!

“Well.... Lucia laughed awkwardly and asked, “What do you mean? Did your dad really consecutively defeat the adventurers from Cathowitz?”

“What’s Cathowitz? Is it something to eat?” Chris curiously lifted her head, having no idea where the adventurers in the competition came from.

Lucia’s head swelled a circle; she thought kids could tell the truth, but any slightly deeper question went completely over her head.

I also don’t know if what Grandpa said is true—Mr. Merlin personally defeated six of the top eight....

Lucia pondered dubiously in her mind, Chris’s statements couldn’t be relied upon, after all, to kids, adults all seem mighty.

“Even if your dad is awesome, could he be as awesome as my dad?” Mini pouted beside them, saying indignantly.

“What’s so great about your dad?” Chris furrowed her little brows, thinking there’s no one in the world more awesome than her dad.

“My dad knows lots of stuff, he’s seen the big wide world~” Mini said proudly.

“Big wide world… what kind of noodle is that? Sounds… delicious…” Little Chris drooled uselessly.

“It’s not food! Anyway, my dad is well‑versed, knows everything, there’s nothing he doesn’t know!” Mini said happily, arms crossed.

Lucia smiled without speaking, thinking Hobbs really is well‑informed—after all, he’s a famous information broker, knowing the movements of big shots down to what underwear Queen Elizabeth is wearing today.

Although Hobbs’s strength is just average, after joining the guild for several years he’s merely an iron‑rank adventurer, but gathering information and being well‑informed is still a rare talent, right?

“Sounds pretty awesome~” Chris, not really getting it, saw Mini’s confidence and thought it must be really impressive!

“Hmph~” Mini hummed proudly and added, “My dad can communicate with the dead—I’ve seen him greet a ghost!”

“A ghost?” Little Chris couldn’t help but say fearfully, “How scary is that.”

“Not scary at all, those ghosts pose no danger, they’re like air~” Mini showed off in front of Chris for a while.

“Wow~” Chris let out a small gasp, already equating Mini with bravery in her heart.

“Ha....” Lucia watched the two little ones bragging, couldn’t help laughing, thinking Hobbs couldn’t possibly have any magic to communicate with the dead—he’s just a weak fire mage; he’s probably just talking to the air to amuse Mini, putting on a show.

“Let me tell you secretly....” Mini leaned close to Chris’s ear and whispered, “I’m also really awesome—I’m actually the founder of history’s most mysterious Knight: Earth Team~”

“Huh? Mini‑sis is a knight?!” Chris exclaimed, having seen many knights on her travels with her parents, all mighty and imposing; she didn’t say it out loud, but deep down she envied them.

“Of course!” Mini stood up, putting on a mature air, and said, “Our organization…. Melon Baby Knights”

“Pff hah.... Lucia burst out laughing again, defeated by this silly name—this bunch of adorably clueless kids is just cute in their childishness~

“Don’t laugh! Hearing this name, an evil adult like Lucia‑sis should be feeling terrified!” Mini said with a dead‑serious face.

“Oh~, mighty knight lord, I’m already scared.” Lucia forced a smile, playing along with Mini’s act.

“That’s about right~” Mini nodded satisfactorily at Chris and said, “Our knight squad exists to oppose those nasty grown‑ups, to let them know how awesome we are—so no adult can look down on us!”

“That’s so cool, Mini‑sis!” Little Chris’s eyes filled with tiny stars, full of admiration for the “Melon Baby Knights”.

Feeling Chris’s admiration, Mini felt very satisfied: “We’re busy every day, needing to gather evidence of the adults’ wrongdoings and constantly oppose other evil forces—it’s too dangerous.”

“Mini‑sis, can I join?” Chris’s eyes brimmed with hope, as if she’d found a place to belong.

“No way, no way.” Mini waved her hands repeatedly, speaking seriously, “To join the Melon Baby Knights, you first have to learn magic—do you know any?”

“......” Chris looked at her cream‑covered hands, feeling disappointed; although lately she felt like her head was full of something, she still couldn’t use any magic.

“That’s really too bad—our Melon Baby Knights are all elites; we can’t just take anyone~” Mini said in an old‑fashioned tone, not realizing how mighty she thought the knight team was.

Lucia furrowed her brows, thinking Mini probably has no magical talent either—she herself can’t do it, yet she’s demanding others…

“Oh right, our knight squad also has a spiritual leader!” Mini pulled out a mask matching Elgin the Great Swordsman’s style, put it on, and added a miniature toy Banri Garan, saying, “This is it, or… magic says”

“Mini‑sis looks so mighty~” Chris, seeing Mini’s outfit, couldn’t put it down.

“Don’t bother me, Mini‑sis, I’m… Elgin the Great Swordsman now! Any evil guy who sees me will be scared silly!” Mini shouted in a rough voice, fighting over this gear with her pals plenty of times.

Lucia covered her face, feeling speechless—lately kids all idolize that great swordsman, and you can always see children on the street wearing masks and toy swords.

Little Chris examined closely, pointing at Mini’s waist blade and said, “My dad also has a blade like that, only it’s a lot bigger than Mini‑sis’s!”

“Nonsense, your dad’s is fake—mine is the true Elgin the Great Swordsman’s blade!” Mini retorted indignantly.

“But my dad’s really looks genuine, it’s heavy and handsome, though the inside’s already rusted....” Chris said, feeling wronged.

“How could a great swordsman’s blade rust? Your dad’s must be fake—a cheap stall‑goods knockoff!” Mini declared firmly.

“No way! My dad’s is the real one!” Chris said, puffing her cheeks like she’d stuffed two buns in her mouth.

“Huh?” Lucia furrowed her brows, listening to the two brats argue, couldn’t help wondering…

Mr. Merlin’s blade

How could it be the same as Elgin the Great Swordsman’s?

(-.)?

title: Chapter 6 — Sin (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 6 — Sin (Bonus)

Volume 28 · Chapter 6

Lucia never noticed Merlin's sidearm; hearing Chris suddenly say her dad also had one, she couldn't help but think—
Oh~, it turns out Mr. Merlin also likes to keep up with fashion, likes Elgin the Great Swordsman? He even specially bought a commemorative item to wear on himself.
Chris said stubbornly, "My dad's is the real one, yours is just a toy!"
Mini shouted, "Nonsense! Mine... it's a token personally given to me by Elgin the Great Swordsman, your dad's sword is fake!" showing a very stubborn expression.
Chris angrily turned and left, saying, "Mini sis, you're so hypocritical, I don't want to play with you!" and went to find her dad.
Mini lowered her head, looked at the toy sword in her hand, feeling a bit guilty, but she wouldn't back down verbally.
Lucia watched with interest, thinking that this child Mini is nothing like Hobbs at all; obviously Hobbs is very smooth—
Lucia said, "Can't you just say something nice? It's just a toy, all fake—how could Elgin the Great Swordsman possibly take out his weapon and sell it casually?"
Mini said angrily, "No way! This is a token of our Gua Wa Zi Qi Tu Tuan, someone like big sis Lucia wouldn't understand!"
Lucia spread her hands helplessly, thinking: Mini finally found a little playmate but got angry and left; she really doesn't know how to yield, but kids get angry quickly and leave quickly—maybe they'll make up tomorrow.
Merlin was happily chatting with Hobbs and Arnold over there; Chris pitter-pattered over to Merlin, tugging at his pants, whining, "Dad! Dad's color!"
Merlin said, "Huh?" He picked up Chris, soothing, "My little princess, what's wrong?"
Chris said, "Mini sis has a toy that looks just like my dad's sword, she said hers is the real one...." Chris's little face scrunched up, she got upset.
Merlin sighed, "Ah... so that's it..." He wryly smiled, thinking his demon sword Banri Garan is genuine, but now many toys have been made, making real vs fake hard to tell; however, seeing Chris upset outside for the first time is quite a novel experience~
Hobbes said apologetically, scratching his head, "Haha, Mini is indeed a stubborn kid; I also don't dare to manage her too much...."
Arnold said, "Elgin the Great Swordsman's sidearm? My father also had a highly skilled blacksmith forge one for him, which he kept as a collection."
Merlin felt helpless; he couldn't possibly hold a grudge over such a trivial matter with a child, right?
Moreover, Merlin himself is still the founding leader of the "Gua Wa Zi Qi Tu Tuan"!
Merlin said, "Actually, Dad is Elgin the Great Swordsman, do you believe Dad?"
Chris lifted her little face and said, "Believe! I believe everything Dad says."
Merlin said, "Then there's no need to quarrel over this; the truth is always held by a few, most people won't see it; you just need to be yourself, arguing with others is pointless." He held Chris close, seriously saying, "You just need to know that Elgin the Great Swordsman, this hero, is your most loyal knight, who will help you fulfill any wish, even plucking stars from the sky for you."
Chris giggled, "Mom says Dad has a thick skin, often saying embarrassing things..." The cowlick on Chris's head swayed.
Merlin said, "Uh, don't listen to your mom, she loves to secretly badmouth..."
Merlin said embarrassedly, thinking: Is Alice always badmouthing me in front of Chris, tarnishing my glorious fatherly image? Too despicable!
However, Merlin felt a bit relieved; fortunately he had done some good deeds earlier, making his daughter admire him, otherwise if his dark past were exposed, his precious daughter might despise him.
Merlin doesn't plan to tell Chris for now that her dad is actually the Demon Lord feared by many; she's so young she might get scared and cry.
Outside the guild's door, Arnold's sister Jenna poked her head out, peeking at Merlin carrying a child, drool dripping onto the ground.
Hearing from her brother Arnold that all the contestants have returned, Jenna is overjoyed, because she can again peek at the man she dreams of.
Jenna said, "Lord Merlin, gulp (swallowing saliva)..."
Merlin, being peered at, felt chills all over, noticing Jenna's ** face outside the door, his heart jumped...
"How did this person come here? Every time I'm stared at, I feel a bit nauseous!"
"I've served many women before, but I've never seen someone so hard to deal with!"
Jenna shouted, "Lord Merlin!!!"; she couldn't help but run in and launch herself at Merlin.
Merlin yelped, "Eek!" He instinctively lifted his foot, making Jenna's pouncing body meet his shoe sole in close contact.
With a "thud", Jenna fell spread-eagle, dying on the spot, her face still bearing Merlin's black shoe print.
Arnold said, "Jenna?!" He helped her up cleanly, "What are you doing? When you're out, you must uphold the Austin family's reputation, otherwise Dad will scold you when you go back."
Jenna coughed twice, then her eyes filled with little stars as she looked at Merlin, lovestruck: "Lord Merlin still has that manly charm, so violent, so bad~"
Merlin's heart filled with dread, goosebumps rose all over; he said, "What do you want? I warn you, don't bother me!"
Jenna said hesitantly, "... I have a proper matter I'd like to ask Lord Merlin for help with?"
Merlin asked warily, "What help?"
Jenna quickly handed Merlin a colorful flyer.
Merlin frowned, "Orphanage comfort performance? The cute little one and the seven perverts' story?" He sensed it's not suitable for children.
Hobbes said, "It's the children's play where the smart white rabbit outwits seven big bad wolves and survives; as the lord of the Austin earldom, each year we prepare a program to perform for the kids at the Lexsham orphanage." Hobbes has seen it countless times; every year it's the same.
Merlin suppressed the urge to curse; such a boring story, given such a profound name, I took off my pants for this? The result is just this!?
Jenna said frankly, "Lord Merlin, we're short-staffed here; if you have time..."
Merlin said, "No, get lost, watch, no sending, thanks!"
Before Jenna could finish, Merlin coldly refused, having no interest in the puppet costumes on board, making a bunch of brats act crazy and foolish.
Merlin thinks: "I, after all, was once a Demon Lord who shook the four directions, making ordinary people faint from fear, a being many feared."
"Now I have to wear a puppet costume to please brats? What nonsense; if other demons knew, they'd laugh at me!"
Merlin thinks: "Having been a 'cowherd' is bad enough; now having to go to the orphanage as an extra is over the top—I can't lose face like that."
Chris looked at the colorful flyer, attracted by the cute big bad wolf and little white rabbit costumes.
She's just a child under three, with almost no resistance to these things; a few glances and she's conquered.
Chris said, "What a cute plushie! I want to see Dad turn into a plushie! Dad, put it on and show me, okay?"
Merlin said, "Uh! Chris, calm down, Dad is a serious person, so..."
Chris said, "Dad just said he could fulfill any wish of mine; is he lying to me?" She pouts, looking aggrieved.
Merlin is speechless; he slaps his forehead with a "pa", his heart aching.
"I am a Demon Lord after all! But my precious daughter likes it?"
"....."
"What sin have I created ="

title: Chapter 7 — Free Air
content:
Chapter 7 — Free Air

Volume 28 · Chapter 7

At night, Merlin brought Chris back home, discovering that Alice had already returned early and was busy in the kitchen.
In the end, Merlin still agreed to Jenna, not because he enjoyed helping others, but because Chris was very interested in that fluffy costume.
Merlin felt that as a father, fulfilling this wish was still possible for Chris; letting her see and touch it in costume was no big deal.
But Merlin felt ashamed inside; as a former monarch of the demon race, he now had to go to an orphanage to comfort children?
If this matter were known to the elders of the demon race council who had once fried Merlin squid, they would certainly be very glad that the decision to drive Merlin away was correct.
However, Merlin felt a bit relieved, fortunate that it wasn't just him who was embarrassed this time; otherwise, he might truly have become a laughingstock among Rex's peers.
Hobbs and Arnold were also forcibly dragged by Jenna to participate, each assigned a role.
Arnold originally resisted, but unable to withstand his sister's soft and hard persuasion, he reluctantly agreed to wear the embarrassing costume.
Hobbs was even simpler; Jenna promised him decent pay, so the idle him quickly nodded and bowed, shouting, "Miss Jenna, you are generous and magnanimous!"
After Merlin returned home, seeing Alice's figure in the kitchen, he felt a bit uneasy, quickly put Chris on the ground, and said solemnly:
"Chris, can you promise Dad one thing?" SE轻/
"What’s that~?" Chris lifted her little face, rubbed her pleated skirt, novel.
"Dad wearing the costume to comfort the orphanage, you must never tell your mom, understand?" Merlin emphasized seriously, he did not want Alice to see him so foolish, otherwise his dignity would be completely lost.
"Why?" Chris didn’t quite understand, feeling there was nothing that couldn’t be told to mom.
"Because this is a secret between you and Dad, a secret cannot be told to a third person." Merlin said with a forced smile.
"But that’s Mom; if we hide it from Mom, she’ll think Chris is a little brat." Chris pouted, feeling wronged.
Merlin rubbed his forehead, feeling a headache, suddenly a flash of inspiration: "Chris, I think you know, your mom is very strict; if she knew Dad wanted to take you to see the orphanage’s consolation performance, do you think she’d agree? She’d definitely lock you up, making you stay home obediently; you don’t want that, right?"
"咕呜！"
Chris was startled into hiccups, her face turned pale, the desire to play overcame maternal love.
Compared to hiding it from Mom, going with Dad to see the fluffy big toy was more attractive to her!
Thus Chris became unusually serious, nodding like a pecking chick, promising Merlin.
"Don’t worry, Dad, Chris won’t tell Mom……"
"Good, that’s right; tomorrow you’ll see lots of fun things." Merlin rubbed Chris’s head, secretly relieved—
Hehe! Kids are really easy to please; taking her to play without regard for principles, truly a plastic mother‑daughter bond!
Chris had already begun imagining in her mind a flock of fluffy cute toys circling her; tomorrow would be a happy day.
Alice saw Merlin return and couldn’t help asking, "How come you’re only back now? What did you go do?"
"We were celebrating at the guild that Miss Alice became a champion adventurer—what a great honor!" Merlin said with a strange tone.
"What tone is that? Are you looking down on me?" Alice’s face fell, her eyebrows twitching nonstop.
"No no no, I don’t mean that; the celebration really ended very late, lots of people kept asking me where you went, why you didn’t come to the party." Merlin paused, speaking teasingly, "I guess they think you’ve become so famous you’re swollen with pride and disdain to talk to them, haha~"
"_... Alice’s face flushed, then she quickly composed herself, "I really didn’t mean that; after finishing things it was already dark, so I didn’t go."
"Mom~" Chris trotted over to Alice after some preamble, opening her arms for a hug.
Alice lifted Chris up and asked, "B“Did you have fun playing today?"
"Happy~mi" Chris laughed nonstop, raising her little hand and starting to count fingers, "I saw many uncles and aunts, plus Lukiya sister, Mini sister treated me to tasty food, and… and… Dad? eat"
"Huh? What’s wrong with your dad?" Alice asked suspiciously.
Chris instantly became nervous, obviously not good at lying, but still forced a grin and said, "Nothing… da~爵"
"You little…" Alice didn’t think further, put Chris down, patted her butt, "Go play first; we’ll eat later, and I need to have a private talk with your dad," a__
In the kitchen, Merlin and Alice discussed the debt matter; the Hero’s Inheritance Holy Armor has already been returned to the Holy Church, and now both of them are debt‑free free people.
Not only is there no debt, the Holy Church even returned a large sum, all from Alice’s minimum monthly repayments.
Life suddenly became prosperous, making Alice feel a bit hard to adapt; just a short while ago she still had to budget carefully, and overnight she heard the spring breeze?
