title: Chapter 8 — The Lone Ruler
content:
Chapter 8 — The Lone Ruler

Volume 28 · Chapter 8

“Are you... are you taking Chris back to the Swamp of Death?” Alice’s heart skipped a beat, and she turned around in astonishment to look at Merlin.

“How should I put it...” Merlin paused, then said seriously, “Chris is also considered half a member of our Lucifer family. My younger sister has never met her, and all my old subordinates need to see her.”

Alice frowned tightly, recalling Lilitu, whom she had only met once. That barbaric and violent image was still vividly etched in her memory.

Merlin wanting to take Chris back to the Swamp of Death struck right at the thing Alice was worried about, forcing her to become tense.

“Do you want to take Chris to meet your group of demon subordinates? What do you mean? Do you want Chris to become the Third Demon Lord?”

“I... I don’t mean that. I never thought of letting Chris become the heir to the Demon Lord Palace.” Merlin felt baffled, wondering if it wasn’t normal for him, as a former Demon Lord, to let his old subordinates meet his precious daughter?

“I disagree! I won’t allow Chris to have anything to do with demons!” Alice turned around angrily, hands on her hips, saying, “I don’t care. I’m Chris’s mother; I also have the right to decide Chris’s wishes...”

“What are you doing? I just want to bring Chris to meet some old acquaintances at the Demon Lord Palace. Are all demons like extremely poisonous snakes and scorpions in your eyes? Then wouldn’t I not be able to approach Chris either?” Merlin showed a serious expression, feeling that Alice was being unreasonable.

“I... I just won’t allow you to take Chris away.”

Alice’s tone held no hint of compromise; the subtext was that she didn’t want Merlin to leave and believed he should stay for the sake of young Chris.

Although it seemed there was nothing currently restraining Merlin, Alice wanted Merlin, for Chris’s sake, not to run wild without scruples.

“If you want to return to your demon homeland so badly, then... go back by yourself, okay?”

“Huh? You think I can’t go back on my own?” The veins on Merlin’s forehead twitched, and he said defiantly, “As long as I am willing to go back, I can sit on the throne of the First Demon King again in minutes!”

Alice gritted her teeth in anger and said petulantly, “Then goodbye. Don’t take Chris with you. She is not your possession!”

“...” Merlin sneered coldly and said calmly, “It sounds like if I take Chris away, you could stop me...”

“You! ?” Alice was speechless with anger and said irritably, “If you dare to take Chris away, I will storm into your Demon Lord Palace!”

“??? ” Merlin was astonished, thinking that Alice was going to fight to the death with him for the child? Did she really have the guts to confront the demon race’s nest?

Alice stared fiercely at Merlin, regretting more and more that she had returned the Hero’s Sacred Armor. If she hadn’t returned the armor, how would Merlin have come up with so many schemes?

Outside, Chris seemed to have heard her parents arguing. She quickly came to the kitchen doorway, poking her little head out to look around. “Mommy, Daddy, are you fighting?”

Merlin: “Chris, your daddy and mommy are very loving.”

Alice: “That’s right. I am having daily emotional exchanges with your daddy.”

“Ah?” Little Chris didn’t quite understand, but she thought in her heart:

Maybe hitting is affection and scolding is love?

Mommy and Daddy’s communication methods are really strange....

No words were spoken that night; the sky was just beginning to lighten.

Alice lay in bed with her eyes closed. Although she looked like she was asleep, the dark circles under her eyes had already betrayed her.

In fact, Alice hadn’t slept all night. Her spirit was in a state of high tension, and she couldn’t let go of what Merlin had said earlier.

Alice was very worried that Merlin would take Chris away while she was asleep and secretly return to the demon race’s homeland overnight.

Just thinking about possibly becoming an isolated person made Alice restless and unable to sleep; her consciousness was constantly focused on Chris’s side.

At this time, Merlin, who usually liked to sleep in, suddenly woke up. He got up quietly, looking at Alice, who was pretending to sleep.

Alice’s heart jumped with alarm. This guy would never get up early normally; why was he so diligent today? There must be something fishy!

Merlin looked nervous, approaching Alice with the guilty conscience of a thief, and called out tentatively, “Alice?”

“Washboard?”

“I’m going to take Chris away...”

The veins on Alice’s forehead appeared and disappeared faintly; she almost jumped up on the spot to strangle Merlin because of the word “washboard.”

However, Alice was curious and wondered what Merlin was up to. Was he really planning to secretly take Chris away from her?

Alice decided to continue pretending to sleep to see what tricks Merlin could play and whether he was truly that ruthless!

Seeing no reaction from Alice, Merlin sighed that this guy slept like a pig, so he hurriedly shook his sleeping precious daughter.

“Chris, wake up, wake up...”

“...” Chris, wearing baby pajamas, rubbed her sleepy eyes. “Daddy is so annoying. I was almost eating cake in my dream. Hmph.....”

“Did you forget something? We have a big plan today, Chris...” Merlin’s expression became serious, trying to make Chris realize...

“Oh! That one!” Chris suddenly perked up, her eyes wide open.

“Shh! Keep your voice down. Remember not to tell your mom.” Merlin reminded her seriously.

“Uh-huh, uh-huh...” Chris nodded excitedly.

Pretending to sleep, Alice felt hurt in her heart. What secrets did they father and daughter have from her? Were they really leaving her?

Alice felt like she was about to cry, especially since Chris seemed quite happy to leave her. It was truly a plastic mother-daughter relationship!

The father and daughter quietly put on their clothes and walked out of the bedroom...

Chris bounced around, looking very excited. Arriving at the door, she continuously slapped it with both small hands, wanting to go out quickly.

Merlin picked up Chris and asked amusedly, “In such a hurry?”

“I want to see Daddy turn into a big toy. Daddy’s fluffy appearance must be very interesting.” Chris was already looking forward to it.

“...” You just simply want to see Daddy embarrass yourself, right? Merlin felt awkward, thinking that it was already very shameful for the great Demon Lord to wear a mountain-climbing plush costume to please a brat, but everything was done to make his precious daughter happy.

“Hehe~” Chris’s ahoge (cowlick) was very active, but she still felt sorry for Alice. “Really not telling Mommy? Will Mommy be very sad staying home alone?”

“No need to worry. We’ll be back soon. This is our secret. Absolutely do not tell your mom, okay?” Merlin explained with a serious face, extending his pinky finger to make a promise.

“Okay~” Chris giggled and hooked her finger with Merlin’s pinky.

The father and daughter prepared to go out to participate in the orphanage’s comfort performance. As soon as they opened the door and it made a “creak” sound...

Alice, wearing her pajamas, suddenly ran out of the bedroom and hugged Merlin tightly from behind, repeatedly saying—

“Merlin! Don’t go! Don’t leave me!”

“What did I do wrong?”

“I apologize, I’ll change, isn’t that enough! ?”

title: Chapter 9 — Murder Plot
content:
Chapter 9 — Murder Plot

Volume 28 · Chapter 9

Alice, who was always concerned with face, actually said something from the heart? This left Merlin astounded.

If today hadn't been Merlin driving her to the corner, with Alice's stubborn personality, she would never have surrendered even if killed.

Merlin's face turned red, his whole body stiff, awkwardly turning his head to ask, "You... what did you say?"

"... Don't leave!" Alice lifted her head, her stubborn expression intact, "You're really stingy to the core!"

"Huh?" Chris climbed onto Merlin's shoulder, blinking her big eyes at Alice, "Mom's eyes are red, Mom is sad...."

"... What's that? Don't talk nonsense!" Alice's face turned red, her gaze darting about.

Merlin fell silent, faintly hearing Alice call out not to leave him. For just a moment, his heart inexplicably stirred, and a knight's impulse to immediately offer his heart to the Princess arose?

"It's all Dad's fault! Dad bullied Mom!" Little Chris became anxious, hammering her small fist twice against Merlin's skull, Dad made me hide it from Mom, and as a result Mom was made to cry, Dad is a bad guy!"

"... Not... Merlin's face was gloomy, thinking he hadn't done it on purpose, who knows, he just hid it and took Chris to watch a performance at the orphanage, and Alice got this upset?"

"Dad bad guy! Dad bad guy!" Little Chris stomped her feet, clutching her small fist, "It should have been taking Mom to see the furry toys!"

"Huh?" Alice's face instantly changed, comparable to a textbook page-turning face change, "Furry toys...."

"... It's the orphanage慰问performance." Merlin, seeing Chris turn on him at the critical moment, had to own up to it honestly.

"... Huh?" Alice stood there dumbfounded, feeling her previous appearance was ridiculous.

Simply put, she was a fool!

"The situation.... is just like this."

Merlin lowered his head, explaining everything to Alice awkwardly, the illusion of kneeling and scrubbing a washboard.

It wasn't that he wanted to secretly take Chris back to the demon race's old home, but he was afraid Alice would laugh at him.

"Mmm-hmm... Alice nodded heavily, raising her hands in protection, like accepting Merlin's apology attitude.

"Mmm-hmm, Mom says she knows~" Chris mimicked Mom's appearance, nodding with her arms crossed.

Merlin hesitated, muttering, "I only... don't want you to know, I'll be wearing a mascot costume in front of the kids, dancing silly..."

"Pfft~" Alice didn't recognize the snort, finding it amusing that usually fearless Merlin now had to fawn over the children!

"Huh? You laughed? You were just making fun of me, right!" Merlin stood up angry, knowing it would be just like this.

"I didn't! I just.... thought of happy things."

Alice suppressed her laughter, her gaze darting about, never meeting Merlin's eyes.

"Tch! That's exactly why I wouldn't want to tell you," Merlin gritted his teeth.

"Why aren't you willing to tell me? Just because you're afraid I'll make fun of you? I'll tell you Merlin, you misjudged me, I'm supposed to laugh out loud!" Alice took a deep breath, clutching her stomach, "Hahaha! Didn't expect you this nose-in-the-air guy to have today! Absolutely is you doing too many bad things, punished by the deities~"

Merlin's face turned black, clenching his fist, "I just.... really want to teach you a-

"Wah, don't bully Mom, Mom is so beautiful~" Chris pouted, seeing Merlin furious, quickly protecting Alice.

"..... Merlin's mouth twitched wildly, thinking Chris had the potential to be a two-faced person from a young age.

One second, "Dad! Dad! I love you!"

The next second, "Actually I love Mom the most!"

"Since you're performing at the orphanage, you'd better try your best, and don't scare the children." Alice paused, interest piqued, saying, "I'll take Chris and stand below, watching you perform to your heart's content~"

"Chris will throw small red flowers at Dad~" Chris quickly agreed, already ready to cheer for Dad, although the performance was just an insignificant supporting role.

"You guys...." Merlin frowned tightly, thinking what the heck? Where's the plastic mother-daughter affection I was promised? Now they've joined forces to scheme against me.

Alice hugged the nearby Chris over, smiling and saying, "Honey, do your best, look at our daughter, how excited she is?"

"Cheer! cheer!" Chris raised her chubby little hand, full of anticipation stars in her eyes.

"Despicable... Merlin gritted his teeth, saying helplessly, "If not for Chris liking it so much, I would absolutely not wear such a foolish mascot costume!"

"Hahaha..." Alice shed crocodile tears, saying, "Seeing you so concerned for Chris, I'm moved to the point of almost crying out loud"

"Tch!" Merlin suppressed the dissatisfaction in his heart, speaking in a fit of temper, "I really should take Chris and secretly run back to the old home, letting you be thoroughly dumbfounded alone at home!"

"You!" Alice was stimulated, replying coldly, "I will definitely throw rotten eggs at you from below!"

Merlin was astonished, evaluating calmly, "Shrew!"

The three of the family went out happily, of course excluding Merlin.

Merlin walked in front the whole time, frowning, absolutely not willing to say more than a few words to Alice.

He just thought about having to wear a mascot costume and dance awkwardly before the children, and there was a feeling of brain congestion.

Originally, the high-and-mighty Great Demon Lord falling to the level of "courtesan" wasn't the bottom line, and there was more embarrassing thing, that was becoming a "clown" pleasing the children.

05 SE2 Small News

"....". Merlin sighed deeply, his mind full of how to get by, still wanting to retain a trace of the Demon Lord's bottom line.

"Just about to see Dad's... ah right, performance, happy or not?" Alice asked Chris in her arms.

"Super happy~" The tuft of hair on little Chris's head swayed left and right, just like a dog's tail!

In the distance, two senior knights of the Temple Knights - Barres, were secretly spying on all this.

He hadn't given up on bringing Alice back, instead was brewing a toxic plan in his heart!

Barres planned to quietly do away with Merlin!

One would think, after becoming a widow, Alice losing her bonds, would finally only choose to return to the Holy Church, continuing to serve the Goddess of Light.

Seeing Merlin is a black-iron adventurer, Barres more in his heart sneered, thinking Alice's eyesight too poor!

Not choosing such a handsome big shot here, but choosing a LOW guy anyone can pin down!

It seems Barres, although getting some intelligence from Bishop Scott, didn't know how terrifying an existence Merlin is?

Barres watched the three of Merlin's family gradually go far away, an unwilling smile appearing on his face, thinking one

Although murder isn't an evil behavior advocated by the doctrine, eliminating heretics is every believer's mission!

Look at how I use clever methods, cutting off that humble man's head....

However, this man doesn't seem to like Alice much? Walking so fast, how come he doesn't talk to his wife?

title: Chapter 10 — Little White Rabbit (Supplementary Update)
content:
Chapter 10 — Little White Rabbit (Supplementary Update)

Volume 28 · Chapter 10

In the orphanage of Lord Rexheim, heads gathered below the stage, collecting over fifty orphans.

Their ages varied; the big ones were seven or eight years old, while the small ones still had bottles in their mouths.

Today was Lord Rexheim's visit day, which could be considered a bit of welfare for the younger orphans.

However, because Earl Austin had handed this matter entirely over to his favorite pearl, Jenna, every year's performance was completely arranged according to Jenna's preferences.

Year after year, it was the story of a little white rabbit outsmarting seven big gray wolves. The children in the orphanage were indifferent; some even brought pillows to prepare to sleep early..........

Behind the stage, in the dressing room, a man wearing a rabbit costume was facing the mirror, applying makeup while humming continuously from his mouth.

"Little white rabbit, white and white.

Two ears standing up, cutting arteries then veins, no matter how you move, how cute~"

This rabbit actor, who was painting heavy makeup, was clearly Bares, disguised as him. He would appear as the male lead of the stage play, performing opposite Merlin, who played the big gray wolf villain.

Although Bares had a burly figure, almost about to burst out of the rabbit costume, it was already hard to tell who he was under the heavy makeup?

That was exactly what Bares wanted, not wanting to be recognized by anyone, so he specially came to the orphanage, kidnapping the real rabbit actor, disguising himself to perform on stage, thus having a thousand ways to directly kill Merlin!

He simply looked at the script. As the rabbit protagonist, he had to deal with seven big gray wolves, which was the same as his goal, simply tailor-made for this operation!.

Bares planned to encounter Merlin on stage and find a way to kill the big gray wolf he was playing. Once discovered, he would have long escaped, and no one would discover it was him.

By then, as long as Merlin died, Alice, having no reliance, would obediently return to the Church?

In the closet, the real rabbit had its eyes bound tightly and its mouth gagged, staring in fear at Bares's back, frequently emitting rescue cries, "Waa!!!"

Bares immediately turned back, his ugly makeup combined with a grim expression, looking extremely terrifying.

He placed his finger on his mouth, his smile growing stronger.

"Keep your voice down. If my plan gets ruined, you'll be the little white rabbit having your ears pulled~"

"You won't see Maria, but you'll see Satan in hell..."

Behind the stage, several big gray wolves had gathered, looking listless. It seemed they were temporarily hired by Jenna. Each wore a big gray wolf costume, with wolf heads on top, making it hard to tell who was who? Only familiar voices could be used to recognize each other.

"It seems everyone was forcibly brought in, and there's no interest in coaxing children." Merlin had the gray wolf head clipped at his waist, muttering, "If not for my precious daughter, who would want to do this boring thing?" Jle

"Merlin, don't talk so full. Actually, there are still people who like it." Hobbs, wearing a big gray wolf costume, patted Merlin's shoulder, "Look over there."

Merlin looked in the direction Hobbs indicated, seeing a big gray wolf striking various novel poses, its whole body radiating a shiny quality, "Ah! This costume is simply awesome, I must collect one in private! Haha~"

Merlin's eyebrows danced wildly. Hearing the familiar voice, he couldn't help but ask, "Arnold, how did you end up here too? Was it your sister forcing you to come and make up the numbers?"

"Tch tch tch~" Arnold waved his hands continuously, coming in front of Merlin, "I personally asked Jenna for a spot."

"Hmm?" Merlin furrowed his brows, thinking Arnold was a three-year-old child? To actually like such a childish costume so much?

"This big gray wolf outfit is so handsome! It's simply a work of art! Too perfect!" Arnold tilted his head back at a 45-degree angle, looking at the sky leisurely, saying, "Wearing it, I feel like I'm being called by my ancestors, my whole person's soul becomes quiet, reminding me of gazing at the full moon in the night sky when I was a child, that excited feeling, is my lost childhood..."

"???" Merlin completely didn't understand, feeling Arnold was out of it.

Big gray wolf A: "Young Master Arnold is right. I wait for this moment every year. If I'm not allowed to wear the costume, living is like a dead fish!"

Big gray wolf B: "I've played the big gray wolf for eight years. When will I get to play a rabbit? I'm about to cry..."

Merlin looked at this group of misfits around him, his brain full of question marks, thinking what kind of people were brought here!

Hobbs poked Merlin, whispering, "It seems only the two of us are misfits, huh?"

Merlin had no words, making himself look like a terrier that had mixed into a wolf pack...

Arnold came over, curiously asking, "Have you all read the script? How are you all dying?"

Merlin: "Died being kicked into the river by the little white rabbit."

Hobbs: "I died drunk from drinking."

Arnold: "I... I died from being stupid."

Hearing the script's content, the three big gray wolves fell into silence, the atmosphere becoming extremely awkward--

Merlin: This is too fucking real!

Below the stage, little Chris sat on Alice's lap, her little hands swaying left and right, eagerly waiting to see her dad dressed as a big gray wolf.

"Why hasn't Daddy come out yet?"

"Wait a bit more, remember Daddy's silly look, because later it will be hard to see."

"I will definitely remember it, babe!"

Seeing her daughter so happy, Alice smiled, lifting her head to look at the stage, thinking that according to the order, Merlin should be the first big gray wolf to be hanged.

Suddenly, all the lights dimmed, leaving only the stage lights. A "strong" rabbit walked out, making a strange smile at the children below.

"I am the smart little white rabbit. I heard big gray wolves want to eat me, so today I will come to kill them all!"

The rabbit performer, Bares, deliberately raised his voice to sound like a woman, making it feel like someone was choking his throat? The purpose was just not to let the people below recognize him, especially Alice.

Bares had never learned makeup; the heavy makeup on his face looked like a ghost. Just appearing on stage made the children in the orphanage cry in fear, how could this be the protagonist rabbit? Clearly it's a big gray wolf harvester among rabbits!

"...Chris instinctively shrank into Alice's arms, secretly looking at the rabbit on the stage, feeling scared in her heart.

Hmm?" Alice frowned, always feeling the rabbit on stage was a bit familiar, like she had seen it somewhere? Yet for a moment she couldn't remember.

Even Jenna, the event's host, felt puzzled, unable to recall the group employees she had found, with such a good figure? Even though the whole body was packed in a costume, one could still see sharp muscles.

At this moment, the big gray wolf played by Merlin appeared.........

Sorry.

This is a补更 (make-up chapter). I will update the next chapter as soon as possible. Two

No matter how busy, basic updates will definitely not owe everyone.

title: Chapter 11 — Miscalculation
content:
Chapter 11 — Miscalculation

Volume 28 · Chapter 11

Merlin walked out of the stage with his head hanging low, completely listless. He felt absolutely nothing about such a ridiculous performance.

All he could think about was reciting his lines casually, stripping off that silly costume, and never mentioning this embarrassing chapter of his life again.

Merlin sauntered slowly to the center of the stage and gave his giant wolf tail on the back of the puppet suit a vigorous shake, producing a series of cringeworthy rustling sounds.

"I'm the Big Bad Wolf, very hungry. I heard there's a clever rabbit in the forest. To-day, I-will- eat-it."

With such an utterly unimpressive tone, the children from the orphanage below began making "tsk tsk" sounds repeatedly, sounding almost ready to fall asleep.

Merlin was supposed to be playing a villain, a fierce starving wolf of the forest, but his attitude was extremely lax, completely lacking the menace of a hungry beast.

If Merlin were truly a starving wolf, this embarrassing hunting drive would probably get him starved to death sooner or later.

Alice was so embarrassed she could feel her social anxiety flaring up, and she had plenty of criticism for Merlin's acting skills.

Couldn't you put in a little effort? Chris is watching!

Think about how Merlin used to carry himself as the Demon Lord, standing at the top of the food chain.

If he had displayed even a fraction of that presence, these kids would've been thoroughly impressed. But instead,

he completely lacked any awareness of being a carnivorous predator!

While Alice was deeply uncomfortable watching, Chris was thoroughly enjoying herself, enthusiastically raising her little hands and chanting continuously.

"Daddy! It's daddy!"

"Daddy turned into a cute puppy!"

"Puppy, puppy, puppy!"

Alice glanced down at Chris, who was beaming with joy, her little ahoge bouncing left and right with great energy.

She secretly sighed and thought with resignation, Fine, as long as Chris likes it.

"How was daddy's Big Bad Wolf?"

Chris tilted her head and thought for a moment, then finally found the right word, "Like a goofy!"

"Hah!" Alice snorted. She thought Chris's description was very vivid. "In a bit, daddy's going to get kicked into the river by the little white rabbit and drown."

"Huh?!"

Chris wore an incredulous expression, clearly never having read the script.

In her mind, her daddy was invincible. How could he possibly die from getting kicked into a river?

This wasn't the daddy she knew. Daddy would never be defeated so easily!

Chris pouted, clearly displeased, and fired back.

"Mama's lying. Daddy is super awesome. Daddy won't be bullied by the ugly bunny!"

"Don't believe me? Then just watch closely." Alice was full of confidence. She had read the script, so of course she knew what would happen next. By then, Chris this silly baby would surely think she had precognitive abilities~

"Lord Merlin!!!''

A piercing scream broke the silence. Jenna spotted Merlin and couldn't control herself, jumping in place and waving her flowers, like a fanatic fan supporting a big star.

This was exactly the moment Jenna wanted. When no one was expecting much from Merlin, she could stand up and cheer for him, making herself the woman standing behind Merlin? Indeed, those romance novels had poisoned her mind~

"I love you, Lord Merlin!"

"Tch!" Alice's expression soured somewhat, but she was too lazy to bother with Jenna. After all, those stupid novel plots would never work on Merlin.

On stage, Merlin felt like pins and needles were stabbing his back. Thanks to Jenna, all those unruly kids were now staring over at him. He had wanted to slip through unnoticed, but suddenly, everything felt terrible.

That bastard Jenna, couldn't she let me fade into the background? Why must she try to murder me!

At that moment, a "swish swish" sound rang out. It wasn't actual water, but people mimicking the sound of flowing water with their mouths.

Two extras unfurled a tattered blue cloth, puckering their lips, "swish swish~ swish swish~"

Merlin couldn't help but roll his eyes. His inner monologue vented: What cheap five-cent special effects! Can you put some effort into this?!

Merlin helplessly turned around, exposing his backside to Barees. According to the script, he knew he was about to get kicked by the rabbit and then fall into the river to drown as his exit.

Although Merlin had his pride and couldn't accept anyone just kicking his rear end, this was just a play, so he would barely endure it and move on.

"Ah ha~" Barees, playing the rabbit, walked to the center of the stage with exaggerated body language. "I can't believe the moment I came out, I found a stupid big bad wolf snoring. Let me kick its butt to shreds!"

Chris's eyes widened as she stared intently, unable to believe that her wolf daddy would be defeated by an ugly bunny.

The other children had long since turned their heads away in boredom. They already knew the plot and had no interest in watching it again.

"Hehehe!"

Barees chuckled, feeling the opportunity had arrived. Looking at Merlin with his back turned, his defenses were completely exposed, and he could take down the man before him with the slightest effort.

Take down a Black Adventurer? Barees was confident. As a Grand Knight Commander of the Temple Knights, stooping to deal with a bottom-tier adventurer would be a joke if it got out.

Smiling, Barees approached from behind Merlin, convinced he was about to complete the task assigned by the Pope and return to Rome flawlessly!

He secretly drew upon the surging battle aura within his body, masking it perfectly to prevent anyone below from noticing that his casual kick actually concealed murderous intent!

"Die, you evil big bad wolf!"

With a roar from Barees, a vicious kick shot straight out, aimed directly at Merlin's waist!

As commander of the Temple Knights and the Pope's personal guard, Barees was certainly no ordinary powerhouse!

Although he wasn't releasing his surging battle aura, even a Saint-tier expert would be killed outright by that single kick!

Barees sneered, as if he could already picture Merlin's spine snapping from the impact. No one would ever know he was responsible.

Chris covered her eyes fearfully, not quite daring to watch.

Just as Barees was about to land his blow, Merlin suddenly sensed a trace of danger. His body reacted on instinct, turning around and grabbing Barees's flying ankle mid-kick~

"?!?" Barees's expression froze abruptly. He hadn't expected this outcome~

Without a second thought, Merlin grabbed Barees's ankle and spun him around like a windmill, then slammed him heavily onto the stage floor.

"BOOM!" A thunderous crash echoed through the hall, and the entire stage trembled and sagged. Dust siftled down from the ceiling, startling countless children awake.

Barees lay motionless on the ground, feeling as though every bone in his body was about to shatter. He stared dumbfounded at the ceiling.

The next moment, the still dazed Barees coughed up a mouthful of old blood, his facial features contorted in agony, and he began spewing foul language~

"What the hell!"

"You son of a b-"

(#^皿')

title: Chapter 12 — Bumping into (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 12 — Bumping into (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 28 · Chapter 12

Arnold watched from backstage, his eyes wide with shock, "Merlin... what is he doing?!"

Hobbs, standing beside him, wiped away a cold sweat, his voice trembling, "No wonder every time I pat Merlin's shoulder from behind, he always jumps in surprise."

"Ah! Lord Merlin!" Jenna shrieked excitedly from the audience, nearly fainting from joy at seeing Merlin's violent display.

Barres lay dazed on the ground, knocked senseless by Merlin's sudden counterattack. He couldn't understand why a Black Iron adventurer had such incredible reflexes. Even when he suppressed his killing intent, he was still detected? This was abnormal!

Perhaps Archbishop Scott hadn't fully reported the situation. Merlin's strength wasn't as weak as it seemed on the surface.

Barres felt he had been at a disadvantage due to his lack of understanding. If they were to fight seriously, he would certainly suffer.

"Hmm?" Merlin raised an eyebrow, as if waking from a dream, awkwardly releasing Barres' ankle from his rabbit costume. "Ah, sorry... I didn't mean to. My hands just don't like being attacked from behind, you know? It's an instinctive reaction. Want to try again?"

"No, no, I won't try again," Barres hastily stood up, wiping the blood from his mouth as he quickly retreated, wanting to get as far away from Merlin as possible. He thought the crowded area wasn't suitable for a real fight. No matter how many times, it would be the same. He'd wait for another opportunity.

Watching Barres limp away, Merlin looked embarrassed, muttering, "Seems I've been disliked. I really didn't mean to."

The children below whispered among themselves, having watched the same story for years. The big bad wolf, always the doomed villain, had today turned the tables, sending the rabbit protagonist fleeing. The unexpected twist gave the children a fresh experience, none knowing the true circumstances behind it, all assuming the script had been changed on the spot.

"Hmm..." Alice looked surprised, not expecting Merlin to counterattack so suddenly, ruining the entire script. She worried, "Is the rabbit actor okay? A normal person's bones would have broken from that hit."

"Daddy! Daddy!" Little Chris cheered, seeing her father defeat the ugly rabbit. "I told you Daddy wouldn't be defeated by the rabbit... Daddy wouldn't lose..."

"This..." Alice hesitated, unsure whether to tell Chris the truth.

"Mommy's trying to trick me again. Daddy wasn't defeated. Mommy's being mean!" Chris pouted, feeling Alice was intentionally deceiving her.

Alice thought for a moment, then found an excuse, "Mommy was just testing you, to see if you have your own judgment. In reality, rabbits can't defeat wolves."

"Oh! ! !" Little Chris believed it, feeling proud that she had passed her mother's test.

.SFACG. .Merlin watched the children from the orphanage whispering to each other, seemingly all excited by the unexpected twist in this old story.

Merlin removed the wolf costume head, secretly sighing. Although there had been a small mishap, the performance could be considered a success.

After the farce ended, the actors began removing their makeup and changing clothes in the backstage area, preparing to leave the orphanage.

Barres, who had quickly shed his ridiculous rabbit costume, snuck into the dressing room with a scowl.

His face twisted in anger, still unwilling to give up on killing Merlin. Being defeated by a Black Iron adventurer was a great shame in his life!

Barres wanted revenge, determined to tear Merlin to pieces to erase the humiliation from his heart. Otherwise, he'd dream about this shameful day every night!

The petty Saint Knight Commander glared at the room in front of him, "106."

Barres had secretly investigated and knew this was Merlin's dressing room. Timing it, Merlin should be changing clothes now.

He secretly planned to make a serious move, intending to crush Merlin with overwhelming power to prevent any future troubles.

This time wasn't like on stage. Barres needed to suppress his strength to avoid detection.

Now, with no one watching, Barres could go all out. He had countless ways to kill Merlin!

Barres checked his surroundings, then swapped the "106" dressing room sign with the "109" sign nearby.

He did this because he feared someone might burst in while he acted. Swapping the signs would give him time to escape.

After exchanging the signs, Barres secretly pulled out a poisonous dagger emitting dark energy from his pocket.

This dagger wasn't Barres' usual weapon but was specially purchased from the black market to kill Merlin.

A single scratch would ensure the victim would die within three days, turning into a puddle of foul-smelling liquid!

Although Barres was a clergyman, using such an evil method violated church doctrine. But for the church's interests, he would stop at nothing.

"Merciful Maria, forgive my sins... it's all to dispel the darkness in the world..."

Barres muttered to himself, approaching the dressing room door to act, when he suddenly heard strange noises.

Merlin: "I'm telling you, you're too tight!"

Hobbs: "I don't know, maybe it's my first time?"

Merlin: "I'm exhausted. No one else is as tight as you."

Hobbs: "Use more force! Add some strength! Ah, yes, right there! Push harder!"

Merlin: "Shut up! Don't talk! Just stand still!"

Hobbs: "Ah~δ, that feels good~"

Merlin: "Don't make weird noises! People outside might hear!"

Barres' face turned pale, his eyes filled with incredulity, nearly dropping the poisonous dagger.

He stood frozen, his expression twitching, thinking he must have misheard.

What... what did I just hear?!

This guy has special tastes, no wonder I saw him and Alice not getting along this morning. Turns out he likes men!

Do I still need to act? They'll eventually break up, and Alice will return to the church...

Barres looked at the dressing room door, his face already showing disgust. He thought, helping evil heretics deserved being burned at the stake!

But witnessing this, Barres felt his worldview shaken, hanging his head in despair as he left.

Alice would rather like this kind of person than be with me?

Am I not even comparable to a heretic homo?

Forget it, killing someone like this isn't worth my effort. I'll just report to the Pope...

Alice will eventually return; it's just a matter of time.

(缶。击)

PS■ Update before 3 PM today)

title: Chapter 13 — Bares's Blessing
content:
Chapter 13 — Bares's Blessing

Volume 28 · Chapter 13

Bares had just left when Jenna suddenly appeared here, looking like a thief. Seeing no one around, Jenna let out a sigh of relief and began executing her evil plan with a mischievous smile.

Jenna had been planning this for a long time, waiting for this very moment. She sneaked into this place, intending to "ambush" Merlin, rush into the changing room, and feast her eyes on Merlin while he was undressed.

Just thinking about Merlin being naked in the changing room, about to be seen from head to toe by her, Jenna's face couldn't help but reveal an evil grin, and her drool was uncontrollable.

"Kuh-heh-heh~"

Jenna quickly wiped her drool and looked up to see the room number "109." Wasn't this Merlin's changing room? I remember it was here, right? Did I get it wrong?

Jenna's heart was filled with doubt as she walked to the "10g" room nearby, her smile gradually turning evil.

"Hey-hey-hey, it's here, right? Merlin, I'm here~"

Jenna kicked open the door to room 109, unaware that it was her brother Arnold's room.

Inside the changing room, Merlin let out a sigh of relief and sat down, looking at Hobbs with a gloomy expression.

"Are you too fat to wear this doll costume? It's too tight..."

"I don't know... The costume design is problematic. It's too tight, making me feel like I'm dancing ballet." Hobbs was furious, throwing the big gray wolf doll costume on the ground and muttering, "I've never worn this ridiculous thing before. I didn't expect it to be so uncomfortable. I almost lost my temper and died from frustration..."

"You lewd thing, you sound so alluring when you talk. If someone hears you, they might think we're doing something indecent..." Merlin's tone was full of reproach. He was sexually normal, but he didn't want to be misunderstood.

"Hey-hey-hey, it's uncontrollable. It's unlikely to be heard, right?" Hobbs blushed and scratched his head.

Merlin sighed, hoping so, as this was the backstage area, unlikely to have many people passing by. Otherwise, if it got into his precious daughter's ears, how could he, as a father, continue to be a father?

"By the way, you were a bit too much today. I saw that group performer playing a rabbit being hit pretty hard by you, right?"

Hobbs tentatively asked, thinking about the unfortunate rabbit, feeling a bit of sympathy.

"Ah, that's right... Merlin put on a slightly embarrassed expression. "It's unavoidable. I'm always alert behind me. Even a slight breeze or rustling grass makes me tense."

"Oh, that rabbit must have been really unlucky. He was limping after coming off stage, and I haven't seen him since." Hobbs said in confusion.

"Is that so?" Merlin looked embarrassed, hoping that would be the end of it.

Suddenly, a sharp scream came from next door, startling Hobbs, who "jumped" off his chair.

"Yaaah!"

Hobbs frowned and, after listening carefully, said in surprise, "It sounds like Jenna's voice. Did something happen?"

Merlin quickly stood up, put on his coat, and called Hobbs. "Come on, let's go see what's going on."

They went to the next room and saw a bizarre scene.

Jenna was covering her eyes, as if she had seen something very stimulating, and was quite shocked, standing there trembling.

Arnold was covering himself with clothes, looking very confused, obviously quite scared. He was staring at Jenna, knowing that his sister was actually a female rogue, but he didn't expect her to be so unrestrained, kicking open the male changing room's door!

"........ What are you doing?!"

Arnold frowned, scolding, "This is a male changing room. Don't you know how to knock?"

"Stupid old brother! What are you doing here?"

Jenna covered her eyes, feeling like she had seen something dirty, and her eyes were about to go blind. "Why didn't I see Merlin? This shouldn't be Merlin's room."

"Huh?" Merlin frowned, his face dark, wondering what this crazy woman wanted from me? I feel like I've dodged a bullet.

"What Merlin? This is clearly my room," Arnold said angrily, thinking that his sister was out of her mind, claiming this was Merlin's changing room.

"Nonsense! This is clearly Merlin's room!" Jenna said seriously.

"? ? ?" Arnold didn't know what wind his sister had caught, stubbornly insisting that this was Merlin's changing room.

"I'm going to tell Father, you're harassing me, bing-bing...." Jenna pouted, covering her face and ran away.

Arnold was startled, shouting in terror, "Wait Jenna! You tell Father, he'll break my legs!"

The two looked at each other, not understanding what had happened--

Merlin: "What's going on?"

Hobbs: "I don't know..."

Outside the orphanage, Alice was holding her baby daughter, waiting for Merlin to come home.

Little Chris was looking around, not knowing where to put her hands, and sometimes sticking her little head into Alice's chest for comfort.

"Daddy, why hasn't he come out yet?"

"Don't worry, he'll come out soon."

Chris heard her mother's reply and had to stay quiet, waiting for Merlin to return.

Merlin promised Chris that he would give her the big gray wolf doll costume hat as a new toy.

Just thinking about being able to wear the big gray wolf hat to prank and scare other kids, Chris became very excited.

"When I put on the hat, Mini sister will definitely..."

"Mini sister?" Alice looked confused.

"Mini sister is the daughter of the drunk uncle, she is a powerful knight, and also the founder of the Pumpkin Knight Squad, in short, she is very powerful!" Chris happily introduced.

Alice frowned, thinking that the drunk uncle should be Hobbs, right? It's that guy whose daughter, I wonder why the name sounds so familiar?

"I definitely have to learn magic, otherwise Mini sister won't let me join the knight squad, I also want to be as powerful as Mini sister...." Chris said seriously.

"Ha, you have to work hard." Alice smiled, thinking that Chris had found a peer, but since she had received the inheritance of the fairy race for some time, she still had not shown any magic, maybe the fairy race gave her a false inheritance.

The mother and daughter waited patiently for Merlin, but Bares came out first.

Alice saw him and asked in surprise, "Bares, you're here?!"

"...." Bares hesitated, then said, "Cough, I came here to take a look around...."

"Mom, mom, this uncle looks like an ugly..."

"Uh!" Bares became tense, avoiding eye contact and saying, "What a cute little girl, but her eyesight is not good. I have something to do, goodbye."

Alice looked down at Chris and didn't take her words seriously, thinking that Chris was just joking.

"Ah, by the way." Bares suddenly stopped and turned back.

"Alice, if you change your mind, you can always come back."

"The door of the Holy Church will always be open to you, and this will be your place to stay."

"And..."

"In the future, if you are affected by emotions, don't mind it. You can find a real man."

Alice was completely confused: "???"

title: Chapter 14 — Greed and Stinginess
content:
Chapter 14 — Greed and Stinginess

Volume 28 · Chapter 14

Alice watched Bares's retreating figure, deeply puzzled in her heart—what did that sentence just now mean? Why couldn't she understand it?

Had he presumed she hadn't given up hope, thinking she might return to the Holy Church?

Alice shook her head and didn't give the matter much thought. She felt she probably would have no dealings with the Holy Church in the future anyway. The fact that she had once been a Hero could be sealed away in her memories forever.

"Mom, are you close to that uncle?"

Little Chris curiously tilted her head up.

"...Generally speaking." Alice looked down at Chris in her arms and said softly, "We were comrades on the same side back then, that's all."

"Hmm?" Chris tilted her little head, not quite understanding. She had the feeling that there were many secrets hidden between Mom and Dad, things done behind each other's backs, things neither wanted the other to know?

"Don't overthink it. Even if Mom told you, you wouldn't understand now. Just know that Mom was once a brilliant warrior who was admired by many people." Alice paused, her gaze tinged with a hint of resentment as she said, "If it weren't for meeting your dad—that pervert—I'm sure I would have long made a name for myself by now, leaving my mark among legendary Heroes. Pity, really..."

Even though Chris didn't understand, she still asked curiously, "Does Mom regret meeting Dad? Mom seems pretty bitter about it."

"Hmm..." Alice's expression grew complicated, speech hovering on her lips before she stopped. "There's nothing to regret, really. Just a bit frustrated. Why am I the unlucky one? Smacking right into your dad like a steel slab."

"Pupu~" Chris covered her mouth, giggling, saying in a little traitor-like manner, "I'm gonna tell Dad what you just said~"

"Ah?! " Alice felt a pang of nervousness and quickly put on a stern face, displaying maternal authority, "You're not allowed to tell Dad what I said, or Mom will spank your bottom!"

"... Little Chris immediately grew tense.

"If Mom spanks my bottom, I'll tell Dad, and let Dad help me get revenge. Dad will spank Mom's bottom instead!"

"???" Alice looked thoroughly bewildered, thinking this little creature was getting sharp. She couldn't fool her anymore; she'd even learned to call for backup. How was she supposed to manage her when she grew up?

"Chris is a good girl and hasn't done anything wrong. Mom shouldn't spank..." Chris put on an air of a little adult, speaking in an aged, preachy tone.

"You little traitor, telling everything to Dad? I've been spoiling you all this time for nothing? Do you like Dad more than me?" Alice frowned, feeling resentful inside. After all, she had put in more effort taking care of the baby than Merlin had.

"Dad is tall and handsome, and he makes lots of yummy food. Who wouldn't like him?" Chris pouted her little mouth, making it clear she liked Dad just a little bit more.

"No. If someone asks, you should say you like Mom more." Alice emphasized seriously.

"But Mom said lying is bad. Chris will wet the bed if she lies." Chris said aggrievedly.

"How is that lying?" Alice blushed and shamelessly coaxed, "Mom will buy you egg tarts..."

"!!?" Little stars appeared in Chris's eyes. She switched sides in a flash, saying earnestly, "Mom is a super beautiful lady loved by all, as expected! Chris still likes Mom a little bit more, only... just a tiny bit less than Dad, swoosh~"

Alice felt satisfied and pinched Chris's little nose. "Sly little thing. Say this from now on when you meet people..."

Merlin walked out of the orphanage, put the big bad wolf headpiece on his head, and crept over to scare his darling daughter. "Sweet little thing, let me lick you~ Awooo~ Awooo~"

"Heeheehee, Dad~" Chris burst into laughter, thoroughly delighted being nuzzled by the fluffy costume head.

"Waited long? Do you like it?" Merlin handed the big bad wolf headpiece to Chris, knowing the little one would love it.

"I like it~" Little Chris put on the big bad wolf headpiece and ran around happily all over the floor, mimicking wolf calls in a childish voice, "Awoo~ Awoo~ Awoo awoo~"

Alice watched the little one carefree and happy, smiling as she whispered, "You've worked hard. Forcing yourself to wear such childish things really must be tough on you."

"Hmph!" Merlin pursed his lips, sounding nonchalant. "What dignity is there in being a father? Since Chris likes it, I don't mind. Besides, I'm not the Demon Lord of the demon race anymore anyway. Why hold on to past glory?"

"Is that so?" Alice actually quite liked Merlin this way and unconsciously leaned a little closer.

"You don't really think I'd take Chris back to the First Demon Lord Palace, do you?" Merlin wore an ambiguous smile.

"...I was never serious! Hmph!" Alice huffed and turned her head away angrily.

"Oh? But you were holding me quite excitedly this morning?" Merlin's smile grew even more smug.

"That was..." Alice's face slowly flushed red, speaking awkwardly, "I hadn't fully woken up that morning! I was just afraid you might suddenly leave without saying goodbye!"

"Even if I wanted to leave without saying goodbye, I'd still need to consider Chris's wishes. This kid throws a fit if she can't see you for half a day. Chris only has you as her mom." Merlin sighed.

"...Since you know that..." Chris is still young and needs a complete family... You understand that without me saying it, right?"

Alice's gaze darted evasively. She had been worried that Merlin, freed from his debts and now a free man, would completely let loose. Now it seemed her worries were misplaced.

"Actually, I just simply wanted my younger sister to meet Chris. It's not about having Chris develop deep ties with the demon race. After all, infighting within the demon race is severe too. I don't want her to get drawn into it..." Merlin spoke in a low tone.

"What do you mean?" Alice grew curious, sensing there was more to Merlin's words.

"The demon race isn't as peaceful on the surface as it seems. There are huge ideological divisions within. One faction of demons, having experienced the brutal Saint War, doesn't want to see war again and wishes to maintain the superficial peace with the outside world. Another faction, having inherited the glory of the Demon Era, radicially believes that recreating the demon race's golden age is their life's mission." Merlin paused and continued, "The conservatives and the radicals argue nearly every day in the council chamber. Physical fights are common too."

"I see. I thought you all were united..." Alice sighed in感叹.

"United? Heh, now I suspect the reason I was pushed out back then was because I didn't pick a side..." Merlin sighed and reminisced, "If I recall correctly, the leader of the radical faction is that fat bastard Mamon..."

The Third Demon Lord Palace, within the main hall, the light was dim, and waves of rotten, coppery stench filled the air. Only the golden throne high above shone exceptionally bright within the grand hall, seemingly cold and piercing yet utterly tempting.

A voluptuous demon clad in expensive silk sat majestically upon the golden Demon Lord throne.

Mamon's hair was combed meticulously, and even the jewels adorning his demon horns glittered splendidly. He swayed the stemmed glass in his hand—

"All treasures of this world belong to me."

"Whoever covets my wealth shall die!"

"Not even a single small gold coin can escape paying with blood!"

title: Chapter 15 — Holy War Plan
content:
Chapter 15 — Holy War Plan

Volume 28 · Chapter 15

Mammon slowly rose to his feet, looking down at the legion of evil demons beneath him. "Whoever dares to steal from the treasures of our Third Demon Lord Palace—by now, they must have steeled themselves for certain death, no?"

"You speak the truth, Your Majesty. None could entertain such designs upon your treasures." Ose bowed slightly, speaking with utmost reverence. "I have already brought back the Demon Armor. As for that thief— he has already suffered the consequences of his actions. The armor devoured him completely."

"Oh?" Mammon nodded with satisfaction, responding with wicked amusement. "Did that little thief show any remorse before he died? He should have thoroughly experienced the price incurred by angering the King of Greed."

"Yes, Your Majesty. He believed himself worthy of death, so I granted his wish and eliminated him." Ose lifted his head, a sinister smile spreading across his face.

"Seems he has at least a shred of self-awareness. But to steal my treasures—this sin is unforgivable." Mammon's gaze hardened, a flicker of regret crossing his features. He had chosen not to bring that thief back alive to torture to death, and that was a slight regret.

Ose patted the black case beside him. With a series of clicking sounds from the locks opening, the Demon Armor spontaneously assembled itself. It walked forward and slowly came to stand before Mammon, prostrating itself fully upon the ground as if begging for Mammon's mercy.

Mammon gazed coldly at the Demon Armor. Though it was not the finest treasure in his collection, it was rare to possess one with its own intelligence. The mere fact that this armor possessed its own life made it a world-class marvel with infinite potential uses, even outside.

"Foul creature, you've been wandering around for so many years... Did you enjoy yourself?"

The Demon Armor could not speak, but it understood. It first nodded submissively, indicating that things had been fine while it was away. But suddenly noticing Mammon's displeased expression, it frantically and desperately began shaking its head, continuously bowing to demonstrate its loyalty.

The Demon Armor was a treasure created with Mammon's own hands. To destroy it would be simpler than breathing.

"Hmph!" Mammon snorted, his tone reproachful. "You left without permission alongside those lowly humans. Tell me, how should I punish you?"

"!!!" The Demon Armor trembled all over in terror, incessantly kowtowing, deeply fearing that Mammon might annihilate him in a fit of rage.

Ose's eyes flickered a few times before he spoke up. "Your Majesty, the Holy War is imminent—we are precisely at a time when every resource counts. Though this creature departed without authorization, it still holds some utility. Might it be spared to contribute in the Holy War? Furthermore, it ultimately killed that human with its own hands, proving its loyalty remains unchanged. I implore you to consider this."

Mammon looked at the shivering Demon Armor on the ground and sighed. "Since you remain somewhat useful, I will keep you alive for now. If you perform outstandingly in the future, I may abandon my intention of melting you down and reforging you."

The Demon Armor felt as if granted a reprieve, nodding frantically. To avoid being annihilated by Mammon, it would need to risk its life in future battles to earn merit.

Ose looked at Mammon upon the high platform and asked curiously, "Your Majesty, now that the Demon Armor has been recovered and the conditions are ripe, shall we begin the Holy War immediately?"

"Ose, do not underestimate the matter. If we were to wage a Holy War against the currently flourishing humans, with only the strength of our Third Demon Lord Palace—do you truly believe we could win?" Mammon posed a question.

"...Ose hesitated before answering honestly, "I had not considered this matter. I only know that when Your Majesty strikes personally, few within the human kingdoms can stand against you."

"Hahaha!" Mammon lounged upon his golden throne, jesting. "Your flattery skills grow ever more impressive~"

"..." Ose lifted his head and said gravely, "This servant merely speaks the truth..."

"Saying few can stand against me is somewhat of an exaggeration. Do you truly think humanity reached today's prosperity by being a bunch of incompetents?" Mammon smiled, continuing. "The human world is vast and prosperous, yet fractured into numerous kingdoms. Each possesses the foundation of its nation's existence—powers unknown to outsiders. The Holy War will be initiated by our Third Demon Lord Palace first. We must be thoroughly prepared; otherwise, the other Demon Lords may well grow restless and come to carve up our victory..."

Ose frowned and proposed, "Since the Holy War concerns the entire demon race, then the other monarchs should also contribute their strength. As long as we can unify all demonic forces, enslaving humanity is not impossible."

"You are well aware that those creatures are selfish and self-serving, possessing not a shred of honor. They have grown accustomed to superficial peace and no longer wish for conflict. To unite the demon race's forces—how difficult is that?" Mammon shook his head. Those like him, radical revivalists, were a minority among the Demon Lords.

"Then what should we do? Are we to simply give up? The entirety of the Third Demon Lord Palace, from top to bottom, is willing to live and die alongside Your Majesty." Ose's expression grew grave. His heart yearned deeply for the era of the ancient demons, to重现 the glory of the Demon Epoch. He believed this was the mission of all demons!

"I harbor no doubt about your loyalty, Ose. But I need you to remain calm." Mammon paused, his gaze profound. "Though the elders of the other Demon Lord Palaces and the Council do not support my plan to launch a Holy War against humanity, the entire demon race is tethered together like grasshoppers on the same string. If I move alone, it will inevitably drag the entire demon race into motion..."

"Uh! Your Majesty's meaning is... to strike first and justify afterwards?" Ose wore a confused expression. Seeing his master's confident demeanor, it seemed as though everything had already been planned.

"We must declare war in the name of the entire demon race. This is not merely a matter for our Third Demon Lord Palace—it concerns the whole demon race." A meaningful smile crossed Mammon's face as he reasoned. "When the Holy War inevitably affects the interests of the entire demon race, the other Demon Lords will surely grow restless. They will be forced into active participation, led by our nose. If we lose, everyone dies together. If we win, everyone shares in the spoils."

"I see... so Your Majesty's meaning is—if we suffer defeat and the interests of the other Demon Lord Palaces are damaged, those complacent creatures, to protect themselves, will rally behind Your Majesty to ensure victory in the Holy War?" Ose barely grasped his master's intention. "But... will things truly proceed smoothly? After the first Holy War ended, we were constantly harassed by the human Holy Church, yet we endured it in silence. I fear that while we fight bloody battles, the other demons will merely watch from the sidelines. Would this not cause us to exhaust our entire reserves?!"

"Rest assured. In the past, swallowing our grievances was unavoidable. Because of the Holy War, we suffered grievous losses—the first-generation demons fell in battle one by one, and successors like myself were not yet mature, unable to organize large-scale warfare." However, the situation was different now... Mammon lifted his head, his expression darkening considerably, sharp light flashing in his eyes.

"We have cultivated and rested for thirty thousand years. Now each Demon Lord Palace is strong and well-equipped. The time has come to reclaim what rightfully belongs to us."

"Let those lowly two-legged sheep properly understand what it means to face a superior species that towers above them."

title: Chapter 16 — The Demon Race's True Enemy
content:
Chapter 16 — The Demon Race's True Enemy

Volume 28 · Chapter 16

Ozzie listened to Madam's plan with excitement, but still had doubts, "But Your Majesty, even if we involve other Demon Lords in this war, what if the old men in the council block us? They are all cowards, and every time they go on a crusade, they are terrified..."

"Hah, those wimps, I have a way," Madam smiled and said quietly, "In fact, among the Demon Lords, I have already secured a powerful supporter who will persuade the council and other Demon Lords to agree to the demon race's full mobilization for this Holy War."

"Hmm!?" Ozzie was stunned, knowing that among the Demon Lords, only Madam would support a full-scale war against humans, "Who? Is there someone like Your Majesty who has outstanding foresight?"

"The seventh Demon Lord Palace's ruler, the Lazy King, Belial," Madam said calmly, naming a name.

"Belial!?"

Ozzie's eyes widened in shock, not expecting the oldest Demon Lord to support Madam and become a supporter of the Holy War.

Lazy Demon Lord Belial, as the only original Demon Lord, has the greatest power and influence in the demon race, and many of the elders in the council were his subordinates and students during his time.

After the first Holy War, the second-generation rulers of the other Demon Lord Palaces took over, but the seventh Demon Lord Palace has never changed its ruler, showing how powerful Belial's influence is in the demon race.

Belial participated in the brutal tenth Holy War and survived, as the only surviving original ruler, he is willing to support Madam, which is of great significance.

Under Belial's management, the seventh Demon Lord Palace is the strongest in the demon race, and the other six Demon Lord Palaces cannot compete with it.

Since Belial has agreed to help Madam persuade the council and other Demon Lords, this means that Madam has already secured more than half of the demon race's forces before the Holy War even officially begins.

Ozzie felt his throat a bit hoarse, unable to believe that the only surviving original Demon Lord would also support a full-scale war against humans.

"Your Majesty, you...you're not joking, right? Belial has never interfered in any demon race affairs, and even if he is not a conservative, he is absolutely neutral. How could he suddenly support you?"

"You think Belial is an old man without any ambitions? Don't be too naive, his desire for the Holy War is stronger than any demon," Madam shook the wine in her hand and said leisurely.

"Won't that be? I thought Belial was always peaceful and didn't seem to have grand ambitions, like wanting to annihilate humans and restore the glory of the demon race..."

Ozzie looked puzzled, remembering that Belial was far from other Demon Lords in terms of sharpness and seemed more like a retired farmer.

"Belial has lived for a long time and is already old, and perhaps he doesn't have much time left. Our demons are long-lived, but not immortal. Unless we can become gods in a true sense, but that is difficult to achieve," Madam paused and said with a touch of melancholy, "This old man has no interest in the lowly humans and does not have the intention of annihilating them, nor does he want to restore the glory of the demon race. He is willing to support me, perhaps for the sake of fulfilling a wish he has had for a long time..."

"Wish?" Ozzie was even more confused, knowing that Belial is the only surviving original Demon Lord, with great power and high status. Why would he not annihilate humans or revive the demon race, and what wish could he have?

"Belial's wish...Madam looked directly into Ozzie's eyes and said seriously, "is to avenge the Holy Ones and Goddess in the heavens."

"Ah!?"

Ozzie was shocked, not expecting Belial's wish to be something big, but to turn the target towards the heavens.

Hearing this, Ozzie's previous impression of Belial collapsed, realizing that the seemingly gentle old man was actually a ruthless avenger.

Ozzie had never thought that this Holy War was just about regaining the demon race's former status, but had never considered fighting against the Holy Ones in the heavens.

"The distant Holy War was a devastating blow to us. At that time, even children who could just pick up a sword were sent to the battlefield to counter the Holy Ones of the heavens, and our active range was squeezed to near the Demon Lord Palace. Our hatred for the Holy Ones of the heavens is irreconcilable, and the war against humans is only to interrupt the Holy Ones' feet in the mortal world. Our true enemy...Madam looked up and said seriously, "is the one sitting on the highest godly throne in the heavens."

"Belial hasn't forgotten the humiliation of the Holy War, and I'm not sure what kind of pain the old demons went through during that brutal war."

Ozzie frowned and felt some sympathy for Belial, who had been tormented by the shadow of the Holy War for so long.

Madam sighed deeply and became much more gentle, "Belial is the only remaining old demon, who has experienced that cruel war. His friends and relatives were all killed by the invasion of the Holy Ones, and only he survived. We, the younger generation, may not be able to empathize with his pain, but the wish to destroy the enemy of the demons is common..."

Ozzie nodded, feeling a bit excited to have Belial's support, "If Belial is willing to assist us, should we start the invasion of humans immediately?"

"No need to rush, relying solely on the third Demon Lord Palace's strength to counter a human kingdom is still a bit tight. I need time to organize a large number of troops, so either don't attack or make the opponent helpless when attacking!" Madam's eyes were sharp and fixed on Ozzie, radiating a sense of greed and authority.

"Two weeks..."

"Within two weeks of the Holy War, we will incorporate a human kingdom into the demon race's territory and make all its wealth belong to me, Madam!"

"If we fail to capture it within two weeks, the Demon Lords and the elders of the council will be hesitant, and Belial's difficulty in persuading them will also be great.

"What we need to do is to let other demons see that under my demonic cavalry, the seemingly prosperous humans are how vulnerable they are..."

"There will be updates, the family side is temporarily stable, and after the final diagnosis results, I will start three updates a day until the end of the month, as compensation for this month."

title: Chapter 17 — Two More Chapters
content:
Chapter 17 — Two More Chapters

Volume 28 · Chapter 17

Oshe understood Mammon's meaning. The first phase of the war needed to be a quick strike, producing results to show the other demons.

When the other demons saw how pathetic humans were, they would naturally gain confidence, and stirred on by Belial, several major factions of the demon race would soon join the war.

Oshe took a deep breath and had to admit this holy war was important. The ultimate goal was to counterattack the Heavenly Realm; its scale would恐怕 no less than the First Holy War.

Participating in and witnessing the resurgence of the demon race personally — Oshe considered it his honor, so he quickly knelt on one knee.

"I am willing to charge at your Majesty's command!"

"Don't worry, there will be a time when I need you. But conquering a human kingdom, I need to build a large army to serve me, which takes some time." Mammon looked at the demon armor that had remained silent and spoke calmly. "Fortunately, you've returned, so the plan can be advanced significantly. I will bestow my power upon you and forge — an army of a million. Taking down a human empire will be as easy as picking fruit!"

The demon armor nodded firmly, expressing its absolute loyalty to Mammon. To avoid being erased, it would fight without any fear of death.

Oshe looked at the demon armor and thought, Mammon intends to bestow power upon this beast? What a waste of heaven's resources! But this armor was already quite powerful to begin with — under His Majesty's augmentation, how terrifying a level would it reach? No human kingdom would be able to resist it!

"Before the army is organized, we cannot do nothing. We can begin paving the way for our first victory now." Mammon said meaningfully.

"What are your orders, Your Majesty?" Oshe promptly asked.

"Send several powerful demons to infiltrate human kingdoms, eliminate those who could block the demon race's advance in advance. Wouldn't our campaign be smoother that way?" Mammon's smile grew increasingly sinister. He intended to clear obstacles beforehand. Those that couldn't be handled, he would deal with personally.

"Your Majesty is brilliant! May I ask, which kingdom shall we strike first?" Oshe eagerly followed up.

Mammon pondered and rose from his seat, walking down to below the throne to examine the sand table closely.

This sand table was a world map, meticulously and accurately detailed, precise down to every small village within each kingdom.

Not only were all the human kingdoms marked upon it, but even the United Kingdoms of non-human races, unknown mysterious seas, and more were all represented.

It seemed Mammon's plans had not been made in just one or two days. Long before now, he had already begun greedily dreaming of shrouding the entire world under his control.

Mammon weighed the pros and cons in his mind, his gaze locking onto a maritime powerhouse independent of the main world map — Great Britain!

That place was very close to the First Demon Lord Palace where Lucifer resided. If anything went wrong during the conquest, he could request assistance from the First Demon Lord Palace when necessary.

Mammon immediately set his sights here, so he slowly poured the red wine in his cup onto the map of the British Kingdom.

The red wine seeped slowly across the British territory on the sand table, like blood being splashed upon it, foreshadowing that war would turn this place into a river of blood.

"Britain..."

"This will be our first occupied nation. It will serve as the optimal springboard for our conquest of the human world."

Oshe looked at the sand table and asked in confusion, "Why did you choose this place? Britain is among the stronger human kingdoms. If we're to control a human kingdom within two weeks, shouldn't we choose a weaker one?"

"Besides the fact that this place is close to the First Demon Lord Palace, allowing us to quickly request Lucifer's assistance, I've also heard some rumors..." Mammon turned around and said mysteriously, "Britain was founded because of a very rare, genuine divine artifact guarded by a monster called the Lady of the Lake."

"Is that true?!" Oshe was astonished.

"I don't know. But Britain's founding emperor was able to overthrow the previous kingdom, so he must have possessed considerable power. This legendary artifact likely exists." Mammon showed no concealment of the greed in his eyes, filled with longing for that treasure. "If I can claim Britain's artifact for myself, then I will possess two genuine divine artifacts! At that point, no one will likely be able to confront me head-on. In the Holy War, we will hold every advantage!"

—

In the early morning, Merlin's family was having breakfast when an uninvited guest suddenly arrived.

Little Minnie was pressed against the window of the Merlin household, peering secretly into the room, searching for Chris's figure.

Since she was very short, she had to stand on a crate just to barely see inside, her entire tiny body almost plastered against the wall.

Merlin had just put a piece of bread into his mouth when he suddenly noticed a small figure sneakily poking its head outside the window. He abruptly turned his head to look —

This terrified Little Minnie badly. She hastily shrunk her head back but accidentally fell off the crate, letting out a string of pained cries...

"What's wrong with you?" Alice looked over curiously. "Is something outside?"

"I think there's someone..." Merlin frowned and rose to walk outside.

"Hmm!?" Little Chris looked around curiously, extended her tongue to lick the milk residue from the corners of her mouth, then hopped off her chair and trotted after Merlin.

Merlin opened the door and saw Little Minnie rubbing her bottom beneath the window. She must have hurt herself falling, her expression twisted in pain, tears welling up in her eyes.

Seeing this scene, Merlin couldn't help but laugh. What was this kid trying to do, sneaking around like a thief?

"Are you looking for something?"

"Eh!" Startled by Merlin's voice, Little Minnie jumped up from the ground and quickly hid behind the crate, her expression full of wariness, clearly fearful of unfamiliar adults.

"Tsk!"

Merlin was puzzled. Was his appearance really that scary to children? After all, I'm your squad leader.

So Merlin cleared his throat, put on an innocuous smile, and tried to communicate with Minnie. "I'm your dad's friend. No need to be afraid. If you need something, just say it."

Little Minnie timidly stepped out from behind the crate and said nervously, "...I'm looking for Shinning, to play with Chris!"

Merlin raised an eyebrow, thinking — oh~, kids make up so fast. After parting on bad terms the day before yesterday, today she's already forgotten?

"Minnie! Minnie sister!" Little Chris slipped out from inside the house, her face full of excitement as she rushed to Minnie's side.

Watching the two little ones, Merlin thought, indeed, Chris needs playmates her own age. Rather than hanging around parents all day, being able to blend into children's circles is probably a good thing, isn't it?

"Oh~" Alice walked out curiously. "What's going on?"

Chris and Minnie were tugging at each other. Alice peeked outside and saw her new daughter had found a playmate. "She's Minnie, Hob's daughter. She came to play with Chris," Merlin explained beside her.

"Oh~" Alice was genuinely happy. Her precious daughter had made a friend outside!

Just as Alice was about to say a few words to Minnie, Minnie suddenly appeared to be facing a grave threat. She stepped behind Chris, protecting her with a deeply suspicious and hostile expression.

"You! Evil big person! Where did you hide our squad leader? Come back with him right now!"
