title: Chapter 53 — Catherine
content:
Chapter 53 — Catherine

Volume 28 · Chapter 53

The dark night echoed with the clashing of weapons inside a box in the royal capital, sparks flying in every direction.

Knights lay scattered on the ground, their flesh turned black, even corroded to expose bare bone.

Fugalo swept his arm, sending a chain of black wind blades slicing through the air with a whoosh.

Mesfield, struck repeatedly, broke into a cold sweat and stumbled backward with every impact, silently cursing how difficult this demon was to deal with!

Under Fugalo's relentless assault, black spots began spreading across Mesfield's body, gradually consumed by dark power...

Mesfield gasped heavily, already feeling clearly out of strength, his body refusing to obey him—the opponent was no weaker than him at all!

"......"

Fugalo approached without hurry, an oppressive terror pressing down.

Mesfield wasn't afraid of a one-on-one duel with the demon before him, but the constant erosion of dark power was the real problem!

Normally Mesfield could unleash his full strength, but under the erosion he could only manage five or six tenths of it.

After all, Mesfield had no experience fighting demons and had been caught off guard the moment he faced a creature of darkness!

If this dragged on, Mesfield felt he had no chance of winning—only a one-hit kill could save him.

Mesfield's face wore exhaustion, one knee buckling to the ground, weak and disheveled, his battered form unable to hold out much longer.

Seeing Mesfield's decline and inability to resist, Fugalo grew bolder, stepping directly in front of her.

The lion-headed demon slowly drew back its sharp claws, intending to kill the human knight in a cruel fashion, tearing her apart.

But at that moment, the weary Mesfield's gaze turned icy—she deliberately feigned weakness to lure Fugalo closer!

"Ha!"

Mesfield roared, channeling power into her sword and thrusting straight toward Fugalo's heart.

Fugalo's pupils contracted, his fanged maw stretching wide as he unleashed a jet-black storm at close range.

Mesfield endured the agony of the dark power eroding her body, gritting her teeth as her sword tore through the storm—

"Pierce!" It drove straight into Fugalo's abdomen! Mesfield gave everything she had, but her body was in too poor a condition—the strike veered off, failing to kill the demon in one blow.

Fugalo looked down at the sword embedded in his body, then lifted his head with a vicious expression, his sharp fangs trembling.

"Die! Demon!"

Golden qi surged through Mesfield's body, and the sword plunged into Fugalo's abdomen erupted with qi—

Fugalo stared blankly at his own body, a massive hole blown through his midsection, flesh and blood scattered.

He glanced at the human knight before him, disbelief flashing in his eyes, then collapsed with a thunderous crash...

Mesfield supported herself with her sword, her body swaying. Half her form had begun rotting from the dark power's erosion.

She looked toward the direction of Morrison's dojo, wanting to help, but her body could no longer bear it—she collapsed with a thud...

Before the brightly lit palace, Bifrons and Hampa arrived according to plan, yet did not see their companion Fugalo?

A trace of confusion crossed both their faces. Their own tasks were already done—why was Fugalo so slow?

Had the human knight been that difficult to handle?

"Did Fugalo run into trouble?"

Hampa said with some worry.

"Probably not. Fugalo is Lord Mammon's right-hand man—dealing with a single human knight should be child's play." Bifrons speculated, unwilling to believe Fugalo couldn't handle one human knight.

"But... something feels off."

Hampa frowned, wondering if something had happened.

"Don't bother with that idiot. Maybe he's on his way. We should rush into the palace and cut off the human queen's head—that's what matters."

Bifrons' gaze fell upon the magnificent palace. Normally, only one Thorn Knight would guard the capital. With the two of them combined, they could slay her easily.

The main palace hall, the path leading to the queen's chambers.

The Eighth Knight Catherine sat cross-legged, suspended in midair, deep in meditation.

Catherine's barrier magic excelled at defense, so guarding the palace was usually her responsibility.

The normally calm Catherine slowly opened her eyes, descending from the sky, her gaze fixed on the palace doors.

The moment Bifrons and Hampa charged into the palace, slaughtering knights outside, she had already sensed the invaders.

"Crash!" The heavy palace doors collapsed. Bifrons and Hampa stood in the doorway, their backs already rivers of blood, knights' bodies scattered around them.

Catherine's brow furrowed slightly. The magic rings on her hands emitted a faint glow. Compared to other Thorn Knights, she remained far more composed, showing no sign of shock.

"As I expected, a Thorn Knight would be guarding here." Bifrons sneered.

"Looks like a slow-reacting woman. No reaction at all upon seeing us?" Hampa exclaimed in surprise.

"Probably scared stiff?" Bifrons grinned with arrogance and contempt.

"This place... is not where filthy creatures like you belong..." Catherine's voice was ice-cold.

"Bold human, quite some guts!" Hampa transformed into a cawing crow, vanishing on the spot to enter a stealth state.

Bifrons drew his paintbrush instead, beginning to sketch Catherine's image on his board—intending to kill every Thorn Knight with his art.

Catherine felt the immense pressure and easily judged that her strength was nowhere near enough to resist these two demons.

Yet she maintained her calm and detached composure, as if hiding an unknown trump card.

Catherine extended her tongue—hidden inside her mouth was an ancient black ring. The moment it appeared, it radiated a terrifying aura of death!

This was her secret, never spoken of to anyone, never used in normal circumstances.

But now, with only herself and the two demons present, she had no such concerns...

Catherine placed the ancient ring on her finger. Mysterious characters flared to life, a faint golden light flowing across its surface.

Bifrons' paintbrush dropped to the ground. He was paralyzed by the overwhelming death气息, as if the Grim Reaper himself had locked onto him!

Hampa scrambled back in panic, dragging Bifrons, wanting to flee.

It possessed the ability to read thoughts—it obviously knew something!

"Run! We can't win! This ring is the Apocalypse—"

Before Hampa could finish, black light erupted from Catherine's death ring. Bifrons and Hampa were reduced to a pile of white bones in an instant—killed outright!

"It's you who asked for this, filthy demons..."

title: Chapter 54 — Departure
content:
Chapter 54 — Departure

Volume 28 · Chapter 54

We must not fear any difficulties we encounter, and face them with a smile!

The best way to eliminate fear is to face the fearsome thing head-on!

Go! Olili!

Inside the First Demon Lord Palace, Pudom slowly closed the *Merlin Anthology*, instantly revealing an expression of enjoyment.

It was as if fervent devotees had received baptism, and the whole person became refreshed.

Pudom placed the *Merlin Anthology* against his chest, and let out a deeply meaningful sigh—

"Ah! No wonder he is the Majesty, why is every sentence so moving? It is simply like the foresight of my race, naturally born as a leader!"

"You this fellow, what kind of fit are you throwing again? Can you be normal? It is precisely because existences like you as subordinates exist that the Majesty would feel immeasurable shame, and we mention it very rarely." Duru said with a gloomy tone.

"No no no, Duru, your idea is too one-sided. Accepting the Majesty's baptism every day is our compulsory course, even if the Majesty is not in the Demon Lord Palace, one should still review every word the Majesty has said every day, shouldn't one?"

Pudom waved his finger, feeling that Duru's awareness had issues!

"You doing this will only make the Majesty very displeased, feeling as if he is being stared at by a mental patient." Duru turned pale, and harbored hidden dislike at being grouped with these idiots.

"Rubbish! How could the Majesty be displeased? Back then, when the Majesty suffered calamity, it was I...."

"Don't say any more, I've already heard you say this thousands of times, my ears have already grown calluses."

Duru's vein popped out on his forehead, and he no longer wanted to listen to Pudom bragging about how close he was to Merlin almost every day, for fear that others wouldn't know he had once assisted Merlin through the most difficult period.

"I just want people to know, the *Merlin Anthology* I compiled will become a timeless classic, and its status in the future will absolutely not be beneath the Prophecy~" Pudom said with delight.

"Do you want to prop up the Majesty? Although I admit the Majesty's power is outstanding, but status and achievements cannot be compared with that legendary Prophecy adult."

Duru paused, and seriously analyzed, "The Prophecy adult unified the demon race, sealed the demon god, brought destruction to the ancient gods—these are all feats capable of changing the world, but the Majesty....

"Is a talentless exile demon, no matter how glorious the deeds of consecutively repelling the Knight Orders of the Temple and pressuring the Holy Church are, the two are incomparable..."

"However you think about it, in my eyes, the Majesty's status is higher than the Prophecy, and I believe the Majesty will definitely have extremely high achievements in the future." Pudom's eyes were filled with hope, at the thought of recording the rise and fall of a great demon, it was simply exhilarating, ah right, I heard that Belzebub's younger sister Miranda has arrived at the First Demon Lord Palace?"

"What? Impossible!" Duru was greatly startled, and asked in surprise, "Belzebub is famously known as a sis-con, he can't live without his sister for a day, how could he easily agree to Lilith's request, temporarily assisting the blood pool?"

"I am not too clear on the details, anyway Belzebub this time was very straightforward in agreeing." Pudom smiled and sighed, saying something akin to a light novel.

"I thought no one in the Demon Lord Palace would get along well with the Majesty, unexpected that Belzebub has discerning eyes!"

"Estimating that Lilith's Majesty will set out today to find the Majesty, I am so envious......"

title: Chapter 55 — Intelligence Officer Xiu (Bonus)
content:
Chapter 55 — Intelligence Officer Xiu (Bonus)

Volume 28 · Chapter 55

Blackman silently followed behind Lilith, his heart full of worry, feeling that if His Majesty returned, it would probably be worse than being outside. After all, outside he could still be somewhat free, but if he returned, too many lascivious sluts would want to drain Merlin.... "If it weren't for this human woman bewitching him, how would His Majesty's temperament change so drastically?" Ophelia began to urge Lilith, "As long as we kill this human woman, His Majesty will surely change his mind." "You don't need to say it; I would do the same. That cunning human female actually seduced my brother—I will flay her alive and devour her!" Lilith spat out harsh words, pretending to want to see Merlin, but really just to get rid of the fox spirit, "But I'm still a bit worried..." "What do you have to worry about?" Ophelia asked curiously. "What if Brother Wan blocks me? I can't... ah.... Lilith felt a hint of worry." "What are you afraid of? You are His Majesty's sister; a mere human woman—could she possibly be more important than you? I believe His Majesty will make his own choice." Ophelia said confidently, thinking that since she couldn't act, Lilith probably could! "That's true; if Brother refuses to act, I'll personally kill that human woman!" Lilith nodded, increasingly eager to see Merlin learn that her brother had married a human—she had suppressed this feeling for a long time. If it weren't for the blood pool seal being of utmost importance, deciding the fate of the entire demon race, Lilith would have long been unable to stay, leaving the Demon Lord Palace to search for Merlin. Lilith this time is also well-prepared; the blood pool of the First Demon Lord Palace is temporarily overseen by Miranda, so she can roam outside for a long time. 3F light novel This little girl utterly disbelieves that she and a lowly human, her brother, would choose a human? Beside her, the gloomy Blackman's face grew uglier, thinking that if Lilith laid a hand on Miss Alice, he would surely suffer greatly! Blackman had personally witnessed Alice's strength; it was absolutely above his own, and even if he gave his all, he would likely still lose. Lilith is merely about as strong as a Goblin King, belonging to the beginner Saint-tier, considered a low-quality product among them—wanting to take action against Alice? Isn't that just a daydream? Blackman grew increasingly anxious, praying that Miss Alice wouldn't deal a fatal blow, otherwise Lilith would have nothing good to eat. Upon reaching the gates of the Demon Lord Palace, the guard demons all bowed their heads and bowed to Lilith— "Just send me here; the ship is already ready, I'll soon arrive in Britain." "That.... Ophelia wore an expression of wanting to speak but holding back, as if expecting something?" "What's wrong?" Lilith furrowed her brows, feeling doubtful. Ophelia immediately dropped to her knees, thick-skinned, tightly clutching Lilith's thigh, "Lady Lilith, please take _ me along!" "Lady Lilith, actually I-.-." Blackman wanted to say more, very much wanting to follow Lilith to see Merlin. "Ah! ?" Lilith was startled, quickly saying, "No! Speaking of Blackman, you weren't just recently seeing the elder brother, right? Little—" "Saying it many times isn't too much, although it hasn't been long, but I've started to miss His Majesty again." Blackman sighed, recalling various philosophical scenes, feeling quite excited. "Absolutely not! You must stay here!" Lilith said in an unquestionable tone. "Lady Lilith, take me with you—don't you need someone to look after your food and daily life?" Ophelia desperately blinked her eyes, hoping to go along. "If you also leave, who will guard the Demon Lord Palace? Don't forget, the elder brother isn't here, we are constantly in danger." Lilith said earnestly, though inside she thought, I want to go and spend a private world with my brother; the fewer light bulbs, the better—who would want to bring them along? Ophelia and Blackman glanced at each other, both sighing, feeling deeply disappointed.

title: Chapter 56 — Invincible Iron Cavalry
content:
Chapter 56 — Invincible Iron Cavalry

Volume 28 · Chapter 56

“Involving the entire demon race?!” Blackman

The modified conclusion scared him - jumped, showing a few points of opening

A joking expression, “.... Impossible, right?

“You’re thinking too simply, Black

Man, the Third Demon Lord Palace has been too active lately, actions frequent

- It’s clearly planning something big!” Black face

Serious, not like he’s just saying it casually.

“.... Blackman lowered his head, thinking

, saying, “What big thing can the Third Demon Lord Palace pull off?

Actually able to involve the entire demon race? I admit Ma Men is very rich, but wanting to influence the entire demon race, I

think it’s too exaggerated.

“Ma Men has been sending his powerful generals out one after another, and is constantly recruiting soldiers and buying horses, this effor

-” Black paused, looked around, and said lowly, “Clearly preparing thoroughly for war

Blackman’s eyes widened in horror, finally realizing the seriousness of the situation, Ma Men has always been fond of pleasure

Now he’s so diligent, I wonder what he’s planning?

“Ma Men is insatiable, his appetite has always been large, now he’s constantly strengthening his army, no matter what he wants to do?

It’s a worrying thing.

Black sighed, thinking that the entire demon race is now in a turbulent period, and soon there will likely be a major purge

How the First Demon Lord Palace can keep a low profile during turbulent times

Has become the number one difficulty!

Blackman frowned, walking back and forth in distress, the whole person appearing very anxious.

Originally after Merlin was expelled, the First Demon Lord Palace’s defense power took a big hit, relying only on a few demon officials who simply can’t withstand large-scale suppression.

Now Lilith has also left, the Demon Lord Palace has no leader, if Ma Men has ulterior motives, the First Demon Lord Palace’s foundation won’t just be ruined! ?

Blackman anxiously beat his chest and stamped his feet, there are also interest disputes among the demon lords, not as peaceful as they appear on the surface.

As long as Ma Men wants to occupy the First Demon Lord Palace, with this group of Merlin’s old subordinates now, they can only obediently surrender to survive.

“Black! Ma... isn’t it about taking advantage of the King’s absence, occupying our territory?”

“My friend, you think too highly of our position, the Death Swamp land is barren, it’s completely a useless isolated island, I estimate even if it’s given to Ma Men for free, he wouldn’t want it, even he would complain about raising this group of gluttons.” Black half-joked, fully explaining the First Demon Lord Palace’s awkward position.

“.... So Ma Men is strengthening his troops, ultimately targeting whom? It’s definitely not just purely to strengthen the Third Demon Lord Palace’s defense, right?” Blackman was confused, increasingly unable to figure out Ma Men’s intentions.

“Of course it’s not as simple as strengthening defense, the situation might be even more serious.. .” Black looked seriously, imagining the worst case scenario-

“Ma Men, wants to wage a second Holy War!”

A demon warship disguised as a human merchant ship has already left the Death Swamp.

The ship’s chains bind the underwater giant beast, pulling it forward. With this deep-sea giant beast, the ship won’t fear any storm, and can even traverse the chaotic waves of many seas.

Lilith stood on the deck, watching her homeland get farther and farther away, knowing the horizon of the Death Swamp had completely disappeared.

She was overjoyed, her heart excited to the extreme, her mind full of how Merlin would properly welcome himself when he sees herself?

Lilith feels she is the only younger sister of the elder brother, after not seeing him for so long, she must be tightly hugged in his arms.

“Ah~, Elder Brother, hugging too tight~ Three Lilith fell into deep daydreams, her hands twisting her shoulders, committing lewdness before many demons disguised as humans.

The demon guards lowered their heads one after another, unwilling to look directly at Lilith. As the acting Demon Lord, she is indeed worrying.

Pudom walked out from the cabin, had already changed into a merchant’s outfit, and the “Records of Merlin” in his hand has never left his side, always more important than life.

“Haha~, Lady Lilith, today the weather is nice~”.

Lilith’s body shuddered, instantly putting away the lewd look, turning her face seriously to question Pudom, “Pudom? How are you on the ship! Shouldn’t you have stayed in the Demon Lord Palace!

“Respected Lady Lilith, I have a habit of sleepwalking, last night I might have boarded the ship in my dream, just woke up.” Pudom feigned a surprised look, gazing at the Death Swamp, “Y! We’ve already gone so far? Looks like I can’t go back, unable to, I’ll just go with you- to visit the King, hihi~”

Lilith’s face instantly darkened, thumping to Pudom’s front, grabbing his collar, “You still have the face to smile! Who allowed you to follow me? Quickly roll back!

“This is really hard on me~ , Does Lady Lilith not need me to accompany her? I am a dedicated and responsible subordinate.” Pudom pulled away Lilith’s hand, straightening his collar.

“I don’t need!” A vein jumped on Lilith’s forehead, she really wanted to strangle this unnecessary light bulb!

“Tsk tsk tsk! Lady Lilith considered it too much~” Pudom shook his head and bobbed, a scent of pedantry assailing his face.

“What do you mean?” Lilith angrily crossed her arms, her gaze suspicious.

“Lady Lilith’s target this time is to rescue the King from the temptation of a human woman, so how can you rely on yourself alone? You’re outnumbered and outmatched, moreover both your and the King’s personalities are necessarily hot-tempered, I’m afraid you won’t be able to drive that human woman away, and might even anger the King, so you need- a negotiation expert to accompany and assist.” Pudom paused, suddenly beating his own chest, recommending himself, “I am not talented, willing to share your worries, I think in terms of pen and tongue, there shouldn’t be anyone in the Demon Lord Palace who can compare with me.”

“Ha.” Lilith coldly laughed, her mouth corner already twitching crazily, “Pen? Until now you’ve only written nonsense, mouth? When nervous you’ll become a big tongue.”

“... Who approved... Who said that? I- . I.... Pudom’s face instantly turned red, wanting to defend himself, “I will definitely become your help!”

“....”. Lilith sighed deeply, her face full of frustration and disappointment, thinking--

This pig teammate not dragging me down is already lucky enough.

Third Demon Lord Palace, crimson firelight shot into the sky, dyeing the sky’s clouds red.

A huge furnace seemed like the sun, making not a blade of grass grow around the Demon Lord Palace, demons carrying stones continuously throwing into the furnace, used to forge weapons and armor.

The furnace’s thick smoke rolled for a long time without extinguishing, demons had long since lost track of day and night, only knowing to continuously transport stones.

Stones everywhere on the road were exhausted bottom-tier demons, even if whipped by the overseer’s leather whip until skin was torn and flesh was exposed, their legs still couldn’t stand up.

Ma Men stood on the high platform of the Demon Lord Palace, elegantly shaking the high-foot cup in his hand, for the scene before him he was very satisfied--

“Soon, I will forge the strongest army in this world!

- A legion possessing Demon Lord power... “Invincible Iron Cavalry?”

title: Chapter 57 — No Reason Needed
content:
Chapter 57 — No Reason Needed

Volume 28 · Chapter 57

Mammon stood on the high platform, full of confidence, feeling that everything was going smoothly. Before long, he would be able to organize an invincible army, one sufficient to flatten Britannia!

At that time, the demon race would rally under his leadership to establish a new order, and Mammon himself could顺势 ascend to the pinnacle of power.

The demons worked themselves to exhaustion, the constant clanging of hammering weapons ringing out, while crimson molten iron from the furnaces spread across the entire land.

Just then, Mammon's personal guard knight Osir entered from outside. He knelt on one knee, his expression far from pleasant, seeming to want to speak but holding back.

"Osir? Your face doesn't look so good. Is there something you wish to report?" Mammon slightly turned his head, asking with curiosity.

"Beelzebub, Foras, Hampa—" Osir paused, a look of grief crossing his face, "they three... have died in battle."

The moment the words fell, the air fell into deathly silence.

Mammon's expression instantly changed. Without saying a word, his face turned cold. Osir kept his head deeply bowed, not knowing what Mammon might be thinking upon hearing this news. The furnaces outside emitted rolling roars.

Crack!

Mammon smashed the tall glass in his hand to pieces, unable to suppress his fury, and cursed loudly:

"These useless fools! They should have severed the head of the Britannian queen and presented it to me! And now they're all dead? What kind of joke is this!"

"Your Majesty, please calm yourself—" Osir buried his head even lower, trembling as he explained, "Perhaps we underestimated Britannia's defensive forces. After all, it is one of the powerful nations among humans and must surely have some ace up its sleeve. Scouts report that Beelzebub and the others were not entirely unsuccessful—they killed three of Britannia's top knights. This can be considered reducing obstacles for our future plans."

Mammon's expression improved slightly. He said coldly, "Those three only killed three knights. We gained nothing of value. With their strength, they should have killed far more knights and turned Britannia's capital upside down!"

"You are right, Your Majesty. Beelzebub and the others were indeed disappointing. This assassination mission did not meet your expectations." Osir hurriedly agreed.

"Fine... never mind." Mammon waved his hand and said helplessly, "I shouldn't have expected too much from them. Since they managed to kill Britannia's top knights, it's not as if they achieved absolutely nothing."

"Your Majesty, should we reevaluate Britannia's strength? Beelzebub's failure serves as a warning to us." Osir said earnestly. The deaths of the three demon officers at Britannia's hands proved that exceptionally powerful individuals existed there. They needed to be extra careful!

"No matter. We cannot lose this holy war." Mammon's gaze drifted toward the direction of the furnaces, and his body radiated a pressure befitting a pseudo-god, looking down upon all things with contempt. I have wagered everything I have.

"!" Osir followed Mammon's gaze, and sweat poured down his face. He trembled in fear as he sensed—countless, terrifying legions linked to Mammon's very soul!

◆

In Britannia, within the halls of the royal palace, Queen Elizabeth had learned of the assassin attack from the previous night.

Even news of demon corpses discovered in the alleys had spread like wildfire, causing a great stir throughout the capital.

People lived in fear and unease. The once bustling and vibrant capital had grown considerably quieter overnight.

Many who had previously not believed in the Church of Light now rushed to the nearest churches to begin praying, hoping to become devout believers and escape demonic persecution.

The worsening chaos only added to Queen Elizabeth's pressure. At this moment, she couldn't even figure out why they were being attacked by demons.

Elizabeth crouched down and lifted the white cloth, seeing the horribly damaged corpses of Clady and Morrison. Both had died in gruesome circumstances, struck down in a single blow!

"...How did it come to this?"

As Elizabeth stood up, she felt her head grow heavy and her limbs weak. Her slender frame swayed unsteadily, and she nearly fainted. Fortunately, Catherine beside her quickly caught her.

The deaths of Clady and Morrison were an immeasurable loss to Elizabeth. Losing two powerful operatives in a single night was something no one could easily accept.

Since the internal turmoil began in Britannia, the thorn knights had been constantly falling, and the kingdom's strength had been continuously weakened. The remaining few had grown ever more precious. And now two more had suddenly died? Elizabeth was deeply shaken.

"Your Majesty, please restrain your grief." Catherine supported Elizabeth and said calmly, "The dead are gone. You need not grieve so bitterly. The current situation is unstable, and you must pull yourself together to resist the threat from the demon race. If you fall, I fear the kingdom will crumble into chaos before long."

Elizabeth took several deep breaths, constantly calming her emotions until she勉强 pulled herself back together.

Looking at the corpses of Morrison and Clady on the ground, she barely held back her sorrow and said,

"Chapman, see to their burial with full honors."

"Yes!" Chapman bowed and responded. He had already been promoted and was no longer a squad leader, but rather the vice-commander of the Azalea Knight Order, entrusted with important duties.

"The news of Morrison and Clady's deaths must never be leaked. If the outside world learns that two thorn knights have fallen, it will undoubtedly cause panic throughout the entire kingdom, and the situation will surely grow even more chaotic." Elizabeth decided to seal off the news of the two thorn knights' deaths. Only in this way could the kingdom be stabilized.

"...But... everyone already knows about last night's demon attack. People are already living in fear."

Chapman hesitated, feeling that some explanation was necessary.

"Announce publicly that all attacking demons were slain by the thorn knights, and that we have suffered not a single casualty. As long as the thorn knights remain, the capital will be a crematorium for demons." Elizabeth spoke with utmost confidence, but in truth, her bravado masked her inner vulnerability. To steady public sentiment, she had to project a tough stance to earn the people's trust.

"Understood. I will see to it immediately." Chapman bowed and instructed several people to carry away Morrison and Clady's corpses.

The great hall fell silent once more. Elizabeth sat headache-stricken on her throne, constantly pressing her temples.

"Windsor, how is she?"

"She has passed the danger stage. The physicians are treating her around the clock." Catherine replied.

"This is the only good news I've heard..." Elizabeth sighed.

"Your Majesty, how should we handle this situation?" Catherine paused and said worryingly, "This can't just be a probe, can it?"

"A probe? They killed two of my knights on a probe? Once the demons set their sights on us, this will never end轻易." Elizabeth raised her head, her expression grim. "The three demons that came last night were merely scouts scouting the way ahead. The demon army... is probably already on its way."

Catherine was startled and asked in disbelief, "What exactly are their goals? Do they intend to fight us to the death? Logically speaking, the demons' enemy should be the Church."

"Catherine." Elizabeth sighed and explained in a meaningful tone,

"We are human..."

"That reason alone is more than enough."

To Be Continued

title: Chapter 1 — Candidate
content:
Chapter 1 — Candidate

Volume 29 · Chapter 1

In the center of the Mediterranean, a certain key island has numerous merchant ships docking nearby.

This island sits at a strategic strait position, a mandatory waypoint for all kingdom naval trade routes.

A large number of merchant ships would dock at the island's harbor for repairs, or directly conduct cargo exchanges—it is the largest and most free market in the world.

This geographically crucial island belongs to the neutral Roseshield family, not to any kingdom.

With such a precious island, the Roseshield family's wealth is evident—even doing nothing and just collecting taxes while lounging is enough to make a fortune.

Though officially a neutral free market, it's no different from human small nations; the Roseshield family is the rule-maker of this territory.

A large number of hired mercenary troops are stationed there, and even many powerful individuals guard it. If it weren't for fishing being caught in nets and the full-scale war breaking out, seemingly a tiny island, it can withstand invasions from major powers.

The most famous building there is the Roseshield family's mansion, called "Jewel City."

From a distance, it gleams with golden and jade, dazzling and magnificent, as if built with countless jewels, towering into the sky!

To spend a night in Jewel City is a dream that many people dare not even imagine, for those who enter the Roseshield family's mansion are certainly not ordinary people.

At this moment, in the Jewel City grounds, the head of the Roseshield family, Cael, stands with hands clasped behind his back, looking at two half-maps of divine relics laid together as one, his cloudy eyes continuously shifting, wondering what he's thinking.

Guardian MacReady stands respectfully guarding nearby, occasionally glancing at this old man, who was recently ordered to remove the inherited Hero's armor, leaving him very confused, even harboring many opinions.

The inherited Hero's armor is a rare treasure; blessed by the goddess and empowered by the strength of generations of heroes, this armor is no longer an ordinary item, and MacReady treasures it deeply.

However, upon learning that the inherited Hero's key was exchanged for the other half of the relic map, MacReady's resentment faded away, after all, divine relics are too important for the family.

"The relic route map is finally complete, we can finally find the ancient gods' relics..."

Roseshield pauses, then slowly says, "If we can successfully obtain the wealth within the relics, our family will stand unshaken for hundreds of years."

"Congratulations, lord, on harvesting the route map!" MacReady bows slightly.

"I traded your armor for the route map, don't complain, okay?" Roseshield slowly turns his head, speaking earnestly, "It's all for the family's century-long plan; we must think of every possible way to enter the gods' relics."

"I understand your hardship, that armor is just a trinket, not something compared to the family's century-long plan." MacReady waves his hand, shifting his words, asking, "That captain's route map is useless for pushing people forward, like a piece of trash, but for us... it's worth far more than all the wealth we could ever exchange! Ten thousand gold!"

"You're right..."

Roseshield reaches into his neck and pulls out a seemingly plain and unremarkable necklace, with a rusted iron plate hanging from its end.

He slowly removes the rusted iron plate, carefully placing it on the relic route map.

The originally rusted iron plate gradually emits a faint light.

"Others always think I don't have ideas, but I not only possess the other half of the relic route map, I also have the key to entering the relics. The treasures within the divine relics, we're bound to get them!"

No wonder Roseshield was willing to risk everything to exchange half of the relic route map from Merlin, it turns out he, with his overwhelming wealth, has almost gathered all the necessary conditions to enter the relics!

MacReady looks at the small iron plate on the table, his heart suddenly leaps, this is the key to entering the relics?

It's the first time he's seeing it, so ordinary! He had only heard the lord mention it before.

"...This is the key? It doesn't look like it..."

"Don't be deceived by your own two eyes, Mac. This little thing has a great history."

Roseshield smiled, he had long anticipated his subordinates would react this way. Such an ordinary appearance, ordinary people would have already thrown it away as garbage.

Who would think that the richest man in the world would hang it around his neck and take good care of it?

"This iron plate, actually is a fragment of the relic's main gate. Without it, one cannot smoothly enter the ancient gods' homeland, Asgard."

"Asgard!" MacReady stared at the small iron plate, it's hard to imagine this little thing is actually a fragment of Asgard's main gate!

"Long, long ago, during the time of the gods, the ancient gods' homeland Asgard was completely isolated from the mortal world. A vast invisible wall divided one world into two parts. The mortal world suffered frequent disasters, barren lands, and was oppressed by ancient gods, forcing humans and other races to constantly fight and struggle just to survive, while on the other side of the wall, Asgard, ancient gods lived in luxury and debauchery, enjoying the resources exploited from the mortal world—luxury we cannot even imagine now. But this balance was finally broken by a demon."

Roseshield pauses, his eyes now show a hint of determination, continuing, "The demon race's prophet, this suddenly appearing one-eyed demon raised a black flag, using an extremely powerful treasure to break open the door to Asgard, marking the end of that chaotic era."

MacReady sighed in relief upon hearing this, he already understands the origin of this small iron plate.

Roseshield picked up the fragment of the relic's main gate, examining it, adding, "This thing, is the fragment left behind when the demon race's prophet broke open the divine gate. With it, we can smoothly enter Asgard."

MacReady felt a surge of excitement, quickly stepping forward to volunteer, saying, "Lord, since the conditions are already complete, let me take the warship and set sail tomorrow to search for the gods' relics, bringing back all the treasures."

"It's unlikely to be that simple—you—personally is still too dangerous..." Roseshield has concerns in his heart, fearing that MacReady alone might fail, "Don't forget, the relic's guardian is, in fact, that legendary terrifying monster, the North Sea Giant Kraken."

Upon hearing about the North Sea Giant, MacReady immediately became timid.

Even though MacReady has great confidence in his own strength, to face someone fighting Kraken is like a joke—.

The North Sea Giant has reigned over the endless sea for countless years, and to this day, no one dares to engage in direct combat with it, being the absolute ruler of the ocean.

"If the North Sea Giant guards the relic, in a direct confrontation, then perhaps no one can enter the relics."

"...Roseshield nodded his head, thinking for a moment, saying, "I have someone in mind. If we can summon them, I feel there might be success!"

"Who?" MacReady furrowed his brow, thinking, "Is the lord joking? Could there really be someone who can directly counter the North Sea Giant? If so, it surely isn't human!"

Roseshield recalled the performance of a certain Black Iron Adventurer in the arena, and the strength he displayed, truly being called the number one among adventurers.

"Merlin, Lucifer."

title: Chapter 2 — Jacob, Son of the Wealthiest
content:
Chapter 2 — Jacob, Son of the Wealthiest

Volume 29 · Chapter 2

"Ah?" McReady exclaimed in surprise, after thinking it over carefully, "...that's the black iron adventurer who spoke rudely in the tournament?" "Exactly, it's him. If we could get him to join the fleet and explore the God's relics together, the success rate would surely increase greatly," Rothschild sighed, unable to forget Merlin's dominating strength shown on the field. "Patriarch, even I lack the confidence to face the North Sea Giant Kraken; why do you believe that a single black iron adventurer joining would guarantee success?" McReady felt extremely unbalanced, thinking the patriarch would rather trust some adventurer than himself. "You don't know, you left the adventurer tournament too early, so you're unaware of what happened in the quarterfinals," Rothschild paused, speaking with deep meaning, "This adventurer Merlin can be called the strongest in history; saying he's the best of the present age is no exaggeration." "Are you overestimating this black iron adventurer? Could he be stronger than a purple gold adventurer?" McReady frowned, rebutting indignantly. "In the quarterfinal, Merlin defeated six opponents in a row and even drove back a dark guild executive, without catching a breath in between—how does that compare to a purple gold adventurer?" Rothschild countered, his expression calm, knowing McReady had been a genius martial artist since childhood, praised by all, developing an arrogant personality; few could make him truly convinced. McReady was at a loss, his mind filled with doubt—if Rothschild's words were true, then Merlin truly possessed strength comparable to a purple gold adventurer, possibly even greater. After all, although purple gold adventurers are rumored to be each stronger than the last, dealing with six or seven purple gold contenders would not be simple. "There's no need to discuss this; I've already decided—let Jacob invite Merlin. As long as I offer a generous enough price, I think he'll be moved," Rothschild revealed a crafty smile, having long planned to bind Merlin to his warship. "Let the young master go?" McReady felt a twinge of apprehension; he knew the family's young master well—a spoiled, lawless playboy. "Exactly, Merlin is our honored guest; if I weren't inconvenienced, I would have gone myself. Jacob is my only son; sending him shows our sincerity." Rothschild pondered, looking at McReady, "You will accompany Jacob; make sure he doesn't speak out of turn, and absolutely do not offend Lord Merlin." McReady nodded woodenly, outwardly agreeing while already scheming inside—Hmph! Just a black iron adventurer, could he really be as formidable as the patriarch claims? Still daring to steal my livelihood? I won't restrain young master Jacob; when the time comes, we'll see how he humiliates the lowly mud‑legs. Half a month passed, and Merlin and Alice had returned to Rexheim. Alice's news of becoming a purple gold adventurer spread like wildfire; nearly everyone in Rexheim knew. No one expected that such a remote little town could produce a purple gold adventurer! Having a purple gold adventurer in a guild is akin to a celebrity license, multiplying its influence several times over. Thanks to Alice's presence, the Rexheim Adventurers Guild received one piece of good news after another, reaching its most prosperous period in history. Not only did County Lord Austin come to congratulate, but even the Duke of Roses sent a congratulatory letter, clearly winning the favor of British nobles. Alice now resembled a red‑hot celebrity chicken—her fame skyrocketed worldwide, reaching the point where virtually everyone knew her. Compared to the mysterious Elgin great swordsman limited to Britain, Alice's influence and her idol are already on a different scale; she has become Rexheim's calling card, the new rising power in people's minds. That night, adventurers flocked to congratulate; their home had never been so lively, only gradually quieting after the late hours. "Congratulations, Alice!" "You're now a purple gold adventurer—don't look down on us common folk, haha." "Go to sleep early, have a good dream, Alice." After the celebrations ended, the crowd left Merlin and Alice's house, waving goodbye, all believing Rexheim's future was bright. Merlin and Alice stood at the door, their polite smiles stiff from long use, seeing off the familiar faces who had come to congratulate. "I'll stay here tonight to sleep with Lord Merlin!" Jenna clung to the doorframe, refusing to let go. "Stop it, or Father will scold you!" Arnold used all his strength to pull his sister away. "I never imagined we'd not only secure first place in the First Guild but also produce a purple gold adventurer—it feels like a dream!" Lucian's eyes sparkled with tiny stars, her heart full of quiet joy; two years ago Alice had arrived in Rexheim like a refugee, yet now she would become the talent to rewrite the guild's history! Although Lucian had initially pitied Alice for being unemployed and alone in a foreign land, thus taking her in, she would never admit it now; instead she'd claim she had foresight, recognizing Alice's potential early on, certain she would surely soar to great heights. "That's odd……" Old Taylor chairman stroked his beard suspiciously. "What's wrong……?" Karl looked at his father in surprise. "Alice has obtained her purple gold adventurer certification, so why hasn't Merlin? Could the arbitration committee have missed his tremendous potential? This defies reason," Old Taylor lowered his voice, voicing his doubt. "Yeah, it's really strange," Karl frowned, muttering, "Could it be that Merlin got something even better?" The guard captain Price also hadn't forgotten to come for a drink, slurring, "C‘White lady’s liquor is just the best! Rarely can I fleece Merlin brothers—usually he's as tight as an iron rooster, haha~" "Today I barely broke even, hehe~" Hobbs, eyes bleary, held the already‑asleep Mini; the little guy had been rough‑housing with Chris all night, resulting in both tiny tots collapsing into exhausted sleep, "Let's go back, Merlin, you really went to town today~" Merlin gave a dry laugh, watching Hobbs' goofy grin, a thought stirring—"If there's another chance, how about bringing your wife along?" "Sometime, if the chance arises, definitely, definitely!" Hobbs raised his eyebrows, carrying the soundly sleeping Mini away. After seeing off the guests, both let out a sigh of relief, returned indoors, and lazily leaned on the sofa. Alice noticed Chris already curled up in the gold basket, sucking her fingers asleep? So to let her dear daughter sleep more comfortably, Alice carried her into the bedroom. "Nurse‑nurse, ya…… little Chris snuggled in Alice's arm, apparently dreaming of a pacifier, sucking her fingers non‑stop, 'chu‑chu… salty… mommy’s naughty, grandma added salt:' …Alice's face darkened, unable to imagine what scene the little one was dreaming of—nurse‑nurse? Sucking on silicone is about the same!" Merlin picked up Alice's purple gold adventurer certificate from the table, turning it over in his hand, pondering: This little thing packs quite a punch? Its influence far surpasses that of any champion adventurer.

title: Chapter 3 — Visiting (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 3 — Visiting (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 29 · Chapter 3

Merlin was about to bring out the Strongest Adventurer's Proof he had obtained—a rotten wooden plaque that had been around for ages—and his mood instantly became a mixed bag of feelings. Although those arbitration committee members kept praising the title of strongest as if it were heavenly, it seemed just so-so to him. Merlin hadn't even felt comfortable pulling out that wooden plaque just now; he guessed even the chairman didn't know about the existence of the Strongest Adventurer's Proof. If things went badly, everyone might think Merlin had come down with chuunibyo, pulling out a rotten piece of wood and bragging that he was the strongest adventurer. Thinking this, Merlin silently slipped the Strongest Adventurer's Proof into his pocket, even considering hanging it on Chris's neck as a toy. However, since this wooden plaque could request assistance from other purple-gold adventurers, it still had some use. Alice came out of the room after taking good care of Chris, saw Merlin playing with his own purple-gold adventurer's proof, and stepped forward to snatch it back. "What are you doing? Look at you drooling... you want it, huh?" "Tch! Who would want it~" Merlin leaned on the sofa, propping his arms behind his head, putting on a look of disdain. "Huh?" Alice glanced at Merlin a few times, smiling, and said, "You envy me, don't you?" "I'd envy you? It's just a little badge forged in purple gold?" Merlin turned his head away, his tone sour. "Hehe...." Alice let out two cold laughs, her voice strange as she said, "Yeah, someone actually got the Strongest Adventurer's Proof and became the industry's NO.1, so why would she take a liking to my little badge? Where's your rotten wood? Hurry up and take it out so I can have a look!" "Tsk!" Merlin glanced at Alice, the veins on his forehead jumping, then slowly put his legs on the coffee table and, in an old-man's tone, said, "My legs are sore, come help me knead them~" Alice's face darkened, she gritted her teeth and said, "I see you're...." "Huh?" Merlin held out the Strongest Adventurer's Proof between two fingers, shaking it, making it clear he was about to order Alice around. Alice gave a "gulping" sound, swallowing her retort back into her stomach; having just become a purple-gold adventurer, she had obviously also been informed by the arbitration committee of the existence of the Strongest Adventurer's Proof. If Merlin needed help, although industry rules required Alice to assist, it wasn't compulsory—refusing would merely lower her evaluation in the arbitration committee. "What do you mean? Using a chicken feather as a command arrow? You're taking this wooden plaque just to use against me?!!" "What's wrong with that? Now the Strongest Adventurer needs you to assist me in kneading my legs~" Merlin wore a smug, self-satisfied smile; although this plaque couldn't be taken out to show off, being able to torment Alice was already worth it! For tormenting Alice to the point of madness, Merlin had a mysterious obsession, and it had practically become his life's pleasure. "...." Alice's face turned ugly, her shoulders trembling with anger; she thought Merlin was nothing but a petty man who had gotten his way, a light novel of sorts. "What? You can't even knead a leg?" Merlin looked at the little wooden plaque in his hand, shaking his head and bobbing his brain, saying, "This thing seems useless; I'll find a chance to talk to the arbitration committee about it—newly promoted purple-gold adventurer Alice actually refuses to knead a leg, this won't do, where am I supposed to put my NO.1 face? I should cancel her purple-gold qualification...." "Merlin&*￥#@!￥..." Alice gritted her teeth, glaring at Merlin, her face full of unwillingness, yet under the pressure of authority she still tremblingly stretched out her hands and viciously grabbed Merlin's thigh twice! It looked like she was kneading his leg, but in reality she was taking revenge on Merlin.... "Hiss...." Merlin sucked in a sharp breath of cold air, sat up straight, feeling a faint pain in the flesh of his thigh. He silently cursed Alice, that damned woman who had no sense of reason, actually not behaving properly. Merlin glanced at the fuming Alice beside him, covering his embarrassment with a light cough. "Cough cough! Let go! It's comfortable enough, technique is passable but needs improvement—Chris using her feet to step on you is stronger than you!!" "!!!" Alice, furious, rolled her eyes straight up, thinking Merlin this bastard why is he fixated on bullying me personally? You can't just wool-gather on a single target!! Merlin lay lazily on the sofa, looking at the Strongest Adventurer's Proof in his hand, an unconscious smug smile appearing on his face— This broken plaque is not bad, it's somewhat useful.... But I estimate other purple-gold adventurers won't be as obedient as Alice~

title: Chapter 4 — Ruthless!
content:
Chapter 4 — Ruthless!

Volume 29 · Chapter 4

“With Your Majesty’s talent, how could she possibly bear to stay in this wretched human town?” Pudum paused, then speculated, “I think there must be a reason for Your Majesty and a human woman, hmm~”

“Hmm?” Lilith looked at Pudum beside her with curiosity, asking, “Did you guess something? Tell me about it.”

“Serving Your Majesty for many years, I still have some understanding of Your Majesty’s character,” Pudum straightened up proudly, smiling enigmatically, “Although Your Majesty is usually very arrogant and pays no heed to others, she is a sword-tongued tofu-hearted person, and among the seven monarchs, she is also a monarch of benevolence with her own bottom line and principles.”

“You’re right.” Lilith nodded, acknowledging Pudum’s evaluation.

“However, there is one bad thing about Your Majesty—a flaw that wastes Your Majesty’s great talent, truly regrettable...” Pudum shook his head, as the author of the “Epic” classic *Merlin Records*, he had studied Merlin for a long time.

“What flaw?” Lilith’s eyebrows unconsciously rose, thinking that Pudum, who had always been accompanying Her Majesty’s brother, the Demon Lord, normally only handles some clerical work, yet is like a paparazzi, digging into Her Majesty’s affairs—could it be that she already knows some secret?

“Your Majesty, as a demon race monarch, has absolutely no ambition, is overly content with the status quo. Clearly possessing power that astonishes the heavens, yet unknown to the world?” Pudum sighed and shook his head, evaluating, “If Your Majesty even had a bit of ambition, she might achieve something great, enjoy the respect of countless people, but these are not very realistic, after all, Her Majesty’s ambition is not there.....”

“It seems you haven’t followed Her Majesty’s brother for nothing; you still have some discernment.” Lilith lowered her head, feeling helpless about Merlin’s situation. Compared to other demon race monarchs, Merlin seems to be the most mixed-up one; if not bullied, he would never move.

Lilith still remembers to this day, when Merlin just succeeded the haughty monarch, everyone was pessimistic about him.

The demon race thought Merlin was too young, also a substandard product created by Vivian with magic, a demon with thin bloodline.

The Holy Church didn’t take the young Demon Lord seriously either, boasting that within a month they would cut off the new Demon Lord’s head and hang it on the temple for the believers to observe?

Although nowadays there are fewer objections, but internally within the demon race, there still exist; other monarchs and the Elder Council still look down on Merlin with his inferior bloodline...

If Merlin’s heart wasn’t under the curse’s constant threat, Lilith couldn’t imagine what state Her Majesty’s brother would be in now. Probably, at a young age, she would have already entered a retired life of raising dogs, wouldn’t she?

“So I think, Your Majesty mixing with humans now, probably also has unspeakable hardships!”

Pudum suddenly changed the subject on the side.

“! ? ?” Lilith snapped back to her senses, staring wide-eyed, “What did you say?”

“Lilith, you also saw that Your Majesty is doing very poorly in the human realm, mixing with a human woman; it’s very likely just due to necessity of living. You are very clear in the Demon Lord Palace, Your Majesty’s charm hurts any female...” Pudum meant well, but speaking of it, she was careful, not daring to strip off the last layer of modesty.

“Your meaning... Her Majesty’s brother would sell her body to a human woman for the sake of living?” Lilith’s complexion suddenly turned ugly, feeling that Pudum was talking nonsense, insulting Merlin!

“I didn’t say that, I only said Your Majesty might compromise due to necessity of living.” Pudum’s gaze was nervous and evasive.

“Don’t talk nonsense, Her Majesty is such a noble existence; how could she do such a lowly behavior of a male prostitute?” Lilith’s tone grew severe, reprimanding, “Compromising with humans? Even if Her Majesty starves to death, she wouldn’t do that!

“With Her Majesty’s temper, she probably wouldn’t reject the opportunity to not struggle for thirty years...” Pudum couldn’t help but mutter.

Lilith was at a loss, frowning, calming down, and her heart began to waver—

No... Could brother really be so shameless? Even if I don’t want to believe it, but since childhood, brother has been that kind of person with no great ambitions!

Could it be that brother really is living under necessity, so he started with that human woman?

It seems this fox spirit must be very rich, right?

Happy balls, happy nails, happy...

Heavens! What has brother experienced?

I must save him!

Home, Merlin suddenly felt a chill, he shrank his posture, and started trembling.

“What’s wrong?” Alice asked perplexedly, seeing Merlin’s expression was somewhat ugly.

“I feel.... someone is talking behind my back?” Merlin frowned tightly, a not-too-good premonition surging in his heart.

“Don’t be nervous, who would be so bored as to talk bad about you?” Alice waved her hand, feeling Merlin was definitely overthinking.

“Is it... you?” Merlin looked at Alice dubiously.

“You lunatic, why would I talk behind your back? I always say it openly!” Alice boldly looked at Merlin.

“You... Merlin also thinks, probing with reluctance, “Then you—must have secretly cursed me, right?”

“I...” Alice’s gaze wandered, nervous, saying, “No~”

“No?” Merlin was puzzled, from the beginning he had been uneasy, thinking the heart curse had started, but after careful thought, the Dark Elf Queen and Earth Spirit are quite substantial, it shouldn’t act so quickly?

Dong dong dong—

Knocking sound came, Alice was polishing the changed holy epitaph, had to poke Merlin to open the door.

Merlin was very reluctant, but still stood up, opened the door, and Pudum and Lilith were standing outside in a dusty state—

“! ! !” Merlin turned to stone, his mind went blank, how could he also think that Lilith, as the proxy Demon Lord, came to find him?

“Ar....” Pudum’s eyes were filled with tears, extremely excited, originally the stomach had already brewed thousands of words, but now everything was stuck in the throat.

“Brother!” Lilith also had teary eyes, finally seeing the brother she thought of day and night, couldn’t help but throw herself into Merlin’s arms, her body almost hanging on her brother’s body, “Brother, I miss you so much, why won’t you come back to see me? Do you know how much I miss you, why is your heart so cruel? Am I not your only relative? Do you not miss this cute younger sister?

“! ! !” Merlin’s whole body stiffened, like being struck by lightning, after seeing Lilith come looking for him, instantly turned into a wooden man?

“Brother?”

Lilith was surprised, unable to understand why Merlin had no reaction, could it be that seeing herself made him too excited. Tsk tsk, brother must miss me so much, right?

I am indeed brother’s little heart, hehe~

Thus Lilith’s face turned red, pouting her small mouth, and came forward, wanting to give brother a kiss.

“Brother, mwa mwa mwa~”

Merlin’s whole body trembled, pulling Lilith who was hanging on him, then— a foot kicked her away!

Lilith’s figure drew a beautiful arc, instantly turning into the brightest star in the night sky!

“Who allowed leaving the Demon Lord Palace to find me!”

“Ah! ! !” Pudum looked dumbfounded, incredulously opened his mouth wide, receiving great shock.

“Lilith, Adult! ! !”z L@

title: Chapter 5 — The Pleasure of Conquest
content:
Chapter 5 — The Pleasure of Conquest

Volume 29 · Chapter 5

Slurp, slurp. Merlin drank calmly, appearing very composed, but in reality, he was panicking inside due to Lilith’s sudden visit. After all, Lilith had been clinging to Merlin since childhood. Now that Merlin had finally regained his freedom, how could he possibly tolerate having another tail attached to his rear end? As for the words Merlin had spoken when he initially left the Demon Lord Palace, those were merely sweet talk designed to keep Lilith stable and留在 (stay) in the palace; they certainly weren’t meant to be taken seriously.

“It is Your Majesty! The living, breathing Your Majesty!” Pu Duo Hai stood with his back straight as an arrow, so excited that he lost control of himself. He stared with wide eyes that didn’t blink, afraid of missing even a single glance at Merlin. “Ah! I’m dying! Finally, I see the living Your Majesty right in front of me! This is simply... a gift from heaven!”

“Don’t speak as if I were dead...” Merlin lifted his eyelids and glanced at Pu Duo Hai. Regarding this subordinate who resembled Mi Kuang Er, he felt somewhat resistant. It wasn’t that Mi Kuang Er was scary; what was truly terrifying was being pursued by men like him!

“Ah, sorry, I lost my composure. In the Demon Lord Palace, I could only look at Your Majesty’s black-and-white portrait every day. Having not seen you in person for so long...” Pu Duo Hai’s face flushed red, explaining incoherently, “Your Majesty, I am too excited. I don’t know what words to use to express my feelings at this moment.”

“Then don’t express it. The farther your thoughts go, the farther you roll. It’s best if you don’t wander around outside the Demon Lord Palace...” Merlin said irritably, having absolutely no desire to see any subordinates from the Demon Lord Palace.

“Ah! ‘The farther your thoughts go, the farther you roll’?” Pu Duo Hai paused in shock, believing this sentence was another golden quote, and began reciting it repeatedly...

“Hey! What are you thinking about?” Merlin startled and looked up, seeing Pu Duo Hai acting like a repeater machine, which gave him a bad premonition.

“...Thinking... thinking...” With excitement, Pu Duo Hai took out the *Merlin Quotes* from his chest and praised enthusiastically, “As expected of Your Majesty, indeed, everything you say is full of great wisdom. If one does not savor it carefully, it would truly be a loss to this world! Please allow me to add another stroke to the quotes!” Trembling slightly, knowing that the *Merlin Quotes* contained many of his embarrassing past records, if Alice heard them, he would lose all his dignity. “Quickly stop! Pu Duo Hai! You bastard, don’t come out saying such stupid things and embarrassing yourself!”

“Huh?” Pu Duo Hai was stunned for a moment, then said firmly, “This is the only biography of Your Majesty. As the historian by your side, I must record your legendary deeds!”

“I...” Merlin’s expression was awkward. He thought, who wants to leave behind such nonsense biography? Is it for the demon race’s descendants to see what kind of idiot monarch I am!?

“Rest assured, Your Majesty, your deeds will influence future generations and serve as an example for young demons. I will mold you into a monarch surpassing prophets,” Pu Duo Hai’s eyes ignited with fervent flames, full of motivation.

Before Merlin could stabilize Pu Duo Hai, on the other hand, Lilith’s purchases became more and more excessive.

Lilith sat obediently in front of Merlin, her eyes red and teary, feeling extremely aggrieved. Her buttocks still throbbed faintly. Brother is too unfair! Clearly we haven’t seen each other for so long, and not only did he not miss me, but he actually kicked me away! Brother is really a heartless jerk!

Merlin sighed, put down his teacup, and saw Lilith crying. Being soft-hearted, he asked, “Isn’t it because you acted recklessly? Who allowed you to leave the Demon Lord Palace?”

“I wanted to come see you. What business is it of yours? Why do I need your permission, brother?” Lilith lifted her small face and said angrily.

“After I left, wouldn’t you be the Acting Demon Lord? If you also leave, who will maintain the Blood Pool Seal?” Merlin said with a stern face, using an elder’s authoritative tone. “The Blood Pool Seal is of great importance. If something goes wrong while you leave without permission, wouldn’t that be disastrous?”

“Hmph! I wouldn’t be irresponsible like you, brother!” Lilith placed her hands on her hips, putting on a confident appearance.

“Your Majesty doesn’t know, before Lady Lilith left, she had already borrowed Milida from the Hero Behind the Mask to help temporarily maintain the Blood Pool,” Pu Duo Hai explained from the side.

“Milida?” Merlin pondered silently. The Hero Behind the Mask willing to lend his pearl to him showed considerable respect. Although the Demon Lord can leave the Demon Lord Palace, the time cannot exceed two days, otherwise the Blood Pool Seal will collapse and cause a major disaster! Now that Milida is helping maintain it in the First Demon Lord Palace, and she is also a descendant of the First Generation Seven Demon Kings, she naturally has the ability to keep the Blood Pool Seal stable. Does this mean...

Does this mean Lilith has plenty of time to cling to me? As long as Milida doesn’t leave the First Demon Lord Palace, she doesn’t have to go back?

I cannot allow this to happen. I don’t want Lilith to cling to me like an accessory! I had finally escaped from the possessive Lilith, and now am I going to repeat the same mistake again!?

Merlin’s face looked difficult, his heart uneasy. He secretly glanced at Lilith and found that she was winking at him across the table.

“Brother~” Lilith made faces, constantly hinting to Merlin that she would accompany him for a long time.

“No way!” Merlin picked up his teacup, showing a serious expression. “You have to return to the Demon Lord Palace obediently after a few days. Don’t wander around outside.”

“Why!?” Lilith was immediately dissatisfied, asking provocatively, “Will brother go back with me?”

“Go back to wait for death?” Merlin looked up at Lilith and said meaningfully, “Lilith, you don’t clearly understand my situation.”

“You don’t even want to go back? Why should I go back! I won’t!” Lilith’s small face turned red with anger. “I knew you were a big pig trotter, your mouth is specifically used for lying. What did you tell me before leaving?”

“You swore that you wouldn’t abandon me. If after escaping the Death Swamp, you just hooked up with another human woman!”

“And... it was still that female Hero who chased us! Truly unbelievable! When I heard that, I thought you were crazy?”

“Brother, you are the Demon Lord! How can you hook up with a human Hero! This is a taboo of the demon race! You would be sent to the guillotine!”

“Brother, your lack of ambition really opens my eyes. Are there no beautiful girls in the demon race? Why did you specifically choose a female Hero?”

“Do you like conquering high-difficulty targets so much?! Is conquering your enemy that satisfying?”

“Pfft!” Merlin spat out the watermelon seeds tightly, instantly becoming embarrassed. “...Don’t talk nonsense.”

Meanwhile, in the kitchen washing fruit, Alice dropped the apple in her hand onto the ground. The atmosphere became strange. Although she lived in the guest room, she could hear the conversation in the living room clearly...

Two blushes rose on Alice’s face. Her wet hands pressed tightly against her chest, her emotions complex. What are these demons discussing? Conquering and such...

Am I really someone easily conquered by Merlin?

Damn it! Two evil things! Dare to underestimate me in my own territory!

title: Chapter 6 — Greatly Shaken
content:
Chapter 6 — Greatly Shaken

Volume 29 · Chapter 6

'Bohci, Merlin cleared his throat and quickly put on a stern face, saying, "Don't talk nonsense. This isn't the Demon Lord Palace. Don't be so blunt."

"Am I lying?" Lilith's hair stood on end as she clenched her teeth and said, "Ophelia already told me. Brother, you're still protecting this female Hero. What exactly are you thinking?"

"Do I need to explain my thoughts to you?" Merlin frowned and seriously questioned.

"Brother 15!" Lilith wildly grabbed at her own hair, getting more and more agitated. "Do you even have your own stance? You're the former demon lord! How can you live under the same roof as humans?"

"Stance?" Merlin was surprised, grinning, "I've already broken my dreams and gone with the flow. What kind of demon lord am I? I'm neutral. Don't try to morally blackmail me. It's useless."

"Even if you've been moved, as royalty of the demon race, you can't just side with the demons. Brother, you're different from those ordinary demons!" Lilith's face was filled with anger.

"So what?" Merlin put on a fake smile and asked.

"Brother! I'm disappointed in you! Your behavior of cozying up to that female Hero has brought shame to the family!" Lilith complained.

"Ah, Alice. Although you're my sister, you should mind your tone when speaking to me. I won't tolerate you continuing to act like this." Merlin's expression turned ugly. He felt Lilith was being too much, practically riding on top of her older brother.

"Ah!" Lilith immediately sat down in a panic, gradually calming down. She remembered that her brother had always been lenient and not strict. A tough attitude might backfire.

"Haha, please don't scold Miss Lilith. She's only thinking of you. After all, Your Majesty, it won't stay hidden for long that you're with that female Hero." Pudding mounted up with a gentle smile and said, "I think Your Majesty also knows that marriage between demons and humans is forbidden. Moreover, your status is too special. You can't violate the taboo. Otherwise, demons up and down will think their dignity has been trampled on, which would be detrimental to you!"

Merlin nodded, thinking Pudding's words were reasonable. His sister Lilith was in a bad mood, making communication difficult.

"Pudding, you're right. I'm well aware of the demons' taboos. But we haven't actually married. It's just a nominal arrangement to live together."

"What!" Lilith perked up her ears and became very interested.

"Is that true?" Pudding asked suspiciously.

"Of course it's true." Merlin took out his black iron adventurer's certificate and pointed to the information on it. "We had no wedding ceremony, let alone wedding rings. I'm just staying here. The marriage information on it is completely because some old fool made a mistake and wrote it down."

"Then it's fine?" Lilith immediately changed color, thinking that as long as Brother hadn't married someone else, she was still Brother's little darling, feeling delighted.

"All along, haven't you all assumed I married a human without my explanation? When have I ever listened to your explanation?" Merlin sighed, speaking with concern, "Lilith, I don't doubt that I love you, and I'll fulfill all my duties as an older brother. But your possessiveness is too strong. I'm not your toy."

"Brother, I'm not..." Lilith felt wronged. If she wasn't too much in love with her brother, how could she show such a loss of composure?

But this brother, who doesn't understand feelings, even thinks he's restraining himself.

Lilith pouted, feeling gloomy, constantly moving closer to Merlin's side, wanting to pour out her heart.

To be continued.

Alice put down the washed fruit, wearing the mistress's smug smile. "What are you all talking about? It sounds very heated."

Pudding suddenly became reserved, feeling very alert inside. This female Hero's aura was restrained, her smile looked friendly, but she had a sharpness like a blade. Not good!

Not only Pudding, but even Merlin sitting next to Alice could feel like sitting on pins and needles. Unfazed Alice was not to be feared, but Alice's constant fake smile was terrifying. Who knew what she was thinking?

Alice learned that Lilith, Merlin's younger sister, had arrived. She immediately recalled the previous fight with Lilith. If it weren't for Merlin's sudden appearance, this crazy sister would probably have become her sword's victim.

Relying on a woman's intuition, Alice clearly sensed the hostility deep in Lilith's eyes, the kind of gaze that only a romantic rival would have. Usually, it wouldn't be wrong.

However, since Lilith was Merlin's sister, Alice didn't intend to settle the score later. As long as Lilith didn't surpass her, she would maintain a friendly appearance.

Alice lightly sat next to Merlin. Seeing her arrive, the atmosphere suddenly cooled down. She put on an act of being puzzled and asked, "Why did you stop talking? Is my arrival not timely? Continue. Don't be so nervous. Given my relationship with Merlin, you can just treat me as one of your own."

"???" Merlin was surprised, looking at Alice beside him with a smile, thinking, "Has this guy learned to lie too? I thought you had no goodwill toward demons at all!"

Pudding's face darkened, his thoughts became active. This woman is too calm. Lilith-sama might not be a match for her. There's only one human in the room. Does she have no fear of us at all?

Lilith, whose veil was lifted, stood stiff on the spot. She slowly clenched her small fists, her whole body trembling with rage.

Lilith pulled down the skirt on her head and threw it on the ground fiercely. Her eyes seemed to spew fire.

"Despicable human! How dare you provoke me!"

"Crunch" Alice calmly bit into an apple, looking at the furious Lilith as if she were a monkey.

"You're what kind of dog? You even dare to sit with us! Who considers you one of us?" Lilith bared her teeth and said angrily, pointing at Alice, "You shameless fox spirit, stay away from my brother! Otherwise, I won't be polite. I'll twist your head off and drink it!"

Alice silently looked at the furious Lilith, then leaned against Merlin's chest. "Crunch" she calmly bit into an apple, saying with a slight smile, "Wow, your sister has such a bad temper."

Merlin sighed, realizing Alice was clearly doing this on purpose. So he sighed and muttered,

"If you know, don't provoke her anymore."

title: Chapter 7 — Fight (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 7 — Fight (Extra Chapter)

Volume 29 · Chapter 7

The fox spirit Lilith gritted her teeth at Alice opposite, thinking of countless vicious ways to torment her to death. "I'm not a fox spirit; initially, your brother clung to me and lived together. I didn't force him." Alice said calmly. "Nonsense! What kind of person is my brother? He'd cling to someone like you, a flat‑chested ?" Lilith didn't believe. "You—Alice's face darkened, she had the urge to teach Lilith a lesson, but considering the other party is Xiang Lin's sister, she couldn't bring herself to act." "Well, it seems like that. Back then I had no money and no place to stay." Merlin Xuang nodded awkwardly, pointing at Alice beside him. "Although this guy is from the opposing camp, in some sense he's someone I'm fairly familiar with↓and having a free place to stay, I really have no reason to refuse, right?" "Did you hear that? I helped your brother a lot; otherwise he'd be sleeping on the streets." Alice gave Lilith a look of disapproval. "Uh! How could that be?" Lilith looked dazed, full of resentment, she began to complain: "Brother! Can't you have some backbone? Why would you accept help from this female Hero?" "Don't call her a female Hero anymore; she's also been fired, and she has nothing to do with the Holy Church. You two don't need to hold too much hostility toward her." Merlin hoped the conversation atmosphere could be less tense, being stuck in the middle made him very awkward. *One day is the Holy Church's dog. Always are the Holy Church's dog! I can't be as easily fooled as my brother! Don't think I'll let my guard down!" In Lixi's eyes, Alice is a completely evil Holy Church lackey; now she seems to have no hostility, who knows if she's planted beside my brother as an interrogator! "I've already been very friendly to you. Don't slander me; everyone's patience has limits." Alice's face grew uglier; she spoke kindly, but Lilith kept targeting her—this female succubus clearly had no intention of sitting down and talking calmly with her. "What do you want? You're just a lowly human, still thinking of rebelling?" Lilith slammed the table, adopting a fighting stance. "Don't forget I'm my brother's biological sister; I can call him to beat you up anytime! Lowly human origin, yet you daydream of becoming the Demon Lord's wife? Nice dream!" Merlin furrowed his brows, made dizzy by his own sister; Lilith has always been like this since childhood, liking to pretend to be powerful with others' authority, though her own strength isn't great, she enjoys stirring up hatred everywhere, and finally drags him out to wipe her butt. Fortunately Lilith's brother is Merlin, who has the ability to support her waist. If it were a useless brother, who knows how many beatings Lilith would have suffered from childhood to adulthood given her nature. "I advise you to leave quickly; don't harbor any unrealistic fantasies about my brother. With you, you're not even worthy of staying by my brother's side!" Lilith stood with hands on hips, looking down at Alice arrogantly. Alice stared coldly, her hands unconsciously clenched into fists, veins faintly visible on her forehead. Lilith's attitude was so arrogant; if not corrected, she wouldn't know whose territory this is. "Qian Lilisi, say less." Merlin whispered a reprimand. "Brother? Alice gave a faint smile to the double‑headed demon wolf, and asked in a probing tone, “Fight? Are you sure?”

“Nonsense! I want you to know how low you are. If you want to hook up with my brother? You don’t!” Pudom swung her whip, and the double‑headed demon wolf behind her was filled with battle spirit. The enemy in her eyes grew stronger—

“I should have done this long ago. Today I will definitely turn your Church’s dog flesh into my little cutie.”

In the living room, only Merlin and Pudom remained. Their states were different.

Merlin remained calm, ignoring the conflict between Alice and his sister, as if it had nothing to do with him.

Pudom, however, was not calm, looking around anxiously, sitting like a needle on Merlin's front.

To avoid damaging the house, Alice suggested going out for a one‑on‑one duel. Lilith couldn’t get it, worried that she couldn’t perform inside the house.

Go to, finish, book, god, station, Pudom’s eyes lit up, barely understanding why Merlin was indifferent to his sister, but still frowned, “If you want to grind Lilith’s character, you should use a gentler way, using that human’s hand, it might leave a psychological shadow on Lilith.”

“Alice clearly didn’t show her strength. Did you see that she’s not weak?” Merlin asked curiously.

“Facing former Lilith’s demon wolf, the human didn’t even blink. Now outside is unusually quiet, indicating the power gap is too large; the human’s strength must be above Lilith’s.” Pudom paused, advised, “But Your Majesty, if it’s not our kind, their hearts are different. Are you too trusting of that human? What if something goes wrong.”

“Rest assured, Alice will have restraint. I know her well. I hope Lilith will be more obedient after being taught a lesson. Merlin closed his eyes, not worried that Alice would beat Lilith to death. After all, Lilith is his own sister. If Alice really acts, she must think more.”

7 down. “Pudom, while Lilith is not there, encourages, ‘Actually, Lilith is not angry with you; she just doesn’t like having a woman by your side. If you are willing to separate from this woman, I think your relationship with Lilith will calm down.’”

“Calm? Why need to calm? We have no conflict; she just doesn’t care about Alice.” Merlin smiled knowingly.

Pudom’s face was not good, lowered his head, didn’t speak, thinking that even if Lilith were arrogant, it shouldn’t be a human who teaches her.

In the past, Your Majesty was like this, far from the normal demon's view. Although he would kill invading humans, he was too gentle towards neutral humans, lacking the arrogance of a demon leader.

Normal demons never regard humans as equals, treating them like livestock. But Your Majesty grew up in the Death Marsh, educated by demons. Why doesn’t he have a different class view?

Pudom was puzzled. Mivian, the second Lucifer, is a true tyrant, ruthless to both kin and others. Merlin, as his son, unexpectedly did not inherit his mother's arrogance.

It seems Pudom, though a clever demon good at reading people, will never guess that Merlin is a time‑traveler.

“I’m back.”

Alice carried the disheveled Lilith back, throwing Lilith on the ground like trash.

Lilith’s familiar, the double‑headed demon wolf, had shrunk to a few times smaller, becoming a double‑headed puppy, desperately licking Alice’s shoes. Its doglike nature was exposed, and it couldn’t care for its master.

“By the way, earlier I didn’t beat your sister. Your sister couldn’t beat me…”

Merlin had black lines on his forehead, didn’t speak, thinking about Lilith’s usual temperament, she could definitely do such a thing.

Lilith, shocked, hurriedly ran into…

She quickly got up and leapt into Merlin’s arms, crying…

Brother! …

“This‑this…”

“I didn’t…”

“I…”

Chris "gulu gulu" climbed down from Pudoum's back, laboriously groping under the table for something?
