title: Chapter 41 — The Haunting Persists
content:
Chapter 41 — The Haunting Persists

Volume 29 · Chapter 41

Merlin's joining was nothing short of injecting a strong stimulant into the relic exploration team, giving the Rothschild elder father and son more field team confidence. Although McReady's death made this profit‑above‑all merchant feel very painful, but since Ren Ba died, to go against Merlin in the dead zone is obviously foolish.
In the Rothschilds' view, Merlin is a person of great value, far above McReady; he clearly knows whether to treat him lightly or heavily.
The Rothschilds could use money to cultivate McReady, and they could cultivate a second one the same way, but Merlin, this strong person who cannot be bought with money, maintaining basic friendship, his value is immeasurable!
Merlin's strength gave the Rothschild father and son a new recognition; originally in the martial tournament, Merlin and other adventurers seemed to fight back and forth, but actually it was the result of holding back.
If Merlin were to get serious, those arrogant and overbearing elite adventurers would end up no different from McReady; before the situation is even clear, they would already be knocked down.
McReady, built up with massive resources, although his foundation is unstable from being forced to grow too fast, yet with various high‑quality resources backing him, compared to ordinary elite adventurers he is not weaker, only stronger.
The seemingly perfect vase‑like McReady has no effect whatsoever in front of Merlin.
As long as Merlin gets serious and puts his heart into it, how could he possibly give a chance to perform in the dead zone?
Even if you possess supreme skills, in front of Merlin you won’t even get a chance to draw your sword.
As night fell, after the exploration team set out three days later, Rothschild arranged for Merlin and his companions to stay in the highest‑class accommodation outside Merlin’s bedroom; Jacob the younger son was pacing back and forth, looking worried, as if concerned about something.
Jacob was very worried that he himself would be arrogant and rude in front of Merlin, speaking inappropriately, and would be held a grudge.
Recalling Merlin’s overwhelming strength crushing McReady’s image, he couldn’t help trembling all over, feeling fearful to the point of insomnia.
Although Merlin is too lazy to quarrel with such an ignorant young master like Jacob, Jacob still isn’t at ease; he fears Merlin is a vengeful person—if he doesn’t take revenge today, what about tomorrow?!
By then, even protecting himself might be impossible, let alone stopping any relatives.
Just now, Jacob was scheming to set a trap, but Rothschild lashed out at him head‑to‑toe, showing he is completely useless.
If it weren’t for Jacob fanning the flames beside him, the old man might not have intended for McReady to recklessly charge, and thus he wouldn’t have died.
Feeling low, Jacob wanted to prove his worth, to show he wasn’t a useless person, so he regarded every opportunity with Merlin as…
If he could gain the favor of such a strong person as Merlin, his father would surely increase his praise for him!
At that moment, the old man who seemed to be a butler came over anxiously, saying, “Young Master Four.”
Jacob’s face showed delight; he said, “How are the preparations?” “All ready, I stayed up all night looking in many places, bringing people who came along; they are all beauties, and if placed outside they would be national‑level disasters.” The old butler lowered his voice, eyebrows dancing, saying, “If the old man were young and roaming, he would have done it himself; it wouldn’t be someone else’s turn.”
Oh?” Jacob’s eyebrow twitched, doubtful, saying, “Really that beautiful? Let me have a look; I think even Lord Merlin wouldn’t look upon her.”
Under the butler’s guidance, Jacob came to the outside of the manor; a mysterious horse‑drawn carriage waited there; following the butler’s various hints, Jacob boldly climbed into the carriage, lifted the curtain and glanced inside—.
Instantly his eyes went wide, blood rushed to his face, his heart pounded heavily.
It turned out the carriage held the beauties the old butler had found—fair skin, beautiful faces, long legs, their translucent, jade‑like skin almost blinded Jacob’s eyes.
Seeing Jacob sneaking about like a thief, they all smiled, their beauty so breathtaking it made the dim carriage interior brighten a bit.
Even though Jacob had seen many beautiful women, he was instantly captivated, marveling at the high quality, far exceeding his expectations!
Such fine specimens, if placed outside, would cause a stir just by their looks!
Jacob swallowed his saliva as he stepped down from the carriage, his mind full of the three women’s alluring postures; just one glance made him feel dizzy.
“Cough, where did you find them?” “Young master, you don’t need to know; the family has many holdings, there are always a few unseen things.” The butler revealed a mysterious smile.
Jacob nodded, not pursuing further; he thought his family wasn’t very upright, likely bought from a slave market or traffickers, specially trained to serve men’s pleasure.
They can no longer be considered human; they are slaves without any status, their value almost entirely residing in their bodies.
“These three aren’t ordinary slave girls; they are high‑grade goods, trained from childhood to serve men well, versed in refined arts, their sensibility surpasses that of wealthy families’ golden heirs!” The butler’s expression turned somewhat serious.
“Good, very good~” Jacob’s mouth curled up involuntarily, preparing to present the beauties to Merlin, using all means to win his favor.
I don’t believe it—would Merlin not be moved by seeing these three Wu people?
In the bedroom, each room almost had a small, exquisite warm pool; Merlin soaked his whole body in the lazy‑respect pool, steam swirling around, beside the sea‑beast statues still spewing hot vapor.
But—
“Anjie Four” this rarely seen ring flew up high, then steadily fell into Merlin’s hand; he used this way to pass the boring time.
Merlin placed the ring before his eyes, examining it carefully, thinking—one—calculating how long it’s been since he left home, maybe almost half a while? He also didn’t know how things were at home; is Alice herself really okay? Could there be any unexpected situation?
And my little treasure Chris, has she been eating properly? If she doesn’t grow tall, what should we do?
Without me, can the Ba…?
When it grew late and quiet, Merlin couldn’t help thinking of many things; he couldn’t restrain himself and began to miss the little cuties at home.
Recalling Alice’s worried look when he departed, Merlin felt twice as amused; he thought, does Alice worry so much that he won’t return? Indeed, he is the man Alice cannot leave, hehe~.
“By the way, when we left, Alice’s thoughts were so delicate—was she preparing something else for me? Merlin muttered to himself, feeling that Alice should have prepared his travel gear; he was curious and extended his mental sense into the space of ‘Anjie Four’.”
Bang! The item was taken out, appearing out of thin air in Merlin’s hand—soft to the touch, simple in style, on the white cloth buttocks a tiny bear print of utter helplessness, gazing boredly at himself; anyone would lose all interest at once!
Is this his… or Alice’s underwear?!!
Merlin rubbed the “madam’s underwear” in his hand, his face turning black as soot; he casually tossed the underwear into the nearby trash bin, out of sight, out of mind—.
“Go die, Alice!”

title: Chapter 42 — Unique Flavor (Add More)
content:
Chapter 42 — Unique Flavor (Add More)

Volume 29 · Chapter 42

"Did Alice forget something when she packed the ring? What kind of chaotic mess is this?"

Merlin grumbled to himself, feeling like he'd seen something he shouldn't have. It couldn't be carried around on his person — otherwise who knows what kind of embarrassment might arise?

The more Merlin thought about it, the more curious he became, so he sank his full consciousness into the ring's spatial dimension to see what "necessities" Alice had left for him.

Alice was still quite thoughtful. She had placed a lot of Merlin's clothes in the ring, along with things he might need on a daily basis.

What surprised Merlin was that Alice, who was usually so tightfisted, had actually left five thousand gold coins in the ring in case there was an emergency.

Thinking about Alice's usual "miserly" image — how she kept Merlin's finances strictly under control and calculated every single coin precisely — it was almost unprecedented for her to be "generous" once in a while and prepare emergency funds for him.

This might have been the first time since Merlin left home that he had so much money in his possession, which made him rather pleased.

Merlin nodded satisfactorily, thinking that this guy Alice had finally loosened his financial control? Leaving money behind because she was worried he might starve to death somewhere? He figured she had done something right at least.

"Wait! What's that? Something doesn't seem to fit..."

Merlin's eyes suddenly moved, and he pulled out a swimming ring from the ring —

It was yellow all over, shaped like a rubber duck, radiating an overwhelmingly childish vibe. Someone not knowing better might think it was bought for a precious little daughter!

Merlin stared solemnly at the children's swimming ring in front of him, his emotions running in complicated directions. Just then, he noticed a small note Alice had already stuck onto it:

"This was specially bought for you. If you fall into water, strap it around your waist — it can save your life! 哒!"

"If I'm not around, be careful and take care of yourself. Don't wander outside, come back as soon as possible."

"Actually, I don't really mind if you go gallivanting around outside. I wouldn't think ill of you either. You leaving just makes the house quieter, and I'm very happy~"

"The main thing is that Chris is still young. If you don't come back, she'll definitely cry and make a fuss. You're her father, so you know what you should do, right?"

「(o'~' 0)」

He never expected Alice to have thought of even this. It was probably because Merlin had nearly drowned several times before, and since she wasn't there to watch over him, she felt she had to not only resurrect Angela's ring but also prepare a swimming ring before she could let him leave in peace.

But Merlin was only going to the surface! For something like that, Alice had already gone to these lengths — what a worrisome woman she was, thinking so much!

"What is Alice doing? Afraid I'll drown? How ridiculous. Don't Lilith and Pluto even exist?"

Merlin's expression was complicated, his heart filled with indescribable emotions. He gave the swimming ring a slight squeeze, and to his surprise, it actually made a "quack quack" duck sound. It was truly just a children's toy, after all!

"Laugh my ass off. You want me to strap this damn thing around my waist? Isn't that too embarrassing?"

Such a cute swimming ring was completely incompatible with Merlin's image. Wearing it would make him look like a giant baby, as if he didn't care about his dignity at all. He'd be laughed at by everyone, though everyone already knew he was a landlubber.

But after reading the last few lines on the small note, Merlin could only sigh and think helplessly that maybe this guy was somehow caring about him? What did the words "go pack your bags and come back" mean, though?

At that moment, knocking sounds came from outside. Merlin looked up in surprise —

Would it be Lilith again, causing trouble?

After opening the door, Merlin saw Jacob standing outside in loose robes, looking unusually reserved, with an elderly steward with a kind face accompanying him.

"Jacob, I've delivered the three ladies I mentioned. They're sent right here."

So he hadn't come for nothing on this lonely night. Three beauties were already being delivered — this was like sending firewood in snowy weather. Shouldn't Merlin properly thank himself?

Seeing Merlin come out, Jacob hurriedly put on a servile smile and greeted,

"Lord Merlin, good evening."

"Lord?" Merlin's brow furrowed in confusion. He glanced at Jacob twice, thinking that the usually arrogant young master was now so obsequiously sucking up to him. It was quite uncomfortable.

"Hehe, Lord Merlin, you're not sleeping this late, are you? Feeling a bit..."

Jacob paused, saying with deep meaning, "...lonely?"

"Huh? Why would I be lonely? I was just about to sleep when you showed up. Speak, young master. What do you want?" Merlin said impatiently, not wanting to waste more words on Jacob.

"Lord Merlin, I have many offenses against you. I hope you won't hold it against me. I'm here to apologize — I was too foolish and failed to see that you are a person of true talent and ability. I was wrong." Jacob made a regretful expression, hoping for forgiveness.

Merlin nodded, having figured out why Jacob was visiting late at night. He was afraid of causing Merlin trouble, so he rushed over to admit his mistakes.

Did I look like a petty person? If so, then there would be far too many people I've wronged over the years.

Merlin smiled and waved his hand carelessly, indifferent.

"No need for apologies. I didn't take any of your words to heart. No need to be this afraid. Go back."

"This... Lord Merlin is magnanimous. I'm truly convinced." Jacob's joy showed on his face, secretly sighing in relief. "But on this lonely late-night hour, having you alone is a bit concerning. This is a small token of my regards — please accept it."

Following Jacob's gaze, three beautiful women with exquisite figures were posing seductively, immediately catching Merlin's attention.

Even though they were draped in black robes, their spring-like figures were barely concealed, revealing those fiery curves.

These three were one in a million beauties, trained specifically to please men. Even a single smile from them was enough to make any man dry-mouthed and breathless.

The dim late-night lighting couldn't hide their beauty either.

But Merlin was unmoved by beautiful women. As the Demon Lord and a man of great charm, he had seen too many beauties.

Whether it was Ophelia or Helena, both were peerlessly stunning faces — unfortunately, Merlin wasn't affected by them.

Merlin raised his eyebrows, detecting a hint of condescension in Jacob's gaze, and felt this young master was still underestimating him.

"Thank you for your kindness, but I have no interest in women. It's too late. Go back."

With a "bang," the door was firmly shut, leaving everyone staring blankly. The three beautiful women looked at each other in confusion — this was apparently the first time they'd encountered a man uninterested in them?

Jacob's face turned pale, feeling the situation was very dire. If Merlin didn't accept his gift, it meant he had fundamentally not forgiven him!

He couldn't figure it out. Three beauties that even he could appreciate — why did they have no appeal to Merlin? Any man would drool over such beauties, right?

The old steward thought it over from all angles, then his eyes suddenly lit up, and he leaned close to Jacob's ear to whisper.

"What? You're saying Lord Merlin likes men?"

Jacob widened his eyes in shock, finding it utterly unbelievable.

But seeing that Merlin had no interest in the three women — there was clearly something wrong.

The old steward's speculation was right on point. Maybe Merlin just didn't like women. Men might work instead!

"So his tastes are that heavy, huh? Pity my appearance isn't handsome enough. If it were, I'd throw myself at him personally!"

The old steward jumped, whispering softly, "Young Master, no need to rush. Actually, two fishermen delivered a handsome young boy this morning. Though he's only a demon, exotic beauty youths fetched astronomical prices at the slave auction. People with unique tastes are rare..."

"Huh?" Jacob froze, his brain suddenly becoming alert.

An exotic handsome youth — didn't that perfectly match the fantasy of someone with unique tastes?

He immediately slapped his thigh.

"Quick! Send that exotic youth to me!"

"Adorn him with the most exquisite jewelry!"

"Apply the most refined makeup!"

"Put him in the most elegant dress!"

"Bind him into the most exquisite package, and deliver him here overnight!"

title: Chapter 43 — The Boldest Human
content:
Chapter 43 — The Boldest Human

Volume 29 · Chapter 43

Dressed in the most exquisite jewelry.★First★Chapter★EZ Read★

Painted the most exquisite containment.

Wore the most exquisite little dress.

Lilith turned in front of the mirror, admiring herself after the elaborate preparation, feeling incredibly beautiful and confident that she would definitely make a good impression on the Hero.

Before Lilith could approach the Hero, she was always hindered by Alice, who was like a lightbulb, preventing her from having any good opportunities.

But now things are different. That troublesome woman is not here, and who can stop Lilith from pursuing her brother?

Lilith's joy overflowed, and this was a rare opportunity arranged by heaven. It was like a newlywed couple going on a honeymoon, and she wanted to fully enjoy this rare chance in the human world.

Thus, Lilith hurriedly prepared, ready to give the Hero the most passionate "night" ever. She hummed a cheerful tune as she said,

"Brother, brother~ Lilith is here~

"Please wash yourself and wait on the bed for me~"

In the dead of night, the anxious Jacob still hadn't come, and he impatiently waited for the old butler to bring the demonic young man over.

As long as Merlin didn't accept Jacob's "good intentions," he wouldn't be able to relax.

Jacob looked worried, pacing back and forth, wondering if the demonic young man could satisfy Merlin's heavy tastes. If not, he would be in big trouble, and he didn't know what else could satisfy Merlin.

It was all his fault for being too stupid and offending Merlin, otherwise, there wouldn't be so many problems.

As his father said, people should leave some room, and never tear each other's faces, so they can continue doing business in the future.

Jacob sighed, feeling that he was still too young and should have listened to others' advice, otherwise, he would suffer a great loss.

He hurriedly came from outside, followed by two servants carrying boxes, looking ghostly, and he was afraid others would know.

"Did you bring it?" Jacob stepped forward and asked, worried about any unexpected situations.

"Don't worry, Master, it came safely, but it took some time to prepare the demonic slave before bringing it here." The old butler wiped the sweat from his forehead, and it was a tiring day for him.

"Good, I trust you."

If this demonic slave was given to Merlin, it might make him unhappy.

The old butler had already prepared everything Jacob needed, so he could rest assured.

Jacob came to the large box brought by the servants, where the demonic slave should be kept.

What surprised Jacob was that the demonic slave was kept in such a small box, and he didn't seem afraid of being suffocated?

"Is the demonic slave kept here? Why not let it out?"

"Don't be so hasty, you don't know the situation. This little demon is fierce, as it was just encountered by two fishermen in the morning, with an unknown background, and it's difficult to communicate with it. It has a great respect for humans, and anyone who approaches it is easily attacked. Just now, it almost bit off my finger." The old butler showed Jacob the bandaged finger and continued, "Since there's no other way, we had to give it a sedative and put it in the box to keep it quiet. By the way, it's quite strange? It only took ten cups to have an effect, and it's not very strong, but it's still quite powerful, and I've never encountered such a situation in my life."

"This demon is so dangerous, how can I give it to Merlin? If something happens, who can take the blame?" Jacob was angry, realizing that the slave hadn't been tamed yet, how could he give it to Merlin? Isn't that provoking him?

"Master is still too young and doesn't understand the fun of it. With the adventurer's strength, how can he like a submissive plaything?" The old butler paused and continued, "The stronger the person, the more they like challenging prey, which brings more fun."

Jacob's eyes brightened, recalling Merlin's bored expression after defeating McCready, which seemed to be exactly the case!

It's not about serving submissive playthings, but about conquering rebellious prey, which gives a sense of achievement!

Merlin, a strong person of that level, must have many lickspittle around, and they might have grown tired of submissive people, and Jacob's face gradually turned wicked, looking at the old butler with a deep meaning, and said,

"Didn't think the butler you were also good at this."

"Hey hey, Master, you're flattering me."

"Open the box, let me see what the little demon looks like! Now that the demonic slave has been sedated, Jacob wasn't afraid of being attacked, and his courage had increased a lot.

The two servants slowly opened the box, and a handsome young man was seen inside, who was the Leviathan.

After a long time in the sea, Leviathan finally escaped from the persecution of Malice, but immediately fell into another deep trap, being captured by a human with evil intentions.

Leviathan, as a sea demon lord, was once equal to Merlin, but now he was reduced to a slave, being arranged by humans at will, which was like a tiger falling into a well and being bullied by a dog. He never imagined that he would suffer such humiliation!

A short period of time seemed short, but Leviathan had experienced the most unbearable suffering. First, he was persecuted by Malice, drifting on the sea for a long time, then captured by two fishermen, forcibly brought to the slave trading market, and finally imprisoned in a small cell by humans, being drugged and losing consciousness.

Leviathan's heart was filled with resentment, and for the first time, he felt the helplessness of fate, and now he was just a commodity being traded by humans, with the demonic identity being the only remaining value.

At present, Leviathan was already drowsy, quietly curled up in the box, with his body washed clean. He was dressed in a beautifully made doll dress, with jewelry shining brightly, and the makeup on his face added a touch of elegance, and his fiery little mouth gave a sense of coming up!

Even though Leviathan had demonic horns on his head, now he looked like a fallen little princess, and if Asmodeus were here, he would definitely praise Leviathan's doll dress appearance, and it would be difficult to meet a rival in the female clothing world!

"Guh" Jacob looked on, sighing deeply, as if opening a new world, and it was hard to stop.

Jacob stretched out his hand, touching the bright silk inside Leviathan's dress, and under the influence of curiosity, he even dared to reach into the secret part of the dress and touch it.

Jacob's eyebrows twitched, his expression shifting between surprise, wickedness, and finally, a mischievous smile.

"Nice! Quickly send it to Merlin's room, I won't be disappointed, he still can't resist!"

It seems Jacob didn't realize that he already had enough material to boast about.

He was the first human in history to touch a demonic slave. See, people~

content:

Volume 29 · Chapter 44

Merlin let out an “ah ah” and restrained himself. The soft pillow, then he lay down, the blanket covered him as if he had just died on the spot. But just as Merlin was about to sleep beautifully, the door rang at just the right moment. ★First★Release★EZ Read Books★ Merlin suddenly opened his bloodshot eyes, anger welling up in his chest. That little young master, never ending, what exactly does he want to do! How many times do I have to say it, I’m too lazy to argue with him! If this continues, I really want to twist his head off. Merlin threw off the blanket, strode over angrily, and sure enough it was that jerk Jacob, his smug smile making him even more furious. Seeing Merlin’s angry gaze, Jacob felt a chill run down his neck, but he still forced himself to say, “Heh heh, Merlin Lord, what a coincidence, you’re still awake?” “I swear, if you dare to bother me again, I’ll twist your head off,” Merlin said, pointing outside, “Merlin Lord, why are you being so...? I have no ill intent.” Jacob, unable to dodge, felt the pressure from Merlin and panicked, “I promise, this time I will definitely satisfy you!” “Don’t show off your little cleverness, I’ve said it before, I’m not interested, hurry up and leave, don’t disturb my rest.” Merlin said sternly, not wanting to get tangled with this young master. Jacob stared, stubbornly believing this nonsense, having already lowered himself to this point, could he still not see his own shock? So Jacob clapped his hands, signaling the servants to bring in the dressed‑up demon boy, giving Merlin a surprise. In the dim wireless light, Merlin couldn’t clearly see what the servants were carrying, but he could vaguely see a beautiful dress and white silk stockings. The servants directly ignored Merlin’s displeasure and tossed “Jacob’s good intention” onto the bed. This made Merlin a bit annoyed; Jacob was too full of himself, ignoring Merlin’s wishes and forcing some nonsense, treating him like a dead person he could do whatever with. Hey! I warn you not to be too... the reason I speak calmly with you is only out of respect for your sister’s face. “I know, Merlin Lord, how could someone like me earn your respect? But my desire to apologize is sincere; please accept my goodwill, otherwise I truly can’t eat or sleep.” Jacob wore a worried expression; only if Merlin accepted his goodwill would he feel relieved, otherwise his little life could be in danger at any moment. “Why do I have to bother you, why keep you until now?” Merlin laughed angrily, thinking Jacob was too timid, lacking even half the courage of the old Rothschild gentleman, “Hurry up and take the pallet away, it’s just a bed, where am I supposed to sleep?” “Merlin Lord, don’t you see...? I’ve put a lot of thought into this this time!” Jacob frowned, having been busy all night doing what? “Hmph, I’ve seen too many country girls, what kind of...? Do you think I’m a pile driver thinking with my lower half? Don’t look down on...? Hiss? Ah!!!” Originally Merlin kept explaining his stance, turning his head to look at the “beauty” on the bed. Although the wireless light was weak, he could still roughly see the other’s face, making out the general appearance. When Merlin saw the youth’s face, his first reaction was killing intent, then doubt, finally like being struck by lightning—shocked—what the heck!? Leviathan!? Merlin’s heart filled with doubt as he looked at the female‑dressed Leviathan; he couldn’t look away, not because he was attracted by her female attire, but pure bewilderment. Even though Leviathan had put on delicate makeup and wore a soft wig, his heroic air still showed through, and Merlin recognized him at a glance. “Oh ho~” Jacob showed an expression of understanding, seeing Merlin, who had been calm, now react, his heart secretly delighted, it seemed the butler’s guess was right—Merlin has no interest in women but a completely different attitude toward men; this demon‑cross‑dressing beautiful boy exactly matches his taste! Shouldn’t he thank himself properly? Merlin’s face darkened as he looked at the unconscious Leviathan on the bed, his mind went blank, the situation had become utterly chaotic, beyond his comprehension— The guardian of the Demon Lord Palace, Leviathan, how did he run from the ink‑surface sea strait to here? And if my memory serves, this guy always looks down on everyone, never puts up with Asmodeus, saying he’s a fake woman, disgracing the demon race, lacking the aura of a Demon Lord—how did he end up wearing women’s clothing? What the hell happened? Am I still dreaming? Merlin was drowned in his own doubts, even once thinking it was a hallucination; after pinching himself, he realized everything was real. Now that unsurpassable sea Demon Lord, dressed in cute Lolita girl’s clothes, posing as a big‑small rough, lying on my bed playing bondage... Merlin felt ten thousand grass‑mud horses galloping in his heart, trampling his fragile worldview; he stiffly turned his head back and said— “That I— “Merlin Lord, what are you thinking about?” Jacob smiled, seeing Merlin’s huge reaction, he proactively asked about the slave’s origin, feeling this was settled, he finally got what he wanted! “Where did it come from?” Merlin’s mind was a bit muddled, his speech came out stiff. “Heh heh, Merlin Lord, cast a net, no need for trouble, just play as you like—this is the slave we bought.” Jacob proudly said, showing off his family’s power, even able to obtain demon‑race slaves like this! Merlin’s thoughts fell like a waterfall of black lines; he thought that was Leviathan, one of the Seven Kings of the demon race, master of the ink‑surface sea strait! How could he possibly be a slave of a human merchant? Who would believe such nonsense? Have humans become so powerful they can casually enslave Demon Lords? How did the Rothschild family bind Leviathan? Their strongest is just... wait, in front of Leviathan they’d only be killed! Merlin felt the more he asked, the more confused he got; the situation became tangled, hard to sort out quickly; probably only asking Leviathan himself would reveal everything. “Heh heh~” Jacob laughed smugly, seeing Merlin dazed, feeling very satisfied, thinking his plan succeeded, then teasingly asked, “Merlin Lord, how about this? Do you like it?” Merlin’s face darkened again, a look of having been bitten— “I have no choice? Either let Leviathan die without saving him, or obediently admit that I’m a... love‑chrysanthemum?”

Volume 29 · Chapter 44

Merlin looked at the comatose Leviathan, and wondered why Leviathan, who was a Demon Lord in the sea of the Strait of the Ink, would fall to become a slave? Did the Sixth Demon Lord Palace appear with great…

“Merlin’s big area?” Jacob’s face was topped with a thief’s smile, like a hound wagging its tail to beg for a reward. EZ looked at the book. “Cough cough!” Merlin hurriedly used a cough to cover his embarrassment, deciding that no matter what, he would first clear up Leviathan’s situation.

“Just stay, you guys, you can’t leave, it’s so late, don’t… “Mingcong! I understand~” Jacob revealed a deeply meaningful evil smile, vividly giving the door to Wu Shang. Before leaving, he forgot to remind, “Merlin, the big area is playing with the net, pay attention to the force below, the soundproofing here is a bit not good~”

“The field below was blackened by the swipe, looking at Jacob’s cheap expression, there was a urge to beat him, estimating the high-gauge image of himself in his heart, the bar became very strange! After buying the points, Jacob’s heart blossomed, the suspended heart finally let go, Merlin accepted his good intentions, how could it possibly still trouble me?”

“Butler, I didn’t expect you to guess correctly, it turns out Merlin’s big area only has interest in men~”

“The small area is just based on experience speculation, although this kind of brother is considered heretical by the Church, but in many noble circles it has become a…” The old butler answered with a laugh.

“So that’s how it is, it seems I am a bit behind the trend, tonight you have done a great deed, I will reward you.”

title: Chapter 46 — Bright White (Extra Chapter)
content:
Chapter 46 — Bright White (Extra Chapter)

Volume 29 · Chapter 46

The world's most awkward moment was when the child died. (??ω?? ?)

Two Demon Lords met in an awkward way, and the atmosphere became tense and heated. The silence was so profound that even the falling petals of a plum tree couldn't be heard.

Merlin, holding Leviathan's skirt, had a stiff smile on his face but was sweating profusely on his backside, thinking, "I'm innocent, I swear!"

Leviathan, feeling deeply ashamed, turned red at a speed visible to the naked eye. He couldn't make sense of why the exiled Merlin was doing this.

"I am the protector of the Lord! How could I wear women's clothes! Who is humiliating me? Is it the Holy Church's Bishop, Ophelia? I've always heard rumors about her and Asmodeus, but I never expected her to do this to me!"

"Ugh! Give back my skirt! What's so interesting to look at?"

Leviathan gritted his teeth and, just as he was about to scold Merlin for his inviolable purity, he found his mouth stuffed and couldn't speak clearly.

"Uh uh uh!"

"That one..."

Merlin's forehead was covered with layers of black lines, and his hands, which had nowhere to place, fully demonstrated his guilty and awkward emotions.

Seeing Merlin act composed, he slowly lowered Leviathan's skirt and forced a smile.

"Actually, I was checking your injuries. Do you believe me?"

"???"

Leviathan was shocked by this explanation. People usually check injuries by asking and examining, but you go so far as to lift the skirt to look at the chicken. Who would believe such a ridiculous explanation? It was completely absurd.

At this moment, Leviathan, who had always believed in the rumors about the demon race, was convinced that young Lucifer, the King of the Sea, was infatuated with Asmodeus. Indeed, in his time of trouble, he was subjected to "poisonous hands."

"What's that look in your eyes? I'm just checking if you have any injuries. Who knows what kind of slave you, the sea demon lord in the merchant association, will be sold for? By the way, this outfit is still mine. Don't misunderstand, I'm also normal."

Leviathan was filled with suspicion and doubt, looking at Merlin explaining, feeling like he was being cheated.

Is this a normal joke? To lift someone's skirt while they're unconscious, is this something normal people do?

Leviathan was worried that Merlin might humiliate himself, so he used all his strength to resist and struggled on the bed.

"Uh uh uh!"

Seeing Leviathan, who was tied up, behaving very naughtily and making a lot of noise on the bed, Merlin was worried that if it got out, he would be embarrassed even if he jumped into the Yellow River.

Jacob had specifically mentioned that the room had poor sound insulation, and if it leaked out, rumors might spread the next day.

Thus, Merlin's face darkened, took out the Banri Garan, loaded it on Leviathan's neck.

"My reputation is all on you. You dare to be naughty. Do you dare?"

Facing Merlin's threat, Leviathan, who was excited, suddenly became quiet. The Merlin in front of him was an exiled Demon Lord. If he did something extreme, it was not impossible?

Moreover, Leviathan recalled Merlin's previous performance, although he was not afraid of this young monarch, he could not be reckless.

Moreover, Leviathan was now in a state of humiliation, seeing Merlin bowing his head was foolish.

Considering the past and the future, Leviathan lay quietly on the bed, although he looked like he would obey, his backside was already soaked with sweat from the shock.

"With your gold needle, do you think I like to watch?" Merlin sneered and said so.

Leviathan heard Merlin's taunt and almost fainted.

Merlin and Leviathan exchanged glances and confirmed that the other would not cause trouble, so he finally untied the ropes on him.

After Leviathan regained some freedom, he stretched his body and thought, "I am also the invincible monarch of the sea. I never thought there would be a day when my body would be so weak."

He threw the binding ropes aside and said seriously, "What happened just now is as if it never happened. Do you understand?"

"Hmph!" Leviathan sneered and said, "It never happened? I've learned a lesson today. I never thought that you, who mixed with Asmodeus, were not just empty talk. That's why the demon race was so popular, saying that you were in the flower circle."

"Oh?" Merlin raised his eyebrows and started sharpening the sword.

Leviathan smiled and hurriedly said, "You respect yourself a little. Even if your mother is Ophelia, she wouldn't do this to me. I am the demon of your mother's generation. You are just a son! Put it simply, you are only a defective product born from Ophelia's demonic power, with a low birth. "

"Hmm?" Merlin frowned, stuck out his tongue to lick the Banri Garan, as if he was starving.

"Don't be arrogant!" Leviathan's expression was serious, raising his voice and bravely saying, "I am the sea demon lord, and my dignity will not allow you to trample on me casually. This humiliation today, I will remember!"

"Oh?" Merlin showed a lecherous expression and tried to slash the air, ready to chop Leviathan.

At this moment, Leviathan, facing Merlin's relentless pressure, surrendered.

"It's okay, it's as if it never happened. It's not a good thing anyway, and I don't want anyone to know that I was humiliated by such a scoundrel."

Choosing to surrender was also because Leviathan was weak, and he had no choice but to bow his head.

In a short time, Leviathan thought about many things. Since he was in trouble outside, it was better to be with Merlin than to be bought and sold. It was obviously safer.

Merlin, as a proud monarch, even though he was exiled now, was absolutely a real Demon Lord-level power, which was enough to give himself a chance. What should he do next?

Otherwise, in the current state, Leviathan was too dangerous to walk alone in the world.

Leviathan decided not to provoke Merlin and tried to use Merlin's strength to protect himself safely. Moreover, being humiliated by Merlin also threatened Leviathan's dignity, and the information was too large.

"Hmph!" Merlin sneered and put the Banri Garan back into the sheath. "With your current appearance, what right do you have to mock Asmodeus? Is it comfortable to wear female clothes?"

"By the way, you look very young and have a good talent for female clothes. Have you considered joining Asmodeus to debut as an idol?"

Leviathan looked at his own outfit and wished he could tear the skirt into pieces. He never thought that he would be in such a situation as wearing Asmodeus' outfit. If his subordinates saw it, how could he stand?

"If you have other clothes, would it be fun to tease me?"

Merlin smiled and took out the spare clothes Alice had prepared for him from his ring and threw them to Leviathan.

Leviathan didn't mind and quickly started changing, even though Merlin's clothes were too large for his youthful body, it was still better than wearing a skirt.

Just as Leviathan was taking off the skirt, Lilith, who had been waiting to ambush at night, suddenly barged in.

"Brother~ I'm here!"

Lilith smiled like a flower, but what greeted her was Leviathan's two white breasts, which were white and white.

title: Chapter 47 — Update Soon
content:
Chapter 47 — Update Soon

Volume 29 · Chapter 47

Lilith arrived at the wrong time; if she had come earlier just to play for a while, it wouldn’t have caused such a big misunderstanding. She stared with a grim expression, her eyes wide as she looked at Leviathan’s buttocks after he had just taken off his skirt. Because Lilith had just joined the group, she stood behind Leviathan, and from his perspective she could only see a slender girl in armor taking off her skirt in front of her brother—what kind of favor is this?! She had only been away for a short while, and her brother had already taken up with a new girl—this is too much! Indeed, all males are like pigs’ trotters; you can’t trust anyone, not even your brother’s mouth. Lilith’s face darkened instantly, a violent aura rose from her, and a whip appeared in her hand, pulled straight by Leviathan. “Lilith?! What are you doing here? Get lost!” Merlin looked up, saw Lilith, and his heart skipped. “Huh?” Leviathan wondered in his heart, Lilith? Isn’t she Merlin’s? She isn’t the temporary acting Demon Lord of the First Demon Lord Palace? How could she be here? Before Leviathan could say anything, Lilith over there exploded. “Where did this little goblin come from? Dare to seduce my brother—go to hell!” “Lilith, stop! It’s not what you think!” Lilith roared, swinging her snake‑like whip, wrapping it around Leviathan’s neck. “Ugh?!” Leviathan felt hard to breathe, his face ugly, the whip tightening; before, he wouldn’t have even looked at Lilith, but now it’s an overwhelming force she can’t resist. Lilith increased her strength, whipping Leviathan around twice before slamming him hard to the ground. “Ugh!” Leviathan felt dizzy, lying motionless on the ground. “Lilith, stop! Don’t cause trouble!” Merlin said sternly, trying to stop his own reckless self from making Leviathan suffer like this. “Brother, where did you pick up this little goblin? Dare to protect him?!” Lilith put her hands on her hips, getting angrier, raised the whip and struck Leviathan’s butt twice. “Ah!!” Leviathan gritted his teeth, feeling his butt swell. “Merlin watched Leviathan lying on the ground, looking miserable, sighed inwardly—this guy is hopeless, even Lilith can easily handle him. “You’d better remember this! My family will never forget tonight’s humiliation! “If I can recover, I’ll definitely make you pay for your cruelty! “I really hate you two for jumping on the Western Phi brothers, how could Wei Ban educate you into such soulless fools!!” Leviathan ran into the side room, took off the embarrassing women’s clothes, put on Merlin’s loose outer garment, constantly warding off the curses of the Western Phi brothers—clearly this series of events left him holding a grudge. Merlin saw the two sitting outside silently listening to Leviathan’s complaints without a word, as if nothing had happened. Lilith finally understood the whole situation, regretting her rash actions, she occasionally glanced at her brother’s blue‑black face, pleading pitifully for his protection. Normally, Lilith knows her own limits; without Merlin backing her, she wouldn’t dare to face the Demon Lords head‑on. As a descendant of a Demon Lord, at best she can only be an acting Demon Lord; her strength is far from a true Demon Lord level—how could she have the nerve to whip other Demon Lords’ buttocks? Lilith behaved obediently, quietly, and dignifiedly sat beside Merlin, head down, no different from a child who made a mistake. “Who’s your brother? Your brother was already angered to death by you, look at your mess!” Merlin said expressionlessly. “I’m not hostile; how would I know Leviathan would be here?” Lilith turned her head, grabbed Merlin’s arm, looking innocent. Merlin gave Lilith a cold glance, “You’re too reckless; even with a bit of sense you’d still do this.” “I don’t want to hear you blame me, brother—I just want you to praise me, touch me, love me!” Lilith shook Merlin angrily, “If Leviathan causes trouble, brother, you must back me up!” Merlin had a headache, wanting to speak but holding back, thinking how he got stuck with such a troublemaker—really, the older he gets, the less lovable he is, far worse than when he was young. The door to the side room opened; Leviathan emerged, restored to his youthful form, trying to take off the outfit that made him ashamed. Since it was Merlin’s spare clothes, they were still too big, so he could only roll up the sleeves and pant legs, barefoot. Leviathan approached Merlin and his brother, his face unfriendly, sat opposite them, caught sight of Lilith’s feelings, couldn’t help but let out a cold snort. “Hmph! Your beads are big…” Lilith saw the renowned Sea Demon Lord, felt an instinctive fear, kept shrinking behind her brother; in front of Leviathan she was just a little demon. “Haha, don’t be angry, I’ve always been like this—he just has a special fondness for beautiful buttocks, sees them and can’t help whipping them, so you should be happy; him being able to strike you proves your butt is beautiful.” Merlin spouted nonsense, not even believing himself, but to protect him he could make up any excuse. Lilith’s head was full of question marks, she looked at her brother in surprise, wondering how he knew she liked shapely buttocks—could he have seen it? How embarrassing! “Tch!” Leviathan glared at Lilith with clenched teeth, not believing Merlin’s nonsense at all. If Leviathan weren’t in such a bad state needing Merlin’s support, he would have turned against him long ago. Before, a demon of Lilith’s level would have been killed on the spot for acting so arrogantly in front of Leviathan; even if Merlin wanted to protect her, it would depend on whether she was willing. You, the Demon Lord occupying the waters off Mexico, how did you end up worse than me? Merlin wondered, his mind filled with doubts. “This is a long story.” Leviathan lowered his head, candlelight shining on his sorrowful face, he said softly— “This short period has experienced more hardships than my first half of life, making me feel emotions I could never imagine before.” “Although you are a wandering demon exiled by the elders, I still accept you as a member of the demon race, as one of the seven sovereigns, so telling you these things is fine.” “All this starts with the hidden villain Marli; not long ago he concealed all information, then suddenly seized the territory of my Sixth Demon Lord Palace.”

title: Chapter 48 — Pursuit
content:
Chapter 48 — Pursuit

Volume 29 · Chapter 48

The source chapter title is metadata only. Use it for terminology consistency; the title itself is not part of the supplied prose below.
SOURCE CHAPTER TITLE:追来（加更）

SOURCE TEXT:
<<<BEGIN SOURCE>>>
Beliatan recounted everything he had experienced, including many details. Merlin and Lilith listened in horror, especially since Mammon was in the Third Demon Lord Palace.

Would there be such a big movement there?

Buying information from the Demon King Belial, secretly encroaching on Beliatan's territory without the approval of the Council of Elders—this crime is already serious enough to send Mammon into the Wild Demon Jar for reflection.

Lilith was very surprised. She had left for so long, how could so many things have happened? She thought the demon race would be as peaceful as usual, but now there is turmoil. It seems that Mammon's confidentiality work is too good.

"In order not to be captured by Mammon and the Four Prohibitions, I had no choice but to abandon my own body to escape, resulting in my current loss of power and little hope of recovery. Now even two fishermen can bully me at will." After Beliatan finished speaking, he sighed deeply. It was because he had someone to confide in that his mood improved a lot.

"That's how it is. After that, things... I guess you also know."

After listening, Merlin let out a long breath, feeling uneasy. He didn't expect so many things to happen in the demon race in such a short time!

"Did Belial secretly support Mammon's actions?" Lilith hid behind Merlin, unable to believe it.

"That's unlikely. Belial is very kind and fair, how could he support Mammon's atrocities?" she said.

"These are all things Mammon said himself, I can't be sure if they are true or not." Beliatan said helplessly.

"Since Mammon has already ridden you, why don't you tell the Council of Elders about his crimes? Mammon is so lawless and will definitely be severely punished." Lilith offered her suggestion.

"Did you not think about this? But Mammon, that cunning guy, must have guessed that I would do this long ago and had prepared for it. Maybe before I even met the elders, Mammon had already caught me." Beliatan had long wanted the Council of Elders to intervene and bring justice, but in his current state, it was not easy!

Merlin remained silent for a long time, remembering that Mammon was definitely a power-hungry guy. He had once said something to himself, but from his words and actions, it was clear that he was the most important thing in Mammon's eyes.

In Merlin's eyes, Merlin was just a young boy, and communicating with such a low-born inferior would lower his status.

When Merlin first regained Viviana's throne, Mammon was the only monarch who explicitly disagreed with his succession, even saying that he would take over the Second Demon Lord Palace and Viviana's inheritance. Mammon's greed is evident.

"Mammon wants to launch a second holy war, this information is definitely true.

"Only this I am certain about, Mammon is serious. He will use the Strait of Messina as a springboard and turn the entire kingdom into the third one."

"Which kingdom?" Merlin frowned and asked.

"I am still very clear about this. Mammon didn't reveal it, but he said it would use the Strait of Messina as a springboard. I think you know that my territory is located on a maritime route, well-connected, and it would be easy to attack anywhere." Beliatan said calmly.

Merlin frowned even more, feeling that the situation had become very troublesome. He himself was a supporter of peace and was most annoyed by organized fighting. Mammon's actions were very much against his will.

With Merlin's current status as a banished demon king, even if he had a voice in the Council of Elders, it would not be much.

If the second holy war breaks out, humans and demons will once again be on opposing sides. How will Merlin, a demon king who has been wandering outside and living among humans day and night, deal with this?

Merlin took a deep breath, trying to calm his restless heart. It was already difficult to be caught in the middle.

Logically speaking, as a demon, Merlin should stand on Mammon's side and support the third holy war.

But Merlin knew that although the demon race's current strength could fight against humans, it was only under the joint leadership of the seven Demon Lord Palaces. It would be impractical for any single Demon Lord Palace to fight against all humans alone.

Merlin didn't know that in Mammon's plan, all Demon Lord Palaces had already been prepared to be involved.

"I still underestimated Mammon's determination. In the end, he gave up his own territory. If I could start over, I would definitely fight my way to Mammon's face and personally destroy this bastard!"

Beliatan said angrily, hating the treacherous Mammon to the core.

"It's too late to say anything now. You are now a lost soul. Why don't you obediently stay at home and be my brother's attendant, serving tea and water?" Lilith's courage grew as Beliatan lost his power, and she even dared to tease him.

"You!?" Beliatan's breathing became rough, and he silently clenched his fists. It was ridiculous, here only your brother had the right to talk to me. What are you? Why don't you come and be my maid? For the sake of the wound, I can treat you well.

Every night, brother and I will bring you washing water."

"Pfft!" Lilith spat at Beliatan, looking aggrieved. "Brother, you should hit him. Even though he is in trouble, he still dares to insult me.

"You should be quiet first."

Merlin was a bit annoyed and was thinking about how to deal with this matter. Mammon hadn't reached his head yet, so should he oppose him?

"Lucifer, why don't you escort me to the Council of Elders? With you accompanying me, I'm sure I can meet the demon elders and maybe organize them to deal with Mammon, who wants to drag the entire demon race into the mud."

Beliatan had made up his mind and hoped that Merlin could lend him strength.

"We also have our own matters to attend to in this world. It seems that we cannot help Beliatan for the time being."

Merlin sighed, thinking that whether Mammon could launch a full-scale third holy war was still unknown. Besides, there were other matters that needed to be taken care of, making it difficult to care about Beliatan.

"What matters do you have that are more important than the safety of the demon race?" Beliatan frowned, thinking that even though Merlin was banished, he was still a member of the demon race, and this was something he had to consider.

"Did you hear about the gods' relics?" Merlin asked curiously.

Beliatan thought for a moment, his eyes brightening. "It was said to be the resting place of the ancient gods?"

"That's right. We have organized an expedition team and are about to set off. I would like to help you with your matters, but there is no time now."

Merlin shook his head.

Beliatan hesitated, and the two of them hurried over, asking, "Could we encounter the 'Dead Sea Giant'?"

"It's possible. It is said that it is the guardian of the relics. Why do you ask?" Merlin felt suspicious.

Beliatan lowered his head, as if thinking about something important. After a long time, he clenched his fists and said, "The expedition team must be equipped with me."

title: Chapter 50 — Deterrence (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 50 — Deterrence (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 29 · Chapter 50

This was the matter Merlin was most on guard against right now. How could the Four Great Princes, who were known for their heartlessness and ruthlessness, possibly easily let go of Leviathan in his time of trouble? Even a disabled enemy, whether not killed off, must be kept under one's control to put one's mind at ease.

Merlin had been lying awake all night, simply waiting. The result was exactly as expected. Magus of Magus and Hunter Heaven from Mammon's side indeed tracked the scent and came pursuing.

The horse-faced demon looked at his severed arm, his whole body trembling with pain, letting out low growls. Worried about waking the nearby humans, he had to grit his teeth and endure the agony, leaving the unconscious Leviathan to hide behind Cow Head.

The horse-faced demon faced a formidable enemy. His entire body went rigid, completely different from Leviathan's fallen state. Before him stood an exiled Demon Lord, a former monarch of pride with genuine Demon Lord-level power! He had once held a status equal to that of his current master!

"Your Majesty—!"

Ose saw Merlin sitting by the window and was so shocked he stammered, his face turning deathly pale, a cold sweat breaking out on his back!

His proud nose had not detected the danger of a high-class demon in the room earlier; only when facing Merlin at close range did he realize Merlin's presence.

This was probably because Merlin's demonic bloodline was thin, causing his demonic气息 to be faint and hard to detect. If even those strong humans misjudged Merlin's identity, how could Ose possibly sense him?

Ose's emotions were extremely tense at this moment. Merlin before his eyes was, no matter what, a top-tier demon who could mingle with Mammon. His knees began to go soft, and he subconsciously swallowed.

"Lord Lucifer...!"

In front of Merlin, Ose, a demon of his level, appeared extremely subservient. He was still willing to address the exiled Merlin with the title "Revered Great One" and had completely abandoned any thought of武力 confrontation. Only staying quiet and talking was the sole path out.

"Oh?" Merlin watched Ose indifferently, searching his memories. "I remember you. Were you Mammon's adjutant?"

"Y-yes!"

Ose's heart was still strong. He rationally chose to submit, not wanting to provoke the dangerous figure before him, so under pressure he knelt on one knee and answered respectfully. "I am a vassal serving His Majesty Mammon, holding the position of Grand Steward of the Third Demon Lord Palace. I accompanied His Majesty to the Death Swamp back then and witnessed your heroic bearing."

"Mammon's steward? Hah."

Merlin chuckled softly, jumping down from the windowsill. "You sure know how to talk. But aren't I also a failed Demon Lord who got fired? Is it worth your respect?"

"Worth it! Absolutely worth it!"

Ose raised his head and spoke under tremendous pressure. "You are exceptionally courageous and can be called the second greatest swordsman of this era. Even compared to Your Majesty the First, it's not much different! I have always admired your heroic bearing, and today being able to face you is my dream fulfilled."

Merlin listened to Ose's rainbow-sucking flattery and felt a bit embarrassed. Was he really...

It was hard to miss from Ose's eyes that he was already scared stiff. At a time like this, how could he dare to say anything unpleasant?

Merlin quietly looked at Ose, holding Banri Garan in his hand, as if he might suddenly strike at any moment.

"Cut the useless talk. I'm asking you—did Mammon send you here?"

Ose's teeth chattered loudly, and he honestly answered, "Y-yes..."

"That vicious bastard Mammon has already occupied Leviathan's territory. Are you really going to be so ruthless and give no one a single way out? Is it only when Leviathan becomes a harmless plaything in your hands that you'll be satisfied?" Merlin understood very clearly that between Demon Lords there existed a bottom line, due to the Blood Pool Seal. No matter how fierce the fight, they would try to leave the other party alive. Of course, they could also turn them into thinking-less puppets, making them even more obedient.

"No! Your Majesty Lucifer! We absolutely didn't mean that!" Ose panicked and explained desperately. "At first we only wanted to borrow the Strait of Messina and had no intention of occupying it. But... but Lord Leviathan resisted too fiercely, leading to this outcome!" He knelt on the ground, cold sweat streaming down his face. "His Majesty Mammon feels very guilty and remorseful. He sent us to fetch Lord Leviathan back to recuperate properly. His Majesty will definitely apologize and find a way to repair Lord Leviathan's body—"

Merlin helplessly pursed his lips and said coldly without emotion, "Do you think I'm a fool who doesn't know anything? I already know what Mammon plans to do."

"..."

Ose felt as though he'd heard a death sentence, like a basin of cold water poured over his head cooling him from scalp to toe. He knew very well how dangerous King Lucifer the First was.

Ose had originally planned to deceive Merlin, trying to get by and smoothly take Leviathan away. Now he lowered his head, no longer daring to look Merlin in the eyes. At this point, let alone taking Leviathan away—just surviving and leaving would be fine.

"You sure talk a good game. Mammon feels very guilty and remorseful—clearly impossible. He's definitely laughing to himself, thrilled that he got such a great deal." Merlin narrowed his eyes. Although he wasn't on good terms with Mammon, he basically saw through his nature. "Raise your head. Look at me."

Ose's heart pounded with terror. He slowly raised his head and looked at Merlin in fright. He was extremely astonished—did King Lucifer understand his master's thoughts better than he himself did?

"Let me guess—what exactly is your plan?" Merlin paused and slowly voiced his deduction. "You want Leviathan to recover his power? That's fundamentally impossible. His remaining value lies in his status as a Monarch and his lineage as a descendant of the First Demon Lords. Therefore, Mammon will control Leviathan in his own hands and use him as a puppet to indirectly rule the Sixth Demon Lord Palace. Anything Mammon has swallowed, he will absolutely not voluntarily spit back out—unless you want to kill it!"

"..."

Ose's heart grew increasingly fearful with each word. Merlin's speculation was identical to Mammon's plan!

He had once heard that King Lucifer the First was a young, inexperienced idiot, lacking experience compared to other Demon Lords and easy to fool with a simple mind! But after this short close encounter, Ose wished he could tear the mouth of the bastard who spread those rumors! How was this guy easy to fool?!

"So from the beginning you wanted to deceive me. How should I punish you?" Merlin examined them with interest.

Ose felt a chill run through his hair and immediately prostrated himself begging for mercy. "Lord Lucifer, spare my life! We never wanted to deceive you!"

The two demons behind him, Cow Head and Horse Face, seeing this, also knelt on the ground and began banging their heads while groaning.

"Spare our lives! We dare not do it again!"

"Lord Lucifer! Our wretched lives aren't worth you killing us!"

Merlin looked at the three terrified demons, and without hesitation drew his blade.

Ose only felt two sword qi flash past, nearly slicing off his ears. His heart stopped, and he couldn't breathe. When he came to, his two capable subordinates behind him were already bloodied messes, hacked to death on the spot before they could even scream.

Cow Head and Horse Face were also Mammon's capable subordinates with strength not inferior to the three demons of Night Britannia. The Thorn Knights had fought them very hard, yet before Merlin they were as simple to slaughter as pigs and dogs!

Ose's mind went blank. His lips had lost all blood, and his terror made it impossible for him to tell if he was dead or alive.

Merlin raised Banri Garan high above his head, the cold moonlight casting an aura of killing intent. He said coldly:

"I'll spare your dog life. Go back and tell Mammon—"

"Abandon all unrealistic ideas, or—"

"Just obediently wash your neck and wait for me to visit personally."

title: Chapter 51 — Biochemical Weapon
content:
Chapter 51 — Biochemical Weapon

Volume 29 · Chapter 51

Osiris was so terrified he nearly pissed himself.

He didn't dare linger even for a moment and hastily fled Gem City.

Merlin surveyed the mess left behind, feeling a little regretful. They had originally thought this would be a simple matter involving one Hero, yet it had ended up so complicated.

Merlin figured Osiris wouldn't dare return to Marum directly — based on the nature of that covetous monarch, he would have surely weighed the situation carefully before choosing his targets. In the short term, Osiris probably wouldn't rashly send someone back just to deliver a message. Rather, he would use Osiris to convey a threat: Marum should call off its plans soon, before the situation became irreparable.

If Marum still harbored some wariness toward Merlin, then it would hold back and waver, buying them more time. As long as they could move quickly enough — if Marum hesitated due to overthinking — everything was still within controllable range, and the Elder Council could clean up the aftermath.

Merlin didn't need to kill Osiris. It was merely a pawn. Its purpose was to convey his attitude and stance to Marum, making the Demon Lord wary and afraid to act recklessly. That was sufficient.

Leviathan, lying on the bed, was no longer pretending to be unconscious. Instead, she sat up quietly, her back turned toward Merlin.

"That bastard Marum," she muttered bitterly, grinding her teeth in annoyance, "really did send him back. He clearly doesn't want to let us go easily."

"We're not fools," Merlin said. "He knows we occupied your territory and will worry about retaliation. Only by treating you as a tool without the ability to think will he feel at ease." He sighed. "He truly doesn't dare provoke us."

"Back during the Holy War," Leviathan said venomously, "the Angelic Host descended from Heaven. Seven Demon Lord Palaces united to defend our homeland, and countless ancestors fell on the battlefield. How could things have come to this today?"

"The times have changed, Leviathan," Merlin said in a calm tone. "What demons from that era are still alive? The only one who survived — Belial — is secretly supporting Marum behind the scenes. You cannot possibly defeat him alone."

Leviathan fell silent. Looking at the ruined foundation of the Seven Demon Lord Palaces established through generations of ignorance, she said with regret, "I hate that I'm powerless to resist them."

"Don't be so discouraged," Merlin said. "The balance of power between Marum and the others — the big shots resting beneath the Blood Pool — that's something I'm closely watching." He paused. "I'll be honest with you: I've already warned Marum. Opposing the Seven Demon Lord Palaces — he will surely hesitate about whether to continue."

Leviathan was silent for a moment, then asked softly, "How do you plan to recover your strength?"

Merlin didn't answer immediately. He simply said, "When the time comes, it will happen."

After Merlin left, Alice and Chris were home alone. The house felt even emptier without him. There was no one left to bicker with, which meant losing a lot of fun.

Life still had to go on. With nowhere to vent her frustration, Alice could only focus on taking care of Chris's meals.

Of course Chris missed Merlin. She called out for "Daddy!" in her dreams every night, hoping he would come back soon.

But Chris had gradually developed a sense of independence. She wouldn't throw tantrums randomly in front of adults. She would only pout and repeatedly ask Alice, "When is Daddy coming back?" And then she would start learning to earn pocket money.

Every time Chris crossed her arms and pouted angrily, Alice had to coax her for a long time before she settled down. Alice sometimes felt a bit exhausted. She barely did any housework either, but now that Merlin was gone, Alice truly understood — he may have appeared to do nothing all day, but he was also silently contributing, and not less than she was.

Today, Chris got up early and busied herself around the house, hoping to do something nice for Daddy so he would praise her when he returned.

Alice was preparing breakfast in the living room when little Chris, barefoot, ran back and forth between the bedroom and the bathroom, making "tap tap tap" sounds with her footsteps. She looked full of energy.

Alice, cooking congee in the kitchen and listening to the chaotic noises from outside, furrowed her brows and called out, "Breakfast can be whatever — it doesn't matter. Mom's cooking isn't as good as Daddy's anyway~"

Chris's voice came from outside, slightly offended: "What do you mean Mom's cooking can only be tolerated? Does that make sense?! Being so picky at such a young age — what will you be like when you grow up? Looks like I need to properly educate her."

Alice wasn't about to let it go. "Hmph! What's so great about Merlin? Where am I worse than him?"

Chris carefully prepared breakfast while Alice, though slightly speechless, pondered what children could possibly think about these days. So she set down what she was doing and went out to check on Chris.

It turned out Chris had hidden in the bathroom, taking Merlin's dirty laundry out of the wash basin and sitting beside it on a small stool, chanting "rub-a-dub, rub-a-dub" as she tried to help wash his clothes.

How could a child as young as Chris know how to properly wash clothes? She was merely putting the dirty clothes into a basin, mimicking what she saw Alice do, pouring water in, and pressing them with her small hands.

Alice, seeing Chris's tiny figure, felt a mix of amusement, fondness, and a faint sense of guilt.

But then Alice reasoned with herself — this was Chris's goodwill. Since Merlin wasn't home, she always felt she needed to protect this family in his stead.

Perhaps this counted as growth? Chris was already learning to share her parents' burdens. How wonderful~

"Hehe~" Chris, fully absorbed in her "washing," lacked the strength, so she compensated with her body weight, dipping the clothes into the basin.

"Chris, what are you doing there?" Alice walked over with a smile.

"Daddy~" Chris turned around excitedly, her face covered in suds, "I'm helping Daddy wash clothes! Daddy left them!"

"You're so good," Alice said, patting her daughter's head. But then she noticed the clothes and couldn't help but pause. "Why don't you just leave those there for now. Mom will—"

"No! If Mom washes them, it won't be Chris's功劳 (contribution)! Chris wants to do it herself — it has to be Chris's own功劳!" Chris stubbornly stuck out her chin, her ahoge wobbling as she continued pressing the clothes.

Alice's smile became somewhat stiff. *This child is so stubborn... does she take after...?*

Chris suddenly noticed the empty space beside her, her expression darkening. She turned and grabbed Merlin's underwear from the basin, holding it up to Alice's face. "Quick, smell it! Daddy's underwear is all stinky~"

"No no no! I'm not going to!" Alice panicked.

But little Chris didn't understand boundaries at all. She shoved the underwear right up to Alice's nose. Alice's eyes rolled back instantly, her stomach churning as she barely held back vomit. She waved her hands frantically.

"Is this even Merlin's underwear?! That bastard hasn't changed it in half a year, has he?!"

*Other men hide their dirty underwear in basins, but this...*

title: Chapter 52 — The Intelligence Officer Visits (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 52 — The Intelligence Officer Visits (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 29 · Chapter 52

Alice was annoyed in her heart as she threw Merlin's smelly socks into the trash can. Her head was still dizzy, showing that its power was quite formidable.
This is a toxic guy. Every time she gets a slightly good impression of him, it immediately disappears!
Fortunately Chris was fine. What if she got sick from the smell? One couldn't relax for even a moment. Dangers were everywhere at home.
Alice muttered inwardly, complaining about Merlin throwing his dirty clothes everywhere.
"Mama, why does Daddy's socks smell so bad?" Chris asked curiously. She had probably never smelled such a powerful odor.
"Well..." Alice was somewhat awkward. She couldn't completely disregard Merlin's dignity, could she? "Your daddy's physique is special. After wearing socks for a long time, they have the effect of repelling insects. The bugs are smoked to death before they can even bite him. Pretty impressive, right?"
"Then this is a treasure! I'll get some for Grandma and Grandpa too!" Chris innocently believed the nonsense and reached out her small hand to捞 the smelly socks from the trash can.
"Stop! Stop right now! Don't grab any dirty things with your hands!" Alice tightly grabbed her daughter's "little claws," her expression somewhat resentful. "Honestly, you should be more obedient. Daddy isn't home right now. Don't go poking around randomly. At the very least, you need my permission before doing anything."
Little Chris was dejected, her ahoge drooping listlessly alongside her mood. "I also want to help Mama and Daddy with something..."
Alice's heart fluttered at Chris's wronged appearance. She felt she couldn't squash her daughter's enthusiasm. So she picked her up from the floor.
"I'm not scolding you. I just want you to behave when helping Mama, and not do those inexplicable things."
"Daddy washes clothes. That's not an inexplicable thing," little Chris retorted, looking up.
"Yes, yes, yes, but you're still too young for laundry. Let me handle it from now on." Alice carried her daughter out, speaking as she walked. "You need to eat properly, sleep early and rise early. Only then will you have the strength to help Daddy."
"Bro-bro—"
Just as Alice left the bathroom carrying Chris, someone knocked on the front door.
This puzzled Alice. By the timetable, Merlin could never possibly have returned this quickly. The Gem City of Asmodeus was far away. Merlin should have just arrived.
Who on earth could it be? An adventurer guild friend?
Alice couldn't guess, but the little one in her arms had long ago lost patience. She broke free from Alice's embrace and ran toward the front door.
She always heard Alice saying Daddy would be back soon, so Chris assumed their father was simply outside.
"Daddy! Daddy must be back~"
Chris took her short steps, jumped, and grabbed the door handle that was taller than herself, dangling like a living ornament.
"Chris, don't act recklessly. It's probably not Daddy—"
Alice hurriedly grabbed the restless Chris, but the door was already opened. With a creaking sound, a man stood outside. His shoulders were broad and powerful, his legs long, and he wore formal attire like a gentleman, carrying a leather travel suitcase in his hand.
What was particularly suspicious was that the brim of his hat was pulled down extremely low, making it impossible to glimpse his face.
The man slowly removed his hat, but he still kept遮挡 covering his head, seemingly worried about someone seeing his face.
"Excuse me, this is the residence of Alice Coldia, right?"
Little Chris felt uneasy around the stranger and shrank back into her mother's embrace, yet her eyes were still curiously fixed on the unwelcome guest.
Alice stroked the back of Chris's head, attempting to soothe her daughter's emotions, then looked up to answer.
"I am. And you are... who?"
"It seems the address is correct. I've found the right place."
The man boldly lowered the hat遮挡 his face, revealing a pair of pointed ears and a beard, with his eyes darting around restlessly.
He was unmistakably one of Merlin's subordinates—one of the Seven Generals, Xiu!
No wonder he was sneaking around遮挡 his face. That appearance walking down the street could scare people to death.
Alice, holding the startled Chris, immediately emitted hostility from her eyes. She always harbored a trace of enmity toward demons, especially when she couldn't discern whether they were friend or foe.
What if it were an invading demon?
Alice gestured with one hand, and the Nameless Aria hanging on the wall responded instantly. The sword flew from its sheath into the owner's hands. Enhanced, it had become even more obedient, radiating an extraordinarily surging divine aura!
Alice's present aura was fierce and intimidating. She held the demon sword like facing a great enemy, her mind highly alert. If the demon before her made any aggressive move, she would strike without hesitation.
"What is your business?"
"Uh..."
Xiu's pupils contracted. Facing Alice's pressure alone, he actually felt considerable stress—
How could this human woman be so powerfully strong?
It exceeded what Blackman had described. The intensity of the pressure was far too high.
If Blackman hadn't lied, then this human's rapid growth is truly terrifying!
Serving alongside Her Majesty has indeed made him stronger than his old subordinates. No wonder Blackman wasn't worried at all, just...
But could this woman truly be trusted? After all, she was a human.
Xiu subconsciously secreted three layers of cold sweat. With the holy aura emanating from the sword rotating freely, it gave him an unusually shocking sensation!
The pressure from the weapon was a hundred times more intense than Alice herself!
It felt like if he were slashed once, he would instantly turn to ashes!
Xiu now felt that Blackman's dropped intelligence was somewhat unreliable. The companion of Her Majesty, this human woman's strength, exceeded his expectations. This sense of discrepancy caused by his intelligence failing to keep up was exactly the thing he detested most.
However, Xiu had come alone this time and absolutely did not intend to oppose Alice. Merlin had been fired and was now stranded outside. Having someone care for him was a good thing. Alice had her own valuable uses.
He wasn't like Ophelia, who was so extreme that she sometimes used unscrupulous means for her own desires. In that madwoman's eyes, Merlin was only correct when he was obedient like a child.
Xiu took a deep breath, placed his hat against his chest, and bowed slightly, expressing friendliness to Alice.
"My name is Xiu. I am an intelligence officer serving beside Lucifer His Majesty, responsible for gathering information within the Demon Lord's Palace."
"One of Merlin's subordinates?" Alice was surprised, eyeing the horned demon before her with suspicion.
"Didn't Her Majesty mention me to you?" Xiu raised his head and asked.
"No." Alice answered coldly. She didn't particularly trust this suddenly arriving demon. Merlin had mentioned he had old subordinates, but he never specified who. He often showed an awkward expression, unwilling to bring them up.
"I'm... somewhat embarrassed." He pondered how to prove his identity and lower the human woman's guard, so he slowly said, "Her Majesty likes to squat on the toilet reading books every morning, and she stays for a long time, right?"
"Her Majesty has no strong concept of money. She likes to spend whatever she earns, living paycheck to paycheck, right?"
"Her Majesty has a lazy habit and doesn't pay much attention to clothing. Sometimes because she forgets, she wears socks for a long time, and they develop a somewhat pungent odor, right?"
"Eh?" Little Chris's eyes lit up. She turned around and tugged at Mama's clothes. "Smelly-smelly~!"
"!!!" Alice's expression frozen on her face, she slowly lowered the sword in her hand, speaking with an awkward tone, "Don't... don't say it so loudly~"
"I believe you are one of Merlin's subordinates..."
"And a rather close one at that~"
(╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻
