title: Chapter 53 — Missed
content:
Chapter 53 — Missed

Volume 29 · Chapter 53

Xiu was slightly startled, astonished.

"Between us," he said, "why did you assert that my relationship with His Majesty is good?"

"Because I know his habits very well," the stranger replied. "For example, something like that—only someone like me could have access to it, right?"

Alice's expression changed. She thought of the "stinky" smell and felt a chill run down her spine.

"Oh? So you've experienced it too?" Xiu's eyes brightened, as if he'd found a kindred spirit. "How about it—that pungent smell isn't very fragrant at all. Only His Majesty could be so special. Clothes worn on his body for a long time develop a unique body scent—a fragrance that no amount of rare incense wood could compare to."

"Ah???" Alice stared with wide eyes, thinking: *What kind of monster is this? It smells so terrible and he's comparing it to delicious food? Is this guy's brain okay!*

"To be frank, my relationship with His Majesty is quite close, and I know many of his secrets. In the Demon Lord Palace, he used to lose his shorts and underwear all the time."

Xiu smiled, speaking with pride. "That's right—the shorts were stolen by me, and the underwear was stolen by Ophelia. We divided the loot clearly. His Majesty used to be so distressed about constantly losing his socks and underwear that he didn't even know it was me who took them."

Alice's mind couldn't process this for a moment. *What kind of nonsense is this? Stealing such disgusting things—what's the point? It would only make Merlin feel uneasy, right?*

"Oh~ I've collected all of His Majesty's shorts. I keep them as family heirlooms, to be passed down through generations. These are the essence condensed from His Majesty's body scent—filled up in a big box. Once you open it, the aroma is indescribable." Xiu became intoxicated, unable to stop.

Alice gagged again, unable to endure the demons' disgusting tastes. She couldn't imagine what kind of thought process they had.

"Do you have any shorts His Majesty wore? I'll buy them at a high price." Xiu's face was full of anticipation, already reaching into his sleeves for money.

"No no no!" Alice shook her head frantically, refusing outright.

No wonder Merlin didn't want to mention his subordinates. Was there nothing normal among them?

Having confirmed the identity, Alice dared not let Xiu in freely. After all, he was Merlin's subordinate—he might have ulterior motives. And with the wind sitting idle, who knew what trouble might come? Alice thought that since Merlin wasn't home now, she had to be on guard. She also wanted to know what the Demon Lord Palace was thinking—like taking Merlin away and such.

Xiu sat stiffly on the chair. The unfamiliar environment made him uncomfortable. He looked around, curious about Merlin's living conditions, feeling the place was rather shabby. The living standards couldn't compare to the Demon Lord Palace—it didn't match Merlin's noble status. Although the demon race wasn't wealthy, the entire Demon Lord Palace existed to serve Merlin. Living here with Alice, it was certainly not as comfortable as in the Demon Lord Palace.

Little Chris beside him, with chubby cheeks and big eyes, curiously watched the strange-looking Uncle Xiu, finding it very novel. Just like her aunt, he had horns on his head too!

Since Xiu was Merlin's subordinate, Alice wasn't worried about him harming the child—after all, Chris was also Merlin's daughter, and she'd seen how that demon doted on Chris. There was nothing to worry about.

This was Chris's first time seeing a horned demon. Added to the fact that her mother had brought him in, her courage grew a bit. She leaned in to observe and found that Uncle Xiu looked more and more like an upright-walking lion.

"Uncle, eat grass?"

"Uh!" Xiu's face darkened. He explained seriously, "I'm not—"

"But Uncle looks just like a sheep!" Chris perched on the sofa, her antenna-like hair swaying left and right.

"All demons have impure bloodlines. In ancient times they bred recklessly, mating with all kinds of creatures, which is why demons now have such varied forms—many of us look like animals."

Xiu explained patiently, not wanting to be mistaken for a beast by the little girl. "Our common trait is having sharp horns. Only the noble-blooded first-generation descendants possess them."

"Oh~" Chris understood somewhat, touching her little cheek. "Uncle said something interesting, just like Bro Potom. He told me lots of stories about demons—they're all so amazing."

"Potom!"

Xiu turned sharply, thinking: *I searched the entire Demon Lord Palace and couldn't find Potom anywhere. I thought that big guy was lost!*

So he secretly followed Lilith out? What a despicable fellow—hadn't even told them and slipped out to have fun!

But it was also a surprise—Potom was actually so bored that he'd tell stories to a child? That didn't seem like demon behavior.

Xiu shook his head, silently sighing. Blackman was becoming less and less reliable. His intelligence wasn't accurate enough—not even knowing there was a child at home.

That child's eyes—looked so much like His Majesty's. Almost identical. Could it be...?

Xiu smiled, thinking this was almost impossible. No matter how mischievous His Majesty was, he couldn't possibly have offspring with a human. Intermarriage with humans was a taboo crime among demons.

"Have some tea." Alice returned from the kitchen, pouring a cup for Xiu.

"Thanks, Alice—small favor." Xiu held the cup, not looking like a vicious demon at all, more like a runner. In his heart, he evaluated—

This human woman was quite considerate. Merlin probably wouldn't be mistreated.

And with that level of strength, she could defeat most of the Demon Lord Palace's executives. The only one who could possibly fight her was... but after Princess Vivian died, that person had mysteriously disappeared.

Xiu sighed silently. If Alice was Merlin's subordinate, then very few in the Demon Lord Palace could beat her.

Alice turned to look at Chris. "Did you just say something random again?"

Chris pressed her lips tight, shaking her head vigorously with an innocent expression.

Alice glanced at Xiu across the room, thinking: *There are demons coming and going here. She probably thinks I'm colluding with the demons, treating this place like the First Demon Lord Palace outpost?*

"May I ask which country you're from, sir?"

"His Majesty is here. Earlier, Lady Lilith should have arrived too, right? I have something important to report." Xiu spoke seriously.

"I'm sorry, they're not here. They've already gone to the Gem City. Something came up." Alice replied flatly.

"What?! The Gem City—a rich place to live?" Xiu grew uneasy. That was far from Britain.

"Yes. Merlin is an adventurer—you know that, right? This was a private commission." Alice accepted the news without expression.

Xiu's face grew grave. He had already learned through his intelligence network that Mammon's Third Demon Lord Palace was acting frequently. Clearly, the peace within the demon race was becoming precarious.

There was also an unconfirmed rumor that Mammon had seized Leviathan's territory.

Right now there were two possibilities: either Britain and the Second Demon Lord Palace were close, and Mammon used the Strait of Messina to march north, launching a holy war to conquer Britain—or it was a civil war, crossing Britain while His Majesty was exiled, seizing the Second Demon Lord Palace, allowing Mammon to control the entire demon force.

The probability of Mammon moving south was low—the southern nations weren't rich enough to interest Mammon.

Either way, the result was terrible. Merlin and Lilith had already left. The Second Demon Lord Palace was leaderless, unable to hold the situation together. If Mammon's army attacked, there would probably be only one option—surrender.

Xiu's expression was troubled. He'd barely made it here, and now he couldn't even see Merlin. He lifted his teacup, wanting to calm his agitated emotions.

Little Chris looked left and right, cheerfully comforting him. "Uncle Lion, don't be sad. Dad will be back soon. Mom told me so."

"Is that so?" Xiu nodded blankly, took a sip of tea, then noticed something—his eyes widened in shock.

"Wha—what?!"

"Dad???"

title: Chapter 54 — Fury
content:
Chapter 54 — Fury

Volume 29 · Chapter 54

"Father isn't saying that randomly. Do you have some hidden meaning?" The royal majesty already has offspring. "Father is father. Uncle, aren't you here to find my father?" Little Chris said innocently. I don't understand children's logic. Alice, seeing this, whispered to Chris, "Don't talk nonsense. Go play by yourself over there." Chris stomped her feet angrily and ran off to play with her toys by herself. "As you can see, this child is our... love..." Alice didn't know what to say. For Chris's existence, it was completely unknown. "What??" Xiu was at a loss, staring at the small figure playing in the corner. The child's eyes were so similar to His Majesty's. So she really was born from His Majesty and Lilith. That bastard Blackman was too unreliable. How did he miss noticing something so significant? When the child was fostered elsewhere, he didn't see it? Xiu's expression was grim. He didn't know what to say. If this matter reached the demon race, it would definitely cause quite a stir. "Although this child's birth process was somewhat unusual, there's no doubt she is our biological daughter." Alice gazed affectionately at Chris playing with her toys nearby, naturally feeling boundless tenderness. Xiu was filled with strange emotions. What did "unusual" mean? Was it saying that His Majesty, feeling empty and lonely late at night, accidentally encountered an elf? Under forbidden circumstances, he still had a child with a human ruler, completely not considering the consequences. "How does Lilith view this child?" Xiu asked. Alice's expression wasn't the best. "It should be fine, I suppose." Hearing Alice's reply, Xiu became even more puzzled. Could it be that the lord大人 had already accepted this? No wonder Puduo had suddenly become enthusiastic, actually telling stories to a child? So he had planned ahead! Xiu thought that whether Lilith and the elders could accept this unexpectedly born child, after all, she possessed human blood, and whether she could inherit... unless in the future she could obtain His Majesty's strength. Xiu believed the current situation was dire. Since His Majesty had already violated the forbidden taboo, how to hide it from the elders would be more important. Chris was after all His Majesty's only offspring, also possessing the Great Demon Lord's bloodline. Her preciousness was self-evident. If the Second Demon Lord Palace and loyal demons learned of this, other demons might not be so understanding. Xiu stood up from his chair, picked up the leather case beside him, and decided to immediately head to Crystal City to find Merlin. The crime of violating the taboo was much more severe. "Alice小姐, thank you for your hospitality. However, I have urgent business and must see His Majesty as soon as possible. I won't disturb you any further. I hope you understand." "Leaving so urgently?" Alice felt somewhat secretly pleased. The demon before her was the most reasonable one she had ever met, never causing trouble. Why did he need to see Merlin so urgently? "Xiu's face showed suspicion. He didn't want to say the internal turmoil of the demon race. He had no intention of treating Alice as his own kind." "Is Uncle leaving?" Little Chris ran over with quick steps, asking curiously, "If you see Father, give him this and say Chris's gift is different now. When Father becomes an adult, he should have this." She handed the thing from Chris over. It turned out to be a star ornament. This was the thing Merlin bought for Chris inside the machine, hoping Father would remember her after seeing it and come home quickly. Xiu held the inexplicable thing in his hands. But seeing Chris's hopeful eyes, he still carefully placed it genuinely in his arms. "Rest assured, I will definitely deliver it." Chris was so happy, thinking of Father rushing back to hug herself. Looking at the innocent and lovely little master, Xiu then suggested, "Alice小姐, if circumstances permit, bring the little master and leave Britain soon, the farther the better. I cannot reveal the reason." "Also, please do not easily admit that the little master is your and His Majesty's child when you meet other demons." "I have no other meaning. There are many enemies of His Majesty, and... the little master's situation is not permitted. I hope you understand." "This is not solely for His Majesty's sake." After Xiu left, Alice repeatedly pondered his final words. Did the current Britain face danger? But nothing seemed to be happening. Was he being overly cautious? If turmoil truly occurred, then as a foreign thorn knight, she couldn't sit by and ignore it either. As for Chris's situation not being recognized by the demon race? Alice looked at the child beside her. "Chris, do you want to go to a place without monsters, or stay by Mommy?" "Stay by Mommy!" Chris's face lit up. "I want to stay by Mommy. I'm a sensible baby~" Alice was very satisfied with her daughter's answer. Although there was the嫌疑 of pleasing herself, she didn't mind at all. Chris was her child, she didn't need the demon race's recognition. What if they didn't allow it? So what? Chris was definitely not a demon! Where would Merlin stand, caught in the middle? He would probably feel conflicted and pained. Even if he left the Demon Lord Palace, after all, he was still the former Masked Devil King. "Masked Devil King III?!" "What does he count for!?" Originally belonging to Leviathan's First Demon Lord Palace, Mammon's mouth spewed curses. In order to win the war against Britain, Mammon used the First Demon Lord Palace as the forward command post, while the old nest, the Second Demon Lord Palace, was converted into a logistics supply. Mammon personally came here and unceremoniously took over everything Leviathan had, beginning to madly accumulate strength. In a short period, under Mammon's management, Leviathan's forces had expanded more than ten times! Mammon publicly claimed he was misunderstood, had no intention of occupying Leviathan's territory, and would return it. But Leviathan's former subordinates had all become useful chess pieces in his hands. Although not possessing a Demon Lord, Mammon truly had the forces of two Demon Lord Palaces, becoming an extremely powerful force. Just now, the messenger Xiu sent had returned. And brought back a shocking piece of news. This made Mammon burst out in rage, cursing loudly. "This green kid, how dare he threaten me?"

title: Chapter 55 — Early Attack
content:
Chapter 55 — Early Attack

Volume 29 · Chapter 55

The table in front of him was abruptly overturned, spewing out a stream of saliva.

The surrounding demons were too terrified to even dare to come out.

Free first release → [EZ Reading] Ouse knelt down, his head bowed low, too afraid to speak, fearing that Mephisto would

transfer his anger onto him.

"Lucifer, the crown prince, is a

useless individual who was exiled by the Council of Elders. How dare he now threaten me?"

"When I was the monarch,

this scoundrel hadn't even been born yet. What

right does he have to give me advice?"

"Even if his strength qualifies him to be a monarch, so what? Am I afraid of him? Hehe~"

Mephisto was so enraged that he burst into laughter.

In Mephisto's eyes, Merlin was just a young demon lord seeking to make a name for himself, and he never took this bloodthirsty young demon lord seriously.

He had personally witnessed Merlin's terrifying sword technique,

but he believed that

if he fought with all his might, the demon would not be able to resist him, and would even be weaker than Merlin's new sword technique.

Mephisto didn't know where Merlin's limits were, but he believed that

Merlin's strength was limited to what he had shown, and he couldn't be any stronger.

"Your Majesty is right, this Lucifer III is too arrogant and wants to make you give up the Holy War, otherwise he will cause you trouble," said Ouse, raising his head.

"I know," he said, "he has only been a monarch for a hundred years, which is nothing compared to Your Majesty's reign. How dare he speak like this? It shows how much Viyan has indulged him!"

"Hmph! Lucifer III only has the precious demon blood of a demon lord, otherwise with his thin demon blood, how could he hold the position of monarch?

Mephisto sneered coldly, mocking, "The entire demon race knows that

Merlin and Lilith are just trash created by Viyan using the power of a succubus. Do they really think they are special? They were only kept as tools to maintain the blood pool seal.

"That's right, they were easily expelled by the Council of Elders, which shows that Lucifer III has no influence with the Council of Elders. How dare he challenge Your Majesty?

He really doesn't know his place!"

Ouse was submissive in front of Merlin, but after seeing the master, he became aggressive again, like a loyal dog.

"Since Lucifer III has clearly taken a stand against us, what should we do about him?"

"Question," Mephisto pondered seriously for a moment, then said with a long face, "Forget it, I never considered Lucifer III as an equal. Now is not the time to engage in a battle with this useless demon lord. Besides, he is an exiled wandering demon, what wind brings him here? I'm only worried about something else."

"What concerns Your Majesty?" asked Ouse in surprise.

Mephisto's eyes became serious, controlling two Demon Lord Palaces, he had become the strongest ruler in the demon race!

"Rather than Lucifer III being against me, he is protecting Leviathan, and I'm worried that he will take Leviathan to the Council of Elders and complain.

Mephisto frowned and said in a low voice, "If the Council of Elders learns of our plan, it will cause great trouble. Even though we have the support of the Demon Race, we still don't have control over the Council of Elders's words.

I think you also know that the Council of Elders, who possess the Demon Sealing Pot, cannot be resisted by strength alone."

He lowered his head, his face showing hidden worry. If Lucifer III took Leviathan to the Council of Elders and complained, the situation would indeed be bad. Now all the troops were in Messina Bay, preparing for war, and were not yet fully prepared.

"Act!" Mephisto suddenly turned around, his eyes flickering with madness.

"What? Your Majesty means that

Ouse was shocked by Mephisto's words.

"Act against Britain now! Immediately!" Mephisto's expression was serious, emphasizing, "Don't give Lucifer III a chance to disrupt my plan! As long as the war starts, it will be difficult for the Council of Elders to stop me!

"But now

we don't have a clear advantage yet, and we need to give Ouse more time to prepare."

Ouse's forehead was covered with cold sweat, and he thought, "We can't wait any longer. If we wait until we have a clear advantage to act, where will we find such a good opportunity?"

Mephisto narrowed his eyes, under pressure, and decided to propose action.

"Situations change rapidly, and we need to act unexpectedly!"

"Even we ourselves are surprised, let alone the enemy, who is even less likely to expect it.

The Kingdom of Great Britain, despite Elizabeth's efforts to maintain stability, has been trying to conceal the fact that they are about to go to war with the demons.

However, the kingdom's internal troops have been active, constantly being sent to the southeastern coast, and many people feel that war is imminent.

Not long ago, Elizabeth issued a secret announcement overnight, ordering local lords to send troops to the southeastern coastal county of Maltonmore to jointly build a military fortress called the 'Portri Defense Line.'

To prevent the demon army from landing in the kingdom and causing serious damage to the inland areas, Elizabeth decided to invest a lot of energy in building a wall to isolate the demons outside, which is the Portri Defense Line.

With the full support of various lords, the originally empty Portri coastline was transformed overnight into a five-meter-high wall, towering and imposing, looking very solid and capable of withstanding attacks from a large number of magic cannons.

Although the construction of the defense line was progressing quickly, it was not yet completed by the deadline. The workers were sweating profusely and working overtime.

Two workers, under the supervision of kingdom soldiers, were constantly laying bricks. Fat-faced worker: "Why did the Queen suddenly want to build a fortress here? And why is she so eager?"

Thin-faced worker: "I don't know either. Look at those scary soldiers around here, I don't think we can talk about secrets.

Fat-faced worker: "Building a fortress here obviously means preparing for an enemy landing. But I haven't heard of the kingdom having any conflicts with other forces recently. It seems like everything is peaceful, right?"

Thin-faced worker: "Don't guess randomly. Just keep working. It's probably just the Queen's precaution in case there are enemies coming from here."

Fat-faced worker: "I hope so. I don't want war to break out recently, because after I finish building this fortress, I'm going to go back home."

Thin-faced worker: "Shh! Shut up! Talking like that is very unlucky.

Everyone, shut up! Get back to work and don't whisper!"

The kingdom's soldiers, who are currently in a state of secrecy about the war with the demons, are not allowed to discuss it casually.

The two workers nodded helplessly and continued to work silently, but suddenly a piercing scream echoed above them, causing everyone's ears to buzz.

A monster with black hands and membrane wings, about ten meters tall, descended from the sky, grabbed the fat-faced worker, flew to a height of thousands of meters, and then crashed down, turning him into a bloody mess!

The soldiers and workers were all stunned, because they could clearly see that the monster on the monster's head had horns, which meant it was a demon!

The dense screams were followed by a large number of demons, as numerous as crows, attacking in a swarm, covering the sky above the unfinished fortress.

On the distant horizon, a large number of demon warships appeared, dozens, hundreds, thousands of them, forming a line, sweeping across the sea in a grand manner.

Merlin's threat did not have a deterrent effect, but instead brought the bloody war forward.

title: Chapter 56 — Come Out in Full Force (Extra)
content:
Chapter 56 — Come Out in Full Force (Extra)

Volume 29 · Chapter 56

In the tent, the deputy commander of the Thorn Knight Corps, Chapman, was lighting an oil lamp to check the progress report. Based on current progress, Chapman estimated that with a little more time, they could soon complete the construction. By then, if the demons wanted to break through the defense and land, it wouldn't be difficult; here would gather the main force of Britain. Chapman put down the report, let out a breath, and could barely finish the task assigned by the queen within the time limit. Just then, a knight rushed into the tent, shouting anxiously: "Deputy commander, the demons are attacking!" "What?" Chapman jumped up and ran out, only to see the surrounding chaos—the coastal beach shrouded in a scarlet sea of fire, and the distant land scorched red by the magic cannons' heat. Hordes of demons roared in the sky, flapping their filthy membranes, shrouding the fortress that was about to be completed. Accompanied by furious roars, the ogres wielding massive clubs charged like tanks, crushing the knights to pieces. Soldiers and workers kept being struck by the landing demons; the camp's safety became perilous. Chapman's teeth chattered; he clenched his fists and saw thousands of demon warships off the coast. There might be even more, because with his naked eye Chapman couldn't see the end of the fleet. The magic cannons on the warships kept firing, harvesting lives, leaving huge scorched pits, as if the temperature along the entire Brittany coast suddenly rose. This is only the vanguard of the demon army's attack; if all the warships' magic cannons fired together, the entire Brittany coast would likely cease to exist. It turns out that the demons, who had always adopted a defensive stance, possessed such massive military power; even if the Brittany defenses were completed, they might not be able to withstand it. The knights panicked, at a loss, shouting: "Deputy commander! What should we do? What should we do now?! Should we fight the demons?" Chapman's expression turned grave as he issued the order: "Retreat!" The knights inwardly doubted: "Did I hear wrong? The demons' attack wasn't even stopped, and now we have to flee? This isn't the way of the Thorn Knight Corps!" Chapman almost shouted: "Didn't you hear my order clearly? I said retreat immediately!" "But how can we explain this to Her Majesty the Queen? As knights, we ought to—" Before the young knight could finish saying "to sacrifice ourselves for the greater good," Chapman grabbed his collar and, with a stern tone, said: "The demons' assault is clearly well-prepared; we lack the strength to resist; any delay will cost brothers their lives; only by surviving can we hope to counterattack; now dying in battle is meaningless." "I will explain to the Queen; I will take responsibility. Now you need to withdraw from here, understand?" The soldiers, stunned by Chapman's shout, blankly nodded; Chapman gazed at the grim demon scene, sighing inwardly: the queen's long-prepared Brittany defense plan had come to naught before completion. The demons' strength exceeded everyone's estimates. Among the demon warships, two were vastly larger than the others; their equipment was terrifying. The magic cannons were top-notch. This is Mammon's exclusive warship; its presence here proves that Mammon himself has come. In order to win the war against Britain, Mammon has brought out all his resources. At that moment, in the warship's council chamber, Mammon donned heavy demon armor, pretended to be mysterious, and sat on a throne made of gold and jewels, looking down at his subordinates kneeling on one knee. Leading them was a female demon dressed in a pure white robe, named Belial; she is a renowned demon of the demon race, Mammon's sole queen, and a chief force in this war. Even his own wife was sent to fight; Mammon truly spared no expense—almost all named demons from the Third Demon Lord's Hall have been gathered on this warship. "It looks like the landing operation was a success; those knights have already been… Belial said, as soon as they engaged, they fell like dominoes; it seems the human kingdom's strength is not much." "Yes, we came at just the right time; the fortress had barely begun construction; if it were truly completed, we'd likely need considerable effort to land successfully; it seems the human queen is somewhat optimistic, able to predict we'd land here." Mammon felt pleased with his decision; indeed, Merlin even helped him a bit—otherwise why would he choose to launch early? "Your Majesty is still too cautious; with our strength, we just need to sweep past with one breath; I don't believe the lowly humans can block Your Majesty's iron hooves." Belial said seriously; from the first clash, one could sense that Mammon's force is enough to crush the British kingdom; the power gap is obvious. "Haha," Mammon laughed, pleased with his wife's words, then pulled Belial into his embrace and teased: "You're the lady who brings me good luck; as long as you're by my side, my fortune won't be bad; maybe this war will go as smoothly as you said." Belial blushed, smiling like clouds, and said: "The demon officials are still here; Your Majesty should be more solemn before them." Mammon reluctantly released his wife, gazing at the elite of the Third Demon Lord's Hall present; together there were saints-rank demons and even stronger beings. Just this number alone would be enough to hoist up and smash Merlin's First Demon Lord's Hall; the power gap is huge, showing how high Mammon's status is among demons. Without doubt, this is moving his Third Demon Lord's Hall onto this warship; nearly all its troops have poured out. "Comrades! To be able to follow me here is a great honor!" "You will witness the downfall of the human era, the stone age epoch reborn; from this moment on, human harassment of us will cease; we will put an end to their era." "You will all become demons' meritorious servants; after victory, you will enjoy boundless wealth and glory; I will not neglect any of you present. We have endured too much false peace; the demon conservatives are a bunch of cowards; they cannot stop humanity's aggression against us." "At this moment, we need to rise and fire the first shot of the Third Holy War! Mammon's pre-war rally stirred the elite demons in the council hall to fervor, as they witnessed the dawn of this era. Mammon himself had become the most ambitious leader among demons, utterly unlike those cowardly demon kings. Mammon's divine aura was fierce; he gazed over every demon with a commanding, lofty tone, declaring: 'I see the human queen's head severed, hanging on the palace walls!'"

title: Chapter 1 — Captain Merlin
content:
Chapter 1 — Captain Merlin

Volume 30 · Chapter 1

A full-armed warship, continuously advancing along the ruin route map. Relying on the precise ruin navigation circle, the expedition team sailed toward the vast ocean, comparing the stars in the sky with the information on the route map, already getting closer and closer to the mysterious location of the gods' ruins.

To ensure the successful exploration of the ruins, Rothschild's father sponsored everything, filling the warships with all kinds of supplies, weapons armed to the teeth, various high-power magic cannons even more powerful than the magic cannons on warships.

At first Merlin thought the expedition team was full of powerful people from all walks of life, but after boarding the ship he found out they were all Rothschild's loyal guards, with only one unknown mercenary team selling their lives for money.

Actually from the beginning Rothschild intended to let Merlin lead a large group to explore the ruins, planting family guards in the team, presumably also for stability, fearing Merlin would act recklessly after leaving.

Rothschild appeared respectful to Merlin on the surface but was very vigilant inside, besides sending many family guards, he also let his son Jacob join the team, if anything could restrain Merlin.

Jacob was naturally unwilling, clearly knowing this expedition was very dangerous and he might lose his life, but under his father's coercion, he still braved boarding the ship, constantly praying to return safely.

Merlin brought along his two subordinates Lilith and Puduo Hai, after all this long time dealing with the sea, more subordinates the better. Of course the sea demon lord Leviathan couldn't be missing, unfortunately its power has been lost, can't rely on it at all, though it's still better than a sea eel.

At this moment in the expedition team's command room, Merlin stood with hands behind his back, examining himself in the mirror, posing various strange poses... white briefs, sexy tight pants put on clean leather boots, plus a gorgeous leather coat.

Merlin slowly put the captain's hat on his head properly, then with his flower-like fingers pinched his fake beard and nodded satisfactorily~

"Not bad~, my beard has a weird vibe~"

"Very suitable for you啊, Qi Lin Da Qu!"

After Jacob was forced onto the ship, he immediately revealed his sycophant talents, circling around Merlin every day, not stingy with praise.

This young master was still very clear in his heart, in the expedition team it was still Merlin who called the shots, whether they could live to return? Also had to rely on Merlin.

Jacob smiled broadly, awkwardly shaking hands beside, looking like a seller of fake goods in the market.

"I've long seen Merlin Da Chi is heroic and divine! Struggling in the adventurer industry is really a waste of talent, with someone as capable as you, you should ride the seas!"

"Is that so?" Merlin looked at his own reflection in the mirror, touching his beard, "Which captain do you think I sound like? Sfs qing..."

"Hehe, Captain Da Qu, heroic and divine!" Jacob shouted without any courtesy.

"Shut up!" Lilith kicked Jacob to the ground, not used to someone who could fawn more than herself. Then she said, "Like a clown who only knows how to fawn, my brother is already heroic and divine, do you need to flatter him? Go lick the captain, it's not your turn."

"Yes yes yes!" Jacob nodded repeatedly, obediently leaving the command room. Once on the ship it was lawless territory, with no one who could oppose Merlin, this young master could previously be arrogant, now could only tuck his tail and behave.

Merlin turned around, stroking his little beard, calmly saying, "Does this outfit look like an experienced old captain? This would make everyone feel at ease."

Puduo Hai smiled, bluntly saying, "You don't look like an old captain, more like a pirate who just changed clothes."

"Shut up Puduo, I don't want you to find fault, I just want you to praise me." Merlin said with a serious face, still wanting to be equated with pirates.

"Puduo Hai don't talk nonsense, how can brother be like a pirate, he's not even as good as a fisherman," Lilith seriously rebutted.

Merlin's face turned black instantly, angry to the point of liver pain from his own pearl.

"Lilith! Now in the captain's name I order you, without my permission you're not allowed to speak, or I'll throw you off the ship to feed the sharks, sfs qing..."

"Hmph! Little electricity brother!" Lilith made a ghost face at Merlin, hugging her arms and not speaking.

"So that's it, you can actually swim啊? How laughable." Leviathan couldn't help but tease, holding the telescope, looking into the distance, occasionally looking at the compass, then comparing with the ruin navigation map.

Merlin is just a nominal captain this trip, not much use, when encountering situations at sea he has to ask Leviathan's opinion.

Truly speaking about navigation experience, it's hard to find any sailor more experienced than the sea demon lord, he's literally a ready-made reliable old captain!

As long as Merlin relies on Leviathan he can steadily reach the gods' ruins location, where are the troublesome sea monsters? When storms come or undiscovered islands appear? It all knows clearly.

"How laughable? Everyone has fields they're not good at, I just don't have the ability to swim." Merlin emphasized, thinking being unable to swim was something unavoidable, in the sky!

"If you really can't swim, then it's too easy for me, I don't even need to use full strength to handle you." Leviathan put down the telescope, saying meaningfully over his shoulder.

"Ah? Can you pay attention to your own situation? You're just a refugee clinging to me, thinking you can handle me is daydreaming!" Merlin sneered, thinking Leviathan was down and out, his tone was still a bit wild, needed to suppress the downward trend.

"I'm not lying, for a land duck like you, it's not too simple, your sword-drawing technique is indeed formidable, not too restricted at sea, I have a kind of method to play..."

Leviathan answered nonchalantly, not like joking, "Also don't call me shorty, in the demon race no one dares call me that. Speaking of generations, I and your mother are from the same era, you should call me Uncle Leviathan, show some respect."

"Can you stop talking? I'm the captain, you're just a slave, can you do your slave's job?" Merlin said haughtily, not caring about talking about generations and status.

"Yeah! Before you were the sea demon lord, now you're just a sea eel, without beside my brother you can't survive!" Lilith imitated her brother, equally haughty.

"So I really hate you two brothers." Leviathan pouted, slowly rolling up the ruin navigation map, really saying-

"After your mother Wei An died, the First Demon Lord Palace almost fell into the Church's control."

"If not for other monarchs lending a hand, you might now be slaves of the Church's prison."

"As for helping you, I was the first monarch to arrive, don't you think you should repay me?"

title: Chapter 2 — Danger Approaches (Bonus Update)
content:
Chapter 2 — Danger Approaches (Bonus Update)

Volume 30 · Chapter 2

Consider this payment for helping you. I am absolutely not my brother's slave.

"Leviathan," Merlin emphasized seriously, continuing, "we only share the same goal, so this is temporary cooperation."

Raising an eyebrow, he picked up Leviathan—this little dwarf—and opened the window to throw him out. "I don't need to cooperate with you on exploring the ruins. You can go to hell."

"Wait, wait, wait—" Leviathan, being lifted, looked panicked. "I admit it's necessary to stick with you. On the journey, you've taken care of us—thank you for everything, I'm very grateful, sorry..."

"Hmph! If you'd been honest earlier, wouldn't that have been enough? Do you still think you're the mighty Demon Lord of the seas?" Merlin sneered, picking up the helpless little Leviathan and putting him back.

Leviathan's face turned red, being lifted around by that brat, feeling deeply humiliated. He silently swore that when he regained his strength, he would swallow Merlin whole!

"Leviathan, you're too soft, my lord. It's not shameful to bow to him." Pudohai said with considerable satisfaction.

"Yeah, losing to my brother too many times, it doesn't matter to me." Lilith looked down at Leviathan with disdain. Such opportunities to look down on a fallen lord were rare.

"You two are so annoying! Why do I have to talk fish with you two? Lucifer III is the Lucifer King—what are you to me? I'm in trouble now, but I'm not some stray cat or dog anyone can push around!" Leviathan retorted with an ugly face.

"You've been sold back and forth like merchandise, and you're wearing women's clothes as a toy. What dignity do you have left?"

Lilith covered her mouth, laughing quietly.

"Forget it! Don't ever mention that again. Otherwise, even if your brother protects you, I won't let you off."

Leviathan said seriously, baring his teeth, still somewhat intimidating.

"My brother is the strongest in the demon race! Scared?" Lilith, relying on Merlin's backing, wasn't afraid of the fallen Leviathan at all. "A tiger with its teeth pulled out is still a tiger?"

"Lilith, say less." Merlin frowned, thinking his luck had brought out the worst in Leviathan—bullying the weak and fearing the strong. Normally, he'd never dare say such things to Leviathan.

"Strongest in the demon race?" Leviathan looked strangely at Merlin. "Hey, Lucifer III, do you think so too?"

"Although I don't want to admit it, my sister is right~" Merlin shook his hair, his fake beard almost falling off.

"I've long heard the young Lucifer King was proud, but I didn't expect it to be this exaggerated. You'll pay for your arrogance." Leviathan's expression became mysterious—hard to imagine Merlin had swollen to this extent?

"Oh? You have your own opinion? Who do you think is the strongest demon?" Merlin looked at the small Leviathan with interest.

"Need to ask? Of course it's Beelzebub, the only surviving first-generation Demon Lord. Its power is immeasurable! Without doubt."

Leviathan spoke seriously, in a very grave tone.

"Only two second-generation Demon Lords could rival it: the Rage Samael, of course only if it could get its own head back, otherwise it's an idiot. The other—your late mother, the proud Vivian. She was a genius among second-generation Demon Lords and should have been able to fight Beelzebub. Too bad she died young..."

"Is that so?" Merlin raised his head, thinking: do other demons rate his mother that highly? This doesn't match the cunning image he usually had.

"Speaking of your mother, didn't you notice anything odd? With your mother's talent, losing to a human 'Hero'—I find that hard to believe. Was that Hero really that strong?" Leviathan asked with doubt.

"That Hero was very strong at the time." Merlin replied calmly.

"Even if that spear-wielding Hero was strong, your mother should have had a way to escape. Dying so simply is too far-fetched. Did your brother look for Vivian's whereabouts?" Leviathan asked suspiciously.

"Of course my brother looked! He sent many demons, but after searching for so long found no results. Could only accept that Mother had passed away!" Lilith answered on Merlin's behalf.

"After His Majesty reclaimed the throne, he sent us to investigate. The facts were clear—Vivian indeed perished in battle against the Spear Hero O'Brian. This was the Elder Council's conclusion." Pudohai replied seriously.

"The Elder Council is completely untrustworthy. Their interests are tangled. If I remember correctly, Vivian was closely connected to the Elder Council before."

Leviathan paused, then repeated his thoughts: "To be blunt, I've long suspected Vivian's death was staged by the Elder Council. Without finding a body, they hastily declared Vivian dead, allowing demon nobles to seize power and try to push your brother aside. Even if you reclaimed Vivian's position, you were still fired. The Elder Council is too hostile toward your brother. Strange~"

"That only shows my family and the Elder Council have a grudge?" Merlin looked at Leviathan. He'd thought of this too, but had no evidence.

"With your mother's personality, she surely had many enemies. But without seeing the body, I won't believe she'd die so easily. Maybe..."

Leviathan squinted his eyes suspiciously, looking around. "That cunning woman is watching us drift along, secretly laughing at us."

Rumble—suddenly the ship shook violently, then quickly stabilized.

Leviathan came to the window, looked through a telescope. Visibly, mist was rising from the sea. He looked at the ruin navigation circle, then the compass, calculating in his mind.

"Seems like we're almost there. The distance to the ruins should be very close!"

"Finally almost there. Glad we didn't encounter anything too troublesome." Merlin's expression relaxed, feeling the journey had been smooth.

"Dangerous sea creatures—I've avoided them all based on experience, except for one."

Leviathan looked through the telescope at the distant mist, thinking maybe the North Sea giant is hiding in the deep ocean below!

"Since we're almost at the destination, let's have a meeting first."

Merlin turned around, thinking of the few mercenaries who had joined suddenly. He felt somewhat uneasy.

"Go bring those mercenaries here. We need to talk."

"Their strength may be useless, but I'm wary of a few of them."

"I don't want to have to watch my back when we meet Kelazen."

Three exploration warships continued approaching the mist.

In the pitch-black, bottomless sea, danger approached silently.

The stench of living creatures woke countless crimson eyes. Huge schools of steel-toothed predatory fish surged toward the ships.

title: Chapter 3 — Show Off
content:
Chapter 3 — Show Off

Volume 30 · Chapter 3

The second of the expedition team’s two warships had stopped here for the last time at Wan Tian.

★Look★ ★at★ ★the★ ★new★ ★chapter★ ★section★ ★on★ ★EZ★ ★reading★ ★book★

Merlin decided to temporarily open up the field and would not change, calling on the people on the ship to unite unanimously, so that they could successfully enter the ruins.

In addition to Merlin and a few others, the expedition team also had a group of mercenaries hired by Ross Liangde.

Being hired by the old man, those mercenaries must not be ordinary people, and they must have secret skills!

Since the mercenaries have no bottom line and only care about their own interests, Merlin was not very at ease with the mercenaries in the team and wanted to talk to them.

Even if the mercenaries didn't plan to go out on a mission and just wanted to survive and collect a low allowance, it didn't matter, as long as they didn't stab you in the back when there was no danger. Merlin didn't plan to target those mercenaries.

Jacob walked into the command room with a smile on his face. "Captain Merlin, I have brought those mercenaries here."

"Shall I let them in?" he asked.

Merlin sat on the chair, turned around, and tidied up his sexy fake beard.

Jacob humbly nodded repeatedly and led the three mercenaries behind him in.

They had different expressions, and their clothes were quite unusual. Their skin was dark, and they wore many bright gold ornaments, full of exotic charm. It looked like they lived in a hot environment, probably from a desert kingdom, the mercenaries of Ptolemy.

The one on the left was a strong man nearly three meters tall, bare-chested, with muscles like iron lumps, tight and firm. His thick arms were as big as water buckets, and he looked very uncoordinated.

He carried a war axe, and every step he took on the ship's deck made a "creaking" sound, which made Jacob heart race and worried that the warship would be pierced by this man.

The one on the right looked light and slender, a young man with his head wrapped and barefoot, with two sickle-like curved knives at his waist, looking like a dangerous guy.

From the young man's walking posture, it could be seen that he was definitely an inexperienced assassin, walking only on his toes, almost leaving no trace on the floor!

The one in the middle had a unique temperament, wearing white clothes, with a slender and graceful figure, and the flat small abdomen exposed was very agile, just like a snake's body!

It's a pity that she wore a light veil, making it impossible to see her true face, but from the aura she exuded, she was undoubtedly the strongest of the three, probably the leader or captain.

The young man glanced around and saw no one else on Merlin now.

"You are the leader of the expedition team, Captain Merlin, right?" he asked.

"Yes, as you can see, I am Captain Merlin. Is there anyone here who looks more like a captain than me?" Merlin spread his hands and deliberately pressed down his thick captain's badge.

The young man pouted and bluntly pointed out, "Real captains have a heavy smell on them, you don't, and even that little guy over there looks more like a captain than you."

"Hmm???" Belitan snorted and smelled himself, thinking, "Do I smell bad?"

"Stop pretending, with your experience, you can't possibly be the captain of a ship. You've been sailing safely for so many days, it's just luck."

The young man frowned. "What luck!

It's because of my brother's wisdom that our team will always be safe! You bunch of ignorant peasants, give me some respect!" Lilith was furious and scolded next to him.

"Yes, how could you rely on luck to be so smooth? Can't you think about it properly?" Pu Xianghai secretly sympathized with Merlin in his heart.

"Then" Belitan was about to speak but hesitated, thinking, "There's no connection between me and Merlin at all, it's all his own merit."

"I admit that I have no sailing experience, but that's not important."

Merlin stood up slowly, adjusted his posture, and put his hands behind his back. "As the leader, I have the ability to protect the safety of the team members, that's enough."

"Captain Merlin is right. I tell you, Captain Merlin is a rare strongman in the world!

As long as he is here, it is absolutely safe! Don't be so aggressive, Captain Merlin is someone who has paid a high price to invite me here, pay attention to your attitude." Jacob gradually became a bit arrogant; he was afraid of Merlin but not of these three mercenaries.

"You are just mercenaries hired to help out, Captain Merlin is the main force of the expedition team. If you continue to speak disrespectfully to Captain Merlin, I will kick you out right now! No money either!"

The three heard that they were going to be kicked out for free labor, and instantly became cold and stared at Jacob's eyes with hostility.

Jacob was originally showing off his authority, but seeing the hostile atmosphere, he quickly hid behind Merlin and trembled with fear.

"Cough!" Merlin coughed lightly and tried to smooth things over, saying that Mr. Jacob didn't mean to withhold their wages, but was just afraid that they would disrupt the internal unity of the expedition team and cause misunderstandings.

The young man glared at Merlin and said coldly, "Since you are the leader personally appointed by that old man Ross Liangde, we will believe that you have real skills and specifically brought us here. What is the matter?"

"If I remember correctly, it's the Wild Dog Mercenary Corps?" Merlin recalled.

"It's the Great Mercenary Corps! Bastard! Coming out of your mouth, it has no dignity at all, it's even a joke!" The young man rolled his eyes and suspected that the other party was not hostile but was mocking his team.

"Oh, the Wild Dog Mercenary Corps, I will remember that." Merlin nodded seriously.

"You, this bastard..."

The young man couldn't help but slowly pull out the curved knife at his waist, but was stopped by his companions, so he had to suppress his anger and pretend not to have heard.

"Are you the captain?" Merlin asked again, feeling that the young man in front of him was about to explode.

"No, my name is Wadier, and the one next to me is Mahamud. We are all subordinates of the captain."

Wadier looked at the woman in the middle wearing light clothes and barefoot, and said seriously, "She is our captain, the Great Mercenary Corps was established by her."

"Oh~, so that's how it is." Merlin nodded, and his figure suddenly disappeared, appearing in front of the barefoot woman with an inexplicable speed.

Even though the woman wore a light veil, one could still see some surprise and fear in her agile eyes!

Merlin stared at the woman's eyes, and the two were very close, almost touching their nose tips.

At first, Wadier and Mahamud were a bit contemptuous of Merlin and didn't take this outsider leader seriously, but Merlin suddenly showed off his skills, which made them secretly sigh, "No wonder Ross Liangde appointed him as the leader!"

Just relying on this strange speed, killing them was like taking something out of a bag!

Chapter 4 — Lamia (Bonus)

Volume 30 · Chapter 4

The mysterious woman smiled slowly. She pulled Chi's hand, the feeling was more than normal; the area was even colder, anyone who saw it seemed like teasing a good woman's... Remnant! "?" The woman wearing a gauze mask, her eyes narrowed, her hand was gripped in Merlin's hand, she dared not move, and she didn't expect the other to be so rude! The agile Mindi Ye and the strong Mahamud barely managed to come back, only then realizing that the team leader Ba Jing was easily 'kidnapped' by Merlin. Merlin's movement speed was beyond imagination, easily surpassing the two's perception, leaving them unable to react at all! As long as Merlin wanted, when they hadn't reacted yet, he could directly kill the unsuspecting enemy with ease. Mindi Ye and Mahajiangde turned back and saw Merlin's rude action, as if he wanted to insult the team leader, and they both flew into a rage! Although they felt the terrifying pressure from Merlin, they still gritted their teeth, picked up their weapons and swung at Merlin, shouting: "Release the team leader! No rudeness!" Wadiye jumped barefoot, drew the curved blade from his waist, the gloomy gold battle aura surged, pressing against Merlin's throat. The sturdy Mahamud was even more furious, raising his great axe to chop, wishing to split Merlin in half; before the axe even fell, the pressure made the whole ship tremble! Just then, as Merlin's life hung in the balance, the mysterious person who had never spoken before raised another slender hand, gesturing for the two companions to stop. Wadiye and Mahamud dared not disobey the order; in panic they immediately stopped, their sharp weapons hovering directly at Merlin's nape! Both of them were uneasy about Merlin, hesitating to lower their weapons, fearing Merlin might suddenly be disloyal to the team leader. "Mmm~, really a healthy foot" Merlin looked at the woman's wheat-colored palm, thick-skinned, lowered his head and kissed it. "Ah! Brother! What are you doing?" Lilis shouted from the other side, feeling her brother was acting a bit shamelessly! Merlin ignored the shouting from that side, raised his head and asked affectionately, "Madam, what's your name?" The mysterious woman smiled faintly, seeing Merlin unexpectedly easy to talk to, she let down some guard and softly answered, "La". "What a good name! It sounds as noble as a desert goddess! Merlin, when he spoke sweet nothings, didn't diminish for a hundred years; he glanced at the two tiger-eyed figures behind him, "Lamia Fu Chi, I mean no harm, can I possibly let your subordinates calm down a bit? Honestly, I don't like being pointed at with weapons." "You two behave; this Captain Merlin is not an enemy." Lamia sized up Merlin; although her face was veiled in white gauze, one could still see a hint of slyness in her eyes; "And her whole body still exudes a hint of a good man's aura; I've rarely seen such a charming man." "What nonsense! Shameless! I'll teach you a lesson!" Lilis rolled up her sleeves, ready to go tear Lamia's mouth apart, thinking that face would definitely be ugly monster! "Lilis, calm down, calm down! We're just talking about things!" Pudohai tightly gripped Lilis's leg, not letting go, fearing he'd ruin Merlin's affair. "That dark-skinned woman is really thick-skinned! She's just a rotten rag! Let go of me!" Lilis, flustered, danced on the spot, baring her teeth. "Actually, you guys coming here isn't a big deal; I just don't quite understand your stance." Merlin paused, seeing Wadiye and Mahamud behind him lower their weapons, the atmosphere slightly eased, "We're about to reach the ruins' location; I suppose the fog ahead will be more dangerous; only our team can possibly succeed in entering the ruins; after all, the difficulties we'll face ahead, I will bear great pressure; I don't want anyone scheming behind our backs." "I see, Captain's earlier worry was that we might use something behind his back; this concern is completely unnecessary; we mercenaries take money to do work, it's normal; Mr. Luo Duan Childe Ba Jing had already advanced a large sum of money." Lamia answered calmly. "But I've heard that you mercenaries have no team底限, no contract spirit at all, and there are many cases of backing out on payment." Merlin glanced at the three mercenaries, feigning sincerity, "Of course I'm not saying you're untrustworthy; it's just that such things happen too often; I need to guard against it; you could just take the small boat and leave now, the money will still be paid; I don't expect you to help much in the expedition." "Team? Or are we leaving? Are you so afraid I'll stab you in the back? You timid mouse-like creatures." Mindi Ye sneered; Mahajiangde apparently couldn't speak, just punched his own chest to express dissatisfaction, glaring fiercely at Merlin. "Captain, you needn't worry about this; we won't be disloyal to you; besides, this is the God's Tomb Ruins, countless people want to go inside to see what's there; no treasure hunter can resist this temptation." Lamia said softly. "Treasure hunter zone? ? ?" Merlin frowned, suspicious; "This has been my hobby, just like you, we also wish to enter various ruins; this aspiration is not weaker than yours; therefore we share the same standard; why would we be unfavorable to you, Captain?" Lamia countered, expressing her stance. "If you sincerely help, I will naturally welcome you; but plainly speaking, if you have any disloyal actions, I will immediately kill Merlin with icy words, staring at the three of you, as a warning." Lamia did not answer, recalling Merlin's unimaginable speed just now, indeed she had the capability to do so. After Jacob took Lamia and the three mercenaries away, Merlin couldn't help but sit alone by the field, lost in thought, as if some question had entangled him. Lilis couldn't hold back and began to vent her temper, accusing the elder brother of being a philanderer, "Brother really has no self-respect at all; any random fling could make you run! Big piglet!", "Your Majesty is not like that; Miss Lilis, calm down; it's clearly that female servant who lowered the Majesty's status!" Pudohai comforted from the side. Leviathan saw Merlin had no response, curiously approached and asked, "What's wrong? You look troubled; do you have some deal with those three mercenaries?" "Deep field." Merlin shook his head, feeling quite curious about Lamia just now; not because he liked that woman, nor because he cared much about her, but because he sensed some danger! Actually, when Merlin first saw Lamia, his heart already sensed a clue— Lamia vaguely had the same chilling aura as Dracula? It seemed not just a coincidence that she shared the name with the three original vampire ancestors.

who left with a smug air of triumph——

“Hmph! You’re nothing special.

If you still give your father some face, he might look up to you?” Vadiye sneered, glancing at Jacob with contempt, and slammed the door shut.

Jacob’s face turned ugly, his temples throbbed, “The poorer you are, the more arrogant you become. Four mercenaries dare to ride on my head? Hmph! Let’s see!”

After Vadiye returned to the room, he saw Raya standing by the window,

looking into the distance at the thick fog.

“Master, that human captain is too arrogant in the middle of nowhere, disrespectful to you. Should we get rid of him?”

“Class? I’ve lived this long

and this is the first time I’ve seen a human who can get so close to demons.” Raya

Raya slowly turned around, her eyes filled with confusion.

“Demon?” Vadiye felt a sense of doubt, not understanding what Raya meant.

The strong Mahmud muttered under his breath.

“In the room just now, only that Mr. Jacob was human; the others were not. We are blood族, the other four are demons.”

Raya’s eyes were filled with a faint blood-red hue.

“Oh! Is that so?”

Vadiye didn’t realize

that upon hearing Raya’s explanation, his heart suddenly dropped.

“Your perception is too poor, Captain. The following areas all have faint demonic auras.

Although that guy named Merlin’s aura is weak and easy to detect, he was called ‘brother’ by the demons, so he must have used some method to hide his demonic aura.” Raya explained meaningfully, thinking to herself that Vadiye’s assistant was really careless and reckless. The helpers he brought were not a single human; all were non-humans with malicious intentions.

“So that’s it.

No wonder the other person’s attitude was so bad. It’s no surprise that the demon was a蛮狼 (barbaric wolf).” Vadiye nodded. If the demons were polite, it would be strange.

“I didn’t expect to encounter such evil demons on this trip. This journey seems more interesting than I imagined.”

Raya’s tone became more expectant, and it seemed she had a good opinion of Merlin.

“Master, those demons are aggressive and seem to be hostile to us. Should we strike first?”

Vadiye’s expression became fierce. “There’s no need to do that yet, Vadiye. Haven’t you forgotten our mission?”

Raya asked with a smile that wasn’t a smile.

“I haven’t forgotten, Master. You said True Heng would wake up, and in order to reclaim the power of the wind, he would kill all blood族. Before True Heng awakens us, we need to find a way to defeat him!” Vadiye said seriously, feeling the immense pressure from these three vampires. This wasn’t just an expedition to explore ruins, but a quest to find a way to fight against the true ancestor Cain!

“That’s right. I vaguely feel that I’m being targeted, and it’s probably too late.” Raya paused, her tone firm. “She will stand before me and take back everything she gave us!”

“Since True Heng is so dangerous, we should first find the other two ancestors and unite to fight against him.” Vadiye sincerely suggested.

Do you think the three vampires who inherited Cain’s power, as ancestors, could unite and possibly find a way to confront the true ancestor Cain?

“It’s useless. I already sent people to contact the remnants of the Dehula clan, but unfortunately they’re already a lost cause, useless. Dehula was killed by an adventurer named Alice, and that’s probably why the true ancestor sealed in the holy bottle was able to awaken.”

Raya shook her head and sighed, “As for that coward Bartoli, I don’t even know where he’s hiding. Such a weak person couldn’t possibly help out. Maybe he’s already been killed by Cain.”

“Oh! So, Master, you are the last surviving ancestor!

Vadiye’s expression became worried, his brows furrowed. “This isn’t a good omen. We don’t have much time left.”

“Kill the true ancestor!

Mahmud was emotional, waving his staff and expressing his feelings in simple words.

“You two don’t need to worry like this. We haven’t reached a point of no return yet.” Raya warmly approached the two men, speaking softly. “We joined the ruins expedition not just for wealth, but to find powerful artifacts or treasures. Only then can we have a chance to defeat True Heng. As the burial ground of the gods, what lies within is unknown, but maybe we can find a way to counter Cain.”

Vadiye and Mahmud both knelt down, expressing their absolute loyalty to Raya.

“We will definitely fight alongside you until the very end!”

Raya silently looked at her two loyal subordinates, a hint of darkness flashing in her eyes. “You were originally humans, turned into bloodthirsty monsters by me. Aren’t you resentful of me?”

“Resentful! I and Mahmud were originally wandering thieves, sentenced to death for stealing treasures from the Ptolemaic dynasty. If it weren’t for Master’s rescue, our heads would have been cut off long ago!”

Vadiye had no regrets; on the contrary, he thought being a blood族 was a good thing.

“We are loyal to you, Raya. Mahmud, though not good at words, still bowed deeply to express his awe of Raya.

“It’s so good, unlike when we first met Cain. We were all very resentful of this evil power, wanting to atone for it with our lives.” Raya recalled the night a thousand years ago, when Dehula and herself were dominated by bloodlust, their lips stained with the blood of the village, and the last remnants of humanity struggled within the bloodlust.

“This is an immortal body, an immortal power. How can it be resented?” Vadiye asked in confusion, not understanding.

“Because you’re no longer human, you have to prey on humans, and become bloodthirsty monsters, like a gazelle suddenly expelled from the herd, losing all sense of belonging and having to face danger alone.” Raya lowered her head, looking at her bloodless hands.

“Master, you specifically rescued me and Mahmud from the arena. Wasn’t it because you saw potential in us?”

Vadiye’s expression showed some disappointment.

“Yes, because I felt lonely, and I saw that you two pitiful creatures were doomed to die, so I couldn’t help but bite you.”

Raya turned to Vadiye and Mahmud, saying calmly——

“I didn’t have any expectations for you; I just wanted some companions to keep me company—that’s all.”

content:
Chapter 6 — Powerful Reinforcements Against the Enemy

Volume 30 · Chapter 6

Challra initially thought that establishing a vampire kingdom might be the right choice. If the vampires were numerous enough, they could become a large group similar to the other races, and even if they were considered monsters, they would have many allies. Lamia paused and looked at the two loyal subordinates in front of her. "You have been a vampire for a long time, and you have not yet realized the situation we are in. Eventually, you will feel the hostility of the world, and the great loneliness will drive you crazy. I hope you can understand my selfishness." (??ω?? ?) Wadie was moved to tears and could not find the words to respond to Lamia. "I did not save you, but I put you into another hell. Do not have any expectations of me." Lamia's tone had a hint of sadness. No matter how large the world is, there is no place for you to live. Perhaps only a pool can understand the feeling. Challra, who wanted to establish the "Empire of the Night," and Bartoli, who tried to blend into the world, both used their own methods to escape the hostility of the world. Lamia did not adopt such an extreme method. She walked alone for countless nights, and eventually, there were only two vampire subordinates beside her. "When I established the mercenary team, I did not intend to change myself, but I just wanted to find something to do, so that I could act like a normal human." "You have us! Me and Mahamud will accompany you to the end, even if it is against the Archfiend, we will fight to the death! Our lives are owed to you, and we are already prepared to return them to you!" Wadie was sincere, placing his hand on his chest and swearing. Mahamud nodded heavily and agreed with Wadie's words. Lamia looked at the two loyal subordinates and felt a little better. "To fight the Archfiend, we need a lot of preparation. Perhaps there are unexpected things in the God's Ruins." "How should we deal with those few demons?" Wadie asked curiously. "It is easy to enter the God's Ruins, and they need us, and we also need them. Temporary cooperation can avoid many dangers." Lamia did not intend to make Merlin angry, but she thought that those few demons were useful. "After successfully entering the ruins, we will deal with them as we go." (??ω?? ?) The news that demons had landed on the coast of Portria spread throughout the kingdom. Even if Elizabeth intended to conceal the truth, the war had already begun, and no method could conceal it. The nobles throughout the land were restless and wrote letters to the palace constantly, but they did not receive any response from the queen. Although Elizabeth had predicted that the Mammon army would land from somewhere and had prepared for it, she did not expect that the Mammon army would be so fast! Suddenly, an attack was launched in one night! On the palace, Elizabeth sat on the throne and listened to Chapman's report of the current situation without any expression. The guards had not slept for a night and had dark circles under their eyes, constantly thinking about how to deal with the next step. "When the fortress was being built halfway, the Mammon army suddenly came and broke through the defense line. Our preparation was not sufficient, and we could not resist the main force of the demons, so we had to choose strategic retreat and save our forces." Chapman knelt with one knee and had a slightly serious expression. "I failed to complete your mission and issued a retreat order. These are all my responsibilities. Please, Your Majesty, punish me." Elizabeth took a deep breath and forced a smile. "You did nothing wrong. It was the Mammon army's main force. You could not have resisted them. I was surprised by how fast their actions were. If the construction of the Portria military defense line had been supervised earlier, it would have been this result. I also have the same responsibility." Chapman remained silent for a while, secretly relaxed his facial expression, and then said seriously, "Now the Mammon army has not stopped its steps, but is advancing towards the capital. The villages and towns along the way have been almost annihilated, and a large number of people have fled north. With the current strength of the enemy, the capital can be reached within two weeks!" Elizabeth's face became even worse. The enemy's desire and determination to occupy Britain were obvious, and there was no room for negotiation. This was the rhythm of the country's annihilation. To have the same fate as the previous kingdom, that was just luck! "Your Majesty must think of a way. If this continues, the demons will come here soon. This is not a civil war, but a war against the demons. It will not be merciful to anyone, not even a child. Chapman's eyebrows were like a knot, and his heart had never been so worried. Katherine stood quietly beside Elizabeth and shared her feelings. "Your Majesty, we have very few people left. Morrison and Craddock have perished. Meryn's condition is very bad. Should I be sent to resist the Mammon army?" "Your structural magic is not good at active combat, right?" Elizabeth asked calmly. "Yes, but I can try to resist the invasion of the demons as much as possible." Katherine answered firmly. "If you have to send me, it means that we are at the brink of death." Elizabeth forced a smile. "Don't worry, we haven't lost yet. There is someone more suitable than you." "No" Katherine hesitated and then spoke out. "Earlkin Daugh?" Chapman's ears twitched, and immediately, he seemed to be full of blood. "Yes! There is Earlkin Daugh! He must be here!" Katherine's face showed a hint of dissatisfaction that was difficult to notice. She did not like this lawless swordsman from the bottom of her heart. "Because of him, all the knights feel embarrassed." "Now is the time to argue. I have already borrowed Earlkin Daugh's favor. If possible, I do not want to rely on his power. It is a double-edged sword. Although it is sharp, it may also injure oneself. My courage is for me to set an example." As the queen, Elizabeth still feared Merlin. Such a terrifying strong man roaming in the kingdom would make everyone feel uneasy. It is the best to actively seek him. "If you do not seek Earlkin Daugh's help, what else is there?" Chapman clenched his fist and was in a state of anxiety. "There is! ?Your Majesty, you still have" Katherine's face changed instantly, and she thought of a man who was not willing to mention. "Is it asking for the help of the fourth thorn knight, the necromancer Sollo?" "I do not approve of you doing this. He is a man who is twice as dangerous as Earlkin Daugh!" (??ω?? ?) Recently, I have been involved in some disputes, so I have been distracted from updating. However, these things have passed, and I do not want to mention them again. I will resume updating, and there will be more chapters.

A magnetic male voice came from outside, the Grand Master of the Temple Knights, Barres.

slowly walked in from the side. For the sake of seeing the Queen, his hair was combed meticulously, lacking the frivolous and carefree temperament.

Now the sea route has been blocked by demons. Mamen occupies the Black Sea Strait, and the Holy Church finds it difficult to send reinforcements to help.

So Barres, who was wandering outside, was entrusted with the task of becoming a strong ally for Britain against the demon race.

The Holy Church has always been the demon race's archenemy, and anyone who can fight against the demon race is indispensable to them.

Barres, as one of the two Grand Masters of the Temple Knights, has extensive experience in dealing with demons

and is a pioneer in the fight against dark forces.

Although Barres is not as strong as the former Hero, he is stronger than the current mediocre pseudo-heroes by at least half!

Barres stopped, looking at Elizabeth without any expression. Even though he was tired, he still had the charm of two beautiful ladies.

Catherine was very sensitive, and from Barres' eyes she could tell that he was another greedy and lustful man. His eyes were full of desire when looking at the Queen.

"Who are you?"

"I am a knight sent by the Pope to support Her Majesty the Queen."

9 sf light

Barres proudly introduced himself, bowing slightly to Elizabeth. Not forgetting to look around with a mischievous smile, his eyes frequently wandered over the Queen's full chest.

Elizabeth's expression was somewhat displeased, but Barres was a strong ally sent by the Church, and such impolite behavior was forgivable.

"This Barres is the Grand Master of the Temple Knights. Now the sea route has been blocked by demons. Barres happened to be in Britain on a mission and didn't leave, so he became a strong ally to support us from the Church."

"Oh? Barres? Temple Knight Catherine

looked at Barres with suspicion. Her first impression of him was very bad. How could such a guy with a lustful face be a noble knight? Or was he a holy priest serving the goddess?"

"Barres, you made Her Majesty rush to the capital overnight. It must have been tiring. We have suffered a surprise attack and heavy losses, and now we need your strength."

Elizabeth smiled politely, warmly saying, "We are all children of the Goddess of Light, and the Holy Church is the goddess's messenger.

When we are invaded by demons, we hope the Holy Church can come to our aid."

"What you said is correct. The great goddess will bless every race. Her light will illuminate every corner. But you don't need to say these empty words. I know the Holy Church very well. Most of you rulers of the kingdom are not devout believers of the goddess."

Barres smiled meaningfully, not being fooled by Elizabeth's fake smile. "Put away your disrespectful words."

Catherine frowned, showing some hostility.

"The beautiful knightly country, calm down. Our church provides free assistance to various kingdoms only because we have foresight and know that dark creatures who practice evil are the greatest threat to all mankind. As knights of the goddess, we must protect all mankind as our mission."

Barres paused, continuing, "However, our church's free assistance, although it does not require any money, does have conditions. Her Majesty may not know about it."

"What conditions?" Elizabeth put away her smile, thinking that asking for help from EZ Reading was indeed not that simple.

"Accept the Pope's baptism and become a believer of the Light Church. Only then can the church give its all to help. I think Your Majesty also understands. There are so many races in the world. The great goddess cannot take care of everyone. She will definitely prioritize her own believers."

Barres smiled, like a street preacher, tirelessly promoting the scriptures. "We are all children of the Goddess of Light, and the Holy Church is the goddess's messenger. When we are invaded by demons, we hope the Holy Church can come to our aid."

"Are you joking? Your Majesty doesn't need to overthrow the king and become a believer of the Dark Church. This is just white-lining and wolfing. It's amazing!"

Catherine scolded loudly. "That's right! You priests, you always talk a good game, portraying yourselves as saviors. But you're still greedy and insatiable. You don't care about money, but you're after the kingdom's treasures!"

Chapman next to her couldn't bear to watch. The Queen becoming a believer of the Dark Church was also letting the kingdom give up everything.

Elizabeth's face turned black and she didn't speak, understanding the other party's intention. If she didn't agree, the Holy Church would not give its all, maybe it would only provide minimal assistance.

Now that Mamen's army was invading, Elizabeth was under enormous pressure. To get help she had to convert to the church, which was not a good deal for any ruler.

Accepting baptism and becoming a devout believer meant that all the believer's property belonged to the church. Elizabeth was afraid she couldn't make this decision.

But Barres was not in a hurry, thinking it was not difficult at all. And then he changed the subject, "I'm not such a rigid person. I'm just a priest, but also a knight. Protecting beautiful women is my duty. Even if Your Majesty doesn't want to be baptized and become a believer, I still want to serve you."

"Do you want to?" Elizabeth didn't think Barres was a high-minded person. He must have already made a plan.

"If I help you repel the invading demon army, I want your kiss—a deep and passionate one."
