He's just well-known in the informant circles because he's very approachable and has outstanding intelligence-gathering abilities. People call him Thick-Skinned Old Huo. It seems quite a few big shots are his customers, secretly buying information from him, and the prices are not cheap!"

"Thick-Skinned Old Huo?" Lochly lowered his head and pondered, never having heard of this name before.

"Master isn't familiar with it. In the informant circles, it's hard for secrets to exist. For safety, you must contact them through secure channels, and you can only use nicknames to address each other — never revealing your real names or identities. This group is a mixed bag, full of all kinds of people. Using money to pry open their mouths is the rule." The messy-haired pirate explained, feeling it was normal that Lochly didn't understand. Even he couldn't access the core areas of the informants. Informants were a profession that made a living selling other people's secrets, and everyone cherished their own lives dearly.

"Is that so? This informant is quite interesting. Pay close attention to him. To be able to obtain demon race information so accurately, this person's methods are extraordinary." A strong interest rose in Lochly's heart, and he said slowly, "If possible, ask him if he knows anything about the great swordmaster Elgin? This informant and the great swordmaster both live in Britain, so there should be some inside information."

"I understand. I'll find time to ask." The messy-haired pirate bowed slightly, deciding to continue contacting that informant in Rexham.

"We've arrived, right? Quickly find a concealed place to sneak onto the island. I've already sharpened my blade. Once I'm up there, one slash per demon brat. I've never killed a demon before, so I don't know what it feels like yet." The filthy pirate showed a hint of fanaticism, already unable to wait to begin the plunder.

"Don't be in such a hurry. The wealth of the Third Demon Lord Palace is ours to take, but not by finding a hidden place — we'll land from the front where the demons are stationed." Lochly's tone was not joking.

"Huh? Master, are you serious? Landing from the front will run into大量 demons. There will definitely be fierce conflict. Although our sailors are all brave and skilled, facing demons they'll inevitably be terrified. Many people will be sacrificed." The filthy pirate didn't understand at all. Not taking the safer route but insisting on clashing head-on with the enemy — this didn't match Lochly's usual style.

"Everyone knows that the Greed Demon Lord possesses大量 treasure, and to this day no one seems to have successfully taken advantage of him. This shows that this demon lord is meticulous and cunning to a certain degree." Lochly paused, and based on rumors, analyzed Mammon's character almost completely, deciding to adopt an unconventional strategy. "We are not the first to set our sights on the Greed Demon Lord. Ordinary people would definitely choose the safe strategy, bypassing the demon-stationed areas and finding an easier place to land."

"Even things you can think of, how could that demon lord not think of them? I'm afraid the easier places to land are even more dangerous, with ambushes already set up."

"Conversely, the position where the demons are stationed looks very dangerous, but it could very well be the easiest place to land. Everything is the cunning demon lord's trick."

"Now that the Third Demon Lord Palace is in a period of weak defense, the Greed Demon Lord knows this very well. He deliberately places the defending demons in conspicuous positions, luring invaders to walk into already-set ambushes to their deaths."

"This method of annihilating invaders without lifting a finger is exactly what fits the image of that cunning demon lord."

"Notify all pirates to prepare. After approaching the Demon Lord Palace to within one nautical mile, all jump into the sea and quietly swim ashore."

"We'll eliminate the demons stationed along the coastline from the front, then take out the Third Demon Lord Palace. The most dangerous approach is, without a doubt, the shortcut to success."

title: Chapter 31 — Unable to Capture After a Prolonged Siege
content:
Chapter 31 — Unable to Capture After a Prolonged Siege

Volume 31 · Chapter 31

In fact, the defensive strength of the Third Demon Lord Palace is indeed weak at this moment. In order to win this war, Mammon has practically put all of his assets on the line.
The demons stationed on the island number only about a thousand. To put it bluntly, if the Holy Church were to send a large army to attack now, the Third Demon Lord Palace would surely fall.
On the beach at night, two demons are keeping watch, one stout and one thin, grilling fish and drinking by the bonfire, taking the chance to relax a bit since no superior is watching.
“I heard His Majesty has already occupied a large part of Britain. The royal capital has already been taken?” asked the thin demon soldier.
“Yes, in just two weeks we crushed Britain’s royal power, the human queen fled in disgrace, and now the British kingdom is a scattered mess, already counted as part of our Third Demon Lord Palace’s territory. A defeated king will completely lose the people’s hearts and find it hard to launch another large‑scale rebellion. I heard His Majesty has begun reorganizing the army and will soon attack Wales, meaning he intends to exterminate the human queen. Before long, all of Britain’s land will fall under His Majesty’s control.” The stout demon took a swig of strong liquor; standing guard in the cold night, he really needed this drink.
“Those demons who fought must be having a blast in the human royal palace, unlike us poor souls stuck here on night watch.” The thin demon soldier sighed.
“Actually, the demons left behind are the most dangerous. I’m really afraid the Holy Church will come to subjugate us; with our numbers we can’t possibly hold them off. Doesn’t His Majesty fear that his home will be stolen?” said the strong demon soldier, worried.
“That’s right.”
The thin demon soldier raised his head, half a sentence stuck in his throat, eyes wide with shock.
Behind his companion, a soaking‑wet figure appeared, a cold‑glinting dagger already pressed against the companion’s neck! The thin demon soldier was about to shout, but suddenly felt a chill at his neck—needless to say, he too had been seized. The two demons on watch were both captured by pirates; in the night sea breeze, the dagger’s cold seeped through their bodies. “You…”
“Do pirates need to tell you who they are?”
The two pirates covered the demons’ mouths, simultaneously slit the throats of the watch soldiers, quietly laid down the corpses, their movements practiced and utterly silent.
The filthy demon wiped the blood‑stained dagger on his clothes, spat at the demon corpse, and said, “Damn! The church’s bunch of stubborn donkeys keep preaching how terrifying demons are, yet killing a demon is no different from killing a human—really boring.”
“Keep it down, let the main force come.” The messy demon took off his own shirt to shield the bonfire from the sea; after doing this three times— a large number of pirates began landing, black shadows thick as swarms appeared, estimated to be nearly two thousand strong.
◇
Under Luoqili’s command, the pirates launched a sudden assault on the stationed demons; flames rose in the camp and battle cries shook the heavens. At first the pirates feared the demons, but as demon soldiers kept falling, their courage grew.
Timid demons screamed and fled the camp, only to be wiped out by the outer pirates; the whole camp fell under the pirates’ encirclement. The demons guarding the camp were nearly slaughtered to a man—yet something strange happened—
The pirates had overwhelming superiority, yet they still couldn’t completely take the camp. Luoqili’s two pirate subordinates kept receiving no word of victory.
Even though over a thousand pirates were sent in, not a single one returned to report. Although the demon camp was shrouded in firelight, venturing there now felt like walking into extreme danger—pirates could go in but never come out.
With no other choice, the two subordinates had to report the situation to Luoqili and see how to handle it; the pirates no longer dared to rashly charge into the camp.
When Luoqili arrived and saw the camp completely surrounded, he thought the demons should have been defeated by now, so why was the assault stalled?
?
“Sir, what’s going on inside? At first things went smoothly, but then the sailors who rushed in to fight vanished—no one came back alive. There’s definitely something wrong inside the camp!” said the messy pirate cautiously.
“Even a thousand men can’t take it; there must be a tough opponent inside, and not a weak one.” Luoqili sensed something off, realizing from the start he might have been outmaneuvered by Mammon. “I underestimated that greedy Demon Lord; I never thought he’d be so upright as to set an ambush in such an obvious spot.”
“What does that mean?” the messy pirate asked, already a bit confused.
“Stay here and don’t let any escaping demon get away. I’ll go in myself to have a look.” Luoqili intended to enter the camp to investigate, to see what monster had slaughtered over a thousand pirates.
“You’re going in yourself? No way! It’s too dangerous! The pirates who charged in all died in there!” said the filthy pirate, displeased.
“Yeah, let us go with you to see who killed our brothers!” the messy pirate also urged from the side. “Don’t worry, I’m not the same as before—not just anyone can win against these eyes.” Luoqili pointed at his cloth‑covered eyes, then continued, “Besides, we need manpower to quickly move the Demon Lord’s wealth; we’d better avoid any more casualties.”
The pirates looked at Luoqili’s blindfolded eyes and felt a strange certainty; many had personally witnessed the power of those eyes. “This…” the messy pirate hesitated, then drew a flintlock from his bosom and a pouch of shot, handing them to Luoqili personally. “Sir, take this. You don’t know magic or martial arts—this simple gun will suit you. In a critical moment it might save your life. No matter what, as soon as we hear a shot, we’ll rush right in.”
“All right.” Luoqili took the gun, tucked the shot into his pocket, and walked alone into the burning camp◇
Luoqili, with his eyes covered, walked through the burning demon camp, mercilessly trampling over corpses on the ground.
Most of the corpses were demons, with fewer pirates, showing that the initial pirate charge had gone berserk and they held absolute advantage. As Luoqili moved toward the camp’s center, more and more pirate corpses appeared, piled thickly, dying in miserable heaps on the ground.
Luoqili stopped, having discovered why the camp couldn’t be taken. Before him—
Was a small hill made of stacked pirate corpses; atop it sat a demon calmly, bones exposed on its black body, the hairline among its red hair sharp and beautiful.
It trembled slightly, the membrane wings on its back fluttering like a cape, carefully wiping its sword. This calm demeanor was utterly out of place amid the surrounding mountain of corpses and sea of blood.
“Just as His Majesty expected, those who dare to attack the Demon Lord Palace at a time like this are desperate gamblers who will never follow common sense.”
“If you had landed from a safe place, you’d face no danger and could reach the Demon Lord Palace smoothly, but landing head‑on will bring you up against me…”

title: Chapter 32 — Trample (Monthly Ticket Extra)
content:
Chapter 32 — Trample (Monthly Ticket Extra)

Volume 31 · Chapter 32

Logi outwardly remained calm, though inwardly he marveled at how Mammon had already out-calculated him. Even more terrifying was that, from the moment the surprise attack began, every move the pirate crew made had fallen precisely within the Demon Lord's expectations. He looked at the demon and asked, "The Wrathful King has already marched out. Are you the cadre responsible for guarding the Demon Lord Palace?"

"That's right. I am Phucas, one of His Majesty Mammon's personal guards." Phucas introduced his name. As a personal guard, his status was roughly equal to Oze near Mammon, making him an absolute confidant at the Demon Lord's side. The fact that the home palace was entrusted to him to guard set his standing in Mammon's eyes far apart from ordinary demonic cadres. "Are you a blind cripple? Were those pirates outside scared senseless? Sending you in alone... how pitiful."

"No, I am the commander of the pirates. The raid on the Third Demon Lord Palace was my idea." Logi boldly confessed he was the mastermind. "Oh?" Phucas glanced at Logi a few more times, speaking with deep meaning. "To be honest, I expected it most. That bunch of bastards from the Holy Church are the most likely to seize this opportunity to strike. But I never in my dreams imagined a band of lowly pirates would have the nerve to provoke us. As the leader of a ragtag group, you barely qualify."

"Without a certain amount of courage, one could never acquire wealth quickly. We are not the only ones who have been eyeing your Third Demon Lord Palace." Logi attempted to sow panic in his opponent.

"It doesn't matter. No matter how many come, they all die. No one can take anything from His Majesty Mammon, not even a single gold coin. This rule will never be broken." Phucas showed absolutely no fear. Even if the Holy Church marched with a massive army, they would all die here.

"The Demon Lord Palace's defenses are riddled with holes. You're quite confident~" Logi smiled, but inwardly grew concerned. Why wasn't this demonic cadre the slightest bit flustered? Was the seemingly full-of-flaws Demon Lord Palace already laid out with an inescapable net?

"Hmph! You're the one full of confidence, aren't you? As the commander of a pirate crew, yet you show no trace of magic power or fighting spirit. You're clearly an ordinary person. Having the nerve to appear before me — do you want to die that badly?!"

Phucas suddenly spun the sharp sword in his hand, raising a ferocious gale of wind that whizzed past Logi's ears in quick succession. The bandages binding his eyes were severed outright.

Logi's legs went weak, and he instantly dropped to his knees, shivering all over, as if completely paralyzed by Phucas's pressure.

Seeing Logi so cowardly — merely Phucas releasing a hint of his aura and the man fell to his knees in terror — Phucas instantly felt deeply bored. "A useless creature like you, how did you become pirate commander?"

"Burn me, I yield! I surrender!" Logi grabbed both hands full of blood-stained dirt and offered them forward, his tone thick with humiliation. "We are just a pirate crew on the verge of dissolution. We wanted to rebuild our strength by raiding the Third Demon Lord Palace, which is why we plotted something so reckless. I've paid the price for my foolishness. The demon race has warriors like you — how could we possibly win? I have deeply reflected on my mistakes. I beg you to show mercy and let us go!"

Receiving praise from an enemy gradually lowered Phucas's guard. An opponent who could be killed with a mere breeze was indeed not worth taking seriously.

"Unfortunately, all pirates who invade will die here. You vile, contemptible humans, attempting to make a grab for the Demon Lord Palace — only death can atone for your sins."

"Isn't there even a sliver of mercy to offer?" Logi said in a pained tone. "I sincerely apologize to you. Eyes are the windows to the soul — you can see it for yourself in my gaze."

"Hmm?"

Phucas shot Logi a cold glance, yet that single look could be fatal in an instant. Those eyes radiating eerie, otherworldly power were as dangerous as the most lethal venomous serpent.

Phucas suddenly felt his left arm grow heavy. It began rapidly petrifying, the stone spreading across his entire body at a rate visible to the naked eye. "W-what is this?!"

"Since you won't offer any way out, then I'll send you to hell instead. You arrogant demons, spouting 'despicable humans' from morning to night — you ought to reflect on yourselves." Logi smiled as he stood up, watching Phucas turn into an "artwork" before his eyes.

"You despicable human! How dare you?!"

Phucas watched his petrifying body with heart pounding. His own power couldn't resist the petrification at all? So Phucas steeled himself and swung his sharp sword at his own arm, trying to stop himself from becoming a statue. Bang —

A gunshot rang out. The bullet accurately struck the sword in Phucas's hand, knocking it from his grip and halting his action.

Logi held the flintlock pistol, white smoke hissing from the muzzle. His expression was cold as he said flatly, "I won't give you the chance. Behave and turn into a statue. Remember to strike a good pose."

"You human!!!"

Phucas's face twisted in agony, cursing and roaring at Logi. He regretted not killing this despicable bastard sooner. An ordinary person yet possessing such bizarre power!

He frantically reached both hands toward his enemy, but his legs had already petrified and could not move. In the end, he became a grotesque statue. Logi approached Phucas's statue and examined the demon cadre's expression in his final moments, offering a calm evaluation — "Demons. How ugly."

◆

With a thunderous roar, the explosion shook the entire Third Demon Lord Palace. The pirates blew open the palace's main doors using gunpowder barrels. Over a hundred fierce-looking pirates, led by Logi, charged into the main hall of the Demon Lord Palace —

Mammon's Demon Lord Palace was exceedingly lavish, far surpassing the other Demon Lords by several tiers. The red carpet beneath their feet was impossibly soft, obviously top-grade merchandise.

The surrounding walls were carved with intricate patterns, further intensifying the hall's opulence — even more magnificent than a human king's palace! And most notably, a fountain stood there with a solid gold statue atop it, an exact likeness of Mammon, looking astonishingly lifelike.

At the highest point of the steps sat an imposing golden Demon Lord throne, upon which rested a suit of pitch-black demonic armor.

The moment the pirates caught sight of the armored figure seated upon the throne, their souls nearly fled their bodies. Their faces drained of color as they hurriedly cried out, "Young master, run! It's the Demon Lord! The Demon Lord hasn't left! He's still here!"

"Everyone, stay calm."

Logi rewrapped his eyes, yet could still perceive many things. Without the slightest panic, he raised his pistol and fired straight at the armored figure on the throne.

Thud. The helmet of the demonic armor was shot clean off, clattering to the ground. Only then did the pirates realize the armor was empty inside — there was no Demon Lord whatsoever. A false alarm.

Logi blew the thick smoke from his gun barrel, a triumphant smile spreading across his face. Medusa's eyes turned out to be surprisingly useful — they could even see through certain things. His control over these eyes was growing ever more adept —

"So even now you don't forget psychological warfare, staging a ruse to frighten off invaders with an empty shell?"

"The Greed Demon Lord Mammon is indeed a cunning ruler..."

title: Chapter 33 — The Sneaking Mouse
content:
Chapter 33 — The Sneaking Mouse

Volume 31 · Chapter 33

The dirty pirates circled the fountain in the center of the hall, their eyes flashing with greed, “This greedy Demon Lord is so rich, he made a pure gold statue of himself—how much gold does that take?”
“I never thought the greedy Demon Lord would be so extravagant—isn’t he just a dead fatso? Look at that belly, it’s practically dripping with oil~” The disheveled pirate also critiqued him from the side.
“Alright, we’ll move the gold statue later and send someone to search the back—since this is the greedy Demon Lord’s lair, there should be plenty more good stuff.” Lochiri thought to himself, estimating that Mammon’s accumulated wealth must be enormous.
The pirates began searching the Demon Lord Palace, leaving no corner unchecked, even prying up the floor tiles to look.
In order to clean out the Demon Lord Palace’s wealth, this band of pirates intended to loot the place clean, not leaving a single gold coin for Mammon.
“Young master! We’ve found a treasure vault behind the main hall, filled with vast amounts of gold, silver, jewels, and many divine weapons—the quality looks extremely high, and there’s so much we can’t even count them.”
Hearing the pirate’s report, Lochiri nodded in satisfaction; it matched exactly what he had imagined.
As expected of the wealthiest Demon Lord among the demon race, the riches inside the Demon Lord Palace alone already surpass the treasury of a human empire! “Hahaha! Just as I expected, our Red Beard Pirates have taken a bite of an unprecedentedly fat prize!”
Lochiri couldn’t help but wear a satisfied smile, praising his wise decision—with the wealth of the Third Demon Lord Palace, he would forge the strongest pirate crew in history, bringing him one step closer to avenging himself against the Elf Kingdom’s Sword Master Elgin.
“We’ve basically gone from a bird gun to a cannon now—everyone can get a divine weapon, and the ship’s old cannons can be swapped for magic cannons—how exciting!” The dirty pirate’s face lit up with excitement, finally bidding farewell to a life of hiding and scrambling.
“Hahaha, with the wealth of the Third Demon Lord Palace backing us, we can go head‑to‑head with the navies of several kingdoms—from now on the seas will be the territory of our Red Beard Pirates, and everyone will have to pay tolls!” The disheveled pirate had already begun plotting the crew’s future development.
Oh? If you’re not careful, a mouse will sneak into the house…
Suddenly a strange voice echoed above the pirates’ heads; they looked up to see the empty demon armor on the throne beginning to sway back and forth.
It stepped toward the dais, picked up the heavy helmet that had just fallen to the floor, brushed off the dust, and placed it back on its head, then regarded the pirates with its hollow, nonexistent eyes.
“Fukas didn’t even stop you? I’m truly surprised—when did pirates dare to challenge me?”
“According to my guess, the first to attack should have been the Holy Church, but I never expected you lot—vultures that live off rotting meat—to have even more gall than those Church fellows.”
“You ought to have heard that no one can take my wealth without paying a price; if you have the guts to aim at me, you must also be prepared to die.”
Seeing the heavy armor move on its own without anyone controlling it, the pirates were struck with terror—one exclaimed they’d seen a ghost! Many began to slowly retreat, faces ashen, bodies trembling, and a fearful atmosphere began to spread.
From what it said, it must be the master of the Third Demon Lord Palace, the greedy Demon Lord Mammon!
This left the pirates unfamiliar with demons feeling doubtful—could it be that Demon Lords have no physical form and are only able to possess objects?
“Young master! What’s going on?” the disheveled pirate whispered, asking if Mammon were still inside the Demon Lord Palace, they couldn’t hesitate—fleeing would be the best choice.
“I’m not entirely sure either…” Lochiri’s face fell; he thought his own eyes could indeed see the emptiness inside the demon armor, and logically a Demon Lord could not possibly appear here.
Through the demon armor substitute, Mammon, far away in the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, could clearly see the situation here: “Don’t be afraid, aren’t you brave enough? Come on—if you defeat me, all this wealth is yours.”
“You think we don’t dare?” Lochiri gritted his teeth, a bead of cold sweat sliding down his forehead; he was certain the figure before him wasn’t the real Mammon, so there was a chance to defeat it.
“No matter if you’re a demon or a ghost—die, old man!” The dirty pirate, ever brave, roared as he shoved the powder keg toward the Mammon substitute. The keg wasn’t just filled with ordinary black powder; it was also mixed with a powder that suppresses magic and fighting spirit.
It’s made of the same material as the shackles used to forge seals that bind magic and fighting spirit; ground into powder and mixed into the black powder. Upon detonation, it can instantly turn warriors and mages into ordinary people, severely suppressing their power.
Former members of the Dark Guild had once tried to use this method to kill Merlin and Alice, but unfortunately it never succeeded.
When the powder keg rolled to the feet of the demon armor, Lochiri contemplated raising his handgun, thinking rapidly—does it not even bother to dodge? Or does it truly see us as weak little mice, or perhaps it’s hiding some trump card?
Either way, it shouldn’t expect the keg to contain magic‑ and spirit‑suppressing powder—this is our winning trump card! After the explosion, no matter how strong the opponent, if they can’t use martial techniques or magic, they’ll face our gang‑up. Besides, this guy definitely isn’t the real Demon Lord, so there’s nothing to fear.
Who says an ant can’t bite down an elephant? Today I’m going to try it.
“Bang!” The gunshot rang out, the bullet struck the powder keg dead on, and the hall was instantly engulfed in flames from the blast. Mammon’s golden statue swayed in the explosion’s force before crashing to the ground.
The blast lasted three seconds; thick smoke filled the air, leaving the pirates shaken, and no one dared step forward to check whether the Demon Lord was still alive.
“He must be dead, right?” the dirty pirate ventured, thinking that even a Saint‑tier powerhouse would be blown to bits, especially when their magic and fighting spirit were suppressed, making them fragile.
“Everyone, grab your weapons and stay on guard!” Lochiri ordered sternly, believing according to his guess that the enemy wasn’t dead.
As expected, from the rolling smoke the demon armor emerged, its steps heavy, its body completely unscathed—the blast’s force couldn’t damage this substitute.
However, Mammon could feel that the demon armor had become much heavier, clearly noticing something off with the powder keg just now—he was under some kind of restraint.
The demon armor clenched its now‑heavy hands a few times, let out a series of laughs, and spoke to the pirates in a mocking tone—“Poor pirates, you’ve even learned to play little tricks?”
“I don’t even need to use any magic or martial techniques to deal with you.”
“You’re overestimating yourselves.”

title: Chapter 35 — Contact
content:
Chapter 35 — Contact

Volume 31 · Chapter 35

A single leap caused massive casualties among the pirates, who were gripped by deep fear. Their faces contorted, and some even dropped their weapons to flee outside the Demon King’s Palace.

This was the King of the Demon Race. Initially, they had a lucky mentality that they could get rich, but now that their illusion had been shattered, where would they dare to plot against the Demon King? Mephistopheles didn’t need to use magic or martial arts to deal with these pirates who tried to steal his wealth. The demon armor substitute itself possessed considerable power, and killing pirates was no different from killing chickens.

“Uhh!” Lochri gasped in shock, feeling his life threatened. Why was this empty shell so powerful without using any techniques?

“Want to run? It’s too late.” The demon armor grabbed the struggling Lochri and pressed him to the ground by the neck, his eyes filled with ferocity. “You’re the leader? So young. Being able to tame this group of desperate pirates, what kind of skills do you have…”

“Shout!” Lochri realized that struggling was useless and couldn’t escape the other’s suppression. He quickly tore off the blindfold and shouted, “Look at my eyes, Demon King!”

Medusa’s eyes emitted otherworldly power, capable of petrifying both body and soul!

1

The demon armor bathed in the petrifying light trembled slightly, but was not affected at all and did not become petrified.

“I’m looking at you, so what?”

“What!!”

Lochri’s eyes were filled with panic. The power he had worked so hard to obtain was useless against the Demon King. Why wasn’t he petrified?

Was it because this empty shell wasn’t the Demon King’s true body?

Petrifying power could only affect the true body of a living being; indirectly driven life would not be affected!

Lochri’s heart instantly cooled in half. He realized the fatal flaw of his eyes. He was still the same useless person who relied on cheating to survive. The magicians could kill him just by manipulating puppets!

The demon armor grabbed Lochri’s chin, lifted his head, and stared intently at his snake-like eyes. “Your eyes seem to possess some kind of mysterious power?”

“Did you use it to kill my subordinates?”

“Interesting. Come to me, and let me study you…”◇

The sky ship was sailing steadily, and they were close to their destination. They were planning to return to the Rothschild family’s territory, an island in the center of the Mediterranean.

Merlin sat lazily on the ground, looking at the torn cloth they had found in the ruins. The simplified Chinese characters on it had been soaked by seawater and were difficult to recognize.

Pudom jumped down from the mast, quickly took out “Merlin’s Records,” and eagerly asked, “Your Majesty, you are currently applying for melancholy. What are you thinking about?”

“Uhh…” Merlin snapped out of his trance, shook his head, and said, “Nothing. Put away what you wrote. Every time I see it, it makes me feel inexplicably annoyed.”

“Hey, hey,” Pudom smiled and put away “Merlin’s Records,” saying seriously, “It’s very necessary to leave some records about you for future generations. After all, you are the youngest Demon King, and many people will want to end you in the future.”

“Not needed,” Merlin said, frowning, looking at the torn cloth, and tentatively asking, “Who do you think wrote this?”

“This…” Pudom looked at the torn cloth and fell into deep thought. Now that he was quiet, he could think of more things. “Although I’m not sure, I have a guess. If no one else has entered the ruins since the Twilight of the Gods, then this was probably written by the Prophet. It’s highly likely.”

“The Prophet again?”

Merlin’s expression became puzzled. Was the Demon Prophet also a time traveler, like himself, but a few epochs earlier?

This was a big discovery. He didn’t know what the Demon Prophet’s character was like. From the information that had been passed down, he only knew that the Prophet had done several groundbreaking things.

He cut down the World Tree, slaughtered the ancient gods, sealed the creator of demons, ended the rule of the old era’s ancient gods, and laid the foundation for the future prosperity of the demon race.

These things combined could only mean that the Demon Prophet had a certain foresight and seemed no different from the great figures in history. Merlin was concerned that the Prophet was a time traveler. Two time travelers existing at the same time were like being in a dark forest. If one was discovered, they would inevitably be attacked.

“But Your Majesty, you can recognize the characters on it, which surprises me. I don’t know what the Prophet was thinking. Why didn’t he use the demon language but instead used strange square characters? If Your Majesty weren’t here, who could understand what was written?” Pudom scratched his head, unable to understand why the Demon Prophet would do such a mysterious thing. Even if it was to remind future generations to leave the dangerous ruins quickly, he wouldn’t have made it so difficult to understand.

Merlin heard Pudom’s question and was shocked. His eyes, which were looking at the torn cloth, became even more terrified. “Of course! Why write in simplified Chinese? Who was it written for?”

Did the Prophet know that the person who would open the black box tens of thousands of years later would be a time traveler who could read simplified Chinese? If the original inhabitant had opened the black box, it would have been meaningless!

Could it be that the Demon Prophet left it for me to see? To remind me that the stone statues would kill me and to make me leave quickly! Merlin thought more and more, and his back was covered in cold sweat. He felt his insignificance in the long river of history, as if everything was within someone’s calculations and arrangements.

He had realized that the Demon Prophet, who was also a time traveler like himself, possessed terrifying abilities. He must have “foreseen” that Merlin would enter the ruins a few epochs later.

This kind of precise “foreknowledge” that could see tens of thousands of years into the future was something Merlin had never heard of, and it was much stronger than his own swordsmanship.

Merlin let out a long breath and temporarily believed that the Prophet was not his enemy. If he hadn’t been reminded of the danger of the stone statues in the ruins, everyone would have died silently like Vadiye. This could be considered the Prophet’s kindness to Merlin, not wanting him to die inside.

“Pudom, you know more about the Demon Prophet than I do. Do you think he is dead?”

“I’m not sure. I only know that after the end of the Gods’ Era, the Prophet mysteriously disappeared without leaving any trace.” Pudom paused, then said mysteriously, “But if the Prophet is really dead, I have a bold guess.”

“What guess?” Merlin asked curiously.

“The First Lucifer greatly revered the Prophet. When he was dying, he chose to enter the Valley of Despair alone. I believe there must be an unspeakable secret here.” Pudom shook his head and expressed his speculation, “It’s possible that the First Lucifer wanted to be buried with the Prophet before he died, or to see the Prophet one last time before he died. These two possibilities exist…”

“Uhh!” Merlin was shocked again. His heart seemed to be struck by a heavy hammer. He recalled the events of his youth. “I wonder…”

“I have met the Prophet.”
<<<END SOURCE>>>

title: Chapter 35 — Arrival
content:
Chapter 35 — Arrival

Volume 31 · Chapter 35

No one said anything, I just really wanted to see this sage, Merlin said, calming himself down and concealing his previous words. The mysterious man hed seen before involved a curse on the heart, and absolutely must not let too many people know.

Your Majesty is actually interested in the sage? I am so relieved. The great sage has a profound influence on the demon race. You must be able to learn something from it. It is a pity that the era is too long gone, and the sage s deeds are impossible to look into. Pudom shook his head helplessly.

Memories of youth were a bit distant, and Merlin could only recall the general idea, not recall too many details.

Although he could not be 100% certain that the man he encountered in the cave was the demon race sage, he was absolutely certain it was not the first Lucifer. Because he remembered very clearly, that man had no demon king s chair arm, and it was impossible for him to be a normal demon.

This does match some records of demon race sages, "a human claiming to be a demon"

Plus appearing in the Death Valley. This place is the territory of the First Demon Lord Palace, and it was impossible for a human to enter so casually. A series of clues seemed to be silently confirming Merlin s guess, but there was no conclusive evidence.

Speaking of which, I almost forgot. During the period when Your Majesty was in trouble as a youth, did you not enter the Despair Valley? You are the only one who could alive return from the valley, you must know what it is like inside, right? Pudom suddenly recalled the youthful matters. At that time, Merlin was still a young prince of the royal family who had just fallen into trouble.

Inside... Merlin carefully recalled and said seriously. Inside it is indeed very dangerous; a slight mishap and you will lose your life.

Did you see the sage? Even if there are just traces... Pudom asked eagerly.

Sorry, this matter happened too long ago, and I a bit vague about it. Merlin answered vaguely. After waking up, that mysterious man was gone. I once sent people to search the entire Death Swamp, but I never found that man who cursed me, as if he had evaporated on the spot.

Is that so? Too bad. Could my guess be wrong? If the sage is not in the Despair Valley, why did the first Lucifer choose that place as his burial site? Pudom fell into thought, unable to figure out the reason.

Merlin fell silent. He had already confirmed that the demon race sage was a traveler like himself, and possessed precognition abilities. It was just that he could not determine what this person, who influenced several epochs of later generations, was thinking? It seemed he could not fully trust him. On the other side, Lilith was swaying before Leviathan, suddenly assuming a victor s posture, and said haughtily—Cough cough!

Leviathan, you are still alive and kicking, thanks to my brother taking care of you. Otherwise, you would have long become Ma men s prisoner, or food for the North Sea Giant Leviathan.

Remember to keep gratitude in your heart for my brother. This is not free help. In the future, you will have to repay it, understand?

"Hmm? Leviathan heard it a bit irritated, his fierce eyes glanced at Lilith, not liking a noisy guy jumping around in front of him.

"Mm!

Facing the current Leviathan, Lilith instinctively felt fear. The restored Leviathan is "Demon King," without restored strength is "little dwarf." But Leviathan possessing truly Demon King-level strength as a monarch, Lilith who could only barely serve as acting Demon King by clinging to her brother s thigh, there was no comparability.

Lilith quickly hid behind Merlin, staring at Leviathan with hostile eyes, constantly whispering.

Brother! This guy actually glared at me ferociously! Help me discipline it, give it some color to look at! Don t let this little dwarf ride on top of our Routephill family s head!

Merlin coldly did not speak, thinking that when he was not around, Lilith was also like this? sooner or later it will establish an enemy for the Demon Lord Palace!

Blast it! I really hate you siblings, living carefree on the foundation left by Vivian, too comfortable. Leviathan paused, and slowly said, No wonder after losing Vivian s protection, you almost lost the entire Demon Lord Palace. If you still do not know to reflect, history will surely repeat itself.

Ha... Merlin dryly laughed, thinking that Leviathan still had prejudice against himself and Lilith. Surely it had once been despised by the first generation Demon Kings. Indeed, small lineage is easily belittled wherever it is.

Leviathan, your strength is indeed amazing. That knife that killed the Kraken is even stronger than what you displayed before us initially. Although you are still young, you are more than capable of serving as Demon King. It is a pity that your attitude is too unlikable.

What do you mean? Merlin looked at Leviathan, seeing its attitude, it seemed there was something to say to yourself.

Your First Demon Lord Palace, is completely isolated, right? Is there anyone who is your friend? Leviathan asked tentatively.

This... Merlin carefully thought about it. Even Asmodeus had fallen out over some issues, it seems the situation is indeed one of isolation. There is no, I just know, Leviathan you are too self-centered, this is not a good thing. The Elder Council represents the will of most demons, it will restrict us from running wild. If you do not look at the Elders expressions, you will inevitably suffer exclusion. The demon race s interior is not something that can thrive just with great power. Those who eat well are often demons adept at reading the situation. If you want to return to the demon race, you should appropriately show goodwill toward the Elder Council.

Hold on, I am not living for those Elder Council guys. After being exiled, not smashing the Elder Council is my biggest constraint. Merlin frowned, using an tone, "Trying to trip me up? Impossible.

Just! My brother gives the Elder Council some face, otherwise early on he would have cut off the tongues of those meddling Elders! Lilith very much appreciated her brother s attitude of fighting to the end against the old oil bags.

Truly a waste of effort Leviathan sighed, some doubt in his heart. What benefits does Merlin have from mixing outside? Does he really not want to return to the demon race at all?

The airship shook slightly, beginning to descend slowly. Jacob, who was holding the rudder at the pilot s seat, shouted—

Merlin Lord! We will arrive soon! The airship is just convenient, returning is exactly five days faster than coming!

Merlin looked at Leviathan, asking, Just a moment away. Are you planning to find trouble with Ma men?

Certainly. Leviathan answered with an affirmative tone, The pain I suffered, that bastard must also taste it.

title: Chapter 36 — Exploration Team Returns
content:
Chapter 36 — Exploration Team Returns

Volume 31 · Chapter 36

"Mammon isn't strong, what's troublesome is the divine artifact in his hands, the demon sword Tyrfing." Leviathan recalled this divine weapon, feeling extremely headache, he had suffered greatly from it! Excluding all equipment factors, among the demon lords' own strength, Mammon was the weakest. Rather than saying it was about defeating Mammon, it was about defeating the demon sword Tyrfing.

"Need help?" Merlin asked with a meaningful smile.

"Would you be willing to help me?" Leviathan asked tentatively in return. If Merlin was willing to assist him in retaking the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, then he wouldn't need to fear Mammon's demon sword.

Although Merlin really wanted to go home quickly to see his precious daughter Chris, Mammon's intention to launch an expansionist war outward probably wouldn't be easy to give up.

"Why not."

"What's the condition? I don't think you're someone who likes meddling in others' affairs." Leviathan felt somewhat uneasy in his heart.

"You and I are both conservatives who support the strategy of holding ground. Mammon's actions have already begun to threaten the stability of the demon race. Is that reason enough?" Merlin answered.

"You won't even return to the First Demon Lord Palace, care a damn about demon race stability." Leviathan paused, lowered his voice and said, "You're afraid that Mammon's expansion will squeeze your survival space in the human realm, right? The more humans fear and guard against demons, the more dangerous guys like you wandering outside will become."

Merlin's expression was awkward, neither affirming nor denying, just smiling slightly, "Whatever you think is fine."

◇

At the pilot seat of the airship, Jacob was ostensibly turning the helm honestly, but his eyes kept glancing toward Merlin's side.

At this moment his mood was very excited. Having gone through nine deaths and one life, he finally returned to his hometown. Even the cool sea breeze was sweet! Finally he could hide far away from these demons, and was about to return to the comfortable days surrounded by servants. He could no longer hide the smile on his face.

Jacob's gains from this trip were acceptable. Although he hadn't seen the precious sealing stones at all, the ancient spirits, goblin manufacturing blueprints, swords and armor used by the ancestors, etc., were all considerable wealth.

Although these things looked like useless trash and weren't worth much, with Jacob's merchant son's mind, he realized that the spirits, blueprints, and armor contained the technology of the ancient ancestors, which was priceless!

Especially the airship under his feet, something that even a mountain of gold couldn't buy. Jacob thought it would change everyone's mode of travel and become the greatest transportation tool of this era.

If Jacob's plan in his heart could succeed, his achievements would rise with the tide, not much inferior to his father Rothschild, and completely shedding the hat of "first treasure son" was imminent.

Jacob had already seen below the airship, a large number of traveling merchants gathered, all staring at the slowly descending airship about to dock at the port. Most traveling merchants were well-traveled, but flying ships were still unheard of. After the惊叹, they discussed it below. Jacob was stared at by countless merchants, his mood was extremely happy. After landing, he decided to boast well. He subconsciously looked over and saw Leviathan staring at him with a wary eye, immediately getting scared.

"What are you looking at sneakily? Human." Leviathan suddenly asked, seeing Jacob was a bit too excited, worried if he'd speak recklessly after landing, considering almost everyone on the ship was demons, only himself being human.

"I-I wasn't looking at anything, hahaha..."

Jacob laughed dryly, cold sweat kept flowing from his forehead. In his heart he thought, this short guy was actually a demon lord. At first when he didn't know, he had even touched its thing. This absolutely couldn't be let known, otherwise he would definitely die!

Merlin suddenly came to Jacob's side, with an innocent smile on his face, patted his shoulder, scaring him all over. "Merlin-sama, is there something?"

"Jacob, you're also a smart person. After landing, what should be said and what shouldn't, do you understand?" Merlin said in a meaningful tone.

"Uh..."

Jacob looked behind him at Pudom and Lilith. Both had disguised themselves, hiding their demonic features, staring at him with unkind eyes.

His hair stood on end, nervously swallowing saliva. No wonder the demons suddenly showed hostility toward him. It turned out they were worried he'd speak recklessly, exposing their identities.

Jacob, understanding the reason, immediately cleared his throat, his expression becoming serious, looking at Merlin to show his loyalty.

"Don't worry, Merlin-sama. Your identities, I absolutely won't reveal a single word. I won't even tell my father. This matter will go to my grave with me."

"If you dare to talk too much, you're dead!" Lilith threatened viciously.

"Not just yourself, your family will also be implicated." Pudom added beside.

"I-I won't betray you, I swear by my soul!" Jacob raised his hand, thinking to himself how he could make these demons believe him.

"Good, good. As long as you behave yourself, nothing will happen." Merlin's face was smiling, but his tone became quite stern, "After all, people who don't behave are basically already dead. No matter where they escape, it's useless."

"I understand." Jacob trembled, scared by Merlin to the point of having no color on his face. He took out the "Angel" ring from his bosom, "This... this is what I found on the ship. I wonder if it's yours, Merlin-sama?"

Merlin took back the ring without courtesy, nodded at Jacob, and said in a low voice, "That's right. I never bully honest people."

◇

"How does this ship fly? It doesn't seem to use wind as power, too amazing!"

"The craftsmanship and materials are strange. I've never seen such light wood, and the sturdiness seems no worse at all." "Young Master Jacob, where did you get this? Will you sell it? Name your price?"

Merchants from all over the world gathered at the port, gazing at this magical airship from afar. Even many wealthy merchants wanted to buy it. Only seeing Jacob, full of pride, surrounded by merchants, his nose almost up to the sky, enjoying the feeling of being the moon surrounded by stars.

"Want to buy? Impossible! This thing is priceless. I got it with my life. You all are witnesses to history today. This ship will become the greatest new transportation tool in human history."

Jacob only boasted about himself, but absolutely wouldn't introduce more information about the airship. The plan to visit the ruins of the gods to seek treasure was also secret.

As the treasure that the world dreams of, most people wouldn't believe that inside was a barren desert, let alone believe that the Rothschild family only got one ship so simply.

To avoid unnecessary trouble, Rothschild had repeatedly warned Jacob, absolutely not to leak the plan to explore the ruins of the gods.

"This idiot is getting swollen, floating up?" Lilith didn't look at Jacob favorably.

"Yeah, what do you mean 'got it with my life'? Besides firing the magic cannons a few times, I couldn't help at all." Pudom nodded in agreement beside.

"Hah, let him be. Actually those few times firing the cannons was quite key." Merlin smiled, his gaze seeing a team coming from afar—Rothschild, who had received the message, leading guards to welcome the group.

title: Chapter 37 — Taking Sides (Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 37 — Taking Sides (Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter)

Volume 31 · Chapter 37

"What do you want then?" Merlin looked at his sister, the God-Conferring Stone he had obtained, its value far surpassing that sky ship.
"This ship is so convenient, you can get anywhere quickly; why not take it back to the Demon Lord Palace? Then I could come see you from time to time~" Lilith thought to herself.
Merlin's heart gave a thump; he had originally been thinking of coaxing Lilith back, but if he had the sky ship, wouldn't she often come to bother him? "No, I already made an agreement with Mr. Rothschild; he also gets a share of the profits from the relics. There's nothing more suitable than this sky ship—this is a deal I personally agreed to. You wouldn't want me to break the rules, would you?"
"Shout!" Lilith huffed and fell silent, feeling that Jacob had gotten off easy.
Rothschild led his guards over, and upon reaching Merlin, the elderly man bowed slightly to show respect. "Welcome back, Mr. Merlin, thank you for your tremendous help in the expedition to the Gods' Relics."
"Although the road was a bit rough, it was still a success. However, you'd better not have too high expectations; the Gods' Relics are not as the rumors say, filled with treasures everywhere. In reality, it's barren, with hardly anything useful." Merlin explained the situation.
Rothschild saw the airship docked at the harbor; its strange design made it clear it didn't belong to this human era.
Hearing Merlin's words, Rothschild still felt a bit disappointed; he had occasionally imagined Merlin would bring back several shiploads of treasure, but reality was stark.
Still, it's better than bringing back nothing at all, and besides, this peculiarly shaped ship comes from the Gods' Relics—it might have enormous intrinsic value.
"It's fine as long as you return safely. Besides, Jacob, that spoiled brat, has never seen big winds or waves; being able to endure hardships with you is valuable life experience. Has he offended you? If so, I'll apologize on his behalf."
"It's nothing, your son..." Merlin watched the proudly grinning Jacob, recalling his crucial role, and commented, "Not bad; if he hadn't grown up in a wealthy, influential family, he would surely be a genius at operating the magic cannon~"
"Hahaha, Mr. Merlin, you flatter me; this kid is just an outsider, only briefly obsessed with magic cannons as a child." Rothschild relaxed a bit; if Jacob offended Merlin, he'd break his son's leg to apologize, and he still hopes to maintain a friendly relationship with someone as powerful as Merlin.
"Brother, I'm hungry; let's go eat. Eating fish every day on the ship now makes me want to vomit at the smell..." Lilith tugged at Merlin's sleeve from behind.
"That... actually I..." Podum looked embarrassed.
"Mr. Merlin, please take your friends to Jewel City for a meal; I have already arranged for the servants to prepare a lavish feast."
Rothschild had already made all the arrangements; everyone was delighted, after such a long journey they felt exhausted, and nothing was more appealing than a big meal.
Just as Merlin and his party were preparing to head to Jewel City, Rothschild suddenly remembered something and hurriedly called out to Merlin—"Mr. Merlin, wait a moment; while you were away, someone came looking for you, seemingly with an urgent matter?"
"Who's looking for me?" Merlin frowned, wondering if it could be Alice, since he'd been away so long and was uneasy. Rothschild recalled, "He said he's your fellow townsman, seems to be called Xiu." He continued, "Since he's your friend, I've already arranged for him to stay in Jewel City."
"Xiu!?" Podum immediately knew who it was—one of Merlin's demon generals, serving as the demon race's intelligence officer, who had chased after Merlin; could there be an emergency?
"Why is everyone coming over now?" Lilith puffed her cheeks in annoyance, not pleased that Xiu had also shown up, especially since neither she nor her brother were present, leaving the Demon Lord Palace short-staffed.
"Xiu, who is he? Your subordinate?" Leviathan asked quietly.
"Well, he's my intelligence officer; if it weren't an extremely urgent matter, he wouldn't be so eager to see me." Merlin's brows furrowed, a vague bad feeling rising—
Recalling this intelligence officer of his, every time he made an anxious report, it was seldom good news◇
In a certain room in Jewel City, Xiu sat quietly in a chair, examining the latest intelligence that had been delivered.
Normally he never wanders around Jewel City; instead he stays quietly in his room, glaring at the servants bringing meals, and whenever someone visits he only opens a tiny crack in the door.
Because Xiu's demonic traits are too obvious—his white-furred goat face is easily noticed—he avoids trouble by confining himself to his own room.
Looking at the latest secret report delivered to him, Xiu's face grew grimmer; the situation had reached an uncontrollable point, with the entire demon race abandoning the defensive strategies devised by the first Demon Lords and instead becoming enthusiastic about war.
Among the seven Demon Lord Palaces, it seems only the First Demon Lord Palace and the Sixth Demon Lord Palace controlled by Mammon show no inclination to prepare for war, while the other palaces have begun mobilizing their armies—showing a tendency eager to launch a full-scale holy war.
Mammon's victorious opening act is like a shot of adrenaline, causing the long-repressed demon race to erupt, with vast numbers of demons swept up in the fervor brought by war.
Xiu burned the secret report, sighed deeply, and thought: the smoother things go for Mammon, the more perilous the demon race's situation becomes; he urgently wishes to meet Merlin to report these circumstances.
Dong dong dong—
The knocking sounded, and Xiu immediately went on alert, pulling his hat and scarf up to conceal his appearance and demonic traits before cautiously opening the door.
Creak—the door opened a crack, and Xiu said in a very cautious tone, "Is it the servant? I said tonight no meals should be sent; did you forget?"
Seeing Xiu so careful, Merlin laughed and pushed the door open directly, saying, "It's me, Xiu—long time no see, hahaha." "Uh!"
Xiu stared wide-eyed in shock, seeing that everyone outside were demons, even the recently missing Jealous Monarch Leviathan. He blankly watched Merlin suddenly appear, wondering what had recently happened to the unclean? Why was he together with the missing Leviathan? Xiu never imagined he would encounter two Demon Lords at once; he quickly dropped to one knee, expressing his respect to Merlin.
"Your Majesty, I have finally seen you!"
"Get up, this isn't the Demon Lord Palace; no need for these troublesome formalities." Merlin helped Xiu to his feet and got straight to the point: "You're so eager to find me—has something major happened?"
"Exactly." Xiu put on a stern face, his expression serious, and spoke concisely—
"The demon race is in grave trouble; the situation is dire, and you need to consider which side you will take."

title: Chapter 38 — Choice
content:
Chapter 38 — Choice

Volume 31 · Chapter 38

Xiu told everything about recent internal demon affairs and Mammon's external crusade, trying to let Merlin and Leviathan understand the current situation. The group that just returned didn't even have time to eat, and after listening carefully to Xiu's report for over half an hour, they barely grasped the situation inside the demon realm and in Britain.

"Has the situation already become this bad?"

Merlin fell into thought, learning that Mammon's great army had already captured the British royal capital, and the next step would be straight to Wales—

Alice and Chris are in Rexham, which is a small town in the Wales region—hasn't the war already reached their doorstep?

Even with the capital's combined forces, they couldn't stop Mammon's army; the Duke of Jiangwei in Wales probably couldn't hold them either, at best only able to delay for a while.

I don't know whether Alice can actually take good care of Chris; if this continues, my precious daughter might be threatened.

Merlin suddenly got a headache, being away from Alice and his daughter, he must find a way to make Mammon withdraw troops and stop the external expansion war."Yes, it's really terrible. Originally the Council of Elders didn't agree with Mammon's actions, but in just two weeks they changed their minds. Now," Xiu paused, then said seriously, "Mammon has already been hailed as a hero of the demon race, the spiritual leader leading demons to resist human oppression—how absurd…

"What on earth is he doing? Mammon violated the defensive strategy set by the first Demon Lords; it's rule-breaking—what kind of hero is that?" Pudom thought this was utterly unbelievable, as if a clown were enjoying applause on an opera stage?

"Exactly! Mammon, this rule‑breaker, should be locked away in the Sealing Demon Vessel! He deserves punishment!" Lilith emphasized angrily.

Although that's correct, Mammon has tied his own interests to those of the entire demon race, been pushed forward as leader by the radical faction in the Council of Elders, and that makes sense." Xiu said in a helpless tone.

"Why are the elders of the Council so cowardly! Shouldn't they stop Mammon's crazy actions? Could it be that all the elders have been bribed by Mammon?" Leviathan angrily slammed the table; the situation now is basically treating him as a sacrifice—how could he not be angry?

"The elders weren't bribed; rather, Mammon's victories in the British kingdom were too tempting. Imagine a herd of pigs occupying vast resources—could the hungry wolves inside the demon realm stay unmoved? When they discover that humans without heavenly protection are no match for Mammon's iron hooves, even the last bit of vigilance most demons retain will vanish, and they'll only think about how to divide up humanity's fertile lands." Xiu let out a sigh; greed is a flaw of all beings, demons included.

"How could this happen!?" Leviathan clenched his fists; after full‑scale war begins, the only option is victory—if they lose, the demon race will have no future, as Mammon has dragged the entire demon race onto the gambling table.

"What are the other demon lords doing? Isn't the advice of the demon lord monarchs in the Council of Elders highly influential? Surely there isn't not a single one stepping forward to stop this?" Merlin felt the situation had developed to an absurd degree; if any demon lord opposed, it wouldn't have come to this.

"Asmodeus, Beelzebub, and Samael, the three monarchs, initially opposed and demanded the Council of Elders immediately punish Mammon, but Belial suddenly appeared, halted the trial of Mammon, and, claiming his identity as a first‑generation demon lord, publicly declared that the defensive strategy set down is unsuitable for the present age, Mammon's external expansion is not wrong, and reviving the glory of the demon age is exactly the right time." Xiu lowered his head, speaking with deep meaning, "Belial participated in the Holy War as a first‑generation demon lord; Your Majesty should know how much influence he has in the Council of Elders. Since he overturned the demon race's defensive strategy, many neutral elders have defected to Mammon, and with Mammon's gains in Britain, those three monarchs also wavered, beginning to tally troops in their own territories, preparing for full‑scale expansion."

"Heaven's taste…" Merlin rubbed his forehead, are all demons afraid that if they're a step late they'll miss out on the meat? And what is that old guy Belial scheming?!

"Whoa! That old thing Belial, throwing his weight around in the Council of Elders." Leviathan grew angrier the more he thought, stood up, "Did Mammon just get away with killing my subordinates and seizing my territory? No way! I'll make that bastard pay!"

"Lord Leviathan, please stay calm. If you now go looking for trouble with Mammon, the Council of Elders will see you as an obstacle to the revival and charge you with treason at worst—this is no small matter." Xiu kindly reminded from the side.

"What? You mean I can't even return to my own home? Unbelievable! The Council of Elders is bullying people too much!" Leviathan's forehead veins bulged; he wished he could storm the Council of Elders and eat those elders who support Mammon.

"—" Seeing Leviathan's bad mood, Xiu turned to ask Merlin, "Your Majesty, what do you think now? You have two options before you."

"One is to join Mammon's forces, return now to the First Demon Lord Palace to prepare troops, and during Mammon's assault on Wales, seize first all northern regions of the British kingdom."

"The other is to oppose the Council of Elders, drive back Mammon's army; as long as Mammon's expansion plan fails, it will surely strike a blow at the radicals' arrogance and pour a bucket of cold water on all demons to calm them down."

"However, the second path is very dangerous—you wouldn't just be opposing the Council of Elders, but the entire demon race. With your current exiled status being awkward, if discovered you risk execution."

"This—" Merlin became hesitant, his feelings wavering, wondering whether he should be the guardian of the first demon lords or ally with Mammon to share the spoils.

"Brother, even though Mammon isn't a good thing, let's just do it together! It feels fine." Lilyth thought she could join the war effort, expand the First Demon Lord Palace's territory, enslave many humans, so by then her brother wouldn't have to leave the Demon Lord Palace? Capturing strong humans to raise like pigs—wouldn't slaughtering one be delightfully satisfying~

"Your Majesty, I also don't advise you to oppose the Council of Elders and go against the whole demon race—that's too crazy. Although I have no doubt you possess this strength, the Council of Elders has the Sealing Demon Vessel, which is unbeatable. Back then they ruthlessly expelled you; now they would ruthlessly kill you." Pudom's worried suggestion: truly making the whole demon race your enemy would mean civil war, with the First Demon Lord Palace and the Sixth Demon Lord Palace joining forces against the other demon lords—outcome uncertain.

Xiu placed both hands on the table, solemnly asking, "Your Majesty, have you decided yet?"

title: Chapter 39 — The Road of Resistance (Month Ticket Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 39 — The Road of Resistance (Month Ticket Bonus Chapter)

Volume 31 · Chapter 39

The Leviathan walking ahead suddenly turned around and asked, "Is Mammon still in my Sixth Demon Lord Palace? Is this news absolutely certain?"
"Yes, Lord Leviathan, please rest assured, the source of the news is reliable. Mammon, besides dealing with the Kingdom of Britain, also has to guard the Strait of Messina to prevent the Holy Church or other kingdoms from supporting Britain," Xiu answered seriously.
"Alright." Leviathan turned his head to look at Merlin and emphasized, "I am not a mount; I absolutely will not allow anyone to ride on my back. On the way to the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, you will stay inside my mouth."
"What time is it now, and you still have the mind to worry about this?" Merlin gave a helpless dry laugh.
"This is very important; it concerns my dignity." Leviathan emphasized solemnly, turned and walked toward the seaside, "I'll go prepare first." After Leviathan left, Xiu looked at Merlin and asked, "Your Majesty, is this your choice?"
"Well, the founders together set the rules; we cannot let Belial, a single individual, ruin them. This matter, which stakes the fate of all demons, must be stopped."
Merlin spoke solemnly, but in his heart he worried about the safety of his precious daughter Chris. Mammon is ruthless and merciless, completely ignoring his warnings, and directly launched the war against Britain.
If Chris is discovered by Mammon, he will surely strike her down; the situation is extremely dangerous. Merlin must stop Mammon as soon as possible—each minute earlier reduces the danger to Lichfield by a bit.
Moreover, even the royal capital couldn't block Mammon's army; even if Alice protects Chris, she likely couldn't withstand the demons. Going directly to see Mammon is the quickest way to prevent Wales from falling.
"Your Majesty, please think carefully. If you truly defy the Elders' will, you will be opposing the entire demon race, which will only worsen your situation. You were originally an exile; if you do this, you may find it hard to return to the Demon Lord Palace and resume your throne. I believe following the Elders' will has no downside, and even if we replace humanity, it could be considered a good thing." Pudom strongly advised Merlin not to take such a risk; opposing the entire demon race is too great a danger. Even if Merlin stops Mammon, whether the demons' external expansion war can halt is another matter.
"I've long wanted to teach those elders a lesson, but I never had a proper reason. Now I can use this opportunity to give the Elders a warning. I haven't forgotten the elders' expression when they told me to get lost." Merlin answered with a smile.
"But..." Pudom wanted to continue advising, but Xiu stopped him sternly.
"Enough, Pudom. This is His Majesty's own decision; we must respect His Majesty's choice. As subordinates, we should fully support whatever His Majesty does. Trying to demand that His Majesty act according to our own ideas is a trait of traitors." Xiu glanced at Pudom, as if restraining his behavior.
"Sigh..." Pudom sighed, said no more, but still felt uneasy inside.
"Alright, Pudom. Since I've decided to fight the Elders to the end, just trust me." Merlin patted Pudom's shoulder, understanding his concern.
"That's also true," Pudom forced out a faint smile.
"Don't think I'm the only one opposing the Elders; there's also that fellow Leviathan." Merlin gave Pudom a reassuring look. "Your Majesty is right; this time we are not fighting alone as the First Demon Lord Palace. We also have the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, and Your Majesty's relationship with Lord Asmodeus is quite good. If we can also win the support of the Fourth Demon Lord Palace, then even if we defy the Elders' will, we still have room to maneuver. The weight of three Demon Lords is enough to make those elders hesitate." Xiu nodded, not thinking Merlin had chosen the worst path.
"Time is short. After Lilith wakes up, just tell her the situation, then you all return to the Demon Lord Palace. Don't keep bullying Miranda alone, or Beelzebub will go mad." Merlin gave these instructions before departing.
"Your Majesty slipped away in the middle of the night; Lady Lilith will surely be furious when she wakes up, and she'll likely take it out on us. She hopes you can return to live in the Demon Lord Palace for a while." Pudom immediately put on a bitter face, recalling the fear of being given small shoes by Lilith.
"My situation is special; Lilith will understand." Merlin turned and left, thinking that Lilith knows he is cursed and cannot stay long in the Demon Lord Palace, and perhaps just seeing each other once is enough.
"Wait, Your Majesty!" Xiu suddenly called out to Merlin, pulling from his bosom an Elgin Swordmaster's mask. "When I was looking for you, I went to Lichfield and saw the human woman living with you, and also the little master? This item was given to me by the little master to hand to you, hoping you can return home soon? She misses you very much."
"Oh!!! Is it Princess Chris? Right?" Pudom's face was full of little stars as he exclaimed excitedly, "We had a great time playing together; the little master is super cute, with eyes exactly like Your Majesty's! She's also very interested in demonkind stories; she will surely become a beautiful and intelligent woman in the future!"
"Hah, maybe just count him as an active child," Xiu gave a dry laugh, recalling the embarrassment of being asked whether he wanted to eat grass. "I never thought someone like you, a history-obsessed stiff, would also have the inclination to play with a child."
"Don't look down on people; I also like cute things. Besides, you are His Majesty's only heir, so you must inherit the Demon Lord Palace someday." Pudom suddenly lowered his voice, chuckling, "You haven't held the little master, have you? I have—those little carrot legs are plump, the feel is superb. Anyway, you won't get the chance to feel it."
"Shut up; if His Majesty hears you, you'll be cut down on the spot." Xiu said expressionlessly.
Merlin looked at the mask in his hand; isn't this just the toy he bought for Chris? It seems the little one really misses him. He lifted the mask to his nose and sniffed; a faint milky scent drifted out, and instantly the old father's feelings began to overflow—
"Ah, it's the scent of the little cutie. I remember knocking over the milk bottle into the toy basket, getting scolded by Alice for a long time, and after that I never dared to play with toys while eating."
"How are they?"
"Not bad, although I didn't reveal too much information. Before I left, I already instructed that the human lady should take the little master and flee Britain for refuge. After that, Mammon quickly sealed off Britain, so no one can escape. I don't know the current situation." Xiu answered truthfully.
"Like that," Merlin sighed, looking at the mask in his hand, his feelings mixed—"that means she's definitely still in Lichfield."
"If Alice is willing to take refuge, then it's not her."

title: Chapter 40 — Time's Up
content:
Chapter 40 — Time's Up

Volume 31 · Chapter 40

“Your Majesty, that修looked as if he wanted to say something but held back. He walked up to Merlin and lowered his voice. ‘I know that after your exile, you lived in the human kingdoms. You inevitably came into contact with many humans, but I hope you do not get too close to them, or else major trouble will arise.’

“What exactly are you trying to say?” Merlin stared at修’s eyes and asked in return.

“You are a noble descendant of the First Generation. You cannot associate with humans; this is a taboo of the demon race. Ordinary demons who violate it will surely die. Your punishment would be even more severe given your status. I am surprised by the existence of the young master. Due to her mother’s lineage, her position is awkward, making it difficult for all demons in the demon race to acknowledge her.”修paused, then continued seriously, “Think about yourself. His Highness Vivian created you and Lady Lilith using succubus power. Because your bloodline was impure, you suffered countless unfair treatments within the demon race. Because the young master has mixed human blood, her future will only be rougher than yours. The Council of Elders has zero tolerance for demon-human hybrids. They will not only prevent the young master from entering the demon race but will also try to eliminate her. So…”

Merlin smiled and patted修on the shoulder. “Don’t worry, I have my limits.”

“I believe you can handle these matters well.”修bowed slightly.

Merlin turned and left, thinking to himself: How could he not know that Chris could never return to the demon race? Making her the Fourth Demon Lord and trapping her forever in the cage of the Demon Lord Palace was not a good thing.

◇

In the pitch-black deep night, stars twinkled in the sky.

After Merlin and Leviathan had left, Prometheus finally could no longer hold back. He angrily questioned修beside him, “Why did you stop me? His Majesty chose the most dangerous path. Instantly creating so many enemies within the demon race is not a good thing. You should understand this better than I do.”

“Yes, I am fully aware of how dangerous His Majesty’s choice is.”修nodded sincerely, not denying this fact.

“Then why did you stop me? Why didn’t you join me in advising His Majesty? Perhaps…” Prometheus frowned deeply, unable to figure out what this goat demon was thinking.

“It’s useless. Don’t you know His Majesty’s personality? Since a decision has already been made, whatever we say is futile. As subordinates, we just need to do our best.”said修in a cold tone.

“What kind of ‘doing your best’ is that? If you truly anger the Council of Elders, His Majesty might never be able to return to the Demon Lord Palace in the future. What is a Demon Lord Palace without a Demon Lord?”Prometheus spread his hands and questioned.

“Regardless of whether His Majesty holds the position of Demon Lord, in my eyes, she is still the master of the First Demon Lord Palace. Aside from His Majesty, who else deserves to be our king?”asked修in return to Prometheus, continuing to add, “Actually, His Majesty’s choice may not necessarily be wrong. With the Second Holy War fully ignited, can we really win? Defeat means the demon race will face eternal damnation. We cannot afford to gamble.”

“What does that mean?”Prometheus paused, stunned.

“The war with the Heavenly Realm caused us severe damage, and we have not yet recovered. Are we truly much stronger than humans? I am skeptical about this.”said修calmly, stating his opinion.

“Mammon easily conquered the capital of the British Kingdom. There is nothing impossible. With seven Demon Lord Palaces united, who could possibly stand against us?”Prometheus thought修’s worries were inexplicable.

“The Holy Church. Do not underestimate our mortal enemies. It remains our greatest obstacle in the mortal world.”said修with a serious tone.

“Are you serious? The Holy Church has long declined. How many of their Heroes has His Majesty killed? They dare not launch crusades lightly anymore.”Prometheus looked down on this.

“Although the Holy Church currently appears to show weakness, according to the intelligence I have gathered, the reality is not so. Their goal is definitely not to kill off all of us demons; they have greater ambitions.”said修with certainty.

“Uh, greater ambitions?”Prometheus was full of question marks, completely unable to imagine what ambitions those mystical religious fanatics could possibly have.

“A few Seraphim Generals who once severely wounded the First Generation Demon Lords may not have returned to the Heavenly Realm but instead stayed behind. It seems they are waiting, guarding against something?”had already collected traces of Seraphim activity in the mortal world.

“Is this news of yours accurate?”Prometheus’s expression turned horrified, filled with suspicion in his heart. If the Seraphim did not return to the Heavenly Realm, it meant abandoning eternal life; staying in the mortal world meant death sooner or later.

“Although I cannot be one hundred percent certain of this matter, the possibility is not low.”said修slowly while looking at Prometheus—“Among those Seraphim Generals who could once kill the First Generation Demon Lords, the appearance of even one would be enough to make us tremble with fear.”“If the expansion of the demon race forces out the Seraphim, then the blow to the demon race will be devastating.”

“So, His Majesty’s choice may not necessarily be wrong. Perhaps it will pull the demon race, which is on the edge of danger, back from the brink…”◇

On a small island somewhere, Dickteping sat cross-legged by a bonfire, slicing open the throat of a pheasant with a knife. He lifted it up and desperately poured the contents into his mouth.

Gulp, gulp. As his Adam’s apple bobbed, large amounts of chicken blood were consumed by Dickteping. Red glints of unsatisfied hunger flickered in his eyes. Dickteping threw the pheasant corpse aside, licked the chicken blood from the corners of his mouth, and under the torment of阵阵“bloodthirsty impulses,”he continued to scratch his neck, suffering immensely.

“Ugh! It hurts so much! This torture of craving blood is agonizing. The effect of chicken blood is too poor, far inferior to human blood.”Dickteping rolled on the ground in pain, muttering various ugly words.

Although becoming a vampire granted him immortal power, and he enjoyed this reckless feeling, whenever the “bloodthirsty impulse”struck, he hated the bastard who turned him into a vampire very much.

In fact, the residents on the surrounding islands had already been killed off. Not only did Dickteping need to drink blood himself, Cain needed it too. Every day, he had to bitterly go hunting.

If there were still humans around, Dickteping wouldn’t have to suck on chicken blood. Animal blood had limited effects in relieving the “bloodthirsty impulse.”Originally, food here was abundant, with three villages of humans nearby, sufficient for Cain and Dickteping to hide here for a long time.

But the location of this island was too awkward, lying exactly on the line connecting the Sixth Demon Lord Palace and the Third Demon Lord Palace.

Previously, Mammon released the demon sword Tyrfing, tearing through the sea area between the two Demon Lord Palaces with piercing power, directly destroying more than half of this island. The three villages were instantly annihilated, with no survivors.

After drinking chicken blood, Dickteping felt somewhat relieved. He got up and looked at the island damaged by Tyrfing. Before him was a cliff torn apart, the cut smooth. Below, just recently, there had been three bustling villages; now, only the cold seawater slapped against the shore無s.

“Really unlucky. I didn’t do anything, yet I got caught in the crossfire of two Demon Lords’ battles. Look, now I can only drink chicken blood…”Da da da, a series of footsteps came from the cave behind him. Dickteping’s face changed drastically; he hurriedly knelt on one knee and bowed respectfully.

Cain walked out of the cave unhurriedly, his gaze having become exceptionally sharp, exuding an aura of dual pressure—coldness and solemn killing intent.

“Their power has been successfully inherited and digested by me.”

“The astonishing sword-drawing technique, and the ultimate law of coldness, I have mastered both.”“It seems the time has come. I should go collect the debts from back then.”

title: Chapter 41 — Advance Again
content:
Chapter 41 — Advance Again

Volume 31 · Chapter 41

"Having the power of those two people at my disposal is enough to sweep away all enemies obstructing me, to reclaim the remaining Undying Divine Power, I will evolve to the most perfect state; even my mother will be wary of me." Cain looked at his hands, with Merlin and Alice's power bolstering him, he no longer had any fear towards the goddess mother of heaven.
Dickteping recalled Merlin's astonishing sword-drawing technique, thought it a rare divine skill; if Cain had mastered it, wouldn't he be invincible? "Master, the First Demon Lord's sword-drawing technique is astonishingly powerful; if you fully master this power alone, you can already sweep away all opponents; the remaining Undying Divine Power seems not so important."
"No, reclaiming the Undying Divine Power is crucial to me; do you think a god is that easy to kill?" Cain seemed to have already made a plan; Lamia and Bathory will surely pay for their earlier deception.
