title: Chapter 55 — Approaching the Strait
content:
Chapter 55 — Approaching the Strait

Volume 31 · Chapter 55

Dark clouds parted, and a divine light enveloped the battlefield, as if the gates of the heavenly realm had been flung open in an instant, revealing the spectacular sight of a second descent of a million holy spirits into the mortal world.

The brave and battle-hardened holy spirits descended from the sky clad in war robes, their wings shaking as they brandished sharp swords in their hands. Following Alice, who looked like a Valkyrie, they strove to tear a rift through the dark twilight.

The Light Aria in Alice's hand emitted a long, humming drone. It had sensed the aura of the demons' arch-enemy and had become exceptionally excited, recalling the ancient Holy War and the scenes of the holy spirit legions slaughtering demons.

Exterminating demons seemed to be the Light Aria's mission; being enemies with such dark creatures doubled its prestige. The divine light it emitted caused the demons to fear looking up, leaving them with no choice but to flee in terror.

Rather than calling the Light Aria a sharp blade, it was more like a conductor's baton on the battlefield. Wherever the blade pointed, a vast number of holy spirits would charge the front lines. It could be called the command sword held by the supreme ruler of the holy spirit legions, possessing the unique ability to command holy spirits.

The valiant holy spirits behind Alice appeared lifelike, but they were not true physical entities; they were simply powers residing within the Light Aria.

Although their individual combat power was inferior to that of true holy spirits, they excelled in their sheer numbers, forming an indestructible military force capable of wiping out any enemy.

Alice had already mastered the method of wielding the Light Aria. At this moment, she harbored negative emotions of "avenging innocent lives," successfully establishing a connection with this contradictory divine artifact.

"That woman with that despicable sword looks harmless, but as expected, you are the most dangerous existence!"

Mammon's enraged curses rang out. He had never imagined that a defeated opponent of his would possess such potential; the blade that killed his wife was even more dangerous than imagined.

Terrifyingly powerful super magic bullets, like burning comets, slammed violently toward the sky, intending to blast Alice and the descending holy spirits away together!

Alice's gaze was firm, and her face remained calm. The third form of the Snow Mountain Sword Technique, "Heaven Opener," had already drained her fighting spirit and magic power. She had no way to retreat and had to determine the victor between herself and Mammon's clones at this moment.

The holy spirits behind her became the most loyal knights, bravely rushing to the front to protect Alice. A massive divine power connected the holy spirits to one another, forming a crushing charging offensive!

Under the charging momentum of the million-member holy spirit legion, Mammon's armored clones became very small, looking like a dimensional strike from a higher plane against a lower plane.

Alice's blade collided with Mammon's super magic bullets. For a moment, the colors of heaven and earth changed as the two opposing forces reached a stalemate. However, with the empowerment of the Light Aria, Alice did not seem to be fighting alone; the holy spirits offered their power to her one after another, giving their "commander" the maximum support.

Under the combined effect of the "Heaven Opener" sword technique and the charge of the million holy spirits, Alice gained an overwhelming advantage, successfully dispersing the super magic bullets that even Gregory could not withstand!

Violent explosions echoed between heaven and earth. The holy spirits crashed into the armored legion and detonated themselves, drowning the toys Mammon took pride in within a divine torrent.

A giant mushroom cloud slowly rose, as if transporting one back to the cruel battlefields of the original Holy War, where countless demons fell under the iron hooves of the holy spirits. This was the first time Mammon had suffered a heavy blow in Britain.

Mesfield silently lowered the King's Sword, feeling as though he no longer needed to force a second strike. He thought to himself that although she was a foreign Thorn Knight, her potential was so immense? He remembered she was once just an unremarkable adventurer; why now...

Everyone could see the demons fleeing in panic. The plan to attack Wales had ended in failure. Under Mammon's instructions, the demons would retreat to the royal capital to deliberate further.

Duke Rose: "I've never believed in the set of things the Church preaches, but now I believe it a little." Kyle: "My Lord, me too..."

◇

Inside the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, there was dead silence. The demons' expressions were very ugly; they had seen everything happening in Wales through the magic mirror. Mammon sat on his throne, leisurely holding a red wine glass in his hand, but his face had long since turned the color of charcoal, showing how infuriated the defeat in Wales had made him.

Beside him, Osse took one look at Mammon's expression and immediately dared not even breathe, fearing he would trigger a bad mood at this moment, not knowing what to say. The meticulously prepared armored legion had been mostly destroyed by two divine artifact users, with only a small portion escaping back to the royal capital. This was undoubtedly a loud slap in the face to the radicals within the demon race!

Osse felt that if the Council of Elders found out about this news, the wind might shift. Thus, he asked softly, "Your Majesty..."

Mammon suddenly stood up from the throne, smashing the wine glass in his hand to pieces, and said angrily, "A bunch of despicable humans, like stinking rats! I don't know where they stole that power from, but they truly use any means necessary to deal with me! I will make them pay a price in blood!"

"Uh..." Osse was startled by Mammon's frantic appearance. In his memory, Mammon rarely lost his composure like this.

"The true power of that sword exceeded my expectations; its suppressive power over us demons is actually that strong! I really should have killed that human woman at any cost before!" Mammon said, gritting his teeth.

"That woman's sword can summon holy spirits? I've never heard of such a treasure," Osse echoed from the side.

"It must be from the heavenly realm. No doubt, that sword is an object of the heavenly realm, perhaps something left over from the Holy War." Mammon speculated in his heart and let out a long sigh. "My preparations were still not sufficient; I should have accounted for interference from the heavenly realm!"

"Your Majesty, what should we do next? If the news of our first defeat in Britain reaches the Council of Elders, it might have a negative impact on you," Osse asked with a worried expression.

"What to do?" Mammon pondered for a moment, and after thinking for a long time, he said seriously, "Let the demons temporarily hold the royal capital of Britain. Wait for me to prepare first, and then I will personally go and exterminate those livestock!"

"You are going to take action personally?" Osse frowned, feeling that the current situation was indeed dire, and it wasn't impossible for Mammon to lead the expedition personally.

Suddenly, a demon soldier ran in from outside the Demon Lord Palace, immediately kneeling on one knee to report, "Your Majesty! The allied forces composed of the Kingdom of France and the Holy Church have gathered outside the Strait of Messina. It looks like they are ready to break our naval blockade of Britain at any moment!"

"Annoying bastards are coming one after another. Do they think I'm easy to bully!?" The pressure of the Pseudo-God realm rose from Mammon's body as he said with a face full of rage—

"Good! I'll make sure they have a coming but no return!"

◇

A lonely small boat sailed on the sea, quietly approaching the Strait of Messina.

The messy pirate rowed with all his might, wanting to reach the Sixth Demon Lord Palace faster to rescue Young Master Rochill from within.

When this shrewd pirate was looting the Third Demon Lord Palace, he saw the demon armor showing its power and realized the situation was bad, so he escaped amidst the chaos.

To prevent the flag of the Redbeard Pirate Crew from falling, he became the hope of the entire village, needing to rescue Rochill and his pirate companions from the Demon Lord Palace. The messy pirate rowed with effort, complaining incessantly, when he suddenly felt the ocean churning violently, and the entire sea area turned pitch black.

It seemed as if some gargantuan creature was moving in the deep sea? Thus, the pirate hurriedly pulled back the oars, lying flat on the small boat, trembling and pretending to be dead. "W-what is this..."

Looking out, an incredibly huge black shadow moved slowly in the sea, like a sea dragon acting without restraint, scaring away all sea creatures. Leviathan twisted its body, continuously approaching the Strait of Messina, preparing to reclaim its Demon Lord Palace.

Inside Leviathan's mouth, Merlin sat cross-legged with eyes closed, resting his mind, as if he had already fallen asleep, showing no nervousness at all about facing Mammon next.

Leviathan: "Lucifer, we're almost there, stop sleeping."

Merlin: "I know. Leave Mammon to me." Ps■

title: Chapter 56 — Bonus Chapters
content:
Chapter 56 — Bonus Chapters

Volume 31 · Chapter 56

If Mammon were truly killed, it might cause quite a bit of trouble, and there's a good chance the Elder Council would brand us with the crime of "killing our own kind."

This time, although Mammon occupied Leviathan's Demon Lord Palace, it grasped the situation just right and didn't kill Leviathan, which left it room to maneuver before the Elder Council, so it avoided severe punishment.

From what Merlin knows, Mammon is actually not that hard to deal with, much easier than fighting Beelzebub. After all, although Mammon possesses power at the pseudo-god realm, its actual combat strength is the weakest among the Demon Lords.

The reason Mammon appears so formidable, seemingly occupying a mid-to-upper tier position among Demon Lords, is entirely due to fighting with all sorts of bizarre treasures—like an enemy specializing in item-based combat.

As long as its treasures are destroyed, Mammon will immediately show its weakness. Without its crutches, given its personality, it would directly submit, abandoning all resistance to prioritize saving its own life.

Merlin thought the most troublesome was the divine artifact Mammon held—the demon sword Tyrfing. This artifact left behind by an ancient demon god was the strongest treasure in Mammon's collection.

Judging from how Tyrfing instantly tore through Leviathan's true body, the artifact's power is astonishing, and Mammon can wield it perfectly—completely different from the two half-baked amateurs, Mesfield and Alice.

Leviathan: "Is it really okay for you to handle Mammon alone? Last time I escaped quickly, otherwise I might have lost half my life. To fight Mammon up close wielding Tyrfing, frankly, I'm not entirely confident."

Merlin sat on Leviathan's tongue, hearing its words lacking confidence, and said calmly, "Trust me, a guy who relies entirely on artifacts to fight is easier to deal with than imagined."

Leviathan fell silent for a long time, recalling the scene where Merlin slew the North Sea Kraken, thinking he should be able to clash with Tyrfing head-on. "But still, be careful. Mammon is always cunning. Never believe a word it says."

"I know, actually my opponent isn't Mammon, but that demon sword left by our evil god ancestor. As long as Mammon retreats in the face of difficulty, I believe the hardliners in the Elder Council will calm down." Merlin speculated.

Leviathan: "Now the demon race is like a hunter with only one bullet in his gun, not knowing enough about the beast in the darkness. Facing two choices: fire and kill the beast for rich rewards, or miss and get eaten. Demons with different stances can't reach consensus. The hardliners won't give up the chance for rewards, the conservatives won't accept the cost of being eaten. Mammon's achievements in Britain became the bargaining chip that broke the balance. The conservatives' foolish zealots began to waver, so as long as Mammon loses in Britain, this farce can be stopped."

"Ah, I see." Merlin nodded, understanding Leviathan's meaning. "As long as Mammon's war plan fails, the Elder Council will give up the idea of external expansion, right?"

Leviathan: "Correct, that's the meaning. But if we intervene, we risk becoming enemies with the Elder Council." "I'm not afraid of the Elder Council. Some old fossils should be thrown into a glacier to cool off and reflect." Merlin said calmly.

Leviathan: "Lucifer, actually you don't need to take risks with me. If not for Mammon's excessive actions against me, I might have wavered like other Demon Lords and stood with Mammon supporting expansion. But I can't swallow this grievance. The Elder Council ignored Mammon's crime of occupying the Sixth Demon Lord Palace—that's an insult to me. In their eyes, I'm probably a stubborn pawn abandoned, while Mammon is the hero leading the demon race to resist human oppression. I can't tolerate that no matter what. But you're different; no need to get dragged in."

"What's the use of talking about this now? I've made my decision and won't regret it. Besides, without my help, you want to reclaim your Demon Lord Palace—aren't you fully capable?" Merlin paused and continued, "The nobility of the demon race was established by the seven first-generation Demon Lords. We can't let one old fossil like Belial veto everything. Does it consider itself the ruler of the entire demon race? I sincerely respect those departed first-generation Demon Lords and will firmly uphold the rules they established. I won't let one or two scoundrels drag the entire demon race into the abyss."

Leviathan: "I didn't expect you to be a benevolent monarch with the whole demon race in heart. I used to think you were just a kid enjoying Vivian's protection. But I admit that was my prejudice; I should apologize to you."

"No need..." Merlin's old face flushed red, eyes dodging. He thought: Who can't wave flags and shout slogans? What kind of benevolent monarch am I? More like a slacking-off monarch. If not for worrying about Mammon's minions threatening my wife and kids in Rexham, I would have skipped out long ago~

Leviathan: "Hmm? Looks like we're not the only ones causing trouble for Mammon?"

"What's wrong? Any special circumstances?" Merlin asked curiously, feeling that Leviathan outside must have encountered an emergency.

"It seems the Holy Church's fleet is approaching the Strait of Messina, trying to break through Mammon's naval blockade." Leviathan's tone suddenly turned angry, teeth gritted. "Damn Mammon! It's forcing my subordinates to obey its orders, sending them to the front as vanguard, using my subordinates as human shield suicide squads?"

Merlin thought for a moment and understood. Perhaps Elizabeth begged the Holy Church for help. The Church fleet is trying to break the blockade to support Britain. Looks like the situation in Wales is not optimistic.

"We can only split up. I need to save my old subordinates; I can't let them die in the Church's artillery fire. After dealing with these priests, I'll go to the Demon Lord Palace to deal with Mammon together with you." Leviathan suggested, deciding to split up.

"Either way, after you deal with the Church, maybe Mammon will have already begged me for mercy." ◇

The combined fleet of France and the Holy Church assembled in the Strait of Messina, integrating nearly a hundred warships.

The flags of the Church and the kingdom were mixed together. This temporarily assembled combined fleet came with great momentum, its scale not inferior to a formal demon race extermination campaign.

The demon cannons on the warships were slowly raised one after another, aiming at the demons in the Strait of Messina. The intense naval battle was about to erupt.

In the sky above the strait, large numbers of sea serpents circled, wary of the approaching combined fleet, not to mention how many ambushes surrounded the strait.

Princess Margaret stood on the deck in full military uniform, looking exactly like a vigorous governor. She slowly lowered her telescope and said helplessly—

"The number of sea serpents is too great. A forced breakthrough will cause massive losses. We must think of another way..."

title: Chapter 57 — Paying a Visit (Bonus Chapter)
content:
Chapter 57 — Paying a Visit (Bonus Chapter)

Volume 31 · Chapter 57

"Don't just look at the surface—the more I look at those Sirens, the more they seem like bait luring us in. Can you be sure there's no other ambush around? If we dare enter the range of their songs, we might get completely wiped out." Margaret paused, speaking hesitantly, "If we could flatten the entire strait and force our way through, that wouldn't be impossible, but it would require moving all our legendary magic cannons over. That's not realistic..."

"Then what should we do? We still need to break through the demons' blockade and reach Britain to reinforce them. The intelligence says the situation there is extremely urgent—the King of Britain has already fallen, and His Majesty still wants to establish a long-term military alliance with the Kingdom of Britain. We can't mess this up..." Blaze anxiously scratched his head, undecided about the current situation.

"Fool, support doesn't only mean resisting demons together with Britain. Attacking the Demon Lord Palace here to relieve pressure on Britain is also effective support. I don't believe the demons, who have been guarding the Demon Lord Palace for so long, would give it up so easily." Margaret speculated in her heart, thinking the Demon Lord Palace was the demons' true weak point. Striking at the demons ravaging Britain was just treating the symptoms, not the root cause.

"Change the strategy and launch a direct attack on the Demon Lord Palace? But... it might lure out the Demon Lord. We probably can't win." Blaze hesitated, speaking.

"Who said we have to win against the Demon Lord? We just need to apply pressure here." Margaret revealed a meaningful smile. Not far away, Joan represented the Holy Church side coming to support. As an inquisitor of heresy, she was entrusted with great responsibility by the Holy Roman Empire, becoming the temporary commander of the participating Temple Knights.

However, she had no command experience, so command was handed to Margaret. In the combined forces, she played the role of deputy commander, with decisions needing to follow the Princess's opinion.

Joan looked at the pseudo-artifact spear Crimson Succubus in her hand, unable to help thinking of Alice. Since their last parting, quite some time had passed. She didn't know if Alice had sunk deeper into the heretics' temptation, or if after Temple Knight Captain Barres conveyed the Pope's goodwill, she had rekindled the idea of returning to the Church?

Joan sincerely hoped Alice could stay away from those evil heretics. Even if Alice didn't have devout faith, it could be cultivated slowly. Being born unable to fight for the Goddess—this was an unimaginable huge loss.

With Alice's personality, she wouldn't stand by and watch the demons rampage. She must be fighting bravely on British soil right now? Then I absolutely cannot lose to her, losing to a faithless opportunist is sheer shame.

If I achieve great military merit here, Alice will surely realize that devout faith in the Goddess is incomparable power!

Joan made a cross in front of her chest. For her, faith was everything. Those who couldn't see the greatness of the Goddess Maria were damned heretics without doubt.

This was Joan's first time being so close to the Demon Lord Palace. Recalling her unwillingness after losing to Alice in the competition for the Hero title, she had already turned this battle into an opportunity to prove herself.

"Joan小姐, come over and discuss something."

"Hmm?" Joan heard Margaret's call, stood up and walked over. "Have you decided to start a full-scale offensive? Me and the Temple Knights are ready!"

"No, listen to me. A rash offensive isn't the optimal choice. We need to prepare for a protracted battle. It might take at least half a month. We should avoid entangling with the demons and prioritize using artillery to suppress the demons in the strait." Margaret said seriously.

"Why adopt such a cowardly strategy? Are you afraid of the demons so you dare not charge?" Joan pressed her chest with her hand, speaking seriously. "As a warrior of the Goddess, I absolutely cannot fear demons. We are saving the pitiful weaklings being ravaged by demons. Goddess Maria will surely protect us in secret to defeat the demons!"

"That... sir, please calm down. The commander for this operation is the Princess." Blaze emphasized Margaret's status.

Margaret's expression was complex, really unable to bear Joan's fanaticism. "Joan小姐, our goal is to help Britain get through the crisis, but the premise is preserving the combined fleet's surviving forces as much as possible. So we should achieve the best support effect with minimal sacrifice. This not only aligns with my interests but also with His Holiness the Pope's interests. Actually, I'm also a devout believer in the Goddess. I'm not afraid of demons, but considering soldiers and knights are living lives, a rash offensive would let them die in vain. That's irresponsible."

"You're lying. I'm an inquisitor of heresy; I can see through your false faith with one glance. You're not a believer of the Goddess." Joan emphasized seriously.

"Fine, you're right. But for this operation, I'm the commander. Do you understand? Follow my orders." Margaret pointed at herself, revealing a smug smile. Although her devout believer identity couldn't fool Joan, as long as she could fool the Pope, it was enough.

"Hmph!" Joan lowered her head in annoyance, not convinced in her heart, thinking Margaret was just cowardly—

Can such a cowardly strategy really help Britain?

◇

The gate of the Sixth Demon Lord Palace slowly opened. Asmodeus ordered Ose to lead the demon knights out to counter the combined fleet's attack. Ose was only serving as the vanguard for the first wave of defense; if he couldn't handle the combined fleet, Asmodeus would rush to support at any time.

However, Ose had full confidence in handling the combined fleet. Dealing with a group of temporarily assembled rabble didn't require Asmodeus to lift a finger himself. Yet just as the Demon Lord Palace gate opened, "whoosh whoosh lou" a series of piercing sounds came through the air. Numerous demon soldiers' bodies flew over, crashing into pillars like cannonballs and passing out.

Ose was greatly surprised in his heart, instinctively gripping the short sword at his waist, thinking: Are human attacks this fierce? They've already landed and killed their way to the Demon Lord Palace?! Impossible!

He raised his head to look carefully. After the smoke cleared, countless demon soldiers lay sprawled on the ground, rolling their eyes and foaming at the mouth, clearly injured badly, killed instantly by the invaders.

You have to know that to counter the combined fleet, over ten thousand demon soldiers had already gathered outside the Demon Lord Palace. Yet they all seem to have been wiped out, and the invaders killed their way to the doorstep. Just how terrifying are the invaders!

"Lucifer! Lucifer-sama?!"

Ose saw in the center of the apocalyptic scene before him, Merlin slowly straightened his waist, turned around to stare at them, and used his hand to brush dust off his body, making himself look dignified—

"Oh~ It's you."

"Asmodeus is inside, right?"

"Go tell him, according to our agreement, I've come to visit in person."

title: Chapter 58 — Face to Face
content:
Chapter 58 — Face to Face

Volume 31 · Chapter 58

Ose saw Merlin come looking for him, panic in his heart, not knowing how to handle this.

Now was the critical moment for Maemon's external expansion, and not long ago in Wales they had hit a snag—if any more trouble came, it would probably be extremely disadvantageous to his master!

But Ose knew Merlin's strength was very powerful; if the other party insisted on picking a fight, he alone definitely couldn't stop them, and would make Maemon's situation even worse.

Ose desperately thought of countermeasures in his heart, how to make Merlin leave here, give up causing trouble for Maemon—ultimately, there seemed to be no irreconcilable contradiction between the two Demon Lords, and they should be able to sit down and talk properly.

Moreover, if the Second Holy War could be won, that would be good for the entire demon race; from Merlin's position, it wasn't necessary to obstruct Maemon's external expansion.

"Haven't you heard what I said?" Merlin asked curiously, looking Ose over, emphasizing, "If you won't go announce it, then move aside properly, I'll go find Maemon myself."

Ose took a deep breath, trying his best to calm down, and forced an ugly smile to ask, "Lord Lucifer, what are you doing here? Are you here as a guest?"

"Do I need to ask? I asked you to relay a message to Maemon, and you forgot?" Merlin immediately frowned, suspecting Maemon had started the war on its own, perhaps his meaning hadn't been conveyed?

"Not forgotten, not forgotten! I relayed it word for word to His Majesty!" Ose sweated cold sweat, hurriedly explaining, afraid Merlin would be unhappy and draw his sword to cut him; recalling the companions who died under Merlin's blade that night, even now it still had lingering fear.

"So that's how it is. It seems Maemon didn't put me in its eyes, completely disregarding my warning. I should let it recognize me again." Merlin's words revealed displeasure, feeling Maemon didn't treat him as an equal.

"No no no! You're mistaken! How could His Majesty not put you in his eyes? Privately, His Majesty always praises your bravery. As a third-generation monarch, you are truly the rising star among the demon race!" Ose helped Maemon explain, hoping to dissolve the conflict between the two Demon Lords.

"Sounded nice, but do you think I'd believe sweet words? Maemon must have privately belittled me as a greenhorn, a mere third-generation monarch daring to point fingers at it, right?" Merlin showed a meaningful smile on his face. Though it was just speculation, judging by the attitudes of Beelzebub and Leviathan, Maemon's evaluation of him would only be lower!

"This..." Ose immediately became nervous, thinking: Did Lucifer grow a thousand-mile eye? Why did he know so clearly? The meaning was exactly the same! Could there be a spy from the First Demon Lord Palace beside His Majesty!

"If Maemon truly put me in its eyes, it wouldn't ignore my warning, directly launch war against humans, and recklessly drag the entire demon race into the mud." Merlin paused, speaking seriously, "Maemon must stop all external expansion actions, strictly abide by the rules established by the first-generation monarchs, otherwise I can only talk to it politely..."

Ose stepped back in astonishment, thinking: Lucifer was clearly not benign; from the start he knocked out His Majesty's guards, a "polite" talk was absolutely impossible!

Most critically, since Lucifer came knocking, Leviathan must be nearby! Remembering last time when he tried to grab Leviathan back and failed, blocked by Lucifer—though Leviathan's strength was greatly diminished, the identity of the Sixth Demon Lord Palace master might be exploited by Lucifer!

Ose thought left and right, believing the situation had reached its worst point, and could only bring up the Elder Council to apply pressure.

"Lord Lucifer, please calm down, don't act so impulsively. His Majesty is now the hero of the demon race, the first leader to break the situation of being attacked passively, the strategy of external expansion has already been approved by the Elder Council!~"

"Oh? So what? You're using the Elder Council to pressure me?" Merlin raised his eyebrows, feeling unhappy about being threatened. "I don't have the guts to threaten you. It's just that the demon race's rules have changed. External expansion, starting the Second Holy War, taking back what once belonged to us—this is the correct path!" Ose's tone was forceful, like an orator. "So Lord Lucifer, I hope you restrain yourself. Stopping His Majesty now is opposing the Elder Council! Is opposing the entire demon race! You will become the sinner of our race's revival!"

Merlin walked to Ose's face with a cold expression, questioning, "Am I the sinner? You sure?"

Ose felt Merlin's pressure up close, terrified all over, but still answered with an affirmative tone, "No mistake, you are the sinner..."

Boom—Merlin mercilessly punched Ose's cheek, sending it flying to the side, crashing through the thick stone pillar outside the hall, buried under the ruins.

"You used despicable methods to stir up the demons' warmongering mood, holding the small advantage gained in Britain, boasting that you occupied the human kingdom, causing the Elder Council to make wrong judgments, privately colluding with Belial to try to guide the demon race's direction, keeping silent about the heavy price to be paid after failure—who exactly is the sinner?"

Merlin rubbed his fist, not bothering to explain further. His gaze swept over the hesitant demons before him, and he shouted angrily—"If you don't want to die, get out of the way!"

Maemon's demon guards saw so many companions lying on the ground, even Ose was being beaten down, where did they have the audacity to block Merlin? So they panicked and scattered like birds and beasts.

◇

Maemon dressed magnificently sat on Leviathan's throne, expression calm without a trace of emotional fluctuation; it had already sensed Merlin's arrival.

It was somewhat unexpected; it had thought that after the Elder Council approved its strategy, Merlin and Leviathan would give up causing trouble for it.

After all, in the demon race, whoever has the biggest fists has the loudest voice. The Elder Council possesses the Seal Demon Pot, so the Elder Council's words carry great weight, which should make Merlin and Leviathan hesitate!

But Merlin and Leviathan ignored the Elder Council and came directly here, making Maemon unable to understand—why would they risk opposing the Elder Council to fight with it? What's the point? If the demon race recovers and prospers, it wouldn't be a bad thing for Merlin and Leviathan either!

With a loud bang, the main hall's door collapsed. Merlin's figure walked out from the smoke, staring directly into Maemon's eyes, and said calmly—

"Maemon, it's time for us to talk properly."

Maemon sat high above, looking down at Merlin. This third-generation monarch, in terms of seniority, couldn't compare to it—undoubtedly just a greenhorn—but at this moment dared to shout at it?

Its face changed constantly, alternating between black and red, finally returning to calm, even revealing an enthusiastic smile—"Haha, Lucifer, how did you come? Welcome, welcome!"

"I've dreamed of you coming to my place as a guest. We really should have a good drink!"

title: Chapter 59 — Item Stream Strangulation (Monthly Ticket Bonus)
content:
Chapter 59 — Item Stream Strangulation (Monthly Ticket Bonus)

Volume 31 · Chapter 59

He followed Merlin to the Demon Lord Palace, thinking it would take some effort to enter the demon's lair and find Lord Lochiri. However, along the way, Merlin displayed his prowess, killing all the demons who dared to block his path. This allowed the chaotic pirates to easily reach the Demon Lord Palace's gates. He wondered, "What kind of background does that golden-haired man have?"

"This is too strong, he's killed his way into the Demon Lord's palace..."

"But having this disruptor is good, he's cleared the way for me. I'll take advantage of the chaos to rescue Lord Lochiri."

"Where is Leviathan? Why haven't I seen it?"

"We should talk about what's been happening recently. You probably don't know about it."

"The Second Holy War has begun. As the rulers of the demon race, we should lead by example and plan how to quickly conquer the human lands, and connect the seven Demon Lord Palaces as soon as possible..."

Mammon slowly descended from his throne, displaying a very warm and friendly attitude. Seeing Merlin, it seemed like they hadn't seen each other in a long time. It almost wanted to invite Merlin and Leviathan to drink together, completely ignoring the fact that it had seized the Sixth Demon Lord Palace and claimed it as its own territory.

Merlin had assumed that Mammon would be furious to see him, wanting to eat him alive. However, the opponent's sudden warmth left him confused and even suspicious.

"I'm not here to drink with you. I'm here to stop you from continuing your reckless behavior. You should know in your heart that you shouldn't try to lull me into a false sense of security with your warmth..."

Mammon tried to chat with Merlin in a friendly manner, but the other refused to be swayed, causing Mammon's smile to freeze on its face. "Well, you're here to stop me from acting recklessly? Why?"

"I don't allow you to drag the demon race into the mud. Stop, the Second Holy War is unwinnable."

"Why are you so sure you can't win? If the demon race unites, the war will be won in a landslide! The world will then belong to us. What's wrong with that?"

Mammon shrugged and added, "The rules set by the original Demon Lords are outdated. Do you understand? They will only make us more passive. Even Belial, the original ruler, supports the war. Do you have any questions?"

"I'm not interested in ruling the world, and as for the rules set by the original Demon Lords, they must have their reasons. Although Belial is one of the original Demon Lords, the ruler who set the rules had seven, and you can't just overturn everything because of your own position..."

Merlin stared at Mammon and asked, "And the fact that you and Belial are secretly colluding, I've already understood. Who knows what you two are secretly plotting? It's not impossible that Belial has already been bought by you."

"Belial, as an original ruler, would be bought by me? You're too high on yourself, Lucifer." Mammon shook its head and denied buying Belial. It and Belial were just a perfect match of ideas, "Belial supports me because we have the same wishes. We both have far-sighted wisdom. Since the human era has replaced our era, demons have been living in barren lands for a long time. Although we can survive, just hiding in the Demon Lord Palaces, are you satisfied? Once we win the Second Holy War, a lot of wealth is waiting for us! Those fertile lands were once ours, and now we just need to take them back!"

"Don't use the noble cause to cover up your own greed, Mammon." Merlin paused and said, "According to your understanding, shouldn't we also return the fertile lands to the elves? Don't forget, the change of era is accompanied by bloodshed and sacrifice. The prosperity of demons is also obtained through plundering elves. We are all thieves, who is more noble?"

"That's too disappointing." Mammon narrowed its eyes and anger began to burn in its heart. Why can humans live on fertile lands, and we have to hide in the Demon Lord Palaces? Is it because of that **goddess**? If we have enough resources, we can cultivate a strong figure comparable to a god, just like the original Demon Lords."

"Anyone who goes against the tide will have a bad ending. I have lived in the human kingdom for a long time, but I have not yet been confident to say that I have seen all the human strong figures. Never underestimate your enemies. The reason why humans have come to their own era is that they have a rich foundation. They are stronger than we imagine."

Merlin sighed and added, "If you insist on going this way, the cost of failure is something the entire race cannot bear. So give up."

"Nonsense!" Mammon angrily shouted, "The doors between the heavens and the mundane world are difficult to open again. Humans have been abandoned by their goddess, and now is the time for us to rise! The Council and other Demon Lords have already agreed with my proposal. If you dare to obstruct me, you are at odds with the entire demon race!"

"You're threatening me?" Merlin tilted his head and said helplessly, "It seems there's nothing to talk about. We'll have to use fists to reason." Mammon slowly turned his back on Merlin and said wistfully, "Lucifer, the most severe punishment awaits you. You will regret it."

"Council? Other Demon Lords? The entire demon race? They don't make me afraid." Merlin said coldly.

"Really..."

The words had barely left his mouth when Mammon suddenly turned around and launched an attack, spreading out his cloak and creating a strong wind pressure!

Suddenly, countless fake divine instruments appeared in the air, all of which were Mammon's prized collections. Accompanied by the sound of "swoosh," they shot towards Merlin.

Numerous fake divine instruments, with the aura of weapons, came like a tidal wave, surrounding Merlin and leaving him with no escape!

Mammon's collection of treasures is indeed rich. Just taking out one fake divine instrument can cause a stir outside. The bizarre-shaped swords, although far from the real divine instruments, already have a certain degree of powerful strength!

"As I suspected, you are indeed a freak. You don't put the interests of the demon race first? No wonder you can't even grow a chair in the corner of a room? A fake demon!"

"I lowered myself to talk to you, and you still dared to pretend in front of me? You're just an exiled failed ruler, you don't have the right to stop my actions!"

"Vivian's succubus power gave birth to a bastard! You don't deserve to be with us!"

Numerous fake divine instruments shone with a cold gleam, charging towards Merlin, making people feel as if they were in the stars.

Looking at Mammon's all-around, no-dead-angle powerful attack, which would pierce Merlin like a hedgehog in the next second, he still maintained a calm expression. "Mammon"

"You finally couldn't hold back, did you."

title: Chapter 60 — Become One
content:
Chapter 60 — Become One

Volume 31 · Chapter 60

Merlin took a deep breath, his eyes suddenly changed, and with himself as the center he expanded the "Repulsive Space", completely isolating the fierce assault of the pseudo‑divine artifact swords within one meter.
A large number of the pseudo‑divine artifact swords seemed to be stuck in soft mud, constantly trembling yet unable to advance even an inch, looking extremely unwilling. "Use some real skill, Mammon, don't try to deal with me with these toys—it's useless…"
"You and your mother are alike—you both speak with a big mouth, but what was her final fate?"
As his words fell, a sharp, piercing whistle tore through the air; a black longsword suddenly lunged from the front, slipping through the gaps between the other swords straight toward Merlin's heart!
Merlin, who was inside the Repulsive Space and thought himself absolutely safe, never expected that this black longsword would pierce the Repulsive Space's barrier, break through his defense, and drive him to the brink of danger.
This pseudo‑divine artifact longsword is called the Demon‑Breaking Blade; it is specially designed to counter mage weapons and possesses the rare ability to dispel magic. Merlin's Repulsive Space draws on the power of earth spirits, which is also magic, but under the assault of the Demon‑Breaking Blade his defense is no more than a thin sheet of paper.
Merlin's pupils instantly contracted, he furrowed his brows, leaned back slightly to gain maneuvering space, and with lightning‑fast right hand he pinched the tip of the Demon‑Breaking Blade with two fingers, defusing the brief crisis.
The gazes of the two Demon Lords met, and invisible sparks seemed to erupt in the air between them—
Merlin keenly felt Mammon's cunning; beneath what seemed like an ordinary attack lay countless schemes and traps, and a moment's carelessness would place him in mortal danger.
"Huh?" Mammon blinked, a mysterious smile spreading across his face, "You're tougher than I imagined—I really can't underestimate you."
"Then bring out the divine artifact you're proud of." Merlin clenched his left fist and smashed the right hand that was gripping the Demon‑Breaking Blade to pieces, "Showing off your toys in front of me is boring—do you really think you can defeat me with these? In your eyes, just how worthless am I?"
"Uh… Mammon wiped a cold sweat from his forehead and said calmly, "Let me bring out a divine artifact to face you? That depends on whether you have the qualifications. Don't underestimate the treasures I've collected, or you'll suffer a great loss."
Waves of heat surged from the sky, and Merlin suddenly sensed another aura extremely similar to Mammon's Demon Lord pressure; his heart jumped—could there be a second Demon Lord present besides Mammon!?
In the confusion, Merlin looked up to see a mighty demon battle armor leaping into the air, wielding an axe blazing with lava, swinging down with the force to split Mount Hua!
The scorching axe blade, infused with lava's power, fell from above Merlin's head; the next moment a violent explosion rang out, the Demon Lord Palace trembled, and the ground cracked, spewing lava everywhere.
Merlin withdrew from the smoke, his clothes scorched and looking disheveled; he wiped the corner of his mouth, his face grim, and shouted—
"Hahaha!" Mammon laughed triumphantly, looking down at Merlin and saying, "I've already warned you—yet you still manage to suffer a loss, how foolish… Merlin stared coldly at Mammon, then at the armor beside him; although its appearance had changed considerably, he could still recognize it as the demon armor he had seen on that thorn‑clad knight."
The demon armor returned to Mammon's hands, meaning that the knight named Sess must be dead—he didn't heed my advice and give the demon armor back; indeed, greed killed him. However, the demon armor before didn't have such overwhelming pressure; could Mammon have tampered with it?
Merlin felt that the pressure emanating from the demon armor was almost identical to Mammon's; if he closed his eyes he might not be able to tell them apart. "You think you can stop me with that? Don't make me laugh."
The demon armor suddenly unfolded, revealing its interior; Mammon, smiling, lay down inside it and fused with the armor, his pressure instantly surging—as if two Mammon stood before him!
Mammon, now fused with the demon armor, lifted the lava‑axe in his hand, pointing it at Merlin, and spoke in a menacing tone.
"Don't worry, I won't kill you, but I'll cripple you just like I did with Leviathan—chop off your hands and feet; it seems like a good choice. Once you can't wield a blade, you'll pose no threat to me."
◇
In the prison of the Sixth Demon Lord's Palace, the atmosphere was unusually quiet; because they needed to face the combined fleet of France and the Holy Church, all demons had been mobilized to prepare for battle, leaving only an elderly demon to guard the prison.
Lochiri and his band of pirates were locked up here; although they didn't know what was happening outside, the frequent tremors made them very uneasy.
"What's going on out there? Sounds like a fight—could someone be attacking the Demon Lord's Palace?" asked a grubby pirate. A little pirate wondered, "Could it be that someone's come to rescue us?"
"Don't dream about it! We're helpless pirates—who would come teach us for no reason?" the grubby pirate sneered, already resigned to dying, hoping only that his death wouldn't be too painful; for these pirates who keep their knives in their belts, death is just everyday fare.
A little pirate said, "But Senior Lohao wasn't captured, was he? Could he be coming to save us?"
"I don't even know how much that old geezer weighs—what guts does he have to storm the Demon Lord's Palace head‑on? That'd just be feeding himself to the demons as a snack." The grubby pirate paused, sighed, and said, "Better not count on him to rescue us; the area around the Demon Lord's Palace is swarming with demons, he can't even get close. We'd be better off praying that the Holy Church attacks soon—if they manage to seize the Demon Lord's Palace, we'll still have a slim chance. When that time comes, remember to claim you're a devout follower of the Light, and never admit you're a pirate."
Lochiri sat silent in the corner, the shackles on his hands and feet making movement impossible; what awaited him was likely to have his eyes gouged out by Mammon and then be brutally killed.
He felt deeply unwilling; he hadn't even had a chance to avenge his father against the swordsman Elgin before he might die at the demons' hands—what a failure. Lochiri rested his head against the cold stone wall of the cell, gazing at the dim iron bars, recalling the brief pirate life he'd led as a child following his father; those had been his happiest days, only to have everything destroyed by the Sword Master.
"Young master, Lochiri…"
Hearing someone call his name, Lochiri turned his gaze toward the cell door and stared wide‑eyed, "What are you doing here!?"
"Hehe! Sorry, young master, I'm a bit late—I ran into a lot on the way." The disheveled pirate produced from his bosom the jail key he'd taken after slaying the old demon—
"Don't worry, I'll get you out right away."

title: Chapter 61 — Broken Bone
content:
Chapter 61 — Broken Bone

Volume 31 · Chapter 61

Luoqili felt doubtful in his heart; he knew the strength of this pirate gang all too well—it was utterly impossible for them to have gotten past all those demons blocking the way and arrived here!" "Well I'll be!" the dirty pirate widened his eyes, "How did you get here???"

Hehehe, after you guys were caught, I took a small boat and spent a few days getting here; we're pirates from the same ship, how could I abandon you?" The messy pirate held a keychain in his hand, trying to find the key to Luoqili's cell. Because there were too many cell keys, searching was difficult. "Which key is this cell's? Trying them one by one is too much trouble. If it weren't for the fact that the guard is just an old, easy-to-handle demon, I might not have gotten the cell key at all—this journey has been truly lucky."

No way, yesterday there were clearly many demons guarding the cell, why is there only one old demon left today?" The dirty pirate exclaimed in surprise.

You don't know, outside a battle has broken out, it's chaotic; it seems the Kingdom of France and the Holy Church have formed an alliance, preparing to assault this Demon Lord Palace. Most demons have been sent to the battlefield, so hardly any demons remain to guard the cells." The meticulous pirate explained.

I knew it! Hahaha! Sure enough, those old god‑swindlers of the Holy Church are fighting the demons~" The dirty pirate laughed hysterically.

How did you get past the countless demons guarding outside the Demon Lord Palace?" Luoqili couldn't fathom it; this was the demons' lair—how could a mere human sneak in?

I'm not entirely sure either, but it looks like an internal struggle among the demon race; two Demon Lords are fighting fiercely outside, and I slipped into the Demon Lord Palace amidst the chaos." The messy pirate paused, then added, "One of them is a blond demon king without horns—he's incredibly strong, flattening every demon on the road. I've been following right behind him, hehe."

Internal demon race conflict? So they have such a huge split…" Luoqili muttered, thinking the two Demon Lords must be fighting intensely, otherwise the Demon Lord Palace wouldn't keep shaking, as if it might collapse at any moment.

Oh~, found it—this is the key!

◇

Come on, Lucifer! When I was monarch, you weren't even born yet! With what you have, do you think you can stop me?

Mammon wore mighty demon armor, brandishing a lava battle‑axe; streams of lava surged up from the ground, enveloping Merlin. Merlin furrowed his brow, drew a short segment of the blade at his waist, and instantly sliced and dispersed the incoming lava.

Useless.

Really?

Mammon's hand flashed light; the lava battle‑axe instantly changed into red and blue dual short swords. Swinging them released a freezing ice storm and a scorching flame tornado, in an instant turning the Demon Lord Palace into an ice‑and‑fire dual realm, making the environment extremely harsh!

The ice‑and‑fire storm struck; Merlin felt extremely uncomfortable, one side cold enough to make his teeth chatter, the other side hot enough to make him sweat nonstop.

Under the barrage of opposing attribute attacks, Merlin's stamina plummeted, his reactions grew sluggish, and ice and fire were destroying his body from within.

Hahaha, how does it feel? My collected treasures each possess rare power; I have a hundred ways to torment you without repeating!~" Mammon laughed wildly, even through his thick demon armor one could imagine his smug expression.

This drizzle‑like attack, do you think it will affect me?

Merlin gripped the demon sword Banri Garan at his waist, rotated it 180°, preparing to smash Mammon with the back of the blade!

Its silhouette was like a ghost, weaving through the blizzard and flames; in a breath it entered within two steps of Mammon!

But suddenly, Merlin felt his foot give way; looking down, he saw a beast trap hidden here? When had Mammon set this trap around him? He hadn't noticed at all; clearly the opponent was luring him closer.

This beast trap seemed made of crystal, nearly transparent; placed on the ground, if not paying full attention it would hardly be noticed, with tiny currents of electricity flowing across it, absolutely not a tool for hunting beasts.

"Hehe, got you!" Mammon spread his arms and roared, "Vanish, Lucifer!"

The crystal beast trap exploded with a bang, a lightning storm swept the entire Demon Lord Palace; countless bolts of light danced along the walls, etching irregular grooves! Thick smoke billowed, Merlin's figure was swallowed by the thunderous blast; the explosion's power was astonishing, causing the lightning fire to linger. "This is what happens when you oppose me; I gave you a chance, but you didn't cherish it~"

Mammon thought Merlin had fallen into the trap, surely not unscathed; at least he must have suffered serious injury.

But just as Mammon prepared to press the attack, a mysterious pulling force acted on him, dragging his whole body toward the opposite side. "What?! ! !"

Through the layers of lightning and fire, Merlin's upper garments were scorched, looking somewhat disheveled; in that terrifying explosion he only suffered minor injuries, but if not for his speed, the foot that stepped on the trap would have been utterly ruined.

Merlin once again sensed Mammon's cunning; facing such an enemy, one must be fully focused, or a slight mistake would lead to a great fall. Thus Merlin unleashed "Gravity Space" from afar, instantly pulling Mammon over.

Mammon was so cunning that Merlin couldn't tell how many traps lay around him; pulling him close was thus the safest strategy.

Being pulled by the "Gravity Space," Mammon was instantly dragged before Merlin; his face showed rare alarm as he shouted in panic, "Wait! Wait! Let's talk!"

Merlin's ruby‑like eyes flashed like lightning; he ignored Mammon's honeyed words, side‑stepping into a draw stance, a clear ring— the demon sword Banri Garan flipped 180° for a draw, using the back as the blade; though it couldn't kill, it could wound or cripple amply! Merlin drew! He struck Mammon's chest with the back of the blade; the sturdy demon armor shattered instantly into countless fragments.

Any defense before his draw technique was meaningless; Mammon's hope of relying on his demon armor to avoid injury was too naïve.

Just one strike, the armor's defense was broken; the draw technique's power pierced the defense, affecting Mammon's entire body.

Mammon's eyes widened, his chest felt as if struck by a heavy hammer, accompanied by a series of "yeh cha cha" crisp sounds, making it hard to count how many bones were broken— if Merlin had used a normal draw technique, this cunning Demon Lord would already be dead.

title: Chapter 62 — Showdown (Monthly Ticket Bonus)
content:
Chapter 62 — Showdown (Monthly Ticket Bonus)

Volume 31 · Chapter 62

Mammon's painful screams and wails were blown away by Merlin's single slash, blasting a huge hole in the north wall of the Demon Lord's Palace.
Smoke and dust filled the air; Mammon, buried under the rubble, didn't know if he was dead or alive, but having taken Merlin's backhand slash head-on, he certainly wasn't feeling fine—his body might have suffered severe injuries.
Merlin sheathed his blade, his eyes sharp, and said, "I warned you before—your little toys don't work on me."
A group of pirates hid in the darkness, watching the battle between the two Demon Lords. It wasn't that they didn't want to leave; they simply had no chance to slip out of the Demon Lord's Palace. The fight hadn't reached a white-hot stage yet—if they went out now they'd surely be spotted, and under the pressure of both Demon Lords they'd be doomed. So the pirates agreed to stay quiet in the shadows, waiting for the two Demon Lords to fight fiercely, then seize the chance to escape.
"Everyone try not to make a sound; the two Demon Lords are still very alert. If there's an opening later, follow behind me and slip out quickly—remember to move fast. If anyone moves slowly, don't blame me for not teaching you."
The pirate who had transferred his registry whispered the instructions to his companions behind him, fearing their escape plan would fail.
The situation was special now; before, he was alone and could easily avoid the Demon Lords' gaze, but now with a large group, any movement would easily draw their attention, so they had to be extremely careful.
"~What should I do if I need to fart?" the dirty pirate asked quietly.
"Hold it in—don't let your fart ruin everyone's lives!" the messy pirate shouted, blowing his beard and glaring. "This"... the dirty pirate looked troubled, "passing gas is a natural human urge—how could there be no reason to let it out?"
But seeing his pirate companions behind him glaring like fierce gods, as if they'd block his rear at any moment, he could only give up the idea, furrow his brows, and forcefully hold it in.
At this moment, the situation was somewhat delicate; the pirates were like a flock of sheep awaiting slaughter, while two tigers fought outside, making the sheep tremble with fear and feel extremely tense.
Locke watched the battle between Merlin and Mammon from afar, his worldview shaken—was this really a fight between kings?
Too strong! It was practically two beasts locked in mortal combat!
Rumors said the Demon Lords were mighty beings at the top of the world—and it seemed true!
I realized my knowledge was so shallow, like a frog at the bottom of a well; true powerhouses should be like them—lightly, they could leave a million corpses; heavily, they could destroy heaven and earth.
Locke was shocked by the Demon Lords' duel, realizing how foolish his idea of robbing the Demon Lord's Palace was; he wished he could become as strong as a Demon Lord, so avenging his father wouldn't be a mere flick of the finger.
However, Locke had a doubt: why was the blond-haired man also a Demon Lord? He had no horns, and under normal circumstances one could hardly detect his demonic nature.
Boom—Mammon lifted all the stones atop his head, barely managing to stand again, but his body trembled uncontrollably and blood trickled from the corner of his mouth, clearly his internal organs had suffered heavy damage.
Cunning Mammon had always valued his safety highly; it had been a long time since he'd suffered such a severe injury.
The shattered bones inside sent waves of heart-rending pain, making him repeatedly gulp cold air while plunging into endless rage—no one had ever injured him to this extent before—
"~Lucifer! You dare do this to me? I'll make you pay!" Mammon's roar grew hoarse, his body began to swell and expand, revealing his true Demon Lord form!
His size increased tenfold; his obese bulk became even more round, his skin turned green, covered in dense little bumps, making him look like a green spiky ball.
T
From beneath, eight thick spider-like legs sprouted, hauling his heavy, obese upper body upward, while fine black scales spread all the way to his waist.
Against his green skin, Mammon's jewelry stood out strikingly; the Demon Lord's horns on his head were broad and sturdy, symbolizing his exalted status among the demon race.
Even though Beelzebub's Fly King true form was already nauseating, Mammon's true appearance was even more hideous, making it hard to bear a second glance.
The pirates hiding in the dark dared not even breathe; Locke's eyes lit up as he thought, "That must be the Demon Lord's true form!" The pressure seemed to have increased too much, making it impossible to judge strength anymore.
Merlin silently watched the somewhat mad Mammon and said calmly, "Finally willing to get serious?"
"Lucifer! You may be low-born trash, but you've managed to anger me! I admit your power exceeds my expectations—you're a worthy opponent for me to give my all to defeat. But you'll surely regret your recklessness; no one can take advantage of me, and you're no exception."
Mammon swayed his massive obese frame; with a gesture, arcs of lightning flashed, and a peculiarly shaped katana, like myriad ghosts entwined, appeared out of thin air—indeed the demonic ancestor's divine artifact, the rending demon sword Tirblade!
As soon as this terrifying divine artifact appeared, under Mammon's urging it released a demonic shockwave, roaring toward Merlin with incredible speed and no way to avoid, slicing the ground ahead into countless tiny squares.
"Splurt!" Merlin instantly stumbled back, specks of blood spraying in the air; inexplicably, numerous fine crisscross wounds appeared on his body, even though Tirblade hadn't been drawn yet, it already possessed such terrifying power!
"You should feel immensely proud of this—only a handful of true powerhouses are worthy of me drawing Tirblade. I acknowledge you as an equal, but today you must fall beneath this A‑sword!" Mammon held Tirblade horizontally before him and continued solemnly, "When I unleash Tirblade, I am destined to stand invincible; no enemy has ever defeated me while I wield the demon sword. You will certainly not be the one to break this rule—you'll merely become a stepping stone on my path to victory."
Locke, hiding in the dark, used his Medusa eyes to see a different sight: Mammon's demon sword Tirblade seemed like a living vicious ghost, roaring wildly and ferociously; he couldn't help but sigh in his heart—
"What the hell kind of weapon is this?! Why does its aura surpass even that of a Demon Lord?!"
"Think it over, Lucifer." Mammon gripped the hilt of Tirblade, his evil black eyes narrowing slightly, "I didn't want to do this, but you forced me; even if you now kneel and beg for mercy, I won't spare you. Prepare yourself meekly for the miserable fate of your defeat."
Merlin tore off his own ragged upper garments, revealing his bare torso; the scars on his chest were shocking, his lean muscles tensed, and veins stood out.
The waist‑rotated 180° Banri Garan was twisted back into place, and Merlin also grew serious, deciding to face the demon sword Tirblade head‑on with his sword‑drawing technique—
"All that talk—what good is it?" "Come on!"
"Your dignity is nothing more than something under my feet, fit only to be trampled upon madly."

title: Chapter 63 — Merlin vs Mammon
content:
Chapter 63 — Merlin vs Mammon

Volume 31 · Chapter 63

Otherwise how could he suppress Mammon? It would never be convinced in its heart, nor would it ever agree to Merlin's terms.

For this war, Mammon had bet everything it had. How could it possibly give up so easily?

Merlin took a deep breath, his gaze sharp as lightning, his entire body tensed to the limit. He decided to carefully control the power of his iaijutsu strike and defeat Mammon with just the right amount of force, trampling its confidence beneath his feet.

In the demon race's way of thinking, it was only natural for the loser to obey the winner. This was also the reason why, despite being one unified entity, the demons were constantly at odds with each other internally.

"Lucifer, today I'll show you just how terrifying a power the relic left behind by the creator of the demon race truly holds!" Mammon's grotesque body sank lower, its grip tightening on the hilt of Tyr's Edge. "No one can survive under this blade at such close range—"

Merlin's expression was grim. Judging from the sheer intensity that had destroyed Leviathan's true form just now, he naturally understood that Tyr's Edge was no joke. But he was even more confident in himself.

Mammon's expression suddenly turned utterly vicious. The grinding sound of the demon sword being drawn made their eardrums ache, and a wailing, ghostly roar instantly echoed throughout the entire Demon Lord Palace!

With Tyr's Edge unsheathed, it was as if the evil spirit sealed within the divine artifact had been liberated. Countless fierce and sinister spirits shot forth at incredible speed, visible to the naked eye only as flashing white light!

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! The evil spirits transformed into sword energy, relentlessly slicing and tearing apart everything around them. Without anyone even touching them, the surrounding ground, walls, and stone pillars were all reduced to fragments, their cut surfaces as smooth as mirrors!

Mammon wielded Tyr's Edge in full force, slashing wildly at Merlin while roaring in fury—"Disappear! Lucifer!!"

The evil spirits intertwined with one another, forming a dense cutting net that thunderously descended upon Merlin.

Such an intensely concentrated attack— even a single fly would be sliced into three small cubes!

The terrifying evil spirit cutting net, accompanied by shrieks, reached the pirates hiding in the shadows. Hearing that sound, they immediately covered their ears and rolled on the ground in agony. If this had come even slightly closer, ordinary people would have long had their brains shattered by those piercing screams.

Yet facing the direct assault of Tyr's Edge, Merlin remained completely still, like a composed and calm grand master swordsman. With his body and sword merged into one, he paid no mind to anything around him.

Even though the evil spirit cutting net hadn't yet reached his front, Merlin could already feel this terrifying power. The razor-sharp airflow had cut his cheeks. No wonder even Leviathan found it difficult to resist.

The moment had arrived—"Slash!"

Merlin gritted his teeth, crimson light flickering in his shifting eyes. Power surged through his muscles and tendons, and with a thunderous release, the explosive wild wind unleashed by his iaijutsu strike split the earth beneath Merlin's feet, forming fissures resembling a seal array.

Because the sword draw was so fast, the blade actually sparked against the scabbard. Flames flickered upward, heating the Banri Garan blade to a red glow. The grim killing intent of the sword energy soared toward the heavens like a demon. As if it had caught the scent of its opponent, it fiercely charged against the incoming evil spirit cutting net!

The two powerful forces collided head-on. The grim killing intent pushed down the evil spirit cutting net, and in the blink of an eye, an earth-shattering explosion erupted. Flames and the shockwave swept outward in all directions, soaring straight toward the dome of the Demon Lord Palace.

"This—this is impossible! How can his power be stronger than Tyr's Edge!?"

Mammon wore an expression of utter disbelief, fear flooding its eyes as it simply refused to accept this reality.

Although that grim killing intent had only overcome the evil spirit cutting net for an instant, it had seen everything clearly. Its full-power activation of Tyr's Edge hadn't defeated Merlin at all—in fact, it had been suppressed!?

In Mammon's eyes, Tyr's Edge in its hands was an invincible presence. No enemy could withstand even a single strike from it. Yet that belief crumbled completely at this very moment!

Mammon had been fiercely proud of its unbeaten legend while wielding Tyr's Edge. But today, someone had shattered it. And it wasn't just anyone—it was a mere kid it had always looked down upon, Lucifer the Third, a lowborn outcast! This couldn't help but make it begin to question its very existence, its heart filled with shame and fury.

The flame blast wave from the explosion arrived in an instant. Mammon couldn't resist at all and was knocked backward with great force, crashing heavily into the cold wall of the Demon Lord Palace, mercilessly burning its body.

The entire Demon Lord Palace rumbled. With the sound of crumbling, the dome collapsed in a roar. Countless massive rocks fell to the ground with booming crashes. The centuries-old Demon Lord Palace hadn't been destroyed by the Holy Church—but by the clash between two Demon Lords.

The duel between Merlin and Mammon had decided a winner in merely three breaths.

"This kind of power! So this is the power of a Demon Lord!" Loki's eyes blazed with fanaticism. The power of the Demon Lords became something he would never forget in his entire life. "Truly so overwhelming. If I had such power, there'd be nothing I couldn't accomplish!"

"Master! Let's go! Don't dawdle—this is our best chance to escape! If we're late, we're done for!" The chaotic pirates dragged Loki away, ordering all the other pirates to follow them as they slipped out of the Demon Lord Palace in the confusion.

"~Demon Lord Lucifer—" Loki's gaze remained fixed on Merlin's figure in the distance, unwilling to look away even as the pirates forcibly dragged him backward.

Merlin frowned slightly, sensing there were others in the Demon Lord Palace. His glance swept across and caught sight of several pirates who had already slipped past the main gate. His heart grew puzzled—

How could there be humans inside the Demon Lord Palace? Could Mammon have captured human slaves? Never mind that—dealing with Mammon came first.

◆

The explosion at the Sixth Demon Lord Palace caught the attention of the joint fleet.

A massive fireball rose in the direction of the strait Demon Lord Palace, turning the sky a deep red and proving extremely conspicuous. Its tremendous power began to spread, causing the sea to churn violently and lose its calm.

"Your Highness, something seems to be happening over there!" Blaise pointed toward the blazing fire, speaking with a cold sweat. "I can feel two powerful auras colliding fiercely. It seems something has gone wrong at the demons' stronghold."

"I can sense it faintly too—those two presences are almost monstrous," Jeanne also gazed toward the distant wishes, her expression grave. "At a critical moment like this, who's attacking the Demon Lord Palace?"

Margaret raised her telescope, observed for a moment, and thoughtfully replied, "Normally speaking, aside from us, there shouldn't be any third party looking for trouble with the demon race. But there is one possibility—though extremely slight…"

"What?" Jeanne追问curiously.

"That—" Margaret frowned, pondered for a moment, then answered—"The demon race itself has fallen into the vortex of internal strife."

title: Chapter 64 — Command
content:
Chapter 64 — Command

Volume 31 · Chapter 64

~Is this possible, Your Highness?" Blaise asked in surprise, unable to imagine the demons engaging in infighting at a time like this.

"It's not entirely impossible, just highly unlikely. Besides, can you explain the current situation? Other than internal turmoil within the demon race, who else would dare attack the Demon Lord Palace?" Margaret was stumped, unable to think of any third party.

"This..." Blaise scratched his head, momentarily at a loss for how to argue.

"It's still possible." Zephyr gazed at the Demon Lord Palace burning in flames. "I've heard His Excellency the Bishop say that the demons have great internal conflicts, and when facing the Crusade Army, they always fight alone, rarely uniting."

"Is that so?" Margaret pondered, then asserted, "Then isn't this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us? Not only can we break through the demons' naval blockade, but we can also seize the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, opening up the Wesinan Strait for our ships."

"Exactly. Your Highness must seize this chance. After capturing the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, you'll gain merit and naturally become the heir to the French throne." Blaise's eyes lit up, as if he could already see Margaret receiving the Pope's blessing and ascending the French throne.

"That sounds pretty good~" Margaret wore a smug smile and issued an order: "Spread the word—aim the magical cannons at those sea demons. The mission has changed. We're taking the Demon Lord Palace."

The orders quickly reached every warship. Amidst the mechanical roar, over a hundred warships' gunports swung toward the distant sea demons.

Margaret planned to first suppress the sea demons with a barrage of heavy fire, then have the command ships press the full assault and launch a landing operation. Since the demons might be in the midst of internal strife, she felt it would be a shame not to seize the entire Wesinan Strait while the opportunity presented itself.

The Wesinan Strait was a crucial maritime route. If it became the territory of the French Kingdom, the benefits would be immense—even just collecting tolls from merchant ships would bring in substantial revenue.

~All preparations are complete, Your Highness." Blaise returned to report.

"Fire!" Margaret didn't hesitate, pointing at the demons above the strait and giving the attack order. Boom, boom, boom—over two hundred magical cannons fired simultaneously, the brilliant light almost illuminating half the sky.

The intense bombardment nearly covered all the sea demons. It seemed Margaret intended to drive the demons to extinction.

The sea demons, facing the torrential cannon fire, fell into chaos. Their existence was merely to serve as targets to draw the cannon fire. Without Leviathan's protection, they couldn't resist the oppression.

But suddenly, a massive wall of water surged into the sky, blocking all the cannon fire. The intense bombardment struck the giant water wall, like a drop of water sinking into the sea, producing a sizzling sound as it was extinguished.

"What's going on!?" Blaise was startled inwardly. Could there be a powerful water-element mage among the demons?

Zephyr's heart skipped a beat. Her body trembled involuntarily as she stammered, "The Demon Lord is the Demon Lord!"

Margaret's face darkened. It seemed the situation wasn't as simple as she'd imagined. After all the cannon fire was blocked, the massive water wall slowly dissipated—but the sky had already grown overcast.

The enormous body of Leviathan had already wrapped around the Wesinan Strait, its neck stretching up into the clouds like a pillar reaching for the heavens. Its ferocious head slowly descended, its twelve crimson eyes glaring angrily at the allied fleet.

Seeing such a terrifying figure, the soldiers and knights of the allied fleet were instantly stunned. Facing the sea Demon Lord Leviathan, they couldn't muster even a shred of fighting spirit. Fear began to spread through the fleet, and many soldiers even screamed and fainted.

"This can't be...!" Blaise gulped nervously, stammering, "This can't be the master of the Sixth Demon Lord Palace—the Sea King Demon Lord Leviathan!"

"The demons should be in internal conflict, so why would it suddenly appear here? Could the infighting have been resolved so quickly?" Margaret gnashed her teeth in frustration, gazing at Leviathan's massive form. Even in her heart, she couldn't help but feel a measure of fear.

"Leviathan, the ruler of the seas..."

Zephyr stared in shock, instinctively clawing at her chest, desperately trying to calm her fear—but to no avail. "I've seen Demon Lords before, yet why does Leviathan's pressure feel even stronger than Belial's!"

Just from seeing this sea Demon Lord once, my resolve, my devotion, everything was effortlessly destroyed. How could I possibly catch up to Alice with such a spirit?

Zephyr broke into a cold sweat, the color draining from her face like the ebbing tide. A single glance had stripped her of all courage, and she'd already forgotten the charge she'd just been eager to lead.

It wasn't that Leviathan's strength surpassed Belial's, but rather that its enormous physique exerted a far greater sense of oppression. For humans adrift on the sea, facing a sea monster that churned the waters, fear was an instinct born from the depths of the soul.

The sea demons, seeing Leviathan's return, were overjoyed and flew into the sky singing moving songs, as if welcoming their master home. Finally, they could escape the oppression of the demons.

Leviathan gazed down at the humans of the allied fleet, freely radiating its imposing aura, leaving them steeped in deep dread.

~ROOOAAAR!

Leviathan let out a mighty roar, the sound waves causing the sea to surge and waves to spray into the air.

Though it was just Leviathan's simple howl, its power was immense, shattering the warships at the front of the allied fleet in an instant. A large number of soldiers and knights fell into the water, struggling and calling for help—but the rest had already been frightened senseless by Leviathan's roar.

"...Margaret managed a strained, unpleasant smile, her teeth chattering. A single roar with such power—if the enemy got serious, the allied fleet would be doomed in an instant.

"Retreat! Retreat!"

◇

Inside the Sixth Demon Lord Palace, the explosion's smoke and flames cleared.

Mammon's fat body slid down the cold wall, clutching the demon sword Teir Vance, kneeling on one knee, his expression twisted in pain as he spat out a pool of black blood onto the ground.

The explosion's aftermath had dealt Mammon a severe blow. His internal organs felt displaced, and the intense pain made him dazed and breathless—even Merlin, standing before him, remained unresponsive.

"Are you satisfied now? You can agree to my terms—give up your expansionist ambitions."

Merlin looked down at him from above, her sharp tone clearly a command.

"Hehhe..."

Mammon struggled to breathe, his exhaustion causing his eyelids to droop. Seeing Merlin in a triumphant posture, his lingering shame and rage overwhelmed his remaining rationality. Forcing through the pain, he suddenly struck, taking advantage of Merlin's momentary relaxation after her "victory" to launch a surprise attack, raising the demon sword Teir Vance and swinging it down toward her throat.

"Lucifer! How dare you—!!"

title: Chapter 65 — The True Ancestor Attacks
content:
Chapter 65 — The True Ancestor Attacks

Volume 31 · Chapter 65

Even though it was a lowly demon of inferior status, it dared to come atop its master today? How could that be endured? Furthermore, it had invested tremendous wealth and energy for this war. How could it easily abandon its ambitions of outward expansion? The greedy Mammon had never in the habit of making a losing deal, and Merlin's demands had already crossed its bottom line!

Mammon suddenly rose in a surprise attack, hoping to eliminate Merlin through ambush and re-establish its authority. But when Tir Segamyr came down with full force, Mammon suddenly felt as though it had struck at nothing—its arm couldn't exert any strength at all.

Looking closely, Merlin had somehow raised his Banri Garan. Strands of pitch-black blood blossoms drifted through the air—as heavy-armored hand wielding Tir Segamyr carved a beautiful arc mid-flight before clattering to the ground.

"Mammon looked on in blank confusion, gazing at its right arm and confirming it was gone. From the clean cut, gushes of blood erupted, drenching the Demon Lord Palace's floor in red!"

"Didn't you learn your lesson? If I hadn't held back, you'd be dead already." Merlin sighed.

"Aaaah!!!" Mammon howled in agony, clutching its severed arm and rolling across the floor, "Lucifer! You despicable bastard! How dare you harm me? You won't escape a miserable end!"

"Oh? Is that so?" Merlin responded calmly, unbothered by Mammon's curses.

"Hnn!" Mammon gritted its teeth and frantically crawled toward its severed arm, wanting to retrieve Tir Segamyr to continue fighting Merlin.

As the distance to Tir Segamyr, which had fallen to the ground, grew ever closer—Merlin suddenly appeared and pressed his foot against the blade, completely crushing Mammon's last hope.

Trying to get Tir Segamyr from Merlin would be harder than reaching the heavens!

"Mammon humbly raised its head and saw Merlin standing above, his facial features contorted and twitching incessantly."

"Why won't you give up?" Merlin pointed the blade of Banri Garan at Mammon's nose. "The next body part to be severed will be your head. I keep my word."

"Mammon's eyes were filled with terror. It had no doubt about Merlin's words—if it continued to tangle, it would surely die!"

"Will you or will you not abandon your ambitions for outward expansion and recall the invading army from the Kingdom of Britain?" Merlin's tone was stern as he questioned, his hand gripping the hilt tightly.

"I I—"

Facing blatant threats and feeling the icy chill radiating from the blade, though deeply unwilling, Mammon bowed its head. Even though it had staked everything on this war, it still valued its own life more.

Mammon tightened its remaining fist and pressed its forehead against the cold floor, teeth clenched, announcing its decision. "I am willing. The army will be recalled very soon."

◇

After Merlin left, the devastated Demon Lord Palace regained some tranquility.

Merlin didn't worry about Mammon reneging, because breaking a promise meant paying with one's life.

This was the rule of the demon race—the defeated must obey the victor, or face a threat to their life. After this battle, Merlin believed Mammon should have seen reality clearly and wouldn't dare to oppose him further. Moreover, Merlin hadn't taken Mammon's life, which meant there would be room to maneuver even with the Elder Council.

The ancient Demon Lord Palace was now a ruin of broken walls, appearing somewhat less majestic.

Mammon stood amidst the wreckage, looking utterly despondent. Today's defeat had dealt an unusually massive blow to it. It slowly approached its severed arm, picked it up, and reattached it. The clean cut healed over in an instant.

Mammon tried swinging its healed arm—it could barely still use it—but the severe injuries to its body remained serious—That damn Lucifer III! I can withdraw the army from the Kingdom of Britain, but you'd better watch out!

I will ally with Beelzebub and lodge a complaint in the Elder Council. Unless you're sealed inside the Magic-Sealing Pot, this matter won't end here! Any bastard who provokes me will pay a grievous price. No one can escape this fate!

The day of the Seven Kings Conference was drawing ever closer. Enjoy your final days, Lucifer.

Mammon thought viciously within its heart. It would fulfill its promise, but that didn't mean it had let Merlin off the hook. Since it had stumbled because of Merlin, it would definitely regain its dignity.
