Merlin's face flushed with embarrassment, picking up his bag and running faster than anyone else, feeling a sense of accomplishment for doing something bad.

Oh my god! ! !

Wasn't it just hugging this good woman, Alice? Why was I so nervous?

Now she should be able to see my attitude, right? Besides Asmodeus, I've never been this serious!

Now Alice must think I'm crazy, right? Good, since I have to leave here temporarily, bye!

Until Merlin's figure disappeared completely, Alice maintained a calm, dignified, and unruffled appearance, showing no signs of panic, but her heart was already a mess, imagining some strange things.

After Merlin's figure disappeared, Alice could no longer pretend and her rigid body suddenly softened, continuously flapping her red cheeks, hoping to calm down. She almost passed out just now.

Oh my god.

What did Merlin want? Suddenly hugging her.

I almost forgot to push him away. I'm not just any girl, can I be hugged around?

Why did he hug me? Was it just a simple desire to hug? What a joke!

If it wasn't because he liked me, how could he have hugged me?

Did Merlin have feelings for me?

What time was it?

Alice blushed, covering her mouth, standing in place, thinking whether her daily care had taken effect?

Although Alice couldn't figure out the exact answer, she did realize that Merlin's feelings for her were different from before, and he had even tried to have more intimate contact with her.

A seemingly ordinary farewell hug let Merlin and Alice both sense each other's intentions. Alice even thought that if she were more proactive, maybe the wedding would have ended a long time ago.

Alice silently exhaled, covering her hot cheeks, looking away, thinking that the next time they met, they wouldn't be able to interact as before. Just thinking about it made her nervous, and she had a little expectation as well.

"Such a slow-witted guy, why didn't you tell me earlier?"

"I don't mind, I've already said I don't dislike him."

"Big fool! No help!"

Alice's thoughts were interrupted by Chris's voice, making her jump.

title: Chapter 45 — Seven Kings' Meeting①
content:
Chapter 45 — Seven Kings' Meeting①

Volume 32 · Chapter 45

The Seven Kings' Conference was held in the council chamber where the elders met, half a month later.

Almost all the most powerful demons in the demon race attended, alongside the elders and the monarchs of various Demon Lord Palaces.

The council chamber was now packed, with demon elders seated around, their faces cold and silent, seemingly all in a foul mood.

Above the elders sat the chief judge, the small old demon Capri, who appeared to be resting his eyes, but was actually restless, his heart

filled with unease.

At the center of the council chamber stood a huge round table, with seven luxurious chairs evenly arranged, symbolizing the seven most powerful demons in the demon race.

The monarchs representing anger, lust, gluttony, envy, and sloth sat quietly in their seats, with only the positions of slowness and greed left empty, as all other demon lords were present.

Merlin was likely still on his way, and all the demons present were waiting for him. Originally, the meeting was meant to discuss external warfare, but

it had now turned into a one-sided trial aimed at punishing Merlin.

Since Belial had already announced Mammon's death, it was likely that everyone knew Mammon had been killed by Merlin, except for Merlin himself and the demons of the First Demon Lord Palace.

The mutual slaughter of monarchs was a major event that would shock the entire demon race. This was no longer a situation that merely touched the limits of the council, but a violation of the entire demon

race's interests and rules.

Internal strife was forbidden in the demon race, especially when it resulted in death, as it would cause the demon race to collapse from within without any external pressure.

This time, it was Mammon who died—a noble first-generation descendant who left no heirs. The loss of a monarch due to internal strife was a huge blow to the demon race, and it might be necessary to choose a new

greedy monarch from the relatives of other monarchs to inherit the Third Demon Lord Palace.

Although monarchs were rarely executed no matter what great mistakes they made, severe punishment was certainly inevitable, especially since Merlin had a sister who could take over the position of monarch. The council of old demons would not be lenient.

Leviathan lowered his head, frowning and remaining silent, his small young body sitting on the chair, his feet not even touching the floor.

Before the Seven Kings' Conference, Leviathan had done a lot of preparation, secretly contacting Asmodeus and Beelzebub, hoping they would join forces with him to stop the demon race's external expansion plans and

suppress the power of Belial, the only first-generation demon lord, in the council.

But after arriving, Leviathan realized all his preparations would be useless, because Belial had announced something to all the demons present:

Mammon had been killed by Lucifer III.

Compared to the mutual slaughter of monarchs resulting in death, Leviathan's and Merlin's interference in the council's decisions was not a big deal at all. With proper handling, it could be easily

overcome.

In the eyes of the demon elders, Leviathan's conflict with Mammon was just a friction caused by differences in ideology. It was not uncommon for demon lords to fight each other, but Mammon's death leading to an escalation of the situation was no longer a fight, but a murder of a fellow demon!

After Belial announced Mammon's death, the demon elders didn't want to mention that Leviathan and Merlin had violated the council's will. They only wanted to investigate Mammon's death, which was the top priority!

Leviathan remained silent, thinking about how Merlin had killed Mammon. He himself had not seen Mammon's body. Had someone carried away Mammon's body after his death? What had happened in the Demon Lord Palace during the time he was dealing with the human fleet?

"Asmodeus, will Lucifer really kill Mammon?"

Asmodeus heard Leviathan's whisper and raised his head slightly, covering his mouth with a fan and responding softly, "How do I know? Lucifer always likes to act recklessly and do things arbitrarily. I think it's not impossible for him to do something like this. What's so surprising about it?"

"No way, I think he's a rough but careful person and wouldn't be so reckless. No matter how monarchs fight, they won't want to kill each other. This is a rule that all demons know, and it's the bottom line for monarchs. Doesn't Lucifer know that?" Leviathan's tone was full of suspicion, and he felt that

there might be some misunderstanding about this matter.

"You shouldn't ask me about this matter. You two clearly messed up together, and you don't even know about it. How could I possibly know?" Asmodeus sighed helplessly, thinking to himself, "Who knows what Merlin is thinking? Why kill him when defeating Mammon would have been enough? Isn't that asking for trouble?"

"How could I possibly know how Mammon died? I was defending against the human fleet at the time. What happened between Lucifer and Mammon in the Demon Lord Palace?

I don't know anything about it." Leviathan responded irritably. When he returned, the Demon Lord Palace had already been demolished, leaving only some of Mammon's subordinates' bodies, and nothing else!

"Didn't you notice anything?" Asmodeus looked at Leviathan suspiciously, wondering if he was trying to cover up Merlin's crimes.

"No, when I sent Lucifer away, he seemed normal, not like he had just killed Mammon. He even said that Mammon would leave my territory on his own, and I didn't think much of it." Leviathan recalled, explaining.

"Is there any secret, Asmodeus?" He looked at Belial opposite him, thinking to himself, "Could it be that this old guy

has done something behind the scenes, maybe trying to muddy the waters?"

As the only first-generation demon lord, Belial's power here was the deepest, even more so than in his own Demon Lord Palace. Half of the demon elders present were his supporters.

Belial had already planned everything and was just waiting for Merlin to come to him. No matter who was secretly protecting him, he would disappear completely today.

Beelzebub tapped his ear on the chair, his eyebrows suddenly frowning, and he stood up, slapping the table, "Hey! When is this going to end? I don't have that much time to sit here with you. My cute little sister is still waiting for me to return to the Demon Lord Palace!"

The originally silent atmosphere of the council was suddenly broken by Beelzebub, and countless eyes turned to him. Many demon elders were disgusted by his loud noise there.

"Haha, Asmodeus covered his face with a fan and couldn't help but laugh when he saw Beelzebub's behavior.

"Is this monster, who is always hungry, really more interested in playing with his sister than in a meeting that decides the fate of the entire race?" Leviathan's face changed, and he was startled by Beelzebub.

"Your Highness Beelzebub, please be quiet. This is a council," Chief Judge Capri stood up to maintain order.

"Who cares about the council! ? Being with you old guys makes me feel like I'm going to die! If this meeting is going to continue, hurry up and finish it, or disperse early! Why should I waste my precious time on you guys?"

Belial sat on the chair, resting his face on his hand and smiling, "Young man, don't be so irritable. I hope you can calm down a bit.

"What?" Beelzebub tilted his mouth, like a lit firecracker, "What are you talking about? Old guy! Be careful, or I'll eat you up and leave not even a bone or a shred of flesh behind."

"Beelzebub, calm down. No matter what, Belial is our uncle. Be a little more respectful to Uncle Belial," Asmodeus said beside him, trying to calm the situation.

"Shut your damn mouth, you dead pervert. You're so disgusting." Beelzebub said coldly.

"Hmm?" Asmodeus immediately changed his expression, putting away his smile and turning his face into a cold mask, "What do you mean? Are you jealous of my beauty? You big fool."

"Leviathan sat on the chair, shivering, feeling that the situation was out of control, his mind in a mess—

Hey! What are you two doing! ?

Didn't we agree to join forces to fight against the council?

We haven't even started fighting yet, and you're already fighting each other!"

E(*△°I)

title: Chapter 46 — Seven Kings Conference 2 (Monthly Ticket Bonus)
content:
Chapter 46 — Seven Kings Conference 2 (Monthly Ticket Bonus)

Volume 32 · Chapter 46

Livitan rubbed his temples, wondering if he had chosen two poor partners, as they were supposed to be negotiating with the elders at this critical moment, yet they were arguing instead.

"You dare call me names? Do you want to fight?" Asmodeus' face darkened as he glared at Asmodeus. "When I speak, I dislike interruptions. Don't you know that?"

"Your lofty attitude is talking to me?" Asmodeus sneered, and the wind seemed to swirl around him. "This is the council, not your Fourth Demon Lord Palace. Be quiet."

"You perverted ghost, you're getting more and more annoying. I've always disliked your androgynous appearance." Lucifer clenched his fists, the bones cracking loudly.

"You perverted one who loves your own sister, you're not much better than me, are you?" Asmodeus taunted.

Chairman Caprius was sweating profusely, fearing that the two Demon Lords would start a fight during this important meeting.

"Asmodeus, insulting me is acceptable, but insulting my sister will have consequences." Lucifer's eyes flashed with menace, and a swarm of flesh-eating flies emerged from his ears.

"If someone insults my beauty, I won't let him go unpunished either." Asmodeus tilted her head slightly, her pupils rippling with a shimmering aura, as if a mirage was forming.

Suddenly, a towering figure stood up, slapping the heavy black-golden stone table with his massive hands. The table was cracked, leaving deep imprints, and the entire council hall seemed to tremble.

Who knows how much power this demon possesses to leave such marks on an unbreakable black-golden stone?

"Shhhhh!"

A deafening roar shook the hall, causing many elders to drop to the ground in fear. They stared at the headless king, Samair, fearing his wrath.

Lucifer: "??"

Asmodeus: "!!"

Both Demon Lords looked at the furious Samair, their brows furrowed in concern.

"Apologies for the disturbance, gentlemen. Though I lack a brain, I do respect etiquette and wish to avoid any rudeness. This meeting is serious, so I hope everyone will restrain themselves and not disrupt the order. I despise those who do not follow rules, so I hope you understand my feelings. Knowing me, when anger takes over, I may do something I regret later."

Samair bowed respectfully to everyone, expressing his apologies. The neat cuts on his neck released a faint black smoke.

"Samair, the most composed and polite king among us, yet in reality, he is not. If Merlin killed Mamon, it shocked all demons. But if Samair kills another Demon Lord, it would be seen as a natural outcome, and no one would be surprised."

Samair's uncontrollable rage could affect his surroundings, and his terrifying power made other kings uneasy.

Belial looked at Samair with a meaningful gaze, regretting that his potential to surpass him was ruined by his parents' injuries, and he was a neutral party.

"Remember this." Lucifer scowled and sat down under pressure.

"Alright, I don't bother with brutes." Asmodeus pretended to be relaxed and turned away from Lucifer.

"This is the right attitude. Don't be so eager. If Lucifer III doesn't come, this meeting wouldn't have happened." Belial looked at the two empty seats and smiled. "Now that Mamon is dead, we need an explanation."

Lucifer raised an eyebrow and said sarcastically, "Did Lucifer kill that fat guy? This isn't all your one-sided words, is it? Until now, you haven't provided any evidence."

"Yes, Uncle Belial, I have a good relationship with Lucifer, and based on my understanding of him, he wouldn't do something as stupid as this. It's not possible that everything is your fabrication, is it?" Asmodeus probed further.

"I also doubt your words, Mamon and Lucifer's fight was not witnessed by me, but Lucifer wouldn't be stupid enough to kill Mamon in my territory, which is irrational." Livitan spoke seriously.

Belial twirled his fingers and observed Livitan, Lucifer, and Asmodeus, realizing that they had been in secret communication.

"As your seniors, I won't slander a Third-generation Prince. The evidence that Lucifer killed Mamon is indeed in my possession; otherwise, I wouldn't dare to announce this." Belial paused and said with deep meaning, "I have experienced the brutal Holy War, witnessed the near-extinction of our demon race, so no one is more eager to see our race thrive and grow stronger than me. Therefore, I don't want to frame a Third-generation Prince who bears the future of our race."

"But Lucifer killed Mamon, and we lost a powerful ally. The Third Demon Lord Palace is now in chaos, and Merlin Lucipher is the mastermind behind this. He should take responsibility for this."

"Oh? Lucifer tilted his head and asked, "Since you have evidence, why not show it to us?"

"The criminal hasn't arrived yet, so don't be so eager." Belial said with a hint of meaning, "If the evidence is not placed in front of the criminal, allowing him to see it, it wouldn't be meaningful."

"If Lucifer III is indeed the killer of Mamon, then he is a rule-breaker and deserves punishment. The rules of the demon race, even for kings, cannot be broken at will. Moreover, he is an exiled identity, and we don't even know if he has reflected on his actions." Samair muttered, believing that Merlin, as a failed exiled king, must have some issues that the Holy Church cannot tolerate.

Asmodeus looked at Livitan beside him, who seemed clueless, and wondered if Belial had not spoken, then Merlin had indeed killed Mamon.

Chairman Caprius on the judge's seat was restless, feeling that the situation was out of control. He began to pray silently, hoping that Merlin would not attend this Seven Kings Council, as it was clearly a trap set up for him!

Suddenly, the council door was gently pushed open.

Merlin entered alone, his shoulders carrying a pack, and he didn't forget to wave at the black-faced noble elders around, displaying a bold and shameless attitude, as if he was returning home.

"Haha, sorry, I must have arrived late~"

title: Chapter 47 — Seven Kings Meeting (3)
content:
Chapter 47 — Seven Kings Meeting (3)

Volume 32 · Chapter 47

Merlin suddenly appeared, causing the eyes of all the demons in the council to snap toward him, all waiting for him to explain the killing of Mammon. "Huh?" Merlin looked around, sensing the atmosphere was a bit subtle, feeling that the demon elders' gazes toward him were filled with anger; he wondered in his heart, is it just because I'm a little late? Do I have to be like that? "I was delayed by something on the way, I didn't mean to be late, I hope you won't hold it against me, haha~" Seeing Merlin's nonchalant attitude, the faces of all the demon elders grew even uglier; clearly they had committed a grave mistake, killing their own kin, yet they could still stay relaxed? This mindset was obviously abnormal. Leviathan slightly furrowed his brow, thinking, what is Lucifer up to? Doesn't he know that killing Mammon is such a sin in his eyes? "Lucifer, hurry up and take your seat, everyone's waiting for you." Asmodeus gave Merlin a meaningful glance, hoping he understood that today's meeting was not simple. But Merlin utterly failed to grasp Asmodeus's meaning, instead finding it strange that this guy's gaze toward him today was so odd. Merlin didn't think much of it, came to the round table, set his pack aside, and sat down in the seat belonging to the Sovereign of Pride, looking at the familiar faces around, he said with a grin— "Have you all been waiting long? Your faces look a bit grim, do you really have to be this angry?" "I, a banished wandering demon, am I really that important? Must we wait for me to arrive before we can start?" "Huh? Strange, why hasn't Mammon arrived yet? Could he be later than me? Obviously I didn't strike too hard; his injuries should have healed by now." Upon saying that, several demon lords' faces turned even darker, unsure if Merlin was feigning ignorance; if so, it proved he felt no remorse for slaying his kin, and the elders' anger began to rise. "Lucifer, the council is a place for discussing matters; weapons are not allowed inside. Don't you know this rule?" Samael suddenly spoke coldly. As soon as he finished, a demon hurried forward respectfully, extending his hands, hoping Merlin would hand over the demon sword Banri Garan, as no demon is permitted to carry weapons in the council. "This..." Merlin drew the katana at his waist, hesitated a moment, but still handed it over to another demon for temporary safekeeping. He wasn't attending his first Seven Kings Council; he knew the rule, he just momentarily forgot it. "Since everyone's here, let's begin the meeting." Beelzebub's smile deepened, he gave Merlin a meaningful look. Merlin felt a strange inexplicable sensation, wondering in his heart, is it starting already? Mammon hasn't even arrived yet—is it appropriate to begin like this? The presiding officer Caprio struck his gavel, instantly quieting the council, sighed and announced. "The Seven Kings Council, begins." Merlin took a deep breath, surveyed the many elders and a few monarchs, thinking they would surely discuss external expansion; I had stopped Mammon, which would surely dissatisfy many demon elders—how should I persuade them? "Next, we will start investigating the death of His Majesty Mammon," Caprio announced the first agenda item. "Huh? ? ?" Merlin heard this, his face full of bewilderment, thinking Mammon died? When? Who did it? "Your Majesty Lucifer, what is your opinion on the matter of Mammon's death?" Caprio asked sternly. The demon lords' gazes all turned to Merlin, wanting to know how he would answer this question. Merlin felt quite puzzled, thinking why are they all staring at me? It's bizarre; I only just learned of Mammon's death myself. "Opinion? What could I possibly say? I'm just surprised—how did Mammon die?" "Are you completely unaware of this?" Caprio furrowed his brows, sensing something was off. "How could I possibly know? What does Mammon's death have to do with me?" Merlin spread his hands, laughing and crying at once. Samael tapped the table three times with his finger, questioning suspiciously, "Could it not be you who did it?" "What nonsense are you spouting? Why would I kill Mammon?" Merlin's face shifted, he gave Samael a cold glance. Asmodeus and Leviathan looked toward Beelzebub; seeing this, Merlin seemed completely unaware of the matter, so they could only check whether Beelzebub's evidence was persuasive. "Hey old man, you didn't say Lucifer killed Mammon, did you? But it looks like that's not the case at all—randomly framing others isn't good." Beelzebub said sarcastically. Merlin turned his gaze to Beelzebub, eyes full of hostility, thinking he hadn't interacted much with this first demon lord; why would he frame me? What scheme is he hatching? "Hmph. Beelzebub chuckled, looking at Merlin, 'Lucifer, your acting is decent, but do you think pretending ignorance can let you escape the fact that you killed Mammon?'" "What are you saying?" Merlin's face turned cold, he said sternly, 'Make yourself clear—when did I kill Mammon?' "'When? Isn't it when you tried to stop our clan's revival, clashing with Mammon?' Beelzebub paused, then sneered, 'You betrayed us, to protect your own interests, you personally maimed your own kin!'" Merlin jumped up from his seat with a 'teng', shouting, 'Nonsense! Beelzebub, don't think because you have great influence in the elder council you can just slander me! I won't allow anyone to defame me at will!' "Lucifer, you really won't shed tears until you see the coffin." Beelzebub curled his lip, clapped three times— A demon dressed in black clothes stepped forward under everyone's eyes, slowly walking to the center of the hall. He lifted his head, expression solemn; it was Mammon's personal guard, Aus. After bringing Mammon's corpse back to the Third Demon Lord's Palace, he had contacted Beelzebub. Aus knew he couldn't oppose Merlin, couldn't help Mammon take revenge, so he could only rely on Beelzebub's power; following Beelzebub's suggestion, he would become a witness who only recognizes Merlin as the culprit. "Eh!" Merlin gritted his teeth, never expecting it to be this demon—who knows if he'll spout nonsense and smear me with dirt. "This demon is named Aus, Mammon's most trusted personal guard; after Mammon's death he came to me, hoping I would uphold justice for Mammon and personally expose Lucifer, the most heinous traitor in demon history." Beelzebub narrowed his eyes slightly, watching the shocked Merlin, wanting to see how he would respond. "Lucifer the Third" Aus's eyes turned red, his gaze nearly bursting, filled with burning hatred toward Merlin— "You think killing Mammon's Majesty lets you off easy?" "For your own interests, you trampled the dignity of the elder council, personally slaughtering your own kin..." "You are clearly a traitor to the demon race! For the death of Mammon's Majesty, I will make you pay with your blood!"

title: Chapter 48 — Seven Kings Conference ④
content:
Chapter 48 — Seven Kings Conference ④

Volume 32 · Chapter 48

Ose's deafening speech was heard clearly by every demon elder present, and they began scrutinizing the youngest monarch among the demon race, unable to help but doubt whether his stance had already turned to betrayal.

Merlin's expression turned cold in an instant, yet he remained seated steadily in his chair without offering any explanation. He had no idea how Mammon had died at all—everything seemed inexplicable, and he had only just arrived and was already the enemy of all the demons.

"Ose, speak up then. How exactly did Mammon die at Lucifer's hands? Let the elders hear it," Belial said, leaning lazily against his chair, his gaze fixed on scrutinizing Merlin.

"As you command." Ose bowed slightly, then raised his head and spoke loudly to the assembled elders—"

"Lucifer is no longer a respected young monarch. Without a doubt, he has betrayed the demon race, and in order to protect his own interests, he did not hesitate to turn the slaughtering blade toward his own kin."

"After the Council of Elders determined the strategy for external expansion, Lucifer disregarded the authority of all the elders and unilaterally stopped His Majesty Mammon's war against the Kingdom of Britain. He charged into the Sixth Demon Lord Palace of Leviathan, engaged in fierce combat with His Majesty Mammon, and mercilessly severed our sovereign's head without a moment's hesitation!"

"Lucifer showed no consideration for the consequences of killing His Majesty Mammon, which has already broken the long-standing rules of the demon race. He deserves the harshest punishment!"

"His Majesty Mammon made the revival of the demon race his mission. He was the demon most likely to break our race's long history of oppression by humans, yet he fell at the hands of the despicable Lucifer!"

"Respected elders, I am willing to take responsibility for the truthfulness of my words. Please punish this traitor of the demon race on behalf of the late King Mammon!"

With the speech finished, the demon elders in the council began whispering among themselves, their buzzing discussions rising to a din. They pointed at Merlin seated before the round table from time to time, thinking that this third-generation monarch had achieved nothing—which was forgivable—but now it seemed his loyalties were completely skewed. To stop the prosperity of the demon race, he had not hesitated to personally slay the equally noble Mammon; the suspicion of "betrayal" was heavy.

Leviathan frowned slightly. He felt that Ose's testimony as a witness was indeed very persuasive, yet it lacked rigor. To conclude that Merlin was a traitor simply because he had killed Mammon carried a whiff of forcing a label onto someone.

However, Asmodeus, who knew more secrets, reacted completely differently from Leviathan. He believed seven or eight out of ten parts of Ose's speech. "Merlin, is all of this true? Did you cruelly kill Mammon for your own benefit?"

"Ose, having experienced all of this firsthand, has bravely stepped forward to expose Lucifer's crimes. I admire this courage. Rest assured, I will fully support you." Belial's gaze swept across the demon elders before settling on the presiding judge Caprio seated in the high position. "The Council of Elders has always been renowned for its impartiality. It will not let any erring demon go unpunished, even if that demon is a monarch."

Many demon elders hearing these words nodded in approval. Their very existence was meant to balance the power of the Demon Lords, and now was the time for them to play that role. Lucifer the Third had to accept punishment in order to reestablish the authority of the Council of Elders.

"Your Majesty Belial, you truly do not disappoint as the most venerable great monarch of the demon race. Only you could uphold justice for our sovereign." Ose bowed deeply to Belial, expressing his gratitude.

"Lucifer, what do you have to say now? A witness has already come forward to expose you." Belial seemed confident of victory as he pressed Merlin for an answer.

Merlin kept his head lowered, so no one could see his expression, yet he suddenly burst out laughing. "Hahaha..."

"What are you laughing at!? Don't you feel even a shred of guilt for killing King Mammon!?" Ose roared in anger.

"Why do you insist it was I who killed Mammon? Throughout all of this, haven't you been talking only to yourself?" Merlin slowly raised his head and fired back with a question. "Could it be that you personally saw me chop off Mammon's head?"

Several of the Demon Lords looked toward Ose again, each harbouring growing suspicion in their hearts. Merlin was right—they could not judge the matter based solely on Ose's words. Whether the killer of Mammon was truly Merlin or not had to be witnessed firsthand to be convincing.

A thin layer of cold sweat beaded on Ose's forehead. He indeed had not seen it with his own eyes. "King Mammon's entire body was covered in blade wounds, especially the fatal injury on his neck. Aside from you, who excels at iaijutsu, was there anyone else present who could have done such a thing!?"

Merlin's heart sank. He remembered there was a second person who knew his iaijutsu and could inflict similar wounds.

Cain—that original ancestor who had once deceived Merlin and stolen his ability. With iaijutsu nearly on par with Merlin's, Cain could have done this.

But Merlin could not be certain that Cain was the one who killed Mammon, for he had not witnessed it himself, nor could he think of any reason why that original ancestor would have murdered a demon monarch.

"Is it impossible? While I was fighting Mammon, a group of pirates slipped away quietly. What if they did it after I left?"

"To be honest..." Leviathan furrowed his brows, recalling. "At the crime scene, I found an exquisitely crafted steel katana. Considering Lucifer possesses Banri Garan, he should have had no need to use a simple steel katana. Perhaps besides Lucifer, there was another skilled swordsman involved."

"That's specious reasoning!" Ose retorted indignantly, raising his voice. "Are you implying that Our Liege was killed by pirates? What nonsense! This is an insult to Our Liege! Even if King Mammon had only one breath left, he would absolutely not have died at the hands of a bunch of pirates!"

"That's not necessarily so~" Merlin rested his arms behind his head, leaning back in his chair with a casual, mocking tone. "Mammon's strength was pathetically weak—everyone knows that. If he couldn't use his divine treasure, then being hacked to death by a group of pirates isn't surprising at all."

"You!?" Ose pointed at Merlin, so infuriated that his eyes seemed ready to pop out, a belly full of foul words stuck in his throat.

"At the end of the day, you never personally saw me kill Mammon, correct?" Merlin paused and said calmly. "So everything is just your speculation. You want to frame me without producing any evidence? Tell me, shouldn't I cut you down?"

Ose was frightened into taking a step back. The charge of framing a monarch was indeed serious enough to warrant beheading.

The positions of the demon elders on both sides began to waver. For a time, none dared to draw a conclusion hastily. Ose's accusation alone was insufficient to convict Merlin. They couldn't rule out the possibility that the killer was someone else.

"Since you like to speculate so much, let me try speculating as well." Merlin narrowed his eyes slightly, his gaze intentionally or unintentionally fixing on Belial.

"I intervened to stop Mammon's external war, which may have harmed the interests of certain radical factions."

"These radicals don't care about the consequences of failure at all. They only want to gain endless wealth through war."

"After Mammon's defeat, they couldn't accept it, so they secretly killed Mammon and framed me, hoping the situation would escalate so they could continue pushing their external expansion strategy, while conveniently getting rid of me—what a clever way to kill two birds with one stone~"

"I've heard that the radical faction elders are all firm supporters of Belial, and they also had very close dealings with Mammon. Then the true killer who murdered Mammon..."

"Wouldn't it be the noble first-generation monarch, the influential Mr. Belial?"

title: Chapter 49 — The Seven Kings' Conference ⑤
content:
Chapter 49 — The Seven Kings' Conference ⑤

Volume 32 · Chapter 49

Merlin's words directly targeted Belial, which stunned many of the demon elders.

What kind of identity is Belial? It is the only surviving original demon from the Holy War, who participated in the establishment of the Council and a series of rules, and is the most respected monarch in the demon race.

Merlin dared to open fire on Belial, which had the meaning of a newborn calf not afraid of the tiger, and few people dared to do so.

Even though Beelzebub had the courage to challenge Belial, and let it defame Belial, he would have to think carefully, "defamation" is a problem that touches the bottom line of a monarch.

"Lucifer, don't start speaking nonsense because you're desperate!" Orcus pointed at Merlin and said, "What kind of person is Belial, how could he do such a mean thing? It's all your slander!"

"Oh well~ Merlin tilted his mouth and joked, "If I slander Belial, isn't your accusation of me also slander? You are Mamon's subordinate, right? Why do you lick Belial like a dog, what benefits have you received from it?"

"You!" Orcus' nose was twisted by anger, but he couldn't find any reason to refute at the moment.

Some conservative demon elders couldn't help but comment, although Merlin's statement was just a guess, but it seemed to be possible, and many strange looks were directed at Belial.

"You say I killed Mamon? That's ridiculous. The struggle between monarchs is based on not harming each other, which I know, and I have no motivation to kill Mamon, what's the benefit to me?" Merlin paused and said meaningfully, "Don't call me a traitor with your mouth full of one, the real traitor, I'm afraid there is another person~"

Hey, Belial, is this the evidence you've shown? Do you want to treat us like monkeys?

Beelzebub stood up and guessed, "You want to investigate the death of Mamon is false, and want to clean up the conservative forces in the demon race is true, right!"

Judge Caprius was surprised and suddenly shouted, "Belial, are you creating facts out of thin air to disrupt the rules of the Council?"

"Belial, what are you thinking? Please give an explanation."

Belial looked up, still calm and composed, and was not affected at all, "Lucifer, no, Merlin, I underestimated your bottom line, abandoned dignity and cunningly argued, only used lies to cover up your shameful deeds, you are not qualified to be a monarch, and you are not worthy to sit in the same position as us."

"What do you mean? Are you threatening me? I respect you very much because you and I fought together in the blood, but my tolerance has its limits."

Merlin retorted with bated breath, and did not retreat at all.

Belial stood up and walked to the center of the council, he adjusted his suit like a gentleman, and then spoke loudly---

"You say you have no motivation to kill Mamon? That's a laughable lie.

"You have sufficient motivation, and you have betrayed the demon race, which is undeniable.

"Undoubtedly, what you have done is the greatest disgrace in the history of the demon race!"

Oh? Merlin looked at Belial with interest, thinking that this old man didn't give up on me easily, what's he up to?

"Belial, please speak carefully," Caprius became serious and emphasized, "The Council is based on evidence, empty words are not many demons willing to support you."

Belial's right hand spread out, and a crystal ball appeared out of thin air, "Next, let me show you the evidence of Lucifer's betrayal of us!"

As soon as the words fell, a series of clear images were projected from the crystal ball, which was the scene of Merlin and Alice communicating with a mysterious fortune-teller, and the family of three looked happy, especially Chris, whose appearance was at least five or six times similar to Merlin.

Seeing this scene, many demon elders were confused, not knowing what was going on? Seeing Merlin chatting with a human woman, it seems that their relationship is not ordinary.

Beelzebub and Asmodeus' faces turned black at the same time, because they knew the situation, if Belial attacks on this point, then Merlin may not be saved.

Especially Beelzebub was more surprised, although he had warned Merlin, but soon, even the children could be used as seasoning! ? ?

Merlin's face turned very bad, he recalled the mysterious fortune-teller that day, and now he realized that the man was Belial's man, and had completely recorded his life in the crystal ball, which was now Belial's evidence to frame him!

"Elders, after Lucifer was exiled, he did not properly reflect on his inability, but fell in love with a human woman and had a child, as a monarch of the First Demon Lord Palace, having a child with humans, this has violated the taboos of the demon race, which is the most disgraceful thing in the history of the demon race!" Belial paused and looked at Merlin, sternly said, "This mother and daughter live happily in the kingdom of Britain, which is the place where Mamon attacked, in order to protect themselves and the children born to humans, Merlin resolutely chose to kill Mamon, such a crime and evil deed, only this Lucifer can do it."

As soon as the words fell, the council hall erupted like a thunderclap, as if it were a clear sky, and all demon elders were unable to sit still, Merlin's matter had obviously violated the taboos of the demon race!

As a noble monarch, he loved a human woman and had a child? Such things are absolutely not allowed in the demon race, and it is simply disgraceful to the demon race from top to bottom.

At this time, Merlin became the public enemy of all demons, killing his own race for humans, which was serious enough to kill him several times.

"Traitor! As the owner of the First Demon Lord Palace, the monarch of the demon race, he did such a thing!"

"Unforgivable! The life born to humans is absolutely not allowed to exist, and should be executed!"

"Right! Lucifer's betrayal of the demon race has violated the taboos, and must be punished severely!"

Merlin listened to the curses of the demon elders, and his mood became worse and worse, no matter what explanation, it was difficult to escape the identity of a traitor, because the fact that he and Alice had a child could not be denied.

Asmodeus covered his mouth with a fan and chose to remain silent, he knew all these things, but he didn't expect them to be exposed at the Seven Kings' Conference, if his previous assassination had succeeded, he might have pulled Merlin out of the mud, but now there was no thread.

Moreover, even Asmodeus began to doubt whether Merlin had chosen to kill Mamon to protect the human wife and child?

The fact that humans harm their own race has already made several demon kings who support Merlin doubt, obviously they cannot tolerate traitors who betray from within.

"Lucifer, is what Belial said true?" Caprius asked seriously.

Merlin's face was black, silent for a while, and felt that there was no need to stay here, so he immediately stood up and walked out of the council.

Boom! A large number of demon soldiers in armor and holding weapons rushed in, surrounding Merlin and not allowing him to leave the hall.

Merlin had to stop his steps and slowly turned back, scanning the crowd of demon elders with a hostile gaze, finally stopping on Belial.

"What's the meaning of this?"

title: Chapter 50 — I am Merlin, I am your mentor. I am Alice, I am your companion. I am Chris, I am your assistant. I am Lilith, I am your opponent. I am Ophelia, I am your enemy. I am Asmodeus, I am your ally. I am Lucifer, I am your master.
content:
Chapter 50 — I am Merlin, I am your mentor. I am Alice, I am your companion. I am Chris, I am your assistant. I am Lilith, I am your opponent. I am Ophelia, I am your enemy. I am Asmodeus, I am your ally. I am Lucifer, I am your master.

Volume 32 · Chapter 50

"Violating the demon race's taboo, and you still think you can leave easily? Don't make things so simple. You should take responsibility for your actions, young monarch." Beelzebub's face broke into a triumphant smile.

Merlin looked at the demon guards behind him, their sharp spears radiating coldness—it seemed they had never intended to let him leave easily from the start.

This meeting was entirely a prearranged trap, and he was the prey they had been waiting for.

Merlin subconsciously touched his waist—the demon sword Banri Garan had already been confiscated. If a conflict broke out, he could only fight bare-handed.

"This Seven Kings Conference is truly boring. I've lost all interest in staying here. You haven't properly investigated Mamon's death at all—you just want to pin all the blame on me."

"Stop making excuses. The evidence is clear. Just accept your trial quietly. Resisting will only increase your suffering." Beelzebub looked at the image in the crystal ball and taunted, "That little girl is your daughter, isn't she? She looks quite cute, but unfortunately she's a lowly mongrel. What's her name?"

"None of your business!" Merlin's face turned terrifyingly dark, utterly disgusted by Beelzebub's remarks about his precious daughter.

"Haha, your gaze makes me feel afraid. It seems that child means a lot to you~" Beelzebub paused, then said meaningfully, "Now, don't you want to leave here and go back to that human woman? I advise you to save your breath. If you give up resistance, you might still get to see them. But if you resist, you'll become a cold corpse."

"What did you say?" Merlin's fists clenched instinctively.

"I've known about your betrayal and collusion with humans for a long time. I just didn't have the chance to act while you were with that human woman." Beelzebub's smile grew richer as he added, "But after you left the Kingdom of Britain, my capable subordinates infiltrated Rexham. Calculating the timing, your wife and child's lives should already be under my control. They might even be on their way to the Elder Council right now. How about it? Do you still want to resist?"

Merlin's anger surged upon hearing this. He had already decided to kill Beelzebub—if anyone harbored ill will toward Alice and Chris, he would never let them go easily. Even if they were a noble First Generation Monarch, they would have to pay a heavy price!

Meanwhile, in the town of Rexham, everything seemed as peaceful as usual. However, a batch of formidable demons had secretly entered—all elite subordinates cultivated by Beelzebub, over a dozen in number, all at the Saint-tier, with their leader possessing the rare Ancestor Realm strength.

They had received Beelzebub's secret orders to come to Rexham and capture Alice and Chris alive, bringing them before Beelzebub for interrogation.

However, when the demons kicked open the door to Merlin and Alice's home and searched quickly, they found it completely empty—it seemed the family had already left Rexham long ago.

This left Beelzebub's subordinates at a loss. Their meticulously planned capture had come up empty, and they didn't know how to report back to Beelzebub.

In a hired carriage departing Rexham, Alice sat the petite Chris on her lap, a helpless smile on her face.

The little one already knew Merlin had left again, and had been angry for several days straight. No matter how Alice tried to coax her, she remained pouting and silent.

Chris felt that her father leaving without telling her was a form of deception, and her mother had colluded with him, sneaking away while she slept—wasn't that going too far?

"All right, how much longer are you going to stay angry?" Alice lowered her head to look at her precious daughter, whose ahoge stood stiffly upright, brimming with energy and making her look extra spirited.

Chris's mouth puffed out like a hamster storing food. She glanced back at her mother, then immediately turned her head away in defiance. "Hmph~!"

Alice rubbed her forehead, feeling a headache. She couldn't understand why a child so young could hold a grudge so fiercely.

"Daddy had something very important to attend to, which is why he had to leave in such a hurry. What good would sulking do?"

"I'm not angry because Daddy left! I'm angry because Mommy and Daddy teamed up to trick me!" Chris's little face flushed red as she hoped her mother would realize the seriousness of the situation.

"You were sleeping so soundly, and your father and I couldn't bear to wake you. You should try to understand the adults'good intentions." Alice gently stroked her daughter's back.

"If I had known Daddy was leaving, I definitely wouldn't have gone to sleep!" Little Chris said stubbornly.

Alice broke into a cold sweat, thinking—exactly because of that, they had to leave while you were asleep. "Alright, alright. Even if you sulk at Mommy, Daddy won't come back right away. But don't worry, this time it'll be quick—not as long as last time. Mommy will buy you something delicious on the way, how does that sound?"

Hearing about the treats, Chris's ahoge instantly drooped, and she spoke against her own wishes, "I... I'll reluctantly believe Mommy one more time. It's not because of the food! Chris just wants to be an obedient child! Hmph~!"

Alice chuckled to herself, thinking—children really are not honest at all.

"Mommy, where are we going?" Chris turned around and asked curiously.

"We're going to visit your Grandma Clodia. It's been a long time since we last saw her. Are you happy to see her soon?" Alice picked up her daughter and asked.

"Happy~" Chris waved her short limbs around, her face already blooming like a flower. "Grandma promised to make me a wooden horse toy, and I still remember! Hehe~"

"Is that so? When you see Grandma, be good and don't go causing trouble everywhere. Otherwise Grandma will spank you, and Mommy won't be able to stop her, understand?" Alice feigned seriousness as she admonished, while thinking to herself—

She needed to apologize properly to her teacher. After all, she'd been too cold last time her teacher came.

And she also needed to ask about the Heavenly Hymn sword. Its origins were somewhat suspicious.

"You think a few words can scare me? You've miscalculated, Beelzebub."

Merlin didn't believe Alice would be captured so easily. Her current strength wasn't some soft persimmon to be crushed at will—only if the Demon Lord himself moved would he worry.

"Since you refuse to give up your meaningless resistance, I'll just have to make you suffer a bit." Beelzebub turned to press the judge. "Presiding Judge Caprio, Lucifer has already betrayed the demon race. The evidence is conclusive. What are you waiting for? Haven't you voted to declare him guilty? Is a show of hands really necessary?"

"This matter..." Caprio was drenched in sweat, hesitating. "Shouldn't we investigate further? Could there be hidden circumstances?"

"Presiding Judge, what are you thinking? Lucifer has already fathered offspring with a human! Are you trying to shelter a traitor?" Beelzebub's eyes turned fierce, multiplying the pressure on him.

The demon elders, seeing Caprio hesitate, suddenly erupted in fury and began cursing—

"Caprio! What are you hesitating about, old fool? Are you a traitor too?"

"If the Presiding Judge can't handle this fairly, we should elect someone new!"

"We absolutely won't allow a traitor to walk free! Lucifer the Third is the greatest shame in the demon race's history!"

Under relentless pressure, Caprio was forced to strike his gavel and pronounce judgment. "Lucifer the Third, suspected of betrayal, shall be temporarily detained."

Beelzebub's expression darkened. He felt Caprio was hiding something and clearly shielding Merlin. Merlin's crimes already warranted execution, yet the punishment was only temporary detention?

The demon guards, receiving their orders, gripped their weapons and charged forward with hardened resolve, hoping to temporarily suppress Merlin.

Merlin gritted his teeth, clenched his fists, and shot a vicious glare over his shoulder as he released the Hundredfold Repulsive Space, his warning ringing out—

"Get lost!"

"You lowly demons aren't even worthy of standing before me!"

title: Chapter 51 — Seven Kings Meeting ⑦
content:
Chapter 51 — Seven Kings Meeting ⑦

Volume 32 · Chapter 51

The demon guards bravely charged at Merlin, these guards who only obeyed the Council of Elders, and simply did not care whether their opponent was a Demon Lord Monarch or not.

They would only act according to the will of the Council of Elders.

Since the player only had one opponent in Merlin, while the other six Demon Lords could fight in coordination, they could probably suppress Merlin, so even though they feared him, it had not yet reached the point where they wouldn't dare act—

Forming battle formations with their sharp spears, they thrust toward Merlin, and over a hundred demon guards poured in, filling every corner of the council hall until there was barely room to stand.

Outside the council hall, an army of over ten thousand demons comprising the Council's forces surrounded the place completely. Due to the limited space inside the hall, they couldn't enter the battle, but they had encircled the area so tightly not even a fly could escape!

Facing the thrusting sharp spears, Merlin immediately unleashed a hundredfold repulsion space, shoving those aggressively charging demon guards backward.

Bang bang bang! The demon guards slammed into the council hall walls like continuous cannonballs, their spears all shattering. The chaos sent the council into disarray, with demon elders fleeing in terror; the few who couldn't escape could only press themselves against the cold walls, shivering.

These demon guards, raised by the Council of Elders, couldn't even get close to Merlin, suffering heavy casualties in their first rash charge!

"Who else dares to block me!? If you want to die, just come at me!"

Merlin's piercing gaze swept over the demon guards before him, his ferocious killing intent filling them with terror.

Seeing the demon guards that had crashed into the wall and died horribly sobered them up considerably, making it hard for them to muster the courage to charge at Merlin again.

The demon guards instinctively began slowly retreating, yet stubbornly blocked the council hall exit, unwilling to disobey the orders given by the Council of Elders.

Merlin walked through as though no one were there, slowly making his way toward the council hall exit. The demon guards, expressions filled with terror, retreated step by step alongside him, their human wall formation rendered meaningless.

"What are you still waiting for?! Lucifer's betrayal of the demon race is an undeniable fact. If you don't act, aren't you suspecting you have some collusion with him? Don't tell me you want to bear the name of traitor yourself!" Berial glared angrily at the other Demon Lords, his words full of threat, unwilling to simply let that tiger return to the mountain.

Several Demon Lords began to waver, unsure whether they should act at such a time. Although the Council of Elders had already issued the order to imprison Merlin, the situation was sure to escalate into a kill-or-be-killed clash between monarchs, and they could easily lose their lives.

"Couldn't it be that, like Lucifer III, you've all already betrayed the demon race?" Berial narrowed his eyes, already showing intense hostility.

"That's not true!" Leviathan raised his head and solemnly refuted, "Don't casually slander us!"

"If you want to prove your innocence, then act! Only by capturing Lucifer III can you clear the suspicions surrounding you." Berial continuously goaded the other Demon Lords into striking first.

"Raaar!" Leviathan clenched his right fist, having absolutely no desire to act, but Berial was pressing him relentlessly, and he and the other Demon Lords were somewhat worried about being branded "traitors."

"Wait a moment." Asmodeus turned around, took out his makeup box, and patted foundation onto his face. "Let me touch up my makeup first, it'll be quick."

"???" Leviathan looked at Asmodeus with a completely puzzled expression, wondering if there was such an excuse to avoid battle? So he followed suit, quickly taking deep breaths. "Sorry, my power was only recently restored. Let me prepare for a moment."

Berial snorted coldly and looked toward the burly Monarch of Wrath beside him. "Samael, why aren't you acting either? Weren't you the one who detests those who break the rules the most? Something has already appeared now."

"I've never liked fighting in a group. If I'm going to fight, I'll fight one-on-one. Someone's already gotten to them before me." Samael's gaze fell toward the exit.

"Hold it right there!"

Hearing a shout, Merlin stopped and turned around to see Beelzebub standing behind him with one hand on his hip.

"You want to stop me?"

"That's right. Although I don't want to do this either, the Council has already announced the sentence. You cannot leave here today. I don't want to be implicated by you— if I'm suspected of being a traitor, that would be terrible." Beelzebub paused, then continued to emphasize, "The favor I owed you in France has long since been repaid, so I don't owe you anything. In the end, today's situation was entirely of your own making. Wouldn't it have been better to follow my advice and leave that human woman behind?"

"This is my own choice. I don't need to listen to your advice." Merlin responded coldly.

"Is that so? It seems you've stopped listening to anything anyone says." Beelzebub grinned, clenching his fists. "Come on, want to fight?"

"Is that necessary? You were already defeated by me long ago." Merlin replied expressionlessly.

"What did you say?!" Beelzebub's facial veins throbbed, his expression twisting in anger. "I should let you see my true strength!"

No sooner had the words left his mouth than Beelzebub opened his mouth wide and spat out a massive swarm of man-eating flies, which darkened the sky and swirled around their master.

These fierce man-eating flies gathered with terrifying might and, without a second thought,疯狂 flew at Merlin. It would only take a few seconds to devour a person's flesh clean.

Merlin rapidly unfolded a repulsion space, forming a 360-degree flawless defensive barrier. No matter how viciously the man-eating flies tore and bit, they couldn't pose any threat to Merlin.

The man-eating flies frantically collided with the repulsion space, and even with their flesh mangled and bloody, they showed no fear. The sound of bodies exploding rang out incessantly.

Just as Merlin relaxed slightly, the ground beneath his feet suddenly shifted, and countless man-eating flies erupted from underground, like a sudden black geyser erupting from beneath the earth!

Merlin hadn't expected Beelzebub's man-eating flies to dig tunnels so quickly, successfully bypassing the repulsion space and appearing directly beneath his feet!

Seeing the large number of man-eating flies emerging from his feet and rushing straight toward his face, Merlin punched downward in a hurry. The force of the blow sent sharp wind blades flying, leaving several scratches on the floor.

But brute force was completely useless against Beelzebub's man-eating flies. As highly sensitive creatures, if an attack wasn't fast enough or broad enough in scope, they could easily escape!

Merlin felt as though his fist had struck thin air, probably only killing a few dozen flies, completely unable to halt the man-eating flies' assault.

Immediately, the man-eating flies began tearing and biting along Merlin's arms, and took the opportunity to lay大量 eggs inside his body.

Merlin drew in a sharp breath, his arm feeling as though countless ants were gnawing at it, the sensation seeming to have reached his bones!

"How does it feel, Lucifer!" Beelzebub suddenly closed in, speaking in a sinister low voice—

"Does this underling you once defeated satisfy you?"

title: Chapter 52 — Seven Kings Meeting ⑧
content:
Chapter 52 — Seven Kings Meeting ⑧

Volume 32 · Chapter 52

Beelzebub let out a series of mocking laughs, a whip‑like kick like lightning lashing at Merlin's waist.
Boom! The air trembled, Merlin's whole body tensed, and he was forcibly kicked back several steps.
It seemed Merlin wanting to leave for a while wasn't that simple, unless none of the monarchs present made a move to stop him.
"Your time is running out; the flies have already laid eggs inside you, your flesh will become their food. If you don't want to rot into a corpse, just surrender obediently." Beelzebub pointed at Merlin and said.
Merlin felt a pain like mosquitoes tearing at his arm, his expression blank and cold as he said, "You don't really think these bugs can bind me, do you?"
"Underestimating my pets will bring you suffering, Lucifer."
As soon as Beelzebub's words fell, the man‑eating flies hovering behind him went crazy, buzzing and swooping toward Merlin.
A massive swarm of man‑eating flies like a flood split into multiple directions, encircling Merlin completely, leaving him no blind spot.
Merlin furrowed his brows; this swarm of flies wasn't strong, but relying on their numbers and rapid reproduction, they were practically a bunch of troublesome monsters—just a faint scent of blood could drive them into a frenzy!
In the blink of an eye—
Merlin relied on repulsive space acting under his feet, instantly shooting up into the midair of the council, avoiding the flies' encirclement.
"You really are an incorrigible bastard!"
Beelzebub suddenly appeared behind Merlin, in midair he leaned and slammed toward his back.
Merlin's heart jumped; in midair he turned, quickly crossing his arms in front of his chest to guard against a fatal blow.
Beelzebub's fist struck Merlin's crossed arms, thunder roared above the council, and the space trembled.
Merlin fell like a heavy cannonball, crashing to the ground, blasting countless cracks and depths into the floor.
Beelzebub landed lightly, sneering, "Don't force me to kill you, Lucifer, what's the point of continuing your resistance? You really think you can leave here?^"
Merlin crawled out of the deep pit, brushed off the dust on his body, "It's been so long since we last fought, looks like you're just itching for a fight."
"Let me see how long you can keep your mouth shut!" Beelzebub waved his hand; the man‑eating flies hovering in midair all gathered together, then launched a mountain‑shaking, sea‑like assault!
The demon elders trembled, seeing the man‑eating flies covering the sky like a black, overwhelming tidal wave that would instantly drown Merlin—could he still survive? Perhaps not even his bones would be left, gnawed away by the flies!
Suddenly! A mysterious pressure swept through the entire council, gravity increased a hundredfold, the air faintly turned viscous!
Merlin unleashed gravity space; the seemingly unstoppable man‑eating flies encountered unprecedented resistance, being slammed down from the sky by a hundredfold gravity, heavily smashing onto the ground—in an instant the ferocious flies turned into a sticky, bloody carpet on the floor!
Even Beelzebub, who tried to take advantage and launch a sneak attack, suffered greatly under the hundredfold gravity.
Beelzebub was seen kneeling on one knee, cracks spreading slowly beneath his feet, his whole body trembling, face flushed from the immense gravity as he tried to stand but felt his bones about to break.
Merlin stepped on the flies' corpses, approached Beelzebub, and asked coldly, "How does it feel?"
"Beelzebub forced a smile, gritting his teeth and asked, 'Where did you learn that gravity magic? So despicable.'"
Merlin didn't bother explaining, raised his fist and swung at Beelzebub—though his fist hadn't even reached the guy, the latter flew off on his own and slammed heavily into the wall.
"What a powerful move—is this the legendary… the King's Overbearing Aura? My life has been without regret, uh!"
Beelzebub feigned pain, uttering a string of words, then slowly slid down the cold wall, but as his head tilted, there was no response.
"? ? ? *Merlin had no idea what was going on? Logically, why would Beelzebub be so weak?"
Leviathan saw this, his expression turned eerie, and he said lowly, "Beelzebub, holding back like this is too obvious—you didn't even release your true form."
"This is just a show for the elders; Beelzebub doesn't want to get involved in this dispute, so he's deliberately clearing his suspicions. Whether we believe it or not, what matters is that the elders believe it." Asmodeus whispered in response.
"How long are you two going to drag this out? Isn't it about time to go fight?" Belial asked coldly.
Asmodeus slapped a layer of mask onto his face, leaned back in his chair pretending to be dead, "Sorry, give me a few more hours—I have to face Lucifer the Third, I must appear in perfect condition."
Leviathan stood on his chair, began stretching, "I've already started warming up, just wait a bit longer, everyone knows my huge size makes me easy to use, sorry~"
Belial narrowed his eyes, already seeing that Leviathan and Asmodeus had no intention of helping, so he cursed inwardly, "Two idiots, planning to just muddle through? Really can't count on them at all—do I have to do it myself?"
As Belial hesitated, he happened to notice the chair of the angry monarch beside him was empty, he jerked in surprise, revealing a hint of a triumphant smile.
Samael would never go easy on Merlin against Merlin, because Merlin has now become a rule‑breaker, a sinner who violated demon taboos and cannot be cleansed.
As a neutral party, Samael's stance is undoubtedly with the council; Merlin openly defied the council's decision, so he won't stand by and do nothing.
Merlin sized up Samael standing before him—the most burly monarch among the demons, possessing terrifying physical strength, which he dared not underestimate.
Because when Merlin was young, he had heard his mother Vivian mention Samael, and she warned him never to provoke him no matter the time.
Looking like a simple‑minded fool, this wrathful demon king is actually a rare genius among demons, hailed as the strongest among the second‑generation monarchs, his realm likely reached the demi‑god level long ago, his power even chasing that of the glorious first‑generation demon kings.
Many demon elders firmly believe Samael's achievements could rival, or even surpass, those of the first‑generation demon kings.
Unfortunately, all of that vanished when Samael lost his head, becoming a headless monarch—everything turned into mere bubbles, no longer comparable to his former self.
Merlin and Samael locked icy gazes, neither speaking, an invisible pressure weighed down, making all the demons present feel a bit short of breath.
The Beelzebub lying on the ground feigning unconsciousness opened his eyes a slit, saw Merlin facing off against Samael, his heart tightened—
Oh no, is Samael going to make a move?
This madman won't hold back like I did—he really will twist Merlin's head off!

title: Chapter 53 — Seven Kings Conference IX
content:
Chapter 53 — Seven Kings Conference IX

Volume 32 · Chapter 53

Judge Caprio fidgeted uneasily. Seeing that Samael had personally stepped forward to fight Merlin, he couldn't help but feel nervous, hesitating whether to speak up and stop it. But with so many demon elders staring at him, there was no way he could help Merlin. Being able to issue a judgment of temporary imprisonment was already the maximum assistance he could provide.

"Hey, even Samael has stepped forward. This monster—even I wouldn't provoke it carelessly. Could Lucifer be in trouble?"

Leviathan's tone carried a hint of worry, knowing deep down that Samael's power was in a completely different league compared to someone like Mammon.

"This is bad. Samael's strength is publicly recognized as the strongest among the Second Generation rulers, and it's the one most likely to catch up to the First Generation monarchs. In terms of talent, only Vivian can compare to it."

Asmodeus's face darkened, feeling that Merlin probably wouldn't have an easy time getting past Samael.

"Could Samael be deliberately holding back like Beelzebub?"

Leviathan asked, puzzled.

"Absolutely not."

Asmodeus gave a definitive reply. "Don't let Samael's frequent loss of emotional control fool you—it's the most rule-abiding Demon Lord. Lucifer has committed such grave offenses; in its eyes, he's already a sinner. What it despises most are rule-breakers."

Leviathan's eyes revealed a trace of worry, thinking to himself that he couldn't offer any help. Not intervening was already the greatest support he could offer.

Merlin stared coldly at Samael and asked, "You want to stop me too?"

Samael extended one finger, pointing at Merlin as it replied, "I'll give you one chance: give up all resistance and submit to the Elder Council's trial."

"A joke. No one can judge me, not even the Elder Council."

Merlin let out a dismissive laugh.

"I'm merely offering you advice. Don't persist in your folly. Demons and humans will never have a future together." Samael paused, then added, "These words are only because of your deceased mother."

"I have never needed anyone's pity."

Merlin said firmly, rejecting Samael's apparent goodwill.

"That arrogant attitude bears some resemblance to your mother's. But... do you truly have the strength to back up that arrogance?!"

Samael's massively muscular body twisted. Don't let its large size fool you; its movement speed was shockingly fast. Its entire body became a blur of afterimages, and the gravel beneath its feet trembled with the gusts of force!

In the blink of an eye, Samael's fist slammed into Merlin's shoulder, and the air erupted with a thunderous crack!

Merlin's body flew backward like a cannonball, tumbling violently across the ground. A series of cracks formed trenches in the floor, and only when he crashed heavily into the council chamber wall did he come to a stop.

With just one punch, Merlin was sent reeling like that, demonstrating that Samael's physical strength was truly second to none among the Demon Lords!

"I won't kill you, but crippling you is certainly within my ability. To dare collude with humans and conspire against your own kind—does it seem Vivian never taught you what rules are?"

Merlin slowly rose from the ground, his gaze growing considerably more serious. Gritting his teeth, he forcibly wrenched his dislocated shoulder back into place.

So this is the kind of guy my mom once warned me never to pick a fight with? He really is more difficult to deal with than the other Demon Lords. Truly something different.

Unfortunately, Samael, having lost its own head, isn't an invincible existence. There must be some hidden weakness.

"You've already lost your head. I don't mind removing your hands and feet as well."

"You ignorant and reckless kid!"

Samael seemed somewhat provoked by Merlin and charged toward him, unleashing a barrage of rapid strikes!

Two massive fists shot forward relentlessly, like a machine gun firing, raining blows across every angle onto Merlin.

Samael's fists carried overwhelming power, and their speed was no less impressive. Relying purely on physical strength alone, every demon present could feel the ground trembling beneath them.

Rumble! The council chamber was reduced to chaos under Samael's assault, the floor pockmarked everywhere. The demon elders were forced to take cover beneath their chairs, and the trembling chamber seemed on the verge of collapse at any moment.

Merlin relied on his speed advantage to repeatedly dodge Samael's fatal blows, though several times he narrowly escaped being hit directly.

Against such a powerful opponent as Samael, mere dodging was useless; it only delayed the inevitable defeat.

Seizing an opening when Samael was catching its breath, Merlin unhesitatingly swung a fist forward, meeting it head-on.

The two fists collided with a deafening crash. The opposing forces generated turbulent eddies that tore the entire council floor apart!

Merlin and Samael each involuntarily took a step back from the brief exchange, both sustaining considerable damage.

Merlin's arm was trembling violently, nearly numb from the impact. Even with his body reinforced by the Earth Spirit, matching Samael head-on still felt insufficient. In terms of pure physical strength, this enraged monarch seemed to hold a slight edge.

Samael stared at its own trembling fist for a long while, equally shocked. It had never imagined that a demon from the demon race could clash with it so directly.

And moreover, a young Third Generation ruler?

It suddenly clenched its fist, suppressing its shock, and was forced to take Merlin seriously, realizing that defeating him would not be easy.

"Your power surprises me somewhat. Finally, the demon race has produced a demon who can stand against me directly. I truly admire you. If you hadn't betrayed us... how wonderful that would be. Only—"

"Huh? What are you trying to say?"

Merlin asked, feigning calm.

"You've chosen the wrong side! As an enemy, you must be eliminated if all demons are to feel at ease! Letting you leave would sow endless disaster!"

Samael had fallen into a rage, its emotions becoming increasingly uncontrollable. Accompanied by a earth-shattering roar, it joined both hands into a devastating punch and brought it crashing down toward—

Merlin's head!

Fortunately, Merlin had long been on guard and prepared himself. Facing such a ferocious overhead strike, rather than taking it head-on, he chose to leap upward and dodge—

Samael's heavy blow.

Merlin landed on Samael's thick arm, spun his body, and with all his strength, delivered a powerful kick to Samael's chest—BOOM!

A colossal sound erupted as the air exploded and shook!

That kick's force almost pierced through Samael's body. The shockwave destroyed nearly everything behind it, and the sturdy black goldstone round table shattered into countless fragments.

Into countless pieces.

Merlin was confident that against an ordinary enemy, this kick would have been enough to kill—its internal organs and bones would surely have been reduced to paste!

Yet Samael remained standing frozen, its expression seemingly dazed. It was clearly caught off guard by Merlin's bizarre fighting style, showing no fear—

Instead, it cautiously engaged him in close combat.

"Hey hey, am I seeing this right? Is Lucifer serious? He actually has the guts to trade punches and kicks with Samael?"

Leviathan's face went pale, unable to believe its own eyes.

"Those two have both gotten serious. If it weren't for Samael, that kick would definitely have killed him!"

Asmodeus felt a creeping sense of fear. In his own frail body, he certainly couldn't have taken it.

While all the other demons marveled at Merlin's strength, only Berial remained composed, a smile of anticipation forming on his face.

"Lucifer is done for. He hurt Samael."

"This will throw Samael into a rage. If Lucifer doesn't die... that fury will never be appeased."

title: Chapter 54 — Seven Kings Meeting 10 (Monthly Ticket Bonus)
content:
Chapter 54 — Seven Kings Meeting 10 (Monthly Ticket Bonus)

Volume 32 · Chapter 54

Merlin's foot was pressed against Samael's chest, and his expression immediately turned shocked. By his prediction, he should have been able to kick the other party into severe injury,

yet the result was that Samael didn't move at all! ?

This made Merlin secretly alarmed — just how damage-resistant is the giant in front of him? He had exhausted all his strength and still couldn't cause effective harm!

Merlin had never encountered an opponent at this level before. Even though he was very confident in his own physical strength, he now had to start doubting himself.

Samael stood expressionlessly, looking at his slightly dented chest, and his whole body began to turn red, thick blue veins bulging like wriggling dragons.

Samael appeared unscathed, but in reality he had already suffered serious internal injuries. Heavy pain came from his internal organs, torturing his fragile nerves. There were many ways to provoke Samael into a rage — and pain was clearly the most direct one!

Samael suddenly fell into a furious rage, his emotions becoming uncontrollable, his power surging dramatically. His body tensed like a bowstring pulled to its limit, and in one motion he死死 locked onto Merlin's ankle —

"Die!"

"W-what?!?" Merlin was startled. His body flew up involuntarily, and the world around him began to spin wildly!

Samael grabbed Merlin's ankle and heaved him off the ground, then repeatedly smashed him left and right without pause.

Just as Merlin hit the ground and hadn't even had time to catch his breath, he was slammed into another patch of ground again, completely denied any chance to counterattack!

Bang bang bang — a series of deafening impacts rang out constantly. In just a few exchanges, deep pits were brutally carved into both sides of Samael's surroundings!

"Die die die die die die!!!"

Watching the scene that resembled a one-sided beatdown, both Asmodeus and Leviathan found it hard to bear the sight. They wondered why Merlin had to provoke a madman? If only he had lowered his posture slightly, things wouldn't have ended up this disastrous.

Samael raised Merlin above his head, spun wildly three times, and then — like a gold-medal pitcher — launched Merlin straight toward the pillar supporting the council palace!

"Die!!!"

The pillars holding up the council hall were extremely thick and sturdy, requiring more than ten people to encircle with their arms. After Merlin was launched, he smashed through more than ten in succession!

Because the speed was too fast, the ten-plus giant stone pillars seemed to snap instantly. Accompanied by rumbling collapses, the council hall, having lost its supports, began to crumble.

The historically significant demonic race council building was destroyed more than halfway in an instant. Smoke and dust rose in all directions, resembling the end of days. The elder demons of the demon race were scared stiff, clutching their heads and fleeing everywhere.

Samael stood red-hot amid the ruins, spitting out a mouthful of dark, scorching breath from his decapitated neck. Blood could be seen rushing through his exposed blood vessels with the naked eye. His狂暴 power was incredibly strong, yet equally difficult to control.

Merlin climbed out from the ruins, his eyes equally filled with anger. Covered in dust and grime, he looked thoroughly狼狈, yet even after suffering so many blows, he still hadn't been defeated.

He tore off his already shabby clothes, baring his upper body — the scars on his chest were horrifying to behold. His seemingly somewhat thin frame harbored unimaginable power!

Merlin pointed his right hand at the out-of-control Samael, clasped his left hand firmly around his right wrist, and suddenly unleashed hundreds of times the gravity space, hoping to suppress the rampaging Samael.

The pressure in the air suddenly became overwhelmingly heavy. Under hundreds of times the gravity space, Samael experienced an unprecedented heaviness, as though a mountain had been hoisted onto his shoulders and crown!

Samael was momentarily unaccustomed to it, and was immediately bent over by the hundredfold gravity. He turned his head slightly and saw Merlin, who was releasing the gravity space.

Samael gradually came to his senses. Bearing the heavy pressure, he straightened his back, and began walking toward Merlin step by step. With each step, his feet sank deep into the earth, leaving clear footprints.

Although the hundredfold gravity space was no weak attack, it still couldn't suppress Samael. Relying on his powerful physical strength, he could still move freely!

Merlin stared in horror, his eyes wide open, utterly disbelief. How could there be someone who could move agilely under a hundredfold gravity? Just how monstrous was the anger monarch's physical strength?!

Refusing to be outdone, Merlin continuously stimulated the Earth Spirit within him, releasing even more powerful force, all concentrated on Samael. The power of the gravity space was further amplified — a thousand-fold gravity field swept in!

An even more terrifying pressure appeared. Under a thousandfold gravity space, ordinary people would have long been crushed to powder!

Samael finally stopped. The thousandfold gravity was making it hard for him to breathe. This time it wasn't merely carrying a mountain — it was carrying a mountain range composed of several peaks!

He "thumped" and knelt on the ground — appearing almost casual, but instantly crushing a massive pit. The council's foundation was utterly destroyed, and astonishing cracks continuously spread. Even Caprio, who had been sitting steadfastly at the presiding seat, was startled and had to quickly dodge.

No one knew how deep these cracks were. Who could guess what would happen if you fell into them?

Samael, pinned down by the thousandfold gravity, took a deep breath — and surprisingly stood up against the pressure. Although he had to hunch his back, he was still able to move!

With each step Samael took, the earth beneath his feet would crack, sending small stones flying like bullets!

"It's you who forced my hand — stop right now!"

Merlin had been pushed to the edge and had no choice but to unleash the absolute limit of the Earth Spirit, increasing the gravity space's power to ten thousand times!

Ten thousand times gravity suppression was already the maximum Merlin could achieve at this point. If he still couldn't suppress Samael with this, then he would truly have no办法 left.

Hmmm——

Accompanied by the roar of the air, the ten-thousandfold gravity space enveloped Samael's surroundings. The space itself became distorted and blurry, and black spots formed by cracks continuously fell downward, as though a rainstorm of spatial fissures!

Samael gritted his teeth and glared furiously at Merlin. His body was twisted beyond recognition, trembling uncontrollably. No matter how much he resisted, under the ten-thousandfold gravity suppression, he was still like an ant — pinned to the ground, his cheek making intimate contact with the mud.

All the demons watched as Samael was about to sink deep into the ground, forcibly merged with the earth by gravity into a single entity.

Rumble rumble rumble! The terrifying explosions forced the demon elders to cover their ears. The impact of the ten-thousandfold gravity hammering the ground was no less than a colossal meteorite crashing into the earth. The solid ground rippled like the sea, raising massive waves of sand and stone straight into the sky!

Belial, Asmodeus, and Leviathan had to quickly rise and dodge, terrified of being caught in the crossfire. They could only watch helplessly as the demonic race council palace disappeared completely, not knowing how many demon elders had died in the earlier disaster.

"Is he crazy?!?" Leviathan's face was grim. "If this continues, not only will we fail to capture Merlin, but the Council of Elders will almost be wiped out! We should intervene and stop this!"

"Give up. At this point, who dares to interfere?" A cold sweat trickled down Asmodeus's forehead.

Merlin lowered his arm and panted heavily. Overuse of the Earth Spirit had given him a terrible headache.

A series of scorching gales swept in, blowing away the swirling sand and stone. At the very bottom of the giant pit, a mighty, massive figure appeared. A slight flap of his membrane wings would stir up a superheated flame storm!

It was still the headless body, but now six thick arms had grown. His entire body was crimson, with swirling black tattoos covering his frame. His abdomen resembled a natural furnace, within which flames of overwhelming fury burned fiercely. Twelve flame membrane wings pulsed, and even the rocks were rapidly melting!
