Alfonso paused, then explained the method: "Simply take the former king's bones, apply the shamanic rite, and have this lady drip her blood onto the bones. If the bones respond, it proves she carries the former king's bloodline—that she is truly Princess Diana. This method is nearly impossible to forge, far more credible than your empty words."

The noble ministers seemed to have heard of such a method and began discussing it among themselves, thinking it worth a try; at the very least, it could dispel some of their doubts.

"I seem to have heard of this shamanic art. It is generally used by the beastmen to sacrifice to their ancestors, and it can indeed verify kinship."

"We can certainly give it a try. We can't simply accept Kaplais's word that she is the long-lost Princess Diana."

"We should verify it. Otherwise, how can anyone believe someone who disappeared over twenty years ago would suddenly return? That's far too unnatural."

A satisfied smile crept across Alfonso's face. He had successfully driven Kaplais into a dead end. No matter what choice he made, death awaited him.

Foolish Kaplais, this is your own doing. Don't blame me for being ruthless~

If you accept my conditions, the scheme of hiring someone to impersonate the princess will surely be exposed!

If you refuse, it amounts to tacitly admitting the Diana before us is an impostor!

It seems you're destined today to escape not the charge of "rebellion." I can hardly wait to see your expression when you're marched to the guillotine.

Alfonso brimmed with confidence. Being able to directly eliminate his mortal enemy was something he had dreamed of doing. Once Kaplais was dead, he would become the true master of the entire court.

A black-robed assassin emerged from the shadows, carrying a tray to Alfonso's side. On it lay a blade and a skull that had already turned black.

Clearly, these had all been prepared in advance by Alfonso. In order to take out Kaplais, he had actually dug up the old king's grave and retrieved the skull.

Alfonso rose from his chair and looked down at Kaplais from above, speaking in a teasing tone—

"This is the former king's skull, already prepared with the shamanic rite. How about it, Lord Kaplais? Do you have the courage to try?"

Kaplais's face turned extremely grim. The suspicious gazes around him felt like thorns in his back. "You despicable, shameless wretch! How dare you disturb the late king's eternal rest?! If His Majesty knew he would be used by you even after death, he would surely kill you!"

"Please don't misunderstand. The late king's greatest wish before he died was to see Princess Diana. Now that she has returned, only her identity remains uncertain. I'm clearing everyone's doubts—what harm is there in that? In a sense, this fulfills the late king's regret. He would understand my做法." Alfonso argued deceitfully. To him, the dead old king was merely a handful of dirt.

"Hmm! You make the beastman shamanic art sound miraculous. Who knows if you've tampered with it? You trust your own eyes, and so do I."

Kaplais retorted, belittling the beastman shamanic art to nothing.

"Very well, then. Let me demonstrate the beastman shamanic art for everyone, so that no one suspects I've interfered." Alfonso picked up the dagger from the tray and, without hesitation, sliced his own palm, letting his blood drip onto the old king's skull.

Everyone in the court held their breath, watching Alfonso's every move, eager to see what mystery the beastman shamanic art held.

After a moment, nothing happened. The old king's skull absorbed Alfonso's blood but showed no reaction at all.

"Hocus-pocus." Kaplais snorted coldly, thinking—Is Alfonso trying to deceive me? Could beastman shamanic art really be this accurate?

"See? I have no blood connection with the former king, so the skull won't react. And now…" Alfonso, dagger in hand, turned to look at the young Amadeo.

Amadeo was startled and instinctively shrank back. Alfonso, holding the dagger close, was dangerously near; if he wished, this young king would die in an instant.

Vival, the knight, immediately became alert. His hand rested on the hilt of his sword, like a bristling beast staring at Alfonso. Should Amadeo face any danger, he would strike back at once.

Alfonso cast a meaningful glance at Vival, then walked forward and knelt on one knee, offering the dagger to Amadeo with both hands. "Your Majesty, to dispel the ministers' doubts, why not give it a try as well?"

Amadeo hesitated, then slowly took the dagger Alfonso offered, his eyes darting nervously.

This was the closest he had ever been to Alfonso—and he still held a sharp weapon in his hand!

A murderous intent stirred within him. If he struck Alfonso now with the dagger, could he eliminate this menace?

But Amadeo knew well that Alfonso was far too powerful. He could never kill him. The fact that Alfonso willingly handed over the dagger proved that, in Alfonso's eyes, the young king was utterly incompetent.

If it were Vival, perhaps a fatal strike could be delivered. Amadeo显然 lacked both the ability and the courage.

Under pressure, Amadeo could only follow suit. Biting his teeth, he closed his eyes and gently sliced his fingertip, letting his blood drip onto the old king's skull.

The silent skull immediately reacted, emitting a faint black glow as it floated into the air and vibrated incessantly!

Amadeo puckered his face in grievance and sucked on his injured finger, thinking—The beastman shamanic art really can verify parentage. Then isn't Kaplais doomed?

The ministers in court erupted in gasps, finding the method truly miraculous. After Alfonso's demonstration, they were now convinced the beastman shamanic art was trustworthy.

Alfonso was delighted. He turned to face Kaplais and said triumphantly, "You have all seen it, haven't you? The shamanically prepared skull only reacts to direct bloodline relatives. So, Lord Kaplais, what do you have to say now?"

Kaplais was utterly stunned. He suspected someone had betrayed him. Otherwise, how could Alfonso have been so prepared? This was like having a dagger plunged straight into his heart. Death was certain! He knew clearly that Alice was not Princess Diana!

Alfonso's smile grew ever more brazen. It was almost time to announce Kaplais's death sentence. He turned toward Alice and said with a grin—

"This lady, since you claim to be Diana, then please prove it to us."

"Drop your blood onto the bone—"

title: Chapter 17 — Monthly ticket mass release (please monthly tickets, friends)
content:
Chapter 17 — Monthly ticket mass release (please monthly tickets, friends)

Volume 33 · Chapter 17

Alfonso had completely taken control of the situation, and everyone was looking at Alice, waiting for her to prove that she was the missing Princess Diana.

Finally, this moment has come, Caprices, you are playing yourself to death, if you weren't so eager to push Amadeus off the throne, I really wouldn't have found a reason to kill you~

Alfonso secretly rejoiced at the sight of Caprices' iron-green face, temporarily forgetting the humiliation he had suffered at the black dragon's hands.

"Why," Caprices lowered his head, his eyes filled with panic, even losing his sanity, "Alfonso you are arguing! What human wizardry? It's all you talking nonsense! You- moved your hands and feet! She is Princess Diana, undeniable! Don't you lot have eyes? !

"Caprices, Earl, what are you agitated about? This is the Council Hall, not a place for you to lose your temper, please keep calm," Alfonso said seriously.

"Shut your stinking mouth, Alfonso! I still haven't had my turn to advise you to keep calm! You are just a rat that crawled out of the slums of the slums!

Not only are you despicable and shameless, but your inner self is filthy to the extreme, don't think I don't know, what shameful things you have done privately!" Caprices furiously pointed at Alfonso and berated him, having been driven to the point of having to tear off the mask.

The numerous noble ministers' gazes all became strange, and even those who supported Caprices chose to remain silent at this moment, daring not to speak randomly. In their eyes, the current Finance Minister had lost his rationality and turned into an old man shouting in a market.

Amadeus, hiding behind, sighed helplessly. Seeing Caprices' agitated state, he was immensely disappointed. Undoubtedly, Caprices had already lost. The fate awaiting him was probably the guillotine, although he wanted to pull himself down from the throne, he still needed him to restrain Alfonso.

If Caprices died, the most important financial power would all concentrate in Alfonso's hands!

Although Amadeus still had a certain amount of private space now, and the right to choose his own knights, afterwards Alfonso probably wouldn't give him any more opportunities. More seriously, Amadeus's own death date was probably fast approaching, because Alfonso, who had reached the pinnacle of power, wouldn't need a puppet anymore.

Amadeus looked meaningfully at Alice, thinking she couldn't be his missing older sister, no matter how flawless the disguise was, bloodline would never be forged.

"Caprices, Earl, do you have a guilty conscience in your heart? Why are you so out of sorts in the palace?" Alfonso's smile became unscrupulously mocking, saying, "Your current appearance is extremely similar to a wild dog at the end of its tether."

"You!" Caprices, enraged, his eyes wide open, pointed at Alfonso but couldn't say a word, indeed having lost all retreats.

"Human wizardry; everyone has already seen it, it is a trustworthy proof method, so why is Caprices Earl questioning it?" Alfonso paused, his eyes fierce, saying, "Could it be that you fear some secret being exposed? Actually, this lady is not the true Diana Princess, but someone you casually found to impersonate?"

"Not true! She... She is the true Princess!" Caprices had already lost the momentum he had previously.

"Then prove it, only then can we dispel our doubts," Alfonso had to admire Caprices' stubbornness. Even at this moment, he wouldn't admit it?

"Caprices opened his mouth, but in the end said nothing, completely unable to turn the situation around.

Alfonso's subordinates brought a plate containing a dagger and the old king's skull, placing it in front of Alice, hoping she could use orcish magic to prove her identity.

Alice stared at the blackened skull, hesitating internally, instinctively glancing at the side of Caprices. She needed some advice, unsure whether she should prove herself.

In the end, Caprices had completely panicked, no reaction at all, he lowered his head, his whole body trembling, thinking that afterwards he would definitely be killed by Alfonso? His secret plan would also be known to everyone, forever nailed to the kingdom's pillar of shame!

Alice withdrew her gaze, looking at the dagger in the plate, suspecting whether Alfonso had used some means, intentionally letting the bone react to the little king. Thus Alice decided to try, she didn't hesitate to draw the dagger across her finger, letting a drop of blood fall onto the skull.

Drip—

After a while, the old king's skull showed no reaction, proving that Alice's impersonation of the princess was exposed on the spot.

". . ." Amadeus slowly closed his eyes, the result was already very obvious.

"Caprices is really crazy, actually using such despicable methods?" Vival silently sighed, things were exactly as he had guessed.

"It seems the result is already clear," Alfonso calmly smiled, questioning, "Caprices Earl, do you have anything else to say?"

Caprices gave a bitter smile, he had long known it would turn out this way, he was already fearless, and loudly berated, "Alfonso! You this despicable person! You only know a bit of divination! The disaster over twenty years ago was all staged by you! To climb to a high position, you did anything! Don't think that now you've risen to glory, you'll pay for what you've done! After I die, more people will stand up to resist you! Amadeus Your Majesty! If you still have a bit of thinking capability, don't be willing to be Alfonso's puppet, you are a King! The true owner of this land! Not a slave to anyone!"

"Teacher, what is he saying? I don't understand it at all," Amadeus dryly laughed, his face full of confusion.

"The Majesty need not mind, he is now just a mad dog, starting to bite people randomly," Alfonso's expression became ferocious, announcing, "Come people! Caprices plotting rebellion! Temporarily arrest him, and I will personally judge him in place of the Majesty!"

A large group of soldiers rushed in from outside the hall, surrounding both Caprices and Alice, the sharp spears flashing with cold light, instantly making the atmosphere tense.

Alice, surrounded by soldiers, gripped the dagger in her hand, her gaze looking at Alfonso in the distance. The situation had exceeded her expectations. In any case, she must try to kill Alfonso now, this group of soldiers couldn't stop her, otherwise there might be no chance later!

Just as Alice, surrounded by soldiers, decided to fight Alfonso to the death, an unexpected turn of events occurred—

The quiet old king's skull placed on the plate suddenly reacted to Alice's blood, floating in the air emitting dim light, and vibrating continuously!

Everyone in the main hall saw this bizarre scene, the atmosphere instantly fell into a silence lasting five seconds, even some dared not believe their eyes.

Alfonso: "This!?"

Vival: "Impossible, right?"

Amadeus: "???"

Caprices: How could there be a reaction?

Alice stared wide-eyed in astonishment, dazedly looking at the old king's skull floating in the air, her brain had already gone blank—

"What is this all about?"

title: Chapter 18 — Future 0 Queen
content:
Chapter 18 — Future 0 Queen

Volume 33 · Chapter 18

The old king's skull, which had been floating in midair, slowly settled back into the plate, returning to its usual calm state, as if nothing had happened.

However, the many officials in the court were far from calm, shocked into silence by the sight before them, and frequently erupted in exclamations of surprise.

"Did my eyes deceive me? The late king's skull just floated up! This must mean..."

"Is the person Kapleas found really the missing Princess Diana, who disappeared over twenty years ago?!"

"Incredible! I thought Kapleas had gone mad, but it turns out it was all a misunderstanding!"

Alice stared blankly at the old king's skull, which had returned to its calm state, struggling to believe her eyes. Was this the Spanish king's response to her bloodline?

For "parents," Alice was completely unfamiliar, and it took her some time to accept the facts laid before her—

She was truly a member of the royal family, and her father was a king, while her mother was likely the late Queen Josephine.

Alice's expression was one of confusion, and she suddenly felt lost, as she had come only to avenge her teacher, but had instead uncovered such a shocking secret!

Who am I?

Kapleas, the Minister of Finance, was stunned, his mind completely short-circuited. He had thought he was doomed, but then a great reversal occurred, not only sparing him from execution, but earning him great merit for finding the true Princess Diana!

This feeling of near-death survival, followed by a dramatic turnaround, was too much for Kapleas' heart to handle, and he couldn't help but sigh, wondering if this was just the way of life—full of ups and downs.

Kapleas looked at Alice with suspicion, unable to believe that he had tricked her into pretending to be Princess Diana, only for the truth to be revealed, and Alice to be the real princess. Such a clever scheme, if not witnessed firsthand, would be hard to believe.

"Miss Alice, are you really Princess Diana?"

"I don't know," Alice replied, her mind in turmoil, doubting her own identity.

"Do you know a female swordsman named Ignes Clodya?" Kapleas asked seriously.

"Yes," Alice answered quietly. "She is my teacher."

Kapleas gasped, instantly understanding everything. He finally understood why Alice's appearance was similar to that of Queen Josephine, and why she possessed a pendant with royal markings. These were not coincidences, but rather the work of fate. "I see," he said, realizing that Alice could not be his sister, and that something must have gone wrong. "I will not admit it!" Amadio shouted excitedly. If Alice's identity was confirmed, his throne might not be safe, which was not what he wanted.

"His Majesty, please remain calm," Vivar said, having already accepted the reality. "Clodya truly is the most severe senior I have ever seen, raising Princess Diana and training her to become one of the youngest Purple Gold Adventurers in history. The effort invested is truly immeasurable."

"Is she really Diana?" Ahfonso stumbled back unconsciously, nearly falling to the ground, his thoughts in chaos. How could such a coincidence exist in the world? I should have noticed this earlier, paying attention to Ignes instead of Diana!

Kapleas, along with many officials loyal to the old king, knelt before Alice, expressing their respect in the presence of all. Suddenly, the court was filled with loud voices—

"Welcome, Spain's First Princess, Princess Diana!"

Alice was at the center of the officials' attention, as the first heir designated by the old king, her status was much higher than Amadio's. Now that her identity had been confirmed, Spain might have its first female queen.

At this moment, Alice was surprised, looking around at the officials kneeling before her, maintaining humility. A sense of standing at the pinnacle of power arose within her.

Alice had never seen such a scene before, and she was unable to adapt to it. She had no acceptance of her status as the first heir.

"Ugh!" Amadio sat heavily on the throne, feeling completely drained, his heart filled with severe disappointment. These officials had never shown him such respect before.

"Ahfonso, do you have anything to say?" Kapleas looked up, his eyes filled with challenge. He held the card of Princess Diana in his hand, and Amadio surrendering the throne was only a matter of time.

"Hah, Kapleas. You indeed have outstanding talent, successfully finding the missing Princess Diana. You should be properly rewarded. I previously suspected you of treason, and I apologize for that. However, I did so to maintain the stability of the kingdom. I hope you can understand."

Ahfonso said with a dry laugh, his mood complex. He had prepared to strike Kapleas fatally, but instead, he had helped him, verifying Alice's identity and giving Kapleas an opportunity to retaliate.

Now, Ahfonso wanted to keep Amadio's position, but it would not be easy. If he did not come up with other plans, Alice would eventually be pushed onto the throne by Kapleas.

Kapleas smirked coldly, saying without a trace of emotion, "Since Princess Diana has returned, it is time to follow the late king's wishes and make Princess Diana our queen."

"This..." Ahfonso hesitated, saying with a somewhat unpleasant face, "This change is too great, and we need to consider it carefully. I will give my answer at the regular meeting in three days. I promise, everything will be in accordance with the late king's wishes."

"Good," Kapleas said meaningfully, thinking that three days would soon pass, and from then on, Ahfonso would no longer be able to stir up trouble in the court, as Princess Diana, who was about to become queen, was not a child.

Ahfonso's gaze was fixed on Alice, his mind filled with both joy and worry. On one hand, he feared losing the power he had just gained, but on the other hand, Princess Diana had come to him voluntarily, allowing him to finally fulfill his promise to the Black Dragon Nidhogg.

This was a good thing. If he could sacrifice Princess Diana to Nidhogg, he might be able to break free from its control. Next, he needed to find a perfect excuse to attack Princess Diana without causing suspicion, as doing so might endanger his position.

Ahfonso needed a flawless reason to act against Princess Diana, as doing so might incite the disapproval of people like Kapleas, and his throne might not be safe.

Alice's gaze was also fixed on Ahfonso, despite being disoriented by her new royal status, she had not forgotten that helping her teacher avenge her was the most important thing at the moment!

The high and mighty position of queen, Alice was not interested in, and if it meant killing the sneaky Ahfonso, she would not mind being queen for a few days.

Their mutual hatred filled the air, and sparks of fire flew between them—

This battle of life and death would only have one survivor.

title: Chapter 19 — Extra chapter coming soon
content:
Chapter 19 — Extra chapter coming soon

Volume 33 · Chapter 19

Alice had confirmed the princess identity, but this matter was temporarily confined within the court and had not spread to the outside world, not to the point where everyone knew.

Since Alice was now a princess, she could not leave the court casually. Every time, a large group of people would follow behind her, which made her feel very uncomfortable.

Alice was temporarily arranged to stay in the place where Queen Huiwen had once lived, that is, her birthroom. For everything before her, she felt very unfamiliar. Even now, it was somewhat difficult to accept the fact that she was the first princess of Spain—originally, when she was young, teacher Claudia had said that she was Princess殿下, not a joke, and had already hinted at it for a long time. Unfortunately, Alice was too young at that time and could not understand the deep meaning in the teacher's words. She felt a bit regretful about this.

The elderly Caprices did not leave but humbly followed beside Alice, actively taking on the role of a guide, introducing her to all the big and small things in the court, and narrating the court turmoil from over twenty years ago——

"That three-year-long great drought almost destroyed the kingdom. Under Alfonso's instigation, kind Queen Josephine was falsely accused of being a witch, forcing the late king to issue a secret execution order for the queen. Teacher Claudia took advantage of the chaos to save you from the confusion and fled out of Spain overnight. I remember that night, Ignis Claudia was covered in blood, holding you, who was still in a cradle, hoping I could provide some help, and smoothly help her escape the city. Unfortunately, she left too urgently, and she didn't tell me where she took you? This led to the entire court having no knowledge of your whereabouts for over twenty whole years.

Alice listened to Caprices' narration and slowly lowered her head, able to truly feel the huge pressure that teacher Claudia had at that time. Not only did she have to take care of herself, but she also had to evade the kingdom's pursuit. This was already the limit a knight could reach.

She realized why Claudia disliked the burdensome court life. Besides having suffered persecution, she also hoped not to walk the same path as her mother. In such an environment, good people had no value; they would only become others' prey.

Undoubtedly, Claudia had long since seen through Alice's character, and like Queen Josephine who was also kind, she had warned those words, letting Alice live as an ordinary person.

Thinking of Claudia, Alice's emotions inevitably became low. Compared to that unseen and untouchable biological mother, obviously the teacher held a higher position in her heart.

However, as a knight, the teacher was willing to do such a thing for Queen Josephine. Alice could not help but doubt what kind of charm her own mother possessed?

"Caprices, may I ask, what kind of person am I, exactly?"

"Diana Princess, you don't need to be so reserved. Just call my name, it's fine. You need to adapt to your high-responsibility identity as soon as possible," Caprices emphasized seriously, his attitude completely different from before, filled with respect. Obviously recognizing that Alice was the missing Diana, he was determined to assist the princess in ascending the throne, and could no longer view Alice as an adventurer.

Alice was not very adaptable to the princess identity, and she did not like the name "Diana" very much. But seeing Caprices' fervent eyes, she was not comfortable dispelling his enthusiasm.

"Your mother is a very good person. Although she is a noble, she has a noble soul, sympathizing with every unfortunate person. My old friend Dennis, even willing to die for the queen. I once had such an impulse, which shows how great your mother was. I believe she is the most beautiful queen, whether in appearance or soul, simply like a pure and spotless lily, constantly infecting those around," Caprices smiled on his wrinkled face, constantly responding to past events.

"Is that so," Alice silently lowered her head, gaining a more detailed understanding of her mother. So many people loved her, even teacher Claudia fought for her mother. Perhaps she was indeed a queen who could make those around her feel warmth.

"However, the queen who should have been surrounded by happiness was killed by this bastard Alfonso. This mouse from the slums' underground sewers, although well-fed and well-clothed, was all due to the queen's kindness, yet she was not grateful and instead used groundless charges to frame the queen!" Caprices gritted his teeth, his whole body trembling with anger, "I and your teacher Ignis have always suspected that someone was manipulating the kingdom's consecutive disasters. Alfonso has the biggest suspicion, but we have never found evidence. Otherwise, we would have eliminated him long ago. By the way, how is your teacher now? Have these twenty years been okay?"

"Teacher... she passed away not long ago," Alice answered with a low emotion.

"Ignis... Caprices was startled, his brows tightly locked, "What happened?"

Alice gazed at the person in front of her, feeling he was trustworthy, and said, not long ago, Alfonso discovered that teacher was hiding in the snowy mountains, bringing a group of people to kill her. When I arrived, the teacher had already long slept at the foot of the snowy mountains.

"Ugh! Again is this bastard Alfonso!" Caprices angrily slapped the table, his eye corners wildly twitching, "No wonder Alfonso suddenly left Spain not long ago. It turned out he had already discovered your traces!"

"To be honest, I am willing to help you because I want to approach Alfonso to avenge the teacher," Alice raised her head and said her thoughts, her gaze extremely determined.

Caprices was stunned, and immediately stood up, kneeling on one knee, "Although this old man is old, he is willing to go through fire and water for Her Highness the Princess. If my old life can go to the end with Alfonso, it is also not letting down the late king and queen's expectations."

Alice really could not bear being treated as a princess, the meticulous and rigid manner made her very uncomfortable. I understood, you get up quickly, you don't need to make a sacrifice. Maybe I can find an opportunity to kill Alfonso directly.

"Alfonso's strength is unfathomable. Are you sure you can kill him?" Caprices asked doubtfully.

"I am not sure," Alice said. "I couldn't even beat the teacher, how could I be Alfonso's opponent?"

"Then please don't take the risk. I have a more stable approach, even not requiring you to make a move personally, and Alfonso can be killed, but there is a premise..." Caprices said mysteriously.

"What?" Alice curiously followed up.

"Please make sure to ascend the throne and become Spain's first queen," Caprices paused, meaningfully saying, "When you walk up to the peak of power, you will also get unimaginable power!"

(Note: The last line seems to be cut off in the source, but the meaning is preserved.)

title: Chapter 20 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter
content:
Chapter 20 — Monthly Ticket Bonus Chapter

Volume 33 · Chapter 20

"Unimaginable power?" Alice looked puzzled.

"In fact, I heard the royal family has a secret only successive kings are qualified to know." Caprice paused, speaking in a low voice, "It seems the royal family once discovered an ancient battlefield from the Age of Gods, and found a batch of corpses with immense power..."

"Hmm?" Alice felt somewhat surprised. Was this land once a battlefield in the age of gods?

"Later, a wise man of the royal family used necromancy to successfully awaken these corpses, creating a mysterious force guarding the royal family." Caprice paused again, adding in a meaningful tone, "I think you should understand—necromancy is synonymous with evil in the secular world, with very bad influence, so few people know about this. I only learned of it by chance. As long as you become queen, you'll have the qualification to master this mysterious power. Killing Alfonso should be a sure thing."

Alice lowered her head, responding hesitantly, "I don't want to become queen."

"Why? You're the legitimate heir to the throne; you shouldn't give up this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! No one is more suitable to rule this land than you." Caprice was very confused—he didn't know Alice's true identity before, but now that he knows, her refusal to inherit the throne is somewhat hard for him to understand.

"My teacher hopes I live as an ordinary person; I'm following her wishes." Alice looked up, smiling at Caprice, "I've always been disobedient since childhood, always liking to go against my teacher's will. Taking care of her should be tiring, right? But this time, I want to listen to her."

Caprice's face looked a bit unpleasant. If Alice refused to inherit the throne, things would be difficult.

"If becoming queen can avenge my teacher, I can serve as queen, but it's temporary—I'll leave eventually." Alice said with a change of tone.

"Okay." Caprice nodded stiffly, thinking there was still hope—maybe Alice would change her mind later.

"It's getting late. Can you bring my daughter here? She'd be unhappy not seeing me." Alice worried about her precious daughter.

"No! Actually your current situation is dangerous. If Alfonso doesn't want to give up his rights, he'll definitely start plotting to harm you. If your daughter is nearby, she might encounter misfortune. Leaving her with me is relatively safer." Caprice analyzed the pros and cons, speaking in a teasing tone, "Please rest assured, little princess, I'll take care of her. I won't let her suffer even a bit."

Alice thought for a moment, finding Caprice's reasoning sound, so she nodded. "Alright. This child is a bit shy; I hope you'll be patient."

"I understand. These past few days won't be peaceful. You must be extra careful and don't easily believe anyone." Caprice warned.

After Caprice left, the huge court room was left with only Alice sitting alone on a chair, bewildered.

What happened today made her feel very tired; the stimulation was great, and she couldn't adapt in a short time.

Just in the morning she was an adventurer from Britain, and by night she had become a noble princess, living in the palace—everything forced her to experience was bizarre.

Alice wandered aimlessly around the room, inspecting the luxurious surroundings everywhere; she couldn't imagine she was born in such a place.

From Caprice and Dennis's words, her mother was a charming woman, but unfortunately too kind and without caution toward others, falling victim to Alfonso's poison.

Perhaps this time she wasn't just avenging her teacher, but also her biological mother whom she'd never met...

Alice saw a cradle beside the bed holding a baby; her expression became complicated—

She could imagine similar scenes: perhaps when she was a baby, she lay there while that princess mother stood beside, speaking softly, exactly like when she took care of Chris.

Suddenly, a piercing pain came from the finger Alice cut with the dagger. This mysterious sensation even stirred the inheritance crystal lurking in her body for a long time...

Crystal!

The dragon inheritance crystal was never completely integrated into Alice; it remained quietly dormant inside, preventing her from using the true power of dragons.

Only from the white dragon in the Ancestral Dragon Temple did she receive the revelation: she must obtain black dragon blood and transform into a true dragon warrior to control the true power of dragons.

Just now, Alice clearly felt her inheritance crystal surge. Besides sensing the black dragon blood, she couldn't think of any other reason.

What was going on?

Alice was very puzzled, carefully recalling today's events. There was only one opportunity for her to come into contact with someone else's blood—

That was during the identity verification, cutting her finger with the same dagger—first Alfonso, then Amadeo; their blood would remain on the dagger.

Alice furrowed her brows, sensing the mysterious force pulling at her inheritance crystal, and had a bold guess.

"It seems this land hides secrets, shrouded in enormous shadows."

"Between Alfonso and Amadeo, it seems one of them has some connection with the legendary Black Dragon Nidhogg?"

In the dim room, the fireplace flames burned fiercely. The indoor temperature was very high, vaguely creating the illusion of being beside a stove.

Yet standing before the fireplace, Alfonso still felt freezing cold, shivering uncontrollably, emitting eerie cold air; his face was pale, covered with a layer of frost.

Alfonso's teeth chattered, making clicking sounds. After so long, he still hadn't shaken off the erosion of the cold poison, could only harden himself and endure. If he couldn't find a solution, death by freezing wasn't far off.

Days ago, Alfonso went to see the Black Dragon Nidhogg, hoping it would help clear the cold poison, but it refused.

Nidhogg demanded Alfonso deliver sacrificial offerings before agreeing to remove his pain, which undoubtedly made his situation worse.

But today, the long-missing Diana returned herself, giving Alfonso hope to live. As long as he delivered her to the Black Dragon, not only could he relieve the pain of the cold poison, but receive more rewards.

Thinking of this, Alfonso couldn't help showing a smile on his face, already thinking of ways to deal with Alice.

Although with Alfonso's current state, dealing with Alice would feel slightly exhausting, the initiative was still in his hands.

Knock knock knock—knocking sounded; a subordinate reported—

"Lord Alfonso, King Amadeo visited late at night and wants to see you."

"Let him in."

Alfonso responded calmly, seemingly having long anticipated the little king would come find him. He quickly stood up, frantically suppressing the cold poison inside, extinguishing the fireplace flames, creating an appearance of good health.

Soon after, little King Amadeo walked in alone, without Vivaldi following. This drama queen burst into tears upon seeing Alfonso, crawling on the ground like a dog, tightly hugging Alfonso's thigh, speaking in a pitiful tone:

"Wahhh, Teacher! Save me!"

"The sister who's been missing for years suddenly returned—it's clearly to snatch everything from me!"

"I don't want to lose the throne! Please think of a way to eliminate Diana! I'll listen to whatever Teacher says!"

(中_中)

title: Chapter 21 — Initiative
content:
Chapter 21 — Initiative

Volume 33 · Chapter 21

“Quickly get up, Your Majesty. Alfonso pulled Amadeo up from the ground and whispered, “You don’t need to worry about this kind of thing.”

“But—!” Amadeo said emotionally, “Teacher, you saw it too! Caprice this old fellow has joined forces with many ministers, wanting to pull me down from the throne, trying to make a missing witch’s son of over two years become the new queen! Why can a person who suddenly returns casually replace me? Teacher, help me!”

“Please calm down, Your Majesty. Isn’t Diana also a witch’s child?” Alfonso said with deep meaning.

“You mean—?” Amadeo looked confused.

“Your Majesty, I have watched you grow up, and I won’t let anyone threaten your position. Alfonso paused and added, “Diana can absolutely not become a knight guard. Besides you, no one can rule Spain.”

“Does Teacher have a way to help me through this crisis?” Amadeo asked curiously.

“Of course. Diana is the child of an evil witch, the descendant of the person who brought endless disasters to the kingdom. How can she become queen? Isn’t this trying to let the kingdom perish sooner? Alfonso narrowed his eyes and continued, “Although Caprice is aggressive, this is just a facade of strong exterior but weak interior. I only need one sentence to make all his efforts go to waste. Don’t forget, Teacher, I am the great astrologer whom everyone admires.”

Amadeo was startled and instantly widened his eyes. He immediately understood Alfonso’s meaning and had a faint guess in his heart—

Alfonso’s astrological predictions had helped the kingdom through several crises, even gaining the trust of the old king. In the court, almost no one doubted him.

So Alfonso could fully utilize this point, slander Alice, saying she would bring misfortune to the kingdom, which would surely arouse the self-preservation psychology of many nobles, thus eliminating Alice.

Such a despicable method could be used, and Amadeo began to doubt whether Alfonso had done this many times. Maybe Josephine Queen’s death last year also used a similar method.

Amadeo kept an impassive face. Even if he understood in his heart, he would pretend to be dull. He excitedly asked further.

“Teacher, don’t sell me out. What exactly are you going to do?

“Diana’s mother once brought a three-year drought to the kingdom, almost causing the kingdom to perish. She might also possess evil powers. These few days, I will go to the Astrology Tower to observe the stars, hoping to get some inspiration.” Alfonso planned to use the old trick, using the method of killing Queen Josephine on Alice, “If Diana indeed inherited her mother’s evil power, she is an ill-omened witch, and regardless, she must be gotten rid of!

Amadeo raised his eyebrows. He felt a slight fear, worrying that one day he would also be eliminated by Alfonso using similar methods. But he could not show any concern, so he could only praise, “No wonder you are the Teacher! At a time like this, only you can make me rely on you!

“However, if Diana is really an ill-omened witch, getting rid of her might be somewhat difficult, after all, she is a purple gold adventurer, and her strength is probably extraordinary. Few people in the court can suppress her, so we need to make some preparations in advance.” Alfonso looked at Amadeo with a mysterious air and said, “Your Majesty, you need to do something.”

“What? As long as it is something Teacher assigns, I will do anything!” Amadeo immediately perked up.

Alfonso came to his table, opened the drawer, took out a colorless potion, and his tone became serious, “No matter what method, please let Her Majesty drink this potion.

“Are you trying to poison her?” Amadeo asked in surprise.

“Don’t worry, this isn’t poison. How could I have the courage to poison a royal family member? I have always been loyal to the royal family.” Alfonso’s face didn’t redden and his heart didn’t skip a beat. He continued explaining, “This is a sealing potion. It can make the drinker lose all fighting spirit and magic power within a month, becoming an ordinary person. As long as she drinks this potion, that’s enough, right?” Amadeo stared at the colorless, tasteless potion in his hand, thinking about many things—

Good, all the initiative is now in my hands. Next, it will probably be netting the target.

In the carriage, Vival was escorting Amadeo back to the palace. He sat opposite the little king, his expression serious.

Amadeo flipped through the documents one by one, his expression fluctuating. “These are all the information about Diana?”

“Yes, the time was too short, so I could only collect so many things.” Vival answered in a low voice.

“Oh~ Serving as a Hero, or a foreign thorn knight from Britain? The adventurer’s career has also resolved several tricky crises multiple times, even participating in pacifying the internal strife in France.” Amadeo put down a stack of stable documents, meaningfully saying, “No matter how you look at it, my sister looks like a hero upholding justice, seeming not to be a scheming homewrecker.

“It probably isn’t wrong. I still know Ignis Senior, who is a person with a very strong sense of justice. The Princess was raised by her, so she cannot become a lowly person.” Vival praised.

“Vival, if you had another chance, would you be willing to be my knight, or my sister Diana’s knight?” Amadeo lifted his head and sized up Vival.

“Undoubtedly, I am willing to serve Her Highness Diana, although I am now Your Majesty’s knight, and naturally I have no second thoughts. This is a quality a knight must possess.” Vival answered sincerely.

“Hahaha!” Amadeo laughed and was not angry. “I like your honesty, Vival. My choice was indeed correct. If I were you, I wouldn’t choose myself either. I only became king out of necessity. In other people’s eyes, I am just an immature little kid, where is there any ability to sit on the throne? My personality is extremely dark, and very selfish. Sometimes I even doubt myself, but I know that in order to survive in the court full of intrigues, I must become despicable.

“Vival did not respond, thinking to himself that he also became a personal guard knight out of necessity, and in some ways was similar to Amadeo, only able to huddle together for warmth to not freeze to death.

Amadeo took out the colorless potion from his pocket, shook it in front of his eyes casually, and asked, “Alfonso let me give this potion to Diana to drink, what do you think?”

“This I underestimated Alfonso.” Vival answered.

“Underestimated what?” Amadeo glanced at his knight from the corner of his eye.

“Underestimated the severity of Alfonso’s injuries.” Vival took a deep breath, confidently answering—

“Alfonso’s injuries are probably more serious than I imagined.

“Now I am very sure that his condition is very bad. This is good news.”

title: Chapter 22 — Golden Barbie
content:
Chapter 22 — Golden Barbie

Volume 33 · Chapter 22

"If Alfonso's body had no serious issues? With his strength, he shouldn't worry about any threat from a purple-gold adventurer, but now Alfonso is using such base tactics to deal with Princess Diana—it can only mean Alfonso's injuries are already very serious," Vitalion said, his tone serious. "Although normally I wouldn't have the courage to oppose Alfonso, but now I have a bit of confidence."

"You're right, Vital, I think the same way." Amadeo smiled, his meaning deep. "Perhaps now is the best opportunity to get rid of Alfonso."

Vital saw Amadeo's hesitant look and understood in his heart, "Your Majesty, aren't you also worried about the threat from Princess Diana?"

"Exactly. If Alfonso is successfully gotten rid of, maybe Caprices and my older sister would find it easier to pull me down from the throne, although Alfonso is a despicable bastard, but honestly, isn't it his merit that I can still sit on the throne?" Amadeo showed a troubled expression.

"I think Your Majesty should temporarily ally with Princess Diana, first getting rid of Alfonso is the correct choice," Vital suggested.

"Why? If I lose Alfonso's support, Caprices would desperately want the sun to rise tomorrow and make Spain have its first female queen ever, and they wouldn't let me off either." Amadeo tightened his brows.

"Your Majesty, please think carefully. You and Princess Diana are both heirs of the late king, whoever wins is guarding the ancestors' legacy. But if Alfonso wins, you and Princess Diana would face a lose-lose situation, and the kingdom would fall into the hands of a bastard from the slums— which is lighter, which is heavier? I hope His Majesty thinks it over carefully." Vital lowered his head, sincerely saying, "Princess Diana is a purple-gold adventurer; her strength should be enough to make Alfonso wary. Perhaps now she is our only option to strive for."

Amadeo took a deep breath, carefully weighing the pros and cons. He believed his knights' advice was given from the perspective of the overall situation and had value to consider, but it wasn't necessarily the most beneficial advice.

Losing Alfonso's support, Caprices would definitely become overbearing. If both guys died, that would be great—then Diana would also lose support, and I have confidence in defeating my sister and consolidating my throne.

"How does His Majesty think? This bottle of sealing potion, I don't advise you to use it, otherwise you'll lose the opportunity to bring down Alfonso." Vital's gaze was sincere.

"No, this potion must be used. Although you're right, I should ally with Diana, but losing Alfonso, I'll only fall faster. Even if Diana dies in this struggle, Caprices will continue to constrain Alfonso. We'll still be in a relatively safe position. However, in the future, we might never find an opportunity to crush Alfonso again." Amadeo sighed long, his hands tightly clasped in a contemplative posture, speaking in a commanding tone—

"So, Vital, tomorrow go probe Princess Diana's stance. I need to find out, is she here to take everything of mine, or is she simply being used by Caprices?"

"What exactly do you need me to do?"

The next day, Alice hardly saw any familiar people, not even her so-called "brother," who never showed up.

Actually, although Alice felt no emotion toward Amadeo, he was still her younger brother after all, having the same father. She still had some things to ask, but there was no such opportunity.

Looking at Amadeo's reaction from that day in the council hall, Alice knew this brother of hers simply didn't welcome her, didn't want to communicate with her—this was reasonable.

After becoming the beloved Princess of the Kingdom, Alice received the highest courtesy in the court. Wherever she went, a large group of maids followed behind her.

They occasionally whispered to discuss the missing twenty-year-old princess, or were delighted to discuss some unknown handsome baron, or chatted about pink rumors in the court.

This was the first time Alice had been in such a circle of women, and she felt very uncomfortable with this life. Although her body wouldn't be tired, her spirit was very fatigued, always being pointed out by the elderly maids for inappropriate behavior that would damage the royal image.

Since last night, Alice's food, clothing, and housing had been under the control of these maids. They would come to clean the room, send sumptuous food on time, and even change clothes several times a day. Even during bathing and grooming, someone would help. It sounds like life is very good, but she felt she had lost her freedom, a bit like a canary raised in a cage for others to observe.

Alice wore a heavy long dress, the inside made of metal, her silver hair piled up, and a silver crown on her head. After being dressed up by a group of maids, she could no longer see any adventurer's appearance at all.

Returning to the room, Alice saw all the maids standing at the door, unwilling to leave easily. So she showed a polite smile and said softly, "You all go about your business. I want to rest alone."

"Your Highness, that won't do. You've just returned and don't understand much. We must watch over you every step of the way," the maid replied in a low voice.

"Can't I just spend some time alone? I'm a person, not a criminal. Besides sleeping, you're always watching me. Can't I have some private space?" Alice couldn't help but get angry. She had only endured this life for a day.

The maids exchanged glances with each other, not wanting to anger the newly returned Princess, so they bowed temporarily and exited the room, not disturbing Alice.

In the spacious room, only Alice was left. She sighed deeply, took off the crown on her head, untied her piled-up hair, and fell headfirst onto the soft bed, letting out a sigh from the soul.

"Ah~w heart"

"Good"

"Why does this ghostly place have so many rules? I sneeze and am called impolite."

Alice, feeling tired, slowly closed her eyes, planning to take a short nap, but the door outside immediately knocked.

"Princess Diana, I've prepared afternoon tea for you."

"Hmm?" Alice furrowed her brows and quickly stood up. She was actually a bit hungry, so she replied, "Come in."

The maid pushing the tea cart slowly walked in from outside. She wore a gorgeous maid uniform that was quite eye-catching, especially with her burly figure, which seemed very peculiar!

The serving maid placed pastries in front of Alice and poured her a cup of red tea, then respectfully stood by the plate.

Alice sized up the strange maid beside her. Her figure wasn't like a normal maid at all; she was burly and didn't fit in with the other maids. Why was there such a strong maid in the court? She looked like she had great strength, completely not like a woman.

"Princess, please have your meal."

"? ? ?" Alice was startled by the "Giant Barbie" beside her. Her whole body was shocked, her exterior scorched and interior tender. "What a rough voice! ? You aren't a maid, are you! ? Who are you!"

"Strong female maid lowered her head, a bit embarrassed, not wanting to lift her face. But under pressure, she had to harden her scalp and take off her wig—

"I am a personal guard knight beside His Majesty Amadeo, Vitalion."

"You can rest assured, I'm absolutely not a bad person."

title: Chapter 23 — Reenactment
content:
Chapter 23 — Reenactment

Volume 33 · Chapter 23

The room was so large that not a sound could be heard, silent to the point of driving one mad——

Alice stared at Vival in disbelief, feeling that the maid outfit on the other person was very ill-fitting, almost about to be torn open by this man.

However, Alice still had some impression of Vival; she had seen him in the assembly hall, standing behind Amadeus.

Alice lowered her gaze, and instantly saw the pectoral muscles squeezed and deformed, covered with coarse hair, besides making her feel filthy,

it was also very eyesore.

"That—

"You need not share any thoughts on my attire, I am forced to dress like this, I hope you can understand.

" "Alice unconsciously covered her eyes, simply unable to bear looking at him, "As a knight personal guard of the King, why must you dress like this? Is it a special preference?

"Not at all, there are Alfonso's spies everywhere in the court, to avoid those eagles and dogs, I must dress like this so as not to attract suspicion," Vival explained seriously, not wanting to be misunderstood as having some peculiar preference.

Hearing the name "Alphonse," Alice's expression recovered a bit of calm, but she couldn't help but complain, "Wouldn't this make it even more conspicuous?

"At the very least, I won't be recognized. I am a knight of His Majesty Amadeus, if I come to see you, and Alphonse finds out, it might cause trouble for His Majesty," Vival answered in a low voice.

"Alice believed a few points in her heart, thinking that a proud knight dressing like this to see herself must be a very secret and important matter, "Is it Amadeus who sent you?"

"Not at all, I wanted to come talk to you myself,"

Vival lied, not admitting that he was dispatched by Amadeus. The reason he changed into this maid outfit was also to gain Alice's trust.

The red tea placed before Alice at this moment had already had Alfonso's sealing agent dropped into it; Vival's task was to ascertain Alice's stance—

If Alice's stance was on the opposite side, aiming for the throne, Amadeus would choose to prioritize eliminating her.

But if Alice was merely being used by Caplais and had no intention of opposing Amadeus, she would become a help in the plan to kill Alphonse.

Everything had already been arranged by this little king; Alice's stance would determine who Amadeus would choose to strike.

"Hmm?" Alice was astonished, thinking that deliberately dressing up in such an eyesore manner was to avoid misunderstandings if Alphonse found out? As a personal guard knight, one's words and actions could indeed represent the meaning of Amadeus himself, "I understand, what did you come to me for?

"Diana Princess, to be honest, I joined the kingdom's guard as a squire knight upon coming of age, at that time your teacher Ignis was my mentor, she once instructed me and pointed out many doubts in martial arts, also counting as my half a teacher," Vival paused, then slowly spoke of his youthful years at twenty, "She is the most upright and loyal person I have ever seen in my life, she can be said to be a model among knights, I have always held her in respect."

"Is that so?" Alice slightly furrowed her brow, thinking this guy is also a teacher's student? Besides me, would he teach others?

"However, more than twenty years ago, Ignis kidnapped you, betrayed the kingdom. Knowing this, I felt extremely shocked," Vival mentioned this matter with deep meaning.

"Impossible! The teacher would never betray anyone so casually, I lived with her when I was young, she was good to me, taking me away was to protect my safety, my mother was falsely accused of being an evil witch, I already know this, if the teacher didn't take me away, would I also be secretly killed?" Alice raised her head with angry gaze, staring into Vival's eyes.

"Cough cough!" Vival hurriedly coughed twice, nodding and saying, "So that's the case, your words answered my doubts of so many years, I have never dared to believe that Lady Ignis would kidnap the princess and betray the kingdom, how is she now?"

"Died," Alice answered with a low tone.

"Huh!" Vival's expression stiffened on his face, feeling quite astonished in his heart. With Claudia's realm, living another hundred years should be no problem, what happened?

Alice looked at Vival, thinking this knight should not be Alphonse's person, to avoid Alphonse's gaze, not sparing dignity to wear maid attire to see her, should be no problem, "Alphonse killed her."

Vival's gaze instantly changed, feeling that the matter became subtle, "You suddenly came back, is it to revenge Ignis?"

"This "Alice picked up the red tea on the table, thinking whether to voice her thoughts, obviously Vival still couldn't fully trust, besides being able to see that he was afraid of Alphonse, he showed no sign of any hostility toward Alphonse.

Seeing that Alice had already picked up the red tea containing the sealing agent, Vival became anxious—

"Hope you can answer my doubts."

"Are you here to contend for the throne, or simply to seek revenge?

Night fell, many nobles of the kingdom gathered in the astrological tower. The great astrologer Alphonse conducted the astrological ritual again after many years.

This time the astrological ritual was placed against the background of Princess Diana, the first heir, having just returned, immediately attracting the attention of all the nobles in the city, perhaps heralding a transformation—

"Lord Alphonse hadn't astrologied for a long time, this time what does he want to know?"

"The mother of Princess Diana is an evil witch, bringing irreparable disaster to the kingdom, maybe Lord Alphonse is not at ease?"

"In principle, Princess Diana should become the first female king in the history of the kingdom, if she also possesses inauspicious power like her mother, I fear she cannot inherit the throne."

"Lord Alphonse's astrological prediction will not be wrong, if Princess Diana is also an inauspicious witch, for the safety of the kingdom, we must find a way to eliminate her."

"As long as Lord Alphonse's astrological prediction is there, our interests will never be damaged, there is nothing that can threaten our position."

Amadeus listened to the discussions around him, his gaze becoming deep, staring at Alphonse standing at the highest point of the astrological tower, relying on the miraculous hundred percent prediction, this man had gained the trust of everyone, regardless of the result, no one would suspect, this is how terrible a thing, can have reason and cause freely kill anyone.

Alphonse looked at the stars in the sky perfunctorily, his expression worried as he turned around, looking at all the nobles present, loudly announced the astrological result.

"This land will soon face a unprecedented disaster!

"All this, is because someone brought misfortune to the kingdom!"

"The inheritor of that evil witch, has returned here."

title: Chapter 24 — Cold Light (Monthly Bonus)
content:
Chapter 24 — Cold Light (Monthly Bonus)

Volume 33 · Chapter 24

After Alfonso revealed his prophecy, the nobles were immediately thrown into great panic, their unease spreading like wildfire—

"What!? More severe than the great drought over twenty years ago!? Won't the kingdom completely collapse!?"

"What should we do? The kingdom faces internal strife and external threats; we can hardly withstand any more disasters."

"Since Alfonso has made this prophecy, this disaster is bound to happen. How can we possibly stop it?"

These nobles usually appeared haughty and superior, many of them holding the kingdom's lifelines in their hands, but upon learning they would lose all this—

Each one revealed a face of fear, for nothing was more important to them than the wealth and power they controlled.

Alfonso felt secretly pleased; their reactions were entirely within his expectations, and they had completely fallen into his trap.

After years of accurate prophecies, everyone trusted Alfonso implicitly, allowing him to fabricate lies and deceive all at will.

Of course, such underhanded tactics should be used sparingly, especially when wanting to eliminate competitors—use them too often, and suspicion would inevitably arise.

Amadio secretly clenched his fists, his eyes full of fear. If Alfonso wanted to eliminate him, he wouldn't even need to lift a finger—just say one word in this astrological tower, and no one would bother to save him.

This ten-year-old boy-king felt extreme danger, growing ever more convinced that as long as Alfonso lived, the kingdom would never truly belong to him.

Amadio forced a grim smile, knowing he had to appear foolish before Alfonso to avoid arousing suspicion.

"Teacher, who exactly is the witch heir you mentioned!? To safeguard the kingdom's stability, we must eliminate her in advance!"

"It is Princess Diana, who just returned!"

Without hesitation, Alfonso placed the hat of an evil witch upon Alice's head, convincing everyone that the princess must be eliminated to secure peace.

The scene was like a repetition of over twenty years ago, when he used the exact same method to murder Alice's mother, Princess Josephine.

History repeated itself, except the victim was now the infant in swaddling clothes from back then.

Of course, Alfonso wouldn't kill Alice; he would bring her before the black dragon Nidhogg and sacrifice his own soul to complete the transaction with Nidhogg.

"Teacher, can you be certain of this?" Amadio asked knowingly.

"Although I don't wish to believe it, this is the truth. Everyone knows Princess Josephine once brought irreparable harm to the kingdom. Now her daughter, Princess Diana, has inherited this evil power!" Alfonso paused, then added, "Though the disaster hasn't manifested yet, she will inevitably bring great loss to the kingdom just like her mother. We must stop this before things worsen!"

"As I suspected! She disappeared for years and suddenly returned—there's definitely no good in that. Just like her mother, she's a witch who brings calamity to others!" Amadio gnashed his teeth in anger and shouted, "Teacher! What must we do to prevent this disaster?"

"Eliminate Princess Diana. There is no other way." Alfonso said decisively.

Hearing these words, some nobles harbored different thoughts, but considering their own interests, no one doubted him. They all began voicing agreement, just as they had unanimously approved the secret murder of Princess Josephine back then—

"It seems we have no choice. For the kingdom's stability, sacrificing Princess Diana is acceptable."

"Yes, Princess Diana is truly pitiful. She was taken away by the court swordsaint since childhood, yet unfortunately inherited evil power. Alas—"

"This is Princess Josephine's fault. If she weren't an evil witch, perhaps Diana could have lived happily beneath her."

Amadio remained silent, committing to memory all the nobles who agreed with Alfonso's prophecy—

These people were just like Alfonso; they could not be allowed to remain. Willing to sacrifice the royal family for their own gain?

This already made Amadio wary, realizing these nobles were just as harmful as the despicable Alfonso!

Alfonso walked slowly closer, speaking in a voice only the two of them could hear, "Your Majesty, how is that matter proceeding?"

"Teacher, don't worry. It's all done. I sent Vivaldi to approach Diana and successfully had her drink the sealing potion. I estimate she doesn't even know what she drank now. Eliminating Diana will be as easy as slaughtering a pig~" Amadio said excitedly, waiting for the teacher to personally eliminate his nemesis.

"Very good." Alfonso nodded. This matched the intelligence he had received from his subordinates last night—Vivaldi had once served Diana afternoon tea—

Looks like I'm going to win.

The next day, the plan to eliminate Diana began to be secretly implemented.

The assassins Alfonso had cultivated nearly surrounded the entire palace, ready to provide support at any moment.

The palace maids had no idea what was happening? Before dawn, they were ordered to temporarily leave.

Only a small number of Alfonso's lapdogs knew what was about to happen—this was identical to the secret operation that killed Princess Josephine over twenty years ago!

Alice seemed completely unaware of everything, still burrowing under the covers, sleeping soundly, oblivious to the fact that she was alone in the bedchamber.

The door was gently pushed open. Alfonso's expression was gloomy as he silently crept inside, seeing Alice still burrowed under the covers, sleeping soundly. He thought the plan was going even smoother than expected.

Alfonso's body had long been corroded by cold poison; he had to suppress it with all his strength or be frozen to death. Normally, dealing with Alice would be no small task.

But now that Alice had drunk the sealing potion, Alfonso had no further worries and was confident he could easily subdue her.

The moment he thought of fulfilling his bargain with the black dragon Nidhogg, Alfonso's lips curled into a smile. He walked slowly to the bedside, and black flames suddenly blazed in his hand, ready to strike the sleeping Alice!

At that moment—

The heavy quilt was shredded. A blade of unimaginable sharpness, flashing with cold light, pierced through the layers of quilt fragments, launching a sudden assault on Alfonso and instantly piercing his shoulder!

Alice's eyes were ice-cold. She had long known all of Alfonso's schemes and had carefully prepared a trap, waiting for the enemy to walk right into it!

Alfonso's body twisted almost contortedly, barely dodging the sword aimed at his heart, only suffering a wound to his shoulder. Yet under the effect of the divine artifact Lightful Lament, he still suffered tremendous trauma!

The black dragon Nidhogg was undoubtedly a creature of the darkness element. Alfonso, whose blood flowed with black dragon essence, would likewise be suppressed by the Lightful Lament.

With the divine artifact's blessing and its ability to suppress Alfonso, Alice's true strength could fully contend with a pseudo-god—

"Alfonso, I've been waiting for you!"

title: Chapter 25 — Court Deadly Struggle
content:
Chapter 25 — Court Deadly Struggle

Volume 33 · Chapter 25

Alfonso quickly retreated, gritting his teeth, clutching his shoulder that was bleeding profusely, feeling that the suppressed cold poison within his body had been stirred, and his entire right arm had already been eroded, frozen into a deep purple.

This made him extremely resentful. The parts of his body completely eroded by the cold poison were no different from the dead, essentially rendering his right arm useless!

Alfonso lifted his head incredulously, looking at Alice opposite him, who was holding a sword. The斗气 and magic power of the sect realm were wantonly raising cold winds, instantly enveloping the room in layer after layer of frost. The situation before his eyes was completely different from his expectations.

Normally, if Alice had really drunk the sealing potion, she absolutely could not have used any magic or martial techniques!

Alfonso's complexion grew uglier, and a layer of cold sweat appeared on his forehead, realizing that he had walked into a trap——

Amadio, this suckling pig of a brat actually betrayed me!

Alfonso was unwilling to believe this fact. He had watched Amadio grow up since he was young, and was thoroughly familiar with the little king. Where did he get the courage to betray himself?

In Alfonso's eyes, Amadio was simply a fool to the extreme, a waste. Without me beside him to guide him, he clearly could do nothing.

Such a silly little king, yet he deceived himself on the most critical information, putting himself in a dangerous situation!

Alfonso's mind floated up Amadio's stupid face, but usually this silly little king who was over + years old had a cunning and crafty expression.

Damn! Useless Amadio, do you think you can kill me just with your ability?!

Alfonso cursed in anger, his entire body bathing in black flames. The pressure of the black dragon drove back the coldness radiating from Alice fiercely.

This Alice was very familiar with this power, and the silent inheritance crystal in her body began to stir, as if craving prey. She had already confirmed that Alfonso must have some connection with the black dragon Nidhogg!

Vibrant black flames burned, and Alfonso's body had already grown dense scales like black gemstones. His gaze revealed intense hatred, and every breath brought terrifying waves of heat!

"Diana, you can't beat me. Surrender obediently, don't make meaningless resistance. Your soul belongs to the great black dragon!"

"Indeed," Alice took a deep breath. It seems coming to Spain was correct, and there were actually unexpected discoveries. "No matter who your servant is? I only know that the crimes you have committed have reached an unforgivable step! For my respected teacher, for the Virgin I have never met! You must pay with your life today!"

"Very good! I like your eyes, they are exactly the same as your mother's! Josephine Queen never would have dreamed that I personally killed her, and now I have to send her child to hell personally!"

Alfonso's face was hideous as he scolded. Although the plan had a flaw, he was not afraid, and planned to fight to the death with Alice, enduring the cold poison erosion. As long as Alfonso could defeat Alice, then relying on the power of the black dragon Nidhogg, he would completely have the capability to rise again.

But if he couldn't take down Alice, she wouldn't need to make a move; Alfonso would be eroded by Claudia's cold poison all over his body, frozen to death alive.

Alfonso had no choice but to try to tear a hope of survival from Alice. He no longer suppressed the cold poison in his body, but fought with all his strength. The comparison of their strengths was obvious; Alfonso was much stronger, but Alice, with the aid of the divine weapon, also had the ability to fight above her level.

Only to see Alice hesitate not at all and take the lead first. The fine sword in her hand shone with holy light, and several sharp golden ice cones shot out, pressing down like a tidal wave!

Alfonso let out a cold snort. His claw-like hands, covered in scales, waved, and the raging black flames instantly evaporated the incoming ice cones. "It seems Igneus taught you well. Did she not mention anything to you about me? This foolish woman, even on her deathbed, would not say your whereabouts. If she had been willing to listen to me back then, perhaps she would not have died! In a sense, it was you who killed her!"

"Shut up! You despicable bastard!"

Alice could not bear Alfonso's mockery of her deceased teacher. She drew out flower-like sword patterns with her fine sword, and a sword wheel composed of many ice blades whirled out, howling!

The sharp ice blade sword wheel seemed to have life, quite agile. Where it passed, obstacles were crushed into powder. Countless cracks appeared on the walls from being cut!

Alfonso sneered lightly. He wove invisible black flame threads, connected to the top wall, and thus pulled his body to avoid the overwhelming ice blade sword wheel. "Compared to your teacher, you are still far behind!"

"Die!"

Alice seized the victory and pursuit. She had already slipped forward, tightly gripping the fine sword in her hand, aiming straight at Alfonso's heart.

With the effect of the Light Sigh cleric's restraint on dragon's blood, as long as he injures Alfonso's vital points, he is surely dead!

Seeing that Alice had gained the advantage, but facing a sword with such momentum, Alfonso showed a meaningful smile. He suddenly opened his back, and hot black flames ignited in his throat. A terrifying wave of heat came!

"Dragon's Breath?!"

Alice's heart took a hit. Although she had expected Alfonso to use dragon language magic, normal dragon's breath requires accumulation and is not suitable for fighting in a narrow space, easily delaying the battle. Like the instant dragon's breath before her eyes, she had never seen or heard of it!

The black dragon Nidhogg is the creator of the dragon race, and simultaneously the creator of dragon race magic and martial arts. As Alfonso's servant, of course he can learn the most orthodox dragon language magic. Instant dragon's breath is just a trivial matter.

Dragon's breath was spat out from Alfonso's mouth. In the blink of an eye, its power expanded a hundred times, with extremely high temperature rapidly melting the surrounding walls. The boundless black flames roared like a demon.

Alice secretly suffered a loss. In her urgency, she had to give up her attack and condense a solid ice wall in front of her, trying to block the powerful black dragon's breath!

However, facing the breath containing black dragon power, the ice wall Alice created was almost useless. Before the black flames even arrived, the wave of heat had already penetrated the thick barrier!

The black dragon's breath hit Alice face-on. In the center of the black flames, the wind howled past her ears. She couldn't help but grit her teeth. Her floating silver hair gradually turned to ash.

Even though Alfonso's body was being constantly eroded by the cold poison, his strength was still frightening—

The boundless black flames rose like a furious demon into the sky, wantonly burning the court!

In a remote cave deep down, the sleeping black dragon slowly opened its eyes.

title: Chapter 26 — Infusion
content:
Chapter 26 — Infusion

Volume 33 · Chapter 26

Scorching black flames burned fiercely, blasting a massive hole in the palace roof's apex, with crimson molten lava slowly cascading across the ground.

Asmodeus floated, slowly descending, believing that Alice had been struck directly by the black dragon's breath and would sustain serious injuries, leaving her with no energy left to spare.

"Hahaha, all this is your own fault, Lady Vanitas. If you had cooperated with me, you wouldn't have suffered such severe injuries. I thought you were somewhat intelligent, but your teacher is just as foolish as you."

No sooner had he finished speaking than the rolling black flames were swept away by gusts of fierce wind, and suddenly a Saint Spirit materialized, bathed in divine light.

It stood towering like a giant, wielding a battle axe and holy shield, its brilliant light and wings forcing the black flames to quickly dissipate.

This mighty Saint Spirit, originating from the Light Hymn artifact, not only can summon the Saint Legion's forces but also can call forth powerful Saint Spirit bodies for battle at any time.

Alice was now inside the Saint Spirit's body, able to freely control this giant spirit-saint under the protection of the solid shield, making it nearly invulnerable to any attack.

In the recent black dragon's breath, Alice felt her body nearly turning to ash, only managing to activate the artifact's power to protect herself, and to her surprise, the effect was quite remarkable.

"Saint..." Asmodeus furrowed his eyes in irritation, unable to quickly defeat Alice, which surprised him greatly, making his mood increasingly agitated.

You really got lucky, didn't you? If Ignis had held the sword you're wielding, I couldn't have defeated her. Too bad this treasure in your hands probably won't unleash much real power."

"Your empty words are so many. If you had that much time, why don't you leave a will?" Alice felt her body merging with the Saint Spirit, filled with power. With the Saint Spirit's body that could withstand the black dragon's breath, Asmodeus might not be able to maintain a firm advantage.

"Thinking of relying on a precious artifact to defeat me? You're too naive!"

Asmodeus spread his hands, his overwhelming black dragon power surged higher, the fiery essence in the air becoming extremely violent!

A large amount of black flames danced in midair, swirling into a center, their concentrated terrifying force detectable even from far away!

Asmodeus roared loudly, suddenly slashing, spewing forth a blazing windstorm from the center of the black flame vortex, thunder booming and warping space itself!

The black flame windstorm swept toward the giant Saint Spirit, bearing the terrifying power that scorches the world, and the giant Saint Spirit emitted a fierce roar.

Alice furrowed her brow, her small sword in hand, the Light Hymn acting like a baton, pointing forward.

The giant Saint Spirit outside immediately sensed it, erected a solid shield, and launched a heroic frontal charge against the black flame windstorm!

The solid luminous shield dragged across the ground, flattening all obstacles outside, the giant Saint Spirit acting like an invincible bulldozer, its momentum unstoppable!

The violent black flame windstorm crashed into the shield, emitting a deafening explosion sound, the rolling black flames seemed ready to devour the giant Saint Spirit, its heroic charge halted, the massive figure stopping in its tracks.

"Clumsy fellow:..."

Asmodeus let out a cold laugh, suddenly his body's internal poison began to act up again, slowly creeping up his neck and face, a purple-blue frostbite spreading!

Due to Asmodeus devoting all his strength to Alice, he couldn't suppress the poison in his body any longer, and since the battle began, the cold poison was destroying his body, clearly he didn't have much time left.

The giant Saint Spirit's body felt the black flame windstorm weaken, immediately grabbing the opportunity, sinking its center of gravity, pressing against the black flames, and launching a more fierce charge toward the tiny Asmodeus!

Boom!

The giant Saint Spirit wielding the luminous shield, moved almost like a moving mountain, its momentum alone could intimidate enemies with unsteady resolve.

Asmodeus showed a painful expression, having finally eased the poison's pain, raising his head again, and suddenly widened his eyes in horror!

The giant Saint Spirit had charged right in front of him, and without hesitation, unleashed an unstoppable shield strike, sending the tiny enemy flying like a mouse with a "POW!"

Asmodeus spat out fresh blood, flew through three thick walls in rapid succession, his expression full of pain, this shield strike had broken countless bones.

Inside the deep Saint Spirit body, Alice stared at the Light Hymn in her hand, thinking—

Can this sword be used like this? Though its power isn't as strong as charging in a legion, it's very flexible and practical. Have I only mastered a tiny bit of the artifact's techniques?

"Vanitas! I originally wanted to let you live a few more days, but now I regret it! You successfully enraged me!"

Asmodeus let out an angry hiss, spreading his dragon's membrane wings and soaring into the sky, his internal poison had completely broken free, half his face already consumed, his body growing increasingly unresponsive, nearly losing all consciousness.

With barely any life left, he could only cling to the will to survive, having lost all rationality, his mind filled solely with the agreement with the black dragon, continuing to live lavishly.

Suddenly, Asmodeus spread his ten fingers in the sky, condensing the scorching black flames into invisible threads, then swung them all at once!

The seemingly unweakened giant Saint Spirit was instantly sliced into several segments, vanishing into points of light in midair, completely unable to defend against Asmodeus's attack.

"Huh!" Alice blinked in surprise, secretly admiring Asmodeus's incredible destructive power, the invisible threads were invisible, only feeling a hot wave rushing toward her, even more troublesome than imagined.

Asmodeus, as if gone mad, shook his dragon wings, dropping down a dense hail of fireballs, launching a devastating barrage toward Alice on the ground!

In crisis, Alice extended a huge ice shield in the sky for defense, but Asmodeus's firepower was extremely fierce, the pale golden melting ice crystals were riddled with holes, completely unable to block it.

Asmodeus took advantage of the opportunity to press the attack, not giving Alice any chance to catch her breath and think, successfully striking her directly, grabbing her delicate throat.

"I won! Haha!"

"No! I won!"

Alice endured the intense pain of being burned by black flames, her hands tightly gripping Asmodeus's hand that was choking her throat, infusing the combined power of the snow mountain's essence, demonic energy, and battle qi through her hands into the enemy's body—

"No! It's me who won!"

title: Chapter 27 — Monthly Ticket Bonus
content:
Chapter 27 — Monthly Ticket Bonus

Volume 33 · Chapter 27

Actually, Alice had already learned some secrets from the personal knight Vival on the day before yesterday—secrets that were not for others to know.

Alfonso had already suffered serious injuries, and his strength was no longer what it was; he was not an invincible existence.

A mage at the pseudo-god realm—was it necessary to use such a despicable method as poison to deal with oneself?

This only showed that this man was afraid of himself; she should be the one taking the initiative!

This gave Alice great confidence. Without any worries at her back, she had dared to engage Alfonso in a head-on slaughter.

When she saw that large areas of frostbite had appeared on Alfonso's body, Alice suddenly understood everything.

Alfonso had actually suffered serious injuries in his fight with his teacher Claudia; the invasion of cold poison was the best proof!

As the inheritor of the Great Snow Mountain Sword Technique, no one knew better than Alice how terrible cold poison was. If not cleared in time, he would eventually be frozen to death alive.

Knowing this, Alice deliberately exposed a flaw, luring Alfonso close to her, creating an opportunity to directly inject the fused power into his body.

At this moment, Alfonso, whose cold poison had penetrated to the marrow, was like a person carrying a mountain; he could be crushed to death at any time. Alice only needed to throw a stone over, and she could break his limit, causing the cold poison to go completely berserk, easily killing him.
